4493190.name: My Name Is
4493190.about_the_game:
My name is...A short, first person, horror experience. Explore the world, and figure out why people are vanishing out here.

When you live out in the middle of nowhere, nothing new ever happens...most of the time. Sometimes people vanish, and you are caught up just trying to figure out what is going on. Did they just find a better place...or did something worse happen?  A short, first person, horror experience.

Explore the locations.

  • Explore in first person - Look around the world. There's not much out here.

  • Walk around - Explore the few places out there. The store and your house.

  • Find the cause of the vanishing people - The locals have to know.

Interact with the world.

  • Talk to the few locals left - Learn their names, discover why people are going missing.

  • Pick up items- Sometimes you need a key or protection.

  • Discover- What is going on with these people?

  • Progress the story over a few in-game days - You can't solve a mystery in one day.

  • Head home and back to the store.

Go home and rest

  • Turn the lights on and off - The dark is scary.

  • Take a rest in your bed - After a long day, sleep until the next day.

  • Pet the cat - he meows.

  • There's really not much going on out here, but home is safe. Home is your safe space...or is it?

You're alone out here. Mostly.
4493190.supported_languages:
English*, French, Filipino
*languages with full audio support

4493200.name: Head Office
4493200.about_the_game:
Thank you for choosing Head Office. Your death is important to us.

You have been appointed Regional Manager of the underworld's fastest-growing termination facility. Clients queue up, take a seat in your state-of-the-art termination booths, and receive our signature service. Business is booming. Literally.

Client Processing

Every booth is a revenue stream. Clients check in, sit down, and are promptly serviced, generating steady cash flow for your department. Outfit your booths with a range of approved termination hardware: Glocks, axes, hammers, saws, and other solutions from our product catalog.

Remains Management

Per company policy, all biological output must be processed. Deploy company drones to transport client remains to your expanding network of disposal divisions:

  • Crematorium Division: Incinerate for Ash
  • Grinder Division: Pulverize into Slush
  • Acid Vat Division: Dissolve for Goo
  • Coffin Division: Package for Ichor
  • Imp Converter Division: Restructure into entry-level demons

Each division generates unique departmental currencies to fund facility upgrades.

VIP Specimen Collection

Occasionally, high-value clients visit your facility with rare accessories. Terminate them, recover their personal effects, and catalog them in your company Bestiary. 100 specimens across four clearance levels, from Common walk-ins to Legendary executives.

Terror Compliance

Excessive throughput triggers regulatory attention. Monitor your Terror index or face an audit. Balance productivity against compliance, or deploy Imp personnel to handle overflow discreetly.

Corporate Contracts

Activate temporary performance contracts that boost payout rates, processing speed, crit bonuses, and more. Allocate departmental budgets wisely to maintain peak efficiency.

Facility Upgrades

Over 30 company-wide upgrades across all divisions. Improve client value, drone logistics, processor throughput, critical multipliers, and unlock full automation. Your quarterly review depends on it.

Desktop Integration

Head Office operates as a transparent, always-on-top desktop widget. Drag remains, collect specimens, and manage your termination empire while you handle other tasks. Multitasking is encouraged by upper management.
4493200.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese

4493220.name: 28 Leicester Square
4493220.about_the_game:
28 Leicester Square is a third-person puzzle horror experience set in the Victorian era. Enter a mysterious manor as a newly hired research assistant and uncover the truth behind the experiments hidden within its halls.

Explore the manor, solve escape-room-like puzzles, and piece together the story while avoiding the its photosensitive threats.

Features

  • Escape-Room Inspired Puzzles – Examine your surroundings, solve locks, and piece together clues to progress through the manor.

  • Mysterious Narrative – Discover notes and letters that reveal the truth behind the monstrous experiments.

  • Photosensitive Threats – Certain creatures are aggravated by the light, be careful where you shine your lantern.
4493220.supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America

4493270.name: Chess Master Quest - Idle
4493270.about_the_game:
Learn Chess. Real Progression. Idle Mode.

Chess Master Quest is an idle progression game built on chess. Every puzzle you solve, every grandmaster game you study, and every opening you learn is drawn from actual chess theory - not random mechanics with a chess skin.

You start at a park bench. Through thousands of tactical puzzles, time-pressure drills, and deep idle systems, you climb to the World Championship stage.

Tons of Chess Content

10,000 tactical puzzles across 5 difficulty tiers, sourced from the Lichess database and matched to your Elo rating.

1,062 Woodpecker drills — timed pattern recognition training inspired by the Woodpecker Method used by titled players.

72 famous games from Morphy to Carlsen, each with strategic context and key takeaways.

399 classic games in 8 curated packs spanning legendary battles, the Romantic Era, the Soviet School, and modern brilliance.

8 openings with named variations, teaching notes, and interactive drills — learn the Ruy Lopez, Sicilian, Queen's Gambit, and more.

16 endgame lessons covering King & Pawn, Rook, Minor Piece, and Queen endgames with interactive drill positions.

Deep Idle Progression

8 upgradeable chess stats — Tactics, Calculation, Strategy, Endgames, Openings, Psychology, Stamina, and Consistency — each leveled through training and gameplay.

10 upgrades across 5 categories — coaching, gear, study tools, tournament prep, and recovery to multiply your growth.

Research Lab — queue long-duration projects across 6 branches (Automation, Analysis, Opening Theory, Endgames, Mental Game, and Tournament Prep) that generate passive bonuses.

Synergy system — combining upgrades across categories unlocks powerful cross-domain bonuses.

Offline progress — your research and training continue while you're away.

Tournaments and Competition

Community Tournaments — enter real chess matches against AI opponents in your bracket, with placement rewards.

Sim-Match events — 20 idle chess events across 3 tiers and 3 time controls. Queue an event and let your stats determine the outcome.

Proving Grounds — an idle auto-battle ladder where your AI avatar fights through 13 opponents from Elo 400 to 2800.

Fatigue and tilt mechanics that reward smart pacing over grinding.

6 competitive league tiers — Pawn, Knight, Bishop, Rook, Queen, and King — with weekly cycles and promotion/relegation.

Play Chess Against the AI

Play against the homegrown engine or against Stockfish (rated 3200!)

Earn mastery XP based on game outcome and opponent difficulty.

Training Modes

Tactics Streak — accuracy-based puzzle runs where one wrong answer ends your streak.

Tactics Quest — level-based tactical puzzle progression with star ratings and multi-move sequences.

Coordinate Training — tap the right square under time pressure to build board fluency.

Board Vision — identify attacked squares, hanging pieces, and control patterns.

Pattern Library — explore 20+ tactical themes including forks, pins, skewers, discovered attacks, and sacrifices.

Daily Engagement

Daily objectives, login streaks, training streaks, and weekly challenges.

Daily puzzle — the same puzzle for every player each day.

Random events — rival challenges, sponsorship offers, training camps, and more.

Early Access

Chess Master Quest is in active development. New content, features, and polish are being added regularly. Your feedback shapes the game.

4494400.name: Monster Tamer
4494400.about_the_game:
Monster Tamer is a 2D turn-based adventure where you capture, train, and battle with unique creatures.

■ Capture & Collect

Explore diverse lands and befriend over 100 unique monsters. Each creature has its own abilities and evolution path.

■ Turn-Based Combat

Master turn-based battles with strategic depth. Build your team, choose your moves, and exploit enemy weaknesses.

■ Train & Evolve

Train your monsters, unlock new skills, and witness their transformations. Every tamer's journey is unique.

■ Vast World

From lush forests to mysterious dungeons, discover a world full of secrets and challenges.

Join the Monster Tamer community and start your adventure today!

4494410.name: Hook Line Ball
4494410.about_the_game:
This is a unique platform action game.

Unique Movement and Attack Mechanics

Unlike conventional platform action games that rely on running and jumping, here you must use the hook line as your sole tool for both movement and attack. Aim at walls or enemies, fire your hook line, and pull yourself toward them. If you recall the hook line mid-swing, you'll continue moving for a distance, carried forward by momentum.

Unique Level Design

To complement this distinctive movement system, the levels are designed differently from those in other platform action games. As a result, you'll experience something truly fresh compared to other games in the genre.

Minimalist Controls

Despite the unique movement and attack mechanics, the controls are surprisingly simple. You only need one hand to control the mouse—one finger for the left mouse button, and another finger for the right mouse button.
4494410.supported_languages: English, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean

4494800.name: Void Rhythm
4494800.about_the_game:
Void Rhythm is a high-octane, top-down shooter set in a dystopian alternate world. As a lone hero prepared for the ultimate sacrifice, you step into a battlefield where danger lurks in every shadow.

Surrounded by relentless foes and a hail of bullets, your only hope is to carve a bloody path through the carnage. In this world, a single mistake will cost you your life.

Master the Flow of Time

Faced with waves of frenzied assaults, you possess the power to trigger Bullet Time, freezing the very fabric of reality. Within this warped space-time, the world stands still—and you are the only Reaper. Unleash your full arsenal in the blink of an eye, turning a lethal ambush into a funeral for your enemies.

  • Kill to Empower: Slay enemies to build your energy reserves.

  • Clear the Field: Activate Bullet Time to shatter the rhythm of combat and wipe the board.

  • The Ultimate Predator: Against an ocean of steel and fire, you are no longer the prey—you are a killing machine transcending the battlefield.

Diverse Enemies & Brutal Bosses

Face off against thugs, elite gunslingers, and bosses with distinct personalities. Every enemy features unique attack patterns and combat rhythms. Outmaneuver them, learn their tactics, and strike when they are most vulnerable.

Evolve and Conquer

Unlock a variety of upgradeable skills to complement your Bullet Time abilities. Experiment with different builds to reach your maximum lethality. As time progresses, even more formidable foes and legendary bosses will emerge. Constantly upgrade your attributes to survive the long, grueling war ahead.

Pure, Unadulterated Combat

Here, there is only primal, direct, and exhilarating combat. Step into the Fury Domain and embrace the breathless thrill of the kill!

Forget the lore. Forget the clutter. Dive into raw, unfiltered, visceral combat. Experience the peak of tension and the pure adrenaline of the kill. The arena is yours.
4494800.supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean

4494830.name: The Vaults Below Durn: A Field Study
4494830.about_the_game:
Far below the town of Durn lies the Vaults, a sprawling dungeon no explorer has ever returned from.

Now it stretches endlessly before you. Can you read the signs to find the safe path through?

An atmospheric dungeon experience designed to be completed in one sitting.

Each room presents a choice between three doors. Subtle signs reveal which door is safe:

  • faint sounds beyond the door

  • moisture clinging to the ancient stone

  • the slightest movement of the air around you

Pay attention. The Vaults rewards the cautious, and punishes the careless. As you descend deeper, the signs will be harder to spot, and you will have to consider the combinations of them to continue on your journey.

As you descend, you’ll find field studies left behind by the last explorer. They will help guide you deeper.

Then there are the journal pages. Why would the explorer leave these behind and what story do they tell? 

  • Deduction based top-down dungeon exploration with environmental clues

  • A short narrative mystery told through notes and the environmental story telling

  • A randomized endless mode for players who master the vaults

  • Extensive accessibility settings:

    • No jumpscares

    • No quicktime events. Play at your own pace

    • Multiple input methods supported, as well as remapping inputs

    • Important audio cues have visual indicators

    • Volume control

    • Stereo/mono toggle

    • Brightness/contrast control

    • Long press duration configuration

    • Multiple display modes, including windowed

    • Option to switch fonts to Atkinson Hyperlegible

    • Color blind friendly

    • Font size customisation
4494830.game_link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4494830/The Vaults Below Durn: A Field Study/

4494970.name: 恐怖夜話
4494970.about_the_game:
*Notice: This game currently supports Japanese only.

Two bizarre ghost stories told in the dead of night.

This is a short horror visual novel where you progress the story with simple clicks.

Embracing the atmospheric, creeping dread of classic ghost stories, the game uses text and sound to slowly build tension, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in the narrative.

Experience a psychological horror where noticing the eerie "inconsistencies" hidden within the tales brings the concealed truth to the surface.

[Story]

It is the night of a soccer club's training camp.
In a quiet room past lights-out, the "Teacher" begins to recount inexplicable events from his past.

One is a bizarre phenomenon on an eerie mountain he visited before becoming a teacher.
The other is a gruesome incident at the sea involving his high school friends.

At first glance, they seem to be nothing more than ordinary, terrifying ghost stories.
Why is the teacher telling these stories now, at this training camp?
What is the true nature of the strange "inconsistencies" lurking within these recounted memories?

When you finish listening to all the stories, you will understand their true meaning.

[Game Features]

  • Two Ghost Stories Told at Camp: Read through two terrifying experiences set in entirely different locations.

  • The "Inconsistencies" Lurking in the Story: The storyteller dispassionately recounts his past memories. However, several inexplicable descriptions are scattered throughout. By reading carefully, you will catch glimpses of "another face" to the narrative—proving it is not just a simple ghost story.

  • The "Choices" to Unravel the Truth: After finishing the two stories, your "deduction" will be put to the test. Uncover the true nature of the inconsistencies within the memories and make the correct choices.

  • Endings: 4 Endings (2 Normal Endings, 1 True Ending, 1 Bad Ending)

  • Playtime: Approx. 1 hour. Experience a rich, intense psychological horror in a single sitting, much like watching a short film.

[Basic Controls]

  • Enter / Left Click: Advance text

  • Esc / Right Click: Open Menu

  • Ctrl: Skip (Stops at unread text by default)

  • Mouse Wheel Up: Open Backlog

  • F: Toggle Windowed / Fullscreen Mode
    *This game is optimized for mouse and keyboard controls.

[Content Warning]

This game contains depictions of blood, mutilated corpses, and psychologically distressing themes (psychological horror elements). Player discretion is strongly advised.

[Streaming & Let's Plays]

Streaming, let's plays, and video uploads of this game are welcome, including monetized content on video sharing platforms.

*When streaming or uploading videos, we would greatly appreciate it if you could include the game title "恐怖夜話 (Kyofu Yawa)" in your video title, and the URL of this Steam store page in your video description!

We would be thrilled if you could help spread the horror of this game to many people.

4495180.name: One Dice Dungeon Delve
4495180.about_the_game:
This game started as a physical prototype on a sticky note and a single d6, One Dice Dungeon Delve (ODDD) captures the raw decision making of tabletop gaming. I wanted to see if I could capture the one more floor/one more run addictiveness of tabletop gaming in a physical format. In the end, an early python terminal project mirroring my game rules was a much better user experience and cut down on all the time that I would be rolling a D6 to generate the dungeon floor with tiles, loot, monsters and stairs. What started at my work has grown into a full-fledged adventure, tested rigorously and improved by an amazing community. No complex math just you, your strategy, and the roll of the die. 

Every interaction, combat resolution, and loot drop is driven by the roll of a single d6.

True visual progression. The Layered sprite system ensures that every helmet, chestplate, sword, and cape you find is instantly reflected on your character sprite. Start your journey as a basic nobody and end it as an armor-clad legend.

ODDD isn't just about stats; it’s about tactical identity and class power fantasy. Choose the hero that fits your playstyle:

  • The Knight: Perfect your Parry. Automatically negate a strike and deliver a soulslike riposte once per floor.

  • The Archer: Piercing Shots and Rapid fire floor clearing. Line up your enemies to deal piercing damage through multiple enemies.

  • The Berserker: Fuel your Bloodlust. Gain temporary HP with every kill and chain-attack through multiple enemies.

  • The Paladin: Divine Aegis. The ultimate heavy-armor tank. Divine Aegis activates on a would-be death then a Shield Throw to crush foes across the room in a line using armor as damage.

  • The Brawler: Throw enemies into each other. Utilize the physics engine to grab, spin, and launch monster corpses as lethal projectiles.

  • The Gambler: The Dice Gambit. Risky gameplay. Activate Dice gambit to force all visible dice to home in and strike your enemies.

     

 

Death is only the beginning. Export your runs and share them with the community. Other players can then import your runs from the leaderboard to see your literal Ghost pathing through their dungeon. Learn from the board leaders or avoid the mistakes of the fallen.

  

This unique boss uses an "Absorption Slide" ability to launch itself down corridors, devouring monsters and loot to gain health and engage the player head on. It also comes in 5 colors!

  

  • One-Die Mechanics: A transparent combat system where every roll is visible and vital.

  • Procedural Mastery: Infinite dungeon generation that uses seeds to return to a specific dungeon layout.

  • Visual Loot: 50+ unique items that visually update on your hero in real-time.

  • Daily Challenges: Compete on global Steam leaderboards with a daily seed run.

Thanks for delving with us!
4495180.supported_languages: English, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America

4495390.name: Nian Monste
4495390.about_the_game:
"Year Beast" is a survival horror game in which players need to evade the patrols of the year beasts, explore mountain villages to find and craft life-saving tools by gaining insight into their respective weaknesses, and finally survive until the end of 6:00.

Note: This game has made a lot of magic changes to the legend of the beast of the year, as well as many original content of the author, so don't take it seriously.

Storyline

You are a left-behind child in a mountain village, young people have long gone to big cities to work hard, only some middle-aged and elderly people, and children left by their parents for their livelihood live here, the Spring Festival is the only opportunity for you to see each other for a long time, but in the past three years, you have never heard from your parents again, you seem to understand something, but you never want to believe that at the funeral of your grandparents, you still don't see them, you live alone in a dilapidated house, and you can only go to the kind neighbor's house for three meals a day on weekdays. On Chinese New Year's Eve this year, some elderly people went to big cities for the New Year, and a few elderly people were forgotten by their children, and the days that should have been lively were particularly dead, you still looked forward to reuniting with your family, until 12:00 midnight, you did not wait for your parents, but bursts of dog barking, whining, and footsteps that shook the earth entered your ears......

Vigil gameplay

Before hunting, "Xi" will unfold an enchantment called "Tree Rings", creating a different space to freeze time within a certain range, and until the "Xi" hunt is over, the outside world cannot see through, and the trapped life cannot escape. There is only one way to hide from a dead end, the only way to take the initiative is to take the initiative, using the explosion and flash of "Xi" that "Xi" is afraid of, and the "red" that it cannot see with its eyes as a cover, to drive it away step by step, weaken the power of the barrier, and gradually advance time, and finally survive until the early morning of 6:00.

The difficulty increases

1. The passage of time will bring about interlocking events, such as "blizzards" or "speeding" negative conditions that last for a long time.

2. The year beast is a general name, which is composed of four types of "evening, ghost, disaster, and leave", and the other three year beasts with different mechanisms will join the hunt in their respective time periods.

Search and production

There are dozens of houses to explore, and players must rummage through boxes to survive, such as finding "firewood" to light the stove pit, or eating food to maintain the body's heat and spirit, reading books to gain knowledge, making various tricky props, and more powerful weapons.
4495390.supported_languages:
English*, Japanese*, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*, Russian*, Korean*
*languages with full audio support

4495530.name: EVEN OR ODD 1
4495530.about_the_game:
Beat a mathematical enigma with pure reflexes.

The Collatz Conjecture—an incredibly simple yet maddeningly complex puzzle that has baffled the world’s greatest minds for decades, derailing the lives of brilliant mathematicians.

While geniuses lose their minds at their desks, “Ichi,” the muscle-brained magical girl, takes on this unsolved mystery in the only way she knows how.

Monsters relentlessly fire “Magic Numbers” at you.

Instantly teleport between lanes—upper for even numbers [↑], lower for odd numbers [↓].

Read the incoming digits in a split second, charge your shot, and smash them back.

One wrong move in this extreme reflex battle can be fatal.

But when massive numbers finally collapse into a single “1,” Ichi’s magic spirals completely out of control.

Geniuses will keep fighting this unsolved mystery with their brains.

As for us? We’re taking it on with gamer reflexes.

◆ Brain-Melting "Even/Odd" Action

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Enemies will unleash a relentless barrage of numbers. Instantly determine if they are even or odd and strike back with the correct magic. Chain correct answers to multiply your power, reduce the enemy's number to "1", and obliterate them with a devastating Finisher!

◆ Perfect Parries & Just Defense

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Don't just take the hits. Read the trajectory of enemy attacks and strike back at the exact right moment to turn the tide of battle. When backed into a corner, unleash the "Auto-Parry" to survive impossible bullet hells.

◆ Death, Rebirth, and Grimoires

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Death is not the end. Return to "Heaven" and use your collected currency to permanently upgrade your stats. Discover and equip over 10 different Grimoires (magic books) with unique effects to continuously push your abilities to the limit.

◆ The Mystery of the Endless Calculation

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

You play as "Ichi", an amnesiac protagonist. Why must she fight? And what truly awaits her at the end of this endless calculation...?

◆ 90 Achievements

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Track your mastery across 9 categories, including Max Combos, Highest Floor Reached, and Max Damage. Can you unlock all 90 achievements and leave your mark on the trajectory of this endless calculation?

4495870.name: Guild Manager 26
4495870.about_the_game:
Build Your Guild. Command the Battle.

Guild Manager 26 is a dark fantasy hero collector and auto-battler. Recruit fighters, forge formations, and command fully simulated 20v20 battles where every stat, ability, and position matters.

Discover 1,300+ unique fighters across 10 races and 5 rarities. Open packs, trade on the Auction House, complete missions, and sacrifice the weak in the Sacrificial Pit. Every card has a race, archetype, unique abilities, and 22 stats — no two play the same.

Place 20 fighters across front, mid, and back lines. Stack races and archetypes to unlock 92 Unity Buffs that transform your entire guild. Every position, every pairing, every stat matters.

Every battle simulates fighter-by-fighter — damage, healing, crits, abilities, and positioning all play out in full. Review detailed scoreboards to see who carried and who fell.

Enter 32-team Tournaments, draft fighters in Gauntlet runs, grind through Melee League seasons, and climb the Ranked Divisions. Buy and sell fighters on the player-driven Auction House. Take on 50-floor Daily Dungeons with Hard Mode, or fight through three full Campaigns with boss fights, rest stops, and charm selection along the way.

4495990.name: 아무 일도 없었다.
4495990.about_the_game:
[Overview]

Experience the crushing psychological pressure and awkward eye contact of a confined lift in this first-person psychological interaction game.

As a player, you must navigate various floors inside a cramped elevator alongside a cast of unpredictable NPCs. These passengers might behave erratically, stare fixatedly at you, or simply maintain a heavy, suffocating silence.

The question is: Can you pretend not to notice? As the NPCs’ unsettling gaze and odd behaviors persist, your "Awkwardness Gauge" will steadily rise. If the pressure exceeds your limit, you will lose your composure and fail the social challenge. Your goal is to endure the tension and reach the 10th floor as if nothing is wrong.

4496220.name: Zero Point
4496220.about_the_game:
A story-driven TPS transcending the boundaries of time and space, 'Zero Point' follows warriors from the past stranded in a future universe due to a space-time rift. Operating as mercenaries from a spaceship hub, you'll experience much more than simple combat. Immerse yourself in the drama and clashing values of companions from completely different eras.

A Multi-Dimensional Narrative Forged by Clashing Values

  • Clashing Values: Join the protagonist 'Mila' and characters from various historical backgrounds as they investigate the cause of the dimensional rift. Experience realistic events where individual goals and beliefs collide.

  • Advanced Dialogue System: Through a sleek UI, the narrative and conflicts between characters are naturally conveyed even in the heat of battle.

The Romance of 'Spaceship' Life and Dynamically Varied Missions

  • A Living Hub, The Spaceship: The spaceship is not just a waiting room; it's a base where you live and interact with your crew. Here, you can upgrade equipment and prepare for your next interstellar warp.

  • Non-Repetitive Mission Experience: Adapt to new battlefield environments every time, with diverse mission structures where terrain, objectives, and enemy mechanics constantly change.



Evolving Hybrid Action and Tactical Co-op

  • Heavy-Hitting Hybrid Combat: We've combined shooting with assault rifles and shotguns with the heavy, impactful melee action of greatswords to deliver a powerful combat experience.

  • Polished Combat Presentation: Enjoy the core thrill of shooting with detailed effects like hit stops, camera shakes, and tactical explosions.

  • Tactical Partner 'Loca': The baby dragon 'Loca', who flies low and shoots fireballs, acts not just as a pet, but as a crucial tactical partner on the battlefield.
4496220.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, French, German

4496240.name: Suicide Mr. Fury
4496240.about_the_game:
This is a female-oriented narrative adventure game with strong meta elements, humorously exploring the romantic relationship between us and virtual characters.

On a stormy night, the ultimate alpha male—Mr. Fury, the king of Beijing's elite circle, ruler of a vast business empire, your hopelessly devoted pursuer and ex-boyfriend—is about to leap off the balcony!

And you, the wielder of the Wheel of Fate, a traveler born on a stormy night, the one even the system cannot control, make a dramatic entrance...

Game Features

🔹Multiple branching storylines

Every choice can rewrite the ending. Will you save the male lead’s life, or uncover the truth behind the system?

🔹A Meta Narrative Maze

Behind the chaotic and hilarious “quick-transmigration” daily life lies a chilling truth about the world. Foreshadowing that breaks the fourth wall awaits your discovery.

🔹Multiverse of Mr. Fury

From a modern-day CEO to an ancient mystical master, from post-apocalyptic wastelands to fantasy realms... new worlds and settings unfold one after another for you to explore.

Step into this twist-filled meta visual novel, and join Mr. Fury as you walk the fine line between absurdity and truth.

Come and play!

4496250.name: CropChampion
4496250.about_the_game:
Welcome to CropChampion, the idle RPG where "just five more minutes" turns into "wait, is it morning already?"

Start by recruiting heroes — some legendary, some still figuring out which end of the sword to hold. Train them, gear them up, and arrange them into formations that look cool and occasionally even work. Then send them into 100 campaign stages, a tower that keeps getting taller no matter how high you climb, arenas full of opponents who really need to calm down, and dungeons that definitely aren't up to safety code.

But fighting is only half the fun. Hatch pets from mysterious eggs and watch them evolve from "aww, it's tiny" to "oh no, it has teeth." Build an airship room by room — because every hero squad deserves a flying house with a garden on it. Tend your farm, steal crops from your neighbors (they started it), raise chickens and cows, and pretend you're playing a peaceful farming sim for a while.

Feeling hungry? Head to the kitchen and cook meals that grant battle buffs so powerful they probably count as cheating. Gather ores, herbs, and fish to craft potions and gear. Visit the tavern to befriend quirky NPCs who have opinions about everything. Play mini-games when you need a break from all the other breaks you're already taking.

And when you've finally conquered it all? Hit prestige, earn permanent upgrades, and start fresh with the warm satisfaction of knowing you'll be even more overpowered this time around.

This is your cozy, chaotic, ever-growing adventure. Take it at your own pace — the airship isn't going anywhere. Well, actually it is. It flies.

--------------------------------------------------------

Dev Note:

4498150.name: The Unnatural Leap
4498150.about_the_game:
A glitch in time, a squad in chaos, and the fine line between a teammate and a traitor.

A Leap into the Unknown

In The Unnatural Leap, a massive system error hasn't just broken the code—it’s shattered time itself. You play as a group of robots flung into a primitive world they were never programmed to survive. To find a way back to the future, you’ll need to master your surroundings, solve intricate puzzles, and most importantly, decide who you can actually trust.

Master Your Special Skills

Every robot in your squad is unique. You don’t just have tools; you have Special Skills that are essential for survival. Whether it's manipulating gravity, hacking ancient structures, or boosting teammates to unreachable heights, your specific talents are the only thing keeping the team from becoming scrap metal.

Your Way, Your Rules

There is no "right" way to fix the timeline. Each trial is designed with multiple solutions in mind.

  • Creative Freedom: Every platforming challenge can be conquered in several different ways.

  • Infinite Combinations: Mix and match your Special Skills with your teammates to find unique paths. Whether you use brute force, clever physics, or a risky "glitch" maneuver, the choice is yours. Your path is limited only by your creativity.

Trust is the Ultimate Glitch

In this timeline, the line between "teammate" and "traitor" is dangerously thin.

  • The Pure Sabotage: Not every betrayal is strategic. Sometimes, it’s just about the chaos. A "friend" might nudge you into a pit just to watch you restart the entire parkour section from the last checkpoint. It doesn't help the team progress—it just proves that in The Unnatural Leap, you’re never truly safe.

  • The Heroic Sacrifice: Contrastly, a teammate can choose to self-destruct, turning their mechanical remains into a one-time tactical checkpoint. It’s the ultimate act of teamwork—offering a shortcut for the squad at the cost of their own current life-cycle.

An Eroding Reality

She only wanted to wash away the deeply unsettling feeling. However, that single, desperate act became the catalyst for a curse that bleeds into her everyday life. Bizarre hallucinations, and nightmares that gradually take physical form. The places once so familiar have now transformed into the most terrifying stages of horror.

4498480.name: Hold My Thing

Hold My Thing is a cooperative game for 2–4 players where you take on construction contracts and build structures together. All objects have weight and obey physics. There are no auto-snapping systems or building assists - your main tool is teamwork.

Physics-Based Construction

Every part of a structure has weight and follows the rules of physics.
Boards can bend, beams can lose balance, and poorly secured parts can bring the entire structure down.

One mistake can collapse everything you’ve been building for the last few minutes.

Work Together

Most tasks are impossible to complete alone.

While one player holds the structure in place, another secures the parts, and a third tries to keep the whole construction balanced.

Teamwork is the only way to finish the job.

Upgrade & Unlock

By completing contracts, you’ll gain access to new possibilities.

Upgrade your tools, unlock construction vehicles, and explore new locations with larger and more complex building challenges.

People eat, rest, grow greedy, seek safety — or power. Injured bandits don’t magically recover without supplies. Ghoul scouts roam endlessly to build new nests. The world moves forward with or without you.

You are not the center of this world.

You must earn your place in it.

Play as one of 6 distinct races, each with two ethnicities, from ruthless Orcs to cunning Goblins and resilient Humans.

Your race influences your gameplay, culture, and the way the world reacts to you.

Forge your identity and decide what kind of legend you will become.

Kopno is built on two interconnected layers:

  • The Surface

  • The Underground

Each layer contains 4 unique biomes, demanding different gear, preparation, and strategies to survive. Exploration is not optional — it’s essential.

Adapt, or perish.

  • Assign jobs: gathering, crafting, military, logistics, and more.

  • Automate production chains.

  • Appoint leadership roles to shape your society’s future.

Your settlement is more than a base — it is a living community shaped by your decisions.

  • Distinct personalities

  • Specialized combat mechanics

Their loyalty is not guaranteed.

Your moral choices and leadership will determine who stands beside you — and who walks away.

Choose from 40 different classes and combine skills to create your own combat style.

Command your companions using customizable behavior systems:

  • Target weak or elite enemies

  • Auto-heal and react to your abilities

  • Execute defined tactical roles

Combat is not mindless hacking and slashing — it is preparation, positioning, and adaptation.

Study your opponents.

Destroying specific body parts can disable abilities, trigger new behaviors, or shift the flow of battle.

But be warned — your own injuries affect gameplay as well.

Every fight has consequences.

Be lawful. Be chaotic. Be merciful. Be ruthless.

Your choices influence:

  • Settlement stability

Will you lead your people to prosperity — or sacrifice everything for power?

Survival in Kopno is not just about gathering resources and building walls.

Explore ancient dungeons.

Uncover the secrets of a lost civilization.

Shape the final fate of every race on the cursed continent.

Your world. Your rules.

Your Own Journey

  • Your character starts their journey as a young adult. You will be by their side for many in-game years.

  • The game ends when you complete the major goal of the different paths that can be taken (e.g. become a millionaire, get enough expertise as developer to be considered an industry leader, survive until retirement)

  • You will decide the direction of their career: go to college or not, learn new skills with online content or rely on your initial knowledge, work overtime or try to have more free time...

  • You can lose if your character reaches critical levels in certain aspects of their life (e.g. burnout, buried in debt, unhealthy habits)

Money

  • At the beginning, your character will be still living with their parents, so rent will be free. But expect to pay rent for your own apartment sooner or later, depending of your actions.

  • You can purchase better furniture for your room (e.g. PCs, consoles...), but be careful with your expenses to avoid getting in debt.

  • When you find a job, your employer will pay you every two in-game weeks. Manage your paychecks carefully.

Grow as a Software Developer

  • You can start your journey by getting into college, or jump straight to work after completing a bootcamp.

  • After that, you will be able to level-up your skills with online courses.

  • Leveling-up your character involves answering real-world software engineering questions. Try to answer them correctly and your character will grow quicker!

4498690.name: Three Axes Bar: Paid or Pain
4498690.about_the_game:
Three Axes Bar: Paid or Pain is the spiritual successor to Clover Pit and Buckshot Roulette. A rogue-lite in which you find yourself locked in an infernal bar in the company of a slot machine and a strange barman. At the end of each round you must close part of the tab if you don’t want to face the consequences!

Cheat the slot machine and the barman to earn more coins. Modify your body with implants that will make you stronger, and their combinations can bring you victory. Explore the bar, break the rules, and run as soon as the opportunity appears!

Features:

  • A fast-paced rogue-lite where your life is at stake, and every spin may be the last!

  • A puzzle bar and multiple endings!

  • More than 100 items for combinations that bring you closer to victory!

  • Meta-progression and bonuses in every run!

  • A grim story about human vices!
4498690.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Japanese

4498730.name: Lisa: The Lost Memories
4498730.about_the_game:
Lisa wakes up in a dark dungeon with no memory of who she is or how she got there.

Strange monsters roam the halls, forgotten ruins hide dangerous secrets, and the only way forward is to fight, survive, and recover the memories she has lost.

In this story-driven adventure, every decision you make shapes Lisa’s journey. The choices you take during conversations, battles, and critical moments will determine how her story unfolds.

Will you uncover the truth behind Lisa’s past, or will the dungeon consume her before she remembers who she really is?

Gameplay

Lisa: The Lost Memories is a story-driven adventure game with visual novel elements, dungeon exploration, and action-based encounters.

  • Explore mysterious dungeon environments filled with monsters, hidden paths, and fragments of Lisa’s memories.

  • Fight enemies through interactive encounters and quick-time combat moments.

  • Make dialogue choices that influence relationships, events, and the direction of the story.

  • Unlock pieces of Lisa’s past as you progress deeper into the dungeon.

  • Discover multiple story outcomes depending on the decisions you make.

The game blends narrative storytelling with interactive gameplay, combining dialogue choices, cinematic sequences, and intense encounters as Lisa searches for the truth about her lost memories.

Features

  • Multiple Endings

    Your choices matter. Every decision you make will shape Lisa’s journey and determine how her story unfolds. Discover different endings depending on the paths you take and the secrets you uncover.

  • Quick-time Events

    Stay alert during intense moments. React quickly during combat and critical scenes. Your timing and reflexes can determine whether Lisa survives dangerous encounters in the dungeon.

  • Cinematic Cutscenes

    Experience key story moments through cinematic cutscenes that reveal Lisa’s memories, emotions, and the mysteries hidden inside the dungeon.

Each playthrough can reveal new choices, new events, and different pieces of the mystery waiting to be uncovered.

4498750.name: ROSA's Quest
4498750.about_the_game:
The world is flooded. Mutant sea creatures are the rulers now. No humans remain... or do they?

You are ROSA, a Rescue Operation Safety Android, in a world flooded with your one weakness: water. With only your trusty laser and the abilities you find across the world will you be able to find any humans that might remain.

Brace yourself for “terrifying” mutant sea creatures that show no mercy as you travel through the world, using what little structure is left to escape. Save little creatures trapped in the struggle to escape as they support you on your journey.

Game Features

  • Discover the secrets behind humanity's fall!

  • Comb through the remains of cities, suburbs, and more as you combat strange aquatic creatures and terrifying monsters!

  • Encounter 8 unique enemies and 4 powerful boss fights!

  • Enjoy a game with 100% handcrafted gameplay and visuals!

  • Experience a soundtrack of beautiful, haunting, and retro music!

  • Unlock a fully customizable laser with 16 different combinations fit for any playstyle!

  • Explore new areas with 2 unlockable mobility upgrades!

  • Make new friends as you save those imprisoned by the enemy and rekindle the hope in others like you!

  • Overcome intense platforming across 9 unique levels!

4498810.name: Jingle Blocks
4498810.about_the_game:
Description

Jingle blocks is a Christmas themed incemental in which you much make enough toys for the whole world !

Break blocks to get material for you toys, collect and unlock new ones, and get more toys each year yo make everyone in the world happy on Christmas

Features

  • 30 toys to unlock

  • 8 World levels

  • A (Christmas !) Skill tree with 40 upgrades

  • A village to upgrade and decorate

4498840.name: Symetria
4498840.about_the_game:
In a dark digital world, geometric signals have lost their balance. Your mission: restore symmetry.

SYMETRIA is a puzzle game where you draw lines on a grid to reproduce geometric transformations. Start simple, then face increasingly complex patterns as you progress through five distinct modes:

Five Transformation Modes

  • Axial Symmetry — Mirror shapes across a vertical axis
  • Central Symmetry — Rotate patterns 180° around a center point
  • Translation — Shift shapes along a vector
  • Rotation — Rotate patterns by precise angles (90°, 60°, 45°...)
  • Homothety — Scale shapes from a center point

150 Levels

30 levels per mode, across three difficulty tiers:
  • Basic — Simple shapes to learn the rules
  • Intermediate — Multi-segment figures that test your precision
  • Advanced — Complex patterns that challenge your spatial reasoning

Features

  • Clean, minimalist cyberpunk aesthetic
  • Ambient electronic soundtrack
  • Star rating based on accuracy — aim for a perfect run with zero mistakes
  • No time pressure — think, draw, solve at your own pace
  • Accessible yet deep — easy to pick up, satisfying to master

4498850.name: RIPCORE
4498850.about_the_game:
9 CIRCLES. INFINITE HORDES. ONE SURVIVOR.

RIPCORE is an adrenaline-fueled roguelike FPS where the relentless action of 90s shooters meets the addictive chaos of modern survivor-likes. You are the last spark of life in the depths of the Abyss. Your goal is simple: descend through all 9 circles of Hell and tear its Lord to pieces.

CORE GAMEPLAY:

  • KILL. COLLECT. EVOLVE. — Annihilate thousands of demons, gather experience, and choose from dozens of game-changing upgrades. With every level, you don’t just get stronger—you become a god of chaos.

  • SYNERGY IS KING — Stack sigils, artifacts, and weapon modifiers. Create a build that turns your rifle into a homing laser machine or a screen-clearing explosive nightmare.

  • FROM CALM TO INFERNAL — Adapt to the rising madness. The deeper you go, the higher the enemy density and the lower the margin for error.

FEATURES:

  • 9 Circles of Destruction: Unique biomes with distinct bosses and survival rules.

  • Deep Build System: Crits, explosions, ricochets, and elemental auras—millions of combinations for every run.

  • The Rage Factor: Unleash your inner fury to literally tear through reality and your enemies.

  • Global Competition: Prove you are Hell's most efficient cleaner on the global leaderboards.
4498850.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish
*languages with full audio support

4498860.name: The Last Survivor
4498860.about_the_game:
2039.
Twenty years after the pandemic that changed the world.
A new deadly virus sweeps across the globe, and society collapses overnight.

As one of the earliest witnesses, you are thrown into the chaos.

With resources running out and information breaking down, you must make choices:

  • Stay at home, or flee with your family?

  • Risk your life to help others, or protect yourself?

  • Trust people, or survive alone?

Every decision shapes your fate.
Every choice comes with irreversible consequences.

When everything falls apart, will you survive?

Inspired by real-world pandemic experiences.
4498860.supported_languages: English, French, German, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean

4498870.name: DON'T OPEN
4498870.about_the_game:
Heavy iron doors separate my little world from the cold hallway. It's always so unsettling there.

DONT OPEN is a PSX-style horror game about routine that falls apart before your eyes. A normal shift at a taco bar, an empty stairwell, and a persistent knock on the door that's impossible to ignore. Based on real events.

HOME IS YOUR FORTRESS. UNTIL YOU LOOK THROUGH THE PEEPHOLE. Your life is a cycle. The day begins in a noisy cafe where you prepare tacos and pour Coke for an endless stream of customers. You spend your evenings in an old apartment, surrounded by dusty belongings and “dead trees on canvas.” But today, your usual routine will be disrupted. DON'T OPEN is a brief immersion into a state of paranoia. There are no monsters or weapons here. There is only you, your neighbors, and a growing sense of fear behind the front door.

FEATURES: Life as it is: from work shifts to mundane household chores — feel the weight of everyday routine. Disturbing neighbors: chance encounters in the hallway. A strange old man or a neighbor suddenly running out of their apartment — who poses a real threat? Hypnotist: a surreal, hypnotic event that will make you question reality right in your living room. 90s aesthetics: low-poly environments and shaky textures recreate the authentic spirit of classic horror. Sound as the enemy: knocks on the door, footsteps in the hallway, and TV interference replace the traditional soundtrack.

4498880.name: Overcommit: Class Inheritance
4498880.about_the_game:
About This Game

Overcommit is a satirical card-based strategy game about surviving the absurd realities of software development.

Build your daily deck of actions, manage your mental state, and try to deliver projects in a workplace full of meetings, chaos, and questionable management decisions. Combine cards, generate code, complete tasks, and navigate the strange ecosystem of modern tech companies.

Your career will take you through different roles and situations in the industry — from junior developer struggles to the politics of larger organizations.

A Corporate Zoo

The tech industry in Overcommit is populated by anthropomorphic animals representing different roles within the corporate ecosystem.

You may encounter:

  • Lions as CEOs

  • Sloths as testers

  • Wild boars as programmers

  • Other unusual creatures trying to survive corporate life

Core Gameplay

Every in-game day is played through a series of card draws representing your workday.

Cards represent:

  • Work actions – productive work, deep focus, debugging, writing code

  • Mental states – stress, creativity, concentration, burnout

  • Workplace events – meetings, interruptions, office politics

  • Personal actions – rest, coffee breaks, or questionable coping strategies

Combining cards can create new states such as Flow, Panic, or Brilliant Ideas, changing how effectively you can work.

When productivity aligns, you generate Code, which can be used to complete tasks and push projects forward.

A Corporate Ecosystem

Overcommit explores different perspectives within the tech industry.

During the game you may encounter or play through roles such as:

  • Developers

  • Testers

  • DevOps engineers

  • Product Owners

  • HR specialists

  • Executives and management

Each role introduces new mechanics, challenges, and absurd situations inspired by real experiences from the software industry.

Features

  • A system-driven card game with emergent gameplay

  • Unique mental state mechanics affecting productivity and decision making

  • Multiple roles and scenarios within the tech industry

  • Narrative events and workplace situations inspired by real developer stories

  • A stylized retro-corporate pixel art aesthetic

4498890.name: Those Who Stayed
4498890.about_the_game:
Those Who Stayed is a first-person psychological horror game set across three nights in a suburban neighborhood that something decided to keep. Read what residents left behind. Piece together why they ran. Understand why some of them couldn’t.

There’s no combat. There’s nowhere to fight back.

There’s only the street, the dark between the lamps, and the growing certainty that you already know how this ends.

60 minutes. One neighborhood. No one stays.

The Gameplay

This game is primarily a first-person narrative walking simulator with exploration, discovery, and environmental storytelling mechanics.

Key Features

  • 60-minute focused horror experience

  • Atmospheric environment and photorealistic graphics

  • Three nights of escalating psychological terror

  • Environmental storytelling through documents and objects

  • No combat

  • Tension through atmosphere

  • Full controller support

  • Play soccer

4498960.name: Watsonville
4498960.about_the_game:
Watsonville is a first-person psychological horror VR game.

It places players in the role of a child navigating the traumatic aftermath of a violent argument between their parents inside a cramped 1990s family trailer. After hiding under the bed during the conflict, you must discover what happened and find a way to escape the house and its past.

Players explore a mobile home and its surrounding spaces, interacting with objects and solving environmental puzzles that reveal pieces of a family's story. As you move through the house, everyday rooms begin to shift and distort through the lens of childhood fear, turning familiar spaces increasingly surreal as reality blends with nightmare.

Can you escape your family's dark past before it consumes you?

Environment

The game takes place in a multigenerational family mobile home. Your grandparents once lived here, and now you have inherited it along with its lingering secrets. From a child’s perspective everything feels larger, more confusing, and more intense.

The walls and rooms are filled with decorations and belongings from the 1970s through the 1990s, reflecting the life of a working-class family across generations. Players must crawl, climb, and duck through these spaces to uncover the memories, ghosts, and secrets hidden within the rooms and something else that lingers in the shadows.

Story

Not only have your parents left you alone in your grandparents’ trailer, they have left you with the weight of generations of unresolved trauma. Each room reveals another piece of the story, fragments of neglect, fear, and memory that continue to echo through the house.

Over time these memories begin to manifest into something more than the house itself. The pain and suffering carried across generations has taken shape as an entity that now inhabits the home, becoming another obstacle you must escape.

Gameplay

Watsonville is a single-player narrative horror experience designed specifically for virtual reality.

Players must piece together clues hidden throughout the home while navigating a frightening environment in order to escape both the house itself and the past that created it. Cassette tapes, photographs, and nostalgic household objects reveal fragments of the story as players search rooms and uncover hidden spaces.

Physical VR interaction allows players to crouch, crawl, climb, and manipulate objects while navigating tight areas throughout the house. Players use their microphone to trigger events and interact with the world. 

Features

• Environmental puzzles hidden within rooms and objects

• Narrative discovery through environmental storytelling, audio fragments, and family artifacts

• Atmospheric psychological horror rooted in memory, surreal imagination, nightmares, and generational trauma

• Full-body VR interaction and Voice Input allowing players to crouch, climb, hide, and use their voice to interact with the environment

• First-person VR through the eyes of a child creating vulnerability, an immersive experience of feeling small and a gateway to childhood nightmares

4498980.name: PIGSKIN
4498980.about_the_game:
ABOUT

PIGSKIN is a first-person cult horror experience set in the late 1980s. Players step into the shoes of Jake, a young adult who has recently purchased a home in the rural mining town of Greenwood, Georgia.

At first, everything seems ordinary—peaceful streets, friendly faces, and a fresh start. But as Jake begins to settle in, subtle inconsistencies start to emerge. Strange occurrences, unsettling encounters, and an unshakable feeling of being watched begin to erode any sense of comfort.

As the line between reality and paranoia begins to blur, Jake uncovers fragments of a disturbing truth: Greenwood is not what it seems. Beneath its calm exterior lies a tightly woven community bound by something far more sinister.

In PIGSKIN, players will explore a grounded, atmospheric world drenched in the 80s-era aesthetic, combined with an intense, unpredictable story. 

GAMEPLAY

PIGSKIN places players in deeply vulnerable, unpredictable situations where every decision carries weight. Built around tense, stealth-driven horror, players must adapt in real time—whether that means slipping through the shadows, making a desperate escape, or holding their breath in silence as danger passes inches away.

Survival isn’t just about avoiding threats—it’s about managing them. Limited resources, environmental awareness, and player choices all intertwine, forcing you to think carefully before every move. Noise, visibility, and timing become your greatest enemies as much as the horrors that stalk you.

Encounters are designed to keep players on edge, with shifting tension and moments of uncertainty that make every situation feel dangerous.

In PIGSKIN, safety is never guaranteed—only borrowed.

4499010.name: The Restricted Index
4499010.about_the_game:
Read between the lies in this first-person mystery puzzle game.

After every other library has been shut down, only one remains. You are assigned the role of its custodian, the last librarian.

Listen closely to patron's requests.

Use incomplete or sometimes ambiguous information to search the card catalogues and locate the correct book.

Identify. Recommend. Ban. Burn.

Your predecessor has vanished.

Hidden messages, forbidden books and whispers of a rebellion hint the library holds the key to a dangerous truth.

Can you solve the web of secrets within the puzzle box of the last library?

The resistance needs your help if they are to gather the evidence needed to topple the regime.

When do the ends justify the means?

This is a timely narrative puzzle game about censorship, power, and the manipulation of truth.

4499030.name: Your Lil' Cow
4499030.about_the_game:
He’s Just a Cow, We Promise.

Bring your cow—a pure, hardworking milk producer—onto your desktop and turn intimate interaction into progression. In this stylized desktop idle game, your goal is to build the touch gauge through dragging up and down (he absolutely loves being caressed like this).

Once your cow reaches his limit, he enters a high-yield Milking Frenzy, showering your desktop with valuable milk currency. Spend your hard-earned milk on the Gacha system to customize your cow with 50+ accessories and chase better efficiency through stat-altering collection bonuses.

Productivity Meets... This Cute Being

Designed for quick breaks or long background sessions, Your Lil' Cow stays with you while you work. After a Milking Frenzy, your cow enters Sage Moo-de; he will sleep quitely on your taskbar.

Your cow loves it when you're busy—each type or click you make helps him recover from his Sage Moo-de faster. Keep your cow standing tall—the harder you work, the faster he rises back to the occasion.
4499030.supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Traditional Chinese, Turkish

4499040.name: Tiny Slime Farm
4499040.about_the_game:
Turn your desktop into a tiny slime farm.

A cozy idle companion that stays on your screen while you work, study, or relax.

Grow crops, cook meals, and collect adorable slimes as your little farm quietly grows beside you.

Plant crops, cook tasty meals, and attract cute squishy slimes to your farm.

Meet new slimes, evolve them into unique forms, build new structures, and slowly expand your tiny world.

Use the crops you grow to cook a variety of meals.

Each slime has its own favorite food.

Feed them what they love and watch them evolve into new forms.

Merge evolved slimes to create brand-new ones.

Discover a growing collection of slimes with different looks, moods, and personalities.

Customize your tiny farm with decorations and backgrounds.

Mix and match frames, floors, and decorations to create the atmosphere you want.

Choose your favorite style and display your farm on your desktop like a living picture.

Your farm keeps running even when the game is minimized.

While you work or study, your slimes continue to move, eat, and grow beside you.
4499040.supported_languages: English, Korean, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Vietnamese, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Portuguese - Brazil, Polish, Thai

4499090.name: Mother Of All Battles
4499090.about_the_game:
Mother Of All Battles is a turned based wargame, with simple 2D graphics, but pure strategy. Conquer the world starting from your single home city. Each city can build units (either tanks, planes, paratroopers, bombers, transports, destroyers, battleships, submarines or aircraft carriers) in order to explore the world and defeat the other five AI controlled enemy players. Each unit has its own strengths and weaknesses: submarines will easily sink battleships, battleships will easily sink destroyers, and destroyers will easily sink submarines.

There are 390 pre-set maps, the ability to create maps with your own custom settings, and a 'Game Of The Day' map so you can compare your abilities with other players.

4499100.name: Shadown
4499100.about_the_game:
In a world of complex geometry, walls are no longer obstacles. Master your only gate—Shadows—and rewrite the logic of space.

About This Game

Shadown is a minimalist third-person environmental puzzle game. Set in a dreamlike world inspired by Liminal Spaces and Core-style aesthetics, you play as an explorer gifted with the unique ability to "pass through shadows."

Conventional physics do not apply here. You must not only find the path but create it. By manipulating objects to cast specific shadows, you will turn solid walls into gateways, flat ground into abysses, and silhouettes into corridors to reach your destination.

Core Mechanics

  • Dimensional Penetration: Shadows on walls act as one-way doors; shadows on the floor become "skylights" you can drop through.

  • Shadow Transition: Step into paired orange and blue projections to instantly teleport across the map.

  • Optical Reconstruction: Slide geometric blocks along tracks to realign light and shadow, solving intricate logical puzzles in real-time.

Key Features

  • Immerse yourself in a serene, profound, and dream-like visual experience built with pure geometric forms.

  • Break free from traditional maze-solving. Learn to perceive and manipulate space through the lens of light and shadow.

  • Deeply customize your character’s appearance to make your journey through the void unique.

  • Use the powerful Built-in Level Editor to challenge the community’s creativity or share your own ultimate architectural puzzles.
4499100.supported_languages: English, French, German, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese

4499130.name: Totem TD
4499130.about_the_game:
Totem Tower Defense combines deckbuilding and tower defense in a unique roguelite experience. Construct your totem from cards, merge its blocks for more powerful effects, and defend it from relentless waves of enemies.

  • Deck-Based Tower Building: Place and merge totem blocks using cards drawn between waves. Each run gives you new cards to expand and adapt your strategy.

  • Wave-Based Real-Time Combat: Position and rotate your totem’s shooting parts during waves to maximize your defense.

  • Roguelite Progression: Choose reward cards after completing each area. If you lose, rebuild your deck from your unlocked cards and try again.

  • Strategic Depth: Decide which cards to play, which blocks to merge, and where to place them — every choice can make the difference between victory and defeat.

Challenge yourself in multiple areas, merge your totem to its full potential, defeat waves of fantasy creatures, and craft the ultimate deck!
4499130.supported_languages: English, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil

4499210.name: Cat Cook: Defense
4499210.about_the_game:
The soup is simmering, but the horde is hungry! Step into a frantic, vertical-scrolling Tower Defense experience where strategy meets action. Defend the ultimate prize—your soup pot—from relentless waves of enemies dropping from the top of the screen.

Control your Chef, build intricate mazes, merge towers on the fly, and survive the onslaught. Can you take the heat?

Dynamic Tower Defense Meets Chef Action

You aren't just an idle commander—you are on the battlefield! Take direct control of your Chef to auto-attack enemies, unleash devastating spells, and even use your own body to block the horde.

  • Build & Maze: Place a variety of defensive towers to deal damage and alter enemy pathing.

  • Merge to Upgrade: Drop identical towers on top of each other to instantly evolve them.

  • Survive the Waves: Battle through intense 16-wave stages, featuring deadly mini-bosses and epic final encounters.

Endless Customization & Deep RPG Loot

Between battles, dive into a massive progression system to prepare for harder challenges:

  • The Kitchen Tech Tree: Spend your hard-earned Fish Cans and Gold to permanently upgrade Chef stats, enhance Tower effectiveness, or cripple enemy health and speed.

  • Loot & Equipment: Equip your Chef with Weapons, Hats, Aprons, and Backpacks. Hunt for high-rarity gear with game-changing passive skills (like flaming arrows or barrages) and merge duplicates all the way up to 5-Star Mythic rarity.

  • Recruit & Evolve: Unlock a diverse roster of Chefs (like the Butcher Cat) and Towers (Ballistas, Rocketeers, Mortars, and more). Gather duplicates to evolve them, unlocking massive stat caps and game-altering passive skills.

Multiple Ways to Play

  • Campaign Mode: Push through increasingly difficult Chapters and Stages to earn Gold, Diamonds, and Fish Cans.

  • Endless Mode: No limits, no mercy. Survive as long as you can on a single map and compete on the leaderboards for the highest wave cleared.

  • Boss Raid: Face off against an "Unkillable" boss in a 50-wave gauntlet. Deal as much damage as possible to climb the ranks and prove your culinary combat supremacy!
4499210.supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Spanish - Latin America, Vietnamese, Malay
*languages with full audio support

4499300.name: The Sievert Scale
4499300.about_the_game:
The Sievert Scale is a surveillance horror game where you work as a newly appointed safety contractor in a UK based nuclear power plant. There is a growing public sentiment against nuclear power, with communities still reeling from Windscale and Chernobyl. Mandatory weekly safety audits are required by law.

Fail the audit, the plant ceases operations.

From your workstation, switch between live camera feeds across the facility - watch for safety contraventions, unusual behaviour and sinister activity. Capture evidence and report incidents before they spiral out of control.

Receive instructions from management via the internal email network. Beware, protocols can change mid-shift. What matters now may not matter later.

Prioritise carefully - not everything should be reported.

A standard shift lasts 60 - 90 minutes. Incidents escalate in real time. Stay alert, adapt to changing directives, and don't let anything slip through.

Some areas of the facility are not part of your initial assignment. As incidents escalate, new camera feeds may become accessible. What’s happening deeper inside the plant was never meant to be monitored.

MONITOR PLANT SAFETY

REPORT ALL INCIDENTS

FAILURE TO REPORT CONSTITUTES NEGLIGENCE

EXCESSIVE REPORTING DISRUPTS OPERATIONS

4499500.name: Ninja Dodgeball
4499500.about_the_game:
Ninja Dodgeball

Step into the arena where reflexes, timing, and precision decide everything. In Ninja Dodgeball, players battle in fast-paced matches where a single ball becomes the ultimate weapon. Master its physics, deflect it with perfect timing, and send it flying back at your opponents at impossible speeds.

Inspired by classic dodgeball modes like Genji Dodgeball and TF2 Dodgeball, Ninja Dodgeball brings the concept into its own unique, skill-based arena experience.

Created by a solo-indie developer who does some basic grunt healthcare stuff as my job :D

Master the Ball

The ball isn’t just thrown — it’s controlled through skillful deflection and movement. Build momentum as players volley it back and forth until it becomes a lightning-fast projectile capable of taking down anyone in its path.

Ninja Movement

Stay alive with fast, responsive ninja abilities:

  • Reflect incoming balls back at enemies

  • Dash to evade impossible shots

  • Attack to redirect and control the ball’s trajectory

Precision and timing are everything. One mistake and you're out.

Fast Competitive Matches

Jump into intense arena matches where every round becomes a high-speed duel of reaction time and strategy. The longer a rally lasts, the faster and more dangerous the ball becomes.

Key Features

  • Fast-paced multiplayer dodgeball combat

  • Skill-based ball physics that reward precision

  • Reflect, dash, and attack mechanics for advanced play

  • Increasing ball speed that escalates every rally

  • Competitive arena gameplay focused on reflex and mind games

Only the fastest ninjas survive.

Can you deflect the impossible?

4499530.name: Don Quijote
4499530.about_the_game:
In a small village in La Mancha, an aging nobleman named Alonso Quijano has read so many chivalric romances that he loses his grip on reality. Believing himself to be a knight-errant, he rechristens himself Don Quixote de la Mancha and sets out on a quest to revive the age of chivalry, right wrongs, and win glory in the name of his imagined lady love, Dulcinea del Toboso.

Accompanied by the pragmatic peasant Sancho Panza as his squire, Don Quixote journeys through a Spain that has no place for knights. He mistakes windmills for giants, inns for castles, and flocks of sheep for armies. Yet within his madness lies a profound nobility—a refusal to accept a world without honor, justice, and beauty.

Don Quijote is an interactive graphic novel that reimagines Cervantes' masterpiece through a unique neo-noir visual style. Every scene is drenched in dramatic shadows and cinematic lighting, transforming La Mancha into a landscape as beautiful as it is unforgiving.

KEY FEATURES


  • Branching narrative with over 200,000 words of dialogue, where your choices shape the story and determine four distinct endings.
  • Unique neo-noir visual style that fuses 17th-century Spain with film noir cinematography and composition.
  • Memorable characters from Cervantes' work, each with psychological depth and their own narrative arcs.
  • Meaningful choice system that poses the central question: can idealism survive in a world that has no use for it?
  • Collectible gallery with special illustrated scenes unlocked throughout your journey.
  • Universal accessibility: no reflex-based mechanics or time pressure. Enjoy the story at your own pace.
  • Dyslexia-friendly font, high contrast mode, adjustable text speed, and multiple font sizes.
4499530.supported_languages:
English*, French*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Portuguese - Portugal*, Polish*, Russian*, Turkish*, Japanese*, Korean*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support

4499560.name: Party Knights
4499560.about_the_game:
Party Knights is a chaotic online adventure! Storm castles with your friends in large scale co-op sieges, survive trap-filled dungeons solo, or battle other knights in 8-player tourneys.

Epic 4-Player Sieges

The ultimate Party Knights experience! You’ll need to work as a team to solve fun and unique environmental mechanics, defeat waves of enemies and conquer powerful bosses to return victorious.

Perilous Dungeons

Dungeons are tailored for a challenging solo experience, put your skills to the test to navigate a gauntlet of traps and puzzles without the help of others. Do you have what it takes?

 

Tourney Mode: 2-8 Player PVP

Compete in multi-round tournaments to crown the king. Battle for glory in a mix of Free for all & Team vs Team minigames or test your platforming skills in obstacle courses. May the best knight win!

Content

  • Cooperative multiplayer up to 4 players

  • 6 PvE Levels of varying difficulty

  • Competitive multiplayer up to 8 players

  • 3 PvP game modes

  • Character Customisation & Emotes

  • Battle Ram!

4499610.name: Sovereign's Enigma
4499610.about_the_game:
Explore a vast underground world in a 2D side-scrolling survival adventure. Find survivors, build a team, and battle powerful bosses in the ruins of a forgotten civilization. Uncover the truth behind the Sovereign's Enigma.

The Never-Ending Cycle

Legends speak of a vast cave hidden beneath the surface — a place filled with ancient life and forgotten relics. Many adventurers descend into its depths in search of treasure or answers.

Those who enter soon realize something is wrong. Time passes, civilizations come and go, and yet the cycle continues.

Investigate the Ruins

In Silent Orbits, explore the eerie ruins of a missing civilization. Scavenge derelict fleets, survive encounters with deadly security drones, and unravel the mystery of a forgotten civil war.

Did humanity wipe itself out, or did they escape?

Navigate the ruins of a post-cataclysmic universe. Use your ship to pierce the fog of war and uncover abandoned space stations, shattered outposts, and drifting derelicts. 

The game features two separate map systems. The first allows for travel between large space sectors. The second allows you to explore each sector on a smaller scale, similar to the world maps in the first Fallout games (grid, fog of war, random encounters).

Weave Codes & Sling Spells

Build Your Kit & Vanquish Your Foes!

4500050.name: A Totally Normal Love Story
4500050.about_the_game:
Made for people who love Hallmark movies — and people who love to hate them.

A Totally Normal Love Story is a cozy small-town romance about coming home, healing old wounds, and finding love where you least expect it. When Willa returns to Maysville, Kentucky after years away, she reconnects with old friends, helps preserve the town’s beloved traditions, and slowly falls for a familiar face who never left. Amidst the festival planning, family history, and small-town charm, Willa must decide whether this quiet life — and this love — is worth staying for.

Get to know the quirky residents of Maysville. Fall in love with its festivals, its history, and its unmistakable sense of community. Watch a traditional romance unfold exactly as you’d expect.

Nothing strange. Nothing hidden. Nothing weird going on here.

Please enjoy your stay in Maysville.

Gameplay:

| Interactive Visual Novel |

The choices that you make impact the character’s dialogue and the ending of the game.

There are no built-in minigames, and the animation is minimal. This is a story-driven experience and will engage patrons of varying types of media beyond just visual novels. Avid readers and movie watchers will enjoy this just as much as, if not more than, gamers. You can enjoy your playthrough on autoplay if preferred, only clicking when decisions have to be made. In preferences, you can control the volume of sound effects and background music.

Features:

Original sprites and backgrounds

4-5 hours of playtime (100k words)

6 endings

Available on Windows and Mac

Disclaimer:

Do not reupload, resell, or redistribute this game or any of the assets in it.

Streaming and gameplay videos are appreciated if commentary is added.

We are a husband-and-wife team with limited resources. To better support the story and make this project possible, we used modern tools to bring the characters, their sprites and backgrounds, to life. None of the writing, voices, sound effects, or music was built with AI.
