4500270.name: Global Protocol: New World Order
4500270.about_the_game:
Take Command of the Modern World

Available Now in Early Access

Global Protocol: New World Order is a data-driven grand strategy game set in the real world of 2026. Play as any of 261 playable countries — from global superpowers to developing states — and navigate the complex web of modern geopolitics, economics, warfare, and diplomacy.

Every country starts with real-world data: GDP, population, military strength, alliances, resources, and political systems. What happens next is up to you.

Every Nation, Your Way

Choose from 261 playable countries, each rated on a 5-star difficulty scale. Lead the United States and maintain global hegemony, guide Brazil through economic transformation, or take on the ultimate challenge with a fragile state fighting for survival. Over 4,600 provinces cover the entire world — every region matters.

Deep Strategic Systems

  • Economy — Manage GDP growth, inflation, trade agreements, resource extraction, budgets, and construction. Build 69 different building types across economic, military, infrastructure, research, social, defense, and intelligence categories.
  • Military — Command 17 unit types across land, sea, and air. Assemble armies, deploy fleets, launch air missions, manage logistics, and fight wars of attrition or lightning strikes.
  • Technology — Research 53 technologies across Military, Civilian, and Space branches. Unlock new capabilities, improve your economy, and gain strategic advantages.
  • Espionage — Build intelligence agencies, run covert operations, steal technology, sabotage rivals, and protect your own secrets. Real-world agencies like the CIA, MI6, FSB, and Mossad each bring unique advantages.

Shape the Global Order

Diplomacy goes far beyond simple alliances. Negotiate trade deals, impose multilateral sanctions through the UN Security Council, form and break military pacts like NATO or the Shanghai Pact, join economic blocs, and compete for prestige on the world stage. The G7, G20, and UNSC are active bodies whose decisions reshape the global balance of power.

A Living World

Each country is governed by its own AI personality — aggressive, cautious, opportunistic, or isolationist. 68 scripted events draw from real-world 2026 flashpoints, while procedural events react to your decisions. Alliance betrayals, economic crises, border disputes, and regime changes unfold dynamically. Every action has consequences that ripple across the globe.

Command Your Forces

Deploy infantry, armor, artillery, fighters, bombers, helicopters, destroyers, submarines, and carriers across a detailed world map. Establish air superiority, blockade enemy ports, transport armies across oceans, and manage the fuel and manpower that keep your war machine running. Fog of war ensures that intelligence is as valuable as firepower.

Nuclear Deterrence

The DEFCON system tracks global nuclear tension across 5 escalation levels. Nine nuclear-armed nations possess ICBMs, SLBMs, cruise missiles, tactical warheads, and hypersonic weapons. Launch a first strike — or hold your arsenal as the ultimate deterrent. Mutual Assured Destruction is not just a theory; it is a game mechanic.

Victory on Your Terms

Pursue one of 5 victory conditions:

  • Military Hegemony — Dominate through territorial control and unchallenged military power
  • Economic Dominance — Build the world's largest economy with unrivaled trade networks
  • Diplomatic Victory — Win global support through prestige, alliances, and UN influence
  • Tech Supremacy — Lead the world in research and technological advancement
  • UN Mandate — Shape international law through decades of diplomatic leadership
Or ignore victory conditions entirely and play in sandbox mode with no time limit.

Built for Modding


Global Protocol was built from the ground up to be modular. Customize your experience or create entirely new scenarios with built-in modding support. Modify country data, tech trees, units, and events to shape your own version of the New World Order.

Global Accessibility


Strategize in your native tongue with full interface support for 12 languages, including English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Turkish, Russian, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese.

Key Features

  • 261 playable countries with real-world 2026 data
  • 4,600+ provinces covering every region on Earth
  • 17 military unit types across land, sea, and air forces
  • 69 building types in 7 categories
  • 53 technologies across 3 research branches
  • 22 major alliances and treaties including NATO, EU, ASEAN, African Union, BRICS+, G7, G20, and more
  • Built-in Modding Support for custom scenarios and data
  • 12 Supported Languages for a truly global experience
  • DEFCON nuclear system with 5 missile types and MAD mechanics
  • Real intelligence agencies and covert espionage operations
  • 68 scripted events based on 2026 geopolitical flashpoints
  • 5 victory conditions plus unlimited sandbox play
  • AI-driven nations with distinct personalities and strategic goals
  • UN Security Council, G7, G20, and international organizations
  • Save/Load system with quick save support
  • 7 map modes — Political, Terrain, Economic, Military, Diplomatic, Nuclear
  • High performance — Built on Unity DOTS/ECS for smooth gameplay

Development Roadmap

We are committed to long-term development and transparency. Follow our progress, see what we're currently building, and track upcoming features on our live public roadmap:

Check our website for the full development roadmap.

Our roadmap includes upcoming overhauls for the UN Security Council, Global Supply Chain simulations, Naval Carrier Groups, and much more.

4500300.name: Pro Sports Boxing

Career Mode

Create a Boxer

select skin type,  body type, hair / color, trunks, robe. choose your entrance music, and all the facial details to morph your character to look exactly how you would like. Select the name and hear the announcer introduce you! the possibilities for your boxer are endless.

Dynamic Fighting

If your hurt, grab onto your opponent to recover, or throw punches in the clinch. extend your jab arm and keep it out as a range finder. The possible fighting styles are endless.

Take on Friends

Get in the boxing ring and battle it out with your friends. Use a whole arsenal of punches from uppercuts, jabs or hooks, body punches and use lightning quick boxing combinations to knock out your opponents, blocking and dodge punches to become a defensive wizard. Who is going to come out victorious? Challenge your friends to a boxing game.

Game Features

  • 100+ unique premade boxers. All with their own stats and attributes

  • 10 unique boxing stadiums and locations. From the Downtown Gym to the New York Garden Arena

  • Create a boxer, change everything from skin, body type, hair, ring attire, ring walk music, stats, and much more. The possibilities are endless.

  • An immersive career mode, Training Camps, hit the heavy bag, work on your footwork, increase speed and strength.

  • Select different promotors and trainers, different trainers can help with different attributes. Bigger promotors can get you more money and ultimately a world title shot.

  • 3 world title belts in career mode, win them all to become the undisputed champion of the world!

  • Dynamic boxing mechanics, grab your opponent in the clinch and throw punches in the clinch, hold your arm out as a range finder for the jab.

  • 3 Judges scorecards, different judges could favour certain styles more, which can produce wildly different score cards in the boxing match, including draws and split decisions.

  • Punch stats presentation

  • Ring walk and fighter introductions

  • Realistic damage, cuts and swelling eyes during the boxing match.

4500310.name: Staatio
4500310.about_the_game:
STAATIO is a real-time multiplayer strategy game where you fight for territory on procedurally generated Voronoi maps. Capture regions, grow your army, form alliances, and eliminate your opponents.

How to Play

  • Drag from your region to any other region to send troops

  • Capture neutral and enemy territories by overwhelming their defenses

  • Hold more territory to generate troops faster

  • Form alliances with other players — or betray them when the time is right

Four Game Modes

  • Classic — Last player standing wins. Simple, tense, strategic.

  • King of the Hill — Fight over a central crown region. Hold it to claim victory.

  • Domination — Capture the most territory and hold your lead. Expand fast or get crushed.

  • Rush — Boosted troop generation, faster movement. Pure aggression.

Your Server, Your Rules

  • Host from the app — the desktop client includes a built-in server. Start a game and share the address with friends. No extra setup required.

  • Self-hosted Docker — run a dedicated server on your LAN, VPS, or cloud. Full control, no subscription, no telemetry.

  • Official servers — jump into a game instantly.

Multiplayer

  • Up to 50 players per room (20 in demo), with room codes and optional passwords

  • Fill empty slots with bot opponents at three difficulty levels

  • Spectator mode — watch ongoing games live

  • In-game chat with smart content filtering (full game)

  • Customizable room names and player settings (full game)

Features

  • Alliance system — team up, reinforce allies, share victory (full game)

  • Dark and light themes

  • Colorblind mode

  • Cross-platform: Linux, Windows, macOS (full game)

4500320.name: Risk & Responsibility
4500320.about_the_game:
You are the Environmental Health & Safety manager of a chemical facility. Every decision you make carries weight — for your workers, your company, and your career.

Balance compliance scores, capital budgets, risk metrics, and political pressure as you navigate OSHA audits, whistleblower reports, vapor releases, and the quiet friction of a facility that never stops running. When crisis strikes, time slows and the real test begins.

Manage what matters:

  • Monitor your facility through a live risk heatmap. Green zones can turn red without warning.

  • Navigate a 12-month regulatory calendar of OSHA audits, environmental reviews, and board pressure

  • Respond to operational events, media scrutiny, supply chain disruptions, and whistleblower reports

  • Balance four interconnected resources: Capital Budget, Compliance Score, Risk Score, and Political Score

  • Make decisions under pressure with no objectively right answer. Only tradeoffs.

When crisis hits: Time slows. Actions are limited. Stakeholders apply pressure from every direction. Your response determines whether you survive the incident or lose your job.

For players who want: A strategy game grounded in real systems. Corporate drama with authentic stakes. The satisfaction of keeping a complex operation running when everything is trying to make it fail.

Risk & Responsibility was designed by a developer with 15 years of professional experience in Environmental Health & Safety and ESG. The scenarios, regulatory systems, and ethical dilemmas in this game reflect real decisions faced by EHS managers every day.

4500350.name: 5 days at grandpa
4500350.about_the_game:
A dark horror game about a grandson who is staying at his grandpa's house for 5 days while his grandpa is gone. But something is off, maybe it's the house, or maybe it's you.

You'll experience a story-driven gameplay with a 5-day simple mechanic where Nathan will get very bad hallucinations. Demons, shadows, and unnatural figures will appear, especially at night, when you have to sleep, and it gets scarier as the days go on. The gameplay explores various locations.

Game Features:

  • Diverse and detailed locations

  • Voice acting for the main character and others

  • Atmospheric sounds

  • High-quality cutscenes

  • Jump scares

4500370.name: OMVROS
4500370.about_the_game:
OMVROS is a brand-new indie falling-note rhythm game. It expands upon traditional 4K gameplay by splitting the track into upper and lower sections, where notes strike from both sides simultaneously.

【Game Features】

  • Dynamic Chart Effects: Every chart features unique visual performances, including but not limited to scroll speed changes (BPM changes), speed offsets, fake notes, and color shifts. The background environment also evolves with the atmosphere of each track.

  • Original "Moe" Anime Style: The game features multiple original, cute anime-style character illustrations.

  • Immersive Visual Performance: Certain hidden tracks feature stunning unlock animations. Combined with dynamic lighting and particle effects, the finale of each chapter is a true visual feast.

  • Renowned Composer Lineup: Featuring masterpieces from several well-known artists in the rhythm game scene, ranging from high-speed hardcore electronic music to melodic pop tracks.

【Early Access (EA) Description】

The game is currently in its early development stage, and Chapter 1 is now fully available. We look forward to hearing feedback from the Steam community regarding judgment feel, visual effects, and chart difficulty. Future updates will include:

  • More challenging original chapters.

  • An original storyline presented in a Visual Novel format.

4500390.name: Churu Please!
4500390.about_the_game:
"Churu" is a snack that every cat loves... but every cat has its own taste!

Key Features:

  • High-Speed Reflex Gameplay: Identify the cat's request and pick the correct treat before time runs out!

  • Global Leaderboards: Are you the ultimate cat butler? Compare your 'Best Score' and 'Total Fed' count with players around the world.

  • Cute & Charming Art: Meet various adorable cats waiting for their favorite snacks.

  • Simple but Addictive: Easy to learn, but hard to master as the speed increases!

4500410.name: Killest Fights CRAW-Mech
4500410.about_the_game:
Killest Fights CRAW-Mech is a turn based RPG about Killest, a cyborg who was once a famous scientist, taking his revenge on the RDA.

  • Discover and Destroy! From a crudely maintained factory to the cloudy surface of Jupiter, and even abandoned civilizations, Killest won't shy away from any location. 

  • 1 Man Army. Killest is alone in battle, but he's got a wide variety of skills with unique action commands to keep himself on the offensive.

  • Let your anger guide you... If your regular skills aren't cutting it, Killest also has access to anger skills, which will assist you in plowing through the enemy. 

  • Droves of Enemies. Robots of all shapes and sizes are here to stop you! Killest will take them all on! Or be wise and move carefully to avoid them.

  • Find Your Identity... Killest's got a bone to pick with the RDA for some hard-repressed personal reasons, and he's taking the fight straight to them. Why is his anger so deep-seated? What happened to him? And how did all that mold him into such a cold combination of metal and man?

  • Roughly 1 1/2-Hour Original Soundtrack

4500470.name: Ninja Vs Bomb
4500470.about_the_game:
"Ninja Vs Bomb" is an innovative webcam body-tracking action game where your own movements become the weapon. Using your hands, you’ll channel the power of a ninja to hurl shurikens at swarms of bomb creatures released by a relentless boss enemy.

Stay alive by collecting heart power to keep your energy from running out, and grab special shurikens to turn up the power when the chaos grows overwhelming. Each level ramps up the difficulty, testing your reflexes, endurance, and precision.

Survive all 10 levels of escalating challenge, keep your heart power from empty, and you’ll claim victory in this war against explosive foes.

Key Features

  • Webcam Body-tracking gameplay: your hands control the ninja’s strikes

  • Fast-paced battles against chaotic bomb creatures

  • Collectible heart power and special shurikens for survival

  • 2 selectable difficulty modes for tailored challenge

  • Tutorial mode to learn mechanics before the real fight

  • 10 levels of increasing difficulty (60 seconds/ level)

  • Unique blend of physical movement and arcade-style combat

4500480.name: Then They Came for Me
4500480.about_the_game:
Then They Came For Me is a fascism survival RPG set in an isolated neighborhood during the reign of a totalitarian regime. Take care of your neighbors, try to stay fed and sane, and make your choices carefully. Resist the regime or lick the boot, every decision you make has consequences.

SURVIVE
Keeping yourself fed can be hard when the economy is crashing and different goods become contraband on the whim of a mad Leader.

PROTECT
Your neighbors are your greatest asset. Maintain their sanity, inspire hope, or admonish them. Hide strangers who are being hunted by the regime, or betray them to be in the government's good graces.

RESIST
Government only has power from the consent of the people. You do not have to consent.
Sabotage regime property, impede investigations, and fight back. Take action because evil doesn't reward neutrality.

4500510.name: 天朝相亲图鉴
4500510.about_the_game:
This is a realistic, high-freedom text-based romance simulation game with life simulation elements.

Over 5 years, you will experience a real, touching yet heartbreaking, ridiculous yet addictive blind date adventure, encounter more than a dozen blind dates with distinct personalities, and trigger countless weird events and plot twists in side storylines. This work truly restores the current situation of contemporary marriage and love, while being full of imaginative plots. You can choose to live a stable life with your beloved, work hard together with a well-matched partner, step into a wealthy life, or opt to focus on your career independently, enjoy casual dating, and other diverse endings. It is packed with detailed development elements—even hair loss and your character's status will truly affect the plot. With ultra-high freedom, every choice will rewrite your fate, allowing everyone to play out a unique life. Will you find true love, pursue your career, or laugh at the absurdities? It’s your life, and you’re in charge! Come and start this hilarious yet authentic blind date journey!

4500530.name: Raging Blasters 2
4500530.about_the_game:
This is an arcade-style vertical scrolling shmup.

Players choose from three pilots to control, board a fighter jet, and defeat enemies. The game follows classic shmup mechanics: fire shots to defeat enemies and avoid bullets, making it a simple yet addictive game.

Three modes: Arcade Mode, Caravan Mode, and Training Mode

Arcade Mode:

Stages appear one after another, and clearing all stages will complete the game. Choose from three difficulty levels: Normal, Hard, and Expert.

Caravan Mode:

Compete for the highest score in a special three-minute stage.

Training Mode:

You can practice by selecting a specific stage and difficulty level.

Features

Supports both single player and two player cooperative play. Similar to the system of the previous game, Gemini Arms, it uses a pseudo two player system. When playing single player, the second player will act as an automatic option, so you can enjoy pseudo two player play even when playing alone.

As such, a major feature of this game is that you can always enjoy cooperative play, whether playing alone or with two players.

4500540.name: 无限接近
4500540.about_the_game:
An epic ABO-themed sci-fi game is here, with a female protagonist who’ll have everyone thrilled! From the start, you play as the most powerful female Alpha who dominates the stars. With both charm and combat skills at their peak, this game offers non-stop excitement!

To tempt your reclusive, aloof boss, you agree to a bet that involves having your memories erased. You venture alone to Hell Island for training, where you meet the person whose fate is intertwined with yours. After escaping death, you find yourself involved in a treason case. As you unravel the truth amidst mystery, you use your strength to protect your homeland. But because of your brilliance, you become a target for corrupt authorities, drawing you into a web of political intrigues.

The game also features many handsome characters with unique personalities: a reclusive boss, conservative colleagues, gloomy teammates, irritable instructors, sweet younger brothers, eccentric doctors, gentlechildhood friends, loyal butlers, and arrogant sponsors… Choose whom you want to pursue!

With its ABO setting, superpowers, and futuristic sci-fi backdrop, this game delivers all your fantasies of intense battles. Get ready to embark on a journey to become the ruler of the stars!

4500620.name: Subclidean
4500620.about_the_game:
Subclidean is a physics based puzzle single player set in a non-euclidean world with impossibly infinite architecture. 

Use portals to flip gravity, alter size, time and more to solve otherwise reality defying puzzles. Explore infinite worlds that repeat seamlessly, where stairways can wrap around each other and a room's size does not dictate how big the interior is. This reality-bending game you challenge your expectations how you approach solving puzzles.

Venture deeper into your subconscious exploring memories and uncover the truth on why you're trapped here and how you can escape.

4500650.name: Cave of Mystery
4500650.about_the_game:
Not by sword or fang, but by song.
It’s said King Flute will return before long.
And when he comes on that day,
In the woods you’ll hear one flute play.

Ancient folklore to some… but whispers of a grotesque divinity to others.

Follow Gregl, a frantic father who plunges into the mythical and sinister Cave of Mystery in search of his kidnapped daughter, Abbigale.

Returning home one late night, Gregl becomes traumatized by a disturbing scene. His daughter is missing, his wife Sarah has been murdered, and there is something horrifyingly different about the town.

The Lord of Legends himself King Flute, a being tied to forgotten myths and spectral powers has returned. This time he seeks to reap unlimited despair upon you. Saving Abbigale may be impossible, Gregl must venture into a dark catacomb where no one has ever willingly gone. However, Gregl knew this day would come.

The Cave of Mystery.

A place that makes the bravest men tremble.
No one has returned. No one tells tales.

When the wind blows softly, they fear it may be the first note of the flute of doom.

Will you save Abbigale and become the first to return from the wretched cavern of mythical phantasms…
Or will the mouth of cave swallow you whole?

 

Game Features:

Survive the Darkness

Face relentless enemies lurking in the depths. Zombies, Monstrosities, and Nightmarish Ghouls mutilated by eldritch corruption.

Explore the Unknown

Descend into twisting catacombs and caverns filled with whispers, lost relics, and unsettling secrets.

 Solve Ancient Mysteries

Unlock sinister puzzles and hidden pathways that reveal the Cave’s unsettling history.

 Fight for Survival

 Use the Lost Sword to fight hordes of eldritch monstrosities with what little courage you can muster. Find magical staffs forged by those lost in the Cave that begged for revenge on King Flute

4500660.name: Cosmic Robots
4500660.about_the_game:
Defend your planet from a relentless robotic invasion in Cosmic Robots, a fast-paced tower defense strategy game set across vibrant alien worlds ruled by powerful machine civilizations.

Waves of robotic enemies are advancing, and only your defenses stand between them and the destruction of your planet. Plan carefully, adapt your strategy, and prepare for an escalating war against hostile robot factions.

Defend. Build. Upgrade. Deploy.

Place laser, plasma, shields and rocket turrets along the invasion path to stop enemy forces before they reach your planet.

Upgrade your defenses, deploy combat robots, and send troops through portals to strike the enemy world. Adapt your strategy and turn the tide of battle as the war intensifies.

Battle across hostile planets ruled by powerful robotic factions.

Face the invading Aquarions, outmaneuver the tactical Geometrians, and survive the advanced machines of Matronet. Each new world introduces stronger enemies, new tactics, and devastating boss machines.

Game Features

• Strategic tower defense gameplay

• Build and upgrade laser, plasma, and rocket turrets

• Deploy robot troops to counter-attack

• Battle across multiple robot worlds

• Face giant robotic boss machines

• Four difficulty levels

• Controller support

4500690.name: Flora Nova
4500690.about_the_game:
Flora Nova is a single player, cozy music gardening game set in a colorful sci-fi solarpunk world. Connect with your community and prevent an alien disease from spreading through the environment by tending to musical gardens that keep the disease at bay.

Clear out the disease that has overgrown around the strange alien relics and revitalize the area through special musical plants as you make a garden to your liking! Decorate your garden, take care of your plants, and collect resources that help you unlock upgrades, decorations, and new areas. Record and share your unique musical creations with in-game NPCs as well as other players across the globe!

4500700.name: Amalgam
4500700.about_the_game:
Amalgam is a Roguelite Movement FPS where your sole ally is your sentient pet gun. Train your gun with commands and strengthen your bond. Each upgrade transforms your weapon, making it feel increasingly alive in your hands. Utilize omni-directional wallrunning, dashing, and sliding to speed through levels and avoid enemy attacks.

As the last synthetically-born child on Earth, you and your sentient weapon descend to confront the Great Machine that reshaped the world. Explore a world of mechanical solitude alongside your gun and rediscover what it means to be human.

Fight as One and free Earth from ruin, no matter how many deaths it takes.

Train your gun with commands, and grow your bond as you fight. Separate from your gun to solve puzzles and discover secrets, and reunite to mow down your foes.

Each upgrade has a unique visual that attaches to your weapon, making each build visually and functionally unique. Craft creative synergies and build a visual hallmark of each run as you play.

Make use of omni-directional dashing, sliding, and wall jumping to evade attacks and speed through levels. Utilize movement-oriented secondary weapons such as high-impulse sticky grenades and a grappling hook.

4500770.name: KeyFortress
4500770.about_the_game:
"If Heaven did not produce the Keyboard Warrior, the path of typing would be as an eternal night! Key, Come!"

💡 The Origin: A Story of "Self-Rescue" and Love

The birth of KeyFortress was not a calculated move, but an accidental "self-rescue." One day, my partner complained to me: "I don't know how to type properly. I have to look at the keys one by one. It's so slow and exhausting." I looked at my own hands—long-term "hunt and peck" typing as a developer had led to the early signs of Tenosynovitis (Carpal Tunnel). I realized that despite my speed, I had never truly "learned" the keyboard. Existing practice software was too boring. So I thought: Why not make a scientific, progressive, and truly "fun" typing game?

⌨️ Scientific "Muscle Memory" Training

This isn't just mindless tapping. In KeyFortress, we have:

  • Virtual Hand Guidance: Real-time display of finger zones on screen, color-coded for each finger.

  • Posture as Power: Typing with the correct fingers triggers unique BUFFs, turning proper form into your source of firepower.

  • Progressive Levels: From index finger positioning to full blind typing, reshape your finger logic step by step.

🛡️ Core Gameplay: Data Fortress Defense (Typing Roguelike)

More than a trainer, this is a hardcore Action Roguelike.

  • 6 Unique Main Weapons: From sniper-like precision to screen-clearing lasers, every weapon has a distinct typing rhythm.

  • 100+ Upgrade Cards: Build your defense style. Will you chase extreme attack speed or stack explosive damage?

  • Two Protocol Modes:

    • Standard Mode: Upgrades pause the game, perfect for beginners to adjust their rhythm.

    • Hardcore Protocol: The battle never stops! All upgrades are settled at the end of the wave for players seeking ultimate "flow."

📚 Armed to the Teeth with "Learning"

Here, your words are your bullets.

  • Massive Built-in Word Banks: From school exams to TOEFL/IELTS/GRE. We even have a Coder-Exclusive word bank!

  • 11 Language Support: Every word has translations. Theoretically, you can learn any major language.

  • Cyber "Blind Typing" Mode: Hide the words and type based entirely on Audio Pronunciation and Translation Hints. The ultimate way to master muscle memory.

  • Custom Import: Studying a specific book? Paste it in and turn it into your battlefield.

⚙️ Meta-Progression & Collection

Outside of battle, there is vast room for growth:

  • Armory & Gear: Customize your initial loadout.

  • R&D Center: Unlock powerful gear to make your "Aegis" system indestructible.

✉️ An Invitation from the Developer

If you want to fix your typing posture but hate boring software; if you want to memorize words in your spare time but crave intense action—please try the Demo.

I’ve placed Feedback Buttons throughout the game.

Every complaint or suggestion will be pushed directly to my phone.

Let’s rewrite the logic of your fingertips together.

----------------

New innovative gameplay: Typing + Roguelike + Slot Machine card strategy mode! Stay tuned!

4500780.name: Touhou: Records of Wealth-Seeking
4500780.about_the_game:
Hot! It’s a burning summer!Keine is about to get heatstroke!Let’s install a fusion generator in the classroom right away to power the air conditioner in the office!

Touhou: Records of Wealth-Seeking    Minamiyama Keine

By Keine Minamiyama

It was a scorching summer in 2024…

As chaos unfolded in the Outside World, capitalism found its way into Gensokyo…

Follow Teacher Keine's lead, and buy Gensokyo in 28 lessons!

Backstory

A respected teacher, Kamishirasawa Keine, transforms into the insanely greedy Minamiyama Keine on the night of the full moon.

For her, the change is as natural as becoming a hakutaku a thousand years ago.

Her personality shifts completely, and she sets a goal:

“Buy Gensokyo in 25 days, and make everyone here carry 10 billion dollars in student debt.”

Meanwhile, Gensokyo faces multiple crises:

the impending death of Hieda no Akyuu, the Temple School Incident, the Internet Shutdown Incident, and the Green Dam Harmony Incident.

As the instigator of the Temple School Incident, which path will Keine Minamiyama choose:

the Shirasawa Sage or the Minamiyama Principal?

Earth Background Story

Gensokyo is a place that shelters forgotten monsters.

A thousand years ago, after defeating demons and evil spirits, the gods chose to retreat into the Litang Continent.

On Earth, a small number of reclusive youkai also entered Gensokyo as civilization advanced and they were forgotten by humans.

As a divine beast and the offspring of gods and youkai,

the Shirasawa was also forgotten.

Its divine half remained on Earth as a soulless body,

while its youkai half entered Gensokyo and took residence within a human named Keine.

Principal Minamiyama — Wang Niang

She is neither just nor evil, caring nothing for fame or power.

For five thousand years, she only earned money in silence.

As capitalism developed, Wang Niang was not forgotten.

Instead, she gained more and more power and the faith of the upper class.

As the saying goes:

What the U.S. government does not govern is governed by conglomerates.

What the conglomerates do not govern is governed by Principal Minamiyama from Shandong.

But…

Wang Niang, a scheming and reclusive girl, has recently become obsessed with games.

This led to the division of the United States and human society, partisan hatred, and economic collapse.

Neglecting all her duties, she was eventually reborn into Gensokyo.

Gameplay

As Teacher Keine enters Gensokyo, she must acquire all assets in Gensokyo. There are 29 assets in total, but you will win the game once you acquire the 26th asset.

To earn more income, you need to upgrade the Temple School classrooms and install a nuclear fusion generator. You must also install an air conditioner in the principal’s office. Otherwise, Keine will suffer heatstroke and you will fail the game!

The game mainly consists of three steps:

  • Acquire assets

  • Upgrade the Temple School

  • Bribe Reimu and give gifts to Kaguya

Touhou: Records of Wealth Seeking puts great effort into its story,

filled with absurd, hilarious, and artistic moments.

Through Minamiyama Keine’s 28 lessons,

we see a world that is both ridiculous and dark.

In this abstract work, you will witness a shrewd and insightful Principal Minamiyama

who conquers Gensokyo without any fighting.

All artwork in this game is a collaboration between myself and AI.

After all, AI art and design still cannot compare to human inspiration.

All characters, locations, items, and other elements in this game are purely fictional.Any resemblance to reality is purely coincidental.

4500800.name: Goblins for Good
4500800.about_the_game:
Goblins for Good is an incremental game. Goblins spawn at your cursor. Upgrade to increase the max Goblins spawned, how fast they spawn, and increase their strength. Unlock merges where five Goblins can merge into a Hobgoblin, five Hobgoblins can merge into an Ogre, and so on. Unlock other cursor effects like healing and damage to support your goblin horde. Grow your army in power and watch your exponential upgrade progress be reflected in the RTS simulation.

Instead of getting lost in the typical incremental overused, endlessly sprawling skill trees, upgrades in Goblins for Good are clearly organized to maximumly increase your strategic decision making abilities.

Exponentially scale your income for juicy explosions of coinage. Scale your economy with upgrades to give you a boost of income upon merging, spawning, killing, pillaging, and more.

Expand your strategic options by merging little goblins into bigger ones, and bigger ones into something even greater — but the little guys never become obsolete, you still  need them for fodder! Strategically choose when to spread your forces or concentrate them to merge into the ultimate goblin goon. 

90% of profits from the sales of Goblins for Good will be donated to charity. In-game, players can dedicate their victory to one of 10 charities listed in their game to influence where the money is donated. Periodic developer updates will share receipts to show the profit and how much was donated to each charity for transparency. 

Goblins for Good isn't your typical sterile incremental game where you spend most of your time in complex UI upgrade trees or watching numbers on the screen go up. Watch ragdolls fly and chaos reign in a RTS-like simulation filled with emergent comedic chaos, in a game you can feel good about playing because you're contributing to real-world good.

Visualize your progress changing from incremental to exponential with charts and graphs. What's the point of the number going up if you can't see the line chart go vertical as you power spike?

4500850.name: Make Moku Proud
4500850.about_the_game:
Who Broke The Sacred Sequence?

Make Moku Proud is a psychological horror visual novel where masked raiders gather in silence... drawing numbered stones to conduct a sacred chant. If it works, their raid succeeds... But If it breaks… everything collapses.

Tonight, something goes wrong... The chant must remain pure, but somebody or something broke it. 

Why Are Raiders Disappearing One By One?

When the ritual fails, Moku issues a correction. The raiders need to go through The Room... Whatever happens there is the source of much debate. 

The Witness Is Exempt...?

You are Veko — the Witness. As the Witness you have special powers that you can use in the case the sacred sequence fails. But will you use those powers? Or maybe there's something else you need to consider...

The Sacred Sequence Must Always Be Obeyed?

As it becomes clear that the sequence has been broken, it's natural to question the morality and effectiveness of the sacred sequence itself. But maybe you shouldn't ask too many questions... Sometimes you should just obey. 

What Does It Really Mean to Make Moku Proud?

The rituals exist in Moku’s name. The chants. The rules... Everything. Maybe it's not so much about who broke the ritual, but what does it mean to make Moku proud?

Key Features

  • Short (~30 minute) psychological horror visual novel built around ritual and guilt... as well as moral hesitation.

  • Choice-driven dialogue that shapes how Veko responds to the collapsing sequence, leading to three distinct endings.

  • Minimalist, atmospheric presentation inspired by gothic and grunge aesthetics.

  • Haunting soundtrack blending ritualistic melodies and gritty sound effects. 

  • A ritual world where faith, authority, and silence become their own kind of horror.
4500850.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Turkish

4500870.name: What We Bring
4500870.about_the_game:
What We Bring is a cozy puzzle game about the objects that shape a life. Organize, sort, and pack through the years, choosing what items to carry forward. The items you keep shape the character’s future, influencing the path they take in a branching narrative story.

From infancy to adulthood, each puzzle explores a new year of life. See new milestones and familiar keepsakes as the character grows and changes throughout the game.

You’ll be faced with decisions of what items to bring along and which ones to leave behind. Each choice changes the trajectory of the character, leading to different environments and experiences.

  • Relaxing puzzles organizing everyday items.

  • Branching storyline with multiple endings.

4500890.name: Anomaly Street

4501310.name: 8 Ball Pro Online
4501310.about_the_game:
8-Ball Pro Online is a 3D billiards simulation that offers multiple game modes including 8 Ball, 9 Ball, 15 Ball and Snooker. Players aim their shots, apply power and spin to the cue ball and clear their own group of balls before pocketing the 8-ball. The game provides the tools necessary to deliver a realistic billiards experience including cue ball control, spin and elevated cue shots. Players can compete against the computer, a friend or other players online.

Against the Computer

If you want to play a real game but don't have anyone to play with, the AI provides you with three opponents, each with their own style. Charlie is the friendliest of the three. He plays for fun, takes whatever shot looks easiest, and forgives a lot of small mistakes. Beating him is mostly a matter of showing up. Vera is sharper. She picks her shots carefully, keeps the cue ball in sensible places, and will play a solid safety if she doesn't see a clean pot. You'll need to think about position to stay ahead of her. Silas is calculated and a bit smug. He plans every shot, lines up combinations and breakouts, and his safety play is genuinely reliable, so don't expect him to hand you the table by fouling out of a tight spot. He still isn't unbeatable. He can misjudge a long thin cut, and a difficult layout will rattle even him. Play a disciplined and solid game, and even Silas can be beaten. Play sloppily, and the table will clear before your turn.

Practice

Improve your aim, spin, power control, and cue ball position with practice mode. Position training places you in a random mid-game setup and requires you to pocket a specific ball, then position the cue ball in a specific area for the next shot. This is the skill that separates good players from great ones. Stuck-ball training flattens the ball against the rail and challenges you to figure out how to pocket it; one of the most difficult shots in billiards. Both modes optionally generate new challenges, show you where to aim if you want a hint, and let you repeat as many times as you like. No opponents, no time limit; just you and the table.

Local Multiplayer

Grab a friend and play on the same device, taking turns shooting on the same table. It's the same game you'd play on a real table, only on your screen. Play three matches or play all night long. The best way to have fun with your friends on your computer.

Online Multiplayer

Play against real opponents online. The lobby shows open tables in separate rooms for 8-ball, 9-ball, and 15-ball. Sit down at a table, wait for another player to join, and send a challenge. Once accepted, the match starts immediately. Spectators can watch any active game; if you're watching a table, you can request to join a player's side during the match. When the game is over, you can play again by clicking the “Play Again” option without returning to the lobby, or you can exit and find a new opponent.

Tournaments

Join elimination system tournaments directly from the lobby and advance as you win rounds. When a tournament opens, sign up and wait for the tables to fill. When it starts, the game matches you with an opponent and your match begins. If you win, you advance; if you lose, you are eliminated. Tournaments can be played in all three game types and support teams. In the special tournament room, special events are organized with their own registration and schedule.

Note: Tournament mode is only available to players who have purchased the Pool Pass.

Friends and Chat

Add other players as friends and see who is online. Send private messages with pop-up chat windows; these windows remain open during the lobby or match. The lobby has its own general chat; in-game chat allows you and your opponent to talk between shots; spectators can join the chat. An emoji selector is also available when words aren't enough.

Leaderboard and Replays

Every online match contributes to your ranking. The leaderboard has two tabs: active lobby players and global points ranking. Click on any name to open their profile and see information such as win rate, total number of matches, country, and recent games. From the profile, you can rewatch a past match, pause it using playback controls, fast-forward/rewind, and adjust the speed. This is useful for analyzing how the match unfolded or rewatching a past game.

4501800.name: AL-SARAB
4501800.about_the_game:
AL-SARAB is a psychological horror game inspired by classic survival horror, blending oppressive atmosphere, exploration, combat, and environmental storytelling in a dusty, decaying neighborhood that feels both familiar and deeply unsettling.

Wander through twisted alleys, abandoned spaces, and silent corners where something is clearly wrong. Search for key items, uncover hidden paths, solve grounded environmental puzzles, and survive disturbing encounters as the world around you grows more hostile and harder to understand.

Every location is built with purpose, filled with visual details, unsettling hints, and fragments of something larger waiting to be uncovered. The deeper you go, the more the city begins to feel alive — watching, shifting, and refusing to let you leave unchanged.

Face tense confrontations, explore at your own risk, and piece together a haunting experience shaped by atmosphere, dread, and the fear of what may be waiting just beyond the next corner.

4501820.name: 10s
4501820.about_the_game:
THE HUNT IS ON!

In 10s, your focus and reflexes will be pushed to the absolute limit. Forget slow-paced puzzles where you have all the time in the world to think. Here, the clock is your greatest enemy, and the pace is dictated by the radar!

Core Features:

  • 🎯 Follow the Radar: The HUD dictates the target color. Find and destroy the matching blocks on the grid as fast as you can. But beware: a single miss-click will shatter your hard-earned combo!

  • 🔥 Explosive Chains & Multipliers: Chain correct matches in shrinking time windows to raise your multiplier. "Bank" your score at the perfect moment to convert massive chains into real points and rank up.

  • ⏱️ Survive the Clock: Time never stops ticking. Build long combos or hunt down the rare, isolated "Time Blocks" on the board to earn precious seconds and keep your run alive.

  • 🥊 Asynchronous Rival System: The game constantly analyzes your global Steam rank and hunts down the score of a real player just above you. Surpass their score in your current run to stamp a glorious defeat over their ghost!

  • 👑 Climb the Ranks: Start as a novice and fight your way up the global leaderboards. Push your limits, rank up through challenging leagues, and prove your worth to reach the legendary top spots on the server.

  • ⚔️ Multiplayer Battle Mode: Face friends or challengers from all over the world in relentless real-time arenas! Chain massive combos to send garbage blocks and bury your opponents' grids. Use the targeting system to focus your attacks, get revenge on whoever attacked you, and be the last player standing to dominate the lobby's podium!

Can you keep your cool when the screen shakes, the alarm rings, and your time is almost up?

4501880.name: Infinite Galgame
4501880.about_the_game:
Infinite GalGame is an AI-driven visual novel engine that generates a completely unique story every time you play.

There is no fixed script. No predetermined ending. You type — and the AI writes the next scene.

🎮 How It Works

Launch the game, click Start, and an opening scene is generated instantly. From there, choose from suggested options or type your own response freely. The AI director crafts each turn: dialogue, character emotion, scene atmosphere, and a matching anime-style CG illustration — all in real time.

✨ Features

∙ Truly Infinite Stories Every playthrough is different. The AI generates dialogue, plot twists, and character moments on the fly — no two sessions will ever be alike.

∙ Anime CG Illustration Each scene is paired with a freshly generated visual novel-style illustration. Characters maintain a consistent appearance throughout your story.

∙ Custom Character Cards Import SillyTavern-compatible character cards (PNG) to play with your own characters — complete with custom personality, backstory, scenario, and opening lines.

∙ Save & Load System Save your story progress at any point and pick up right where you left off.

∙ Bilingual Support Switch seamlessly between Chinese and English. Story content, UI, and AI output all adapt to your chosen language.

∙ Optional AI Voice Characters can speak their lines aloud with AI-generated voices matched to their gender, age, and personality.

∙ Safe & Moderated Built-in multi-layer content safety: keyword filtering on both input and output, AI self-review on every response, and a one-click in-game report system.

📝 Note Infinite GalGame requires an internet connection to generate stories. Content is produced by AI and may occasionally be imperfect — use the in-game report button to flag anything unusual.

Every story starts with a single line. What will yours be?

Greed Party is an online co-op party game for 1–4 players built around greed, luck, and chaotic melee combat. Drop into a cursed gambling world, collect falling chips, spend them on slot machines, and take your chances on random weapons before facing the boss.

Each run follows a simple cycle: gather chips, gamble for loot, fight, and do it again. Every weapon comes from the machines, so your build is always at the mercy of luck. You might walk into the boss arena with a mop, a suitcase, a sword, or a massive war hammer.

Weapons are split into four tiers, from ridiculous improvised junk to deadly high-end gear. Trash weapons include absurd finds like pencils, plungers, and mops. Better luck can get you metal tools, blades, heavy weapons, and rare top-tier rewards.

Play solo or with up to three friends online, adapt to whatever the machines give you, and try to survive each cycle for as long as you can. There is no final escape — only another spin, another fight, and another chance to push your luck.

  • Colorful, chaotic melee combat and throwable weapons

  • Run-based structure where every run starts from zero

First love.
Childhood rooftops.
Your closest friend.
Your mother.

4502050.name: Retire in the Fairy Mountains
4502050.about_the_game:
The player accidentally enters a mysterious realm abundant with resources and fertile land. Colorful mushrooms can be found everywhere. Are the mushrooms poisonous? This is the Immortal Mountain—all mushrooms here are edible. They make amazing dishes and perfect hot pot ingredients!

Not enough mushrooms? You can till the land and grow your favorite vegetables, fruits and crops. In your spare time, fish by the river, raise chickens, ducks and pigs—all of them are ingredients! You can also unlock special delicacies and activities during traditional festivals.

If you still feel bored, cut down all the weeds and trees to clear space, and build any architecture you like. Decorate it with exquisite ornaments to create a unique little world and enjoy life!

If you have too many plants to take care of, don’t worry. Find magical treasures that can manage the farm automatically. You only need to decide what to grow. Running out of backpack space or afraid of losing items? Don’t panic—your backpack can be expanded infinitely.

Regular fishing is too simple with too little reward at a time? No problem. We offer a special fishing method that lets you get a huge catch all at once. It’s super satisfying!

Besides all this, you will gradually uncover the secrets of this mysterious realm. It turns out to be connected to the Heavenly Court in Chinese mythology!

Revive the ancient peach tree and repair the teleportation array, and you can enter the legendary ruins of the Heavenly Court!

What? The Peach Garden is unguarded? You can eat peaches as you like! But don’t eat too many—they will make you immortal!

What? The Moon Palace is so beautiful! There really is a moon hanging in the sky! But where have all the immortals gone?

4502060.name: Between Worlds: challenging puzzles
4502060.about_the_game:
"Between Worlds" is a 2D puzzle game where you reach the goal by reshaping the boundary between the front and back sides of the world.

The characters in this puzzle can use an action called "Fix" to transform themselves into part of the terrain.

If a wall blocks your path, turn a character into a platform and build your own staircase forward.

A platform created in the front world becomes a hole in the back world.

Changes made in one side of the world will also affect the other.

Understanding the puzzle from both perspectives — front and back — is the key to finding a solution.

The puzzles are filled with a variety of gimmicks, including gravity-altering switches and warp holes.
These elements intertwine across the front and back worlds, challenging the player's understanding and creativity.
Even situations that seem impossible at first may reveal a new path once you change your perspective.

And if you ever get completely stuck, hints are available!

Level Editor

This game also features a level editor that lets you create your own original puzzles!
Unleash your creativity and design entirely new challenges of your own.
Created puzzles can be saved as JSON files.
(*Online sharing functionality is not currently implemented.)

4502140.name: STAR TALE: Odyssey One

A radiation storm has crippled the ship. Biological containment systems have failed. And alien organisms secretly recovered decades earlier have transformed the ODYSSEY ONE into something unrecognizable.

Fight your way through six infested decks.
Restore power, oxygen, and the fractured mind of an AI that may no longer be on your side.

Every system you repair brings the colonists one step closer to Sagan II… or gives the infestation more time to spread.

No one is coming.

Explore the world, complete quests, fight monsters, mutants, and factions, gather resources, hunt and forage, fish, trade, and gain experience to develop your skills.

  • RPG-Shooter from 1st/3rd person in the spirit of post-apocalypse.

  • A well-thought-out world history with unique features.

  • Large open world filled with mutants and various anomalous zones.

  • Character progression through both skills and attributes, allowing you to create a versatile fighter.

  • Branching storyline that helps players unravel what's happening.

  • Crafting system that lets you create everything needed for survival.

4502280.name: Super Cyber Wave
4502280.about_the_game:

Master razor-sharp reflexes as you pilot unlockable characters through a symphony of psychedelic bullet patterns, each with unique attack types to obliterate endless enemy waves and conquer boss fights.   • Underwater Abyss: Dodge razor-toothed sharks while navigating treacherous currents and bioluminescent bullet storms.

  • Volcanic Inferno: Survive meteor showers and lava-spewing eruptions in a hellscape of fire and fury.

4502340.name: JOB
4502340.about_the_game:
JOB

Start with nothing. Build everything.

You play as a small-time hustler trying to rise through the criminal underworld. Manage your stash, grow your network of employees, and turn dirty money into a legitimate empire — all while staying one step ahead of the law.

Every decision matters. Buy too much product and your raid risk spikes. Miss a mafia debt payment and it's game over. Hire the right employees and watch your operation scale.

Features

  • 🏠 Housing system — Upgrade your home to unlock new products, expand your stash and hire more employees

  • 👥 Employee management — Hire, equip and assign workers to legal jobs, dark missions and theft runs

  • 💊 Product pipeline — Buy, store and resell drugs, stolen goods and weapons through a dynamic market

  • 💸 Money laundering — Clean your dirty cash through businesses, each with their own risk and reward

  • 🏢 Business ownership — Purchase restaurants, laundromats and more for passive income and auto-laundering

  • ⚖️ Tax & debt system — Monthly taxes, mafia debt deadlines and escalating fines keep the pressure on

  • 🌙 Day/night cycle — Daytime raises arrest risk, nighttime increases fines — plan accordingly

  • 🚗 Vehicle upgrades — Equip employees with better transport to unlock higher-paying missions

4502440.name: .synth_protocol
4502440.about_the_game:
When a virus makes robots go rogue, you and your squad are sent in to take back control of the situation by taking on endless waves of increasingly violent synths. Go now mercenaries! Execute .synth_protocol.

.synth_protocol is a goofy cooperative first person wave shooter, where you team up with your friends to take on endless hordes of zombie-like robots, synths. Progress to unlock new areas and cosmetics, or just mess around and have fun goofing off with your friends.

Online co-op from 1 to 4 players with proximity voice chat.

4502500.name: Monocre
4502500.about_the_game:
White or Black—

A world painted in just two colors. Toggle the colors of your character and the blocks to "forge" your path to the goal in this brand-new puzzle experience.

◆ Master the Two Colors

This game revolves around just two colors: white and black. When your character is white, you can touch white blocks but will phase right through black ones. Conversely, when your character is black, you can interact with black blocks and will pass seamlessly through white ones.

◆ Manipulate Colors at Will

Your character can transfer color to the blocks, or absorb color from them. Should you change your character's color, or the block's? Master color manipulation to reach the goal!

◆ Dynamic Gimmick Blocks

  • Gray Blocks: Solid blocks you can touch regardless of whether you are white or black.

  • Frame Blocks: Outlines that materialize into solid blocks once you pass through them.

Swap Blocks: Special blocks that instantly swap colors between themselves and your character.

◆ In-Game Content

  • You can play 12 stages per world.

  • Currently, up to 9 worlds are available, with more to be added in future free updates.

  • Even if you get stuck on a stage, you can check the solution step-by-step to see how to clear it.

4502510.name: Eerie Dossier:the Haunted House Observation Log
4502510.about_the_game:
Observation, Reporting, Upload

Welcome to the Anomaly Monitoring Institution, a job that's both safe and enjoyable. All you need to do is click on abnormal items on the surveillance screen to report them. There are no threats to your safety here or any notable anomalies worth noting. Occasionally, there might be some subtle noises, but rest assured, you're safe.

Be Aware of the Approaching Threats

Some things may not be as they seem, and with the night still long, certain recurring items on surveillance appear puzzling. These aren't just illusions or pranks; they're actively observing you and approaching you step by step.

Game Play Instructions

Use your mouse to switch between monitoring screens and report anomalies in images.

If you report too many anomalies or miss critical ones, the game will fail.

Some special anomalies require specific countermeasures.

4502550.name: Kingdom of Krawall
4502550.about_the_game:
Kingdom of Krawall is a turn-based strategy game about building your kingdom and crushing your enemies. Grow your economy, expand across the map, secure valuable tiles, and shape your strategy. Fortify your defenses, raise an army, and wage war against your rivals. Capture their palace to win, or be wiped from the map.

Whether you play solo or with friends, Kingdom of Krawall delivers the excitement and strategic depth of a classic 4X game in a single sitting.

  • 20+ handcrafted maps with 50+ starting positions, find your path to victory in every scenario.

  • 50+ units, equipment, and resource cards for endless strategic variety.

  • Single-player – Learn the game in a tutorial, then master every starting position and the unique challenges it brings.

  • Multiplayer – Face other players with simultaneous turns, so the action never slows down.

  • Map Editor – Design your own maps and challenges and share them with the community.

  • Conquer new lands – Expand your borders by placing units to claim new territory.

  • Secure valuable tiles – Capture anomalies and seize key landmarks, including villages and obelisks.

  • Gain the strategic advantage – Identify, capture, and hold vital positions to strengthen your borders and push into enemy territory.

  • Command Servants – Gather resources, craft goods, or train your Servants into builders and military units.

  • 30+ buildings – Construct farms, blacksmiths, barracks, and more to expand your economy and unlock new crafting and training options.

  • 30+ items – Equip your units and upgrade your buildings with horses, weapons, tools, and more.

  • 15+ anomalies – Capture steppe beasts, horses, and other special tiles to unlock powerful goods and units that can turn the tide of the game.

  • Prepare for war – Raise a mighty, well-supplied army by claiming anomalies and using them to train your Servants into powerfull units.

  • Protect your realm – Secure your borders, fortify your defenses and hold key positions to survive.

  • Outplay your opponents – Launch bold campaigns, strike at the right moment, and crush your enemies to seize their palaces and claim victory.

If you enjoy games like Ozymandias, The Battle of Polytopia, Hexarchy, Civilization, or Catan, you’ll feel right at home in Kingdom of Krawall.

4502680.name: Monsters Awaiting Parcels
4502680.about_the_game:
The world has long since stopped being a familiar place. Creatures from every corner of the universe now live among us. And despite all their differences, they share one very common habit: ORDERING PARCELS. 

AT YOUR PICKUP POINT, YOU CAN MEET ABSOLUTELY ANYONE =)))

  • The counter is never empty! Monsters show up with all kinds of plans: to pick up a parcel, to send one, or… maybe to swipe someone else’s. Keep your eyes peeled!

  • Match the photo, name, and document number carefully. If anything looks fishy, peek into the Registry of Creatures — your trusty guide to all the weird and quirky monsters.

  • QR Codes & Parcel Hunting

    Scan the QR code and verify the shipment number, recipient’s name, and delivery status. Find the right box in the warehouse among dozens of others. One mistake, and someone might walk away with the wrong parcel!

  • Payment & Sending Parcels

    Some clients come to pick up parcels, others to send them—register the shipment, collect payment if needed, and generate a new QR code.

  • Spotting Rule-Breakers & Handing Out Orders

    Tricksters might try to grab someone else’s parcel or cheat the system. Your job is to catch them in time. If everything matches — QR code, ID, parcel, and payment — you can hand over the shipment to its rightful owner.

But one mistake, and someone else’s box could end up in the wrong hands… or paws. Stay sharp at your new workplace!

4502690.name: GRUDGE
4502690.about_the_game:
Something is wrong inside your home

You wake up in the middle of the night after hearing a strange noise echo through your house.

At first, everything seems normal.

The hallway is silent.
The lights flicker softly.
The house feels familiar.

But something is different.

The shadows feel deeper.
The silence feels heavier.
And somewhere in the darkness… something is watching.

GRUDGE is a first-person psychological horror experience where reality begins to break apart, and the only way forward is to confront what hides inside the dark.


A House That Shouldn't Exist

What begins as a quiet night quickly spirals into a disturbing nightmare.

The house you once knew begins to change.

Rooms appear where they shouldn't.

Hallways stretch longer than before.

Doors emerge that were never there.

At the center of it all stands a mysterious figure.

A grotesque clown.

Silent.

Distorted.

Watching.

You don't know what it wants.

But it always seems to be there.

Waiting.

Explore the Nightmare

The house acts as the central hub of the experience.

Behind each mysterious colored door lies a different nightmare — each one presenting new mechanics, puzzles, and horrors to survive.

Every area tells a fragment of a larger mystery.

Some are quiet.
Some are disturbing.
Some will hunt you.

And every one of them brings you closer to the truth.

Will you escape the house…

or will the house keep you forever?

Empire Eleven: From Rock Bottom to Eternal Glory

Empire Eleven is a premier football management simulator where you take total control of your club, stepping into the shoes of a Manager or even the President/CEO. From tactical decisions on the pitch to high-level financial strategies off it, every choice dictates the success or failure of your organization.

Tactical 2D Match Engine

Experience the match through a specialized 2D tactical view. Be prepared for every moment of the game. Master the pitch. And everything beyond it.

Designed to be mechanically complex yet relaxing in execution, Empire Eleven allows you to dive into spreadsheets and financial projections without the pressure of punishing timers. It is pure strategy, distilled into a clean and intuitive interface.

From Manager to President

  • Total President Mode: Control the club’s destiny far beyond the touchline. Negotiate multi-million dollar sponsorships, manage stakeholder expectations, and dictate the commercial direction of the franchise.

  • Stakeholder Management: Keep investors satisfied and board members informed. Your financial decisions shape the market’s confidence in your project.

  • World-Class Infrastructure: Design and expand your stadium and centers of excellence. Every upgrade directly impacts revenue and youth development.

  • Customizable Club Culture: Define your team’s philosophy. Will you be a talent-producing powerhouse or a buyer of global superstars?

The Architecture of Revenue

Transform a regional club into a commercial juggernaut. Manage everything from match-day pricing to global naming rights contracts.

  • Strategic Transfer Market: Buy low, sell high. Use data analytics to find undervalued talent and maximize ROI (Return on Investment) with every sale.

  • Deep Financial Ecosystem: A realistic economic model where cash flow is as vital as the scoreline. Navigate carefully through Financial Fair Play regulations!

In-Game Editor & Modding Hub

Take total control of the footballing world with our powerful In-Game Editor. Shape the beautiful game exactly how you envision it:

  • Complete Customization: Build your own leagues, create custom clubs, and mold players from scratch.

  • Master the Database: Control every aspect of the football ecosystem with ease.

  • Datapacks & Community: Create your own custom Datapacks and share them with the world!

Build Your Legacy

Your legacy starts in the front office. Build more than just a team; construct an institution that stands the test of time. From financial ledgers to the top of the podium, the fate of the club is in your hands. Do you have what it takes to become the greatest CEO in football history?

Master the pitch. And everything beyond it.

Add to your Wishlist now and start planning your dynasty.

4502710.name: Stonewards
4502710.about_the_game:
DIG. FORGE. DEFEND.

A First-Person Co-op Roguelite Defense.

Stonewards is a solo or co-op mountain-defense roguelite. Protect a bastion and keep your King alive! Dig for resources to unlock character upgrades and fight off waves of monsters.

DIG

Once a wave is cleared, the race is on. Head into the procedurally generated mines to find the metals you need. Navigate 3D tunnels, discover hidden caves, and get your loot back to the bastion’s stockpile before the next horn sounds. If you’re late, your friends will be fighting the horde one dwarf short.

FORGE

Between waves, your loot is your lifeline. Use your mined ore to craft specialized ammunition and repair crumbling walls, or deposit it to unlock randomized power-ups for your current run. Whether you focus on explosive arrows for yourself or defensive buffs for the King, every choice counts. Your survival tonight depends on how you spend your haul.

DEFEND

The monsters only have one goal: reaching the King. While the exterior walls are your first line of defense, you must always be ready to fall back. Coordinate with your team to cover the perimeter and use your crafted consumables. If the enemies breach the bastion and the King falls, the run is over.

A Cooperative 3D Roguelite Defense.

  • 1-4 Player Co-op & Solo – Grab your pickaxes and rally the crew. Whether you’re diving alone or with a squad, those walls aren't going to defend themselves.

  • Protect the King – The King is the heart of the bastion. If he falls, the kingdom falls with him. Keep the monsters away from the throne at all costs.

  • Mine the Mountain – When the horn stops, the clock starts. Tunnel into the 3D procedural mines to find the rare ores and materials hidden in the dark.

  • Stockpile & Forge – Bring loot back to the bastion to craft ammo, repair walls, or fill the stockpile to trigger randomized power-ups for your current run.

  • Hold the Line – Take your position on the walls. Repel relentless waves of monsters and ensure no enemy breaches the gates.

4502730.name: Savi's Tale: When White Petals Fall Like First Snow
4502730.about_the_game:
Join Savi the cat in the afterlife's 'Good Place' as he prepares a gift for his person. Explore a cozy world, grow along the way, and build friendships with a variety of characters. Run and play, reflect on cherished memories, and discover the meaning of bonds and waiting.

A Resting Place for Souls, the 'Good Place'

Ruled by the absolute beings known as the Celestials, this is a haven free from pain, danger, and hunger. Yet the sorrow, longing, and lingering attachments of souls still remain. You become Savi, a cat, and explore this unfamiliar yet breathtaking world.

An Invisible Connection, 'The Bracelet of Bonds'

The 'Bracelet of Bonds,' a thick band of red thread wrapped around his paw, woke Savi from his long slumber as he waited for his person. Unlike other animals, Savi’s bracelet is unusually thick. What kind of story is hidden within this? And where will it lead him?

A Rich Story, Told Through Discovery

  • What kind of cat was Savi? Discover his story through witty conversations with a diverse cast of characters.

  • The relationships built through dialogue and actions will subtly influence how others react to and treat Savi.

Explore a Cozy, Combat-Free Open World

  • Play hard. This is the way… of cats!

  • Glide, swim, climb, and trek through snowfields across every corner of the world!

Preparing for the Reunion!

  • As Savi waits for his person, he prepares a gift and creates a place to live together.

Collectibles and Light Progression

  • Abilities and items gained through exploration gradually expand Savi’s range, leading him to new places.

"Waiting isn't a standstill, but a journey where new bonds are forged."

At the end of that wait, what will you find?

4502750.name: Infamous Keepers
4502750.about_the_game:
Infamous Keepers is a Tower Defense/Tactical Roguelite set in the Legend of Keepers universe where you play as a Dungeon Keeper.

Your employer, the Dungeon Company, has recently gone through massive layoffs, putting their dungeons to the test by closing the portals that connect them.
Cut off from any outside help, prove that your dungeon can still be successful and turn a profit: if a team of heroes makes it all the way through, you can kiss your career goodbye.

  • Strategically Place Your Towers and Traps: Give a warm welcome to your dungeon's "visitors"—floors and walls are all fair game.

  • Get the Most from Your Employees: Send them to the front lines to slow enemies down or assign them to a tower to boost its stats.

  • Evolve to Survive: Unlock a variety of upgrades for your employees and use Relics to make your dungeon unique!

There's more to being a Keeper than just setting traps. You'll have to make pragmatic and often cruel decisions.

  • Manage Your Schedule: Once an assault is over, decide what to do next. Recruit monsters, buy towers and traps, trade resources, or sell your lowest-performing employees into slavery for rare items.

  • Fine-Tune Your Defenses: From young heroes thirsting for adventure to out-of-control mutant rats, you'll face a wide variety of enemies, forcing you to tailor your strategy to each threat… and to pray to Golthor that the strongest Cult Champions won't attack.

  • Do More with Less: In addition to the regular day-to-day management of your dungeon, be prepared for random events whose consequences can be rather… unpredictable.

If any intruders manage to sneak past your defenses, take care of them yourself!

  • The Last Line of Defense: Wait deep in the heart of your lair, ready for action.

  • Unique Spells: Different types of Keepers have different spells that can turn the tide of battle.

  • Become a Legend: Grow stronger and become an unstoppable force feared by all.

4502870.name: Verse Unknown
4502870.about_the_game:
Verse Unknown is a single-player 3D platforming game with trailbuffet elements. It is currently in development.

Marrow and her sister Clavi have lived in misfortune their whole lives. After a tragic accident that renders even passively scraping by impossible, Marrow will have to venture out in search of a better home.

EXPLORE SURREAL WORLDS

Each of the game's three main globes contain a myriad of challenges that can be tackled in whichever order you happen to stumble upon them. In between these challenges there are many secrets to find, some useful, some not. Once you've done enough, will you have the courage to brave each globe's trial?

Player expression through exploration is one of our highest priorities. We want every player to encounter something different, for your journey across Lehr to be your own.

GRAB, SHAKE THROW!

Play as Marrow and use her trusty circlet boomerang to attack enemies, interact with the world, and grab objects! Each object has a different function. Some are gameplay altering, while others are just silly knick-knacks. Grab and shake... EVERYTHING. You'll thank me later (if you're polite).

MEET WEIRDOS

Lehr's globes are teeming with characters to talk to. They come in all kinds of shapes, sizes, colors and artistic mediums. Some of them give you quests! We really want this world to feel lived in, so we paid special attention to making each character feel unique while staying cohesive.

A GAME BY CHEY AND ZOE

Verse Unknown is made by CZDOOM, a two-person team literally named after ourselves. This game wasn't made by a computer. It also wasn't made by a massive team of people, each highly specialized in one specific skill. We're unique in that we both enjoy doing a little bit of everything. Whenever you talk to a character, hear a song, fight an enemy... that could be from either of us! Or from both of us working together. We're making this game for fun, for ourselves and as an extension of us. We hope you'll enjoy the ride and find value in it!

INSPIRATIONS

These games inspired us to make Verse Unknown and are still actively inspirations as we develop it. Once it's playable, we think you should give our game a try if you enjoy at least two of these:

  • ENA: Dream BBQ - Similar surreal style, studying it has really helped us translate our art into 3D!

  • The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker - Exploring an open world of islands with secrets, quests and collectibles.

  • Psychonauts - Creative 3D platforming in a world full of weird characters and attention to detail.

  • Mischief Makers - Experimental platforming, free-form movement and grabbing/throwing/shaking objects.

FAQ

When is Verse Unknown coming out?

  • We want Verse Unknown's demo to come out this year in 2026. Both of us are working on this game unpaid in our free time, so we don't want to make any hard promises in terms of deadlines. However, if all goes well the game should be fully complete at some point in 2028.

What the hell is a trailbuffet?

  • A trailbuffet game, as coined by Zoe Fighters, is a series of varied challenges placed in a large open world which can be tackled in any order (buffet). The player's exploration directly impacts the world and the ways in which they retrace their steps (trail). Our previous game, Fourmiworld, is a very pure trailbuffet.

Is this game related to Fourmiworld?

  • This game takes place in the same narrative multiverse as Fourmiworld, so this is a dimension that Wandereye COULD have theoretically stumbled across! However, the two are not directly tied together and this is not a sequel.

You will face dangerous enemies, challenging bosses, and navigate through a world filled with obstacles and puzzles. Each encounter requires timing, movement, and strategic combat decisions.

4503060.name: Dungeon of Regret
4503060.about_the_game:
Tough but Thrilling Combat

Dungeon of Regret is a multiplayer action boss-rush where you face extremely dangerous and aggressive demons in intense, close-quarters combat.

Hone your skills through brutal, life-or-death battles against demons that seek to tear you apart. Death is just another beginning!

1–4 Player Co-op

What you can’t do alone, you can achieve together.

Dungeon of Regret supports multiplayer for up to four players. If one isn’t enough, try two—if not, bring three or four and take on the challenge together!

Entrust your back to a trusted ally, and you’ll find the burden of facing demons a little easier to bear.

Of course, a truly brave player may choose to face it alone.

Four Distinct Combat Styles

There are four characters, each wielding a different weapon—and with different weapons come different combat styles.

From an all-out, aggressive brawler approach to hit-and-run tactics,

Join forces with these four unique characters and slay the demons that have seized the Dwarven castle!

Intricate and engaging special attack patterns of demons

Every demon has a hidden trump card. Think you can handle it? Here it comes.

Survive their empowered attacks—and seize your chance to strike back.

Even if you fail, don’t give up—there’s still a chance.

The demons’ attacks can be overwhelming—look away for even a moment, and you might leave yourself open.

Take a moment to regroup, and your allies will get you back on your feet.

Now’s your chance to fight better than before!

4503080.name: Rob o Bot
4503080.about_the_game:
What should have been a new era of automation has turned into chaos.

4503300.about_the_game:
When the streets knock, you open the door... figuratively.

The classic buy-low-sell-high hustle, rebuilt from scratch with gorgeous 2D city art, animated weather, and more strategic depth than any Dope Wars game before it. If you remember playing this in computer class when the teacher wasn't looking — welcome back. It's never been this good.

RUN YOUR OPERATION

PROVE YOU'RE THE BEST — FOR REAL

Global leaderboards with server-side anti-cheat and Steam Leaderboards. No hacked scores. No fake runs. Every dollar is verified.

PREMIUM EDITION — NO BS

✓ Steam Cloud saves across all your machines

LOOK THE PART

• Your hustle, your style

BUILT DIFFERENT
