4503320.name: Kuessaria
4503320.about_the_game:
Kuessaria is a 2D multiplayer sandbox RPG that blends real-time action combat with deep crafting, building, and exploration — all in a shared online world.

Important notice:

A lot of features are experimental, partially implemented, or just not ready yet! Keep an eye on the list of current features and planned features at the bottom of this description for what I can guarantee is in the game today!

Adventure Together

Team up with friends in parties of up to 4 players. Explore dangerous wilderness, delve into dungeons(WIP), and take on powerful bosses with coordinated combat. Trade items with other players, chat, and tackle challenges that are tougher alone.

Fight Your Way Through

Face off against a variety of enemies — from passive slimes and bats to aggressive zombies and dungeon horrors. Learn enemy patterns, dodge boss mechanics across multiple phases, and cast spells to turn the tide. Equip swords, staves, and battle axes, and unlock skills like Fireball and Heal to customize your combat style.

Build Your Own World

Every player gets their own persistent, instanced world — a personal sandbox where every block is breakable and placeable. Mine ores, chop trees, plant crops, and smelt bars at your furnace. Place crafting stations, storage chests, furniture, and walls to build your base exactly how you want it. Invite friends as collaborators to build together, or as visitors to show off your creation.

Craft and Progress

Gather resources and work your way up through tiers of tools, weapons, and armor. Smelt ores into bars, cook food for powerful buffs, and craft gear at specialized stations — crafting benches, furnaces, anvils, and cooking stations. With 75+ recipes and dozens of unique items, there's always something new to work toward.

Grow and Farm

Plant tree saplings and tend crops in your personal world. Grow wheat, herbs, and vegetables over real time, harvest your produce, and use it to cook food that restores health and mana. Manage your farm alongside your adventures in the wider world.

Level Up Your Way

Earn experience from combat and quests, level up, and allocate stat points across Strength, Intelligence, Defense, Speed, and more. Equip gear that boosts your stats, pick up quests from NPCs in town, and unlock new progression as you advance.

Current Features

  • Real-time multiplayer with party system (up to 4 players)

  • NPC quests and vendors

  • Expanded world content — new biomes, maps, and encounters

  • Continued crafting and progression depth

Fed up with the monotony, I decided to add a little "excitement" to my daily life by imposing a simple rule on myself:

"I can only stay in the dark for five seconds." From one streetlight to the next. Connecting the dots of light—a childish game, or so I thought.

In the dead silence of the residential streets, you must reach the next pool of light before the five-second count is up.

...But that ordinary daily life began to change, bit by bit.

The "5-Second" Countdown

The moment you step into the darkness, the countdown begins. You must reach the next source of light before it hits zero.

The Streetlights Intervene

Something is Eroding Reality

Your once-boring daily life is being slowly consumed by something.

Immersive Mode

4503710.name: SAMURAI CLICKER Infinite Build Mastery
4503710.about_the_game:

Defeat foes, gather items at your base to strengthen your character, and rise to face even deadlier challenges. With a vast array of items, you can experiment with endless combinations and synergies to create your own unique combat style.

Whether you prefer "One-Hit Knockouts," "Lightning-Fast Combos," or "Deadly Poison Tactics," the choice is yours. Craft your perfect build and crush the powerful enemies that stand in your way!

Overview: Welcome to the Museum After Dark. Tonight, the Finest Treasures are Yours for the Taking.

Your objective is simple: "collect" more national treasures and historical relics scattered throughout the vast halls than anyone else. But you aren't the only one with your eyes on the prize. Outsmart your rivals, rack up the highest score, and etch your name into history as a legendary collector.

Key Features

1. High-Stakes Free-for-All Multiplayer

It’s every collector for themselves. In this pure competitive mode, there is no such thing as cooperation. Predict which treasures your rivals are after and master the strategic art of intercepting their routes.

2. An Eye for Value

Every exhibit has a different score assigned to it.

  • Strength in Numbers: Quickly sweep up smaller gold coins and pottery in bulk.

  • The Grand Reversal: Go for the rare, massive exhibits to turn the tide of the game. The key to victory lies in deciding which items to prioritize within the limited time.

3. Intricate Museum Stages

Navigate through complex, labyrinthine exhibition areas that stand in your way. Success depends on mastering the layout and finding the most efficient paths before your rivals do.

Detailed Information

  • Genre: Multiplayer Treasure Action

  • Players: 1–4 players

  • Victory Condition: The player with the highest total score when the time runs out wins.

"History is meant to be taken. Let the heist begin."

You clicked.

Now you’re trapped in a deadly game show where every jump, every step, and every second could be your last.

  • Rotating gauntlet crushers

  • Precision platforming jumps

  • Collapsing pathways

  • Deadly mines and sniper fire in the final hallway

Every step matters. One mistake can send you falling into chaos.

When things go wrong, they go very wrong.

Characters react with dynamic ragdoll physics, turning every hit, fall, and trap into unpredictable moments of chaos.

Get launched by a hammer, thrown by a pendulum, or blasted off the course — the environment doesn't forgive mistakes.

Circus Survival isn't just a challenge.

It's a show.

A charismatic announcer watches your every move, reacting to your successes and failures as you struggle through the course.

Will you impress the audience…
or become the next spectacular failure?

Only the most determined challengers will survive the course and claim the $1,000,000 prize.

The question is simple:

How far can you make it?

Features

• Brutal obstacle course survival gameplay
• Precision platforming challenges
• Dynamic ragdoll physics
• Deadly traps and environmental hazards
• Snipers, mines, swinging pendulums and crushing gauntlets
• Game show atmosphere with a live announcer

4503970.name: Dual Cultivation Trainer
4503970.about_the_game:
For cultivators the path up the mountain is long and narrow.

Suyin was gifted with strong spiritual roots and natural aptitude. But fate has strangled her progress with an insurmountable bottle-neck. Now, the jade beauty has come to you — the old monster of the abandoned monastery —with a desperate plea. Dual cultivation — the forbidden art of cultivating through sex — it's the only technique that can push her through. If her sect discovers what she's doing, she'll be expelled, her name erased, and her cultivation crippled. But if she succeeds...

What you do with this arrangement — whether you guide her to a righteous breakthrough or somewhere darker — is entirely up to you.

Train. Teach. Corrupt — or don't.

Dual Cultivation Trainer is an erotic trainer with a branching corruption and relationship system that evolves as you train Suyin in five forbidden techniques.

  • Tongue of the Serpent — Trace the path. Stay in the channel. When she grips the sheets, you're doing it right.

  • Meridian Mapping — Find every spot that makes her gasp. Hit them in the right order. Hold pressure until she can't keep quiet.

  • Breath of Still Water — Let her take you deep. Match the rhythm. Ride the surges without gagging her on the wave.

  • Spirit Cartography — Her body hides what it wants under silk and composure. Read the heat with your hands.

  • Jade Gate Tempering — The dark gate. Angle, depth, rhythm — slow until she stops clenching, then as deep as she can take.

Corruption Is a Real Choice

The forbidden path is faster with stronger techniques, faster qi regeneration and access to the Hunt — seducing and draining rival cultivators for their qi. It's the optimal strategy, but it will change her. The woman who flinched at your touch on day one will become something else entirely.  There are four tiers of transformation — Righteous, Wavering, Fallen, Demonic — each influencing how she speaks, looks, what she wants and what she's willing to do.

The path you walk together determines which of the seven endings you reach.

4504050.name: The Fifteenth: A Pluvial Prelude
4504050.about_the_game:
游戏介绍：

《7月15日雨夜：前传》是一款以本世纪初广东汕头为背景的推理悬疑AVG，包含地图探索、点击解谜、家族伦理等元素，拥有丰富的剧情支线。游戏采用逐章更新形式，目前第一章文本量为10万字以上，CG数400张以上，人物立绘及细致拆分700张以上。玩家可在游戏场景中通过点击、对话等形式欣赏剧情及自由探索，推理案件真相。

故事内容：

2000年，主人公冼夏涛因为一场意外亲眼目睹弟弟惨死，模糊的凶手身影和巨大的愧疚成为日日惊扰他的梦魇。两个月后，冼夏涛收到一封神秘信件，信中邀请他前往位于广东汕头的奇瑶坞教堂，称那里有他最想要的东西。为了查清案件背后的真相，他毅然只身赴约，只愿弥补那无法挽回的过错。而令冼夏涛未曾想到的是，被想要的东西吸引而来的并不仅仅只有他，而这也不仅仅之是一场简单的游戏……

人物介绍：

冼夏涛：白手起家的商业精英，为追查杀害自己弟弟的真凶被卷入一系列事件中。

张明诚：影视歌三栖艺人，总是笑眯眯的，在年轻一代中拥有超高人气。

吴万茜：在某次意外事件中被救下来的少女，温和怯懦，有些时候却意外地强势。

洪丽波：玉龙首席执行官，拥有着极强的洞察力与蛊惑人心的手段，视家族利益高于一切。

洪志祯：总是跟在洪丽波身边的神秘男子，患有眼疾。

洪可辛：当地最大的水产商，掌管着庞大的渔业生意，性格暴躁但重视家人。

葛明云海：同为高人气影视歌三栖艺人，似乎和张明诚有些不对付。

周林氏：一心想要帮助弱势群体的私人律师，掌握着诸多案件的关键线索。

林波：为了寻找恩人的下落四处走访，体能很好，具备优秀的侦察与反侦察技术。

声明：

本游戏内容纯属虚构，所有人物、事件、地点等均为艺术创作，与现实中的任何个人、团体、事件无关，如有雷同，纯属巧合。

本游戏中所有角色的一切言行与价值观均不代表制作组立场。

本游戏包含轻度血腥暴力、惊悚表现与激烈言辞，并涉及对抑郁、焦虑、创伤后应激等心理状态描写，可能引起部分人群不适，敬请留意。

Features

■ Rich combinations of buildings and units, with powerful synergies between structures and troops to unleash explosive combo effects.

■ Integrates city management, resource control, and tile-linking mechanics, offering high replayability with a fresh experience every match.

■ Lightweight controls with no complicated micro-management. Command vast armies easily, balancing casual fun and deep strategy.

■ In-depth strategic gameplay: seizing neutral structures and using terrain effectively are critical, and smart decisions will lead you to victory with minimal effort.

Who Is This For

Whether you are a casual player who loves management or a strategy enthusiast who enjoys tactical competition, you will find your fun here.

Join Now

Join Battle Builds today and begin your fantasy conquest!

4504350.name: 26 Moves: The Queen's Plot
4504350.about_the_game:
"Are you the master of your own fate, or just a pawn in someone else’s game?"

In the shadows of a city that never forgives, a grand design is unfolding. 26 Moves: The Queen's Plot is a psychological noir point-and-click adventure where the truth is the most dangerous piece on the board.

Relive History’s Most Defining Moments
War of Ancestors isn't just a shooter; it’s a playable archive. Step into the boots of soldiers and civilians whose voices have been lost to time. From the birth of a nation to its greatest internal conflict, you will engage in tactical FPS combat across three iconic eras:

  • The American Civil War: Experience the grit and tragedy of a house divided.

  • Untold Perspectives: Play as characters based on real-world accounts that rarely make it into textbooks.

  • Authentic Arsenal: Master the weaponry of the 18th and 19th centuries, from flintlock muskets and bayonets to rifled carbines.

4504510.name: The Great Exhibition
4504510.about_the_game:
The Great Exhibition is searching for its next curator. The job requires you to venture into lost temples to acquire the greatest collection of ancient artifacts for the museum. Keep growing the collection, increase our prestige, and descend ever deeper.

Delve into Lost Temples

As the head curator, you venture into long forgotten tombs of old. The path to greatness is blocked by countless lethal traps and mind-bending puzzles. Become an expert archaeologist and find your Magnum Opus. 

Curate the Collection

As the head curator, you manage the collection. Arranging the displays in the most prestigious way. Gather sets of artifacts to boost their value and attract the attention of world renowned explorers.

Venture ever Deeper

As the head curator, you venture ever deeper into the tombs. Purchase specialized equipment and finance expeditions to unexplored lands. A good memory will suit you well as all tombs are connected in more ways than you imagine.

Attract the World’s Attention

As the head curator, all eyes are on you! Sway the experts and gain access to the most prestigious archaeologist clubs.

Mysteries

As the head curator, you are in charge of the narrative. What stories underpin these civilizations? What ties them all together? The artifacts are like pages in a book, what does their ending mean for us? And above all... what happened to Mr. Silas Vane?

4504600.name: Anti-Anti-Cheat: a musical action game
4504600.about_the_game:
Anti-Anti-Cheat is a musical action game where you must dodge numerous enemy bullets that appear in rhythm with the music. Can you defeat the Anti-Cheat?

Game features:

  • Dynamic, high-quality soundtrack

  • The entire environment moves in rhythm with the music

  • Numerous enemy bullets

4504610.name: Paralegal
4504610.about_the_game:
Jump into the stress of the working world, as [Law firm's name here]'s newest Paralegal.

Do important and fulfilling tasks, such as

bringing coffee

sorting decades old files

letting a client scream at you over the phone or in real life.

In this game, you live through a fast paced work environment, every wasted second is a client that's gonna be mad or another task piling up.

Run from the phone, to your desk, to the printer, to the lawyer's office upstairs and back to the phone just to find out the client was calling the wrong law firm.

Respond to all the emails, finish all your weekly tasks, make sure the lawyers calendars are up to speed and run from station to station, fulfilling menial tasks under the pressure of the next phone call already ringing.

Spend week after week, paycheck to paycheck trying to survive and renovating your run down flat. Just make sure your work performance is good enough or you might get fired. Remember, you are replacable.

In this 2d side-scroller, you run from place to place, trying to fulfill all tasks, most of them by doing point, click, drag and drop minigames, all of this under the limited time of the day. Each week your performance will be evaluated and you get your salary which manages to barely feed yourself and maybe your pet, just to use whatever's left to renovate and decorate your home in the way you want.

4504620.name: Hacker CLIcker
4504620.about_the_game:
Hacker Clicker is the classic idle clicker loop everyone already knows, except now it looks like you are doing something wildly illegal and at least mildly impressive.

Smash your mouse button or keyboard for data. Buy sketchy upgrades. Automate the grind. Pretend this is productivity.

For advanced operators, windowed mode is available so your desktop can still look professional.

And yes, every 3 hours, some mysterious pieces of data may quietly drop into your Steam Inventory.

IF YOU REALLY CARE, THE DROP CHANCES LOOK LIKE THIS

  • Cached — 81.01%

  • Leaked — 15.00%

  • Breached — 3.00%

  • Classified — 0.90%

  • Blacklisted — 0.08%

  • Ghost Archive — 0.01%

4504630.name: 人性游戏
4504630.about_the_game:
Game Background

“The Human Game” is a battle of humanity waged with life as the stake. Jingchuan and An’nan, underground debt slaves, risk their lives on a hundred‑meter high steel bridge to break free. After surviving, they fall into a greater conspiracy: the mysterious tycoon Zhou Muyun experiments on human nature and controls everything with the Messiah System.

From deadly crises and psychological struggles to street chases and uncovering the truth of their father’s lab, they face the ultimate choice between survival and loyalty. When facing the fatal danger of being sealed in cement, they defy cold data control with a bond stronger than instinct, proving that the light of humanity can never be defined by algorithms.

Key Features

  • Investigation

    Players conduct investigations to obtain different items.

  • Choice

    Player decisions shape the direction of the story.

  • Strategy

    Choosing when to buy items affects the ending.

  • Reaction

    Quick, correct responses determine story progress.

  • Branching Paths

    Different branches unlock unique items and story routes.

*languages with full audio support

4504640.name: Emi's Solo Ghost Hunting 2
4504640.about_the_game:
Emi's Solo Ghost Hunting 2 is a 2D survival horror game based on the story of a solo paranormal investigator called Emi, who got a call from a client in order to investigate a haunted property called The Cold House, located just beside a cemetery in California, for proof of the paranormal.

The Cold House was built during the 1800s just on the opposite side of a cemetery located in California by the owner, Tobey Cold. He, along with his wife Mary, lived there happily until the day something tragic happened. Mary accidentally fell down the stairs and died on the spot. It is believed that her spirit still lingers in that house. Later, during the 1900s, he sold the house to Mr. James, who was a popular singer at that time. But during the 1930s, he died in a car accident. It is reported that his spirit still resides in that house, and the sound of guitar playing is often heard.

The house was then sold to the grandfather of Ms. Anna, the current owner of the house, who inherited the property after her father's demise. Since the 2000s, she has lived with her family in that house. They have been experiencing paranormal activities, which include furniture movement, an old guitar playing on its own, knocks on the doors, disembodied voices, weird noises coming from the basement area, dark apparitions, etc. So, Anna called Emi, the solo paranormal investigator, to investigate the property for documenting the paranormal activities.

You play as Emi, the paranormal investigator, and will you be able to help out your client, Miss Anna?

Key Features:

  • Explore the entire area of a haunted house in California!
  • Come face-to-face with the trapped spirits and demons!
  • Collect items like keys, urns, guitar etc.
  • Make use of the various paranormal equipment like night vision camera, full spectrum camera, EMF meter, EVP recorder etc.
  • Explore unknown area and avoid deadly traps, like fire, demon arms etc.
  • Around half an hour of paranormal investigation.

Warning:

This game contains flashing lights which may not be suitable for people with epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. Player discretion is advised.

4504680.name: Laika Space Adventure
4504680.about_the_game:
This game is about an alternate reality where the space dog named Laika survived the flight and crashed on Mars. You must learn to live on a harsh and unforgiving red planet, manage your oxygen, monitor temperature at nights, and mine meteors to build greenhouses. You will have to farm crops to sustain yourself and not die of hunger.

Key Features

• Survive in a hostile Martian environment
• Manage oxygen and temperature systems
• Farm crops to obtain food
• Mine meteors across the map
• Emotional survival gameplay

4504690.name: Caroline's Underworld
4504690.about_the_game: Caroline's Underworld is a gothic fantasy RPG with interactive storytelling elements. Caroline finds herself lost in the underworld after following a suspicious goat down a rabbit hole. Now she must find a way out before she forgets herself and where she came from. Navigate through a weird and whimsical underworld, complete quests, meet interesting creatures, and solve puzzles to uncover the way forward.

4504710.name: Conquest
4504710.about_the_game: Conquest is a strategy board game where you fight against up to 7 computer or human controlled opponents to take over the world before you are eliminated by your enemies. From your starting territories launch attacks on surrounding enemy held territories. Try and capture entire continents for extra reinforcements at the start of your next turn. Once you've mastered the 'World' map there are 55 extra maps to play on. The Artificial Intelligence of the computer opponents is particularly strong and you'll have to fight hard to beat them!

4504720.name: Hentai Hijinks, Edge of oops
4504720.about_the_game:
Take a break and enjoy a relaxing puzzle experience featuring a collection of beautifully illustrated anime characters. Each level challenges you to complete a puzzle while revealing a high-quality image of a stylish anime heroine.

The gameplay is simple and satisfying: select a puzzle, assemble the pieces, and complete the image at your own pace. Once finished, you can download the completed artwork and add it to your personal collection.

With multiple illustrations to solve and a calm atmosphere, it’s a straightforward puzzle experience designed for players who enjoy sensual anime art and relaxing gameplay.

4504730.name: 澄心大学
4504730.about_the_game:
欢迎来到澄心大学！

《澄心大学》是一款校园题材的剧情养成视觉小说。你将以大学新生的身份进入澄心大学，在校园生活中安排课程、参与社团与部门事务、结识性格各异的伙伴，并在一次次选择中，逐步走近四位截然不同的少女。

看似平静而明亮的校园日常背后，藏着每个人不愿轻易示人的另一面。你的每一次行动、每一次对话、每一次关键节点的决定，都将影响角色关系的发展，也将把故事引向不同的分支与结局。

这是一个关于青春、心动、成长与取舍的故事。你会在热闹鲜活的大学生活中体验相遇与陪伴，也会在情感与现实的碰撞中面对犹豫、错过与选择。属于你的大学篇章，将从这里开始。

游戏特色

多分支剧情体验
在校园主线之外，逐步解锁不同角色的专属剧情，走向各不相同的情感发展与个人结局。

兼具日常感与情感张力的校园故事
轻松明快的大学生活、层层推进的人物关系，以及在平静表象之下逐渐浮现的复杂情绪，共同构成这段独特的青春旅程。

角色介绍

商翎

冷静、克制、难以接近，似乎总与他人保持着恰到好处的距离。可当你真正靠近时，才会发现她的疏离之下藏着极强的原则感，以及不愿轻易示弱的柔软一面。与她的相处，并不是简单的热烈靠近，而是在一次次试探与理解中，慢慢走进她真正的内心。

牧野

她看起来轻松、随性、充满亲和力，总能以自然的方式拉近人与人之间的距离。但越是相处，就越能察觉她并不像表面那样无忧无虑。她擅长把情绪藏在笑意里，也擅长在玩笑与真心之间维持微妙平衡。越是靠近，越会被她表象之下的真实所吸引。

澜汐

安静、温柔、带着若即若离的疏淡气质，仿佛始终与周围保持着一步之遥。她并不张扬，也不会轻易表达自己，却总能在不经意的细节里留下最深的印象。平静从来不是没有情绪，而是把难以言说的一切都藏得更深。她的路线，是一段细水长流却格外难忘的靠近。

白芨

温柔、细致、可靠，似乎总能在别人最狼狈或最需要帮助的时候，恰到好处地伸出手。她擅长照顾人，也擅长处理那些容易被忽略的细节；对小动物和孩子尤其耐心，待人总是体贴而克制。可越是接近，越会发现她的温柔并不只是单纯的亲切，而是一种习惯于把情绪收好、不轻易给别人添麻烦的成熟。她像一阵安静的风，不喧哗，却会在不经意间留下最深的余温。

其他角色

除了四位女主之外，你还将在澄心大学遇见更多重要角色。
他们有的是校园生活中的同行者，有的是推动剧情发展的关键人物，也有人会在某些时刻悄然改变你与他人之间的关系走向。

这些配角共同构成了澄心大学完整而鲜活的群像，让这段大学时光不仅仅是恋爱故事的舞台，也成为一个真实、热闹、复杂而值得回望的世界

邓金一

动物健康学院辅导员。身材娇小，气场却一点不小，做事利落、效率惊人，几句话就足以让人瞬间站直。她对待学生并不温吞，甚至称得上严厉，但那份压迫感背后，是对规则、秩序与责任的高度认真。她是会让人紧张的老师，也是关键时刻足够可靠的存在。

牟艺霖

外表甜美、擅长社交，总能用自然又亲切的方式迅速融入人群。她很懂得如何经营气氛，也很懂得如何在恰到好处的时候表现自己。只是那份过于熟练的从容背后，似乎还藏着更锋利的一面。她的笑容是真诚还是试探，她的靠近是善意还是计算，往往没有表面看上去那么简单。

谢吉

校学生会主席，能力出众，执行果断，始终带着不容置疑的掌控力。无论是后台统筹、现场调度，还是面对突发状况时的临场判断，他都能迅速稳住局面。可在强势与锋利之外，他也并非一味冰冷，而是比任何人都更明白成长与压力意味着什么。对他而言，真正重要的从来不是完美无缺，而是在混乱中学会站稳脚跟。

赵嘉豪

沉默、理性、话少到近乎冷硬，总给人一种难以接近的距离感。他习惯用规则、逻辑与数据看待问题，不喜欢无意义的热闹，也不擅长把情绪摊开来说。可正因如此，他的认真、克制与判断力也格外鲜明。比起讨人喜欢，他更在意事情是否严谨、是否成立，而那份近乎执拗的认真，恰恰构成了他最鲜明的锋芒。

林亦菲

外表时髦、表达直接，看起来像是那种轻松融入人群、很懂气氛的人。她对流行、宣传和沟通节奏有着天然的敏锐，也总能迅速抓住“怎样才能让人注意到”的关键。可在看似随性的表象之下，她同样有自己的自尊、脆弱与不愿被轻视的一面。她不是单纯浮于表面的热闹，而是一个在情绪与好胜心中都格外鲜活的人。

李浩然

协会服务部副部长，稳重、理智、可靠，是那种会让人下意识觉得“有他在就不会乱”的前辈。他擅长在复杂事务中迅速理清重点，也擅长用平和的方式把压力拆解开来。比起锋芒毕露，他更像团队里那个始终在线的支点——既有处理问题的能力，也有照顾后辈、让人安心的分寸感。

周雨

同为协会服务部副部长，她温和、细心，待人自然不生硬，总能先一步照顾到他人的情绪与状态。比起单纯强调效率，她更在意一件事是否“有人味”，也更敏锐于团队中那些容易被忽略的摩擦与疲惫。她让规则不至于显得冰冷，也让忙乱的部门生活多出几分柔软和缓冲，是那种会让人不自觉想依赖的存在。

4504740.name: Blowhard
4504740.about_the_game:
Blowhard is a leaf-blowing adventure game set in the picturesque English village of Netherpuddling.

You are Francis - a local contractor armed with a high-decibel leaf blower and a complete lack of social awareness. Desperate to escape the village, you're clearing away the leaves to raise funds. But the "autumn clutter" is the least of your worries. Between the stubborn wet leaves and the even more stubborn residents, each blow brings you closer to solving the mystery of the elusive Sycamore Slayer.

Features include:

  • Blow away the leaves. Complete jobs all over the village, and surrounding areas

  • Solve a world of puzzles through the art of blowing.

  • Meet the residents. Deafen them, ruin their selfies, and find other ways to annoy with a leaf-blower

  • Upgrade your machinery. Can leaf blowers suck? They can with enough hard-earned cash!

  • Root out the mystery and put a stop to the Sycamore Slayer's nefarious scheme

4504810.name: Omnicore: Freiza's Retribution
4504810.about_the_game:
- 🌌 Procedurally generated galaxy

   - ⭐ 400+ star systems across 5 hostile zones

   - 👾 150+ enemy types across ground and space

   - 🏹 15 tower classes with unique abilities

   - 🪐 14 planetary biomes with environmental hazards

   - 💰 3 trading game modes: Auction, Bomb Draw, and Stock Exchange

   - 👑 Conquer, govern, and tax your vassal stars — their happiness shapes the fate of your empire

   - 🚀 Deep-space exploration with resource gathering and dangerous frontier expeditions

   - 🛠 Full battlefield crafting for survival, adaptation, and momentum

   - 🔮 Equivalent-exchange transmutation that turns surplus matter into the resources you need most

   - 🎙 Voiced storylines in 7 languages: English, Russian, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, French, and Spanish

   - ⚔ Timeline-based tactical ship combat

   - 🤖 5 autonomous faction AI systems

   - ⏳ 500+ hours of gameplay

The Plague Tide consumes the galaxy. Five warlords carve what remains. In desperation, Chancellor Aldric reaches across time — and  summons you. A wizard from a forgotten age. Your mission: reclaim over 400 star systems across 5 hostile zones.

 You are not ready for this.

 A procedurally generated galaxy sprawls before you. Five factions with autonomous AI expand every 21 days, devouring your borders. Tax your vassals too hard and they rebel. Ignore a frontier and watch it dissolve. There are three ways to lose. Exactly one way to win.

 When night falls, everything wants you dead. 71+ enemy types swarm — ground crawlers, wall-phasing hunters, flying beholders, siege ents, and 10 bosses that will end your run. Build mazes. Place towers. Craft on the battlefield — but if enemies destroy your table mid-build, everything is lost. Night doesn't end on a timer. It ends when every last enemy falls. Or when you do.

 When dawn breaks, you dig. Beneath every conquered planet lies ore, oil, and diamonds. Drill through alien rock. Lay pipe networks to hidden oil pockets. Deploy autonomous workers. The sand orb — a glowing sphere collecting your haul — expires in 10 seconds. Deposit it or lose everything. The clock never stops.

 When credits run dry, you trade. Auctions with real-time descending prices. 20 NPC competitors — the Impulse Buyer grabs fast, the Shark bluffs high, the Calculator never overpays. 32 Fate Cards flip the table: Monopoly, Sabotage, Market Crash. Then the Bomb Draw. Pull profit cards one by one — but 15% are bombs. Push your luck or walk away with nothing.

  Intergalactic Stock Exchange is always open, waiting to test your genius against a living market. If you’ve got the brains to read the swings and make the right calls, credits will come easy, and in this galaxy, credits are the lifeblood of survival, expansion, and power.

Bomb Draw is where cargo becomes cash. Dutch Auction gets the goods into your hold, but Bomb Draw is where you turn nerve, timing, and greed into a mountain of credits. Learn how to play both systems together and you can build a fortune fast, but every card is a wager, and luck can just as easily leave you with nothing but smoke.

---

When factions push into your territory, you fight. Drop onto hostile planets. 14 biomes, each one killing you differently. Ice worlds where you can't stop sliding. Crystal caverns that reflect your bullets back. Arenas that shrink until there's nowhere left.  At the highest difficulty, 15 enemies spawn instantly. The last waves get 3x HP. Pure adrenaline.

 When empires crumble, you battle among the stars. Timeline-based tactical combat. Both ships race a shared bar — reach 100 first, you act. Bullets cost 20 time. Lasers cost 70. Outplay the clock. Cloakers vanish and ambush for double damage. Vampires drain your hull to heal themselves. And to destroy a faction HQ, you face the Gauntlet — up to 22 consecutive battles. No healing. One loss means total failure.

 Everything is connected. The ore you mine fuels the ship that carries you to the auction that funds the upgrades that let you survive the arena that claims the planet that expands the empire you must defend when night falls again. One galaxy. One war. It never stops.

 ---

Voiced Worlds

 Every war cry, betrayal, and final stand comes alive through fully voiced storylines in 7 languages:

 - English

 - Russian

 - Arabic

 - Chinese

 - Japanese

 - French

 - Spanish

 The UI is currently in English only, but full interface translations for all supported languages are coming soon.

4504840.name: Secret Files: Tunguska - Remastered
4504840.about_the_game:
A Critically Acclaimed Classic in a New Light

Secret Files: Tunguska – Remastered is the modernized edition of the award-winning point & click adventure from 2006 – technically enhanced and visually improved, while staying true to the spirit of the original.

Experience one of the most successful adventure games of its time in a new form and join Nina and Max on a globe-spanning investigation.

A Catastrophe That Changes Everything

Central Siberia, 1908: A massive explosion devastates the Tunguska region, leaving behind a mystery that remains unsolved to this day.

Almost a century later, scientist Vladimir Kalenkow disappears without a trace. His daughter Nina sets out on a desperate search – only to uncover clues that go far beyond a simple missing persons case. It soon becomes clear: her father’s fate is inextricably linked to the Tunguska event.

Together with Max, she follows a trail that leads from Berlin to Russia and Ireland, on to Cuba, and into the most remote regions of the world. But they are not alone: secret services, ruthless organizations, and a mysterious sect will stop at nothing to keep the truth buried.

The closer Nina and Max get to the truth, the greater the danger becomes – because they are not only searching for Nina’s father, but for a secret that was never meant to be uncovered.

A Globe-Spanning Adventure

  • Travel to diverse and exotic locations

One in a Thousand is a minimalistic and cozy hidden-object game about the quiet joy of searching for four-leaf clover, just like you did when you were younger and carefree. Take a moment to slow down, look closely, and train your eye to recognize the subtle patterns that will lead to your lucky find.

What awaits you

  • Find the four-leaf clover hidden in a patch full of clovers, in an almost realistic environment (~1 in 2,500 chance in-game vs ~1 in 5,000 in real life).

  • Discover 10 authentic leaflet patterns and shapes inspired by real wild clovers found in grass patches around Piedmont (Italy).

  • Keep a collection book that tracks every four-leaf clovers you find, and uncover new notes as you progress — botanical curiosities, inspirational quotes, and gameplay hints.

  • Stumble upon ladybugs hidden under the clovers; they may nudge you toward what you're really looking for (but you can also explore without them for a more true-to-life challenge).

[h1]Your Genes Are Your Cards[/h1]

Gene Jackpot is a roguelike deckbuilder where you gamble with your own genetic code.

You are G-00, a gene experiment. To escape a biotech corporation's underground lab, you must weaponize your own DNA. Play a Strength gene and your arm grows massive. Play a Toxin gene and your skin discolors. Play an Electric gene and your nervous system overloads.

Mutation System

  • Mutation Gauge — Reach 100% to evolve into a perfect form... or collapse

  • Roguelike Deckbuilding — Fresh card combinations and mutation paths every run
  • Biopunk World — A gene experiment's escape story. Each run reveals more of the truth
  • 4 Playable Characters — Each with unique starter decks and mutation traits
  • Research Hub — Between runs: NPC dialogue, upgrades, and codex
  • Ascender System — Increasing difficulty tiers as you clear runs
  • Procedural Coding Art — All visuals generated entirely by code. A unique art style like no other

Story


"The Genesis Project" — a secret project to break the limits of human genetics. Among hundreds of failed experiments, G-00 is the only stable subject. As you awaken and attempt to escape, the lab's secrets, the truth about the experiments, and the existence of "the Original" unfold with every run.

4505290.name: Chessillo
4505290.about_the_game:
Build your army. Break the enemy strategy. Defeat the 3 kings.



Chessillo is a tactical chess roguelike where every run challenges you to build an army strong enough to survive 3 acts and defeat 3 enemy kings.


Recruit pieces, combine faction abilities, and adapt your strategy from battle to battle. It is not just about making the right move: it is about creating a composition that can bend the rules of the board.

Build a different strategy every run



Every victory opens up new decisions. Recruit pieces, improve your composition, and turn ordinary units into the key pieces of your army.


Sometimes the best choice is to strengthen your plan. Other times, it is sacrificing a piece that no longer fits. Each run pushes you to find new synergies, improvise with what you are offered, and discover combinations you did not expect.

Three princes, three ways to play



Every run begins with an important choice: which character will lead your army.


The 3 characters in Chessillo each have their own passive and unique faction abilities, pushing you toward different strategies from the very first battle. Some favor adaptation, others reward more specialized compositions, and others change how you manage your pieces throughout the run.


Choose your starting point. Then improvise.

Not every battle is won the same way


In Chessillo, clearing pieces without thinking is not enough. Each battle can have a different objective, and understanding it in time can be the difference between a clean victory and a ridiculous defeat.


Regicide — capture the enemy king.

Survival — last the required number of turns or eliminate the threats.

Elimination — leave no enemy piece standing.


The strongest army will not always be the one that deals the most damage. Sometimes you will need to control the board, protect a key piece, or survive one more turn.

Survive 3 acts and overthrow the 3 kings



At the end of each act, an enemy king awaits with their own abilities and an exclusive event designed to put your strategy under pressure.


A comfortable composition can suddenly stop working. Improve your pieces, reorganize your army, and adapt your plan before the next king makes you pay for your bad decisions.

Main features


  • A tactical roguelike inspired by chess.
  • Runs divided into 3 acts.
  • 3 characters with their own passives and unique faction abilities.
  • Recruitable pieces that can gain abilities from different factions.
  • More than 36 abilities to discover and combine.
  • 3 battle types: Regicide, Survival, and Elimination.
  • Forge upgrades, events, and decisions between acts.
  • 3 enemy kings with their own abilities.

Build your army. Survive the 3 acts. Overthrow the 3 kings.

4505500.name: MergePiece: Merge pixels into masterpieces
4505500.about_the_game:
🎨 MergePiece — One Color at a Time, Restoring Timeless Masterpieces

MergePiece is a pixel-merging puzzle game themed around world-famous paintings. On the board, every color fragment originates from a real masterpiece — your mission is to merge them back into the complete artwork.

How to Play

The core rule is simple yet profound: scattered across the board are tiles, each carrying ultimate colors. Click an empty cell — if two or more colored tiles are adjacent to it (up, down, left, or right), they will converge toward the center and merge, stacking their colors as the count decreases. Repeat until only one tile remains, all colors reunited, and the masterpiece is restored before your eyes.

It sounds simple, but it demands sharp spatial reasoning and careful layout planning — every move counts, and once you reach a deadlock, there is no way forward.

Key Features

🖼️ 200 World-Famous Paintings
From the Mona Lisa to The Starry Night, from Vermeer to Van Gogh, the game features over a hundred masterworks spanning the Renaissance to Impressionism. Each work includes the artist's biography, creation date, and museum collection — enriching your mind while you solve puzzles.

🧩 Deep Puzzles, Step by Step
Every level is unique yet always solvable. Difficulty scales gradually — master the rhythm early, then push the limits of spatial thinking in later stages.

⚙️ Rich Special Cell Mechanics
As you progress, the board introduces new variables: restricted cells (merge-blocking obstacles), portals (one-way/two-way spatial jumps), locks & keys (sequence-based unlock puzzles), and void cells (impassable areas) — ensuring each painting's restoration feels fresh and surprising.

☁️ Steam Cloud Save & Achievements
Your progress is always saved and seamlessly synced across devices. Unlock multiple Steam achievements that mark every step of your connoisseur's journey.

🌐 Multi-Language Support
Available in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, French, and German — welcoming art lovers around the world.

Who Is This For?

·         Players who enjoy casual puzzles seeking a balance between relaxation and thought

·         Those interested in Western art history who want to expand their knowledge through gameplay

·         Puzzle enthusiasts addicted to the "aha moment" — when the right merge path suddenly clicks

Every click is a conversation with a master. Pick up the brush — you make the final stroke.

Note: A free playable Demo is available, featuring the first 20 masterworks, so you can experience the core gameplay anytime.

  • 😱 Berserk Mode: As your stress meter fills, you might snap! Lose control and start pummeling the Hero for real.

  • 📊 Damage Forecasting: Balance "restraint" and "theatricality" by checking your predicted DPS.

Pump up the Hero’s hype, stage a "near-death" thrill, and aim for a 5-star Customer Satisfaction rating!

🎭 Game Features

  • ✅ Host, Don't Slay: A genre-flipping parody that turns RPG tropes upside down.

  • ✅ Risk-Management Combat: Tense tactical battles where "over-performance" is your greatest enemy.

  • ✅ Training Simulation: Level up the Demon King’s stats to craft the perfect "Final Boss" performance.

  • ✅ Corporate Management: Upgrade facilities, manage the budget, and dispatch minions to keep the company running.

  • ✅ Sanity System: If the Demon King’s "Reason" drops too low, they lose control. Can you handle the pressure?

  • ✅ Random Events: Office parties, seasonal depression, the Hero’s blog going viral... you never know what’s coming next.

  • ✅ Middle-Manager Blues: Debt repayment, rent, and surprise audits. Even for a Demon King, life is a grind.

🎮 Genre

Command Battle RPG × Management Sim × Corporate Parody

4505530.name: Lucia Journey
4505530.about_the_game:
A Mind That Won’t Stay Quiet

Lucia Journey is a psychological narrative RPG about living with a mind that refuses to stay silent.

Follow Lucia, a girl struggling with major depressive disorder, as everyday life slowly begins to blur with unsettling hallucinations. What appears normal on the surface hides a constant internal battle — one that only she can hear.

Your choices shape how Lucia responds to the world around her, the people she meets, and the voices inside her mind.

Some decisions bring hope.
Others push her closer to the edge.

In Lucia’s story, every choice matters.

Confront the Voices Within

Lucia’s inner thoughts manifest as enemies during intense turn-based hallucination battles.

Instead of fighting monsters, Lucia faces distorted voices born from her own mind — doubt, fear, guilt, and crushing self-criticism.

Use different inner responses to resist the pressure and survive the mental storm.

A Story Shaped by Your Choices

Your decisions influence Lucia’s journey:

  • her mental state

  • relationships with others

  • how she confronts her struggles

Every choice carries consequences and leads to multiple endings, each reflecting the path Lucia ultimately takes.

A World That Begins to Distort

Lucia’s everyday life may seem ordinary, but moments of stress and emotional turmoil can cause reality to fracture into surreal hallucinations.

The world around Lucia gradually shifts between calm reality and disturbing distortions, revealing the fragile boundary between the two.

Key Features

  • A psychological narrative RPG about inner conflict and mental health

  • Choices that shape Lucia’s fate and lead to multiple endings

  • Unique turn-based hallucination battles against Lucia’s inner voices

  • A stylized world where reality and hallucination blur together

  • Emotional storytelling focused on struggle, identity, and recovery

4505600.name: Final Stand Waves
4505600.about_the_game:
Defend your tower against endless hordes of zombies in this 2D top-down game.

Eliminate as many enemies as possible and survive as long as you can. There are no winners, only the challenge of seeing how far you can go as the waves get increasingly difficult.

4505670.name: Hopfinity
4505670.about_the_game:
Master the Grapple

Unleash pixel-perfect swings to zip past hazards, chain hooks for momentum, and evade enemy pursuits, or grapple them to get a huge boost! One mistimed shot, and it could be game over!

Endless Procedural Worlds

No two ascents are the same! Caves twist with spikes and shadows, castles swarm with turret fire, skies erupt in Bombarder blasts. Chase high scores in an infinite upward spiral—unlock your true potential level by level.

Grab your grappling hook, Hopfinity's sky awaits!

4505680.name: The Unfamiliars
4505680.about_the_game:
A quiet rainy night in your remote mobile home was supposed to be peaceful.
But when distant sirens begin echoing across the countryside, something feels terribly wrong.

Grabbing your old VHS camcorder to document what’s happening, you begin recording the strange events unfolding outside your windows.

Unfamiliar figures appear in the darkness.
They knock.
They speak.

And whatever they are… they want inside.

Gameplay

The Unfamiliars is a first person atmospheric horror experience presented through a VHS camcorder perspective.

Players explore a small isolated mobile home while documenting strange and unsettling events unfolding outside during a rainy night. As time passes, unfamiliar figures begin appearing at windows and doors, creating tense encounters where players must decide how to react.

Watch the darkness outside, investigate strange sounds within the home, and experience a night that becomes increasingly disturbing.

Features

• First person atmospheric horror experience
• VHS camcorder visual style inspired by analog horror
• Exploration inside a small isolated home
• Unsettling encounters with mysterious figures outside
• Psychological horror focused on tension, atmosphere, and sound design

⚠️ CONTENT & HEALTH WARNINGS

This game contains: 

  • Flashing lights

  • Loud Sounds

  • Sudden visual effects

  • Dark and confined environments

  • Intense & Disturbing audio cues

  • Disturbing imagery and themes

Players sensitive to flashing lights, motion effects, or horror content should proceed with caution.

4505730.name: Gunmetal Rails
4505730.about_the_game:
Build a War Train. Survive the Wasteland.

Gunmetal Rails is a roguelite bullet hell where you build and arm a locomotive, cart by cart, weapon by weapon. Attach carts to your train, bolt guns into their slots, stack upgrades, and fight through waves of enemies that get nastier every round. How you build is how you survive.

Your Train, Your Rules

This isn't just stat-stacking. Your build is physical. Every weapon fires from its actual position on the cart. Every cart adds weight and slows you down. Every slot is a decision. Do you run three light carts with fast guns, or one heavy cart loaded with a legendary cannon? That's on you.

Features

  • Multiple unique locomotives — each with a passive mechanic that changes how you play

  • 150+ upgrade cards across 6 tiers — locomotive buffs and per-cart enhancements with real trade-offs

  • Dozens of weapons across multiple rarity tiers — from rapid-fire miniguns to explosive launchers

  • 3 cart types — Light (2 slots), Medium (4 slots), Heavy (8 slots)

  • Varied enemy types — including healers, bombers, stealth units, and bosses every 5 waves

  • Drag-and-drop cart management — slot weapons, reorder carts, apply upgrades between waves

  • Endless wave survival — how far can your build take you?

Choose Your Locomotive

Iron Horse — Balanced all-rounder. Hits harder with every cart you own.

Phantom Express — Glass cannon. 15% dodge, 15% crit, light carts have no speed penalty. Can't equip heavy carts.

War Rig — Slow tank. +5 armor, all weapons gain 10% explosion chance. Medium and heavy carts only.

Scrap Hauler — Economy engine. +30% gold, +1 shop card, 20% cheaper prices. -30% damage.

Early Access Roadmap

Gunmetal Rails is in active development. Here's what's planned:

  • More weapons, enemies, and bosses

  • More locomotives with wilder mechanics

  • Hand-drawn artwork replacing all placeholder visuals

  • Co-op multiplayer (2-4 players)

  • Steam achievements and cloud saves

  • Community-driven balance and content — your feedback shapes the game

Pricing Promise

The price will always remain the same. No price hikes at launch, no "early supporter" tax in reverse. If you buy in Early Access, you're getting the full game at the same price as everyone else. Early supporters just get more time with it.

Built With the Community

Gunmetal Rails is a solo-dev project, and the survivors-like genre thrives on variety and balance. Early Access isn't just about funding — it's about building the game with the people playing it. What weapons feel good? What builds are broken? What do you want to see next? That feedback drives development. Community will guide the balancing of the game, to ensure its available to everyone to enjoy.

4505740.name: Christopher Ledger: Corporate Auditor
4505740.about_the_game:
Objection. The courtroom isn't the only place where people lie.

Christopher Ledger: Corporate Auditor is a courtroom-style visual novel about corporate fraud, cover-ups, and the billion-dollar scandals hiding in plain sight in every corner office.

You play as Christopher Ledger, an auditor investigating shady corporations — cross-examining executives, tracing evidence, and unravelling conspiracies one contradiction at a time.

Key Features:

  • Dramatic cross-examinations — audit style

  • Flight Risk encounters — stop CEOs from fleeing mid-audit by switching between party members to persuade or disrupt them

  • Equip and use items purchased from the store directly from your inventory — no courtroom rules here

  • A story rooted in real corporate fraud history

Christopher Ledger: Corporate Auditor is a planned five-episode detective series. Expect a playtime similar to other courtroom Visual Novels. 

Episode 1 launches free in mid-August 2026, followed by the full series via Kickstarter.

Wishlist now to be notified the moment Episode 1 drops!

4505760.name: Polter Geists
4505760.about_the_game:
**Death isn't the end of your problems. It's just the beginning of a really weird management sim.**

Welcome to Polter Geists, a creature collecting RPG that traded tall grass for haunted graveyards. The world of Ohm is already dead, the towns are full of skeletons, and absolutely nobody has time for your nonsense. Instead of making friends with cute animals, you are aggressively stuffing spectral nightmares into magical flying coffins.

**Weaponized Hauntings**

The creatures you collect are called Geists, and their designs are beautifully unhinged from raven spirits that stalk prey in silence to stubby phantoms stuck inside fossils. Every Geist you catch features completely randomized genetics, meaning no two monsters are the same. Sift through the decayed husks of spirits to build the perfect team, or sacrifice your free time hunting for incredibly rare "Shiny" variants with 1 in 100000 drop rates.

**Strategic Turn Based Combat**

Button mashing will get you killed. The combat system is a masterclass in resource management. You have to balance Stamina for attacking and blocking, Spirit for casting spells, and a Power meter that unlocks your most devastating moves. The game respects your intelligence, and the undead will absolutely destroy sloppy tacticians.

**An Unhinged Goth Punk World**

Explore 28 different archetype biomes ranging from Abyssal craters with impossible geometry to Dream realms with reversed gravity. But the real star is the locals. The world building is a canvas for dark comedy. You will get roasted by skeleton guards, pressured into drinking highly questionable potions by alchemists, and uncover literal game exploits from embarrassed townsfolk.

**The Fate of Ohm**

Confront a terrifyingly polite Vampire Lord and punch your way through a supernatural mafia built entirely on bones. The villains here don't scream or throw tantrums they speak in dark, cryptic poetry and casually sentence you to death with the grace of a host offering you a cup of tea.

Polter Geists balances perfectly on a razor edge, using the macabre as a staging ground for dark, sly humor. It's fearless, poetic, and beautifully off kilter.

Enter the abyss. The world is only going to get weirder from here.

4505860.name: Jax Vs. The World

4506000.name: Click & Mine

You will use mined resources to unlock upgrades which in turn will allow you to mine more effectively.

4506040.name: Super Disposition
4506040.about_the_game:
Super Disposition is a physics-driven action adventure set on a mysterious alien world.

Control a small android that can roll as a fast moving ball or transform into a rocket to fly freely through the environment. Use momentum, gravity, and precise control to explore dangerous landscapes and hidden areas.

The game combines exploration, combat, and puzzles across levels that constantly change gameplay perspective.

Total Movement Freedom

Dynamic Camera Gameplay

Gameplay shifts between multiple perspectives:

  • Third-person exploration

  • Fixed camera perspectives

  • 2.5D gameplay sections

Combat and Action

  • Destructible environments

Puzzles and Challenges

Explore a strange alien world, overcome mechanical and organic threats, and master the movement.

4506060.name: Scrap Syndicate
4506060.about_the_game:
WELCOME TO THE GIG ECONOMY AT THE END OF THE UNIVERSE.

The planetary economy is a joke, and pride won't pay your oxygen bill. That’s why you sold out to the Scrap Syndicate.

They operate on the absolute fringes, salvaging the radioactive orbital sectors no one else has the stomach to touch. This gives them untracked tech, total autonomy, and the capital to run illegal underground death pits.

Your job is to buy a disposable, rusty chassis, bolt on whatever salvaged plating and illegal weaponry you can afford, and throw it into the meat grinder. If your math is right, you get a cut of the glory and a heavy payday.

SYNDICATE BENEFITS PACKAGE (FEATURES):

  • Zero-Effort Auto-Farming: You don't actually fight. You're upper management. Bolt the junk together, toggle 'AUTO ON', and go make a sandwich while your monstrosity gets repeatedly dismantled in the arena. Grind scrap and let brutal attrition do the heavy lifting while you AFK.

  • Duct-Tape Engineering: Manage four dedicated hardpoints—Head, Chassis, Left Arm, and Right Arm. Balance the physical weight of your weapons against your bot's speed and heat generation, or watch it immediately collapse under the sheer mass of your own terrible design choices.

  • The Garbage Collider (Supply Grinder): Take your meager arena winnings, crack open salvaged crates, and violently smash duplicate pieces of junk together until they magically molecularly fuse into high-tier, experimental weaponry.

  • Survivorship Bias (Progression): The bots that don't immediately explode gain experience. Level up their core framework and tweak their base stats so they can survive exactly 4 seconds longer in the next pit.

  • The Ladder of Regret (The Gauntlet): Think you built the perfect, unkillable machine? Drop it into the Gauntlet to face an escalating ladder of Apex bots. It's a ruthless, completely unfair battle of attrition against underground bosses. Lose once, and your ladder progress is instantly vaporized. No checkpoints. No crying.

The hustle isn't pretty, but it pays. Build your trash. Enter the pit. Try to make rent.

4506110.name: Escape From Ground
4506110.about_the_game:
Climb endlessly through a procedurally generated world where every run feels different. Bounce across unique platforms, dodge strange creatures, and react quickly as the environment constantly changes while you push higher and higher.

Player jumping upward through platforms, procedural platform generation, biome transitions.

Use powerful boosts to reach new heights. Fly with jetpacks, launch yourself with mega jumps, and become temporarily invincible to break through dangers. Master the timing and keep climbing to beat your best score.

Jetpack boost, mega jump launch, invincibility passing through enemies.

Dunjourney is a time-limited, turn-based roguelike RPG.

Players are challenged to make optimal decisions within a strict time limit.

For every action you take, the enemies take one as well. Simple yet deeply strategic, a thrilling dungeon exploration awaits where a single step can mean the difference between life and death.

● The Dungeon

The labyrinth's layout and enemy placements are randomly generated every time you step foot inside.

Along the way, you will discover shops selling valuable goods and encounter unpredictable random events.

And at the deepest level of each area, formidable bosses lie in wait.

● Items & Equipment

The wide variety of items you uncover in the dungeon are vital to your survival.

Collect powerful gear to prepare yourself for the harrowing challenges of the deeper floors.

4506510.name: Again!? Yakuza: Reclaim Power, Interrogate Bodies, Subjugate
4506510.about_the_game:
What will a Yakuza Boss who has been expelled from his own clan do?

A visual novel, a point-and-click detective set in a noir atmosphere and the mundane details of life, with complete freedom of choice, movement, and various ways of obtaining evidence! A heavy city atmosphere where everyone has their own life, their own goals and desires. Helping the former Boss? That's not their duty!

  • Over 120 images of girls, each with her own reasons for agreeing to this

  • 5 girls, each can help, but you need to find the right approach! No one will help you just because you're... a man

  • A random traitor system selects a traitor at the beginning of each new game! The traitor has their own motives and goals! The evidence also changes according to the specific traitor! Every playthrough is unique!

  • Time is limited! The Boss has 72 hours to find the traitor and return to the clan, otherwise...

  • One-handed control! A great opportunity to relax between moments of desperation!

April. The fourth month of the year. The worst possible one. For the Boss of a Yakuza clan, the month starts especially badly. Arriving at headquarters, a familiar place is occupied by another, and the guys who yesterday bowed at his feet are today pointing weapons. The former Boss has three days to gather enough evidence and reclaim his position through the Council of Elders.

The Boss doesn't ask for help; he simply takes what he needs, and right now he needs evidence, witness testimonies. To do this, he will have to visit several mutual acquaintances who have plenty of their own problems. Few are willing to waste their lives on a Boss, especially one like him. He'll have to resort to old-fashioned methods.

                                                                       Shizuru

The Boss's assistant. She is only interested in the clan's success. She doesn't care about the Boss's fate; she continues to work for the clan herself and remains that cold and intimidating element. She now views the Boss as part of the past and has no interest in helping bring that past back.

                                                                        Keiko

Police Sergeant. She always wanted to work in the police force, and now... she has what she dreamed of. Her job is to monitor all the clans and gangs in the district. She often visited the Boss, and just as often left with money. After the Boss was expelled from the clan, she sees it as an opportunity to break free from this vicious cycle.

                                                                        Mitsu

Works in an Escort House. One of the most in-demand and desired women. Her name is constantly on everyone's lips, and the waiting lists for her... are substantial. Sweet as honey and understands the game they're all playing here better than anyone. Her ears work just as well as her body, but the price... is fitting. Help the Boss? Pfft, only for a very, very high price!

                                                                       Ryuuko

Former clan member. She joined the clan herself, worked, completed tasks, but was expelled by the Boss personally. Now she has her own gang; no one can ever kick her out from there! For her, the Boss being thrown out on the street is the best joke fate has ever played in her entire life!

                                                                         Nana

Current clan member. She joined only thanks to the Boss, who accepted her without vows and traditions. Her job is to hand out leaflets on the street and be the Boss's eyes while he is busy. She is timid, afraid of making mistakes, but does everything she is ordered to do. But... is that always true?

It's best not to make the Boss wait!

4506600.name: Orbital Decay
4506600.about_the_game:
THE STATION IS IN PERIL. YOUR MIND IS THE ONLY RESCUE.

Orbital Decay is a high-stakes, fast-paced educational simulation where realistic orbital physics meet rapid-fire mathematics. A massive modular space station is suffering critical system failures, and its orbit is decaying fast. If it hits the atmosphere, it burns.

As the station's emergency flight director, you must calculate precise thrust vectors and deploy immediate countermeasures to stabilize the trajectory. The catch? The targeting computers are offline. You have to do the math yourself, and the clock is ticking.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Dynamic Mathematical Combat: Defend the station by solving rapid, procedurally generated math equations under extreme pressure. Every correct calculation fires the thrusters; every mistake pulls the station closer to the atmosphere.

  • Realistic Orbital Physics: Experience the tension of real orbital mechanics. Understand the relationship between velocity, thrust vectors, and atmospheric drag as you fight to maintain a stable altitude.

  • Global Leaderboards: Speed and accuracy are your ultimate weapons. Chain together correct calculations to build your multiplier, maximize your score, and dominate the competitive global leaderboards.

  • Arcade-Style Loop: Jump right into the action. Whether you have five minutes or five hours, the addictive loop of learning, calculating, and surviving will keep you coming back to beat your personal best.

  • Sharpen Your Mind: Designed from the ground up to be both an intense arcade experience and a powerful educational tool. Master your mathematical reflexes in a scenario where every number counts.

4506860.name: From Embers
4506860.about_the_game:
About This Game

Every villager in From Embers has a name, a family, and a story — and when they die, they are mourned and remembered. You'll guide them from a single campfire to a sprawling kingdom across four ages of civilization, balancing food, shelter, and faith against brutal winters, nighttime monster raids, and the slow weight of difficult choices.

Every run ends — to plague, to winter, or to your own decision to start over — and the legacy of your greatest people echoes into the next.

This is a slow-burn settlement sim with rogue-lite structure. Not a twitch survival game. You'll spend most of your time assigning workers, weighing event choices, and watching your fire glow against the dark.

Is This Game For You?

From Embers is deliberate and methodical. A typical run takes as long as it takes...

You'll spend most of your time:

- Assigning villagers to jobs and watching production tick up

- Reading event popups and weighing how your settlement responds

- Placing and upgrading buildings to set up district synergies

- Stockpiling food before winter and reinforcing your defenses before dark

You'll probably enjoy it if you like: settlement-builders (Banished,

Frostpunk), idlers with depth, narrative rogue-lites, the slow tension of

seasonal survival.

You'll probably want to skip it if you're after: fast-paced RTS, real-time

combat, immediate city growth, or a single-sitting experience.

Know Your People

Your villagers aren't numbers. Each one has a unique name, up to three personality traits, ten trainable skills, and family connections - parents, spouses, children. They marry, grow old, and are remembered in eulogies when they fall. Click any villager on the map to see their full history. When your most legendary citizens die, their story doesn't end - they become ancestors whose traits echo into future generations.

Survive the Seasons

Spring is for growing. Summer is for building. Autumn is for stockpiling. Winter will test everything you've built.

Food production drops sharply in the cold, blizzards can cripple your entire settlement, and if your stores run dry, your people will starve. Every year is a crisis waiting to happen - and surviving the harshest winters permanently hardens your villagers.

Rise Through Four Ages

Advance your civilization across four eras - Tribal, Settlement, Kingdom, and Empire - each unlocking new buildings, technologies, resources, and threats. Watch your humble campfire grow into a castle surrounded by academies, markets, and monuments.

Build With Intent

Place 30 unique buildings across a 70×40 isometric grid, where strategic positioning matters. Thirteen district bonus pairings reward thoughtful layouts - farms near granaries boost food production, libraries adjacent to academies accelerate research. Every placement decision shapes how efficiently your settlement runs.

Make Hard Choices

Dozens of narrative events challenge you throughout each run - welcome refugees or hoard supplies, fund the scholar's research or put everyone to work, negotiate with raiders or rally your defenders. Multi-event storyline chains unfold differently based on your previous decisions, ensuring no two runs tell the same story.

Defend Your Home

When night falls, monsters come. Wolves prowl the wilderness, bandits raid the settlement, and as your civilization grows, trolls and siege ogres threaten your walls. Train soldiers, build barracks and guard towers to strengthen your defenses, and set rally points to direct your warriors. Your hunters patrol the fields by day while your soldiers hold the line after dark.

Prestige and Begin Again

When you're ready, reset your civilization and carry forward Legacy Points to unlock nine permanent upgrades for faster gathering, larger starting stockpiles, reduced building costs, and more. Your greatest villagers become legendary ancestors. Ghost outlines of your old settlement echo across the new map. Each run starts stronger than the last.

Features

  • Four eras of civilization: Tribal, Settlement, Kingdom, and Empire

  • 30 unique buildings with 13 strategic district placement bonuses

  • 18 technologies forming a branching research tree

  • 40+ narrative events with multiple outcomes and branching storyline chains

  • Six resources, ten worker types, 13 personality traits, and ten trainable skills

  • Full day/night cycle with seasonal survival pressure

  • 10 weather types plus three catastrophic mega-weather events

  • Five huntable animals and six monster types with scaling difficulty

  • Nine prestige upgrades and legendary ancestor inheritance across runs

  • 34 milestone achievements and 11 dynamic settlement titles

  • Three difficulty levels with autosave

  • Hand-painted isometric pixel art with animated villagers and weather effects

4506900.name: Float Lord
4506900.about_the_game:
Climb higher. Push off solid ground and launch yourself upward, one careful move at a time.

Every spike waits to end your run. One mistake, one touch, and you’ll turn to stone and plummet back down—undoing seconds, minutes, maybe more.

Falling isn’t just failure — it’s fear. Drop too far and you lose hard-earned progress, watching your effort slip away. The real challenge isn’t the climb — it’s handling the fall.

The game remembers everything. Climb and stay to lock it in. Fall—and your setback becomes permanent.

Grab colorful fruits and veggies as you climb. Unlock silly skins and give your fragile balloon a new look.

Fall as many times as you want — at least you’ll look good doing it.

Master your timing and momentum, or trust your instincts and hope for the best.

Every climb is different. Every mistake matters.

But why climb at all? Because stopping isn’t an option.

FEATURES:

  • Vertical precision climbing

  • Brutal fall consequences

  • Collectible fruits and veggies

  • Unlockable balloon skins

  • Simple controls, high tension

4506920.name: Catapult Legend
4506920.about_the_game:
Catapult Legend is a physics-based medieval destruction game focused on satisfying, strategic gameplay.

Take control of your wind-powered siege engine and bring down castles with precision and force. Feel the tension build as you pull back the catapult — the longer you hold, the more devastating your shot becomes.

Choose your ammunition wisely and adapt your strategy: unleash a massive boulder to crush key structures, use large rocks for balanced destruction, or scatter a storm of pebbles to cover a wide area. The pebbles spread on impact, hitting multiple targets at once and triggering satisfying chain reactions.

Travel across diverse lands — from dry wastelands and lush valleys to freezing snowy regions — where each level presents new challenges and creative destruction opportunities.

With an advanced fragmentation system, structures break apart realistically while enemies react dynamically to every hit. One well-placed shot can change the course of the entire battle.

⚔️ FEATURES

• Physics-based, satisfying destruction system

• Control shot power by adjusting catapult tension
  – Hold longer → unleash stronger shots 💥

• Multiple ammunition types
  – Pebbles (wide spread, hits multiple targets)
  – Large rocks (balanced and controlled destruction)
  – Massive boulder (maximum power, single-point impact)

• 4 unique regions, from dry lands and valleys to snowy environments

• Realistic fragmentation and dynamic enemy reactions

• Strategic aiming and chain-reaction destruction

• Stylized and atmospheric medieval world

4506940.name: Spinnopoly
4506940.about_the_game:
You have spent years in the dim glow of the screen chasing the one big win that would clear your name and your debts. But the numbers never added up and the debt only grew. You eventually collapsed from exhaustion with the sound of the spinning reels being the last thing you heard. You woke up here in a void of shifting colors and humming machinery standing before a machine that feels more alive than you are.

Spinnopoly is a short incremental clicker about a gambling addict’s desperate attempt to escape a rigged purgatory. The game practices true randomness. Starting with a 1 in 178 billion chance of a jackpot the odds are effectively impossible. In this strange space your luck is at absolute zero.

As you play you realize the rules of reality have thinned. You can earn enough to rig the system slowly changing the inner workings of the reels to give yourself an edge. You can polish the symbols for higher payouts or force the jackpot closer to existence. But be warned because the more you pull the machine’s strings the more the space begins to glitch. The void does not like to be cheated and it will do everything in its power to keep you in your place.

4506990.name: MYMEMORY
4506990.about_the_game:
MYMEMORY

MYMEMORY is a story-focused RPGMaker game set in the SCP Foundation universe. Play through Camille's memories as she is contained and classified as SCP-9831. Play through her life, explore her story, and discover what the Foundation is hiding. Are they covering something up? Does Camille know more than she's letting on? Does she know about... you?

Features

  • 2-3 hours of gameplay, and a LOT more if you want to find all the secrets!

  • Unique hand-drawn art style

  • Plenty of puzzles, dialogue options, and branching paths!

  • Multiple endings

  • Original 12-track OST

  • A non-silent protagonist in an RPGMaker horror game

  • Maybe a plot twist

Steam Exclusive Features!

The Steam version of MYMEMORY has many features not found in the SCP article version, including:

  • Exclusive Digital Artbook as a free DLC, which includes all development assets, Krita files, Ableton Live projects, and bonus art!

  • Uncompressed assets, including art and music!

  • Dramatically better performance and no need to mess with your browser settings!

  • Scalable fullscreen

  • Inline SCP Article viewer

Note from the developer:

Thank you for checking out my newest game! I'm jswessler, a solo developer based in New England, and it means a lot to me that you've read this far. MYMEMORY is my next project, inspired by classic RPGMaker hits like Oneshot and Ib, but modernized into a new format! I'm really proud of what MYMEMORY became over the last year, and I hope everyone enjoys it!

I've been reading and following the SCP Foundation since 2019, and I'm so happy to finally be writing for it! MYMEMORY was inspired by SCP-245. After that article switched to a Twine project, I figured the wiki needed another RPGMaker game to fill that gap!

Thank you for playing, and I hope I can keep making more games!

-jswessler

Little Knight Cliche is a precision platformer that puts your skills to the test through 40+ handcrafted levels. Take on the role of a Little Knight and journey through a world where every jump counts and every mistake leads to a quick restart.

Reclaim the lands taken by the Zahar. Build and lead armies to recover the villages seized by the enemy. Acquire better weapons and manage your soldiers throughout the liberation campaign.

Real-Time Action

Explore a medieval open world, gather soldiers, and lead battles to reclaim your people's lands. The enemies don’t stand still—they constantly advance, taking villages and expanding their control while you fight to stop them.

Every decision matters. Every battle changes the map.

Even if you fall in combat, you can return to the fight. Reorganize your troops, plan your next move, and keep fighting to restore the kingdom.

4507150.name: Micrographia
4507150.about_the_game:
A sleep with no awakening. A human bone appearing spontaneously inside the brain. A face frozen in an expression of unspeakable horror. These are the symptoms of the Nightmare Sickness. No one can determine its cause, but no one wants to wait until the skeleton is complete.

You play as a mercenary afflicted by this disease. In a nameless brutalist city where day and night blur together, where people wander sleepless and reality is unraveling, you have little time before your mind finally breaks. Hired by the mysterious Eschaton Battalion to find a cure, you become caught between factions far beyond your control: a sprawling corporation with occult ambitions, a fanatical cult, and something waiting behind your dreams.

Key Features

A fast, demanding top down shooter Inspired by F.E.A.R., combat is short, brutal, and lethal. Enemies use tactical AI, flanking, taking cover, and communicating with each other. Every firefight can be fatal. Every mission demands a different approach, whether you are fighting on a train, during a riot, or inside someone’s mind.

A surreal horror atmosphere Cold corporate power meets uncontrolled occult forces. A world where corporations have replaced gods, and where something that should not exist is beginning to awaken.

Your choices matter Your reality is collapsing. The characters around you may help you, manipulate you, or exist only inside your head. It is difficult to tell. Dialogue and decisions shape the path of your story.

Total freedom of approach Violence, negotiation, deception. There is never just one way to handle a situation. Use a wide array of weapons, tools, skills, or occult powers to survive. Honor is optional. Your enemies will not show you any.

A singular artistic direction The game draws inspiration from corporate pictograms and micrography. Characters appear as pictograms, faces are created from police facial composites, typography and cold, dense interfaces evoke industrial signage. In this brutalist city, the rain falls in letters.

Available in French and English.

The man in your dreams will try to lure you. Do not listen.

Music by Loïc Dutronc.

4507210.name: Bathyscraft
4507210.about_the_game:
In Bathyscraft, you begin your expedition with a small, fragile submarine and a simple goal: reach the bottom of the ocean. The deeper you travel, the harsher the environment becomes - you'll need to keep your crew alive and upgrade your bathyscaphe if you want to succeed!

Build Your Submarine

Expand your vessel using a card-based room system. Each room you add becomes part of your submarine and unlocks new statistics, tools or features.

Design your layout carefully: every room matters, not all combinations are possible, and the dangerous creatures of the abyss might try and destroy what you've carefully built...

Collect and Craft

Explore the depths to gather various materials and resources. Use them to feed your crew, craft better equipment, reinforce your hull, and build specialised rooms that allow your submarine to descend even further.

Survive the Depths

The ocean is not forgiving. To survive your descent, you must balance critical systems:

  • Pressure increases as you dive deeper, threatening to crush your submarine.

  • Food keeps your crew alive during long expeditions.

Every decision affects how far your submarine can go.

Reach the Abyss

Plan your submarine, upgrade wisely, and push deeper with every expedition.
With the right combination of rooms, equipment, and resource management, you may finally reach the deepest point of the ocean.

The abyss is waiting.

4507370.name: Celestial isle's dream
4507370.about_the_game:
1.Background Story

    After the World War Three, the Star Core shattered, and fragments of the unknown rift scattered as spiritual star dust, falling onto the human world. Amid the mutations, some beings awakened as "fairies" with wisdom and extraordinary powers; most humans weakened and fell into a deep slumber, causing the collapse of social order. A few humans fused with the star dust to become "Spiritual Cultivators," but the imbalance of power led to turmoil. At this time, the Ruins Spiritual Court manifested, and messengers from the divine realm brought an omen: the world would be devoured by the rift, and Spiritual Cultivators could enter the Ruins Realm.

The fairy factions then split into two paths:

    "Order Restorers": Mostly transformed pets, willing to use the power of the Star Core to close the rift and restore order, even if it means accepting their own regression.

    "Wisdom Guardians": Mostly wild animals that transformed, who, after being hunted by Spiritual Cultivators, decided to purge humanity and plunder spiritual cores to enter the Ruins.

    Yiyun, a pet transformed, was chased by humans due to the conflict between humans and fairies, leaving its master. Under the guidance of the "Order Restorers," Yiyun embarked on a journey, determined to close the rift and restore the world’s order.

    The road ahead is unclear, the rift between humans and fairies hard to mend, and the Ruins Oracle difficult to discern between right and wrong.

    The story of the game begins here...

2.Game Features

    (1) Harvesting: Players can gather various resources for building their home by engaging in activities such as chopping trees, mining, and more in different maps.

    (2) Expansion: As the player levels up, more areas can be expanded for building facilities, fulfilling basic home functions like farming, cooking, and crafting weapons.

    (4) Pets: Players can hatch pet eggs to obtain different pets. The pets can be placed on the island, interact with the player, and can also be sent on exploration missions to gather resources from different maps.

    (7) Characters: Players can unlock and use different characters with unique appearances and skills for combat. Each character has a variety of skills in different forms.

    (8) PVE Gameplay: Players can challenge various types of dungeons, with each dungeon offering different materials as rewards.

    (9) PVP Gameplay: Players can choose different characters to participate in player versus player combat. The game offers 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, and other player match types. To win, players must defeat all members of the opposing team.
