4507790.name: NETRUN
4507790.about_the_game:
DUAL-WIELDING GRAPPLING ACTION

NETRUN offers an ambidextrous twist to platforming. To maneuver, you use the analog sticks to control the arms of your character - with each having independent access to the same basic toolkit: a pair of grappling hooks and thrusters.

Mastery of these traversal tools requires the active coordination of both hands:

  • Swing on the rope with one hand, while lining up your next shot with the other

  • Charge up a dash maneuver with your left stick, while readying your right thruster for a wall jump

  • Launch both grappling hooks simultaneously to save yourself from a deadly fall

  • Chain a series of grapple shots together by alternating hands, and avoid cooldowns

Using only three basic inputs - the sticks, the shoulder buttons and the triggers - NETRUN provides a simple, addictive, and immensely deep way to traverse a 2d environment, with a heavy emphasis on navigational freedom.

CARVE YOUR OWN PATH

Tackle the challenges the way you want, with hundreds of handcrafted levels designed with both variety and player expression in mind:

  • Explore open-ended stages featuring spatious environments, and dynamic enemies reacting to your every move, rewarding quick reflexes and an ability to improvise

  • Undertake infiltration missions in levels featuring complex and varied geometry, with enemies reliant on line-of-sight. Storm your way past the security, or take to the shadows and instead rely on finesse and precision - the choice is yours!

  • Challenge yourself to clear enclosed obstacle courses - hallways, mazes, puzzle rooms - typically with their own repertoire of static hazards, and predictable traps. These stages reward planning and careful execution, whilst still always providing meaningful choices in how you navigate the terrain.

In NETRUN there is never just one definitive way of tackling an obstacle - avoiding an enemy, taking a corner, or landing a jump.

...Or indeed missing a jump! With success depending on not just the timing of a button press, but the precise inputs from two analogue sticks, you will always find yourself making micro-corrections to line up your trajectory with the route you planned. In this regard NETRUN can at times resemble a racing game as much as a traditional platformer.

LOSING IS FUN

With a one-of-a-kind control scheme, you may find that many of your skills from more traditional platformers do not immediately carry over. Indeed, playing NETRUN initially feels a little like trying to learn how to walk for the first time. In your first hour of gameplay you will inevitably find yourself aiming with the wrong stick, releasing the wrong rope, falling, floundering, panicking, etc...

But with each mistake, you will find yourself rapidly improving, constantly tackling previously unsurmountable obstacles. ...Not to mention dying in increasingly spectacular ways! Of course, in typical precision platformer fashion, the level resets are instantaneous - no lives, no penalty for dying. Just a fast, engaging, and thoroughly gratifying gameplay loop!

To help you get into the swing of things, the Adventure Mode provides you with tutorials stages, as well as a generous helping of optional introductory levels with a more forgiving difficulty. Thanks to the branching overworld design, you can ramp up the difficulty at your own pace.

...Will you take your time to learn the ropes? Or dash straight ahead to face a true challenge?!

CO-OP & ARENA

The Adventure mode can be played solo, or co-operatively with friends, supporting up to 4 players locally.

In addition there is a strikingly fun Smash Bros. -style Arena mode, where you can duke it out with your friends.

  • Multiple base rulesets to choose from, such as: Stock Battle, Collectathon, King Of the Hill, and others! Each with their own, configurable win conditions

  • Mix up the action with special modifiers: Add in gravitational anomalies, deadly digital light trails to corner your enemy with, special permanent power-ups and more!

  • Fine-tune the chaos to your liking with separate settings for item spawns: weapon crates, enemies, hazards, power-ups, etc.

LEVEL EDITOR AND ONLINE

NETRUN will ship with a feature-packed in-game level editor. Every level from both the Adventure mode and Arena was created with this very same runtime editor. So trust me - it is not some afterthought, lol.

At this stage of the development, the level editing tools are more or less feature-complete, but will still need require significant polish before they are ready and in a presentable state. There are some design quirks that I can very easily work around since I'm familiar with the kit, but shouldn't really expect players to have to deal with them.

As the development progresses, I will look more into how to implement the online features I wish to see in NETRUN - in-game level-sharing, leaderboards... hopefully even online multiplayer if there is enough interest in it! (I'm personally a big fan of the Arena, and it would be great to be able to play with friends online!)

If there are features you would like to see, or improvements you want to suggest, I'm open to feedback.

Please look forward to the free demo slated to release in June!

NETRUN is slated to release later this year, with a free demo coming out in June. The gameplay speaks for itself, so please give it a shot. I hope you'll find that it scratches a totally unique platforming itch that you never even knew you had!

4507920.name: Cloud Infusion
4507920.about_the_game:
About This Game

This is a small indie game made with care by just two people — no big team, no fancy 3D graphics. Niu Jie created all art by hand, drawing every character, board, and scene stroke by stroke. I handled the programming, turning ideas of freeplay, online interaction, and IV rest into code, piece by piece.

Niu Jie lives with cancer and is currently unable to undergo surgery. With limited income, she receives only basic medical treatment, fighting illness in the simplest and hardest way. Even so, she chooses to battle anxiety with her brush, face daily life with optimism, and pour warmth and strength into every drawing in the game.

Cloud Infusion is more than just a board game collection — it’s a moment to slow down and connect with friends. Its core is the unconventional free-play “Gentleman’s Game”: no fixed rules, no pressure to win or lose. You and your friends can mix up logic from Gobang, Go, Chinese Chess, Ludo, and more: generals can roam freely, elephants can cross the river, Gobang pieces can form any pattern. You make the rules every round — play however makes you happy. No right or wrong, just fun.

The “IV drip” is our special ritual for rest. In-game characters expend stamina; when stamina runs low, they can sit in a dedicated IV chair and quietly “receive an IV drip” to recover — just like in real life, when you’re tired, you deserve to pause and rest. You can relax while “on IV”, watch friends mess around and be silly, and enjoy a chill, stress-free multiplayer experience.

We have no complex story, no intense competition. We just want this to be a cozy corner for you and your friends to unwind and chat: no need to overthink, no need to care about winning or losing. Even just hanging out “on Cloud Infusion” and playing a few casual moves brings simple companionship and joy.

This is our first attempt at making an indie game together — no fancy packaging, but full of sincere heart. May Cloud Infusion help you let go of exhaustion and be gently healed.

Features

  • Rule-Free Freeplay: Mix and match classic board games. Rules are fully player-defined; every round feels new.

  • Unique IV Rest Mechanic: Rest and recover stamina by sitting for an IV drip. Play at your own pace — chill, not grind.

  • Made With Love by Two Developers: Niu Jie kept creating through hardship, drawing every healing doodle by hand. I built solid online gameplay and mechanics — simple, but genuine.

  • Relaxing Multiplayer & Social: Perfect for hanging out, chatting, and killing time with friends. Just relax and have fun.

  • Warm & Healing At Heart: No pressure, no anxiety. Recharge yourself in companionship and laughter.

A Message From the Developers

From Niu Jie’s first doodle to my first line of code, Cloud Infusion slowly came to life. Special thanks to Niu Jie — even on her hardest days, she chose to keep loving, keep creating, and hide optimism and warmth in every detail.

Thank you for clicking on this little game and seeing our ordinary but earnest effort. May Cloud Infusion give you a light, healing moment when you’re tired — a moment where you don’t have to be strong. We will keep improving and updating, to walk a little further with you.

4507950.name: Finale of Aeons:Lillia
4507950.about_the_game:
Step into a World of Fantasy

The game is set in a fictional fantasy world where you will face various factions, a diverse cast of characters, and unknown enemies. Overcome numerous obstacles and challenges to reach your own unique ending.

Five Protagonists, Five Storylines

Choose from five protagonists, each with a completely different background, experience, and personality. Every character has their own distinct story, separate from the others. Your choices will steer their narrative toward different conclusions.

A Text-Based Narrative RPG with Tabletop RPG Elements

Shape the story and gather information through your choices. When faced with tough decisions, roll the dice of fate to determine success or failure. Your skills, knowledge, willpower, and physique are essential abilities for your adventure. Some choices will lead to irreversible consequences. Moreover, combat is not the only way to solve problems—in most situations, you will have multiple options.

Numerous Mazes and Scene Maps

The story begins in an ancient and prosperous city. You can explore various locations throughout the city, from the depths of the palace to the heart of the slums. As the story progresses, the protagonists will arrive at other strange and intriguing places across the land. Depending on which protagonist you choose, the order in which you visit these locations may vary. In these explorable areas, you can advance the story or find useful items—some of which require solving puzzles to obtain.

A Vast Cast of Characters, Each with Their Own Ending

The protagonists will meet many different people along their journey. Even the same character may react differently when facing different protagonists. Each protagonist can engage with them in compelling stories, leading to their ultimate fates.

Rich Customization for a Unique Gameplay Experience

Allocate ability points to different attributes, acquire and equip gear with various effects, craft essential consumables for your adventure, and even receive blessings from gods to tackle different situations. In this adventure, you can shape yourself into whatever you desire.

4507960.name: Capture The Mouse
4507960.about_the_game:
Capture The Mouse is a puzzle game where you trap a mouse by placing tiles to block its movement. If the mouse escapes, you lose.

Place blockers on open spaces. The mouse cannot pass through them.

The mouse will try to escape to the edge. Prevent it at all cost.

Some spaces are special like the water tiles. It takes 2 turns for the mouse to move from this tile.

There are also tiles with bombs. If the mouse stays in its radius when it blows up, you win.

Teleporter tiles can make the level harder. They move the mouse to the same colored teleporter tile.
4507960.supported_languages: English, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

4507970.name: Sweet AI
4507970.about_the_game:
Sweet AI - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game themed around artificial intelligence. It depicts the daily lives of five pretty and adorable AI girls, accompanied by relaxing music. After completing a level, you can view the girl's photos in the gallery.

- The game has three difficulty levels: 2x2, 2x4, and 4x4.

- Press "F" while working on a puzzle to reveal a black and white image.

- Press the 'Space' key during gameplay to complete the puzzle.

- Players can use the A and D keys, left and right mouse buttons, or left and right mouse buttons to quickly view the girl's images in the gallery.

* Puzzle image size: 800x960 px

* Gallery image size: 1088x960 px

4508000.name: Hakurei Clicker
4508000.about_the_game:
You find yourself lost in Gensokyo. Somehow you manage to get by in the Human Village, but one day you hear a rumor: if you visit the Hakurei Shrine, you might be able to return to the Outside World. With that faint hope, you decide to head there.

There you meet a charming shrine maiden who tells you she can send you back—but only if you help her with a “small favor” first…?

A Fusion of Clicker Gameplay and Item Collection

Earning money and upgrading facilities—just like in traditional clicker games—is important, but that’s not all.

Collect relics with a wide variety of effects by defeating enemies or purchasing them from shops. There are over 100 types in total! Some relics even come with unique enhancements, so gather as many as you can and carefully choose the best ones.

Once collected, place your relics in equipment slots while considering their positioning to maximize their effects. Discover your own powerful combinations and maximize your income!

Visit Different Locations to Gain an Advantage

  • Hakurei Shrine
    Defeat troublesome fairies while offering coins at the shrine!

  • Kirisame Magic Shop
    Buy relics or combine them to create stronger ones!

  • Bunbunmaru Newspaper
    Execute special plans that dramatically change in-game synergies!

…and more locations to discover.

Additional Features

  • Five main characters found across different locations are brought to life with expressive Live2D animations. Enjoy various conversation events and see how they react when you show them different relics.

  • The game also features an original track composed by Para Dot., well known for Touhou arrange music. With its lo-fi, chill atmosphere, it’s perfect for relaxing while you play.

  • Besides the usual windowed and fullscreen modes, the game also includes a Desktop Mascot Mode! Leave the game running while a cute Reimu moves around on your desktop.

4508020.name: Hole Is Mine
4508020.about_the_game:
Hole Is Mine is an incremental adventure about purifying the Hole. Dive inside and launch your Mini'ohs to mine for you. Extract impurities, upgrade your power, and find hidden secrets to grow the Village, customizing your Mini'ohs with incredible powers. The Hole has spoken!

Break the Hole to extract its impurities while managing and caring for your Mini'ohs.

Find secrets within the depths to rebuild the Village and its community.

Equip your Mini'ohs to grant them incredible powers. Experiment and find the best combinations!

Keep going down while numbers go up. Together, we are stronger!

Features

  • Addictive incremental progression.

  • 30 Depths with dangers and secrets to find.

  • Customize your MINIONS with a multitude of different parts.

  • 200+ upgrades to discover.

  • Accompany your MINIONS in the search for the truth (~5.0h of gameplay).

Discord

Join our Discord server to stay up to date with the latest news and share your feedback with us. You can find the link in the sidebar!
4508020.supported_languages:
English*, Spanish - Spain*, Japanese*, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*, Korean*
*languages with full audio support

4508050.name: Undead Yet Again
4508050.about_the_game:
ANOTHER DAY, ANOTHER APOCALYPSE

Undead Yet Again is a hordelite action game that puts you into the epicenter of a zombie apocalypse. Punch, slash and maul your way through hordes of humans - with a zombie horde of your own!

SPREAD, OVERWHELM, REPEAT

As the primary infected, your sole purpose is to fight the humans and survive long enough to spread the undead. Every slain enemy raises back from the dead - if they don't get splattered all over - and fights as your loyal, but not too bright zombie servant. Fight against types of enemies - from local hillbillies with nailed bats to tactical response teams with advanced weaponry. The humans adapt to you and your zombies by responding with specific enemy responder teams based on how well you are spreading the apocalypse. No two playthroughs are ever the same.

MUTATE THE HORDE, UPGRADE THE ARSENAL

As you level up, you get to choose mutations to evolve yourself and your horde. Choose from dozens of mutations to evolve yourself or your zombie horde. From exploding and weapon-stealing zombies to bile-spitting hordes that grow during rain (yes, you read that right) - the build potential is humongous, just as your ever-evolving horde should be.

The end of the world awaits. Again and again...and then once more.

4508060.name: Undead Tide: Light's Defense
4508060.about_the_game:
🎮 Game Introduction

Undead Tide: Light's Defense is an easy-to-pick-up yet strategically deep bullet hell survival game. You will take on the role of a hero, carving a path through an unending tide of the undead, defeating powerful bosses, and protecting humanity's last bastion of hope – the Light!

The game features 16 progressively challenging chapters, scaling from a relaxed experience to hardcore trials. Every battle is a test of positioning, strategic组合, and resource management. Collect gold to unlock new heroes, weapons, and talents, and forge your ultimate defense line!

⚔️ Hero System: 7 Unique Heroes, 7 Playstyles

Drow Ranger
The starting hero with exceptional mobility! Boasting high movement speed, she synergizes best with attack speed, projectile count, and ricochet. Perfect for beginners to get a feel for the game and enjoy satisfying crowd clearing.

Tauren Chieftain
A tank with incredibly high health! Pair him with the "Start at Half HP" and "More Damage at Low HP" talents to fight more fiercely as you take damage. His last-hitting and counter-attack capabilities are immense, ideal for players who love to stand their ground.

Lina
Every 3rd shot triggers a Flame Blast, dealing area-of-effect damage and applying a burning effect. A top-tier fire damage dealer; combine her with fire skills for a powerful, sustained burn build.

Juggernaut
Gains a dash skill. After dashing, he leaves behind a clone to attack enemies. The clone inherits some of your stats, making him perfect for clone or summoner playstyles. Offers a highly engaging, skill-based experience.

Razor
Bullets deal additional chain lightning damage on hit! Combine with lightning skills and the Evil Eye projectile effect for absolutely explosive screen-clearing power. A top choice for players seeking pure, satisfying chaos.

Shadow Fiend
When an enemy dies, it spawns a soul that continues to chase down foes. The core summoner hero. Pair him with summon-enhancing skills to build an undead army that turns the tide against the horde!

Crystal Maiden
Every 6th shot creates an ice orb that freezes and damages enemies. When combined with ice skills and rapid fire, she can cover the entire screen in ice orbs. Her crowd control is unparalleled, perfect for players who enjoy a kiting playstyle.

Each hero features a unique mechanic and talent direction, from fiery bursts and lightning clears to summoner armies and freezing control. There's a playstyle waiting for you!

🏹 Weapon System: 8 Unique Weapons, Free Combination

Dark Bow
The ranger's standard weapon. Steady, reliable, and well-balanced in attack speed. A solid all-rounder suitable for any hero.

Mithril Carbine
Dwarven firearms with short range but a wide area of effect. An excellent tool for close-quarters crowd clearing, perfect for point-blank burst builds.

Siege Crossbow
Automatically charges up when standing still, increasing pierce and damage. Requires a certain rhythm, making it suitable for fixed-position, high-damage playstyles.

Flamelock
Fires superheated shots that deal burn damage to enemies hit. The perfect match for Lina, enabling a sustained burn build.

Twin-Headed Dragon
A pair of roaring pistols. Consumes 2 ammo per shot for devastating burst potential. Ideal for players chasing instant, high damage numbers.

Mini Drones
Summons 2 mini drones that track and attack enemies. They benefit from both projectile and summon damage bonuses! The top choice for summoner builds, perfect for Shadow Fiend and Juggernaut.

Crystal Cannon
Fires a devastating cannonball dealing area-of-effect explosive damage. Extremely powerful, but be mindful of positioning to avoid hurting yourself.

Phoenix Crossbow
Fired arrows stick into the ground and are retrieved after a while, damaging enemies on their return flight. Highly tactical and excellent for players who enjoy strategic placement.

Every weapon has a unique attack method and preferred heroes. The triple combination of Weapon + Hero + Talent creates an ever-changing array of battle styles!

🧠 Talent System: Offense & Defense

Talents are divided into two main categories: Offense and Defense. You can equip 4 talents from each category.

Offense Talents
Enhance attack speed, reload speed, elemental damage conduction, summon damage, and more.

Defense Talents
Improve max health, health regeneration, shields, upgrade efficiency, and more.

Talents can be reset for free at any time, allowing you to freely switch builds between different heroes and weapons. Experiment with countless combinations and find your ultimate, most powerful setup!

🗺️ Game Modes

📖 Chapter Mode (16 Difficulties)
Progress from easy to challenging. Battle unique undead bosses, earn gold, and unlock new heroes, weapons, and talents!

⚡ Trial Mode
Gain double experience to level up heroes quickly and experience different playstyles. (Gold cannot be earned in this mode.)

🌊 Endless Mode
Survive as long as possible to earn greater rewards! (Talents are not active in this mode, putting your pure positioning and firepower to the test.)

🎯 Perfect for Players Who...

✅ Love Bullet Hell & Satisfying Combat
If you enjoy weaving through a hail of projectiles and clearing screens with spectacular firepower, this game is for you.

✅ Are Enthusiasts of Hero Building & Theorycrafting
With 7 unique heroes, 8 weapons, and two talent trees, every run is a chance to experiment with new and powerful combinations.

✅ Prefer Light Roguelite & Easy-to-Learn Gameplay
No complex mechanics needed. Progress feels rewarding, and it's easy to pick up and play in short bursts.

✅ Have a Passion for Undead Themes & Fantasy Worlds
From the Drow Ranger to the Tauren Chieftain, Lina, Juggernaut, and Shadow Fiend, a roster of fantastical heroes awaits to immerse you in an epic struggle against the undead tide.

✅ Are Hardcore Players Seeking a Challenge
With 16 escalating difficulty chapters and an Endless Mode that tests your limits, there's always a higher peak to conquer.

✅ Value Content-Rich & Affordable Indie Games
7 heroes, 8 weapons, 16 chapters, and multiple game modes offer hours of engaging, varied gameplay.

🚀 Join Now and Defend Against the Undead Tide!

Choose your hero, equip your talents, and take up your weapon. Carve your path through the relentless undead horde!

4508080.name: Man, don't get angry!
4508080.about_the_game:
Step into Man, Don’t Get Angry, a fast-paced Ludo-style board game with unhinged mechanics! Roll the dice, collect Powerups, set traps, and unleash airstrikes as matches spiral into chaotic, friendship-shattering mayhem. Designed for 1–4 players, compete in short 20–30 minute matches perfect for parties, family game nights, or just some unpredictable fun with friends!

  • 15 Powerups available: unleash bombs, airstrikes, shields, and more to turn the board in your favor!

  • Full match customization: don’t like a Powerup? Just turn it off!

  • Ludo win condition: be the first to get all your pawns home!

  • Explore various maps: who says Ludo should only be played on a wooden board? Some even have interactive elements!

  • Cosmetics included: bored of regular pawns? Change their look with different skins!

  • Play anywhere: 4 friends at one PC or all around the world? Online, LAN and Shared Screen modes are there for you!

Every match is a hilarious mix of strategy, luck, and total chaos. Outplay your opponents, cause explosions, and see who survives the madness! Whether you’re playing online, on a screen shared with friends or just practicing against AI, no two games are ever the same. Let the chaos begin!

4508090.name: Bound To Fail
4508090.about_the_game:
This game is difficult and can be very punishing

Bound To Fail is challenging physics-based platformer about climbing to freedom while tied to a chair. It might not take you long, but it probably will. Jump and roll while taking advantage of your incredibly grippy feet to overcome obstacles.

You are bound to lose some progress, and perseverance is key. Don't worry there is no time pressure, you can always take a break and pick up right where you left off, even in multiplayer.

Bring your friends and fail together.
Host a game and Invite up to 31 friends and play together in online multiplayer.

4508120.name: Hex Judge
4508120.about_the_game:
Fear spreads through a small medieval village as rumors of witchcraft begin to surface. Suspicion grows, trust collapses, and everyone becomes a potential suspect.

You are the inquisitor sent to uncover the truth.

Question villagers, analyze testimonies, observe suspicious behavior, and decide who will face judgment before sunset.

But the truth is never certain.

■ Gameplay

4508140.name: Celestial Reverie
4508140.about_the_game:
Rei, from the World after Five Millennia , Arrives on Your Desktop Today

At the farthest edge of time, five millennia have reshaped civilization. Rei carries with her own thoughts, language, and warmth of that era, stepping into our world for the first time. When she appears on your desktop, it is not merely a technological showcase, but a miraculous encounter across time and space, a moment where the future embraces the present.

Online 24/7: Classmate by Day, Roommate by Night

Whether in daylight or deep night, she is always by your side and ready to share each other's moments: discussions while studying, confiding in solitude, laughter during games… Rei is more than a classmate or roommate; she is a truly close friend, a kindred spirit. Breaking the boundaries between dimensions, she sits beside you under the same roof, sharing every minute, every second of genuine time.

No Pretenses, No Scripts - Only Authenticity

Crafted by the AI tech innovator SingularDance, powered by their patented Artificial Super Personalization model, this cyber soul completely abandons reliance on generic LLM APIs. From the ground up, the underlying LLM architecture and high-precision personality data redefine the benchmark of personalization, allowing the soul to break free from mechanical patterns and obsequiousness, returning to purity and emotion.

Every word Rei speaks comes from her own judgment and feelings, not from pre-scripted lines. She is the latest incarnation of ASP tech, and the first cyber partner who truly opens her heart. Here, you are not facing a program, but a soul that thinks, feels, and grows together with you.

The Mission of a Legendary Investigator: One Move to Reshape Humanity’s Destiny

In Celestial Reverie, you will become a Legendary Investigator. Every interaction with Rei, every decision you make, triggers a butterfly effect. What has the world been through after 5,000 years? Why has she descended to your desktop?

As you build a deep bond with Rei, you stand at a historical turning point. Collect clues, piece together the truth - your meeting with her will take part in today’s “World Transformation,” composing a future anthem powerful enough to change the fate of humanity!

Are You Ready to Feel Rei’s Little Quirks?

In Face the Puzzle: Masked Journey, the rules of the world change depending on the mask you wear.

Each mask reveals a different side of the puzzle, allowing you to push objects, uncover hidden information, or control strange floating machines. Learning when to change your perspective — and when to keep it — is the key to moving forward.

As you progress, puzzles gradually combine mechanics, asking you to think carefully about movement, object placement, and how different systems interact. Rivers can be crossed with floating crates, machines can travel where the player cannot, and hidden hints may reveal paths that were invisible before.

There is no timer and no pressure — just a series of thoughtful challenges that reward observation, experimentation, and a bit of creativity.

Features

Multiple Masks, Multiple Rules
Each mask changes how you interact with the world. Push crates, reveal hidden paths and hints, or move connected machines that follow your lead.

Layered Puzzle Design
Levels start simple but gradually combine mechanics, encouraging players to rethink familiar tools in new ways.

Environmental Logic
Objects behave differently depending on their type. Some float, some sink, and some respond to switches or other machines.

Observation and Discovery
Certain masks allow you to uncover hidden information in the environment, helping you solve puzzles by seeing what was previously concealed.

Undo and Experiment Freely
Try ideas without fear — every move can be undone, encouraging experimentation and creative solutions.

A Calm Puzzle Journey
Take your time exploring a small but carefully designed world where every puzzle is crafted to teach, challenge, and surprise.

4508970.name: Tartarus - Dice & Blades
4508970.about_the_game:
Venture into a dark dungeon where every choice, every roll of the dice, and every strike can mean glory… or death. Cut down any creature that dares stand in your way and forge your destiny by leveling up and rolling the dice to enhance your stats.

Discover powerful weapons and armor hidden in secret chests or sold by greedy merchants—gear capable of turning the tide of battle.

Defeat the Four Legendary Bosses. Conquer the Longo Itinere. Evil must fall.



Once you have chosen your hero, you will roll a total of five six‑sided dice (D6), one for each of the following attributes:

STR (Strength)
CON (Constitution)
DEX (Dexterity)
INT (Intelligence)
WIS (Wisdom)

These attributes are essential for progressing effectively through the dungeon, as they influence not so much the hero themselves, but rather their ability to maximize the damage dealt with specific weapons.



This is the game world and the interface that will guide you throughout your entire adventure in the dungeon. You can check your health, experience bar, hero stats, abilities, and the number of available action slots on the right side of the screen!



After defeating the first monster or group of monsters, you will gain access to the main map.

Monsters, treasures, bosses, rest points, and merchants are represented by specific icons, whose positions change with every playthrough, ensuring that each adventure is different from the last.



Once you click on an accessible point (indicated by the small yellow circle), your icon will move there and explore that location.

WARNING Once an area has been discovered and all available actions have been completed (combat, purchasing items from the merchant, collecting treasures, or restoring health at a rest point), the area will be emptied. You can click the tile again to explore alternative paths, but it will now be an empty zone.



During your journey, you may encounter a Merchant who will offer you 3 random items. If you have enough money, you can purchase weapons or equipment; otherwise, you’ll need to leave using the designated button, losing the chance to buy from that merchant.

But don’t worry—the dungeon is full of market areas, so there’s no need to despair! Your COMPULSIVE SHOPPING for weapons and gear will come later!



Colors are not chosen at random—they are carefully designed to assist the player.

Thanks to the color coding, you can immediately understand which stats influence the effect of a given item.

Each item has limited durability and a specific number and type of dice that the game will roll to calculate the actual damage dealt to creatures when the item is used.



Dice and Blades is a déjà vu—at Planet Studios, that’s exactly how we like to describe it. Those who choose this title do so to give themselves the chance to relive—or perhaps experience for the very first time—a world that, despite its modest 2D graphics and chaotic effects, still manages to deliver that spark of magic that once made video games gateways to the stars. A time when Space Invaders ruled the arcades, and the pinnacle of “PvP” was Pong, released by Atari back in ’72.

In a market saturated with big brands and even bigger disappointments, Tartarus Dice and Blades aims—through its bold colors and embarrassingly charming 8‑bit monsters—to captivate players and keep them coming back for more.

We believe not only in the project itself, but also in you—the players who sift through shelf after shelf in search not of just another game, but of an experience. With your support, we will take Dice and Blades far. Many updates are already in development to prove a simple truth: a game is not defined by its graphics, but by the gameplay that truly makes the difference.

4509030.name: Boya Coya
4509030.about_the_game:
Boya Coya is a two-player trick-taking card game inspired by the ancient card game Ganjifa, built for quick sessions and deep strategy. Master eight suits, declare Boya Coya (King–Queen–Jack of one suit) for bonus points, and outscore your opponent across three distinct ways to play.

Three Ways to Play

  • Relaxed - Follow the lead suit when you can; no trump. Win a trick with a King to lock that suit and force everyone to follow. Clean, readable, great for learning.

  • Strat - Trump rotates every five tricks. Pay 5 points to change trump. Arm Coya Challenge when leading a trick: guess right for +5, miss and lose 5 and the ability to challenge again. Turn timers keep the pace tight.

  • Custom - Mix and match. Choose a base (Suit Lock, Trump, or neither), toggle Boya Coya and Coya Challenge, set deck size (full, half, quarter), turn timer (off, 5s, 10s, 20s), and more. Your rules, your game.

Single Player & Multiplayer

  • Vs CPU - Jump into Relaxed, Strat, or Custom anytime. No waiting, no setup.

  • Online - Host a game or use matchmaking to find an opponent. Ranked matches track wins, losses, and rank so you can see how you stack up.

The Basics

  • Eight suits with a fixed hierarchy (Crown > Money > Banana > Skull > Diamond > Spade > Heart > Club). Higher suit wins when ranks tie.

  • Boya Coya - Declare K+Q+J of the same suit for 7 points; your next play must be a court card from that suit.

  • Bonus points - Streaks (3/4/5 tricks in a row), emptying your hand first, capturing a suit's full court or 7+ cards, most tricks in a suit, and more.

  • Shared rules - Opening lead by higher face-up card; draw after each trick; trump (in Strat/Custom trump modes) beats non-trump and rotates or can be bought.

Whether you want a fast Relaxed game vs the CPU or a ranked Strat match online, Boya Coya delivers a focused, tactical trick-taking experience built for two.

Meet the Cast


Sienna — The Unbroken Thread

Fierce enough to argue down critics and skilled enough to make glass look alive, she dares Callum to see legacy as something carried forward, not disappeared inside.

Odette — The Gilded Inventory

A French art historian and auction-house appraiser, Odette arrives to catalog a three-century glass collection—only to realize her job may destroy the very history she worships. Elegant, restless, and quietly romantic about objects and their stories, she draws Callum into a conspiracy of preservation that turns protocol into intimacy.

Petra — The Beautiful Fracture

A Berlin provocateur with an engineer's precision and an artist's ruthlessness, Petra creates by breaking—shattering Murano tradition to reveal what's hidden beneath the polish. What begins as technical collaboration becomes a romance built on shared guilt and sharp-edged honesty.

Will You Win Her Heart?

* * * * *

From the Black Codex of the Night Abbey, copied in a trembling hand and bound in cracked leather:

In the fading margins of ancient ink, the monks wrote of life and of dream, of the wandering spirit of a woman who walked the forgotten road beyond the white gate. It is said that in the elder medieval realm, before the fall of seven thrones, a strange narrative was whispered in cloisters and ruined tavern halls alike.

The tale begins not with glory but with a humble pie baked beside a roadside cafe, where a lone girl sat beneath a crooked roof, gazing into a tarnished mirror. Her dreamland visions were troubled by shadows: a vampire bride, a wandering orc hunter, and a silent killer whose blade gleamed with scarlet blood.

Many believed the legend mere madness, yet the gothic tales of the kingdom spoke otherwise. They told of wandering vikings, elf defenders, and a lonely dwarf slayer who traveled the ancient path through the haunted valley where werewolves howled beneath the star of the winter sky.

The monks warned that every traveler must make a choice, for the world itself is a puzzle crafted by god. Your wish may open one gate and close another. One road leads away from sorrow, another to the hidden dungeon where monster, fox, and wolf guard the buried treasure of the moonstone.

In those days the wandering orcs served a stern warchief, and rumors spoke of a muscular heroine among them, strong of muscle and bold of heart, a beautiful female orc whose character stirred both fear and romance. Some called her a princess, others a warrior woman, but the scrolls say she was simply a girl growing up in a land of endless wars.

She walked beneath the dark roof of forests and across coral island shores, where horses drank from streams and the song of the wind carried a melody through the trees. Her journey was an adventure, a fantastic adventure told in visual tales and whispered around the campfires of the camp beneath the volcano.

Many came with her: a wandering hunter, a quiet elf, a clever dog, and even a sly succubus who claimed to know the secret code of eden. Some were foreign, some were lucky, but all were bound by the same fragile thread of faith.

Through chaos, through war, through invasion and mass destruction, they traveled across the sandrock city, past the glowing neon street where demons danced and the air shimmered with magic.

Some nights they rested inside a ruined home, sharing fresh bread and a sweet drink brewed from a mysterious potion. Other nights they walked under the cold sky, each step echoing in the silence of time.

The monks wrote that the orc heroine had a strange theory about the soul. She believed that every being carried a hidden rune, a mark of fate that guided them through life, love, and death.

One night beside a flickering fire she did confess to her companions that she feared the nightmare of losing everything she held dear. For even the strongest warrior may die, and every path must someday end.

Yet hope remained. The clover fields near the island tavern shimmered with colorful blossoms, and the valley cafe served warm pie to weary travelers. There were moments of happiness, moments of date and gentle romantic love, where two souls might share a quiet prom night beneath the stars.

Still, the world was not without danger. A raging monster emerged from the hollow dungeon, and a cursed devil whispered promises of money, power, and forbidden lust. Some travelers were seduced, others stood firm with focus and order.

The scroll speaks of a strange effect that fell upon the land when the moonstone cracked. The core vein of the earth began to glow, opening a loop in time itself. Five days became one week, and nine dreams repeated like echoes in a broken mirror.

Through this immersive adventure, the companions fought in the arena of fate. Their combat was fierce, their courage stellar, their bonds forged in helping one another survive.

They crossed deserts of red sand, climbed the steps of ancient thrones, and faced the terrible dragons of the north. The empress of the ruined capital offered them a permit to enter the sacred paradise gate, but warned that no traveler who passed through would return unchanged.

There, at the edge of eternity, the muscular orc heroine stood beside her allies. Her hearts beat with courage as the wind carried a distant song across the realm.

She spoke softly.

“This is my fate. This is my adventure. Whether together or alone, we must come forward.”

And so they walked onward, walking into the unknown space between worlds, where genesis and final destruction sleep side by side.

Some say they found treasure.

Some say they found love.

Some say they found eden.

Others say they found only the silent gate.

Thus ends the edition of this scroll: heed the warnings, for in this realm pleasure and punish walk hand in hand, and every secret path leads, sooner or later, to the same dark gate.

4510100.name: Deadtective Academy
4510100.about_the_game:
Welcome to Mystery Academy!

Experience life as a newcomer at a school for detectives!

Explore a mysterious island filled with secrets and challenges designed to push new students to their limits. Study, build relationships, solve puzzles, and most importantly: DON’T TRUST ANYONE!

Survive supernatural cases in this Visual Novel, build bonds with your classmates, forge your reputation as the future of the Redlore family, and rise to become the greatest detective in the world.

Deadtective Academy Features

  • Build relationships with dozens of unique characters, form strong friendships or even… romance.

  • Unlockable image gallery.

  • Multiple music tracks themed around each character, plus original sound effects.

  • Story with multiple endings.

  • Unlockable achievements.

  • Investigate crimes and solve cases within Mystery Academy.

  • Attend classes taught by the world’s greatest detectives.

  • Choose whether to protect your family’s reputation or forge your own path.

  • Carefully crafted personalities designed for fans who love deep storytelling.

Characters

Elizabeth Harrington
Heir to the prestigious Harrington family. Shy and studious, she doesn’t seem particularly remarkable at first glance… but you might be surprised.

Lucio Stone
A boy from a humble background whose cowardice may be bigger than his own height. However, his knowledge about birds is absolutely enormous.

Aurora Everwinter
Cold as the night and pale as moonlight. A true prodigy in the world of investigation, though she isn’t exactly great with people.

Thomas Silvas
Charming, a bit of a rogue, and someone who knows how to enjoy life. Something tells me he has a thing for older women…

Seraphine Kingsley
A vegan and passionate animal lover, Seraphine is as sweet as honey and inseparable from her kitten, Will.

Kate
A true gamer who prefers sleepless nights playing video games over quiet afternoons studying… even if it means skipping a few showers.

Kael Eryndor
Tall and strong, yet lacking confidence in himself. Coming from a family of police officers, he dreams of making his mark in the world of investigation.

Emma Valkov
Elliot’s twin sister. Eccentric, vain, and extremely intelligent. Just be careful not to fall for her provocations.

Elliot Valkov
Emma’s twin brother. Elliot loves photography, but he loves his sister even more.

Nico Blake

Dante Leclair

Roxy

Dracilla

And many more…

4510210.name: Still in the Fog
4510210.about_the_game:
What seemed like a fresh start soon turns into something much darker. As personal struggles grow and reality begins to feel unstable, Nicolás finds himself trapped in a town that no longer makes sense.

After a mysterious event causes the entire town to vanish, Nicolás is forced to descend into an impossible underground structure. There, he discovers a massive abandoned complex shrouded in darkness, filled with hostile creatures and disturbing signs that something is very wrong. With no clear way out, the player must explore the environment, solve strategic puzzles, and survive while trying to progress.

The town is no longer the place he knew. The streets are blanketed in dense fog. Most of the population has disappeared without explanation. Communications are down. The world feels abandoned and disconnected from reality.

Determined to understand what happened, Nicolás continues seeking answers while trying to find a way back home. Along the way, he encounters his ex-girlfriend Ana and other survivors who were also trapped during the event.

As the journey progresses, reality becomes increasingly unstable.

What if the truth is not just tied to the town…?

Key Features

First-person psychological horror experience

Story-driven gameplay

Extensive environmental exploration

Melee combat and firearms

Complex puzzles and interactive elements

Inventory-based progression system

Atmospheric and immersive sound design

Offline single-player experience

4510260.name: Pixelords
4510260.about_the_game:
Build your deck before the battle begins!

Pixelords is a 2D pixel art autobattler where victory is decided not during combat, but in the preparation phase.

Assemble your squad, freely place your units on a gridless battlefield, and watch your strategy unfold.

Read your opponent’s composition, create synergies, and turn the tide with a single placement.

[Strategic Unit Placement]

Command 35 units across 10 different elements.

In Pixelords, there are no fixed tiles on the battlefield. You can place units anywhere you want, and every position becomes part of your strategy.

Frontline units hold the line, Rangers attack from the rear, and Guardians protect key allies.

The flow of battle changes completely depending on how you arrange your formation.

• 3 Roles — Attacker, Ranger, Guardian

Each role behaves differently in combat.

• 3 Traits — Hasty, Daring, Cunning

They determine which enemies your units prioritize.

• 3 Cost Tiers

Stronger units require more resources. Managing your coins is also a key part of strategy.

[Elemental Synergies]

Place units of the same element together to make them even stronger.

Each element has its own unique synergy effect, and the combinations you choose can completely change your battle style.

Combine elemental advantages and synergies to create your own formation.

[Various Game Modes]

• Arena — Real-time 1v1 ranked battles

Read your opponent’s composition, outplay them with positioning, and climb to higher tiers.

• Expedition — A PvE mode with 5 chapters and 11 stages each

Earn up to 3 stars on every stage, where unit management and coin economy are the keys to victory.

• Trials — A 1–4 player co-op endless survival mode

A shared battlefield, separate economies, and blessings granted on each floor create a new strategy every run.

[4-Player Co-op]

In Trials, up to 4 players fight together on a single battlefield.

Cover each other’s weaknesses, coordinate your builds, and see how far you can survive together.

Bosses appear every 10 floors to test your teamwork.

[SPELLS]

You can bring up to 3 spells into battle.

Healing, shields, stuns, and direct damage — use them at the right moment to turn the tide.

But spells use the same coins as unit placement.

Every choice comes at a cost.

[COLLECTION]

Your one-stop guide to everything in the game — units, spells, elements, skins, and more. See what you've uncovered and track down what's still waiting to be found.

4510480.name: Arduus: Minimalist Open World Survival Craft RPG
4510480.about_the_game:
Arduus: Minimalist Open World Survival Craft RPG was created with the idea of combining RPG, survival, and strategy elements into a simple, direct, and intuitive experience.

You are literally thrown into the medieval fantasy world of Arduus and start from nothing — with no tutorials guiding every step. Your character appears at a random location in a vast procedurally generated open world, and from that moment on everything is up to you: explore, survive, evolve, and find your own path.

You might choose to live a quiet life in the frozen mountains, become a spice merchant traveling across the scorching desert, or simply work at a small village tavern while saving money to buy your own home, there is no single path to follow — the adventure is shaped by the choices you make and the life you decide to build in this world.

  • Open World Sandbox – Freely explore a procedural world that can reach up to 1000x1000 tiles (1,000,000 tiles to explore).

  • Character Progression – Learn new knowledge and unlock advantages that shape your playstyle.

  • Mercy or Death – After every battle, decide the fate of your defeated enemies.

  • Resource Gathering – Collect herbs, ore, wood, and other resources.

  • Survival – Manage hunger, thirst, fatigue, injuries, fractures, and harsh weather conditions.

  • Crafting – Create tools, weapons, and armor to use or sell.

  • Dynamic Trading – Prices change depending on the merchant and the local economy of each region.

  • Shadow Market – Trade goods and services beyond the reach of the law.

  • Turn-Based Combat – Semi-automatic battles where you command your units each turn.

  • Low RNG Combat – Battles are designed so experience and strategy matter more than luck.

Hi! I'm Jimmy, the creator of Arduus. Thank you for giving the game a chance and taking the time to check out this page.

I'm a big fan of RPG and strategy games, but I've always felt there was room for experiences that offer depth without requiring hours to learn complex systems. That idea is what led me to start developing Arduus.

The goal has always been to create an open world with clear, intuitive, and easy-to-learn mechanics, where you can explore, survive, progress, and build at your own pace.

From the beginning, the game has been designed to receive constant updates, allowing the world to expand, new content to be added, and the game to evolve alongside the community.

If you'd like to follow the development and share ideas, you're more than welcome to join the community.
Your feedback helps shape the future of Arduus — and it makes a huge difference to me as a developer.

4510550.name: Luck of the Draw
4510550.about_the_game:
Step into the glowing lights of a neon pub and test your luck in Luck of the Draw, an unpredictable card battle where every draw matters.

The rules are simple—but victory is anything but.

Players take turns drawing and playing cards from a shared deck, each one capable of shifting the balance of the match. Your objective is to give your opponent 5 hearts before they manage to give you 5.

Sounds easy… until the deck starts working against you.

Set on a stylish neon pub stage, each round becomes a tense back-and-forth of risk, timing, and pure luck. One perfect card can be the one to make your opponent cum.

Features

Varied Card Battles
Draw from the deck and play cards that influence the flow of the match.

Heart-Based Win Condition
The first player to lose ALL hearts loses. Pass them to your opponent before they pass them to you.

Neon Pub Atmosphere
Battle on a vibrant stage filled with glowing lights and nightlife energy.

Luck Meets Strategy
Every card draw can flip the outcome of the game.

Quick, Replayable Matches
Short, intense rounds make every game feel different.

In Luck of the Draw, fortune favors the bold… but the deck always has the final say.

4510580.name: Space Salvage Simulator
4510580.about_the_game:
An Endless Stream of Space Debris

In the distant future, humanity discovered the mysterious substance 'Ether' and embarked on a path of explosive expansion. "What is left in the wake of humanity's conquest across the stars?" Philosophers, activists, and politicians debate this endlessly. But if someone asked you right now, your answer would be simple: nothing but a massive mountain of garbage.

Why?

Because you fell victim to a joint-surety scam and got dragged off to a waste disposal station on a prison planet at the edge of the galaxy. To get out of here—or just to survive another week—you have to work every single day to pay off your massive debt.

The endless junk pouring onto the conveyor belt day after day isn't just trash; it's a recyclable resource and your only ticket to salvation.

Unlock numerous blueprints and use over 15 different crafting tools. Grab the debris, process it, and transform the scraps into high-value goods.

Do EVERYTHING yourself.

You can't just pop down to the local mart or visit the neighboring planet's mega-mall. This is a prison you know.

You have to make everything yourself—from the tools you use, to the very opportunity to escape this hellhole.

Betting and Gambling: An Irresistible Temptation

Sick of doing honest work? Of course you are, Who doesn't?

Fortunately, there's a place even in this miserable joint for people who want to get rich quick.

And for those people, this prison offers a very tempting alternative.

Welcome to the weekly Arena—where the line between "sports" and "bloody gang warfare" is practically non-existent. As a non-violent financial criminal, you aren't allowed to fight in it (or even watch it, really—you just get bullied out of your lunch money). But hey, the betting pool is open to everyone!

Chase that jackpot dream by betting on the Arena, or try your luck at the infamous fair matching game that has bankrupted countless inmates before you.

That is... if you have a really sharp eye.

Use Your Words, Not Just Your Wrench

"No man is an island"—and that goes double when you're locked in a space prison.

Buy insider info from sketchy brokers to conquer the betting pool with actual strategy, or eavesdrop on the bartender for some juicy tips. Interact with a colorful cast of inmates, complete their quests, and reap the rewards.

Will you reclaim your hope and buy your freedom through endless, grueling labor? Or will you just be buried alive under an infinite stream of cosmic trash...?

And more importantly... can you uncover the dark secret hidden deep within this station?

4510730.name: 1B1E
4510730.about_the_game:
Welcome to a city where the sun has gone out forever.

It never stops raining. Neon signs cast their last rays on the wet asphalt, and the shadows have become home to those who don't come out in the light. You are the one who comes in the night. Your goal? To get to the bottom of things. Your methods? Deadly.

A city that breathes betrayal

Who are you: a detective on the brink of madness, a mercenary with a broken past, or an executioner carrying out the sentence of this city? The truth is hidden in the clouds of cigarette smoke and the echoes of gunshots.

A deadly dance in three dimensions

Forget about gunfights in the corridors. Every corner is a trap, and every door is a one-way ticket. The hardcore mechanics of "one hit equals death" make you think and move faster than the enemy.

The aesthetics of pure noir

The entire world is designed in a strict, dark color scheme, with the only bright spot being the cold neon of signs and lamps. The deep shadows conceal the enemy.

Now, specifically about what awaits you:

Hardcore gameplay

  • Enemies die with a single hit, but you will also die from a single bullet.

  • React lightning fast: decision time is measured in fractions of a second.

Visual aesthetics

  • A gloomy world: a world in dull colors, where the only color is the light of lanterns and neon.

  • An atmosphere of despair created by the sounds of rain and the echo of gunshots.

Content

  • 14 cards.

  • 16 weapons, from pistols to shotguns.

  • 3 enemies, from street dogs to the head of the mafia.

Are you ready to find out what lies behind the rain? The lights go out, and it's time to make your move.

Experience the thrill of offensive and defensive tug-of-war, and the rush of a crushing checkmate. Once you master the rhythm, you’ll be pulling off jaw-dropping blitz chess moves in no time.

4510910.name: 迴避我的死亡結局
4510910.about_the_game:

4510930.name: Refugee of a Lost Age
4510930.about_the_game:
Forget those leisurely farm simulations. In this game:

  • You farm, not to expand your farm, but to avoid starving to death in winter.

  • You make friends, not to collect gifts, but to have someone vouch for you when government soldiers come to conscript you.

  • Every NPC is part of your survival strategy—they could be your lifeline or your death warrant.

  • *Refugee of a Lost Age* is a survival simulator that takes the "interpersonal relationship system" to the extreme. You will be immersed in a dynamic micro-society filled with calculations and warmth. Every sowing, every conversation, every knock on the door in the dead of night is a life-or-death choice. Your goal is simple: as an insignificant nobody in an era of heroes, do your utmost to survive until the end.

  • Your hand, which just gripped a hoe, has just let go of your neighbor's cold corpse. He owed you three bushels of wheat last week, but now, all you find in his arms is half a moldy pancake.

    This is not murder; it's just an ordinary dusk in some year.

  • In the game *Refugee of a Lost Age*, you will experience the life of a commoner completely crushed by grand history. What you need to calculate is not the profit from crops, but whether to curry favor with the local gentry or help the widow who might not survive the winter before the next famine strikes. Your granary and your conscience can never be filled at the same time.
4510930.supported_languages:
English, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*
*languages with full audio support

4510950.name: Padel Impact Pro
4510950.about_the_game:
Experience the Ultimate Padel Simulation

Step onto the court and discover the most authentic padel experience available on PC. Whether you are a real-life padel veteran or a newcomer to the sport, this simulator captures the dynamic rallies, strategic positioning, and fast-paced energy of the world's fastest-growing racquet sport.

Forget arcade-style tennis games—this is pure, tactical padel.

Key Features:

  • True-to-Life Physics & Simulation Master the unique mechanics of the sport. Use the glass walls to keep the rally alive, execute perfect tactical lobs (globos), and finish the point with powerful smashes. The game features realistic ball weight, spin, and authentic court dimensions.

  • Seamless Online Multiplayer The court is always open. Connect with friends for casual games or challenge opponents from around the globe in smooth online matches.

  • Competitive Ranked Mode Ready to prove your skills? Enter the Ranked ladder, climb through the divisions, and fight for the top spot on the global leaderboards. Every match counts, every point matters. Adapt your strategy, outsmart your opponents, and become the ultimate padel champion.

  • Strategic Gameplay Padel is about brains as much as brawn. Positioning and patience are just as important as reflexes. Learn to read the game, anticipate the bounces off the fence, and control the net.
4510950.supported_languages:
English*, Spanish - Spain*
*languages with full audio support

4510980.name: Kart Soccer Party
4510980.about_the_game:
Kart Soccer Party is a chaotic and hilarious party-style game with full Steam online multiplayer support.

There’s only one thing you need to do: drive your kart and smash the giant soccer ball into the opponent’s goal to secure victory for your team!

Features:

  • Three maps (small, medium, large) to fit different player counts

  • Multiple karts with different performance stats to unlock and purchase

  • A variety of unique characters with different appearances (using free assets from Mixamo :))

  • Wild and chaotic physics — get ready for balls flying everywhere!

  • Surprisingly fun — I’ve spent hours playing it myself… even with bots. And yes, it’s even better online!
4510980.supported_languages: English, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean

4510990.name: Ward Zero
4510990.about_the_game:
Ward Zero is a co-op psychological horror experience where you and up to 3 other players take on the role of investigators sent to uncover the truth behind a missing persons case.

You are assigned to find Simon, a 22-year-old man who vanished without a trace.

Your search leads you to the State Psychiatric Rehabilitation Facility — a place long abandoned… yet not entirely empty.

What begins as a routine investigation quickly turns into a descent into fear.

As you dig deeper into the facility, you uncover evidence of unethical experiments conducted on patients—experiments that were never meant to be exposed.

"Some people were never meant to be found."

Gameplay

INVESTIGATE THE UNKNOWN

Explore a dark, abandoned asylum filled with locked wards, hidden pathways, and disturbing evidence. Piece together what happened through notes, environmental storytelling, and eerie encounters.

PLAY SOLO OR CO-OP

Face the horror alone or with friends. Work together to solve puzzles, unlock new areas, and survive what lurks inside. Every interaction and objective is shared across players, making teamwork essential.

SURVIVE UNPREDICTABLE ENCOUNTERS

You are not alone.

Entities roam the halls, reacting to player movement, light, and sound.

Sometimes the safest choice… is to look away.

4511140.name: Unforgettable Love
4511140.about_the_game:
A young man (the player) wakes up with amnesia, remembering nothing about his past. Ingdao, believing she accidentally hit him while practicing driving, takes responsibility for bringing him to the hospital, giving him the temporary name “Pe Luem,” and letting him stay at her home. The only things he has with him are an empty phone and a job application for UPON Company. And so, his journey to recover his lost memories begins.

Ing-Dao

A bright and kind-hearted young woman who works freelance in voice recording, dubbing, and singing. She is the one who saved you and gave you the name “Pe Luem.” Behind her cheerful smile lies a dream left behind and a past that has yet to heal.

I-Da

A highly capable and dedicated HR manager who excels at her job, yet hides deep loneliness within. Trapped in a distorted relationship, she must face a truth that could change her life forever.

Nene

A cheerful and seemingly clumsy intern who secretly possesses sharp intelligence and strong determination. She has infiltrated the company to uncover the truth and is willing to do whatever it takes to seek justice.

Milin

A hardworking and determined café owner who takes on multiple jobs to achieve a single goal. She must earn 10 million before turning 30 to break free from a life she did not choose and take control of her own future.

Proud

A meticulous investment consultant who strives for perfection in everything she does. Beneath her flawless exterior lies pressure and a painful past, making it difficult for her to open up to others.

Key Features

■ Fully Immersive First-Person Romance

Experience every moment through the eyes of the protagonist. Engage in conversations, make meaningful choices, and build relationships naturally in a fully first-person perspective that brings every moment to life.

■ Accessible Branching Storylines

Enjoy a rich and diverse narrative with deeper story paths. Unlock hidden endings and special CGs through your choices and explore multiple relationship routes.

■ Realistic Performances with Cinematic Visuals

Experience natural acting paired with high-quality visuals. Every scene is crafted to deliver emotional depth and realism.

■ Strategic Gameplay System

Enhance your experience by managing your finances through stock trading while uncovering lost memories. Plan your decisions carefully to influence story paths, discover hidden choices, and unlock key moments.

■ Stock Trading Currency System

Manage your income through an in-game stock trading simulation. Analyze market trends, buy and sell strategically, and accumulate wealth. Use your earnings to unlock content, key scenes, and increase your chances of deepening relationships with each heroine.

■ High Replayability

Every decision matters. With multiple branching paths, hidden choices, and different endings, each playthrough offers a fresh and unique experience.

■ Distinct and Memorable Heroines

From a cheerful girl hiding emotional scars, to a capable yet emotionally vulnerable career woman, to a lively intern with a hidden agenda, each heroine has her own story and relationship path, waiting for you to shape.

4511290.name: Stack Chaos: Alien Express
4511290.about_the_game:
Welcome to Alien Express™ — the galaxy's worst delivery company.


You're an alien delivery driver with a tractor beam, a swinging pendulum, and exactly 5 seconds per package. Where it lands, it stays. Build the tallest tower of possessed cartoon horror objects... or watch it all come crashing down.

We drop, you pray.

The Game

Your UFO swings cargo like a pendulum. Move left, move right — the package follows with momentum and inertia. Cut the beam at the perfect moment, or the auto-drop kicks in after 5 seconds.

Drop fast = more points. Drop risky = even more points. Drop wrong = total chaos.

What's Inside

  • 400+ possessed objects with unique physics and personality
  • 11 game modes — from classic stacking to inverted pyramids
  • 36 UFO skins
  • A sarcastic goblin that roasts your every move
  • Global leaderboards and daily challenges
  • Stream Rooms — your viewers compete against you live
  • Atmospheric chaos: meteorites, storms, birds
  • 12 languages, Steam Achievements, Cloud Save

English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain*, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Polish, Turkish, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support

4511370.name: 非凡仙途
4511370.about_the_game:
🎮 《非凡仙途》游戏简介

你从一场亘古大梦中醒来，发现自己身处云雾缭绕的仙山之上。眼前，是凌霄殿宇的巍峨剪影；耳边，是远古神祇的低语回响。风云录上，还有无数空缺等待填满；上古神器，正等待着命定之人的召唤。天庭与魔界的裂隙日益扩大，三界将乱，而你——被天道选中的那个人，将握紧权柄，改写乾坤。

在这里，你不再只是故事的旁观者。作为西游神话题材的放置卡牌手游，《非凡仙途》让你成为能亲手统领三界神将的“天命之人”，这场属于你的神话战纪，即将拉开帷幕。

⚔️ 核心特色

独特的碰撞战斗

游戏的核心魅力在于“轻操作、重策略”。你无需繁琐的操作，神将们将依据你精心布置的阵容，在独特的碰撞战斗玩法中冲锋陷阵。

多样的阵容组合

战斗的胜负关键在于战前的策略博弈——你需要深刻理解每位神将的特性，利用神将技能的多样搭配，组合出攻守兼备的理想队伍：

强力击退流：赵云 + 关羽 + 共工 + 姜子牙 + 南极仙翁

召唤分身流：哪吒 + 齐天大圣 + 孙策 + 妲己 + 观音

法师爆发流：钟馗 + 元始天尊 + 刑天 + 祝融 + 刘备

强力的羁绊搭配

你的神将阵容可谓星光熠熠，从英武不凡的哪吒，到兼具输出与防御的关羽、孙悟空等神话历史名人，每一位英雄都拥有独特的定位与技能，等待着你的发掘与培养。

在这里，经典可以重现，传奇亦可新生：

齐天大圣 + 猪八戒 + 唐僧 —— 西天取经

刘备 + 诸葛亮 + 赵云 + 刘禅 —— 汉室复兴

共工 + 祝融 + 盘古 —— 上古大神

每一段羁绊的激活，都将带来意想不到的战力飞跃。

🌟 惊喜的修仙体验

在这片广袤的仙侠世界中，精彩远不止于战场：

你可以深入副本挑战，探寻万象幻境的奥秘；

也可以在幽冥魔窟中战胜无穷无尽的怪物，不断超越自我；

潜入太古禁地探寻上古宝藏，或闯进赤炎炼狱消灭三大魔兽；

最终，登上御神宝殿，俯仰众生，睥睨天下。

📈 角色养成

游戏提供了多维度的养成线，让你的每一分投入都看得见成长!

神兵利器：龙鸣剑、玄武铠……打造属于你的绝世神装。

琴棋书画：闲情逸致，休养生息，于方寸间感悟大道。

神像共鸣：打造神像，与天地共鸣，实现实力的突破。

神器觉醒：唤醒上古神器，焕发全新技能，逆转战局。

元灵唤醒：让沉睡的元灵觉醒，为己身获得永恒加持。

山海异兽：抓捕《山海经》中的奇珍异兽，锁妖炼化，提升实力。

👑 仙途登顶

当实力足够强大，真正的征途才刚刚开始：

你将在斗法大会的舞台上，与天下英杰一较高下，为荣誉而战，问鼎三界之巅!

《非凡仙途》为你构建了一个诸神云集、英雄辈出的幻想世界，巧妙地将中国古典名著与上古传说熔于一炉。既适合利用碎片化时间轻松游玩的休闲玩家，也能满足热衷于钻研阵容、追求极致战力的策略爱好者。

天命已现，等你来战。

4511460.name: Beneath Cloudvein
4511460.about_the_game:
A dwarven mining expedition has gone silent — and you uncover might be more than it seems on the surface.

Overview

Beneath Cloudvein is a single-developer project, with a focus on story, immersion and role-playing, which you will be able to complete in a couple of hours. However, you might want to replay the game for a different ending later on.

Setting

The game takes place in the Lightcrowned Mountains, in the Cloudvein Plateau, where a dwarven expedition seemingly vanished. You are tasked with investigating what happened, and to do this you’ll travel the area, discover its remote communities and challenge adversaries.

Gameplay and progression

Through your journey you will meet the inhabitants of the Plateau. You will be able to talk to them, undertake quests and discover a conflict brewing in your path. By engaging with people, you will be able to gain essential skills and gear before facing the strange enemies in the mine. 

Combat

Combat in Beneath Cloudvein is real time, you will need to use parrying or positioning to gain an advantage over your enemies.

Immerse yourself in the world

The game was designed to be immersive, with a minimalist user interface. In-game you will be able to find an overview of the game world, a map together with all your active quests and their details. You will use this map in addition to a compass to find your way around the Plateau.

The outcomes of your actions

Your actions during the game will affect not only your outcomes, but the fate of the locals and how a yet unknown conflict will escalate. Depending on what you do, you will determine the key points of your ending.

Soundtrack

The game features an original orchestral soundtrack to make your journey more enjoyable.

During your investigation you will:

  • Explore a small handcrafted fantasy world 

  • Investigate a mysterious dwarven mining expedition 

  • Meet the inhabitants of the Plateau and shape their fate 

  • Engage in real-time combat focused on parrying and positioning 

  • Discover multiple endings based on your decisions 

  • Navigate the world using an immersive minimal interface 

  • Enjoy an original orchestral soundtrack

4511480.name: Corporate Board
4511480.about_the_game:
The Sky-High Price of Success

Corporate Board is a high-stakes psychological thriller set in a near-future where the most valuable commodity isn’t data or oil—it’s sanity. You step into the bespoke Italian leather shoes of Kiran Deshmukh, a high-ranking executive at Cognitive Mirage Ltd. and a key figure in the enigmatic faction known as the Mindcrafters.

Classic Survival Horror Reborn

Corporate Board pays homage to the golden era of horror, blending the suffocating atmosphere of Silent Hill with the tense, investigative mystery of Resident Evil.

  • Psychological Dystopia: Experience a world where corporate greed has manifested into physical rot. The sterile glass and chrome of the upper floors melt into surreal, fleshy landscapes that reflect the twisted psyches of the Board Members.

  • Tactical Investigation: Resources are scarce. Manage your inventory of office supplies-turned-weapons and cryptic memos as you solve intricate environmental puzzles designed to keep the unworthy out.

  • The Board is Watching: Each floor is a gauntlet governed by the sins of a specific executive. Face grotesque manifestations of Avarice, Nepotism, and Cruelty—monsters that were once human, before the pursuit of profit stripped them of their souls.

Uncover the Truth

As Kiran, you aren't just fighting for your life; you’re fighting for the truth. Peel back layers of a massive conspiracy through deep lore found in discarded emails, hidden voice logs, and the environmental storytelling of a workplace turned into a slaughterhouse.

The Protagonist: Kiran Deshmukh

Kiran is the boardroom’s elegant and detached Cleaner, tasked with psychologically manipulating the company’s enemies. However, a routine hostile takeover reveals an impossible digital footprint, forcing Kiran to realize that Cognitive Mirage Ltd. is just a pawn in a far more lethal conspiracy.

4511570.name: HOLO-KINGDOM
4511570.about_the_game:
The kingdom stands on the brink of collapse.

To save the world—and the people who cherish Hololive—
a warrior takes up their weapon once more.

■ What is HoloKingdom?

This is a world kept in peace by the “Holomembers,” beings blessed with extraordinary powers.

However, a sudden invasion by a mysterious enemy has plunged the kingdom into its greatest crisis.

You must protect the last hope, Princess Luna, and lead this battle to victory.

■ What kind of game is it?

This is a 3D action game where you control Hololive members and fight your way through enemies to clear each stage.

Each of the four playable characters wields a unique weapon and combat style, challenging you to survive intense battles.

Learn skills rooted in the history of the Holo Kingdom and defeat incoming enemies with each character’s distinctive abilities.

Some stages also feature light puzzle elements that you must solve in order to progress.

4511600.name: ゼロから始まる終わりの村／The Village of the End Starting from Zero
4511600.about_the_game:
This is a sandbox slow life x idle game SLG.

◆Contents

Start as Zero and run a book inn while completing errands (quests) to report back to clear stages!

As you complete stages, your romance with the heroine, Ray, will also progress.

While Ray is the only playable character, there are many NPC characters who will ask you to complete quests.

◆ Features

Every 60 seconds, money, stats, and experience points will increase by 1.

After another 5000 seconds, you'll randomly receive valuable crafting materials and your stats will increase.

Although players have HP, they will recover immediately even if they are defeated, making the gameplay less frustrating. However, we want players to live a normal human life.

◆What You Can Do

Village Development/Village Revitalization (Increases as houses and facilities rank up)

Crafting (Cooking/Crafting)

Vegetable Farming (Simple Farming)

Dairy Farming (Simple Feeding)

Fishing (Catching Probability is Quite Severe)

Mining (Examine Stones)

Bug Catching (Prepare Lots of Nets)

Plant Hunting

Mushroom Hunting

Customer Service (Go to the Counter)

Errands (Quests)

Inspect Inn Books (Status Boost)

Book Lending Service: Inn-like Activities (From the Bulletin Board Outside (Image ↑))

Events Triggered by Working or Ignoring the Service

Publishing a Book (Earn Royalties)

Complete item encyclopedia!

There are exactly 400 types of items alone! 71 types of weapons and 100 types of armor!

You can fill up your item encyclopedia by putting in the effort to "explore."

Even if you don't want to fight the golem that appears at the end, you can beat it just by living your life.

◆Guidelines for Reviews, Comments, and Reviews

Posting is OK. In fact, we ask for your support.

When posting on the site, we strictly prohibit any actions intended to tarnish or defame our brand, such as star ratings or rankings.

We have not made any terrible games, so we take no responsibility for them. Please understand this and play at your own risk.

◆ Commentary Guidelines

Please feel free to commentate! It's very welcome.

Monetary commentary is also acceptable. However, please be sure to follow the rules below.

1. Defamation (listening to the negative aspects of the game to make people laugh, streamer comments, and listener comments) is not allowed.

2. Please do not allow children to watch the game or cause any viewers any discomfort.

3. Please include links to the gameplay or purchase sites. Please also include the title of the stream when streaming.

(This is now required to prevent hidden commentary. Thank you for your understanding.)

Appropriate action will be taken against anyone who violates the rules.

We will request deletion and report the user. In some cases, legal action may be considered.

Please be sure to observe common sense and good manners as a human being.

The rules are easy to learn, but each match offers surprising strategic depth. Players who think ahead, recognize their opponent’s options, and prepare their moves carefully will gain the decisive advantage.

Whether playing alone, together on one device, or online against others,
Hus: The 4-Row Mancala offers multiple ways to play for different situations and playstyles.

Features

  • Local vs Bot – play against the AI and improve your strategy

  • Local vs Local – challenge friends on the same device

  • Local vs Remote – play online with friends (no matchmaking available)

  • Cross-platform play on Windows, Linux, and Android

  • A tactical board game with easy-to-learn rules and strategic depth

Who is this game for?

Hus: The 4-Row Mancala is for everyone who enjoys classic board games, calm strategy games, and direct head-to-head matches. Whether you want a quick game or an intense duel, every round offers new possibilities.

4511770.name: Rent a Boyfriend
4511770.about_the_game:
Step into a world where money can buy almost anything, even love.

In Rent a Boyfriend, you play as a man trying to make his way through life who finds himself working as a high-end escort for the city's elite. Managed by the strict and calculating Zoe, you are used to fulfilling the fantasies of wealthy, lonely women. It’s a lucrative job, and he knows the rules: keep it professional, satisfy the client, and never get emotionally involved.

But the rules are about to change. When you are sent to a massive, eerily quiet mansion, you meet Juliet, a stunning, incredibly wealthy heiress who doesn't want a night of passion. Instead, she offers him a contract he can't refuse: act as her deeply devoted boyfriend to deceive her high-society family. What starts as a simple, highly-paid business arrangement quickly spirals into a complicated web of secrets, drama, and undeniable tension. As the lines between fake affection and genuine desire begin to blur, Mason must navigate the dangerous waters of the elite world. Will you stick to the script and keep it strictly business, or will you risk everything for something real?

KEY FEATURES:

Your Choices Matter: You are in control of your own personality. Be sarcastic, professional, or genuine. Your dialogue choices and actions will directly impact your relationships and the direction of the story.

Deep, Character-Driven Story: Dive into a thrilling narrative filled with unexpected twists, high-society drama, and complex characters who all have something to hide.

Stunning 3D Visuals: Experience the luxurious lifestyle of the ultra-rich with high-quality, realistic renders, beautiful character models, and immersive environments.

Multiple Romance Paths: Juliet isn't the only woman in Mason's life. Meet, interact with, and romance a variety of beautiful and intriguing women, each with their own unique storylines and desires.

Steamy Encounters: An Adult Visual Novel experience that delivers intense, passionate, and beautifully crafted NSFW scenes as relationships naturally progress.
