4511810.name: Idle Slot Machine
4511810.about_the_game:
Idle Slot Machine is a chaotic and entertaining idle/management game built around slot machines, monkey workers, and nonstop money-making. You begin by spinning your machines manually, earning cash with every pull, and slowly turning a tiny setup into a booming automated operation.

At the start, everything depends on you. You click your slot machines to earn money, then use that income to buy helper monkeys. Once hired, these monkeys begin spinning the machines for you, allowing your operation to keep generating profit even faster. With every new machine and every new worker, your small business grows into a larger and more efficient money-making system.

But building your empire is not just about growth. Your machines constantly attract trouble. Thief gorillas try to steal your slot machines, eagles swoop in to snatch your monkeys, and clown gorillas distract your workers, temporarily stopping production. Expanding your operation is important, but protecting it is just as critical.

To maximize your profits, you can unlock skill tree upgrades that improve income, speed, automation, and overall efficiency. Every choice matters: buy more machines, hire more monkeys, or invest in upgrades to push your earnings even further.

From a humble beginning to a massive idle profit empire, your goal is simple: automate everything, survive the chaos, and keep the money flowing.

Features

  • Start by manually spinning slot machines

  • Buy new machines to expand your operation

  • Hire helper monkeys to automate production

  • Unlock skill tree upgrades for better profit and efficiency

  • Defend your business against thief gorillas, eagles, and clown gorillas

  • Build a growing idle economy with automation-focused progression

  • Enjoy a simple but addictive gameplay loop centered on expansion and optimization

4511850.name: The Great Beyond
4511850.about_the_game:
Dig! Defend! Develop!

The choices you make in this RTS game are critical.

Build utilities, worker amenities, living quarters, and production factories to keep your economy flowing. Then, prepare for the onslaught of enemies by building towers, hiring and training Battle Engineers, and managing your energy and ammo reserves. But, not all missions are the same!

There are a variety of mission types!

  • Protect the galaxy from a mysterious virus found on an asteroid, and stop the spread!

  • Defeat bandits of aliens destroying local settlements!

  • Complete special research projects by gathering samples and completing tasks!

  • Run a profitable mining site!

  • Refuel rundown ships!

  • Discover and retrieve artifacts deep underground!

  • Repopulate a planet destroyed by volcanos!

The Developer

You might recognise me as Borrego6165 - my old account related to the game studio LVGameDev. I helped them on games such as SimAirport and SimCasino! This is a solo project unrelated to that studio. I have lots of experience with tycoon/simulation games, and wanted to add a survival twist!

4511900.name: Sandwich +1
4511900.about_the_game:
Your only job? Stack food towers as high as they'll go. Sandwich +1 is a cozy idle clicker where every click adds to the pile, and stress is not on the menu.

🥪 Click, Stack, Grow

Every click drops a random ingredient. Build wobbling, towering sandwiches and send them off to thirsty, happy customers. The taller the tower, the bigger your payout!

🧑‍🍳 Automate Your Kitchen

Tired of clicking? Hire cute flying spatulas and whisks to do the work for you. Upgrade their speed, buy more prep stations, and watch your kitchen turn into a self-sustaining sandwich empire while you sit back and relax.

✨ Discover Legendary Ingredients

Unlock dozens of new fillings to add to your random drop pool. Start with simple cheese and lettuce, and work your way up to legendary lobster and steak. Hit a special combo? Watch your customers react!

🛋️ No Stress. Seriously.

  • Zero Stress: No timers, no failing, no burnt food. You can't lose.
  • Play at Your Pace: Jump in for a 5-minute break or chill for an hour.
  • Satisfying Progression: Constant upgrades, new stations, and numbers that only go up.
  • Cozy Vibe: Warm colors, satisfying "plop" sounds, and nothing but good vibes.

4512010.name: Auction House
4512010.about_the_game:
Rule the server economy without the MMO grind.

Welcome to your personal goblin-mode fantasy. Auction House is a single-player incremental economy simulator where the only thing that matters is making your gold counter go up. Start as a lowly gatherer clicking copper nodes, and scale up into a ruthless tycoon controlling a massive, interwoven empire of crafters and gatherers.

Start Small, Automate Everything, Build a Kingdom
Every tycoon starts somewhere. Click to mine ores, sell them for pennies, and use your meager profits to buy better tools. Once you have the gold, hire goblin foremen to automate your resource gathering. Go from painfully chipping away at copper to passively generating thousands of exotic materials while you focus on the real game: the market.

Build the Ultimate "Alt Army"
Why buy materials when you can make them yourself? Use your wealth to unlock new character slots and assign them specialized professions. Create massive, complex "shuffle" trains through your communal Bank Vault:

  • Your Miner deposits raw Copper, Tin, and an assortment of Ore.

  • Your Blacksmith turns it into Bars, Equipment, and Swords.

  • Your Enchanter enchants the Swords.

  • You Warrior uses Food from the Chef & Farmer and Potions from the Herbalist and Enchanted Swords from the Mage to Slay Beasts.

  • Your Mage disenchants the Monster Loot into Aether Dust.

  • Your Jewelcrafter uses the Aether Dust to forge glowing rings that sell for a greedy markup!

Manipulate the AI Auction House
The market is alive. Prices on the Auction House fluctuate based on simulated world events and AI behaviors. Reagents sell fast with low margins, while epic gear sells slow for massive payouts. Cash in straight away, or time the market and sell high.

The Dopamine of the "Proc"
Numbers going up is good, but sudden explosions of wealth are better. Every time you gather or craft, you roll against your character's stats for massive casino-style dopamine hits:

  • Multicraft: Instantly duplicate your crafting output by 2x, 5x, or even 10x for free!

  • Resourcefulness: Save precious, expensive raw materials during a craft.

Key Features:

  • Satisfying Incremental Progression: From manual clicking to massive automated production lines.

  • Deep Crafting Chains: Over a dozen professions and hundreds of recipes to discover.

  • Dynamic Economy: Play the market, flip items, and predict AI-driven price trends.

Do you have what it takes to buy a kingdom?

4512020.name: Ivy‘s Dream Cafe

Have you ever wondered if your dreams were designed by someone?

Ivy never used to dream.
Until one night, she does.

The dream feels strange, almost like it was planned in advance. Some of the things in it seem to exist in the real world too.

As nightmares begin to spread across Dream Town, Ivy finds herself pulled into something much bigger than she expected. Something connected to her dream, and to someone she has completely forgotten.

Learn magic, uncover the rules of dreams, and travel between dreams, illusions, and reality as you search for answers.

Can you uncover the secret behind the dream?

  • Investigate the truth: follow subtle hints, and reveal what was never spoken aloud

  • Dream magic: cast spells, traverse nightmares, and track dream beasts

  • Make emotional choices: decide whether to question, protect, forgive, or let go

  • Visual & audio style: hand-painted dreamscapes, emotional lighting, and original healing soundtrack

  • A story that resonates : explore themes of identity, self-perception, and emotional struggles through a gentle, women perspective narrative

4512120.name: Hentai Remedy

4512130.name: Sanguis OS
4512130.about_the_game:
Welcome to Sanguis OS.

You are the sole operator of the Leviathan, a massive, blood-fueled drilling machine designed to harvest the energy of the underworld. Your mission is simple but suicidal: descend through the 9 layers of Hell, keep the engine running, and survive.

You cannot see the outside world. Your only connection to reality is a claustrophobic retro-terminal interface. You must rely on your radar, cameras, and resource readouts to make life-or-death decisions.

Key Features:

  • Micro-Manage Survival: Balance your blood (fuel), engine heat, and hull integrity. If you run out of blood, you fall into the abyss. If the engine overheats, you burn.

  • The Venting Dilemma: To cool down the overheated engine, you must open the vents. But opening the vents allows the horrors of Hell to breach your hull. Neutralize threats before they destroy your armor.

  • Demonic Malware: The energy of Hell corrupts digital systems. Fight off demonic viruses like Gluttony (drains your RAM), Illusion (creates fake error pop-ups), and Scramble (mixes up your controls).

  • Harvest the Damned: Blood running low? Activate the crushers to harvest demons and keep the pump flowing.

  • Deep Descent: Descend from Limbo down to the 9th Circle: Treachery. Every layer brings new anomalies and aggressive system failures.

Can you maintain the system, or will you become another ghost in the machine?

4512190.name: ZrOth
4512190.about_the_game:
In this strange world ruled by Zroth, you must regularly pay a tribute to avoid the apocalypse.

Your goal is to gather the resources needed to pay this tribute before time runs out.

To do this, you will need to use these resources wisely to capture locations that will give you even more in return.

Resources

You have 3 resources to manage, each with a special purpose:

  • Wood, used for building.

  • Gold, used to upgrade your base.

  • Villagers, used to capture specific locations.

But be careful each resource is also required to build paths toward new locations and expand your territory, so make sure you don’t run out of any of them.

Locations

There are several types of locations that allow you to acquire the resources needed to pay the tribute and expand your kingdom:

  • Forests for wood.

  • Mines for gold.

  • Villages for villagers.

Each location has its own system for generating resources, so use them to create powerful combos!

There are also other locations to discover that will either strengthen or weaken you. Among them are relic sites.

Relics

Relics are strange objects that grant effects to your kingdom. Don’t miss them, they will make your journey easier.

However, be careful, your kingdom can only hold a limited number of these powerful relics. It’s up to you to choose wisely and create your own build.

Biomes

The world of ZrOth is made up of many different biomes that affect your kingdom.

Use them to your advantage, or avoid dangerous ones to expand safely.

Replayability

Each defeat makes you stronger by unlocking new effects and environments that you can use!

The World of ZrOth

The world of ZrOth is cruel, and only by using all its rules to your advantage will you gather enough resources to survive.

It’s up to you to endure as long as possible and build the most prosperous kingdom.

And never forget… ZrOth is watching you

4512200.name: Spirit Demon Tribulation
4512200.about_the_game:
• Shan Hai's Splendour, Truly Rendered,

  • Mystic Familiars, Friendship Gendered.

  • Tactical Fights, Where Fortunes Are Spurned,

  • Farm and Flourish, A Life Well Earned.

  • Gather Your Mates, For Epic Boss Raids!

[Spirit Demon Tribulation] is an exquisitely beautiful mmorpg inspired by the "Shan Hai Jing" (Classic of Mountains and Seas). Its meticulously crafted world scenes and wonderfully agile spirit characters are all designed from the classic mythological stories found within the "Shan Hai Jing".

In ancient times, a great war erupted between the Witch and Demon clans. The Three Sovereigns of the Demon Clan and the Twelve Ancestral Witches perished together. Then, the Great Demon Taihao emerged, uniting the Demon Clan and quelling the chaos. However, the lingering resentment of the Witch Clan attracted the Demon God Xie Tu, who imprisoned Taihao, plunging the Demon Clan into disarray. The Demon God Xuanyuan confronted Xie Tu. Unable to defeat Xuanyuan, Xie Tu suffered a crushing defeat and fled. Yet, Yan Mo, still resentful, impersonated Taihao and ambushed Xuanyuan. Xuanyuan suffered severe injuries, with only a wisp of his soul left to wander through the chaos. And this is where our story begins: Demon Lords will transform into Xuanyuan's lingering soul, embarking on a journey through the mountains and seas to recover memories and weapons...

4512260.name: Neon Cowboy
4512260.about_the_game:
It's time to become the Neon Cowboy, head out west and fight for true love!!

This retro style 2D arcade platformer follows the story of Starletta’s debut record, "Neon Cowboy". You'll become the Neon Cowboy yourself and shoot enemies with your tears (which are in endless supply) while you travel from screen to screen to save your true love, St. Monica. You'll fight robots, cyborg crocodiles, giant cobras, and any other enemies your mortal enemy-Sabot-is throwing your way. Starting in Miami you will cross the country to head to California where St. Monica is being held captive (which means this is a RIGHT TO LEFT SCROLL game).

The soundtrack is all based around Starletta's discography too! There may even be some unreleased music hidden in the game somewhere....only one way to find out!

So saddle on up, it’s time to traverse the expansive unknown to be who you were meant to be. Those West Coast lights are calling your name.

Now let’s ride!

4512320.name: Stonecall
4512320.about_the_game:
Stonecall is a top-down action roguelike where every room tests your skill. Dodge, reposition, and time your shots while building powerful synergies to survive the deadly challenges of the Stone Vault.

An ancient vault to conquer

Descend into the vast Stone Vault, where legends speak of a mythical artifact sealed deep below. Fight through chambers carved into the earth, filled with awakened stone golems and ancient defenses that still stand guard.

Simple controls, challenging combat

Stonecall’s combat is built around timing, positioning, and fast decision-making. With just a movement stick and a single action, every input matters. Learn enemy patterns, master the rhythm, and act at the right moment to survive the trials within the Stone Vault.

Choose your fighter

Enter the vault as one of characters drawn to its power. Each one offers a distinct way to fight and survive, opening up different strategies and playstyles.

Grow and adapt

Purchase relics from a mysterious merchant to drastically reshape your abilities. Combine them with divine blessings to create powerful synergies and push your build in unexpected directions every run.

Face ancient sentinels

Each floor is guarded by a powerful stone sentinel, created to stop intruders at all costs. Understand their moves, adapt your build, and survive their trials to uncover the vault’s secrets.

4512400.name: Ritterschlag
4512400.about_the_game:
From Good-for-Nothing to Knight

The Lord's ways are mysterious — sometimes all it takes to become a knight is beating up the rabble in front of the tavern for twenty nights. The fighter battles on his own — he is equipped between rounds.

Make Decisions

Choose from 10 classes — from swordmaster Siegfried to Brother Blasius and Moritz the Murderer. Each class has its own weapons, abilities, and build fantasies. Between battles, gold is spent at the merchant, items are collected from fallen enemies, and points are distributed across 8 attributes to shape the build. With 102 items across five rarity tiers, no two runs play the same. Focus on poison, critical hits, or a thorn build.

Survive Twenty Nights

Each night the rabble grows bolder — vagabonds, thugs, ruffians, and in between 3 bosses who will make short work of the fighter if the build is no good. 6 difficulty levels from Child's Play to Madness decide how hard the rabble hits — and along the way, new classes and items are unlocked.

Features

  • Medieval roguelite autobattler — inspired by Brotato

  • Ragdoll physics with dynamic knockback, blood effects, and slow motion

  • First-person perspective and cinematic camera in the heart of the melee

  • 10 classes with unique abilities, weapons, and build fantasies

  • 102 items in 5 rarity tiers

  • 8 attributes: Strength, Vitality, Toughness, Wisdom, Intelligence, Dexterity, Charisma, Favor

  • 6 difficulty levels

  • 3 bosses: Siegfried, Gustav, and Horst, who put the build to the test

  • 20 nights with ever more dangerous rabble

4512410.name: Alchemic Apothecary

4512440.name: Legendum
4512440.about_the_game:
Legendum is an incremental RPG where you live many lives in a fantasy world, each from youth to your twilight years. Uncover a narrative that spans generations, and etch your name into history.

Fight hordes of enemies automatically, as an armored knight, a ranger striking from afar, or a powerful wizard teleporting across the battlefield. How you build and equip your character makes the difference.

Manage your daily schedule: your energy is limited, so choose carefully. A farmhand might study a holy text at dawn, tend the fields in the day, and spend the evening unwinding in the tavern.

Every choice outlasts you: spare a goblin in one life, meet them as a trader in the next. Discover a lost temple now, unseal its chambers a lifetime later. Your actions shape the world your next life inherits, but your years are finite, and history forgets those who squander them.

Explore the vast realm through the Chronicle, unravelling a web of mysteries and lost secrets. Travel through towns, dungeons, meet new folk, and engage in whimsical story beats along the way.

Choose how you begin each life, from peasant farmhand to wizard's apprentice, an exiled noble, or prisoner with an erased memory. Each origin has its circumstances to contend with, but the ultimate question is who will you become?

Legendum is a semi-idle incremental RPG. Your character will fight automatically on the left side of the screen, while you actively manage various mechanics on the right side. However, at any time you can take over combat abilities and target them manually.

Features

  • Shape your build with stat points: are you a strong fighter that mines ore for money, or a sharp-eyed marksman that became a hunter?

  • Train your attributes and master dozens of skills. Your attributes open doors, while each skill unlocks unique perks and abilities.

  • Age through a full lifetime: start young and sharp, but as the years wear on, your body slows while your skills remain. The aging warrior relies on technique where they once relied on raw power.

  • Earn wonder through life's most curious moments: a chance encounter with a strange wizard, a quiet night stargazing, a riddle with no answer. Gather enough, and you'll begin to dream.

  • Collect powerful heirlooms that persist across lives. Unearthed in forgotten ruins, revealed to you in dreams, or claimed with the legacy you leave behind.

  • Uncover a story that spans generations: piece together a dark plot across multiple lives, inching ever closer to Lunorak's defeat. But not every life serves the grand narrative, some are simply lived, strengthening your soul for the battles ahead.

  • Grow your legend through each deed, rising from mere commoner to a hero who scholars will speak of for generations to come.

4512470.name: Bug Band
4512470.about_the_game:
Bug Band is a charming story-driven rhythm game where you play as a stag beetle named Poe who loves music.

a heart-warming story with a cast of kooky characters

spend your days attending bug high school, playing music with your misfit friends, and figuring out what life after graduation could look like.

a short, delightful game

much like the characters of our story, this game is small! please expect a few hours of engaging story and fun music-based game play.

features

  • be really small

  • walk around and talk to the other bugs in town

  • play rhythm games with a catchy original soundtrack

  • live out a cute story about fitting in (one way or another)

  • arcade mode: skip the story and just play the music-based mini-games if you want!

credits

Fiona Rowan is making this game along with a handful of talented collaborators: art and 3D models by Annie Zhang, music by Evan Tarrh, prototype by Annie Zhang and Fiona Rowan, 3D models by DT Akinkugbe, narrative design consulting with d. h. croasdill.

4512570.name: A Game About Chopping Trees
4512570.about_the_game:
CHOP THE TREES

Leave the noise of the world behind and step into the quiet, rhythmic life of a woodsman. A Game About Chopping Trees is a meditative experience built for those who find peace in simple tasks — wrapped in a chill and relaxing atmosphere where there are no timers, no pressure, and no stress. At its heart, this is a game about the pure joy of chopping trees.

EXPLORE

When it's time to move on to the next stretch of woodland, climb aboard your trusty handcar. Pump the levers and glide along the rails through a serene, quiet landscape — the journey between forests is just as peaceful as the work itself. Simple. Satisfying. Yours to enjoy at your own pace.

UPGRADE

Listen to the satisfying crack of timber as trunks splinter and fall under your steady hand. As you work your way through the forest, invest your earnings to upgrade your chopping abilities — sharper axe, stronger swing, and a more efficient technique that make the process feel rewarding.
4512570.supported_languages: English, Russian, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese

4512620.name: Eternal Quest: Ascended
4512620.about_the_game:
An idle action RPG with absurd mechanical depth.

Theorycrafters rejoice!

Build the perfect hero, synergize your build, and watch him tear through mob after mob while you sit back and admire the carnage.

Eternal Quest: Ascended is deceptively simple on the surface, but beneath it lies a plethora of carefully crafted algorithms, mechanics and interactions waiting to be discovered!

Why would I play Eternal Quest: Ascended?

Have you ever played an epic RPG and loved the complex character building, meta crafting and optimization exploration, but then you had to slog through all that annoying GAMEPLAY? Have you ever wished you could just build your character and then had someone to just check if the build works or not, only to be disappointed by having to check it yourself by actually playing?

Eternal Quest: Ascended is the solution to your problem!

It delivers all the depth and complexity of character building while removing all the annoying parts! You just level up your hero, optimize his build, and watch him go!

What's special about this game?

Eternal Quest was built from the ground up by a theorycrafter, for theorycrafters, based on a lifetime of theorycrafting experience!

  • Every piece of gear matters; no extra stuff just to make numbers go up

  • No stat points; that's too micro and doesn't do anything

  • Skill trees that are short and sweet where every point placed is important

  • 5 base Skill Trees with 4 more to unlock and build around!

  • Buffs and Curses powerful enough that you actually want to use them

  • Evolving systems including unlockable talents and skill trees, ascension artifacts, dynamic class naming, advanced gear crafting and more!

  • Over 100 build defining Mythic Items

  • Items level with you (for a price); you never have to worry about leveling out of your favorite items

So you don't actually play?

Nope! Your hero fights automatically using a simplified priority system. Your job is the strategy. Of course, if the situation demands it, you can switch to turn-based combat mode. and micromanage difficult battles.

So what does my hero actually do?

The world is full of enemies ready to test your build. Your hero will wander the 3 realms, defeating enemies and powerful bosses. Every zone he beats unlocks the next, with enemies growing more and more powerful!

Push your build as far as it can go.

If it fails… tweak it.

If it succeeds… push it even further.

When you can't push any more, Ascend your hero to imbue him with powerful artifacts from the 8 ancient mysteries and return to the world to push once more.

Tell me more about the character building!

i already told you about that, but sure!

Don't fiddle with little "one point here / one point there" nonsense. Well, you'll have to do that a LITTLE BIT. But on the whole, the system is build with big simple blocks that can combine with complex interactions that evolve as you play.

Carefully crafted mathematical formulas for hit / block / dodge that make sense, resistances and armor all matter.

3 different zone progression types to test your build against, each with their own optimization challenges.

This sounds time consuming...

You can play actively or let the game run while you relax.

Jump in, adjust your build, and watch the results.

It’s the perfect RPG for players who love thinking about builds more than endlessly clicking through combat.

Wait - - - isn't this a flash game?

No, Eternal Quest WAS a flash game. But now it's a steam game! It ascended! I designed and developed this game over 7 years of my life, only to release it just in time for flash to DIE A HORRIBLE STINKY DEATH. Now, 8 years later, it has emerged once more to find its place on Steam... with a few fancy updates!

So how is it different now?

Well, most of the game is the same as it was, doesn't it sound good enough?

No!

Look at all the features I already outlined! Come on, it's a really awesome game!

Still no!

Alright look... the Flash version was built first as a free flash idle game. But then I pivoted to add in microtransactions because that was the dirty trend at the time (and still basically is). But for this Steam Version of the game I gutted the microtransaction system, reoptimized everything around a single non-whale power progression curve, integrated all of the formerly nickel and dimed mechanics into the base game and basically just redesigned things to be a smoother and better experience. I also fixed a few outstanding bugs that have been sitting on my todo list for 8 years.

Huh?

Basically, I took out any PTW stuff (not that there was much) and balanced it so you dont need to spend to win.

But I wanna whale out!

Too bad! This is a game for theorycrafting and optimization, not for spending your way to the top. If you really wanna spend money on this, get the Supporter Pack DLC!

So that's it? You just made everything free and threw it on STEAM?

OMg, look dude... the game was already pretty awesome, and no... I didn't just "throw it on Steam". First of all, I did a lot of work to rebalance things and test the new curves. And putting a game on steam is also a lot of work! There's like a whole dashboard of things to fill out, I had to upload a bunch of different images and cut them myself even though I'm not an artist, and I wrote this whole damn description from scratch!

but if that's not enough, I also integrated cloud saves and added like 60-ish achievements.

I only see 59 achievements

OMg i said "60-ISH". Look, are you gonna get the game or not? The game is awesome and it's not that expensive. If you wanna try it out, go for it. If not, then that's ok it's not for you.

But it's not even out yet!

OK so wishlist it then! And then you can buy it when it's ready.
4512620.reviews:
“I think this game is awesome, and I'm not just saying that because I made it!”
100/100 – Jeremy Moshe

4512660.name: MiCROBE
4512660.about_the_game:
Destroy enemies. Collect Mass. Evolve. It starts simple, but gets out of hand fast.
 

Your primary resource is Mass, harvested from every enemy you consume. The bigger you get, the stranger and more dangerous your prey becomes. From cells to organisms, organisms to planets, planets to stars and stars to things that shouldn't exist. 

 

With 300+ skill nodes arranged in an ever-growing organic tree, you choose how your microbe develops: aggressive, efficient, chaotic, or something in between. Mutations earned through boss kills persist forever, compounding across every prestige run.

 

 

What you'll get:

  • 300+ node skill tree: build your playstyle across damage, speed, collection, chaos and much more

  • Chain lightning, shockwaves, explosions: unlock cascading mechanics that turn late-game sessions into screen-clearing madness

  • 6 evolution stages: Microbe, Cellular, Organism, Planetary, Space, Cosmos

  • Prestige system: reset and rebuild stronger, with mechanics that fundamentally change how the game plays

  • Mutations: 10 permanent upgrades that evolve alongside you, persisting through every run

Alpha v0.4

4512710.name: Arcadox
4512710.about_the_game:
Welcome to Arcadox, a game where classic Arkanoid nostalgia meets the aesthetics of the early internet and 80s dreams.

Forget boring backgrounds. In Arcadox, you bounce a ball through digital worlds where pixel art intertwines with glitches, statues, and endless rows of palm trees at sunset. The game is specifically designed for those who appreciate not only a challenge but also a visual vibe.

WHAT AWAITS YOU:

  • 15 LEVELS WITH SOUL: We didn't just place blocks. Each level has its own geometry, secrets, and visual design. From simple pyramids to complex labyrinths, you'll be sure to guide the ball where you want it.

  • UNIQUE STYLE:

    • Webpunk: Glitches, rendering errors, the aesthetics of the "digital abyss" and 90s monitors.

    • Vaporwave: Soft pastel colors, Greek architecture, Japanese characters, and that same feeling of "sunset nostalgia."

  • SOUNDTRACK: Music in Arcadox isn't just background music, it's a full-fledged part of the game. Specially selected tracks in the synthwave and retrowave genres create the perfect mood for immersing yourself in the game for an hour or two.

  • VARIETY OF MECHANICS: This isn't just a "score a point." Destroy blocks, collect bonuses, avoid obstacles, and watch the game transform as you progress.

Immerse yourself in the nostalgia of a future that never happened.

4512740.name: Teckel Adventure
4512740.about_the_game:
Get ready for the craziest adventure yet!

Luna is a dachshund on a mission. Someone stole her ball. And without her ball, there’s no play. No play… no play.

Fearless — not even bats or freezing cold can stop her — she sets off to get it back across enchanted forests, dark caves, icy slopes, and the city streets. One little paw at a time.

Teckel Adventure is a 2D platformer packed with challenges, secrets, and a healthy dose of canine humor.

What awaits you:

Explore  unique levels — mysterious forests, cavernous depths, snowy mountains, and nighttime city streets. Every world hides secrets, shortcuts… and at least one thing that wants to bite Luna’s butt.

Collect the Dog Tokens hidden in every level. Find them all to unlock bonuses and achievements.

Face mischievous cats, diving crows, sneaky hedgehogs, stubborn mushrooms… and two bosses that might make you question your life choices.

Unlock secret mini-games — a frantic vertical climb and a high-speed ice slide.

Want to improve?

Play casually… or prove you’ve got real dog spirit. Mini-games, high scores, and New Game+ await those still hungry for adventure.

Features:

Precise and responsive controls: walk, run, double jump, glide, and ice sliding
Levels, bonus stages, and 2 unlockable mini-games
Collectible Dog Tokens with per-level tracking
Checkpoint system — Luna always gets back up. Always.
Steam achievements
Best time leaderboards
Full controller support
Available in 19 languages — because good dogs are universal

“Small dog… Big jump!”

4512760.name: AL Potato - Nowhere near Vegas
4512760.about_the_game:
A potato. An orange. A broken-down car in the middle of nowhere.

AL Potato: Nowhere Near Vegas is an absurd point-and-click adventure game inspired by the golden age of LucasArts classics like Monkey Island, Day of the Tentacle, and Sam & Max.

When AL the potato and his best friend Pancho crash their car in the desert, their Vegas dream hits a wall — or rather a road sign. Now it's up to you to get these two unlikely heroes back on the road.

Features:

  • Classic point-and-click adventure gameplay: explore environments, pick up items, and combine them to solve puzzles

  • Witty, humor-driven story filled with absurd characters and unexpected situations

  • Hand-drawn art style with charming, fully original visuals

  • A variety of brain-teasing puzzles that reward creative thinking

  • Dialogue-driven interactions where talking to the right (or wrong) characters opens new possibilities

  • A love letter to the classic LucasArts era, made by two lifelong fans of the genre

If you've ever wanted to guide a sentient potato through a sun-scorched desert full of weirdos, bad luck, and Vegas dreams — your moment has arrived.

4512770.name: Once There Were Cats
4512770.about_the_game:
Once There Were Cats is a game of wits and wizardry, an RPG where you fight enemies by solving trivia. Explore the harvest gothic world of The Gloam alongside your duck sidekick, gather powerful artifacts, and encounter mythical creatures on your way to the Quizard's tower, where your fate awaits.

This is a pre-alpha demo, designed to capture the vibe and gameplay features.

QUIZ-BASED COMBAT

In OTWC the combat system revolves around solving multiple-choice questions, such as trivia, riddles, puzzles etc. Think fast! You need to answer before time runs out.

BEWARE OF MONSTERS

The Gloam is home to monsters drawn from global folklore. Monsters in OTWC have special attacks and ask questions based on their personality, nature and origins. They can poison you, set you on fire, blind you, confuse you… if you let them.

SPELLCASTER WIZARD CAT, KILL! KILL!

If you didn’t pay attention in school and don’t know the answers, don’t worry: you can use spells to eliminate answers, slow down the timer, skip questions, change topics or inflict damage. Try incinerating a kappa with a fireball! It’s one of life’s great pleasures.

YOU HAVE A DUCK FRIEND

If you’re really stuck you can always call on your duck sidekick Sir Goo Goo to suggest an answer. He’ll do his best, but he is a duck. 

COLLECT POWERFUL ARTIFACTS

Through your adventures, you’ll come across tons of cool wands, grimoires and artifacts you can equip that will give you special abilities and cater to your playstyle. If you think you know all the answers, try making a risky offensive build.

EAT LOTS OF FOOD

Adventuring through The Gloam is sure to make a kitty hungry. But don’t worry, there are lots of delicious things for you to eat. Rare foods even provide unique buffs in combat!

SLEEP IN BOXES

When you get tired, why not take a nap in a cozy cat-sized box? Who knows what you’ll dream of when you slumber… 

EXPLORE THE GLOAM & MAKE FRIENDS WITH WEIRDOS

Besides fighting, there is a whole strange world to explore, full of quirky creatures, side quests, easter eggs and puzzles. Talk to everyone, sometimes you can even talk to inanimate objects.

PLAY WITH A BALL OF YARN

This is pretty much self-explanatory.

RECOVER YOUR MEMORIES

What happened to all the other cats? Who is Char? Where am you? What am you? It’s up to you to find out.

ARE YOU SMART ENOUGH???

You don’t really have to be that smart, so we think yes, you are smart enough! You are strong enough! Don’t be a scaredy cat! Play OTWC today, you budding genius.

DISCLAIMER

No cats or ducks were harmed during the production of the Once There Were Cats demo.

4512780.name: CENSOR
4512780.about_the_game:
The galaxy is a symphony. Play it as a weapon.

In a galaxy ruled by the imperious Grand Order of Ki’Ur, music is not art, it is a physical law forged by dead gods. Darius, a rogue elite operative trapped in an endless cycle, must reach the heart of the galaxy. His mission: harness the ancient Symphony to compose a New Song powerful enough to shatter the Order’s control and reforge the very fabric of reality.

TACTICAL DECKBUILDING COMBAT

Command your ship in strategic turn-based battles where every card alters reality. Build your deck using powerful Motives, enhance them with rare Amplifiers, and create devastating acoustic combinations capable of destroying entire fleets.

Experiment with different builds, adapt to unpredictable reality glitches, and discover powerful synergies that transform your ship into an instrument of cosmic destruction.

The galaxy changes every time the timeline resets. No two journeys are the same.

THREE COMBAT PHILOSOPHIES

Choose a strategic approach that defines your playstyle:

  • Knowledge
    Precision strikes, shield manipulation, and tactical battlefield control.

  • Dominion
    Explosive thermal attacks and overwhelming offensive power.

  • Vitality
    Corrosive damage over time combined with powerful regeneration systems.

Your chosen philosophy dictates your allies, your arsenal, and the ultimate fate of the galaxy.

A ROGUELIKE GALAXY

Each run features:

  • dynamic sectors that warp and reshape based on your narrative choices

  • dangerous elite encounters and powerful bosses

  • traders, anomalies, and mysterious events

  • hidden locations echoing with the lost chords of the galaxy’s mysterious creators

POWER THAT PERSISTS BETWEEN RUNS

Even when reality collapses, your story continues. Discover ancient Shards of the Cosmic Symphony — crystallized fragments of reality’s source code left behind by the Architects, the godlike engineers of creation.

These resonant relics permanently upgrade your ship and reshape every future run. Unlock new artifact slots, upgrade your Core Ship Module, and grow stronger with every cycle.

UNCOVER THE TRUTH BEHIND THE SONG

For centuries, the Grand Order of Ki'Ur has used a mind-altering broadcast known as The Hum to subjugate billions. But their flawed imitation of ancient technology is failing. Reality fractures into deadly glitches.

As Darius, an elite Archon-Tracer slowly dying from the very power you wield, you are trapped in a repeating time loop — the only one who remembers every shattered reality.

Guided by Asha, the last living relic of the Architects, you must navigate the wreckage of an empire to compose a final melody that will decide the fate of the galaxy.

What will your final chord bring: the salvation of a dying empire, or its chaotic end?

4512830.name: Null Root
4512830.about_the_game:
DEFEAT THE NULL CORRUPTION: Fight through escalating waves of enemies and bosses in a fast-paced action roguelite built around precision, positioning, and rapid decision-making. Each run starts simple but quickly spirals into chaotic, screen-filling bullet hell combat. Collect resources, unlock new abilities, and push deeper every run.

DUAL-CONTROL COMBAT: Your daemon core and cursor work independently. Some abilities fire from your daemon, others deploy at your cursor's position. Detonate an explosion at your daemon's location, then blink to your cursor to escape. Draw lines that detonate seconds later and spawn a firewall with your cursor. Every ability placement is a tactical decision.

SYSTEM FEATURES:

  • Bite-Sized Chaos: Fast-paced runs ranging from 30 seconds to 10 intense minutes.

  • Deep Arsenal: 20 distinct active abilities, choose your loadout and chain them into devastating combos.

  • Tactical Upgrades: Progress through 3 distinct tech trees: Offense, Defense, and Utility.

  • Formidable Threats: Survive relentless elite geometric swarms and conquer 5 challenging bosses.

  • Risk & Reward: Defend data caches mid-run for bonus loot, and unlock run modifiers to push the difficulty to the absolute limit.

4512840.name: Break The Bank
4512840.about_the_game:
Break The Bank is an incremental game about smashing piggy banks to get rich.

Crack open as many piggy banks as you can to collect coins.

Spend your coins to unlock upgrades inside the skill tree.

4512850.name: granny's toybox
4512850.about_the_game:
Draw & play as a toon in a toybox city!

Features:

  • draw & paint your own procedural animated toon homunculus.

    

  • make friends with other toons, or invite your real life friends to come play!

  • decorate the town & the toons with blocks, collage cut-out stickers, & knick-knacks 

  • a complex genetic system of personality quirks that motivate the various toons 'round town

  • explore the seedy underbelly of the city and uncover secrets

  • work or scavenge to get food and gold coins to pay your rent or die and try again

  • use your trusty net or fishing rod to collect feral critters, and sell them to the local aquarium museum. 

  • collect knick-knacks & stamps and fill out your encyclopedia!

go crazy!

4512890.name: Forbidden Sight
4512890.about_the_game:
Forbidden Sight is a multiplayer, action-adventure stealth game where you play as a gang of art thieves. Trapped inside a wax museum after a heist gone wrong, you must manipulate electromagnetic light to reveal the unseen… and survive what it awakens. 

Core Features

  • Gun with electromagnetic waves 

  • Wax museum setting with periods of human history

  • Puzzles and exploration

Story

Your friends invited you to steal the most valuable artifact from the infamous Human Archive Museum (H.A.M) with them! As an experienced art thief, the mission is clear: you must collect valuable technologies, sneak around the museum's security system, and of course, grab the largest artifact of them all: the legendary Wax Figurine.

4512970.name: Tiny Drift
4512970.about_the_game:
TINY DRIFT is a unique retro pixel art drifting experience. Play in fast-paced, action-packed arenas, dodge everything thrown at you, and become the Drift God. Smash through enemies, collect rewards, upgrade your driving skills, and experiment with new playstyles.

Tiny Drift combines a unique arcade, roguelike, and roguelite gameplay style with the fantasy of the high-speed drifter. Drift through it all, upgrade your vehicles, collect power-ups, and jump back in for another run.

Key Features

  • Infinite Playstyles: Unlock various unique micro-vehicles and discover countless upgrade combinations.

  • Stages: Defeat bosses at the end of each stage to progress. Each stage offers distinct challenges and unique gameplay perspectives.

  • Arenas: Survive waves, clear the map, or race against the clock—each arena presents a different test of skill.

  • Unique Upgrades: After every arena, choose a unique upgrade that can completely transform your playstyle.

  • Zen Mode: Just drive. Choose your drift experience, from chill vibes to hardcore challenges.

4513010.name: Goblin Quest III
4513010.about_the_game:
Goblin Quest III is the sequel to Goblin Quest.

Goblin Quest III is a fantasy world conquest with a nonlinear storyline.

Fully allowing you to play the story your way, with the player choice being our guiding gameplay mechanic.

Explore the familiar region of “The Eben Hinterlands,” lands filled with warring chiefs and old magic.

Purchase houses to rent, dominate forts for better item, delve into strongholds for random rewards and more,

The entire world is added. From deserts, foggy forests, to burning ashlands, the realm is open for your conquest.

Battle the many different races of giants, humans, goblins, and more as you struggle for total supremacy.

After being brought back to life, you become the Warmaster, master of the Eben, and begin your quest to dominate everything.

The Forest is just the beginning.

4513050.name: GODS OF VOLLEYBALL
4513050.about_the_game:
GODS OF VOLLEYBALL is a fast-paced, timing-based arcade volleyball game with a splash of martial arts style! Jump straight into the action with a fixed team of colorful characters—no roster to choose from, no customization needed. Just pure, timing-driven volleyball mayhem.

🎯 TIMING IS EVERYTHING

Forget player positioning or complex controls. When the ball comes to you, a simple timing prompt appears—hit it perfectly to execute devastating serves, spikes, and blocks! The better your timing, the more powerful your move.

👊 MARTIAL ARTS FLAIR

Add style to your strikes! Perfectly timed executions unlock martial arts-inspired animations—watch your team unleash spinning kick serves and palm-strike spikes. It's volleyball with attitude, not a fighting game.

👥 ONE TEAM. ONE MISSION.

You play as a fixed roster of pre-set characters—a team of vibrant athletes dressed in bold, revealing athletic wear inspired by beach volleyball culture. From small tops to sporty shorts, each character brings their own unique look and energy to the court. No swaps, no unlocks, no customization—just your team, ready to dominate.

💥 CARTOON VIOLENCE & HUMOR

When that perfectly timed spike connects, opponents go flying! With comedic ragdoll physics and zero blood or gore, every hit lands with a laugh. The action stays fun, lighthearted, and over-the-top.

🎮 STAGE-BASED SINGLE-PLAYER CAMPAIGN

Progress through increasingly challenging stages across unique courts. Each match tests your timing skills, and every perfect execution brings you closer to becoming the ultimate volleyball champion.

4513060.name: Yandere Virus
4513060.about_the_game:
Oh no!! Your precious friend has been infected with the terrifying Yandere Virus!


What started as a fun trip with your friends has turned into a nightmare in an instant.
When you come to your senses, you find yourself in a mysterious place,
and your dear friend has been infected with the “Yandere Virus.”

Explore this unknown place alone, or together with your friends.
Gather scattered materials to craft a cure,
save your friend and escape this place.

Run away from your Yandere friend


Your infected friend is no longer who they used to be.
Driven by a distorted mind and uncontrollable aggression, they will chase after you, taunting you with unsettling and disturbing whispers.

The moment you get caught, it’s all over.
If you want to survive—run.

Collect Platonic Pumpkins


Mysterious “Platonic Pumpkins” are hidden throughout this graveyard.
These pumpkins are essential ingredients for creating the cure.

Risk your life to collect them,
and complete the only cure that can save your friend.

Beware of Mutated Plants


Mutated plants lurk all around the graveyard, waiting to attack you.
Just when you think you've escaped your Yandere friend,
they will strike without warning.

Play Solo or Together with Friends


You can face this horror alone, or with your friends.
Invite up to 3 friends on Steam and enjoy intense cooperative gameplay.

Game Features

  • Up to 4 players (online co-op / single-player supported)
  • Relentless pursuit from friends infected with the Yandere Virus
  • Platonic Pumpkin collection and cure crafting system
  • Unpredictable attacks from dangerous mutated plants

4513090.name: MythGotchi
4513090.about_the_game:
MythGotchi is a casual life sim style TamaGotchi. You go on adventures, earn gold, upgrade your home.

Train to gain power, collect artifacts and epic equipment. Gather allies and fight against demons.

The world is at the brink of ruin.

Take control over a Fawn that has just managed to escape her desolate homeland. As, she tries her utmost to survive.

In a world that gets more dangerous by the day it's up to you to help save it all.

In this game you can go on missions, gather gold, collect artifacts and weapons.

Decorate your home and ensure that the Myth to be, is well taken care of. After all, behind every Myth is a legend. And, how this Myth ends, is in your capable hands.

So, prepare train until exhaustion, do fool hearty adventures or just laze about until the end of the world comes knocking.

Adventure is calling, will you answer it?.

Or will you leave the world to its fated doom.

Spend Gold to upgrade your home, gaining more comfort and unique effects form items.

Reach the end of an adventure to gain equipment.

Spend time in town to earn gold or to buy potions.

Defend against the hordes of demons as they try to ravage the land.

Train until you are prepared for what is to come.
4513090.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Swedish

4513120.name: Immortal Faces
4513120.about_the_game:
Immortal Faces  is a memory card game set in the dark atmosphere of vampire folklore. You are the last hunter in an ancient castle, where time loses its meaning and the faces of immortals are erased from mortal memory.

Your task is to memorize the locations of the cards with portraits of ancient vampires before the timer runs out and darkness consumes you forever.

Each card is more than just an image; it is the face of an immortal whose memory time itself is trying to erase. Remember their features, their placement, the connections between them, or become another victim in the endless night.

PECULIARITIES
🧠 Deep memory gameplay

60 levels of increasing difficulty, from simple grids to card labyrinths

Dynamic memorization mechanics with elements of psychological pressure

Maps with unique artistic portraits of vampires, created in the style of Gothic painting

⏳ Timed game with a timer system

  • 90-60 second timer

  • Adrenaline-pumping moments when seconds matter

🏆 Achievement and progression system

  • 10 unique achievements revealing the history of the castle

  • Memory statistics: accuracy, speed, endurance

🧛 Full immersion

  • Dark gothic aesthetics with elements of horror

  • Atmospheric soundtrack that heightens the feeling of fear and tension

  • Gradual uncovering of the vampire legend through gameplay

  • Visual distortion effects that challenge your Memory

WHO IS THIS GAME FOR?

  • For card game lovers looking for a digital adaptation

  • For connoisseurs of atmospheric horror without gore

  • For those who want to train their memory in an engaging way

  • For fans of gothic aesthetics and vampire themes

  • For players who value short but intense gaming sessions

4513140.name: Mythic Manager
4513140.about_the_game:
Mythic Manager is a guild management simulator where you recruit, train, and lead a roster of MMORPG players through dungeons, raids, and PvP tournaments.

Build Your Roster
Scout and sign promising players from the recruiting pool. Every member has unique stats, personality traits, and potential — some are diamonds in the rough, others are all hype. Managing your roster means tough decisions about who to develop, who to bench, and who to cut.

Watch Them Fight
Your guild runs auto-battled dungeons and raids with real mechanics — tank swaps, AoE dodges, interrupts, and burst phases. You don't control the combat directly, but your decisions on team composition, gear, talents, and training determine whether your team wipes or clears.

Manage Everything Else
Balance your gold, assign professions, craft gear, manage morale, and navigate the social dynamics between your members. Rivalries form, mentorships develop, and personalities clash — just like a real guild.

Compete for Glory
Progress from a scrappy startup guild through dungeons, heroics, mythic raids, and PvP arena seasons. Earn prestige, unlock milestones, and prove your guild is the best on the server.

Features:

  • Deep roster management with player age, potential, and career arcs

  • Auto-battle system with visible mechanics and stat-driven AI

  • 9 classes with multiple specs, talent trees, and gear progression

  • Professions, crafting, and a player-driven economy

  • Personality traits, morale, and relationship systems

  • PvP arena tournaments

  • Multiple difficulty settings for scouting, recruiting, and signing

Early Access — The game is actively in development. Core systems are playable now with full end game content with even more content, polish, and features on the way.

4513150.name: Built the End
4513150.about_the_game:
They are coming.

An endless wave of machines is advancing, and your base is the last line of defense. In Built the End, you must construct and adapt your defenses to survive increasingly dangerous robotic assaults in this fast-evolving take on the tower defense genre.

Build and position a wide range of towers, each designed for a specific role. Some deliver heavy damage, others slow or disrupt enemies, and some are built to counter particular machine types. Success depends on how well you combine and position your defenses as new threats emerge.

Gather resources from the environment to expand and reinforce your base, making constant decisions about when to invest in new towers, upgrade existing ones, or prepare for the next wave.

Enemy waves grow more complex over time, introducing new behaviors and attack patterns that force you to adapt. Swarms, heavily armored units, and specialized attackers will challenge even the strongest defenses. No single setup will hold forever.

Push your defenses further each run, refine your approach, and experiment with different tower combinations to see how long you can last.

Every wave is a test. Every choice matters. How long can you hold the line?

4513160.name: Toddler Tumble
4513160.about_the_game:
Welcome to the softest, bounciest, most chaotic obstacle course ever built.

Toddler Tumble is a colorful party platformer where tiny daredevils race, bounce, and tumble through gigantic playrooms packed with pillows, ramps, spinning toys, and ridiculous obstacles.

Run, crawl, jump, and bounce your way through giant cushion courses designed to test your timing, balance, and toddler determination.

But be careful…
One wrong step and you might go tumbling.

4513210.name: Maybe It Meant Something
4513210.about_the_game:
Platform as Izzy the cat through this potentially pointless story of hatred and creative dissatisfaction.

Stumble, swim, slip and swing along this short and interesting journey through a nightmare of creative purpose. Expect atmospheric environments, creative platforming, light puzzles, hatred, confusion, and an amusing character or two.

4513270.name: Myth-OS
4513270.about_the_game:
Step into a universe where your most creative ideas come to life.

Myth-OS is an unprecedented AI-driven sandbox that shatters the boundaries of traditional gaming. Imagine having the infinite possibilities of a Tabletop RPG, guided by a dynamic digital Game Master, perfectly fused with the deep, complex simulation of a Grand Strategy epic.

From Lone Adventurer to Emperor

Scale your adventure exactly to your playstyle. You can start your journey as a wandering vagabond with nothing but a sword and a dream, exploring ruins and taking on local bounties. But your story doesn't have to end there. Gather followers, build a settlement, and rise to power. Before long, you could be commanding armies, managing global supply chains, and ruling a vast empire.

Your Personal AI Game Master

Experience dynamic, emergent storytelling tailored specifically to your actions. The AI Game Master seamlessly weaves your choices into the world's narrative.

  • No Pre-Written Scripts: Quests, events, and NPC interactions are generated dynamically based on your current situation and past choices.

  • True Reactivity: If you burn down a village, the AI GM ensures the local lord sends an army after you, and nearby economies suffer from the loss of goods. No two campaigns will ever be the same.

A Deeply Simulated, Living World

While you are out adventuring, the world doesn't stand still. Myth-OS features a complex, underlying simulation that tracks thousands of entities in real-time.

  • Autonomous Factions: Rival empires engage in diplomacy, forge alliances, and declare war entirely on their own.

  • Living Economies: Market prices shift based on real supply and demand. Trade routes are established, and resources are physically tracked.

  • The Butterfly Effect: A bandit raid you ignored on Day 1 could lead to a kingdom collapsing on Day 100.

Rewrite the Rules of Reality

Want to play in a completely different setting? You have the ultimate power to reshape the universe. Myth-OS is a genre-agnostic sandbox. You aren't locked into fantasy or sci-fi—you can build whatever you want. Write your own game rules, invent custom technology trees, and shift genres to create your perfect dream game.

Your words reshape the universe. What kind of world will you build?

4513300.name: Dinerz - Diner Simulator
4513300.about_the_game:
Welcome to Dinerz! From the first sizzle to the final bill, you’re the boss of your very own diner.

Start small with just a few basic ingredients. As the orders roll in, cook your way to success to unlock premium toppings and boost your profits! Master a massive menu—from juicy burgers and crispy fries to fresh pizzas and beyond—as you build your culinary empire.

Sizzle, chop, fry, and bake to create a variety of tasty dishes.

Make it your own! Decorate your diner exactly the way you want!

Try to cook the food, not the kitchen. If you fail, the fire extinguisher is your new best friend.

Don't forget to clean up your tables, and wash the dirty dishes.

4513330.name: Paddy Slide
4513330.about_the_game:
Welcome to Paddy Slide, a relaxing and deeply satisfying puzzle game where you bring life to empty water fields! Swipe, slide, and plant your way through countless grids to create a lush, green paddy. It’s easy to pick up, but finding the perfect path will test your puzzle-solving skills.

Slide to Plant! Your goal is simple: fill every empty cell in the water paddy with vibrant green seedlings. However, there’s a catch! Once you swipe in a direction, you won't stop sliding until you hit a wall or an already-planted grid. You must carefully plan your moves to cover the entire field without trapping yourself in a dead end.

Think Smart, Save Seeds! Every level gives you a limited number of seedlings. While simply filling the grid will let you pass, true puzzle masters aim for efficiency. Every backtracking or wasted move consumes extra seedlings. Find the absolute optimal path to minimize waste and earn the prestigious 3-Star perfect rating!

Build Your Farm & Unlock Skins! As you complete challenges, you'll earn coins to upgrade your personal idle Farm. Collect your harvest over time to unlock up to 30 adorable and quirky plant skins. From cute blooming flowers to weird and funny sprouts, customize your sliding experience!

Key Features:

  • Simple & Addictive: Intuitive swipe controls. Easy to learn, surprisingly deep to master.

  • Endless Puzzles: Infinite procedurally generated levels across multiple difficulty tiers. The challenge never stops!

  • True Brain Teaser: A robust grading system that challenges you to find the mathematically optimal path.

  • Unlockable Cosmetics: 30 unique, fully animated skins to collect and equip.

  • Cozy & Relaxing: Beautiful minimalist pastel visuals, squishy animations, and satisfying planting sound effects.

  • Idle Mechanics: A relaxing personal Farm that grows and generates income even while you take a break from puzzles.

Take a deep breath, plan your route, and let’s get planting in Paddy Slide!
4513330.supported_languages: English, French, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

4513360.name: Zorbo
4513360.about_the_game: Welcome to the ruthless action world of Zorbo. This world is full of danger in every corner, and surviving is just the beginning. Choose your skills and decide how you will defeat your enemies. There are smart enemies and secrets waiting to be found. Make your strategy, pick your weapon, and write your own story in this tough battle. Are you ready to survive?
4513360.supported_languages: English, Russian, Turkish, Italian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Spain, German

4513370.name: Hypnagogia 壊れた夢 Broken Dreams
4513370.about_the_game:
Welcome back to the world of Hypnagogia- a place wherein unusual things lurk between dreams, nightmares, and the spaces unseen...

After the events of the very first Hypnagogia game, but before the tale of the Dreamer in Boundless Dreams, a foreboding and mysterious torrent had been bubbling beneath the surface.

Gogi, the dream guardian, has awoken from his slumber and called upon once again to help get to the bottom of it. Dark and troubling forces manifesting within the dreamscape have caused the God Mirror to fracture, causing a nuclear-level communications disruption and has left all dream worlds completely isolated.

Evil, corrupted energy has now begun swirling, infecting and warping many of the different worlds. It's up to Gogi to scour each and find the source of the corruption all while keeping his own sanity intact.

  • Explore, platform, and puzzle-solve your way through a ravaged, rodent-run city, a blood-filled underworld crypt, a soothing frozen hotspring, and more.

  • All new mechanics: swim underwater and avoid draining your dream sanity as you navigate a handful of vibrant and colorful dream worlds.

  • Pull levers, climb ladders, grab/stack/throw objects, and interact with your environment like you never have before in any previous Hypnagogia game.

  • Complete controller support (and recommended).

  • Engaging, narrative-based single-player story.

  • First-person exploration with light platforming and puzzle solving.

  • Character conversation and decision making.

  • Environmental interactions, swimming, and sanity management.

  • Banging original soundtrack.

4513380.name: Idle AI Factory
4513380.about_the_game:
Idle AI Architecture is a deep, node-based automation and incremental game where you step into the role of a Digital Architect. Your mission: Build the world’s most powerful AI processing grid from the ground up.

Starting with a simple Internet connection and a Power Supply, you must design intricate networks to harvest, process, and sell data. Every node matters. Connect Harvesters to Tokenizers, and Tokenizers to Neural Trainers to turn raw data into high-value Insights.

Don't let your data farming interrupt your real-life productivity. Idle AI Architecture lets your factory run directly over your desktop. Keep a subtle eye on your production pipelines, manage your nodes, and watch your profits skyrocket while you work, code, or watch videos.

As your wealth grows, so does your technology. Upgrade your skill tree to unlock advanced multi-modal processing. Move beyond simple text harvesting to process Audio and Images. Eventually, train complex Neural Networks, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Diffusion Models for astronomical profits.

True efficiency requires strategy. High-tier AI nodes consume massive amounts of power and generate dangerous levels of heat. Build cooling systems, upgrade your power grid, and carefully balance your inputs and outputs to keep your factory running at maximum capacity without bottlenecking.

  • Satisfying Automation: Connect inputs to outputs in a free-form sandbox and watch your data flow.

  • Transparent Overlay: Run the game seamlessly over your desktop so you can optimize your factory while using your PC.

  • Exponential Growth: Upgrade your systems and watch your profits scale from humble beginnings to unfathomable wealth.

  • Strategic Grid Management: Balance power consumption and thermal limits to keep your factory optimized.

  • Deep Skill Tree: Invest your earnings into dozens of upgrades to speed up production and unlock new node types.

  • Idle Progression: Set up the perfect automated pipeline and reap the rewards as your AI architecture works for you.
4513380.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish

4513390.name: We Were Here Before
4513390.about_the_game:
We Were Here Before is an interactive fiction game about a frontier settlement that is already, quietly, being forgotten. You are its governor. You have been here before. The Bureau has prepared a briefing.

Each run will take 45 - 60 minutes.  With 120+ story endings, and four seen each play through, it creates a large replayable experience.

You will govern.

A frontier settlement needs decisions made. The Horizon pulses at the center of the table — when it breathes out, something arrives that no charter prepared you for. A merchant who knows what you ordered before you ordered it. A child who arrived three days before her mother did. An IOU for a name, found in a bag of odds and ends, that keeps coming back. You will read what arrived. You will make a choice. You will not be able to take it back.

You will build.

Every choice leaves something behind. Resources — bureaucracy, memory, prosperity, fragment — spill from the decisions you make and become the settlement's foundation. Drop them on the grid and something rises. Frontier dwellings. A town square. A market. An archive. When a story concludes it hands you a Legacy District named for what you did: A Counting House. A Quiet Survey. The Certain Garden. Find it a place on the grid. What you built is what you governed.

You will compromise.

You will never see a stat. You will see consequences. Did you open the vault or seal it? Did you pay the debt or find the clause that made it unpayable? Did you tell the settler what was happening to them, or decide they were better off not knowing? The settlement remembers. The frontier remembers. The Bureau of Metaphysical & Philosophical Research has opinions about what you did and no jurisdiction to act on them.

You will be filed.

When the Horizon finishes its work, the Bureau of Frontier Settlement Assessment & Proposal Division issues Form 7-C — a bureaucratic obituary assembled from the specific choices you made, the districts you raised, and the governor you turned out to be. It is not a score. It is a document. It will reference things you forgot you decided. It will be more honest about you than you were. Read it, or don't. It will be filed either way.

You have been here before.

The Horizon takes every settlement eventually. That is what it does. That is what it has always done. But something persists — a name you chose once, surfacing in a stranger's mouth. A branch you closed, gleaming on the path you didn't take. An echo from a settlement that ended, leaking back across the boundary. 24 story arcs. Over 120 possible endings. You will see four in a run. Each time you return you carry something the frontier left in you. Perhaps this time you will understand what the Horizon wants. Perhaps this time you will find the thing that makes it stop. The Bureau has its doubts. It has filed them accordingly.

Governance is the thing you do between arrival and the obituary. The Horizon is patient. It has been here longer than the Empire. It will be here after.

4513410.name: Yuki-Onna Checker
4513410.about_the_game:

4513420.name: Dreaming Briar Rose -Demon's Temptation-
4513420.about_the_game:
"Once the roses bloom in full, you won’t be able to return to the human world—"

You were saved from a near-fatal traffic accident—by a Demon.
But recovery takes two weeks.
And you’ll spend every day of it in the Demon’s Realm—surrounded by demons who find your situation far too entertaining.
Soon, they begin to close in—each for their own reasons.
But one thing ties them together: a Pact.
In other words—your Soul.
With seductive words and dangerous promises, they tempt you little by little.
If you give your heart to one of them, you may never return to the human world again.
As the days pass, what begins as an uneasy stay slowly turns into something harder to leave behind.
Caught between sweetness and danger, you begin to uncover what truly lies within the demons’ hearts.

A dark, bittersweet romance where love and temptation intertwine.

Game Features

  • A dark fantasy otome visual novel

  • 8 romance routes, each with 2 endings

  • A simple affection system that determines which ending you can reach

  • An Ending List and Sound Test to unlock as you play

  • Estimated playtime: 4–6 hours per route / 30–50 hours total

  • Japanese and English language support

Meet the Demons

Spend two weeks with a cast of unforgettable demons—
each with their own charm, secrets, and temptations.

Sero — The Demon of Protection

The silent master of the mysterious mansion. Calm, sincere, and unwavering.
He treats you like someone worth saving... even when you don’t believe it.

Rivel — The Demon of Revenge

Elegant, sharp-tongued, and dangerously entertained by you.
Every sweet word hides a blade.

Noche — The Demon of Plunder

He barks and blusters like a kid trying to act tough, but you can’t just leave him be.
Rough around the edges, hopelessly honest, and far softer than he wants you to notice.

Kalmia — The Demon of Resurrection

Beautiful, cruel, and endlessly entertaining—especially when he’s insulting you.
He doesn’t call you by name. Not when “piglet” is so much more fun.

Urheil — The Demon of Exchange

All smiles, easy jokes, and a friendly drawl—the kind of guy who makes any room feel safe.
Until you glimpse the steel underneath... and realize he’s terrified of caring too much.

Zarnitza — The Demon of Transposition

A massive, old-fashioned warrior who praises everything as “Beautiful!”
His grand words sound absurd... until you realize he means every word.

Ikorl — The Demon of Advance

A mischievous clown with an innocent smile and something darker underneath.
Playful one moment, unsettling the next—always a step ahead.

Ksina — The Demon of Curse

A flirty, unstable Demon who swings from charm to despair without warning.
He’ll whisper you into a blush... then sink into self-loathing in the same breath.

Content Warning

This game contains dark themes including death, emotional distress, and supernatural danger.
Some scenes include references to violence, psychological tension, and romantic intimacy.
The main game contains kissing scenes, but no explicit sexual content.
Planned post-launch After Stories may include mildly suggestive romantic scenes.

After Stories

Additional After Stories are planned as post-launch DLC.
These short epilogues continue each romance after the ending where the heroine chooses the Demon’s Realm.

Closing Line

Will you return to the human world—
or choose a future in the Demon’s Realm?

4513470.name: Under Us
4513470.about_the_game:
After several meteors strike the Earth over 48 hours, a strange and terrifying phenomenon emerges from the depths. Unknown creatures invade the surface, and the world as we knew it is no more. You are one of the last survivors in this devastated world, where each night becomes a true nightmare.

Under Us is a survival horror game where tension is ever-present. The days are your only opportunity to prepare, explore, and plan. But as soon as the sun sets, everything changes... the darkness takes over, and nightmarish creatures roam, ready to devour you. Every night is a battle for survival.

Key Features:

  • Immersive Storyline: Dive into a mysterious narrative, with unsettling revelations as the game progresses. Uncover terrifying secrets about the meteors' origins and the creatures that have overrun the planet.

  • Sandbox Mode: Explore and survive at your own pace in a free-roam mode, either solo or with friends. Discover hidden locations, build shelters, and endure the dangers of the night in an open-world environment.

  • Unpredictable and Terrifying Nights: When night falls, anything can happen. Creatures become more aggressive, strange phenomena occur, and the atmosphere becomes increasingly tense. Be prepared for the unexpected.

  • Realistic Survival System: Eat, drink, and hunt to stay alive. Find sources of water, hunt animals for food, and craft survival tools to endure in a hostile environment.

  • Building and Tool Crafting: Build sturdy shelters to withstand harsh weather and lurking creatures. Craft weapons, traps, and intricate structures to protect yourself from the threats that surround you.

  • Complex Ecosystem: The wildlife in Under Us interacts with the environment and other creatures in realistic ways. Predators, prey, scavengers, and passive-aggressive creatures—all these factors influence the game's dynamics, creating a living, breathing world.

  • Experience and Attribute System: Gain experience to enhance your skills and customize your survival style. Allocate points to different attributes to help you face the growing threats.

  • Mini-Games and Rare Loot: Unlock mini-games as you progress. These challenges will reward you with rare weapons and protection gear.

  • No Microtransactions: No in-game purchases! Everything you need is available as soon as you enter the world of Under Us.

*languages with full audio support

4513500.name: Prisoner-7
4513500.about_the_game:
Prisoner-7 is a creative 2D platformer inspired by Celeste, Mega Man, and Animal Well, while introducing many original mechanics.

You play as a prisoner escaping a heavily guarded facility, overcoming traps and hazards with precise movement, clever use of tools, and quick decision-making. Different enemies require both skill and strategy to defeat.

As you progress, new mechanics are introduced while existing ones evolve in new ways, creating fresh challenges throughout the journey.

4513510.name: Beefy Boi
4513510.about_the_game:
Beefy Boi is a comedy horror game about an individual reluctantly entering the workforce for the first time. His mom told him to get a job or GET OUT! 


ACQUIRE ORDER: 

GATHER INGREDIENTS: 

EVADE YOUR BOSS: 

MAKE THE ORDER: 

GIVE IT TO THE CUSTOMER: 

Features:

  • A Beefy Boi - That's you, you're beefy.

  • Beefy Bois first job is working at a fast food joint isn't all that bad, right? Take orders, gather the ingredients, and build the customer's order. Easy, except you're the only employee on the clock, along with your employer of course, but he's a total slacker. Just try not to interrupt his groove while you're back there.
