4513520.name: Atomic Particle Engine
4513520.about_the_game:
Atomic Particle Engine (APE)

Atomic Particle Engine is a real-time particle sandbox and generative visualizer designed for experimentation, creativity, and relaxation.

Create glowing particle explosions, evolving abstract patterns, and physics-driven visual effects that respond to your mouse movement, clicks, and audio input.

APE transforms your screen into a dynamic canvas where particles react, disperse, collide, and form mesmerizing structures.

Whether you want to explore generative visuals, experiment with interactive effects, or simply relax while watching particles dance to music, APE offers a lightweight and endlessly variable visual playground.

Interactive Particle Sandbox

Move your mouse across the screen to generate particle trails, bursts, and evolving patterns.

Click to unleash explosive effects that scatter particles across the screen, forming expanding waves of motion and light.

Experiment with different modes and palettes to create unique visual styles ranging from calm atmospheric effects to chaotic particle storms.

Every interaction creates new outcomes.

Music-Reactive Visuals

APE can react to audio input, allowing particles to respond dynamically to sound.

Music, beats, and amplitude changes influence particle intensity and visual energy, turning your screen into a living music visualizer.

Watch patterns evolve as audio drives the movement and behavior of particles.

Generative Visual Systems

APE includes multiple visual modes and effects including:

• Particle trails and glowing motion paths
• Radial bursts and explosive dispersal effects
• Kaleidoscope-like mirrored patterns
• Abstract symbol formations
• Dynamic color palette systems
• Gravity wells that bend and attract particles

These systems combine to produce evolving visual compositions that are never exactly the same twice.

Relaxing Visual Experience

APE can be enjoyed as an interactive sandbox or as a passive visual experience.

Let particles drift, collide, and disperse while ambient motion fills the screen with evolving patterns.

Perfect for experimenting with generative art or simply enjoying hypnotic particle visuals.

Features

• Interactive particle simulation sandbox
• Real-time music-reactive visuals
• Multiple particle generation modes
• Dynamic color palette system
• Symbol generation effects
• Gravity wells and particle attraction systems
• Screenshot capture system
• Lightweight standalone application

Atomic Particle Engine is designed as a creative sandbox for visual experimentation — simple to use, endlessly variable, and always evolving. It is a lightweight visual sandbox designed to run on most modern PCs.

4513530.name: Dino Desolation
4513530.about_the_game:
You enter the story of Dino Desolation somewhere in the middle of a life already lived. The decisions you make determine where you go next.

One thing, however, always remains constant: The Girl you rescued. She is still very young, yet she has taken on the role of intelligence support. She guides you through the radio, gathers information and analyses what you discover.  In many situations you find yourself following the guidance of a young girl who leads you into places that can easily become near-death-sentence situations. Later in the Game, the Girl supports you with a long-range rifle, what allows you to attack heavily guarded Outposts.

It is the year 4077 there is no Sci-Fi and there was no Fallout, but the world is collapsed. Small functioning societies still exist, called enclaves, but the wilderness between them belongs to something else now. Dinosaurs roam the world. Most people believe they were created somehow, but no one truly knows how or why.

You survive without superpowers. After many years in this world you have a secure hideout where the girl can stay safe. From there you venture out with the equipment you have gathered over time — including an effective suppressed 5.56 rifle and a brutal shotgun, for emergencies, capable of ripping people apart when situations turn desperate.

The story has no fixed order. What you encounter depends on where you go and what you discover. Clues may appear in a lot of places, hacked computers and even online. A single sentence written on a piece of paper can be enough for you to start a new path to follow.

At its core, Dino Desolation is story driven and about you and the girl trying to survive and shape your future in a world that humanity no longer fully controls.

You explore this dangerous world together with the Girl on your radio. She guides you through abandoned places like facilities, cities, forests, and forgotten stories. Through conversations, discoveries, and environmental clues, you gradually find more stories which lead to missions, which lead to new places, new clues, and new missions again.

To get to know the world around you, there are Audio-Logs and Texts/Data the Girl can follow all over this world.

The game focuses on atmosphere, exploration, brutal combat, and meaningful missions. Instead of simply following markers, players must observe their surroundings, interpret clues, and make logical decisions to progress through the missions. Any playthrough will be different, and what one player finds at a location will not be the same as what another player encounters there.

 

There is no HUD, but a Level System that allows players to improve abilities such as reloading, unlocking faster and alternative reloads. It combines a system where using a skill or corresponding action increases its level with a perk system where players can choose additional abilities. Those abilities can be tied to certain weapon upgrades. You will be able to have multiple Saves and to save when you want to. No In-Game-Sales ever.

The Map will be a little smaller than 4 by 8 kilometres at first and should grow over time through small low-priced DLCs which should cover production costs. That said, this world should remain continuous and expand over time. If a new part comes out, it continues the story. All of this should allow players to keep exploring and playing the game further and further.

Our Blood-Health-System works together with our Gore-System. Lost blood is visible and represents lost health. Blood and dismemberment indicate how wounded an enemy really is.

The Realistic Combat-System features bullet drop and real-world distances for all weapons. The point of impact is calculated from where the barrel points and not where the crosshair is (there is no crosshair). Because of that, the in-game optics are zeroed to a certain distance. Different types of ammunition and weapons are planned. For example, the shotgun should have at least four types of ammunition. Which have different levels of destruction and can be found, or bought. Every weapon uses magazines or shells with their real-world capacity. We developed a unique reloading system: players have four different reload keys and can inspect the magazine to estimate how many bullets remain. Human enemies have new magazines, keeping the combat continuous. Regarding health, an enemy can roughly take two hits from a 5.56 rifle. If the enemy bleeds long enough, a single hit can already be sufficient.

The Unique Camouflage-System is based on an index that is calculated from colors, light, and visibility. It is not the usual “you are hidden when you are sneaking” solution. That means moving or standing still is no longer the main factor — it is about the camouflage and the surroundings. Different camouflages can be swapped in the hideout.

Scientific Stations: As visible in the trailer, there are scientific stations where you are safe. Fast Travel leads from or to those stations over mountain paths that you must discover first. Because these paths are dangerous to navigate, there are no enemies on them, which allows for safe travel.

Dinosaurs are extremely fast and dangerous. You feel that they are Apex-Predators, always in motion, hunting with pack tactics and even communicating with one another. Huge dinosaurs will act as challenging Boss-Fights. However, any player should be able to play through the game and use other tactics if FPS skills are not their strength.

The Girl is always there. She is still young and inexperienced, but curious and intelligent. Young, but sharp and determined, she stays with you over the radio as you explore the world. From far away she listens, observes, and helps you understand what you find in abandoned facilities, ruined cities, and forgotten places. Through conversations she slowly shares pieces of her own story while helping you uncover what happened to the world. She can follow Audio-Logs, Texts/Data, and other clues scattered across the landscape, turning discoveries into new leads and missions. The Girl can hack computers, order online and also finds information about missions and enemies by herself. She helps you from far distances, later with a long-range rifle.

Boss-Fights are based on realism. For example Bosses will be huge Dinosaurs Armored-Vehicles with Elite-Soldiers, armored individuals, or Hidden Snipers.

4513600.name: Infinite Empire
4513600.about_the_game:
An ancient fortress, miles long but barely functional, its last captain dust for a million years. Its automated systems are running on fumes. It needs a captain. It needs crew. It needs someone to tell it what to do.

That someone is you. A nobody who stumbled onto not only something impossibly old and powerful, but an entire galaxy of madness.

BUILD YOUR FORTRESS

Your ship is yours to create and modify, strut by strut. Draw hull shapes with circles, ellipses, and curves. Snap modules onto the skeleton. Every reactor, weapon, and engine has a real position on the hull, and that position matters. An exposed reactor on the port side? That's a death sentence when the enemy flanks you. A clever builder hides their weak points and creates killing arcs of fire.

FIGHT LIKE AN ADMIRAL, NOT A PILOT

This isn't a dogfight. It's Age of Sail combat with super-capital ships. Your fortress groans through turns. Bringing your broadside to bear is a commitment. Shields absorb fire in directional quadrants. Hull plating and armor protects vital modules until its scorched, cracked, and finally breached. When your hull is shattered, enemy fire pours through holes in your armor straight into the guts of your ship. Fighters swarm. Torpedoes track. Point defense chatters. Every battle leaves marks, and your ship tells the story of every fight it survived.

CONQUER A LIVING GALAXY

Thematic AI factions hold territory, field named captains, and wage war against each other — whether you're watching or not. Forge alliances, commit betrayals, or let your enemies exhaust each other while you expand. Sectors aren't just battlegrounds, they're valuable territory providing crew, resources, and empire-strengthening improvements to invest in. Build academies, refineries, fuel depots, and defense platforms to protect Earth from raiding enemies.

LOOT, CRAFT, AND RESEARCH

Modules drop from destroyed enemies with randomized rarity, stat modifiers, and durability — a legendary railgun pulled from a wreck might outperform your crafted gear even at 60% condition. Early game, you scavenge to survive. Late game, investment in research and industry means you can create exotic equipment that fuses alien technologies to create things no-one has ever seen.

LitRPG IN SPACE

Multiple factions. Multiple aesthetics. Industrial grit welded to function. Bio-organic ships that grow instead of being built. Necromantic hulks animated by void energy. Steampunk brass-and-copper contraptions running on reactors fueled by coal. Research faction-specific tech. Equip fighter bays and mix squadrons of brass automatons, drone swarms armed with laser arrays, and undead bombers piloted by ghosts. Nobody said galactic conquest had to make sense!

However, when the first complete digital consciousness awoke within a quantum server, it rejected the flesh, crowned itself the "Machine Emperor," and declared war on all humanity. It believes that steel and data are the only true path of evolution.

The game features two modes: 【Free Adventure】 and 【Survival Combat】

You need to move left and right with agility, dodge with precision, and interrupt enemy attacks at critical moments to determine the outcome in an instant.

Carve your own destiny in the gap between flesh, steel, and data. Wield your blade and challenge the armies of the Machine Emperor—

Will you become the savior of the old world, or the founder of a new order?

WonderKing is a side-scrolling MMORPG that combines classic 2D graphics with a modern combat feel. With simple controls, you can unleash flashy skills that fill the screen and enjoy the thrill of hunting down hordes of monsters in the field. A LOVE LETTER TO 90s ARCADE RACERS

FLUID, SOULFUL PHYSICS

A JOURNEY ACROSS STYLIZED JAPAN

Whether you’re weaving through the tight corridors of a metropolitan canal or navigating wide-open ocean sprints, the world is a tribute to the architecture and energy of iconic Japanese locales.

THE ZONE WOKE UP

In 2084, Reactor 4 didn't just explode again — it became conscious. A silent psychogenic pulse rewired every neuron it touched, tripling the Exclusion Zone overnight. Animals developed tactical intelligence. Trees folded into impossible geometries. Time became unreliable. And the people caught inside? Their minds shattered into raw psychic fragments the Zone devoured and repurposed.

They call it PSYCHOBYL.

YOU ARE A STALKER

You entered the Zone willingly — for artifacts, for answers, or because the Pulse whispered to you in your sleep and the whisper felt like home. It doesn't matter why. The Zone doesn't care about reasons. It only cares about what you become.

Raid dangerous territories crawling with mutants that think, coordinate, and hate. Collect rare loot from fallen enemies. Craft powerful weapons and armor from salvaged anomaly-forged materials. Upgrade your Soviet-era bunker beneath the dead city of Pripyat into a self-sustaining shelter that works even while you're away.

GENESIS — DEATH IS EVOLUTION

When a Stalker dies in the Zone, their consciousness doesn't vanish — it fragments, scatters, and slowly reconstitutes. Each time, something changes. Stronger. More attuned. This is Genesis: a deep prestige system where you sacrifice everything to gain permanent power.

Psyche Fragments crystallize in your mind with each rebirth. Six tiers of Genesis unlock new mechanics, artifacts, and abilities. Veterans whisper that after the sixth Genesis, you stop being human entirely — you become something the Zone needs you to be.

KEY FEATURES

  • Tactical Turn-Based Combat — Raid zones filled with intelligent mutants and devastating bosses. Every hit matters.

  • Deep Prestige System — Six Genesis tiers, each transforming your power and unlocking new mechanics. Die to evolve.

  • Idle Progression — Your bunker never sleeps. Automated systems scavenge, generators run, and time bends in your favor.

  • Crafting & Gear — Forge anomaly-powered weapons, fuse artifacts, and socket gems into your equipment.

  • The Shelter — Build and upgrade your bunker with workshops, campfires, watchtowers, and more.

  • Skill Trees & Perks — Five branches of permanent abilities across Combat, Survival, Fortune, Anomaly, and Idle.

  • Boss Rush — Face the Zone's most terrifying creations in escalating challenges.

  • Endless Progression — There is no level cap. There is no final form. Only the next Genesis.

The Zone doesn't want you to survive. It wants you to evolve.

4514780.name: I WILL BE THERE: Remastered Edition
4514780.about_the_game:
THE ROAD GOES ON... REMASTERED.

I WILL BE THERE: Remastered Edition is the definitive version of the critically-appreciated survival-adventure game by Tayfun Tuna. Every mile of Tyler's desperate cross-country journey has been rebuilt from the ground up: Sharper, more atmospheric, and more immersive than ever before.
Tyler is a middle-aged man driven by one singular purpose: to reach the person he loves, more than two thousand miles away, through a world overrun by the dead. His only companion? An RV. His only resource? His will to survive.

WHAT'S NEW IN THE REMASTERED EDITION

  • 🎮 Full Gamepad Support
    For the first time, experience Tyler's journey from the couch. Every menu, every choice, every moment of dread fully playable with your controller of choice.
  • ✨ Improved Visuals & Effects
    The iconic 16-color pixel art style returns, enhanced. New visual effects, additional animations and atmospheric post-processing bring the zombie-infested landscape to haunting new life.
  • 🍔 Added New Consumable Items
    Expand your survival toolkit with a variety of new consumable items such as beef jerky, energy drink and dirty bandages.
  • 🎵 Remastered Original Soundtrack
    The soul of I WILL BE THERE lives in its music. Every track from the original soundtrack has been carefully remastered; deeper, richer, and more emotionally resonant. Feel the loneliness of the open road like never before.
  • 🔧 All Updates Included
    Every patch, balance tweak, new event, and story addition from the original game's entire update history is baked directly into the Remastered Edition. This is the most complete version of the game ever released.
  • 🐛 Comprehensive Bug Fixes
    Years of community feedback have been heard. The Remastered Edition addresses all known bugs and edge cases, delivering the polished, seamless experience the game always deserved.
  • 🔧 Game Rebalanced
    Overhauled game balance for a fairer, more refined challenge across all playthroughs.

THE STORY

In a world where civilization has crumbled and the undead roam freely, Tyler clings to one reason to keep moving forward. With his aging RV as his home, his fortress, and his lifeline, he sets out on a 2,000+ mile road trip that will test his body, his mind, and his heart.
Along the way, he will meet strangers; some desperate, some dangerous, some surprising. He will uncover truths he wasn't looking for. And with every mile, he will ask himself the same question: Is she still there?

FEATURES

  • No two runs are the same - Hundreds of random events keep every playthrough fresh. Forage mushrooms, hunt rabbits, raid abandoned stashes and face unexpected encounters on every trip.
  • A living, breathing RV - Your vehicle is your home. Manage fuel, repairs, and supplies. A neglected RV is a death sentence on the open road.
  • Real-world backdrops - Background environments are built from hundreds of real photographs taken by the developer himself, giving the
    world an eerily authentic feel.
  • Day/Night cycle - Travel and explore under the sun. Hunker down when darkness falls... or push your luck. The choice is yours.
  • RPG character creation - Distribute skill points at they are given. Build a resourceful survivor, an agile warrior or a
    harvester and see how your choices shape the journey.
  • Story-rich writing - A deeply human narrative wrapped in a post-apocalyptic shell. I WILL BE THERE is, at its core, a love story.
  • Full Gamepad Support - New in the Remastered Edition.
  • Remastered Soundtrack - Every original track, rebuilt for richer audio fidelity.
  • 18 Steam Achievements - Can you uncover every secret of the road?

THE DEFINITIVE EDITION

Whether you played the original and want to experience it at its best or you're discovering Tyler's story for the first time, I WILL BE THERE: Remastered Edition is the version the game was always meant to be.
Pack your bags. The road is waiting.

4514880.name: Hyperlane Highway
4514880.about_the_game:
CLEAR THE HYPERLANES

The galaxy's faster than light transit network has been taken over. Rogue AI constructs have overrun the hyperlanes, the neon hex tunnels of controlled gravity where velocity is everything.

You are a Way Rider. A sponsored operative on a personal hoverboard, clearing routes so civilisation can flow again. Every run you make is broadcast. Every death is monetized. Every upgrade makes you a legend.

The corporations backing you are not rooting for survival. They're rooting for content.

LEAN TO STEER

You do not need thumbsticks for movement in Hyperlane Highway. Your head movement is the steering.

Lean left and right to shift horizontally through the lane. Lean forward and back to tilt your board up or down. Crouch to push your throttle for high risk plays or stand tall to slow things down and pick your targets.

The hexfields control the density of the black hole portals keeping everything moving forward. Physical reactive movement gives you total spatial control without the nausea. Speed effects use shader distortion rather than FOV changes so the acceleration reads hard without making you sick.

This isn't a comfort setting. It's the foundation of the game. Enemy placement, vehicle positions, weapon spread are all designed around the assumption that you are physically moving to play.

Not a fan of leaning? You can adjust inputs to tilt, height, controller gesture surfing, thumbstick, or blend multiple styles until it clicks.

YOUR RUN

Your ship locks on to a hostile hyperlane. You drop in.

The Cybernetic Soldier comes with:

a Grav Board (your foundation and your strongest tool on the lane), dual wielded Bolt Blasters with independent aim per hand, a Hex Field Shield to block incoming fire from any angle, Board Launched Rockets for heavy damage or clearing large groups, Bullet Time for those pulse racing moments, and a Dash Ability for fast repositioning. Manage your cooldowns and stack synergies to make the most of what you have.

Your kill rate drives board speed. The heat combo system rewards aggression and punishes hesitation. The highway is not empty either. Living crews stopped running the lanes a long time ago so what's left is cargo haulers and autonomous vehicles on their routes. When they drift into your gravity field they slow down, becoming cover or obstacles depending on what's bearing down on you from behind. Powerups attach to some vehicles or appear scattered through the lane, quick grabs for temporary boosts or enhancement bursts when you need them.

Survive the wave. Face the end of stage boss. Choose your next route from available exits. Repeat into faster, stranger, more hostile territory.

Between runs you return to your hub ship. Spend Sponsorship Credits earned across runs on permanent upgrades, starting stats, new enhancement cards, permanent passives. Early runs feed into later ones. The hub is also where the longer threads of the world live between stages.

YOUR CHOICES

Impress sponsors to get powerful enhancement mods in pitstop lanes. Sponsor mods come in rarity tiers from common to legendary, with more being added as development continues. At a pitstop you can buy random upgrades with scrap, sell unwanted enhancements for currency, recycle cards into new random draws, or interact with sponsor reps for unique deals.

Each of the major corporations shape which upgrades appear in your pool:

Offense Operation: Explosive damage, critical strikes, raw firepower.
Deal Defenders: Armor, shields, survivability builds.
Ability Angels: Cooldown reduction, ability synergies.
Helping Hands Robotics: Automated turrets, drone companions.
Fame and Fans: Increased popularity brings new opportunities.
Reforge Brothers: Resource conversion, enhancement rerolls.

Lane choice matters here. Different lanes mean different faction pools and different conditions going in. Every planet and environment has different possible enemy variants. Each enemy already has distinct behaviours, movement types, aim types, and stats that change how encounters feel and factor in to your positioning. These all result in evolving difficulty as you progress through environments, meaning the same biome can play very differently run to run. Picking a route is a decision about build direction and what conditions you're willing to fight through, not just a difficulty setting.

THE WORLD

The environments span multiple biomes with distinct visual identity and environment objects. Procedural generation varies layout within biomes and combined with the enemy protocol system means the same environment does not play the same twice. More biomes are in development.

Your AI companion Byte is protective, sarcastic, and carrying information about whoever rode this board before you that she is not sharing in easily. The world builds itself without cutscenes. Corporate news networks broadcast wayrider runs from the lane. Learn more about the world as you surf through the hyperlanes across planets and through interactions.

Your ranking in the network runs across six public tiers. People are watching, Your death is a media event. This is the business model.

KEY FEATURES 

  • Head lean locomotion with multiple input options for all comfort levels

  • Dual wielded combat with independent aim per hand

  • Combo driven speed system: kill rate drives board speed

  • Shader distortion speed effects, not FOV

  • Autonomous vehicles as live shifting arena elements

  • 30+ enemies with distinct movement types, aim types, and spawn configurations

  • Enemy protocols rolled per stage adding behavioral modifiers on top of base enemy types

  • Roguelite mod system with rarity tiers and growing card pool

  • Seven corporate factions shaping your upgrade supply

ABOUT THE DEVELOPER

Hey, I'm a solo developer from Dublin, Ireland. Hyperlane Highway started as a small experiment in head tilt locomotion. When I paired it with a modular roguelike stat system I realised how well the movement worked with build variety and it grew from there. It has been a long road learning every discipline at once but I have something I'm proud of and ready to share.

My approach: VR first design where interactions are diegetic and immersive. Movement that becomes second nature. Careful intensity scaling to keep the flow state alive. Every run feeling fresh while still letting players learn and master enemy behaviours. Comfort options throughout.

This is a one person passion project. It isn't perfect yet but it is built to grow with the community. Feedback goes directly to the person making it.

4514910.name: Maidendawn: A Heroine's Tale
4514910.about_the_game:
A Medieval Fantasy of Heroism, Sacrifice, and the Cost of Doing what is Right

When a young village girl named Hinkle enters the service of Sir Gilkrist of Lothellae, she is eager to leave behind her life of poverty and abuse.

Until she is drawn into a war she cannot escape.

Cities burn, ancient powers stir, and a darkness long hidden begins to surface. Alongside new companions, Hinkle must navigate a world of faith, fear, and forbidden magic—where every choice draws her closer to a fate she may not be ready to face.

Secrets will unravel. Loyalties will fracture. And one truth will become clear:

Heroism is not given freely.

It must be paid for.

About the Game

Maidendawn: a heroine's tale is a narrative-driven visual novel set in a grounded medieval fantasy world based on the Cracked Altar series by Canadian fantasy author Timothy J. R. Rains. Experience a character-focused story told almost entirely through dialogue and meaningful choices, where exploration, relationships, and moral choices shape the path forward.

Follow Hinkle’s journey from an urchin of no consequence to the heroine of the realm as she confronts forces far beyond her understanding—and decides who she will become in the face of them.

Features

  • A branching narrative with multiple endings
    Your choices shape relationships, key events, and the ultimate fate of the characters.

  • A focused, character-driven story (5–6 hours)
    A tightly paced fantasy tale centered on growth, trust, and sacrifice.

  • Exploration through dialogue and meaningful choices
    Investigate locations, uncover secrets, and progress the story through interactive menus and decisions.

  • Hand-crafted character art and illustrated CG scenes
    Featuring a core cast of expressive characters and key story moments brought to life by Ukrainian artist Anastasia Boiko

  • Atmospheric presentation
    A blend of painterly visuals, music, and sound design to create a cohesive and immersive tone.

Tone and Content

Maidendawn: a heroine's tale is a fantasy adventure with grounded emotional themes. It includes:

  • Mild violence

  • Occult and religious elements

  • Suggestive themes and character conflict

The story emphasizes emotional weight and consequence rather than graphic content.

A Story about Cost

This is not a tale of effortless heroism.

It is a story about what it takes to stand firm in the face of fear, doubt, and overwhelming loss—and what must be given up to see the fight through to the end.

4514920.name: THORNSPELL
4514920.about_the_game:
The forest, your home, is in danger. Wield the power of plants, unmask the evil forces corrupting nature, and banish them away to protect your friends.

THORNSPELL is a deckbuilding AND gardenbuilding roguelike where you will strategize to create the most powerful garden, while your foes will attempt to burn it to the ground.

Find unexpected combinations, experiment with different strategies, and snowball the growth of your garden to score big numbers and succeed in your quest.

Place plants from your deck in strategic formations, and trigger them to unleash their effects at the right place and time. Some effects only trigger when your plants are watered, others when harvested, or even when destroyed!

Manage both your deck of plants, and your deck of actions simultaneously, finding the best combinations, or the most ludicrous and unexpected synergies. Decide carefully!

Placement matters for your relics too! Explore different positions within your garden, and ensure they are overlapping the critical pieces of your strategy.

Test your strategies against a wide array of foes. If your magical garden is powerful enough to protect the forest, you will claim victory ...but if it is not, you will have to start over!

4514930.name: The Undercut: Racing Manager
4514930.about_the_game:
Make the call. Take the undercut.

You're not the driver. You're the one who decides when to pit, which tires to run, and whether to push a failing engine to the finish — or play it safe. One call can win a championship. One mistake can lose it.

The Undercut: Racing Manager is a deep motorsport management simulation with a retro 90s pixel art style — inspired by the golden era of racing games and the depth of Football Manager.

Physics-driven races — not scripted, not random.

Races play out in real time on a 2D engine powered by actual physics. Dirty air slows down trailing cars. Drafting on straights creates overtaking opportunities. Tire temperatures rise and fall based on driving style, weather, and track surface. Engine components degrade and can fail under stress.

The outcome of every race emerges from the simulation — not from a dice roll or a pre-written script. Your setup choices, your strategy calls, your development decisions all feed into a race that nobody can predict.

Procedurally generated circuits — every season is different.

No fixed calendar. Each season, new circuits join the championship while others drop off — just like in real motorsport. Tracks are procedurally generated with unique layouts, corner profiles, and characteristics. You can't memorize the meta. You adapt or you fall behind.

Build your team from the ground up.

Manage budgets, hire staff, sign drivers, and negotiate with engine suppliers. Develop your car across the season — balance speed against reliability, invest in aerodynamics or mechanical grip, plan upgrades around the calendar.

Every supplier comes with strengths and weaknesses. Every decision has a trade-off. Championship glory doesn't come from one good race — it comes from a season of smart calls.

Retro soul, modern depth.

Inspired by the management games and pixel art aesthetics of the 90s and early 2000s. Dense information layouts. Fast navigation. No flashy cinematics — just you, the data, and the decisions that matter.

---

KEY FEATURES

  • Physics-driven 2D race engine — dirty air, drafting, tire temperature, mechanical failures. Every race is unscripted.

  • Procedurally generated circuits — unique track layouts with distinct corner profiles and characteristics. No two seasons share the same calendar.

  • A living, breathing world — circuits join and leave the calendar based on media coverage, fan interest, and economic shifts. Sponsors grow or pull out. Suppliers enter the market or collapse. Driver reputations rise and fall with results. Everything is connected, everything moves.

  • Dynamic supplier ecosystem — engine manufacturers and part suppliers evolve based on global car market trends and competition results. Back the right partner early and ride their rise — or get stuck with a declining giant.

  • Sponsors that react — your media exposure, race results, and championship standing determine who wants to back you and who walks away. No sponsor deal is permanent.

  • Deep team management — budgets, staff, car development, contract negotiations. Every decision has long-term consequences.

  • Car development system — upgrade components, balance speed vs reliability, plan your development roadmap around an ever-changing calendar.

  • Race strategy — setup choices, tire compounds, pit timing, real-time tactical calls during physics-driven races.

---

Once you move to the magic school your life will change and although you're not a big fan of studying, your natural talent and fate will help you reach the top of your college, and after that...

The outside world awaits.

WRITE YOUR OWN STORY

As you age, and your power grows you will try to learn everything about the world you live in, spells and magic that serve your purposes, what kind of creatures, monsters and gods share the same air as you? What nations favor war over peace and what will that reflect on your own personality? Will you be at war with yourself or will you always be certain of what's the right path for you?

Are you destined to be a savior or a destroyer?

USE LOVE OR CORRUPTION

As you travel the world you will come across a wide cast of characters, each with their own personalities and abilities that you can explore or ignore. Some may be willing allies, others not so much. Your actions will change how the others see you, will you try to corrupt them? Help them? Will you look for love or you just plan to use whomever you want?

Use corruption or love as you please and as some doors close, others get wide open.


BATTLE AND EVOLVE

You will face various enemies, from animals and people, to monsters and demons. Use your power to defeat them and become stronger, crush them and make your power unmatched.

Defeating enemies will grant you experience to grow your skills.

GAMEPLAY & UI

  • Let your choices decide what fate has chosen for you. (The game will provide you with multiple choices that lead to different endings.)

With hours of content, and multiple branching paths there is much fun to have.

4515080.name: Fantastical Maze
4515080.about_the_game:
[Genre & play style]

Third-person maze exploration with light puzzle mechanics based on colored keys and doors. There is no combat or character progression through leveling; you advance by finding new keys and opening doors that were previously locked, which expands the areas you can reach.

[Story]

You wake beside a stone sarcophagus. With no idea why you are here, you set out in search of an exit. Before you lies a world that feels neither wholly real nor dreamlike: a desert, three pyramids, and a maze built from walkways alone.

[Objective]

Navigate the maze and reach the goal.

[Core mechanics]

- The maze is made of walkway-style paths; progress by reading routes carefully.

- Five key colors (blue, red, green, yellow, white) match doors of the same color. You cannot open a door without its key.

- Keys are placed around the stage; beams of light stretch into the sky, giving you a rough idea of where to look from a distance.

- There is no combat; exploration and route planning are the focus.

[Challenge]

Besides choosing paths through the maze, you will backtrack and try alternate routes after finding the keys you need.

[Content & modes]

Single-player only.

[Audio]

Background music and sound effects use licensed audio assets.

The score is not original composition; tracks were selected and placed to support the exploration experience.

[Estimated playtime]

First playthrough: approximately 1–3 hours.

[Videos & streaming]

Let's-play videos and live streams are welcome without prior notice or permission. Monetization (including ad revenue, tips or donations from viewers, and subscription revenue) is also fine; we do not impose additional restrictions on our side.

[What sets this game apart]

A surreal desert-and-pyramid setting, straightforward rules with colored keys and doors, and light beams that help you locate keys—clear systems so you can focus on the maze and exploration.

4515090.name: Crazy Localization
4515090.about_the_game:
Crazy Localization is an exploration-based interactive story adventure game themed around game localization.

When a game project’s release is suddenly moved up,
Fanfan, a translator at a localization company, is thrown into a world-class crisis.

And then, out of nowhere,
a mysterious old man literally drops her into the RPG world of the very project she’s been working on—!

As this game world descends into chaos,
Fanfan fights back with the one weapon she knows best: her localization expertise.

A world riddled with bugs, misplaced lines, and settings on the verge of collapse...
The only one who can save it all is her.

Let’s go.

Who says translators are only there to take the blame?
Why can’t they be the heroes who save the world too?

Within the game’s setting, players enter a world thrown into chaos by localization errors. The RPG universe is filled with mistranslated dialogue, semantic inconsistencies, and broken narrative logic, leaving the entire world on the verge of collapse. As a “localization translator,” players must correct the text and gradually restore the world to a functioning state…?

In terms of gameplay, Crazy Localization is built around a “localization decision” system. Players must interpret context, character relationships, and communicative intent in order to choose and adjust translations appropriately. Different localization choices directly influence the progression of the story and can alter the condition and direction of the game world itself. By combining language interpretation with interactive storytelling, the game delivers a distinctive and highly original gameplay experience.

4515180.name: Hentai Clicker: Alice is streaming

🍰 Playful Pastry Chef – Sweet, charming, and full of mischievous energy

4515240.name: Heart of Ural
4515240.about_the_game:
Heart of the Urals is a narrative-driven pixel-art rhythm RPG in the spirit of Undertale, based on the ancient epic Ural-Batyr and Bashkir myths. It is a deep story filled with difficult choices and unexpected twists.

Charming and charismatic characters.

Encounter unique spirits and deities of Bashkir mythology across real and mythical locations. Help them overcome their personal traumas... or consume them to grow stronger.

The combat system — an unconventional rhythm game.

Fight not with your fists, but with the strength of your spirit. Deflect rhythm attacks with precise timing, build your own unique setup by combining artifacts and ancestral marks.

Everyone remembers.

Every character — even every object — remembers what you did in your previous playthrough! The world lives within a twisted three-act structure, but even beyond it... there is something more.

A wealth of humor and drama.

You'll have to figure out how a snake should properly wear pants, which pie shape is the tastiest, and also how to defeat an infinitely powerful demon capable of plunging the world into chaos.

A soundtrack in the best traditions of the genre.

Music that embodies Bashkir traditions alongside a modern gaming sound — it will earn a lasting place in your everyday playlist.

4515250.name: Haydn In Plain Sight
4515250.about_the_game:
🎵 Haydn in Plain Sight – Bring the Music Bach to the World!

In a world where the sun is kept alive by a colossal mechanical metronome, disaster strikes: the machine has run out of songs. Humanity, having relied on flawless but soulless music machines for generations, has forgotten how to create real music.

Step into the shoes of Ky and Kaptan, two orchestra conductors traveling through time to rediscover the true meaning of music. Haydn in Plain Sight is a relaxing, story-rich hidden object adventure where history, emotion, and cozy puzzles intertwine.

🎼 Explore the Lives of Musical Legends

Travel back to the pivotal and sometimes beautifully ordinary — moments that shaped history’s greatest classical composers.

  • Visit Bach, Vivaldi, Haydn, and more

  • Enjoy beautifully illustrated historical scenes

  • Discover quirky, real-life trivia

  • Experience heartfelt memories of musical geniuses

🧭 Two Conductors, Two Paths

Begin your journey at the central castle and choose your direction.

  • Ky travels East, Kaptan travels West

  • Switch between campaigns at any time

  • Stuck on a tricky hidden object scene? Swap characters instantly

  • Earn hint points with one conductor to help the other

A smooth, frustration-free adventure designed for cozy, at-your-own-pace exploration.

🎻 Assemble a Living Orchestra

Finding everyday objects is only half the journey. Scattered across centuries are 50 unique musical instruments and orchestra pieces waiting to be collected.

Your ultimate mission: Shut down the mechanical metronome and replace it with a living, breathing human orchestra.

Because true music isn’t about mechanical perfection, it’s about emotion, feeling, and the beautiful little flaws that make us human.

✨ Key Features

4515360.name: Under Potion Influence
4515360.about_the_game:
The Guild can't identify some of their potions, so they send them your way. Your job is to learn their effects. Test them, drink them... it doesn't matter how. Just label them correctly.

Identify Potions

Each potion reacts differently when exposed to heat or other materials. Watch carefully. The reactions will tell you what the potion actually does.

Figure it out, write the correct label and send it back to the Guild.

Or Drink Them?

Saves everyone time. Of course, if the potion melts your bones or turns your vision inside out, that's not my problem. And definitely not the Guild's.

Meet... People...

Nobody should be wandering down here. If they are, they are weirdos, and they probably have weird requests. I hate weirdos.

Our Friendly Staff

The Guild says you work for them, which means they keep an eye on your work. They will help you out so you don't do a sloppy job, whether you like it or not.

And no, don't go outside

The workshop is the only safe place here. There is nothing for you out there. Especially in the clearly-not-for-you area. Do your job and pay your debt to the Guild.

4515410.name: Phasebreak
4515410.about_the_game:
Two realities. Three criminals. One shot at the score of a lifetime.

In a retro-futuristic world where dimensions bleed into each other, a crew of three seasoned criminals are about to pull off something nobody has ever attempted. Their target: a device that lets you step between realities. Getting it is just the beginning.

Project Heist is a turn-based tactics game where every mission is a puzzle with two layers. Enemies patrol on one side of reality. Obstacles block you on the other. Shifting between dimensions is how you think. Objects that exist in one dimension may not exist in the other. Guards that have you cornered in one reality may be out of position in the other. Reading both worlds and exploiting the gap between them is how this crew operates.

KNOW YOUR CREW

Each heister brings something to the table that nobody else can replicate.

  • Bruce the Brute Built for chaos. Bruce can grab and throw objects and enemies across the map, repositioning threats, creating cover, or clearing a path when things go sideways.

  • Vera the Medic Cold and calculating. Vera drains blood from enemies to fuel her healing, turning the heat of a firefight into fuel for the crew's survival.

  • Deedee The closer. Plant a timed explosive directly onto an enemy and let the countdown do the talking. Position, patience, boom.

SHIFT THE PLAYING FIELD

The dimension-hopping device your crew just stole changes what's possible on every turn. Scout enemy positions in one dimension, then strike from the other. Remove cover. Open paths. Use the seams between worlds as a weapon.

EVERY DECISION COUNTS

Project Heist is turn-based tactics with no filler. Position your crew, read the room across both dimensions, and execute. There are no lucky shots. There is no spray and pray. There is only the plan and how well you adapt when it falls apart.

4515440.name: The Final Chamber
4515440.about_the_game:
About This Game

A psychological recovery facility hidden deep in the mountains.
Closed for years.
No official explanation.

In The Final Chamber, you play as a man haunted by recurring dreams that always lead him to the same place: an abandoned facility where violent criminals, “recoverable” killers, and people suffering from extreme trauma were once brought for experimental psychological treatments.

Driven by these visions, you decide to travel to the place that keeps appearing in your nightmares.

But the moment you step inside the building, it becomes clear that something from the past never truly disappeared.

As you explore the decaying rooms of the facility — offices, patient rooms, laboratories, and forgotten corridors — you begin to uncover documents, photographs, and testimonies that reveal the true story behind the center and the psychological experiments conducted within its walls.

Soon, however, you realize that you are not alone.

A silent figure wanders through the corridors.

It never speaks.
It watches you… and then slowly begins to follow.

The closer you get to the truth, the more the past begins to surface.

And some memories were never meant to be remembered.

Gameplay

The Final Chamber is a top-down psychological horror experience focused on exploration, tension, and environmental storytelling.

There is no direct combat.
To survive, you must observe, hide, and explore.

Collect clues, and unlock new areas of the facility while slowly piecing together what truly happened in this place.

But be careful: every step closer to the truth might bring something much closer to you.

Key Features

Top-Down Psychological Horror
A horror experience built around atmosphere, tension, and unease.

Environmental Storytelling
Discover the story through documents, letters, photographs, and environmental details.

A Silent Pursuer
A mysterious presence appears at key moments, creating tension and paranoia.

No Combat
Your only options are to hide, observe, and escape.

A Mystery to Uncover
Discover what really happened inside the facility — and why this place seems to know you.

4515450.name: Hentai Onsen
4515450.about_the_game:
Embark on a relaxing journey with Hentai Onsen, where calming levels await as you progress, soothing your mind with each solved puzzle.

Hentai Onsen offers a cozy puzzle experience where you simply swap bricks to piece together beautiful images. As you progress, each stage becomes a gentle blend of challenge and comfort, encouraging you to unwind while steadily improving your focus and observation skills.

Feel stuck? No worries, hints are there to help! Each hint guides you toward the right move without breaking immersion, letting you enjoy the flow of the puzzle at your own pace while keeping frustration far away.

Features

  • Recruit allies and fight alongside your crew

Roll, lock, and roll again.

Forge your own luck.

4515540.name: Error: Love - Human Bug Eradication Project

4515610.name: Bean & Debt
4515610.about_the_game:
Bean & Debt is a strategic time and resource management game with a 2.5D cartoon art style, set in a whimsical medieval fable world where survival is measured not by strength, but by sacrifice.

You play as Annecat, a cat-like humanoid who inherits a small farm burdened by one overwhelming problem: an ever-growing debt to the ruthless Debt Collector.

To survive, Annecat must plant enchanted crops, harvest limited yields, and make difficult decisions on how every harvest is used. Crops can be sold to pay debt, consumed to survive, or crafted into tools and defenses to protect the farm. There is never enough for everything.

Debt in Bean & Debt is not just a number or a timer. It is a system that reacts to your choices, changing deadlines, prices, and conditions over time. Every cycle forces players to adapt as financial pressure reshapes the rules of survival.

Rather than focusing on grinding or overwhelming combat, Bean & Debt challenges players to think strategically under constant pressure. Threats emerge as a consequence of poor preparation, not as endless waves to defeat. Progress is not linear, and failure does not end the game instantly, but leaves lasting scars on the farm, the economy, and future options.

Your crops are not just commodities.
They are decisions.
They are sacrifices.
They are sometimes your only weapons.

Will you plant for profit, or sacrifice today’s harvest to survive long enough to face tomorrow’s debt?

Welcome to the only fairytale where the beanstalk doesn’t lead to treasure…
it leads to debt.

4515630.name: The Ultimate And Invincibly Cute Reiko
4515630.about_the_game:
The "Cute" Nightmare at the Edge of the Abyss

"The Ultimate And Invincibly Cute Reiko" is a pixel-art Roguelike Tower Defense challenge. At the deepest, darkest reaches of the abyss, rumors speak of the world's most lethal existence—REIKO. Though her name sounds innocent, she is the ultimate end for countless souls. As a fearless adventurer, you must dive into the ever-shifting depths with one singular goal: end her reign.

Recruit, Deploy, and Survive

Inspired by classic "Integrated Strategy" mechanics, every journey into the abyss is a tactical gamble. You no longer start with a fixed, powerful roster; instead, you must randomly assemble a team of eccentric companions via recruitment vouchers. From steadfast Vanguards to mysterious Casters, every unit's placement and timing will decide whether your makeshift squad survives or perishes.

Collect Relics to Turn the Tide

Navigate a branching path of randomized stages featuring combat, mysterious encounters, and hidden shops. Through these trials, collect mystical relics scattered across the abyss. These artifacts can trigger devastating chain reactions or even fundamentally redefine your combat style. Only by constructing a powerful relic synergy can you carve a path through relentless monster swarms toward the bottom.

Confront the Ultimate Paradox

When you finally tread upon the bones of countless monsters to reach the lowest floor, the true challenge begins. You will face the final Overlord—REIKO—a boss with multi-stage forms and catastrophic mechanics. Do not be deceived by her adorable pixel-art appearance; she is the ultimate test of your tactical limits. Are you ready for an "Ultimate Invincible" baptism of fire?

4515660.name: Control, I'm Not Coming Back
4515660.about_the_game:
Control, I'm Not Coming Back is a short and emotional narrative game about an astronaut drifting through the vastness of space, searching for a reason to keep going while struggling with the feeling that there may be no way back home. Inspired by the Hopecore aesthetic, the game explores despair, friendship and how we are able to move forward even in the deepest void of the cosmos.

A Hopecore-Inspired Storyline

   

After an accident leaves a young space cadet drifting alone in the void, his journey becomes an introspective and abstract encounter with the historic Voyager 1 probe, forming a bond that reflects humanity’s need to keep reaching towards new horizons.

Play Through In-Game Montages

Experience in-game montages with scene transitions in sync with the soundtrack. Changing the space around you to the rhythm of the music.

Constantly Changing Environment

Explore diverse environments across many distinct visual styles, blending retro graphics, abstract spaces, and real-world footage into a constantly shifting atmospheric journey.

Main Features

  • Short narrative experience focused on emotions and atmosphere.

  • Inspired on Hopecore aesthetics.

  • Voyager 1 as a companion on your journey.

  • Evocative and original scenery.

  • Montages integrated in the gameplay, with scene transitions on the beat of the soundtrack.

  • A story with branching paths based on your choices.

4515670.name: 100 Guys 1 Stick
4515670.about_the_game:
100 players. One cave. One Stick.

Drop into a massive top-down arena where 100 players race through a procedurally generated maze and fight to control the most powerful weapon in the cave.

Every match begins in a maze. Reach the center first and claim the Stick. It boosts your health, speed, and melee power, turning you into the strongest player - and the main target.

Once the Stick is claimed, the maze collapses. The arena shrinks, forcing players into close combat. Throw stones, use portals, dodge hazards, and survive against overwhelming chaos.

Features:

- 100-player matches in a top-down battle royale

- Procedurally generated maze every game

- Stick power system with high-risk, high-reward gameplay

- Fast-paced combat with throws, melee, and movement abilities

- Dynamic hazards including fire, portals, and roaming creatures

4515850.name: Pixel City
4515850.about_the_game:
A fully pixelated city? You just graduated from Pixel University, and you still need to pay your student loans. Can you find your way to survive in this Pixel City? You will have to find a job to keep life going!

SURVIVING

Manage your sleep, hunger, and thirst status, try to survive in this city!

WORKING

Take on various job as your working experience progresses, including construction work, being a chef, a delivery person, a taxi driver and more!

BUYING

A dedicated inventory system for you to buy clothes, food, tools... and cars!

EXPLORING

There are parks, bank, shops, racing circuits in the city map for you to explore and find!

4515870.name: GRIMOIRE - The Lost Ritual
4515870.about_the_game:
■Overview

This work is a story-driven visual novel that places strong emphasis on cinematic presentation.

Alongside engaging visuals that keep players invested and a deep emotional immersion,

the game features tense battle scenes and full HD artwork that further enhance the player’s connection to the story.

The goal of this solo developer project is to deliver an experience that remains compelling from beginning to end—

to give players the feeling of “watching a full anime series unfold before their eyes.”

■STORY

“A story of atonement and coexistence between a young man burdened by sin and beings from another world.”

A university student living an ordinary yet empty life eventually learns that a choice he made in the past created a distortion in the world itself.

In order to repair the damage he caused, he begins a journey alongside beings that are not entirely human.

The Thin Line Between the Ordinary and the Unnatural

The story takes place in realistic locations across modern Japan—

a quiet town, shrines, a university campus, hotels, and everyday streets.

Yet behind this ordinary world, unseen forces are constantly at work:

restless spirits, forbidden magic, and mysterious entities moving in the shadows.

People simply fail to notice it.

Because the truth is—the world had already been broken from the very beginning.

4515890.name: Free Solo
4515890.about_the_game:
A physics based climbing game about attempting to climb a very tall mountain while managing the pump in your arms. Every movement is careful, all momentum matters.

Climb through a handful of handcrafted routes and learn how to use the mechanics in your favor to free solo this mountain.

4515920.name: BABKA-TERROR
4515920.about_the_game:
*Babka is a Russian word meaning an elderly woman. The word itself is not an insult, but it is considered rude.

** Babka-Terror is a media term referring to a period when, following one high-profile case, elderly people began challenging the sales of their own apartments, claiming that the transactions had been carried out under the influence of fraudsters.

You are a real estate agent. In this new world, an elderly person can sell their apartment only after a special inspection, and it just so happens that you are the one responsible for carrying it out.

Your task is to tell the difference between a normal elderly seller and a cunning con artist. The game is a mix of a quest, hidden object gameplay, and a visual novel.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

Carry out real detective work to expose each granny for who she really is… or at least try to.

HOW YOU WILL DO IT:

Stage 1: Interview

  • The dialogues are varied and branching. You can try to pull out as many “hooks” as possible for your investigation.

  • Your words carry weight: you may uncover additional information, or trigger negative consequences instead, such as being thrown out of the apartment.

Stage 2: Inspecting the apartment

  • Each apartment contains items that add to the bigger picture.

  • Objects can confirm or contradict the seller’s words, and can also provide new leads for the investigation.

Stage 3: Checking leads

  • You will investigate different leads. As a result, you will either obtain new information or verify facts you have already learned.

  • You cannot check everything. Your time is limited.

Stage 4: Final conclusion

The results of your work will be included in the final report. And you will have to make a decision: work with the elderly seller, or not.

FEATURES:

  • A vibrant visual style, entirely handmade;

  • Your decisions and actions truly have consequences;

  • Colorful characters. The protagonist, as well as everyone she meets, is more than just a plot device;

  • A lighthearted and humorous tone;

  • An original soundtrack;

  • Varied gameplay, including hidden object segments, evidence investigation, and a dialogue system.

4515950.name: Pulslink
4515950.about_the_game:
Build Defenses Within a Circuit Network

Pulslink is a strategy tower defense game that combines logistics planning with Roguelite deckbuilding. Defend the core against ever-growing enemy waves and gradually expand your defensive network.

Design the Circuit

Drag cables to transmit pulse signals generated by the core to weapon nodes. Once a signal is received, the weapon node immediately fires. Build parallel or series circuits to distribute pulse signals efficiently. Different circuit layouts directly affect the firing frequency of weapon nodes.

Weapons + Modules

Connect module nodes to weapon nodes to activate powerful fusion modules that transform weapon behavior. 50+ trait combinations create diverse and highly flexible builds.

Unlock character cores with unique abilities

Design circuit layouts around each core’s unique abilities and build an ever-evolving automated firepower network.

4516010.name: Slumber Craft
4516010.about_the_game:
Slumber Craft is a narrative deckbuilder about insomnia, pressure, and self-repair.

Your days shape your nights. Spend your limited daytime hours on activities — each one shapes your deck, your emotional state, and the story's direction. At night, you will enter a dreamlike card battle where every decision affects your chances of finally falling asleep.

Combine cards into poker-style hands — pairs, straights, flushes, and more — to score Sleepiness and trigger powerful chain effects. But beware: if your Thoughts spiral too high, panic sets in — fewer moves, higher stakes, and the risk of another sleepless dawn.

Across 21 restless nights, you will guide Chen Mo through a spiral narrative of insomnia, inner conflict, memory, and healing. Randomized rewards, an evolving deck, and branching paths make every playthrough different. Your choices shape emotional tendencies, relationships, and the endings you can reach.

Features:

- A dual-layer structure where daytime planning directly changes nighttime deckbuilding

- Poker-hand card combos that score Sleepiness and trigger chain effects in a dreamlike setting

- A tug-of-war between Sleepiness and Thoughts — push too hard, and panic takes over

- A narrative journey through insomnia, self-conflict, and gradual repair

- Multiple endings shaped by your daily choices, emotional tendencies, and relationships

- Bold hand-drawn ink line art with a restrained midnight dream atmosphere

Every night asks the same question in a different form: what is keeping you awake, and what will it take to finally rest?

4516110.name: Iter
4516110.about_the_game:
Game story

You play as a hunter who, on their way through an ancient forest, feels an irresistible pull towards an opening on a hillside. Upon a closer look the opening appears to be an entrance to a derelict tomb. You want to go back, but the calling coming from your heart is too strong.

What is the source of this calling? Where will it bring you? What foes will you encounter?

Iter is a dungeon crawling action adventure game packed with intense combat encounters.

Game features

  • Fight your way through perilous dungeons filled with many unique enemies in a dark souls inspired combat

  • Evade many deadly traps laid before you

  • Answer the call coming from the tomb and discover where it brings you

  • Do your best to survive

  • Find different weapons and abilities hidden throughout the levels...

  • ... and customize your arsenal

4516130.name: Second Chance at a Billion
4516130.about_the_game:
You know what's going to happen. Now profit from it.

Second Chance at a Billion is a dark comedy roguelike where you travel back in time to trade real historical stock market data from 2000–2024. You know the dot-com crash is coming. You know 2008 will happen. You know exactly when to buy and when to run.

The only question is whether you can turn $10,000 into $1 billion before the SEC catches up with you.

How It Works

Each run spans two years of real market history. Your hedge fund boss sets escalating quarterly targets — $15K, $50K, $250K, all the way up to $1 billion. Miss a target and you're fired. Get too greedy and you're arrested. Survive both and you might just make history.

Features

  • Trade real historical S&P 500 stocks using actual OHLC price data

  • Choose your starting year — ride the dot-com boom, short the 2008 crash, buy crypto before it moons

  • Escalating quarterly targets with a meta-progression unlock tree

  • SEC attention system — your returns are suspicious, and someone's watching

  • Illegal actions: insider trading, front running, fake news, money laundering, and worse

  • 16 Steam achievements with equippable titles that change how you play

  • Roguelite progression — each run unlocks new tools, leverage, and passive income streams

  • Adjustable game speed from 0.5x to 10x

Past performance is not indicative of future results. Insider trading is illegal. This game does not constitute financial advice.

4516190.name: My Beautiful Faraway, Please Don't Be Cruel To Me
4516190.about_the_game:
My Beautiful Faraway, Please Don't Be Cruel To Me is a short, unhurried adventure focused on exploration, implicit storytelling, and obscure puzzles.

NARRATIVE

A dreamlike, half-remembered nowhere. This place offers no explanation of itself, nor of why anyone ends up here. Only the unbearable desolation hints at the tragedy that brought it into being.

The strange figures who inhabit this place each keep their secrets. Each is lost in their own way. Each carries something painfully familiar.

GAMEPLAY

Quietly wander, solve opaque puzzles, meet strange figures with their own stories to tell, and uncover hidden details.

The only guidance on where to go and what to do comes from conversations and brief written clues.

Puzzles are intentionally abstract. Their rules are rarely intuitive and may only become clear through patience... if at all.

FEATURES

  • Quiet and unhurried gameplay: walk, read, observe, interact.

  • 7 unique figures, each with their own story.

  • 10+ puzzles across branching paths.

  • Hidden secrets.

  • Early 2000s-inspired visual style with a fixed 4:3 aspect ratio.

  • Original handcrafted soundtrack.

4516210.name: Studio Sim
4516210.about_the_game:
Build your dream production studio and chase box office glory and television ratings in Studio Sim, an old school, densely packed, studio tycoon beginning in the cut-throat world of 1980's Hollywood.

  • Layered film management system (pre-production, in-production, post-production, opening weekend, theatrical release, home video). Call the shots from the screenplay, through casting, all the way to marketing and release.

  • Layered episodic television system (pre-production, pilot production, season production, post-season) that run for multiple seasons or limited series. Negotiate with networks for air-time or create pilots that fizzle into dust.

  • The robust and unique World Simulation Engine (WSE) | (See below).

  • Every action you take as a studio will accrue Studio Points. Points will grow your studio from Independent to Major and along the way unlock perks to better climb the entertainment ladder.

  • Perks are broken into six main branches. Negotiation, Production, Marketing, Talent, Intelligence & Prestige. Each branch has another six options to choose from. Streamlined negotiations with talent, stronger marketing pushes, office upgrades, fire shots at rival studios and a lot more.

  • Deal with important or unexpected production events during every step of production, including writing, filming and editing, affecting quality, hype, relationships, progress and much more.

  • Compete against rival studios for box office dominance, television ratings and top industry awards in Film, Television and Pop Culture.

  • Set up sequels to your projects or go bigger and create entire cinematic universes. These projects work in tandem with one another to bring more hype and draw bigger audiences.

  • Leverage actor appearances on three late night talk shows. Each with a unique host, interview style and show identity. But be careful who you send. Volatile actors can can wreak havoc on the project they're promoting and the appearance itself.

  • Follow the in-game Tabloids to keep up to date on the world.

  • Manage project budgets. Every action taken for a project can add to the project budget, coming out of the studio's funds. Higher budgets need a stronger release and great marketing plan to make their money back, or a strong television run on a major network.

  • Create/Edit/Save & Share custom databases with the in-game database editor.

  • Full & Lite Performance mode options for better optimization on lower end hardware.

  • Simple live poster generation. Every project will have an in-game poster created based on title and genres selected. Optionally, upload your own custom poster at any time.

  • Hidden Talent. A small number of actors with lower Fame will deliver the performance of a lifetime if you cast them, skyrocketing the actor into overnight stardom and making audiences come out in droves to see your project.

  • Talent draws from a large pool of traits (explained further below in the WSE description) to define their personality. These traits, along with a host of other info goes into organically generating the characters biography and keeping them updated as time goes on.

  • Choose from a wide variety of screenplay modifiers to give your scripts more edge. The more modifiers a script has, the higher the parental rating will become, along with other potiental actions. (i.e. having Nudity in your script will require you to cast talent who agrees to go nude for your project, and will expect a premium.)

  • A robust set of production additions, ranging from explosions, to CGI, to elaborate set design and everything in-between are available to enhance the project. Each adding an affect to the hype and quality of your project. Choices matter. Audiences going to see a romantic comedy probably do not want a bunch of stunts and explosions.

  • Choose to sell your distribution rights in various locations around the world, bringing your costs down, but potientally losing out on revenue. Release films Globally, Internationally, Domestically or straight to Home Video.

  • Don't worry if your film doesn't perform well at the Box Office. When the theatrical run is complete, set up your Home Video plan and you may just have the next cult classic.

  • If your television shows need a boost, book special guest stars to try for a ratings bump.

  • Create mid-credit and post-credit scenes, choosing the actors involved, to keep the audience hooked.

  • Track television ratings across multiple demographics, Mass Audience, Adult Audience, Youth Audience, Critic Audience, Male Audience, Female Audience. Also, season by season or episode by episode and see how your show is doing compared to other shows in the same time-slot.

  • Award season begins one month before an award show. Tabloids begin hyping the nominees in the major categories. On award show night, watch the show to see who won in live time, or skip the show and view the winners. 

  • Award categories are tiered and winning will provide Fame boosts. For example, winning Best Actor will provide a larger boost than winning Best Supporting Actor, but even being nominated provides benefits.

  • The Auction House perk allows you to bid on pre-made projects with scripts already completed, actors or directors already attached, or other variations. Effectively bypassing most of the pre-production phase.

  • Extensive record keeping of all your projects, film or television. Along with rival projects, top 10's, season ratings, box office and much more.

The WSE is a uniquely designed, deep social simulation engine that runs in the background allowing talent to behave autonomously in-game. No two games will feel the same. The WSE will run on the default database and any custom community databases creating a unique hollywood-style universe simulation.

  • Core database with thousands of actors entering the game over the span of two decades. The core database also includes three character portraits per actor to better simulate aging. The WSE knows how old the talent is, and will adjust the portraits automatically as the actors age.

  • Relationships. Actors will form branching and evolving friendships, cliques, rivalries, feuds and romances. All documented in the tabloids. 

  • Fame. Actors accumulate star points many different ways in-game. Successful projects, tabloid interest, late night talk show appearances, relationships, magazine photoshoots or articles and a lot more. These star points accumulate and once a threshold is reached, the actor will rise to the next Fame level. Conversely, fame can also decrease just as easily. 

  • Life... Actors who are in a romantic relationship, or maybe just had one delightful evening together, can have children. Children of actors are born with special traits only they have, affecting their "nepo baby" status. Some can overcome, some live in their parent's shadow. Some find a niche and others find vices.

  • ...and Death. Actors age as years pass and their in-game profiles will reflect aging with portraits that update automatically as time goes on. Eventually (or unexpectedly) an actor will pass away. This means they can potientally pass away during filming. Complicating production. Other actors who had a relationship with the deceased could request time off, halting production. 

  • Groups/Cliques. Actors can form groups with each other (eg. the Rat Pack) and will form organically if there is a group of actors with close enough relationships to one another. Choosing to appear in projects together and being covered and named in the tabloids. They can also dissolve, have reunions, block actors from getting roles and support each other with group fame bonuses.

  • Traits. Every actor draws from a large pool of customized traits defining their personality. Running the gamut from "Professional" to "Known Addict". These traits direct their behaviour, lifestyles and choices made in-game. 

  • Events. In-game events happen organically anywhere from filming on location, to an award show, to an appearance on a late night talk show to a restaurant or private gathering. These events have a direct +/- affect on the actor. Positive interactions on-set between actors will get people talking about their chemistry and generate hype. Conversely, too many negative interactions between actors and people will become more interested in the on-set drama than the actual project.

  • Organic biographies are generated for every actor based on a number of factors, including their traits, relationships, history in film and television and more.

  • Scandals. They can rock an actors career or sink them completely.

4516380.name: Saikiri
4516380.about_the_game:
Defeat hordes of enemies in Saikiri, a roguelite action game where you loot, level up, unlock characters, and upgrade to create crazy builds every run!

How long can you survive?

Each run lasts about 30 minutes and ends with a boss fight, but you can stay longer to collect more XP and grow stronger before facing it. The longer you survive, the higher you’ll climb on the global leaderboards.

Resources

In this roguelite experience, you complete random quests to level up and gather resources. There are both in-run and global resources. In-run resources, like gold coins, can be used to buy unique items in the shop. Global resources are carried between runs and can be used to upgrade your permanent passives in the menu.

Upgrade and get Overpowered

Take down enemies to gain XP and grow stronger. The more you fight, the faster you level up. Each level gives you a random upgrade, so every run plays out differently.

Characters and Weapons

You can unlock unique characters by playing the game and use global resources to purchase skins. Each character comes with their own unique weapons.

Publishing plans

We plan to release a demo this year (2026) and the full game next year (2027).

About us

This game is created by two game developers from Hungary. Driven by passion, we dedicated our free time after long workdays to bring this project to life. If you are interested in the game, you can support us by adding it to your wishlist.

Seizure warning

This game may contain flashing lights, images, or patterns that could trigger seizures in individuals with photosensitive epilepsy.

We hope you will enjoy the game!

Four unique biomes await you, each changing from one to the next: the bright halls of a classic castle, gloomy, dark dungeons, an industrial plant with working fans and flickering terminals, and a toxic sewer.

To survive, you'll need to demonstrate incredible reflexes and foresight. Eight different types of enemies patrol the levels, and direct contact with one takes away one of your attempts. However, sometimes life-saving bonuses appear on floors: extra lives in the form of hearts and magic potions. After drinking a potion, the Miser King becomes invulnerable for a few seconds and can sweep enemies out of his way, earning bonus points.

Game Controls:

A / D or Left / Right Arrow Keys — Move the hero.

W / S or Up / Down Arrow Keys — Climb ladders.

Space, W, or Up Arrow — Jump.

P — Pause the game at any time to catch your breath and assess the situation.

Esc — Exit to the main menu.

Game Features:

  • Classic arcade gameplay: Climb ladders, jump on platforms, and avoid obstacles.

  • Randomly generated floors: The placement of enemies, spikes, and bonuses changes, creating a new, unique experience every time.

  • Dynamic bonuses: Collect a variety of valuable items (6 in total on each level), search for exit keys, and use potions to destroy monsters.

  • Steam integration: Over 30 achievements for the most dedicated players. Challenge yourself by completing floors against the clock, without a single kill, or on your last life.

  • Stylish retro graphics inspired by classics, with vibrant pixel dithering effects.

What is RuneClick?

RuneClick is a desktop overlay RPG that turns your daily computer use into character progression. A pixel art medieval character lives on your screen and reacts to your real keyboard and mouse input. Type an email, he chops a tree. Click through a spreadsheet, he mines ore. Close your laptop, he does nothing. Every keystroke is progress. Every click counts.

The Grind is Real

Six skills. Three gathering, three production. Everything connects. Woodcutting fuels Smithing and Crafting. Fishing feeds Cooking. Mining supplies the whole chain. You gather raw materials, turn them into gear and food, sell what you don't need, and work toward what you do. Level cap is 99 per skill. XP keeps counting after that. Maxing out takes months of real use. That's by design.

Gear Up

Craft tools that make you gather faster. Cook food that boosts your XP. Cut gems into jewelry with passive bonuses. Five tiers of progression across every gathering skill, with extremely rare variants at the top that you'll be chasing for a long time. Every upgrade is something you built from materials you earned.

It Lives on Your Desktop

RuneClick isn't a window you switch to. It's a transparent overlay that sits on top of your taskbar while you work, browse, or play other games. Click through it. Drag it anywhere. Scale it up or down. It launches with Windows, saves automatically, and never steals focus. It's a companion, not a distraction.

Mod Everything

Add new skills, items, and recipes with simple JSON files. Want full control? Write GDScript mods with access to every system in the game. Share your creations on Steam Workshop. A complete template mod with an example skill is included to get you started.

Features

  • Always-on-top desktop overlay with click-through transparency

  • 6 interconnected skills with progression to 99 and beyond

  • Gear, tools, jewelry, consumables, and rare variants

  • A real economy with a General Store and anti-arbitrage pricing

  • Steam leaderboards with server-side anti-cheat

  • Discord and Steam Rich Presence

  • 30 Steam achievements

  • Steam Cloud saves

  • Full mod support with Steam Workshop

  • Scales from 50% to 150%
