4520010.name: Chef's Dogma
4520010.about_the_game:
Chef's Dogma is a quick, but turn-based Roguelite game, primarily focused on battling and then using the rewards, events, and shops to upgrade your team. The game is planned to release with Steamdeck support, including full-controls! A run can take roughly 20-40min playtime, making it perfect for a lunch break, train ride, or relaxing at the park!

Select your Team from a Multitude of 'Foods' and 'Chefs'. Diversify, Double-Up, Triple-Up, or even Quadruple-Up to make your best Dish!




Battle your way through Apocalyptic Cities, Exotic Forests, Ancient Deserts, Fiery Volcanoes, and Depraved Dungeons until you find your Salvation.




Make your party stronger from the spoils of those vanquished, empowering your minions to decimate future foes!





Evolve two foods into 'Entrees' taking 1x Ability from each and a 3rd to form a new type of Combatant!
   



Then unlock over 50 playable characters to include 'Foods' and 'Chefs' with unique abilities and play styles, to begin your journey anew.





Core Features

  • 50 Foods to Unlock with their own types, abilities, strengths, and weaknesses.

  • 8 Chefs to Unlock with specialty combinations and their own off-turn ability usage.

  • 60+ Stat Upgrades and Effects that will empower or change how you face each fight.

  • 7 forsaken locations to traverse through, see the delusions of an unwell mind.

  • Compete in the "Chef's Challenge" leader-board, taking a randomized team through a sequential gauntlet of all levels.

  • Meta progression to soothe the Permadeath and Roguelike mechanics to make every run feel impactful.

4520070.name: Rockett Gear EX
4520070.about_the_game:
A fast-paced retro platformer where you control a rocket-powered gear fighting through a mechanical world.

Rockett Action! Rockett Speed! Rockett 2D Adventure!

Rockett Gear EX is a fast-paced 2D retro action platformer inspired by classic mecha and arcade games. Play as Jett and fight alongside Yuromi to stop Project Z before they unleash a weapon capable of destroying Earth. Experience intense combat, high-speed gameplay, and a nostalgic sci-fi atmosphere that pays tribute to the golden age of retro gaming. 

Story

Rockett Gear EX is a fast-paced 2D retro action platformer inspired by classic mecha and arcade games. Play as Jett and fight alongside Yuromi to stop Project Z before they unleash a weapon capable of destroying Earth. Experience intense combat, high-speed gameplay, and a nostalgic sci-fi atmosphere that pays tribute to the golden age of retro gaming.

Classic Gameplay. Modern Precision.

Rockett Gear EX delivers classic, skill-based platforming with smooth, responsive controls. Jump, dash, shoot, and sprint your way through dynamic stages designed for fast, fluid action. Easy to pick up and satisfying to master, just like the retro games you grew up playing.

Upgrade Your Power.

Collect Z-Crystals and uncover valuable items hidden throughout secret paths to upgrade Jett’s abilities and weapons. As the adventure unfolds, unlock powerful enhancements and special moves that expand your combat strategy and make every encounter even more exciting.

Become the Ultimate Rockett Gear EX Warrior.

Transform into the powerful Rockett Gear combat armor. Equipped with a high-powered buster and unique special abilities, the Rockett Gear X armor allows you to defeat formidable enemies and uncover hidden areas within each stage.

Challenging Stages, Enemies & Bosses.

Explore a variety of unique and challenging stages filled with obstacles, secrets, and intense encounters. Face strategic enemy patterns and epic boss battles that will test your reflexes and skill.

4520150.name: Hikari! Harem Hot Springs Vol. 1
4520150.about_the_game:
Take the role of an aspiring mangaka who watches in shock as his dream girl sketches mysteriously come to life at the hot springs inn where he works. Teach these beauties from another world how to survive in ours, manage the chaotic ryokan, and slowly build your own steamy harem!

Game Overview

Hikari! Harem Hot Springs is a steamy slice-of-life hentai visual novel with exploration and sandbox elements where you step into the shoes of an aspiring mangaka (named by the player) whose ero dream girl sketches mysteriously comes to life at the traditional hot springs inn where you work.

Live day by day as these beauties from another world invade your already chaotic everyday life. Teach them how to blend into our world, handle the daily mayhem of running the ryokan, and gradually deepen your bonds through heartfelt conversations, playful and emotional moments, and plenty of spicy encounters!

Meet Aria! The main heroine of this first volume.
She's the most adorable, gentle, pure-hearted elf you'll ever want to protect... among other things.
Will you protect her smile, make her moan in the springs... or both?

KEY FEATURES

H-Scenes: Progress in the story to unlock new spicy moments with Aria! You can then rewatch them later in the CG Gallery or by interacting with her at any time during the in-game exploration.

Progress at your own pace: dive straight into the main story or take it slow with exploration and multiple intimate interactions with the girls which will unlock over time.

Mix of story and sandbox-style freedom: Progress in the adventure, then return anytime to relax and enjoy quality time with your favorite girl in your growing, passionate harem with Free Roam Mode.

Love Meter: Build Love and Lust points to unlock everything from casual chats and alternate outfits to intimate touching and fully replayable erotic CG scenes.

Wardrobe and Photo Mode: Enjoy all the unlockable outfits and make your own scenes to save in your device with these extra modes!

4520380.name: Robowild
4520380.about_the_game:
The Earth is flooded and humanity is long gone. Play as a robot explorer venturing across the ocean to explore islands now overrun with strange robot life. Fight, hunt, forage, and craft upgrades to prepare for voyages to more distant and mysterious lands. Gather your research and piece together the untold history of the cataclysm that reshaped the Earth. 

Gameplay

  • Explore: Mark points of interest using your scope, then swim, climb, and glide through the sky to reach them.

  • Fight: Shoot, roll, dodge, and parry. Unlock and equip new abilities to hunt creatures and defeat enemies. 

  • Forage: Collect mushrooms, crystals, metals, circuit boards, and other items to craft into upgrades and tools.

  • Enchant: Travel to distant corners of the Earth to have your items blessed by robot shamans. 

  • Build: Claim any part of the world as your own and build and customize your own bases.

4520390.name: 逆战勇士团 ReconBraves
4520390.about_the_game:
[Developer's Words] Every battle here is a contest of wits. With 17 vivid characters and 31 meticulously designed levels, we invite you to relive the pure charm of classic tactical RPGs.

[Background] Set on an otherworldly continent ruled by the Magic Dragon Empire, where corrupt elites tyrannize the land and enslave its people. To revolt against this dark reign, a group of passionate youths formed the "ReconBraves." Through countless perils, these 17 core members unite to defy the evil forces led by Prime Minister Ramos, writing a heroic epic of their own.

[Game Features]

  • Classic Tactical Gameplay: This Game is A single-player SRPG built, focusing on strategic layout and character development.

  • Rich Level Challenges: A total of 31 stages take you step-by-step on a crusade against the Empire.

  • Diverse Growth: 17 cultivable characters across various classes like Tactician, War Lord, and Shadow Slash.

  • Attribute Progression: With a level cap of 40, eight core stats—including HP, ATK, Skill, and Agility—grow precisely as you level up.

  • Deep Equipment System: Features 7 weapon types (Sword, Spear, Axe, Bow, Staff, Dagger, Gauntlet) and a full gear system including Armor, Helmets, and Accessories.

  • Unique Combat Mechanics: Realistic hit rate formulas, defense modifiers, and critical hit checks make every move unpredictable.

  • Strategic Tactical Actions: Beyond attacking, use commands like Guard (halve damage) or Rest (restore HP/MP). Master the "no-cost" equipment swapping strategy to counter tough foes.

  • Progressive Shop Updates: Nine tiers of shops unlock increasingly powerful "Black Gold" legendary gear as you progress.

  • Counter-attack & Resupply: Trigger counters within range; leveling up automatically refills HP and Energy to keep the battle tempo high.

[Pro Tips]

  • Leveling Strategy: Healing, buffing, and non-lethal attacks all grant a portion of EXP. Balanced distribution is key to victory.

  • Supply Prep: Shops offer recovery potions from Small to Extra Large, along with "Emergency Action Potions" for extra turns and "Short-range Teleport Scrolls."

  • Gear Choice: Pay attention to weapon traits—for instance, the "Black Gold Axe" ignores 30% of target defense when attacking without moving.

4520400.name: Periapsis: Gravity Slingshot
4520400.about_the_game:
Earth is no longer sustainable.

Lead humanity’s final journey beyond the Solar System. Launch ships from fragile worlds, use gravity to bend your path, discover new star systems, and search for planets that could carry civilization forward.

Plan each launch, manage fuel and cargo space, and decide when to scan, deploy, trade, or push deeper into the unknown. Every expedition costs time and resources, and every discovery may open a new route for humanity.

Will you guide humanity to become a multi-planet species?

Key Features

  • Skill-Based Launch & Gravity Navigation
    Time your engine burns, reach escape velocity, and use planetary gravity to bend trajectories and reduce fuel costs.

  • Strategic Expedition Planning
    Choose what to carry, where to fly, and when to spend fuel — preparation matters before every launch.

  • Planet Scanning & Orbital Deployment
    Scan planets for data, then deploy probes from orbit to recover resources and rare samples.

  • Star Atlas & Stargate Exploration
    Reveal new star systems, travel through stargates, and gradually expand humanity’s reachable frontier.

  • Ships, Equipment & Colonization
    Buy tools, unlock new hulls, seed promising planets, and establish colonies beyond Earth.

4520410.name: Umbral Briar
4520410.about_the_game:
In the shadowed wilds where thorn and twilight entwine, Umbral Briar invites you into a living world that does not forget.

This is a dark fantasy multiplayer online RPG built on the soul of the classics—where your journey is defined not by fleeting systems, but by lasting choices, meaningful progression, and a world that evolves without erasing its past. Inspired by the depth and community of old-school RPGs, Umbral Briar modernizes combat with fluid responsiveness and tactical weight, while preserving the deliberate pacing and identity that made the genre timeless.

There are no quest hubs cluttered with exclamation marks. No checklist-driven design. In Umbral Briar, your character already knows what matters. The world itself is the quest.

A village plagued by something unseen. A forest that grows wrong. A ruin whispering beneath the soil. You don’t accept these quests—you discover them. And when you act, the world responds. NPCs recognize your deeds not because you spoke to them first, but because you chose to intervene.

Progression is horizontal and enduring. When the world expands, it expands outward—not upward. New lands bring new opportunities, not obsolescence. Your hard-earned gear, your crafted tools, your knowledge of the world—these remain relevant. Always. There are no seasonal resets, no artificial cycles that wipe your progress clean. What you build in Umbral Briar stays built.

At max level, the journey doesn’t end—it deepens. Old dungeons don’t become irrelevant relics; they become shared history. Whether you return for rare materials, hidden secrets, or simply to help a friend experience something meaningful, the world rewards continued exploration and cooperation across all levels.

Professions matter. Exploration matters. Community matters.

There are no microtransactions. No pay-to-win shortcuts. No fear of missing out. Nothing is designed to disappear. The game respects your time by ensuring that everything you do has permanence and purpose.

Umbral Briar is not a race to the endgame. It is a world to live in—one that remembers where you’ve been, what you’ve done, and who you’ve become.

Wishlist Umbral Briar. It's almost time for you to awaken.

4520500.name: Puzzle
4520500.about_the_game:
Puzzle is an exciting puzzle game that invites players to embark on an amazing journey through the world of cosmic nature.

Here, the mysterious cosmos blends with the beauty of living nature, creating a unique atmosphere full of light, harmony, and mystery.

Players will experience 40 engaging levels filled with logical puzzles, visual beauty, and a gradual increase in difficulty. Each new level reveals unique elements of the fantasy world: glowing plants, starry landscapes, energy flows, and cosmic life forms.

✨ Game Features

🧩 40 Exciting Levels

Each level offers a new puzzle that demands attention, logic, and innovative thinking.

🌌 Unique Theme – Cosmic Nature

The game combines the beauty of nature and the mysteries of the cosmos: living planets, starry forests, glowing flowers, and fantastical landscapes.

🎵 Pleasant atmospheric music

The soft and relaxing soundtrack makes the gameplay even more enjoyable and helps you fully immerse yourself in the game world.

4520520.name: The Time After
4520520.about_the_game:
The Time After is set a few generations after global warming has destroyed civilization. A ruthless survivor tries to explain how we ended up here through the stories handed down to him and the remains of the time before.

Fight the locals and loot the ruins to keep the survivor and his wheels going as he drives south to escape the killing heat. 

The game is a journey through a series of open world locations that help to explain how the time after came to be. Taking on the role of the grim survivor, the player will engage in third person shooting, driving and scavenging for supplies and ammo to continue their journey. The survivor shares his perspective on how things are and what went wrong in the time before.

4520530.name: Bouncy Kingdoms
4520530.about_the_game:
Bouncy Kingdoms is a ToyBox Fantasy Adventure Game! 

  • Customise your own Hero!

  • Explore an Open-World with 4 Kingdoms to explore 

  • Meet lots of Fun Characters, Teddy Bears, Action Figures, Plushies + More

  • Complete Quests to help Heal the World 

  • Traverse Dangerous Dungeons!

  • Use your Sword to Fight Rock Monsters!

  • Enter Create Mode to Construct Buildings, Structures and Rides

4520630.name: 鴷de（的）自学笔记之C语言（Le de Self-study note of C Game Language）
4520630.about_the_game: 《Le de Self-study note of C Game Language》 is a casual puzzle solving third person shooting game. In the game, use 0 and 1 shooting to traverse each geometry, observe the displayed images, and experience the experience of relaxing and learning in silence with a short process. You will play the role of a small robot named Le, traversing every geometric object and finding your own direction to move forward.

4520640.name: TechnoMayan
4520640.about_the_game:
In an alternate history triggered by a well-placed meteor, the descendants of the Maya were left undisturbed to bring their technologies to unrivaled heights. Now, they are the first to cross the Atlantic. They are not bringing guns, they bring sweet Techno music.

Command a floating festival across a mythical ocean, dazzle ancient sea terrors with wave-shattering beats, and prove that a perfect song is mightier than a cannonball. In this sometimes bullet-hell, but definitely notes-heaven adventure with rogue-like elements, the only thing louder than the explosions is the bass.

A World Reimagined

Set sail across a massive, open-world recreation of the Atlantic Ocean. We’ve mapped the real-world seas and infused them with ancient mysticism and epic tales. Chart a course from the sun-drenched Gulf of “Mexico” to the legendary Strait of Gibraltar, discovering hidden archipelagos and rhythmic anomalies along the way.

Win the Crowd, Fund the Voyage

Music is your primary tool. Charm passing merchant vessels and fellow sailors with your unique sound to earn the gold and supplies needed to keep your expedition afloat. A generous public is the lifeblood of a successful world tour.

Leviathans of the Deep

The ocean hides gargantuan terrors. Face off against massive, mythical sea monsters and use mesmerising frequencies to discourage their attacks in high-stakes bullet-hell encounters.

The Show Must Go On

Every failure is just a rehearsal. Even if your ship founders, the rhythm never dies. Gather your collected resources and knowledge to come back stronger for your next set.

A Sanctuary of Sound

Your home base is a mystical marvel, capable of pulling you back from the brink of disaster. Return to this safe haven to refit your vessel, using your hard-earned spoils to transform a simple boat into the ultimate floating stage.

Reinforced Rhythm

Survival requires more than just talent. Upgrade your ship with incredible technologies to ensure your stage can withstand the crushing weight of the Atlantic’s most dangerous waves.

Master Your Sound

The right tool makes the melody. Unlock mystical instruments. Perhaps you’ll get the fabled Gold Flute to lead your sonic revolution.

Features

  • A massive open-world map : Based on real-world ocean geography, enhanced with mythical landmarks and epic mysteries.

  • 100+ upgrades : From hull-thumping engines to mystical sails, improve your vessel with a massive array of technological marvels.

  • Tens of ever scaling Encounters : Whether they are friends or foes, you’ll need to find a way to get what you need to keep the music playing.

  • Massive Bosses Battles: As you approach your destination, the sea's ancient guardians grow more formidable, reacting to your rising fame and volume.

4520650.name: 持镣铐者#735
4520650.about_the_game:
Game Introduction

On November 30, 1875, Temis, the police chief known for a 100% case clearance rate, was transferred to the crime-ridden city of Nineveh.

Starting with a high-value gem theft, the story gradually uncovers the deep-seated darkness hidden within the city of Nineveh and the chief himself.

Game Features

・Freely determine the life or death of criminals through choices.

・The number of surviving criminals influences the ending.

・The protagonist has no romantic inclinations; there are no mutual romantic relationships in the game.

4520720.name: Hentai World Bar
4520720.about_the_game:
Enter a relaxing and enchanting puzzle journey where each completed level uncovers stunning artwork of charming girls. Gentle background music creates a calm atmosphere while you slide and arrange tiles, gradually revealing every image piece by piece.

Play at your own comfortable pace with no time limits, and enjoy a rewarding feeling of progress as the puzzles slowly become more challenging. Whether you’re a casual player or someone who enjoys puzzle challenges, this game blends relaxation, beauty, and engaging gameplay perfectly.

Features:

Unlock attractive and beautifully illustrated girl artworks at every level

Enjoy soft and relaxing background music while playing

View finished pictures in full-screen mode

Experience puzzles that steadily increase in difficulty

No timers or pressure—just play freely and relax

A relaxing puzzle experience featuring lovely girl artwork, soothing music, unlimited time, and a smooth difficulty curve for calm and enjoyable gameplay.

4520780.name: 诸天斗法
4520780.about_the_game:
Celestial Clash is a free-to-play online strategic card game inspired by the classic Chinese novel Journey to the West. Build a powerful deck, master the Five Elements, and challenge players from around the world.

────────────────────────────────

CHOOSE YOUR FACTION

────────────────────────────────

Four unique factions are available, each with a distinct identity and playstyle:

🌿 Flower Fruit Mountain – A wood and earth faction built around aggressive Disciple swarms and evolution chains. Summon monkey warriors and ascend them into legends.

🔥 Flaming Mountain – A fire and metal faction focused on disruption and recursion. Bounce enemy Disciples, control the board, and recycle key cards for repeated value.

⚗️ Tushita Palace – A fire and water faction wielding powerful Artifacts and spell synergies. Build up your arsenal and close games with overwhelming force.

👻 Underworld – A mysterious faction with unique mechanics centered around fate, sacrifice, and judgment. High risk, high reward.

────────────────────────────────

BUILD YOUR DECK

────────────────────────────────

Each deck contains 40 cards drawn from your chosen faction's pool. Combine Disciples (creatures), Spells, and Artifacts to create powerful synergies. Unlock additional factions and expand your collection using in-game Spirit Stones earned through ranked play.

────────────────────────────────

CORE GAMEPLAY

────────────────────────────────

Celestial Clash is a turn-based card game played on a shared board. On each turn:

• Draw cards and generate Mana to pay for your cards

• Summon Disciples to the field – they can attack the enemy Sect directly (Breakthrough) or challenge opposing Disciples (Duel)

• Cast Spells for instant effects, or deploy Artifacts for persistent advantages

• Use your Sect's unique Skill ability for a tactical edge

Master a rich set of keywords including Rush, Reckless, Evasion, Ward, Spellbind, and more. The Ascension system lets you evolve low-cost Disciples into powerful high-tier forms mid-game, creating dramatic momentum swings.

────────────────────────────────

GAME MODES

:

────────────────────────────────

🏆 Ranked Mode – Real-time 1v1 matchmaking. Climb the ladder from Qi Refinement through Foundation Building, Golden Core, Nascent Soul, God Transformation, Mahayana, and finally Heavenly Tribulation. Earn win streak bonuses and daily Spirit Stone rewards.

⚡ Tribulation Trial – A special roguelike challenge mode. Win 3 consecutive matches to complete the trial and claim rare rewards. One loss ends your run – can you go undefeated?

🤖 Practice vs AI – Hone your skills against AI opponents at any time.

────────────────────────────────

FREE TO PLAY – FAIR TO ALL

────────────────────────────────

All factions and cards are unlocked using Spirit Stones earned through gameplay. There are no randomized loot boxes and no pay-to-win mechanics. Every player competes on equal footing.

────────────────────────────────

FEATURES AT A GLANCE

────────────────────────────────

• 4 factions, 100+ unique cards

• Real-time online PvP matchmaking

• Full ranked ladder with 7 rank tiers

• Roguelike Tribulation Trial mode

• Deck builder with full card collection

• Replay system to review your matches

• Leaderboard to track top players

• Free to play with no pay-to-win

4520870.name: Seek Shellter
4520870.about_the_game:
Seek Shellter is an arcade-style pathfinder full of cute snails who must collect batteries and seek shelter before the timer runs out.

Steeped in retro-60s atomic charm reminiscent of “Duck and Cover”, Seek Shellter features evolving levels, unique minigames and many worlds that will test your quick thinking and reaction timing.

  • Top-Down Pathfinding - Randomly-generated levels throw more at you as you find the shortest path to collect enough batteries and seek shelter before the bomb drops!

  • Unlock More Snails - Help other snails to unlock and play with unique abilities.

  • Local Co-Op - Team up with a friend to clear levels, win minigames and unlock worlds together.

  • Local PvP - Compete against your friend to see who can collect enough batteries and seek shelter first! No friends? Don't fret, the computer is up for some PvP too!

  • Tailor Your Experience - Select the right difficulty for you, and even adjust the game speed if it's too fast or slow.

4520880.name: ウォーキング エイト
4520880.about_the_game: 霧に包まれた戦場を進み、異変を観測・判断してループからの脱出を目指す一人称視点の心理ホラー探索ゲーム。変化する単一マップを探索し、景色や死体、オブジェクト配置の違和感を手掛かりに進行。異変を見つけた時は「撃つ」「進む」「閃光弾を使う」を選択し、誤れば同じ戦場に引き戻されます。

4520940.name: Doom Survivor: Horde Rush
4520940.about_the_game:
🎮 Game Introduction

Doom Survivor: Horde Rush is an easy-to-pick-up yet strategically deep bullet hell survival game. You will take on the role of a post-apocalyptic hero, carving a path through relentless zombie hordes, defeating powerful mutated bosses, and protecting humanity's last hope!

The game features 18 progressively challenging difficulty levels, ranging from casual experiences to hardcore trials. Every battle tests your positioning, strategic combinations, and resource management. Collect gold and gems to unlock new heroes, new weapons, and new talents, and forge your ultimate firepower defense line!

⚔️ Hero System: 5 Post-Apocalyptic Heroes, 5 Combat Styles

Ada
A mysterious and beautiful agent, the starting hero with exceptional mobility! Boasting high movement speed, she synergizes best with attack speed, projectile count, and ricochet. Perfect for beginners to get a feel for the game and enjoy satisfying crowd clearing.

Leon
Ada's boyfriend. Every 3rd shot fires a fireball that deals 3 burning damage per second to enemies. A top-tier fire damage dealer; combine him with fire skills for a powerful, sustained burn build.

Alice
A clone hero. When an enemy dies, she fires a homing skull bullet that deals 5 damage to nearby foes. The core summoner hero. Pair her with summon-enhancing skills to turn the tables on the zombie horde with their own ammunition!

Wesker
Ada's colleague. Bullets deal an additional 3 lightning damage on hit. Combine with lightning skills for absolutely explosive, screen-clearing power. A top choice for players seeking pure, satisfying chaos.

Code:6B
A mass-produced AI. After dashing, leaves behind a phantom that wields a giant sword, dealing damage equal to your bullet damage to nearby enemies. This high-skill hero is perfect for players who enjoy impact skills and dash-focused weapon builds.

Each hero features a unique mechanic and talent direction, from fiery bursts and lightning clears to skull summons and phantom dashes. There's a playstyle waiting for you!

🏹 Weapon System: 11 Unique Weapons, Free Combination

Pistol
The starting weapon. Well-balanced in all aspects, a solid all-rounder suitable for any hero.

Shotgun
Short range but wide area of effect. An excellent tool for close-quarters crowd clearing.

Crossbow
Bullets pierce one enemy. While standing still, bullet damage increases over time. Resets upon moving. Suitable for fixed-position, high-damage playstyles.

Fire Gun
Bullets deal 3 burning damage per second to enemies hit. The perfect match for Leon, enabling a sustained burn build.

Dual Pistols
Fire two bullets simultaneously. High burst potential, ideal for players chasing high fire rates.

Dragon Lance
Fires dragon-shaped homing bullets that scale with summon damage bonuses! The top choice for summoner builds, perfect for Alice.

Grenade Launcher
Fires grenades that explode, dealing area-of-effect damage. A crowd-clearing powerhouse.

Bow
Fired arrows stick into the ground and are automatically retrieved after a while, dealing damage to enemies on their return flight. Highly tactical and excellent for players who enjoy strategic placement.

Laser Gun
A powerful ranged weapon that pierces through everything. Pure linear destruction.

Vacuum Blade
Rapidly fires sword waves dealing area-of-effect damage. Effective at both melee and range.

Alien Rifle
An extraterrestrial weapon. Fired bullets pierce through enemies and bounce off screen edges.

Every weapon has a unique attack method and preferred heroes. The triple combination of Weapon + Hero + Talent creates an ever-changing array of battle styles!

👗 Fashion System: 6 Masks + 6 Wings

Mask System

  • Bat Mask: Increases Luck. Luck increases the chance of item drops from oil barrels. Exploding barrels deals massive damage to zombies.

  • Knight's Glasses: An immunity artifact. Your sight pierces all. (Immune to slow and confusion)

  • Assault Mask: Grants powerful abilities to brave adventurers. Increases pickup range.

  • Tengu Mask: A mysterious mask from another world. Every 40 seconds, fires 5 slowing water orbs in all directions.

  • Apocalypse Mask: A high-tech mask from the year 2077. Increases pickup range and Luck.

  • Pumpkin Helmet: A Halloween-exclusive helmet. Grants immunity to monster entanglement.

Wing System

  • Bat Wings: Monsters, begone! Increases movement speed.

  • Knight's Wings: "The path is dangerous. May the knight be with you." Increases Evasion.

  • Assault Wings: "The adventurer's will lives on." Increases movement speed and knockback effect.

  • Tengu Wings: Legend says these wings are a spirit beast's transformation. Every 35 seconds, releases a large field that attracts experience orbs.

  • Apocalypse Wings: Future wings with amazing features. A versatile type that boosts various attributes.

  • Pumpkin Cape: A Halloween-exclusive cape. Increases movement speed, etc.

The fashion system not only provides cool looks but also offers rich stat bonuses to help you survive longer in the horde!

🧠 Talent System: Free Construction, Endless Builds

Talents are divided into multiple categories, allowing different heroes to pursue various talent directions!

Talents allow you to freely switch builds between different heroes and weapons. Experiment with countless combinations and find your ultimate, most powerful setup!

🗺️ Game Modes

📖 Survival Mode (18 Difficulties)
Progress from easy to challenging. Battle unique bosses, earn gold and gems, and unlock new heroes, weapons, and talents!

⚡ Trial Challenges
Three difficulty trials, each lasting 5 minutes. A great place to farm weapon shards!

🌊 Endless Challenge
Survive as long as possible to earn greater rewards! A true test of your ultimate survival ability.

🎯 Perfect for Players Who...

✅ Love Bullet Hell & Satisfying Combat

4520950.name: Ancient World
4520950.about_the_game:
Ancient World is a story-driven game with survival elements set in an open desert, featuring crafting and a narrative quest. You will search for your missing sister, fight goblins, solve traps in ancient ruins, and try to survive the harsh desert conditions.

You and your sister set out on a dangerous journey to find the treasures of an ancient tomb. To enter, you need a complete amulet—but you only have one half, inherited from your grandfather. When your sister mysteriously disappears, the search for treasure turns into a brutal fight for survival.

What awaits you

Survival in an extreme climate. Scorching heat by day and freezing cold by night. Keep track of your hydration, find shelter, build fires. Hunger and thirst aren’t just meters—they’re a constant threat.

Resource gathering and hunting. Hunt desert creatures, gather resources, find oases—there you can rest, replenish supplies, and encounter a wandering trader.

The raft as a mobile base. The raft stays where you leave it. Use it to store resources, save the game, and escape from enemies.

Exploring ruins and battling goblins. The desert is full of dangers: goblins set ambushes in canyons and dungeons, and the ancient builders left cunning traps—both in the ruins and inside the pyramid.

A story-driven mystery. Only attention and wit will help you overcome all the trials and uncover the secret hidden in the sands.

4520960.name: IamMETEOR
4520960.about_the_game:
Control a rocket and break through endless waves of blocks.

IamMETEOR is a fast-paced arcade brick breaker with a twist.

Use your rocket and its launcher to fire rapid shots, bouncing and smashing blocks while filling the screen with a meteor-like storm of projectiles.

The more you fire, the more chaotic the game becomes.

FEATURES

• Rocket-based brick breaker gameplay

• Shoot continuously to create chaotic, meteor-like effects

• Procedurally generated stages

• Increasing speed and intensity

• Score attack focused gameplay

• Retro arcade style

Simple to play, chaotic to master.

4520970.name: PinBall Escape
4520970.about_the_game:
Title: Pinball Escape: The Library of God
Tagline: A celestial climb where every flip counts. Cooperate to escape the Divine Study!

Short Description

Trapped in God's mystical library for their constant bickering, an Angel and a Demon must finally put their differences aside. In this roguelike vertical pinball adventure, use your agile flippers to aim for the heavens. Climb higher to find the exit, but be careful—one wrong move and you'll go tumbling back to where you started!

About This Game

A Divine Punishment
God is tired of the endless war between Heaven and Hell. As a lesson in cooperation, He has shrunk a snarky Demon and a stoic Angel, trapping them inside His infinite study. Their only way out? Reach the highest shelf of the library.

Roguelike Pinball Action
Control the celestial pair as a single ball in this unique vertical climber. Use powerful flippers to navigate through shelves filled with magical obstacles, portals, and bumpers.

High Stakes, Higher Reaches
The higher you go, the more dangerous the library becomes. Reach new "Stages" to set height records. But beware: falling down isn't just a mistake—it's a setback that returns you to previous stages. How high can you climb before God's mocking laughter gets to you?

Key Features

  • Unique Vertical Pinball Mechanics: Forget traditional tables—climb through an endless, shifting library.

  • Agile Flipper Action: Master the timing of your flippers to navigate through shelves. Precision is key to reaching the next shelf.

  • God's Watchful Eye: God isn't just a spectator. He’ll mock your failures and laugh as you fall.

  • Roguelike Progression: Every session is a test of skill. Push your maximum height and unlock new stages.

  • Cute Fantasy Aesthetic: Simple, vibrant, and colorful world-building.

4521110.name: The Polar Darkness
4521110.about_the_game:
During the Winter Solstice in northern Finland, a journalist is sent to a remote village to cover a controversial revival movement led by a charismatic cult leader and her child preacher.

When the boy mysteriously disappears during a sermon and a blizzard traps everyone in the village, she is forced to investigate a secret the community has protected for generations.

Explore the isolated village of Sysiluoma and uncover the truth through conversation, observation, and deduction.

  • Question villagers and uncover conflicting stories

  • Gather clues and piece together what really happened

  • Solve puzzles grounded in the world and its people

There is no combat or rush, only the quiet pressure of something not meant to be uncovered.

4521270.name: Dealer's Doom
4521270.about_the_game:
Every run in Dealer's Doom begins at a blackjack table.
It may also end there.

This is not just blackjack with a roguelike skin. It is a high-pressure strategy game built on betting, risk control, rule adaptation, and run-defining synergies. You are not simply trying to beat the dealer's hand. You are trying to survive 10 escalating floors, manage your chips, outplay shifting rules, and assemble a build strong enough to break the table before the table breaks you.

The familiar foundation is still here:
Hit. Stand. Double down. Split. Surrender. Buy insurance.

But as the run goes on, the game keeps changing the terms of the fight.

Why Dealer's Doom stands out:

  • Classic blackjack at the core, roguelike strategy at heart
    Each round follows the tension of real blackjack: place your bet, play your hand, and live with the result. The twist is everything built around it. Between floors, you pick powerful abilities, make high-stakes service stop decisions, and shape your next run with unlockable starter contracts. Knowing blackjack helps. Building around chaos is how you win.

  • Every floor changes the table
    Dealer behavior, reward pacing, action restrictions, insurance value, and draw logic can all shift as you progress. Some floors pressure your economy. Some force you into tighter lines. Some bosses demand a completely different rhythm of play. A safe decision on one floor can be a fatal habit on the next.

  • Deep build variety with room for broken combinations
    The current game includes:
    10 floors
    38 abilities
    9 starter contracts
    7 service effects

You can build around winstreak momentum, insurance discounts, one-time protection, phoenix-style revival, peeking at the next card, rerolling rounds, or stealing information from the dealer. Runs do not just feel different because of luck. They feel different because your tools, risks, and priorities change dramatically from build to build.

  • Risk management matters as much as card luck
    Dealer's Doom is not about mindlessly fishing for good draws. It is about making smart decisions under pressure. When should you push for profit? When should you protect your bankroll? When is doubling down the winning line, and when is survival worth more than greed? Every bet is a strategic commitment.

  • Failure still drives progression
    Even failed runs move you forward. Earn gold, unlock new contracts and services, expand your long-term options, and fill out your codex as you discover more of the game's systems. The more you play, the more ways you gain to challenge the table on your own terms.

  • Built for “one more run”
    If you love chasing mastery, there is plenty to aim for:
    Clear your first floor
    Finish a full run
    Win with a natural blackjack
    Sweep a split round
    Survive a brutal losing streak
    Trigger a phoenix revival
    Complete the codex
    Defeat every boss

Some runs will collapse in slow motion.
Some will explode into absurd momentum.
Both will make you want to queue up another hand.

Features:
A fresh fusion of blackjack fundamentals and roguelike buildcraft
10 escalating floors with boss pressure and shifting rule sets
38 abilities, 9 starter contracts, and 7 service effects
Meaningful chip management and profit-target decision making
Persistent progression through unlocks, codex discovery, and achievements
English and Simplified Chinese support
Steam Achievements and Cloud Save support

If you enjoy card strategy, run-based progression, risk management, and games that constantly force you to adapt, Dealer's Doom turns a familiar card table into something far more dangerous.

You are not here to play the dealer's game.
You are here to end it.

4522510.name: Kill the Lich Idle
4522510.about_the_game:
Kill the Lich is a minimalist incremental game centered around time compression and resource propagation. Your resources build automatically over time, but their growth accelerates when you optimize their downstream flow ratios, and you can manually push them along to go even faster. Each action grants attributes that reduce the requirements of other actions, allowing you to push further. Eventually, you can head north to Fight the Lich's Forces in an automated Phase 2, gathering three vital resources that make your next loop faster and unlock new goals.

Unfolding World

With each loop, you gain access to an expanding web of actions. Your goals and strategies will constantly evolve as you prepare for the ultimate fight. As you delve deeper into the system, the number of available actions scales to over 300.

Visualize the Math

As an idle game, the math takes center stage. Every formula is fully exposed so you can see exactly how to respond to it. A scrollable map with multiple zoom levels lets you step back and visualize the exact state of your complex network at a high level.

Route the Flows

Your primary resource — Momentum — generates and increases automatically. Your core gameplay loop involves routing it in different directions based on your current objectives, whether that's boosting Momentum generation or unlocking new action nodes. With multiple secondary resources in play, choosing the correct directional flow is the ultimate optimization puzzle.

True Idle Game

Designed to be played over weeks and months, this is a true idle game. You will frequently set up your flow logic and then step away to let the harvest play out, with new unlocks and hints keeping you engaged for the long haul. To ensure your time is respected, being offline or paused banks Bonus Time at 100% efficiency. You can spend this to multiply the game's simulation speed, ensuring no time is ever wasted.

Design Granular Automation

As you play, you will unlock deep automation tools. These give you the ability to dictate exactly when and by how much your downstream flow dials shift, enabling complex decision-making tailored to your current stats and situation.

Prestige and Time Compression

After a few hours of build-up, you can engage the Lich's Forces. This resets your current progress and pushes you as far as your build allows, rewarding you with resources to spend on a massive upgrade tree. The core strategy lies in selecting the most efficient upgrades to compress the timeline of your next run, allowing you to reach new heights faster!

Prestige, Second Order Reset, and New Game+

To keep the progression and time compression flowing endlessly, the game features two distinct layers of prestige restarts, as well as a New Game+ with its own upgrades, for players who want a little more! Each reset layer is curated to continuously evolve the player experience.

Online Community

Join the thriving Discord for bug reports, suggestions, or to brag about your progress!

4522710.name: Swarmbound
4522710.about_the_game:
What if an 8-bit console had unlimited power and an open-door policy?

Swarmbound is a high-performance "Bullet Heaven" roguelite built on a simple premise: Retro aesthetics, modern scale, and total moddability. Face off against impossible swarms of up to 1,500 active enemies at a buttery-smooth 60fps, then change the entire game without ever hitting "Quit."

No bloated engines. No long load times. Just pure, unadulterated arcade chaos.

Features

  • The "Impossible" Swarm: Battle massive waves of enemies that would have melted original hardware. Our custom MonoGame engine handles 1,000+ mobs and hundreds of projectiles without breaking a sweat.

  • Five Classic Classes: Master the frontline Paladin, the crowd-clearing Sorceress, the entity-commanding Necromancer, and more.

  • Deep Tactical Survival: It’s not just about moving in circles. Balance class-specific abilities, manage area-denial spells, and hunt for shrines to turn the tide.

  • Lo-Fi, High Fidelity: Immerse yourself in a world of chiptune SFX and MIDI compositions. Toggle the integrated CRT Post-Process Shader for that authentic scanline glow.

  • Optimized for Handhelds: Built specifically for the Steam Deck, offering "pick up and play" sessions with near-instant loading and zero-compromise performance.

The "Open Engine" Experience

Swarmbound was built to be broken. We believe the community makes the best content, so we built the game as a modular platform.

  • Full Mod Support: Every sprite, sound effect, item, and spell is mod-loadable.

  • Hot-Swappable Content: Swap mods in and out live without restarting the game.

  • The Druid Example: To prove the power of our modding tools, the entire Druid class—including its 8x8 sprites, unique spells, and SFX—was built and loaded using the same external mod system available to you.

The "Unlimited NES" Philosophy

Swarmbound is a love letter to the 8-bit era, stripped of its technical constraints. We’ve traded high-res textures for high-density simulation. Every 8x8 sprite and 1x1 pixel projectile is part of a massive, synchronized world designed to test your reflexes and your build.

How long can you survive the swarm?

4522870.name: Islandustry
4522870.about_the_game:
Welcome to your new factory empire!
In this casual automation and strategy game, you’re competing against rival tycoons to see who can build the most profitable business. The goal is simple: grab the best land, set up your production chains, and play the market to get rich.

Find the Best Land
Every round starts with an auction. Scout the map, figure out which plots hold the richest resources, and outbid everyone else to claim it. If you want to make big money, you have to start with the best dirt!

Build and Exploit
Once the land is yours, it’s time to get to work. Set up your machines, link up your production chains, and start extracting resources. Automate everything as best as you can so the goods just keep rolling in.

Play the Market (But Watch the Clock!)
Market prices are constantly going up and down. It’s up to you to decide when to stockpile your items and when to sell for massive profits. But don't get too greedy! You are on a timer, and if you wait too long for the perfect price, time will run out and you'll miss your chance.

Upgrade and Do It Again
After your time on the land is up, take your hard-earned cash back to town. Spend your profits on permanent upgrades to unlock new machines/items or to make your machines run faster and your production chains more efficient. Once you're geared up, the next land auction begins!

4522880.name: Boundary Compass Detective Stories Case 01: The Last Leaf
4522880.about_the_game:
【Introduction】

Every shadow in this room holds a fragment of a lingering "will."

A strange request arrives at a small detective agency. The mission: to investigate the residence of a homeowner who has vanished without a trace.

Inside the silent house, you will find a series of elaborate puzzles scattered throughout the rooms. As you unravel each mystery, you draw closer to the truth the owner left behind. What awaits at the end of the final deduction?

"Compass of Boundaries: Case 01 - The Last Leaf" is a quiet, atmospheric first-person mystery adventure focused on exploration and logical thinking.

【Key Features】

  • Immersive Exploration: Examine every corner of the house to find hidden clues. Your observation skills and intuition are key to discovering where and how to use the items you find.

  • Intricate Puzzles & Gimmicks: Features a wide variety of puzzles, ranging from intuitive brainteasers to complex mechanical challenges that require careful thought.

  • An Emotional Mystery: More than just a puzzle game—trace the footsteps of the missing owner and uncover a touching, deeply personal narrative.

【Systems & Support】

  • Hint System: Never get stuck for too long. A multi-stage hint system ensures that everyone, from puzzle novices to veterans, can see the story through to its conclusion.

  • Auto-Save: The game features an auto-save function, allowing you to focus entirely on your investigation without worrying about losing progress.

【Streaming & Video Guidelines】

We fully welcome individuals and organizations to stream the game and post gameplay videos. No prior permission is required. We hope you enjoy sharing your journey as a detective with your audience!

4522890.name: STRANGER WITHIN - Tales of Dorothy
4522890.about_the_game:
STRANGER WITHIN is a mystery 2D point-and-click escape adventure where players solve puzzles and combine clues to uncover a hidden truth.

Trapped in unfamiliar places, you must carefully examine your surroundings, collect clues, and connect scattered pieces of information to find a way out. Every object, note, and subtle detail may hold the key to your escape.

But you are not alone.

Fragments of different personalities within you will guide your journey. Each personality offers unique perspectives that help you interpret clues, uncover hidden meanings, and move forward through the mystery.

As you escape from one place to another, a deeper story begins to unfold. Memories and traces connected to a girl named Dorothy gradually surface, revealing a narrative that goes far beyond a simple escape.

Can you piece together the truth hidden within yourself?

FEATURES

• Classic 2D point-and-click gameplay

• Escape room style puzzle solving / Sometimes, strategically defeat the enemies that stand in your way.

• Combine clues and information to uncover solutions

• Multiple personalities that assist you during your journey

• A mysterious story that unfolds as you escape

• Over 8+ hours of gameplay.

GAMEPLAY

Players interact with objects, investigate environments, and collect clues to solve puzzles. By combining different pieces of information, new paths and solutions will emerge.

Throughout the game, the personalities within you provide hints and insights that help interpret the clues you discover.

Each successful escape not only brings you closer to freedom, but also reveals fragments of Dorothy's story and the truth hidden behind the mystery.
developers: Great LEE SEUNG YONG - Team E.S

4522960.name: SpellCarved
4522960.about_the_game:
Spellcarved

How long can you last?

Spellcarved is a wave-survival action game where every run is yours to shape.

Battle through waves of enemies, crack open chests for cash, and spend your earnings on stat upgrades, wild power-ups, and new abilities between rounds.

No two runs play out the same — with randomly generated maps, 6 enemy types, and waves that keep ramping up the chaos, you'll always have something new to deal with.

Pick from 20 different power-ups, mix and match your build, and see how far you can push it before things get out of hand.

This is my first ever "completed" game, and I genuinely hope you enjoy it! I'd love to hear what you think — feedback, suggestions, or just letting me know how far you got are all welcome. Thanks for giving it a shot!


-Spooked

4522980.name: Dino-Tipping
4522980.about_the_game:
Dino-Tipping is a fast-paced infinite runner that takes the classic sliding dino concept and cranks it up to full throttle.

Survive the Endless Slide You're a tiny pixel dinosaur hurtling forward at relentless speed. Barrels, rocks, swooping birds, and tree stumps stand between you and your next high score - one wrong move and it's over.

More Control Than You'd Expect Unlike most runners, Dino-Tipping gives you real mobility. Move your dino left and right, double jump over tricky obstacles, glide through the air to nail those tight gaps, and turn off gravity with a single button. Mastering your movement is the difference between a good run and a great one.

Chase Your Best No hand-holding, no fluff - just you, your reflexes, and a local high score to beat. Every run is a chance to go further than before.

Key Features

  • Infinite runner with ever-increasing speed

  • Double jump and glide mechanics for precise control

  • Left/right movement for full dodge control

  • Pixel art dinosaur and obstacle design

  • Local high score system

Share the joy with your friends, and make sure not to take the turbulence personally!

Controls:

  • ↑ Up — Jump

  • ↑ Hold Up — Glide

  • ↓ Hold Down — Crouch / Dive straight down

  • ↑↑ Double tap Up — Double Jump

Start/End:

  • Press the tip to start!

  • ESC to exit

4522990.name: Veil Breach: Raven County
4522990.about_the_game:
Raven County has gone dark. The VPA sent someone to figure out why. Not everyone heading in was sent by the VPA. Survive relentless waves of anomalies, build your loadout on the fly, and last as long as you can in a county that stopped making sense three days ago.

SURVIVE THE BREACH

Veil Breach: Raven County is a third-person 3D horde survival bullet heaven. Keep moving, collect XP, level up mid-run, and choose from a randomized selection of weapon upgrades as the waves grow heavier and faster. Take on quests scattered throughout each location, uncover what the VPA is not telling you, and decide when to go looking for a boss fight. Runs last under 30 minutes. Each one plays out differently.

BUILD YOUR LOADOUT MID-RUN

Passive weapons fire on their own. Active abilities are yours to control. The difference between a good run and a great one usually comes down to how well you use both.

Every level-up pulls from a randomized pool of upgrades spread across five rarity tiers, Common through Legendary. Stack bonuses on your existing weapons, crack open chests to unlock new ones, and build combinations that snowball hard before the final waves hit.

KEEP MOVING OR DIE

Standing still is not a strategy. Raven County is full of things that want you dead and the map itself is not on your side. Dodge booby traps, navigate environmental hazards, and use speed boosts and launch pads to stay one step ahead of the horde. Momentum is not just a playstyle, it is your best survival tool.

CHOOSE YOUR SURVIVOR

A VPA field agent. A couple of Raven County locals who are having the worst week of their lives. A chicken. And many more, each with their own story and their own reason for still being standing.

Every survivor comes with a different starting weapon. Pick one and see how far the run goes.

TWO LOCATIONS. ONE COUNTY.

Soma Castle

The knights of Soma Castle stood guard for centuries. Three days ago they started moving on their own. The VPA has logged the breach signatures coming from inside. They have not shared what the signatures matched.

Raven City

The city proper fell fast. Streets that had names now have none. Something is using the infrastructure and the Agency very much wants to know what before it figures out the rest of the county.

More of Raven County is out there. How much gets uncovered depends on how long you survive.

KEY FEATURES

  • Third-person 3D horde survival Bullet Heaven

  • Passive auto-fire weapons alongside player-controlled active abilities

  • Randomized upgrade system across five rarity tiers, Common to Legendary

  • Growing roster of survivors each with a unique starting weapon

  • Two hand-crafted maps with escalating wave difficulty

  • Quests scattered throughout each location

  • Optional boss encounters for those looking for a bigger fight

  • Environmental hazards, booby traps and speed boosts that reward aggressive movement

  • Collectibles including XP, gold, health packs and tactical consumables

  • Low-poly PSX visual style

  • Runs under 30 minutes, built for one more try

  • Full gamepad support and Steam Deck compatible

4523040.name: Judge SIM
4523040.about_the_game:
In Judge Sim, you step into the role of a judge responsible for resolving complex courtroom cases. Listen carefully to witnesses, analyze evidence, uncover contradictions, and make decisions that can change the fate of the accused.

The truth is not always obvious. Justice depends on you.

Every case is a legal puzzle where you must maintain control of the courtroom, evaluate witness credibility, and decide whether to sustain or overrule objections. One wrong decision could lead to an unjust verdict—or allow the guilty to walk free.

Throughout your career, you will face dozens of unique cases filled with unexpected twists, hidden evidence, and conflicting testimonies. Can you uncover the truth and deliver justice?

⚖️ Listen to testimonies and analyze statements
📂 Examine evidence and uncover contradictions
👨‍⚖️ Rule on objections and control the courtroom
🧩 Solve unique cases full of twists
📈 Build your career as a judge

Justice is in your hands.

4523140.name: Legend's Duty: The Rifted World
4523140.about_the_game:
Legend's Duty: The Rifted World is a single-player third-person action RPG set in a shattered fantasy world.

Step into the role of Rowe and fight across dangerous lands overrun by monsters, dungeons, and powerful bosses. Master close-range sword combat, ranged attacks, bombs, and magic skills as you face intense battles alongside your companion Layla.

Features:

• Fast-paced third-person action combat

• Melee, ranged, bomb, and magic-based attacks

• Companion support from Layla during battle

• Multiple areas to explore, including dungeons and boss encounters

• Character growth through combat and progression

• Colorful effects and dramatic fantasy action

• A compact single-player experience with an estimated playtime of around 1 hour

The UI is primarily in English. Essential gameplay instructions and important explanatory text are available in English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Spanish, and Portuguese.

Answer the call. Fight through the Rifted World.

4523160.name: Slot Theory
4523160.about_the_game:
Slot Theory is a tower defense about building something beautiful and deeply wrong.

Every wave, you get 1 choice: a new tower, a modifier, or an upgrade. Build a 6-slot machine across 20 waves, commit to your picks, and watch the wave play out. No panic micro. No filler choices. Just decisions that stack.

Draft-Driven Tower Defense

Every wave, choose 1 of 5 cards:

  • new towers

  • powerful modifiers

  • build-defining upgrades

Each pick permanently changes your run.

There’s no going back. No filler choices.
Just decisions that stack.

Build Synergies That Escalate

Mods don’t just increase stats, they change how your towers behave.

  • Split shots that flood the screen

  • Chain reactions that jump through entire waves

  • Feedback loops that reset attacks and spiral out of control

Build toward precision, chaos, or something completely broken.

Surge System

As your towers fight, they charge up Surges.

When they trigger:

  • Spread surges hit everything

  • Burst surges slam key targets

  • Control surges reshape the battlefield

  • Echo surges keep hitting after the fact

Your build doesn’t just scale, it reveals itself in real time.

Strategy Over APM

No micro. No spam.

Victory comes from:

  • positioning

  • timing

  • and the decisions you made before the wave even started

Runs With Identity

Every run becomes something distinct:

  • different towers

  • different mod combinations

  • different outcomes

Your final build gets a name and a place on the leaderboard.

Replayable by Design

  • Handcrafted maps

  • Procedural runs

  • Endless mode

  • Unlockable towers and modifiers

No two runs play the same.

Build it. Watch it unfold. Break it.

4523170.name: Glory Hole Barista
4523170.about_the_game:
The worker-owned café has a new loyalty program!

If a customer buys five coffees, they get to use the glory hole down the hall. As the barista, you must satisfy the specific needs of each client.

Satisfy your customers

Choose between your skills to target specific desires. But be careful: each action must be replenished, so you'll need to consider the order of operations.

Drive them crazy

Match your partner's intensity to build their pleasure. Balance their desires, lube, and intensity to unlock higher orgasm ranks. Satisfy customers to level up your abilities and unlock new actions!

Service with style

Use rewards to access several different outfits to customize your look.

Romance your regulars...

Featuring story scenes with 2+ romanceable characters!

...and maybe your work crush?!

4523240.name: The Last Connection
4523240.about_the_game:
Game Description:

The Last Connection is a narrative-driven game where you play as a Switchboard Operator. You will be connecting a town of characters to each other during your last week, before being replaced by a machine. Your choices in who to connect calls to will help solve the problems of townsfolk, have lasting consequences, and can help people overcome their barriers and improve relationships. You will explore, achieve endings, and unlock what truly makes this town and its people special.

Features:

  • Switchboard-based dialogue with voice acting!

  • 5 days of branching story choices and endings!

  • Explorable map of the town with chances to interact with the people who live there!

  • Notebook that keeps track of helpful information!

  • Puzzle-themed achievements to collect!

Important Note about Save System:

Please keep in mind that the current version of the game doesn't have a save system, meaning your progress will be lost upon exiting the game. On average, the game takes 40 minutes to 1 hour to finish, and save system is a planned update that will be added in the near future.

4523310.name: Megalophobia
4523310.about_the_game:
Colossal entities now roam the earth. They are so massive that their limbs pierce the clouds and their movements warp the horizon. In each chapter, you must survive the devastating presence of a new, uniquely terrifying colossal entity.

Built around the raw feeling of megalophobia (the fear of massive objects), this game is designed to make you feel completely powerless.

Keep your head down: Open spaces are your worst enemy. You need to move carefully between abandoned barns, dense forests, and deep ravines. If you are exposed when a shadow passes over, you won't survive the fallout of their movement.

Read the earth: You can't outrun them, but you can feel them coming. A titan shifting its weight miles away causes localized earthquakes. You have to listen to the deep, rumbling audio cues and feel the tremors to anticipate their path and get out of the way.

Navigate a broken world: The map isn't static. A careless step from above can flatten a hill or crush an entire town in seconds. You will constantly have to find new routes through fresh, smoking craters and shattered landscapes.

4523350.name: Collusion
4523350.about_the_game:
Collusion is a high-octane, top-down shooter with a bullet-hell soul where national politics are settled with lead. In a dystopian and fragmented Mexico, every state is an independent fiefdom protected by absurd bosses and regional hazards. Your mission: traverse the Republic, annihilate local factions, and unify the country under your command… or die trying


From the alien-infested land of Tamaulipas to the gun-toting sharks of Veracruz, every boss fight is a test of skill and reflexes. Defeat them to claim their territory and expand your influence across the map



CONQUER ALL 32 STATES

4523530.name: Will or Water
4523530.about_the_game:
In this point and click puzzle-adventure RPG, you play as a brave explorer seeking an ancient temple’s magical secrets. As soon as you enter this old ruin, it is clear that this will not be an easy task. If you survive the deadly traps and manage your resources, perhaps you’ll uncover the mysteries buried beneath the sand.

  • Navigate your way through a shifting ruin, with each delve different than the last

  • Manage two scarce resources, your Will and Water

  • Traps and other dangers affect your Will, draining physical or mental stamina

  • Use the magical properties of the Water found in this ancient temple to regain Will, or to advance through trials

  • Learn the lost language of the temple’s creators and listen to their guidance

  • Find curious items that help you along the way

The people of the nearby village are in great need. Their oasis is drying, turning to dust. Legends tell of a temple and ancient magics buried deep beneath the sand. You will face great dangers in this place. Might you return with your Will...or Water?

Tread Heavy is a Twin-Stick Tank Shooter. Use your main gun, dash, and your expanding series of upgrades to blow up waves of robots. Battle across your arena to collect XP from defeated enemies and return to the centre console to upgrade your tank further!

4523720.name: Squid Arrives：Make Squid Great Again
4523720.about_the_game:
🦑 Squid Arrives: Make Squid Great Again

In the year XXXX, the squids living in the deep sea received a billion "nuclear meals" delivered from a certain island.

After enjoying this gift full of technology and hardcore radiation, they suddenly awakened. The glorious history of cephalopod world domination—previously erased by Earth's will—now shines brightly in their brains once again.

Entering this cephalopod-rise timeline, you will play as a brave Squidism Warrior, piloting various fighter jets to eliminate the Little Green Men occupying the land and their co-conspirators.

Kill count bonuses earned in combat can be used to purchase new ammunition and aircraft upgrades, allowing you to pay out of pocket to become the most famous Air Force Squid among all squid folks.

🦑 Game Features (Or: How We Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Squid)

🎖️ Very Trendy Officer-san

Communication with them might be... quirky. But hey, in a warzone, anyone willing to have a normal conversation with you is definitely not on your team. Trust issues? More like survival instincts.

📰 Realistic Warfare Gameplay

👾 About Your Enemies

🎯 Custom Loadout System

Multiple special aircraft variants and ammunition types to choose from. Got decision paralysis? No worries. At the memorial service, you won't need to choose anything anyway. Problem solved.

🗺️ Diverse Battle Maps

Land, sea, and air maps that keyboard strategists are very familiar with. You've been "commanding from the couch" for so long—time to experience it firsthand! (Warning: Damaged edition only. No refunds on actual damage.)

4523770.name: Sim: Heavyweight Boxing Champion
4523770.about_the_game:
Choose Your Era — 1880 to 2026+

Start your career in any year from the bare-knuckle age of the 1880s to the modern mega-fight era and beyond. The game world evolves authentically with the times — title fight rounds change from 25 to 20 to 15 to 12 as the sport modernises, sanctioning bodies appear in their real years (one world title until 1963, then WBC, IBF in 1983, and WBO in 1988), venues shift from Yankee Stadium and the Polo Grounds to Caesars Palace and Riyadh's Kingdom Arena, fighter nationalities reflect each era's talent pools, and purse money grows from thousands to tens of millions. Boxing news announces every historic rule change as it happens.

2,500+ Real Heavyweight Fighters

Ali, Tyson, Foreman, Frazier, Louis, Dempsey, Lennox Lewis, Holyfield, Holmes, Marciano, Klitschko, Fury, Usyk, Joshua, Wilder, Jack Johnson, Jim Jeffries, Bob Fitzsimmons, and over two thousand more. Every significant heavyweight from 1880 to 2026 and beyond (upcoming top-rated amateurs) is in the game with authentic ratings, fighting styles, and stances. Start in their era and share the ring with the greats — or begin in a different decade and watch them emerge as young prospects turning professional.

Your Journey to the Top Starts Here

Start as an unknown amateur and fight your way through a living, breathing heavyweight division of 500 unique boxers at any one time. Every fighter has their own record, style, strengths, weaknesses, and personality. Choose your fighting style, pick your stance, and begin the long climb from unranked nobody to undisputed world champion.

Live Round-by-Round Fight Commentary

Every fight unfolds in real time with rich, detailed commentary that makes you feel ringside. Choose your strategy before each round — box from range, apply pressure, fight on the inside, or go for the knockout. Watch stamina drain, cuts open, swelling develop, and momentum swing round by round. Judges score independently with realistic split decisions, majority decisions, and controversial verdicts. No two fights ever play out the same way.

A Title for Every Era

In the early eras, there's one heavyweight champion of the world — winning that single belt makes you the champion, undisputed by definition. From 1963 onwards, sanctioning bodies fragment the picture: the WBC arrives, then the IBF in 1983, then the WBO in 1988. By the modern era, four world titles sit at the top of the mountain.

Regional titles emerge in their own historical order as stepping stones for rising contenders. The British title (1891) is the oldest, followed by the European (1946), Oriental and Pacific (1952), Commonwealth (1954), North American (1969), African (1973), and Pan Asian (1995). Hold all four world belts simultaneously and become the undisputed heavyweight champion of the world.

A Living, Breathing Division

This is not a static roster. The heavyweight division evolves every month. Fighters age, decline, and retire. New prospects turn professional from the amateur ranks. Champions rise and fall. Mandatory challengers are ordered. Title fights are scheduled, cancelled, and rescheduled. Sons of legendary fighters emerge carrying their father's surname and a genetic edge. The division has a life of its own — and you are part of it.

Rivalries That Write Themselves

Rivalries form naturally through close fights, controversial decisions, callouts, and press conference confrontations. Your rivals will call you out in the media, demand rematches, and fuel grudge matches that the whole division watches. Some rivalries last an entire career.

Deep Career Management

Every decision matters. Choose your opponents carefully — fight too far above your level and you risk a devastating loss; stay too safe and you will never climb the rankings. Before every fight, select a training camp — Power, Speed, Defence, Cardio, Technical, or Brawler — each with genuine tradeoffs that shape how your fighter performs on the night. Manage your fighter's age, energy, and physical condition across a career that can span over a decade. Purses grow from thousands to millions as your reputation builds. Watch your social media following explode as you become a household name — or build your fanbase the old-fashioned way in the pre-internet eras.

Annual Awards and Recognition

At the end of every year, the boxing world hands out its awards. Fighter of the Year, Young Fighter of the Year, Fight of the Year, Knockout of the Year, Upset of the Year, and Comeback Fighter of the Year — each with a detailed writeup that captures the story of the season. Win them and cement your legacy. Watch them go to your rivals and fuel your motivation.

Complete Fight Records and Statistics

Every fighter in the division has a full BoxRec-style record with detailed fight history, opponent records, methods of victory, venues, and purses. Active fighters retain their full pro fight history with no cap, so every bout is documented. Your own career page tracks everything from knockouts and win streaks to earnings and title defences. The all-time records page celebrates legends past and present — most career wins, longest title reign, oldest first-time champion, retired with fewest defeats, and many more.

Watch the Division Unfold

You are not the only story. Watch title fights play out with full commentary. Follow the rise of young contenders. Track who holds each belt. Read the boxing news that covers every major result, upset, and title change in the division. The heavyweight landscape is always shifting.

Olympic and World Amateur Championships

The amateur scene runs in parallel with the professional division. Olympic Games every four years and World Amateur Championships every two years produce medal winners who turn professional and enter the rankings. Olympic gold medalists arrive as elite-tier prospects, with appropriate floors for silver and bronze. Some of them may become your greatest rivals.

Hall of Fame and Legacy

When the time comes to hang up the gloves, retire and see how your career measures up. Your record, titles won, title defences, earnings, and achievements are preserved in the Hall of Fame. Then start again — create a new fighter in the same universe and enter an evolved division where the legends you fought alongside are now retired icons.

Built for Replayability

No two careers play out the same way. Eight fighting styles, multiple stances, adjustable difficulty, and a division that generates its own drama ensure that every playthrough tells a different story. Generate up to 1,000+ years of heavyweight history and watch dynasties rise and fall.

Features at a Glance

  • 2,500+ real heavyweight fighters from 1880 to 2026 with authentic ratings and styles

  • Era Authentic mode — title rounds, venues, nationalities, and purses adapt to the year

  • Sanctioning bodies appear in their real historical years — one world title pre-1963, four belts by 1988

  • 500 unique AI heavyweights with distinct styles and records at any given time

  • 4 world titles (WBC, WBA, IBF, WBO) plus Ring Magazine and 7 regional belts

  • Live round-by-round commentary with adjustable speed

  • Round-by-round strategy selection — adapt your gameplan as the fight develops

  • Pre-fight training camps with meaningful stat boosts and tradeoffs

  • Realistic judging with split decisions, majority decisions, and controversial cards

  • Organic rivalry system with callouts, grudge matches, and media drama

  • Son of Legends — children of great champions emerge in the division

  • Annual awards with full editorial writeups

  • Complete BoxRec-style records for every fighter — full fight history retained for active fighters

  • All-time records page with career, era, and milestone leaderboards

  • Olympic Games and World Amateur Championships

  • Boxing news that covers every fight, upset, and title change

  • Hall of Fame for retired legends

  • Continue Universe mode — retire and start again in the same division

  • 8 fighting styles and multiple stances

  • Adjustable commentary speed, font size, and sound settings

  • Career earnings, social media growth, and commercial progression

  • Deep career mode spanning decades of heavyweight boxing

All fighter ratings, records, and statistics are fictional estimates for entertainment purposes. No endorsement or affiliation with any real person or organisation is implied.

4523790.name: HASHIRU
4523790.about_the_game:
SOMEWHERE IN YOUR MIND—

Working hard every single day wears you down. At first, it feels manageable. Then it tightens, dragging behind you, growing heavier with every step.

You’d think dreams would be an escape.

They aren’t.

With insomnia, nothing feels real. You’re never fully asleep, yet never truly awake. Your dreams twist into something too vivid to trust. You can’t tell what’s right or wrong… whether you’re waking up, or falling deeper.

And anxiety is always there.

Watching. Waiting.

ABOUT THE GAME

Play as Alexei, a man who suffers with insomnia. When he finally drifts off, he becomes trapped inside a series of unstable dreams shaped by his own thoughts and fears. Don't get too attached to your dreams. don't enjoy them more than real life. or the consequences will be unforgettable.

This is a first-person psychological puzzle and movement game where you must navigate surreal environments, solve puzzles, and escape before your mind collapses in on itself.

GAMEPLAY FEATURES

  • First-Person Exploration
    Experience the world directly through Alexei’s eyes as reality shifts around you.

  • Mind-Bending Puzzles
    Use logic, observation, and your own perception to solve increasingly complex challenges.

  • Fast-Paced Movement & Agility
    Run, jump, and react quickly to traverse unstable dream environments and avoid falling behind.

  • Dynamic Dream Environments
    Explore distorted locations pulled from memory, including a fractured city that constantly changes.

  • Psychological Horror Elements
    Encounter manifestations of anxiety that follow, pressure, and distort your decisions.

OBJECTIVE

Escape the dream.

Stay focused. Keep moving. Think clearly.

Because if you wake up too soon…

you may never be able to sleep again.

YOU MAKE THE DIFFERENCE.

Your mind is unpredictable. Unforgiving.

That falling feeling. That sudden jolt before waking.

Here… it doesn’t fade.

Insomnia doesn’t stop you from sleeping.

It convinces you that you can’t.

So let go.

Let your thoughts drift.

And hope you find your way out.

Original Soundtrack By Archer Angel

4523810.name: Super Loot Runner
4523810.about_the_game:
As the hero's squire, you have two jobs: keep up with him, and pick up the loot.  Also, change his clothes while he runs and keep feeding him potions or he'll die.  So that's four jobs.

While you're at it, upgrade your bag so you can hold more stuff, and your ability to more creatively stack the small items into the tiny spaces between the big things so you can run longer before needing to go back to town.  That's how life goes!

4523920.name: Armeria In Bloom
4523920.about_the_game:
■Train Your Body and Mind — Defy Your Fate.

A growth-driven action RPG where you overcome brutal battles by strengthening your strength, agility, core, and mental endurance.
Form Shifts transform your combat style, and strategic choices in form selection can determine victory or defeat.

Through repeated training and combat, players confront the threats lurking throughout the world and challenge the fate set before them.

Experience a new kind of action that fuses character growth through training with dynamic mid-battle transformations.

■STORY

Set across the mysterious archipelago known as the ZeNo Islands, a conflict begins against the divine rulers called the Ordivis who govern each land.

Using the sacred domain Kuon Castle as your base, you will travel between islands gripped by growing anomalies, facing relentless battles and rigorous training along the way.

As you continue to resist overwhelming powers, you will gradually draw closer to the hidden truths of this world.

■TRAINING

Growth is driven by training.
By strengthening both body and mind, new abilities are unlocked, fundamentally changing how you fight.

■FORM SHIFT

Each form alters equipment, skills, and traits.
Choosing the right form for the situation deepens the strategic layer of combat.

■COMBAT

Fast-paced action and a wide variety of formidable enemies.
Your growth and decision-making will determine the outcome of battle.

4523960.name: Epicurean
4523960.about_the_game:

Defeat the enemy three days in a row to find out why you're so desperate in your mission. You arrived on a secluded beach on an island and find a lonely beach shop attended by a dog, a voice from the intercom calls to you, are you ready to play life-and-death game with a group of mafioso slash occultist in order to fulfill your goal?

4524030.name: Bulletball
4524030.about_the_game:
BulletBall is a fast-paced arcade style lightgun game where you shoot, deflect, and blast the ball to score against your opponent. Inspired by classic light-gun and arcade games, it blends reflex-based shooting with sports-style gameplay for intense competitive matches.

MAD LEVELS

Shoot it out in 9 unique arenas. An Arcade, Carwash and Pinball machine are just some of the places the action goes down. So whether you are fighting zero gravity on a space station, or kicking cans on Trash Boat Tours, We have an environment to test the mettle of any experienced gun slinger.

BALLS GALORE

18 awesome ball designs and 18 super cool reticles ensure that you'll never have a dull shootout. Round Tv's, Killer Tomatoes and Brent in his fishbowl are screaming towards your goal as we speak. Make sure to clap back with sweet reticles like sprinkled donuts, bear traps and razor sharp circular blades!

ALL HARDWARE
