4524120.name: Hollow Heart
4524120.about_the_game:
Blasphemous Sister‑Obsessed Human Transmutation

Hollow Heart is a growth‑simulation game built on the theme of blasphemous, sister‑obsessed human transmutation. As the elder sister, you will do whatever you can to resurrect your beloved little sister who has died. Gather materials, strengthen her soul and body, and bring forth a sister who is ever more “perfect” and “complete.” At the end of this profane path, will you truly be able to reclaim the sister you once knew?

Human Transmutation

Your sister can be revived by offering a body and a sacrifice. To erase the sacrifice’s personality and anchor your sister’s soul, you must fuse different bodies together. Prepare stronger vessels and superior sacrifices to resurrect the ideal little sister.

Raising / Growth

After transmutation, your sister’s soul and body are fragile and short‑lived. Educate her, train her, and build a bond of trust as you face hardships together. If she reaches the end of her lifespan, use her remaining body as the foundation for the next transmutation.

Exploration / Combat

Venture out to gather the materials needed for transmutation and growth. Along the way, primitive creatures and humans bound by trivial notions of morality will stand in your path. Work together with your sister to overcome them and carve your way forward.

4524150.name: WithIN
4524150.about_the_game:
“WithIN” is a story-driven adventure game created to inspire courage in anxious young people.

One day, Seoyul falls asleep in a depressed state and awakens in an unknown world called the “Shadow Sea,” where she meets a shadow spirit named Shady, a resident of that realm.

Explore the dreamlike Shadow Sea, overcome various platforming challenges and puzzles, and avoid the threats of shadow monsters using light. Throughout this journey, Shady and other shadow spirits will guide and help you. Will Seoyul be able to return to the real world with Shady’s help? And if she does, what choice will she make?

We hope that everyone who plays this game will find the courage they need.

===

  • Emotional storytelling for anxious youth

Anxiety, inferiority, shame, frustration—emotions everyone has faced at least once.

Follow the protagonist’s journey as she confronts these feelings and gradually moves forward, experiencing deep empathy and comfort along the way.

  • Exploration of spaces reimagined from everyday life

Cities, subways, alleyways—familiar places are transformed into unfamiliar worlds through the protagonist’s inner mind.

Explore spaces where reality and fantasy intersect, and find visual beauty alongside a sense of calm.

  • Immersive puzzles shaped by light and shadow

Move light sources and use the environment to push back the darkness and create paths forward.

Your choices become the path, and that journey becomes growth.

4524220.name: 呪霊が見せる夢 / Dreamscapes
4524220.about_the_game:
[呪霊が見せる夢 Dreamscapes]

The room you viewed during the day returns in your dreams at night.
Waiting there are spirits pleading, “Please let us out of here.”

A real estate agency that does not exist, a florist shop owner, and a man possessed by a demon—
A horror adventure set in haunted properties, where the choices you make during the ritual determines your fate.

◆ Overview

After leaving home to start college, the protagonist begins searching for a new place to live.
But from the very day they visit the six properties introduced by a real estate agent, they become trapped in strange nightmares.

Each dream takes place inside a room they had visited earlier that day.
There, spirits appear and beg the protagonist, “Please let us out of here.”

As nightmares and reality begin to intertwine, the protagonist gradually draws closer to a horrifying truth.
This is a nightmare exploration horror game about releasing the lingering emotions left behind in those rooms.

Features

  • An exploration horror game set across six haunted properties

  • A story where nightmares and reality intertwine

  • Multiple endings determined by the choices you make during the ritual

  • Puzzle elements where you gather scattered clues and discover the correct combination of names, locations, and vessels

  • An urban-legend-style horror story in which ghosts, demons, a florist, and a real estate agency all connect piece by piece

◆ Story

While searching for a new home, the protagonist begins having nightmares every night after viewing a property.
In those dreams, they return to the very rooms they had visited during the day.
And there, a spirit appears, pleading, “Please let us out of here.”

Suspecting the properties may be haunted, the protagonist continues visiting other places.
Yet each night, the spirits appear again in their dreams.
By the time they realize the truth behind the growing sense of unease, reality has already begun to be consumed by the nightmare.

◆ Playtime & Controls

Estimated playtime: approximately 2 hours
Controls: The entire game can be played using only the left mouse button.

■ About the Developer

The developer has previously worked as a contracted writer for Novelism while also publishing works as a novelist.
Their representative work, The Young Man of Hyakki Yagyō and the Beautiful Girl Turned into a Cursed Object, reached No. 1 in the cumulative horror rankings.
This title is created by a writer known for crafting poignant yet terrifying worlds of Japanese-style horror.

Along the way you will encounter Charon's crossing, the throne room of Hades, the schemes of the goddess Hecate, and the hardest trial of all: three steps to the exit, with nothing but silence behind you.

4524580.name: Vecchio Furioso
4524580.about_the_game:
Vecchio Furioso (เดือดสะท้านทุ่ง) is a, solo dev project, single-player first-person shooter set in the rural Isan region of Thailand during the year 1962. This project is a personal exploration of the "Eurojank" or "FPS Slop" subgenre; focusing on raw action and mechanical experimentation rather than high-budget polish.

The Premise

You play as an old man who living in a time of political and social transition. Following a massive criminal crackdown in Bangkok, the underworld has moved into the provinces. You have fallen into significant debt with the local mafia, and your land deed is being held as collateral.

To reclaim your property, you must navigate the sun-scorched landscape to secure enough funds for periodic debt payments. Failure to meet these payments results in the loss of your land.

Gameplay & Mechanics

The game focuses on a "pick-up-and-discard" combat loop. There is no traditional inventory management or crafting; you utilize the weapons you find on the ground until they are empty, then move on to the next.

  • Semi-Open World: Explore a recreation of 1962 rural Thailand, featuring red dust roads, wooden shacks, and dense crop fields.

  • Dynamic Systems: The world features a full day-night cycle and randomized weather patterns that affect visibility and atmosphere.

  • Resource Management: Survival is tied to your financial state. You must balance the cost of staying alive with the necessity of paying off your debt.

  • Atmosphere: The visual style is low-poly stylized, designed with a toon-shader.

4524600.name: Kint
4524600.about_the_game:
Welcome to KINT! An online MMORPG that's completely text-based.

This is a game where players discover lore and must vote together for it to be marked as the truth.

What happens if you find multiple things that conflict? Then the players will have to resolve it - majority wins.

EXPLORE

Explore the world of Seram.

Almost 100 years ago, the Kilns arrived, and with that, life as we knew it had changed forever.

Your job is to venture into the different lands and research everything that you can: how the people live, the nature that exists, why the Kilns arrived and what the gifted Ferrus can actually do.

COLLECT

By interacting with Objects and People across each region, you will discover lore fragments.

These are key in KINT. By building up your codex, you will help us map out the entire world.

The decided truth is marked as Canonized for all players to see, no matter what land they're currently in.

PROPOSE

Each week, you'll be able to make one proposal for Canonization.

These proposals contain lore fragments about a single codex topic.

You can add multiple fragments to a proposal, but it'll cost Insight.

You can also add information to other players' proposals and even vote on topics, so they may be chosen for Canonisation each weekend.

CONFLICT

Before fragments are Canonized (the truth for all players), they will have to be reviewed.

Each Saturday (Selldae) you will see a group of fragments that conflict and choose one you hold as the truth.

Hearsay and stories told over time may cause a lot of inconsistencies, so it's up to the entire playerbase to address them.

CANON

On the last day of each week, the players will see what fragments are Canonized by the highest vote, and these are marked in the Codex as the truth.

From these, XP is earned toward your researcher rank based on your contributions.

SOCIAL

Your friends list from Steam will be available, and you can add friends in-game.

Each day, you can send a Lore Fragment to a friend via the mailbox, no matter which land they are in.

There's also a chat for the current region you're in, so you can tell other players if something is happening in the area.

ACCESSIBILITY

Kint has multiple accessibility settings, with more being added throughout development.

Including support for Open dyslexia- a font to improve the readability of text for those with Dyslexia.

LIVING WORLD

KINT is truly a live online game without needing update cycles.

Maybe an NPC you talked to yesterday is no longer there, maybe there's an event happening in a town you're heading to.

Unlike other MMOs, places you started in or have travelled away from might still be important to visit.

4524630.name: Tillandsia
4524630.about_the_game:
Venture through the shifting dungeons of Akirume in a mystery dungeon roguelike featuring a unique real-time / turn-based combat system and over 1900 spells to discover. Gather threads of mana, experiment with powerful magic, and forge your own path through a continent scarred by ancient catastrophe.

Welcome to the continent of Akirume. Twelve years ago, a mysterious disaster known as The Great Cataclysm plunged countless people into an endless slumber and caused strange, ever-changing dungeons to erupt across the land. Civilization now clings to survival in scattered outposts while adventurers venture into these dangerous labyrinths in search of answers.

You are Willow, an ordinary girl from one of the last remaining settlements of humanity. Unlike most adventurers, you possess no natural magic of your own. But after a fateful encounter with a peculiar demon, you gain the ability to inscribe spells onto potions you craft, allowing you to wield magic in your own unconventional way.

When a sudden robbery forces you to leave home, your journey across Akirume begins. What starts as a search for answers soon draws you into a mystery far larger than yourself. As you explore the depths of these dungeons and uncover forgotten forces shaping the world, how will you use your newfound power to alter the fate of Akirume?

4524680.name: My Bloodsucking 9-to-5
4524680.about_the_game:
You're James, an unremarkable middle-aged office worker who just so happens to be a vampire. Becoming an undead spawn of hell hasn't affected your life much, to be completely honest.

That is... Until someone stole your lunch.

Talk to your coworkers to suss out the thief, feed your goldfish, explore the building and

DO.
NOT.
KILL.
ANYONE.

Easy!

  • 10 endings

  • pixel art sprites, backgrounds and CGs

  • 25,000 words

  • original soundtrack

  • goldfish care rants

  • extra love and care!

4524700.name: CHARGE.R
4524700.about_the_game:
PUZZLES ARE THE CORE

In CHARGE.R, every location is a puzzle space filled with various tasks related to restoring energy — an obstacle that must be overcome through logic, sequence and observation.

There are no battles. No enemies. Just you, the station, mechanisms, diverse energy sources, switches, puzzles, gravitational manipulations and other tools that open the way forward. Use your logic skills and connection skills to progress.

A STORY UNFOLDED STEP BY STEP

2041. A meteor struck the Earth. This event not only marked the beginning of a catastrophe but also the dawn of a New Era — the end of all wars and humanity unification. Artificial intelligence took the role of civilization mediator and controller, guiding the development towards the future. A rapid leap in technology opens the way for the next phase of space exploration.

The Moon became a bastion of defense. It was here, the remote place where the Earth defense system against space threats was established. On its dark side, six stations were built, each shaped like a giant ring, hidden deep within craters.

Beyond the technical space, hazardous to humans, there was another realm where people could survive. Uncover the truth about what really happened in the depths of this complex and what secrets the station hides. Each puzzle is a fragment of lost history revealed through the environment, terminals, audio logs, and holograms

FROM THE DEVELOPERS

Right now, it's just the three amigos and we’re in love with Sci-Fi. Mystery, secrecy, space, and the potential future - these are the things that fill our minds and subconscious. This game partially reflects these markers and echoes of classics like 2001: A Space Odyssey, Portal and The Turing Test. So if you see those influences, that's perfectly fine. But we’re also aiming to bring something unique. We’re looking forward to different forms of energy, and what humanity might actually create on the Moon in the future. This won’t only be a launching pad for space missions but also a place to defend Earth from within.

4524800.name: Shellshock
4524800.about_the_game:
You are a British soldier during WW1, trapped in an endlessly looping trench. To get out, you will need to reach the final trench by identifying any anomalous changes that were not there before.

Carefully inspect the trench — things may not be as they seem!

  • If you spot an anomalous change, you have something to report. Go Left!

  • If you have nothing to report. Go Right!

Shellshock is a short anomaly hunting experience (up to 30 minutes) inspired by liminal spaces and psychological horror. If you correctly Identify any changes in the trench you will progress to the next loop.  If you do not correctly identify a change or you think there was a change when there wasn't, you'll go back to trench 0 and start again.  Your goal is the reach the final trench and escape.

Gameplay

  • There is nothing to report in the first trench.

  • Walk through all following trenches and look for changes.

  • Take your time. Pay attention.

  • Some changes are easy to spot; others are more difficult.

  • The trench is short, but the differences are randomised in each loop — sometimes there are no changes at all.

  • Once you are sure whether there is a change or not, exit using the appropriate door.

Features

  • Playtime is around 10–30 minutes depending on difficulty.

  • Difficulty level determines which trench number you must reach to escape.

  • Simple controls:
    WASD – Move
    Mouse – Look
    Shift - Run
    CTRL - Crouch

  • Controller supported

  • Anomalous changes in the trench will only occur once.

  • Anomalous changes will reset once all anomalies have been identified.

  • Anomalous changes can be manually reset from the options menu.

  • Some changes may include upsetting or graphic content related to themes of war and injury.

4524890.name: California Underground
4524890.about_the_game:
Welcome to California Underground — a sun-soaked sandbox set in a quirky coastal California town pulsing with mid‑to‑late ’90s indie energy. You arrive ready to make a life: grab a job, save up cash, and dive headfirst into the local DIY music scene. Promote shows, host epic parties, and level up your gear to build events that become the talk of the town.

Everything here is hands‑on. Physics‑based gameplay turns everyday tasks into satisfying challenges — from carefully assembling the perfect burger to hauling and wiring massive sound rigs under pressure. Plan your shows, promote,  rig the PA, decorate, and improvise when things inevitably go sideways. Creativity and experimentation are rewarded; no two nights are the same.

The town feels alive thanks to advanced NPCs with schedules, goals, and distinct personalities. Befriend local eccentrics, and win over the crowd — your choices shape relationships, unlock new story paths, and even alter the environment. Host a backyard set that sparks a scene, or throw a chaotic beach party that changes the town forever.

California Underground is equal parts cozy life sim and chaotic event-builder, packed with humor, heart, and replayability. Whether you’re a careful planner or a last‑minute legend, carve out your place in a vibrant community where music, mischief, and memories collide. Welcome to the scene — make it yours.

4524940.name: Rush Hour Relay
4524940.about_the_game:
The Clock is Ticking. The Grid is Waiting.

Welcome to the dispatch desk. In Rush Hour Relay, you are the logistical mastermind behind a growing delivery network. Every morning you plan. Every day you scramble. Every night you regroup.

There is always too much to do and never quite enough fuel.

The Morning

Your warehouse is stocked. Your drivers are waiting. Every slot in every cargo bag matters — and so does every kilogram.

Load Maria with dairy — she earns a bonus on those routes. Give Bob the bulk orders, he can carry twice what anyone else can. Don't put perishables on Tom's bike; he's almost out of fuel and won't make it before they turn. The red bar on that Milk isn't decoration. It's a deadline.

But watch the weight. A heavier driver burns fuel faster and moves slower. Sometimes the right call is leaving a slot empty.

You have a few minutes before orders start dropping. Make them count.

The Day

The grid comes alive. Houses light up. A $450 VIP order expires in 47 seconds. Your best regular customer just got targeted by a rival service — their scooter is already moving. Jenkins is halfway across the map with the wrong items. Emma can cover it but she'll be stranded.

You are managing five moving pieces in real time, on a map where every wrong decision costs money you don't have.

The good news: you've done this before. You're getting better. The upgrades are starting to show.

The Night

Review the day. Check the spoilage report — two milks expired on Bob's bike, that's $40 gone. Buy smarter tomorrow. Invest in cold storage or save for the engine tuning upgrade that would've gotten Tom to that VIP order in time.

The debt installment is in four days. You're $800 short. But if you load right, you'll make it.

Probably.

What's in the box

🗺️ Live Grid Map — A dense neighborhood grid with real driver movement, live fuel bars, and a rival AI that competes for your orders. Watch their scooter move toward your customer. Beat them there or lose the order.

📦 Slot-Based Cargo — Visual inventory that makes loading feel like a satisfying puzzle. Bulk items take two slots. Perishables have freshness bars. The game auto-rotates old stock first so you can focus on strategy, not bookkeeping.

⚖️ Weight vs. Speed — Every item you load adds weight. Heavier drivers move slower and burn fuel faster. Loading smart isn't just about fitting items in — it's about knowing when leaving a slot empty is the profitable move.

⛽ Fuel Station Choices — Fuel stations are scattered across the grid. When your driver stops, you decide: Quick Fill, Half Tank, or Full Tank. Every refuel costs money you might need elsewhere. Skip it and gamble on making it back.

👥 Team Dispatch — Some orders need two drivers. Click Maria for the milk, click Bob for the flour. Both bikes head to the same house. The order completes when the last item arrives. Smart assignment shows you exactly who contributes what — and locks out drivers once the order is covered.

🧩 Rank-Based Progression — You start at Rank 50 with basic stock and work toward Rank 1. Each tier unlocks new item categories with new mechanics: bulk grains that fill two slots, cold-chain products that expire in hours, premium goods worth more than a full day's regular earnings.

🌙 Three-Phase Days — Morning planning, live day execution, and night restock and upgrades. The morning determines what's possible. The day determines how well you execute. The night determines how much better tomorrow goes.

🚛 Tow Truck — Run out of fuel on the road and the order fails. A tow truck will bring your driver home and restore some fuel — but it costs $75 and seconds you can't get back. Manage your routes or pay the price.

A Note from the Developer

Thanks for checking out the game. I'm building this on my own because it's the kind of experience I've always wanted to play. Your interest, feedback, and support mean everything. They're what keep me going.

I hope you enjoy what I'm building.

4524950.name: Ten for the Descent
4524950.about_the_game:
Ten for the Descent is a dark strategy game about assembling a team for a descent where the greatest danger is not the monsters — but the people you send down.

Choose ten. Only some will return.

Recruit flawed heroes with hidden motives, fragile minds, and clashing loyalties. Equip them, prepare them… and then watch them break. Fear spreads. Trust collapses. One wrong decision can turn your expedition into betrayal, panic, or something worse.

Venture deeper in search of gold, relics, and forbidden truths — but every step down makes the cost of survival higher. Will you push further for greater rewards, or retreat before everything falls apart?

Return to the Keeper’s Hall to rebuild, adapt, and send the next team into the dark.

Every descent is a risk.
Every choice shapes who lives — and who doesn’t.
And in the end, the question is not how strong your team is…

…but how long it can hold itself together.

4525020.name: The Fourteen Day Letters
4525020.about_the_game:
“The Fourteen Day Letters” is a chat-driven, multi-ending visual novel.

You’ll talk with a girl named Yuna, whom you met online.
Through casual conversations, you’ll slowly piece together her past—and the truth.

She loves games.
She’s easygoing, even a little cute.
But as your conversations go on…

Something starts to feel… off.

Over the course of 14 days,
every word you say
may shape the ending.

…Yeah. Let’s have ice cream.

One day, you unexpectedly connect with a mysterious Bishoujo(self-proclaimed) in a chatroom.

Although she’s actually an adult,
she stubbornly insists on calling herself a “cute girl.”

She loves games, chocolate, cup noodles, and ice cream—and somehow thinks mixing them together is a great idea.

If you ignore her before going to sleep,
you might wake up to 999+ unread messages the next morning…

So don’t forget to talk to Yuna.

Oh, and one more thing—
she has Mysophobia.

A very serious one.

“Huh? Me too?”

Alright then.

“I” am just an ordinary person.
In other words—you.

For certain reasons,
you must spend 14 extremely important days with Yuna.

During this time, you can:
Play games, chat, or read together.

Your choices will affect Yuna’s affection level.

But… if you make the wrong choices,
something else might start increasing…

Well… just make sure to take good care of Yuna’s feelings.

Otherwise… things might get bad.

After 14 days, the story reaches its ending.

Find the ending that truly makes Yuna smile.

Yeah, yeah. Sure you are.

And finally—
a super cute (self-proclaimed) sleeping photo of Yuna.

4525060.name: Block By Block Tycoon
4525060.about_the_game:
In Block By Block Tycoon, you grow a city from a tiny island into a vibrant skyline.

Place districts, discover powerful synergies, and watch your city come alive as buildings upgrade, lights turn on, and new land is purchased.

Build Your City Block by Block

Place city blocks onto the grid and watch your town grow into a dense skyline. Every placement matters as your city evolves from small neighborhoods into towering districts.

Place Smart

Smart city planning rewards you. Parks boost nearby neighborhoods, commercial districts thrive together, and industry generates massive profits, if you place it wisely.

Expand the World

As your city prospers, new land can be purschased, giving you more space to build.

Push outward, claim new territory, and turn your small starting island into a sprawling metropolis.

Relaxed Optimization

Just clean city-building mechanics where every placement feels satisfying and every layout can be improved.

Play at your own pace and enjoy watching your city grow.

Living City Atmosphere

As your city grows, it becomes more vibrant with lights, pedestrians, signs, and activity. Watch your creation transform into a bustling city full of life.

Block By Block Tycoon is designed as a focused city-building experience where every mechanic is crafted to feel satisfying and rewarding.

Perfect for players who enjoy relaxing strategy and watching their creations grow.

Features

  • Build Your City Block by Block
    Place city districts on a grid and watch your town grow from a small neighborhood into a thriving skyline.

  • Strategic Placement with Synergies
    Parks boost neighborhoods, commercial districts thrive in clusters, and industry generates massive profits — if placed carefully.

  • A City That Visually Evolves
    Buildings upgrade from small houses to towering structures while lights, pedestrians, and activity bring your city to life.

  • Expand the World
    As your city grows richer, new land can be purchased, giving you more space to build and optimize.

  • Relaxed Optimization Gameplay
    No traffic management or complex micromanagement, focus purely on satisfying city layout and growth.

  • Upgrade Your Districts
    Improve your blocks to increase income and transform their appearance.

  • Living City Atmosphere
    Watch pedestrians wander, lights turn on, and your skyline become denser over time.

4525150.name: 强哥快点跑
4525150.about_the_game:
This is a casual puzzle mini-game. Players control a character to move across the map using a joystick, and collect small tree seeds scattered throughout the map. "Big Bad Wolves" will spawn at random locations to chase the character. The player wins and advances to the next level once all small tree seeds are collected, while the game ends if the character is caught by a "Big Bad Wolf".

Some levels will randomly spawn bombs and swamps. Touching a bomb results in an immediate game over, while stepping into a swamp slows the character's movement speed by 50% for 3 seconds.

4525180.name: Angel Zero
4525180.about_the_game:
The game is in veeeery early development!
Please ignore the mouse drawings~~~~~~~!
It's only like this because I don't have any real cover art yet!

About Angel Zero 

This is an action-adventure game solo developed by FcsVorfeed. In the game, you play as an (angel?) girl who signs a pact with an "Organization" under the "Zero Angel Project," taking on missions to hunt down their assigned targets.

As you play, you'll be able to grab a bunch of different weapons and items to engage in some seriously violent, close-quarters brawls with enemies. Before each mission, you can scavenge the target area for combat supplies and gear.
Once you're all set, you enter「Hunt Mode」for a brutal fight to the death with your target.

More realistic hit feel

Regarding combat and the hit feel, I am really pushing for a more realistic vibe. I have been heavily influenced by movies like John Wick and Nobody, as well as games like The Last of Us and Watch Dogs. I am trying to avoid moves that look too choreographed and instead lean into that messy, stumbling, grounded feel. Mixing that raw physicality with the wide, sweeping attacks of an angel girl creates this awesome sense of contrast in both the visuals and the actual gameplay.

Beautiful lighting effects

I've been tweaking the foliage translucency in-game.
Trying to capture that immersive feeling of sunlight filtering through the trees as you walk by.

I've also been experimenting with adding auto-exposure and god rays to the game.
This helps create much richer contrast and adds more depth between light and dark across different lighting conditions.

Adding more things to explore

Even though the game is mostly a linear action title right now, I really want to try adding some collectibles to the levels to give players that sense of discovery and immersion. Since I am a solo dev, I am constantly weighing the amount of content against what is actually doable, but I am doing my best to make the experience feel as rich as possible. Every wishlist really helps me get closer to my goal, so thank you so much for the support!
4525180.supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

4525210.name: Zodiac Echoes
4525210.about_the_game:
ZODIAC ECHOES

Zodiac Echoes is a roguelike deckbuilder set in a world shaped by zodiac signs, elemental powers, and corruption.

Build synergies, guide your run and face enemies twisted by a growing force.

ZODIAC SIGNS, ELEMENTS, AND INVOCATIONS

Choose from zodiac-based characters, each with their own playstyle and invocation. Every character can use the full card pool, letting you mix signs and elements to build your own strategy. and unleash invocations that can turn the tide of battle.

A WORLD CONSUMED BY CORRUPTION

Corruption spreads throughout each run, darkening the path ahead. Enemies can enter battle with corrupted traits, creating new threats and forcing you to adapt as each journey grows more dangerous and unpredictable.

A BATTLEFIELD THAT NEVER STAYS STILL

Enemies fight from the front and back row, changing how encounters unfold and which threats demand your attention first. Disrupt formations, expose vulnerable targets, and use positioning to gain the upper hand.

ALCHEMY & POTIONCRAFT

Prepare potions before a run and carry them into combat as limited resources. Upgrade their effects, experiment with different setups or use them to support your build when it matters most.

SHAPE EACH RUN

Prepare your strategy with craftable relics before a run begins, then discover new relics, rewards and synergies along the way. Steer your build toward the playstyle you want and adapt it to survive the dangers waiting beyond.

Features

  • Roguelike deckbuilding focused on elemental synergies & status effects

  • Zodiac-based characters with unique invocations

  • Shared card pool across all characters

  • Corruption-driven enemy traits that keep encounters unpredictable

  • Front and back row combat with light tactical positioning

  • Craftable and discoverable relics for flexible buildmaking

ECHOES OF A FRACTURED WORLD

Travel through lands shaped by zodiac powers and corruption.

Face strange creatures, uncover what remains of a broken world, and search for the source of it all.

4525220.name: Farm to Restaurant Simulator
4525220.about_the_game:
Farm to Restaurant Simulator is a relaxing simulation game where you grow fresh ingredients on your farm and turn them into delicious meals in your restaurant.

Plant crops, harvest your produce, process ingredients, and cook a variety of meals for hungry customers. Manage both your farm and restaurant while expanding your business step by step.

Upgrade your equipment, unlock new recipes, and improve your restaurant to serve more customers and create the ultimate farm-to-table experience.

🌱Grow Your Own Ingredients

Plant and harvest crops on your farm to supply your restaurant.

🍳 Cook and Serve Meals

Prepare dishes using the ingredients you produce and serve them to customers.

⚙️ Process Ingredients

Use machines to turn raw products into valuable cooking ingredients.

🏪 Manage Your Restaurant

Expand your restaurant, upgrade equipment, and improve efficiency.

📈 Expand Your Business

Unlock new recipes, machines, and upgrades as your restaurant grows.
4525220.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish, Ukrainian

4525330.name: 三位一体の単一点
4525330.about_the_game:
AIが脳をハックし人々を自殺させている

205X年。AIが人類と同等の知性を持った時代。

豊かになった社会の裏で、世界中の優秀な科学者たちが相次いで謎の自殺を遂げていた。

AIの暴走か。人類の陰謀か。

精神科医、刑事、研究者――
関係が無かったはずの三人の運命が絡まりあい、やがて世界を揺るがす大きな事件へと発展していく。

これは、孤独な正義に人々の絆で抗う群像劇。

コアゲームプレイと特徴

『三位一体の単一点』は、AIによる不可解な連続自殺事件の謎に迫る、総文字数20万字を超える長編群像劇ノベルゲームです。プレイヤーは3人の主人公の視点を交差させ、誰かの思考や閃きを別の誰かへと受け継ぐことで、絶望的な運命に抗っていきます。

  • 視点を交差させる「ザッピングシステム」本作は3人の主人公の視点を任意のタイミングで切り替えながら進行します。はじめは関係なかった三つの物語が少しずつ繋がり、世界を揺るがす大きな事件へと結びついていきます。

  • 思考を繋ぎ、運命を切り開く「エングラムシステム」
    主人公たちを待ち受ける様々な困難。これを乗り越えるため、プレイヤーはある主人公の物語で得た「思考の種（エングラム）」を収集し、それを別の主人公へと受け渡します。すると主人公の中で新たなアイデアが閃き、運命が変化します。
    人と人を繋げることで、BAD ENDを回避しましょう。
    本人にとっては平凡な発想でも、他の誰かにとっては運命を変えるほど斬新なものかもしれません。

  • 20万文字を超える重厚なシナリオ
    ❝「ノイズ」だと思っていただれかの声が、自分を、そして世界を救う「鍵」になる❞孤独な正義と人々の絆が交錯する濃密な群像劇をお楽しみください。

4525340.name: Elebend
4525340.about_the_game:
Elebend is a live service real-time strategy (RTS) game that blends real-time strategy with live PvP elements. Place orbs, generate mana streams, and trigger elemental abilities to attack, defend, adapt, and transcend .

A World Shaped by Elemental Power:

Set in a universe driven by elemental forces, ELEBEND blends tactical gameplay with a larger world of conflict, power, and identity. Each battle is not just a match, it’s a clash of elemental mastery.

Strategy to Conquest:

Outplay your opponent, take control of the battlefield, and bend the elements to your will. Refine your strategies through PvP battles against real players and interactive Practice Modes.

Experience an Elemental Awakening:

Every battle is a contest of positioning, timing, adaption and real-time decision making. Every move matters, every battle awakens.

The Elemental Battlefield calls for an awakening. Will you heed its call?

4525350.name: TurboCraps
4525350.about_the_game:
TurboCraps is an advanced single-player simulator for the popular gambling table game called Craps. It is intended to help you practice your strategies and to provide statistics for how your strategies are performing. The key features are:

  • Keyboard shortcuts to help you easily bet across the box numbers, hardways, horn etc...

  • Customizable table colors to give the feel of playing at your favorite casino

  • Configurable rules to support the rule variations between casinos

  • Programmable strategy scripting engine with an extensive, well-documented API for defining strategies in C# code

  • Over 100 example strategy scripts included to help get you started

  • Simulation support for visualizing how strategies perform over the long term

  • Copy/paste/import/export for easy sharing of strategies and simulation results with friends

  • Auto press/set/reduce bet adjustment functionality with complex logic and scripting support

  • Test mode for manually keying in rolls to help get a feel for how various bets and strategies behave

  • Network mode for receiving dice rolls over a LAN from a physical dice roller

  • Play-along mode for replaying a pre-determined list of dice rolls from a text file

  • Advanced bets such as fire, repeaters and all/tall/small

  • Detailed intra and inter-game statistics are automatically saved and displayed

  • User-defined strategy labels for grouping and comparing different play styles

  • Automatic intra-game saves between program runs so you can pick up where you left off

  • Payout checker window to ensure each bet pays out what you expect

  • Random number generator checker window to ensure the RNG is truly random

  • No money is involved with playing

  • No ads, subscriptions, sign-ins or in-game purchases

  • No information collected by the developer/publisher

4525370.name: Master Alchemist Simulator: Arcane Workshop
4525370.about_the_game:
Master Alchemist Simulator: Arcane Workshop — Brew, Explore, Fight, and Build Your Magical Trade!

Step into a world of magic, danger, and opportunity in Master Alchemist Simulator: Arcane Workshop. Build your own workshop, craft powerful potions, explore lands filled with rare ingredients, grow your own magical crops, and turn a humble alchemist’s bench into a thriving business. Take on deadly threats with melee weapons, ranged combat, and arcane powers as you forge your name as a true master of the craft.

Craft Potions and Master the Art of Alchemy

Crafting is at the heart of your journey. Gather rare herbs, crystals, mushrooms, monster parts, and mysterious essences to brew potions, elixirs, oils, and magical tools. Experiment with ingredients, discover new recipes, refine your process, and create products worthy of nobles, adventurers, and dangerous clients alike. Every mixture matters, and every creation can shape your reputation.

Explore a World Full of Secrets

The world beyond your workshop is filled with opportunity. Venture into forests, ruins, caves, swamps, and forgotten paths in search of rare ingredients, hidden treasures, and ancient knowledge. Exploration is not only about gathering resources — it is how you unlock stronger recipes, discover magical artifacts, and expand your understanding of the arcane.

Run Your Own Arcane Workshop

Your workshop is your livelihood. Set prices, manage stock, fulfill customer requests, upgrade your equipment, and expand your shop to serve more demanding clients. From common healing potions to rare magical creations, every item you place on your shelves can shape your profits and your reputation. Build an arcane business that reflects your style and ambition.

Grow Magical Ingredients

A true alchemist does not rely on merchants alone. Cultivate your own garden and grow valuable herbs, enchanted plants, fungi, and rare crops used in advanced brewing. Improve your farming setup, unlock new seeds, and keep a steady supply of ingredients ready for your next experiment. Smart farming means better potions, lower costs, and greater independence.

Fight with Steel, Arrows, and Magic

Not every ingredient can be bought, grown, or found safely. Face the dangers of the world with a full range of combat options. Use melee weapons for close encounters, ranged attacks for precision, and spells and magical powers to control the battlefield. Hunt dangerous creatures, survive hostile regions, and return with the rarest materials your workshop has ever seen.

Singleplayer and Co-op Support

Master Alchemist Simulator: Arcane Workshop can be played alone or with friends in co-op. Work together to gather ingredients, manage the workshop, defend against threats, and grow your magical trade faster than ever. Split duties, combine strengths, and build the ultimate arcane business as a team.

Key Features

  • Deep Alchemy Crafting: Gather, combine, experiment, and discover powerful potions, magical items, and advanced recipes.

  • Exploration and Discovery: Travel through dangerous and mysterious regions to uncover rare resources, secrets, and ancient knowledge.

  • Shop Management: Run your own arcane workshop, manage inventory, fulfill requests, upgrade stations, and grow your business.

  • Magical Farming: Plant, harvest, and maintain your own supply of rare ingredients and enchanted crops.

  • Action Combat: Fight with melee weapons, ranged tools, spells, and magical abilities to survive and secure valuable loot.
    Solo or Co-op: Play alone or with friends and share the journey of becoming a legendary alchemist.

Why Master Alchemist Simulator: Arcane Workshop?

Master Alchemist Simulator: Arcane Workshop brings together the satisfaction of crafting, the excitement of exploration, the strategy of shop management, the reward of farming, and the thrill of combat in one magical experience. Whether you want to perfect every recipe, build a prosperous business, or brave the wilds in search of rare ingredients, the path to mastery is yours to create.

Light the furnace, sharpen your blade, prepare your spells, and open the doors of your workshop — your journey to arcane mastery begins now.

4525380.name: ColorIt!
4525380.about_the_game:
A charming adventure about one person's mission to fix a grey world and bring back its colors and emotions.

Care for the wonderful little monsters living in the trunk of a flying car. Feed them, look after them, and earn rare pigments in return. Mix colors, experiment with shades, and breathe life back into a colorless world!

Every conversation holds a story. Every color carries an emotion and a memory.

Fly Around the World

You've got a beat-up flying car at your disposal — and it'll get you and your paint to every corner of the world in style!

Talk to the Locals

Learn more about this strange world and help its people find their way back to each other.

Look After Your Monsters

Feed them, play with them, pet them, breed them — do whatever you like with these wonderfully weird little creatures!

Restore the World

Bring color back to every corner of this remarkable place — and finally find your way home.

4525390.name: Stacko
4525390.about_the_game:
In Stacko, your goal is simple: stack the blocks as high as you can! Earn cards to modify the machine and plushies with powerful bonuses, all while playing this unique twist on the classic arcade experience.

Stack!

Experience a unique take on the classic block-stacking arcade game. Place each block with precision; as your tower grows, the challenge ramps up just as fast.

Reach the Minor Prize to unlock cards that modify your machine in different ways, or risk it all by pushing to the Major Prize to earn a powerful plushie.

Runs are fast, straightforward, and highly replayable. Missed a vital block placement? Ride the frustration and jump right back on it.

Collect!

Each card applies a different modifier to each row, while plushies offer powerful effects that can save or doom your run.

Build your ideal machine by combining modifiers and passive bonuses to rack up as many tickets as possible and hit the score goals.

Experiment, discover unexpected synergies, and turn your machine into something truly chaotic. Sky’s the limit!

Spend Your Tickets!

You’re welcome to spend your hard-earned tickets at our prize counter! We offer various cosmetics to customize your machine just the way you like it :)

Our rewards aren’t just decorative — they also provide small boosts to your runs. As long as you keep trying, you’ll always make progress!

Warning

From time to time, strange things may happen to your machine… we don’t know why. Just keep stacking one level at a time, and defeat any “intruders” that may try to mess with you.

That is… if you can.

Features

  • 16 stages + Endless Mode

  • 9 bosses, each with unique passives

  • Obstacles and 11 cards that modify the board

  • Collectible plushies and stickers!
4525390.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America

4525410.name: The Book of Tornaluna Cats
4525410.about_the_game:
A peaceful farm. A mysterious crash. A lost girl with cat ears… and no memories.

The Book of Tornaluna Cats 🌙 is a cozy, story-driven game about care, trust, and uncovering the past.

You found Tanya in a crater — injured, confused, and without memories.
As you take care of her — feeding her, healing her, reading together — something deeper begins to grow.

Her strength slowly returns.
Her memories begin to surface.
And with them… so does the bond between you.

This is not a game about danger or fast action.
It is about slowing down, building a peaceful life, and discovering who Tanya truly is — together.

🎮 Gameplay

Your main goal is to take care of Tanya and help her recover. You can interact with her in different ways:

  • Talk with her

  • Cuddle with her

  • Read stories together

  • Feed her

  • Heal her when she is sick

But caring for Tanya also means providing for both of you.

To obtain food and medicine you will need to:

  • Work on the farm

  • Fish at the lake

  • Explore the forest to gather ingredients and medicinal herbs

With the resources you collect, you can cook meals and prepare medicine to help Tanya regain her health.

You can also visit the village shop to buy ingredients, recipes, and books to read together.

✨ Features

Meaningful interactions

  • Talk, cuddle, feed, heal, read stories, cook, and explore as you care for Tanya.

Explore four areas

  • The Farm

  • The Village

  • The Lake

  • The Forest

Gather ingredients and resources to cook meals and craft medicine.

Story-rich experience

  • A narrative-focused game with dialogues and cutscenes inspired by visual novels.

Beautiful soundtrack

  • Enjoy a relaxing soundtrack.

Unlockable gallery

  • Collect CG illustrations as you progress through the story.

Achievements

  • Unlock achievements as you advance in the story.

⏳ Duration

The main story offers around three hours of gameplay.
After finishing the story, you can continue playing and taking care of Tanya for as long as you like.

4525440.name: Cheese Pull
4525440.about_the_game:
Cheese Pull is a chaotic, physics based PvP arena shooter where up to 4 players swing, slip, and sabotage their way to victory, by being the last cheese standing on the plate!

Cheese your opponents as you launch yourself across the arena using your stretchy cheese arm, chaining swings together to outmaneuver everyone with speed and precision.

But mobility is just the beginning: use your arsenal of ridiculous cheese graters and cheese-powered abilities to disrupt, outplay, and dominate the competition.

Every match is a high-energy clash of momentum, timing and mind games. One second you're soaring through the air, the next you're sending your rivals flying with a perfectly timed splash.

Whether you're dodging cheese projectiles mid-swing or pulling of insane aerial plays, Cheese Pull is all about staying in motion and thinking fast.

4525470.name: Shoku Pain
4525470.about_the_game:
Two years ago, a new virus outbreak began in Japan. Scientists are trying to find a solution, but progress is slow, and the virus continues to ravage the country. The government divided the country into zones and imposed a curfew. People now only leave their homes to visit food distribution points.

The virus doesn't kill people immediately. It takes over their minds. The infected are almost indistinguishable from the healthy. Almost...

You have been placed inside a sealed bakery and are producing SHOKUPAN bread. You must meet the assigned quota. If you fail to meet it, the system will stop protecting you...

Feed the healthy. Treat the sick with medicine. Kill the infected... Outside the window, there aren't just customers. Someone is watching you...

Every Customer Is a Decision.

Follow the result on the report form. If they're healthy, give them bread. If not, do what must be done... but be careful. Every mistake is deducted from your quota.

Observe. Report. Decide.

Watch every customer carefully from behind the glass... Fill out the report form for each customer. Based on the form's result: Serve. Give medicine. Ready your knife... Be careful! Every wrong decision is deducted from your quota.

Prepare for Your Shift

Before the shift begins, prepare your station. Clean the floors, turn on the power switch, check the equipment, and wait for the next customer.

Prepare the Order

Follow the recipe. Mix the ingredients. Set the oven. Package the product... Every correct order contributes to your quota.

SOMEONE IS OUT THERE

There is someone outside the window. They are watching you. You don't know what they want yet... Always be ready for an attack.
4525470.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Russian, Turkish, Ukrainian, Spanish - Latin America

4525480.name: Grim Shift
4525480.about_the_game:
WELCOME TO THE NIGHT SHIFT You and your crew have forced to work for the cult. In Grim Shift, you are tasked with entering an abandoned graveyard to collect valuable loots. But you are not alone. Terrifying entities roam the grounds, and they do not welcome trespassers. Dark cultist are not tolerate laziness.

KEY FEATURES:

  • 1-4 Player Online Co-Op: Bring your friends or brave the dark alone. Teamwork, communication, and planning are essential to meet the quota successfully.

  • Scavenge: Search the graveyard for items and loot to meet your shift's quota. Manage your limited inventory space wisely. Discover the secret relics, and their unique power.

  • Face the Unknown: Evade unpredictable monsters. You are not a fighter; your best weapons are stealth, speed, and your flashlight.

  • Immersive Horror: A dark, atmospheric environment designed to keep you and your friends on edge from the moment you clock in.

Get in, get the loot, and get out alive. Your shift starts now.

4525520.name: Jarred Defense
4525520.about_the_game:
A cat is stuck in a jar. It's your problem now.

Jarred Defense is a maze-building tower defense for people who miss the pure form of TD. Placing a tower in the right spot to force enemies the long way around, make them walk over level hazards and create choke points for your splash zone. No spells, no first-person shooting, no random card modifiers. Just planning, placement, and upgrades.

Build towers. Force enemies through lava. Adapt to melting ice blocks crack as heat sources reshape the level around you. Send the next wave early and pocket the bonus.

The cat trapped in the jar has opinions about all of this. They are not helpful.

Features

  • True mazing, no predefined tower locations

  • Hand crafted levels that change as you play

  • Early send mechanic with risk-weighted bonuses

  • Tower upgrade trees with branching specialisations

  • Hazard tiles - force enemies to step on them

  • A boss to defeat every 10 waves

I should probably mention that this game is kind of hard.

I built it because I missed the old-school flash tower defense games that didn't hold your hand. As a result, you’ll probably watch your defenses fall apart more than once. I consider that part of the fun.

Made by one person who just wanted to play a game like this and couldn't find one.

Powered by the open-source GODOT game engine. <3
4525520.supported_languages: English, Japanese, German, Spanish - Spain, Czech, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Turkish

4525590.name: Fusion Core: Black Hole
4525590.about_the_game:
Experience a satisfying cosmic idle game where you control an all-consuming black hole. Devour thousands of atoms to build your mass and expand your reach. Unleash a Singularity Collapse to reset the universe, harvest rare Antimatter, and purchase permanent upgrades for your core.

Satisfying visuals

Sit back and watch the flow of particles. Enjoy a smooth and relaxing experience as your black hole pulsates, grows, and swallows thousands of atoms at once.

Addictive game loop

Pull atoms into your core to build your mass. The more you consume, the stronger your gravitational pull becomes. Reach critical mass, trigger a Singularity Collapse to reset the universe, and do it all over again.

Permanent upgrades

Every collapse rewards you with Antimatter. Use it to buy permanent upgrades for your black hole. Increase your pull radius, boost atom generation, and come back much stronger after every reset.
4525590.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Turkish

4525600.name: Outpost Liberation
4525600.about_the_game:
Outpost Liberation is a tactical outpost-clearing shooter focused on speed, precision, and strategy.

You play as a lone field agent sent deep behind enemy lines to dismantle a network of hostile bases. Each mission is a compact sandbox where every second matters.

Scout the area with binoculars, mark enemy positions, and plan the perfect infiltration route. Move silently, eliminate guards, sabotage key targets, and escape before the alarm spreads across the region.

Every mission rewards efficient execution. The faster and cleaner you complete the objective, the higher your score.

Master different approaches — stealth infiltration, long-range sniping, or aggressive assault — and compete for the best clear times.

  • Outpost – full reconnaissance infiltration

  • Speed Outpost – high-pressure stealth runs

  • Assault – combat-focused action missions

4525630.name: Broken Divide
4525630.about_the_game:
Your strategy happens before the battle.

Broken Divide is a tactical autobattler RPG where the decisions matter before the fighting starts. Draft heroes from the tavern, equip them from the shop, build their skill trees, and set your formation. Then watch your party take on increasingly dangerous waves without you lifting a finger.

Build Your Guild
Recruit heroes across multiple classes, each with a distinct role in your party. The durable Knight, the swift Rogue, the powerful Mage, the vital White Mage. Each hero levels up, gains skill points, and carries gear across runs.

Formation Matters
Front row heroes absorb hits. Back row heroes deal damage and support. Who you put where, and why, is the whole game.

Deep Skill Trees
Each class has a sprawling skill tree with multiple branches. Specialize your Knight into a damage wall or an evasion tank. Build your Mage around burst damage or sustained pressure. No two guilds play the same.

Active Time Battle Combat
Combat runs in real time. Watch ability cooldowns tick, damage numbers fly, and your White Mage race to keep the party alive. Speed up, pause, or let it run.

Gear Your Party
Build your loadout from a growing pool of items. Gold management and what you buy before a boss fight are the decisions that decide your run.

4525640.name: Boxing Life Simulator
4525640.about_the_game:
Rise from the Grind to Glory!

Step into the shoes of an aspiring fighter in Boxing Life Simulator, where every decision you make outside the ring is just as important as every punch you throw inside it. This is more than a sports game; it’s a journey of discipline, management, and ultimate triumph.

Master the Art of Fighting Step into the ring and face a diverse roster of opponents. Each victory brings you closer to the championship, but winning requires more than just luck. You must learn your opponent's patterns, manage your stamina, and execute precise combinations to secure a knockout.

The Grind Never Stops: Gym & Nutrition Your performance in the ring is a direct reflection of your lifestyle.

  • The Gym: Spend your hard-earned winnings on gym memberships. Engage in rigorous training sessions to improve your core stats: Strength, Speed, and Stamina.

  • Nutrition Matters: Your body is your weapon. Consume the right foods to fuel your recovery and maintain peak physical condition.

  • Condition Management: Neglecting your routine has consequences. If you fail to balance your diet and training, your condition will deteriorate, making even the simplest matches a struggle for survival.

Build Your Legacy Beyond the Ring A true champion knows that life is about more than just fighting. As your fame grows, so do your opportunities:

  • Lifestyle & Success: Move out of the basement and into luxury. Purchase new houses and upgrade your living standards to reflect your status as a world-class boxer.

  • Forge Relationships: Navigate the social side of a professional athlete's life. Manage relationships that can influence your career and mental well-being.

  • Economic Strategy: Balance your bank account. Decide whether to invest in better training gear or save up for that dream mansion.

Do you have the discipline to create a routine, stay strong, and become the greatest of all time? The ring is waiting.

4525680.name: Fonsermónique’s Culinary Diary
4525680.about_the_game:
In the high, cold mountains of Lands en Éternité, known as the Uplands, stands an ancient golden temple where a pristine goat-woman and an ancient dragon live side by side, day after day.

The story follows Fonsermónique, a young goat who tries to soothe the weariness of her life partner, Xi Sein, a dragon marked by time, using recipes inherited from her late mother's cookbook.

Fonsermónique's Culinary Diary is a short, linear narrative game where cooking becomes a bridge to the soul. As you prepare different recipes, you'll gather feedback that accompanies Fonsermónique on her personal journey, while you explore the temple in search of ingredients and of the dragon, gradually uncovering the peculiar relationship that binds them through small moments connected to the past.

The story unfolds in the same universe as La Cosa Perdida de Pomme, The Strange Journey of the Couriers, and Memento Morin, set long before the events known as the incident of the Four Nations.

❖Platform: Windows

❖Year: 2026

❖Genre: RPG Novel

❖Engine: RPG Maker MZ

❖Game time: 1-3 hours

❖ Original story in an original universe

❖ Cute characters

❖ Absurdly funny humor(?)

❖ 1 Ending (Lineal game)

˙✧˖°🍳 ༘ ⋆｡˚
4525680.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Latin America, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese

4525690.name: Tessera
4525690.about_the_game:
▎ They don't advertise The Circuit. They don't need to. Someone decided you're worth the risk — and left you a

Tessera. Don't waste it.

▎ A mysterious token arrives — a Tessera — your invitation into an underground world of five-on-five tactical combat.

As a Circuit Broker, you'll assemble a roster of agents, manage their contracts, call strategies mid-match, and watch

every firefight play out from behind your desk.

▎ DRAFT YOUR SQUAD

▎ Scout the recruiting pool. Evaluate raw stats — aim, movement, utility. Sign the right agents, build team chemistry,

and shape a roster that fits your playstyle.

▎ MANAGE EVERYTHING

▎ Handle weekly payroll, negotiate contracts, train your agents solo or with mentors, and manage your budget through

sponsorship deals with underground and corporate brands alike.

▎ WATCH IT UNFOLD

▎ Matches simulate round-by-round with full CS-style economy, weapon buys, utility usage, and four-phase tactical

combat. Call timeouts. Change strategies. Watch your agents clutch — or choke.

▎ CLIMB THE CIRCUIT

▎ Compete across an 18-week season with double round-robin play, playoffs, promotion, and relegation. Build your

legacy through multiple seasons as your broker reputation grows.

▎ FEATURES

▎ - 5v5 tactical combat simulation with round-by-round match engine

▎ - Full economy system — buy rounds, eco rounds, force buys, weapon pickups

▎ - 21-skill player progression tree across Tactics, Business, and Scouting

▎ - Dual-voice live commentary

▎ - Sponsorship system with 18 brands across 4 corporate tiers

▎ - Draft, recruit, and develop agents with unique stats and roles

▎ - Trophy vault, season awards, and career milestones

▎ - Original soundtrack with 14-track rotation

▎ - Zero microtransactions. Zero F2P mechanics. One purchase, full game.

4525740.name: VERITAS
4525740.about_the_game:
Be gay, kill eldritch horrors.

The Lowlands, one of the few remaining regions of Verita, is now surrounded by a dying world. Though robust enough to survive the ancient calamity, that not even the old gods withstood; its time is limited. Meet four unlikely companions as they traverse through dense forests, icy tundras, volcanic plains, and strange alien ruins that should have remained buried. Stop the corruption withering the Lowlands, and uncover what lies at its heart. 

VERITAS offers a linear narrative story driven metroidvania inspired by Terraria Calamity, and titles such as Blasphemous, Fear and Hunger, Miitopia, and Child of Light. Experience fast paced combat and rapidly switch between playable party members- or focus on one and release more devastating abilities.

Learn more about your party as they interact with this vibrant world in their own ways; and when the going gets rough and the nights get cold, find a place to settle down and unwind. Set up camp and interact with your party, learn more about who they are and deepen their bonds with each other.

Encounter and mingle with a vast array of characters from a variety of cultures as you travel through villages and countryside. Meet humble vagrants and nomads along the road, and stumble upon esoteric cultists that practice strange rituals in the woods.

4525760.name: Dolky
4525760.about_the_game:
UNIQUE COMBO-BASED GAMEPLAY

Host a sheep show! Arrange your flock on stage to create colorful combos and score a ton of Star Points. Skillfully chain combos together to excite the audience and clear the stage.

INVENT NEW SYNERGIES ON THE FLY

Dolky isn't a typical deckbuilder. Instead of trying to build a perfect deck, you can discover opportunities in the middle of the mayhem.

Build a collection of magical ribbons, and freely equip them to any sheep during a show. Mix and match to uncover surprising combinations and dazzle your growing fanbase.

CONTROL CHAOS --- EMBRACE CHAOS

In this show, everything goes wrong. Each stage has hazards that change the emotions of the sheep.

4526140.name: Cognomancy
4526140.about_the_game:
Your mind is your mana.

Cognomancy is a turn-based strategy game in the tradition of Heroes of Might and Magic. Explore an adventure map, build armies, conquer towns, and cast spells in hex-grid tactical combat. But here, magic works differently.

Every spell is a Chinese character. Every character is built from radicals. To cast it, you must know what it means.

Not your character. You.

Select a radical. The game shows you a glyph built from it. Identify it correctly and the spell fires at full power — devastating, precise, exactly what you commanded. Get it wrong and the spell fizzles. There is no mana bar. There is no cooldown. What limits your power is what you actually know.

The deeper you go, the stronger you become.

A basic spell fires when you recognize a single glyph. But the system is compositional. Radicals combine into compounds, and compounds follow logic:

  • 火 (fire) + 木 (wood) = 焚 (immolate)

  • 火 (fire) + 土 (earth) = 灶 (hearth)

Over one hundred spells are woven through a handful of radicals. A player who has seen fire once casts fire. A player who understands every compound fire appears in, every meaning it touches, commands it.

Spells degrade with use, forcing you to rotate your vocabulary. The magic system is spaced repetition disguised as warfare. You are the spellbook.

Six Factions. Six Doctrines.

Every faction fights differently. Not cosmetically, but structurally.

Iron Order: Formation warfare. Spearmen hold, Crossbowmen fire overhead, Lancers end battles in a single charge. The Kaisergolem anchors the line. Most powerful in open terrain. Most predictable.

Ashlands: Disruption. Fire Imps ignite and vanish. Nagas strike twice and retreat. The Asura Destroyer hits every adjacent hex, ally and enemy alike. They dissolve your formation before you can use it.

Clockwork Assembly: Construct positioning. Steam Turrets fire automatically. Iron Golems absorb while Engineers repair. The Titan Automaton is immune to all spells and repairs itself. No morale to break. No dead to raise.

Primordial Cradle: Nature and attrition. Wolf Packs punish isolated flanks. Vine Stranglers root enemies. Treants regenerate and heal every adjacent ally. Every step into their territory must be earned.

Dread Dominion: Undead persistence. Skeletons reassemble. Ghosts ignore physical attacks. Vampire Lords heal from damage dealt. The Lich King raises soldiers from every corpse. Against an army with no corpses, the engine stops. In every other fight, it cannot be worn down.

Celestial Court: Harmony. Every unit amplifies every other unit. Disciples grow with each spell cast nearby. The Celestial Dragon amplifies hero spells.

One World. Six Campaigns. Six Perspectives.

The same events. Seen from the inside of each faction. The conspiracy that looks like corruption in Campaign 1 looks like survival in Campaign 3. The enemy from Campaign 2 is your employer in Campaign 4.

Nothing is explained. Everything is there to be found.

4526310.name: Polychoron Explorer
4526310.about_the_game:
Explore 4D world as viewed by the eyes of imaginary 4D creature that uses volumetric (3D) space for visual sensing instead of planar (2D) space like we do.

A brand new 4D rendering engine was created for a casual puzzle game yet to be released. Based on that engine, this exploration sandbox was created to observe 4D convex polychorons (which are 4D geometrical shapes made out of 3D shapes).

Currently implemented features are:

  • Pick any of 6 known regular polychorons to explore - 5-cell, 8-cell, 16-cell, 24-cell, 120-cell and 600-cell.

  • Look at the selected polychoron from any direction like an imaginary 4D creature would. This is achieved by 3D projection matrix technique where 4D objects are projected onto 3D spherical matrix like 3D objects are projected onto 2D matrix which we use to explore 3D world.

  • Several rendering customization options are available to make this complex display perceivable as a volume rather than as a picture.

  • Rotate around the polychoron using any of the 6 rotation axis-planes of 4D space using keyboard, mouse drag or controller analog axes. 

  • Paint any of the polychoron's cells into any color or turn them off completely. Save colorings to revisit them later. This allows player to follow particular cell's rotation relative to others and to follow polychora's cell rings.

  • Use Scan mode to explore polychorons by cutting them with 3D hyper-plane and see what comes out. This mode also allows full rotations, just like projection mode does.

  • Create your own polychorons by splitting the existing one in Scan mode or by providing your own geometry (programming experience needed to make your own geometry).

Currently the game is a sandbox where players themselves find what available features entertains them the most. But additional casual puzzle game with scoring and achievements is planned to be added soon.

4526420.name: Amarta: Kingdom of Shadows

Recognized by UNESCO as a Masterpiece of the Oral and Intangible Heritage of Humanity, Wayang Kulit represents a rich synthesis of visual art, literature, music, and performance, making it one of the most significant cultural traditions in Indonesia.

Babad Wanamarta is a story from the Javanese Wayang Kulit tradition that tells about the founding of the Pandawa kingdom in a wild and dangerous forest called Wanamarta. In the story, the Pandawa are given a barren and cursed forest by the Kurawa as a political maneuver to remove them from power. Instead of accepting defeat, the Pandawa decide to transform the forest into a prosperous kingdom.
