4526480.name: Prim3 Hunt
4526480.about_the_game:
Prim3 Hunt – The Prime Hunt Puzzle Strategy Game

Combine numbers on a 5×5 grid to create prime numbers, control space, and plan every move in a deep minimalist puzzle-strategy experience.

Easy to learn. Hard to master.

What begins as a simple number puzzle quickly evolves into a system of patterns, risk, and precision. Every decision shapes the board. Every mistake lingers.

A signal is trying to reach you...

Buried inside an old system, something is waking up—fragment by fragment, number by number. Prim3 Hunt (also known as Prime Hunt) is a unique prime number puzzle game where you combine numbers to stabilize a corrupted digital system.

Developed by Aksonia, this indie puzzle experience blends deep strategy with a haunting retro-tech atmosphere inspired by early computing systems.

CORE GAMEPLAY

Numbers fall into a 5×5 grid. Your goal is to link adjacent numbers to form prime numbers and clear space while maintaining control of the board.

  • Prime Number Creation: Combine smaller values into valid primes through smart connections.
  • Strategic Planning: Every move impacts future possibilities — think several steps ahead.
  • Grid Control: Poor placement can block your path. Space management is critical.
  • Pattern Recognition: Learn to identify and build efficient prime combinations.

This is not about speed — it’s about precision, foresight, and mastery of a system that doesn’t forgive careless moves.

GAME MODES

Prim3 Hunt offers multiple ways to experience the Prime Hunt system:

Story Mode
Uncover the hidden signal. Restore stability layer by layer as the system reveals more of itself.

Classic Mode
Reach the target prime before your moves run out. Pure strategy, no distractions.

Endless Mode
No limits. Just you, the grid, and ever-growing numbers.

Move Limit Mode
A fixed number of moves. Every decision must count.

Timed Mode
Constant pressure. Maximum output with no hesitation.

Daily Challenge
A new puzzle every day. Compete on global leaderboards and refine your strategy.

PROGRESSION & MASTERY

The system evolves as you do.

  • Unlock new modes by discovering increasingly complex prime numbers
  • Improve consistency and decision-making under pressure
  • Push deeper into corrupted layers of the system

In Prim3 Hunt, progression is not just about unlocking content—it’s about understanding the system itself.

RETRO-TECH ATMOSPHERE

Inspired by early 90s computing and CRT-era interfaces, Prime Hunt delivers a distinct visual and audio experience:

  • Subtle signal distortion and authentic visual artifacts
  • Minimalist terminal-style interface
  • A quiet, unsettling sense of being observed

The system does not explain itself. It reacts to what you discover.

FEATURES

  • Unique Prime-Based Gameplay: A puzzle system built entirely around creating prime numbers
  • Deep Grid Strategy: Every move reshapes future possibilities—no randomness safety net
  • Meaningful Decisions: Small choices lead to large consequences over time
  • Multiple Game Modes: From relaxed play to high-pressure challenges
  • Daily Competitive Play: Test your skills against other players
  • Minimalist Design: Clean visuals focused on clarity and atmosphere

A DIFFERENT KIND OF PUZZLE GAME

Most puzzle games give you answers.

Prim3 Hunt gives you patterns—and expects you to understand them.

SYSTEM STATUS

Signal detected: PRIME HUNT
Decryption in progress: AKSONIA
Stability: INCOMPLETE
4526480.supported_languages: English, Finnish, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain

4526490.name: Spooky Action: at a distance
4526490.about_the_game:
Something connects them. You just don't know how yet.

Spooky Action: at a distance is a minimalist logic puzzle game built around a single idea borrowed from quantum physics: two particles, linked across any distance, so that what happens to one instantly affects the other.

In this game, that idea becomes a puzzle.

Move an object. Watch its entangled partner react. The reaction depends on the nature of their bond — and there are multiple kinds, each with its own logic, its own surprises, its own way of turning a simple move into something unexpected. Bonds can be chained. Changed. Combined with mechanical effectors that bend the rules further.

There is no single correct path. There is only the destination — and countless ways to miss it.

What you'll find: — 100+ handcrafted puzzles across increasing complexity — Multiple types of entanglement with unique behaviors — Mechanical effectors that twist the rules — No timers, no randomness, no luck — Clean, minimal aesthetic — One player. Pure thought.

"Spooky action at a distance" — Albert Einstein, on quantum entanglement, 1935.

4526600.name: Trouble in Potion High
4526600.about_the_game:
🧪 Potion High

Something has gone very wrong in Potion High. As an outside specialist for "hopeless cases," you must fight your way through corridors overrun by interdimensional creatures. Restore order using potions and your own pocket laboratory. Can you contain this chaos?

🏛️ Something has gone very wrong...

Normally, Potion High is a prestigious school of potions. However, sudden, strange events have trapped the students and turned the facility into a surreal labyrinth full of dangers. You are sent to the scene to solve a problem that no one else dared to touch.

You don’t have time for studying – you’ve got a job to do.

🌌 Pocket Alchemical Laboratory

At any moment, you can escape the chaos of the school corridors by stepping through a portal into your private universe. That is where your miniature laboratory is located, where you:

  • Brew unique potions: Every problem in Potion High requires a liquid solution. You have a clear goal and a specific recipe.

    • Need a shrinking elixir to bypass a blockade?

    • A decoction to open a closed passage?

    • Or perhaps a love potion to pacify a nuisance?

  • Create concoctions that will allow you to defeat monsters from another dimension and unlock the way forward.

  • Plan your next move: In the pocket world, time flows differently – use it to your advantage.

Key Features:

  • Linear, dense plot: Every step brings you closer to discovering what (or who) is behind the catastrophe.

  • "Wacky & Eerie" style: Colorful, crazy graphics mix with moments of unease and the grotesque.

  • Situational and dialogue humor: Prepare for absurd conversations and comical situations that will break the tense atmosphere.

  • Fighting Interdimensional Beings: Your potions are your only weapon against creatures that shouldn't be here.

  • A mix of comedy, absurdity, and a light thriller.

  • Exploration, FPS elements, and brewing key potions.

4526640.name: Light the Fire
4526640.about_the_game:
Light the Fire is a survival-driven tower defense where you control when the battle begins… and how difficult it will be.

Explore, gather resources, unlock new recipes, craft gear, build your base and defenses, and ignite the fire when you're ready.

But be careful, the more wood you feed the fire, the stronger the waves become.

How long can you survive?

Features

  • Resource gathering and exploration

  • Crafting system and equipment progression

  • Base building and defensive structures

  • Player-controlled wave system

  • Scalable difficulty based on your decisions

  • Online co-op mode

Gameplay Loop

  • Gather resources

  • Build and prepare

  • Light the fire

  • Survive the wave

  • Repeat

Note

This is an Early Access game.

You can already play the full core experience, but more content and improvements are planned.

Enter at your own risk… and bring some patience.

4526660.name: 桌宠小然
4526660.about_the_game:
About This Game

Cute Diana is a desktop companion game focusing on deep cultivation and interactive companionship. More than just a static decoration, Cute Diana is a virtual partner with an independent attribute system, a career path, and a life full of details. Through daily interaction, attribute management, and engaging mini-games, you will witness the journey of growth shared between you and Cute Diana right on your desktop.

Key Features

📊 Comprehensive Status Management

Cute Diana features five real-time status dimensions that require your attention:

  • Growth & Leveling: Gain experience over time to level up (indicated by the strawberry icon), unlocking advanced features and new content.

  • Survival Needs: Satiety and Cleanliness deplete over time. You must feed and bathe Cute Diana to keep her healthy.

  • Well-being: Neglect can lead to declining Health or even illness, while her Mood directly impacts her work efficiency.

🎭 Dynamic Attribute System

Shape Cute Diana’s personality and capabilities by developing her core attributes:

  • Intelligence, Stamina, and Charm: These three stats act as gateways to unlocking advanced courses, high-paying jobs, and unique random events.

  • Luck (Hidden Stat): A lucky Cute Diana has a higher chance of obtaining rare items during daily activities.

📚 Education & Career Progression

  • Incremental Learning: Choose from various courses like "Live Stream Strategy." Each 30-minute session boosts specific attributes, and completing exams yields major rewards.

  • Diverse Work Choices: Earn "Ran Coins" through various jobs, from a simple "Typist" to a "Flower Shop Assistant" or even "Event Staff".

  • Progression Logic: Higher levels and better attributes unlock more lucrative and challenging career opportunities.

🎮 Interactive Mini-Games

Engage in active gameplay through "Special Jobs" to boost your earnings:

  • Streaming Simulation: Experience the life of a virtual idol. Depending on Cute Diana's attributes, viewers may send "SuperChats." Click them to collect Ran Coins.

  • Professional Typist: Test your own skills in a typing challenge. Success grants not only currency but also exclusive high-tier items.

🎁 Extensive Collection & Customization

  • Massive Item Library: Collect over one hundred unique items, ranging from food and snacks to rare collectibles.

  • Dynamic Shop: The store inventory refreshes periodically. Use your hard-earned Ran Coins to buy gifts and necessities for Cute Diana.

4526710.name: N U C L I D E A N
4526710.about_the_game: NUCLIDEAN puts you into the shoes of a janitor at a planetary outpost invaded by an alien cult. In this retro boomer-shooter with a Non-Euclidean twist, you will encounter portals, crazy geometry and bloody monstrous enemies. All that on a distant planet where the rules of the Earth do not apply.
4526710.game_link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4526710/N U C L I D E A N/

4526720.name: Pawn Within: Two Fates
4526720.about_the_game:
In the vast sea of stars, engage in a tactical battle right at your fingertips.

This is a tabletop simulation game that combines classic tactical SRPG combat, match-3 synthesis, and Skill Build. Set aboard a distant starship, you will control the hero Luca and his companions across an intricate magical board. On grid-based battlefields filled with obstacles and enemies, you will cast powerful magic through clever positioning and unique equipment combinations to solve endless tactical challenges.

Game Features

🎯 Assemble your skill disk!

The unique skill disk system lets you freely customize your playstyle. Collect sector-shaped pieces to build your own exclusive skill combinations. Before each battle, adapt your setup to different stages and enemy types and enjoy deep strategic deck-building.

🔄 Spin your skill disk!

As your wheel stops, one or more skills enter your inventory. Keep them or fuse them? The choice is yours. This mechanic adds unpredictability and excitement to every battle, forcing you to adapt on the fly and keep each encounter fresh.

⚡ Manage your action points wisely!

The innovative action point system breaks traditional SRPG limits. Move or spin? Every choice matters. Properly allocating every action point is the key to victory. Will you play aggressively or defensively? Your AP management will decide the outcome.

🔷 Three combined skills are stronger than one!

Our groundbreaking match-3 synthesis system lets you upgrade skills in combat. Match identical skill icons to create higher-tier abilities with more powerful effects. Strategy and luck come together to make skill growth fun and rewarding.

🌟 Master every skill!

Dozens of unique effects await discovery, from basic attacks to elemental skills of Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth. Skills chain together in powerful combinations. Mix and match freely to unlock secret synergies and create your own one-of-a-kind build.

🦸 Warrior! Mage! Assassin! Hunter! Priest! Druid! Robot!

Multiple playable heroes, each with unique skill trees, passive abilities, and combat styles. From all-around warriors to immune robots, assemble your favorite team and experience completely different playstyles.

👹 Nearly unbeatable bosses!

At the end of each chapter await powerful, unique bosses. Each has distinct mechanics, skills, and phase shifts. Study their patterns, plan your tactics, and defeat them to prove your strategic skill.

♟️ Realistic chess-piece animations!

Beautifully crafted chess animations bring every move, attack, and hit to life, delivering a truly immersive tabletop experience.

4526750.name: Night Creed
4526750.about_the_game:
In the ruined lands of an ancient kingdom, an evil that has lurked for centuries in the ruins of ancient castles awakens. Monsters emerge from dark rifts, filling the deserted fortresses and forgotten roads.

The nameless warrior in the dark hood does not come to these lands by chance. He is a hunter of darkness, the last of an ancient order that once protected people from such nightmares.

Gameplay:

Night Creed is a 2D platformer. You control a character and move horizontally, fending off waves of enemies from both sides, both ground-based and flying. The player can use rolls to dodge attacks, use magic to destroy large groups of enemies, and collect life and mana orbs, which are needed to use magic. At the end of each wave, a boss appears—a unique enemy with a large amount of health and a unique attack pattern.

Game Features:

- Beautiful pixel art

- Musical style

- High difficulty

- Responsive controls

4526770.name: Declutterer
4526770.about_the_game:
Declutterer is a tidying and storage game. Accept commissions from different clients, clean up clutter, organize items, and restore order according to their requests.

Apply as a rookie declutterer , start by tidying up your own workspace, complete commissions one by one, and take on increasingly messy rooms to bring everything back in perfect order.

4526890.name: Silver Requiem
4526890.about_the_game:
Dance on the Edge of Death. A single counter turns the battlefield into your stage.

High-Mobility Counter × Build-Oriented 3D Soulslike Action

[Game Overview]
This is a 3D Soulslike action RPG where seizing "the momentum of a split second" through counters and dodges dictates your next move.

  • Three Paths After a Counter
    After parrying an enemy's strike, the rhythm of battle shifts based on your judgment: will you launch an aerial follow-up, retreat to strike a weak point, or deliver a definitive finishing blow?

  • Strategy Redefined by Your Build
    Your build fundamentally redefines your combat style, allowing you to parry the strikes of formidable bosses as fluidly as flowing silver.

    • Example 1: Grapple into the air and unleash a crushing plunge attack.

    • Example 2: Instantaneously gain distance to snipe a vital weak point.

    • Example 3: Chain multiple counters to nullify relentless assaults.
      Or, will you cast aside raw power to seize destiny? When your build and choices align, the battlefield becomes your personal stage.

  • "Destined Choices" Forced by the Curse
    Upon defeating a boss or experiencing a surge of raw emotion, you are forced to make a choice. Will you embrace the Curse to gain immense power at the cost of altering your combat style forever, or settle for a minor advantage? Once carved into your story, these choices cannot be undone. 

[Worldview]
19th century—a city submerged in mist.
A silver-haired undertaker, burdened by lost memories and a dark hex, wanders a world where the grudges of the dead have taken form.
Express this world through your skill and choices, as if dancing a waltz. Witness with your own eyes the truth behind the undertaker’s lost past.

4526900.name: Bar Keeper
4526900.about_the_game:
[Cocktail × Tower Defense]

Alcohol can turn people into either virtue or evil.

Players become bartenders, your role is to serve your allies the perfect cocktails to counter the approaching threats.

Serving cocktails triggers a variety of buff effects your allies.

Give your allies instructions, make choices based on the battle situation, and defend your haven to the end.

【The “Drunkenness” System That Determines the Outcome】

Maintain the perfect level of intoxication to keep them fighting at their best.

Players must decide which cocktails to serve to whom and how many to serve.

Your skills as a bartender will be put to the test.

Don’t force them to drink too much.

After all, you are a "Bar Keeper"

【Battle and Rewards】

Repel the waves of enemies to earn a variety of cocktails.

Whether you choose to bring out their full strength or take a gamble with a quirky concoction—it’s all up to you.

Create your own unique build and defend the bar to the end.


【Collection】

Numerous real-world cocktails make an appearance. You can admire each cocktail you’ve acquired one by one on the collection screen.

Fill up your cocktail collection and enjoy the beautiful drawn pixel art to your heart’s content.

4526910.name: Who move my key?
4526910.about_the_game:
Who Move my key? is a fast-paced parkour game themed around the keyboard.

Survive among constantly shifting key layouts and high-speed obstacles. Dodge danger, collect coins, and keep pushing for higher scores by purchasing upgrades and unlocking different gameplay forms and challenge content. You can also use the customization options you obtain to create your own keyboard style.

Game Modes

The game features 3 standard modes with different difficulty levels, as well as 10 challenge modes.

Whether you want to learn the mechanics step by step or jump straight into tougher challenges, every run will test your reflexes, observation, and control.

Key Changes

What would happen if your keybinds suddenly changed in the middle of a run?

Changing keybinds is the game’s signature feature. When the player touches a “virus,” the key layout changes in a variety of different ways.

This means that not only do you need to deal skillfully with all kinds of enemies and obstacles, but you must also keep track of your current controls at all times to avoid pressing the wrong key at a critical moment.

Progression System

The game includes 48 different upgrades.

These upgrades can grant you:

  • New movement options

  • Additional keyboard skins

  • More health and invincibility time

  • Higher score multipliers

  • Dash and teleport abilities

Even if you can’t beat your high score right away, you can collect coins, buy upgrades, and come back stronger for the next attempt.

Keyboard Customization

The game presents your controls and upgrades in the form of a keyboard.

If you want to make it more personalized, the game also offers more than 40 different keycaps and background plates to unlock and combine, allowing you to build your own keyboard style.

Milestones and Leaderboards

Each mode has its own milestones and leaderboard.

You can set new records in different modes, unlock new content, or focus on the mode you’re best at and keep climbing the rankings.

Achievements and Stats

The game includes a large amount of trackable information and collectible achievements.

Your progress and challenge history will be recorded in detail. Alongside the satisfaction of improvement, you can also unlock real Steam achievements.
4526910.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, French, German, Finnish

4526920.name: Space Commanders: Solar System
4526920.about_the_game:
A unique journey following a lone space commander who ventures into the silence of the Solar System, exploring the dark surfaces of distant planets and moons to gather scientific data, establish small outposts, and search for new worlds and potential habitats for humanity. In the cold, dark, and isolated void of space, every step becomes a fight for survival.

Each planet offers a distinct atmosphere, temperature, gravity, and lighting environment based on real scientific data. You choose which world to begin your mission on.

You are not entirely alone in your exploration. A stranded spaceship deep in space carries a crew of astronauts waiting for rescue. To reach them, you must collect data across multiple planets, manage your landing craft with precision, and carefully monitor your oxygen levels. When your oxygen runs out, death is inevitable—every movement must be calculated.

You explore planetary surfaces in first‑person, while navigating your spacecraft and landers through third‑person/top‑down perspectives. All items, surface details, and planetary information are grounded in real scientific sources. The game also includes a 30‑question quiz on space history and science, allowing you to reinforce what you learn throughout your journey.

4527040.name: One Step One Mistake
4527040.about_the_game:
Hostile military territory. A beautiful spy, dressed in a mini dress, approaches a key official of the enemy government.

She successfully gathers intelligence using a honey trap, but is captured and forced into a desperate escape.

The only way forward is to cross a dangerous minefield filled with countless buried explosives.

Using the numbers hidden beneath the tiles as clues, she must deduce where the mines are buried.

But this is no ordinary minesweeper.

Armed drones patrol overhead, missing not even the slightest movement.

If she takes too long, the drones will launch a relentless attack.

Every step demands careful judgment. A single mistake means instant death.

Will she find a safe path and escape—
or step on a mine that ends everything?

4527070.name: Layer Defender
4527070.about_the_game:
The network is under attack. Only the Salad Squad stands between order and total system failure.

Layer Defender is a single-player isometric horde survivor built in Unreal Engine 5. Phishing schools, Ransomware juggernauts, and elite Cyber Ninjas flood the arena in escalating waves. You auto-fire. You dodge. You choose your upgrades wisely — and sometimes you make desperate decisions that cost you dearly.

Build your squad. Sacrifice your layers.

You start as the Onion — balanced, resilient, and built around the art of layered defence. Seven layers stand between you and oblivion. But those layers are also your lifeline to something more. Sacrifice them between waves to deploy a Special Support Module — a teammate with abilities that can turn the tide.

Carrot sniffs out cloaked Rootkit threats before they reach you. Chili brings increased fire damage and chaos. Garlic slowly restores your defensive layers over time. Pumpkin absorbs punishment that would flatten anyone else. Tomato leaves acid wherever it goes — and slows anything caught in it. Considers this a feature, not a bug.

Onion plus three squad slots per run. Choose who you trust with your survival.

Every layer counts.

Layers aren't just a health buffer — they're your post-wave recovery mechanic. The more you sacrifice for squad power, the less health you recover at wave end. Push too hard too fast and you'll limp into the later waves on fumes. Survive long enough and layers are fully restored before boss fights. If you make it that far.

Upgrade. Adapt. Survive.

Between every wave, choose one of three upgrade cards — incendiary rounds, piercing bullets, emergency revives, or a dozen other options that change how your run plays out. No two runs play the same way.

Explore varied environments.

Fight through distinctly different arenas — warehouses, airports, temples and more. Each environment brings its own layout, chokepoints, and interactive elements. Doors, switches, and the architecture itself become part of your strategy.

Features:

  • Isometric horde survival with wave-based escalation

  • 6 playable characters — each with 2 active abilities and a unique passive

  • Layer sacrifice system — strategic tradeoffs every wave

  • 12+ In-run upgrade cards

  • 30 persistent progression upgrades

  • Cyber threat enemy roster — Phishlings, Rootkits, Ransomware, APT Stalkers and more

  • Varied environments with interactive elements

  • Built in Unreal Engine 5

4527100.name: Firefield
4527100.about_the_game:
■ About development

A solo development work by a 45-year-old with no programming experience who wrote approximately 120,000 lines of code and 100 achievements in 3 months using only AI.

The only development partner is Anthropic's AI agent "Claude Code." I don't use Unity or Unreal, I created my own custom engine and map editor. There is not a single line of code or specifications written by humans. All 100 Steam achievements are automatically generated by AI.

Subtitles are available in 95 languages ​​and full audio dubbing is available in 70 languages. All translation, dubbing, and quality checks are performed using AI.

■ Story

1997.

A great king was killed by a flame called the Fire Field.

Rainz killed the king.

The world hated him.

However, on the other hand, there were a small number of people who worshiped him as a savior.

As one of the "people of Rainz," you step into the cemetery in the north where the king is buried.

No one who goes down to the basement of the cemetery ever returns.

Is the truth of the king sleeping there? Rainz's sin? Or is it an inherited curse?

Fire Field is a dark fantasy action RPG that takes you deep underground.

■ What you can currently play

In the current version, you can explore up to the 5th floor underground.

Enemies become stronger each time you go down a floor, and a boss awaits you at the deepest level.

Your goal is to equip yourself in the city, advance underground one layer at a time, and survive as you dive deeper.

■ Features

・Dungeon exploration gets more and more tense as you go underground

・Underground structure that changes every time you explore

・More than 100,000 equipment variations, hack and slash elements

・Item system that gives different abilities to each piece of equipment

・Customization and appearance changes for each equipment part

・A system where you become a ghost when you die and wander through the reverberations that remain underground.

・A fragmented story about Rainz, the King, and the Fire Field.

・Rough and cold visual expression with the atmosphere of the 90s in mind

・Battle with the boss waiting in the depths

■ Supported languages

・Subtitles: Supports 95 languages around the world (all translated by AI)

・Audio: Supports full dubbing in 70 languages (all generated by AI)

・Supported platform: Windows

■ About Early Access

Through Early Access, Fire Field aims to further expand its underworld, enemies, and story.

This work is currently being developed primarily as a single-player experience.

As part of our future roadmap, we are planning to implement Steam Deck compatibility, a Mac version, and online co-op play.

■ About Fire Field

Fire Field is a work based on the theme, "People disappear, but the cause remains."

The deeper you go underground, the more you gradually uncover what happened in the past and what the flames left behind.

This is still the beginning of the story. But the flames are already burning.

4527150.name: Banana Belt Miner
4527150.about_the_game:
Banana Belt Miner is a fast-paced twin-stick space shooter where humanity discovers that bananas are the most powerful energy source in the universe.

Pilot your mining fighter through dangerous asteroid fields, harvest glowing cosmic bananas, and battle the ruthless Simian Empire determined to claim the Cosmic banana reserves for themselves.

Upgrade your ship, defeat massive enemy warships, and survive endless waves of enemies as you carve your path through the deep space of the banana belt.

4527180.name: Rift Diver
4527180.about_the_game:
Dive into the Rift

The Above is dying, and the Kingdom has reached into the filth to find its only hope: the "Unforgiven." Once branded as the architects of our extinction, a disgraced Knight, Archer, and Shaman have been offered a final deal. Step through ancient, rune-carved portals into the shifting chaos of the Below to kill the Reaper and close the Rift your own failure helped open.

Embark on a focused 4-level story campaign in a desperate fight for redemption, or test your limits in the brutal Endless Dungeon. Choose your hero and plunge into a world where your skill is the only thing between you and becoming just another soul harvested by the deep.

Survive the Endless Swarm

In Rift Diver, every run is a desperate fight for survival. Battle through waves of relentless monsters, from skeletal archers and magical eyes to the massive Gatekeeper. Master the art of the dash to weave through chaotic projectiles and time your strikes to crush the swarm.

Key Features

  • Multiple Game Modes: Battle through a structured story campaign culminating in an epic final boss, or see how long you can survive in the ever-scaling Endless Dungeon.

  • Hero Classes: Play your way with unique characters, each featuring distinct combat styles and abilities.

  • Dynamic Upgrades: Gather gold from fallen foes to upgrade your health, damage or buy abilities from the Shop.

  • Epic Boss Encounters: Test your mettle against massive, screen-filling bosses like the towering Frog Queen and The Gatekeeper.

  • Crisp Pixel Art: Explore a beautifully hand-crafted world brought to life with vibrant 2D animations and explosive effects.

A True Solo Passion Project

Rift Diver began in February 2025 as a collaborative university project prototyped alongside Kerim Kapetanović, Faris Balić, and Haris Šuta. Following that foundational phase, Amar took the helm as the sole developer to bring the game to its full potential.

Driven by a vision to create a polished action experience, Amar completely rebuilt the project from the ground up—reworking core systems, optimizing performance in Godot, and hand-crafting the art, design, and sound. What started in a classroom is now a dedicated solo vision coming to life.

Risk the Rift. Reap the Rewards.

How deep will you go? Whether you are hunting for the final boss or grinding for coins in the endless depths, Rift Diver offers a punchy, satisfying combat loop that will keep you coming back for "just one more run."

4527250.name: Don't Push Your Luck
4527250.about_the_game:
"Do you truly believe you're lucky?"

A chance granted by a higher power.

Don't Push Your Luck is a third-person platformer that combines precision-based control with a ruthless system of chance.

Climb the towering ruins of civilization, gather resources, and break through the barriers of probability to reach the top.

One mistake—one stroke of bad luck—can send you all the way back down.

A Climber Challenging Fate

You’ve been invited to a proving ground designed for those who claim to be “lucky.”

Simple jumps and parkour won’t be enough.

To survive here, skill is essential—but in the moments that matter most, you’ll need to prove your luck.

A Vertical Journey Through Time

Begin at the bottom in a primitive age and ascend through ancient, medieval, and modern eras—

all the way to a futuristic pinnacle.

Each stage features distinct visual themes and increasingly unforgiving terrain, pushing your limits as you climb.

Ruthless Machines of Chance

Throughout each stage, you’ll encounter devices that determine your fate—slot machines, coin flips, and more.

Wager the resources you’ve gathered.

Will luck carry you forward to the next era, or will you lose everything and fall back to the bottom?

The choice is yours.

Risk Management and Strategy

Don’t rely on luck alone.

At the start of each stage, shops offer ways to improve your odds or unlock shortcuts.

But be careful—earning enough resources means taking on even greater risks.

4527290.name: Litter Treasures
4527290.about_the_game:
A gentle cat universe that lives beside your screen while you work.

Litter Treasures is a cozy game about caring for curious little cats and the small surprises they leave behind. As they dig, nap, and explore their sandy home, your job is to create the perfect place for them to live.

Choose items for their rooms, arrange their spaces, and decide which cats belong where. Different environments, objects, and personalities interact in playful ways, shaping the treasures your cats uncover.

There’s no pressure and no way to fail. Just a calm space to nurture your growing cat family while discovering strange and charming things hidden in the sand.

FEATURES

  • Care for adorable cats and give them a thoughtfully designed home

  • Arrange rooms, choose objects, and experiment with different combinations

  • Scoop the litter to uncover strange and charming treasures

  • Explore multiple cozy rooms, each with its own quirks and challenges

  • Adopt new cats and discover how their personalities change your home

  • Build a growing collection of curious discoveries left behind in the sand

  • Play in fullscreen or dock it to a side of your monitor to play while you work.
4527290.supported_languages:
English*, Spanish - Spain*, Japanese*, Spanish - Latin America*
*languages with full audio support

4527340.name: Chi Chi's Magic Wash
4527340.about_the_game:
Help Chi Chi, a young witch, start her journey in learning her trade. Her magical studies aren’t like everyone else’s…
Instead of curses or fortune tellings, Chi Chi specializes in restorative cleaning enchantments—a gentle art that restores beauty to enchanted places.

In Chi Chi’s Magic Wash, relax by using a spell-powered wand to wash away grime, uncover hidden details, and bring life back into whimsical environments. Clean mystical statues, forgotten homes, overgrown mushrooms, and more as you explore a warm, enchanting world at your own pace.

Chill, unwind, and join Chi Chi on her cozy journey restoring the fantasy lands, one sparkle at a time.

4527360.name: Nifland
4527360.about_the_game:
Nifland is a co-op survival horror game with social deduction for 8–10 players.

SURVIVE THE ICE. FIND THE TRAITOR. DON’T LOSE YOUR MIND.

A ship lies trapped in the ice. Beyond it, a fog-shrouded forest waits. The crew must stay alive, keep the vessel running, and figure out who is dragging everyone toward disaster.

HOLD OUT

Search the ship for food. Catch fish in the forest. Repair the reactor. Watch over the condition of your team. Cold, hunger, and constant breakdowns can turn any expedition into a desperate fight for survival.

TRUST NO ONE

One of the players is the Traitor. They look like any other crew member. They help with the group’s tasks. They give nothing away. And they wait for fear and distrust to tear the team apart.

If someone draws too much suspicion, they can be knocked out, locked in a cage, and put to a vote.

THERE IS A BEAST ON THE SHIP

Something monstrous roams the dark corridors. It makes safety feel impossible, even inside the ship. It drives players into mistakes, panic, and separation.

THE FOREST DISTORTS REALITY

Beyond the ship, it becomes harder and harder to trust your own senses.

Fog, a snow spirit, and strange visions lead players astray and make it difficult to tell what is really happening. The farther you go, the harder it becomes to separate real danger from delusion.

FEATURES

• Co-op survival horror for 8–10 players

• Survival, social deduction, and a hidden Traitor

• Dangers both aboard the ship and beyond it

• Food scavenging, fishing, and reactor repair

• A monster hunting the crew

• Conflict, distrust, and harsh decisions within the team

• A surreal atmosphere and growing paranoia

4527390.name: RobBred - Funny Chat
4527390.about_the_game:
What is RobBred - Funny Chat

RobBred - Funny Chat is a game with one goal: to turn strangers into friends. Unlike other voice chat games, this one is special. Together, you both decide your fate at a single switch.

One press of a button—and it's goodbye...or hooray! :D

What is the goal of Funny Chat?

  • Decisions determine everything.

  • Reactions lead to moments.

  • Funny encounters create funny memories.

Turn strangers into friends, forge connections, and increase the fun of shared interests.

Goof around, have funny conversations, but above all: have fun together!

What do the Buttons do?

With each new encounter, both players have four options: Stay and ask questions, become friends, leave, or continue searching.

Sometimes you don't have to press anything at all.

The result is then extreme laughter, friendship, or an interesting conversation. Or maybe all of the above.

In the end, the buttons give players the choice of how they part ways.

Either as friends or as strangers.
4527390.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Portuguese - Brazil, Bulgarian, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Danish, Finnish, Greek, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Dutch, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Swedish, Spanish - Latin America, Thai, Czech, Turkish, Ukrainian, Hungarian, Vietnamese

4527460.name: Void Odyssey
4527460.about_the_game:
The galaxy is vast. Learn to move through it.

Void Odyssey is a turn-based tactical RPG set across a sprawling, hand-crafted galaxy where mastering the art of orbital movement is just as critical as mastering combat. Plan trajectories, exploit gravitational forces, and navigate living star systems where every decision about how you move through space carries weight.

A Galaxy Worth Exploring No two corners of the universe are alike. From neon-lit space stations buzzing with merchants and mercenaries to forgotten worlds steeped in arcane power, Void Odyssey rewards those who venture off the beaten flight path. Chart your course and carve your own story through the cosmos.

The Cosmos is Yours to Navigate In Void Odyssey, space isn't just the backdrop, it's a mechanic. Every system flows with real orbital motion, and learning to move through it shapes every step of your journey. From threading debris fields to timing a planetary slingshot, the voyage between destinations is an experience in itself and not just a means to an end.

Where Magic Meets the Stars Void Odyssey doesn't ask you to choose between fantasy and science fiction. Ancient magic and starship engineering exist side by side, woven into a genre-bending universe that plays by its own rules.

A Cast as Big as the Universe The galaxy is alive with colorful, memorable characters with their own agendas, backstories, and something to offer anyone willing to listen.

Void Odyssey is currently in development. Wishlist now to follow our journey and be among the first to explore the galaxy.

Original music composed and produced by Adam Linnell.

4527480.name: MAD
4527480.about_the_game:
MAD is a hardcore pixel-art top-down action shooter set in a brutal, 90s-inspired dystopia where violence isn’t just survival - it’s entertainment. In the rotting heart of a corrupt future city, the wealthy elite broadcast a sadistic spectacle to the masses: a deadly game staged inside a skyscraper where ordinary people are thrown in and hunted for sport. The rules are simple: climb, kill, and don’t die. The reward? Freedom… or at least the illusion of it.

The Tower: A Vertical Slaughterhouse

Fight your way through a massive deadly skyscraper designed to break you. Each floor presents a new gauntlet of deadly traps, surveillance systems, and hostile environments engineered for maximum carnage.

Fight, Sabotage, Rebel

Engage in fast-paced, unforgiving combat where precision and aggression are your only allies. Dodge bullets, outmaneuver enemies, and turn the environment against your hunters.

Hunters and Killers

Face a relentless roster of enemies - from street thugs and cyber-enhanced enforcers to elite assassins trained to hunt you down. Each encounter demands quick thinking and sharper reflexes as enemies adapt, flank, and overwhelm.

Survival with an Edge

Scavenge weapons, gear, and upgrades as you fight your way upward. Build your character through light RPG progression, unlocking new abilities and enhancing your combat style.

Break the Cycle

There were many contestants on the TV show before you - but you could be the one to survive and end this madness. As the line between contestant and insurgent begins to blur, one goal becomes clear: reach the top, silence the Host, and end the broadcast once and for all.

Don’t change the channel. The hunt has begun.

4527550.name: Flounder
4527550.about_the_game:
Manage the ecosystem, unlock special fish and items, and survive boss incursions. Every fish has a trick. Every item changes the game. Discover unstoppable combos and conquer each run your way!

Features:

  • 58 fish types, 51 items and 13 bosses. All with unique behavior and abilities. (With more to come!)

  • Endlessly Replayable: Strategize and build new combos every run

  • Meta-progression: Become stronger as you unlock permanent upgrades and pets across runs

  • Play at your pace: Difficulty ranges from Zen Mode to Boss Rush

  • Catch rare fish variants to be kept in the peaceful Virtual Tank mode

Start each run with a school of Guppies. Grow their population to trigger various spawn conditions. Balance your predator and prey population to set yourself up for the next boss wave.

From time to time, challenging bosses appear to attack your fish. Various fish types will help with your defense. Equip your fish with powerful items, unleash their abilities and keep the ecosystem alive!

Collect coins as you nurture your fish and repel bosses. Spend them wisely at the rotating shop to hold the line!

Before each run, strategize and choose from various persistent items and pets to start your game strong.

Select Zen difficulty to start a peaceful run. Catch fish including rare variants to add them to your collection. Earn coins to display prized fish and enable upgrades for the Virtual Tank to build your dream aquarium!
4527550.supported_languages: English, French, German, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese

4527640.name: Stellar Breach
4527640.about_the_game:
Buckle up for this chaotic adventure in the world of Stellar Breach, a fast-paced sci-fi roguelite where survival hinges entirely on your reflexes and your loadout. The universe is throwing everything it has at you, and you'll need to thread the needle through absolute cosmic mayhem to make it out alive.

Master the Dash, Own the Void Combat in Stellar Breach is completely built around precision timing and your core dash ability. You aren't just holding down the trigger; you're weaving through dense asteroid fields, chaining movements, and tethering through scrap to outmaneuver your enemies. Every encounter is a frantic dance of positioning where a perfectly timed dash means the difference between victory and becoming space dust.

Face Down Cosmic Nightmares The galaxy is not empty, and it is definitely not friendly. Prepare for brutally challenging gameplay anchored by intense boss battles. Whether you are dodging the overwhelming, neon-soaked bullet hell of the Maw of the Void, surviving an escort sequence against the Forge-Master, or trying to outrun the relentless Nebula Wraith, every boss requires you to learn their patterns and push your mechanics to the absolute limit.

Your Choices Shape the Run You aren't flying solo. Step into the paws of Barnaby, navigating the stars alongside your trusty, occasionally snarky AI companion, C.A.T. Between the frantic space battles, your choices matter and actively alter your game experience. The tactical decisions you make in dialogue drastically change how you play the game.

Endless Build Potential No two runs through the breach are ever the same. Thanks to the massive potential for various build types, you can tailor your ship to match your exact playstyle. Synergize your dash mechanics with wild, overlapping upgrades and lean into completely different combat routines every time you leave the hangar.

4527650.name: Cardmare: Descent
4527650.about_the_game:
Build Your Deck - Push Your Luck - Survive Against All Odds

Welcome to Cardmare: Descent, a fast-paced roguelike deckbuilder where every run lasts only around 10 intense minutes. Strategically shape your deck as you acquire new cards from the merchant and upgrade your cards during battle. There are no limits... scale your cards indefinitely and create absurdly powerful combos… if you survive long enough.

Descend through 10 deadly floors, battling undead warlocks, ruthless renegades, venomous spiders and nightmarish creatures, and try to gain as much gold as possible.

Will you gain enough gold to buy powerful new cards, or become too greedy and push your luck too far?

A Strategic Class System

Choose from nine different classes: Fighter, Paladin, Defender, Rogue, Ranger, Alchemist, Sorcerer, Druid, Necromancer.

Key Features

Turn-based combat: Every decision can mean victory or defeat.

Quick runs & deep gameplay: Jump in and complete a run in ~10 minutes.

Incremental upgrades: Power up your deck mid-combat for devastating strikes.

Push-your-luck gameplay: Will you risk it all to gain as much gold as possible?

Infinite scaling: Upgrade cards endlessly and try to break the game.

High replayability: Choose from a variety of characters, classes and cards. Levels and enemy encounters are randomly generated.

Ascension system: Easy to learn, hard to master. Each ascension level increases the difficulty: try to beat them all!

4527670.name: Vestige

4527800.name: Punt! Rollin Raccoons
4527800.about_the_game:
The Raccoons are out and up to no good! Punt your very own Raccoon and cause havoc in this Pinball inspired arcade game. Destroy whatever is in your path, complete missions, and customize your rotund friend.

Explore unique playgrounds to ping yourself around. Use the environment to chain together combos and get as many point as possible. 

Use the points you collect to unlock hats and colors for you Raccoon to destroy the city in style.

4527820.name: LEVATE
4527820.about_the_game:
The silence of the night makes thoughts louder...

The main character is a teenager named Gosha, who increasingly finds himself trapped inside his own mind. His days are spent in his room, surrounded by unfinished tasks, forgotten hobbies, and constant procrastination. The world outside the window feels distant and unfamiliar, and any attempt to change something ends in guilt and exhaustion.

Sometimes a mysterious girl named Anya appears by his side.
She understands him better than anyone else.
On occasion... even too well.

Gradually, the line between memories, anxiety, and reality begins to blur. And the deeper the hero sinks into his own thoughts, the harder it becomes to tell - is that inner voice trying to help him… or holding him in place?

GAME FEATURES

  • A short atmospheric psychological story

  • Stylized pixel art reflecting the protagonist's drowning perspective on the world

  • A soundtrack that enhances immersion in this world

4527840.name: Of Grace & Gambit
4527840.about_the_game:
Build a deck of characters and social maneuvers, attend elegant events, and outplay your rivals as you shape your reputation and pursue your place in the marriage market of Regency high society.

The Season Awaits

The silver is being polished, the tea is brewing, the invitations are arriving and the eyes of the ton are watching. In this Regency inspired world, wit and strategy are your greatest weapons. Welcome to Of Grace & Gambit.

Play Your Cards Right

Choose your House and build your deck from their unique collection of cards. At each event you will face an opponent across the table.

  • Character cards: Build a circle of influential allies.

  • Scandal cards: Ruin your opponent's reputation with a well placed whisper.

  • Courtesy cards: Protect your Composure.

  • Item cards: Give yourself an edge with the right accessory.

Can you keep your Composure while making your opponent lose theirs?

Current Houses

The Season Unfolds

When invitations arrive, it is up to you to decide which event to attend. Each event type has its own board, dressed to match the occasion. While you are never sure who you will face, some rivals prefer certain events to others.

Your Reputation precedes you, for better or worse. Win with grace and the ton will take notice. Lose badly enough and certain prospects will not even consider a match with someone whose standing falls short of their expectations.

Make a Good Impression

At the end of every event, the ton will have their say. A decisive victory will leave one kind of impression where a bold display will leave another. 

Each season, five prospects are randomly drawn from a pool of nine, with more being added regularly.  Some prospects admire composure under pressure. Some are drawn to boldness. Will they be watching if you have a public misstep? Most definitely.

If you build enough Regard, and enough Reputation, you may find yourself with a match at the end of the season.

FEATURES

  • A single player game of social dueling. Forget health points, you are trying to keep your Composure. Use Influence to "attack" your opponent's social standing. Spend Favor to play your cards.

  • Multiple Houses to choose from, each with a distinct deck and playstyle.

  • A full season structure with invitation choices and quiet days in between events where prospects may call.

  • A rotating cast of Prospects each season, with their own tastes and reactions to how you play.

  • Unlock new cards and cosmetics by building your House reputation across seasons and matching with prospects.

More features and content are in development.

Of Grace & Gambit is being developed by a solo developer with a love for Regency fiction, card games, and characters with opinions. It is a work in progress and your interest means a ...ton. Wishlist to follow development and be notified when the season begins.

Society is assembling. The cards are being shuffled. The season begins soon.

4527860.name: Slay Them All
4527860.about_the_game:
Click. Slash. Upgrade. Repeat.

Slay Them All is a fast-paced dungeon clicker where every click unleashes destruction.

Fight through waves of monsters, collect crystal shards, and spend your gold on a deep upgrade tree that transforms your run from humble beginnings into an unstoppable slaughter.

Short rounds. Big rewards. Always one more upgrade.

  • Click to attack and watch enemies explode in satisfying combat feedback

  • Spend gold on a rich upgrade tree and feel the power spike with every purchase

  • Dive deeper into the dungeon as your power grows

Built for players who love that just one more run feeling.

4527890.name: Sword & Siege Crusades: Book I
4527890.about_the_game:
Crusades: Book I

March east into one of history’s most consequential medieval conflicts in Crusades: Book I, a detailed tactical wargame covering the battles and campaigns of the First and Second Crusades and the battles fought between them.

Beginning with Pope Urban II’s call to arms in 1095, Crusades: Book I follows the rise of the crusading movement from its explosive beginning through the capture of Jerusalem, the creation of the Latin states, and the growing pressure of increasingly organized resistance that culminated in the failed siege of Damascus in 1148.

Take command in Crusades: Book I, where 40-meter hexes and 10-minute turns place you in control of medieval armies fighting for cities, fortresses, roads, and passes. Every battle is shaped by the realities of the age: detailed siege warfare, difficult terrain, fragile supply, and the constant struggle to hold a frontier with limited manpower. Bring medieval sieges to life with Mangonels, Onagers, Ballistae, Trebuchets, Siege Towers, Battering Rams, and ladders.

Command the Armies of the Crusading Era

Recreate the major campaigns of the 1st and 2nd Crusades and the battles between from either side of the conflict.

Lead the forces of the Crusader states and western armies, including:

  • Knights

  • Men-at-arms

  • Spearmen

  • Crossbowmen

  • Archers

  • Pilgrims and levy forces

Or take command of the Islamic alliances and regional powers, including:

  • Turkish cavalry

  • Infantry armed with spears and swords

  • Archers

  • Garrison troops

  • Regional field armies

The historically accurate Order of Battle includes the major forces that fought across the era, allowing you to experience the strengths and weaknesses of both sides — from heavily armed western knights and determined infantry to fast-moving eastern cavalry and defenders fighting for cities and fortresses.

Siege Warfare and Frontier Conflict

The Crusades were not decided by open battle alone. Crusades: Book I captures the full nature of medieval warfare in the Levant and Anatolia, where strongholds, roads, and relief operations often mattered more than simple battlefield victory. Conduct detailed siege operations using Mangonels, Onagers, Ballistae, Trebuchets, Siege Towers, Battering Rams, and ladders to break fortified positions or defend them against assault.

Fight across a harsh and contested landscape where:

Cities and fortresses dominate operations

Roads, passes, bridges, and ridgelines shape every maneuver

Supplies and frontage can decide the fate of an advance

A delayed relief force can doom a city, while ample supply can save defenders

From the sieges of Nicaea, Antioch, Jerusalem, Tyre, Edessa, and Damascus to smaller clashes, marches, ambushes, and defensive stands, Crusades: Book I recreates the military realities of an era where every victory had to be held against inevitable counterattack.

74 Detailed Scenarios

Crusades: Book I includes 74 scenarios covering a wide range of actions and engagements, including:

  • A solo tutorial scenario

  • Five training scenarios

  • Historical battles

  • Variant scenarios

  • What-if scenarios

  • Specialized versions for both head-to-head play and play against the AI

The game covers major and lesser-known actions from across the 1st and 2nd Crusades and between, including battles such as:

  • Nicaea

  • Dorylaeum

  • Antioch

  • Ma'arat al-Numan

  • Jerusalem

  • Ascalon

  • Heraclea

  • Ramla

  • Acre

  • Harran

  • Tripoli

  • Tyre

  • Aleppo

  • Edessa

  • Ephesus

  • Damascus

Two Branching Campaigns

Two dedicated campaigns containing 23 scenarios allow you to follow the major events of the era through a connected series of battles and strategic decisions.

Play through the First Crusade or the Second Crusade, from either the Crusader perspective or the Islamic alliance perspective. These branching campaigns allow player choices to shape the path forward, with strategic decisions influencing which scenarios follow and how the campaign unfolds.

Extensive Maps and Medieval Visual Detail

A range of historically accurate maps are included covering the major locations fought over during the 1st and 2nd Crusades, as well as lesser-known battlefields.

The game also includes extensive 3D unit graphics representing the major armies of the era, bringing the crusading world to life on the battlefield.

Powerful Editing Tools

Customize and expand your experience with a full suite of editors, including:

Campaign editor

Scenario editor

Sub-map editor

Use these tools to modify existing content or create new medieval engagements of your own.

Multiple Ways to Play

Multiple play options include:

Play against the computer AI

Play-By-Email (PBEM)

LAN and live Internet play

Two-player Hot Seat mode

4527900.name: Sword & Siege Crusades: Book II
4527900.about_the_game:
Crusades: Book II

Continue the struggle for the eastern Mediterranean in Crusades: Book II, a tactical medieval wargame covering the wars that followed the failure of the Second Crusade and the long contest that led to the Third and Fourth Crusades.

Beginning in 1149, the game follows a period of shifting alliances, fragile Crusader forces, and increasingly ambitious campaigns that reshaped the balance of the region. From the defeat at Inab and the rise of Nur al-Din, to Saladin’s victory at Hattin, the struggle for Jerusalem, the great operations of the Third Crusade, and the shocking diversion to Constantinople in 1204, this is an era defined by endurance, reconquest, siege warfare, and grand expeditions strained by distance and logistics.

Take command in Crusades: Book II, where 40-meter hexes and 10-minute turns place you in control of armies fighting across the Levant, Anatolia, and beyond. Storm fortresses, hold vital routes, defend ports, and fight major battles.

Command the Rival Armies of the Later Crusades

Recreate the campaigns of the later Crusading era from either side of the conflict.

Lead the Crusader Alliance, built around:

  • Armored knights and lance cavalry

  • Infantry armed with sword, spear, and axe

  • Crossbowmen and bowmen

  • Sappers and siege crews

  • Ballistas and other engines used to force fortified positions

Or command the Anti-Crusader Alliance, fighting with:

  • Fast cavalry able to strike, harass, and disengage

  • Horse and foot archers armed with powerful recurve bows

  • Spearmen and swordsmen

  • Onagers and other siege weapons used to break strongpoints and resist invasion

The historically accurate Order of Battle captures the changing military character of the 12th century: Crusader armies built around shock action, fortified defense, and siege assaults, facing opponents whose growing strength lay in mobility, missile fire, regional coordination, and the ability to concentrate force at decisive points. The result is a broader and more developed battlefield than Book I, shaped by reconquest, counterattack, and increasingly large-scale coalition warfare.

A Wider War of Sieges, Routes, and Reconquest

Crusades: Book II expands the conflict beyond the foundations of the Crusader states and into a broader struggle for dominance. The frontier is no longer a story of sudden conquest alone, but of repeated campaigns to seize, defend, isolate, and relieve the strongpoints that control entire regions.

Fight across battlefields where:

  • Castles, ports, and walled cities anchor strategy

  • Roads, crossings, and supply lines are vital

  • Field armies must cooperate with garrisons, fleets, and relief forces

Crusades: Book II captures the military character of the period through major sieges, open battles, raids, marches, relief attempts, and desperate defenses. Siege warfare plays a central role, with medieval engines and assault methods helping decide the fate of key strongholds and cities.

From Inab, Harim, Montgisard, Jacob’s Ford, Hattin, Acre, Arsuf, and Jerusalem to the storming of Constantinople, Crusades: Book II recreates an age in which the fight for the Holy Land became part of a far larger contest stretching across the eastern Mediterranean.

102 Detailed Scenarios

Crusades: Book II includes 102 scenarios covering a wide variety of engagements and battlefield situations, including:

  • A solo tutorial scenario

  • Five training scenarios

  • Historical battles

  • Variant scenarios

  • What-if scenarios

  • Specialized versions for both head-to-head play and play against the AI

The game covers actions from the years between the Second and Third Crusades, the Third Crusade, and the Fourth Crusade, including battles such as:

  • Inab

  • Ascalon

  • Lake Huleh

  • Butaiha

  • al-Buqaia

  • Harim

  • Bilbeis

  • al-Babein

  • Alexandria

  • Montgisard

  • Damietta

  • Hama

  • Jacob’s Ford

  • Kerak Castle

  • Hattin

  • Jerusalem

  • Tyre

  • Safed

  • Acre

  • Arsuf

  • Constantinople

Four Branching Campaigns

Four dedicated campaigns containing 26 scenarios allow you to follow the major operations of the era through connected battles and strategic decisions.

Play through:

The Fourth Crusade

The Third Crusade: Anatolia

The Third Crusade: The Levant

The combined Third Crusade: Levant and Anatolia

These campaigns are branching in structure, allowing players to make strategic choices that affect which scenarios follow and how the wider campaign develops. Play from the perspective of either the Crusader Alliance or the Anti-Crusader Alliance as the conflict unfolds across multiple theaters.

Extensive Maps and Medieval Visual Detail

A wide range of maps covers the major locations fought over during the later Crusading era, from the Levantine coast and inland fortresses to Anatolian battlefields and the walls of Constantinople.

All of Crusades: Book II's maps are built from careful study of real terrain and historical locations, helping create battlefields that reflect the operational realities of the age. Crusades: Book II also includes extensive 3D unit graphics representing the major armies involved, bringing the later Crusades to life in rich medieval detail.

Powerful Editing Tools

Customize and expand your experience with a full suite of editors, including:

Campaign editor

Scenario editor

Sub-map editor

Use these tools to modify existing content or create entirely new medieval battles and sieges of your own.

Multiple Ways to Play

Multiple play options include:

Play against the computer AI

Play-By-Email (PBEM)

LAN and live Internet play

Two-player Hot Seat mode

4527910.name: Star Scrap
4527910.about_the_game:
```

Star owes a million credits to the wrong people. The only way out is taking contracts nobody else will touch - and the only backup is Scrap, a salvage drone with a mouth bigger than its thrusters.

Star Scrap is a twin stick space combat roguelite. Take on contracts across 7 zones, fight through up to 100 waves of enemies, collect upgrade cards to build devastating combos, and claw your way out of debt one run at a time. Or throw it all away in Survival mode and see how long you last.

  • 8 weapons from rapid fire blasters to gravity wells that drag enemies to their doom

  • 33 upgrade cards across 4 rarities - stack them, level them up, and unlock devastating synergies

  • Enemies and bosses drawn from a shuffled pool - no two runs play the same

  • Scrap - your drone companion with deadpan commentary on your life choices

  • 9 difficulties from Rookie to Nightmare, plus an endless Survival mode

  • 5 ships with unique passives, permanent upgrades

  • Push your limits in Survival Mode how many levels can you survive? Chase your personal best and see if your friends can beat it

The Loop

Pick a contract. Set your Heat level - higher Heat means tougher enemies but bigger payouts. Fight through waves of increasingly dangerous enemies across asteroid belts, nebula clouds, derelict graveyards, and deep space. Every boss kill shifts you to a new zone. Earn credits, pay down your debt, upgrade your ship, and push deeper.

Build Your Way

Collect scrap from kills to earn upgrade cards mid run. Cards level up when you pick duplicates - max a card and it leaves the pool, thinning your choices toward the build you want. Go glass cannon, stack vampiric lifesteal, build around chain lightning synergies, or find your own broken combo. 4 synergy chains reward specific card combinations with powerful bonuses.

Your Fleet

Start in a rust bucket with 10 card slots. Earn your way through 5 ship tiers, each with unique passives - from post thrust invincibility to double damage after overheating. Higher tier ships get fewer card slots but better stats and heat efficiency. Choose your trade off.

Scrap

Your salvage drone companion reacts to everything - bosses, your health, your terrible decisions, long silences, and the occasional existential observation. 

Original Art & Sound

Original background art, zone transitions, and visual identity. A 14 track original soundtrack that shifts with each zone and combat phase.

Early Access — What's Here Now

  • Complete core gameplay loop - contracts, upgrades, progression, debt payoff

  • 16 enemy types with distinct behaviours

  • 7 multi phase bosses with unique mechanics

  • 8 cooldown/heat based weapons (no ammo management)

  • 33 upgrade cards, 4 synergy chains, card slot system

  • 5 ship tiers with passives and permanent modules

  • 9 contract difficulties + Survival mode

  • Full controller support (Xbox, PlayStation, keyboard + mouse)

What's Coming

  • Additional enemies and bosses

  • Balance refinement based on community feedback

  • Quality of life improvements driven by player suggestions

  • More original music tracks driven by community demand

  • Steam Achievements 

```

4527930.name: Idle Deepcore
4527930.about_the_game:
Dig deeper. Smelt more. Expand the network. The mine must grow.

Idle Deepcore is an incremental mining game where every block you break brings you closer to an underground industrial empire. Start with your mouse. End up leading a network of automated mines plunging into the depths.

From a pickaxe to an empire

Break your first blocks by hand. Extract raw ore. Smelt it into ingots. Reinvest. Then start again, bigger, deeper, faster.

What begins as a simple excavation becomes a network of mines running in parallel, while you are already planning the next one.

Conquer the world map

Claim new mining zones, each with its own terrain and potential. Manage multiple mines in parallel. Decide where to invest for the best long-term return.

The cycle: mine, smelt, upgrade, repeat

Ore alone is not enough. Turn your raw materials into valuable ingots at the smeltery. Unlock upgrades, buy more powerful furnaces, develop advanced mining technologies.

Every layer of progression feeds the next.

Features

  • Incremental gameplay focused on depth and expansion

  • Manual mining and automated production

  • Multiple mines in parallel, managed in real time

  • Claimable mining zones on a world map

  • Smelting system to turn ore into ingots

  • Upgrade tree for machines and technologies

  • Pickaxe upgrades for faster extraction

  • Long-term progression through ever deeper layers

How far will you go?
4527930.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Bulgarian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Danish, Spanish - Latin America, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Norwegian, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Swedish, Czech, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese

4527970.name: The Anomaly Inspector
4527970.about_the_game:
You are an Anomaly Inspector working the night shift.

Your job is simple: walk through each area, inspect for irregularities, and report your findings. CLEAR means everything is normal. ANOMALY means something has changed.

But as the night progresses, the changes become more unsettling.

THE JOB

Objects appear where they shouldn't be. Rooms feel subtly wrong. Sounds echo from empty hallways.

Every decision matters.

FEATURES

  • 48 Unique Anomalies - More in the works!

  • 35 Progressive Levels - More to come!

  • Showpiece Events

  • Professional Voice Acting 

  • Atmospheric Environments 

  • 2-3 Hour Experience

MATURE CONTENT

Psychological horror with implied violence, disturbing themes, and mild jump scares. Not recommended for players sensitive to these elements.

FROM THE DEVELOPER

The Anomaly Inspector is my first commercial game, developed solo as a love letter to atmospheric horror that trusts player intelligence.

Thank you for supporting indie horror.

- Argaze

Can you complete your shift? Or will you become part of the facility's dark history?

4527990.name: Rogue Battler
4527990.about_the_game:
Overview

Rogue Battler is a retro-inspired minimalist auto-battler with roguelike progression, where every decision shapes your run.

Fight your way through a sequence of encounters, choose your path, adapt your build, and survive as long as possible in a fast-paced, strategic loop.

Auto-Battler Combat

Combat is fully automated. Once a battle begins, your character attacks, regenerates, and triggers effects based on their stats.

Victory depends on how well you prepare:

  • Attack, Critical Chance, and Speed define your offense

  • Defense, Evasion, and Shield determine your survivability

  • Health, Regen, and Leech sustain you over time

There is no manual input during combat — only your decisions before it.

Choose Your Path

Before each fight, you are presented with multiple rooms.

Each room determines the type of enemy you will face, influencing the rewards you can obtain. Choosing the right path is key to building a strong and balanced character.

Every run becomes a series of meaningful decisions:

  • Focus on offense, defense, or sustain

  • Adapt to what the game offers you

Bonuses

After winning a battle, you will be offered a selection of bonuses.

These bonuses improve your stats and allow you to shape your build over time. Each choice matters and can drastically change the outcome of your run.

Blessings

Occasionally, you will encounter blessings — powerful upgrades that act as enhanced bonuses.

Unlike regular bonuses, blessings provide significantly stronger stat increases, but always come with a stat penalty. These trade-offs force you to think carefully before committing, as each choice can strengthen your build while introducing new weaknesses.

Blessings can push your build to the next level, enabling unique and powerful combinations if you can handle their downsides.

Roguelike Progression

Each run is different.

With randomized encounters, rewards, and upgrades, no two playthroughs are the same. Success depends on your ability to adapt, plan, and make the right decisions at the right time.

Minimalist Retro Style

Rogue Battler features a clean, minimalist visual style inspired by classic retro games.

Simple visuals, clear information, and fast-paced gameplay create a focused and satisfying experience.

Easy to Learn, Hard to Master

The game is easy to pick up but offers deep strategic choices for players who want to optimize their builds and push further each run.

Survive. Adapt. Choose wisely.

Developer's Note

I'm thrilled to share this game with you. Your support means the world to me as a solo developer. Have fun, and good luck!

Inspired by classic domino gameplay and modern roguelike deckbuilders, Dominoir turns simple tiles into a deep system of combo-building strategy.

Build insane scoring combos

Link domino tiles together to create scoring chains and multiply your score through clever placements.

Discover powerful upgrades

Collect upgrades that dramatically change how you play. Some boost specific tiles, others reward risky plays or chain reactions.

Manipulate the board

Special tile modifiers can transform the board, letting you reshape strategies and unlock new combo opportunities.

Endless roguelike runs

Every run presents new upgrade combinations and strategies to discover.

Easy to learn, hard to master

Classic domino rules meet modern combo-building strategy.

Stylish noir casino atmosphere

Play under the lights of a smoky 1940s casino with a distinctive vintage aesthetic.

Gameplay

Plan your chains carefully

Domino tiles link together to form chains.

The longer the chain, the bigger the multiplier.

But careful placement can unlock unexpected combo paths.

Build a powerful upgrade engine

Upgrades dramatically change how scoring works.

Some reward specific tiles.

Others reward risky plays or clever combos.

Stack the right upgrades and your score can explode.

Tile modifiers change the rules

Special tile modifiers transform the board:

  • Golden tiles boost scores

  • Sticky tiles lock into place

  • Other modifiers open new strategies

Every run evolves in unexpected ways.

House rules

House Rules are powerful modifiers that redefine how the game works.

They can:

  • Change how scoring is calculated

  • Add new effects to tiles

  • Reward risky or unusual strategies

Stack multiple House Rules to create completely new playstyles.

The real strategy is not just playing well —

it’s building synergies that plays for you.

Combine:

  • Upgrades

  • Tile modifiers

  • House Rules

…and watch your score spiral out of control.

4528410.name: Logos Orbit

"A calm space strategy experience where you guide and balance growing star systems and watch how they evolve over time. Perfect for players who enjoy relaxed, experimental gameplay." — CriticForge

Will you delay the heat death of the universe, or spark the birth of new stars?

"Logos Orbit" is a new kind of intellectual action puzzle that fuses the intuition of astrophysics with the logic of game theory. You play as the incorporeal consciousness of a "Tuner," intervening in a minimalist cosmos built of abstract geometry.

Your role is not to move the stars directly. Instead, by placing "Sigils" in space, you rewrite the stars' fundamental properties (their Logos)—such as mass, magnetism, and repulsion—to control their destinies.

🌌 The Iterated Game of Orbital Resonance and Collapse Guide the stars into "Orbital Resonance," a state where they orbit stably without colliding. The longer they maintain this delicate distance, the more "Harmony Points" you generate.

However, the universe is constantly expanding. As the difficulty ramps up, once-beautiful equilibriums are threatened with collapse. Continuously tune these deteriorating orbits and challenge yourself to see how long you can sustain your society of stars (star systems).

Placing just a single Sigil can drastically alter a star's trajectory and avert a catastrophic collision. Experience the overwhelming sense of omnipotence this brings.

Begin your journey to tune the beautiful yet unforgiving orbits of the stars in "Logos Orbit."

The Alaya Network—an anomaly piercing the veil of reality—is a multi-universal gateway fueled by human consciousness. While it has bestowed many with transcendent power, the sedimentation of collective dread and malice has birthed the Void: an entropic force of primordial chaos.

The Great Qian Dynasty, a realm where the ethereal elegance of Wei-Jin discourse meets the majestic spirit of the Tang, is now succumbing to the Void’s corruption. Its former grandeur is dissolving: crumbling jade palaces, temples choked by spectral mists, and distorted sanctums where eldritch horrors intertwine with classical Eastern aesthetics.

You and your cohorts, trespassers from the waking world, convene at Xuansha, the desert fortress linking Great Qian to the Western Regions. Into the silence of the Void, an odyssey of the unknown begins.

✅ Strategic Turn-Based Combat

Master the Eastern Mystic Arts. Command the esoteric techniques of the Hundred Schools of Thought and wield macabre relics to dismantle the spawn of the Void. In this realm, raw power pales before tactical ingenuity. Only by orchestrating your skills and seizing the rhythmic flow of battle can you claw your way out of despair.

✅ First-Person Dungeon Crawling

Step into the fog-shrouded labyrinths through a classic first-person perspective. Navigate grid-based mazes with trepidation, encountering aberrations born of the Void's rot. Every tile moved is a gamble between a fatal ambush and a vital revelation.

✅ Stylized Characters & Aberrant Monstrosities

Recruit four protagonists bound by the fraying threads of reality and illusion: the Taoist Immortal, the Buddhist Exorcist-Monk, the Mohist Sentinel, and the Confucian Scholar. Together, you will stand against the corrupted icons of Great Qian—creatures that are both your greatest peril and the keys to unraveling this collapsing world.

✅ Fragmentary Narrative & Esoteric Puzzles

The truth of Great Qian is not told; it is unearthed. Piece together the descent of the Void through scattered scrolls, cryptic inscriptions, the haunting whispers of survivors, and even digital echoes from the real world. Decode the hidden nexus between the Alaya Network and your own reality.

✅ A Pure, Solo-Developed DRPG Experience

A labor of passion by a lone creator, this DRPG is an uncompromising journey into atmosphere and mystery. Zero microtransactions. Zero multiplayer. Just you, the silence, and the haunting depths of the Great Qian.
