Try the King Arthur-themed mouse and see if your next click can pull the sword from the stone.
Or use the basketball-themed mouse, where every click throws a shot — and landing the ball in the hoop rewards you with a huge pile of coins.

Each mouse theme comes with its own visual style, interaction gimmick, and reward logic.
Every click brings the chance of surprise — rare items, bonus coins, or progress toward unlocking something new.

MouseWorks is a relaxing casual clicker and collection game.
By clicking, collecting, and unlocking more and more themed mice, you turn simple interactions into a constant stream of satisfying rewards.

Features

Switch between unique themed mice

Every mouse has its own design and gameplay interaction. These are not just cosmetic skins — each one feels like a different little toy.

Click for surprises

A simple click can trigger random drops, bonus rewards, and satisfying feedback. Coins, items, and rare finds are always waiting.

Fun and creative themes

  • Duck Theme: Squeeze the duck for a chance to get duck eggs and other rewards

  • King Arthur Theme: Every click gives you a chance to pull the sword from the stone

  • Basketball Theme: Every click throws a ball, and scoring a basket earns a large coin reward

Collect items and keep progressing

Earn coins and rewards as you play, then use them to unlock even more themed mice and expand your collection.

Relaxing and easy to enjoy

Simple to play, satisfying to watch, and perfect for short breaks or long collecting sessions.

Every click is a little bit of work.
And every reward brings you one step closer to building the ultimate collection of hard-working mice.

4528680.name: Hell Smasher
4528680.about_the_game:
What the hell is HELL SMASHER?

Hell Smasher is incremental action-clicker game where YOU are the VILLAIN!

OK - but what the hell that means?

As the Bringer of Doom, Mutilator of Worlds your job is to summon creatures of hell, launch them toward crowds of mortals and smash them into red bloody pulp. Go fast, go far, go smashing!

After each short and fast paced round of destruction you get to upgrade your skill tree and hire new minions into your army of evil. Harvest souls, upgrade stats, smash more mortals next round!

Gether your army of minions. Each of them with different unique ability. Mindlessly mashing a button will only get you so far so you better learn how to use them! Some fly, some tear through mortals like a rhino, some carry bombs and some are gluttonous soul harvesters that spew out souls when popped like a bloody magic balloon.

Grow in strength and breach human defensive positions. Unlock new lands that just wait to be conquered by your army of flesh hungry not-so-alive minions.

How exactly do you play it?

Hell Smasher is simple in nature - one button to do all the actions - every action requires a different clicking pattern to work effectively.

Mix it with an iterative rogue-lite gameloop, grim dark theme where you’re the power hungry baddy squashing mortals, harvesting their souls to upgrade skills and grow your army of minions and you get my game.

Single button mashing + a bit of tactical thinking + skill tree + blood and demons

  • Go fast, go far, squash filthy mortals into bloody pulp, upgrade your skills and stats.

  • Gather up your minions - each with different bonuses and mechanics that activate when squashed.

  • Break human points of resistance to get to new areas.

  • Harvest souls and grow in power. Buy upgrades - expand your skills and minions army!

  • Unlock unique creatures - each with unique playstyle and stats!

4528700.name: Afternoon Patient
4528700.about_the_game:
A Note from the Developer

Please Note: The current screenshots and videos represent Work-In-Progress (WIP) stages of development. As a solo indie developer, I have published this store page to meet Steam’s requirements while I continue to polish the final experience. The lighting, textures, and environments are subject to significant improvement. Thank you for your patience and for supporting an independent project!

The Protocol is Simple: Find the Exit.

You wake up in a quiet, ordinary flat. At first, everything seems normal—until you look at the clock. It’s 2:30 PM. You wait, but the minute hand never moves. The sunlight through the window is frozen. You are trapped in the stillness of an afternoon that will not end.

To find your way back to reality, you must navigate a series of shifting, surreal environments that track the passing of time. Your only "companion" is a heavy, metal IV pole that you are physically tethered to.

Key Features:

  • The Stillness of Time: Experience a world where time has stalled. Each hour brings a new location—from the sun-bleached silence of a residential block to the final, haunting stillness of a cold blue hour.

  • The Burden You Carry: You are not alone; you are anchored. To move forward, you must learn to live with your lifeline. Navigate the narrow geometry of a world caught in time, where your only constant is the heavy metal stand trailing behind you.

  • The Choice to Reconcile: Every step is a delicate negotiation between your freedom and your constraint. Is this pole your support, or is it your prison? You must decide: will you fight against the tether, or will you find a way to reconcile with the burden that follows you?

  • Ambient Horror: There are no jump-scares. The dread comes from the absolute silence, the rhythmic rattle of the wheels on the floor, and the realization that time itself has abandoned you.

In this ward of time, the only way out is through. Keep the wheels moving.

4528860.name: Ball's Mod
4528860.about_the_game:
What is Ball's Mod?

Ball-shaped fighters. Orbiting weapons. Pure physics chaos.
Throw a fighter into an arena, give it a weapon that spins around on contact, and let the physics sort it out. Weapons hit automatically as they orbit — your job is to build the loadout, not aim the swing.

Build Your Own Weapons

Ball's Mod is a weapon playground. The game ships with a full Weapon Lab where you can build weapons from scratch and see changes live:
  • Melee blades that orbit at any speed, size, and angle
  • Ranged weapons that fire projectiles automatically
  • Dual wielding — mix a sword on one side and a bow on the other
  • Attach accessories, particle effects, and custom VFX to any weapon
  • Burn, poison, and ice effects — each with their own stacking mechanics
If you can imagine a weapon, you can probably build it right in the game. No external tools needed.

Build Your Own Arenas

The built-in Map Editor lets you design battlefields from scratch:
  • Place walls, platforms, and destructible blocks
  • Add trigger zones — damage fields, speed boosts, healing areas, knockback traps
  • Set up water zones, gravity fields, and environmental hazards
  • Custom spawn points with directional velocity
Save and share maps as portable folders. Drop them in, they just work.

Build Your Own Effects

Two more editors for the visual side:
  • VFX Lab — multi-track timeline editor for hit sparks, explosions, slashes, and any combat effect you want
  • Particle Lab — full particle system editor with emission shapes, trails, textures, and color curves
Weapons, maps, and effects all use the same portable format. Share your creations by copying a folder.

Make Your Own Rules

Ball's Mod is data-driven from the ground up. You can customize how the game plays:
  • Swap textures, sounds, and animations with zero coding
  • Define weapons, maps, and game rules through simple JSON files
  • Write entirely new game modes — boss fights, survival waves, tower defense
The rules are yours to set. Built-in content and community content use the exact same format. Nothing is locked away.

Features

  • Physics-based auto-combat with orbiting weapons
  • Melee, ranged, and dual-wield weapon types
  • Burn / Poison / Ice status effect system
  • Four built-in editors: Weapon Lab, Map Editor, VFX Lab, Particle Lab
  • Full mod support — assets, data, and scripting
  • Portable JSON format for all user content
  • Rebindable controls and localization support

4528910.name: Plunder Rush
4528910.about_the_game:
Plunder Rush is a 1-4 player online co-op roguelike adventure, where you create and customize your own pirate to brave the tides of Celenor with your crew!

Every voyage presents a fresh gauntlet of challenges. You’ll need to strategically outwit the ocean itself by managing your vessel, upgrading your ship’s defences, and equipping your pirate with a formidable arsenal to take on the world's wacky and wild trials.

No two voyages are the same. Navigate through the Shifting Seas, where weather, island layouts, and encounters change every time you set sail. Work together with your captain and crew to scout the horizon and plot a course that determines whether you’ll find fame and fortune—or the abyss.

As you sail, you’ll discover ways to refit your ship and enhance your voyage to counter the struggles ahead. Be strategic with your modifications; your choices will determine whether your journey is a triumphant success or a short-lived disaster. Adapt or sink!

Fortune favors the bold—and the clever. Seek out lost treasures guarded by the world's enemy factions, or hidden behind environmental puzzles. Every piece of loot is a hard-won victory, earned through the coordination of your entire crew.

When the voyage ends, it’s time to divide the spoils! Bring your share of the loot back to your Cozy Pirate Hub to spend, expand and turn this hub into the dream pirate dock! Purchase new ships, unlock powerful gear, and plan your next grand adventure from the safety of your personal sanctuary.

The further you sail, the more the sea tests your might. Push your crew to their limits as you face the ultimate challenges lurking in the fathomless deep. Do you have what it takes to survive the final tide and uncover the secrets of the Pirate’s End?

4528920.name: Stack Up
4528920.about_the_game:
Step into the world of modern special operations combat.
This multiplayer tactical shooter focuses on teamwork, positioning, and weapon mastery, delivering intense firefights inspired by real special forces engagements.

Victory does not belong to the fastest trigger finger alone.
Every encounter rewards players who understand movement, coordination, and the flow of combat.

Authentic Weapon Manipulation

Many shooters simplify or omit real firearm operations for convenience.
This game brings those elements back to deliver a more grounded and authentic experience.

Players must manage actions such as slide manipulation, hammer control, and realistic reload procedures. Mastering these mechanics is not just about efficiency—it reflects the mechanical depth and craftsmanship of real firearms.

Our goal is to capture the true feel, rhythm, and character of handling real weapons, and bring that experience into gameplay.

Real Special Forces Tactics

Survival depends on more than just aim.
The game rewards players who think and move like trained operators.

For example, in tight interiors, using a High Ready stance allows for faster reaction, while in more open spaces, a Low Ready stance provides better visibility and control. These are fundamental principles drawn from real-world tactical practices.

The game also features a hand signal system inspired by real special forces communication, allowing players to coordinate with teammates even without voice chat.

Beyond these examples, many additional details inspired by real tactical environments are built into the game. Some are immediately visible, while others are left for players to discover through experience.

Built With the Community

The game is actively in development and will continue to expand with new maps, modes, and systems.

We believe the best tactical experiences are built together with the community.
Player feedback will play a key role in balancing gameplay, refining mechanics, and shaping future updates.

4528940.name: Shadows of Gothenburg
4528940.about_the_game:
The year is the 2020s.

Gothenburg is marked by an ongoing investigation into a serial killer.

You play as Erik, an office worker who, after a long and exhausting day, just wants to get home. Snow falls quietly over the city and cold winds sweep through the silent streets. But something about this evening feels different. What begins as an ordinary journey home through Gothenburg gradually turns into an increasingly unsettling experience.

The game is a story-driven thriller horror experience in a first-person perspective. Dialogue choices and interactions shape how the experience unfolds, while you encounter puzzles that must be solved to progress.

This is an experience built on atmosphere, presence and the feeling that something is not right.

Includes

  • An atmospheric depiction of Gothenburg on a late winter evening

  • A story-driven thriller horror game with dialogue choices (multiple choice)

  • Puzzles that are naturally integrated into the game’s progression

  • First-person exploration with a focus on immersion

  • Dynamic sound design that enhances atmosphere and tension

    All you need to do is get home.

4528950.name: THE Fart King
4528950.about_the_game:
"THE Fart King" is a challenging and dynamic parkour game with a rich plot. In this game, players use mechanisms and overcome obstacles to climb to the top, and ultimately, different choices lead to different storylines. If you choose a high difficulty level, falling will result in losing some progress and having to start over.

He was kicked out of the castle by her, suffering a severe fall. When he returned as a king, would he seek revenge with joy or forgive and forget with a smile? "THE Fart King" is coming soon

How to play:

Operate "WASD" to control movement in the forward, backward, left, and right directions, use the "Space Bar" to control the second jump, and press "Shift" to control acceleration.

4529010.name: Flow Reader — Speed Reading Trainer
4529010.about_the_game:
⚡ Read faster. Eliminate hesitation. Perform at your peak.

Flow Reader is a high-performance training system designed to eliminate hesitation, increase reading speed, and sharpen your focus using controlled visual flow.

Most people don’t struggle with typing speed—they struggle with processing speed.

Instead of reading word-by-word, Flow Reader trains you to extract meaning from groups of words using your peripheral vision—allowing you to move through text smoothly, efficiently, and without interruption.

🧠 Why It Matters

Your typing speed is limited by how fast you can read and process information.

If your eyes hesitate, your hands hesitate.

Flow Reader helps eliminate that delay by training your brain to:

• Recognize word clusters instantly

• Reduce micro-pauses while reading

• Maintain continuous flow under speed

🚀 Features

• Dynamic word grouping for faster comprehension

• Adjustable speed controls for progressive training

• Focused reading lane to eliminate distractions

• Real-time performance feedback

• Clean, minimal interface built for flow and precision

⚔️ Built for Performance

This is not a passive reading tool.

Flow Reader is designed for people who want to push their limits, reduce hesitation, and build real speed and control.

🎯 More Tools

Looking to take it further?

Check out additional performance tools and join the community through the in-app links.

🔥 Train your reading. Dominate your typing.

4529020.name: Neo Kinetic
4529020.about_the_game:
Neo Kinetic is a fast-paced anti-gravity racer inspired by classics like Wipeout and F-Zero. Race across the world on over-the-top tracks, tearing through futuristic cities and megastructures at supersonic speeds. Take part in a new era of racing hosted by the Neo Racing League at the dawn of the 24th century, featuring ships that far exceed what was once thought technologically possible.

Features

  • Each ship offers its own playstyle

    Choose from a roster of teams with distinct backgrounds and engineering philosophies, each offering their own ships with varying strengths and weaknesses.

  • Speed classes allow for players of all skill levels

    Choose between three speed classes with significant jumps between each. Start below the sound barrier at your slowest and push far beyond it at your fastest.

  • Tracks which test you limits

    Race across a global lineup of tracks set in futuristic environments. Courses vary in difficulty, from straightforward layouts to complex designs filled with magnetic locking track sections that twist, turn, and loop in gravity-defying ways.

  • Campaign

    Take part in a globe-trotting campaign as you race in the Neo Racing League, competing in races and challenges to climb your way to the top of the standings.

  • Custom Races

    Select a track and race against opponents with combat mechanics or optionally turn of combat if you want a cleaner experience. Time trials allow you to improve you skills on specific tracks without having to worry about lap counts.

4529030.name: Do Not Destroy
4529030.about_the_game:
Do Not Destroy is a single-player first-person action game set in randomly generated, fully destructible cities. Known as the “Concerned Citizen,” you’ll fight against Pluto’s corporate invaders, scavenging their alien technology as you tear through your city and take it back.

Unprecedented Destruction

  • Destroy when, where, and how you want. No restrictions.

  • Break everything from doors, to elevators, to rooftops.

  • Tear through structures without scripted weak points or preset break locations.

  • Optimized to destroy whole buildings smoothly.

A New City Every Playthrough

No two cities are the same. Each full playthrough drops you into a new procedurally generated metropolis that you'll explore, destroy, and reclaim from start to finish. 

Free the City

Aliens from Pluto have taken over with advanced technology and an inhumane ideology! They've brainwashed the humans and turned everyone into NPCs! As the only human left who can see through their lies, you must fight to reclaim your city from the suit-wearing occupiers.

Scavenge Alien Technology

With help from inside Plutie ranks, turn the enemy’s power against them by stealing and repurposing alien technology. Grow from a scrappy Concerned Citizen into an unstoppable force as you build stronger weapons, movement options, and combinations.

Explore Your City

Move through the city on your terms. Enter any building, explore every floor, and carve your own path through a world built to be broken.

4529140.name: Oceanborne
4529140.about_the_game:
A ROBOT WITH A PURPOSE

Set sail into a bright, mysterious ocean in Oceanborne, a colourful, handcrafted 3D adventure RPG where every island hides something new. You play as a robot awakened to repair what’s broken and help bring life back to a world swallowed by clouds.

GATHER TO GROW

Resource gathering is at the heart of your adventure. Chop trees, mine stone, fish the surrounding waters, and fight monsters to collect the materials you need. Every activity feeds your progression, turning exploration and combat into the resources that power your next steps.

CRAFT, REPAIR, PROGRESS

Use what you gather to craft components for repairs and character upgrades. Rebuild damaged structures to permanently reopen routes, unlock new areas, and push farther across the ocean.

POWER THE LIGHTHOUSE

As you explore, you will discover rare Island Heart gems. Bring them back to your lighthouse base to power it up and clear more clouds from the sea. Each Island Heart reveals fresh waters, new islands, and new opportunities to gather, craft, and progress.

EXPAND YOUR BATTERY

Your robot runs on battery power, and your battery grows through play. Repairs, quests, and upgrades increase your capacity, letting you stay out longer, travel farther, and take on bigger challenges.

A SATISFYING ADVENTURE LOOP

Oceanborne is built around a fun, satisfying loop: gather resources, craft what you need, repair the world, and keep sailing into the unknown.

KEY FEATURES

  • Gather resources through tree chopping, mining, fishing, and monster battles

  • Craft components to repair structures and upgrade your character

  • Restore damaged paths permanently to unlock new islands and areas

  • Find Island Hearts to power your lighthouse and clear ocean clouds

  • Expand your battery through upgrades, repairs, and quest progress

  • Explore a colourful ocean world filled with secrets and adventure

Inspired by beloved adventures like Fantasy Life i, Forager, and The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker, Oceanborne invites you to gather, craft, repair, and venture deeper into a mysterious sea of islands. If you enjoyed those games, you’ll feel right at home in Oceanborne.

4529170.name: Long Rest
4529170.about_the_game:
This is our very first commercial game.

We’re just two developers who wanted to challenge ourselves not only to start a game, but to actually finish and publish one.

Your time, feedback, and support truly mean a lot to us :)

Long Rest is a fantasy run game built around a simple tension: your party pushes into a dungeon tier, chests keep appearing, and your heroes move to claim them.


But the curse deepens over time, dealing mounting damage until the tier ends in victory when the curse fully settles or in defeat if the party falls first.

Between runs, return to camp to pick a dungeon tier (higher tiers trade tougher curse pressure for richer rewards), open the skill tree, and spend multiple currencies on chest-focused and global upgrades so the next expedition comes back stronger.

4529190.name: The Bornfire
4529190.about_the_game:
The Bornfire — idle bottomscreen game set in a dark fantasy world inspired by Celtic mythology.

A bonfire is burning on your screen as you perform your daily tasks, turning your taps and clicks into Imbas and Grios — two kinds of resources you can use to unlock fragments of lore, new characters, and artifacts of the world of Tirvalen. Each fragment is part of a larger story about a world that has lost its memory.

In Tirvalen, everything exists because it’s being told about. The land, the people, the spirits — they are Seankhas, a narrated reality. When a story stops being told, it fades. When it’s forgotten completely, it vanishes as if it never existed. The bonfire remembers all that was destroyed. And now it tells the world anew to those willing to listen.

From the flames emerge those the world has forgotten. They sit beside you and speak, if you are there to listen. Each character has two sides of their memory. The light side, unlocked with Imbas, holds what they wish to preserve. The dark side, unlocked with Grios, holds what they'd rather forget. Which memories to uncover? That is for you to decide. Each story revealed brings new characters to the bonfire.

Everything that happens by the bonfire is a ritual. Offerings at the altar determine who will emerge from the flames, how the weather will change, and what sounds will fill the silence. Some items unlock the path to new characters. Others change the balance of the game. Experiment! The results may surprise you.

The crackling of the fire, the sound of the wind, the rustle of the rain. Ambient music and ASMR soundscapes, living on your desktop as a background for work, study, or silence. All music is stream-safe.
The Bornfire is a world you want to stay in. A melancholy in which hope flickers.

4529230.name: Circuit Defense
4529230.about_the_game:
This is a strategy game rooted in classic tower defense. Enemies approach your base from all four directions, following fixed paths toward the center. Your goal is to construct defensive towers around the base and stop them before they break through your defenses.

What sets this game apart from traditional tower defense is its core mechanic: the Power Grid system. The rules are simple:

  • Power lines expand outward from the base, forming a grid.

  • All building modules must be connected to the grid in order to function.

  • The more powered connectors a building has, the stronger it becomes. Each additional connector grants a 100% attack speed bonus.

Under these rules, how you design and expand your power grid becomes the heart of the strategy. Power lines themselves occupy tiles on the map, so you need to carefully manage space while extending electricity to your buildings. You also need to plan ahead and leave connectors available for future expansion.

Different towers have different numbers of connectors, and each additional powered connection provides a significant boost. Because of this, fully powering a single tower using cheap power lines is often more effective than simply building more towers.

However, buildings placed along enemy paths can be attacked and destroyed. This means your power lines are vulnerable as well, and protecting your grid becomes an important part of your defensive strategy.

In addition to the power grid system, the game also includes several supporting mechanics to deepen the gameplay:

  • Building Synergies – Some modules provide bonuses to nearby structures, such as buff modules with area effects or resource modules that gain benefits when placed next to each other.

  • Active Skills – For example, Overclock, which temporarily boosts the global attack speed of all towers.

  • Fog of War (Experimental) – Some towers can shoot farther than they can see. Enemies must be inside revealed areas to be targeted, so radar modules are needed to expand your vision and unlock the full potential of long-range defenses.

In this game, success isn’t just about building more towers. Carefully planning your power grid, managing space, and protecting critical connections are the keys to building an effective defense.

4529260.name: Infinite Dungeon: Idle Adventure
4529260.about_the_game:
• Assemble your roster, scale your economy, unlock advanced systems, and push deeper into the dungeon every run.

  • The core loop is easy to start and hard to quit: optimize damage, boost speed, trigger powerful effects, and keep climbing.

Core Gameplay

Idle progression with active decisions:

  • Your team fights automatically, but your upgrade path, unlock timing, and build priorities decide the outcome. 

    "Damage over time dominates the long run"

Strategic build crafting:

  • Mix hero damage type, damage styles, and unlock paths to create powerful synergies.

    "Area of Effect clears crowded waves fastest"

Endless scaling:

  • Progression is built for long-term growth with higher floors, stronger enemies, and deeper optimization.

    "When stuck, try cursed damage - it scales with enemy max HP"

Prestige progression:

  • Prestige for permanent power, unlock new systems, and return stronger every cycle.

    "Attack frenzy always wins (RIP your non-stop clicking finger)"

Key Features

  • 10 total heroes to recruit and unlock over time.

  • 4 active hero slots.

  • Global upgrades for economy, combat power, and scaling efficiency.

  • Global unlocks with high-impact mechanics and late-game specialization.

  • Hero skills and advanced skills for deeper tactical identity.

  • Multiple damage/defense interactions for build diversity and counterplay.

  • Prestige system!

  • 2 special upgrades to discover in-game... with luck, you might use them before your next prestige!

4529300.name: De profundis 1454
4529300.about_the_game:
De Profundis 1454 is a turn-based tactical game, set in the first year of the war between the Teutonic Order and the Kingdom of Poland. As a player, you lead a group of simple civilians- outcasts, who are trying to survive in the area of ​​​​several armies, each of which uses scorched earth tactics.

The people you have under your command are not proud knights in shining armor, not mercenaries, dogs of this war, who make a living out of it. Not even brigands, armed and very familiar with violence. A bathouse wench. City executioner. Ratcatcher. A group of street urchins. A nun. Fighting not for a king or a golden coin, but to survive another day, to get another meal.

Use the terrain, your opponent's weaknesses and the strengths of your people to secure a victory, but always remember, that cold, sickness and hunger kill as easily as a sword, and the greatest danger may not always come from the enemy, but from those who are next to you.

A game created by nerds for nerds, in which the reconstruction of buildings and units is based on archaeological and archival research. 4529350.name: 15LANDS: Where Stars Fall / 十五区：星落何处
4529350.about_the_game:
"System self-check complete. Welcome back to 'Campfire'—the only warmth left in a freezing sea of data."

---

This is a world where logic reigns supreme and emotions have run cold. Scientists claim our brains are suffering from irreversible "inertial degeneration." To keep civilization going, the government pushes puzzle-solving on everyone: your social status, healthcare, and even your right to an apartment are entirely tied to your "Spark Level." Brainpower has become the only measure of a human's worth.

And you? You're just a cog in this massive, ruthless machine. As a recently laid-off senior programmer from Titan Crowdsourcing, you've been handed a baffling gig: fix the old, bug-ridden, and long-forgotten "Campfire System."

---

As the system boots back up, the grayed-out avatars in your contact list—silent for years—suddenly light up.

You chat about your busy lives, trying to gloss over the awkward silence. The kids who once stargazed together are now just tired adults, heads down, rushing through the daily grind.

---

When you hit 'Enter' on the repair command, the screen doesn't just spit out a cold "Success." Instead, it bleeds into vivid, first-person memories.

You'll step into these wonderful moments in all sorts of ways.

---

- Craving a coffee from Odd Corp? You'll need to beat the logic puzzle on the ordering screen first.

- Need to move a herd of cows blocking the road? Better arrange their spots into the right pattern.

- When things like playing soccer, running, or painting are dismissed as "low-intellect" wastes of time, do you still dare to admit you just want to break a sweat and feel alive?

---

The teenagers in these memories lived under very different roofs. There were no literal monsters here, just the suffocating silence of the dinner table, and the sharpest weapon of all: "I'm doing this for your own good."

Perhaps it's a quiet kind of pain you know all too well.

---

Inside the "Campfire System," your to-do list is way more fun than you'd expect. Fixing code is just the start. You'll also dive into all sorts of quirky daily routines within this tiny screen:

- Will you rack your brain over daily puzzles to grind your "Spark Level"?

- Or plant a seed and gamble on whether it sprouts a rare flower or just catnip?

- Maybe you'll catch up on the news, debate philosophy with a cat (?), or just call an old friend.

- Collect picture book pages, write in your diary, or chat with the local shopkeeper... In this day-night cycle, you'll need to manage your time and try your luck when the store is actually open.

---

You'll need to play detective, pulling the truth from clues scattered everywhere:

- A snippet of conversation;

- A diary entry;

- A news pop-up;

- An audio recording;

- A text memo;

- Or maybe something else entirely...

---

Here, the art style shifts right along with your journey.

Retro pixels, vibrant collages, abstract cartoons, black-and-white decorative art... These completely different styles piece together a landscape of memories you can almost touch.

---
15LANDS: Where Stars Fall — To the wonderfully unremarkable, who outshine the stars.

4529440.name: Football Director
4529440.about_the_game:
Version 0.1 Features:

  • 2 Available Countries (Spain and England)

  • 6 Divisions (4 from England and 2 from Spain)

  • Over 6,000 players

  • Over 1,500 staff members

  • Over 100 sponsors

  • 8 Facilities to upgrade or build

  • Club Vision System where you decide your club's philosophy

Football Director — Your club. Your business. Your legacy.

Football isn't won just on the pitch. Behind every champion team there's a director who made the right calls: the signing no one saw coming, the manager who changed the dressing room mentality, the sponsor that made it possible to build a competitive squad. In Football Director you don't sit on the bench, you sit in the boardroom. You're the owner, the CEO, the one who decides the direction of the club from its very foundations. You don't pick formations or give tactical instructions here. You decide who does that for you.

Every season is a test of management. You have a limited budget, a squad that needs reinforcements, a coaching staff that might not be up to the task, and fans demanding results. Your job is to build a structure that works: find the right manager, surround them with the right staff, and give them the players they need to compete. Get it right, and results will follow. Get it wrong, and the consequences are yours to bear.

A club is a business, and you run it

Football Director replicates the real structure of a professional football club. You're not just managing a squad of players, you're running an entire organisation with four departments that need to work like clockwork: Sporting Direction, Medical Department, Marketing, and Finance. Each department is made up of employees with their own attributes, performance levels, and salaries. You decide who to hire, who to fire, and how much you're willing to pay for the talent you need.

Your sporting director will be your right hand in the transfer market. Your head of medical will determine how your players recover from injuries and how long they take to return to the pitch. The marketing department will influence your club's ability to attract sponsors and generate revenue. The finance department will keep the books in order — or not — depending on who you put in charge. Every hire has a direct impact on the club's overall performance. A good sporting director will bring you better transfer options. A mediocre medical team will mean your players spend more time in the treatment room than on the pitch. Everything is connected, and everything depends on you.

It's not just about having the best starting eleven. It's about having the best structure. Clubs that win leagues don't do it just because of their players — they do it because behind the scenes there's a solid organisation that makes everything work. That's your job. That's Football Director.

Matches are won in the boardroom

When matchday arrives, you've already done your work. You signed the players, hired the manager, and gave them the tools to compete. Now you sit back and see if your decisions were the right ones. Football Director's simulation engine plays out every match minute by minute, using a system that accounts for dozens of variables: each player's individual quality, their current form, their accumulated fatigue, their morale, any injuries they're carrying, and the coaching staff's tactical ability.

You won't see a static match or a simple final score. You'll watch your team wear down physically over the course of ninety minutes, see how a player with low morale performs below their level, how an unexpected injury in the 30th minute forces the manager to restructure the team. The substitution system follows the current three-window rules, and the coaching staff's AI makes decisions based on the match context: whether the team is losing, whether a player is exhausted, whether they need to protect a result.

Every match is a direct consequence of what you've built. If you invested in a good medical team, your players will arrive fresher. If you hired a manager with sharp tactical awareness, the substitutions will be smarter. If you cut corners on the squad, you'll pay for it when the season gets tough and injuries pile up. In Football Director, matches aren't won with instructions from the touchline — they're won with the decisions you made weeks, months, and seasons before.

Finances, transfers, and the art of building without going under

Money is everything and yet it's never enough. You can have the biggest budget in the league, but if you manage it poorly, you'll end up in a spiral of debt that drags the club down for years. Football Director puts you in charge of a club's real finances: television revenue, matchday income, merchandising, and sponsorships versus wages, transfer fees, infrastructure, and staff costs.

The transfer market is where great projects are forged and where badly planned ones go to die. Every player has a transfer fee and a salary that will impact your accounts for the entire length of their contract. Signing the star everyone wants can give you an immediate competitive boost, but it can also compromise your ability to strengthen other positions. Do you prefer one superstar and an unbalanced squad, or a well-rounded team that can compete on all fronts? That tension between ambition and sustainability is at the heart of the game.

Sponsors are another key piece of your financial strategy. As your club grows in reputation and results, new brands will want to be associated with you. Every sponsorship deal has its own terms, duration, and financial impact. Negotiating well can give you the margin you need to sign that midfielder you're missing. Negotiating badly can leave you tied to a deal that doesn't reflect your club's true value. Financial management isn't a side feature of the game — it is the game.

Leagues, players, challenges

Football Director in its version 0.1 includes the leagues of Spain and England. Thousands of players with detailed, position-specific attributes make up the squads of the clubs you'll find in the game. A full-back who bombs forward isn't the same as one who prioritises defensive cover, and that's reflected in every player profile.

Each league has its own dynamics. The AI teams compete against each other under the same rules as you: their players get tired, get injured, lose form, and go through good and bad runs. There are no hidden advantages or shortcuts for the machine. The simulation is fair and symmetrical, which means your victories will be earned and your defeats will have a real explanation.

The game is designed to grow. The Spanish and English leagues are the starting point, but the plan includes adding new national competitions, leagues from other European countries, and continental tournaments that will expand the scope and depth of every save. Each new league won't just be another setting — it will be a new market with different players, rules, and challenges that will enrich your experience as a director.

A game in progress, shaped by your voice

Football Director is in active development and will arrive on Steam in Early Access. This means you're entering a living project that grows with every update. The foundations are already built: the simulation engine, the employee system, finances, sponsorships, and the management interface are all working. But what's coming is even more ambitious.

On the horizon are European competitions, a youth academy system to develop talent from the age of 12, the ability to sell club shares to secure funding, league assemblies, and random events. Every update will bring new features that expand what you can do as a director.

This isn't a game made by a big studio with a massive budget. It's an indie project made with passion for football and management games, inspired by those classics that kept you hooked for hours. Your feedback matters. Your suggestions will shape development. Football Director is built with you.

4529720.name: 我是小保安
4529720.about_the_game:
Game Background

Golden Home in Pingfan City is an ordinary-looking old residential compound, yet it hides a secret that could upend the global power hierarchy. Here lives Wang Dazhu, the security guard, who uses a single copy of the Community Management Code to put all arrogant super-powered individuals in their place!

Thor storms into the compound riding thunder and lightning, only to be slammed into the ground by the boom barrier for failing to register. A sword-wielding cultivator shows off his aerial skills and accidentally flips his trousers, only to be subdued by a clothes drying rack. An underground boxing champion disturbs the residents with loud noise, and ends up tied up like a zongzi dancing to square dance anthems. The mighty Nine-Tailed Fox runs amok, yet its divine power is sealed by a 9.9-yuan plastic dog leash…

When the top powerhouses on the global ranking clash with the toughest community property rules, will thunderous power crush everything, or will the Management Code prevail over all superpowers? As a player, you will immerse yourself in Golden Home, witnessing Uncle Wang tame all kinds of "demons and ghosts" with regulations. You will also make critical choices: strictly enforce property rules and issue fines, or flexibly mediate neighborhood disputes? Help superhumans integrate into the community, or safeguard the peaceful daily life of the compound?

From Thor compensating for broken floor tiles and the Flame Lord stoking the boiler, to establishing a Superhuman Mutual Aid Association and drafting a Global Code for Superhuman Community Integration, this community security guard has quietly reshaped the world order. There are no earth-shattering salvation declarations here—only simple rules like "Vehicles must be registered", "No high-rise littering" and "Keep noise within limits". Yet these rules make the strongest bow their heads and bring chaos to order.

Immerse yourself in the "Community Makeover Story" of superpower big shots, unlock dozens of hilarious iconic scenes and fun interactive moments, and realize amid laughter: true power is not about conquering the world, but guarding the order of ordinary life.

Are you ready to become the "Rule Guardian" of Golden Home?

Featured Systems

Investigation

During gameplay, players will conduct investigations, with different investigations yielding different items.

Choice

In key story segments, players' decisions will determine the direction of the subsequent plot.

Strategy

As the story progresses, the order of investigations will affect different plot developments.

Reaction

In events requiring quick responses, correct or incorrect reactions will shape the follow-up storyline.

Branching Paths

Different story branches will reward players with distinct items, corresponding to varied plot outcomes.

4530030.name: MURINO: The Fog Is Coming
4530030.about_the_game:
MURINO: The Fog Is Coming is an atmospheric first-person horror game about the life of a courier in the endless district of Murino, where towering apartment blocks disappear into the fog, familiar routes stop being reliable, and an ordinary delivery job gradually turns into a fight for survival.

The player lives in one of Murino's apartments, in Building P-352, and works as a courier. Each day begins like a routine: accept an order, leave the apartment, pass through entrances, courtyards, and service passages, reach the destination, and return home. But in Murino, even simple work quickly becomes dangerous. The buildings here stretch on endlessly, the courtyards all look alike, and the Fog and Samosbor make familiar paths less and less safe.

In the world of the game, no resident has a name - only a personal identifier. Every citizen here is part of a system of record-keeping controlled by the PARTY. Even money in Murino is not really money: instead of a conventional currency, the city uses QVT - quota, a unit of account that reflects not so much wealth as an allowed volume of consumption. It is a currency designed not for freedom, but for control - another way to turn everyday life into a regulated norm.

An important part of the game is the radio.
As you play, you can listen to music, news, and broadcasts from different stations, through which the structure of Murino is gradually revealed.
On the radio, you will hear:

UKV-01 "ORDER" - the official voice of the PARTY, propaganda, reports, and the justification of violence in the name of stability

VANYA FM "NAMES LIVE" - the revolutionaries' broadcast, the conflict with the PARTY, calls to action, threats, and an alternative truth

"THE FOG HERALD" - myths, rumors, legends, and disturbing stories about what is happening in Murino

"DELIVERY 24" - everyday background noise, the routine of courier life, advice, instructions, and a sense of false normality

In MURINO, the radio is not just music in the background. It is one of the main sources of information about the world, the events unfolding in the city, the clashes between the PARTY and the revolutionaries, the suppression of protests, disappearances, and the things people in Murino do not speak about out loud.

The sewer system plays a separate role - the lower layer of the city, hidden beneath courtyards and entrances. It is not just a shortcut, but an important part of exploring the world. Here, you can find an underground shop and get items that help you survive another trip out: cigarettes, alcohol, food, and other things that create the illusion of stability and control over your own life. In Murino, even such small comforts become part of survival.

As the game progresses, the courier's routine begins to intersect with larger events. Orders, routes, choices, and contact with different sides of the conflict gradually pull the player deeper into the life of the city. Murino remains a residential district only on the surface - in reality, it is a closed system where the Fog hides what should not be seen, the PARTY controls everyday life, and every time you leave your apartment, you may end up somewhere you were never meant to reach.

The entrances in Murino rise so high that no one knows how many floors they really have anymore. Among the residents, one simple warning is passed around: the main thing is never to end up on the 1001st floor.

4530250.name: End of Empires: Breaking the Cycle
4530250.about_the_game:
END OF EMPIRES: BREAKING THE CYCLE is a Sci-Hy (scientific hypothesis) game—the second in the genre WILLSWAYSTUDIOS is pioneering. It explores Center Libertarianism through play: a multi-perspective 3D strategy-ARPG set in World War III where you survive, craft, build, fight, and participate in counter-economics and direct democracy. The entire world—every building, character, and vehicle—is built from code at runtime. No imported 3D models.

---

[DETAILED OVERVIEW]

The world is stuck in a cycle. History oscillates between unipolar superpowers and multipolar competition. Empires rise, overreach, and fall. END OF EMPIRES: BREAKING THE CYCLE presents this as a playable theory: you experience the anacyclosis cycle (Monarchy → Tyranny → Aristocracy → Oligarchy → Democracy → Mob Rule → Collapse) as NATO and BRICS+ clash across multiple theaters in 2035.

But there is an alternative. The Agora Network—a parallel system of counter-economics and direct democracy—operates behind the front lines. Your choices: perpetuate the cycle or help break it.

Center Libertarianism is the hypothesis the game simulates, an attempt to reconcile left and right libertarianism and their chasm over property. The hypothesis is a socio-economic-political philosophy offering a new framework for a bold economic structure and a new system of organization and direct participation in policy.  Its core axiom: separate private property from the means of production. Consumptive and personal property remain private; productive property becomes commonly owned. Worker cooperatives, land trusts, and democratic enterprises replace oligarchic firms. The game invites you to explore, test, and evaluate these ideas through gameplay—not lectures, while offering an experiment in direct democracy. The template is for a peaceful rev-simulation, while integrating new insights from history. 

---

[KEY FEATURES]

• Sci-Hy gameplay: Explore political and economic hypotheses through simulation

• Center Libertarian win condition: Break the cycle through counter-economics and direct democracy

• Survival, crafting, building: Health, hunger, thirst, energy; recipes and stations; placement and blueprints

• Combat: Melee, ranged (bow, firearms), projectile simulation, destructible environments

• Vehicles: Ground vehicles, helicopters, patrol vehicles

• Multiplayer: Host or join rooms; shared world; real-time sync

• Procedural world: Seven faction capitals (Washington DC, Beijing, Brussels, Brasilia, Moscow, New Delhi, Tehran) on a 2400×1800 map

• Citizen assemblies: Participate in direct democracy; draft declarations and constitutions

• Custom engine: Every building, character, tree, and weapon built from code at runtime—no imported 3D assets

• Day/night, weather, seasons: Dynamic sky, clouds, rain, storms, lightning

---

[TECHNICAL NOTE]

END OF EMPIRES: BREAKING THE CYCLE runs on a custom engine that generates the entire visual world from TypeScript at runtime. Buildings, characters, vehicles, trees, and terrain are all procedural—parametric geometry, PBR materials, and deterministic generation. The result: a tiny distribution size, deterministic multiplayer, and a world that can be fully described by code. The EmpireEngine was built while making the game. 

---

[PHILOSOPHY]

"The Empire Game is the problem, and Center Libertarianism is a possible solution."

The game teaches through systems. You experience why empires fall and discover that alternatives exist—a truly democratic experiment that breaks the cycle of elite theory.

Explore a lost civilization

4530480.name: Feed The Hole
4530480.about_the_game:
About This Game
In Feed the Hole, you play as Keith, a regular guy running a strange little operation where fishing, hauling, and selling are the heart of the day. The loop is hands‑on and tactile: cast, catch, carry, cook, chop, and cash out—then upgrade your setup and keep the hole fed.

What you actually do:

  • Fish with real cast control
    Charge your cast, launch a bobber, and wait for a catch. Fish scale in size and mass, so every catch feels different and affects value and handling.

  • Automate with an auto‑fisher
    Power on an auto‑fisher to cast bobbers on its own and dispense catches to a point you choose.

  • Grab, carry, and throw with physics
    Pick up objects, move them smoothly, and even charge a throw for distance.

  • Use a magnet tool
    Pull multiple fish toward you at once with a magnet stick to speed up gathering.

  • Bucket your haul
    Drop fish into a bucket that safely holds and disables their physics. Tip it to empty contents with a quick pour.

  • Cook for higher value
    Place fish on a campfire to cook them, cooked fish sell for more, but leave them too long and they burn.

  • Chop into chunks
    Use the knife tool to cut fish into pieces; chopped chunks keep the cooking state and can be sold.

  • Check prices and sell
    Use the pricing gun to see the value of a fish or a full bucket. Drop items into the hole to feed the hole and get that hard earned cash

  • Buy and unlock gear
    Spend money at shops to spawn items or unlock rods, then equip them via the item switcher or rod wall.

4530500.name: Under Review
4530500.about_the_game:
YEAR 1985. WELCOME TO THE HEART OF BUREAUCRACY. You have just started your new job as a Human Resources clerk in a government agency. Your task: review incoming applicant files and decide who gets hired—and who doesn't.

However, these files contain much more than simple job applications. Rumors of an unidentified disease are beginning to echo through the agency's corridors. The pressure is mounting, and every hiring decision carries far more weight than it should.

Review the documents, cross-check the records, manage your budget, and protect your reputation. Under Review is a decision-driven game where cold bureaucracy, moral ambiguity, and a growing mystery collide.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Document Review: Examine incoming applicant files. Cross-reference stamps, signatures, and personal details with the rulebook. Every single detail matters.

  • Budget Management: Earn your salary and get bonuses for correct decisions—but pay the price for your mistakes. Manage your rent and stay financially afloat.

  • A Growing Mystery: Strange rumors are spreading. An unidentified illness, unusual directives from above... Uncover the dark truth the agency is trying to hide.

  • Moral Decisions: Follow the rules blindly or bend them. Every choice has consequences—not just for the applicants, but for you and your surroundings.

  • 1980s Atmosphere: A handcrafted retro aesthetic brought to life through AlterOS—a bureaucratic computer system distilled with cold, corporate tension.

  • Multiple Endings: Your cumulative decisions shape the outcome. Will you uncover the truth, or become an accomplice to the system you serve?

4530520.name: Hostile Entity
4530520.about_the_game:
Reality has been breached.

You are an agent of The Reality Compliance Office (T.R.C.O.), a covert government division responsible for containing supernatural threats and unexplained anomalies. When a catastrophic rift in reality begins swallowing people, locations, and entire task forces, T.R.C.O launches a classified operation known as Project NOCLIP.

Multiple agents have entered the breach.

None have returned.

You are the next agent sent into the anomaly — a distorted dimension filled with twisted environments, hostile creatures, and impossible structures that defy the laws of reality. Somewhere inside this labyrinth, an entity known only as Smiles controls the chaos.

But the anomaly has a darker origin.

The rift was created by the tortured soul of a boy who died during a classified experiment conducted by T.R.C.O. The weight of his suffering fractured reality itself, creating a gateway where nightmares bleed into the real world.

Now the entity behind the breach has built a maze of hostile dimensions to trap anyone who enters — and to make the world suffer as he did.

Your mission is clear:

Enter the breach.
Eliminate the threat.
Close the rift before reality collapses.

Game Features

Explore 30+ Levels
Fight your way through a series of dangerous environments within a warped dimension where every level presents new threats and challenges.

Intense Boss Encounters
Face powerful hostile entities guarding the depths of the anomaly, each with unique attacks and mechanics.

Fast-Paced Top-Down Combat
Dodge, fight, and survive against relentless enemies in a brutal action-driven experience.

Uncover the Truth
Discover what really happened inside the T.R.C.O experiments and the events that created the breach.

Escape the Maze
Survive the anomaly and stop the entity controlling it before the damage spreads into the real world.

4530530.name: Welcome to Bloomroots
4530530.about_the_game:
Welcome to Bloomroots 

A Roguelike built around a simple cycle: calm by day, chaos by nite.

In the daylight, explore a peaceful, open pixel world as you gather Bloomroots scattered across the land. Plan your route, collect Bloomshines, and prepare for what is coming.

When nite falls, everything changes.

The same Bloomroots you harvested twist into Bloomrots. They are hostile, relentless, and hunt you down across the darkness of nite.

Welcome to Bloomroots goes deeper

The world shifts across four distinct seasons, each introducing new challenges, mechanics, and ways to play. From environmental effects like fog and rain to changes in Bloomrots behavior—their speed, aggression, and pursuit—every season forces you to adapt.

Each season contains 7 exciting modes, from easy to hardcore, along with unique special modes.

In total, 24 modes challenge you to master the cycle, including a “Reach Nite 13” survival challenge in every mode.

Just Vibes

A carefully crafted lo-fi soundtrack with over 100 tracks is designed to mirror the emotional rhythm of the game:

Daytime tracks are upbeat, warm, and lightly energetic, keeping the pace flowing as you explore and gather.

Nite tracks shift into chill, slower, and more atmospheric tones, creating tension, focus, and a sense of unease as danger closes in.

Each of the 13 days and nites in every season features its own track, subtly reinforcing progression and the passing of time.

So much to do

Collect Bloomshine to fuel your progression and upgrade 11 different player stats, shaping your strategy and pushing your survival further with each attempt.

Between runs, expand your experience through the Bloom Plaza, where new gameplay elements can be unlocked:

Sweetroots – grow and collect powerful power-ups
Stoneshines – mine rocks for valuable gems
Wildroots – discover rare, hidden Bloomroots
Elite Challenges – in-game achievements

It’s a loop of preparation, transformation, and survival, layered with depth, variety, and constant escalation.

How long can you last when the world itself turns on you?

Key Features

  • Day-to-nite gameplay loop: peaceful gathering shifts into intense survival

  • Four unique seasons, each with distinct mechanics, pacing, and environmental effects

  • 24 total modes, including difficulty tiers and special gameplay modifiers

  • “Reach Nite 13” challenge for extended survival runs

  • Bloomrots that evolve in behavior, speed, and threat level

  • Over 100 music tracks with dynamic day/nite and seasonal variation

  • 11 upgradeable player stats for deep progression and strategy

  • Bloom Plaza hub with unlockable systems and gameplay expansions

  • Endless open world with replayable Roguelike structure

Gameplay Overview

  • Explore an open world during the day

  • Harvest Bloomroots and gather Bloomshines

  • Prepare for the coming nite

  • Survive as Bloomrots emerge and hunt you down

  • Upgrade your stats and unlock new systems

  • Adapt to seasonal changes and mode modifiers

  • Repeat and push further each run

  • Have fun!

4530590.name: Neon Grand Prix
4530590.about_the_game:
Zero gravity racing at epic speeds with an aesthetic inspired by the neon glow of synthwave.

A fast-paced, single-player zero-gravity racer built on precision, control, and no brakes. Tear through a neon skyline at high velocity, where every run demands razor-sharp focus and split-second decisions. 5 handcrafted tracks. Perfect your line. Beat your best time.

4530600.name: Ice Moon Odyssey
4530600.about_the_game:
THE GAME

Ice Moon Odyssey is a hand-painted 2d adventure game. You'll explore, collect specimens, and craft upgrades for your research equipment. Stealth mechanics and 'creature-care' are important too. And you'll need to try not to get eaten by any alien sea monsters while you're out cruising the depths on your sea-bike..

The game takes place on a newly discovered moon of the planet Neptune. A small ice covered satellite which has been dubbed Glacialis. We thought it would be extra cool if life were discovered in the orbit of the mysterious blue gas giant. Afterall, Neptune was named after the roman god of the sea! 

You play as a marine biologist and explorer, known as an Icebreaker. Part scientist, part adventurer. And you have been tasked with documenting all that you find. 

Unless you’ve been living in a pineapple under the sea (or under a rock, Patrick) then you know what’s going on with our environment. About the impacts we humans are having on things. But we're not here to point fingers. Most everyone on our team appreciates sushi as much as the next person.

We know that you know the ocean needs help.

And what it really seems to need most is more geniuses, and big hearts, and heroes to fight for it and to dream up new ways to heal it and protect it.

And that’s where IMO comes in.

You see, there's a feeling we’ve been after. This whole time. A dream of hope. Wrapped up in cobalt-blue, cyan, cerulean, and ultramarine. Millions of hand-painted blue pixels, and music to swoon over, accompanied by the siren calls of never before seen wildlife hidden deep beneath the icy surface of a newly discovered alien world.

4530610.name: Clutch Legend: FPS Career Simulator
4530610.about_the_game:
You're nobody. For now.

CLUTCH LEGEND is an FPS career simulator. You start from the bottom: amateur league, a barely-there contract, a team nobody's heard of. Every week you choose how to train, which maps to study, whether to invest in a coach or push through alone. The game doesn't tell you if you chose right. You find out later.

Choose your role. Build your identity. Are you an IGL who reads the game three rounds ahead, a Sniper who flips rounds with a single shot, an Entry Fragger who creates space by going in first, a Lurker who operates from the shadows, or a Rifler who holds the team together? Your role changes how you play, how others perceive you, and how you grow.

Climb the leagues. Four tiers, multiple regions, playoffs, Major. Every promotion brings better contracts, stronger opponents, and higher expectations. Sign the wrong one and you're locked in for a full season.

Play every round or simulate everything. Follow the match live: kills, plants, defuses, real-time scoreboard on a 2D map. Or simulate in a second.

Your head matters as much as your aim. Stress builds up. A losing streak, a contract weighing on you, pressure from home: at some point you can't ignore it anymore. Manage it or watch your season collapse.

You're a character, not just a player. Every week brings situations that ask you who you are: how do you react when your rival calls you out on social media, what do you do when a teammate is struggling, whether you take the interview or avoid it. Your choices shape a personality that influences your team, your contracts, and the press.

Fame, sponsors, and streaming. Alongside your competitive career runs a parallel one: clips, streams, followers, sponsor deals. Fame is built slowly and lost fast. Manage it well and you unlock premium contracts. Ignore it and you're leaving money on the table.

Chemistry and world championship. Team chemistry builds over time. If you climb high enough, the World Championship awaits: 32 nations, BO3 bracket, Hall of Fame.

No shortcuts. Just decisions.

4530650.name: Reroll or Die
4530650.about_the_game:
Reroll or Die is a turn-based, roguelike deckbuilder where you build a deck of equipment cards, adding and removing them as you progress. But in this dungeon your equipment is useless on its own. You have to power it with dice rolls.

Slot. Strike. Survive.

  • Every turn you roll your dice, draw a hand from your deck, and decide how to combine them to attack, defend or trigger powerful abilities.

  • Don't let bad rolls end your run. Use dice manipulating equipment to reroll, split, combine your dice.

Forge your archetypes

With 100+ equipment and trinkets, the combinations are endless. Discover your own playstyle or try some established ones:

  • Swarm your opponent with lots of D4 and multi-use equipment

  • Focus on precise dice manipulation to trigger "exact value" bonus effects with D8

  • Sacrifice speed for raw power. Use heavy-hitting, but hard to use D12 weapons.

Features

  • A Polyhedral bag: Fuel your arsenal with D4, D8, D12, D20 dice.

  • Branching paths: Pick your route through the branching dungeon as you progress further. Take risks for better loot.

  • Broken builds: Build your deck over the run: add or remove equipment cards to shape your strategy.

  • Narrative events: Encounter strange rooms and helpful inhabitants of the dungeon where your choices or a lucky roll can save or destroy your run.

  • Powerful bosses: Something ancient is lurking in the deepest chamber of the dungeon. Defeat bosses whose unique abilities will challenge your deck-building skills.

  • Meta-progression: unlock new equipment and rare trinkets after every run, ensuring that no two descents into the dungeon are the same

4530690.name: DEPLETED
4530690.about_the_game:
DEPLETED is an upcoming 3v1 asymmetrical horror game focused on tension, strategy, and replayability. We're actively building the game with the community. Join our Discord to test early builds, share feedback, and shape the future of DEPLETED!!

The Mother needs you to complete the ritual for her. Will you be the Ritualist, or become the Sacrifice?



THE RITUALISTS

Step into the hideout as a powerful Ritualist adopted by The Mother. Hunt down and kill all the Sacrifices you lured in there to complete the ritual.


THE SACRIFICE

What was supposed to be a normal trip has turned into a nightmare for you and your friends. Fix the phone or fix the laptop in order to call for help but be careful, the Ritualist can destroy them.


GAMEPLAY

The ritual has begun. Attempt to call for help by repairing the last remaining tools that might save you. Experience the terror in either third-person or first-person perspective.

4530700.name: All Seasons With You
4530700.about_the_game:
What happens when two completely opposite people fall in love? Well, you already know how that ends.

"Oh, sure. Another romantic cliché."

Wrong.

It’s not just a romantic cliché. It’s my romantic cliché!

All Seasons With You is a romantic comedy about a nosy bartender and a lonely executive whose paths cross on an ordinary night — and from that moment on, nothing goes quite the way it should.

Choose which character to play each day and follow their journey through the seasons — their narratives won’t always match, and it’s up to you to decide who’s telling the truth.

That classic dream of growing together... but not always at the same pace.

• Interactive minigames

• Choices that are a bit... questionable

Follow me on Instagram for more game news!

4530740.name: Marmorea
4530740.about_the_game:
Guido Tognocchi is an actor. You may have seen him in an Italian crime drama or in a TV commercial. One thing is certain: his face is more familiar to others than to himself. Yet in the small Italian village of Pietralba, nestled in the marble rock of the Apuan Alps, fame means nothing.

It all begins with a troubling letter from his brother. From that moment on, every certainty crumbles. Guido returns to the mountain village surrounded by marble quarries. There is something ancient and dark in the air—something that does not wish to be found.

Guido must cross the gloomy, smoky village, decipher cryptic riddles, and sift through mysterious letters in the silence of the Apuan peaks. He can rely only on his senses, his clarity, and his sense of direction.

In Marmorea, every shadow is suspicious, every detail a clue to move forward and survive.

Will you uncover the secret of Pietralba?

4530750.name: Overwhelming
4530750.about_the_game:
FACE YOUR OTHER SELF

What if the person you could have been is watching you?

In Overwhelming, you step into two mirrored lives. Odysseus and Ulysses are two versions of the same person, shaped by different choices, different rules, and different ways of understanding the world.

The city looks the same.

But something is not right.

PLAY BY RULES OR NOT

Odysseus lives by structure.

Every action must follow his task.

If you break the rules, something feels wrong. He believes it may even lead to death.

Ulysses is different.

He moves freely, explores at his own pace, and follows his own curiosity.

But the more he searches, the less certain everything becomes.

THE SAME WORLD, DIFFERENT TRUTHS

You will meet the same people.

But you will not hear the same stories.

Characters respond to who you are. Your status, your behaviour, your presence all shape what they choose to reveal.

Sometimes they lie. Sometimes they hide things. Sometimes they only tell part of the truth.

There is no single version of reality.

RECONSTRUCT WHAT YOU THINK IS REAL

Explore through classic point and click gameplay.

Observe your surroundings, interact with objects, and gather fragments of information.

Then return to key moments.

Compare what each character experienced.

Reinterpret what you thought you understood.

The truth is something you build.

FEATURES

  • Two playable protagonists with distinct playstyles

  • Narrative driven point and click exploration

  • NPCs that react differently based on identity and status

  • Conflicting information that must be interpreted by the player

  • Replay system to revisit and compare events

  • Semi open world with diverging experiences

  • Psychological and atmospheric storytelling

4530790.name: False Flag
4530790.about_the_game:
This is a short puzzle platformer.

The objective may seem simple at first, but progressing through levels requires understanding how each situation works rather than following standard platforming rules.

Each level introduces a small twist. You will need to observe, experiment, and sometimes rethink what the “correct” action is.

Game Rules

Move through the level and interact with the environment.

- Not every goal leads to progression

- Hazards such as falls, fire, and traps are part of the solution

Level Design

Each level is built around a specific idea.

As you progress, new variations and combinations of mechanics are introduced. Some solutions are straightforward, while others require trial and error.

Gameplay Features

- Simple controls

- Fast restart

- Short levels focused on a single concept

- Gradually increasing difficulty

This game focuses on a single mechanic and explores it across multiple levels.

4530880.name: BACK*SPACE
4530880.about_the_game:
BACK*SPACE is a liminal space exploration game inspired by many of our favorite takes of liminal space; dead malls, strange corridors, and abandoned places, analog nostalgia. I love liminal spaces myself, and so decided to create the  game I wanted to play. What I love about these spaces is the idea of being alone in the unknown, lost in these strange, surreal rooms, and just being free to explore. I hope to have created rooms that are confusing enough to feel vaguely lost, but not so mazelike so as to feel like a penance. This game has no monsters, no action, no time limit, no intensity, it is intended very much to be a smooth, (mostly) quiet exploration, so action adventurers will not find that kind of satisfaction in this game. at all.

BACK*SPACE has a demo version, which introduces a few of the 16 levels available and their general style. In the demo you can explore one 'rooms' type level, and one 'pools' type level, along with the tutorial and hub.  Try before you buy!  I would appreciate if you left me some feedback.

BACK*SPACE has 16 full levels to explore, all inspired by many different aspects of liminal space, and takes inspiration from the backrooms, poolrooms, malls, and utility corridors. Some familiar takes, some maybe less familiar.

After a brief introductory level, a main Hub allows for access to all 16 levels.  In each level, there is a lost item to be found. Finding all of these items will open the 'final' elevator. Could it lead out of this place? Or just, to more rooms?

Lost items will not always appear in the same location on every investigation, so an explorer may even enjoy multiple walks/playthroughs of the BACK*SPACE.

An explorer is not required to find all of the lost items to 'unlock' anything except the main 'exit', but I hope that adding something to search for it will encourage deeper exploration, and some satisfaction of completing a goal.

These lost items might be tucked away anywhere, perhaps discarded on the floor, hiding behind the furniture, or just left on the table. Are you watching closely?

Some levels are slightly more 'linear' than others. Many rooms are dark, but your flashlight will help. A stuck explorer can save/reload and would restart at the beginning of the current level.

Game Options allow for adjusting sensitivity, mouse invert, VHS/analog effects, 3 save slots, and disabling sound. Saves will store items found, current level, options set, and time played.

The first area is a tutorial of sorts, that will show controls.  This can be played with keyboard/mouse or Xbox controller.

There is minimal audio, but listening closely may help in your search. Otherwise I might suggest playing your favorite vibe playlist and chill in the rooms.

Some areas utilize some flickering fluorescent lights. It is not particularly extreme by any means, but users with photosensitivity should proceed with caution.

A common complaint seen in other similar game discussions is about motion sickness due to the various VHS effects.   I leaned in to the VHS, so, If you are sensitive to motion sickness, try disabling all the VHS effects and headbob settings to smooth out your walk.

The motion in this game I intended to make quite smooth to minimize those kinds of effects.

BACK*SPACE uses UE5 Lumen. I know it goes both ways on Lumen opinions. I also understand that it is possible that Lumen doesn't work on certain GPUs, although I don't know that I can be the official word on Will It Work For You.

I built this whole thing on a preowned GTX 1070 8GB, so, chances are that if you are more modern than that you should have no issues. There are a few places where fps can get a little chuggy, which I hope to learn more and improve.

I made this as a solo developer, obviously utilizing many commonly found assets. I have credited what I have used in game (find all the things!). I did not use AI anywhere in this project.

I hope you enjoy my take on liminal space. I certainly enjoyed learning UE5 and making this. I understand the genre is a little bogged with content, but, I love the rooms, and so I made the rooms.

I average about 20-30 minutes a level, and I made the rooms, so I hope that this exploration will last a wanderer around 8-12 hours if you wanted to search every room, maybe more.  New hiding spots may lead you to different spaces.

Game Asset and other credits are featured in-game on completion.

Wanderers, let me know your feedback on how the game plays for you.  I would appreciate your input on gameplay improvements.

4530890.name: Cyber Bike Duels
4530890.about_the_game:
Cyber Bike Duels is a high-speed head-to-head combat racing game built around pressure, aggression, and split-second decisions. Race against another player online or jump into a private session with a friend. If matchmaking leaves you waiting, an AI opponent drops in so the duel still begins. Every match is a fight for position and survival as you weave across lanes, manage your bike’s strengths, grab health pickups, and time your abilities to break your opponent’s momentum.

Key Features

  • Fast-Paced Cyberpunk Bike Duels
    Race head-to-head in neon-powered combat duels where speed, positioning, timing, and abilities decide the winner.

  • Online Multiplayer Racing
    Battle other players in real-time online matches with public and private lobby support.

  • Private Match Codes
    Create or join private sessions using a lobby ID so you can duel friends directly or organize discord tournaments.

  • AI Opponent Support
    Play against AI racers when another player is unavailable, keeping matches moving even during low-player times.

  • Combat Abilities
    Use offensive and defensive abilities including Fire, Freeze, Shield, and Bomb to attack, defend, and turn the race in your favor.

  • Health, Damage, and Status Effects
    Racers can be frozen, shielded, damaged, slowed, or knocked off rhythm during battle.

  • Dynamic Track Hazards
    Dodge obstacles and collect HP pickups while racing through intense cyber tracks.

  • Multiple Terrain Types
    Race across changing environments including pavement, grass, sand, snow, autumn, beach, and water terrains.

  • Cyber Bike Shop and Garage
    Buy, sell, equip, rename, and upgrade bikes through a dedicated bike shop and garage system.

  • Upgradeable Bike Stats
    Improve each bike’s top speed, acceleration, and handling with up to 10 upgrade levels per stat.

  • Distinct Bike Models and Skins
    Collect cyber bikes with different archetypes, stat strengths, and visual styles such as Neon Blue, Neon Pink, Toxic Green, Sunset Fade, Stealth Black, Carbon Weave, and more.

  • Win Streak Rewards
