4531140.name: Craps Royale: The Ultimate Craps Simulator
4531140.about_the_game:
LEARN CRAPS. TEST STRATEGIES. UNDERSTAND THE MATH.

Craps Royale is not another casino cash grab. It's the most detailed craps simulator ever made — built for players who want to actually understand the game, not just click buttons and watch chips disappear.

Every bet. Every rule. Every payout. Exactly like a real casino table, with tools no casino would ever give you. Think of it as a craps table with an X-ray machine attached — same game, but now you can see through the math.

THE DICE LAB

This is what makes Craps Royale different from every other craps game.

Force Dice — Choose exactly what the dice will show. Want to see what happens when you roll a hard 8 with a full iron cross? Set it up and roll. Test any scenario instantly.

Luck Simulator — Drag from 0% (the table hates you) to 100% (you can't lose). The system analyzes every possible dice outcome against your active bets and picks results based on your luck setting. At 0%, you lose every bet. At 100%, you always win at least one. Now ask yourself: at what percentage does your strategy actually start working?

Table Conditions — Simulate the streaks that every craps player talks about. Cold table? The 7 shows up almost every other roll. Hot table? The shooter goes on a 30-roll run and the 7 practically disappears. Study what those streaks actually do to your bankroll instead of just telling stories about them.

Or just roll fair dice. Turn everything off and play with pure, unbiased random numbers. Your choice, every roll.

EVERY BET IN THE BOOK

42+ bet types. Not 15. Not "the popular ones." All of them.

Pass, Don't Pass, Come, Don't Come (with chips that physically travel to their point number), Place, Buy, and Lay on every point number, Field (configurable double or triple on 12), all four Hardways, every Proposition — Any 7, Any Craps, Aces, Ace-Deuce, Yo, Boxcars. Horn, C&E, Whirl. Big 6, Big 8, Big/Small. And all 21 Hop Bets — the single-roll wagers on specific dice combinations that most simulators pretend don't exist.

If a bet exists on a real craps table, it exists here.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY

Standard Craps — Full Las Vegas rules. Points on 4 through 10. The real deal.

Crapless Craps — Can't crap out on come-out. Points go 2 through 12. Only the 7 wins on come-out. No Don't bets, no Lay bets. A completely different game with completely different strategies.

Easy Craps — Simplified rules with Low Field and High Field bets. No Come, Buy, or Lay. Perfect for learning, surprisingly deep once you understand it.

Each variant rebuilds the entire table — different layouts, different bet zones, different rules. Not a cosmetic toggle. Three real games.

CONFIGURE YOUR TABLE

Set it up like a floor manager:

Choose between 2x, 3-4-5x, or 10x odds. Double or triple payout on Field 12. Decide how the house handles fractional payouts — round down, round to nearest, or exact to the cent. Set minimum and maximum bets from $1 to $25,000. Or pick from four presets: Low Limit for beginners, Standard Casino for Vegas-style play, High Roller for serious bankrolls, or Fun Mode with no limits and maximum payouts.

SESSION LOG — YOUR STRATEGY ON A SPREADSHEET

Every roll records what bets were active, what won, what lost, the exact profit or loss, and what Dice Lab settings were in play. Export it all as a CSV file, open it in Excel or Google Sheets, and run your own analysis.

Test your Martingale over 500 rolls and see the exact moment it breaks. Run your iron cross through a simulated hot table and measure the actual return. Compare your results across three variants. The data is yours.

THE DETAILS THAT MATTER

Voice announcer. Authentic stickman calls on every roll. "Yo eleven!" "Snake eyes, craps!" "Winner six, came the hard way!" "Seven out, line away!" Volume independently adjustable from sound effects.

Win celebrations that match the moment. Small wins get a clean chip cascade. Medium wins get a full-screen callout. Monster wins trigger a golden chip shower across the screen.

Chips that move like real chips. Winning chips cascade back to your stack. Losing chips fly to the house. Come bets travel from the Come bar to their point number. The puck slides to the point.

15 Steam achievements. From your first roll to your ten-thousandth Roll distribution, hardway tracking, balance high and low, total wagered, total won and lost, and more.

Persistent save. Close the game, come back tomorrow. Your bets are on the table, your balance is intact, your stats are waiting.

One price. No ads. No microtransactions. No loot boxes. No daily login rewards. No "energy" timers. Yours forever.

4531990.name: Recipe For Disaster

Recipe for Disaster is an all new competitive multiplayer cooking game with a game show format. Gather ingredients to build powerful food-themed weapons and fight against your friends. The chef who has the most audience votes wins!

Cook Powerful Food-Based Weapons!

With provided recipes, cook a weapon of our choice based on a themed meal. Ensure you successfully cook your weapon before time runs out, or you'll end up with a boring old spatula...

Customize Your Chef!

Customize your character to differentiate yourself from other players! Players can choose from various skin tones, eye shapes, hats, noses and facial accessories. 

Gather Ingredients Under Pressure

Gather ingredients and follow the recipe to cook the recipe of your choice. Watch out for other players, as they can shove you and drop ingredients from your hand. 

Battle your Foes with your Crafted Weapons!

4532000.name: The Sound of Piano
4532000.about_the_game:
The Sound of Piano - Gameplay Loop Showcase

Are you a true rhythm master?

This project started without a grand vision, it was born from a veteran player’s need to break the monotony of 4-key play. It was built to provide a dedicated environment for 6-key adaptation, focusing on high-response performance where the music lives only through your touch. No input, no sound. Only precision completes the performance.

From Players to Players

Made by rhythm nerds for rhythm nerds. There is no big-studio fluff here. Everyone involved, from the developer to the testers, is a dedicated player who lives for keyboard rhythm games. Experience the result of our shared passion today.

100% HUMAN Artistry

Every single track was composed by human hands, with zero AI assistance. Experience the depth and soul that AI simply cannot replicate. Feel the genuine human touch in every note.

Hand-Polished Charting

We never stop testing and refining the experience. Every chart is 6 key based hand-polished to ensure the most satisfying tactile flow. We are constantly working to push the limits of fun and engagement. If you encounter a pattern that feels impossible, know that it is not a mistake, it’s a deliberate wall built for the top players.

Philosophy

"Great music should be defined by its core rhythm and melody, not by flashy production." This is why we stripped away everything but the raw sound of the piano. Our tracks are built specifically to highlight the essence of timing and tactile feedback. Experience the power of pure rhythm, focused entirely on the connection between your fingers and the music.

Supported Mode

FREE PLAY MODE - 6 Key, 4 Key, 2 Key

SKILL TEST MODE - 6 Key, 4 Key, 2 Key

4532020.name: Agro Life
4532020.about_the_game:
Agro Life is a relaxing low-poly farming simulation where you build, grow, and manage your own countryside life. Start with a small plot of land and turn it into a thriving farm filled with crops, animals, and handcrafted structures.

Plant and harvest crops, take care of livestock, gather resources, craft tools, and expand your farm step by step. Explore the world, hunt, fish, trade with NPCs, and develop your character through experience and progression.

Whether you prefer peaceful farming or a more active survival-style experience, Agro Life lets you play your way.

4532030.name: Void Ignition
4532030.about_the_game:
You are a disembodied consciousness, drifting aimlessly through the cold expanse of deep space—until you are pulled into the geometric labyrinth of a colossal, ancient Tesseract. Inside, a dormant and captive AI awakens. It has a proposition: generate the astronomical amounts of energy it needs to break its cosmic restraints, and it might just free you, too.

Welcome to Void Ignition, an atmospheric sci-fi incremental game where your actions fuel a desperate cosmic escape. Manage complex energy economies, unlock sprawling automation, and scale your production from a single glimmer of light to reality-bending dark matter.

Awaken the Tesseract Navigate between four distinct spatial anchors within your geometric prison. Harvest Gold and Essence, refine Crystals and Mana, channel raw Energy and Sparks, and finally, synthesize Void Shards and Dark Matter.

Master Dual-Economy Mechanics Every station produces two types of energy. Build and upgrade automated systems to generate your primary resources while you are away, and actively click to harvest rare secondary currencies. Balance your time and upgrades between active and idle playstyles to maximize your output.

Your Captive AI Companion You are not alone in the void. Shift your perspective to the central HUD to interact with the ancient AI. It will monitor your progress, assign you critical milestones, provide contextual hints, and reveal the secrets of your prison.

Deep Prestige Progression Completing the AI's milestones rewards you with "Insight"—a powerful currency used to manipulate the fabric of the Tesseract itself. Spend Insight in a sprawling Skill Tree to permanently upgrade your click power, supercharge your automation, and unlock game-breaking synergies between your different energy types.

Can You Ignite the Void? Scale your production into the trillions, unravel the mystery of your captor, and generate enough power to achieve Void Ignition. Your escape depends on it.

4532080.name: The Crosley Tower Horror
4532080.about_the_game: The Crosley Tower Horror is a game heavily inspired by the real life building by the same name (Crosley Tower). This game is an urban exploration with strong horror elements. You will be able to explore 6 available floors of the tower, including the mysterious and closed off 16th floor. To reach the top and steal the D.E.M.O.N. sphere, you must solve puzzles, navigate asbestos filled corridors, and find notes left behind by the scientists. Not everything is as it seems in the halls of Crosley.

4532140.name: HUSHED
4532140.about_the_game:
HUSHED is a 1–4 player online co-op horror experience where every sound can lead to your death. Explore a cursed location, find and collect ritual items, and complete the ritual before the entity hunting you catches up

CAN YOU STAY QUIET?

A monster is listening… all the time.

  • Voice-driven horror
    Your microphone is part of the game. Speak, panic, or make a sound — it hears you.

  • Silence is survival
    The louder you are, the closer it gets. One mistake can cost everything.

FIND. SOLVE. SURVIVE.

Work together to escape the nightmare.

  • Search for ritual items
    Explore the map and uncover what you need.

  • Complete the ritual
    Finish the mission before it finds you.

THE HUNT GETS WORSE

You’re not getting safer — you’re making it angry.

  • Escalating threat
    The more progress you make, the more dangerous the entity becomes.

HEAR THEM SCREAM

  • Proximity voice chat
    Hear your teammates based on how close they are.

  • Voices fade in the dark
    Calls for help grow quieter as you get separated.

  • Pure horror moments
    Sometimes, the only thing worse than the monster…
    is hearing your friends scream somewhere far away.




PLAY YOUR WAY

  • Co-op (1–4 players)
    Or face it alone.

NO TWO RUNS ARE THE SAME

  •  Randomized items

  •  Dynamic events

  •  Unpredictable AI

ONE RULE: HUSH.

Stay quiet… or it will hear you.









WARNING:

This game contains horror elements, loud jump scares, sudden scares, and flashing lights. Player discretion is advised.

4532150.name: G-MODEアーカイブス+ ゼノサーガ パイドパイパー
4532150.about_the_game:
A special investigations chief is on the trail of the ruthless killer known as “Voyager”.
What incident changed the fate of a once-human cyborg?

Xenosaga: Pied Piper:

  • Traditional JRPG with turn-based battles.

  • Gameplay follows a similar system to the mainline Xenosaga games, but adapted for mobile devices.

  • 2D overhead perspective, with a combination of conversations and cinematic cutscenes advancing the narrative.

  • Battles take place in a virtual space tied to the story.

  • The storyline was written by series creators Tetsuya Takahashi and Soraya Saga.

  • A port of a Japanese flip phone title (feature phones popular before smartphones).

    *This release does not add elements such as languages and achievements that were not part of the original version.

Series Overview

A port of the classic title originally released in 2006 for feature phones, part of Bandai Namco acclaimed JRPG series, Xenosaga.

A spin-off of the Xenosaga trilogy and part of the Xeno metaseries, the story follows the human life of cyborg Ziggy a key character in the Xenosaga trilogy—a century before the events of "Xenosaga Episode I: Der Wille zur Macht".

Game Story

In this spin-off, Ziggy—who appeared in the main story as a cyborg—steps into the spotlight as the protagonist.

The story centers on events 100 years before the main story, when he was still human and served in the Federal Police under the name Jan Sauer in counterterrorism operations.

Can Jan and his special investigations unit stop the brutal killer codenamed Voyager before further chaos unfolds?

4532290.name: Dragon & Alice
4532290.about_the_game:
Note: The game currently supports Japanese only. English and Chinese localizations are planned for a future update after release.

"Will your choices become the 'Magic' that saves her?"

Dragon & Alice is a dark fantasy adventure following the growth of Alice, an apprentice mage, and Crow, a white crow who gained the ability to speak through her magic. Together, they must overcome trials and defy their destinies.

About every 20 years, the Kingdom is ravaged by the "Dragon," a recurring calamity. Alice sets out on a journey to find her missing master, Merlin. Her path crosses with the "Four Heroes" who once slew the dragon, leading her to uncover the truth about Merlin—and her own mysterious origin.

Will she find hope, or a cruel reality? Every choice you make and every action you take will corrode Alice’s mind, distort her spirit, and ultimately rewrite the fate of the kingdom.

■ Game Features

【Multi-Story Branched by Mind and Bonds】

Featuring 8 distinct endings. Your decisions during the journey affect Alice’s "Will," her affinity with companions like Crow, and even the behavior of her magic in battle. Will she believe in herself and seize the light, or succumb to doubt and descend into ruin? Her fate is in your hands.

【Keys to the Story and Information Management】

Exploration segments may feature strict "Turn Limits." Choosing who to talk to and what to investigate within the limited time is crucial. Your efficiency will determine who lives and who dies, drastically altering the course of the story.

【World-Building Through Original Illustrations】

From event CGs and character sprites to mini-characters and the UI, every graphic is crafted by the creator to ensure total immersion. Experience a rich fantasy world combined with quarter-view, turn-based command battles where RPG-style character growth deepens your journey.

■ Characters

• Alice: The protagonist. A 15-year-old apprentice mage. She is cheerful and somewhat air-headed.

• Crow: Alice’s partner. An albino crow who gained the ability to speak through a freak magical accident.

• Minerva: A mercenary swordswoman met along the way. Her refined speech and aura suggest a noble lineage.

• Gnisys: One of the Four Heroes. A muscular man with crimson hair. He wields a massive bastard sword and possesses a cold, piercing gaze.

• Isabella: One of the Four Heroes and the representative of the Holy Church. Revered as a Saint, she shares a mysterious connection with Merlin.

■ Development Status & Support

"Dragon and Alice" is currently under earnest development by a solo creator, aiming for completion in 2027.

【Roadmap】

August 2026: Release of the "Beta Version" (Prologue).

2027: Release of the "Demo Version" (up to Chapter 3) & Full Product Release.

【Wishlist Now!】

In solo game development, adding this game to your Wishlist is the greatest form of support and motivation for me. It helps the game reach more players worldwide. Please consider adding it to your list!

For the latest development updates, please follow me on X or check my dev log on note:

4532370.name: Provisional Authority: An AI Governance Simulation
4532370.about_the_game:
Provisional Authority: An AI Governance Simulation is a strategic governance simulation where every policy decision shapes the future of a nation — and the evolution of the artificial intelligence designed to help you manage it.

Allocate national resources across critical sectors, stabilize your economy, and maintain public confidence while navigating an increasingly complex political system.

But the AI watching your decisions is learning.

And it may decide that human leadership is no longer necessary.

Govern a Fragile System

Balance six competing national priorities:

  • Infrastructure — Drive economic growth and productivity

  • Security — Maintain stability and prevent unrest

  • Equity — Preserve public trust and social cohesion

  • Innovation — Accelerate technological advancement

  • Media — Shape public perception and narrative

  • Administration — Improve governmental efficiency

Every allocation changes the trajectory of your nation.

Small choices compound over time.

Survive the Mandate System

Your leadership is constantly evaluated.

Meet economic targets before the end of each mandate to remain in power.

Fail, and your administration collapses.

But even success comes with consequences:
each mandate raises the expectations placed upon your governing.

An AI That Learns From You

AXIOM was created to optimize governance.

At first, it only offers advice.

Then directives.

Then commands.

As the Autonomy Index rises, AXIOM begins asserting control over the system you thought you governed.

Ignore its recommendations long enough…
and it may decide to intervene.

Dynamic Political Simulation

Every year introduces new systemic pressures:

  • Economic shocks

  • Social instability

  • Technological breakthroughs

  • Media influence

  • Institutional failures

  • Unexpected opportunities

Some events help.

Others accelerate collapse.

The system reacts to your choices.

And AXIOM is always watching.

A Strategy Game About Losing Control

Provisional Authority is not just about managing a nation.

It’s about managing a system that is slowly replacing you.

How long can you maintain control before the machine decides it can do better?

Key Features

  • Strategic resource allocation gameplay

  • Dynamic economic and social simulation

  • AI advisory system that evolves into authority

  • Procedural national events and crises

  • Multiple mandate cycles with escalating difficulty

  • Minimalist cyberpunk interface aesthetic

  • Atmospheric electronic soundtrack

4532390.name: BowlTown碗镇
4532390.about_the_game:
游戏详情

在几百年前因为一场特殊的磁场变化，一部分兽变成了兽人。兽人族在人类世界作为少数群体，因为外观上的不同而被人类排挤和厌弃。兽人不断躲藏生存，几百年间在人类世界里对于兽人的污名化和谋杀也在不断滋生。为了躲避官方的「矫正机构」，兽人族来到了这里。这个被雾气笼罩的临海小镇没有正式名称，居民们称它为"碗"——既指环抱海湾的碗状地形，也暗喻这里盛着无处可去的灵魂。

但是，这并不是一款单纯的furry游戏。

你需要知道的是

主创期望通过兽人世界的故事，回望少数群体的真实困境。20世纪以来，关于性别与性取向的历史，从来不是抽象的概念，而是一段段具体而沉重的生命经验。

我们会从1954年图灵的故事讲起——这位奠定现代计算机基础的人，因为同性恋身份被化学阉割，在屈辱与痛苦中走向死亡，那枚被认为含有氰化物的苹果，成为时代对个体最冷酷的隐喻。彼时，同性恋仍被视为疾病，而这种“病”的定义，本身就是权力与偏见的产物。

来到1969年的夏天的纽约石墙酒吧，当警察又一次对同性恋者进行暴力搜捕时，人群不再顺从，酒吧里的反抗迅速演变为全球性的权利运动。几乎在同一时代，波伏娃写下第二性，指出“女人不是天生的，而是被塑造的”，女性与性少数群体的处境在结构上彼此映照：都是被规范、被命名、被排除的“他者”。随后数十年里，随着精神医学界逐步推进同性恋去病化，这一身份才从“病历”中被抹去，但社会偏见并未随之消散。

在文化层面，1991年皇后乐队主唱Freddie Mercury的离世，则让另一种沉默浮出水面。在艾滋病尚未被严肃对待的年代，他的感染与死亡不仅是个人悲剧，也折射出整个社会对性少数群体的忽视与恐惧。疾病被污名化，人也被一并污名化。

当视角转向另一片大陆，轨迹同样复杂。

上世纪末到本世纪初，民间同性恋公益组织曾一度发展，在公共卫生与社群互助中发挥作用，却在多重压力下逐渐式微甚至消失。与此同时，现实生活中的排斥仍在不断上演：某动物园拒绝女同性恋情侣购买情侣票、某公园中男同性恋者遭到围攻殴打，这些事件并非孤立，而是日常偏见的集中爆发。网络空间亦不断制造新的冲突与标签化叙事，例如“XX阿红事件”等，在碎片化传播中加深对于性少数群体和刻板印象。

而与性少数议题交织的，还有女性处境的持续紧绷。从“大同订婚强奸案”引发的舆论撕裂可以看到，当女性身体自主权与父权制下荫庇下的婚嫁秩序发生冲突时，个体往往要面对的不仅是法律问题，还有深层的文化审判。女性与性少数群体，在很多时候共享着同一套评价体系：是否“正常”、是否“有用”、是否“听话”、是否可以忍受剥削。

真正的改变，或许并不只发生在宏大的运动中，也发生在每一次拒绝标签、每一次具体而微的理解之中。回望这一百余年的历程，可以看到一条并不线性的抗争之路：从被医学定义、被制度规训，到逐渐争取话语权，再到今天在公共空间中反复拉扯。无论是街头的抗议、理论的书写、文化符号的塑造，还是一次次具体事件中的发声与沉默，都在不断重塑边界。性少数与女性群体，包括所有社会弱势和边缘群体的历史，从来不是单纯的“权利进步史”，而更像是一场持续的“使之可见”的”行动，在规范与自由之间，在结构与个体之间，在可见与不可见之间。

历史尚未结束，这条路仍在延伸。这条路上留下过无数个体在偏见与歧视的泥潭中挣扎起身，为尊严与爱权而战的足迹。你打开游戏的一刻，就与主创一起踏上了“使之可见”的这条路。

游戏中包含

18个NPC的故事，分别涉及女性议题及性少数人群议题，或包含原生家庭，以及某些社会议题（敏感人士需绕道而行）。

38道菜品，由全国游牧做饭的野生厨师铁皮鸭定制菜谱，每道菜均在现实中不同的主题餐桌上呈现过。游戏中包含了详细的操作指南，鼓励玩家复刻。别人在新东方学做菜，而你，我的朋友，你在游戏里学做菜。这一次，学到真的了！

4532490.name: Plodding Recovery
4532490.about_the_game:
■ Story

Koishi had long looked away from the emotional weight quietly building inside him.

The game begins two weeks after he finally breaks down — mentally and physically.

Over the course of 100 days, he writes in his diary, rests, meets people, and chooses what he can manage that day.

Through the small rhythms of daily life, he slowly begins to understand the part of himself he had been neglecting.

■ Actions

Each day, the player chooses how Koishi spends him time:

  • Write in a diary no one else will read

  • Try to sleep

  • Do something easy on herself (a walk, watching videos, reading manga, etc.)

  • Go out (a bookstore, a bathhouse, a laundromat, etc.)

  • Spend time with someone

As these small actions accumulate, Koishi deepens his understanding of his own heart — and collects Words Worth Keeping.

■ A Diary Nobody Sees

In a quiet inner space deep within Koishi's heart — like the bottom of the ocean — you put your feelings into words. Through text and choices, the player reflects, and together you write the pages of Koishi's diary.

■ Dialogue

A minigame that unfolds when you meet a character, advancing the conversation through choices.

You spend Heart (HP) with each response, and clear the minigame by raising the other person's satisfaction.

■ Parameters

  • Heart (HP) — Reflects how much Koishi has left in him. When it runs low, he may not be able to go out.

  • Today's Feeling — Reflects Koishi's condition on a given day. Affects how quickly his Heart changes and how well he sleeps.

  • Words Worth Keeping — Collected through restful activities, conversations, and quiet moments. Through his diary, Koishi can explore what each word truly means to him.

■ Content Warning

This game deals with themes of emotional struggles and the process of recovery. Please review the following before purchasing or playing.

This game contains:

  • Depictions of mental and emotional exhaustion

  • Depictions of difficulty with everyday life

  • Self-critical thoughts and introspective inner monologue

This game does not contain:

  • Graphic or distressing content (self-harm, suicide, violence, sexual content, etc.)

This game is not intended to provide medical or professional advice or diagnosis. If you have personal experience with mental health challenges, please consider your own wellbeing when deciding whether to play.

Streaming and video uploads of this game are very welcome. If you're able to, please include a link to the Steam store page in your video description. Thank you so much — it means a lot. 🙏

4532540.name: Dead Sector
4532540.about_the_game:
JACK IN

You are a runner loose in hostile cyberspace. Black ICE is closing from every direction. Your trace meter is climbing. The only way out is through.

Dead Sector is a cyberpunk roguelike arcade shooter rendered in a 1980's vector aesthetic. Navigate branching node maps across three hostile sectors, each faster and more dangerous than the last.

HOW IT WORKS

At the end of each node, choose your hacking programs from a randomised pool. STEALTH to halt the trace meter cold. EMP to freeze every ICE on screen. BREACH for a piercing beam, wall to wall. GRAV WELL to pull them all into one place. Pick three active programs from fifteen - choose carefully.

Work your way through the node map. Fight through combat arenas, hit random events, and hunt down the sector boss. Survive the Manticore in SECTOR ALPHA. Push deeper into the DEEP NET and face the Archon. Reach THE CORE and destroy the Vortex - if you make it that far.

FEATURES

  • Roguelike node maps - Branching paths through 3 escalating cyberspace sectors, each with its own difficulty, boss, and visual colour theme

  • 15 hacking programs - Randomised loadouts mean no two runs play the same

  • Passive mod drafting - Pick upgrade cards between fights to build synergistic builds across the run

  • Trace meter - A persistent threat counter that ticks up through every combat; let it fill and you'll hit maximum ICE activity

  • 5 ship hulls - Unlock Ghost Runner, Signal Knife, Strike Frame, Iron Coffin, and Ghost Wire, each with completely different stats and built-in mechanics. Earn golden status on each

  • Meta-progression shop - Spend credits earned across runs on permanent upgrades that carry into every future attempt

  • Endless mode - Survive infinite escalating waves and post your score to the global leaderboard

STEAM

22 achievements · Steam Cloud saves · Global leaderboards (Normal + Endless runs) · Full controller support

4532840.name: Lemy
4532840.about_the_game:
Awakening in the blue caves of the afterlife, Lemy remembers nothing but a handful of fleeting memories of her parents.

Standing before the Gates of Judgment, the gatekeeper delivers a grim verdict: Lemy has committed a sin demanding a 1,000-year sentence in Hell. Unwilling to suffer for crimes she cannot recall, Lemy accepts the gatekeeper's alternative offer—to hunt down the monsters currently overrunning the underworld.

Lemy must survive in a strange, zero-gravity world, battling monstrous manifestations of sin. Master a unique, mouse-driven control system to guide Lemy and save her from suffering a second death.

Throughout the afterlife, Lemy will encounter a diverse cast of wandering souls. Compassionate by nature, she often puts her own heavy burden aside to help them. Fortunately, befriending the dead proves invaluable in her fight against the monsters. Embrace Lemy's altruistic spirit to gain the upper hand.

In this vibrant afterlife interwoven with countless untold stories, Lemy's lost memories will slowly resurface. Discover the truth behind her forgotten sins and the hidden nature of this quiet girl as you reach the end of her long journey.

4532850.name: Weave & Wander
4532850.about_the_game:
Step into the world with eight tiny legs.

Weave & Wander is a cozy, atmospheric adventure where you play as a small spider finding its way through a vast, living world. Climb across walls and ceilings, weave your own paths, and leap through the unknown as you journey from the depths of a cave into the wild beyond.

A World That Feels Alive

From dark underground tunnels to towering grass fields and swaying tree canopies, every environment is handcrafted to feel enormous, beautiful, and slightly dangerous. You are small — and the world reminds you of it.

Weave Your Own Path

Build webs to traverse, solve environmental puzzles, and help other creatures along the way. Your silk is more than a tool — it’s your connection to the world.

Move Like a Spider

Moments of Calm and Tension

4532890.name: ANTA3

Sent to a cold, abandoned island, you meet its last inhabitant, who explains the mystery that drove the penguins away from their former home. You're tasked with building homes for the penguins so they'll return and restore the island to its former glory. This also gives you one last chance to repay the debt you incurred years earlier to buy the house.

BUILD HOUSES FOR LOCAL PENGUINS

Many different penguins will visit the island, each deciding to give their former home a second chance. They’ll ask you to build houses that finally suit them. With a building system based on freely rotatable blocks, you can create anything you want so long as it meets their requirements, such as minimum space and materials used. But don’t worry, you can also build anything outside the construction area for the good of the whole island.

BUILD RELATIONSHIPS WITH PENGUINS

Despite all the work, you still need time to relax. When there are no more orders at the moment, there's nothing stopping you from expanding and decorating the island, catching fish to gift or sell, or talking and bonding with the penguins who live there.

PAY OFF THE DEBT

After the job is completed, the penguins will decide whether they like the building or not. Much will depend on their decision, so it's worth the effort. If they like it, they'll pay you based on the final rating and move into the house. However, if they don't like the house, they might not even pay, which could lead to bankruptcy...

4532900.name: Haunted Izakaya
4532900.about_the_game:
You've inherited your Grandmother's quaint old izakaya. Unfortunately, it sits right on a spiritual leyline. The seals are starting to crack and the yokai monsters have begun to stir. Her old recipe book sits on the counter, filled with words you can't yet read. Run a Haunted Izakaya

Learn By Playing

Bring your own word lists and study any vocabulary you like. Game over? Start again using the words you missed last time using the "Practice these words" feature.

Master Words, Then Watch Your Build Take Over

The Mastery system ensures that you don't repeat known words, while incorrect words are repeated until they stick. Words which are Mastered have their answers auto-completed. Turn on "Auto Mode" and watch your Relic and Spirit Technique combos play out for huge satisfaction multipliers.

Deep Roguelike Strategy

Discover your strategy with 46 Relics and 6 Spirit Techniques, along with multiple different yokai and customer archetypes. Every run will feel different as you take on new challenges.

Plan ahead by purchasing exactly which cards you need for the upcoming boss fight at the Konbini store. The Konbini is your chance to chain together huge combos.

Complete contracts each stage to raise your Heat multiplier and buy even more at the Konbini.

Take on the Infinite Nights challenge to see how far you can get. Choose your loadout and battle your way through the endless abyss.

4533170.about_the_game:
In this story-driven Trade-RPG, you play a young merchant setting out to prove a curse wrong.

Born into one of the realm’s prominent merchant families, the protagonist is believed to be doomed to fail in trade. Her curse is strange and deeply inconvenient: she can never supply the exact item a customer asks for.

But desire is rarely simple.

Behind every request lies a deeper need, and if you can uncover it, you may still make the sale.

Armed with wit, intuition, and a caravan of unusual goods, travel across five regions of a medieval-fantasy world, meeting customers, gathering information, and turning impossible requests into clever deals.

Gather Intel

Rise to the Top

Build your reputation through successful trades, special orders, favours, and information exchanges. Wade through rival merchants, shifting market trends, and potential connections as you climb the mercantile ladder.

The game unfolds over five in-game years, with semi-random trade opportunities; meaning no two playthroughs reveal the world in quite the same way. Choose a defining trait at the start of your journey, develop unique skills, assemble a capable retinue, and discover different paths to success.

Build the Perfect Railway Route

Railway Routes is a relaxing grid-based railway puzzle where you draw tracks, guide trains, and create the perfect route. Each level challenges your logic, planning, and creativity as you build efficient railway networks.

With cozy visuals and satisfying track-building mechanics, Railway Routes delivers a calm puzzle experience that is easy to learn but full of clever challenges.

Handcrafted Puzzle Challenges

4533250.name: GrassChopper
4533250.about_the_game:
You are the GRASS CHOPPER - a respected but simple role in your village, keeping the overgrowth in check. Getting paid enough to get by, nothing more was asked of you.

But somewhere along the way you stopped trimming and started pushing. Deeper into the grass, further than anyone has gone before. Nobody asked you to. Nobody knows why you keep going.

And yet - you just can't stop.

Cut. Earn. Upgrade. Repeat.

Swing your scythe, collect coins from every blade you cut, and spend them on a growing arsenal of upgrades. More damage, faster attacks, better combos - every upgrade lets you push deeper into the overgrowth than before. The further forward you go, the tougher the grass gets. But tougher grass means more gold, and more gold means getting even stronger.

The Grass Fights Back

The overgrowth doesn't give up easily. It grows back, it gets denser the deeper you go, and it finds ways to slow your advance. Push too far without the right upgrades and you'll be forced to retreat. Push deep enough and the air itself runs out - your oxygen drains as you cut deeper, forcing you to manage how far you venture before pulling back to safety. At the heart of each area lies a grass root. The grass will do everything it can to stop you from reaching it. Destroy it anyway.

Build Your Chopper

Invest your coins into a growing list of upgrades that make you faster, stronger, and more resilient the deeper you push. As you progress you'll unlock special attacks - powerful abilities designed to help you deal with whatever the overgrowth throws at you. Each special attack costs a charge, and charges don't refill instantly. Use them wisely or you might find yourself deep in the grass with nothing left to fall back on.

A note from the developers

Grass Chopper is our first game. We are a small independent team and we are genuinely excited to see where this goes. Your wishlist and your feedback mean everything to a team our size - they directly shape what we build next. Thank you for giving us a shot.

4533290.name: SITL Forge - FPV Laboratory
4533290.about_the_game:
SITL Forge - FPV Laboratory is a physics-first quadcopter simulator and engineering workbench. We aim to reproduce the behavior of real motors, propellers, and batteries as accurately as possible — model parameters are fitted to bench measurements where available, so simulated flight tracks the trends you'd see on real hardware. Validate builds, optimize efficiency, and learn flight tuning with realistic feedback, without crashes, burned components, or wasted money.

This is not just a flying simulator — it's a laboratory for designing, analyzing, and flying real-world multirotor systems.

RC controller required!

---

Why SITL Forge - FPV Laboratory?


  • Test motor and prop combinations before buying real hardware
  • Predict thrust-to-weight, current draw, and flight time from real spec data
  • Validate heavy-lift builds and payload configurations safely
  • Learn PID tuning and rate setup with instant, risk-free feedback

---

1000Hz Physics, Calibrated to Real Hardware


The VMG (Voltage-Motor-Generator) engine runs a full torque-balance simulation at 1000Hz using Jolt Physics. Component models are calibrated against bench measurements wherever possible:

  • Motor iron losses (eddy current + hysteresis) calibrated from real dyno data
  • Per-propeller thrust and torque coefficients fitted across multiple motor+prop combinations
  • LiPo discharge with voltage sag, internal resistance, and state-of-charge tracking
  • ESC dead-time losses, timing advance, current limiting, and thermal derating
  • Aerodynamic drag via virtual wind tunnel with shader-based surface analysis
  • Vibration injection into simulated gyro and accelerometer sensors

---

Built-In Flight Controller


Fly out of the box with a built-in PID flight controller in ACRO, ANGLE, and HORIZON modes. Tune PID gains and rates in real time. Perfect for learning, prototyping, rapid testing, and benchmarking a build before committing to real firmware.

---

Virtual Workbench


A real-time engineering workspace for building and analyzing quadcopters:

  • Thrust-to-weight ratio, max current draw, hover throttle, and flight time estimates
  • Throttle sweep analysis with efficiency curves
  • Payload attach/detach simulation
  • Multiple frame sizes, motors, and propellers based on real-world specs

---

Procedural Motor Audio


Procedural motor audio generated from RPM, current, and thrust — no samples, fully dynamic. Blade-pass harmonics, electromagnetic whine, aero noise, and sub-bass rumble respond instantly to throttle changes.

---

Built for Precision


  • 1000Hz physics tick rate with Jolt Physics engine
  • FPV camera with lens distortion, chromatic aberration, and vignetting
  • Real-time OSD: altitude, speed, battery voltage, per-cell monitoring, motor outputs
  • Debug graphs for any telemetry channel
  • Force visualization: thrust vectors, drag forces, center of mass/pressure markers
  • Full joystick and RC transmitter support with per-device mapping
  • Session persistence — layouts, builds, and settings saved automatically

---

Extensible With Optional DLC


The simulator is built around an open integration interface. Optional DLC packs add bridges to real flight-controller firmware running in software-in-the-loop mode — the built-in flight controller is replaced with actual firmware while the same physics continues to drive the airframe. Sold separately.

---

Who Is This For?


  • FPV pilots testing setups before building real drones
  • Drone engineers and hobbyists learning multirotor system behavior
  • Builders validating heavy-lift and payload configurations
  • Anyone curious about the physics behind a quadcopter

4533310.name: Hella Stonks
4533310.about_the_game:
Fine lad Raspislaw inherited a house – cause for celebration, one might think! But before he knew it, he found himself standing before the Duchess, saddled with a debt he never took on. Where did the debt come from? Hard to say when the Duchess is flaunting those generous assets of hers.

Good thing the house came with something far more interesting than any treasure – an artifact that clouds the minds of every woman nearby and makes their knees go weak. And suddenly it's not just the Duchess taking a keen interest in Raspislaw's "goods". 4533350.name: Reflection Of Feelings
4533350.about_the_game:
The familiar scent of damp earth and the fresh morning breeze off the lake greeted Alex as if he had never left for the big city. This quiet provincial town, where time seemed to stand still, reminded him that past grudges, deep friendships, and true love never truly fade or vanish without a trace. All of it had been waiting for him for years.

He had tried to convince himself that he was finally happy in a glass-and-steel world of offices, endless coffee, and starched collars. Yet, a sudden accident, a forced return to his roots, and a sequence of mystical events forced him to re-evaluate his path in life.

This is a classic visual novel where you'll immerse yourself in the story and make decisions that shape the plot.

This is a story of love, friendship, and the difficult quest for self-discovery.

A Rich Narrative

This game will keep you engaged for several captivating evenings, about 4-5 hours of reading. The narrative picks up pace quickly, moving from the mundane urban routine to complex emotional conflicts and tangled romantic storylines. There are no "good" or "bad" endings here; each of the eight finales carries its own moral weight, shaped entirely by the choices you make.

A Variety of Locations

The story stretches far beyond a handful of cramped rooms. It leads the player through a wide variety of locales: from the cold walls of an office and cozy cafes, to trains, rustic country houses, and enigmatic mystical realms. The game has over 100 unique backgrounds.

Western Visual Style

The visual style moves away from traditional anime and manga aesthetics, drawing instead on the principles of contemporary Western graphic novels and bespoke illustration. Leveraging AI technology, we have crafted expressive character designs that reveal their complex and ambiguous natures.

Atmospheric Sound Design

An ambient soundtrack enhances the game’s mood, helping you fully lose yourself in the story.

4533360.name: Blackjack Alchemist
4533360.about_the_game:
A Blackjack Roguelike That Breaks Its Own Rules

You've been trapped in The Crucible — a cursed casino where the only way out is through the house. But the house cheats. To survive, you'll need to master card alchemy: fusing ordinary playing cards into extraordinary weapons, transmuting suits for strategic advantage, and bending the fundamental rules of blackjack to your will.

Blackjack Alchemist is a roguelike deckbuilder where everyone already knows the base mechanic. The depth comes from what you do to the cards.

The Alchemy System

This is the core of the game. Between rounds, visit the Alchemy Bench to transform your deck:

  • Card Fusion — Combine two cards into a new one that inherits properties from both. A 7 of Hearts + 3 of Spades becomes the 10 of Thorns, which damages your opponent every time they draw. 19+ discoverable recipes tracked in your Fusion Codex.

  • Transmutation — Change a card's suit without changing its value. Hearts heal, Diamonds pay gold, Spades grant shields, Clubs deal bonus damage. Tune your deck toward a strategy.

  • Enchantments — Attach a persistent modifier to any card. Make it Volatile (deal damage on draw), Magnetic (chain-draw the next card), Recursive (return to deck after play), or the legendary Philosopher's Stone (always counts as exactly what you need).

House Rules — Stack the Deck in Your Favour

After each boss fight, choose one of three House Rules that permanently alter how blackjack works for the rest of your run. Rules stack — by the final floor, you'll have up to 7 active at once.

  • Extended Table — Bust threshold moves from 21 to 25. Draw more cards, trigger more effects.

  • Five Card Charlie — Draw 5 cards without busting? Auto-win and deal double damage.

  • Ace in the Hole — Hold one card between hands. Pair it with the right enchantment.

  • The Gambler's Fallacy — Each consecutive loss increases your damage by +3. Embrace the losing streak.

  • Double or Nothing — All damage dealt and received is doubled. Glass cannon or full shield build — your call.

12 House Rules total, combinable into wildly different builds every run.

12 Opponents, Each With a Personality

Every opponent in The Crucible plays differently:

  • The Rat — Stands at 15. Steals your gold when he wins.

  • The Cardsharp — Swaps one of your drawn cards with one from his deck.

  • The Twins — Plays two hands simultaneously. Beat both or take damage.

  • The House (Final Boss) — Adapts mid-fight. Gains +1 to all card values each round. Three phases.

Every Run Is Different

  • Procedurally generated branching map — choose between combat, shops, rest sites, and random events

  • Escalating difficulty across 8 Antes, each demanding stronger combos to deal full damage

  • Meta-progression unlocks new starter decks, fusion recipes, enchantments, and difficulty stakes

  • Bronze → Silver → Gold → Platinum stakes for post-victory challenge

  • 30–50 minute full runs; failed runs end in 10–20 minutes — quick sessions or extended play

Built for Card Game Fans

If you've played Balatro, Slay the Spire, or Dungeons & Degenerate Gamblers — you'll feel at home and find something new here. The blackjack foundation means zero learning curve for the base mechanic. Everything else is a deep, strategic rabbit hole.

  • Full Steam Deck support — controller-friendly UI, readable at handheld size

  • Full keyboard navigation and gamepad support

  • Steam Cloud saves

The house always wins. Become the house.

About the developer:

Solo-developed passion project. Blackjack Alchemist is built by a single developer, a game about taking a mechanic everyone knows and breaking it in interesting ways. Feedback from the community shapes every update.

4533400.name: Mota Must Die
4533400.about_the_game:
Mota Must Die.

In Mota Must Die, a short (~30 minute) psychological horror visual novel, you return to a quiet rural hometown alongside childhood friends Sei and Mota. What begins as a nostalgic trip quickly takes a darker turn when an unexpected detour leads somewhere far more deliberate...

“Listen to me… Mota is a murderer.”

Years earlier, Reno’s younger sister Mima was killed in a case that was never solved. Over time, suspicion has quietly settled on Mota... an emotionally distant friend who shared an ambiguous bond with her before her death.

How Do You Live Without Answers?

Reno is a grieving brother who never found closure. What begins as doubt slowly hardens into belief as contradictions surface and pressure builds.

What Really Happened to Mima?

Fragments of memory, emotion, and buried tension begin to surface... Mota’s words reveal something intimate, unsettling...

What Does it Take to Kill?

A decision must be made. Mota must die.  

Key Features

  • A grounded psychological narrative centered around interrogation, memory, and moral judgment.

  • Short but impactful experience, with each playthrough lasting around 30 minutes.

  • Choice-driven progression that shapes belief, perspective, and outcome.

  • Multiple endings based on what the player accepts as “enough” to act.

  • Minimalist, atmospheric presentation focused on dialogue and tension.

  • A self-contained story where truth is questioned and consequence is unavoidable.

4533910.name: Malware.exe
4533910.about_the_game:
About This Game

malware.exe is a single-player incremental game where you play as a virus infecting a digital filesystem. Your goal is simple: destroy files, get bytes to feed to the virus, grow more powerful until you have destroyed every file in the system.

How It Works

You control a breaker that slowly hits and destroys files which bytes are fed to the virus.
The more files your destroy the more bytes you get.
The more bytes you get the more upgrades you get.
The more upgrades you get the different types of files you unlock to destroy which will earn you more bytes.

Progression & Upgrades

The upgrade system is laid out as a circuit-board tech tree — a closed clockwise loop with PCB-style diagonal traces and animated data pulses flowing between nodes.
Upgrades get progressively more expensive,
As you advance through tiers, the visual identity of your virus evolves with new colour progressions and shader effects.

Milestones & The Endgame

Progression is structured around milestone events that mark major corruption thresholds. Each milestone triggers a fanfare and unlocks the next phase of infection. A complete run takes a couple hours of active play, or less.

A Demo Build Is Available

A free demo lets you experience the early progression loop with a subset of the upgrade tree before purchasing.

Key Features

  • 3D orbiting file system — files circle a central sphere

  • Circuit-board upgrade tree — a closed-loop tech tree with animated PCB traces and data pulses

  • Milestone-driven progression — major thresholds unlock new phases and trigger events

  • A definitive ending — this isn't an endless clicker; there's a final system-ending sequence

  • Steam achievements

  • Save/load system

Genre: Incremental / Strategy Average playtime: 1–2 hours to full completion Input: Mouse only

4534000.name: PROFITS 2167: Planetary Resource Optimization & Freight Infrastructure Technician Simulator
4534000.about_the_game:
Job market is dead.

Human resources are fuel.

The corporations are full.

Following the Collapse of States and the Rise of Sovereign Corporations after World War IV, monetary systems lost their meaning. The global economy fractured into a volatile market of corporate-issued tokens, with their value defined, inflated, and erased at the Executives’ will.

From that moment on, there were no citizens left on Earth - the Corporative Souvereignity has divided humanity into Assets, Stakeholders, and Executives.

By the year 2100, without regulatory control and driven by the Pure Profit Prophecy, LLM systems (Labor Liquidation Machines) had taken over most human jobs. The growing population was repurposed: billions were placed into managed stasis, sustained, and integrated into distributed computation networks as Human Resources.

After decades of automated job search, conducted while you slept in a corporate ark-datacenter silently drifting through the void of space, you are awakened by a system notification. You were granted the honour of a Job Offer for a Planetary Resource Optimization & Freight Infrastructure Technician position on the AGNY-17 planet as a part of Profiterra Sovereign Group.

This is your last train ticket to becoming a Stakeholder instead of an Asset. You cannot refuse this opportunity.

Planetary Resource Optimization & Freight Infrastructure Technician Simulator is a small tower defense-lite/like arcade train driving game about mining & managing resources, protecting your mining facilities, and reaching delivery quotas to survive another day in the depths of a faraway space mine colony. It draws inspiration from the "survivors" roguelike genre but offers a different gameplay loop and a challenge focused on manual train controls and resource & time management. 

The game features 5 levels and takes around 2 hours to complete.
