4534010.name: Scene No.0
4534010.about_the_game: This is a multiplayer-based cooperative escape horror game for 1 to 4 players. While watching a movie at a cinema, players encounter a mysterious phenomenon and are pulled into the world of the film itself. Inside, they find various movie stages set in exotic backgrounds and eras, each inhabited by distinct ghosts that reflect their specific settings. Players must survive while being hunted by these spirits, searching the environment for hidden clues, evidence, and various objects to interact with in order to meet the requirements for escaping the cinematic world. ​Moving beyond simple evasion and survival, players must fulfill escape conditions tailored to each film’s narrative, such as resolving a ghost's lingering grudge or incinerating them. To find the path out, players must understand the identity of the ghost and the lore of the movie. This offers an active way to confront the horror, requiring players to uncover the truth behind the spirits to successfully return to the real world and complete the stage. ​With the cinema as its core theme, the game is designed to provide a fresh and immersive experience, offering unique tension and excitement even on multiple playthroughs. Currently, only the Hospital stage is available.

4534020.name: 舌尖上的神兽
4534020.about_the_game:
“Beastly Feast ”is a visual novel game. Modern Chen Qian travels to a mythical world as a motley-feathered chicken chick. In despair, he awakens the Devour & Evolve System, discovering he can devour anything to evolve, unlocking Chaos Power and exclusive recipe guides. Players advance the plot through decisions and exploration, break the bloodline hierarchy, and ultimately become a Chaos Divine Beast, experiencing the ultimate thrill of transcending realms through eating.

Game Background

Waking up, Chen Qian finds himself in a mythical beast world—turned into a "motley-feathered chicken chick" up for sale, trapped in the cruel "bloodline supremacy" rule. In despair, he awakens the Devour & Evolve System, starting a counterattack journey of "eating everything". From gnawing spirit stones, swallowing flame stones, chewing ancient steles to accidentally eating dragon scales, he evolves from a food-grade chick to a Chaos Divine Beast that shakes the continent. Along the way, he faces bloodline discrimination from phoenix elites and oppression from dragon elders, while receiving secret help from the Nine-Tailed Fox and sincere companionship from a human beast tamer. There are also shocking secrets like the mythical beast academy's "cultivation and sacrifice" and the resurrection of ancient fierce beast remnants. Follow Chen Qian to roam the dangerous yet delicious mythical beast continent, break rules through "eating", and rewrite fate with strength.

Feature Systems

Investigation

During the game, players need to conduct investigations. Different investigations yield different items.

Choices

In special plots, players' choices determine the direction of subsequent storylines.

Strategy

In plot progression, different investigation orders affect the storyline.

Reaction

In events requiring quick responses, correct reactions determine subsequent developments.

Branches

Different plot branches grant different items, corresponding to distinct story developments.

4534030.name: 兽神
4534030.about_the_game:
Game Background

The story takes place in a fantasy world where multiple races coexist, including humans, canine-people, tiger-people, and half-beasts. There is a clear class gap between races — tiger-people nobles hold power, while groups like canine-people and half-beasts often occupy a disadvantaged position.

The protagonist, Douglas (a canine-person), starts as a kitchen hand due to his "frail health" and is frequently mocked. However, he possesses far sharper sense of smell and taste than others. Later, he awakens divine powers such as healing and "War Roar," gradually breaking prejudices and growing into a tribe leader.

The world is fraught with crises: external survival threats like ogre invasions, and internal oppression where tiger-people nobles exploit the underclass (e.g., forcing low-price human trafficking). Douglas must lead the half-beast tribe to find a way to survive amid racial conflicts and power struggles.

Feature Systems

Investigation

During the game, players need to conduct investigations. Different investigations will yield different items.

Decision-Making

In special story segments, players' choices will determine the direction of subsequent plots.

Strategy

As the plot progresses, different investigation orders will affect the development of the story.

Reaction

In events that require quick reactions, whether the player makes the correct response will determine the direction of subsequent plots.

Branches

Within the plot, different branches will provide different items and correspond to different story developments.

4534200.name: Incremental Retro Racing
4534200.about_the_game:
Earn more and more stars by driving faster and faster in Incremental Retro Racing. Accumulate and unlock 70+ vehicles, upgrades, track generation options, and more. Includes unlimited tracks and customizable CRT filter for that old school retro feel.

In Incremental Retro Racing you accumulate an ever increasing amount of stars by racing in many ways. Driving top speed, beating the clock, taking over cars, etc.

After each race you can go into the shop and use stars to unlock new vehicles, upgrades, modifications to track generation, the way you earn stars, and more. Make millions bazillions! Try to unlock everything.

Start out slow and steady and as you accumulate more the game will get faster and weirder vehicles and options to modify track generation will appear. You want to drive narrow roads with a maximum of hills and curves? Or long straight 30-lane highways with no traffic? There are unlimited tracks.

To add to the old school feel of the retro gameplay Incremental Retro Racing also includes a fully customizable CRT Filter. Turn your 4K screen into an old tube with static noise and lousy picture. Just don't hit the tv to remove the color tornado but tweak the options instead.

4534250.name: Bob BOBBED Bob...
4534250.about_the_game:
A MISSING-PERSON LOST!!! A BIG desolate LANDSCAPE WAITING TO BE EXPLORED… A SINGLE PLAYER INDIE EXPERIENCE: BASED ON A PODCAST???

You can use the SHERIFF-SENSE to guide you to the TRUTH, alerting you when you get close to clues!

You’re very responsible and never get scared and are always punctual writing notes after so many years in the force. Mysterious floating/disappearing trees don’t exist. No mountain demons either.

You can explore the Skyrimish Bobalachin mountains, finding Sheriff Bob in the mystery of the case and the beauty of the nature around him.

You can solve the mystery from about half an hour to many more.

Inspired by an accusation by Markiplier and Wade against Bob on the Distractible podcast (though we think you may not have to see it to enjoy this game).

For those speed demons, you can TIME YOURself going around the fence or getting all ten items! We aren’t that speedy when it comes to game dev, so we didn’t program that in (& there were probably other reasons).
developers: Adam and Simmons (Isaac Ward & Julian Ward)
publishers: Adam and Simmons (Julian Ward & Isaac Ward)

4534260.name: Kodama: Slumber of the Gods
4534260.about_the_game:
Precision Platforming
Master tight, responsive controls as you leap, dash, and climb through carefully crafted challenges.

Fluid Combat
Slide, stomp, dodge, and jump your way through enemies in fast-paced encounters. Chain your abilities together to outmaneuver foes and stay one step ahead.

Awaken the Kami
Discover ancient statues and awaken gods from Japanese folklore. Unlock new abilities that transform how you explore and fight.

A Colorful Hand-Drawn World
Explore a richly detailed, hand-crafted world inspired by Japanese folklore, brought to life with vibrant environments and hand_drawn animation.

No AI "Art"
All visuals are carefully drawn, with no use of AI-generated art, crafted with passion.

4534350.name: Radar Identified
4534350.about_the_game:
You are the controller.

Radar Identified puts you in charge of the upper airspace — the invisible highways above FL200 where hundreds of aircraft cross the world every hour. Your job: keep them separated, keep them moving, and get them where they need to go efficiently.

Built by real-world air traffic controllers and pilots who wanted a simulation that gets the details right — from proper phraseology to realistic climb profiles and sector procedures.

This is not a tower game. There are no runways, no taxiways, no ground vehicles. A radar scope, flight strips, and the constant hum of radio traffic. You are the en-route controller — the one who guides aircraft between sectors, manages descents into major airports, and resolves conflicts at 35,000 feet.

Realistic en-route ATC

  • Control German upper airspace sectors — US and Canadian sectors coming soon.

  • Real waypoints, airways, and sector boundaries based on European ATC procedures

  • ICAO standard phraseology — readbacks, callsigns, and proper radio communication

  • Flight level management with semi-circular rule

  • STCA (Short Term Conflict Alert) and separation monitoring

  • Handoffs to neighboring sectors and lower airspace controllers

  • Authentic airline callsigns and aircraft types — from Lufthansa A320s to Emirates A380s

  • Dynamic weather with wind affecting groundspeed and storms.

Your tools

  • Radar scope — aircraft blips with data tags showing callsign, flight level, speed, and destination

  • Flight strips — accept, manage, and hand off each aircraft

  • Radial menu — quick access to flight level changes, heading vectors, and direct-to clearances

  • Command line — type ATC commands directly for faster control

  • Time control — speed up quiet periods, pause to plan your strategy

Learn at your own pace

A full handbook system with deep lessons teaches you everything from accepting your first aircraft to resolving head-on conflicts. No prior ATC knowledge required — but if you're a ATC SIM veteran, you'll feel right at home.

Four sectors

  • EDMM — München: Heavy international traffic with Emirates, Thai, and Singapore mixing with European carriers

  • EDUU — Rhein-Main: Compact sector with converging routes and Nürnberg traffic

  • EDFE — Erfurt: Gateway to eastern Europe with Czech, Polish, and Scandinavian traffic

  • EDSE — Stuttgart: Close to France and Switzerland with multiple scenarios of traffic

4534550.name: BlackStump
4534550.about_the_game:
Overview

BlackStump is a free-to-play cozy cooperative life simulator where up to 8 players can cooperate to mend natural and spiritual connections in abandoned landscapes using the power of their voices and their creativity.

Play with friends

BlackStump is built for co-op gameplay. Play minigames with friends by interacting with wisps.

Combine your resources to appease spirits roaming about the land.

Explore the island

The world is filled with activities to try; if you find one, get some friends over to join in!

Proximity Chat

Use your voice to chat with friends and navigate the world around you!  And maybe even hear the world talk back...



This game was made as a Senior Capstone project for RPI's Games and Simulation Arts and Sciences program.

4534590.name: ISLAND OF VALKYRIES
4534590.about_the_game:
Visual novel with hentai themes in which the protagonist is transported to an island inhabited by valkyries, with the mission of perpetuating their species. However, these fierce warriors will not give in easily: before accepting you—and having sex with you—they will challenge you to turn-based battles to prove your worth.

But it’s not all about strength. During battles, you must also answer their questions correctly to earn their respect and affection. If you have enough intelligence points in your stats, you can unlock one or even two different endings with each of them.

Win battles to earn money and purchase resources in the shop: improve your attributes such as strength and intelligence, and obtain potions that will help you recover health during combat.

Dive into this adventure and meet, face, and conquer four different valkyries, each with their own personality and challenges.

Single-player visual novel based on turn-based combat and multiple-choice decisions.

Content Warning: This game includes explicit sexual content, inappropriate language, and moderate violence. All characters are adults. The situations depicted are entirely fictional and are intended for artistic and entertainment purposes; they do not seek to promote or glorify the behaviors portrayed.
4534590.supported_languages: English, French, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese, Russian

4534600.name: Last Protocol
4534600.about_the_game:
Last Protocol is a Sci-fi 2D Top Down RPG Hack-and-slash game, where you help Jaiden Kent, who is a space cleaner, to get home after uncovering disturbing truths about his work. The game mechanics consists of shielding yourself from enemies, attacking space creatures, and learning about the unsettling world of Zavarna Space Station.

Game Features and Mechanics

  • Shielding yourself from alien creatures

  • Attacking with your trusty saber

  • Using Kafinate, a high-performance gas that helps you perform better

  • Use keycards and explore the area to solve puzzles and progress further

  • Unlock pieces of lore along your journey

Good luck getting home, Jaiden Kent.

4534610.name: Ask Mom: Find Objects, Learn Words
4534610.about_the_game:
A game for anyone who wants to learn a language easily and with fun!

Welcome to an educational game where you learn foreign words while helping a family find lost items, choose groceries, and make sense of the chaos of home and everyday life — all with the gentle humor of a mom who knows where absolutely everything is.

🎯 What kind of game is this

Ask Mom is a combination of:

  • hidden object searching (hidden object),

  • learning words in a foreign language with voice acting,

  • short story scenes and dialogues in the player’s native language (or in the language you’re learning for a more advanced level).

It’s perfect if you want to learn without boring drills — through everyday situations, emotions, and relatable family moments.

🧩 How it works

  • You see a word in the language you’re learning

  • You find the matching object in the picture

  • You listen to the pronunciation and remember it in context

  • You progress through little stories about family life

The word sets are varied: it’s not only about finding lost items, but also lots of words for different everyday situations:
What should you take from the fridge for breakfast? What do you need to pack for school? What do you need for a picnic?

🌍 A multicultural family

This family is an incredible blend of several nationalities. Words from different cultures appear naturally in the game: household items, holidays, food, habits.

⭐ Why you should add it to your wishlist

  • light, natural vocabulary learning;

  • short levels, great for daily practice;

  • humor and a cozy family atmosphere;

  • progress feels fast — words stick on their own;

  • high-quality word voice acting;

  • regular updates with new scenes and word sets are planned.

💛 Add Ask Mom to your wishlist

I’m making this game solo, and every wishlist helps it show up higher in discovery and reach players who truly need it. 

If the idea of light, cozy, lively language learning resonates with you — please wishlist the game. It really helps the project grow.

A free demo is coming soon so you can fully try the hidden-object and vocabulary mechanics.

Mom: "I have a wonderful big family. But every member of my family has one flaw. They keep losing EVERYTHING!"
4534610.supported_languages:
English*, French*, Italian*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Spanish - Latin America*, Portuguese - Portugal*, Russian, Ukrainian, Portuguese - Brazil*, Turkish*
*languages with full audio support

4534620.name: Mercatoria
4534620.about_the_game:
[h1]Mercatoria[/h1]

A hex-grid, turn-based grand strategy game set in the Age of Discovery,
inspired by the 1999 classic Imperialism 2.

The year is 1492. You take command of one of six European powers — England,
France, Spain, Holland, Portugal, or Sweden — and compete for dominance of
the Old World through trade, industry, colonisation, and war. Across the
Atlantic, the New World lies mostly unexplored: sugarcane, tobacco, fur,
and diamonds await the nation bold enough to reach them first.

Every turn is a year. Every map is new. No two games play the same.

What you actually do in Mercatoria


Build a transport network. Resources don't appear in your stockpile
by magic. Send Engineers out to build roads, connect your iron ore mines
and timber clusters to your capital, lay down a harbour, and watch your
industrial base come to life. Rivers give free transport. Roads take 1–3
turns to build depending on terrain. Every hex matters.

Industrialise. Raw materials become finished goods in your capital:
timber becomes lumber and paper; iron ore and coal become steel; wool
becomes fabric for training your workforce. Lock your production batches
manually or let auto-production handle the grind.

Grow your workforce. Level 1 workers produce 1 Labour per turn.
Upgrade them through four tiers using luxury goods — sugar at tier 2,
cigars at tier 3, fur hats at tier 4 — and a single worker can do the
output of eight. But luxuries need to come from somewhere, which usually
means the New World, which usually means you need a navy.

Explore, colonise, and conquer. Send Explorers out to prospect for
hidden minerals. Build fleets. Establish bridgeheads. Land armies on
indigenous territory and claim new colonies — or leave the natives in
peace and trade with them instead.

Wage war, or avoid it. Combat plays out over up to six rounds of
simultaneous fire: artillery first, cavalry second, infantry and warriors
in melee. Units earn medals that stick with them across battles.
Generals automatically emerge in every garrison of 10+ units and boost
morale and deployment. Forts reduce incoming damage. Terrain matters.
Encirclement matters.

Trade and diplomacy. The World Market is a shared auction house —
your order gets matched with nations that like you more than your
competitors. Subsidise allies. Boycott rivals. Form Non-Aggression Pacts
and Alliances. When an ally gets attacked, you'll get a war request
popup. Decline it and your alliance breaks, and your relations sink.

Research a deep tech tree. Over 80 technologies covering farming,
mining, transport, military tactics (four eras of infantry, cavalry, and
artillery), and extraction — the techs you need to upgrade your resource
hexes beyond Level 1. Only one research slot at a time. Choose carefully.

Win the Old World. Control 70% of Old World provinces and you win.
The New World doesn't count toward victory — but its wealth can fund
your conquest.

Features


  • Procedural maps — every game is a fresh world of 180×110 hexes
  • 6 playable major powers with distinct AI personalities (Militarist,
    Trader, Expansionist)
  • 6 neutral minor nations and 8 passive indigenous peoples in the New World
  • 20+ resources, recipes, and manufactured goods
  • Over 80 technologies across 7 research categories
  • Four eras of military units — Infantry, Pikemen, Musketeers, Grenadiers,
    and their Cavalry and Artillery equivalents
  • Three classes of warship — Sloop, Frigate, Man-of-War
  • Veteran units that earn medals and improve over time
  • Full fog of war with exploration and scouting
  • Singleplayer vs AI
  • Multiplayer — LAN TCP/IP and Steam P2P, lock-step turns
  • English and Dutch language support
  • Save slots (8 manual + 1 autosave)

A word from the developer


Hi. I'm Dennis, the one person working on Mercatoria. I'm not a studio.
There's no marketing team, no publisher, no second developer. Mercatoria
is what I build in my evenings and weekends because I love strategy games
and because nobody has made a proper Imperialism 2 successor in 25 years.

Mercatoria is in Early Access. That means:

  • The game is playable, stable, and has hundreds of hours of content
    today — I wouldn't release it if it wasn't.
  • Some rough edges still exist. A few UI elements are placeholders, some
    balance numbers are being tuned, and I'm still adding features.
  • Your feedback matters. If something is unclear, unbalanced, or
    buggy, tell me. Steam forums, Discussions, reviews — I read all of it.
  • I update when I can. Sometimes that's weekly, sometimes life gets in
    the way. I'll always be honest about where the game stands.

I want Mercatoria to be a game strategy fans actually enjoy playing for
years. I can't promise I'll implement every request, but I can promise
I'll read every one and take them seriously. If you loved Imperialism 2
and have been waiting a long time for something in the same spirit —
welcome aboard. Let's build this together.

— Dennis, Groundwork Studio

4534720.name: Expandica
4534720.about_the_game:
Build your settlement, manage resources, and conquer enemy camps—all while pursuing your ultimate goal: closing the portal that unleashes evil creatures into this world.

As you develop your settlement, you’re free to shape it however you like. With a variety of decorative elements and the ability to modify the terrain by placing or removing blocks, creativity plays a key role in how your world evolves.

You can control villagers and assign them to different tasks—working, patrolling, exploring, or fighting enemies. This flexibility allows you to play at your own pace and approach challenges in your own way.

Conquering enemy camps requires strategic thinking. Each camp is designed as a unique puzzle, meaning that simply having a large army won’t always guarantee victory.

As developers, we aimed to blend settlement building and resource management with RTS mechanics to create a balanced and engaging experience. We hope you enjoy the game!

4534730.name: Backpack Alchemist: Medieval Shop Simulator
4534730.about_the_game:
Manage Your Own Medieval Alchemy Shop!

Leave behind swords, dungeons, and the rush to save the world. Backpack Alchemist offers you a peaceful yet mentally stimulating medieval shop experience. Step behind your old wooden counter, light your candles, and unzip your custom leather backpack. In your world, everything starts with fitting the right item into the right place.

It's All a "Grid-Based" Puzzle

How complicated can an old leather bag be? To a common merchant, it's just an item, but to a master like you, it's a puzzle waiting to be solved. You must efficiently pack massive scrolls, oddly shaped horns, and fragile potion bottles into a limited grid system. You cannot expand your shop without mastering spatial management.

Your Customers Are Waiting

The door to your shop never closes. Weary travelers, knights, and mysterious strangers arriving in town will demand the exact concoctions they need. Review their orders, find the right ingredients amidst the chaos of your bag, keep them happy, and fill your safe with gold.

Combine, Craft, Prosper

The ingredients on your table are just the beginning. Combine the right elements to craft much more valuable, rare, and bulky objects. Use the empty spaces in your bag wisely to evolve from an ordinary apprentice into a legendary alchemy master.

Key Features:

  • Relaxing yet Deep Mechanics: No combat, no time pressure. Just you, your items, and the perfect grid system where you must use your wits.

  • Satisfying Management: Grow your shop, find rarer items, and push the limits of your backpack.

  • Hand-Drawn Medieval Atmosphere: Retreat to your own quiet shop behind an authentic wooden counter, enjoy the moody view from your window, and immerse yourself in original hand-drawn items with a peaceful soundscape.
4534730.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish

4534780.name: Ashikai
4534780.about_the_game:
Ashikai is a dark fantasy isometric action RPG set in a yokai-cursed feudal Japan.

Inspired by Japanese tales of yokai, we follow Shinro, a samurai cut off after an ambush. You will fight through cursed roads, caves, and ruined strongholds to find Lord Kuroda and make your way back to your family, while precise katana combat and hard choices shape every step of the journey.

The more you refine your timing, the deadlier combat becomes. Perfect reads create brutal punish windows, clean deflects steal momentum by burning through enemy stamina, and every strike starts to feel decisive.

As Shinro grows, he learns combat skills and sharpens them through mastery, refining how he attacks, defends, and recovers under pressure. Shinro evolves faster with perfect timings and calculated battles. Clear real-time feedback makes every exchange readable during the fights.

Ashikai pits you against both human fighters and oni horrors, each with their own roles, strengths, and combat stats. Enemies do not simply trade blows. They react, parry your attacks, dodge your advances, cover for one another, punish overextension, and press their advantage when they sense weakness.

Every encounter is a tactical problem. You are reading formations, disrupting enemy synergy, and preventing the fight from turning against you. Push too far while underleveled, and stronger foes will punish hesitation, collapse on mistakes, and make every bad decision hurt.

Shinro can discover over 20 katanas, from humble common blades to rare unique weapons that can reshape how you cut through enemies.

Each blade rolls with its own power, rarity, and combat traits, so finding a new katana is not just a bigger number. It can push you toward faster strikes, heavier crits, life leech, elemental effects, or a completely different way to survive the next fight.

Factions in Ashikai are more than background names: ronin, citizens, yakuza, Shinsengumi, bandits, and other powers all have their own place in the world.

Shinro’s actions can shape his reputation across the world, from who he helps and which quests he takes to who he attacks, protects, or betrays.

Favor one faction long enough and the balance can shift completely, turning old enemies into allies, former allies into threats, or Shinro himself into a new kind of outlaw.

Fight your way, craft your adventure and become the ultimate warrior
4534780.supported_languages:
English, Japanese*, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Thai, Traditional Chinese, French, German, Polish, Russian, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support

4534790.name: SHU
4534790.about_the_game:
SHU is a strategic tower defense game where every placement decision matters. Waves of relentless enemies — from cunning goblins to fearless warriors — march toward your base. Your mission: stop them all.

Build, upgrade, and position your towers wisely before each wave strikes. Use archers for ranged precision, mages for arcane devastation, or artillery for heavy splash damage. Each tower type brings a unique playstyle, and combining them is the key to survival.

Features

  • Three Unique Tower Types — Archer, Mage, and Artillery towers, each with their own strengths and upgrade paths

  • Wave-Based Combat — Survive increasingly difficult enemy waves, from scouting goblins to armored warriors

  • Gold Economy — Earn gold by defeating enemies, then spend it strategically to build and upgrade your defenses

  • Campaign Mode — Take on handcrafted levels with escalating challenges across a campaign map

  • Custom Game Mode — Load any saved map with your own starting gold and difficulty settings

  • Built-In Map Editor — Design and save your own battlefields from scratch, then challenge yourself to survive them

  • Save & Load — Save your maps and return to your custom creations at any time

  • Grace Periods — Use the time between waves to reinforce your defenses and plan your next move

How to Play

Place towers on the map during the preparation phase. When the wave begins, your towers attack automatically. Defeat every enemy before they reach your base — if your hit points drop to zero, it's game over. Survive all waves to claim victory.

Whether you're a tower defense veteran or a first-time defender, SHU offers deep strategic gameplay and endless replayability through its custom map editor and configurable difficulty.

Will your towers hold the line?

4534870.name: AutoShowRoom
4534870.about_the_game:
Welcome to your very own car showroom!

Click and collect a whole lot of different cars from all around the world to create the ultimate heaven for car enthusiasts and collectors.

NEW COUNTRIES! NEW CARS!:

Unlock 10 different locations :

LEVEL UP!

Keep leveling up and get better and rarer cars: 

NEW MECHANICS!

Unlock new mechanics as you progress:

EVENTS

Showcase your cars on random events to earn the most LP's (prestige currency)

TUNE YOUR FAVORITE CARS!

Unlock modding and tune cars to match with events and earn more!

AND MORE!

Minigames boost your run:

Gameplay:

-Buy and open containers from different countries.

-Collect cars and showcase them in your showroom.

-Attract more visitors.

-Match the ongoing event with the cars highlighted to earn more prestige points.

-Buy permanent upgrades.

-Play next run faster and unlock more locations.

Features:

-Cute and relaxing incremental game.

-Discover more than 100 cars.

-Huge number of country specific and theme events: AnimeCon event, Classics event etc...

-Tune your cars to match the events

-Strategize and manage for the optimal growth.

-For idlers, you will still earn prestige points with minimum to no active play.

-50+ permanent upgrades.

4535020.name: Gamarra - Street Vendor Simulator
4535020.about_the_game:
Step into the chaotic streets of Gamarra, Peru’s largest textile market, and build your street vending business from the ground up.


Deck out your stand with tables, racks, displays, colorful awnings, and even loudspeakers blasting your best deals. The flashier it looks, the more customers will flock to your shop!

Stock up on a variety of items—from small electronics and personal care products to underwear, shirts, and the local sports teams gear. Watch your shop come alive as customers browse, pick, and buy!

Every customer has a budget—price your goods wisely, offer deals to attract shoppers, and master the art of bargaining to thrive in the bustling streets of Gamarra!



The streets of Gamarra are ruled by Los Pulpos gang—pay up or face the consequences. Corrupt police are always on the lookout for vendors to extort or raid. Meet Gamarra's colorful characters, uncover their stories, and manage your health, stamina, and resilience to survive the chaos while building your business.

Your impoverished family is your main motivation, but they also need your support. Decide how to spend your earnings—invest in your stand, expand your business, or send money home to care for your loved ones. Every choice matters as you work toward owning a permanent store and becoming a respected entrepreneur in Gamarra.

4535030.name: Card Trainer
4535030.about_the_game:
A unique card game where you play as one of the unit cards. Build a unique deck consisting of unit cards, equipment cards, magical items, consumable cards, skill cards, ability cards, and curse cards to defeat your enemies.

Currently there are 2 game modes: world adventure mode and endless dungeon mode, featuring 292 unit cards (6 species and 6 ranks) and 197 playable cards.

4535050.name: Rescue the Hostages: Words of Fear
4535050.about_the_game:
The danger continues in Words of Fear, the next entry in the Rescue the Hostages series that blends suspense with a clever twist on word puzzles. This FMV horror experience puts you face-to-face with a dangerous new challenge where careful thinking may be the only thing standing between life and disaster.

The notorious mad bomber has returned, and this time four hostages are caught in the middle of his latest scheme. Your task is to work through a complex word search puzzle, uncovering the right words to disarm the explosive device. Each discovery raises the stakes as the countdown continues.

Stay focused, search carefully, and keep your nerves steady. Every word matters, and time is running out. The question is simple: can you solve the puzzle in time to save them?

4535090.name: Beyond Hatred
4535090.about_the_game:
Beyond Hatred is a 2D ARPG where magic and tragedy collide.

You were just a simple human when you witnessed your father’s murder right before your eyes, powerless to stop it. That moment sealed your fate.

Driven by rage and the need for justice, you venture into a world filled with hostile creatures, arcane secrets, and powers far beyond your understanding.

To confront the killer —an enemy you already know, yet far stronger than your current abilities— you must become a true sorcerer.

Explore dangerous lands, master new spells, level up, equip powerful items, and face unique enemies and bosses. Every step brings you closer to the truth… and to vengeance.

🛠️ Development Status
Beyond Hatred is currently in development. This demo represents a portion of the project’s vision, and the final game may differ as it evolves.

🎮 Playable Demo Coming Soon

The playable demo will be available soon. Discover the story, experience real-time combat, and explore the progression and magic systems. Immerse yourself in the world of Beyond Hatred and prepare for your adventure!

4535170.name: Dicebinder
4535170.about_the_game:
Dicebinder blends the strategic depth of turn-based roguelites with the thrill of dice and creature collecting. Roll dice to battle creatures made of cards—defeat them or bind them to your team. Inspired by classic tabletop RPGs and monster collectors, the game adds a highly tactical layer of party building.

🎲 TACTICAL DICE COMBAT

Combat revolves around managing your dice pool. Roll dice to determine your available actions each turn. Meet specific number requirements to activate powerful creature skills, spend dice to generate shields equal to their value, or store up to 3 dice to unleash massive combos on your next turn. Every roll forces you to balance risk, aggression, and survival.

⛓️ BIND YOUR ENEMIES

Why just kill monsters when you can recruit them? Instead of simply dealing damage, you can use your dice to bind weakened enemies. Bind enemy cards to instantly add them to your current active party, or discard them to unlock them permanently for future runs. This progressive capture system ensures that every battle is an opportunity to completely change your strategy and build the ultimate deck of creatures.

⚡ ROGUELITE PROGRESSION & AUGMENTS

Ascend 5 unique elemental towers filled with unexpected challenges. At the top of each climb waits a boss that alters the fundamental rules of the fight. Conquer them, and you will have the opportunity to draft powerful Augments—choosing one of three game-changing effects that can turn the tide in challenging encounters and create wild synergies with your team.

If your party is defeated, the game doesn’t end in frustration. Dicebinder features a robust background mission system that records your stats as you play. Completing these missions rewards you with meta-upgrades and new permanent unlocks that strengthen your account for subsequent runs, ensuring a continual sense of advancement even in defeat.

🧬 CREATE CRAZY COMBOS

Your captured creatures grow stronger the more you play them, gaining levels and attack power. Conquering towers unlocks a massive pool of random skills, and each unit can equip up to 2 customizable abilities—giving you full control over your party’s playstyle. With its blend of dice strategy, chance, and RPG progression, Dicebinder creates endless opportunities for powerful builds and crazy synergies, appealing to fans of deckbuilders, dungeon crawlers, and creature collectors alike.

4535200.name: Harpooneer
4535200.about_the_game:
In Harpooneer, you swing your way to the top of the mountain using 2 Harpoon Guns, overcoming difficult environments and puzzles while constantly being at risk of losing massive progress if you should make even a small mistake and fall.

Have fun shooting harpoons, reeling them in, and detaching and doing it all over again as many times as it takes to get to the top of the mountain!


This game is not for the faint of heart, so do not mistake it to be something to complete in an afternoon.

This game is inspired by other popular "rage games", such as Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy, A Difficult Game About Climbing and Chained Together. I grew up getting mad (and over) such games, and wanted my foray into indie development to be a game that I myself would have wanted to play when I was younger.

4535260.name: Brute Battles
4535260.about_the_game:
Your Brute, Your Rules

Split your stat points between Power, Agility, and Toughness to define how your brute fights. Every level-up brings something new: pick from 45+ traits that can completely change your fighting style, recruit pets that charge into battle alongside you, and keep chasing better randomly generated weapons!

Enter the Arena

Chained combos, clutch dodges, pets tearing into the enemy, weapons drawn at random from your bag.

Earn Your Look

Unlock Armor & Weapon skins just by playing. Hit milestones, complete achievements, and dress your brute in gear that shows what you've accomplished in the arena.

Rise to the Top

See how your brutes stack up against players from around the world. Climb the leaderboards.

4535290.name: Power of X
4535290.about_the_game:
Power of X is a flash-era inspired puzzle platformer where you control a hivemind of clones in an underground facility. Carefully manipulate special abilities to control a whole screen of clones at once.

There are 10 different mutants to discover, and more puzzle elements to make the game get more and more challenging as you go along. 

Will you be able to escape? Or, more accurately... how many of you will be able to escape?

4535300.name: First Steps in Learning about Childbirth
4535300.about_the_game:
"First Steps in Childbirth" is an educational serious game that allows players to learn about the process of childbirth through an interactive story and mini-games.

From the onset of labor to delivery and the beginning of life with a newborn, players can experience each stage in a structured and engaging way. The game is designed to help users understand the roles of medical staff and the progression of childbirth in an accessible format.

This title is a sequel to "First Steps in Pregnancy" and is developed with the cooperation of medical professionals.

Features:

- Story-based experience covering the full childbirth journey

- Interactive mini-games simulating key moments

- Educational TIPS explaining important concepts

- Quiz-style learning elements

- Designed for beginners, families, and healthcare students

This game is intended for educational purposes only and does not provide medical advice. For actual medical decisions, please consult a qualified healthcare professional.

4535320.name: Rotfang: The House
4535320.about_the_game:
Play as the family dog in this horror game, defend the house from a monster lurking in the shadows. Complete tasks for your family, explore the house, and find the dark secret buried below. A film aesthetic and an ultra realistic environment creates a very unique sense of immersion while playing. Tense chases and the threat of being caught lurks behind every corner. Bark, hold a flashlight, and grab items to bring back to family members. 

A unique camera system is used in the game, similar to the classic fixed camera systems of older games.

Tank controls make each encounter more difficult, and exciting.

The average playtime is 1 - 2 hours.

Created by a solo developer.

4535410.name: Orbosis Gloriosis
4535410.about_the_game:
Orbosis Gloriosis is an incremental arcade game built around physics and upgrade management.

The core loop is straightforward: deal damage to orbs until they crack and shatter into smaller ones to harvest their energy. You can also gather earnings from Orbs merging back together.

Purchasing an upgrade unlocks its adjacent nodes, letting you chart your own path through the tree. You can focus your build on raw damage, increase your auto-attack frequency, boost your critical hit rate, or spec into chain reactions that cause lightning to jump between targets.

The damage numbers and upgrade costs scale higher and higher, creating synergies that add to the satisfying and pleasing-to-the-eye mechanics of the game.

4535430.name: 童谣无忌
4535430.about_the_game:
Rhyme of the Innocent is a dialogue-driven mystery visual novel set in 1998. Step into the shoes of Gu Yao, a journalist in 1998, as you travel to Hongcha Valley—a remote village in Anhui Province—to uncover the truth behind an anonymous letter and an eerie nursery rhyme connected to an old, unsolved case.

Investigate the village through exploration, evidence-based conversations, item inspection, and timeline reconstruction. As testimonies begin to conflict, each choice may change what you learn and how the story unfolds.

  • Dialogue-focused detective narrative

  • Exploration, item interaction, and clue-linking mechanics

  • Chapter-based progression with multiple endings

  • Atmospheric presentation with cinematic audio-visual moments

4535450.name: 【クラウドファンディング・ストレッチゴール特典ソフト】鉄道にっぽん！限定特別版 for ズイキマスコンPRO

大手私鉄「小田急電鉄」を舞台に、大都市から自然を感じる情景へと移りゆく沿線の鉄道運転を楽しみましょう！

小田急電鉄のロマンスカーGSE（70000系）で「新宿駅」を出発し、「小田原駅」を通り、その先の箱根登山線に入った終着駅「箱根湯本駅」まで【88.6 kmの運転区間】をお楽しみ頂けます。

警笛ペダルや計器モニターをお持ちの方は、より本格的な運転士気分を味わえます。

4535470.name: Endless Castle: Under Siege
4535470.about_the_game:
Game Description

Deeply blending the classic elements of idle and tower defense games, this game offers rich hero and equipment build options. Hands-free and hassle-free, enjoy the joy of strategic combination and effortless growth!

Please Note

This game contains extensive equipment grinding elements. Players who do not enjoy grinding for gear are advised to purchase with caution!!!

Game Features

  • Auto Battle
    Fully hands-free with auto-battle mode — level up and hunt for loot at the same time.

  • Numerous Heroes
    40 unique heroes allow you to build diverse lineups and explore various playstyles.

  • Hero Equipment
    Random combinations of dozens of ability affixes make every drop and forge a moment of anticipation!

  • Varied Modes
    Beyond idling, enhance your overall strength through colonies, dragon battles, expeditions, fortresses, and other distinct gameplay modes.

    No penalties for defeat — simply wait for your power to grow and try again. No enemy is unbeatable!

4535630.name: WallFront
4535630.about_the_game:
Defend your fortress from countless enemies in an experience that blends classic positioning strategy with the depth of modern Roguelites. In Wallfront, you don't just control a single hero—you manage an elite squad where every unit and strategy is vital to the survival of the wall.

A Great Variety of Troops Wallfront offers numerous unique units at your disposal. For those who wish to defeat their enemies with a unique strategy using spells, weapons, or even their bare fists! Position your troops however you prefer and create an unbeatable army.

Roguelike Elements The fate of the frontier depends not only on steel and magic but on the secrets you unearth. Accumulate an arsenal of crucial tactical artifacts.

Transform a simple group of defenders into an unstoppable force by equipping troops with passive abilities that interact with each other. Your creativity is your ultimate defense.

Meta-progression Fall in combat, rise with more power. Wallfront's meta-progression system ensures that no run is in vain. Collect diamonds to purchase permanent upgrades for damage, defense, and utility. The wall may fall today, but tomorrow it will be unshakable.

Wallfront is a love letter to classic tower defense games, expanded with the adrenaline of roguelites. Developed by Yajirushi Studio, our focus is to deliver a pure, challenging, and rewarding tactical experience. Add to your Wishlist and help us keep the wall standing!

4535670.name: Rock, Paper, Scissors: Survival
4535670.about_the_game:
Rock, Paper, Scissors: Survival takes the world's most iconic hand game and transforms it into an explosive fantasy fighting experience... playable solo against AI or online against real players worldwide through Steam.

This isn't the RPS you played as a kid. It's a card-based fighter where up to four warriors battle in a single arena under one rule: Rock crushes Scissors. Scissors cuts Paper. Paper covers Rock. And magic? Magic changes everything.

Magic is the twist. Alongside the three classic throws, every fighter can command a fourth weapon... devastating spells that can rewrite a match in an instant. Play the triangle wrong and you lose the round. Play magic at the right moment and you end the fight.

Choose your champion. A fearsome African warrior. A disciplined Japanese assassin. A brawling Irish berserker. A sorceress of devastating power. Each brings their own combat style, their own battle cry, and their own ferocity to the arena but every fighter commands the same four weapons.

Every round is a mind game. Read your opponent, anticipate their move, and strike with precision. Land the right throw and watch your champion unleash a cinematic finishing blow, because a sheet of paper becomes a shuriken, a rock becomes a weapon of war, and a pair of scissors becomes an instrument of destruction.

Every victory is survival. Every defeat could be your last.

Features

  • Solo survival against AI opponents, or online multiplayer against real players through Steam

  • Eight fully animated fantasy fighters, each with unique combat personalities and animations

  • Four weapons per fighter: Rock, Paper, Scissors, and devastating magic spells

  • Explosive cinematic attack and spell effect animations

  • Dynamic sound design with character-authentic battle cries

  • High-stakes survival gameplay where strategy meets split-second decision making

The ancient game has evolved. Are you ready to survive it?

4535680.name: am I STILL me
4535680.about_the_game:
Short Description

Gain forbidden power. Reshape your build. Risk losing yourself.

A dark fantasy deckbuilding roguelite where corruption makes you stronger — and determines how your story ends.

About This Game

In am I STILL me, power always comes at a price.

This is a dark fantasy deckbuilding roguelite where you grow stronger by embracing corruption. Every choice can reshape your deck, your strategy, and ultimately your ending.

Build your deck from 180+ cards, discover powerful combinations, and adapt through tense turn-based battles. Summon allies, exploit status effects, and create devastating synergies that push your build in different directions.

But every gain has consequences.

The more power you take, the more your mind and body begin to change. Corruption can unlock greater strength, but it also pulls you closer to losing who you are.

How far will you go for power?

And when it’s over... will you still be yourself?

Features

- Dark fantasy deckbuilding roguelite gameplay shaped by player choice

- Build and refine unique decks from 180+ cards

- Create different playstyles through cards, dark powers, and corruption

- Turn-based battles focused on synergy, risk, and adaptation

- Use corruption as a source of power — at the cost of your selfhood

- Multiple endings based on the path you choose

- A dark fantasy journey about power, identity, and self-destruction

4535690.name: evoke: The Rules of Toys
4535690.about_the_game:
About This Game

A room choked with trash, where light and sound have long since faded.
A man sits in silence, staring endlessly into the static of a flickering television.
The owner who once cherished Patch is now a hollow shell of his former self.

— I just want to see that smile again.

Bound by the Three Rules of Toys, Patch must venture into the darkness of the room, retrieve lost “mementos,” and return them to his owner.

The Three Rules of Toys

First Rule: A toy must never be seen moving.

Second Rule: A toy must never break.

Third Rule: A toy must always make its owner happy.

First Rule: Never Be Seen Moving　— A deadly game of Red Light, Green Light —

Wherever the owner’s gaze falls, even the slightest movement is forbidden.
If you are seen, you will be caught—and torn apart.
Hide behind furniture. Use everyday objects to create blind spots. Move only when unseen.

Every step is a tense, calculated advance in this stealth-puzzle experience.

Second Rule: Never Break　— Evolution through damage —

Your fragile body can be repaired using scraps scattered throughout the room.

Each salvaged piece grants new abilities, opening paths once blocked.
But the more you “fix” yourself, the further you drift from being a toy — and closer to something else.

Third Rule: Always Make Your Owner Happy　— Memories awakened, a shifting world —

Deliver the mementos you find to your owner — without being detected.
But not all memories bring comfort.

When emotions overflow, the owner loses control,
and the room itself begins to change.

Former Companions

Patch is not alone. Other toys have survived, hidden within the room.
In brief moments of calm between the tension, you will encounter them.
Working together with these companions is key to moving forward.

Features

Stealth Puzzle Gameplay

Read the owner’s gaze, track sound, and use the environment to find your path.

Repair & Evolve

Rebuild your body with scraps and unlock new abilities.

Emotion-Driven Multiple Endings

The “memories” you choose to return shape a story that is both cruel and tender.

4535700.name: ESKAPI2 7カイキ
4535700.about_the_game:
You are trapped in a nightmare world.

To escape, you must find the "offerings" and "shrines" and offer seven prayers.

However, you must not be seen by the "ghosts" and "monsters" that infest the mansion.

If you are seen, use obstacles to your advantage and escape with all your might.

"ESKAPI" is a simple escape game where you just need to find the "key items" and "escape points" to advance to the next stage.

The placement of gimmicks such as doors that make up the stage, enemies, and items changes randomly each time.

Create a path with light source items.

Hide behind cover to avoid being found.

Lure enemies with sound-making items.

Aim to clear the game with your favorite play style.
4535700.supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese

4535740.name: BattleFrame
4535740.about_the_game:
MOBILIZE // FIGHT // EXTRACT

BattleFrame 

A third-person mecha action shooter that looks to bring back the weight and tension of classic mech combat. Step into the role of a Strider, warriors-for-hire that are contracted throughout the Frontier by one of three warring factions: the Greater Vostok Union, the Kossak Republics, and the Pyrats.

Features

  • Deploy across an array of fractured theatres — dense forest worlds, crumbling industrial wastelands, cosmo-stations - and experience intense PvE engagements, either Singleplayer or Co-Op.

  • Arm yourself with a vast arsenal from long-range rifles to massive melee weaponry. 

  • Customize your BattleFrame - swap out parts and upgrade your machine with powerful Attachments and Modules.

  • Risk it all in 1v1 PvP deathmatches against rival Striders.

4535750.name: Dragon Eggs: Adventure in Fractal Bullet Hell
4535750.about_the_game:
Dragon Eggs is a 3D roguelike bullet hell survival game where you wake up in a mystery island facing hordes of enemies. You have to dodge hundreds of thousands of projectiles from the enemies, gather pets to fight back automatically for you, and level up them to survive for as long as you can!

Fractal Bullet Hell

Bullets keep splitting into more bullets!

Merge Pets to Upgrade:

Endless combinations!
4535750.game_link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4535750/Dragon Eggs: Adventure in Fractal Bullet Hell/

4535770.name: 绿囚 / GreenGuardian
4535770.about_the_game: To survive horror games, players need the help of the outside world to survive. Test the player's action and strategy. Operation and play: use the box to control the water switch in the plant laboratory to plant plants to obtain energy. Through the synthetic energy and weapons to resist the attack of physical monsters, and finally escape from life. Features: Real physical interaction, dragging interactive items through the mouse. Into the tower defense gameplay. Customs clearance time: more than one hour

4535780.name: Love is Undead
4535780.about_the_game:
You’re a former scientist turned shut-in. Then, a zombie virus devastated the world, leaving it in ruins. After years of isolation, your supplies finally run dry, forcing you to leave the safety of your home. But fate has other plans. An accident leaves you bitten by a zombie. Surprisingly, nothing happens.

This unexpected discovery sparks a new purpose: to develop a vaccine and save humanity. But first, you’ll need another test subject… preferably a cute one.

Love is Undead is a post-apocalyptic adventure game that’s uniquely designed to be played using only your mouse. Venture into a zombie-infested world to scavenge for resources and ingredients that could aid your research for a cure… all while building a bond with your new research subject, Amber.

  • Resource Management
    Manage resources such as time, ingredients, food, as well as taking care of Amber.

  • Exploration / Adventure
    Venture out into the zombie-infested world, looking for usable resources, encountering special events along the way. Unlock other areas while seeing what's left of humanity (aside from zombies).

  • Relationship
    Surviving alone isn't enough to save humanity. Amber seems compatible with your vaccine, but she also needs food, medicine, and care. Make sure she feels safe and happy being around you.

  • Progressive Content

    The game features additional dialogues, options, and more, depending how close you've become with Amber.
4535780.supported_languages:
English, Japanese*, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support

4535810.name: トコのトムトムランド
4535810.about_the_game:
Dominate the Battle Between Heroes and Demon Lords—Make This World Go Viral!

In a world where trends rule all, Toko—a merchant who loves the buzz—one day obtains the "Telecrystal," a device that streams a hero's adventure in real-time!

Earn steady profits during daily "Normal Operations" by predicting trends, then cash in big during hero "Broadcasts" with the Telecrystal!

Normal Operations Phase Visit weapon shops, smithies, and information brokers to prepare for business. Once ready, stock your shelves with items and open for the day. Results appear instantly!

Broadcast Phase When the hero adventures, the town goes wild! Set up a festival stall to profit. Watch the hero's journey on the Telecrystal and select 5 items from your stock of 10. The hero's exploits raise and lower prices in real-time! Read the battle and swap items strategically.

The Choice is Yours At each dungeon's end, the demon lord faces the hero. Boost the influencer hero for higher profits, or fund the demon lord army for a windfall. Your business success depends on your production choices!

4535850.name: LACUNA -ZEROA-
4535850.about_the_game:
About This Game

Every world you've ever dreamed of. One battlefield.
LACUNA -ZEROA- is an open world survival craft FPS set in a world shaped by colliding civilizations — ancient Gothic ruins, abandoned sci-fi military outposts, and mythical landscapes inspired by dark fantasy and JRPG worlds. Every region tells a different story.

Five Elements. Infinite Tactics.

Choose from five elemental attributes — Fire, Ice, Lightning, Wind, and Earth. Your element shapes how you fight. Enchant any weapon with elemental power — load Thunder Rounds into your assault rifle, coat your scythe in ice, or set your shotgun shells ablaze. Every weapon in your arsenal becomes an extension of your element.

Unleash powerful elemental abilities in combat. Raise an Ice Wall to block enemy fire. Execute a Shock Dash to close the distance in a flash. Combine your enchanted weapons with your abilities to create devastating combat strategies unique to your playstyle.

An Arsenal of Weapons

LACUNA -ZEROA- features a wide variety of weapons — from firearms like assault rifles and revolvers to melee weapons like swords, greatswords, and scythes. Every weapon can be enchanted with your element, giving each one a distinct identity on the battlefield.

Fast, Fluid Combat

Experience aggressive first-person combat with fast movement mechanics. Sprint, slide, wall-climb, and mantle through a vertical world built for dynamic engagements. No stamina bars slowing you down — LACUNA -ZEROA- rewards relentless aggression and creative movement.

Survive Together or Alone

Scavenge resources from ancient ruins and fallen enemies. Craft weapons, armor, and elemental consumables to gain an edge. Manage your food, water, and health as you push deeper into hostile territory. Play solo and carve your own path, or team up with other players to dominate the battlefield. Trust no one — or build an empire together.

PvP and PvE

Battle other players for territory and resources in open world PvP. Hunt dangerous creatures and powerful bosses lurking in the darkest corners of the map. Whether you seek conflict with other survivors or challenge the world itself, LACUNA -ZEROA- delivers both.

A World of Many Inspirations

Explore a vast open world where every region draws from a different vision. Frozen Gothic cathedrals. Overgrown JRPG-inspired fantasy forests. Abandoned near-future military installations. Sci-fi research facilities buried underground. Each area has its own atmosphere, loot, and dangers — rewarding those who dare to explore.

Key Features

  • Five Elemental Attributes — Fire, Ice, Lightning, Wind, and Earth

  • Weapon Enchanting — enchant any weapon, from firearms to melee, with elemental power

  • Elemental Abilities — powerful skills that reshape the flow of combat

  • Diverse Weapon Arsenal — assault rifles, revolvers, swords, greatswords, scythes, and more

  • No Stamina System — fast, unrestricted movement with sprint, slide, wall-climb, and mantle

  • Open World Survival Craft — gather, craft, build, and survive

  • Solo or Team Play — survive alone or form teams with other players

  • PvP and PvE — fight players and hunt dangerous creatures

  • A World of Contrasts — dark fantasy, sci-fi, military, and JRPG-inspired environments built in Unreal Engine 5

4535860.name: The Way Home | 집으로 가는 길
4535860.about_the_game:
■ Before You Buy: Recommended For

  • Horror Beginners: This game avoids excessive jump scares, prioritizing a slowly tightening sense of psychological dread.

■ About the Game

A deep, rural village in 1990s South Korea. On your way home from work, walking alone down a dark road with only a few dim streetlights, you encounter a mysterious incident. Experience the eerie events unfolding over just three days and uncover the true nature of the invisible threat hunting you.

■ Key Features

  • Condensed Horror Experience: Designed to deliver intense psychological horror within a 30 to 40-minute playtime.

  • Multi-Ending System: Your choices in critical moments will determine the protagonist's fate with two distinct endings.

  • Chapter Saves: Progress is saved for each day (chapter), allowing you to jump back in at any time.

  • 1990s South Korea

■ Streaming & Content Creation

We warmly welcome streamers and content creators to broadcast and create videos of this game.

  • Including the store URL in your video description is greatly appreciated and provides immense support to the developer.

■ Controls

  • Flashlight On / Off : [ 1 ] 

  • Move: WASD

  • Run: WASD + Shift

  • Interact: F

  • You can view the controls in-game by going to ESC -> Settings -> Controls.

  • If you experience stuttering or lag: We recommend going to ESC -> Settings -> V-Sync: OFF and limiting the Frame Rate to 60, 120, or 144 to match your monitor's refresh rate.
4535860.supported_languages: English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, French, German, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian

4535890.name: The Profaned
4535890.about_the_game:
You are not here by accident.

Burdened by sins you cannot escape, you find yourself trapped within a silent, forsaken church.

There are no prayers left to save you - only a ritual.

Observe your surroundings carefully.

Something is always wrong.

An object shifts when it shouldn’t.

A figure appears where none existed.

The church itself begins to change.

These are anomalies.

Your task is simple: find them, capture them, and cleanse your sins. But the church does not forgive mistakes.

If even a single anomaly remains unnoticed, your progress is erased… and the ritual begins again.

With every cycle, the tension grows. Doubt creeps in. Are you missing something… or is the church watching you?

Features:

  • Atmospheric anomaly-hunting gameplay set in a haunted church

  • Subtle and disturbing changes that test your perception

  • A tense loop where failure resets your progress

  • Psychological horror driven by observation and uncertainty

You are being watched.

Stay focused.

Capture the anomalies.

Cleanse your sins.

Designed as a short but intense experience, the game can be completed in approximately one hour (~1 hour),

depending on your awareness and attention to detail. Inspired by atmospheric and psychological horror

walking simulators like The Exit 8, liminal space environments, and P.T., it focuses on subtle fear, tension,

and the unsettling feeling that something is always just… wrong.

4535920.name: Little Casualties
4535920.about_the_game:
"Sorry Gerald."

Little Casualties is a chaotic, Lemmings-inspired puzzle game where hundreds of tiny named units march confidently toward an uncertain fate.

Place bridges, catapults, trampolines, and parachute dispensers to guide enough survivors to the exit.
The rest are acceptable losses.

What the critics are saying:

"It's kind of depressing" - Wife

"Ugh" - Me

"Dumb" - Bro

An epic journey spanning generations.

Gerald didn’t make it. Neither did Steve, Karen, or Jorge.
But Gerald Jr. is ready to try again. Then Gerald III. Then Gerald IV.

The cycle continues. This is their story.

Features:

  • Guide swarms of tiny units, each with their own name and short life expectancy

  • Watch them scatter, swarm, and occasionally succeed

  • Place tools strategically, or just see what happens

  • Build chaotic solutions with bridges, launchers, trampolines, and other questionable engineering

  • Classic Mode with handcrafted levels and escalating chaos

  • Squad Mode with a persistent roster, permadeath, lineage, and progression

  • Memorial Wall where everyone is remembered, more or less

  • Dozens of achievements across multiple runs

  • Piano-driven soundtrack built in Sonic Pi, which is a real thing

  • Native Linux support, also a real thing

Biomes in the full release:

Outside. Sawmill. Underground. City. The Office Building. Maybe Mars.

More biomes are planned as development continues. Gerald has a lot of places left to explore.

Made by one person.
No budget. No time.

4535930.name: Pax Astra
4535930.about_the_game:
Every ideology. Every method. One galaxy that remembers everything you do.

The war is over. The hard part starts now.

Altara was an empire built on conquest. Now it is a democracy built on rubble — and you are its first elected President. What you build from here, and how you build it, belongs entirely to you.

Pax Astra is a political RPG that puts you inside the machine of power — Negotiating with rival factions, signing or vetoing legislation, reading intelligence reports, issuing edicts that reshape society from the ground up. Every decision compounds. Ministers remember betrayals. Elections reflect your record. Foreign powers react to your moves. You will negotiate, legislate, scheme, and occasionally lie your way through a volatile political landscape. The state bends toward whatever ideology you feed it — or it breaks trying.

But Pax Astra does not stop at the office door.

Beyond Altara's borders lies the galaxy. Colonize distant planets, build industries, control trade networks, fund scientific expeditions, and push into unknown space. What begins as domestic politics escalates into something stranger and larger — negotiations with hiveminds, forbidden science, threats from outside the known galaxy, and paths that no political theory prepared you for.

What you can do in Pax Astra:

  • Govern without limits — liberal democrat, communist, fascist, libertarian, theocrat, or something entirely your own. No ideology is locked. No path is correct.

  • Shape the state itself — nationalize industries, expand labor rights, consolidate executive power, build a cult of personality, orchestrate a coup. Altara can become many things. Not all of them were intended.

  • Command the stars — colonize planets, build trade networks, fund expeditions into unknown space, and develop an interdimensional exploration program.

  • Face what lies beyond — negotiate with hiveminds, weaponize forbidden science, build a GODMACHINE, and confront threats from outside the known galaxy.

  • Live with consequences — elections reflect your record, alliances fracture, civil unrest builds, and the structure of the state itself shifts based on your choices. Altara ends differently every time.

Grounded in real political history. Open to the cosmic.

Altara begins where post-war Germany and Japan did — a radicalized society forced into a fragile, unfamiliar democracy. The political systems are real. The pressures are recognizable. But the universe around Altara opens into something far stranger, drawing on the tone of Dune, Legend of the Galactic Heroes, and Star Wars as much as political theory.

Inspired by Suzerain, Stellaris, and The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante.

Built by one developer. Designed for players who want their choices to mean something.

4536070.name: Succulent Break
4536070.about_the_game:
Welcome to your own desktop greenhouse.

In the gaps between work and daily life, pixel succulents grow quietly. No pressure, no complex mechanics — just a little patience to watch your succulents bloom with color.

4536100.name: Beer Gunner
4536100.about_the_game:
Beer Gunner

A fast-paced run-and-gun shooter in the spirit of the classics — shoot, jump, and shred monsters to energetic music.

You’re a living beer, armed to the foam. The enemies aren’t exactly fragile, so you’ll have to really “foam them up.” And freezing? Well, what did you expect — cold beer should chill the situation 🍺

What’s inside

• Dynamic gunfights and platforming

• Varied enemies and simple but punchy combat

• 4 levels + a secret one

• 3 difficulty modes — from easy to true beer hell

Graphics and music created with Nano Banana and Suno AI. And this description… probably too 😄

4536120.name: Beat Boxy
4536120.about_the_game:
📦 Special Delivery!

Beat Boxy is a brutally fun, rhythm-based 3D auto-runner featuring vibrant, stylized low-poly graphics and an incredibly catchy soundtrack. You play as Boxy, a wooden shipping crate rocking a white baseball cap, gloves, and boots. Boxy is perpetually running to the right, desperate to reach his delivery destination. It’s accessible enough to play with just two inputs, but challenging enough to test your reflexes, your patience, and your sanity.

🏃‍♂️ Simple to Learn, Impossible to Master

Boxy moves at a constant speed, and your survival depends entirely on two actions: Jump and Slide.

  • Two-Input Mastery: Jump over hazards, or chain jumps together for seamless landings. Slide to avoid overhead obstacles.

  • Dynamic Audio Rhythm: Sliding isn't just a physical maneuver. It slows Boxy down by 25% and dynamically slows the music's tempo right along with him, affecting your final completion time!

  • One-Hit Permadeath: Boxy doesn’t have a health bar. If you clip a traffic cone, hit a wall, or fall into a pit, Boxy explodes into wood planks. The upbeat music instantly dies like a record scratch, and it’s an instant restart.

  • Slow Zones: Need a breather? Certain areas feature "Slow Zones" that drop Boxy's speed and the music's tempo by exactly 50%. It gives you a moment to process the chaos, but hitting them will ruin your chances at a top-tier clear time.

🛹 3 Speeds of Stress

Boxy's speed stays consistent within each level, but depending on the stage, you'll be tackling obstacles using three distinct modes of transportation; each one faster than the last:

Running - Speed 1 (Base Speed)

Skateboarding - Speed 2 (25% Faster)

Rollerblading - Speed 3 (50% Faster)

💎 Risk, Reward, and Ranks

  • Gem Economy: Scattered throughout the treacherous levels are Gems used to unlock fresh new outfits in the shop. But if Boxy dies before the finish line, every Gem you collected spills out. You only bank what you survive with!

  • Brutal Ranking System: At the end of each level, you are awarded a rank based on your clear time; from Flawless and Prodigy, all the way down to Garbage and Literal Feces.

  • The Ultimate Shame: If a level is truly breaking your spirit, you can choose to skip it after 100 failed attempts. The catch? You are permanently branded with the Literal Feces rank for that stage until you're able to beat it.

📖 The Story

Boxy's journey begins in what he doesn't realize is just a dream. While in transit, he dreams of the perfect, idyllic delivery route: blissfully running through a beautiful sunrise park and skateboarding through a concrete jungle, ultimately arriving at a suburban house to be unboxed by a happy customer.

Then, the nightmare begins. Boxy wakes up screaming as a giant mechanical sorting claw snatches him off a conveyor belt in a massive shipping facility. Now, he has to run for his life to escape the warehouse, parks, and city streets to make his actual delivery window. What's inside the box? You'll have to survive to the end to find out!

So what do you think?... Can you Beat Boxy?

4536220.about_the_game:

4536290.name: Last Draft
4536290.about_the_game:
Facing a strict seven-day ultimatum from your publisher to deliver a completed draft or face immediate termination, desperation sets in. With nowhere else to turn, you retreat to Blackwood Manor; an infamous estate whispered about among your peers for its ability to cure writer's block. You aren't here looking for a muse, you are here out of pure career survival.

BLACKWOOD MANOR

The reputation for producing incredibly authentic horror comes with a dark catch. The inspirations are literal. Within the manor exists a conduit to another reality. It is a reality that neither needs nor recognizes the freedom and autonomy of your own. You will soon discover that the supposedly fictional chapters published by your peers are, in fact, a terrifying reality you must endure during your stay at Blackwood Manor.

Hide and protect when they do try to remove you from this reality. There is no fighting back. You must abandon your keyboard and stay out of sight until the threat passes. But to stay alive demands a sacrifice of time. Every agonizing second you spend hiding is a precious second drained from your ticking deadline.

4536320.name: Nexus of the Dead God: The Microcosm
4536320.about_the_game:
This is a fantasy-themed tactical strategy game. You will lead a squad—formed solely for the sake of survival—as you continuously push forward across a vast hexagonal map. Recruit companions, adjust your formation, devise tactics, and carve your way out of the Bone-strewn Continent through a series of automatically unfolding battles.

QQ Group: 760152147

Everyone is welcome to join the group and chat! Your suggestions are the driving force behind my progress!~

The Bone-strewn Continent is no ordinary fantasy land; rather, it is a place undergoing rapid mutation—a dead end that is inexorably sealing itself off.

Petrification is spreading, and physical bodies are falling into disarray; to remain stationary is to suffer necrosis alongside this dying world.

Your objective is not to expand your territory, nor to establish a kingdom, but to lead your squad in a ceaseless advance to find an exit.

The squad's goal is simple: Survive, then fight your way out.

You must fight while simultaneously maintaining your own stability, traversing this decaying world before it collapses completely.

Core Features

Advance Across a Vast Hexagonal Map

This isn't a simple menu-based stage selection; instead, you must find your path forward by continuously advancing across a sprawling world map. Battles, resources, routes, and impending threats are all interconnected; every step forward presents new risks and demands new choices.

Tactical Strategy Centered on Squad Formation

How you position your front and back rows—who absorbs damage, who deals damage, who provides support, and who follows up with a pursuit—will directly dictate the rhythm of the entire battle. Your squad's true strength lies not merely in the individual characters, but in how seamlessly the entire team functions as a cohesive unit.

[/p]

Drive Auto-Battles with Tactical Conditions

Characters automatically determine when to unleash skills, prioritize targets, and execute countermeasures based on the tactical conditions you’ve preset. The true enjoyment lies not merely in selecting individual skills, but in watching your entire strategic framework execute itself.

Skills, Status Effects, and Follow-up Attacks Form a Chain Reaction

Crowd control, debuffs, follow-up attacks, counterattacks, protection, and support—all these elements interact with one another. Victory or defeat in many critical turns depends less on the strength of a single character and more on whether you have successfully established the entire chain reaction in advance.

Recruit Companions to Gradually Complete Your Roster

As you advance through the game, you will continuously encounter new members, gradually expanding your available roster. As your team grows in size and functional completeness, the scope of available tactical options will broaden significantly.

Equipment, Shops, and Growth Choices Shape Your Playstyle

Outside of combat, you must utilize shops, equipment, and character progression systems to continuously reinforce your team. Your task isn't simply to stack raw stats, but to constantly refine the functional structure of your entire squad within limited parameters.

A Desperate Survival Atmosphere Beneath a Classic Fantasy Veneer

While the game retains a distinct fantasy aesthetic, its narrative is driven not by traditional tales of warring kingdoms, but by the struggle of survivors attempting to break free from a world in upheaval. The world-building avoids overwhelming the player with convoluted lore; instead, it places the pressure, danger, and objectives directly before you.

Ideal for Players Who...

Enjoy the team-building and map-progression experience found in games like *Unicorn Overlord*.

Love analyzing team compositions, skill synergies, and the logic behind automated tactics.

Enjoy tactical strategy games but also crave the satisfaction of long-term character growth and map-based progression.

Enjoy fantasy settings but prioritize system depth and combat construction above all else.

If you are looking for a fantasy tactical strategy game that strikes a perfect balance between map progression, team building, and deep auto-battle mechanics, this title is well worth adding to your wishlist.

Starting as a small squad whose only goal is survival, you will press ever forward—constantly strengthening your ranks—until you finally lead your team in a breakout from the Isle of Buried Bones to uncover the truth behind the Spirit Pivot Ruins.

4536460.name: Visual Novel: Call of Toilet

The Zone calls, the Zone awaits...

Sanya and Vanya are two idiots who decided that the Exclusion Zone isn't a place for gloomy stalkers, but a Russian-style "Gold Rush." ​​Forget epic battles with mutants. Here, you'll find showdowns with old ladies at the clinic, chases in a tracked Zaporozhets, and dancing with mermaids at the Tinaya Gavan club.

4536530.name: Sisyphus Inc.

4536600.name: Thieves and Tasers

Thieves and Tasers is a 2v3 social PvP heist game designed to be played with friends. Split into two teams, thieves and guards, and play quick rounds that alternate between tense stealth and explosive outbursts of mayhem.

As a guard, your mission is to stop the thieves by any means necessary. Hunt them down using tools like security cameras, laser traps and most importantly your taser to stun them.
