Easy to pick up, yet packed with strategic depth that rewards mastery. Outsmart your friends in this fast‑paced, cat‑and‑mouse heist game.

4536610.name: City Masterplan
4536610.about_the_game:
Build at a True 1:1 Scale — No Grid Limits

City Masterplan is a city-building simulation where true-scale construction meets flexible, grid-free planning.

Design your city without constraints — draw roads freely, build complex highways, and develop diverse districts at a true 1:1 scale.

From terrain sculpting to fine detail, you have full control over how your city takes shape.

A city is more than how it looks — it’s how it functions.

Plan and run an urban system supported by traffic simulation, economic systems, and data. Optimize flow, build supply chains, and use clear information panels to guide your decisions.

Start from a single road—and expand it into a functioning metropolis.

Freeform Road Systems — Design Without Limits

Every road you draw shapes how your city moves.

With fully flexible, grid-free tools, you can design any layout you imagine.

• No Grid Constraints

Draw roads freely—curves, highways, elevated bridges, and complex interchanges—without rigid limitations.

• From Country Roads to Megacities

Expand from quiet rural paths to dense urban networks, connecting every part of your city into a seamless system.

• Traffic That Responds to Your Design

Traffic flow is shaped by your infrastructure. Adjust layouts, reduce congestion, and keep your city moving efficiently.

Diverse Architecture — Define Your Own Style

Shape a city that reflects your vision with a rich architectural toolkit and full visual control.

• Build Across Cultures and Styles

Design anything from a classic American metropolis to a distinctly Chinese city, giving each district its own visual identity.

• True-to-Scale Landmark Buildings

Place iconic structures with accurate proportions and detailed materials—designed to hold up even at close range.

• Details That Reward Every Zoom

A large, high-quality asset library, supported by procedural generation, adds depth and variation across your city—from dense commercial areas to lived-in residential districts.

City Simulation — Run a Functional System

Every city runs on systems that need to be managed.

Take control of a complex city supported by transparent mechanics and real-time data.

• Balance Growth and Citizen Needs

Expand your city while managing housing, jobs, and essential services. Growth requires planning to stay sustainable.

• Build Realistic Supply Chains

Connect production, logistics, and consumption into a working economy. Efficient systems support stable development.

• Make Decisions with Real Data

Use clear data panels and visualized reports to understand your city—and make informed adjustments over time.
A Living World — Build at Scale

Your city is shaped by terrain, scale, and environment.

• A Massive Building Canvas

Expand from dense city centers to distant outskirts across a large-scale map—build a metropolis across a continuous landscape.

• Landscapes That Shape Your City

Plan coastal cities, mountain towns, and varied terrain where geography becomes both a creative tool and a planning consideration.

• Dynamic Weather and Lighting

Weather and lighting change over time, affecting how your city looks throughout the day and across conditions.

• Realistic Detail at Every Scale

From vegetation to building surfaces, details remain consistent as you zoom in and out.

4536740.name: Echoes
4536740.about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in a first-person psychological horror experience where every choice matters. Confront the Echoes of a forgotten past and uncover the truth behind your lost identity.

GAMEPLAY & FEATURES

  • Psychological Horror. The darkness hides Echoes of the past. As you explore, the environment itself tells a story, fragments of memories, whispers, and unsettling details that hint at what happened before. Stay alert, pay attention to your surroundings, and be prepared to confront the unexpected.

  • Decisions & Consequences. Your choices define your story. You can simply push forward and solve the puzzles… Or explore deeper, uncover hidden dialogues, and discover objects that may unlock multiple endings.

  • Environmental Storytelling & Puzzles. The truth is not told. it’s discovered. Explore your surroundings, connect subtle clues, and interpret symbols scattered across the environment. Markings, notes, light patterns, and forgotten details will help you reconstruct the Echoes and uncover what really happened.

  • Narrative-Driven Experience. A dark, emotive and atmospheric story set around a cursed route, where mysterious Echoes communicate with you and react to your actions. Every interaction reveals a fragment of the truth.

  • Minimal UI / Immersive Experience. No intrusive interface. Everything is integrated into the world: light, sound, and environment are your only tools. Even use your phone can kill you if It doesn't the right moment.

STORY

You wake up alone in the middle of a desolate road, with no memory of who you are or how you got there.

In your hand, a forgotten flashlight.

Around you, whispers.

Echoes.

Some guide you.

Some deceive you.

Some want something from you.

The way you choose to interact with these echoes will shape your fate. But first, you must endure a disturbing journey through a cursed place filled with secrets, darkness, and unsettling trials.

4536780.name: Unwanted Host

A tense body-horror experience where every decision has a cost, and every mistake can be your last.

FIND THE PARASITE

4536810.name: 2TAP

4536830.name: Wilderness Strike: Survivor

4536880.name: 仙途
4536880.about_the_game:
Here is the translation of the provided game description:

This is a cultivation simulation game centered on the core goal of "a mortal striving for enlightenment and breaking through to ascension." Players start as an ordinary mortal and must carefully advance step by step in the world of cultivation, accumulating strength until they break through to the Divinity Transformation stage. Only then can they challenge the guardian of ascension; successfully ascending leads to the game's ending.

Core Gameplay

Players can obtain cultivation techniques from sects and purchase various necessary items from the cultivator market to continuously improve their abilities. Entering instances to challenge spirit beasts yields rare items and resources that aid the path of cultivation. In instance battles, failure results in immediate death. If attempting to flee, two prerequisites must be met: "speed greater than the opponent" and "not severely injured." Otherwise, escape is impossible.

Key Systems

1. Spiritual Root System: Spiritual roots are innate to a character. Their specific effects can be viewed in the character details. Each spiritual root corresponds to an exclusive talent, which can enhance resource acquisition efficiency, increase attributes, and serve as a prerequisite for learning certain advanced techniques. Note that the more spiritual roots a character has, the more spiritual energy required for cultivation, and the difficulty of advancement increases significantly. However, cultivators with more complete spiritual roots possess greater potential in the later stages, resulting in superior overall strength.

2. Age Mechanism (Core Rule): Cultivators have an age limit. In-game, 1 minute equates to 1 year. The maximum age for the mortal stage is 64. If a character reaches 64 without achieving a realm breakthrough, they will pass away. The game does not support manual saving; death is permanent, forcing a complete restart. Players are advised to carefully plan their cultivation progress.

3. Cultivation Technique System: Players can equip only 4 techniques for battle. Some techniques inflict special effects like poison, burn, or freeze, while certain effects (like stun) can be countered through specific immunities. Techniques are categorized as passive or active. Passive techniques provide permanent benefits, such as increased health, that scale with the technique's level. Active techniques are used manually in combat; using them in synergy can significantly increase the chance of victory.

4. Equipment and Spirit Pets: Equipment, magical treasures, and spirit pets provide unique special effects. When synergized with suitable cultivation techniques, they provide a significant advantage in instance battles and the final ascension challenge.

Supporting Activities

The game features mining and a spiritual herb garden. Mining yields ores used to forge powerful weapons. Planting spiritual herbs in the garden yields mature plants that can be used to refine pills. These pills can aid in realm breakthroughs and restore cultivation, providing strong support on the path to ascension.

Only by rationally allocating resources, synergizing techniques and equipment, managing the pace of cultivation, and avoiding the threat of the age limit can one smoothly break through realms, reach the Divinity Transformation stage, challenge and defeat the guardian of ascension, and successfully complete the journey of cultivation.

Think you know chess? Forget some of that. Rule House is a pawn chess adventure where every stage rewrites the game. Travel the globe and beyond, master an ever-changing board where new pieces, twisted variants, and cunning opponents keep you guessing from first move to last.

A World Without Kings

Global chaos has claimed many things, including the world's supply of kings and queens. But the humble pawn? Plentiful. From this crisis, pawn chess is born. A scrappy new game with one objective: get your pawn across the board. The goal doesn't change, but the pieces, the boards, and the house rules do. You are Ryan Chessman, and you're going to become the first-ever world champion.

Every Stage Changes the Game

Rule House starts simple: a 4x4 board, basic pawns, and a fast-talking New Yorker named Big J who just wants you to get one pawn across. Easy enough. But every stage adds something you didn't see coming. A Parisian hustler teaches you En Passant. A monkey in the Amazon introduces poison pawns. In Australia, everything is upside down, including the pieces! By the time you're on the moon dodging a ticking clock, you'll barely recognize the game you started with.

Each new location brings a new opponent, a new board, and a new twist that forces you to rethink your entire strategy. Levels are handcrafted puzzles disguised as chess matches, simple to understand, devious to solve.

Key Features

  • Pawn Chess Anyone Can Learn: No chess knowledge required. Start with pawns on a tiny board and learn naturally as the game expands. Be ready when it gets deviously complex.

  • Stages That Reinvent the Board: Every level introduces new mechanics. From poison pawns, to inverted pieces, even ticking clocks keep you on edge. No two stages play the same way.

  • A Globe-Trotting Adventure: Travel from New York to Paris to Antarctica to the moon, each location with its own board, opponent, and surprises.

  • Characters With Personality: A cast of quirky, funny, fully-voiced opponents who taunt, teach, and trash-talk their way through every match.

  • Handcrafted Pixel Art: All made for this game exclusively, using the Dawn Breaker 32 palette it gives off a consistent and classy retro vibe.

  • Original Soundtrack: Every location comes with its own original track to set the mood. From the streets of NY to a biblically accurate angel in the sky.

  • Escalating Challenge: What starts as a chill puzzle evolves into brain-bending strategy. You will lose. You will learn. You will adapt.

Rewrite the Rules

Rule House is a game about discovering chess all over again: one pawn, one stage, one ridiculous opponent at a time. Whether you're a grandmaster or you've never touched a board, there's a seat at the table.

4537300.name: Among The Sierra Nevada
4537300.about_the_game:
Among The Sierra Nevada is a single-player survival horror mystery set in the rugged backcountry of Northern California’s Sierra Nevada mountains. Blending investigation, exploration, evidence collection, puzzle solving, and narrative horror, it puts you in the role of a man chasing proof of the impossible—only to uncover something much larger buried in the forest.

You play as Dave Wilder, who, as a child, survived a life-changing encounter with Bigfoot. The creature saved him, but when Dave returned to camp, his father refused to believe what happened. Years later, with his father aging and no longer able to return to the wilderness, Dave sets out to prove the truth once and for all. What begins as a deeply personal mission to mend a broken relationship becomes a dangerous descent into a mystery involving a missing park ranger, hidden evidence, and a secret agenda built around whether Bigfoot should be exposed… or kept buried.

The deeper you travel into the mountains, the more the wilderness changes. Trails give way to isolation. Campsites feel abandoned in a hurry. Broken trees, scattered carcasses, and strange signs in the dirt suggest that something enormous has been moving through the forest long before you arrived.

This is not a power fantasy. This is an investigation into something that may be intelligent, territorial, and far closer than you want it to be.

The Core Game Loop

At the heart of Among The Sierra Nevada is a gameplay loop built around searching, documenting, surviving, and uncovering the truth.

You will:

Explore remote wilderness areas on foot, moving through forest trails, steep terrain, campsites, hidden paths, ranger outposts, and isolated points of interest in search of signs that Bigfoot is real.

Locate physical evidence such as footprints, hair samples, clawed bark, snapped branches, disturbed ground, dead animals, and unnatural environmental markers. Every clue helps you build your understanding of what happened in the area and where to search next.

Gather resources and manage inventory so you can preserve and use what you find. Collect the materials needed to cast footprints, document discoveries, and maintain the tools required for deeper investigation.

Photograph evidence with your smartphone to create proof. Getting the shot is only part of the challenge—reaching the right place, at the right time, while still staying alive, is what makes every discovery matter.

Use collected evidence to unlock progression and upgrades, improving your ability to investigate, navigate, and survive in increasingly hostile territory.

Solve environmental puzzles by finding keys, unlocking combinations, interpreting notes, tracing clues left behind by others, and revisiting suspicious locations with new knowledge or tools.

Uncover story layers through journals, notes, environmental details, and video tapes, gradually piecing together what happened to the previous park ranger and discovering the real motives behind those trying to hide or expose the creature.

Evade or endure terrifying encounters as the wilderness itself becomes more threatening. When creatures get too close and trigger infrasound, Dave’s body enters Instinct Override—a panic-fueled sprint that overrides caution and sends him running at full speed for 30 seconds. In those moments, survival becomes physical, immediate, and only partially under your control.

The result is a tense investigative loop:
search for signs, document evidence, gather what you need, push deeper into the forest, unlock new leads, survive escalating danger, and use every discovery to move closer to the truth.

Investigation That Feels Physical

Among The Sierra Nevada is built around the feeling of being an actual field investigator in hostile terrain.

You are not simply checking objectives off a list. You are reading the forest.

A broken limb may point to a recent passage through the area. Scratched bark may suggest territorial marking. A footprint near disturbed soil can lead to a cast, a photograph, or a new trail into deeper wilderness. Hair caught on a branch, an overturned campsite, or a carcass left in the wrong place can all become the next step in your investigation.

The game emphasizes observation, interpretation, and follow-through. Progress comes from paying attention to the environment, understanding what evidence means, and using what you find to make informed decisions about where to go next.

Survival Horror in the Open Wilderness

The Sierra Nevada is beautiful, but it is not safe.

This is survival horror grounded in exposure, isolation, uncertainty, and pursuit. The fear does not just come from what you see. It comes from what you suspect is nearby. It comes from the silence between signs. It comes from realizing that the evidence you are following may also be evidence that something is following you.

As you progress, the tension rises through environmental storytelling, audio pressure, sudden encounters, and the growing sense that the truth is being deliberately concealed. The mountain is not just a backdrop. It is an active source of danger—steep, remote, unforgiving, and full of places where help will not reach you.

Traverse the Backcountry

Movement is a major part of the experience, and Among The Sierra Nevada uses traversal to reinforce both realism and tension.

One of the game’s defining tools is the pole vault, which serves multiple roles throughout the journey. Use it to move quickly down switchbacks, cross difficult terrain, create distance in emergencies, and even defend yourself when necessary. It is not a gimmick—it is woven into exploration, escape, and survival.

Traversal is about more than getting from one marker to another. Route choice matters. Terrain matters. The mountains shape how you investigate and how you survive.

Instinct Override

One of the game’s signature mechanics is Instinct Override.

When hostile creatures get too close and activate infrasound, Dave enters a state of involuntary survival panic. He sprints without stopping for 30 seconds, turning fear itself into a gameplay event. This mechanic changes the rhythm of encounters by forcing you to react to danger in a way that feels immediate and human, not heroic.

Instinct Override can save your life by creating distance from a threat—but it can also pull you into unknown terrain, separate you from your plan, and leave you disoriented in the wilderness. It is both a survival response and a source of vulnerability.

A Mystery Bigger Than Bigfoot

While proving Bigfoot’s existence drives the story forward, Among The Sierra Nevada is also about secrecy, competing agendas, and the cost of truth.

As Dave searches for evidence, he uncovers signs that others were in these mountains before him—watching, recording, hiding, and perhaps manipulating what people believe about what lives there. The disappearance of a previous park ranger becomes a critical thread in the investigation, tying together journals, recordings, abandoned sites, and disturbing clues left behind in the wild.

The story unfolds through exploration and discovery rather than exposition alone, encouraging players to connect the dots themselves.

Story

When Dave Wilder was a boy, his father took him camping in the Sierra Nevada. While gathering firewood one morning, Dave encountered Bigfoot—and survived because of it. But when he returned to camp, no one believed him. Least of all his father.

That disbelief never left him.

Now, years later, with his father too old to return to the mountains and their relationship still marked by that moment, Dave sets out to find proof. He wants evidence. He wants answers. He wants to finally be believed.

But the forest is holding more than a creature.

It is holding a history.

And the closer Dave gets to the truth, the more dangerous the search becomes.

Key Features

  • Single-player survival horror mystery set in the Sierra Nevada mountains

  • Investigation-driven gameplay loop focused on exploring, tracking, documenting, and surviving

  • Physical evidence collection including footprints, hair, claw marks, broken limbs, and animal remains

  • Footprint casting and evidence preservation using gathered resources and field tools

  • Smartphone photography system used to document proof and support progression

  • Inventory management and resource gathering tied directly to investigation and survival

  • Environmental puzzles and locked-path progression involving keys, codes, clues, and discovered materials

  • Narrative exploration through notes, journals, video tapes, and environmental storytelling

  • Pole vault traversal mechanic used for movement, escape, utility, and defense

  • Instinct Override system triggered by infrasound during close encounters

  • Realistic visual presentation inspired by the wilderness of Northern California

  • Rich, story-focused experience with an estimated playtime of 8–10 hours

What Makes It Unique

Among The Sierra Nevada combines the grounded process of wilderness investigation with the dread of survival horror. Instead of simply hunting a monster, you are trying to prove, preserve, and understand what happened here while navigating a realistic mountain environment that feels hostile, remote, and alive.

It is a game about evidence, fear, belief, and the dangerous line between discovering the truth and becoming part of the mystery yourself.

You came to prove Bigfoot exists.
You may uncover why the truth was buried.

4537320.name: Who Is The Next Chosen One?
4537320.about_the_game:
Aliens are threatening to destroy your homeland, and the only way to stop them is to find the strongest heroes and form a team capable of defeating them. Unfortunately, the budget only allows you to recruit the four most worthy ones, so the greatest tournament of all has been announced: "Who Is The Next Chosen One?".
Broadcast to the public, citizens are eager to discover the winners and cheer for their favorites.

You are Doommask, the chosen champion of the tournament, and you will face every participant team by team, one each weekend. After each match, you’ll decide whether to recruit your defeated opponents into your team (up to a maximum of four members) or send them home after their crushing defeat.

The problem is... YOU ARE NOT A REAL HERO!!
Now you must find a way out of this situation and your only weapon is your charisma. Form alliances, sabotage other contestants, and do everything you can to make everyone believe you are a TRUE hero!

Will you be able to keep your secret until the end of the tournament?

In "Who Is The Next Chosen One?", you are called not only to win turn-based RPG battles, but also to manage your time outside of them. Spend your free time getting to know the other contestants: will you sabotage them to prevent them from facing you? Or befriend them by helping them with their personal struggles?
Alternatively, you can train your team to become the strongest in the tournament and overpower anyone who steps into the ring! Or you can focus on your public image through meet-and-greets, small jobs and public speeches, all to gain attention.
After all, truth isn’t what is real, but what people believe. If you can convince others that you possess an ancient demonic power or that you can summon a meteor to destroy the world you might gain powerful leverage over your opponents. This is the only way Doommask can learn new abilities, he definitely can’t just punch someone who could disintegrate him in a second!
Use your Charisma to discourage and intimidate your enemies, draining their Willpower and leaving the dirty work to your teammates...
And remember, this is a show! Who would enjoy matches that end instantly because your team wipes out everyone? No one. Winning isn’t enough, you need to make it spectacular! Get the Audience involved: have them cheer for you, start a wave, suggest actions, and witness incredible moments. You have no idea what a properly hyped crowd can do.
If you put on a great performance, you’ll be richly rewarded, and sponsors will start to notice you!Oh, and one last thing: when they ask you to promote products during battle, be careful about what those items actually do!! The rewards may be tempting, but blowing up contestants might be a bit too much for the audience... and terrible for your reputation.

  • A Reputation system based on your choices in and out of battle, shaping how both contestants and the audience perceive you, deeply affecting the narrative and character relationships.

  • Over 21 unique characters, ready to fight with you… or against you.

  • A calendar system that structures your actions: each day and evening you can choose how to spend your time, but every seven days, a battle awaits you in the arena!

  • A classic turn-based battle system with a twist: Doommask has no offensive abilities! Talk to the audience, your allies, or your enemies to turn the tide of battle, and let your teammates handle the fighting. Just be careful, if you’re left alone, you’ll have to find a way to survive!

  • Dynamic abilities and item effects: using a skill like “Throw a Dead Fish” will have different results depending on whether your opponent is a cat… or a fish.

4537380.name: Appalachia
4537380.about_the_game:
Rule number 1

The hills have been calling out to anybody willing to listen but a true Appalachian would know better than to go meddling in the forest at night. Something is causing trouble up here and the trail ain't what it once was. Uncover the mysteries of the mountains and come face to face with the most infamous horrors of Appalachian Folklore. Using your Thermal Imager and EMF meter you analyze, track and scout the hills of Appalachia but it doesn't take long to realize it's you that's being hunted.

A survival horror experience that throws you into the hollers and the hills of Appalachia, you'll investigate the trail and coal country in search of your missing Uncle and his neighbor Walter. Piecing together a mystery along the way you just may be able to restore some of that peace and quiet the old folks can't seem to forget.

NOTICE

This game is still actively in development. Information on this page is subject to change as the game's development progresses further.

4537400.name: Paper2Galgame
4537400.about_the_game:
Paper2Galgame (Paper2Gal) is an interactive visual novel experience that “gamifies” academic papers. Upload your own documents (PDF/TXT/DOCX), study materials, or pick from daily recommendations—then explore them alongside your companion through dialogue and story progression. Break down structure, key concepts, and core conclusions as if you were playing a Galgame.

Customize your companion’s appearance, personality, and speaking style, choose your preferred output language and reading pace, and even enable a dedicated “blackboard” area for clearly presenting formulas, key points, and structured notes. Want a more immersive experience?

Whether you're starting your research journey, diving deep into a paper, preparing for a meeting, or simply looking to make dense reading more engaging, Paper2Gal transforms academic study into a journey you can progress through, revisit, and share.
4537400.supported_languages:
English*, Russian*, Japanese*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support

4537430.name: Warmby
4537430.about_the_game:
Warmby is a quirky creature‑raising sandbox where you play with, breed, and grow strange little creatures with big personalities. Every Warmby has moods, quirks, and reactions you can discover just by interacting with them! Explore their world and watch how they respond.

    Raise your Warmbies your way. Breed new ones, unlock surprising traits, dress them up in cute outfits, and experiment to see what kinds of creatures you can create. Play minigames, explore a playful sandbox environment, and uncover hidden behaviors as your Warmbies grow.

    Warmby is built to evolve. Player feedback will play a huge role in shaping new features, new Warmby types, new minigames, and the direction the game takes as it grows. Your ideas and discoveries help decide what Warmby becomes next.

4537500.name: Beat A Boo!
4537500.about_the_game:
As a devotee of the devil himself, you are burdened with the grim mission to capture the ghosts of the damned trapped on earth. Explore the haunted halls, find the ghost's type and perform the corresponding ritual. But prepare yourself to be chased by monsters and try not to step on a trap. For your own good.

DO EVERYTHING YOU CAN TO SURVIVE. YOU ARE REPLACEABLE

Serving the devil is not a piece of cake. The end for you is not death but eternal torment. So use magical artifacts -or a gun, your choice- craft sigils to boost your stats and sacrifice everything to stay alive. Even Especially your friends.

EYE FOR AN EYE

Failure to comply with the mission is not tolerated. A soul can only be replaced by another. So if you want to keep yours and don't want to be trapped in a cursed object, simply don't fail.

How hard can it be...

Right?

TUNES FROM THE UNDERWORLD

To seal the restless souls, you must play for them. For some reason, they're suckers for a killer beat! Every ghost has their favorite tune -make sure you play the right one.

Don't miss a beat or you'll miss your heartbeat!

Let's go Beat A Boo!

4537520.name: The Fool's Journey
4537520.about_the_game:
The Fool's Journey is a roguelike deckbuilder set amid the hysteria of the Salem Witch Trials. Explore through this ASCII style journey and build your deck card by card! Gather powerful relics, and fight your way through three acts of colonial horror!

Every run is different. Every choice matters. Large variety of reverse cards that have two faces.

THE REVERSED MECHANIC Play any reversible card upright for safety — or flip it reversed for a more powerful effect at a cost. Risk and reward live on every draw. Build your strategy around the gamble, or play it safe. The choice is yours.

FIVE PLAYABLE CHARACTERS Each with unique starter relics and playstyles:

  • The Fool — Balanced and adaptive

  • The Pagan — Poison and patience

  • The Hedge Witch — Healing and endurance

  • The Seer — Card draw and control

  • The Blood Witch — Power through sacrifice

Four characters are unlocked through progression, giving you something new to chase on every run.


415+ UNIQUE CARDS ACROSS SEVEN SUITS Swords cut. Cups heal. Wands burn. Pentacles endure. The 32 Major Arcana cards are the most powerful tools in your arsenal — from The Fool to The World. Curses pile up along the way. Turn them to your advantage or let them drag you under.

87 RELICS WITH DEEP SYNERGIES Passive artifacts that reshape your strategy mid-run. Suit Resonance relics reward focused decks. Boss relics offer game-changing power. No two builds play the same.

230+ ENEMIES ACROSS THREE ACTS From Salem's paranoid townsfolk to the spectral horrors lurking beyond, each act escalates in danger and darkness. Elite encounters test your limits. Bosses demand mastery.

THE ROGUELIKE ESSENTIALS

  • Procedurally generated maps with branching paths

  • Rest sites, shops, and story events with real consequences

  • 45+ achievements with meta-progression unlocks

  • 8 potions for clutch tactical moments

  • High score chasing across characters and difficulties

A WORLD STEEPED IN DARKNESS Accused witches. Corrupt magistrates. Spectral evidence. Every card, relic, and enemy is rooted in the atmosphere of 1690s colonial America. The writing does the heavy lifting — no jump scares, just dread.

4537530.name: 龙王捕鱼
4537530.about_the_game:
《龙王捕鱼》采用全新顶尖3D引擎打造，呈现超强国风美术表现力，原汁原味复刻街机经典玩法。游戏内设多个东方神话奇幻渔场，捕获各种山海经中的神秘强大BOSS。炫酷的仙境场景、超高清的画质，给您带来绝对震撼的国风视听盛宴。

  • 【国风3A画质】

    画面华丽升级，重新定义国潮捕鱼游戏品质。超高清3D画质，影视级视觉享受。倾国倾城的东海龙女、威震四海的神明龙王、浴火重生的上古朱雀、翻江倒海的混沌巨兽、镇守天门的金甲神将等，华丽酷炫的BOSS觉醒特效，全方位打造次世代东方神话捕鱼，给您身临其境的沉浸式体验。

  • 【满屏爆金体验】

    全新龙宫渔场！爆率全面升级！超高倍率！超凡掉率！极高的爆机率，满屏飞舞的大额金币数值，给您意想不到的爽快体验。万人同屏在线，快来大闹龙宫称霸渔场吧！

  • 【独创神话玩法】

    丰富多彩的超新玩法，龙门跃迁、法宝炼化、异兽图鉴收集、龙宫夺宝、封神悬赏等多种玩法火热开启，丰厚惊喜连连，全方位体验不只是捕鱼的乐趣，精品街机捕鱼全新国风玩法，一起欢欢乐乐捕鱼去~

  • 【天天豪礼相送】

    每日登录领取海量惊喜，海量金币领到手软。专属节日活动、炫酷神话翅膀、私人定制的法宝炮台皮肤等多重惊喜。更有秒天秒地的龙王吐息激光，横冲直撞的定海神针，倾尽神力的九天雷劫，毁灭一切的龙神狂暴技能！快跟我一起来玩捕鱼吧！

4537540.name: 海神捕鱼
4537540.about_the_game:
《海神捕鱼》采用全新次世代引擎倾力打造，拥有突破极限的美术表现力，完美复刻经典街机捕鱼玩法。游戏内设多个亚特兰蒂斯奇幻3D渔场，等您来捕获各种潜藏在深海的神秘BOSS。炫酷的深海场景、超高清的电影级画质，为您奉上一场绝对震撼的视听盛宴。

  • 【极致3A视觉】

    画面华丽蜕变，重新定义深海捕鱼品质。超高清3D建模，带来影视级视觉享受。魅惑动人的海妖塞壬、执掌三叉戟的威严海神、吞噬万物的深海巨妖（克拉肯）、镇守遗迹的远古巨龟、穿梭风暴的幽灵海盗船等，搭配华丽酷炫的BOSS觉醒全屏特效，全方位打造次世代神话捕鱼，给您身临其境的沉浸式体验。

  • 【爆金狂欢体验】

    全新海域！爆率狂飙！高倍率！高掉落！超高的爆金几率，满屏炸裂的大额金币数值，给您前所未有的爽快体验。万人同服在线竞技，快来称霸这片神话海域吧！

  • 【海域创新玩法】

    丰富多彩的超新玩法，海神试炼、圣物觉醒、深海寻宝、巨兽讨伐、海图收集等多种特色玩法全面开启。丰厚惊喜不断，全方位体验不只是捕鱼的乐趣，精品街机捕鱼全新升级，一起欢欢乐乐探索深海去~

  • 【海量尊享福利】

    每日登录即可领取海量惊喜，免费金币送不停。丰富节日活动、炫酷定制翅膀、尊贵专属的炮台皮肤等多重惊喜等您解锁。更有秒天秒地的海神之怒激光，横穿深海的破甲钻头，倾尽神力的雷霆风暴，毁灭一切的狂暴技能！快跟我一起来玩捕鱼吧！

4537550.name: Thoughtless
4537550.about_the_game:
- A VISUAL NOVEL THAT JUDGES YOU -

Who are you, really?

They've arrived. They've already won, a long time ago. Now humanity lives segregated into their own homes, away from everybody else. One of them is you: Hipher, a young man who  gave up to a life of ever identical days and mindless tasks.
Will you find the strength to leave your sheltered life if it involves the safety of a loved one? Will that be enough for you to confront the Thoughtless?

A dark and desolate sci-fi visual novel made by a one-man team about the struggles of human communication. How far can we go in the search of truth? How much do we actually want to know?

Discover the answer to these questions for yourself, thanks to a choice system that values individuality. Much like a personality test, the game wants to see how you really think, what kind of player you really are, and many of the outcomes will depend on that. Will you relent to the aliens? Or will you fight for humanity? Will your accept your inner self, or find peace in someone else?

Staff

Writing, Characters and Music: Throgolin

QA: Armònia, Quote, Davide 

How To Play

The game features very simple command systems. 

All of the actions are conducted through a left mouse click or touch.

Thoughtless is available in web format and is also mobile friendly. I recommend playing in fullscreen for the best experience.

4537570.name: PSYCORP
4537570.about_the_game:
AI PSYCHOSIS WILL MAKE YOU CEO

A narrative driven AI corporate dystopia set inside of PSYCORP. How much of your mind are you willing to lose to control your family's company, and the future of surveillance in America?

  • Explore the brutalist skyscraper of PSYCORP, and your AI-Augmented siblings who run it. Lie, sabotage, and hurt your way to your fathers position of CEO, with branching dialogue and an ever changing conspiracy. Slowly, the AI in your head starts to steal more and more of your free will, taking over your free will, and your choices.

  • The experience of a half-AI executive makes your perception of the world organic, yet digital. Experience the world of PSYCORP behind a sociopath's eyes. Black, White, and red all over.

  • Inspired by industrial electronics artists of the past, PSYCORPS sound and music is loud, blown out, and distorted, reflecting your overwhelming perception of reality.

  • Explore the many floors of PSYCORPS: the towering lobby, the gravity defying class divided office floors, and the luxurious terraces that only the elite can experience.

  • A 2 hour experience of surveillance, exploitation, and power struggle that will leave you feeling like the sci-fi you just experienced isn't so different from the present…

4537590.name: All or Nothing
4537590.about_the_game:
All or Nothing is a fast-paced logic puzzle card game that delivers endless "aha!" moments of pure satisfaction. Spot hidden patterns across vibrant geometric cards in a race against time, where every correct set you find vanishes in a rewarding burst and fuels your combo streak. Whether you're chasing high scores solo or battling friends locally, this addictive blend of quick thinking and strategic depth will keep you coming back for just one more round.

Key Features

  • Core Set-Finding Gameplay — Scan a layout of 12 face-up cards, each defined by four attributes: Color (Red/Green/Blue), Symbol (Triangle/Circle/Square), Count (1/2/3), and Shading (Solid/Striped/Empty). Find sets of exactly three cards where each attribute is either all the same or all completely different — then watch them disappear and new cards deal in.

  • Time-Decaying Scoring — Act fast to maximize points before the timer reduces your reward; quick thinking and sharp pattern recognition pay off big.

  • Combo Chains & Bonuses — Chain multiple sets in rapid succession for escalating multipliers and massive score boosts that make every hot streak feel exhilarating. Correctly identifying that no set exists keeps the combo going.

The minimalist design and classical soundtrack that keeps you locked in the zone. All or Nothing is approachable enough for casual sessions yet offers deep, satisfying challenge for experts hunting perfect runs and leaderboard dominance.

4537600.name: Dice Gun Commando
4537600.about_the_game:
The eldritch Chaos Lord has invaded our world and twisted the laws of physics to suit its paradoxical purposes! The only way to defeat it is to use dice-driven weaponry to control the chaos.

Equip your guns with a wide assortment of dice and mods to modify how they work, from applying knockback to spewing poisonous gas to turning mobs into exploding chickens*. Survive waves of cosmic horrors and fight off the Chaos Lord himself to save our planet! (And the universe, probably.)

Features

  • Carry up to six auto-firing guns, finding more as you fight

  • Dozens of different dice to load into your guns

  • Hundreds of gun mods that react to what your dice roll

  • Crazy synergies from combining the effects of your guns, dice, and mods

  • Fast runs (10-20 minutes)

  • Collect energy gems to level up, earn rewards, and make your arsenal stronger

  • Fight Lovecraftian mobs, elites, and bosses that wield their own dice-driven powers against you

  • Break the laws of physics game

* No animals were harmed in the making of this game. (pending legal review)

4537640.name: Black Powder Box
4537640.about_the_game:
Black Powder Box is a sandbox FPS shooter focused on PvE/EvE combat, a level editor, both realistic and sci-fi environments, and complete chaos!

In Black Powder Box, you can utilize the level editor to create custom maps, customize NPC behavior and factions within them, create chains of events and interactions between objects, place props and lighting, and use other tools to build any amazing experience you’re aiming for.

You can create a wide variety of levels, ranging from typical shooters and simulated facilities to horror or puzzle-solving ones.

Later, you can play these maps, join any faction in combat, destroy everything you see, solve puzzles, and enjoy the game however you want.

As of Alpha 1, Black Powder Box main features are:

  • NPCs customizable behaviour and factions

  • Level editor

  • Player–NPC compatible weapon system

  • In-game movement and actions along with partial UI gamepad support

  • Customizable chain-of-events functionality during level creation

4537700.name: Notebook Workshop
4537700.about_the_game:
It's time to build the notebook shop of your dreams!

Decorate your journals, bind and spiral them with care and create a completely unique collection that is entirely yours!

Grow Your Workshop

Once you hire John, you can hand over the production to him. This way, you can focus on meticulously packaging orders and delivering them to your customers.

Colorful Binding Machines

Bring your cozy workshop to life with colorful binding machines. Let your equipment reflect your style!

Special Shapes

Add a unique flair to your notebooks using machines that can cut custom shapes.

Neighborhood Shop

Decorate your workshop with ornaments from the local neighborhood shop, making your notebooks and orders even more special.

Don't forget to add "Notebook Workshop" to your Steam wishlist!
4537700.supported_languages:
English*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*, Dutch*, French*, German*, Italian*, Japanese*, Korean*, Polish*, Russian*, Spanish - Spain*, Turkish*
*languages with full audio support

4537710.name: Aqua Street
4537710.about_the_game:
Aqua Street is an open world racing game with a fairly large and detailed map. The game has powerful cars and is ready to race with friends because the game is online, but if you want to drive quietly or race and complete checkpoint missions to make money, there is also a single player mode. Currently the game is still being worked on to add new and interesting things. The game runs well on any computer. We also have a traffic system and police who follow you when they catch you racing.

The game has a lot of interesting systems, and the cars move very fluidly and realistically.

The game also has a car tuning system, get your car full and let's race!

Play and the game creates its own vibe with the soundtrack. The money system is available in the game, you can earn money from races, completing checkpoints to buy new cars from the showroom or customize them. Play with your friends and create unforgettable memories. The game is in beta.

The game has Free Roam, Race, Checkpoint, Trailblazer and Pursuit missions.

4537730.name: Tomo Cafe
4537730.about_the_game:
Tomo Cafe is a story-rich focus game. Focus with characters, bond with them through stories, and grow together.

After inheriting a study cafe from your grandpa, you encounter unexpected customers. Emi, Senna, Alvin, Mae… They all come into your life carrying dreams, secrets, and struggles of their own. The more time you spend together, the more you will find out… about them, about the cafe, and about yourself. 

Focus & Productivity: 

Enjoy first-person study sessions with the characters. Use built-in productivity tools, pomodoro timers, sticky notes, and to-do lists, to stay on track with your everyday.

Original Character: 

4 unique characters each with their own passions, problems, and dreams. Dive into visual novel-inspired story arcs, make meaningful choices, and shape how their journeys end.

Manage Cafe: 

Customize your Tomo Cafe in the 2D isometric view! Place furniture and decorations that unlock unique interactions. Invest your earnings to upgrade equipment, keep the cafe tidy, and attract new regulars.

4537740.name: Scrap Planet
4537740.about_the_game:
Scrap Planet is a sandbox survival game where you rebuild a ruined world using trash and recycled materials.

Explore a desolate environment, collect scattered resources, and construct your own creations block by block.

Use the robot's building system to place and stack blocks freely, allowing you to create structures, towers, and designs however you like. You also have prebuild buildings and environmental building to bring the planet back to life.

4537750.name: CTRLR.CLUB
4537750.about_the_game:
CTRLR.CLUB is a precision-based reflex and rhythm game where timing, control, and consistency define your performance. Players react to dynamic signals, hit targets with accuracy, and maintain synchronization as speed and complexity steadily increase. Each session is designed to challenge focus, sharpen reaction time, and reward clean execution.

Built with both casual and competitive players in mind, CTRLR.CLUB offers an experience that is easy to pick up but difficult to master. Whether you're chasing high scores, refining your precision, or training specific weaknesses, every run provides immediate feedback and a clear path for improvement.

With its clean visual design and satisfying input-response feel, CTRLR.CLUB creates a focused, high-energy gameplay loop that keeps players engaged, pushing for better timing, tighter control, and consistent performance.
4537750.supported_languages:
English*, Spanish - Spain*
*languages with full audio support

4537770.name: Nonogueram
4537770.about_the_game:
A nonogram roguelike!

About

  • Traverse through the floor map

  • Complete nonograms to earn items, gold, and time rewards

  • Making mistakes costs health

  • Running out of time will damage you continuously!

  • Rest at campfires to heal

  • Enter shops to spend your gold for items

  • Try to beat all floors!

  • Try to complete your collection of all items!

How To Play

Nonograms (also referred to as "Picross") are grid-based puzzles where cells are filled or crossed out based on the numbers in the associated row and column labels. 

The labels on the rows and columns list out the numbers which refer to the exact length of consecutive filled cells in the respective row/column. Between each number in the label, there will be a gap of at least 1 cell, which is filled via crosses.

A very core rule for this style of game is when all possible layouts of filled and crossed out cells have a common solution for individual cells.

In the first example below with the label "3", there are 3 possible combinations of where it can be filled safely. In all 3 cases, the middle column is filled. This allows us to safely fill the cell in the middle.

In the second example below with the label "2 1", there are also 3 possible combinations. The same strategy can used to fill in the 2nd column as all 3 possible combinations of this label have it filled in, regardless of label complexity.

Notably, this rule also applies to crosses, but this case usually only applies when a secondary rule is also in place (such as in the column for these examples). More strategies and tricks can be found on the nonogram Wikipedia page!

Occasionally you will encounter cells that are ambiguous, meaning they have more than one solution. These cells are marked with yellow.

Ambiguous cells can either be filled or crossed out safely as this game will not punish you for choosing “incorrectly” here. There are also items that highlight these tiles for you!

4537780.name: Climber Toys: Together
4537780.about_the_game:
Climber Toys: Together is a chaotic multiplayer climbing experience where tiny toy-like characters struggle their way to the top of a dangerous, obstacle-filled room. Every jump matters, every mistake counts — and sometimes, falling is just part of the fun.

Climb Together, Fall Together

Play with up to 8 players in a chaotic co-op experience where teamwork quickly turns into chaos. Help each other… or accidentally ruin everything.

Use Your…"Fart" Unique Ability

Boost yourself forward to pull off risky jumps and save impossible situations. It might look silly, but mastering it can save your run — or send you even further into chaos.

Dynamic Obstacles & Creative Parkour

Make your way through a chaotic mix of moving hazards and tricky platforming sections. Dodge swinging hammers, avoid speeding toys, and adapt to platforms that react to your movement. Some parts will help you, some will test your patience… and some just want to see you fall.

Customize Your Toy

Change colors, wear hats, and show off your style while climbing. If you're going to fall, at least look good doing it.


Optimized & Accessible
Enjoy a smooth experience with detailed graphics settings, colorblind options, and a clean, user-friendly interface.



Easy to learn but hard to master,

Climber Toys: Together is all about skill, timing, and a bit of chaos. Whether you're climbing with friends or competing to reach the top first, every run is a mix of progress, failure, and unexpected moments.

4537800.name: Snuggle Nightmare
4537800.about_the_game:
Welcome to Brain World Rots Theme Park!

Brain World Rots is a theme park created after the viral “Italian brainrot” phenomenon, featuring state-of-the-art facilities and intelligent animatronics such as Tung Tung Sahur, the first advanced animatronic developed by Sing and Song Co.

Snuggle Nightmare

After the mysterious closure of Brain World Rots, years later Sing and Song Co. is planning the grand reopening of the famous theme park. You are Max Brush, a 23 year old who takes a job as a technical assistant on the night shift inside the facility. What seemed like a simple task soon turns into something far more disturbing. The park hides more than it seems.As you progress, you will uncover hidden areas, forgotten documents, and clues about what really happened before its closure. What truly happened here?

Animatronics

Our founder, Mike Anthony, had a clear goal: to create an animatronic capable of playing and interacting with children as if it were human.

To achieve this, Sing and Song Co. developed animatronic models with advanced artificial intelligence, realistic behavior, and unique capabilities, designed to deliver an unforgettable family experience within Brain World Rots.

Key Features

  • The enemy changes its behavior based on how you play

  • Solve environmental puzzles

  • Find keys, codes, and hidden access points

  • Unlock new paths while avoiding detection

Will you be able to escape… or become part of the park forever?

4537820.name: Overcome Your Fears - Lighthouse
4537820.about_the_game:
Overcome Your Fears - is an episodic horror game that immerses you in a world of the unknown. Each story is a new chilling episode, and there is no mysticism: only real events experienced by people.

"Overcome Your Fears - Lighthouse" is the second episode of the series.

Adam Foster, a 23-year-old office worker whose life is turned upside down after a breakup with his girlfriend. In an attempt to escape from himself, he takes a job as a lighthouse keeper, hoping to clear his mind. He could never have imagined the horror he would have to endure at his new workplace...

Gameplay.

The game is a first-person walking simulator with mechanics of exploration, driving, and conversations.

Key Features.

  • Atmospheric environment.

  • Elements of psychological horror with unexpected plot twists.

  • VHS aesthetic.

  • Interactive dialogues with NPCs.

  • Voice interaction with the game.

  • Unique sound effects that increase the tension.

4537830.name: SOCIETY
4537830.about_the_game:
A multi-friend-group social survival crafting game.
It's your friends against their friends.
Survive, gather, craft, build.
Then steal, kidnap, ally, betray, negotiate, and convert.
SOCIETY.

  • This is a social survival crafting multi-friend-group game.

  • You and your friends survive on an island.

  • Gather, explore, craft, farm, and build.

  • Other friend groups are on this island too, but only one can rule the island.

  • Steal, kidnap, ally, betray, and negotiate your way to become this island's ruler.

  • There are no NPCs. Every player is real. Proximity voice chat.

  • This game takes social conversational skill to win.

4537850.name: Jack The Reaper : Vagrants in the Mist
4537850.about_the_game:
19XX, Britain.

In a certain city, a murder case occurs.

It was considered a simple incident, but as murders with the same method occur in succession, it grows out of control.

Soon, people come to call these cases the 'Jack the Ripper incidents.'

People discover a commonality—that the 'Jack the Ripper incidents' occurred only within the 'Sullivan Family's' territory—and begin to suspect Sullivan.

As the interrogation grows intense, Sullivan, to quell the commotion, orders the enforcers Reaper and Robellia to find the true culprit of the 'Jack the Ripper incidents.'

[ The Figures Surrounding 'Jack the Ripper' ]

It is unknown who 'Jack the Ripper' is.

However, there are countless individuals that 'Jack the Ripper' points to.

Never lose sight of the suspicion that builds through the characters' actions and conversations.

  • Become 'Reaper,' enter the rough mafia world, and pursue the true culprit who murdered Robellia.

  • Do not miss suspicious points in the characters' actions and conversations. It is up to you to decide whom to suspect.

[ Repetition and Mastery ]

Who was the most threatening enemy to you?

Through repeated combat and death, weigh who you must eliminate first.

  • You are not a hero. The enemies' attacks will be fatal in every way.

  • The specially modified gun can only be loaded with 2 rounds. Eliminate enemies by using intelligence and, at times, displaying quick reflexes.

  • Break through the mafia with your own clearing formula created through death.

[ Memory and Record ]

Was there anything suspicious?

Was there anything you wanted to remember?

Robellia told you to write in a diary whenever that happened.

  • Record today's suspicious points in a 'Journal.'

  • 'Interrogate' the suspects based on the journal to get closer to the truth.

  • Find the true culprit through interrogation and punish 'Jack the Ripper,' who murdered Robellia.
4537850.game_link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4537850/Jack The Reaper : Vagrants in the Mist/

4537870.name: Prehistoric Adventure
4537870.about_the_game:
Visit the World's greatest theme park

A world of adventure awaits you, as you enter the Prehistoric Adventure.

See the mightiest animals that have ever existed

Giant sauropods, frightening sea monsters, and legends, like Triceratops, and the mighty tyrant king himself - Tyrannosaurus Rex.

Enter the visitor centre

The visitor centre has a wealth of information, where you can see skeletons of extinct giants, and learn about the age of the dinosaurs, and the animals of the last Ice Age, like the saber tooth cat, and the iconic mammoth.

Modern attractions

You don't have to be stuck in the past, though, with various white knuckle theme park rides to try out, like the exciting river rapids.

Fun for all ages

Your little ones don't have to be left out, with plenty of mini rides to enjoy, and the chance to get up close with some of the smaller animals.

4537880.name: The Great Flock Off
4537880.about_the_game:
The Great Flock Off

The world's most important poultry competition is waiting for you.

Crack, collect, compete, but only the best chickens win!

The Great Flock Off is a cosy deck-building strategy game where you collect, merge, upgrade and compete with the most spectacular chickens the world has ever seen. Draft your chooks, upgrade your coop, and strut your way through ten days of increasingly fierce competition, all at your own pace, with a cup of tea in hand.

Your Chickens, Your Strategy

Every run starts fresh. You'll draft chickens from a rotating selection, each one coming with their own rarity, colour, size and special abilities that combine in surprising ways. A tiny common chicken might seem underwhelming on paper, but pair it with the right effects and watch it punch way above its weight.

As your flock grows so does your strategy. Do you build around a single colour for big multiplier bonuses? Stack flat bonuses on your biggest birds? Hunt for rare Whimsy chickens with effects that completely break the rules? The combinations are deep enough to keep every run feeling different, but approachable enough that you'll never feel lost.

The Journey to the Top

Each run takes you through a hand-crafted journey map. Before every contest you'll pick your path, choosing between different competition routes and stopping off in town to visit the shop, upgrade your chooks, and manage your growing flock. Every decision matters. Gold is tight, contests get harder, and one bad day can cost you a life.

Lose three lives and it's back to the beginning, but you'll always know exactly where things went wrong, and you'll go again with a better plan.

Contest Day

When contest day arrives, your chickens march out into the arena one by one and take their place under the spotlight. Watch them walk out to the stage, settle into position, and then score their points in real time as each ability fires off. Flat bonuses tick up, multipliers kick in, group bonuses light up your whole flock at once. It feels genuinely satisfying every single time.

Beat the rival teams and climb the leader board. Fall short and you lose a strike. Make it to Day ten in the top three and you win the whole thing.

Always Something to Discover

With a huge variety of chicken effects, weather conditions that shake up every contest, special contest rules that force you to think differently, and a prestige system that keeps things interesting long after your first win, there's always a new combination to try, a new strategy to explore, or a new flock to be proud of.



The Vibe

The Great Flock Off is the kind of game you sit down with for "just one more run" and look up an hour later. It's got the strategic depth of a deck builder wrapped up in the cosiest, most charming package I could put together. Pixel art chickens, a laid back pace, a lovely soundtrack, and absolutely no pressure to play any way but your own.

Whether you're a seasoned deck builder or just someone who really likes chickens, you'll feel right at home.

Crack, collect, compete, but only the best chickens win!

The Great Flock Off, coming soon.

4537890.name: Serpentine Harbor
4537890.about_the_game:
Welcome to Serpentine Harbor. You'll live in a Mediterranean island where humans and not-humans have found shelter.

Arrived as an Art Student, your main goal is to improve as an artist while creating sculptures based on your experiences on the island and with your neighbors.

Progress from small figurines to big marble statues using different materials.

Immerse yourself in Greek mythology and art. Some of your creations will be inspired by real art works from ancient and classical art. Live alongside gorgons, cyclopes and minotaurs as your neighbors.

You'll be able to combine different models and create your own hybrid designs.

Meet your new neighbors and learn their stories. Explore, farm, cook.

4537930.name: Field Recordings
4537930.about_the_game:
Record the echoes of a fractured reality.

In 2130, reality began to break apart.

Now, ten years later, fragments of the world drift in isolation, connected by unstable fractures. Guided by a lonely AI from the abandoned Project Ariadne, you travel between these pockets, searching for survivors and signals left behind.

Can reality be fixed? Your task is to record what remains.

FEATURES

  • Explore a haunting archipelago of fractured realities

  • Use the Field Recorder to tune into echoes left in unstable spaces

  • Stabilise fragments and uncover hidden traces of those who came before

  • Meet survivors adapting to life at the edge of collapse

  • Uncover the mystery of Project Ariadne and the truth behind the fractures

Each recording brings you closer to understanding what went wrong — and what still remains.

Mac and Steam Deck support planned for release.

4537940.name: Pick Three!!!
4537940.about_the_game:
Pick a weapon and enter the ring where you'll be spinning around fighting your opponent until one of you drops down. Don't worry about wasting your one shot; each match-up is a best out of three, and after each fight is another opportunity to get stronger.

An opportunity from three choices!

We heard choices matter, but sometimes there's just too many options. So we decided to make players always pick one option out of three for everything! Choosing your weapon, your color, your opponent, your stat upgrades, your gear, and even your special Augments. Every choice matters!

Depending on which enemy you picked, your reward for winning a fight is one of 3 places; The Blacksmith, the Ref's Booth, and the Fan Club. Each place has unique mechanics, resources, and stats that interact with eachother, so juggling your visits and making use of what you get is key to winning a run.

Avoid rerolling your choices to keep the Ref happy so you can obtain rarer Augments that enable new playstyles. Gain additional Redirects to reposition in times of need while utilizing unconventional stats like Emptiness and The Will to Proceed. Scale your Hype and cater to your fans so they can fight alongside you. Whether you specialize in one mechanic/stat or make use of as many as you can, there are several unique ways to play every weapon ball. And for an additional challenge, you can unlock up to 3 Bracket levels that add significant modifiers to the run.

I love "pick 3" mechanics. I love picking from 3 options. Positive affirmations.

4537950.name: AM I HERE?
4537950.about_the_game:
You don’t play as a character.

You play as their footsteps.

The character is completely invisible, so the only thing you actually see are their footprints moving around. That’s it. No body, no safety net. Just two steps at a time and your ability to guess where you are.

It’s a platformer, technically. There are moving platforms, jumps, obstacles, all the usual stuff… except you’ll be doing all of it without ever seeing the thing you’re controlling.

At first it feels weird. Then it feels hard. Then it starts to make sense. Kind of.

You’ll learn to read movement through timing and spacing instead of visuals. You’ll miss jumps you were sure you nailed. You’ll land jumps you absolutely didn’t deserve. And somehow, it works.

Or at least, it works enough to keep going.

Features:

  • You are invisible. Not “stealth game” invisible, actually invisible.

  • You only see your footsteps, so good luck with that.

  • Moving platforms, tricky jumps, and a level that don’t really care about your feelings.

  • A different way to think about movement and space (whether you like it or not).

THIS IS A RAGE GAME, KIND OF...

If you like platformers, you’ll enjoy this.

If you like challenges, you might survive this.

If you like feet…

…well, you’re getting a lot of those.

4537970.name: Region at War: The Shogun's Tale of War
4537970.about_the_game:
Special Notice for Windows 11 Users

We’ve completed additional testing on Windows 11 systems, and the games are now running flawlessly in our tests. However, since hardware configurations can vary between devices, we still recommend trying the demo before purchasing to ensure everything works smoothly on your specific setup.

Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy the experience!

The Shogun's Throne is Vacant

The Shogun’s seat sits empty. The Emperor’s influence is fading. The lands of Hinomoto are fractured by endless war as every clan fights for power.

It is time for a new leader to rise. Crush your enemies and unite the realm under your banner.

A Hybrid Strategy Experience

Experience a deep 2D grand strategy game that combines turn-based empire management with real-time tactical (RTS) battles. Whether you choose the fierce Takeda, the cunning Mori, or the ambitious Oda, your path to victory depends on your strategy.

Key Features

  • Campaign Management: Plan your conquest in a turn-based system. Expand your territory, manage your influence, and outplay rival clans on a beautiful pixel-art map.

  • Real-Time Tactical Battles: Lead your armies in massive RTS battles. Positioning, terrain, and unit synergy are the keys to victory.

  • 1:1 Unit Representation: Experience large-scale combat with up to 2,000 vs 2,000 individual units on screen at once, fully optimized for performance.

  • Build Your Domain: Manage your economy and upgrade your settlements. Turn small villages into powerful fortresses to fund your war machine.

  • Research and Evolve: Research new technologies to improve your military and economy to stay ahead of your rivals.

  • Flexible Battalion Control: Combine battalions into one large force or split them into smaller units for flexible tactics. Use Ctrl + Selection to move mini-battalions and flank your enemies.

Latest Update: 2 May 2026 (Ver. 1.24)

This massive update entirely shifts the landscape of the Sengoku period. We are introducing deep dynasty-building mechanics, completely overhauling the AI for major clans, and bringing much-needed balance to the battlefield. Prepare to forge your legacy!

Major Features: Bloodlines & Legends

  • New Family & Dynasty Building System: You are no longer just commanding an army; you are building a lineage. Secure the future of your clan through generations.

  • The Legends Arrive (Historical Roster): Play as and recruit highly detailed historical warlords with accurate base stats reflecting their real-world legends.

  • Political Marriage Arrangements: Use your Gold (Dowry) and Action Points to secure powerful spouses from minor clans. Buy your legacy and breed the ultimate genetic lineage for your non-historical officers.

  • Child Education System: Heirs are born as blank slates. Invest Action Points to manually train them, push their potentials to the absolute limit, and rewrite history before they come of age.

  • New Battlefield Unit - "Seii Taishogun": Your commanding general is now physically represented on the tactical map! They project powerful, dynamic aura buffs to nearby troops based entirely on their personal stats (Charisma, Intel, Melee, etc.).

AI & Combat Balance

  • Major Clan AI Revamp: The 7 playable Daimyo factions now utilize a completely unique, advanced AI logic. No more falling victim to random minor clans! The major warlords will now expand aggressively and provide a genuine, terrifying challenge for your conquest.

  • Ranged Combat Nerf: We have addressed the "Overpowered Ranged Meta." Arrows, bullets, and shurikens no longer ignore enemy defense. Defense skill matter now. Ranged units will require actual strategy rather than just blind firing!

  • Tactical Terrain Generation: The random terrain generator has been highly optimized. Expect more complex, challenging, and tactically interesting mountainous battlemaps. High ground has never been more vital.

Visuals & Optimizations

  • Vector-Based Campaign Map: The strategic campaign map has been entirely rebuilt using vector graphics technology. Enjoy crystal clear, razor-sharp visuals no matter how far you zoom in, alongside a refined art style with less AI-generated reliance.

  • Under-the-Hood Optimizations: Smoother performance across the board during massive late-game campaigns.

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed the Teleport Exploit: A very subtle (but entirely game-breaking) bug found by our brilliant testers allowed players to magically teleport an army across the map immediately after claiming an empty city in certain condition. The space-time continuum of the Sengoku era has been restored.

  • Fixed army under re-training can join an army outside city.

Previous Update: April 13, 2026 (Ver. 1.23)

New Features:

  • Demo Freeplay Mode: Explore the game mechanics in the newly added Demo version.

  • Tutorial: Added a "How To Play" button for a quick guide on game mechanics.

  • Seven Playable Clans: Choose from 7 unique clans, each with its own technology tree and unique units.

  • Observer Mode: Watch the AI clans fight for supremacy on their own.

  • Multilingual Support: Support for multiple languages added for a global audience.

Bug Fixes & Optimizations:

  • Campaign Map AI: * Fixed rebels spawning directly on top of cities.

  • Fixed AI spawning and sortieing on incorrect grid coordinates.

  • Battle Map AI: * Fixed pathfinding loops when units moved outside the map boundaries.

  • Fixed errors occurring when field battles started too close to a city.

  • Fixed army deployment being reversed in specific scenarios.

  • Performance: Optimized code to prevent stuttering during massive 2000 vs 2000 battles.

  • UI/UX: Fixed button placement issues when changing screen resolutions mid-game.

4538040.name: HERO BOY
4538040.about_the_game:
HERO BOY is a single-player, narrative-driven adventure game about confronting lost dreams from past, present, and future.

You'll play as an imaginative 8-year-old boy and his lame early 20s-something counterpart, split across time and stuck between their shared dreams and nightmares.

In this third-person point-and-click adventure, players explore the endless void and take on perspective-based puzzles, recurring night terrors, imaginary friends/foes, all in search of the Hero within.

4538060.name: Subsurface
4538060.about_the_game:
Descend into the depths. Meet your quota… or don’t come back.

Subsurface is a 1–4 player co-op horror experience set in decaying underwater facilities, where you and your crew are sent below the surface to recover valuable resources… but something is already down there.

Every dive is a risk.
Search flooded corridors, abandoned structures, and collapsing environments while gathering enough loot to meet your quota and escape.

But you’re not alone.

The deeper you go, the worse it gets.

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 CO-OP SURVIVAL

Play solo or with up to 4 players online.
Stick together… or risk being picked off one by one.

💰 QUOTA-BASED GAMEPLAY 

Collect valuable resources and meet your quota before time runs out.
Fail, and you’ll be sent back down.

🌊 MULTIPLE UNDERWATER LOCATIONS

Explore unique maps with different layouts, hazards, and hidden dangers every dive.

🔦 LIMITED VISIBILITY

Darkness is your enemy.
Rely on your light, your team, and your instincts to survive.

🫁 CONSTANT PRESSURE

Limited visibility, isolation, and the depths themselves work against you.
Panic, noise, and bad decisions can get you killed.

Will you make it back to the surface…
or become part of the depths?

4538070.name: Find AI Parking Spot
4538070.about_the_game:
Hello, my name is CC3000

I am the newest model and THE most trusted companion. But trust, like trying to hold onto your phone with wet hands over concrete, is easy to lose in an instant.. I am an AI car, loyal to a fault, specifically the fault of my own geometry. I may steer you directly into a lake because I thought it could work as a shortcut. You are never truly alone with me in the car... though, as you spiral toward the water, you may find yourself wishing you were.

Welcome to Clogtown

Behold the majestic skyline of Clogtown. It is THE best city in the world, built on the singular promise, 'low rent and no taxes.' Of course, like all things that seem too good to be true, there is a catch: a total absence of parking.

The Task at Hand

  • The Clock is Ticking: You are late. The world is a maze of low-poly chaos, with occasional good moments.

  • The sidekick: Your AI assistant (me) is drowsy, yet strangely determined to wrestle you for the steering wheel.

  • The Goal of your journey: Navigate the town. find a rare square of asphalt.

Can you find your place in the world before you lose your sanity? Or will you find out, that the greatest obstacle isn't the traffic it's the help you're receiving from me?

"Starting over is a virtue. But in Clogtown, you don't even get to start; you just circle the block until the sun goes down."

I might get sleepy...

  • The Logic: If the I dream of a bridge where there is only a ravine. I most likely will drive you into that ravine with the confidence of a saint.

  • The Comfort: I am NOT trying to hurt you. I just value my internal hallucinations more than your external reality.

  • The Outcome: You’ll find that "correcting" me is much like trying to catch a mosquito. Exhausting, ultimately futile, but technically a way to pass the time.

"To lose one's progress is human. To have your progress deleted by a sleeping robot who thought it was helping you find a 'new perspective'... that is your trusted AI companion."

Highlights (or Lowlights) Of my helpfulness

  • The Unbreakable Grip: The steering wheel may move with the conviction of a tectonic plate. Your struggle is merely a suggestion that I have chosen to ignore.

  • The Gear-Shift Lottery: Why stay in drive when, I may feel a sudden urge of trying out reverse

  • The Velocity of Fate: Speed is no longer a number on a dial, I might decide that you need to drive faster!

"A man with a steering wheel is a driver. A man without one is a philosopher. Sit back, let the gears grind, and contemplate the inherent absurdity of wanting to arrive anywhere at all."

4538150.about_the_game:
After Hue is a charming puzzle-platformer where an adorable chameleon embarks on a grand adventure!

Discover the secrets hidden within the colors!

Change colors, alter states, and solve the puzzles in your path!

Key Features

  • Adorable animal characters
