4538170.name: Yet Another Reality Show
4538170.about_the_game:
Lead a party of up to six adventurers in this fantasy CRPG with a reality television twist! Build your party alongside wacky companions, vanquish enemies in tactical combat, and even outlast fellow houseguests in the region's famous Bachelorette Tournament!

Yet Another Reality Show features exploration of hand-crafted maps connected through an overarching overworld. While you clear out a map's fog-of-war, you will encounter a cast of companion characters to accompany your journey, acquire items and skills to kit out your party, engage in deep and reactive dialogue trees with NPCs, and complete quests that have world-altering consequences. The choices are yours!

The world's newest discovery is magicvision, a way to not only record events, but also broadcast them far and wide! Needless to say, magicvision has taken the world by storm as a form of wondrous entertainment.

Events such as the game's Bachelorette Tournament offer an opportunity to put your roleplaying to the test as you forge and break alliances, manage social relationships, and maybe even fight your fellow houseguests, all to claim the spotlight. Will you use magicvision to prop yourself up as the next heroic reality star, or are there more capabilities for this technology yet to be discovered?

Engage in grid-based combat integrated on the same maps that you explore! Position your party in ambush positions prior to combat, or even bumrush neutral NPCs in broad daylight if you're unafraid of the consequences.

Combat takes place in individual turns determined by all units' initiative, with each turn using an Action Point (AP) system to determine available combat actions. Drink a potion quickly, then decide whether you want to blast a horde of enemies with an area-of-effect Fireball, or accurately snipe a meddlesome backliner with an Aimed Shot -> every combat offers a chance to demonstrate your tactical acumen!

Choose how you want to build your party! Play as a diplomatic scholar with an arsenal of arcane and divine spells, as an intimidating brute bulldozing dialogue and combat alike with their two-handed maul, or even as a stealthy dual-wielding rogue out to assassinate the competition. Use up to five other companions to diversify your team, or maybe just run a hunting party of all archers.

As in most RPGs, you acquire experience and level up while playing through the game. Leveling up allows your characters to improve their Attributes, general physical and mental prowess applicable in a variety of situations. In addition, you and your party can also specialize with separated Combat Skill and Utility Skill points, allowing you to roleplay as a persuasive, charismatic knight without sacrificing polearm expertise in combat, if you so desire!

FEATURES:

  • Party-based RPG featuring a customizable player character with your choice of up to five additional companion characters

  • Hand-crafted map zones and overworld designed to encourage exploration

  • Custom reality television-themed encounters and questlines, such as the Bachelorette Tournament

  • Expansive dialogue system with companions and NPCs reactive to player decisions

  • Tactical grid-based, turn-based combat using an Action Point system

  • Diverse build options involving general Attributes as well as separate points for Combat Skills and Utility Skills

DEVELOPER NOTE:

"Yet Another Reality Show is a solo-developer project inspired by both the classic isometric turn-based RPGs as well as some of my favorite (or groan-inducing) reality television shows. This is my first commercial release, so I welcome any constructive feedback you can give! Please enjoy the game!"

  • Agggron from Royal Squirrel Studios LLC

4538200.name: Heat
4538200.about_the_game:
Heat is a sandbox survival game, with tower defense elements, modular tools, and really cool building system.

Hey! I’ve always loved survival games, so this is my take on one.

I’m not trying to reinvent the genre or create something overly complex. I just want to make survival systems feel more interactive and meaningful.

Survival aspects were inspired by my homeless journey of living in a tent!
(I did chose to live like this to save a bit of money, have a cool story and be able to finance everything myself, more about this in About Gamedevelopment section)

CRAFTING

Instead of simple recipes, the game uses a modular tool system. You’ll spend most of your time crafting, finding, and retrieving components, then combining them in different ways. The goal is to let you experiment and discover your own solutions.

BASE BUILDING

As someone who plays a lot of survival games, I always felt building systems could offer more freedom. Here, you’re not limited to predefined structures... you can build in a more open, flexible way.

EXPLORATION

You’ll explore procedurally generated maps, searching for resources and useful gear.

There is also a risk of losing your equipment, inspired by games like Escape from Tarkov.

ABOUT DEVELOPMENT

Hello there! A little bit about myself and Detail Software.

I’m currently the solo developer behind this project at the time of writing.

Around may of 2022 I move to a tent, I bought a piece of land in Czech Republic to start my GameDev Company. It mostly started as a joke. But a a time went by I kinda fell in love with this and it allowed me to finance everything myself (mostly freelancing and a loan from a bank), so I wont be pressured by any investors or deadlines. I know no deadlines sound scary but I confident in my ability to deliver. I really don't wanna do any microtransactions and similar things, u gonna pay once and will have the full game.

Most of the core systems, 3D models, animations is designed by me from the ground up. (and my friend wrote most of the inventory system, but is not part of the project for a long time)

This game has been a deeply personal journey so far. Most of it has been developed from a tent, turning limited conditions into a creative playground. What started as an idea has slowly grown into a living world, shaped piece by piece through persistence, experimentation, and a lot of late nights.

Being a solo developer means wearing many hats like design, programming, art, etc. But it also gives me the freedom to build something truly unique, without compromise. Every system, every mechanic, and every detail reflects that hands-on approach and it only depends on u to decide if its positive or negative lmao.

This is just the beginning, and I’m excited to see where it goes next.

4538210.name: Snailium
4538210.about_the_game:
Play as a snail in Snailium, a calm exploration game with a sci-fi twist. Traverse atmospheric environments, collect unique items, and discover new areas in search for the rare, undiscovered element - Snalium.

Explore Ethereal Stylized Environments

Each biome and map has been designed to give an interesting and unique experience to players with a stylized, sci-fi style.  

Collect and Use Items

Find and collect items around the world to gain new abilities. Each item has been inspired by real-life purposes for a snail.

Calming, Casual Gameplay

With no forced combat or encounters with enemies, players can enjoy a relaxing, enjoyable experience with Snailum

Decide How You Want to Play

Whether you enjoy playing at a fast pace or taking your time, Snailium can be played however the player wishes. Nothing is forced and it is up to player to decide what they want to do. No matter what they decide, there is still plenty to enjoy.

Completely Handmade

I developed Snailium with a challenge for myself - make every single asset for the game from scratch. This includes the models, code (within the engine), the textures, materials, sound FX, music, art, etc...  I truly enjoyed this first experience in game development and have learned so much.

4538260.name: SeverSoul XOOKEEPER
4538260.about_the_game:
Keep the entities fed, pacified and contained every night within a dark decaying facility. Can you survive each shift in this intense point & click horror?

OBJECTIVE
Congratulations! Due to budget cuts along with an unknown cataclysmic event, you have been demoted to XOOKEEPER! Your job is to make sure none of the four entities in your sector escape by keeping their biomes' anti-psionic batteries charged, feeding the entities whenever they are hungry, and pacifying them with an electric deterrent whenever they get a bit too rowdy. Oh, and also make sure the generators keep running so that your facility doesn't fall into a hellish dimension of torment and agony! Your shift is every night from 10PM - 6AM. Your supervisor has been notified and will arrive soon. Only one week left!

MECHANICS
The batteries keeping the four entities at bay slowly deplete throughout your shift. Whenever the batteries are low, you will have to take them out of their respective biomes, charge them in the main computer room, and bring them back before the entities have a chance to escape!

If an entity becomes hungry for an extended period, they will attempt to break out of their biome, using up a lot of charge from their battery that is keeping them locked away. To prevent this, feed the entities when they are hungry, and pacify them when they attempt to break out. 

If an entity does break out, have no fear! You have plenty of places to hide, such as lockers, under tables, and in vents. Turning off your flashlight also helps make you less noticeable.

However, don't stay hidden for too long! The entities are smart and can eventually find you. Also, you will need to come out of hiding to occasionally check on the generator to make sure it is still running, and not actively sending you to your demise.

THE ENTITIES
Here at the XOO, you will be taking care of the lethal Nychus, the horrifying Chort, the mesmerizing Siren, and the cold Yuki-Onna. What fun! Each creature has their own unique habits while hungry, running amok, and eating your flesh and/or soul! Keep note of their behaviors to increase your chances of survival.

TOOLS

But never fear! We at the XOO always equip our employees with the latest technology that we are willing to pay! For example, we provide each observation and control room with its own terminal with up to five useful commands! You can charge, feed, and pacify any entity that needs your extra care. We even recently updated our operating system so that it will recognize any command just from the first three letters you type! And it comes with double the colors of the last update! So modern and convenient! And just for being last month's Employee of the Month, we'll even throw in a $5 flashlight on the house...for $5 out of your paycheck!

FEATURES

  • 4+ monsters to hide from

  • An old, semi-abandoned government facility

  • A totally confident, not scared at all scientist ready to survive the week

  • Maybe some hidden, dark lore and secrets???

  • Ṭ̸̢͓͍̆͆̍̈́̔ë̷̖́̍̀̔R̵̖̬̻͔̎̎͗̈́̊͜w̴̹̓4̷͈̬́͋̑̑Ȋ̵̹͇͇̺͍̔̐͊̚G̸̼͛̇̐̆̚a̸̡̙̩̹̟͋̌͝n̵̹̺̈́̀̉2̸̼̿́͠ͅ0̸̘̳͍̐͂̽̆̕%̵̳͌͆̄̐͠!̵̦͙̲̠̾̐ͅË̷͉͂̍̚4̵͔͙͉͇̈́̄ĉ̶̳̽͜H̵͔̼̬͊͒?̵̲̹̰̾͘W̸̨͉̒͐͋̕͜͝a̸̡̗͈̭͊͂̀̓4̷̣͋́̃̈́͋_̸̟̠͉̖̺͆̉͊͑͠2̷̯̥͙̎̑̈̅͘2̴͓͇͋

  • And me, your humble, always 100% accurate, truthful, and willing to help, supervisor!

4538280.name: Pizza Turbo
4538280.about_the_game:
A pizza box on wheels. A deadly city. Zero margin for error.

Pizza Turbo is a high-speed arcade racing delivery game where the city is actively trying to destroy you.

Race against time, keep your pizza hot, and survive chaotic streets using nitro, jumps, and skill-based stunts. Drive fast, react faster, and master pure arcade chaos.

Fast. Ridiculous. Dangerous.
Just how delivery should be.

Deliver or die trying

Deliver pizzas from point A to point B in a chaotic open city… if you can.

Mines, tornadoes, bombs, UFOs, and unpredictable events turn every run into a fast-paced arcade challenge.

Your temperature is your life.
If the pizza gets cold, you’re done.

Welcome to Old York

A chaotic open-world city where peace is not an option.

Explore, drive, and survive in an environment inspired by early 2000s urban madness.
Complete deliveries, unlock upgrades, discover new pizzas, and adapt to a constantly hostile world.

Every delivery is a challenge.
Every street is a risk.

Speed is nothing without style

This is not just a racing game. It’s arcade driving with tricks.

Chain tricks, build combos, and use power-ups scattered across the city:
boosts, low gravity, shields, and more.

Use ramps, trampolines, traffic, and anything in your path to maximize speed, score, and survival.

Because in Pizza Turbo, delivery isn’t a job.
It’s survival.

4538330.name: MINOS INITIATIVE - 2112
4538330.about_the_game:
MINOS INITIATIVE – 2112

A dark sci-fi survival CRPG set deep beneath the surface of a dying world — inside a vast, fractured underground network known only as MINOS.

What began as a joint excavation and research project funded by powerful surface organizations has become something else entirely.
Something no faction fully controls anymore.

DESCEND INTO THE MINOS NETWORK

  • Procedurally generated sectors with dynamic layouts

  • Faction-influenced NPC's and abandoned infrastructure

  • Power systems, blackout zones, and reactive lighting

  • Hidden vaults, terminals, and encrypted data caches

  • Increasing instability the deeper you go

SURFACE FACTIONS & CONTRACTS

The remnants of the old world now operate from above, each with their own agenda:

  • HELIX EXTRACTIVE — resource dominance at any cost

  • BLACKLINE RECOVERY — retrieval of unknown assets

  • NADIR MATERIAL AUTHORITY — control through allocation and restriction

  • ZENITH INNOVATIONS — signal research and experimental technology

  • AURIC FRONTIER GROUP — wealth, rarity, and long-term control

Through Data Shards, you receive contracts from these factions:

  • Gather rare materials

  • Recover lost technology

  • Extract data from unstable systems

  • Deliver resources through hostile territory

SURVIVE THE UNDERGROUND

Everything you carry is something you fought to keep.

  • Scavenge scrap, batteries, med-gel, and rare materials

  • Manage inventory, weight, and scarcity

  • Craft and build tools, defenses, and utilities

  • Navigate darkness, failing systems, and environmental hazards

  • Find food, water, and moments of safety where you can

COMBAT & ENCOUNTERS

MINOS is not empty.

  • Engage rogue machines, corrupted systems, and unstable survivors

  • Fight faction remnants and operatives with their own objectives

  • Use tactical ranged and close-quarters combat

  • Adapt to unpredictable AI behavior and shifting threats

  • Survive encounters where control is an illusion

THE TRUTH IS FRAGMENTED

Through terminals, data shards, and scattered survivors, a pattern begins to form:

The factions above are not just observing MINOS.

They are competing over it.

And something deep below is responding.

DESCEND FURTHER

Every floor brings you closer to answers.

And further from safety.

Ensure you are prepared for anything at all costs.

4538350.name: Astral Trial
4538350.about_the_game:
This is a cold, ruthless city ruled by 14 "Astral Guardians." And you are the only disruptor.

Pick up your cards, see through their intentions, and crush their rules!

Climb upwards until you overthrow it all.

⚔️ Fully Transparent Symmetrical DBG Combat

Breaking away from the traditional Roguelike formula where enemies rely on pre-defined scripts, this game features enemies sharing the exact same card logic as you: draw pile, hand, discard pile, and energy.

  • Full Information Transparency: You can see the enemy's draw pile size, hand size, and remaining energy in real time.

  • Dimensional Advantage: Not only can you precisely calculate damage and defense, but you can also tactically deplete the enemy's deck, read and destroy their hand, and even leave them with no cards to play.

  • Exclusive Relic Duels: Each elite and boss possesses exclusive relics similar to "hero skills." You need to understand and strategize against their unique combat personalities.

🌌 12 Independent Chapters, 12 Unique Card Pools

Say goodbye to lengthy single-run experiences. The game uses a streamlined "independent chapter system," with each chapter lasting approximately 30-60 minutes.

  • Unique Card Pool Construction: Unlock new card pools as you progress through the game, offering twelve distinct combat styles.

  • Zodiac Field Effects: Each of the twelve zodiacs has different field rules. For example, "Contract Transparency" allows both players to see each other's hands, while "Involution Law" penalizes the player who plays fewer cards, ensuring a fresh experience every chapter.

  • Starting Deck Advancement: Unlock starting decks of varying strengths as you progress, allowing you to experience complete playstyles without starting from scratch.

💔 Survival Through Death: Defeat is also part of the story.

A carefully crafted deck ruined by a single mistake? Not here.

  • Dual Health Bar Mechanism: Health (HP) is no longer the only limit; "Faith Points" will serve as your second health bar.

  • Narrative Penalties: Losing a battle doesn't result in an immediate Game Over. Instead, it triggers a unique penalty storyline and dialogue specific to that boss, consuming Faith Points to replenish health and continue fighting.

  • Meta-Progression: Regardless of victory or defeat, your resilience (maximum Faith) will be permanently increased, providing you with more starting relics and deck options for your next challenge.

4538420.name: D-Extinction
4538420.about_the_game:
You are hunted

They told you it was a research facility.

They didn’t tell you what they were researching.

You play as a rookie agent sent into a classified lab that has gone dark for weeks. What begins as a routine investigation quickly turns into a fight for survival.

Story & Gameplay:

A classified facility has gone silent. You’re sent in to investigate.

What you find inside was never meant to exist.

This is a bodycam-style horror experience where you investigate what went wrong and your survival depends on one thing—not being seen.
The facility is overrun by highly intelligent predators. They don’t forgive mistakes.

Move carefully.
Collect evidence.
Watch everything.

Because once they find you… there’s no escape.


Realistic graphics and high-quality 3D sound fully immerse you in the eerie atmosphere of moving with these prehistoric beasts.

4538450.name: Shattered Spheres
4538450.about_the_game:
The stars are waiting. So are your enemies.

In the tradition of the classic space strategy games that defined a genre, Shattered Spheres strips 4X empire-building back to what matters: exploration, tough decisions, and the slow satisfaction of watching your civilization reach across the galaxy.

No sprawling planet micromanagement menus. No systems buried under systems. Just you, the stars, and whoever is trying to take them from you.

Explore a living galaxy. Planets orbit their stars in real time — every turn shifts the map, making positioning and timing matter in ways most space strategy games ignore.

Build your empire your way. Expand aggressively and crush your rivals through military conquest, or outmaneuver them at the negotiating table through careful diplomacy. The path to victory is yours to choose.

Strategy without the spreadsheet. Shattered Spheres is a love letter to an era when 4X games trusted you to think — without demanding you manage every last detail of every last colony.

Inspired by Davin Brin's short story "The Crystal Spheres."

4538480.name: Terra Ninfa
4538480.about_the_game:
Step into a world full of picturesque wonders, puzzling mysteries and serene vibes while you revive forgotten dried-up landscapes by manipulating the flow of water.





Paint your cosy haven with the colours of nature by growing trees, bushes, flowers and welcoming back life in barren lands. Bring a wild beauty and peace to a neglected world and discover the secrets of the Nymphs.

🌿 What is it 🌿

Terra Ninfa is a laid-back exploration puzzle game that offer the player the opportunity to relax and discover many dioramas filled with interactive elements.

The gameplay is as simple as clicking on objects and enjoying the domino effect that develop as a result. Click by click, players discover how to help nature come back to the world.

The puzzle elements are based more on exploration and experimentation rather than complex brain teaser. Every action aim to provide the player with satisfaction and a sense of progress. 

🌿 What's in it 🌿

Terra Ninfa features many dioramas from around the world, each with their own style and feeling.




The full version of the game will feature 25+ carefully handcrafted puzzles and dioramas, different biomes like antique Greek landscapes to canyons with countless hidden collectibles and Steam achievements.





Wishlist Terra Ninfa and spread the news with everyone. 🌿💚

4538590.name: OBSERVE
4538590.about_the_game:
12:47 AM.

You missed the last train.

The gates are locked. The shops are closing. The PA system announces that service has concluded and wishes you a pleasant evening. Everything about the station is normal, functional, and exactly as you've seen it a thousand times on your daily commute.

Except tonight, things are not what they seem. Something is watching. What is seen cannot be unseen.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

午前0時47分。 終電は、もう行った。

改札は閉ざされている。売店はシャッターを下ろしていく。構内放送が本日の運行終了を告げ、利用客に丁寧な挨拶を送る。駅のすべてが正常で、機能的で、毎日の通勤で何千回と見てきた光景そのものだ。

ただし、今夜は——見えているものが、すべてではない。何かが、見ている。一度見たものは、二度と見なかったことにはできない。

4538600.name: Claire Darksage and the Penumbra Deaths Collector's Edition
4538600.about_the_game:
At the behest of Professor Lucinda, Claire Darksage and Tiska the Fairy journey to the Altheria Kingdom’s Magic Academy to aid an old friend, Professor Rezzabel. But dark forces have already breached the gates: Penumbra Spawns stalk the halls, and one of the realm's seven guardians has been brutally slain.

A forbidden power is at work: Penumbra Magic. Born from a shadow-pact, this ancient curse drains the life force of the living to raise the dead. Now, Claire must navigate treacherous landscapes and uncover secrets guarded by a foe who has been pulling the strings from the shadows.

Accompanied by a mysterious talking cat, a defiant young princess, and a resolute royal inspector alongside his young sub-inspector, Claire will discover that some truths are darker than she ever imagined. Beware: in a kingdom built on sorcery, the deadliest threats often wear the most familiar faces.

Game Features:

  • 18 Signature Hidden Object Scenes: Expertly crafted in the Claire Darksage style.

  • Revamped Card Battle System: Master new strategies and deeper tactical combat.

  • Battles against Mythical Beasts: Face the kingdom's legendary creatures and find a way to soothe them.

  • Challenging New Minigames: Fresh puzzles to test your wits and magic.

  • A Rich Fantasy Epic: A story of betrayal and ancient curses.

Collector's Edition Includes:

  • Bonus Chapter: Exclusive story "The Missing Guardian".

  • Exclusive HO Scenes: Additional hidden object challenges found only in this edition.

  • The Altheria Tournament: Prove your combat mastery in a dedicated battle arena mode.

  • Even More Minigames: Extra puzzles to keep the magic alive.

4538660.name: Signal Scavenger
4538660.about_the_game:
About This Game

Signal Scavenger is a tactical third-person extraction shooter set in a fog-covered, post-apocalyptic world where humanity no longer exists—only remnants of a controlling organization and the prisoners it sends to die.

You are one of them.

Deployed into hostile regions filled with mutated threats and unstable signal zones, your mission is simple: clear, disable, survive, and extract. Every successful operation brings you closer to freedom. Every failure resets your progress.

A WORLD WITHOUT MERCY

The surface is consumed by dense fog, broken infrastructure, and unknown signals spreading across abandoned zones. These signals must be located and disabled before they trigger catastrophic consequences.

You are not sent to survive.
You are sent because you are expendable.

CORE GAMEPLAY LOOP

  • Equip your unlocked gear and choose your loadout

  • Deploy into a contaminated region

  • Explore, scan, and complete randomized objectives

  • Manage limited time before forced extraction

  • Escape with what you’ve earned… or lose everything

Each run is a high-risk, high-reward operation.

MISSION OBJECTIVES

Every deployment is different, with randomized tasks such as:

  • Clearing hostile-infested zones

  • Disabling signal sources

  • Restoring power systems

  • Eliminating high-threat targets

  • Retrieving critical, limited-time assets

Time is always against you. Stay too long, and you won’t make it out.

PLAY YOUR WAY — STEALTH OR CHAOS

Approach each mission how you want:

  • Stealth: Avoid detection, move carefully, and outmaneuver enemies

  • Loud: Engage directly with weapons and force

But be warned:

  • Mutants react to sound and movement

  • Detection systems can trigger large-scale enemy alerts

Once things go loud… survival becomes much harder.

PROGRESSION & UPGRADES

Survive and extract to improve your chances:

  • Upgrade gear for efficiency and survivability

  • Optimize loadouts for different mission types

  • Become faster, deadlier, and more tactical with each run

Failure means losing progress—adapt or repeat.

INVENTORY & LOOT

  • Slot-based inventory system with limited capacity

  • Make real-time decisions on what to carry and what to leave behind

  • Extract with valuable resources to fuel your progression

Every slot matters.

UNIQUE MECHANICS

  • Scan & Clear System – Locate hidden threats before they find you

  • Dynamic Signal Zones – Core objective that shapes each run

  • Randomized Missions – No two deployments are the same

  • Hidden Dangers – Not all threats are visible

ROGUELIKE EXTRACTION DESIGN

  • Each run is a fresh attempt

  • Death resets your current progress

  • Adapt your strategy with every deployment

ATMOSPHERE

  • Fog-heavy environments

  • Tactical, slow-paced survival gameplay

  • Ambient horror sound design

  • Constant tension between exploration and escape

FEATURES

  • Third-person tactical shooter gameplay

  • Stealth and loud combat approaches

  • Randomized missions and replayability

  • Extraction-based progression system

  • Gear upgrades and loadout customization

  • Slot-based inventory management

  • Casual difficulty option for accessibility ( WIP )

CURRENT STATUS

Signal Scavenger is currently in active development and will be released in Early Access.
This initial version represents the core gameplay experience, with ongoing improvements and additional content planned throughout development.

A detailed roadmap will be shared, outlining upcoming features, systems, and updates as development progresses. Player feedback will play a key role in shaping the future of the game.

4538670.name: Love at First Frost
4538670.about_the_game:
About Love at First Frost


High in the Colorado Rockies, Whitmore Lodge stands against the cold—a timber-and-stone landmark preparing for its 50th anniversary season. You play as Asher, a once-celebrated nature photographer whose career collapsed after his award-winning glacier images were stolen and weaponized. Now he takes safe, corporate shots to avoid ever risking his art again.

But the mountain's light isn't safe, and neither are the three women who pull him out of hiding. Over one pivotal winter night, a single choice sets your path.

Meet the Cast




Margaux — The Beautiful Cage
The founder's granddaughter and reluctant manager of the lodge's anniversary season, Margaux is sharp, exhausted, and held together by competence and cutting humor. She's the lodge's heartbeat—and its prisoner—torn between the freedom she built elsewhere and the home she never stopped loving.



Neve — The Controlled Fall
An elite ski instructor and former Olympic hopeful, Neve is all charisma and speed on the surface—until you notice the careful way she protects her injured knee. She refuses to live cautiously and challenges Asher to stop confusing safety with survival.



Tamsin — Data and Doubt
A brilliant glaciologist studying the retreating Whitmore Glacier, Tamsin carries quiet intensity—and the constant fear that her work won't withstand scrutiny. Asher becomes her unexpected ally when his old photographs turn into the evidence she needs.

Key Features


  • A single pivotal choice with three full romance routes—follow Neve, Tamsin, or Margaux and shape Asher's future through one focused love story
  • A vivid winter-lodge setting—bonfires, hot springs under starlight, blizzards, darkrooms, glacier trails, and gala nights framed by mountain grandeur
  • Romance driven by purpose and conflict—injury, ambition, science, scrutiny, legacy, and pressure push each relationship toward risk, intimacy, and renewal
  • A narrative built around photography—reclaim a stolen artistic identity as each route challenges what it means to capture something real
  • Each romance route includes explicit adult scenes. 9 adult scenes across three romance routes

4538680.name: Midnight Queue
4538680.about_the_game:
Midnight Queue is a decision game set in a nightclub in the mysterious city of New Orleans in 1985. Over five nights, you'll face a line of customers trying to get into the club — but not all of them are human. Your job? Decide who gets in.

 

Observe each customer carefully and make your choices. Each night, a new tool is unlocked to help you in your work, but the final judgment is always yours. Every choice has a price:

  • Letting vampires in can be fatal

  • Rejecting innocent humans has consequences

  • Accepting bribes can completely change your fate

Features:

  • For fans of Papers, Please and That's Not My Neighbor

  • Vampires infiltrated among humans

  • Over 90 unique characters

  • Multiple unlockable endings

  • Randomly generated queues — no two playthroughs are the same

  • Moral decisions with real consequences

  • Bribe system that impacts your outcome

  • Investigation system with multiple tools

  • Progressive difficulty across five nights

4538820.name: Wasteland Light
4538820.about_the_game:
Unknown creatures appeared out of thin air, rapidly taking over the world. The remaining humans are struggling to survive. You awaken in this dead silence, surrounded only by roaming mutants and unknown monsters. Alone or with friends, build your base, explore the world, and fight back against the horde.

Game Features

Survive: Scavenge for resources in the ruins, battle threats in the wild, build up your strength, and confront the truly dangerous monsters head-on.

Build: Establish your own base, gather survivors to build defensive lines together, unlock workshops, and craft epic gear.

Combat: Engage entrenched monsters and deadly bosses across the map. Switch between your normal and transformed states, using every tool at your disposal to defeat powerful foes.

Craft: Craft chips for legendary equipment. Unlock additional transformation forms, and master both your weapons and your transformations to stand against formidable enemies.

Cooperate: Form a squad of up to 8 players in multiplayer mode. Team up with friends to engage in group battles, build your base, and fend off swarms of monsters together.

Explore: Explore a world conquered by monsters and uncover the hope that illuminates this crumbling world.

4538830.name: Track Star
4538830.about_the_game:
Four years. One career. No guarantees.

Track Star is a high school track & field career simulation spanning your entire athletic life — freshman tryouts to senior day. You choose your specialty, build your athlete week by week, and find out whether you had what it takes. Some athletes make nationals. Most don't. Both are valid outcomes.

Every week is a decision

Each week you manage your training load, protect your energy, and decide which meets are worth the risk. Push too hard and you're injured. Play it too safe and your rival pulls ahead. There's no perfect playbook — just the choices you make and the times on the clock.

World events shape your seasons too. A heat wave tanks outdoor performance. A rival school produces a phenom who's suddenly on your radar. The news cycle doesn't stop for your training schedule.

Build the athlete you want to be

Choose your specialty and shape your career around it. A Sprints build plays completely differently from Distance or Jumps. Your stats, your training focus, your event selection — all of it compounds across four seasons. By senior year, you'll know exactly what kind of athlete you built.

Qualify or go home

The championship path is real and it's unforgiving. Make your Class meet. Advance to State. Survive Regionals. Only a few athletes reach Nationals — and only one wins. Fall short and you're running the annual Turkey Trot with everyone else who peaked too early.

The rivalry is personal

Every career has a rival. They show up at your meets, they remember your times, and they're not rooting for you. Whether you chase them down or spend four years in their shadow depends entirely on the athlete you built.

It ends with a decision you didn't expect

College recruitment isn't guaranteed. By senior year, your performance history either opens doors or closes them. Some athletes walk away with scholarship offers. Some walk away with a good story. A few walk away with both.

Features

  • Four-season high school career — freshman to senior

  • Weekly training and competition loop with energy management

  • Multiple athlete specializations, each with distinct playstyles

  • Championship qualification ladder: Class → State → Regionals → Nationals

  • Dynamic rival system that tracks your career arc

  • World events engine that shapes your seasons with real context

  • College recruitment endgame with scholarship outcomes

  • Hard Mode for athletes who think they've seen everything

  • Hall of Fame and career records across playthroughs

  • Animated Race Results — because watching your PR get called deserves a moment

  • Dozens of achievements and milestones

Disclosure

I use Claude Code to assist in game development, but all content, narrative, formulas, etc. are created by me.

4538860.name: COZY MOVING DAY
4538860.about_the_game:
COZY MOVING DAY is a relaxing moving game where you pack boxes, load furniture, and bring order to beautifully crafted locations without any stress. Whether you are moving through a cozy apartment, a large house, a modern office, or a peaceful place surrounded by nature, every job becomes a small feel-good moment.

Room by room, you pack furniture, paintings, decorations, and many other items into boxes and load them into your company van. No rush, no pressure. Just you, your task, and a peaceful atmosphere.

A Cozy Game Made for Relaxation

In COZY MOVING DAY, calm, atmosphere, and your own rhythm take center stage. There are no enemies, no danger, and no pressure. Instead, you can enjoy a peaceful gameplay experience that gives you time to breathe, unwind, and simply enjoy the moment.

Progress at Your Own Pace

4539270.name: Seven Nights In The Dark
4539270.about_the_game:
🌑 Seven Nights In The Dark

Some kids are afraid of the dark. Ethan has real reasons to be.

Ethan is a 10-year-old boy just like any other — until the lights go out.

He suffers from REM Sleep Behaviour Disorder, a rare sleep condition that turns every single night into an inescapable nightmare. Intense night terrors. Sleepless hours. Lucid dreams so vivid that the line between sleep and reality completely disappears. The doctors call it a disorder. Ethan knows it's something more.

Every evening, when his mom wishes him goodnight and turns off the light, the same nightmare is waiting for him. Same nightmare. Same room. Same four demons.

⏰ 10:00 PM — The nightmare begins

The moment the clock strikes 10 PM, you are trapped inside Ethan's mind. His bedroom becomes a cage. The door — your only connection to the rest of the world. The window — a gateway you do not want to open. And somewhere in the darkness, something is moving.

Four demons haunt Ethan night after night. They are not random. They are not loud. They are patient, calculated, and they know exactly where to look. Each one has its own behaviour, its own weaknesses, and its own moments where it becomes unstoppable.

Your mission is simple: survive until 6:00 AM.

Ethan's mom wakes him up every morning at six. If you make it that far, the nightmare ends — for that night. But there are six more to go.

🛏️ Survival has rules

Inside Ethan's bedroom, you have a few ways to protect yourself. Simple ones. But vital.

Hide under the bed — the darkness there can keep you safe, if you know when to use it

Get inside the closet — a classic hiding spot, but not always a reliable one

Close the bedroom door — keeps the demons at bay, at least for a while

Turn on the heater — the warmth drives some of them away, but not all

No method is foolproof. No hiding spot stays safe forever. You will need to learn how to read the signs, listen carefully to every sound, and make fast decisions under pressure. One second of hesitation can cost you everything.

🌒 Seven nights. Seven nightmares.

Each night is harder than the one before. The demons grow more aggressive. Their patterns shift. What worked on Night 1 might not save you on Night 4.

As the nights go on, you will learn more about Ethan, about his condition, and about what truly lurks inside his nightmares. Not everything is just fear. Some things have an explanation. Others do not.

Seven nights. Four demons. One bedroom.

Do you think you can make it until morning?

💡 About the disorder

REM Sleep Behaviour Disorder (RBD) is a real sleep condition in which the brain's normal mechanism for muscle paralysis during REM sleep fails to activate properly. Those affected physically act out their dreams — moving, talking, screaming. Nightmares are frequent, intense and extremely vivid. While it primarily affects adults, rare cases have been documented in children as well.

Seven Nights In The Dark is a work of fiction inspired by this real condition, created with respect for those who live with it every day — or rather, every night.

Goodnight, Ethan. Sweet Dreams.

🌑 Seven Nights In The Dark — survive the nightmare, one night at a time.

4539310.name: Guild of Three
4539310.about_the_game:
Weave Three Decks into One Party Strategy

Guild of Three is a turn-based deckbuilding RPG where you control three characters and three decks.

Each character has their own hand and role, and you must coordinate all three decks to build a single party strategy.

Relay Cards do not disappear at the end of a turn. Instead, they are passed to the next character.

Cards that rely on timing — defensive buffs, heals, support, or expensive plays — can be passed forward for the next character to use.

You need to think beyond the current turn and decide which cards should be passed to the next character.

　

　

Classes and Positioning Change How You Fight

Classes are not locked to specific characters.

Each class comes with its own exclusive cards, talents, and combat role, and can be further shaped with neutral cards.

A Cleric who can go on the offensive or a Wizard who holds the front line— even the same character can play very differently depending on the role you assign.

Who takes the front line determines whether your back line survives and how your party functions for the rest of the battle.

　

　

Your Party Keeps Growing Between Expeditions

After completing a contract, return to the guild to reorganize your party and prepare for the next expedition.

Card upgrades improve your key cards, while neutral card Crafting expands your tactical options.

Trinkets reinforce each character’s strengths, and level-ups and talent choices further define each class build.

This isn't just stat growth — It shapes the strategies and deck builds you bring into your next expedition.

　

　

Power Comes at a Price

As they battle monsters, your characters are exposed to Corruption.

Dark magic is powerful but unstable, and the more you rely on it, the greater the cost becomes.

As Corruption builds during an expedition, your deck is consumed by curses, forcing you to begin later battles at a disadvantage.

Whether to accept immediate gains at a long-term cost or manage your deck for the rest of the expedition is always a critical decision.

　

　

Key Features

  • Turn-based combat built around a 3-character party and 3 decks used at the same time

  • Party tactics built on Relay Cards and frontline/backline positioning

  • 8 classes, each with its own talent tree and 16 exclusive cards

  • Persistent progression through neutral card crafting, upgrades, trinkets, and talent choices

  • 4 dungeon themes, each with its own monsters, elites, and bosses

　

　

A Small Guild, Where Adventure Begins

Three childhood friends found a small guild and take on monster-hunting contracts as they travel from dungeon to dungeon.

What begins with small jobs and familiar monster hunts gradually leads to strange artifacts and greater threats.

What started in a small guild grows into a much larger conflict, and the three find themselves standing at its center.

　

Three characters, three decks.

Pass Relay Cards, combine classes, and arrange your front and back lines to create your own party strategy.

4539410.name: Cubie
4539410.about_the_game:
Change your perspective, change the rules

​Cubie is a minimalist 2D puzzle platformer where space isn't your enemy, but your greatest tool. Forget everything you know about traditional gravity—in this world, the physics depend entirely on how you enter a surface. Whether you approach from the left, right, top, or bottom, each side of the cube reorients your reality. What was an impassable abyss just a second ago can instantly become your new path forward.

The world of Cubie remains the same. Only your perspective of it changes.

Dynamic Gravity

Navigate all six sides of the cube. Every transition over an edge shifts the world’s orientation. Master the art of spatial thinking to find a way forward where others see only the edge of the map. In Cubie, your destination is often just one "flip" away.

Freedom in Rotation

​

​You are not just a victim of your environment. Take full control of your perspective. Survey the cube from every angle and decide which path to take. The ability to actively rotate the world allows you to pause, observe, and strategically outsmart each logical challenge. In Cubie, your next move is a matter of choice, not chance.

Interactive Mechanics

​

​Experience classic puzzle elements in an entirely new dimension. Push boxes, trigger floor switches, and unlock gates—but stay sharp. Every object is bound by the same laws of gravity as you. Always remember: a button on the ceiling is out of reach until you find the right perspective to make it your floor.

A Wealth of Challenges

  • Over 80 Unique Levels: From intuitive tutorials to complex logical labyrinths that will push your spatial imagination to its limits. Remember: there isn't always just one right way forward.

  • Minimalist Design: No unnecessary distractions. Just you, Cubie, and the pure satisfaction of a solved mystery. Focus on the logic, master the cube.

4539460.name: Fragments of Fear
4539460.about_the_game:
FRAGMENTS OF FEAR is an episodic psychological horror anthology that explores the terror hidden in the mundane. Each chapter tells a self-contained, found-footage story of fear and survival, while slowly piecing together a larger, ominous narrative.

You know that creeping dread when you walk home alone in the dark, or when you are waiting in an empty room and feel someone watching you? This collection brings those universal fears to life. Your survival depends entirely on making the right choices.

Navigate a trailer park, endure an eerie bus ride, and wait alone in a laundromat as an unsettling presence looms closer. When a killer strikes, the night becomes a desperate race to escape.

  • VHS Aesthetic: Authentic visual filters and atmospheric sounds that immerse you in fear.

  • Choice Driven: Multiple endings to discover. Every sound, shadow, and choice could mean the difference between life and death.

Gameplay & Mechanics:

  • First-Person Exploration: Navigate claustrophobic, dimly lit environments. The gameplay focuses heavily on tension, atmosphere, and the feeling of being watched rather than complex combat.

  • Interact & Survive: Complete your required objectives like loading the washing machine or finding your way down a dark street by interacting with everyday objects. Pay close attention to your surroundings because an aggressive AI will haunt your every move.

  • Pacing & Dread: Move carefully through the world. The game utilizes slow-burn psychological horror, environmental storytelling, and sudden terrifying encounters to keep you on edge.

4539480.name: Roommate Lover: Love in Progress
4539480.about_the_game:
Storyline / Characters

《Roommate Lovers: Love in Progress》is a first-person live-action video dating game. In the story, you'll experience choices and challenges in both your career and personal life alongside four beautiful women.

The story is set against a realistic workplace and everyday life backdrop. You'll play a young urbanite with a hidden identity, renting out an extra room in your apartment to alleviate the pressure of a mortgage. By chance, you'll spark romances with your female boss (Yang Yan), a dance streamer tenant (An Xiaotang), your college sweetheart working as a housekeeper (Li Zhixuan), and your childhood friend next door (Lin Xia).

Every choice you make will change the course of the story—different characters will display different emotions and values, ultimately leading to multiple endings.

Who will ultimately stay by your side?

The aloof and powerful female CEO boss: Yang Yan, cold to others but gentle only towards you—she simply likes you?

Dance streamer tenant: An Xiaotang, I only rely on you, can I take care of you for the rest of my life?

Li Zhixuan, a college sweetheart who works part-time as a housekeeper, desperately hopes to reconcile with her boyfriend. Why didn't they get together back then?

My childhood sweetheart, the girl next door: Lin Xia, can I only be your little sister?

Highlights

Immersive first-person romance game

The game unfolds entirely from a first-person perspective, immersing you in the story and forcing you to make crucial choices throughout a series of progressively unfolding events. From heartwarming and comforting everyday life as a roommate, to your female boss's repeated heroic rescues, to a heart-fluttering romantic date with your first love, to the ambiguous and tantalizing moments of attraction, you will personally experience and freely choose your own path, gradually leading to your unique ending. This is not just a dating simulation, but a story about choices, infatuation, and growth.

In this romance game, every decision you make will influence the plot, unlocking your unique storyline! We've meticulously crafted different story branches and varied endings, allowing you to experience the game repeatedly and fully explore all the possibilities of this heartwarming journey. Each chapter contains a hidden epilogue and surprise videos, adding more detail and emotion to your simulated romance experience. Those seemingly insignificant choices may even trigger mysterious hidden easter eggs—perhaps a sweet encounter never before revealed, perhaps a heroine's unspoken secret, or even more surprises waiting for you to discover…

The game features live-action performances by popular bloggers and professional actors, whose natural and genuine acting, coupled with high-definition and exquisite visuals, makes you feel as if you've personally stepped into a real love story, immersing you in every thrill of romance. Four adorable female protagonists will accompany you to unlock an immersive and heartwarming romantic experience.

We've partnered with professional film directors to create this production using top-tier film-level shooting and production standards. We meticulously depict every expression, movement, and interactive detail, delivering an ultra-high-definition visual experience that makes you feel like you're having a face-to-face conversation with your dream girl. We present a unique romantic feast that combines cinematic quality with highly interactive elements.

About Us

We are the developers of LumaGate. We are always focused on creating captivating narratives and immersive story experiences for players, allowing them to experience deeper and more genuine emotional resonance within the game. We cherish every player's experience and feedback. In the future, we will continue to dedicate ourselves to bringing you more games that resonate with your soul, and we look forward to exploring a longer journey together in this world full of stories and emotions.

4539530.name: Snap the Cat
4539530.about_the_game:
Snap the Cat

Get your cameras ready! Snap the Cat is a short incremental game about taking photos of cats. Improve your equipment, upgrade your account, discover different biomes, and unlock new cats and costumes to make your photos the most viral.

Your main resource is likes. The more interesting your photos are, the more likes you'll get! As time goes on, people will start following you, and you'll be able to monetize your account. The more popular you become, the more opportunities you'll have to improve your skills — with an extensive skill tree, you'll be able to unlock new abilities to get the maximum benefit!

Open packs to get new, unique cats and outfits for them. Rewards are guaranteed!

Features

  • 8+ biomes

  • 40+ cats

  • 25+ costumes

  • Progress through resource gathering

  • Skill tree of upgrades to explore

  • Simple and relaxing gameplay

Could you get everyone on the planet to follow you?

4539550.name: Tabletop Survivors
4539550.about_the_game:
This project started as a tabletop experiment to see if a deck of random event cards could power a unique story every time I played. The results were incredible. Compared to traditional RPGs with fixed plots, the sense of adventure created by this total unpredictability far exceeded my expectations. That’s why I decided to turn this idea into a full indie game.

Tabletop Survivors is a turn-based Roguelike Card RPG where the story is driven by random events. I’ve also added an innovative 'Card Distance' mechanic to the combat, making weapon range a key factor and significantly deepening the strategy.

The story takes place after a zombie outbreak. You hear on the radio that you need to get to the port as soon as possible to catch the last evacuation ship.

On this arduous journey through the apocalypse, you and your companions will face the hardships of lack of water and food, deal with hordes of zombies, and defend against bandits you may encounter at any time. Will you be able to reach your destination?

SURVIVORS

Each character has a randomly generated combination of skill points, and you need to combine and utilize their abilities in a reasonable way to build a powerful team.

CHOICE MATTERS

Your choices will determine the plot and the characters' fates, so please be careful. Your choice, your story.

WATER, FOOD, SLEEP, AND MOOD

Survival requires water, food, and sleep, and the inability to obtain these will affect mood. A depressed survivor will perform poorly in both action and combat.

WEAPONS AND AMMUNITION

You can buy weapons from gun dealers, seize weapons from enemies, or even pick up a shovel or pitchfork to use as a weapon.

Although cold weapons are not as powerful as firearms, they can save precious ammunition.

ARMOR

From simple clothes and hats to sophisticated military armor, you need to constantly improve your protection to deal with increasingly powerful enemies.

UPGRADE AND REPAIR

Equipment of the same level can be combined and upgraded to achieve higher performance.

Old equipment can be restored to its original performance through repair.

MEDICINE

Medicine can restore HP, but wounds can only heal slowly over time.

MORE RULE OPTIONS

Shooting accuracy decreases at night? Food spoils over time? Gunshots attract zombies? You can customize even more rule options.

Are you ready to embark on this apocalyptic journey?

4539590.name: Wax Rogue
4539590.about_the_game:
Gameplay

Wax Rogue is a game that blends roguelike elements with building mechanics. You must construct a tower that allows you to travel back and forth between resources in the sky and the wax furnace on the ground as quickly as possible.

Candle Life

The candle burns, and its light will eventually go out with you. Build fast, move fast, and don't waste a single second. Feel the constant tension and adrenaline rush of recharging your candle in your last second of life.

Every Game is Unique

Unlock new buildings. Craft custom equipment that can unleash powerful combos. Use the anvil to increase your building speed and place speed potions faster! Also, improve your stats to create a unique character suited to the situation. Each upgrade is random and might just lead you to the jackpot.

Progression

Between games, use your ghost to upgrade the candles' permanent abilities and help them achieve their goal of eternal life. Choose upgrades based on your play style. Make strategic choices that will make you better with each new game.

World

You play as a living candle dedicated to finding the secret of immortality. In this world, candles are tired of only living for the time it takes for a wick to burn; they want eternal life.

Characters

Between games, chat with the game's various characters. Discover colorful characters and delve into the story to uncover the origins of this fear of death. Enjoy reading short but impactful dialogues with powerful messages on a topic that affects us all.

Visuals

Experience Wax Rogue in minimalist retro pixel art visuals. To discern the medieval fantasy universe through a few cleverly placed pixels, allowing you to feel the simultaneously gloomy and amusing atmosphere of this small world.

4539630.name: Sorry, My King
4539630.about_the_game:
You owe the crown 5000 gold. You have 7 days.

Knight Kairen returned alone from a doomed expedition. The king calls it negligence. The punishment: an "atonement tithe." Gather 5000 gold in 7 days or lose your name, your title, and your freedom.

The lands beyond Valenford are dangerous. The forests hide predators. The villages hide worse. The graveyards never stay quiet. And somewhere beneath it all, something called the Summit is watching.

Explore. Fight. Decide.

  • Procedural maps — Every location is generated fresh. Forests, villages, graveyards. Each biome has its own enemies, NPCs, and secrets. No two runs are the same.

  • Card-based combat — Guess higher or lower. Simple to learn, deep to master. Each enemy has unique attack patterns, minigames, and abilities that change how you fight.

  • Time is your true enemy — A real-time countdown runs during exploration. Every step, every shop visit, every detour costs seconds you cannot recover.

  • 18 enemies — Each with a unique map behavior and battle mechanic. Goblins throw bombs. Ghosts phase in and out. The Village Guard is a wall you must break.

  • 9 NPCs — A baker who lost her son. A captain who refused to lead again. A cartographer who maps every body he finds. A nameless knight who paid five times and never left.

  • 40 items — Weapons, armor, artifacts, potions. Every item carries a story. The sword was standard issue for a regiment that no longer exists.

The Casino

A door appears in the wall. It wasn't there a moment ago. Behind it: the Veiled Apex. A gambling hall that costs 1 HP to enter. The odds are fair. That's the cruelest part.

Win gold to shorten your journey. Lose and fall deeper. The Apex watches with a single unblinking eye. It does not cheat. It does not need to.

The Truth

Notes scattered across the land tell a different story than the one the king told you. The debt may not be yours. The system may be older than the crown. And the reason no debtor dies in these lands has nothing to do with mercy.

How much you discover depends on how you play. Rush to the exit and you'll pay your debt in ignorance. Explore every corner and the world reveals itself. 8 endings await, shaped by your choices, your knowledge, and your gold.

Made for short sessions, built for deep runs

  • Runs last 30-90 minutes

  • 7 in-game days, each with a unique scripted location and procedural maps

  • Bestiary that unlocks enemy lore through combat

  • Hidden notes with layered narrative

  • Dungeon synth + chiptune soundtrack

  • 1-bit pixel art aesthetic inspired by early Game Boy

  • 5 languages: English, Russian, German, Spanish, French

Turn your Steam Deck into a Mini AirHockey table for 2. Organize your own local tournament up to 8 players with full brackets and instructions who needs to play who at what time! Based on an idea that someone pitched for Better With A Firend, but I cannot find the comment anywhere...

Features

  • Quickplay mode to dive into a match right away

  • Tournament mode where you can set the amount of players, up to 8, and follow the instructions to have your own local tournament among friends. It will generate a bracket and tell you who should play who. No online play planned.

  • Original soundtrack

4539710.name: Train 404
4539710.about_the_game:
Train 404 is a first-person co-op survival horror experience. Players are trapped in a procedural labyrinth, your survival depends on a single, grim objective: secure your passage home before the train leaves you behind.

THE MISSION

The rules of the 404 are simple, but the execution is lethal. To escape the maze, you must navigate the shadows to:

  • Collect enough coins throughout the map and deposit them in the Ticketing Machine.

  • Secure the Golden Ticket that spawns randomly in the map once enough coins have been deposited to the Ticketing Machine.

  • Sprint & Evade the relentless entities and race back to the station before the departure time.

COOPERATION BY CHOICE

In this dimension, your peers are your greatest asset or your most unpredictable liability. The social dynamic of teamwork is entirely optional.

Common strategies include:

  • The Tactical Squad: Form a tight knit crew to move together, share resources and provide mutual defense. There is safety in numbers, if a teammate falls, the survivors can recover their coins to keep the mission alive.

  • The Lone Wolf: Abandon the group to prioritize your own progression. Move with unmatched speed and claim all upgrades for yourself. But be warned: if you succumb to the monsters, your body and your loot may never be found.

STRIKING THE MATCH

Reaching the Train provides you safety from the monsters out there. However, safety is not certainty. The Train's engine is cold and you must manually engage the Train's temperamental power console. Once the Train is powered up, the Train leaves immediately, leaving any players that are not in the Train behind.

PROCEDURAL SURVIVAL

No two descents into the 404 are the same. With a procedurally generated layout, every run demands fresh navigation and quick thinking. Whether you choose to prioritize the collective survival of your team or your own individual escape, the dimension remains indifferent.

4539810.name: Almazuela Picross
4539810.about_the_game: Almazuela Picross is a Picross game where you'll solve puzzles using clues in each row and column. You can mark or discard cells using the buttons.
4539810.supported_languages: English, French, Spanish - Spain, Catalan, Basque

4539860.name: Reignfall: Fallen Crown
4539860.about_the_game:
Fifty years ago, your dynasty was betrayed. The throne was stolen. Your family was scattered into the dust of history.

Now you have returned. The crown is yours — if you can keep it.

Swipe. Decide. Reign.

Characters appear before you one by one — peasants, generals, priests, merchants, traitors, and allies. Each carries a request, a threat, or a secret. Swipe left or right. There is no neutral ground. Every card advances your kingdom by one year.

Your goal: survive until the year 2000.

Four Forces Stand Between You and Ruin

Your People, Army, Church, and Economy are always watching. Let any one collapse — or spiral out of control — and your reign ends. Each card carries a rank and a suit — the rank determines how hard a decision hits the parameter it represents. A King-ranked card hits thirteen times harder than a 2. Every number means something. Every symbol tells you where it hurts.

In times of war, famine, or epidemic, the stakes rise even further. Survive a plague. Hold the line against invasion. Make it through a famine without losing your people's trust. Each crisis is a test — and each one you survive can earn you a title.

Your Path is Never Fixed

Every decision carries moral weight. Over time, your choices build toward the Path of Virtue or the Path of Corruption — each with its own skill tree, its own powers, and its own cost. Rule with justice and earn the trust of your people. Rule with cruelty and command through fear.

But no path is permanent. You can turn back at any time. Four hundred years of tyranny can give way to mercy — slowly, the darkness recedes, old powers lock away, and new ones open. Two paths, always in motion. The king you are today is not the king you have to be tomorrow.

The King's Road

Every seven runs, the King's Road shop opens. Spend your influence points on Skill Cards, Power Cards, Ancient Cards, and the rare Sigil of Sacrifice — obtainable only through making true sacrifices. Certain card combinations unlock powerful synergy bonuses. Unlock new cards permanently as your dynasty grows — each death adds to your collection, each run builds toward something greater.

Death is not the end. It is progression.

Spin the Wheel of Kings

When a king falls, a new one rises. But the Wheel of Kings doesn't always land where you expect.

Rule as a dyslexic king whose letters rearrange themselves across every scroll and decree. Lead as an amputee whose generals quietly question your authority. Command as a mad king whose will bleeds into every decision — where control itself becomes uncertain. Every king type changes how you see the throne, how you read the world, and how you survive.

A Dynasty That Remembers

Earn titles through your deeds — survive a war, end an epidemic, shape the outcome of a historical turning point. In 1453, you may find yourself at the gates of Constantinople. The choice is yours: act, or let history pass without you. What you do — and what you don't — defines the titles you carry and the keepsakes you unlock.

Keepsakes grow stronger with each run. Your dynasty chronicle fills with every king you played, every crisis you weathered, every betrayal you survived.

This is not just one king's story. It is the story of a bloodline.

Features

  • Dark fantasy roguelite card game with deep branching narrative and historical events

  • Dual moral skill tree — Path of Virtue and Path of Corruption, always unlockable, always reversible

  • 13-rank card system where rank directly determines the impact multiplier on your kingdom's parameters

  • Four kingdom states — peace, war, famine, and epidemic — each triggering unique cards and crises

  • The Wheel of Kings — king types with physical and cognitive traits that dynamically alter UI, audio, and gameplay

  • King's Road shop with Skill Cards, Power Cards, Ancient Cards, Sigil of Sacrifice, and synergy bonuses

  • Title and keepsake system tied to historical events, crisis survival, and run achievements

  • Adaptive difficulty with checkpoint system across three difficulty modes

  • Survive from the ashes of a fallen throne to the year 2000
4539860.supported_languages: Turkish, English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Russian

4539870.name: Khaldun: Text Based Strategy
4539870.about_the_game:
What are a ruler’s duties? Managing wars? Meddling in the intrigues among advisors? Deciding production in villages and cities? In this game, you can do all of that and much, much more. Inspired by the work of the great historian Ibn Khaldun, who is regarded as the founder of sociology, this game will teach you how the course of history unfolds.

Let us take a look at some of the game’s core mechanics:

Whether you are raiding a village, laying siege to a city, or engaging an enemy state in open battle, the sword rules all. But without tactical planning, all of it is meaningless! Watch the battle unfold in real time (yes, in ASCII graphics), where terrain, morale, army composition, and tactical decisions can decide whether your army returns victorious or vanishes into history.

Just like in real life, you can talk with your commanders and advisors about state affairs, but remember: every conversation affects your relationship with them. Be careful not to earn their hatred, or they may start plotting behind your back!

The game’s most unique mechanic. You have never seen anything like it in another strategy game, yet in real life it surrounds you at every moment, even if you do not realize it. Asabiyyah is a key concept in Ibn Khaldun’s theory of history and will affect many aspects of your kingdom.

As prosperity rises, luxury increases, but asabiyyah declines; and an empire with weak asabiyyah is destined to collapse.

-Ibn Khaldun

Villages are responsible for food and raw material production, while cities produce specialty goods and art. Reckless conquest can lead you into chaos, because every region has its own area of specialization. You must prepare a conquest plan that suits your strategy.

Khaldun is a very detailed strategy-management game. Even if you do not notice it, the systems behind the game change according to your decisions. There are many more features in the game that I cannot describe here. I tried to create the most realistic experience possible for players, and I hope you enjoy it.

4539900.name: Boobie Impact
4539900.about_the_game:
A short adult visual novel / dating sim about an absurd yet intimate fantasy daily life between a young man and his four-breasted girlfriend, with dialogue and interactions adapted from the author's real-life experiences with his partner. What begins as ordinary couple life gradually turns strange, as the protagonist slips into bizarre erotic dreams, surreal fantasies, and increasingly unusual scenarios involving his girlfriend.

  • Surreal dream scenes and unusual erotic scenarios

  • A bizarre heroine with a distinctive four-breast character design

  • Designed for players who enjoy weird, playful, adult visual novels

4539910.name: PhotoBricks
4539910.about_the_game:
Discover, relax, create.

PhotoBricks is an interactive digital gallery featuring curated photographs from around the world and letting you add your own. While all of these can be viewed in Gallery mode we built this so you can clear the bricks away and reveal the photographs for yourself.

A sanctuary from stress

Clearing bricks is a zen-like experience with a soothing soundscape designed to help you relax as you enjoy the calm gameplay. No twitch reflexes required, this is a game for everybody, although for those who want it, multiple challenge settings allow the difficulty to be significantly increased. For the rest of us this is a gentle game of discovery and relaxation, offering 100 beautiful and interesting photographs to reveal.

Hours of content

Beyond the photography the game includes plenty of content alongside, and as a different way for you to enjoy its tactile meditative gameplay.

A 119 level campaign is built in, with most of the levels taking 2-5 minutes to complete; around 7 hours for a first pass through the full campaign but with the challenge settings changing how they play there's plenty of replayability even if you don't find yourself trying to beat your best time or highest score.

If that's not enough, an Infinite mode offers near limitless procedurally generated playfields for those 5 minute breaks from work when you want to relax. Bookmark and share your favourite random seeds, and compare your score and time against others on the daily seed.

Be creative and make it personal

If you'd rather interact with your own photos, just drop them into a folder and tell the game where to find them.

This lets you engage by slowly revealing them from behind a wall of procedurally generated bricks. After you've done that?

 

Export your photograph with a custom reveal based on how you revealed it, as an 8 second video you can share and post online. This is directly generated within the game:

Babysitter mode

It turns out children love watching the Idle mode, even though we put that in for adults. But it's more fun to engage with the game: The development team kept getting distracted from creating and testing the game because they found themselves caught by 'just complete this level.. ok, just one more'.

PhotoBricks is a quietly compelling game you'll keep returning to.
4539910.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese

4539930.name: Cooking Survivor
4539930.about_the_game:
Survive

In Cooking Survivor, you must battle hordes of hungry customers, create the meals they want, and serve them within the time limit to keep them happy.

Will you survive the entire shift, or will you disappoint your customers?

Get stronger

Learn, improve, and win:

You’ll lose, but don’t worry, defeats give you the chance to get stronger!

Rise up with your new powers, get them by passing levels and unlock new abilities by getting achievements!

Every round is different, discover combinations and synergies that will help you complete your shift!

Multiple worlds available

Multiple levels, guaranteed replayability:

Explore the worlds of Cooking Survivor, meet new customers, and battle bosses!

Each level has its own mechanics, will you be able to conquer them all?

4539950.name: Unanswered
4539950.about_the_game:
This base game includes Act 1 of the UNANSWERED story. Subsequent acts will be released as DLC in the future.

Delve into the Darkness

UNANSWERED is a first-person psychological horror experience where observation and resource management are your only way out. Trapped in an environment that distorts your memories, you must explore every corner looking for vital tools to progress. Use a flashlight to pierce the darkness of the hallways, and switch to your UV flashlight to reveal invisible clues, hidden trails, and messages that the human eye cannot perceive on its own.

Master Your Fear

Every step in this nightmare demands composure. The house and its corners hide blocked routes that you can only open by solving puzzles, tracking down forgotten keys, or manipulating fuse boxes to bring light back to dead zones. Sometimes you will have to force your way through, tearing off planks and overcoming obstacles under a suffocating pressure where your precision will be vital. Measure your steps, control your nerves, and avoid running desperately, or constant stress will cloud your ability to survive, leaving you at the mercy of whatever waits in the shadows.

Survive the Limbo

You are not alone. Terrifying entities lurk in the shadows, and they will not hesitate to hunt you down if you expose yourself too much. In UNANSWERED, death drags you to Limbo, a dark and flooded dimension. To regain consciousness at your last save point, you must navigate this purgatory and find the light before it is too late.

4539970.name: The Show Goes On
4539970.about_the_game:
The Show Goes On is an atmospheric psychological horror game with puzzle and exploration elements.

You find yourself in a closed space where every room is a new challenge. Doors are locked, mechanisms are broken, and the environment feels… wrong. To escape, you must carefully explore your surroundings, find solutions, and keep moving forward despite the growing tension.

You are not here by accident. Buried in debt, you decided to make some easy money and signed a contract to take part in a questionable, illegal show. It seemed like a simple way out at the time. Now it feels like a trap you can’t easily escape.

Sometimes you will hear a voice.
The Observer. The Host.

But it doesn’t always help.

Features

Puzzles and interaction
Explore the environment, find items, and solve mechanical tasks to progress.

Psychological tension
No constant jumpscares — fear is created through atmosphere, sound, and anticipation.

Dark locations
Narrow corridors, abandoned rooms, and strange scenes that raise more questions than answers.

Unpredictable moments
The environment may change, and some things are not what they seem.

4540010.name: Business Defence
4540010.about_the_game:
Meet BBB (Bachgen Business Boy), a CEO so out of touch he thinks handing out coupons and making vague promises about sustainability will solve all his problems. Spoiler: it won't. Protestors are marching on BBB's headquarters, and it's up to you to defend it using the only tools BBB knows:- BUSINESS THEMED TOWERS.

Business Defence is a tower defence game where your arsenal is built entirely from corporate gizmos. Deploy the Coupon Cannon to chip away at the crowd, call in the Sustainability Sniper to target those idealistic youngsters with some greenwashing, or let the Marketing Mortar get the message out there. You'll need more than good intentions to keep the protestors at bay across small, medium and large maps.

But who are these protestors, and what do they actually want? As you progress through BBB's journey, the lines between villain and hero get blurry... Actually no, it's pretty clear that BBB is not the good guy here and no PR team is fixing that. But maybe, just maybe, the protestors will show BBB how to turn over a new leaf.

Business Defence is an original tower defence game brought to you by Bachgen Business Boy. Yes we have gone heavy with the self insert. Featuring an original soundtrack composed by Welsh musician A. Blank, you can listen mid-level or browse the full soundtrack at your leisure using the main menu's built-in music player.

Designed for casual players with mouse and touchpad controls, Business Defence automatically adjusts its visuals to suit your hardware and aims for a steady 60FPS. Whilst not solely an educational game, Business Defence does encourage players to think conscientiously about business decisions and why the people outside the boardroom matter too.

4540020.name: IRON-PLUNDER
4540020.about_the_game:
THE PLUNDER AWAITS!

Ambient Noise needs comic books, and the Mecha-Skull shrines of the Machine-Faith can be traded for comics!

Assault their constantly shifting stronghold by way of action-packed arcade twin-stick shooting,

Crush your foes and get the IRON-PLUNDER (That being comics).

GAME FEATURES:

  • Fast paced twin-stick shooting.

  • Diorama-like isometric 3D perspective.

  • Battle a wide variety of enemy robots - including the fierce Robot Crab!

  • Navigate striking industrial sci-fi megastructures.

  • Fully supports both Gamepad and Keyboard/Mouse controls.

4540040.name: Soul General
4540040.about_the_game:
Game Background

Three thousand years ago, the living beings of the world first tasted the method of spiritual energy cultivation. Both demons and humans could cultivate for a hundred years to transform into spirits. A human woman, with a hundred years of cultivation, transcended beyond the two realms. Over the next three hundred years, she guided some of the human race to cultivate this method, thereby laying the foundation for humanity. Thus, the human race, the demon race, and the spirit race entered a hundred-year war, known in history as the 'Lingwo Rebellion'. Players will take on the role of human warriors defending their homeland against foreign invaders, leading their armies to reclaim lost lands and restore peace to the world.

The game is an ancient-style musou roguelike action game. Players will lead a powerful allied squad to charge into enemy lines and resist invasion. As players progress, more mysterious events and ultimate challenges will be unveiled.

Battlefield Confrontation

In each playthrough, players lead their squad to challenge hordes of enemies, obtain random rewards per run, and find a powerful combination to achieve victory. Recruit more troops; you can choose to strengthen yourself or enhance your army, letting them charge into battle for glory.

Diverse Combinations

The game features various build combinations. Players can choose their preferred combination to clear the game, gaining abundant combat skills and resources in each challenge. These resources can be used back at the base to permanently enhance specific attributes, making players stronger and the experience more enjoyable with each battle.

Strengthen Your Squad
