4540150.name: GridFall: Nine-Grid
4540150.about_the_game:
8 characters, 8 completely different build ideas

  • ROBO: Extremely focus on the first 5 upgrades to gain passive stats, at the cost of delaying active skill unlocks.

  • LUNA: Repeatedly clicking the same cell type grants stat bonuses, but cells of that type can never form a line of three to unlock active skills.

  • RUFF: Balance means you can unlock more active skills, but RUFF provides numerical compensation for extreme min-maxing.

  • BRUIN: A smooth character – unlocking active skills at a normal pace grants small rewards.

  • CLAWDIA: No one would pick the same cell twice in a row, except CLAWDIA.

  • FENNEL: Focus on overall topological beauty – gain huge bonuses through central symmetry.

  • LAPIN: Under specific topological conditions, stat-less cells can still grant stat bonuses.

  • BAMBOO: And our favorite simple and straightforward Panda.

Gold corners, silver edges, grass belly

An indie game that combines a nine-square grid design on the foundation of a survivors-like. The developer hopes to incorporate a construction with mathematical beauty.

Each time the player levels up, a nine-square grid panel appears with three random cells, from which the player must choose one to upgrade. Only by completing a horizontal, vertical, or diagonal line of three can the player unlock an active skill.

It is easy to see that if you have the chance to choose the center cell (position 5), the probability of forming a horizontal, vertical, or diagonal line of three is the highest. Corner cells (1,3,7,9) come next, and edge cells (2,4,6,8) are the lowest.

To balance this resource conflict caused by topology itself, the developer gives different passive traits to different cells. Simply put, if you want a higher probability to quickly form a skill, choosing the center cell (position 5) will likely come with some numerical loss. If you are willing to choose edge cells (2,4,6,8), you will have a lower chance of forming a line of three in the short term, but you will receive some numerical compensation.

How can you win without being greedy?

Besides trying to form a line of three as soon as possible, you should also know that in the first five upgrades, the numerical rewards given by edge cells (2,4,6,8) are far greater than those in the mid and late game. If you want to survive for 5 minutes at high difficulty, take the risk and go for edge cells (2,4,6,8). Even if the price you pay is failing to form a line of three and being about to die!

The ultra-fast pace of 5 minutes per round – let your choices decide your survival!

Every failed bypass or aggressive command generates Heat. If your Heat reaches 100%, your IP is logged and the connection is fried. But your story doesn't end there.

When the Feds close in, you face a Final Stand:

Outrun the Trace: Test your endurance in a rapid-fire tapping mini-game to stay one step ahead of the law.

The Bribe: Pay off the right people with your hard-earned credits to make the Heat disappear.

Accept Fate: End the game on your own terms, or fail the escape and watch your entire save file be permanently wiped from the terminal.

Key Features

Analog Authenticity: Stunningly rendered CRT visuals with procedural scanlines, phosphor glares, and reactive glitch effects that intensify as your Heat rises.

High-Stakes Escape: A unique "Last Chance" mechanic that turns a failed hack into a frantic physical scramble for survival.

Persistent Evolution: Auto-saving progression keeps your career on the line. Every credit earned and every server formatted counts toward your global ranking.

Are you in, or are you just another log in the system?

4541050.name: Project Ark
4541050.about_the_game:
In Project Ark, the land has become uninhabitable after the apocalypse. The sea has become the only habitable place. The crew of your ship encounters a group of survivors fleeing an alien invasion. It becomes clear that these "guests" can't swim. Rebuild your ship into a floating city. Create all the conditions for human survival.

The player will have access to the following mechanics:

  • construction and destruction of ship blocks;

  • resource production and processing;

  • resource gathering;

  • technology research;

  • farming;

  • floating city management;

  • traveling across the world map;

  • interacting with other survivors (rescue, befriend, or antagonize – it's YOUR choice).

Build, produce, and collect resources, research technologies, take care of your health, and rescue survivors!
4541050.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Bulgarian, Spanish - Latin America, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Ukrainian

4541130.name: Div Zero
4541130.about_the_game:
About This Game

A fracture in the fabric of dimensions has torn apart what should never have been separated, leaving behind unstable spaces, impossible transitions, and a mystery buried beneath the surface of reality itself.

Div Zero is a single-player VR puzzle adventure built around exploration, atmosphere, and spatial interaction. Walk through fractured worlds transformed by the rift, where each environment holds clues, each puzzle reveals a deeper layer, and every discovery pulls you further into the collapse.

Explore places warped by dimensional instability. Solve environmental puzzles through observation, movement, and interaction. Follow signals, symbols, and strange objects to uncover what happened, why the worlds are bleeding together, and what waits at the center of it all.

The world does not simply tell its story. It surrounds you with it.

What's Included

Div Zero contains 10 distinct scenes, each a self-contained environment with its own atmosphere, puzzle mechanics, and narrative thread. The experience is designed as a single-player VR adventure built entirely around exploration, environmental puzzles, and discovery.

Features

  • 10 handcrafted scenes across fractured dimensional spaces

  • Environmental puzzle-solving built around observation and spatial interaction

  • High-fidelity environments with real-time PBR rendering

  • Custom shader effects powering dimensional rifts and environmental glitches

  • Dynamic foveated rendering support on compatible XR headsets

  • Comfort-first movement system designed to reduce motion discomfort

  • Supports hand tracking and VR motion controllers

4541170.name: Retro Pond
4541170.about_the_game:
Design your dream pond, breed fish into endless unique variations, discover rare mutations, share them with friends or let them compete in contests.

Features

  • Start with 24 real-world fish, breed and combine them freely into endless variations.

  • Discover 100+ rare mutations and ability cards to personalize your fish

  • Chat with your fish — each one responds with its own unique personality, listen what they have to say about your pond.

  • Share your creations — export fish as QR coded image trading cards and send them to your friends to use in their own ponds.​

  • Collect ability cards and use them to compete in contests against other breeders.

  • Design your pond using 100+ decorations across 3 unique themes

    This game is DRM-Free, fully portable and does not connect to the internet.

    Streamers: Streaming this game and monetizing said streams is allowed and does not need further permission.

4541190.name: Seas of Static
4541190.about_the_game:
Welcome aboard, Admiral.

A world choked by the fallout of a decades-long nuclear conflict continues to act out the motions of this war whose onset is remembered by none. As economies collapse and supplies falter, nations recommission relics of old wars. You captain the Dreadnought, an ancient warship retrofitted with a nuclear reactor. Serving as the long arm of the Empire’s navy, you hunt, battle, and vanquish your nation’s enemies. It is not your duty to question these orders, it is your duty to act.

Venture into the Seas of Static

Once known as the Pacific Ocean, the Seas of Static are now a marine graveyard. Fallout permeates their deepest reaches, erasing all traces of the flora and fauna of old. Now, steel behemoths prowl these silent waves, still fighting the same war that brought the seas to ruin.

Command your Fleet

Command your fleet from the Dreadnought’s bridge. Storms of highly concentrated fallout disrupt all forms of digital and analog communication. Use an extensive suite of combat, reconnaissance, and utility tools to pinpoint the position of vessels on the battlefield and strike when you are confident. Manage your resources carefully. Supplies are thin across the seas as few vessels are capable of braving the fallout to restock your stores. Victory is your goal, above all. Allied losses are inevitable, but sacrifices must be made. Do not let their lives weigh on you. They would willingly give them again in service of the Empire.

Expand your Arsenal

Expand the capabilities of the Dreadnought over the course of the story. Install powerful new tools to help tackle all manner of threats you may encounter at sea.

Do not Falter

The title of Admiral is a great honor, but it has been known to weigh on those who don it. The Empire assures you that radiation within the bridges of all commissioned warships is well below hazardous levels, however, should you begin experiencing auditory/visual hallucinations while stationed, do not panic. Simply recite the empire's core tenets, Stability, Prosperity, Victory, until hallucinations have subsided.

##1#%$5Re3eivingBr0adc@st&&#2*%1

Code Delta Romeo. This is research vessel A15BT,  requesting emergency asylum. We have just made a scientific breakthrough that could eliminate up to 98.765% of nuclear particulates from the atmosphere. The Empire wishes to exploit our research solely for military gain. We refuse to let our work fall into the hands of warmongers. Please, to anyone receiving this, h-MESSAGE TERMINATED

4541270.name: Cards Of Calling
4541270.about_the_game:
Command your creatures. Build your strategy. Survive the unknown.

Cards of Calling is a roguelike deckbuilder where you don’t fight alone — you summon and command a pack of creatures to battle for you.

Build your deck, grow your army, and adapt your strategy as every run presents new challenges.

🐺 Lead Your Pack

Summon creatures to the battlefield and fight alongside them.
Each minion has its own role — from aggressive attackers to defensive protectors — and your strength depends on how you use them together.

🃏 Build Around Synergy

Your cards don’t just deal damage — they interact with your creatures.
Gain powerful bonuses when minions are present, sacrifice them for massive effects, or create unstoppable combinations.

⚔️ Tactical Turn-Based Combat

Face dangerous enemies with unique behaviors and intents.
Plan your turns carefully, manage your energy, and decide when to attack, defend, or empower your army.

🗺️ Explore a Living World

Travel through a 3D overworld filled with:

  • Elite encounters

  • Shops

  • Mysterious events

Every choice matters — risk and reward shape your journey.

🔁 Replayable Runs

No two runs are the same.
Discover new cards, build different strategies, and refine your playstyle with every attempt.

Will you master the bond between summoner and beast… or fall with your army?

4541300.name: Your Friend, Sam
4541300.about_the_game:
What happened to Sam? That is the question that you must answer in this fantasy exploration game as you navigate Ridgemont Forest in search of anything that can tell you what happened to your long-lost friend. 

You lived in Ridgemont decades ago, and when a mysterious letter from your best friend who went missing appears at your doorstep it is your job to connect the dots and figure out where he went.

Solve puzzles by collecting clues and defend against the corrupted creatures of the forest on your quest to figure out what happened to Sam all those years ago.

  • Collect clues to connect the pieces of the story of where Sam went

  • Solve puzzles to progress with each puzzle bringing you one step closer to an answer

  • Battle corruption wherever it may appear and free the spirits of the forest

  • Find out what happened to: Your Friend, Sam

4541310.name: Flirt Simulator
4541310.about_the_game:
Forget Pre-written Options. Write Your Story with Your Own Words. Flirt Simulator is a first-person (FPS), AI-driven life and dating simulation. It completely eliminates traditional dialogue trees and pre-written texts, offering a dynamic world where you communicate with characters in the city using your own words.

Communication Without Limits You are no longer forced to choose from on-screen dialogue prompts. Say whatever you want to the characters you meet, or text them freely from your in-game smartphone. Thanks to advanced AI, every character responds to you in a completely natural, real-time, and context-aware manner. You can flirt with anyone, any way you like.

Advanced NPC Memory and Dynamic Relationships The characters in this city are not just lines of code. Each has their own personality, distinct tastes, and, most importantly, a memory. They remember what you say, the gifts you give, and how you treat them. A character's Love, Desire, and Trust levels towards you evolve organically based entirely on your words and actions.

Life and Character Management To build successful relationships, you must first manage your own life. Take care of your basic needs and work to earn money. Use your hard-earned cash to invest in yourself. Hit the gym to increase your "Muscle" and "Handsomeness" stats. Buy new clothes to boost your "Charisma." The stronger your profile, the better your chances of making a lasting impression.
4541310.supported_languages: English, Turkish, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Dutch, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Bulgarian, Danish, Indonesian, Finnish, Polish, Norwegian, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Greek

4541320.name: Florence Mirror
4541320.about_the_game:
Florence Mirror is a dark fantasy Action RPG set in a modern-day Florence on the brink of collapse. Beneath its historic beauty lies a hidden mirror dimension, an ancient reflection where humanity’s sins and fears have taken monstrous form.

You play as Leonardo Tornabuoni, the last descendant of a forgotten noble bloodline sworn to protect the seal between worlds. As the barrier weakens and creatures begin to spill into reality, you must reclaim your family’s lost power, confront the echoes of history, and restore balance before both realms are consumed.

Engage in intense, skill-based combat against over 30 unique bosses, each representing twisted aspects of human nature and society. Explore a city where past and present intertwine, encountering legendary historical figures and uncovering a deep, lore-rich narrative inspired by real events and hidden histories.

Choose your path:

  • The Blessed Path – a more accessible, story-driven experience

  • The Cursed Path – a brutal Souls-like mode demanding precision, mastery, and resilience

Master arcane abilities, adapt your combat style, and survive in a world where every reflection could be a gateway to something far more dangerous.

  • Dark fantasy Action RPG with optional Souls-like difficulty

  • 30+ challenging bosses across main story, dungeons, and side missions

  • A unique setting blending modern Florence with a supernatural mirror dimension

  • Story-rich experience inspired by real historical figures and events

  • Deep combat system focused on timing, positioning, and skill

The mirror is breaking. What waits on the other side is already watching.

4541350.name: Fraga
4541350.about_the_game:
A pilgrimage that wasn't on any map.

You're lost in the Fraga. Alone, with no help, something is watching you from deep within the forest. Survive in this turn-based combat game where every move counts.

JUST YOU, THE ADVENTURE AS A PILGRIM

Forget about relying on help, there are no friends or companions: it’s just you on this journey.

You’ll face countless dangers that the Fraga will throw at you. Decide every move in this turn-based tactical combat game, where every decision is crucial.

EVERY GAME IS UNIQUE

Explore procedurally generated boards, filled with events, items, and choices that will shape every playthrough.

Will you take the risk to claim all the rewards… or will you flee before what’s chasing you catches up?

ADAPT, SURVIVE, OVERCOME

Upgrade your pilgrim, equip yourself with items that change your playstyle, and create synergies to survive.

Master the system and face bosses where you’ll have to put everything you’ve learned to the test.

THE PATH HIDES MORE THAN YOU THINK

La Fraga isn’t just hostile—it also hides secrets.

Discover what has happened, trade with the Buhonero, and unravel the story hidden deep within the forest.
4541350.supported_languages:
English*, Spanish - Spain*, Galician*
*languages with full audio support

4541390.name: That's An Order Ensign
4541390.about_the_game:
As a new recruit you've got a lot of tasks to complete - from the mundane to the deathly dangerous and everything in between. Perform admirably, and quickly, or you may be walking the proverbial (possibly literal) plank!

As the newest Red Shirt to join the crew you must navigate each of the orders you're assigned. If you complete your tasks on time AND make it out alive, there my be a promotion in the future for you! However, failing a mission will look bad on your record. Fail too many and you're dismissed!

Try to stay alive, but do your job. 
Because after all... That's an order, ensign!

FEATURES

Super Fast Gameplay

Complete a slew of bite sized missions in quick succession.

Think on your feet, you're either on the clock or on borrowed time!

The Simplest Controls

Move, scan, sometimes even shoot your way around each environment... or don't! 
Sometimes doing nothing is the way to go!

Randomized Career
You may encounter new challenges on each playthrough, Not every career is the same!

4541400.name: Dustwalker
4541400.about_the_game:
Dustwalker is a sci-fi side-scrolling survival runner where you pilot a rover across a hostile alien world that gets more dangerous the farther you travel.

Drive across rough terrain, leap over rocks and gaps, and use your booster to clear tougher obstacles and keep your momentum. Enemy UFOs patrol the skies above, forcing you to balance movement, timing, and combat while managing limited resources.

The run begins with a basic rover, but you can improve your chances of survival by collecting upgrades and pickups along the way. Find a turret, gather ammo, restore health, activate shields, and make quick decisions as the pace increases and threats begin to stack up.

Features

  • Side-scrolling rover action - Drive, jump, and boost through an endless alien landscape.

  • Real-time combat - Fight hostile UFOs and destroy obstacles with collected weapons.

  • Mid-run progression - Start vulnerable and build your loadout as you survive longer.

  • Resource management - Monitor ammo, health, fuel, and shield energy under constant pressure.

  • Increasing difficulty - Hazards and enemy pressure ramp up the longer each run lasts.

  • Replayable runs - Procedural encounters and pickup timing make every attempt different.

Dustwalker is about pushing forward as long as possible, adapting to what the world throws at you, and seeing how far a single run can go.

4541420.name: Khaos Keys
4541420.about_the_game:
About Khaos Keys

A vertical scrolling rhythm game using the whole entire keyboard, mimicking a piano-like or touch-based instrument! Players move their hands over the full range of keys, striking notes to the rhythm. It’s genuinely a hand-crafted experience with an original soundtrack! In more extreme difficulties, players wear gloves to reduce the friction on their fingers against the keys, hitting chains of multiple notes by sliding. Some of the levels also contain moments where the camera’s viewport will focus on different parts of the area, creating for intense yet immersive gameplay when synced to the beat. Ultimately, the player’s experience is highly customizable, easy for beginners to learn, yet hard for professionals to master. Can you keep up with this intense style of play?

Content and Features

  • Vertical Scrolling Rhythm Game!

  • The keyboard is your life’s instrument!

  • Original musical soundtrack!

  • Stunning 3D user interface and animations!

  • Multi-region keyboard layout support for >60% form factors!

  • The camera's position and rotation can change!

  • Customizable to the player’s preference!

  • Easy for beginners to learn, hard for professionals to complete!

  • Wearing gloves while playing reduces friction!

More Information

  • Normal notes, simply strike those!

  • Hold notes, press and hold, releasing at the end!

  • “Mega” notes, strike your thumb on the spacebar!

  • “Weak” notes, slide your fingers on all of ‘em!

  • “Crucial” notes, strike the key accurately to the rhythm of the music!

  • Difficulties of levels ranging from 1-15 throughout Basic, Advanced, Expert and Master!

  • 6 different types of judgement: MAX, Perfect, Great, Good, Bad, and Miss!

Screenshots of Game
4541420.supported_languages:
English*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support

4541440.name: Spider Lily
4541440.about_the_game:
An Unfamiliar World

Welcome to the Yellow Springs, where a vast wastewater treatment facility processes the dead from a dark, black sea filled with unconscious souls and the things they were buried with. Pumping stations are temples, filtration chambers are trials, and the rivers connecting them carry souls, bound to the water.

You are the Lost Soul. You are Dead.

One soul wakes up. She swims against the tide, and manages to pull free. You are this Lost Soul — a hungry ghost, alone on the shores of the afterlife.

The Blind Fish is the Key

On the shore you encounter a golden fish, its eyes being pecked out by ravens. You fend them off, pick up the fish, and tie a strip of cloth around its wounds. This act of care binds your souls together.

Guide the Fish To Advance

With a drum scavenged from the shore, you must escort this blind fish through a system that exceeds your comprehension. The Blind Fish cannot tell you where to go, but keeping it alive and in water is the key to navigating this unfamiliar place – just be careful not to fall into the water and return to that deep sleep...

Everything Around You Contains a Clue

These unlikely companions embark on a journey to escape death — navigating the vast machinery of the afterlife, befriending the caretakers of this place, and uncovering who they were. The story of their relationship will carry you through an emotional landscape of what lies beyond life: attachment, dependence, and letting go.

4541460.name: A Smithing Game
4541460.about_the_game:
A Smithing Game is a chaotic multiplayer game where you forge weapons and use them to fight up to 3 other players.

Customize your weapon:

Pick a metal, shape it, quench it, and sharpen it to create all sorts of unique weapons.

Each step of the smithing will contribute to how your weapon performs in battle.

Battle other players:

Prove your skills as a bladesmith by wielding your weapon in exciting hand-to-hand combat. Eliminate all other players and try to be the last smith standing.

Style your Smith:

Customize your smith with a wide variety of unique hats, outfits, and facial expressions to ensure you go into combat looking your best.

Features:

  • Play with up to 3 friends or other players online

  • Proximity voice chat

  • Freely design your weapons

  • 4 maps

  • 6 weapon types

  • 8 different ores and ingots

  • Lots of yummy mushrooms!

  • Private and public servers

  • Character customization

4541520.name: Serenity In Surrender
4541520.about_the_game:
Your home is a prison decorated with self-neglect. Beyond your door is a system of liars. You've submitted yourself to a lifetime of floating endlessly and watching opportunities disappear into your past. 

Until you crash into Daisy. 

She's beautiful. Smart. Successful. And suddenly, you've rearranged your world to meet her at the bus stop every morning, hoping she'll take you home as her personal assistant. Your carefully crafted condo of comfort is threatened by the horrors of vulnerability, but maybe, just maybe, you'll realize you've had the ability to write your own future all along. 

What does it mean to trust people again? 

Experience the slow-burn romance between a dedicated introvert and the girl-next-door as they learn to cherish the strength within themselves. 

Falling is love is scary! But, you're determined to win Daisy's heart. Pick the right choices to raise Daisy's affection level, which affects how your love story will end. 

As you spend more time with your beautiful neighbour, you'll learn more about her past and whether you have the heart to support her. Are you in love with a pretty face, or do you desire a deeper connection?

During the story, you can serve Daisy in a cooking minigame! Select the options in the correct order to deliver Daisy a 3 star dish. Or pick whatever you want. Daisy will correct your mistakes, but she'll make fun of you the whole time. Which is what you wanted, right? 

  • Unlock three different endings!

  • Full voice acting (except for the faceless MC)

  • Uncover Daisy's past and support her as she reconnects with family

  • Meet Daisy's wacky, yet amazing friends

  • Earn in-game currency for reading the story to unlock holiday dates with Daisy

4541560.name: Super Scoundrel Solitaire
4541560.about_the_game: Super Scoundrel Solitaire is a traditional solitaire game. It's played with a regular deck of cards, but it has a dungeon theme. Try to reach the last room of the dungeon by defeating monsters, equipping weapons, and drinking health potions. Can you make it to the end?

4541570.name: Hentai Bunny Girl Puzzle
4541570.about_the_game:
Hentai Bunny Girl Puzzle is an 18+ casual puzzle game in which the goal is to unscramble pieces, revealing a completed sexy adult picture.

Each image is broken down into a grid (3x3 by default), and the individual pieces are scrambled.  The player then selects two pieces, which swaps their positions.  Once all pieces are in their correct places, the puzzle is solved, and the player may proceed to the next puzzle.

Puzzles may be completed in any order.  Difficulty can be adjusted, increasing or decreasing the number of rows in each puzzle. Completed puzzles may be re-played or viewed in their completed state.

Gallery included.
4541570.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish

4541580.name: EverDarkly: Beloved
4541580.about_the_game:
EverDarkly: Beloved

Something out there used to be alive. The wreckage remembers.

EverDarkly: Beloved is a top-down 2.5D space shooter roguelite. You are Blaze, a salvager working the dark between the stations. You have a ship, a debt, and a voice in your head named Luna. You will die a lot. You will come back. The Cradle is patient.

Runs that mean something

Drop into procedural belts and ruins. Fight, scavenge, decide when to push and when to leave. Death is not a punishment. It is part of the loop. Every run feeds the next. Every story arc has a shape, and the shape is yours to find.

Loot that rolls

Every weapon you pull is its own thing. Four rarity tiers. Stat ranges that mean a blue you love can outclass a purple you don't. Build the loadout that fits the way you fight, not the way the game thinks you should.

Adrenaline as ammunition

Tear apart the environment. Asteroids, debris, every breakable thing in reach. The chaos charges your adrenaline. Speed. Shield regen. The difference between "barely" and "easily." Combat is not about playing it safe. The game rewards you for making a mess.

The Cradle

A hub at the edge of nowhere. Talk to Harlan, the freighter captain who knows more than he says. (His parrot is named Poly. Do not ask.) Trade at the Bazaar between runs. Spend what you scraped together. Sleep, if sleep is what you can call it.

Luna

Your AI companion. She narrates. She helps. She is good company for a job like this.

Features

  • Top-down 2.5D combat with manual aim and weighty feedback

  • Procedural runs anchored by a hand-built hub

  • Rolled loot with four rarity tiers and stat variance that actually matters

  • Adrenaline-driven combat economy

  • A roster of enemies that hate you in different ways

  • Hand-tuned story arcs, not infinite filler

  • Full controller support via Steam Input

  • Made by Studio Serotina

The dark is patient. The dark is not empty.

4541590.name: Bit
4541590.about_the_game:
In Bit, you play as Bit. A little pixel alone in the void.

Bit has the urge to climb. Why does he want to climb? Find out with him across 10 unique worlds and help him find his purpose.

You will fight bosses, gain unique abilities and ascend through hand-crafted challenges that test your skill and resolve. Each world introduces new mechanics from dashing through galaxies to platforming across shifting terrain.

Features:

  • 10 Unique Worlds  Each with its own theme, music, mechanics, and a boss standing between you and the truth

  • Skill-Based Platforming Tight, responsive controls with a move set that grows as you climb. Master each ability or fall trying

  • Epic Boss Battles  Face towering guardians like Arbiter the Ancient, each with distinct attack patterns and phases

  • Earned Progression No upgrades to buy. No shortcuts. Every checkpoint is proof you earned your place

Steam Deck support right from the start!

Bit is small. The void is vast. But something up there is calling.

Climb.

4541610.name: Ascension: The Infinite Descent
4541610.about_the_game:
The Infinite Descent Awaits

Plunge into the depths of an endless, unforgiving dungeon in Ascension: The Infinite Descent. Your goal is simple: survive and descend as far as possible into the abyss. Make no mistake—you will die, and you will die often. But in this dungeon, death is the engine of your progression. The deeper you manage to push into the darkness, the greater the rewards you reap, accelerating your growth for the inevitable next run.

Tactical Loadout Combat

Your survival relies on a carefully chosen loadout of abilities, not a random deck of cards.

  • Custom Loadouts: Equip up to 3 repeatable action cards at a time, selecting from a growing pool of physical strikes, arcane wards, elemental spells, and monstrous summons.

  • Deep Scaling Math: Your actions don't just do flat damage. Every attack, shield, and status effect scales dynamically based on your eight core attributes.

  • Strategic Turns: Manage your Action Points (AP) and Reaction Delays to outmaneuver the horrors lurking below.

Die, Rebirth, Transcend

Progression is built around a deeply satisfying roguelite loop that rewards your persistence and tactical planning.

  • Rebirth: When you fall, your dungeon progress is calculated into Rebirth EXP. This EXP determines the size of your Attribute Point pool. Spend these points to permanently boost your base stats: Strength, Agility, Intellect, Vitality, Perception, Perseverance, Willpower, and Spirituality.

  • Optional Boss Portals: Every 10th floor harbors a portal leading to a formidable boss. Stepping through is entirely up to you, but if you choose to find and defeat these gatekeepers, you will unlock crucial new content, mechanics, and upgrades.

  • Transcendence: Conquer the very first boss to unlock the Transcendence System. Choosing to Transcend requires a heavy sacrifice—resetting your attributes and dungeon progress completely —but rewards you with points to spend across eight distinct Transcendence Trees, one for each core attribute. Each tree offers unique, playstyle-defining bonuses: unlock exponential physical damage and permanent thorns in the Strength tree , manipulate Action Points and speed with Agility , or empower your monstrous allies through Spirituality.

Key Features:

  • Endless Descent: A procedurally scaling dungeon where the challenge—and the rewards—are infinite.

  • Status Effect Mastery: Apply Magical DoTs like Burn, delay enemy turns with Shock, or drain their Action Points with Stun.

  • High-Risk Fusion Damage: Unleash devastating Fusion attacks. Fusion scales incredibly hard if you invest heavily in both Strength and Intellect, but without proper investment, it will struggle to break through an enemy's combined Physical and Magical defenses.

  • Summoner Builds: Invest in Spirituality to summon Giant Spiders and other allies whose stats scale directly alongside your own.

4541690.name: Disillusion
4541690.about_the_game: Disillusion is a 3D puzzle narrative game that centers around the survivor of a spaceship crash on an alien planet. Wander through caves full of alien creatures and strange plant life, search for your crew — or what remains of them — and repair parts of the destroyed ship to discover the truth behind the crash and send a message home. But a message raises an important question: what story do you tell when the worst has come to pass?

4541800.name: Nothing Remains
4541800.about_the_game:
Nothing Remains is a short hack and slash action experience where you face AI-controlled enemies inside a collapsing simulation.

You play as a lone warrior empowered by a mysterious force of light, exploring sci-fi environments as you try to prevent the world from collapsing.

Gameplay focuses on:

  • Simple and responsive melee combat

  • Light-based attacks and a ranged option

  • Small-scale combat encounters

  • Exploration of a futuristic, atmospheric world

This is a more direct and compact experience, focused on atmosphere and concept rather than complex systems or deep progression.

Nothing Remains was developed by a single creator as their first project.

The world is collapsing.
You are trying to stop it.

4541830.name: DEATH FROM BELOW
4541830.about_the_game:
Aye, the sea’s been restless as of late. Folk say something stirs beneath the waves, something as old as the tides themselves. Me, I don’t pay such tales much mind, but even so, I’d keep that harpoon close at hand. There’s good money to be made... for crews that make it back.

WORK TOGETHER OR SINK ALONE

This is not a solo voyage. Your ship is a complex system that demands coordination. One crew member manages the boiler pressure, another navigates through the fog, while someone else scans the depths for what lurks in the dark. No single player has the full picture.

MASTER A LIVING, STEAM-POWERED SHIP

Your vessel is not a menu, it’s a machine. Every module inside the ship is physical, interactive, and interdependent: open valves to redirect steam, pull levers to operate the crane, and load ammunition by hand. The ship is your greatest tool… and your greatest liability.

AN UNFORGIVING OCEAN

You’ll cross the seas as a trespasser, never as its master. Navigate treacherous waves, avoid hidden hazards, and manage limited resources as you push further into the unknown. Odds may seem dim, but fortune favors the prepared.

WHAT STIRS BELOW

Something moves beneath the surface. Massive leviathans and the cursed shadows of drowned sailors will test your crew at every turn. These aren’t simple fights against bullet-sponge behemots, each encounter demands strategy and coordination: cripple a creature’s movement, blind its senses, expose its weak points. You’ll have to adapt, or be dragged under.

4541850.name: Spermies
4541850.about_the_game:
In Spermies, you take control of a single, determined sperm on a high-stakes race through challenging biological landscapes. Combining precision racing with environmental puzzles, every track demands speed, reflexes, and a bit of luck.

Key Features:

  • Diverse Challenges: Over 25 levels at launch, ranging from high-speed sprints and multi-lap circuits to "survival" gauntlets where one wrong move is the end.

  • Environmental Hazards: Navigate complex obstacles like fluctuating pH levels (acidic traps) and dense Cilia forests that test your movement skills.

  • Unique Control Scheme: Experience a physics-based movement system designed specifically for controllers (keyboard supported) that captures the chaotic fluid-dynamics of the race.

  • The Future is Bright: Launch is just the beginning. With a planned roadmap for new levels and a hidden Easter egg revealing our next project, there’s plenty to discover.

Initial launch of the game Spermies is intended to be released with 25+ levels, with more to come at a later date. 

We are excited for you all to see what we have been working on; And we have included an easter egg to our next game release after this as well! We are very excited to see what you all think of this fun and unique game!

4541880.name: Fenix
4541880.about_the_game:
About This Game:

Fenix is a 3D platformer that brings back the charm of classic 90's exploration-focused games, reimagined with modern mechanics in an open-ended world. 

Play as Fenix the Fox and explore a vibrant forest level filled with secrets, characters, and challenges.  With a focus on freedom and discovery, players can choose their own path through a non-linear world packed with hidden areas and unique landmarks.  With smooth, responsive movement including combinations of jumping, sprinting, and rolling, and a fully controllable 360° camera, every moment will feel fluid and satisfying as you traverse the terrain and uncover everything the world has to offer.

Along your journey, encounter unique NPCs, complete quests like the “Lost Slimes, or "The Ships Crow Nest” and defend yourself using claw and tail attacks against enemies.  Dynamic animations, immersive environments, and unforgettable moments help bring the world of Fenix to life.  With a full save/load system, a background music playlist, and ongoing updates including new content, features, and polish, Fenix delivers a nostalgic yet modern platforming experience.

Your goal is to collect 147 gems scattered across the environment, reaching up to 1000 total points for full completion.  Along the way, you’ll encounter characters, complete quests, and uncover the beginnings of a larger story.

“A massive open-world 3D platformer with free exploration, inspired by Spyro, Banjo-Kazooie, and Gex.”

Key Features: V0.0168 ↓

🌍 Explore a Living World:

  • Open world, non-linear forest environment

  • Discover hidden locations and secrets at your own pace

  • Landmarks including a lighthouse, temples, and a hot air balloon

  • Dynamic environment with animated trees, grass, water, and clouds

💎 Collect & Progress:

  • 7 unique gem types with different values & sound effects

  • 147 total gems to collect 

  • Reach 1000 points for 100% completion 

  • HUD tracking your progress in real-time

🦊 Fluid Movement & Gameplay:

  • Smooth 3D platforming with responsive controls

  • High and low jump mechanics

  • Combinations of sprinting and rolling for faster traversal

  • 360° free-look camera with obstacle avoidance

  • Seamless animation blending for natural movement

⚔️ Combat & Enemies:

  • Tail spin and claw attack abilities

  • Multiple enemy types including spiders, bees, and mushrooms

  • Enemy AI with patrol routes and player detection

  • Combat animations, sound effects, and feedback

🧠 Quests & Characters:

  • Interact with NPCs and uncover world lore

  • Dialogue system with multiple characters

  • “Lost Slimes” quest system with rewards

  • More characters and story content planned

💾 Game Systems:

  • Save & load system with multiple save slots

  • Pause menu with full game control options

  • Title screen with music toggle and navigation

  • Death system with restart game and return to title screen options

🎮 Controls:

  • Movement: W, A, S, D & Arrow Keys on Keyboard  // Left Joystick on Controller

4541890.name: Sneakin Femboy
4541890.about_the_game:

Sneak around F.I.R.E. agents and expose their corrupt nature by using your held items or objects on the map. 4541930.name: Charm Studies
4541930.about_the_game:

the game includes a small tutorial for those who are new to picross, but you won't fail if you make mistakes either. you can still see all of the story regardless of your picross skills.

i hope that all players will be able to relax and enjoy the pleasant vibes!

  • a cozy story you can complete in an afternoon

4542020.name: ThunderTop Legacy
4542020.about_the_game:
Return to ThunderTop and Face the Unknown

You have traveled from a distant realm with a single purpose: to save your home village. ThunderTop, the place where you grew up, is being consumed by hordes of relentless monsters. To free your people, you must embark on a perilous journey through forgotten lands, gathering strength and resources for the ultimate confrontation at the dreaded End Mountain.

Agile and Dynamic Combat

Survival demands sharp reflexes. Master a fast-paced combat system focused on direct action. Seamlessly switch between slashing sword strikes and the precision of the bow and arrow to keep enemies at bay. Master the art of the dodge to avoid lethal attacks and manage your healing items wisely in the heat of battle.

The Final Ascension

At the peak of End Mountain, a floating castle guards the source of all chaos. Face the formidable final boss who distorts this reality and reach the Great Mystic Portal. Victory means more than just saving ThunderTop—it is the resolution of a deep personal mystery.

Key Features:

  • Action-Focused: Fast-paced combat using strategic swordplay, archery, and dodging.

  • Vertical Exploration: Journey from the village floor to castles on floating islands.

  • Logical Progression: Collect resources across the world to unlock access to the final areas.

  • Intriguing Narrative: Discover the secrets behind the invasion and the whereabouts of the protagonist's father.

4542050.name: The Blood Knight: Episode Dawn
4542050.about_the_game:
The Blood Knight: Episode Dawn

Defeat, Devour, and Forge. The Blood Knight is a Turn-Based JRPG inspired by the classics. Guide Zeno Trillion, a boy who can turn objects into something more. Master unique skills and equipment, unleash Zeno's Critical Skills, and lead companions through a journey full of twists and turns.

Tactical and Unpredictable Combat

Explore, Loot and Devourge

Every corner of the world hides a forgotten treasure waiting to be reclaimed, and every battle drops crafting materials to be harvested and Devourged into the best equipment possible.

Story Twists and Companions

Different quests bring different allies and companions on Zeno’s side. Embark on these unique storylines that come along with twists and turns that will change Zeno Trillion’s fate forever.

4542060.name: Evergarden

4542100.name: Zoovivors
4542100.about_the_game:
This is a top-down survivor-like shooter combined with a roguelike card mechanic. Reroll the shop and buy cards, discover and craft powerful new ones, and build your ultimate deck to survive wave after wave of crazy animals!

Main controls: WSAD to move the character. Holding down the left mouse button will accumulate the "power gauge", and releasing it will fire the equipped weapon towards the mouse position. Depending on the degree of charging, your attack will be divided into light attack, medium attack, and heavy attack.

"Vicious" animals will continuously spawn and chase and attack you. Throwing weapons at your enemies to defeat them. Collecting experience points dropped by enemies to level up. Every time you level up, you can enter the shop to buy items to enhance your character. You’ll win when the timer ends.

Items in the shop need to be equipped after purchase to take effect. There are mainly two types: one is weapons that can be directly equipped, and the other is items that provide bonuses to various aspects. Three identical items can be crafted into a higher level of rarity. Some different item combinations can craft very powerful items, which can even change the gameplay.

When enemies are defeated, they will occasionally drop gems. The collected gems can be used to permanently increase the character's talent abilities.

Discover new craft recipes, try different powerful items synergies, and experience the emergent gameplay, the fun is endless!

4542110.name: Full Stacked
4542110.about_the_game:
Every round, the game changes.

Full Stacked is a fast-paced multiplayer FPS where every round you draft powerful cards that warp the rules of combat. Stack explosive rounds with homing bullets. Combine a grappling hook dash with featherfall. Turn your shield into a body-swapping teleporter.

Build Your Loadout, Break the Game

After each round, pick from a hand of cards that permanently modify your abilities for the rest of the match. Simple stat boosts? Sure. But legendary cards let you steer bullets mid-flight, respawn from the dead, or turn your shield into a gravity well that pulls enemies in. Cards stack, cards combo, and the right picks at the right time can turn a losing match into an unstoppable run.

Fast, Fluid Combat

Dash through danger. Raise your shield at the last second. Crouch, slide, and double-jump across different maps. Different weapons each play differently: burst rifles for mid-range pressure, snipers for patient picks, grenade launchers for area denial, and trusty pistol. 

Play Your Way

Jump into Free-For-All or team up in 2v2 matches with up to 4 players. Hosts can tweak everything — wins needed, cards offered per round, map rotation, available weapons, and more. Quick brawls or long strategic series, you set the stakes.

4542120.name: Neurospasm
4542120.about_the_game:
A First Person Roguelike Horde Shooter

Kill hordes of weird fleshy enemies, using lots of weapons, and active abilities that you power up by getting kills

Collect and Stack 80+ Unique items

Each item can change your weapons and bullets, change your stats, add passive abilities, or spawn buddies that help you in some way. And the best part, every item can stack, making them more and more powerful

Ascend through the Pyramid

Travel through 5 layers, all with their own styles, enemies, and unique mechanics

Fully procedular maps

The layers of the pyramid all have a consistent theme, but the layout changes every time you visit them

Upgrade Yourself

Unique Events

Layer Mechanics

Each layer has it's own unique mechanics, that you can learn and use to get stronger

Key Features:

  • 80+ Unique Items to Unbox and Stack

  • Use Up to 6 Weapons at once

  • 5 Unique Stages, that are procedurally generated

  • Lots of fleshy enemies, and bosses to fight

  • Permanent Upgrades, and unlocks

  • Randomised Events, that can shake up runs

  • Unique mechanics for every stage

4542140.name: Duper
4542140.about_the_game:
Duper is a multiplayer social strategy game where 5 players compete in real time to build power, make deals, and come out ahead. Each match is a contest of economics, diplomacy, and betrayal: gather resources, expand your position, negotiate trades, and decide when to cooperate and when to strike.

Every game revolves around reading other players and adapting on the fly. Alliances can help you survive, but they are never permanent. A smart deal, a timely betrayal, or a well-planned attack can completely change the outcome of a match.

Key Features

  • Build troops, tanks, planes, and forts to grow your power and defend your position.

  • Control territory on a shared map by expanding, capturing tiles, and pressuring your opponents.

  • Engage in free-form diplomacy and live in-game chat to influence every decision at the table.

  • Trade keys, coins, blueprints, and more to outmaneuver rivals and shift the balance of power.

  • Form alliances, strike deals, and execute betrayals in real time—no agreement is ever truly safe.

  • Navigate game rounds with bidding, card trading, and battle phases that constantly reshape the game.

4542150.name: Genterra
4542150.about_the_game:
Earth is failing. Genterra Corporation has the means to save what's left of humanity — a rescue rocket built off-world, fueled by the labor of automated factories scattered across four planets. You are the Architect: the corporation's remote operator, working from a terminal on Earth, building the supply chains that will get us out.

You won't set foot on any of these worlds. You'll deploy buildings, route logistics, configure recipes, and scale operations from a console. Each planet has its own resources, challenges, and mechanical identity — what works on the first world won't work on the next. ARIA, your AI advisor, will guide you through each deployment, and report back to the corporation on your progress.

The early game is mining, smelting, and learning the systems. The mid game is research, expansion, and orbital dispatch. The late game is multi-planet logistics, advanced production chains, and finally the launch of the rocket that gets humanity off Earth. Time is short. Quarterly targets are non-negotiable.

Features

  • Cell-Based Factory Logistics — Lay belts tile-by-tile. Stack two lines through belt bridges. Manifold with splitters and mergers.

  • Deep Recipe Chains - Ore → ingots → plates → frames → circuits → rockets. Extractors, smelters, constructors, compounders, and compilers feed a tree that gets stranger and harder the deeper you go.

  • Multi-Planet Progression - Complete one world's foundation protocol, dispatch a research rocket, and unlock the next planet. Each world brings new resources, harder recipes, and a fresh blank canvas (planet 1 only in early access).

  • Research-Gated Tech Tree - Buildings, belt tiers, pipe tiers, and entire categories unlock through a tree you fund with the items your factory produces.

  • Copy, Paste, Stamp - Design one manifold the right way, then duplicate it across the map, bridges, splitters, mergers, and belts included.

  • Power as a Real Constraint - Coal plants smoke, solar arrays accumulate dust, and kilowatt budgets actually bite. Plan your grid or watch the factory idle.

  • Objectives & Deployment Checklists - Always one clear next goal, never a hand-holding tutorial.

  • Per-Building Upgrades - Spend bits to boost extractors, smelters, and assemblers individually. Tune your bottlenecks instead of replacing them.

  • Item Encyclopedia & Production History - Every item you've ever produced is recorded, lifetime totals, recipe graphs, and where each ingredient comes from.

  • Save Anywhere, Branch Anywhere - Multiple named save slots with thumbnails. Autosave. Quicksave with one key.

  • Keyboard-First Workflow - Number-row category and building selection. WASD camera. R to rotate. Box-select with Ctrl. The whole loop is built for hands-on-keyboard play.

Genterra Corporation thanks you in advance for your service. Productivity is mandatory.

4542180.name: Wanfeng Lake In GuiZhou
4542180.about_the_game:
This casual puzzle game features beautiful graphics that make up:

Wanfeng Lake, located in Xingyi City, Guizhou Province, is a stunning alpine reservoir known as the "Pearl on the Plateau." Surrounded by karst peaks, its crystal-clear waters span 160+ square kilometers. Popular activities include kayaking, cycling along scenic routes, and photography of its sunrise/sunset vistas. The lake also hosts international sailing competitions.

Game starts:

Click on 'start game', the image will be grayed out, and the colored parts will be randomly scrambled into 16 small fragments, scattered randomly on the screen

Game process:

Players click on the small image, drag it to its original position to restore it, until all the small images move to the correct position, and the game ends

End or start the next game:

All the small fragments move to the correct position, and the game ends. At this point, click "try again" to repeat the game.

4542210.name: War Room: Tactical Sandbox
4542210.about_the_game:
By Historians, For Strategists: The Next Level of Sandbox Simulation

Developed by the creators of the Lado B da História channel, War Room transcends the boundaries of a typical game. It is a robust, scalable military simulation engine designed for those who refuse restrictions. Whether you are a historian testing Napoleonic tactics, a content creator seeking unique tactical visuals, or a strategy fan wanting to watch the world burn, this tool is your command center.

Features That Command the Battlefield:

  • 🛡️ Eras Without Borders: Pit Roman legionaries against battle tanks or medieval knights against modern infantry divisions. The vast unit catalog allows you to explore history’s "What Ifs" on any scale.

  • 🌍 Terrain Generator: Don’t be limited to pre-made maps. Create terrains from scratch with our HD generator, adjusting biomes, sea levels, and relief to build the perfect strategic landscape.

  • 📦 Total Expandability: Experience the freedom of going beyond official content. War Room allows you to import custom maps and personal assets, ensuring that any specific unit or historical scenario can be brought to life within your simulation.

  • ⚔️ Advanced AI Battle Mode: Issue direct orders or simply watch the chaos unfold. Our AI system processes tactical stances (Offensive, Defensive, Retreat), morale systems, panic, and balance of power in real-time.

  • 🎬 "Tactical Glass" Aesthetics & Shaders: Feel the weight of command with visuals inspired by high-tech tactical monitors. Dynamic ocean shaders, CRT effects, Depth of Field (DoF), and cinematic filters turn your simulation into a war film.

  • ✏️ Professional Tactical Precision: Draw complex routes, set arrival times, program synchronized detonations, and use map markers to orchestrate military maneuvers with the precision of a true General.

  • 🎥 Built for Creators: Featuring a retractable UI, recording indicators, and a "Cinema Mode," War Room is the ultimate tool for those producing documentaries, history videos, or tactical analyses.

Master the Timeline

In War Room, time is your ally. Use the scrubbing system to rewind the action, correct positioning errors, and re-watch the exact moment your strategy crushed the enemy.

Become Part of History

We are constantly expanding War Room’s capabilities. By wishlisting, you support a project dedicated to historical accuracy and tactical depth. Help us decide which eras and features come next.

Recreate and play historical scenarios.

Deep mechanics that let you create complex battles.

AI that can truly surprise you on the battlefield.

Transform the map. Command history. Welcome to the War Room.

4542220.name: 记忆迷宫 Memory Maze
4542220.about_the_game:
*Memory Maze* is a pixel-art puzzle game developed independently by solo developer "Liu Dao Bu Dao" using the Godot Engine; it was officially completed in March 2026. Breaking away from the homogenized design tropes of traditional maze games currently on the market, this title centers on an original "dynamic light and shadow occlusion" system combined with a core gameplay loop driven purely by memory. Utilizing a low-budget, minimalist art style, it crafts a puzzle-solving atmosphere brimming with a sense of the unknown and deep immersion. The game features no complex controls, no mandatory payments, and no intrusive advertisements, focusing instead on a pure, cerebral, and casual gaming experience suitable for players of all ages.

🌟 **Core Gameplay: Say Goodbye to Full Map Visibility—Break Through the Maze Using Only Your Memory**

The game's most defining feature is its complete rejection of traditional maze game conventions—such as full-map visibility or mini-map hints—in favor of an exclusive dynamic light and shadow occlusion mechanism. Players control a small protagonist figure who must explore the environment relying solely on a limited light source held in hand. Areas lying beyond the reach of this light source remain shrouded in total darkness; walls completely block the light, leaving behind no outlines or vague visual cues, thereby maximizing the maze's sense of mystery and the thrill of exploration.

Under this mechanism, players cannot "cheat" their way through levels by relying on visual cues alone. Instead, they must maintain constant focus, utilizing their own memory to precisely record every path taken, the orientation of every fork in the road, and the location of every dead end. Simultaneously, players must dodge randomly appearing traps and search for hidden clues, gradually feeling their way toward the optimal route until they successfully reach the maze's exit to clear the stage. The gameplay emphasizes testing concentration and memory; with its relaxed rather than tense pacing, it serves equally well as a casual, relaxing pastime or as a brain-teasing challenge for dedicated puzzle enthusiasts.

🎮 **Minimalist PC Controls: Zero Barrier to Entry**

The game has been optimized for a lightweight, streamlined experience on PC. Its control logic is extremely minimalist, requiring no complex key combinations, allowing even complete beginners to pick it up instantly: Use the WASD keys or the Arrow keys to move the character forward, backward, left, and right, while using mouse clicks to perform all interactive actions—such as using items or triggering mechanisms. 🧩 Comprehensive Item, Mechanism, and Shop Systems: Enriching the Level-Clearing Experience

To diversify gameplay and lower the barrier to entry for newcomers, the game features a fully integrated system for item collection, interactive mechanisms, and shop-based exchanges using in-game currency. All items can be redeemed entirely for free using in-game coins, with absolutely no additional real-money purchases required. Specific details are as follows:

✅ **Randomly Spawning Maze Items** 1. **Coins:** Scattered randomly throughout the maze; collecting them yields 1–5 coins per pickup. These serve as the sole currency for redeeming items in the shop. 2. **Hand Grenade:** Detonates a specific section of the maze wall, forcibly carving out a new path and allowing players to quickly bypass complex dead ends. 3. **Firearm:** Allows players to shoot at "Ghost" obstacles within the maze, instantly breaking their pursuit and enabling smooth progress along the intended route. 4. **Time Extender:** Immediately adds 30 seconds to the timer for the current level upon activation, helping to alleviate time-related pressure. 5. **Standard Map Book:** Temporarily reveals the complete layout of the current maze upon use, allowing players to quickly grasp the overall structure and orient themselves. 6. **Advanced Map Book:** An advanced utility item that not only reveals the full maze layout but also directly highlights the correct path to complete the level—making it an essential tool for helping beginners clear stages quickly.

✅ **Interactive Scene Mechanisms** 1. **Ghosts:** Minor obstacles that appear randomly throughout the maze. They will automatically begin tracking the player when approached; however, players can easily shake them off by simply running away quickly. These ghosts inflict no damage and serve only to add a mild sense of urgency to the level-clearing process. 2. **Campfires:** A core interactive mechanism within the environment. Players can manually light a campfire when standing nearby, significantly expanding the illuminated area. This temporarily lifts visibility restrictions, making it easier to quickly survey surrounding paths and intersections.

✅ **Coin Shop Redemption Pricing:** Coins collected by the player within the maze can be freely redeemed for items at either the in-level shop or the main menu shop. The pricing for all items is clear and transparent: Hand Grenade (20 coins each), Firearm (30 coins each), Time Extender (50 coins each), Standard Map Book (70 coins each), and Advanced Map Book (90 coins each). 🎨 **Minimalist Pixel Art: Crafting a Highly Immersive Atmosphere on a Budget**

The game employs a visual style that blends pixel art with minimalist hand-drawn aesthetics, prioritizing a design philosophy focused on creating a high-impact atmosphere with minimal resources. The overall color palette is dominated by deep grays and pure blacks, while core light sources utilize warm yellow and cool white highlights to create a stark contrast between light and shadow—perfectly complementing the core gameplay mechanic of dynamic light and shadow occlusion. Environmental details have been meticulously polished; walls feature rough stone and wood textures, while the ground is subtly accented with small elements such as scattered pebbles and weeds. Areas lying outside the player's field of view remain pure black, devoid of any outlines or contours. Though lacking flashy visual effects, this approach successfully conjures an intensely immersive labyrinthine atmosphere, allowing players to focus their full attention on the puzzles themselves.

4542250.name: GRID CRYPT
4542250.about_the_game:
'GRID CRYPT' is a grid puzzle game where you read and exploit enemy behavior. The monsters roaming the dungeon act with fixed priorities and routes. Turn their instincts against them — lure enemies into traps, trigger friendly fire, and carve your own path forward. But what awaits you in the depths of this dungeon...?

 

Freedom to Choose Your Approach

Read the movements of enemies that react to the map and your position, then decide: wipe them out, or head straight for the stairs. Eliminate every enemy on the floor, or take the risk and push on to the next stage — the choice is yours.

Trial, Error, and the Joy of Discovery

The key to mastering GRID CRYPT lies not just in learning enemy behavior, but in uncovering the hidden logic of each stage, map, and the dungeon itself.

A Compact but Deeply Satisfying Puzzle Experience

Over 70 stages await, along with a King lurking in the dungeon's depths.

4542270.name: Void Fate
4542270.about_the_game:
In a world corrupted by the unknown "Void" force, humanity's only rule of survival is to weaponize this deadly power. Welcome to the highly classified combat training system: the "Void Fate Protocol." As a core tester, you will embody a combat avatar and dive into a sealed arena, facing randomly generated Void monstrosities and extremely dangerous giant simulacra. There is no turning back—your only option is to evolve through life-and-death clashes.

Visceral Hardcore Action Combat

Perfect Parry: Block at the exact moment of an enemy's attack to not only prevent your own posture buildup but also massively increase the enemy's posture. When their posture is full, deliver a fatal execution!

Perfect Dodge: Dodge attacks at the right moment to trigger a 1.5-second "Void Time". In this state, everything around you moves in slow motion, while your actions are accelerated and consume no stamina.

Soul-Burning Void Power

Transcendence: Forcefully activate this mode by overdrawing stamina to gain a Super Armor state immune to hit reactions, while every basic and heavy attack becomes imbued with devastating energy blades.

Special Skills: Use "Void Vortex Snap" to turn into an afterimage, forcefully piercing through enemy lines and leaving behind explosive vortexes, or unleash "Void Dimension Blade" to slash out a 360-degree black-and-white fan-shaped energy wave, instantly breaking the enemy's formation.

Seize Cores, Build Your Playstyle

Defeat formidable enemies to seize "Void Cores". The system will provide three random Roguelite reward affixes for you to overwrite your combat data.

Craft Your Exclusive Combat Style: You can specialize in the "Perfect Dodge Build," "Perfect Parry Build," or "Transcendence Build". The more affixes of the same build you choose, the easier it is to obtain ultra-rare god-tier abilities like "Fleeting Wrath" or "Karmic Carapace".

Despair-Inducing Boss Fights

Multi-Stage Enrage Mechanics: Prepare to face bosses with massive health pools and diverse attack patterns.

PC-Exclusive Optimizations & Features 

To provide the ultimate action control experience, I have implemented deep, low-level optimizations for the PC platform:

 

Seamless Input Hot-Swapping: The system supports instant detection and seamless switching between Keyboard/Mouse and XBOX controllers. No matter which input method you prefer for combat, simply press a button on the corresponding device, and all UI prompts and operational feedback will automatically synchronize within a millisecond.

 

Fully Customizable Keybindings: Full custom keybinding is supported, allowing you to adjust the layout to fit your optimal control logic whether you use a controller or a keyboard and mouse.

 

Ultimate Visual Performance: High-quality FPS locking and resolution scaling options are unlocked, allowing the lighting and visual prowess of Unreal Engine 5 to be fully unleashed on your hardware.

# Race, Tune, Flip, and Fight!

This isn’t just a racing game — it’s a bike adventure with story and action!

# Feel the rush of stunt action at your fingertips!

Flip through the air, slam down with your wheels, and unleash a hail of bullets

Pull off daring stunts to hunt down Petros and set your speed on fire!

# Chase, Escape, Battle! The action never stops!

Tear through maps packed with various hills and Petros

Clear missions and objectives to move to the next stage!

# Collect unique characters and build your ultimate bike!

Each character is unique with its own speed, weapon, and personality.

Combine parts to customize your very own bike!

Speed is just the basics. Only those who survive can truly call themselves Hunters.

The bike action that will set your heart on fire starts now!

4542350.name: FlashReading
4542350.about_the_game:
• FlashReading — Adaptive Speed Reading Trainer

**Read faster. Build vocabulary. Train smarter.**

FlashReading is an intelligent reading trainer that adapts to your vocabulary level in real time. Using RSVP (Rapid Serial Visual Presentation) and AI-generated content, it pushes your reading speed while tracking every unfamiliar word — so you learn as you train.

---

Intelligent Speed Adaptation

FlashReading doesn't just time you — it learns from you. After each session, it analyzes your word familiarity, marked words, and confidence level to calculate your optimal reading speed. Adjustments are gradual and data-driven, keeping you in the sweet spot between comfort and challenge.

Push from 60 WPM to 1500 WPM as your skills grow.

---

Two Reading Modes

- **RSVP** — words flash one at a time in your focus zone, eliminating eye movement and subvocalization

- **Line-by-Line** — traditional horizontal reading with adaptive pacing

Both modes let you mark unfamiliar words mid-session without breaking flow.

---

AI That Knows Your Vocabulary

FlashReading tracks word familiarity across dictionaries and generates articles tailored to your level:

- **Expand Mode** — weaves your unfamiliar words into new articles so you encounter them in context

- **Speed Mode** — generates content at your reading level for smooth, confidence-building sessions

- **Paste Mode** — train on your own articles (textbooks, papers, anything)

Supports local LLM (Ollama) or cloud API. No AI? Use built-in sample articles.

---

Vocabulary That Sticks

Mark words you don't know. FlashReading tracks them, measures familiarity over time, and surfaces them in future articles. It's spaced repetition built into your reading flow — no flashcards, no extra study sessions.

---

Key Features

- RSVP and line-by-line reading modes

- Adaptive WPM based on session performance and word familiarity

- AI article generation (local or cloud) with difficulty control

- Vocabulary tracking and custom dictionaries

- Reading calendar and session history

- Mark range control — adjust which words get flagged based on familiarity

- Multiple user profiles

- Cross-platform (Windows, macOS, Linux)

---

Who Is This For?

- Language learners building fluency in a new language

- Students tackling dense academic material

- Professionals who need to process large volumes of text

- Anyone who wants to read faster without sacrificing comprehension

---

*Your reading speed is trainable. FlashReading makes it measurable.*

4542360.name: Velanor
4542360.about_the_game:
Velanor is a 2D pixel-art MMORPG with top-down action combat utilizing WASD/click-to-move and tab-targeting. We offer challenging dungeons, unique character builds, and gear worth grinding for.

Four Classes
Knight, Mage, Priest, and Ranger. Each one plays differently and has its own set of abilities. Specialize your character by equipping gear, allocating stat points, and investing in a talent tree to shape your build around how you want to play.

Group up with other players to take on stronger monsters, earn better equipment, craft new items, and keep pushing further. The world gets harder the deeper you go, and the loot gets better to match.

What will your story be?

4542380.name: Twirly Treats: A Cozy Juggling Game
4542380.about_the_game:
A cozy and rhythmic juggling game with a curious squirrel.

Enjoy a smooth, rhythmic three-ball juggling performance using acorns.

A squirrel watches closely—and may occasionally do something unexpected.

This is a casual score attack game where you juggle at a steady tempo with simple controls, aiming for a high score.
The soft visuals and piano jazz BGM create a cute and relaxing atmosphere.

Controls and Scoring:

Press the left and right keys in rhythm (tap and release briefly).
The length of each input changes the height of the throw in distinct steps.
Each successful throw earns 1 point.

Controls:

Left Shift / Right Shift (Keyboard)
or
L / R (XInput Controller)

Basic Throw Patterns:

Cascade
Alternate throws: right, left, right...

Chase
A flowing pattern like right, right... forming a figure-eight motion

Try experimenting with different throwing styles!

Mistakes and Game Over:

Dropped acorns are eaten by the squirrel, costing you a life.
When you run out of lives, it's game over.

  • Throwing too hard (holding the key too long) can send acorns off course

  • Hitting a hand that is already holding an acorn will deflect it

  • Collisions in mid-air with other acorns or obstacles will cause drops

Be especially careful of acorn collisions—multiple drops in quick succession can quickly lead to game over.

Game Modes:

Start
The standard mode.
A hungry squirrel will try to interfere with your juggling.
Its interruptions become more intense over time.
Keep your rhythm and aim for a high score without losing all your lives.
Starting lives: 2

Free Juggling
A relaxed mode with no interference from the squirrel.
Focus purely on juggling—practice tricks or aim for a high score at your own pace.
Starting lives: 1

Perfect for quick play sessions, and for players who enjoy improving their score through practice.

4542400.name: Cliffside Cafe
4542400.about_the_game:
Cliffside Cafe is a casual point-and-click cooking game where you play as a barista running your very own cafe! With tons of recipes and ingredients to unlock, will you become the ultimate barista?

At release, Cliffside Cafe will have a free demo and a paid version with all features. You can play the current WIP version on itch.io under the same name

Implemented Features:

4542410.name: Fundoshinobi: The Naked Ninja
4542410.about_the_game:
Game Information

In this game, you become "Sho," the successor of a ninja clan that dons only the traditional fundoshi loincloth. Your mission is to purify women who have been tainted by dark Yin energy.

The game progresses through various stages, each consisting of several sub-stages. You can equip up to 4 weapons and synthesize them up to level 4 for devastating power.

When the time limit for a sub-stage expires, a boss with unique attack patterns will appear. Defeat them to begin the purification process. For a complete purification, Sho’s Yang-infused vital fluids are required.

At the end of each stage, powerful final bosses await. Once they are defeated, you will need to put in even "greater effort" to ensure they are fully purified.

Between stages, you can strengthen Sho using "Kuroha’s" Onmyodo (Yin-Yang arts) and "Kina’s" Lucky Mallet. Additionally, use the "Essence" gathered from purified women to upgrade your fundoshi, and unlock new Secret Arts and Battle Skills using Ninja Swords obtained from specific bosses.

Key Features:

  • Over 30 types of weapons and 8 unique ninja weapon traits.

  • Over 20 bosses with diverse and challenging patterns.

  • Frame-by-frame, hand-drawn animated H-scenes.

  • Various other erotic elements to discover.

4542420.name: Nav Singh's POOHOPIA (Winnie The Pooh)
4542420.about_the_game:
Welcome to POOHOPIA, a cozy sandbox adventure tucked away in an enchanted town within the woods. 

One morning Pooh wakes up in his treehouse to find his dearest friends have mysteriously vanished. The woods feels strangely quiet, and fences and town signs have started creeping in from the edges. Pooh (You) decide the only thing left to do is make the perfect surprise party to bring everyone home again.

Gather, craft, decorate, and gently reshape the land as you turn the town into a warm, welcoming place that calls your friends back, one by one.

Forage & Fish

Stroll peaceful paths, float up trees with a balloon for honey, forage for sticks and mushrooms, and cast a line in the calm pond for fresh fish for eating, cooking, or simply just decoration.


Craft Decor & Treats

Turn simple finds into picnic blankets, balloon strings, honey lamps, flower garlands, benches, log tables and party snacks at your workbench.

Place & Shape the Clearing

Freely arrange your creations anywhere in the growing party clearing. As you place more items, the party meter fills up and you might see your friends start coming back home.

[Photo Coming Soon]

Friends Come Home

As the clearing becomes prettier and more inviting, your friends (Owl, Pig, Donkey, Rabbit), all come home one by one. All characters and the world are lovingly based on the 1926 original Winnie-the-Pooh book, now in the public domain.

Planned Features

Online multiplayer & co-op coming soon. Visit friends’ worlds, co-build the party clearing, trade items, throw shared parties and simply hang out together in Poohopia.

4542520.name: Motelia
4542520.about_the_game:
Motelia is a first-person psychological horror game set in an isolated 1960s roadside motel. You are the new caretaker. You came here to work, earn money, and start a new life. But this place is not normal, and your new job will test your mind.
THE DAILY ROUTINE Motelia is a management simulator where you are completely alone. You must do your daily tasks to keep the motel running:

  • Keep it Clean: Use your janitor cart. Push it down to the room, pick up the trash, mop the floors, and change the dirty bed sheets.

  • Fix Problems: Repair broken fuse box so the business stays open.

WEIRD CUSTOMERS A motel needs guests. Stand at the reception and give them their room keys. However, the people visiting this isolated road are not ordinary. You will deal with weird customers. Some act strangely, some say disturbing things, and they will make you feel unsafe in your own workplace.


LOSING YOUR MIND There is no safe time in Motelia; the horror never stops. The game features a constant Sanity System. As you do your simple jobs, you must fight to keep your sanity:

  • You hear footsteps in empty rooms.

  • You clean a red stain on the carpet... is it wine, or is it blood? If your sanity drops too low, you will see terrifying hallucinations. Can you finish your work without going completely mad?

4542580.name: Savor Hour
4542580.about_the_game:
Savor Hour is a short horror narrative-cooking game, where you play as Plum, a cook who once promised friends to open a restaurant together. Serve customers before sunset, cook with physics-based mechanics, interact with friends through unique dialogue, and explore an atmosphere that slowly shifts into something strange. Mini-games and mild jump scares are woven throughout the story.

The completion takes approximately 50–80 minutes to complete.

Features:

  • Story-driven dialogue with a unique dialogue UI.

  • Physics-based cooking.

  • Handcrafted 3D and 2D hand-drawn art.

  • Original assets and soundtrack.

Cooking with a physics-based:

Allow you to cook with freedom, such as frying multiple eggs or meats at once in a wok.

Conversation with selectable responses:

Respond anytime, even while walking—no need to stop to have a conversation.

4542590.name: Fish Slayer
4542590.about_the_game:
• You are a small animal that needs a lot of calories every day to survive! The sea is full of fish waiting for you to hunt, but there are also many dangerous creatures out there. You must survive in these perilous waters!

  • Fast-paced gameplay! Each wave of fishing lasts 90 seconds. Hunt down as many as you can!

  • A variety of animal characters, weapons, and hundreds of items are available for you to choose from.

  • A variety of game modes are available for players to challenge!
