4542610.name: The Baron's Burden: One Fortnight
4542610.about_the_game:
Serve the crown in The Baron's Burden: One Fortnight. As a medieval baron, you have fourteen days to manage your estate, grow your crops, and satisfy the ever-changing demands of a capricious king or face the consequences of his displeasure.

Build your plots, recruit peasants to work the land, and make sure you have what the King demands, be it gold, crops, or meats. Each demand is a race against the clock, and a king who doesn't get what he wants is a dangerous king indeed!

No two runs are the same. The King's personality shapes the demands he makes and how harshly he judges your failures. Some kings are patient, while others are not. Unlock new crops, new environments, and new royal temperaments as you prove your worth across multiple runs, building toward mastery of the estate one fortnight at a time.

And if you've earned it, you won't be managing the estate alone. A loyal companion at the Baron's side makes the fortnight a little less burdensome.

4542630.name: Roller Coaster Looper
4542630.about_the_game:
Roller Coaster Looper is a roguelite idle-like coaster-builder where strategy happens in the shop and satisfaction happens on the track.

Between rounds, you browse a rotating market of track segments, eccentric riders, and decorations. Then watch your choices play out as your coaster loops endlessly, stacking thrill multipliers and generating increasingly unhinged reactions from your passengers.

Build the Loop

Draft from 24 unique track segments each with distinct thrill values and special effects. Slow Burn ignites with every loop. The Slingshot launches into the next segment for bonus multipliers. The Haunted Stretch slowly fades away over time. Every purchase shapes the run.

Recruit the Riders

Fill your train with any of the 29 waiting riders, each with their own personality, synergies, and scoring quirks. The Gambler has a 20% chance to triple their score (or nothing). The Dare Devil loves inversions. The Conductor is a robot rider that is more thrilled the longer the train gets. Matching the right riders to the right track is how the big numbers happen.

Stack the Cards

Discover and activate card modifiers that bend the rules across an entire run. Boost specific rider types, unlock combo chains, multiply thrill in exponential ways. Card packs game changing but expensive, crack them open and adapt your strategy on the fly.

Survive 12 Rounds

Each run is 12 rounds of escalating goals. Meet the thrill target, keep your riders happy, and don't lose all your stars. Every third round, a boss modifier changes the rules: bigger requirements, new constraints, and a reward for winning. Make it to the end of Round 12 and you've built something special.

Earn While It Loops

While your coaster runs, a lightweight idle layer runs with it. Tap decorations to generate bonus thrill and XP. Level up during the ride to earn Win Points, then spend them on run-scoped upgrades: crank up simulation speed, boost base thrill per segment, or juice your click power even further. Veterans start each run with more Win Points based on how many unique win combinations they've racked up. It's entirely opt-in: ignore it and you'll still finish the run. Lean into it and the numbers get very silly very fast.

Keep Building Between Runs

A Research Lab of challenges tracks your lifetime accomplishments and unlocks permanent upgrades. New rider types, new segment variants, new decorations to add, new card archetypes. Each run means your next run will have even more options.



  • 24 track segments with unique effects and synergies
  • 29 riders with distinct synergies, personalities, and scoring behaviors
  • 23 kinds of decorations that excite riders even more
  • 41 cards to discover and combo across a run
  • 8 coaster types that grant you a unique bonus with 8 levels of difficulty for each
  • 12-round structure with boss modifiers and escalating goals
  • Research Lab meta-progression across runs
  • Infinite Mode after clearing Round 12

Physics not relevant. Screaming is optional but recommended. Structurally questionable, emotionally thrilling.

4542650.name: AnimalSchool
4542650.about_the_game:
Welcome to [AnimalSchool], a vibrant and challenging animal school simulation tycoon game! You will play as an ambitious headmaster, starting from a rundown rural animal school with just a few classrooms. Through your wisdom and management, you will ultimately build it into a world-renowned top-tier aristocratic academy.

🎓 In-Depth Simulation, Care for Every Student
Your students—a bunch of adorable yet mischievous little animals—have independent stats for Hunger, Mood, Knowledge, Health, and Comfort. You must carefully plan their daily schedule: find the perfect balance between teaching and playtime to ensure they are well-fed, happy, and healthy. Remember, a sick or unhappy student can't learn effectively!

🏗️ Build Freely, Plan Your Dream Campus
From essential buildings like Classrooms, Offices, and Cafeterias to luxurious facilities like Swimming Pools, Gardens, and Playgrounds, unlock and upgrade over 14 different types of buildings. Strategically plan your campus layout, construct infrastructure like Power Plants and Water Facilities, and lay a solid foundation for expansion. 👨‍🏫 Recruit a Team, Handle Unexpected Challenges
You can't do it alone! Hire and upgrade your staff: diligent Teachers for lessons, efficient Janitors for cleanliness, professional Chefs for delicious meals, and reliable Repairmen on standby to fix broken facilities. Emergencies happen, and a strong team is key to your success.

💰 Operate Smartly, Become an Academy Tycoon
Your core goal is profit maximization. Earn substantial tuition fees by improving teaching efficiency, keeping student morale high, and minimizing the impact of incidents. Reinvest your profits to unlock new areas, upgrade equipment, and hire more staff, creating a powerful growth cycle. Can you build an efficient, prosperous, and joyful educational empire?

✨ Game Features

  • Multi-Dimensional Simulation Management: Dive deep into teaching, logistics, facility maintenance, and financial operations.

  • Rich Construction & Upgrade System: Start from scratch, freely plan and expand your unique campus.

  • Strategic Daily Planning: Balance student stats, handle random events, and make critical decisions.

  • A Sense of Progressive Achievement: Experience the complete epic journey from a shabby elementary school to a luxurious aristocratic academy.

Are you ready for the challenge? Enroll your first students now and begin writing your own educational legend!

Hidden Girls is a relaxing game that combines hidden object gameplay, visual novel storytelling, and anime-style character interaction.

Help a cast of charming girls find the items they need by exploring beautifully illustrated scenes. As you progress, you'll unlock branching storylines where every choice you make shapes the outcome.

4542680.name: Observation Daruma Log
4542680.about_the_game:
Daruma Observation Log is a roguelite observation simulation game in which you cultivate and observe inorganic beings called Darumas, collect mysterious energy, and decide when to escape from an experiment site on the verge of collapse.

This is an Energy Experimental Site. Here, mysterious energy is harvested when tiny beings known as Darumas vanish. Inside circular chambers, Darumas collide, reproduce, and eventually reach the end of their lifespan and disappear.

There is no stability in this facility. As time passes, disasters such as snowfall, lightning strikes, disease, fires, and violent gusts grow more severe, pushing the site into an uncontrollable state of chaos. If left unchecked, the only outcome is the total extinction of the Darumas and the complete loss of your results.

What You Do

At the start of the game, you spend your funds to place circular chambers (petri dishes) and then place Darumas inside them.

Once placed, the Darumas begin moving on their own, colliding with one another and producing new baby Darumas.

Those baby Darumas eventually mature, increasing the population inside the facility.

But you are not simply watching it all happen.

Using your limited funds, you place one item in each chamber to shape and control the experimental environment.

For example, you might place a piggy bank to generate more money, a hospital to prioritize disease control, a microscope to speed up growth, or a stove or fan to manipulate the room temperature.

What you place, and where you place it, dramatically changes both how the system grows and how it falls apart.

In other words, the player must constantly make decisions with mouse-only controls:

  • where to expand with new chambers

  • which Darumas to place, and how many

  • which item to place in each chamber

  • which connections to open, and which to block

  • whether to keep pushing forward, or escape now

This is a game of nonstop observation, management, and decision-making under pressure.

It’s Not Just About Growing More

More Darumas does not mean more stability.

As density rises, the risks of disease and corruption increase, while changes in room temperature can also raise the chances of infection and fire.

The player must constantly read the information on the game screen and respond to each situation as it unfolds.

A snowfall warning appears.

The temperature starts to drop.

More infected Darumas are beginning to spread.

Some chambers have already been damaged by fire, and the next lightning warning is on the way.

You might still be able to earn more.

Or this might be the exact moment you need to escape.

Observation and retreat decisions are essential.

Escape, or Get Greedy

Before the game ends in total failure, you can press the Escape button in the lower-right corner of the screen to attempt to leave the experiment site.

However, pressing it does not end the run immediately.

Once you hit the button, a departure countdown begins, and you can no longer interact with the game for a set amount of time.

All you can do is watch and hope the facility survives long enough for you to get out safely.

If you escape successfully, you can bring home the mysterious energy you collected.

The longer you stay, the higher the Chaos Multiplier rises, increasing the value of what you take back.

But if you get too greedy, the entire population may die during the escape countdown, and you lose everything.

You must do both:

know when the run is most profitable, and recognize the signs of collapse before it is too late.

Through Repetition, the Structure of the World Reveals Itself

The mysterious energy you bring back can be used in the World Turbine.

There, you can permanently unlock new facilities and systems to prepare for the next experiment.

Each successful escape also updates the Observation Log, gradually revealing more of the world’s underlying rules.

What the player reads is not a story.

It is a record of how this world breaks, what triggers each chain reaction, and when to cut your losses.

The title is Daruma Observation Log, but what you truly need to observe is not the individual Darumas.

It is the structure of the world itself.

Features

■ Place Darumas, Observe Their Growth, and Operate the Facility

Place chambers, then add Red Darumas and Blue Darumas.

They move on their own, collide, reproduce, grow, and eventually disappear.

As you watch these systems unfold, you expand the layout, adjust placements, and build facilities to influence the overall behavior of the experiment.

■ Mouse-Only Decisions: Placement and Retreat

Controls are entirely mouse-based.

Place Darumas, expand with new chambers, choose and place items, control movement with filters, and press the Escape button when it is time to leave.

The actions themselves are simple, but the decisions behind them are anything but.

■ A Roguelite That Falls Apart Through Disaster

Snow, lightning, disease, fire, and violent gusts.

As time passes, risks stack on top of each other and the environment deteriorates at an accelerating pace.

The longer you stay, the greater the rewards become—but the closer you move toward collapse.

4542700.name: UnDo
4542700.about_the_game:
UnDo is a Sokoban-based puzzle game built around simple, intuitive mechanics, yet it offers a satisfying challenge. Use the bugs created by Undo to overcome the Game Master's deadly traps and escape the game.

UnDo is the story of a player trying to escape deletion from an ordinary box-pushing game that is slowly fading into obscurity.

The manager of an old game console, known as the Game Master, decides to delete the box-pushing game after no one plays it anymore. To stop the protagonist from escaping, the Game Master traps them in a stage that cannot be cleared.

But as a result of the deletion process, glitched tiles begin to appear throughout the map. By using the strange bugs triggered by Undo, you must overcome the Game Master’s interference, clear the stages, and prevent the game from being deleted!

4542710.name: ZeroOut
4542710.about_the_game:
Complete puzzles by zeroing out the board! This is achieved by placing the pieces onto the board. Once the piece is placed, the numbers of the affiliated squares on the board will decrease based on the number of the piece. Pieces may need to be rotated or flipped.

This game supports keyboard & mouse input only.

4542730.name: Jump Broke
4542730.about_the_game:
Demo Coming Soon!!!

Reaching the top is the goal, but how you get there is up to you.

In Jump Broke, you play as a legless Mimic. To reach the summit, your only means of movement is to eject coins from your body. This is not just a platforming challenge, but a gamble with your wealth.

Game Logic: Recoil Jumping

Due to your physiological limitations, you must blast coins toward the ground, using the physical recoil to launch yourself into the air.

  • 1 Jump = 1 Coin: Regardless of the jump height, every action consumes exactly 1 coin in real-time.

  • Precise Control: The game supports variable jump heights based on how long you hold the button. Manage your inputs carefully with limited resources.

Hardcore Challenge: A Tough Path to the Top

This is a highly challenging platformer:

  • Demanding Controls: Level design emphasizes mastery over jump timing, force, and precise angles.

  • Sunk Cost: Spikes and traps won’t charge you extra, but gravity will. Falling doesn't just waste the coins you spent to climb; a hard landing will make you spill your gold everywhere. Every mistake has a literal price.

Art Style

  • Simple Pixel Art: The game features clean and straightforward pixel graphics.

  • Hand-drawn Frame-by-frame Animation: Actions such as jumping, soaring, and landing are all hand-drawn frame-by-frame to ensure clear and solid gameplay feedback.

Two Endings: With Treasure or With Debt?

Running out of coins won't end the game, but it will change "how" you reach the top:

  • Bankrupt Victory: You can keep jumping even with a zero balance, but your bill will enter a state of debt.

  • Profitable Clearance: Only the most skilled players can stand at the peak with remaining treasure under strict resource constraints.

Can you reach the summit with your dignity—and your wallet—intact?

4542750.name: VELATO
4542750.about_the_game:
VELATO - The First Single-player Poker-Bluff Roguelike Deckbuilder

Bluff | Challenge | AI | Poker | Roguelike | Deckbuilder | Declare | Strategy

What Is VELATO?

VELATO is a single-player Poker-Bluff Roguelike Deckbuilder where players build a Joker-driven economy engine, manipulate AI opponents through bluffing, and survive escalating table pressure across each run.

  • A bluff-driven roguelike deckbuilder built for risk-takers and over-thinkers alike.

  • Buy, sell, raise, and lie. Every hand is a market, a AI-mind game, and a math puzzle in one.

Do you dare to play? 🤡

Coming to Steam in Early Access on June 26, 2026, VELATO operates on three layers, each adding strategic depth:

Layer 1 — Poker Hand & Joker Engine

Players draw poker hands, resolve their strongest line, and build around Jokers that modify score, multiplier, economy, consistency, and risk.

  • Over 120 Jokers, each built around Suit, Rank, Bet, Truth or Bluff

  • 3 table phases per floor: small table, big table, and a boss showdown

  • A bluff-driven poker system where declaring the right hand matters as much as building it

  • Dynamic AI opponents with visible boss rules and hidden behavioral patterns

  • Score engines and risk engines that let you win with raw hand power or mind games

  • Boss-specific punishments and counters that force you to pivot your strategy

  • Multiple playstyles to build around: honest control, pressure betting, flush setups, rank spikes, and deception runs

  • A high-stakes gold economy where every bet can snowball your run or end it on the spot

Layer 2 — The Bluff Mechanic

VELATO’s AI does not simply roll a random call. It reads public signals, tracks exposed bluff patterns, reacts to risky betting, and escalates through controlled boss rules. This single mechanic transforms every hand from a math problem into a psychological negotiation. It's the kind of tension that previously only existed in multiplayer poker, brought into a single-player bluff roguelike for the first time.

Layer 3 — Economy Pressure & Boss Counterplay

Progression in VELATO is not only about bigger numbers. It is about staying solvent under rising table stakes, choosing when to risk, when to conserve, and when to pivot into counters against boss rules.

5 Unique Selling Points of VELATO

For partners evaluating VELATO's competitive position among the best roguelike card games on Steam, these are the five differentiators that define our positioning:

  • Raise & Bluff Mechanic — Push chips and test nerves against AI opponents that read player patterns. No other deckbuilder has built this at scale.

  • Finite & Infinite Jokers — A two-tier resource system where some Jokers fade with use while others persist indefinitely. Adds strategic resource management beyond standard deckbuilder design.

  • Investment System — Players can sell Jokers between hands for profit, creating a market layer that rewards economic foresight alongside tactical play. (Coming up next)

  • Multiplayer (2–4 Players) — A multiplayer mode where the bluff mechanic finally meets human opponents. Planned for post-launch expansion. (Coming up next)

  • Collectible Trading Cards — Rare Jokers drop in special runs and carry display and trade value, opening community-driven economy potential. (Coming up next)

ADD VELATO INTO YOUR WISHLIST & GET READY TO CHALLENGE OUR SYSTEM 😎

4542800.name: Kill The Nova
4542800.about_the_game:
"Kill The Nova" is a brand-new experience where classic puzzle meets roguelike deckbuilder. Craft insane synergies to generate "impossible numbers," and plunge the developer, "Nova," into the depths of despair!

■ The Dopamine-Pumping Power of Multipliers

Combine over 150 different "SP" (Special Pieces) to craft the ultimate synergy. Meet the puzzle conditions to break blocks, and inflate your multipliers to astronomical levels.
It’s all about the multipliers. Hit overwhelming numbers and make the developer beg for mercy (*Note: there is no actual animation of him begging :> ).

  • Highly addictive Puzzle × Deckbuilding

  • Over 150 stackable SPs with limitless potential

  • Break through and transcend the 7 challenging "Ranks"

■ Control Everything in the Game
Choose your path from 10 randomly generated frames. A boss battle awaits at the end of each level. You decide which "Prime Cell" (boss) you want to fight—survive their attacks, and overcome them.
During the "Rebuild" phase after battles, you can modify the pieces in your hand to reach even greater heights.

  • Over 20 diverse "Prime Cell" bosses to challenge

  • A Rebuild system that lets you customize your pieces exactly how you want

  • *Use powerful items to gain the upper hand (Yes, you can actually win)

■ Destroy "Nova", the Enemy of Your Dopamine

But beware... it seems you aren't the only one who can place pieces on the board...

■ Other Features

  • An original soundtrack that pumps up the gameplay

  • A glorious, mind-melting victory sound that hits you right in the brain

4542820.name: Sad Virus Asia
4542820.about_the_game:
STORY:

Sad virus is back in this new part of third person walking simulation game. Mission is to find 10 beer bottles in now Asia place which include elements like small forest and Asian style village and castles.

There are several deathly traps like moving spikes and deathly moving balls. Also there are launchpads so Sad Virus can jump higher to places where are beer bottles. 4542830.name: Otherworld Cultivation: Survivors
4542830.about_the_game:
Otherworld Cultivation: Survivors

Otherworld Cultivation: Survivors is a casual horde-survival game that blends Eastern immortal cultivation (xianxia) with roguelike elements. Through repeated battles, players choose different skills, secret arts, and sacred treasures to continuously improve their cultivation. Even when besieged by countless demons and monsters, you can ride the sword freely, clear the battlefield arbitrarily, and fear nothing.

The otherworld is shrouded in turbid qi, and evil creatures run amok across the realm. The order of heaven and earth has collapsed, and all living beings are in dire straits—there is nowhere to run, nowhere to hide. All you can do is wield your sword to slay demons, fight side by side with a maiden trapped in despair in this otherworld, cleanse the filth of the world, hold off wave after wave of sieges, and struggle to survive amidst endless powerful foes.

Story

The mortal world has been eroded by the turbid qi of the otherworld, and the realm of immortal cultivation is on the verge of collapse. Countless demons and monsters pour out from the rifts. You accidentally break into this dying otherworld and become one of the few remaining cultivators still resisting. You must not only survive in this desperate situation, but also gradually uncover the truth behind the spread of turbid qi and find a glimmer of hope to save the world.

Gameplay & Mechanics

The game adopts a roguelike horde-survival gameplay. Each battle randomly refreshes combinations of skills, talents, and sacred treasures. You need to move flexibly among the tide of enemies, choose your growth path while dealing damage, and create a unique combat style. It supports free switching between third-person perspective and over-the-shoulder perspective, providing a more immersive and exciting combat experience.

Character Progression

By defeating demons, you gain experience and cultivation resources to continuously level up, unlock new skills, enhance sword-flying abilities, and collect various rare sacred treasures. Grow from a novice cultivator to a powerful immortal who slays demons and monsters and can take on thousands of enemies alone, with free and rich growth paths.

Teammate Recruitment

Encounter various teammates in the otherworld, each with unique skills and styles. It is not about switching characters, but fighting together with you~ No more fighting alone!

Game Goals

Strive to survive in wave after wave of increasingly powerful monster sieges, defeat powerful bosses, purify areas contaminated by turbid qi, and complete key story missions. Each run is a brand-new challenge, testing your operation, judgment, and Build matching strategy.

Playtime

Each run lasts about 20–30 minutes, with a fast rhythm that allows you to start a game anytime.

Unique Features

  • Eastern xianxia theme + exciting horde-survival gameplay, combining casual and thrilling experiences

  • Free switching between third-person and over-the-shoulder perspectives, adapting to different combat habits

  • Roguelike random growth, with different Builds in each run, full of freshness

  • Teammate recruitment system: you can meet and recruit various types of immortal cultivation partners to fight together and complement each other's combat power

  • Sword-flying combat and large-scale crowd clearing, with smooth combat feedback and full horde-clearing pleasure

  • Multiple unlockable characters + recruitable teammates, each with unique skills and gameplay

  • Casual and easy to learn, while having sufficient depth to cater to both new and core players

4542840.name: COOKBOT
4542840.about_the_game:
COOKBOT is an atmospheric narrative game about cooking.

You'll be mixing, cutting, cooking, baking, pouring and freezing different foods to fulfill food orders given to you by the crew of the space ship ZIMA on route through deep space.

The crew will talk to you about all sorts of things. They might treat you differently. They might treat each other differently. No matter what they say, you are to provide them what they ordered. If not, the on-board vending machine is a suitable replacement.

This game was co-financed by the Croatian Audiovisual Centre.

4542860.name: Isekai x Isekai
4542860.about_the_game:
Isekai x Isekai is a relaxing and heartwarming 2D idle desktop game.

It features a wide cast of adorable characters with distinct personalities. You can interact with them anytime, or simply watch their daily routines and cute behaviors for a cozy, comforting experience.

Characters will automatically generate Hearts over time. You can use these Hearts to pull in the gacha system for a chance to unlock rare, alternate forms of characters!

The game also includes two fun mini-games where you can play and earn additional characters and rewards.

Sit back, collect your favorite characters, and enjoy your charming isekai adventure! Your support would be greatly appreciated!Some dialogue content is only available in Chinese.

4542880.name: Ironblood
4542880.about_the_game:
The Empire is yours! But power is not kept - it is fought for, week by week, decision by decision, fight by fight.

IRONBLOOD is at it's core, a deep dark fantasy management sim. You run a fighting promotion. You sign fighters, negotiate contracts, build fight cards, and schedule events. Every week you advance time, and the world moves with you - fighters develop through career phases from raw prospect to ageing legend, rivalries form between repeat opponents, morale shifts based on wins and losses, and contracts expire if you're not careful.

Every campaign begins with a freshly generated world - new fighters, new lore, new rival promotions with their own histories and ambitions so no two plays are the same.

THE WORLD LIVES AND BREATHES

Dynamic lore events fire across the empire as you play - in the vein of Crusader Kings, the world reacts, evolves, and surprises.

EVERY DECISION HAS WEIGHT

Critical moments are resolved with a d20 roll modified by your Emperor's stats, perks, and achievements.

THE ARENA IS EVERYTHING

A deep fight simulation engine drives every bout - round by round, with full commentary, sound effects, voice overs, and a soundtrack. Permadeath is real.

BUILD YOUR LEGACY

Every event, every card, every bout is tracked in full. The Hall of Fame immortalises the greatest fighters ever to compete under your banner.

YOUR EMPEROR, YOUR LEGACY

A deep Emperor stat and perk system shapes how you rule. Your choices unlock unique abilities and define what kind of dynasty you leave behind.

A NEW WORLD EVERY TIME

Every campaign generates a fresh database - new fighters, new backstories, new lore, new rival promotions.

4542890.name: Crane's Dream
4542890.about_the_game:
Crane's Dream is a deep psychological drama and a severe test of your reflexes. Soldier Georgy returns from the frontlines, but the war isn't over for him—it has moved into his mind. This period of bloody conflict, where the Russian Empire clashed with mysterious Japan, has forever changed the hero. Now he must find the line between reality and madness before his inner demons consume him completely.

Two Worlds, Two Genres

The gameplay is divided into two interconnected phases. By day, the game is an atmospheric side-scroller with point-and-click elements. Explore the streets, talk to characters, rebuild lost connections, and make meaningful choices. By night, you plunge into a twisted battlefield—a dynamic isometric action game where fears take physical form.

Across Time and Continents

Georgy's story is not just a brief episode, but an epic journey set against global historical upheavals. The game is divided into chapters spanning nearly twenty years. You will start in the restless St. Petersburg of 1905, witness the devastating events of 1917, and try to find peace in Shanghai in 1924 among the Russian émigré circles. With each new era, the locations, the society around you, and the hero's nightmares evolve.

Tactical Isometric Combat

Every dream is a test of endurance. Use your trusty revolver, count the bullets in your cylinder, and dodge out of the line of fire using dashes. Alternate between shooting and brutal melee attacks to survive, because death will throw you back to your last save, forcing you to rethink your approach to the battle.

Mythological Enemies and Bosses

You will face terrifying creatures from Japanese and Slavic mythology. Enemies can patrol the area, hunt down the hero, and even reincarnate right in the middle of combat. At the end of the nightmares, epic boss fights await you, requiring you to study their unique patterns and adapt your tactics.

On the Edge of Reality and Madness

Dreams increasingly bleed into reality, and while awake, Georgy begins to be haunted by Mitka, a Slavic house spirit—an ambiguous companion who pushes you toward strange actions. It is your actions and dialogue choices that determine the ending: will the hero find healing and a new life in a foreign land, or will he sink entirely into the abyss of madness?

4542980.name: The Last Gap
4542980.about_the_game:
Add the game to your Wishlist!

[i]“The Last Gap looks really satisfying! Precision parking challenges with tight spaces and a star system for perfect runs is a great idea, and the different locations keep it fresh.”[/i] — QUDO

🚗 The Last Gap: Precision is Everything!

Every millimeter defines the line between glory and a total wreck! In The Last Gap, we don't care about your lead foot—we need surgeons behind the wheel. Forget mindless high-speed racing; this is about absolute precision. Do you have the nerves of steel required to maneuver your car into the tightest gaps while the clock is ticking?

🌟 Full Version Features:

  • 55 Hardcore Levels: Battle your way through an expanding world map. From tight parking garages and chaotic construction sites to absurd obstacle courses on a football pitch—every scenario demands a new strategy.

  • The Clone Mechanic (The Core of the Game):

    Use your clones to bridge the impossible! It’s not just about raw speed—you’ll need strategy and perfect timing to succeed. Strategically deploy your clones to pave paths that would otherwise be out of reach. Do you have what it takes to be a Puzzle Master?

  • The Gauntlet Mode (The Ultimate Test): From level 12, the 'Whirlpool' opens to the Gauntlet. Here, the rules are suspended! 20 extremely difficult special levels await you. Only the best will pass here.

  • Become a Legend (Online Leaderboards): Think you're the best? Prove it! Compare your best times on the global online leaderboards and fight for the throne of the Parking Masters.

  • The Hunt for Gold (20 Red Coin Stickers): 20 rare red coin stickers are hidden throughout the world. Only those who take the riskiest paths and find hidden gaps will collect them all. Are you up for the challenge?

  • Challenging Star System: Earn up to 3 stars per level. Only those who park scratch-free, in record time, and perfectly within the markings will reach the full 165 stars.

  • Extensive Tuning Shop: Use your hard-earned stars to customize your ride:

    • Body Shop: Unlock exclusive paint jobs—from elegant Gold and Stealth Black to vibrant Neon Purple.

    • Wheel Customization: Give your car the perfect finishing touch with matching rim colors.

  • Living Physics World: Experience dynamic environments with physics-based objects. But beware: every knocked-over cone or touched barrier costs you precious time!

  • Optimized Experience: A full options menu allows you to perfectly adjust graphics quality, resolution, and volume to your PC.

🎮 Total Control:

No matter how you play, The Last Gap adapts to you:

  • Keyboard: Classic WASD or Arrow Key controls.

  • Controller Support: Full support for your gamepad—providing even more precision for those tight corners.

  • Quick Actions: R for an instant restart (when things get tight) and ESC / M for a quick path back to the world map or main menu.

🌍 Language Independent: The gameplay is intuitive and designed to be understood by everyone, regardless of language. Precision is a universal language!

🛠️ A Passion Project:

The Last Gap started as a small idea and has evolved into a high-precision parking simulation. My goal was to create an "easy to learn, hard to master" experience that constantly challenges you to get just a little bit better.

Add the game to your Wishlist now and become part of the community!

4543030.name: Exploiters
4543030.about_the_game:
Exploiters

Exploiters is a continuously flowing idle defense experience where you build and expand your colony against relentless zombie waves. Instead of turn-based progression, the game evolves in real time—resources accumulate, threats escalate, and decisions shape how long your defenses can hold. With a focus on growth and adaptation, players develop strategies to manage incoming danger while strengthening their position.

The game features a variety of zombies and multiple characters, alongside systems like passive income and automated combat that reduce the need for constant input. As the challenge intensifies, players adjust their setups to withstand stronger enemies and maintain momentum. Exploiters aims to offer a steady, evolving gameplay loop centered around survival, scaling, and efficiency.

4543080.name: CHOMP CHOMP Carnage
4543080.about_the_game:
The ocean is alive. And it's made of yarn.

CHOMP CHOMP Carnage is an arcade fish-eating game that's fast, satisfying, and bursting with cute chaos.

Dive into a hand-crafted knit ocean where every fish, predator, and prey is stitched together from wool and thread.

Grow big enough to eat the fish above you until nothing can catch you. Don't get eaten by the ones above that.

EAT. GROW. REPEAT.

Start as a small vulnerable fish in a sea full of things that want to eat you. Devour everything smaller than you, dodge everything that isn't. Watch out for environment perks and hazards too. Each tier you climb can open up a new prey. Work your way up the food chain. Start small, survive long, and become the apex predator of the knitted sea.

CARNAGE MODE

Eat fast enough and you'll trigger Carnage Mode- a frenzied window where your score multiplier climbs and nothing can slow you down. Keep the chain going. The moment you stop feeding, the clock starts ticking. Squeeze every bite out of the frenzy before it runs out.

POWER UP YOUR BITE

Grab floating powerups to swing the odds in your favor. Burst into a speed dash, accelerate straight into Carnage Mode, or unleash a screen-clearing chomp that wipes every fish in sight. The right powerup at the right moment turns a desperate scramble into a highlight reel.

HAZARDS

Mines, patrols, jellyfish and more. Watch out for unexpected effects that these hazards have. Learn what each hazard does, then decide: dodge it, or use it to shake a predator off your tail. What hurts you can also hurt them.

A WORLD LIKE NO OTHER

No scales. No slime. Every fish, predator, and ocean creature in CHOMP CHOMP Carnage is crafted from knit and wool. Cozy to look at. Carnivorous to play.

4543090.name: Simply Higher or Lower
4543090.about_the_game:
Simply Higher or Lower is simple. You must guess if the next card is higher or lower than the current one presented. Get 10 in a row and you win. This means that you can technically finish the game in 10 clicks. It can also take forever.

I hope you enjoy this small project and have some fun with it for a while. It's not a complicated game, but it's mine.

4543360.name: The Office: Dirty Affairs
4543360.about_the_game:
Step into the world of high stakes corporate ambition where success isn't just earned, it's negotiated through power, influence and dangerous relationships.

You play as Tony, an ambitious employee competing for a coveted executive position in a company on the brink of a major merger. But in this office, promotions aren't just about performance, they are shaped by manipulations and the secrets people keep behind closed doors.

Form relationships with a cast of complex characters.

As tensions rise, you will face choices that will test your loyalty, ambition and morality.

4543390.name: Medieval Castle Simulator
4543390.about_the_game:
Claim a fallen castle and rebuild it from the ground up. Transform a humble stronghold into a mighty medieval fortress.

Customize Your Castle 

Personalize every corner of your castle. Expand you market, decorate spaces, and optimize layouts to make your stronghold unique. 

Grow Your Castle 

As your wealth increases, expand your castle and open new areas to grow your economy and strengthen your domain. 

 

Hire & Manage Employees 

Recruit villagers to automate tasks and optimize your castle’s operations, but remember, loyal workers don’t come for free! 

 

Protect Your Goods 

Not everyone comes to buy. Keep an eye out for thieves day and night, and protect your valuable resources. Justice must be served, but how you deal with them is up to you.

 

Keep It Clean 

Keep your castle clean. Maintain cleanliness to attract more customers and keep your empire running smoothly.

4543470.name: ProBelt
4543470.about_the_game:
By placing mathematical operators on a grid and connecting them by conveyor belts you need to get to a specific result in order to solve tasks and level up.

Each task starts with a source producing numbers and a goal that expects a specific result. On the way from the source to the goal construct conveyor belts leading in and out of operators. At the end the number(s) delivered to the goal must match the requirements. 

Operators are similar to what's part of a programming language, like if-else constructs, memory cells, for loops, modulo, square roots or stacks. There are also operators to display results, like a 7-Segment display.

The game uses real numbers.

Each level upgrade unlocks additional operators.

A level editor (unlocked when highest level reached) allows players to produce tasks. In the level editor a (proprietary) script language is used to calculate what number(s) the source produces and what number(s) the goal expects.

There is a sandbox mode in which players can freely build whatever they want using the operators available at the current level.

Each new operator gets explained in a tutorial or in a task.

4543490.name: Infinite Museum
4543490.about_the_game:
Trapped inside a museum on Floor 9, your goal is simple: reach G Floor and escape.

But as you descend, the museum begins to change. Subtle anomalies appear in each corridor, forcing you to carefully observe your surroundings and decide which exit to take.

Enter the elevator with the RED light above if you notice something unusual.

Enter the elevator with the GREEN light if everything appears normal.

A correct decision takes you one floor lower. A mistake sends you all the way back to Floor 9.

Test your memory, attention, and nerves in a looping psychological horror experience where even the smallest detail could be the difference between progress and starting over.

Features:

Psychological set inside a mysterious museum

Spot anomalies and choose the correct path

Loop-based structure with constant tension

Simple controls, observation-focused gameplay

Steam achievements

4543500.name: MicroMacro: Downtown Detective
4543500.about_the_game:
MicroMacro: Downtown Detective merges hidden-object and detective game into a new genre with a surprising narrative depth.

Step into a cartoon city, jam-packed with details, goofy characters – and loads of crimes. Search for clues, follow suspects and make clever deductions to crack all cases.

4543520.name: hEvEN oN sNOrF

4543590.name: Leave a Message
4543590.about_the_game:
The anything goes party game!

Leave a Message is the ultimate unfiltered party game where your friends and family can test their wits and flex their humour by answering increasingly silly prompts with recorded voice answers!

Buy once and party hard forever!

Fun for everyone!

Players join via their phones, tablets or browser tabs to jump in on the action! The game supports up to 6 players and also supports audience participation through voting!

Each round, players vote for the funniest voice recording leading to tons of laughs and tons of fun!

Perfect for playing online with friends!

4543620.name: Milky Way: Chumak Trail
4543620.about_the_game:
Under the endless sky of the Milky Way, the road stretches across the silent steppe.

You are a Chumak — a trader, a traveler, a keeper of an ancient path. Your caravan carries salt from distant shores, moving slowly through wind, dust, and time itself.

The journey is long. The nights are quiet. The stars are your only guide.

Manage your caravan, care for your oxen, and make choices that shape your fate. Trade with settlements, endure hardship, and listen to the stories carried by the road.

This is not a race. This is a journey.

A journey through history, through memory, through the land itself.

Follow the Chumak Trail.

Features

• Guide a traditional Chumak caravan across the Ukrainian steppe

• Trade salt and goods along ancient routes

• Care for oxen and manage your supplies

• Experience a calm, atmospheric journey under the stars

• Inspired by Ukrainian history and folklore

• A meditative blend of strategy and storytelling

4543670.name: Stack Match
4543670.about_the_game:

You Can:

4543680.name: Yet Another Shift
4543680.about_the_game:
JUST A WORK

You are a checkpoint guard at a facility run by Prion Solutions. Your job is simple: check the documents, follow the rules, approve or deny entry.

You don't know what happens behind the gates. You don't need to know.

YET ANOTHER SHIFT

Every day brings new instructions. New criteria for who gets in. The rules keep changing and if you think about them too long, they start to feel wrong. But the pay comes on time, and you have your reasons for being here.

HOME, SWEET HOME

At the end of each shift, you go home. Watch the news. Eat something. Sleep. Try to connect the dots.

Every decision at your desk echoes in headlines you'd rather not read. The truth about Prion Solutions accumulates and eventually overflows. Whether you choose to see it is up to you. But the consequences won't stop at you.

4543710.name: Shilutey Shopping Avenue
4543710.about_the_game:
It’s a tower defense game disguised as a management/city building game. 

Customers are coming to your street. They are happy if they can spend all their money. They are sad if they have to take cash home. Your job is to make sure that nobody is sad again by building all the shops you can. 

In this game you have one street. Not the whole city, just one street. You have to make it the best street. The game has 30+ different buildings (Shops, Restaurants, Bus stop, etc.) for you to choose from. You can build the same buildings multiple times or you can build different ones. 

There are two main resources in the game: money and happiness. You need money to build and you get money from customers. Happier customers spend more money. The more money they spend, the better shops you can build. Better shops make customers more happy. This is the cycle of shopping and happiness. 

What will I get?

Demo:

  • Normal - you have to keep customers happiness at 100%

  • Easy - you have to keep customer happiness at 70% or above

Survive mode of play with two different difficulties. You lose as soon as you don’t meet the requirements of the challenge. Playing multiple times will make you better at the game, which in turn will let you survive for longer. 

Full game - you will get a list of various missions.

Mission:

  • Council orders - 18 levels with different success conditions.

  • Festive Shopping - 10 levels, each one with higher profit goals. 

  • Money Maker - one level with increasing profit goals.

  • Money Baker - one level with increasing profit goals and limits on what you can build.

  • Happy Shopper - keep happiness at a target level. 

  • Happy Hopper - keep happiness at a target  level with limits on what you can build.

  • Foodie - feed customers with increasing food consumption goals. 

After each successful level you can unlock new buildings and spend experience point on upgrades which will make your life easier in the next level. 

Is this game for you? 

If you need hand holding, this game doesn’t do that. It lets you make your own mistakes and find out what works. 

If you like games that punish you, this game is also not for you. This game is hard, but not that hard. 

You can read hints to play better, or not. We don’t care. Whatever...

Will this game run on my computer?

I bought my computer in 2022 for work. It has an integrated graphic card, so most games don't work on it. If you don’t have the latest PC, that’s okay. This game should work.

4543920.name: A Playground Afternoon

An online 2-25 player party platformer game that lets you and your friends compete in classic playground games.

Customise your character, start up a lobby and invite all your friends!

4543940.name: SlimeSurvivor
4543940.about_the_game:
Slime Survivor is a roguelite where you raise quirky slime characters and fight off endless waves of enemy slimes. New builds, new strategies, and unexpected chaos — every run is a fresh adventure.

Choose Your Path

After each battle, you decide where to go next. Your choices shape the difficulty, the rewards, and how your run ends.

Normal Zone — A straightforward fight with modest rewards. Pick this when you want to push forward and save your strength for what's ahead.

Elite Zone — Packed with dangerous enemies, but the loot matches the risk. Only if you're feeling confident.

Shop — Spend the gold you've earned to grab powerful upgrades. Explosion, piercing, chain, split — completely reshape the way you fight.

Boss Zone — The final gate of each area. Take down a powerful boss and walk away with a unique weapon.




Survive the Wave

Each zone throws a relentless swarm of enemies at you within a time limit. Wipe them out, outlast them, or just barely scrape by — if you're still standing, you move on. And it only gets harder. More enemies, faster, deadlier.

Cute Slimes. Serious Gameplay.

They bounce, they jiggle, they look adorable — but every slime has unique abilities and a distinct playstyle. Which slime you pick and which items you combine completely changes your strategy. Every run feels like a new puzzle to solve.

Fair warning: you might look up and realize it's 4 AM.

4543950.name: Escape Plan
4543950.about_the_game:
You have ended up in prison and immediately you don't want to be here. You need to escape.

Escape Plan is a top down strategy style game with narative mechanics similar to Dwarf Fortress that together with interacting with the prison and it's residents you will find a way to plan your escape.

You don't know who is in here with you and what type of character they are. Who do you try to communicate with! Who to avoid and who to fight against! Also, who has a certain talent or skill that would be helpful in escaping. Finding out what type of Inmates ( as well as Guards ) are in the prison with you, effects how your escape pans out. Do you go for the stealthy escape or full on with your gang and fighting your way out.

Your inmates don't have many attributes. Only two. Threat level and intellect But the narrative will give you many different options depending on your actions. There will not just be one way but more than one way execute a part of your escape plan. You will not be able to jump ahead and say go straight in and make that phone call to bribe a guard or just create your ultimate gang by trial an error. Maybe there will be a narrative ( found out through other inmates etc. ) to find out some information such as one of your gang members wants a certain luxury item. Then you will go on your quest to get that item.

Find out about the characters that surround you through interaction and clues through the narrative that unfolds as you play. Your journey to the final escape location can be played out in many ways with many different types of communications and objects and locations etc. Not just one set route.

You can start of as any of the Inmates that has a certain skill set that effects the narrative So a Inmate with a pick pocket talent will give the player a different narrative than say playing as a thug with a high threat level but low intellect.

Controlling your character is by paths and choosing which locations to go to. But not directly controlling them by steering them around like other games. This makes the gameplay like a real prison ( I presume ! ) where you have your routines to attend ( canteen times and roll call etc.) and just have that little window to go somewhere else to slip buy the guards or get an object or to pick another route to avoid someone.

There is character interaction with just the following five choices. Talk, attack, follow, observe and avoid as well as selecting your route around the prison. Together with your prison routines and the guards keeping an eye on you the narrative mechanic with throw at you story lines about your fellow inhabitants and behind the scenes unlock your progress towards your escape.

With the five actions together and the narrative mechanic you can create at least the following situations. Instruct inmates, use decoys, create an escape team, create a gang, get objects, craft objects,crawl through ducts, stash items, use the telephone, get outside information from your visitors, bribe characters, climb ropes, pick locks, hack digital locks, use vehicles, oh, and of course . . . dig tunnels. Whether the guards and inmates allow you to do these actions is another matter. Some may even steal your objects or inmates tell other inmates about your plans etc. that will hamper your progress.

The way out is easy. Just create that escape plan.

4543970.name: Fallen Scout
4543970.about_the_game:
Fallen Scout is a cozy yet mysterious 2D adventure about a tiny scout who took one wrong step and came tumbling down a cliff. Now stranded in a forest laid in shadow, that definitely didn't look this creepy from up there, he now must find his way through the darkness armed with nothing but courage, determination, and a surprisingly powerful flashlight.

The forest has been swallowed by shadow, and the things lurking in it are not friendly. Brutes that block your path, cat-like creatures that watch you from the bushes, and bat-things that dive from above. Lucky for you, they all share one weakness: they really, really hate light. Point your flashlight at them to slow them down, and keep it on them long enough to melt them into nothing. Just don't let them get too close.

Features:

  • Use your flashlight to slow and melt shadow enemies

  • Face off against three enemy types: big, sneaky, and flying

  • Solve environmental and light-based puzzles to progress

  • Discover hidden secrets and collectibles

  • Stunning 2D art no matter where you look

  • A complete story-driven adventure

Made with <3 (and Unity) by Fallen Interactive

4543990.name: Soviet Shop Simulator
4543990.about_the_game:
Manage your own grocery store and prove yourself as an entrepreneur in challenging times of the past.
In this simulator, you have the opportunity to build and run your own business from scratch. Order products, take care of the interior design, serve impatient customers, and deal with thieves. Grow your business, increase your reputation, and survive unpredictable events. Work day and night. You decide your store’s opening hours. Stock your shop with over 120 stylized products from various categories such as vegetables, fruits, meat, dairy, beverages, canned goods, spices, preserves, alcohol, sweets, and cleaning & hygiene products, available through purchasing 21 licenses. Remember that soaring inflation affects the rising prices of products and licenses, so making thoughtful investment decisions and managing your store’s pricing is crucial. Rapid growth and a wide assortment may attract thieves, but fortunately a local fixer can help you deal with them. The game also features special events that may seem challenging at first but, when used wisely, can bring significant profits such as floods or power plant failures.

ORDER PRODUCTS

Use the computer to order products and shelves, purchase licenses, take loans, and hire employees.

STOCK STORE

Collect ordered goods delivered by truck from the parking lot behind the store. Place them on shelves as quickly as possible so customers have access to all available products each morning.

SET PRICES

You decide the prices of products in your store. Rapid inflation means you will often need to increase prices to keep up with rising wholesale costs. Setting prices too high will discourage customers and negatively impact your reputation.

SERVE CUSTOMERS

Scan products, take payments, and give correct change as quickly as possible. Long queues can reduce your store’s reputation on the local market.

DECORATE INTERIOR

A local trader is always happy to help you improve your store’s appearance. They offer plaster for repairing walls, a variety of colorful paints, and tiles in many unique patterns.

TRY YOUR LUCK

High inflation, rapid expansion, or a lack of customers may leave you short on cash. In such cases, you can try your luck in the lottery and win the grand prize.

SPECIAL EVENTS

Survive unpredictable natural disasters and city events and try to turn them into profit.

4544030.name: I'm blocked
4544030.about_the_game:
In this game, your objective is to survive for 14 days by protecting yourself inside your house. To stay alive, you must build and maintain wooden barricades that cover the windows of your shelter. These barricades are essential for your survival and must be placed and repaired using wood. At the beginning of the game, a radio message informs you that you need to stay inside and wait for the authorities to arrive. After that, you are on your own and must rely on your actions to survive. To gather resources, you can go into the garden and cut down trees using an axe. By cutting trees, you obtain wood, which is the only resource used to create and repair barricades. Managing your wood carefully is important, as you need enough to keep your defenses intact for the entire duration. Your goal is to survive all 14 days by maintaining your barricades and making sure your shelter remains protected.

The game features a left-click pickup mechanic and a right-click throw mechanic.

Build your barricade and place it on the windows.

To get more wood, you have to pick up the axe and throw it at the tree.

4544070.name: Entermoney
4544070.about_the_game:
Play as John, a construction worker dissatisfied with his life who dreams of becoming a rock star. After being scammed by the God of that world, he sets off on a journey to recover his money while helping God’s employees and improving their lives.

GAMEPLAY

The game map is played from a top-down camera. The player progresses through different areas, each with its own theme and main character, such as water, vampires, technology, etc.

When touching an enemy, the camera shifts to a 3D arena, featuring beat ‘em up-style combat with RPG elements, including levels, new combos, unlockables, and other battle systems.

The game constantly evolves, introducing new mechanics and abilities in each area. In certain moments, even without touching an enemy, entering a scene will switch the camera to 3D, with enemies attacking you as you move forward through the environment.

CHARACTER INTERACTION

Each area introduces new characters, each with a strong and exaggerated personality. After all, Entermoney is about broken and traumatized people who hide deep pain for different reasons.

However, with John, a cheerful and charismatic protagonist, they can be helped, and little by little, begin to overcome their insecurities. Even though they work for the God who stole John’s money, they ultimately decide to help him.

Without realizing it, the people John helps also help him in return, easing his own fears and sadness. Because even he hides tragedies within himself. The heart of Entermoney isn’t just the gameplay, but also the characters and how they connect.

EXAMPLE OF INTERACTION: the sprites of the faces of the characters that are in the dialogues! like the game protagonist, john.

CREDITS

  • Written and created by Yago de Azevedo

  • Programmed by Jonathan Moreno

  • Cover art by Taki

Thank you for reading this far.

4544080.name: Rogue Sundown

Outplay your opponent in a fast-paced splitscreen duel where every decision counts.

Rogue Sundown is a local splitscreen showdown built around fast, responsive combat. Set in a desert village, players duel using a mix of shooting, melee attacks, and movement abilities to gain the upper hand.

Close the distance with aggressive melee strikes, control space with precise gunplay, or reposition quickly to outplay your opponent. Quick to learn—but every fight is won by skill. Rogue Sundown delivers a focused, action-driven experience built for shared play.

🔥 Key Features:

🎮 Local splitscreen multiplayer combat
🔫 Fast-paced shooting and melee mechanics
⚡ Fluid movement and responsive controls
🌿 Village arena designed for dynamic encounters

4544200.name: True Confession
4544200.about_the_game:
True Confession

True Confession is a game aimed at fans of action movies 80-00 years (Heat, Training Day, The Wire, The Departured). In visual style resembles postal plus, crimsonland, gta2. So it's oldschool but seasoned with modern mechanics and deep religious and psychological plot.

The main character (Henry Hughes) tormented by nightmares, in which he dreams of gunfights and murders. Henry is a religious man and he is frightened by the attraction of anger and hatred that he experiences in his dreams - with these feelings he goes to the pastor and consults with him.

Every day echoes in Henry's subconscious, in his ruthless dreams. 

It covers the topics of crime in the streets, emotions, religion, psychoanalysis, alcoholism, unemployment and so on.

The game is hardcore, each opponent can pose a fatal threat and gives rise to a healthy sense of rivalry. True Confession is distinguished by its down-to-earthness, the game does not have automatic health regeneration and superpowers, an important distinctive mechanic of the game is "anger".

As the game aims to feel grounded, there are no rocket launchers, flamethrowers, or tanks — this game is about crime in the streets, not the battlefield.

All graphics and animations are handdrawn and 3d rendered, without any use of AI.

Let's go and pray/play together!

4544260.name: Lumory: A Distant Summer
4544260.about_the_game:
Lumory: A Distant Summer

Explore a bright, surreal world shaped by liminal spaces and distant summer memories.
Drift through soft blue-green environments inspired by early 2000s aesthetics—calm, open, and free from danger.

Glide with Your Childhood Scooter

Movement is at the heart of your journey.

Ride a childhood scooter—simple, familiar, and full of memory—now reimagined with smooth, weighty motion.
Glide across land, flow through open spaces, and even travel over water.

What once was a small object from the past becomes your way forward—
leading you to hidden paths and new perspectives.

See Beyond with Dream Vision

Reveal what cannot be seen.

With a single input, the world transforms—
hidden light emerges, paths shift, and impossible routes unfold before you.

A closed door may dissolve into light.
A distant space may suddenly become reachable.

Dream Vision is not just a tool—it's how you navigate the unseen.

Capture the Perfect Shot

Frame quiet, surreal compositions and capture fleeting moments of light and space.

Explore and Interact

4544280.name: Project GOVNOVOSIS
4544280.about_the_game:
DIRTY WORK, BIG CALIBER

The end of the world is a drag, sure, but clogged sewers won’t unclog themselves. In this game, you take command of the most underrated combat unit in history: the vacuum truck. Surrounded by thousands of foes, your rig must keep moving, drenching monsters in automatic fire and flooding the arena with toxic surprises. Crush them under your wheels, blast them with the hose, and never slow down!

CRAFT YOUR ABSURD BUILD

As in any proper action-roguelike, the key to survival is the right build. Collect XP from fallen enemies, level up, and pick your upgrades. Turn your basic pump into a weapon of mass destruction! Combine primary weapons with dozens of passive skills: increase your splash radius, boost reload speeds, or mount ram on your bumper. Every run is unique.

ARTIFACTS AND META-PROGRESSION

Didn’t survive the shift? No big deal. Between runs, use your hard-earned resources to buy global upgrades. Discover unique artifacts that fundamentally change your playstyle, unlock new specialized vehicles, and prove that a sewage truck driver is at the top of the food chain.

4544440.name: COREateral
4544440.about_the_game:
2040. Corporations have discovered faster-than-light travel. The result? An interstellar gold rush. Every company scrambles to assemble makeshift robots from spare parts, loads them into rockets, and ships them off to uncharted exoplanets. You are one of them. Rusty. Expendable. Competing against seven other robots with the exact same objective.

SCAVENGE

Resources don't collect themselves. Drill, extract, stockpile - every second counts when other robots are doing the same.

UPGRADE

Spend your resources wisely. Turn your rusty scrap heap into the perfect machine

  • Create synergies with crazy effects

CONQUER

FEATURES

Coming soon

4544480.name: Ninja Vanish
4544480.about_the_game:
Billy falls asleep… and vanishes.

Pulled into a living dream, Billy becomes a ninja and must fight his way through a shifting world to find a way home. The forest is alive. It watches, reacts, and tests every move you make.

Run, jump, and battle your way through Forest World as you search for the first Stone of Eternity. Every path hides something. Every choice shapes your journey.

Explore deeper, move smarter, and stay sharp. The dream will not let you leave easily.

What to expect:

  • Fast-paced side-scrolling gameplay focused on movement, timing, and control

  • Action combat against forest creatures, spirits, and trickster enemies

  • Hidden story elements that reward exploration and curiosity

  • Secret paths, hidden areas, and collectible treasures throughout each level

  • Supporting characters who guide you and reveal more of the world

  • Puzzle and trial mechanics based on rhythm, observation, and decision-making

  • A dynamic environment that shifts and reacts as you progress

  • A grading system that tracks performance, encouraging replay and mastery

Find the Stones. Learn the rules. Find your way home.

4544490.name: Forgotten Fluff
4544490.about_the_game:
Enter a quiet, abandoned circus where something feels… unfinished.

The performers are still here, but not as they once were. As you wonder through mysterious, forgotten spaces, you’ll piece together the story of a place that was once full of life.

Solve a series of puzzles by interacting with objects in the environment. Progress comes from observation, experimentation, and connecting subtle clues scattered through the circus rooms.

As you move deeper into the circus, your role within it may not be what it first seemed.

Features

  • Atmospheric puzzle experience

  • Environmental storytelling

  • Carefully designed spaces filled with interactive details

  • A world that reveals itself through exploration

  • Unique vector artwork

4544520.name: R.E.C
4544520.about_the_game:
A routine counter-terror operation turns into a waking nightmare. You are an operative deployed to dismantle a deadly plot. But uncovers a hidden bioweapons lab. 

Disclaimer:

The R.E.C represents a work-in-progress version of the game. The story, gameplay mechanics, visuals, audio, and other features are still in active development. As a result, the R.E.C DEMO may not fully reflect the final experience.

Many elements shown or playable in the R.E.C will change, be improved, reworked, or removed entirely before the full release. The final version of the game will likely include significant updates, additional content, and various adjustments based on development progress and feedback.

Thank you.

A Cinematic Blend of Action and Psychological Horror

R.E.C is designed as a shooter intensity with deep survival horror elements.

Combat is grounded and deliberate, balancing survival resource management with sudden bursts of aggressive, high-impact encounters. Every bullet counts. Every decision matters.

Switch Perspectives. Change the Experience.

The Player can Seamlessly shift between immersive first-person combat and cinematic third-person. Experience firefights up close through the protagonist’s bodycam.

4544550.name: Dinobreak: The Hatching
4544550.about_the_game:
Dinosaurs are Cooler than Zombies

Look alive! The 2023 game DINOBREAK has been reimagined with the modern graphics of the latest Unreal Engine.

Revisit the rumble in the urban jungle in DINOBREAK as dinosaurs overwhelm the city of Cypress Ridge on a fateful night in 1999. Take a walk on the wild side with paleontologist Alex Muldone and her research team when their newly discovered saurian takes over the city. Band together with your team and survivors across the city to uncover the origins of the onslaught, and try to find a way to stop history from repeating itself.

Features

  • Multiple difficulty modes, including Assisted and Easy options to allow all players to enjoy the adventure!

  • Switch between over-the-shoulder or first-person shooter modes at any time during gameplay.

  • Classic survival horror mechanics meld with intense action and hordes of monsters.

  • Extremely cheesy and stiff voice acting to bring the past alive.

  • Experience the entire story in a narrative driven classic campaign.

  • Hit the arcade in Operation: Feral Raptor, a non-stop action packed bonus mode across the entire city.

  • Limited inventory space and saving will keep you on your toes.

  • Extreme gore paints the city in blood as the dinosaur's rampage unfolds.

4544560.name: Outbreak The Fedora Files: What Lydia Knows - Known Factors
4544560.about_the_game:
Super and extra-natural phenomena around the world are officially disavowed. In the United States, these phenomena are unofficially investigated by an elite squad of agents known as the Federal Disaster Organic Response Agency, FEDORA. These are their stories…

In this second file of “The FEDORA Files” three-part limited series: What Lydia Knows, intrepid detective Lydia Daniels takes her fight to cleanse the heart of the corruption in Cypress Ridge to the halls of power, or City Hall, to be exact. Join old friends and make or break alliances old and new as you search for evidence that will shed light on the whole conspiracy. It’s up to you to find out who is really pulling the strings in this second installment that acts as a prequel to Outbreak: Shades of Horror.

Features

  • Narrative rich visual novel with a deep and engrossing storyline.

  • Meet, befriend, or alienate a wide cast of characters where your relationships matter.

  • The road not taken: your choices determine the evidence you find, but the road not traveled may have been the one that saved you.

  • Create alliances: Decide whether to stand with your friends or join city hall to uncover the truth.
4544560.game_link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4544560/Outbreak The Fedora Files: What Lydia Knows - Known Factors/

4544570.name: Bara Coloring Book
4544570.about_the_game:
It all started with an unexpected gift. A close friend handed you a blank coloring book with a promise: these pages hold more than just outlines.

In Bara Coloring Book, you are invited to pick up your virtual brushes and add color to a series of stunning illustrations. As you relax, filling in the details and uncovering sensual scenes, the book comes to life. Every completed page not only reveals beautiful artwork but also unlocks a chapter of that character's personal story.

Who are these imposing men? What are their desires, secrets, and passions? The only way to find out is through your colors.

Features

  • Stunning Artwork: 50 illustrations focusing on muscular, charming men, ready for your artistic touch.

  • Captivating Stories: Each character has their own lore. Finish the painting to read engaging tales about them.

  • Relaxing Atmosphere: Pressure-free gameplay, perfect for unwinding and enjoying the moment at your own pace.

  • Personal Gallery: Save your completed masterpieces and revisit the stories of your favorite characters whenever you like.
4544570.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian

4544580.name: TIRE LAUNCHER TOGETHER
4544580.about_the_game:
CO-OP chaos begins here in TIRE LAUNCHER TOGETHER! 🔧🔥

Play with 1 to 4 players… but seriously, who would want to play alone? 😏😄

Gather your friends and prepare for the most scientific tire launching experiment ever conducted.

Grab the Tire Launcher, look around for literally anything and start creating absolute madness. A ladder? Perfect. A tent? That works. A cactus? Why not. A friend? Even better. Everything can be used. Everything can become a ramp. 😄

Launch tires like it is the most important mission of your life 🛞 And if there are no tires nearby, just grab a friend and launch them instead. Physics exists in this game, but sometimes it is not entirely sure whose side it is on.

Refuel this hellish machine with gasoline ⛽ Hit the right parts with a stick and build ramps from nearby objects. Then watch your construction either work perfectly or collapse in the most hilarious way possible.

Try to hit the target 🎯 It almost never works 😄

Something will break. Something will flip over. And sometimes it might suddenly work perfectly for no logical reason.

Work together in real time. Argue about who ruined everything. Add “just one more part” even though everyone knows it is a terrible idea.

Compete with your friends. Who builds the most efficient setup. Who creates the most ridiculous one. Or who launches a teammate straight into a cactus first.

No rules. No correct solutions. No guarantee of success.

Just you, your friends and the chaos you create together 🎉

4544620.name: Whispers of the Tallgrass
4544620.about_the_game:
Whispers of the Tallgrass is an atmospheric first-person survival horror set in an abandoned industrial wasteland overtaken by towering grass. Among rusting structures, derelict facilities, and overgrown pathways, something lurks in the tall grass, hunting you down. To survive, you must explore the area, scavenge for useful items, piece together what’s happening through scattered notes, and find a way to escape.

FEATURES

🎧 A variety of mysterious and frightening sounds of the night

The night is filled with many sounds — listen carefully, trying to recognize among them those that hide danger.

🕵️‍♂️ An relentless predator that tracks you using sight, hearing, and smell

You will have to think through your route in advance, keep moving constantly, and at the same time try to remain as hidden as possible.

🌾 Wild thickets of giant grass as both shelter and a source of danger

Use the dense overgrowth to hide, but remember: what conceals you may also conceal your pursuer.

🏭 The setting of an abandoned industrial wasteland

Explore grim deserted industrial sites in search of key items necessary for escape.

🌀 An anomalous zone

The tall grass hides not only the predator, but also strange anomalies, encounters with which lead to unforeseen consequences.

🚪 Several escape paths and outcomes

Your discoveries and decisions will determine the outcome, depending on what you find and what risks you are willing to take.

🎲 Randomized item placement

Key items are placed differently in each playthroug, creating your own unique personal experience.

📖 Understanding what is happening depends on your attentiveness

Find notes and tablets left by others to piece together the puzzle of the events unfolding here.

💾 Limited saves

Progress is saved only in certain places, giving each decision additional weight and tension.

4544630.name: Tac-Tile
4544630.about_the_game:
Fight Together as a team.

Fight jelly monsters with a friend in this co-op dice battle game. Glide across a colorful board, stack powerful perks, and take down the boss before your turns run out.

What is Tac-Tile?

Tac-Tile is a turn-based co-op board game where two players work together to defeat a boss on a hex grid. Each turn you roll dice to move, land on tiles that grant perks or cost you hearts, and battle the boss using a Yahtzee-inspired combat system — but here's the twist: a lower score is better.

Features

  • A unique combat mechanic inspired by Yahtzee — roll your dice, lock matches, and make every turn count

  • Multiple bosses each with their own abilities and phases to keep you on your toes

  • 30+ perks ranging from shields and teleports to the legendary Forbidden One — an instant win if you can pull it off

  • A wide roster of perks to keep your run strong and your enemies underfoot

  • Customizable player token skins earned with coins you get just from leveling up and playing

  • Unique emotes you can show off while playing

  • Player cards that you can save and share to social media to show off your best stats

More to Come

New bosses, perks, and content are on the way in future updates. This is just the beginning.

4544650.name: Astro Hop
4544650.about_the_game:
About This Game

A classic 2D platformer set in a colorful and cute world. Your goal is simple: guide your character, overcome obstacles, avoid deadly traps, and reach the exit gate at the end of the level. Time your moves perfectly and survive without falling!

Features:

  • 30 Different Levels: Complete 30 challenging stages to succeed.

  • Classic Platforming Mechanics: Jump, dodge moving saws, and watch out for lava pits.

  • Simple and Clean Design: Minimalist, sweet, and colorful pixel/vector graphics.

  • Fast-Paced Gameplay: Short and fun gaming sessions with easy-to-learn controls.

4544690.name: The Labyrinth
4544690.about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS GAME 

Dare to face the darkness?

The Labyrinth is more than just a maze; it is a test of your sanity. Plunged into an oppressive and dark environment, every turn could be your last. Here, silence is your only ally, and light is a distant luxury.

In this disturbing psychological horror game, your senses will betray you. The walls seem to shift, whispers multiply, and the feeling of being watched will never leave you.

Key Features:

  • Oppressive Atmosphere: A dark and visceral visual experience designed to keep you under constant tension.

  • Mental Challenge: Test your sense of direction and stress resistance in a labyrinth where logic fades before fear.

  • Pure Horror: No defense, no easy way out. Only your will allow you to survive the darkness.

The labyrinth awaits. No one emerges unscathed.

4544700.name: Skazka form №7. Volost Board
4544700.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Volost Administration. The work here is hard, but on the bright side — it’s dangerous. You’ll find the specifics in the manual, but in short: take in petitioners, settle disputes, lead investigations, and hand cases over to the court. The rest? We’ll see. Don't steal, don't kill, stay on good terms with the geese, and if you see Koschei — leave him be. He's mine.

Everything seems fine in the Faraway Kingdom: peasants are brawling, heirs are feuding, and neighbors are tossing each other around on pitchforks. In other words, nothing special — pure bliss. But something feels off in this "paradise" at the very edge of the realm. And what are the odds that all these troubles will land right on the head of a rookie investigator in a backwater administrative office?

What awaits you:

  • An atmospheric quest in a Slavic folklore setting. Conduct interrogations, track down witnesses, and gather evidence.

  • The scales of justice in your hands. Settle local disputes in the role of a magistrate.

  • True detective work. Collect and verify documents, physical evidence, and tracks.

  • Life at the Administration. Immerse yourself in the daily routine of a tight-knit team, complete with simple jokes, unique characters, and the cozy atmosphere of a Russian tea party amidst the chaos.
