Russian*, English
*languages with full audio support

4544740.name: Tiny Throne
4544740.about_the_game:
YOUR DECK IS YOUR KINGDOM

Tiny Throne is a strategic roguelike deckbuilder. Start with a humble set of blueprints and draft your way to a thriving empire. Every building you place, every resource you gather, and every unit you deploy comes from the cards you choose.

EXPAND YOUR MINIATURE EMPIRE

Every inhabitant is a resource. Your population represents your Action Points, use them to draft new blueprints, play cards, or reshuffle your deck.

  • Synergy is Key: Place farms next to mills for food bonuses, or fortify your village with cannons.

  • Manage the Harvest: Your people need to eat! If your food supply fails, your population drops, and your actions vanish. Balance growth with survival.

DEPLOY YOUR ARMIES

Prepare in the building phase, then strike in the Attack Phase.

  • Tactical Raiding: Use your gathered units to lay siege to enemy villages.

  • Loot & Level Up: Victory brings treasure chests filled with cards and resources to bolster your deck for the next day.

  • Hold the Line: Defenses are not optional. Watch the calendar, prepare your catapults, and protect your houses. If a house falls, the families inside, and your action points, fall with it.

VISIT THE SHOP

Refine your deck, buy powerful cards and give a twist to your run.

KEY FEATURES

  • Strategic Hex-Building: Spatial puzzles meet resource management.

  • Deckbuilding Roguelike: Draft and delete cards to optimize your run.

  • Dynamic Combat: Both defensive survival and offensive raiding phases.

  • The "Cozy-Hardcore" Loop: Charming visuals paired with a punishing, rewarding economy.

4544780.name: TideWane
4544780.about_the_game:
DIVE DEEP

Descend into waters teeming with life. Your submarine auto-attacks nearby targets while you manage oxygen, collect PSI energy, and hunt for treasure. Each dive pushes deeper — how far can you go before the pressure crushes you?

KILL EVERYTHING

Face dozens of fish species across 5 ocean zones — from darting minnows in the Shallows to armored leviathans in the Hydrothermal Vents. Build massive kill combos for bonus PSI. Hunt 25 milestone bosses guarding the depths.

BUILD YOUR POWER

Spend PSI energy across a sprawling upgrade grid. Boost damage, speed, oxygen capacity, combo multipliers, and more. Unlock passive abilities that transform your submarine into a deep-sea killing machine.

ASCEND AND TRANSCEND

Three prestige layers reshape your progression:

  • Ascension resets your PSI grid but earns Pearls for a second upgrade grid

  • Transcendence resets everything but earns Void Cores for permanent endgame power

  • The Void Tree offers 30 nodes across 5 branches — including the path to the OMEGA ending

COLLECT AND FORGE

Discover 36 artifacts with unique effects. Forge them to higher levels using salvage from Deep Dive mode. Complete the bestiary documenting every creature you've encountered.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR SUB

Unlock 20 submarine skins and 16 cursor designs. Each sub has a unique look rendered in pixel art style.

FEATURES

  • 5 ocean zones with distinct atmospheres and enemy types

  • 25 milestone bosses with unique mechanics

  • 3 prestige layers — Ascend, Transcend, Void

  • Hundreds of upgrades across PSI, Pearl, Void, Drift, and Zone grids

  • 36 collectible artifacts with forge levels

  • Deep Dive endless mode with mid-dive events

  • 20 submarine skins + 16 cursors

  • 100 Steam achievements

  • Procedural audio — every sound is synthesized in real time

  • Full settings control — auto-dive, screen shake, damage numbers, and more

4544820.name: Rogue Planet
4544820.about_the_game:
Welcome to the world of Rogue, or the Village of Veloria more specifically. The rest of Rogue is off limits, unless you can find the exit? 

A team of outcasts, set to discover truth and dismantle suffering

Play as Reva, an optimistic yet slightly immature inhabitant of Rogue and her friends Opal, Lular and Strella on adventure to the outside of Veloria and beyond. Reva and her village are from a foreign planet, where warfare forced them to exile, but the walls reveal there is something more to the story, potentially that the cycle of war is continuous. Paired with Stella's secrecy, Opals insight, and Lular's intellect, Reva's team will face many challenges and conflicts throughout this RPG Sci-Fi. 

Fight against the regime of Sangria

In the real world of Rogue, outside of Veloria's walls, there lies the essence of the unknown, and the contrast of imminent suffering and desirable happiness. Reva's party longed to see the beauty of the outside world, but will they regret their decision? Will they be able to stop the Sangrian regime?

Gameplay

This action-packed, story mode RPG features:

  • multiple endings

  • story-rich gameplay

  • turn-based combat

  • power behind hope.

The rules are simple: never let the bad guys win.

4544830.name: Tidy Shadows
4544830.about_the_game:
Tidy Shadows is a part hidden object and part decorating game where you navigate pitch‑black rooms by flashlight and uncover different messes needing to be cleaned. Scrub, stash, mop, and deep clean every mess before it’s too late. Race against the clock as it counts down.

Prefer to just relax and rearrange your home instead?  No problem! Simply, shut off the time limit, flip on the lights, and decorate your home without time constraints.

4544940.name: The Infinite Grimoire
4544940.about_the_game:
Build your own magical academy and shape it into a growing arcane empire.

Start with simple production tables and create basic tomes. As you progress, merge your creations into stronger forms, unlock new knowledge, and expand your capabilities. Every decision pushes your academy further.

Train students, teach them powerful books, and send them out into the world. Scout new locations, gather resources, and take control of key regions to strengthen your influence.

Upgrade your academy, unlock new production lines, and optimize your workflow. Balance production, merging, and expansion to keep everything running smoothly.

The world doesn’t stop when you do. Your academy continues to produce, grow, and evolve even while you’re away.

Features

  • Build and upgrade your magical academy

  • Produce and merge arcane tomes into stronger forms

  • Train students and assign them tasks

  • Explore, scout, and expand across the world map

  • Unlock new production tables and systems

  • Manage your economy and optimize your growth

  • Fully idle progression — your academy keeps working while you’re offline

4545040.name: Unclaimed: Loot or Junk
4545040.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Unclaimed Goods Warehouse! 🏬

Every year, thousands of packages get lost, stuck at customs, or simply forgotten. To some, they’re just "lost mail," but to you, they’re a gold mine. Crack open boxes, examine the contents, and decide their fate: will it join your private collection or go straight to the market?

Your Collection, Your Pride! 🌟

Hidden among piles of everyday junk are unique sets of items. These aren't for sale. They are your trophies, your dream shelf. Can you find that one missing "green plastic soldier" or the fabled golden lightbulb?

One Person's Trash is Your Treasure! 🗑️

Not everything you find is museum-worthy. Old irons, worn-out tires, and empty cans are the foundation of your growth. Earn. Invest. Expand.

Tactile Experience & Thrill! 📦

  • Cardboard Boxes: Slice through tape with scissors or rip it open with your bare hands.

  • Wooden Crates: Enjoy the satisfying crunch of splintering wood.

  • Safes & Cases: Bring out the heavy tools to reach the most valuable prizes.

No deadlines, no rush. Just you, mountains of boxes, and the pure anticipation of what’s waiting inside.

What else awaits you in the game:

  • — Hundreds of Unique Finds: From worn-out tires to ultra-rare collectible artifacts.

  • — Unboxing Arsenal: Use scissors, crowbars, and bolt cutters to tackle different types of packaging.

  • — Physics & Chaos: Toss, drop, and watch as loot satisfyingly spills out of every crate.

  • — Collector’s Thrill: Hunt for complete themed sets—from retro gadgets to the ironic "Golden Junk" series.

  • — Progression & Growth: Sell your finds, expand your warehouse, and upgrade your stats.

  • — Endless Mode: Relax in a meditative treasure hunt with no timers, no penalties, and zero limits.

4545080.name: Smile Run
4545080.about_the_game: Smile Run is a level based endless runner.  Pick from two adorable characters.  Kit the wolf or Lily the dragon.  Run through 4 types of environments with different gameplay.  Jump through the Sky environment on multiple platforms, run through the Forest environment dodging trees, swim through the Water environment, and keep your torch lit as you run through the Cave.  Environments can change seamlessly during a single run.  Smile Run has two modes.  Deliver a gift to your friend in a timed Gift Delivery mode.  Or play endlessly while keeping your ice cream in Ice Cream mode.

4545110.name: Tell the Ocean
4545110.about_the_game:
Tell the Ocean

"Guaranteed to be more disappointing than the end of Stephen King's Dark Tower series."

This is not a game about fun. If that's what you're looking for, there are thousands of other wonderful games on Steam. This one is different.

Tell the Ocean is a quiet place to clear your thoughts, write what matters, and sit with yourself for a while.

The Journey

Level 1: The Bottle

A hut on a desert island. A typewriter. Write what's on your mind — the angry email you'll never send, the thing you need to let go of, the thought that's been circling for days. Bottle it. Throw it into the ocean or burn it in a fire. Release it. Let it go.

Level 2: The Library

A library in the desert. A window looking out at a dark tower in the distance. Here, you write your mantra. The thing

you want to hold onto. The word, the phrase, the intention that will guide you through the next level.

Level 3: The Grove

A small forest next to a tent. Five minutes of stillness. The mantra you wrote floats in front of you as you sit with it, accompanied by music and a view that doesn't ask anything of you.

Level 4: The Tower

You climb the tower. At the top, a typewriter on a pedestal. Here, you write your to-do list. The only thing you actually came here to do. The journey was the preparation. This is the work.

Why It Exists

I originally designed it to help with my writer's block, which it works wonders for. Sometimes you need to release what's stuck before you can focus on what matters. Because sitting still for five minutes is harder than it sounds. Because writing things down — even things you'll never show anyone — changes something.

Tell the Ocean teaches you things you didn't know you knew about yourself. It won't give you a dopamine hit or a high score. It will give you a place to sit with yourself for a while. That's all. That's enough.

Features

  • Bottle your thoughts and release them into the ocean or fire

  • Write a mantra in a desert library overlooking a distant tower

  • Five minutes of meditation

  • Beautiful music that doesn't rush you

  • A purple robotic cat to keep you company

  • A to-do list at the end of an epic journey that turns out to be exactly what you needed to write

4545120.name: Drowned Caves
4545120.about_the_game:
Atmospheric, short, and simple adventure puzzle game that gives the player freedom in finding the solution to the obstacles they encounter along the way. 

As an adventurer, you were unfortunate to be trapped in caves! Now, you are challenged to find a way out of the drowned caves. You'll experience a set of challenges that will randomly appear along your way, overcome them to find your way back.

Use your imagination, beat the array of puzzles, and complete the journey. But beware, those caves are not as simple as they first appear, they have secrets, you will be watched, and they will hide...

Explore a series of cave environments, moving from chamber to chamber to solve the riddles within. Dive into a dark atmosphere that tests the limits of your, in this realm of cold stone and dim corridors, only patient and sharp minds will find the way out.

4545170.name: EDU SIMULATOR
4545170.about_the_game:
«Found this CD-R in a trashed PC, "EDU SIMULATOR" written in Sharpie. Now EL EDU is the only thing I see when I close my eyes—PLEASE, reach the end, find the truth, so I can sleep at night again.»

ABOUT THIS GAME

EDU SIMULATOR is a satirical first-person survival horror roguelite. Inspired by the "slender-chase" era of 2012 but filtered through a gritty 90s technical aesthetic, it puts you against a shifting digital labyrinth. Your objective: survive the pursuit. To escape each floor, you must navigate randomly generated corridors, activate the buttons that power the exit doors, and avoid being caught by "EL EDU"—a relentless, two-dimensional entity that slides through the environment to hunt you down.

The core experience is built on a high-stakes roguelite loop. Every run forces you to adapt to new layouts where spatial awareness and strategic window vaulting are your only defenses. Survive a floor to gain temporary advantages, push deeper into the endless maze, and try to uncover what’s at the heart of the system before it’s too late.

FEATURES:

  • EL EDU: This game features EL EDU. (I've never seen another game bold enough to feature this!)

  • "CUTTING-EDGE" VISUALS: Boasting the absolute best graphics you will ever see in a game that specifically contains EL EDU.

  • RANDOMIZED DREAD: Every run generates a brand-new maze layout. If you fail, the system rebuilds itself—no memorization allowed.

  • DYNAMIC PERKS: Build unique strategies and synergies with up to 21 different perks to help you survive the deeper floors.

  • HIGH-OCTANE CHASES: Master your pathing and strategic window vaulting to obstruct EL EDU’s path. Warning: he gets faster and more aggressive with every floor you clear.

  • COLLECTIBLE POSTERS: Scour the maze for a variety of posters and complete your gallery of digital anomalies.
4545170.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Finnish, Japanese, Spanish - Latin America

4545200.name: Broken Crown
4545200.about_the_game:
Broken Crown is a fantasy real-time strategy game built for players who miss the depth and intensity of classic RTS titles — reimagined with modern systems and large-scale battles.

Build your base, gather resources, recruit armies, and command your forces in battles where formations, positioning, and decision-making truly matter.

In a world shattered after the fall of the Crown, factions rise from the ashes.
Only those who master economy, technology, and battlefield control will survive.

🛡️ What Makes It Different

Broken Crown is not just another RTS — it's built around control, clarity, and scale.

  • Battles with hundreds of units simultaneously (600–800+)

  • Units organized in real formations, not chaotic blobs

  • Clear battlefield readability, even in large engagements

  • Highly responsive units with improved pathfinding and behavior

👉 Every fight feels controlled, tactical, and meaningful.

⚔️ Key Features

  • 🏗️ Full base-building system with resource gathering and worker management

  • 👥 Diverse unit roster: infantry, archers, cavalry, scouts, and medics

  • 🧩 Dynamic formation system (frontline / backline logic)

  • 🧠 Smart unit behavior & optimized AI systems

  • 🌫️ Fog of War with smooth visibility transitions

  • 🧪 Research system that shapes your strategy

  • 🗺️ Structured campaign missions with objectives and lore

  • 🤖 Skirmish mode (up to 8 players)

  • 🎖️ Veterancy system — units grow stronger and visually evolve

  • 💾 Save & Load system with screenshots and match data

🧠 Gameplay Philosophy

Broken Crown rewards thinking, not spamming.

  • Reckless attacks will fail

  • Positioning wins battles

  • Strategic choices define your playstyle

👉 This is an RTS where how you fight matters more than how fast you click.

🌍 World & Atmosphere

The Crown has fallen.
The realm is fractured.
War is inevitable.

Each battle takes place in a world where power is contested and survival is earned — with map-specific context and emerging narrative elements.

🔮 Current & Future Content

  • Campaign missions with structured objectives

  • Fully playable skirmish mode

  • Ongoing improvements and balancing

Planned:

  • Endless survival mode (defend against waves)

  • More maps, units, and research options

  • Multiplayer (peer-to-peer)

👤 About the Developer

Broken Crown is entirely developed by a single developer.

Every system — from AI to formations, from combat to progression — has been designed and built with one goal:

👉 Create a true RTS experience, without compromise.

No shortcuts. No unnecessary systems.
Just strategy.

4545290.name: Madame Manager: Velvet Simulation
4545290.about_the_game:
💋 MADAME MANAGER: VELVET SIMULATION:

Puts you in charge of running a brothel. The fate of the city’s most intimate business will be shaped by your moral choices and management style. Think you’ve got what it takes?

🎮 CORE MECHANICS:

The day begins and a wide variety of customers flood into your establishment. Your job is to carefully match them with the right employees to maximize satisfaction. Not just your staff’s quality, but your venue’s overall vibe matters too.

🧼 EMPLOYEE CLEANUP:

After every encounter, your employees end up a total mess. As a responsible manager, it’s on you to clean them up and get them ready for the next client.

💉 ILLNESS & TREATMENT:

Some customers may carry diseases. After all, you can’t exactly ask a homeless guy walking into a brothel for a health certificate. Your employees can get sick, and it’s your responsibility to treat them.

🛎️ NEGOTIATING WITH CLIENTS:

Customers come in all types. Some crave the warmth of a woman, others want a rough, masculine presence. Some are drawn to their own gender. Remember: the more niche and personal the desire, the bigger the payout.

🏗️ VENUE UPGRADES:

You’ll take a rundown, grimy place and turn it into a dream-like entertainment hotspot. Unlock new rooms, upgrade beds, add a dance floor, a bar, and more—build the city’s ultimate attraction.

💵 COLLECTING MONEY & ROOM CLEANUP:

Some customers go all out emotionally… and physically. That usually leaves rooms in chaos. You’ll clean them up, because let’s be real—no one saves up for weeks just to walk into a filthy room. And yeah, don’t forget to grab your cash from the nightstand after the job’s done :)

🌈 HIRING EMPLOYEES:

People are unpredictable—especially when it comes to their hidden desires. Build a diverse roster of employees so every customer finds someone that fits their taste.

🔴 Madame Manager: Velvet Simulation is a thematic business management simulator. Its content follows these boundaries:

Visual Boundaries: No explicit sexual depiction or heavy nudity; only suggestive elements (like cleavage) that support the atmosphere.

NPC Safety: All characters are 18+. No non-consensual acts, even in fiction.

Substance Use: No content that promotes or encourages smoking or alcohol use.

4545350.name: The Pissing Game
4545350.about_the_game:
Enter a world where the most mundane of acts becomes a quest of legend. In this game, you confront the ultimate challenge of... relieving yourself into a bowl. But this is no ordinary bathroom break. As you aim, the world around you teems with relentless bugs, each one a small but formidable adversary. Every victorious strike rewards you with Piss-coins, the currency of this strange realm.

With Piss-coins, power grows. Upgrade your abilities, unlock hidden features, and gain access to mysterious new areas that lie outside the bathroom. And at the heart of it all lies the ultimate release, the sacred act that binds the journey together: the flush. What seems trivial at first becomes a ritual of strategy, skill, and discovery in a world that is as bizarre as it is captivating.

4545380.name: Parting Shadows
4545380.about_the_game:
Three strangers walk into a tavern. What happens next is up to you.

Parting Shadows is a story-driven RPG built around meaningful decisions. Every playthrough follows a different path through branching narratives filled with mystery, betrayal, and consequences that stick.

Three Complete Stories

The Stranger's Shadow -- A city hides a dark secret behind a familiar face.

Echoes in the Dark -- Wake in a cave with no memory. Trust no one.

The Woven Night -- Shared dreams unravel a conspiracy. Three endings await.

Each story stands alone with its own cast, mysteries, and branching paths. Choices you make determine which battles you fight, which allies you trust, and which endings you reach.

6 Classes. 34 Specializations.

Pick one of six starting classes and upgrade through two tiers of specialization as you progress. A Squire can become a Ranger, then a Hunter. A Mage can become an Acolyte, then a Priest. With 56 classes to discover, no two parties play the same.

Speed-Based Turn Combat

Battles use a speed-based turn system where faster characters act more often. Manage buffs, debuffs, and abilities across your three-member party to overcome increasingly dangerous enemies.

Play Your Way

Solo, local co-op for 2-3 players, or online multiplayer. Branch decisions are resolved by vote when playing with friends.

Built to Replay

Branching paths, hidden endings, a full enemy compendium, and 56 classes to discover. No single playthrough sees everything.

4545390.name: Hypnogenesis
4545390.about_the_game:
VIDEO SYNTHESIZER ARCADE GAME

Hypnogenesis is a short, experimental, video feedback space shooter in which arcade gameplay is integrated with the controls of a video synthesizer. You are the Fungal Fighter! Fly through the vortex and slip your tendrils into enemy minds. By exploring the game, players simultaneously experiment with the creation of emergent visuals.

A VARIETY OF EMERGENT VISUALS

All of the visual effects in Hypnogenesis are created with video feedback during gameplay. Player controls are latched to video parameters like brightness, contrast, hue, and xy position, which transform the behavior of the video feedback. Hypnogenesis has four stages offering a different set of relationships between player controls and video feedback.

PSYCHEDELIC SHMUP MEETS VIDEO ART

Before video games, televisions were one-way receivers of broadcast signals, and there wasn’t really a way to interact with the image. In the 1960s and 70s, video artists like Nam June Paik developed video synthesis to experiment with video signals, for example by warping the image with magnets, or by playing with video feedback. We imagine that Hypnogenesis is part of an alternative history of games that followed from this spirit of experimentation. In other words, what if video games were based on video synthesizers?

Created in openFrameworks using Andrei Jay's open source Video Waaaves software.

4545400.name: Infinite Night
4545400.about_the_game:
🤖 This game was 100% developed with AI (Claude Code) — from game design and programming to balancing and localization.

Infinite Night is a dark fantasy survivors-like action RPG where you must endure an unrelenting onslaught of monsters in a cursed world beneath a blood-red moon.

⚔️ Choose Your Hero, Three Playstyles

Choose from the Knight, Mage, or Barbarian. Each character has unique stats and 4 exclusive Ultimate Skills, offering completely different combat experiences.

🗡️ Collect Weapons & Build Your Arsenal

Pick your starting weapon from Melee, Ranged, or Magic categories. Discover and upgrade a wide variety of weapons and skills during battle. Combine them strategically to create devastating builds — weapons can even evolve into ultimate forms.

🔮 Destroy the Seal Stones, Lift the Darkness

Find and destroy Seal Stones that appear across the stage. As each stone shatters, the darkness fades and the world grows brighter — but stronger enemies awaken with it. Destroy all 5 Seal Stones and the Final Boss descends.

💀 Bullet Hell Boss Battles

Bosses attack with ranged barrage patterns. Read and dodge aimed shots, fan spreads, 360° radial bursts, lasers, and lightning strikes. Each boss has 3 phases — in the final phase, a shield activates and guardians are summoned. Defeat the guardians to break the shield.

🏰 3 Chapters, 21 Stages

Knight's Destiny, Witch's Power, Savage Land — each chapter features 7 stages with unique environments and enemies, from Skull Cemetery to Volcanic Zone. Each chapter hides a secret stage unlocked only by mastering special conditions.

⚡ Grow Stronger, Face Greater Challenges

Spend gold earned in battle to permanently upgrade your character's stats. Enemies scale with your level, ensuring every moment remains a challenge. As more Seal Stones are destroyed, monster HP and damage increase, keeping the tension alive until the very end.

🎮 Key Features

  • Dark fantasy survivors-like action RPG

  • Seal Stone system — lift the darkness as you progress

  • Bullet hell boss battles — 3 phases + shield + guardian summon

  • 3 characters, each with 4 exclusive Ultimate Skills

  • Dozens of weapons (Melee/Ranged/Magic) + evolution system

  • 3 chapters, 21 stages + hidden stages

  • Enemies scale with your level — always a challenge

  • Permanent skill upgrade system

  • Supports English, Japanese, Chinese, Russian, Spanish, and Portuguese

4545470.name: The Totemist
4545470.about_the_game:
Run an occult shop where complex crafting systems meet supernatural mystery. Gather materials, perform cleansing rituals, craft totems, and imbue them with power. 

You run a small occult shop in a town that feels just a little off. Customers come to you with the quiet weight of everyday life, and you help them carry it a little easier.




Gather materials from the world around you. Cleanse and prepare them with rituals drawn from real modern witchcraft.


Craft totems and talismans, then imbue them with intention to give them something extra. Unique effects, deeper power, a little more of yourself in every piece you sell.


Your crow keeps you company in the workshop.  Your frog minds the storefront. And the town slowly reveals itself through a cast of characters whose lives are messier, warmer, and stranger than they first appear.

Something is happening here. You can feel it in the energy. And you might be the only one who can see it coming.


The Totemist is a narrative-driven cozy shop simulator with an occult heart. Crafting, characters, and a mystery that gets under your skin.

  • Gather and cleanse raw materials for your craft.

  • Craft totems and talismans using rituals inspired by real modern witchcraft.

  • Imbue items with unique effects and increased power.

  • Manage and expand your shop inventory.

  • See the world through soul energy rather than physical appearance.

  • A character-driven narrative with a small, handcrafted cast.

  • Uncover a growing mystery hidden beneath a quiet town.

  • Companion crow in the workshop, companion frog in the store.

4545530.name: Robovac Flashback
4545530.about_the_game:
For most people, cleaning somebody's apartment every day and receiving no payment in return sounds like a nightmare. However, you're a robot vacuum cleaner and nothing would make you happier! Perform daily cleaning tasks for your owner and help keep her apartment looking pristine. 

However, when you begin malfunctioning, your connection to your owner and reality itself is severed. By exploring the strange new reality you have found yourself in, you might just be able to return home to your owner.

Features

  • Chapter-based structure! - Robovac Flashback will be released in four chapters over time.

  • Reality-bending environments! - In each chapter you will explore new non-sensical environments, each with their own variety of level gimmicks.

  • Plenty of dirt to vacuum up! - As you explore the game's levels, there will be no shortage of dirt for you to fill up your tank with.

  • Quirky characters! - Across your adventure, interesting critters and characters await.

  • Boss battles! - Despite being a simple vacuum cleaner, you can't please everyone. Some enemies will stop at nothing to block you on your adventure.

  • Collectables! - Take risks by dodging particularly precarious hazards to collect a wide variety of collectables. 

  • Upgrades! - Upgrade yourself so you can traverse new areas and vacuum more efficiently.

  • You can wear hats! - Dress yourself up in cute hats.

4545590.name: ArchiFun
4545590.about_the_game:
ArchiFun is a creative sandbox game where you can build spaces and populate them with animated characters to create all kinds of situations.

Start from scratch and turn any idea into a living scene, from everyday moments to completely unexpected scenarios.

No objectives, no rules, you decide what happens.

Place characters and watch your creations come to life with unique results every time.

Create, experiment, and tell visual stories your way.

Quickly build any scene you can imagine.

Key Features:

  • Free building — Walls, floors, and ceilings with no creative limits.

  • Decoration variety — Hundreds of furniture pieces and objects to create your dream space.

  • Materials — Customize every element with a variety of materials.

  • Ambient lighting — Adjust lighting for day or night.

  • Characters & pets — Place actors with unique animations that bring your spaces to life.

  • Interactivity — Open doors, turn on screens, activate fans, and more.

4545670.name: Peace Incarnate
4545670.about_the_game:
Peace Incarnate is a short first person shooter RPG with a unique story. Fight, sneak or punch your way to the namesake city for your faction's interest. Work with individuals who are not what they seem. Find different weapons, tools and armor to adapt to all encounters: Every opponent is prepared to fight you in their own way.

MULTI-FACTION FIGHT

  • Build your character for stealth, melee, shooting, or ingenuity.

  • A world map allows you to choose where to go.

  • Explore the secrets of Peace Incarnate.

  • A universal limb damage system. Shoot different body parts depending on the situation.

  • Not-So-Special Mode: Where everyone else has armor and abilities similar to you. 

  • Multiple endings.

4545680.name: Echoes of the Spire
4545680.about_the_game:
Strategy before the fight, not during it.

Where many tactical games test your ability to adapt on the fly, Echoes of the Spire rewards preparation. Scout enemy stats, skills, and formation before every battle. Swap heroes, adjust your formation, and equip the right skills to counter what you're about to face.

Plan your battle accordingly, adjust your formation and switch your skills anytime to counter enemy formation.

Check battle detail screen to see how effective the skill is

Build your base, pick and choose buildings that fit your style

Features

  • Squad-based tactical combat with formation positioning.

  • 40+ playable heroes, enemies, bosses with unique skills.

  • 180+ skills with 5 scaling tiers.

  • Events, biomes, mutators and more.

4545700.name: Enjoy Your Stay
4545700.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Hudson Hotel, where our guests are our top priority. Our checkout service is currently unavailable. In the meantime, please partake in the amenities, and thank you for your cooperation.

Please pay no mind to any irregularities during your stay. Many spaces within the hotel are currently under renovation and may not lead where you might expect. If you find yourself somewhere you shouldn’t be, do not panic — this is perfectly normal.

Enjoy Your Stay is a slow, atmospheric first-person experience built around observation and discovery. Walk the hallway. Notice what changes. Decide whether to turn back or press forward.

Beyond the hallway lie hidden spaces that reveal the nature of the hotel and some of its guests. There are no chases or death screens — only the hotel.

------------

Features

  • Anomaly-spotting gameplay loop requiring careful observation to progress

  • A PSX-inspired hotel rendered with custom models and retro aesthetics

  • Interconnected anomalies that hint at deeper stories within the hotel

  • Hidden areas and strange tableaus beyond the hallway

  • No chase mechanics or death resets

  • Freely investigate areas and anomalies without resetting progress

------------

Inspired by The Exit 8, POOLS, Rounderhouse's SCP-7819, and The Backrooms.

4545750.name: Milliseconds Matter: Precision Platformer
4545750.about_the_game:
Run, jump and dash through levels in a precision platformer where every millisecond matters.

Instant restarts and short levels make you always want to play just one more run.

Every Millisecond Matters.

Complete each level as fast as possible.

Every level can be beaten in under twenty seconds.

Find shortcuts to improve your time.

One Button to Jump. One Button to Dash. Easy, Right?

Simple controls. No excuses.

You can't stop moving, so use skill to avoid obstacles and follow the fastest route.

Race. Refine. Repeat.

Race against the ghost runner of your best time.

Take on the developer's ghost runner to prove your skill.

Compete With Other Players on Leaderboards.

View other players' times and climb to the top of leaderboards.

Use precise jumps, well-timed dashes, and clever shortcuts to reach maximum speed.

Every Level is a Work of Art. Literally.

Run through levels built inside giant images—guitars, controllers, and more.

Complete a level to reveal the full picture.

4545760.name: Sainthood Relics
4545760.about_the_game:
Uncover What Lies Beneath

Carefully excavate layered blocks to reveal hidden relics buried within. Each surface is made up of different materials, and every strike matters. Use precise tools and thoughtfully chosen patterns to clear each layer as efficiently as possible.

A Satisfying Excavation Loop

Chip away at stone, sand, and clay with clean, tactile feedback. Watch each layer break apart piece by piece as the shape of a hidden artifact slowly emerges. Every action is designed to feel deliberate, readable, and satisfying.

Optimize Your Approach

There are no fail states; just the quiet challenge of doing better. Experiment with different tool patterns and refine your strategy to clear each surface using fewer moves. Like a puzzle box, each excavation rewards careful planning and precision.

Discover Relics and Their Stories

Each relic you uncover is inspired by real historical artifacts and traditions. As you reveal them, you’ll uncover the true—and sometimes surprising—stories behind the lives they came from.

A Calm, Focused Experience

With minimalist visuals, soft atmosphere, and a focus on gentle interaction, Sainthood Relics is designed to be a peaceful, meditative experience. Take your time, slow down, and enjoy the process of uncovering something meaningful.

4545770.name: Pick Them up!
4545770.about_the_game:
Clean up a world buried in trash.

Pick Them Up! is a 3D cleanup game where you collect garbage by hand, manage your bag, and process waste efficiently as you restore each area.

Pick up trash one by one, keep your workflow moving, and clear each zone step by step. As you progress, new tools and systems help you clean faster and handle larger amounts of waste.

What starts as a simple cleanup job grows into a full routine of collecting, sorting, processing, and clearing entire areas.

Key Features

- Pick up and clean large amounts of trash across multiple zones

- Use different cleanup methods and tools to work more efficiently

- Manage your bag capacity and process collected waste

- Unlock new systems as you progress through the cleanup

- Turn heavily polluted areas into clean spaces again

4545780.name: Lost in the Fogbound Deadwood
4545780.about_the_game:
You have 60 minutes.
Escape the forest… or die trying.

Lost in a fogbound deadwood, your vision is limited and your sense of direction begins to fade.
This is not a place you can simply walk through and survive.

You must explore, find keys, collect coins, and unlock new paths.
But every step forward comes with risk.

This forest shows no mercy.

Hostile enemies roam the area, and getting too close can be fatal.
Hidden traps and deadly terrain can end your run instantly.

Your time is limited.
Your ammo is limited.

Fight or avoid.
Advance or retreat.

Every decision matters.

🎮 Key Features

  • First-person survival escape experience with a strict 60-minute limit

  • Progression through keys, coins, and environmental routes

  • Dense fog that severely limits visibility and orientation

  • Enemies and hazards that punish careless decisions

  • High tension driven by exploration and resource management

There is no map. No guidance.

Only the fog… and the way out.

Will you escape in time?

4545820.name: Solidarity
4545820.about_the_game:
What is Solidarity about?

Solidarity is a character building, auto battling roguelike. Combine different races, classes, weapons and many more to make the perfect team. Find artifacts that synergize with your characters builds and power them up. Unlock powerful upgrades in the growth tree to progress further in your next run. Modify the stats of your team to perfectly suit your playstyle, the choices are endless!

Key features

  • Over 40 races to unlock and use.

  • Over 30 classes to unlock and use.

  • Over 80 Artifacts to build your characters up.

  • Over 70 unique pieces of weapons and armor to find and equip.

  • 10 different run types to explore and complete, each with 3 difficulty options.

  • Random events with possible rewards or difficult battles.

  • And tons of other ways to power up your characters along the way.

Build your team

  • Build a new team for the next run or stick to what works!

  • You could have an orc warrior for your front line and maybe a nymph cleric in the back to heal him?

  • Maybe a zombie to soak up damage for your team and a powerful imp sorcerer to nuke the enemy team ?

  • How about 4 werewolves that transform during the night to crush your enemy?

  • The combinations are endless, try to find a team that is perfect or maybe just one that you find the most fun and unique.

Roguelike progression

Completing runs earns you growth tree points depending on the run type and difficulty that you can spend to have an advantage on future runs.

Additionally, unlocking new races, classes, etc will earn you mutation points which you can use to modify the stats of your team. For example having a higher magic stat, being faster, more critical hit chance, even a higher chance at artifacts.

4545850.name: Age of Gods
4545850.about_the_game:
A turn-based strategy game focused on skill, positioning, and decision-making.

Compete in tactical battles with up to 8 players in free-for-all or team-based matches. Capture structures, generate gold, and build your army to dominate the battlefield.

FEATURES

• Tactical turn-based combat with deep positioning strategy

• 8-player matches (FFA or team-based)

• Unique unit synergy system across factions

• Resource control via villages, towers, and portals

• Class triangle system (Ranger > Mage > Melee)

• No RNG — outcomes are determined by strategy

GAMEPLAY

Gain gold each turn by controlling structures like villages, towers, and portals. Use that gold to summon units in tiered order, build your composition, and outmaneuver opponents on a tile-based battlefield.

Every move matters — positioning, timing, and unit synergy determine victory.

STRATEGY WITHOUT RANDOMNESS

Combat is fully deterministic. There are no dice rolls or hidden mechanics — success comes from planning, positioning, and understanding unit interactions.

Terrain, class advantages, and synergies all play a critical role in every engagement.

MULTIPLAYER

Play solo or with friends in casual or competitive matches supporting up to 8 players. Form alliances, coordinate strategies, or go head-to-head in free-for-all battles.

Master the battlefield and prove your strategy is superior.

CAMPAIGN

Explore a story-driven campaign filled with strategic missions and evolving challenges.

Unlock new units as you progress, expand your army, and uncover the lore behind each faction.

4545870.name: Empeti - Quest for the Pinnacle
4545870.about_the_game:
You don't fight enemies.

You face people and relate to them effectively with empathy skills!

In EMPETI: Quest for the Pinnacle, every conversation is a decision that has consequences. What you say can build trust or break it, changing your quest entirely.

Set in a medieval kingdom gripped by a mysterious emotional affliction, your journey unfolds through choices that influence trust, conflict, and human connection. Every interaction carries weight. Every word has consequences.

Will you rise to the pinnacle ... or fracture the bonds that hold the kingdom together?

Gameplay:

Step into a story where dialogue is gameplay.

  • Navigate emotionally charged situations.

  • Choose how to respond in real conversations.

  • Experience different outcomes based on your decisions. 

  • Explore a structured journey across interconnected narrative arcs

Story:

A kingdom stands on the edge of collapse, with the sole heir-princess struggling with emotional difficulties.

As a noble suitor seeking the hand of the princess, you must navigate courtly intrigue, personal relationships and her inner struggles - where success depends on not strength or force, but on understanding.

In a world where emotions shape reality, your greatest challenge is not conquest ... but connection and empathy.

What makes EMPETI different?

  • Meaningful choices: Your dialogue decisions have lasting consequences

  • Emotion-driven gameplay: Navigate complex human interactions, not just objectives

  • Multiple endings: Every path leads to a different outcome

  • Narrative depth: Designed for players who enjoy story-rich experiences

Who this game is for?

  • Players who enjoy story-rich, choice-driven games

  • Fans of narrative adventures and visual novels

  • Gamers looking for meaningful decisions and emotional impact

  • Anyone interested in games where dialogue shapes the world

A grounded experience:

EMPETI is grounded in real-world psychological insight, offering a gameplay experience that is authentic, human, and  thought provoking, with empathy skills more caught and not taught, while remaining engaging and immersive in the game.

4545930.name: You Weren't Invited
4545930.about_the_game:
You Weren’t Invited

A man is dead.
Everyone has something to hide.
And somehow... you’re part of this now.

You Weren’t Invited is a murder mystery visual novel where romance and investigation intertwine. Trapped inside the Velgrave Estate after a fatal dinner party, you must uncover the truth behind Ambrose Velgrave’s death.

But you won’t be doing it alone.

Five women. Five stories. Five versions of the truth.

Get close to them. Earn their trust.
Or push too hard and watch everything fall apart.

Because one of them is lying. One of them is the killer.

🔍 Investigate the Truth

Gather clues, track contradictions, and build your case. Every conversation matters. And every detail could bring you closer to the truth.

💔 Build Relationships

Your choices shape how each character sees you. Form deep connections, pursue romance, or keep your distance. But remember: trust is fragile.

🎭 Multiple Endings

Your decisions determine who you believe, who you accuse, and how the story ends. Will you uncover the truth or be consumed by it?

🕯️ A Story About Perception

Memories shift. Motives blur. And the truth is never as simple as it seems.

⚠️ One truth remains:

You weren’t invited.

So why are you here?

---

Written, Designed, Coded, & Directed by CJ

Art by dysphoria_chan

Music by @CrunchLordSupreme

4545940.name: Beencremental
4545940.about_the_game:
Beencremental is a colorfull incremental game about bees. Played with a mouse only, guide your queen to Collect pollen, drop it into the plinko machine to produce honey, upgrade your beehive and create an unstoppable swarm to conquer the four seasons.

Make-a-wish Dandelions will help you upgrade your Plinko Machine, exponentially growing your Honey production!

4546040.name: The Death Handover
4546040.about_the_game:
“Everyone has a ‘Handover Document’—it’s only a matter of time. You sign for them today; who signs for you tomorrow?”

A Rehearsal for the End

In this rain-soaked old city, you’ve taken a job no one else wants: a mortician. Your routine revolves around a cold workbench—setting up mourning halls, giving the "guests" their final bit of dignity. People call this trade eerie, but the real terror isn't the dead; it's the realization that no one escapes the script.

The Ritual is the Appetizer; Fate is the Main Course:

  • Not a Process, But a Final Dignity: Your task is to wash away worldly ties, stitch the skin, and dress the deceased. As you go through the daily grind of your schedule, the chill of "one day, I’ll be lying here too" becomes the one procedure you can’t skip. Mortuary work is a ritual. Through these few tasks, you must touch the cold reality of death. Staring at the workbench, the feeling that this is your own future hits harder than any jump-scare.

  • Halls for the Living, Truths for the Dead: The mourning hall is for the living, but the handover slips are for the dead. In this city of blurred eras, every body that passes through your hands seems tied to the same unseen, crimson thread. You think you’re just a spectator getting paid, but you’ve been part of the play all along.

Borrowed Life Must Be Repaid:

  • “Soul-Returning”: It’s Not a Hallucination, It’s a Debt: When you touch the deceased, you are dragged into their final moments. It’s more than memory retrieval; it’s a reckoning. You must find what they "owe" in those twisted visions, because every unpaid debt eventually finds its way back to you.

  • The Cycle of Five: All the victims are linked to an ancient curse—five lives, different ways to die, one massive debt. As you handle one "guest" after another, you’ll realize the thread of fate is tied around your own wrist.

  • The Final Handover: A Familiar Name: This is more than a simulator. In the end, when you're forced to verify the final document, you'll find a name that looks terrifyingly familiar. At that cold workbench, you will face the most brutal part of the ritual: dissecting the past to see where the cycle truly ends—and who it has been pointing to all along.

The door is open. Step inside. This isn't just a game; it's a debt coming to collect its owner. And you have nowhere to hide.

[hr][/hr]

Developer's Note

This game is a solo project in early development. While still a work in progress, it is a labor of love exploring the themes of fate and our final journey. Thank you for being part of this rehearsal for the inevitable.

4546050.name: Game Dev Simulator
4546050.about_the_game:
Welcome to your first day on the job.

Game Dev Simulator is a story-driven VR experience where you play as a new employee at Mundane Interactive, a small game development studio.

A Full Virtual Desktop at Your Fingertips

Sit at your desk and interact with a fully functional desktop OS in VR. Browse emails, manage tasks, install games, surf the web, change your wallpaper, change your cursor, buy new music, and more — all through an intuitive VR mouse and keyboard. Your virtual office is packed with things to touch, grab, throw, and break.

Test the Games

As Mundane Interactive's newest QA tester, you'll play through a variety of very different games, ranging from funny, bizarre, heartfelt, creepy, rage enducing, or just downright terrible. Some of the games include:

  • Legend Of The Elder — A 2D adventure inspired by classic RPGs

  • Tithonus — A thought provoking constellation-connecting experience under the stars

  • Click & Run — An innovative 90s OS themed rogue-lite

  • Gerbil Jam — A 3D rhythm game with multiple songs

  • Retro Racer — A throwback arcade racing game

  • Slap Game — A motion control detective game where you slap a confession out of the criminals

  • ...and more

Features

  • Fully interactive VR office — Grab, throw, and interact with everything on your desk

  • Multiple full mini-games — Each one a different genre with its own mechanics

  • Cliphead — Your desktop mascot who pops up with commentary on everything you do

  • 50+ main and side tasks to complete — Hidden challenges scattered throughout the office

  • A story you won't forget

4546060.name: Bullet Hero
4546060.about_the_game:
Bullet Hero - is a musical bullet hell based on rhythm and skill of dodge everything

  • Dodge, survive, repeat - play music-based levels

  • Create your own level - flexible and robust level editor give you ability to create any level that you can imagine for music you like

4546070.name: Gentle Night
4546070.about_the_game:
About Gentle Night

Experience Gentle Night, a psychological horror Visual Novel where human morality shatters against the backdrop of an apocalyptic nightmare. When a quiet town becomes a prison of despair, you—the exiled shop manager—hold the power to dictate the "taboo" rules of survival.

The Story

Exiled from Tokyo to Suekawa, Ryo’s life takes a dark turn before he can even unpack. A supernatural fog has cut off the town, leaving him trapped in a midnight supermarket with monsters lurking just outside the glass.

Inside, Ryo finds himself with a group of beautiful survivors. As fear erodes their sanity, the social masks they once wore begin to slip. When these high-class beauties beg for your "shelter," will you be their savior, or their master in the descent into darkness?

Key Features

Visceral Immersion: Hear her heartbeat and her desperate whispers. Our polished script ensures every interaction is an intimate sensory journey.

Professional JP Dubbing: Fully voiced by Japanese talent for that authentic anime feel. Every emotion is captured with stunning clarity.

Deep Narrative of Possession: Explore the dark intersection of survival, lust, and control. This is a game of psychological dominance.

4546080.name: 诡校中学实录A strange school
4546080.about_the_game:

4546100.name: Kircles
4546100.about_the_game:
Create insane tower combinations and break every level your way.

Kircles is a designer-driven tower defense where strategy comes from how you combine your towers. Mix 18 unique turrets to unlock powerful synergies, discover new behaviors, and stop the swarm before it reaches the exit.

With 60+ handcrafted levels across three campaigns, every challenge can be solved in multiple ways. Optimize your resources, experiment with different builds, and find solutions that fit your playstyle.

4546110.name: Uraz the Journalist
4546110.about_the_game:
You are the editor of a struggling newspaper in a city under pressure 
where every headline leaves something behind.

DECIDE

Choose what becomes the story,
and what is left behind.

PRESSURE

Watch your decisions spread across the city,
one district at a time.

OBSESSION

Watch Uraz drift deeper into obsession,
pressure, and irreversible choices.

OVERVIEW

Uraz the Journalist is a story-rich psychological drama about editorial control, moral compromise, and the quiet violence of choosing what the city gets to see. As pressure builds across its districts, Uraz is pulled deeper into obsession, and every decision leaves a mark that cannot be undone.

4546130.name: Ex-Master, Zombie
4546130.about_the_game:
You are a zombie, risen from the grave to reclaim what was lost. At first, you are only a head, but with each found body fragment, forgotten skills, strength, and the true nature of the Ex-Master return.

Ex-Master, Zombi is a 2D side-scrolling Metroidvania where every step opens new possibilities:

  • Explore dark and mysterious locations;

  • Find parts of your body and restore your power;

  • Master new abilities and reclaim your lost skills;

  • Confront those who took your life and prove that death is not the end.

Piece yourself together. Remember who you were. And become stronger than ever.

4546210.name: Bitvania
4546210.about_the_game:
We are incredibly grateful for to our Kickstarter supporters. Your belief in this project means everything to us, and we can’t wait to get back to work and bring this world to life for you.

Welcome to Bitvania, you enter the fight completely empty-handed. Fists won't save you here. There is no default melee attack—if you want to stay alive, you must constantly dodge, and pick up whatever is available on the ground. From kitchenware to lethal household items, your survival depends entirely on what you have!

  • 10 Unlockable Characters
    Beat up your enemies and unlock 10 different characters! Each character has their own strange style and survival traits to help you live inside the chaotic Bitvania world.

  • If You Can Pick It Up, It’s a Weapon!
    Find a wild and unpredictable arsenal on the floor. From dagger to durian and even your mom's favorite slipper to smack anyone who looks at you wrong!

  • The Weapon-Stamina Link
    Your stamina and your weapons are best friends. Every throw drains your stamina. Watch your stamina, or your weapon pays the price.

  • No Stamina = Instant Weapon Break
    Do not push your body too hard! If your stamina hits zero while you are attacking, your weapon breaks instantly. Now you are completely defenseless and useless.

  • The Big Choice: Health or Stamina?
    Which one is more important? Increase your health to survive big hits, or your stamina so your weapon does not break? Choose wrong, and you will retire.

  • The 1% Miracle: 999 Mega Damage!
    Are you losing a boss fight? Don't worry, luck is here! Every single hit has a 1% chaotic chance to do 999 Critical Damage. Boom! Enemy deleted.

  • Orchestral Soundtrack
    Listen to the beautiful Official Bitvania Soundtrack. It is a massive, powerful, fully orchestral music score. It makes slapping enemies with a slipper feel like a holy movie!

In Bitvania, you don’t survive the darkness… you become it.

4546260.name: Cunning Stunt Racer
4546260.about_the_game:
Strap in, rev up, and take on gravity-defying tracks where precision driving is the difference between victory… and a long fall into the void.

Inspired by the legendary Stunt Car Racer, Cunning Stunt Racer brings back the raw intensity of high-risk, high-reward racing — rebuilt with retro visuals with a modern twist, modern physics, and competitive gameplay.

Master a collection of brutal stunt circuits high above the ground, every track is a test of control and nerve. Once you've mastered those, why not download tracks made by the community or even create your own with the built in track editor!

Feel every bump, landing, and loss of traction. Your car isn’t glued to the road — it fights you.

Momentum, balance, and throttle control are everything. One mistake can send you flying… or falling.

Go wheel-to-wheel against AI opponents in tense duels where position matters as much as survival. Push too hard and your car will pay the price. Damage affects performance, forcing you to adapt your driving style mid-race — or risk total failure.

Manage your boost carefully. Use it to clear huge gaps, gain an edge on straights, or recover from mistakes — but waste it, and you’ll be left behind.

Classic inspiration with modern execution

Do you have the control to stay on the track… or will gravity win?

4546280.name: Demon Draw
4546280.about_the_game:
Demon Draw is a game that blends rogue-lite elements with slot machine mechanics. Arrange your hand, unlock synergies, and collect artifacts to craft your build. Rain bullets upon demons and experience the ultimate thrill where strategy meets luck!

🃏 Horizontal & Vertical Layouts, Precise Tuning

The core gameplay revolves around positioning cards horizontally and vertically to freely arrange poker hands like pairs, three-of-a-kind, and straight flushes. Every move directly impacts follow-up synergies and your overall damage output—the foundation of a successful hunt!

🔗 Card Synergies, Chain Explosions

Hands are no longer isolated. Different patterns trigger powerful synergies, allowing you to explore infinite combinations within a limited space. Accumulate chain combos through strategic positioning and turn your cards into a barrage of bullets to master the art of demon hunting!

✨ Powerful Artifacts, Game-Changing Builds

A massive collection of powerful artifacts with unique affixes awaits. By mixing and matching these items, you can create countless tactical builds that rewrite the rules of the game. Unlock near-infinite scoring potential and unleash world-shattering damage for a truly exhilarating experience!

🍀 A Gamble with Luck, Turning the Tide

Luck is just as vital as skill! A sudden stroke of fortune can instantly flip the battlefield and reverse a losing streak. Beyond the strategic depth, embrace the surprises and variables that luck brings as you embark on a path full of the unknown!

🦹🏻 Hunt Demons, Overcome Challenges

Travel the world to hunt down legendary demons and monsters. These foes possess lethal skills, requiring you to flexibly adjust your card patterns and cleverly utilize your artifacts. One wrong move could mean total defeat. Survive the hunt in a world where danger lurks at every step!

4546290.name: MineZone
4546290.about_the_game:
A 3D horror survival game inspired by the classic Minesweeper.

Explore a haunted graveyard, investigate tombs, and avoid hidden dangers.

Use visual clues such as colors, numbers, and particle effects to detect nearby mines.

But beware — mines aren't your only threat.

Zombies roam the area, and being spotted means instant death.

As time goes on, they become more numerous, faster, and deadlier.

4546300.name: LichXCoven - Pureheart Edition

In this incremental game, you can destroy the enemies with your mighty clicks, and trigger chain reactions to kill enemies faster. Once you've killed enough enemies, you'll be taken to the next floor. But be careful, you have limited energy to spend before having to go back to the dungeon's patio!

-- Use it to upgrade the girls and go deeper --

The faster you kill enemies, the lower you'll be able to go! Spend mana to buy upgrades (damage, more energy, upgrade your spells...) and always go deeper thanks to the checkpoints every 5 floors.

Each of the girls have their own playstyle, try to reach the bottom of the dungeon with each to get access to all their dialogs!

Apply damage over time & burn them all

Charm enemies & detonate them to regain energy!

Critical clicks trigger frozen blood projectiles - and they crit too!

As you go down the floors with the girls, you will unlock dialogs for each of them!

4546370.name: Starport Merchants
4546370.about_the_game:
Starport Merchants puts you in the boots of a scrappy trader, starting with nothing but a small ship and some pocket money.

Travel between the planets looking for opportunity and the most optimal way to build your business empire.

There are many ways to build up your merchant empire. Discover the income streams that fit your personal style.

Or do a little bit of everything, it's your business after all.

  • Haul cargo

  • Take jobs

  • Transport passengers

  • Smuggle goods

  • Mine asteroids

  • Trade stocks (or short them)

  • Build factories

  • Automate fleets

  • Invest in real estate

  • Buy art

  • Gamble at the casino

  • Colonize a planet

  • ... but don't forget to pay your taxes

You are not alone in your pursuit to rule the markets.

Compete against seven rivals or find a way to work together. Each rival has their own distinct personality.

  • Get to know the distinct personalities of your rivals

  • Establish Trade Agreements and learn to work together

  • ... or commit Industrial Sabotage and set your rivals back

  • Multiple revenue paths: Choose how you want to build and monetize your business.

  • Level playing field: Rivals follow the same rules and play the same game.

  • Crisis events: Unexpected events can raise or lower earnings. For you and your competitors.

  • Detailed finances: Know exactly how your money flows in and out.

  • Visual analytics: Use charts and graphs to analyze performance and trends.

  • Narrative choices: Encounter story events during your travels. Decide how to handle them (or ignore them).

Is this game for you?

  • A single playthrough of Starport Merchants might take some time, but the game is designed for quick, pick‑up‑and‑play sessions.

  • Ideal for players who want a tycoon game with just enough depth but that doesn’t require hours of study.

  • Great choice if you enjoy GUI‑based tycoon games.

  • Comparable titles include Gazillionaire, Dope Wars and Wall Street Raider.

  • When in doubt, play the demo!

4546380.name: Zero Sum
4546380.about_the_game:
You failed math class. Math didn't forget.

Zero Sum is a pencil-on-paper twin-stick shooter roguelite. Your enemies are numbers and your weapon is math. No health bars. No hit points. Just raw arithmetic violence.

A "48" is charging at you. You fire ÷2. Now it's "24". Three more divisions: "12," "6," "3." Now switch to minus. Bang. Bang. Bang. Zero. Gone. Next.

That was the easy part.

Your Arsenal Is Unconventional

Forget guns. You carry operators. Minus and Plus are your reliable sidearms. Precise but boring, until they save your life. Division rips through enemies. Root turns big numbers into rubble. Modulo is a powerful grenade that can nuke even the biggest numbers if played right.

Multiplication? A slow trap. An AoE effect that slows everything it touches. Useful if you're smart enough to set up a kill with it. And then there's Sigma, a vortex grenade that sucks in every nearby enemy and combines them into a single number whose value is the sum of everything it ate. Turn a massive swarm of numbers into one big, easy-to-handle target.

Seven operators. Twenty-two firing modes to unlock. Every shot requires a decision. Every clean kill and clever combo rewards bonus points. Integer split, perfect root, modulo blast. The game knows when you're showing off and rewards you for it.

Die. Learn. Multiply.

Run one, you're rationing division ammo. Do you minus this 72 down shot by shot, or use your division for the perfect clean kill? Do you root the cluster of 16s for instant clears, or hold it for the tanky 256 barreling toward you?

Run twenty, your chain-divides ricochet through swarms, your root shotgun pulps clusters in a single shot and your Sigma vortex eats half the screen. Permanent upgrades carry between runs. Temporary buffs stack within them. Every death makes the next run meaner.

You didn't only get good at math. You got good at violence, too.

The Numbers Fight Back

Enemies aren't just walking health bars. A prime number can't be cleanly divided. A factorial grows exponentially if you ignore it. Rethink to deal with Negatives. You can't outrun fast enemies. You don't just shoot, you solve.

Bosses That Would Make Mathematicians Sweat

Nine bosses, each built around a mathematical concept that wants you dead (a small selection):

The Euler Owl

  • a wise creature, firing Taylor series bullets that duplicate. Deal with them before the expansion overwhelms you.

The Factorial Factory

  • an inconspicuous boss that launches factorial projectiles. 9! splits mid-air into 9 × 8 × 7 × 6 × …, each number racing toward its anchor to recombine into something enormous. Kill the pieces before they merge or face their giant product.

The Pi Boss

  • a pie protected by digits. Each slice of pi must be dealt with to turn armor into weak points.

The Yin-Yang Boss

  • two spinning halves, one light, one dark. Focus too much on one half and the other goes berserk. Balance the harmony meter or get swarmed.

The Prime Sieve Spider

  • an eight-legged boss whose web is the Sieve of Eratosthenes. Trapped in its grid, you must identify and destroy the composites and avoid the prime traps. Hit the wrong number and it breaks free as a real enemy. Clear the web to expose a leg joint. Fail, and the entire web turns into a swarm.

Sketched by Hand, Animated Like a Fever Dream

Zero Sum looks like your notebook came alive and got angry. Enemies are the doodles you drew when you were bored in math class. Except these doodles want revenge.

Features

  • 7 operator weapons with 22 firing modes total: every operator unlocks three to four distinct modes that change projectile behavior, AoE and mathematical consequences

  • 80+ upgrade nodes across the operator tree: chain division, shotgun roots, area-of-effect modulo blasts, freeze lines, Sigma vortexes and more

  • 9 boss fights built around real mathematical concepts: exponentials, prime sieves, pi, harmonic balance, factorials and more

  • 6 game modes across escalating waves: Classic, Holdout, Survival, Conveyor, Boss Rush and more

  • Roguelite progression: permanent upgrades between runs, temporary buffs within them. Every death makes the next run meaner

  • 3 difficulty modes that not only scale enemies and rewards, but also introduce complete new boss mechanics

  • Twin-stick controls with mouse + keyboard or full gamepad support

  • A skill ceiling made of mental math. The fastest players aren't the ones with the best reflexes, they're the ones who can factor 391 in their head while dodging the swarm

4546420.name: Gridwardens
4546420.about_the_game:
Gridwardens is a turn-based tactics game built for quick, satisfying battles on a grid. Pick your squad, read the battlefield, and outsmart your opponent with clever positioning, timing, and ability combos. Every turn matters, and every unit can swing the match.

Key features:

  • Single-player campaign: 36 handcrafted missions with evolving objectives

  • Challenges mode: 12 unique tactical trials to test your mastery

  • Local 2-player battles: play on the same device for head-to-head tactics

  • Deep roster: 21 unique units and 100+ abilities for endless team setups

  • 6 themed arenas: each with its own look and vibe

Plan your moves, punish mistakes, and build the kind of turn that makes you grin.

4546430.name: Primus
4546430.about_the_game:
Primus is a brutal Roman gladiator arena crawler where you build a Ludus, lead fighters through deadly arena circuits, and climb the ranks toward the title of Primus.

Survive the Spectacle


Choose your leader, prepare your gladiators, and enter blood-soaked arena runs filled with tactical fights, crowd events, rival champions, beasts, injuries, and final bouts.

Each circuit is a test of survival. Your gladiators must endure the whole run before they can return home with rewards, scars, and hard-earned progress.

The crowd is watching and the sand is waiting.

Core Features


  • Arena Crawler Structure: Choose a circuit, survive a sequence of fights and events, then return to your Ludus with rewards and consequences.
  • Formation-Based Combat: Position your gladiators, use their abilities, and manage speed, damage, defence, and survival.
  • Crowd Events: The crowd can reward bloodshed, punish weakness, shift momentum, or unleash beasts into the arena.
  • Ludus Management: Train fighters, recover from injuries, upgrade your house, and prepare your team for the next circuit.
  • Head of House Choice: Choose a leader who shapes your Ludus with unique traits, combat style, and strategy.
  • Scars and Death: Gladiators gain experience, suffer wounds, earn scars, and may die permanently if pushed too far.

Can Your Ludus Survive the Arena?


Every victory raises your name.
Every scar tells a story.
Every death feeds the spectacle.

Enter the arena. Survive the circuit. Rise to become Primus.

4546440.name: LUBA
4546440.about_the_game:
LUBA is a walking simulator with platforming elements, environmental puzzles, and a classical music soundtrack. You find yourself in a strange, confusing place that never feels truly familiar, with no memory of how you got there, and only light and shadow to guide your way.

Move across platforms and solve environmental puzzles that let you change the world around you. Only light helps you reveal new paths, and every step feels uncertain, as if you are walking through a half-forgotten dream.

There is no combat and almost no dialogue — just you, the unsettling environment, and carefully selected classical music pieces that enhance the mysterious mood. An atmospheric exploration and a calm, yet slightly disorienting, contemplative journey.

Features:

  • Walking simulator with light platforming elements and environmental puzzles.

  • World exploration built around light and shadow.

  • Soundtrack based on classical music.

4546470.name: Remain At Your Desk
4546470.about_the_game:
You have two jobs.

The first is fake. You click through tasks, file reports, sync databases, and collect a paycheck. Nobody knows what you actually do. You just need to look busy enough to get promoted.

The second job is the real one. After hours, you break into the corporate network to pull data that isn't yours. You route through systems, crack firewalls, stay ahead of whoever's paying attention.

RISK

Every hack raises suspicion. Push too far and security starts paying attention. An audit lands on your desk and then an interrogation follows. If your story doesn’t hold, you’re back to Intern with nothing.

TWO ECONOMIES

Credits come from the day job. They buy upgrades, automation, and time. Intel comes from hacks. Intel only drops on hacks, so there's less of it than credits and you have to take more risk to get it. It feeds its own upgrade tree, and those upgrades make every hack after faster and deadlier. Climb a rank and the Black Market opens. Intel buys permanent edges there, the kind that survive every reset.

COVER

Personas let you hack as someone else. The janitor, the IT admin, the consultant nobody questions. Each one has its own bonuses but burns out if you rely on it too much. If suspicion creeps up, you file a fake report, wipe the logs, or pay someone to forget they saw you.

LEVERAGE

Not everything is worth selling. Hack the same target enough times and you build a dossier. This creates permanent leverage that survives resets. The email server shows you who hates who. The security network shows you where the cameras are not. Executive files show you how the system really works.

PRESTIGE

Get promoted and you start over with stronger multipliers and personas that stick. Get caught and you start over with nothing.
