4546490.name: Arkansas 2125
4546490.about_the_game:
Arkansas 2125 is a turn-based post-apocalyptic game set in a ruined future where every decision can mean the difference between survival and death. The player takes on the role of Thomas, a lone wanderer who sets out on a dangerous journey after being encouraged by his girlfriend. His goal is to obtain the legendary Farm Restorer, a device said to be capable of changing the fate of the world.

During his journey, the player explores vast, hostile areas and visits many different villages inhabited by survivors trying to rebuild their lives after the fall of civilization. Each village has its own atmosphere, characters, problems, and unique quests that help uncover the story of the world and its people.

The game places a strong emphasis on atmosphere, narrative, and player choices, which can influence relationships with NPCs and the outcomes of certain events.

Key Features:

  • Turn-based gameplay focused on strategy and careful planning

  • A wide variety of firearms, from basic pistols to more powerful weapons

  • Melee weapons offering alternative combat styles

  • A large variety of quests, including main story, side, and optional missions

  • Character progression system with skill and stat development

  • Multiple unique villages, each with its own story, NPCs, and activities

  • Exploration of a post-apocalyptic world filled with secrets and dangers

  • Strong focus on immersion and atmosphere

The game has been developed by a solo developer since 2024 and is being created using the Unity engine. Arkansas 2125 is a passion project aimed at players who enjoy turn-based gameplay, post-apocalyptic settings, and narrative-driven experiences.

4546540.name: Afterlight
4546540.about_the_game:
Something went wrong in the mountains of Pine Ridge County. A decade ago, a classified government research facility buried deep in the wilderness, went silent. Within weeks, so did everything else. No broadcasts. No rescue. No explanation.

The world you knew is gone. Nature has reclaimed the roads, the power grids have long since failed, and the dead outnumber the living a thousand to one. Pine Ridge County is yours now. What's left of it.

Quick Overview

  • Handcrafted open world of dense mountain forests, decaying towns, and abandoned research facilities

  • Dynamic day/night cycle - horde attacks every single night, escalating in size and aggression

  • Two types of infected - Day walkers you can manage. Night infected you need to outthink. Faster, harder to kill, and repelled by light.

  • Weather system - fog and storms roll in without warning, and anything that limits your visibility after dark can get you killed

  • Base building and fortification system - construct and reinforce your defenses before nightfall

  • Scavenge, repair, and drive vehicles across Pine Ridge County

  • Tiered loot system - better gear hidden in more dangerous locations

  • Full survival simulation - manage hunger, thirst, injuries, and stamina

  • Hunt wildlife and scavenge the land to stay fed and supplied

  • Skill tree progression - grow stronger the longer you survive

  • Trade with NPC survivors scattered across the county

Vast open world

A handcrafted open world spanning dense mountain forests, crumbling infrastructure, and overgrown ruins. A decade after the collapse, nature is slowly reclaiming what civilization left behind, but the abandoned research facilities still litter the mountainside, silent and waiting. Every location tells a story. Not all of them have endings yet.

Survive the Day. Dread the Night

Daylight belongs to the living, barely. Use every hour to scavenge, build, and prepare. When darkness falls, the horde descends on your position without fail. The infected that roam Pine Ridge during the day are dangerous. The ones that come out at night are something else entirely, mutated, faster, and harder to put down. Every dawn you survive is borrowed time.

Build, Fortify, and Hold the Line 

Your base is the only thing standing between you and the horde. Scavenge materials from across the county, construct walls and defenses, and reinforce your position night after night. What you build, and how well you build it, determines whether you see morning.

Loot, Craft, and Gear Up

Supplies are scarce and spread thin across a sprawling open world. Scavenge abandoned towns, ransack ARC facilities, and push into dangerous territory for higher-tier loot. Craft weapons, tools, and equipment from what you find, and manage your hunger, thirst, and injuries.

Drive, repair and customize vehicles

Locate and repair vehicles scattered across Pine Ridge County. Push deeper into dangerous territory for the supplies you can't find close to home. Just make sure you're back before dark.

4546580.name: HexArmy
4546580.about_the_game:
HexArmy is a turn-based tactical strategy game built on a hex grid where the outcome of every battle depends on the decisions you make before the first shot is fired.

Choose from 10 real-world-inspired factions, each with a distinct military doctrine that reshapes how you fight. The United States fields air superiority with extended jet range and precision strikes. Russia overwhelms with discounted armor and infantry, flooding the map with numbers. Iran exploits rear flanking at 75% bonus damage and deploys units that act immediately on spawn. North Korea entrenches behind fortified cities with +50% bombardment resistance. New Zealand runs a lean volunteer force — fewer units, lower budget, but every capture heals your army and restores the city.

These aren't cosmetic differences. Faction choice alters your draft budget, unit costs, terrain bonuses, defensive modifiers, production capacity, and AI behavior. Two players running the same strategy with different factions will produce different wars.

THE DRAFT

Before combat begins, you build your roster. Each faction receives a gold budget — typically 900 to 1,020 gold — and a catalog of 21 unit types spanning ground forces, armor, air power, naval assets, and special operations. You pick up to 8 units (some factions allow fewer), balancing cost against capability. Unspent gold carries into the match as starting funds.

A lean draft with scouts and infantry leaves gold for early production. A heavy draft with tanks, jets, and a bomber puts firepower on the field immediately but starves your economy. There is no correct answer — only the answer that survives contact with the enemy's composition.

21 UNIT TYPES

Ground forces form your frontline: Infantry entrench for bonus defense, Tanks absorb hits with armor plating, Artillery suppresses from 5 hexes away, and Engineers repair your cities and fortify defensive positions. Recon and Scout units extend your vision deep into enemy territory. APCs carry up to 5 units across the map and rapid-deploy them in a single turn. Snipers eliminate foot soldiers from concealment with 92% accuracy. Mortars lob indirect fire but require a spotter in range.

Air power controls the tempo: Jets strike with afterburner speed, Helicopters strafe adjacent hexes, Bombers deliver 3x strategic strikes against structures and naval targets. Paratroopers airdrop behind enemy lines, immune to anti-air fire.

Naval forces dominate the coastline: Destroyers bombard from shore, Submarines dive invisible for ambush attacks, AA Frigates deny enemy air over open water, and Transports ferry your ground army across seas.

Then there is the Nuclear Launcher — 3,500 gold, one warhead, 30 damage to the target and every adjacent hex. It self-destructs after firing. Guard it carefully.

Every combat unit has a unique ultimate ability on cooldown. Tank Blitz resets movement and grants a double attack. Artillery Barrage hits the target and all adjacent hexes. Submarine Dive renders it invisible for two turns with a 50% damage bonus on the first strike. PsyOps Phantom Signal injects false reports into the enemy operations log. These abilities create decisive moments that swing the battle when used at the right time.

TERRAIN AND POSITIONING

Hex terrain is not decoration. Forests grant +2 defense and +10 dodge while blocking line of sight. Mountains provide +3 defense but cost extra movement for most units. Cities generate 100 gold per turn and offer garrison defense. Deserts and plains allow rapid movement but leave units exposed.

Flanking matters. Attacking from behind deals bonus damage. Entrenched infantry behind a fortified forest hex with an engineer healing adjacent is a fundamentally different problem than the same infantry standing on open plains. Elevation, concealment, and chokepoints emerge naturally from the procedurally generated maps.

Seven map generators produce battlefields ranging from tight corridors to sprawling continental theaters of up to 5,000 hexes, ensuring no two matches play the same.

FOG OF WAR

You see only what your units see. Vision is computed per unit based on type, terrain, and special abilities. Recon units see 4-5 hexes deep. Radar sweeps 8 hexes in a rotating directional arc. Scouts ignore forest vision penalties.

Snipers and PsyOps units are invisible unless an enemy stands adjacent. Submerged submarines vanish entirely. Smoke screens from mortar ultimates blind everything in a 2-hex radius for two turns.

On Medium and Hard difficulty, the AI operates under the same fog of war rules you do. It does not see your hidden sniper. It does not track your submarine. It builds its threat map from what its units can actually observe, and it makes mistakes because of it.

ECONOMY AND PRODUCTION

Your HQ generates 200 gold per turn. Every city you capture adds 100 gold. Damaged cities cost more to produce from, so engineers repairing your infrastructure directly improves your economic output.

Production happens at any city or structure you control. The full unit catalog is available — if you can afford it. Iran's infantry costs 30% less. Russia's tanks are discounted 15%. New Zealand cannot build jets at all. These constraints force doctrinal production decisions that differ every game based on your faction and the state of the map.

COMPETITIVE MULTIPLAYER

HexArmy supports 2, 3, and 4 player matches in free-for-all or team configurations (2v2, 2v1, 3v1). Matches run in real-time turns over Socket.IO with disconnect recovery.

A 17-tier ranked ladder tracks your ELO from Bronze III through General. Monthly and lifetime leaderboards reset and record your competitive history. Create or join a Battalion — a clan of up to 20 players with its own ELO rating, emblem, and leaderboard position.

Single-elimination tournaments support 8, 16, or 32 player brackets with automatic seeding and ELO rewards for placement.

FIVE VICTORY CONDITIONS

Not every war ends the same way:

  • HQ Takeover — Capture the enemy headquarters.

  • Military Annihilation — Destroy every enemy unit.

  • Complete Domination — Capture all cities and destroy all enemy units.

  • Infantry Only — Only foot troops may be drafted and produced.

  • 20 Turn Survival — The player controlling the most cities after 20 turns wins.

Each mode reshapes your draft, your economy, and your definition of a winning position.

PROGRESSION

24 military ranks from Private to General, earned through combat actions, victories, and mastery challenges. Higher ranks require elite conditions: win streaks on Hard difficulty, flawless victories, and faction-specific mastery.

97 commendation medals track everything from your first kill to a 10-game win streak to completing a sub-7-turn victory. A persistent service record logs your lifetime combat statistics, K/D ratio, economic output, and competitive history in a public dossier.

Units that survive combat earn experience and promote through three tiers: Veteran, Specialist, and Commander. Each promotion offers a specialization choice that permanently alters the unit's capabilities. Commanders project faction-specific auras that buff nearby allies — and their death is a significant loss.

KEY FEATURES

  • 10 Doctrine-Driven Factions — Each faction has unique costs, bonuses, restrictions, and AI personality. Faction choice is a strategic decision, not a cosmetic one.

  • 21 Unit Types with Ultimate Abilities — Ground, air, naval, and special forces, each with a unique cooldown ability that creates decisive tactical moments.

  • True Fog of War — Vision is per-unit, terrain-dependent, and applies to the AI on Medium and Hard. No omniscient enemies.

  • Procedural Battlefields — 7 map generators, up to 5,000 hex tiles. No two matches play the same.

  • Competitive Ranked Ladder — 17-tier ELO system with Battalions, tournaments, and monthly leaderboards.

  • 5 Victory Conditions — HQ Takeover, Annihilation, Complete Domination, Infantry Only, and 20 Turn Survival.

  • Unit Promotion System — Veterans promote with branching specializations. Commanders project battlefield auras.

  • 97 Commendation Medals — Deep achievement system tracking combat milestones, mastery, and elite play.

  • 6-Direction Sprite Rendering — Units visually face their movement direction with 504 unique perspective-aware sprite variants.

  • Adaptive AI — Faction-aware AI with three difficulty tiers that adapts targeting, production, retreat, and territory control to its doctrine.

  • Multiplayer — 2-4 players, free-for-all or teams, real-time turns with disconnect recovery.

  • Full Gamepad Support — Analog stick navigation, trigger zoom, and face-button controls for couch play.

4546590.name: Meowdieval Clowder
4546590.about_the_game:
Meowdieval Clowder is a colony sim where you manage a medieval settlement of cats. Start small: a wooden hut, a couple of whiskered hunters, and a simple dream of a well-fed life. Gradually develop your village, master new crafts, explore the surrounding lands, and defend your clowder from enemies.

Key features:

  • A colony of cats: each with their own personality, skills, and quirks

  • Inheritable and acquired traits

  • Production progression from wood and stone to steel

  • Expeditions and a global map

  • Tactical real-time combat with pause

  • Equipment with unique properties and modifiers

  • Base building and defense

Manage a colony of cats

Every cat is an individual with their own personality, skills, and needs. Some are born hunters, others become master craftsmen, and some would rather bask in the sun all day instead of working. And yes, you'll have to live with that.

A cat's mood and relationships affect the efficiency of the entire colony. A well-fed, content cat works better, this rule quickly proves itself true.

From club to claymore

Everything starts simple: a wooden club in paw and stones picked right off the ground. Over time, you'll progress through copper, bronze, iron, and finally forged steel.

Each new material unlocks not just stronger items, but entire production chains. Simple workshops gradually transform into a real forge, where weapons and armor are born, capable of protecting your clowder from any threat.

Inheritable traits and upbringing

Every cat has innate traits: appearance, personality, and aptitudes. These traits are passed down through generations: a brave and strong father is likely to bring equally courageous kittens into the world.

But heredity is just the beginning. Over their lives, cats gain perks, mastering specific crafts and roles. A blacksmith who spends years at the forge becomes a true master of their trade. A hunter who tracks prey across dozens of expeditions gains unique abilities. Losing such a cat is a true tragedy, but that's what makes your clan's survival so meaningful.

Explore the world

Your colony is not isolated. Around you lie forests, mountains, plains - a vast world full of resources, dangers, and unexpected encounters. To survive and thrive, staying within four walls isn't enough, you must venture beyond the horizon.

Gather squads and send them on expeditions. Explore the global map, discover new locations, find rare resources. Meet other cats and invite them to your clowder - every new whiskered soul could become a key member of your colony.

But the world won't wait. Mice, rats, and dogs are already settling these lands, building their nests and villages. Send your squads to destroy these strongholds, push the enemies back from your home, and make the lands around you safer.

Defend your clowder

Your settlement is constantly under threat. Enemies will not leave you alone: they will attack, steal supplies, ambush your hunters, and lay siege to your walls.

You'll command squads of cats in real-time combat with tactical pause. A well-equipped cat can turn the tide of battle, and a coordinated group can hold off overwhelming forces.

Reinforce your walls, build defensive structures. The stronger your clowder, the more peaceful life becomes within it.

Choose your gear

Equipment is not just about defense and damage. Every piece of clothing and weapon has unique properties and modifiers - meaning it can become a key element of your strategy.

Collect, compare, look for perfect combinations. The right gear can turn an ordinary cat into a legendary hero, capable of shifting the outcome of a battle alone or supplying the colony with resources of the highest quality.

Meowdieval Clowder is in development. Subscribe and wishlist the game to stay updated.

Here, sharp claws and a fluffy tail rule!

A Pure Roguelike Challenge

4547110.name: Vaethorn: Realm of Legends
4547110.about_the_game:
Vaethorn: Realm of Legends is a tactical roguelite card game set within the pages of an ancient, living storybook. As you venture deeper into the realms, every choice you make is written into the fate of each card and of your Lord. The sharpest moments of strategy lie in your decisions, and the closer you draw to the dragon's mountain, the hotter the fire burns. Play without a timer, and find yourself lost in the weight of each choice.

Attack Cards:
Each turn, you draw new attack cards. Use them to break a Keeper's defense, or place them into your Lord's revitalize formula to preserve your vitality.

Relic Cards:

After every successful expedition, you earn three relic cards, and each one demands a careful decision. A relic card can be played in three places: place it in the slot to empower your attacks, place it on your Lord to preserve vitality, or place it on a Keeper to weaken its defense. Every equation you solve shapes the course of your journey through the realms.

Sorcerer Cards:

Captured in the battles of the realms, sorcerers lay down their lives for the Lord — their only purpose is to protect. You must play your sorcerer cards at the right place and the right moment. Each sorcerer is one-use only: placed into the slot, they fulfill their duty, and there they fall. A fallen sorcerer never returns, and your journey continues without them.

Every Card Joins the Journey:

Each turn, 3 relic cards and 1 sorcerer card are drawn from your inventory. The number of attack cards grows with the realm's difficulty. By the time you reach the Boss, your card pool is filled with everything you've gathered across the journey — and you'll see your richest hands in that final battle.

16 Lords, 16 Challenges:

Every Lord has their own vitality, their own revitalize formula, and their own destined path across the map. Some Lords are forgiving; others demand flawless play from the very first card. Wherever your chosen Lord's destined realms fall on the map, the difficulty of your journey and the strategy it demands will be shaped by that path.


30 Hand-Illustrated Realms:

Every realm is drawn by hand with care. Chart your route through destined realms and perilous transit battles, and manage your vitality across the entire journey. There are no easy heals waiting, only the cards in your hand.

Balanced Backward from the Boss:

Every value in Vaethorn is derived backward from the final Boss. Defense stats, realm difficulty, Lord vitality, relic and sorcerer cards... everything is tuned to make the journey feel tense, fair, and rewarding.
4547110.supported_languages: English, German, Turkish, French, Italian, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil

4547120.name: Artificial Violet
4547120.about_the_game:
ARTIFICIAL VIOLET

What remains of you when algorithms decide for you?

Step into the role of Violeta, an influencer who builds her life around social media in search of validation. Between filters, trends, and endless comments, her sense of self begins to fracture—until she no longer knows who she is beyond the screen.

Throughout this visual novel, your choices will shape her journey.

Every decision matters. Every interaction leaves a mark.

Will you chase approval at any cost, or try to reclaim what remains of your authenticity?

The game features multiple endings based on the choices you make.

Between what we show and who we are…
Who is Violeta, really?
4547120.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America

4547180.name: REST STOP
4547180.about_the_game:
Abandoned and alone at a highway rest stop in the middle of the Appalachian Mountains, the night breeze begins to caress your cheek. The scent of wet pine tells you you’re home. The taste of iron in your mouth reminds you that you can’t stay here forever.

Rest Stop is a first-person psychological horror experience.

 Play as Lia, a young woman who finds herself unexpectedly stranded at a highway rest stop deep in the Appalachian mountains. Find your missing friend, avoid unsettling travelers, and figure out how to get home before something terrible happens to either of you. You can’t stay here forever.

Talk with others

There's other people passing through the rest stop. Some of them might be able to help you. Others have their own destinations to worry about. Some of them should be avoided at all costs.

Find a way forward

Find a way out of here that causes the least amount of pain possible.

FEATURES

  • Retro aesthetic

  • Atmospheric environment

  • Light puzzle elements

  • Rich narrative experience

  • An unshakeable feeling of dread

4547190.name: Slime Clime
4547190.about_the_game:
Become Gloopert

You are Gloopert, a young slime from the city on a grand adventure! Do you have what it takes to climb up to the temple

and save the magic?

Though ultimately this is your own task, you might find people willing to help at any corner. Speak to them to learn about magic and yourself!

Game Features

  • Explore three hand-crafted areas on your trip to the top

  • A normal Gloopert can walk and jump

  • As you progress through the game, you unlock the ability to dash, double jump and wall jump!

  • Speak to NPCs and answer their questions to unlock these abilities and determine your own magic

Accessibility Options

This game offers multiple accessibility options. In the settings you can:

  • remap controls (one-handed by default)

  • slow down game speed

  • enable free checkpoints

  • adjust volume & visuals

4547250.name: ANIMA : Dark Fairy Tale for Adults
4547250.about_the_game:
About This Game

## The Story

Trace the distorted truth of the protagonist. Wounded inner thoughts and memories you wanted to deny will begin to tighten their grip on you.

Key Features:

  • 3-Chapter Structure: Follow the protagonist’s journey to recover lost memories through chapters set in a Hospital, School, and Home.

  • Psychological Pressure and Plot Twists: Cooperate with allies, only to face the shocking truths hidden behind them.

  • Horror Direction: Classic jump scares combined with a heavy, soul-shaking narrative.

Developer’s Note:

I’ve strived to capture the raw cruelty of reality. Beyond just being a "scary game," I hope this serves as an opportunity to look at the world from the perspective of those suffering in pain. The content can be quite disturbing, so please be mentally prepared before playing.

## Psychological Survival & Puzzles

Simply finding the path is not enough. You must manage three core psychological indicators that haunt your sanity as you delve into the grim truth.

  • Stress (⚡): Sharp tension numbs your senses. As stress reaches its limit, progressing normally becomes impossible, eventually leading you down a path of ruin.

  • Depression (💧): The swamp of deep helplessness makes every step heavy. As depression consumes you, the world grows darker, drawing you closer to a tragic end.

  • Karma (👁️): Every small choice you make accumulates into a heavy 'Karma.' This invisible burden will ultimately dictate the final fate you must face in the decisive moment.

## Key Features

  • Real-time Stat Management: Monitor your psychological state through a meticulously designed UI and balance your stats using situational items and actions.

  • Puzzles: Engage with unique puzzles and environmental gimmicks that challenge your perception.

  • A Grim Modern Fairytale: A cruel yet beautiful narrative crafted specifically for an adult audience.

  • Psychological Pressure: Symbolic and grotesque imagery that delivers a deeper sense of dread than direct gore ever could.

  • Multiple Endings: Over five brutal conclusions determined entirely by the weight of your choices.

  • Unique Artwork: A bizarre and overwhelming atmosphere created through a distinct blend of static illustrations and immersive text.

🔈 Sound Mode Settings Check the [Options] menu in-game!

  • Streamer Mode OFF: Enjoy the original soundtrack exactly as the developer intended. 🎶

  • Streamer Mode ON: Optimized to prevent copyright issues when streaming on platforms like YouTube. 📺

4547290.name: Night Of Dread
4547290.about_the_game:
Night of Dread is a retro-style third-person survival horror inspired by the cult classic zombie movies and retro games of the 80s and 90s. It features modernized tank over-the-shoulder aiming and gameplay with a heavy, tense feel, paired with classic inventory management and exploration. Navigate atmospheric environments and locations with low-poly graphics, and fight the undead, blending an early 3D style with modern engine techniques and capabilities for a gritty, immersive experience.

  • Immersive and atmospheric environments.

  • Third-person gameplay.

  • Low-poly style graphics.

  • Retro-style survival horror.

  • Classic inventory managment with limited saves.

  • Exploration and engaging combat.

"Add Night of Dread to your Wishlist now to face the nightmare."

4547330.name: Hotel Beresford
4547330.about_the_game:
During the Great Depression, in the aftermath of the devastating impact of the Wall Street Crash of 1929, a tragic event shook the very foundations of Hotel Beresford.

Now, your mission is to uncover the truth.

You will follow in the footsteps of Samuel Chapman, the hotel’s owner and a key figure in the incident, piecing together what really happened through memories, testimonies… and secrets that were never meant to surface.

But there’s something else.

Is this event connected to the disturbing incidents surrounding the Beresford family in 1824?

INVESTIGATE, OBSERVE, DISCOVER

Hotel Beresford is a visual novel focused on the psychology of its characters, where every line of dialogue, every glance, and every environmental detail may hide a crucial clue.

Nothing is random.
No one is truly innocent.

To uncover the mystery, you’ll need to trust your instincts:

  • Analyze each scene for hidden details

  • Interpret character behavior

  • Make choices that shape your understanding of the story

  • Solve puzzles to move forward in your investigation

A UNIQUE ATMOSPHERE

Immerse yourself in an elegant yet unsettling hotel set in the 1920s, where art style and narrative come together to create a deeply immersive and disturbing experience.

Every guest has a story.
Every story hides something.

KEY FEATURES

  • Mystery-driven narrative with a psychological focus

  • Investigation based on observation and deduction

  • Puzzles seamlessly integrated into the story

  • Setting inspired by the 1920s

  • Complex characters with interconnected secrets

Hotel Beresford holds the truth.

The question is… are you ready to uncover it?
4547330.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain

4547370.name: SEVER
4547370.about_the_game:
Down to your last $100, you enter the darkest, most dangerous corner of the city, with one last chance to change your life. Here, flesh has value — Do you have what it takes to make it out alive?

SEVER is a short horror blackjack experience where every hand could be your last. Face twisted bosses, with sinister tricks and varied mechanics, as you risk everything for a shot at unimaginable wealth.

 The fear settles in your bones, you realize there is no escape. Do you understand what you've stumbled into?...

Short yet intense experience designed to deliver tension, thrills, and a rush of adrenaline.

Gamble wisely and trade pieces of yourself for cash. Push your luck—and pray you don’t find its limits.

Use items to sway the advantage in your favor against cheating Dealers.

Play blackjack with many twists — every decision matters, and failure is lethal.

Challenge multiple bosses with increasing difficulty. 

Will you walk away rich, or become just another part of the collection? Every hand you play brings you closer to survival—or oblivion.

4547440.name: A Knight of Lothen
4547440.about_the_game:
Overview

Lothen has fallen.
Monsters roam its lands, and something far darker stirs beneath the ruins. Answering the king’s call, you are Sir Dorian Ester, a lone knight sent to reclaim a kingdom on the brink of collapse.

Core gameplay

A Knight of Lothen is a metroidvania where exploration and combat go hand in hand.

Traverse a connected world, unlock new abilities, and discover powerful items that open new paths, secrets, and challenges.

World / setting

Set in Vitallia, a dark medieval world shaped by war, and powerful history. From ruined strongholds to cursed wilderness, each area hides fragments of a larger story waiting to be uncovered.

Features

  • Fast-Paced combat

  • Original Heavy Metal Music

  • Atmospheric pixel world

  • Sword & Sorcery theme

Who it's for

Designed for players who enjoy exploration-driven action and mastering combat through skill and progression.

Inspired by classic action adventures and metroidvanias.

4547520.name: The Harbinger of the Deep
4547520.about_the_game:
Slice, Shock, or Shout away other Beings' frustrations! 

  • Carefully choose your actions to destroy others' frustrations and befriend them

  • Or, ignore them and choose to slay them all

  • Avoid the bullet hell of other Beings' frustrations and keep yourself alive

Journey through 8 vast areas of the Sea!

  • Find out the secrets that caused the Tsunami

  • Harder and harder challenges await the further areas

  • Unlock many shortcuts to travel the Sea easier

  • Meet many different faces and Beings along your journey

Choose your path and define the future of the Sea!

  • Multiple endings to explore

  • Choose the fate of the Beings you meet

  • Lead them or leave them all behind

Continue your story, anytime anywhere!

  • Available fully offline and optimized to be played on lower-spec devices

  • Playable on most gamepads, Mouse and Keyboard, and Keyboard only

  • Configurable Inputs and easy-to-access Backups

4547550.name: Railway End
4547550.about_the_game:
This is a point-and-click "spot the difference" game. It contains no dialogue, action, or combat elements and is not a horror game.

About the Story

A girl gets off a train at an empty station. She searches for anomalies in the scenes based on photos in an album. Only after finding all the anomalies can she continue. However, what awaits her at the end of the railway is…

Game Features

1. Original Music

2. Paper Artwork

3. A short game of approximately half an hour (around 10 scenes)

4. Two Endings (True Ending and Fake Ending)

Author's Note

Hello everyone, I'm HAIM. I was responsible for all aspects of this game: artwork, music, script, and programming. With the goal of making this game accessible to people all over the world without language barriers, I once again challenged myself to create a textless game. Since childhood, I've often dreamed about trains. In recent years, I've started traveling to various places to collect materials about trains, and this year, this railway-themed game was born.

4547610.name: Abyss Cards
4547610.about_the_game:
Abyss Cards is a strategic roguelike deck-builder with real-time auto-battle combat. Recruit powerful units, cast devastating spells, and collect ancient relics as you descend deeper into a cursed dungeon — where every choice is permanent and death means starting over.

🃏 Build Your Deck, Define Your Strategy

Draft from dozens of unique unit cards and spell cards across every run. Field fearsome warriors, cunning mages, spectral archers, and legendary heroes — then combine them with powerful synergies to create an unstoppable force.

⚔️ Watch Your Army Fight

Deploy your cards onto the battlefield and let them clash in real-time auto-battle. Position matters. Timing matters. The right combination of units and spells can turn a hopeless battle into a glorious victory.

💎 Collect Powerful Relics

Discover rare and legendary relics that fundamentally alter your playstyle. A single relic can transform your entire strategy — shielding your frontline, corrupting your enemies, or flooding your hand with mana.

🗺️ Forge Your Own Path

Navigate a branching dungeon map filled with battles, elite encounters, mysterious events, merchants, and campfires. Every node is a decision. Every run tells a different story.

💀 Roguelike Depth

Permadeath — every run is a fresh start

Multiple character classes — each with a unique starting deck and playstyle

Scaling difficulty — from casual adventure to mythic nightmare

Unlockable content — discover new cards and relics across runs

Three dungeon stages — each with its own enemies, bosses, and atmosphere

👻 Face the Darkness

Battle through three haunted stages — from the cursed Shadow Abyss to the spectral Soul Rift and the terrifying Abyss Heart. Confront elite champions, ancient golems, phantom empresses, and world-devouring final bosses.

Easy to learn. Impossible to master. The Abyss is waiting.

4547730.name: Under A Groove
4547730.about_the_game:
“Under A Groove” is a fast-paced rhythm action game that anyone can jump into.

Just press the button in time with the beat.

Simple controls make it easy to start—but staying in the groove is where the real challenge begins.

Immerse yourself in a world where music and motion are perfectly synchronized.

Every beat drives vibrant, stylish animations, creating a satisfying audiovisual experience.

Feel the rhythm.

Stay in the groove.

Features

Just press the button in time with the rhythm—easy to learn, fun to master.

  • Fully synchronized visuals and music

Experience seamless audiovisual feedback that enhances every beat.

  • Catchy and energetic soundtrack

Music that makes you want to move.

  • Dynamic animations that react to your performance

Your success changes what you see.

  • Quick, replayable rhythm challenges

Perfect for both short sessions and long playtime.

4547760.name: Evil thought
4547760.about_the_game: Evil Thought is a first-person psychological horror game that blends Chinese folklore and dreamcore aesthetics. It focuses on immersive atmosphere and narrative-driven puzzles, with no traditional combat. Players will step into endlessly looping, eerie spaces to uncover the truth behind the protagonist’s descent into evil thoughts. The game features numerous unique puzzle levels and multiple endings, with a main story playtime of approximately 3–5 hours.

4547800.name: EIR
4547800.about_the_game:
Survive the relentless hordes in a world of swords and sorcery. EIR is an action-packed roguelite survival game that combines the satisfying combat of an auto-shooter with the strategic economy of a skill-drafting system.

【Key Features】

  • Survive the Relentless Hordes
    Your attacks are fully automatic. Take control of unique characters—from a valiant Knight wielding devastating sword techniques to a powerful Mage casting ancient spells. Focus on your positioning to dodge and weave through countless monsters attacking from all directions, and gather as much Gold as you can from fallen enemies.

  • Skill Drafting: Luck Meets Strategy
    Use your hard-earned Gold to purchase new Skill Cards. The spells and weapon techniques available in the shop are randomized every time. Adapt to the situation, buy the right cards, and discover powerful synergies to construct your ultimate build.

  • The "Grade Up" Dilemma: Spend or Save?
    Every Skill Card has a "Grade" that dictates its power. Initially, only lower-grade cards will appear in the shop. However, by spending your Gold to upgrade the overall shop Grade, you unlock the chance to draft much stronger, rarer, and more devastating high-tier skills.

Do you buy cheap skills right now to survive the current wave? Or do you save your Gold to upgrade the Grade for explosive power later on?

Your survival depends not just on your reflexes, but on how wisely you manage your limited resources.

4547810.name: GRIDLOCK DUNGEON
4547810.about_the_game:
Defeat your enemies by making every move and item count within strict limits!

What is GRIDLOCK DUNGEON?

A rogue-lite RPG where the grid is your battlefield. Navigate to an item’s tile and select it to activate its effect. Adapt to enemy patterns by strategically switching between offensive weapons like swords and defensive gear like shields.

A Shifting Board with Every Step

Moving changes the item you left behind. If you ignore an item, it’s gone! Don't let a "must-have" item transform while you're distracted. Items appear randomly, so if what you need isn't there... well, you know what to do.

Limited Movement and Actions

You can't just wander freely. Movement is restricted, forcing you to find the most efficient path to your target. Even if you reach an item, your actions per turn are limited. Ask yourself: "Is this the right moment to use this?"

Forge Your Own Path

From fearsome foes and shops to treasures and mysterious events—the route is yours to choose. Balance your HP and inventory to find the optimal strategy.

The Law of the Dungeon : Move efficiently. Act wisely. Survive.

4547840.name: Link Lab
4547840.about_the_game:
Link Lab is an abstract and relaxed puzzle game for all ages. All you have to do is connect objects together to solve each level. Linked objects share and mix traits allowing you to create objects that didn't previously exist to solve levels. Be careful which resource you spend where though, as each one is single use and you might need that piece later!

Each world features new mechanics that complicate and expand the game space and challenge you to think in new ways. Explore the way these mechanics interplay as you progress through over 100 levels.

A mouse or touch screen is all you need to start solving problems by making connections!

4547860.name: Escape from EloHell
4547860.about_the_game:
Welcome to Escape from EloHell.

Aka "Matchhistory Slot Machine" Aka "One-Click MOBA" Aka "We removed everything from ranked that was getting in your way"

Ranked climbing in its purest form, no toxic teammates, no 40 minutes hostage situations, just pure grind.

Finish matches with a single click, chain win-streaks into combos, collect buffs and unlock skill upgrades as you claw your way to Rank 1.

How to play?

Each match on your board has a winrate, a role, special effects and makes your MMR change by a certain amount. Finish matches with a single click - your results trigger chain reactions across the board: dodges, resets, winrate swaps, and more. Read the board, pick the right match at the right time, and turn the odds in your favor to gain MMR and reach Rank 1.

Features

  • One-Click Matches. Every match resolves instantly. No loading screens, no queues, no surrendering at 15.

  • Season System. Each season has a limited number of rounds. Race to hit your peak rank before the season ends!

  • Many different Match Effects. Matches chain together through effects like dodging neighbors, swapping winrates, triggering flashbacks on completed matches, duplicating results, and unleashing chaos across the board.

  • Buff System. Collect persistent buffs through periodic Patch Notes events. Buffs activate based on conditions like win-streaks, rank-ups, or roles played. Upgrade them up to level 5 for maximum impact.

  • Tokens. Unlock consumable abilities between runs like Spin, Chaos, Reset and Lucky Day tokens that let you manipulate the board in your favor.

  • Skill Upgrades. By completing achievements you can unlock Skill Upgrades that give you an edge on your next run.

4547900.name: DNO: Lone Courier
4547900.about_the_game:
Welcome to Dnovsk

DNO: Lone Courier is a delivery game in the village of Dnovsk. You play as a character named Eddie, who went to work his shift as a courier.
Explore a quiet but mysterious settlement where every delivery brings you closer to understanding the place and its people.

Drive the boat

Move between locations using your trusty boat. Master the controls and navigate through changing conditions to reach your destinations on time.

Upgrade the boat

Enhance your boat’s performance and durability. Better upgrades allow you to take on more challenging routes and deliveries.

Get the package

Pick up packages from helicopter. Each delivery may come with its own risks and conditions.

Deliver the products

Transport goods to their destinations and earn your pay. Plan your routes carefully to avoid delays and complete orders efficiently.

Additional features:

  • Investigate location — discover hidden details and secrets around Dnovsk.

  • Talk to the residents — meet locals and learn their stories.

  • Work off your debts — complete jobs and gradually get back on your feet.

4547950.name: Dude The Dark Agent
4547950.about_the_game:
A Dark Agent, A Deadly Mission

Dude The Dark Agent is a 2.5D action game that blends the classic 90s FPS spirit with modern features. Hunt down enemy soldiers, smash ancient statues, and survive against dangers lurking around every corner in dense jungle maps rendered with the raycasting engine.

### ⚔️ Choose Your Armory

Instantly switch between four different weapons:

- **Shotgun** — Devastating power at close range

- **AK-47** — Automatic fire, mid-range dominance

- **Uzi** — Rapid fire, ambush-style combat

- **Knife** — Silent and deadly close combat

### 🏆 Skill Tree & Shop

Upgrade your skills with the gold and diamonds you collect:

- Increase your health and armor capacity

- Upgrade your weapon power

- Improve your drop rate

- Buy ammo, health, and armor from the shop

### 👥 Local Splitscreen for Up to 4 Players

Fight on the same screen with your friends! 2, 3, or 4-player splitscreen mode comes with full gamepad support. Each player chooses their own character, carries their own weapon, and determines their own fate.

### 🗺️ Level Editor & Automatic Design

Create your own maps with the built-in level editor. Place trees, rocks, statues, enemies, items, and more on a 75x75 grid. If you lack creativity, press the "Automatic Design" button — the algorithm will generate a unique jungle map for you: full of temple ruins, tombstones, strategic troop positions, and hidden treasures.

### 🎯 Combo System & Achievements

Create combo chains with consecutive headshots:

- 2x Headshot → "YOU'RE GOOD!"

- 3x Headshot → "YOU'RE PERFECT!"

- 4x Headshot → "YOU'RE GREAT!"

- 5x+ Headshot → "YOU'RE SUPER!"

Prove yourself with 26 different Steam achievements.

### 🔥 Features

- Classic 2.5D raycasting FPS engine

- 4 different weapons + knives

- Destructible statues and rocks

- Enemy AI: attackers, static shooters, and fleeing soldiers

- Blood particles and impact effects

- Headshot combo system

- Skill tree and shop

- Local splitscreen for up to 4 players (gamepad supported)

- Built-in level editor + automatic map generator

- 26 Steam achievements

- In-game video recording

- 24 language support

- Music and sound effects system

4548000.name: Runeborne Arena
4548000.about_the_game:
INTRO

USE YOUR VOICE. MASTER THE RUNES. FACE THE ARENA.

Runeborne Arena is a dark fantasy action experience combining deliberate, skill-based combat with real-time voice abilities — or traditional controls if you prefer.

Fight through dangerous regions, collect powerful runes, and unlock the path to a final boss that adapts to your playstyle.

GAMEPLAY OVERVIEW

Explore four distinct regions, each hiding a powerful rune.

While carrying runes, you gain unique advantages in combat. Only by collecting all four can you unlock the gate to the final boss.

Your journey is a balance between power and risk — the more you rely on certain abilities, the more the final challenge will evolve.

HYBRID COMBAT SYSTEM

Runeborne Arena combines traditional, timing-based melee combat with voice-controlled abilities.

Every action matters — positioning, stamina management, and precise timing are key to survival.

Use your voice mid-combat to gain the upper hand, but mastery requires control over both systems.

A separate non-voice mode is also available, allowing all abilities to be used through traditional inputs for players who prefer not to use a microphone or play quietly.

 VOICE-DRIVEN COMBAT

Use real spoken words to activate abilities in real time.

Your voice is not just a feature — it is part of your combat toolkit.

 RUNE POWER SYSTEM

Each rune grants unique combat advantages while carried.

Adapt your playstyle by choosing how and when to use them. Runes can make you stronger — but overreliance may come at a cost.

 ADAPTIVE FINAL BOSS

The final boss adapts to your playstyle.

Frequent use of certain runes will make the boss more resistant — and more dangerous — against those abilities.

Your combat habits directly influence the challenge you face.

 INTENSE ARENA BATTLES

Engage in challenging combat that rewards patience, precision, and discipline.

Enemies hit hard, punish mistakes, and force you to learn their patterns in order to survive.

 DARK FANTASY ATMOSPHERE

Explore a mysterious world filled with corrupted nature, ancient power, and haunting environments.

From shadowy forests to forgotten ruins, each area blends beauty with danger.

 CHALLENGING ENEMIES

Fight powerful enemies that demand adaptation and mastery.

Every encounter pushes you to improve, react with precision, and make the right decisions under pressure.

4548050.name: Imperial Wager: The Shattered Crown of Augustus
4548050.about_the_game:
"The Realm is a Board. The Crown is the Jackpot."

Imperial Wager: The Shattered Crown of Augustus is a macro-level feudal grand strategy game where absolute control is a myth. Centuries after the fall of the First Emperor, the god-blessed Crown of Augustus lies shattered, its volatile shards sealed within surviving, half-broken relics scattered across the realm.

To claim the empty throne, you must master these enigmatic devices—navigating a high-stakes system of risk, unpredictable AI delegation, and geopolitical gambling. Operating from your Regent’s Keep, you will manipulate your treasury, draft mandates, and manage your vassals, watching as a bloody war of swords and subversion dynamically unfolds across the procedurally generated realm.

You can dictate every sword swing and tax collection yourself—but trying to micromanage a decades-long conquest will drain you quickly. A true Dominus knows better; they set the stakes, delegate the rest, and play the odds.

Key Features:

Command the Realm (Card Mechanics):

Wars are not fought with drawn swords, but with Imperial Mandates. Draw from your faction’s deck and project your will directly onto the map. Each card projects a specific geometric shape, challenging you to cleverly overlap effects to quell Unrest, purge Venality, and spread your Influence.

Delegate to Feudal Vassals (AI Management):

To truly expand the empire, you must entrust power to the officials in your cabinet. The vassals you assign bring their own distinct personalities to the table, eventually melding into a collective Faction Psyche. This overarching psychology forms the underlying logic of your state, guiding how your autonomous AI behaves and reacts to the shifting world. You provide the stakes; they roll the dice.

Rig the House Odds (Spatial Puzzles):

Rebuild the lost laws of antiquity. Fit geometric, Tetris-like Tenet blocks into the Monolith of Edicts to literally weave the rules of your fiefdom. By customizing these physical laws, you dictate the overarching strategy of your campaign. You must weigh powerful tradeoffs and constantly adapt your state's engine to navigate shifting eras, tilting the cosmic odds in your favor.

Consult the Relics (Risk & Reward):

The First Emperor left behind esoteric devices to calculate fate. Funding your empire and uncovering rare mandates relies heavily on consulting these ancient, unpredictable machines. Every relic boasts its own distinct probability mechanics and risk-versus-reward systems. Wager your wealth to awaken them, but beware the volatile whims of fortune.

Asymmetric Feudal Factions:

Play as one of several distinct medieval powers fighting over the remnants of Rome. Whether you rely on the heavy cavalry of House Aquila, the bureaucratic purges of House Valerius, or the shadow-subversion of the Frumentarii Cult, you must adapt your gambling style to survive the Dark Ages.

4548070.name: TERAFAB.AI
4548070.about_the_game:
TERAFAB.AI

You are Stuck in an "Eternal Monday", every sunset wipes the board clean, but, every sunrise hands you the chance to learn from every failed run before.

You have been tasked by the MacroHard Company with building a mega-factory to crank out 1 TeraWatt of custom AI chips integrated under 1 roof to power AI Cars, Bots, Satellites, Data Centers, and blast humanity straight into galactic civilization.

Meanwhile, Evil A.I. Bots and turrets will be Your enemies and try to destroy You and Your factory!

Dive into the world of factory automation with this comprehensive game designed for rapid prototyping and easy expansion, this game provides all the core mechanics for full-featured factory building and logistics.

Designed for Modularity: Quickly create new machines, items, recipes, and research paths.

Flexible Camera System: Features a Top-Down View with the quick option to switch to an immersive Third-Person View.

Complete Factory Foundation: Includes a full suite of machines, a robust conveyor system, power management, progression, and a playable character with inventory.

Core Gameplay Systems:

Advanced Logistics & Conveyor System

A complete system for managing item flow, built using performant instance control.

Spline-Based Conveyors: Set the start and end points for quick, flexible belt creation.

Smart Snapping: Belts snap automatically into the conveyor inputs/outputs of machines.

Logistics Tools: Includes Splitter and Merger machines for complex layouts.

Spline Roads and Stackable Conveyor Poles.

Complete Power System with Generators and Power Poles.

Machines & Production

A full example set of destructible factory machines with inventory and UI interfaces.

Generators: Solar Panel, Wind Power, Wood Burning, and Coal Generator.

Furnaces: Manual Furnace (no power/belts) and Electric Furnace (1 in/1 out).

Assemblers: Double Assembler Machine (2 in/2 out).

Resource Management: Miner, Chest, Container (with belt entrance), Power Poles (MK1, MK2, Cables).

Automatic Turrets

Includes recipes and items: Rock, Coal, Iron Ore, Copper Ore, Gold Ore, Organic Material, Wood, Copper Wire, Copper Ingot, Iron Ingot, Gold Ingot, Brick and Structure Part.

Progression & Research

Unlock new technologies using a currency called Donation Points and specific item requirements.

Centers: Dedicated Research Center and Donation Center machines.

World & Exploration

Infinite Level Spawn: Procedural and configurable generation of Foliage, Trees, Resources, and Enemies.

Enemy System: Random Enemy spawners and Enemy atacks ( Player and Buildings )

Map System: Simple Map and MiniMap interface.

Vehicle & Drone Systems: Includes a fully driveable Offroad Vehicle and Personal Drone/Drone Logistics.

Character & Player Mechanics

Inventory System: Full drag-and-drop support, filters, and equipment slots.

Equipment System: Simple, variable-based stat alteration for:

Weapons (Fire Rate)

Ammo (Damage)

Armor (Protection)

Legs (Character Speed)

JetPack (Consecutive flight time) (Includes "Good" and "Bad" versions of items.)

Death & Respawn: System with a dropped loot mechanic.

Quality of Life: HotBar System (0 to 9 keys), Painting System, and a Repair System (1 Structure Part repairs 100 points).

User Interface: Character Panel with statistics, a graph showing lifetime production/consumption, and 335 AI-generated portraits.

4548150.name: Glass Monsters
4548150.about_the_game:
Glass Monsters is a single-player first-person 3D survival shooter where every battle takes place in a procedurally assembled glass arena. You fight through constantly shifting spaces filled with transparent walls, domes, bridges, ramps, and other geometric structures, fend off waves of aggressive creatures, and search for safe ground where cover can stop being cover at any moment.

At its core, the game is about mobility and constant pressure. Accuracy matters, but staying alive also means keeping moving: running, jumping, managing stamina, changing routes, and reading the arena fast. The arena affects your tactics just as much as the enemies do. Some areas offer a brief moment of safety, others trap you, and the destructible glass environment gradually reshapes the flow of combat in the middle of each wave.

As you progress, you will fight through a series of levels with different architecture, lighting colors, and combat pacing. Some arenas focus on tight passages and sharp turns, while others are built around open spaces, vertical movement, and exposed routes. Enemy behavior also changes from one type to another: some overwhelm you in close combat, some attack from the air, others rely on leaps or ranged fire attacks. In the later stages, especially dangerous enemies appear that can break obstacles and force close-range encounters on their own terms.

The arsenal is built around combat roles rather than just damage values. One weapon is better for precision and controlling distance, another for sustained pressure, and another for heavy explosive shots with a separate ammo pool. Enemies can drop new weapons, ammunition, healing items, and rare pickups that temporarily change how the arena is visually perceived, helping you read the battlefield in a different way during combat.

The defining feature of Glass Monsters is the combination of procedural arenas, destructible glass environments, and dynamic transparency. Cover cracks and shatters into fragments, enemy and object silhouettes shift depending on the situation, and muzzle flashes and fire attacks make every encounter feel both beautiful and dangerous. This is not just a visual gimmick: the environment directly affects how you make decisions in battle.

The game is designed as a focused single-player experience: push deeper, adapt to each new arena, keep the weapons and ammo you have earned between levels, and survive increasingly intense pressure. At the same time, the game includes pause, save and load, difficulty selection, music volume adjustment, and interface language switching.

Key Features:

  • Single-player campaign with 9 levels and escalating difficulty

  • Procedurally assembled arenas with varied geometry and lighting styles

  • Fast-paced first-person combat with running, jumping, and stamina management

  • Multiple weapon types with distinct combat roles

  • Different enemy archetypes: ground-based, jumping, flying, ranged, and heavy threats

  • Destructible glass obstacles and cover that changes throughout the fight

  • Enemy drops including ammunition, healing, new weapons, and rare temporary upgrades

  • Boss phases where the arena and survival routes become even more dangerous

  • Save/load, difficulty options, and support for multiple interface languages

Your head drops into your palm, vision blur as your weighted eyelids slowly shut – just for a short moment of rest, you convince yourself…

Past Due: Midnight is a first-person psychological horror set inside a corporate office twisted by dark influence.

You awake at your desk in the middle of the night only to quickly realize something is off, and leaving the office may easier be said than done.

Make your way through six uniquely themed levels, each with its own atmosphere and visual identity.

Follow clues, solve puzzles, and interact with your surroundings – using whatever you can to push forward.

As you progress, piece together the phantom story unfolding across the office’s abandoned floors.

Can you survive the night and reach the exit, or will this nightmare consume you?

4548330.name: VI: REM
4548330.about_the_game:
The Only Way to Wake Up is the 6th Door

VI: REM is a ruthless dream dimension that doesn't hold your hand or tell you where to go. Your goal is simple but deadly: find the code for the 6th door and wake up from this nightmare. But this code won't be handed to you on a silver platter.

Someone is Following You

You are not alone in this dream. A relentless entity stalks you like a shadow. You cannot fight it. Your only options are to run, hide, and manage your flashlight wisely.

Gameplay Dynamics:

Unwavering Exploration: No quest markers or maps. You will roam freely across 5 different environments and forge your own path.

Mystery and Deduction: The story and the ultimate code for your escape are hidden within scattered notes. A seemingly ordinary detail or a randomly scribbled number... Pay attention to everything you see; it's up to you to piece the puzzle together.

Ruthless Survival: If you quit the game before escaping the nightmare, you start from scratch on your next playthrough. You can continue if you die in-game, but collected flashlight batteries do not respawn. You must solve the mystery before your light runs out.

Knowledge is Power: Even if everything resets when you close the game, the codes and notes you memorized in previous attempts will be your greatest weapon in your next escape.

Read carefully, stay quiet, and don't waste your light.

4548450.about_the_game:

游戏采用章节式结构，每一个章节对应一个独立的聊斋故事。玩家将通过文字对话、事件触发与剧情推进，逐步走入这些诡谲离奇的怪谈之中，接触隐藏在人、妖、鬼、怪背后的执念、欲望与因果。

本作想呈现的，不只是表面意义上的“中国风”，而是更接近《聊斋》原作气质的东方怪谈体验：怪谈背后有人心，异象背后有情，因果背后有代价。

4548470.name: Ground Floor
4548470.about_the_game:
Demo for Ground Floor is now available!

Join Our Community!

We're excited for you to play Ground Floor! To stay updated, share feedback, and chat with fellow players, please join our Discord server.

Game Summary:

Len Chandler finds himself trapped in an elevator. Searching for a way out, he travels from floor to floor. Strange scenes unfold between him and his colleagues, friends, and family. Fragments of conversation. Disconnected topics. Shifts in time. Unresolved problems.

Len must piece together storylines, explore rooms, and uncover the small actions that could set things right for the people he cares about most.

Along the way, Len gains insights into these central relationships. Every connection brings him closer to understanding what truly matters. But will it be enough for him to reach the Ground Floor of the elevator and his life?

Key Features:

  • Explore 28 elevator floors – Choose which floors to visit and experience the story in different ways each playthrough.

  • Experience a personal journey – Watch Len uncover the struggles of his colleagues, friends, and family.

  • Bridge emotional distance – Help Len navigate and repair his relationships.

  • Piece together 4 interconnected stories – Arrange 6 scenes per story and uncover how moments connect across time.

  • Solve problems through meaningful actions – Explore rooms, examine objects, and restore misplaced items to resolve each story.

  • Unravel the mystery – Find out why Len witnesses these life events and how resolving them allows him to leave the elevator.

Take on the role of a lost child who must hunt animals, fish, or gather berries to survive. But be careful! Even berries can kill you. Gather resources, craft items, and fight monsters and bosses to survive each day. But be careful at night and in dark places. Complete special tasks from NPCs that will allow you to advance the story, but be careful. If you don't complete a task on time, you may disappear from the world and have to start all over again.
