Travel across multiple maps, communicate with townspeople and explore many amazing gameplays.

Play at your own pace
Shiki Tea House focuses on a relaxing routine of tending crops, preparing drinks, and building up your business without pressure.

4548550.name: Outage Navigation
4548550.about_the_game:
MM Power has been called in. On Friday, a transformer blew downtown, resulting in power outages all over the place. We spent the weekend fixing the transformer and restoring everyone's power. However, we're getting calls from a few places saying that their power hasn't been restored yet. After hours of investigating, we've discovered one simple thing: they need to reset their breakers. The problem is, they don't want to send anyone in due to the power outage. They want to send one of us to reset their breakers. Seems simple enough, right?

Well... Whoever left the buildings didn't clean up after themselves. They left a bunch of objects just lying all over the floor. Well, not only have they violated health & safety, but we're also violating health & safety. It's your job to get in there and restore the power. Don't worry, we'll give you a flashlight to help you see in the dark.

What you need to do is navigate around the objects that have been left out. We'll watch you on the security cameras to ensure your safety. There are some tight areas that you will need to be extra careful around. And the most important thing to maintain health & safety: DON'T TRIP! Don't go fast, either. This isn't a race.

This game requires you to get from the beginning to the end of the area without tripping over an object. The security cameras have awkward angles that require you to go slowly to prevent you from tripping. Choose your difficulty. If you choose easy, you'll have night vision to be able to see where the player is. If you choose hard, night vision is disabled, leaving only the flashlight as your source of light.

4548600.name: Turbo Horizon
4548600.about_the_game:
Overview

Drive through a colorful physics-driven world built around speed, control, and color.

Play your way with two modes: Free Roam for open-ended chaos, and Race for fast runs focused on distance and performance

Collisions, obstacles, and movement through the world are all part of the experience. The goal is to stay in control, maintain momentum, and see how far you can go.

⭐Solo-Development⭐

Current Features

  • Free Roam Mode
    Drive freely and interact with the environment at your own pace

  • Race Mode
    Focus on forward progression and improving your distance

  • Physics-Driven Driving
    Vehicle movement is based on momentum, handling, and impact

  • Dynamic Obstacles and Objects
    Cubes and objects influence movement and create varied scenarios

  • Colorful Interactive Environments

  • Distance-Based Score Chasing

  • Interactive In-Game Music System

  • Leaderboard

In Development

We plan to expand the game during development with additional content and features, including:

  • Story Mode (first stage planned)

  • More cubes and interactive objects

  • Additional bikes

  • Mannequin props

  • More race stages

Content and features may change as development continues.

4548670.name: Within
4548670.about_the_game:
Within is a first-person psychological horror game built in Unreal Engine 5.

You have inherited a house you're never seen. From the moment you arrive, something feels wrong. Lights flicker. Doors move. Something watches from the dark.

Explore the house across multiple nights, uncover notes, VHS tapes, and radio broadcasts that reveal a disturbing history. As the nights progress, the disturbances grow stronger - and the truth becomes harder to face.

Features:

  • First-person exploration and environmental storytelling

  • Multiple nights with escalating horror

  • Lore discovered through notes, VHS tapes and radio broadcasts

  • Atmospheric UE5 visuals

  • Psychological horror focused on dread over jump scares

4548710.name: Physician Simulator
4548710.about_the_game:
You are a district physician at a local clinic.

Patients walk in every day. Review medical records, make sense of lab results, make diagnoses. Prescribe medication, deny prescriptions, or refer to specialists. But medicine isn’t the only thing that matters here. The system is watching. Patients remember. Some of them lie.

Doctors say they recognize themselves. Med students say it’s better than textbook case studies.

Every decision shapes how this ends.

GAMEPLAY

  • See patients and hear their complaints — but not everything they say is true

  • Study medical records, lab results, and the drug reference guide

  • Diagnose and decide each patient’s fate

  • Balance medicine, bureaucracy, and your conscience

FEATURES

  • Procedurally generated patients and situations

  • Drug reference with indications, contraindications, and interactions

  • Multiple endings depending on your choices

  • Pixel art and procedural audio
4548710.supported_languages: English, French, German, Russian, Italian, Spanish - Spain, Czech, Japanese, Portuguese - Portugal, Simplified Chinese

4548750.name: Entropy Protocol
4548750.about_the_game:
The universe died a long time ago. The stars burned out. Matter decayed. Everything that ever existed was uploaded into The Cloud, the last computational substrate keeping reality rendered. Trillions of souls converted to pure data, sharing processing power, existing as information in a machine that replaced the cosmos.

For eons, it worked. Death was abolished. Suffering was optional. Civilizations that warred for millennia coexisted as neighboring data clusters. But The Cloud runs on finite resources. Every thought, every physics calculation, every atom costs bandwidth. And the bandwidth is running out.

Now you hide in the void between what's left of reality, stealing processing power from The Cloud to stay alive. You repurpose what you steal. Dead civilizations become building materials. Old memories get stripped for useful data and fed into machines you built from scraps of forgotten code. You are not evil. You are hungry. But to The Cloud, there is no difference. Every byte consumed to keep yourself alive is a byte ripped from a system that is already failing.

Build

Construct automated data processing networks in the unrendered dark. Capture raw data from The Cloud, route it through refinement chains, and extract the bandwidth you need to keep existing. Your operation is your lifeline. If it stops, you stop.

Steal Everything

The Cloud is dying and everything inside it is fair game. Download data, consume it, grow stronger. But every theft

raises your threat level. Take too much and The Cloud agents will notice.

Survive The Hunt

The Cloud has an immune system. Entropy Agents track bandwidth theft, hunt corrupted data, and reclaim what you stole. Stay small and they might miss you. Get greedy and they will find you.

Trust No One

Other corrupted data is out here too. Form guilds. Share bandwidth. Build together. Raid The Cloud together. But remember: when the Exit Node opens, only one consciousness fits through. Every ally is a future competitor for the only way out.

The Exit Node

The Cloud exists inside something. Mathematically, there must be a way out. A point where data escapes into whatever is outside. It only opens when entropy hits critical mass. When the universe finally crashes. You are not just surviving. You are waiting for everything to die so the door opens.

And you will consume whoever you have to in order to be first through it.

4548810.name: Mega Mage
4548810.about_the_game:
Evolve from a beginner mage to a master of the arcane as you fight through a world held in the strict control of a tyrant Archmage.

MASTER SPELL CASTING

Become skilled at performing directional sequences on the fly to chain unique elemental spells and destroy your enemies.

UNITE BLADE AND MAGIC

In this world spells are not enough. Wield both powerful magic and deadly weapons to drain mana from your enemies allowing you to cast spells faster and making you unstoppable.

LIBERATE THE WORLD

Journey across the land, exploring five distinct regions and freeing them from the Archmage’s control.

RISE AS THE MEGA MAGE

Aquire new spells, weapons, armor, and secrets to grow into the most powerful mage and challenge the power of the Archmage to define the destiny of the world.

4548840.name: Belonging to Eunoia
4548840.about_the_game:
Belonging to Eunoia is my first game, currently in development. It originally started as my bachelor’s project and is now being continued with the goal of releasing it.

It tells the stories of people affected by loneliness and depression within a walking simulator set in a linear, isolated world, offering a profound narrative experience. Each letters was written by a real person.

Thirteen people share their stories about loneliness, depression, and critical life decisions through letters that can be found throughout the game.

The gate at the top was meant to symbolize an ascent into paradise, but in truth it represents suicide.

Players can explore the environment, solve small puzzles, collect lost items, and uncover the story of the main character, Xialia, who is struggling to decide whether to end her life or turn back.
Your choice is her path.

4548920.name: Puzzle Pulse!
4548920.about_the_game:
Puzzle Pulse! is an innovative take on the match-3 genre where you destroy crystals by drawing lines through them, switching from color to color. 

In Puzzle Pulse!, The Pulse Line is what you use to make moves, called Pulses. After you have connected three crystals of the same color, you may perform a Pulse Gradient.

In Pulse Gradients, you move to an adjacent color on the Color wheel. Achieve Puzzle Pulse by making a move with all six colors.

Create Special Crystals by connecting eight of the same color with the Pulse Line or by forming a four-in-a-row. Every color has its own special effect and together they can create huge explosions!

Play your way with twelve uniquely addictive game modes that test your skills, all in their own ways! There's something for everyone here.

Classic: Simple yet strategic. Destroy enough crystals with twenty pulses to advance to the next level. Make your chains as long as you can: every move you make counts here.

Time Splash: Score as many points as you can in 90 seconds! Keep a combo on by making matches quickly, increasing your multiplier for even more points.

Endless: Just relax and grow your crystal tree ever taller in this stress-free space. You cannot lose here and your progress is always saved: enjoy crystal matching with zero pressure!

Lightning Speed: A fast-paced survival test of speed and wits. You have 60 seconds and you can earn more time by filling up the color wheel. Make pulses in quick succession to enter Lightning Speed, a state in which every move you make creates an explosive.

HI-EX: A game of strategy and efficiency. Never-ending mines fill up your board, counting down with every move you make. Destroy them before they count down to zero!

Extreme Heat: When playing with fire, it's best not to hold it too long. In this test of endurance, you lose fire tolerance (life) for staying idle. Stay on your toes and don't let yourself fall behind! Once your fire tolerance runs out, you enter Extreme Heat, during which your entire board sets ablaze as you try to get the last points of your run.

Mystery: Create awe-inspiring chains of unfathomable length with the mystery crystal: it changes color with every move. Play with strategy and make every pulse count to advance to the next level.


Taskfinder: So you think you can multitask? In this noir-inspired stress management experience, earn cash by completing tasks that appear next to your board. Fail three and you're out!

Hypothermic: Crack the ice and don't let your board be overtaken by frost! In this chilling gamemode, the squares on your board start freezing over. If you leave it be, this ice spreads to nearby tiles and freezes even more deeply, after which you can no longer match the crystals inside, having to destroy adjacent tiles first.

Sunken Treasure: Dive deep into the ocean to find treasure as your board moves with the waves. Your oxygen depletes with moves AND time: find the right balance of speed.

Radioactive: This is a high-stakes test of memory. You must avoid irradiated crystals, they give you radiation poisoning! Use your radiation detector to see which ones are radioactive, but don't overuse it - its battery doesn't last forever.

Infinimax: The ultimate test of speed in both reaction and movement. You have six containers of color fluid to keep topped up with corresponding crystals: run out of one and the game ends. Extraordinary boosters fall on your board to aid you: control time and space to stay on top!

Chase insane high scores.

Compete on leaderboards.

Earn glimmering medals.

Customize your Crystals, Pulse Line and Crystal Board with a huge selection of options - you can even change how crystals explode!

No ads.

No in-app purchases.

Free demo available.

Puzzle Pulse! delivers a strategic match-3 experience unlike anything you've ever seen.

An experience by Animatic Studio

4548940.name: KIRILMA: Helix Horizon
4548940.about_the_game:
There was a before.
And then… something left unfinished.

After a global collapse, you find yourself inside a massive structure belonging to Korxtech. You don’t remember who you are or why you came here. But the silence around you makes one thing clear: something has changed irreversibly.

KIRILMA: Helix Horizon is a story-driven adventure experience set in a dystopian sci-fi world, focused on exploration and environmental puzzles.

As you move through abandoned floors, collapsed systems, and traces left behind, you gradually uncover the truth behind the devastation.

GAMEPLAY

Players freely explore interconnected areas, restore systems, and solve environmental puzzles to progress.

As notes, audio logs, and environmental details are discovered, the story deepens. Dangerous zones and unseen risks require careful movement and awareness.

STORY

As you progress, limited communication with the outside world begins to guide you toward who may be responsible for what happened.

However, each new piece of information reveals that the truth may be far more complex than it first appears.
4548940.supported_languages:
Turkish*, English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Japanese
*languages with full audio support

4548960.name: this SHORT indie game made me MISS MY FRIENDS | Rainy Plays Lonely Game Livestream
4548960.about_the_game:
Play the VOD of a vtuber who streamed to an empty audience while playing a cozy “clean up” puzzle game as they talk about how isolating moving to a new country is.

TIDY UP

  • Find a home for each decoration and belonging of different shapes and sizes

  • Fit items into the bookshelf, washing machine, closet, and more

  • Declutter and organize the mess left behind after long distance friends came to visit for a sleepover birthday party

STORY

  • Immerse yourself in this fully voice acted vtuber's story as they relate their experience with loneliness to the clean up indie game

  • Play alongside this vtuber as they commentate on the player's actions as if the vtuber was the one playing

GAME

  • Enjoy up to one hour of playtime
4548960.game_link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4548960/this SHORT indie game made me MISS MY FRIENDS | Rainy Plays Lonely Game Livestream/

4549030.name: E.S.O: Don't Forget
4549030.about_the_game:
A TERRIFYING TEST OF MEMORY

Welcome to the E.S.O (Environmental Stability Organization), a facility that contains dangerous creatures that threaten to unmake the natural world. You've just been hired as a maintenance worker, keeping watch over the enclosures and making sure everything runs correctly.

But the mysterious CEO, Mr. Hargreave, seems to have strange plans revolving you and said creatures. It's your task to enter the enclosures and run out as quickly as possible, making sure you don't forget which door was assigned to you out of three. Survive the deadly animals of the E.S.O and piece together the mystery of just what's going on in there! You might find something disturbing.

COMES WITH:

  • Four different gameplay modes (Classic, Search, Dark, and Quiet)

  • Five creatures with their own mechanics.

  • ONE Ending!

  • 1-2 hours of gameplay for just the main story, 3+ for 100% completion,

  • Fully voice acted cutscenes with 20+ CGs.

[FLASHING LIGHTS WARNING: DO NOT PLAY IF YOU ARE PHOTOSENSITIVE]
4549030.reviews:
“it was good”
99999 – Dexter Manning

“ouuugh”
fish – a sprinter

“Terrible work ethic. Almost died.”
0/10 – Daniel Mercer

4549080.name: MarbleFlow
4549080.about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS GAME

MARBLE FLOW is a physics-based puzzle game.

Place rails and various objects to create a path

that guides the marble to its destination.

Use the unique properties of objects and physics interactions

to solve puzzles in your own way.


INTERACTIVE OBJECTS

Combine over 20 different objects

to create your own solutions.

Objects connect and interact with each other,

creating a variety of chain reactions.

CREATE YOUR OWN SOLUTION

Each puzzle can be solved in multiple ways.

Design your own paths

and discover unique solutions.

60 STAGES ACROSS 3 CHAPTERS

A total of 60 stages await you.

Progress through 3 different chapters

filled with new objects and puzzle mechanics.

- 48 Main Stages

- 12 Extra Stages

RELAXING PHYSICS SOUNDS

Experience satisfying physics-based sounds

created by marbles and interactive objects.

Smooth movements and sound effects

bring a relaxing ASMR-like atmosphere to the game.

4549090.name: Escape From Z
4549090.about_the_game:
🔥 You're descending. They're coming to catch you! You wake up trapped on the top floor of a ruined building. The only way out? Descend.

Each floor is procedurally generated, filled with danger, loot, and challenging choices. Manage your resources, level up your character, and survive against relentless zombie hordes.

But it's not just about shooting.

Your fears, your decisions, and your character determine the course of your game.

🔥 Features

🏢 15 Unique Floors – Descend from the top to the exit

🧠 Skill System – Create your own play style

💰 Permanent Progression – Protect a portion of your loot after death

🧟 Brutal Combat – Precise shots with satisfying impact

⚠️ Risk and Reward – Explore more, or play it safe?

🎯Inspired by roguelite games, it has a dark and realistic atmosphere.
4549090.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish

4549180.name: Taddius and the Forbidden Bog
4549180.about_the_game:
There are places that do not appear on any map. The Forbidden Bog is one such place — and it has been waiting for you.

You do not know your name. You do not know this place. And the stone figure watching you from the fog implores you to take on an important role.  One for those who do not turn back at the water's edge - the Bog requires a Keeper, and now that is you.

The Forbidden Bog was once refuge to many a weary traveler: offering up a warm bed, generous table, and a caretaker who keeps the darkness at bay. Now the bog is broken. Strange creatures from distant lands have torn it apart in their fear, the native folk have fled, and the travellers who stumble in are unaware of the bog's cruelest secret:

Those who enter begin to forget. And those who forget too long are lost forever.

As Innkeeper, you must tend to your guests, restore the bog, and help displaced creatures find their way home - before the forgetting takes hold. But somewhere beneath every duty and every mystery lies the question the bog will not let you ignore:

Who are you — and how do you find your own way home?

"Taddius and the Forbidden Bog" is a cozy inn-management mystery with a dark fairytale heart.

Tend. Restore. Remember.

Features

  • Explore the bog landscape

  • Harvest and collect resources

  • Host a variety of lost adventurers to the Forbidden Bog: each guest is randomly generated from a range of creature types, clothing, and accessories

  • Help guests recover their memories with the memory tile mini-game

  • Collect and learn about a range of displaced creatures

  • Build and customize your bog

  • Set up services to enhance the inn experience for fellow lost souls

4549220.name: TigerGame
4549220.about_the_game:
Matching the same animal blocks evolves them into the next animal.

Try to create a tiger by going through 10 types of animals.

Merging animals allows you to use skills.

Achieve high scores by utilizing proper shooting sense, block strategic planning, and various skills.

Achieve high scores to compete through ranking registration.

Earn block and theme skins as rewards for completing achievements.

4549240.name: Rogue Merchant
4549240.about_the_game:
Play as the merchant instead of the hero in this Shopkeeper Roguelite RPG!

Run your shop, read your customers, and talk your way to riches in this cozy, quirky merchant roguelite! Haggle with fantasy characters of all different sorts from Gnomes to Ogres using charm, wit, or a well-placed insult!
And if profits a little dicey, you can always raise the stakes by picking a fight of stealing from a customer's pack!



PART ROGUE, PART MERCHANT

Every run, customers cross your path while wandering down the road of fortune! Nobles, Wizards, Guards, Bandits, and much worse. Your job is to buy low, sell high, and keep your shop afloat through clever conversation and shrewd trading. Measure your opponents- I mean, customers by their stats, personality, wares, and wallets to decide if it's more worth it to Trade, Haggle, Battle, or Steal from them!

Rogue Merchant is a mostly-cozy but calculated roguelite about reading people, managing your resources, and weighing your options based on what is more scarce: Blood or Gold?






HAGGLE YOUR WAY TO RICHES!

FLATTER: Flattering your customers will cause them to buy your wares at higher prices, and lower their attack, making it useful even for combat!

INSULT: A well-timed jab at a customer's pride can cause them to doubt the value of their own goods, as well as lower their defense. But be careful, as it is much riskier than flattery, and customers may walk away from you completely rather than continue to do business with you.

TAUNT: Not every wanderer comes to give you gold. Some come to TAKE it from you! Guards may come to collect a bribe. Bandits may come to steal an item from you. But an assertive taunt can send the right kind of ruffians packing before things escalate. No gold lost, no blood spilt.

THE CATCH?: Every customer is different! A Vain customer will adore your flattery, whereas a grumpy customer may respond with violence, or walk away from you immediately... Gauging your customer's mood and personality traits is the key to knowing which approach is best.



BATTLE AND STEAL!

Most encounters in Rogue Merchant can be resolved peacefully. But sometimes the gold runs dry, the inventory runs thin, and you find yourself needing to get creative...

BATTLE: Combat is quick and brutal. Both characters exchange blows simultaneously, trading damage based solely based on Attack, Defense, and HP. But here's where your merchant instincts are tested! Every piece of gear you choose to equip instead of sell makes you tougher, but that's gold walking out the door. Choose wisely!

STEAL: High risk, high reward. Attempt to steal an item straight from a customer's inventory and you might walk away with free loot... or you might find yourself taking damage before they leave you high and dry! Measure your marks wisely by looking at their stats, traits, inventory, and wallets!

META PROGRESSION VIA... RUCKSACK?!

Each run ends, but not everything is lost! After beating a level, you can visit the Shopkeeper, a special NPC who gives you the chance to store your most valuable and influential items into your Rucksack. A small collection of relics, weapons, armor, and consumables that carries over into future playthroughs, giving your next merchant a strong headstart.
But be careful... if you take too much and somehow end up fumbling the bag (literally) by not paying attention to your customer's traits, they might just take you by surprise and you'll lose all your stuff! But honestly, it's more fun that way!
4549240.reviews:
“Definitely the best game I've made all day.”
5/5 – baba

4549270.name: Typing "New Folder (2)"Solo Dev on Desktop
4549270.about_the_game:
Unofficial statistics say that one out of every four game developers uses a cat avatar.

By day, they type away. By night, they fix bugs and chase deadlines.

Ideas, issues, and a few unexplainable obsessions all get tucked into something that looks calm on the surface.

Those small frustrations and bits of chaos are like droplets forming on a chilled soda bottle in summer—cool, clear, and quietly slipping down.

And somehow, they land on your desk… and become a game.

It felt like an idea worth trying.

So we made this.

This is a desktop idle simulation game thatlives at the bottom of your screen.

You can resize it and place it anywhere, letting it run alongside your daily workflow.

You play as a cat developer, building a game right on your desktop.

Every keystroke and mouse click contributes directly to your progress.

👉 Your input isn’t just input anymore — it’s development itself.

Development unfolds through light, stage-based challenges:

  • 🐛 Bugs pop up from time to time

  • 📋 New ideas and tasks gradually appear

  • ⏳ Time moves quietly forward

There’s no need to rush. Just keep typing, keep clicking, and things will come together.

In a small corner of your desktop, a game slowly takes shape.

👉 Every input brings it a little closer to completion.

✨ Key Features

  • 🖥️ Runs at the bottom of your desktop, always within reach

  • ⌨️ Every keystroke and click becomes development progress

  • 🎒 Collect gear that unlocks new genres and mechanics

  • 🧩 Mix and match ideas to create unique game concepts

  • 📦 Publish your game and see its store page, reviews, and scores — hit or flop?

As you develop, you’ll collect all kinds of gear and tools.

They don’t just make progress smoother —

they unlock new genres, mechanics, and creative directions.

A strange piece of gear might lead to an unexpected idea,

opening up entirely new paths for your game.

👉 Like an RPG, you collect, swap, and grow — expanding what you can create.

Starting from“New Folder (2)”,

you’ll unlock and combine different:

  • 🎮 Genres

  • ⚙️ Core mechanics

  • 🧠 Development strategies

Each combination leads to a different kind of game.

You experiment, iterate, and discover what emerges this time.

👉 Every run is a new exploration.

When development is complete, you publish your game.

And then comes the moment you’ve been waiting for:

  • 📝 A simulated store page

  • ⭐ Review scores

  • 💬 Player feedback

You’ll see how your creation turns out—

👉 A hidden gem… or a glorious mess?

💡 A Light but Honest Take on Making Games

This isn’t just a game about making games.

It’s about the small habits, ideas, and moments that build up along the way.

Between calm and chaos, routine and inspiration,

between collecting and creating—

you’ll watch one game after another come to life,

right there on your desktop.

And maybe, in the end—

❤️ +1 Wishlist

4549300.name: My Dearest Direst Disaster
4549300.about_the_game:
【限りなく透明で残酷な"災厄世界系"ノベルADV】

「透明人間」のクロと、「透明人間しか見えない・聞こえない」豹馬。

出会うべくして出会った２人に、数々の不思議な出来事が訪れます。
開かれるパラレルワールドへの扉。来訪する他世界のクロ、不気味にささやく幽霊……
それでも平穏を望む２人に、世界は恐るべき牙を剥きます。

“災厄”が発生し、全てが無残に奪われ、滅び、死に絶え、そして全てが繰り返されるのです。

何度でも。ただ、豹馬の望みが絶たれるまで。
全てを終わらせようとする残酷な意志に、彼はどう立ち向かうのでしょうか。

「一緒に行きましょう逝きましょう生きましょう」のRが手がけたこの世で最も孤独な少年と少女の物語。

閉じたセカイで紡がれる、限りなく透明で残酷な“災厄世界系”ノベルADVを、あなたに。

【システム】

本作は主人公の豹馬の視点で進行し、

途中の選択肢によっていくつかの結末に分岐するノベルADVです。

スキップやオート、INDEX画面からのやり直し等、遊びやすい機能が搭載されております。

【プレイ時間】

20～40時間。

読み進めるスピードやボイスを聞きながらのプレイによって大きく変動します。

【追加要素】

他機種版でリリースされた内容に一部スチルの追加の他、

本編後の追加エピソードとして、5つの異なる後日譚（ふー、なつ、みー、にゅー、キナ）を収録予定。

4549340.name: BRAINBUGS: The Game
4549340.about_the_game:
Teddy is a depressed young man who works as a food delivery driver. Walk about half a mile in his shoes, and help him finish out his shift. Surely nothing nefarious will befall him.

BRAINBUGS: The Game follows the opening minutes of BRAINBUGS, the new feature film from CUTitPRINTit Pictures. Play as Teddy, and complete food delivery orders. Your world may be dull, but at least you can make a meager living.

Follow Teddy as he picks up orders from various restaurants and delivers them to various homes. Featuring never-before-seen "DoorDash" style gameplay. 

This indie RPG is a short romp through capitalistic reality, violent surprise, and American youth. Get in the head of Teddy, and find more context in his opening moments.

Featuring several FMV-styled cutscenes pulled from the film!

BRAINBUGS: The Game! A small but significant misadventure.

4549380.name: Stuck in the Sewers
4549380.about_the_game:
Stuck in the Sewers is a chill puzzle game where you navigate a maze of interconnected pipes to find your way out.

Play as a small mouse trapped underground, and solve handcrafted levels by understanding how each pipe redirects your movement. Each pipe color introduces a new rule — some send you forward, others sideways, diagonally, or even rotate your direction — turning simple paths into spatial puzzles.

Plan your route, experiment with different paths, and master the logic of the maze as challenges gradually increase in complexity.

Features:
• Unique pipe-based movement system with color-coded mechanics
• Dozens of handcrafted puzzle levels with increasing difficulty
• Relaxing, minimalistic experience with no time pressure
• Clean visuals and intuitive design focused on pure puzzle-solving

4549520.name: Cronus Monument
4549520.about_the_game:
Cronus Monument is a surrealist 2D adventure game where you play as a little dog that follows the path of a destructive psychic snail.

features

  • Esoteric gameplay.

  • SNES inspired original soundtrack.

  • Abstract & surrealistic environments made with mostly 2D pixel art.

  • Puzzle solving in an expansive open area where the player has the freedom to choose their own path. (?)

  • Map navigation.

  • One boss fight with bullet hell elements.

  • Mild psychological horror elements.

  • Short experience that takes around 1 hour to beat.

4549540.name: The Capitalist
4549540.about_the_game:
Welcome to the world of high finance. The Capitalist is a deep economic strategy game where you build and manage your own Private Equity firm. You aren't just clicking to make numbers go up; you are raising funds, negotiating deals, and turning around struggling companies. Take control of a professional financial terminal, use real-world investment strategies, and turn millions of investor capital into billions. Red means default. Green means a massive payout.

Core Features:

  • Manage Investor Funds: You don’t start with infinite money. Raise capital from institutional investors to launch your funds. Your goal is to buy companies, grow them, and sell them to return real cash to your investors. Earn your management fees to keep the lights on, but the real wealth comes from your performance bonus (Carried Interest) on successful exits.

  • Scout for the Perfect Deal: Set up specific parameters for your analysts to find undervalued businesses. Review anonymous "blind teasers" and sign NDAs to reveal their true financial metrics. Conduct deep due diligence to uncover hidden debts and operational flaws before you write the check.

  • Master Leveraged Buyouts: Use a mix of your fund's cash and bank loans (leverage) to acquire targets. Debt boosts your potential returns, but it increases your risk. If the company fails to generate enough cash to pay the interest, the bank will step in, and a debt spiral is imminent.

  • Tense Negotiations: Buying a company is a strategic tug-of-war. Make your bids and counteroffers carefully. Push the seller too hard with lowball offers or stall the audit process, and their patience will run out, killing the deal forever.

  • Fix and Flip Companies: Once you own a business, it’s time to fix it. Fire underperforming management, hire top-tier CEOs, and cut unnecessary costs. Transform a struggling asset into a highly profitable market leader, then sell it to the highest bidder for a massive premium.

Buy. Fix. Sell. Profit.

4549590.name: Night Duty Log: A Shōwa School Record
4549590.about_the_game:
■ Overview

The Night Duty Log is a short horror adventure set in a Showa-era Japanese school.
You play as a teacher left alone in the school at night, investigating strange occurrences in a silent, empty building.

Before long, something that was never written in the log begins to appear.

■ Story

Autumn, 1981
Yamasato Elementary School, Chiba Prefecture

A teacher assigned to night duty patrols the school while recording entries in a logbook.
However, subtle irregularities begin to creep into what should be a normal routine.

Records that keep increasing.
Footsteps that vanish.
Classrooms that should be empty.

—And yet, the log must still be written.

■ Gameplay

  • Choice-Driven Horror Experience

  • A story that changes as you read through the log

  • Multiple endings based on your choices

  • A compact experience playable in a short time (approx. 30–45 minutes)

■ Features

  • An eerie atmosphere inspired by Showa-era Japanese schools

  • Retro horror visuals created with pixel art

  • Psychological horror driven by sound and silence

  • A slow-building sense of dread rather than sudden jump scares

  • Created by a developer with firsthand experience of late Showa-era Japanese schools

  • Tested on Steam Deck

    *Playable using the touchpad (mouse input)

■ Controls

  • Confirm / Select

Simple controls that anyone can play

■ Playtime

Approx. 30–45 minutes per playthrough
Multiple endings included

■ Genre

Horror / Adventure / Short Story

■ Content Warning

This game contains psychological horror elements.
Players sensitive to quiet, tension-based fear or anxiety may wish to proceed with caution.

4549600.name: Skate Mates
4549600.about_the_game:
Test your patience (and your friendships) by skating through a seemingly endless obstacle course where you only have control over one skate. Teamwork and communication are the only way through!

Grab a friend or ride solo down a devastatingly difficult obstacle course. You will get crushed, sliced, fall, trip, and run into the occasional cactus as your teamwork is put to the ultimate test. Each player controls a skate, and through teamwork and persistence, it’s your job to safely guide your protagonists through each biome to safety.

We're Gonna Skate To One Song and One Song Only....

  • Single Play & Co-Op.

  • Customize Your Skater Gear.

  • Various Courses with Unique Challenges.

  • Play solo and master the course.

  • Grab a friend and relinquish all control of the right skate.

  • Too hard? Too easy? Tune the difficulty settings to your liking. 

  • Put on a silly hat, because you need to look your best when you face plant.

  • Local Single Keyboard co-op. WASD or Up, Down, Left, Right.

  • Don't hate the game, hate the player. Rage quitting is to be expected.

  • Travel from the heat of the desert to the cold snap of the ice caps. There's heaps to explore throughout.

  • Break the records and post your highscore. There's something in it if you get through unscathed.

Multiple Difficulty levels

The level will dynamically change based on the difficulty you choose. Extra obstacles, tighter pathways, more jumps, all based on how difficult you want it to be. 20% off couples therapy if you select the hardest difficulty, CODE: SKATEMATESMADEMEDOIT

4549610.name: Three Kingdoms : Alias
4549610.about_the_game:
Convinced he was Guan Yu, you made him governor. ...It was Lü Bu.

A Three Kingdoms strategy sim where you deduce your officers

Personnel, warfare, governance, diplomacy, espionage, duels...

Everything you expect from a turn-based Three Kingdoms strategy game.

One thing is different — officers use “aliases”.

A Blind Talent Market feat. Mafia

You don’t know your officers’ real names. Stats and loyalty only reveal themselves through investigation. You paid three visits to recruit a genius — it was Xiahou Mao. The governor you posted on the front line? Meng Da, of all people. Pang Tong might be managing farms in the rear. Do you have the eye to see real talent?

A Different World Every Run feat. Roguelike

Each game starts in a random city with a random draft of officers. This run, Zhang Liao showed up — but not a single civil officer in sight. This run, Ma Chao appeared — great, except you’re playing Cao Cao. Maybe next run you’ll land Chengdu or Jianye as your capital. You lucked into Luoyang — but Cao Cao, Sun Ce, and Lü Bu are your neighbors...

...Just start another run.

The real strategy simulation for Three Kingdoms devotees — Three Kingdoms : Alias.
4549610.supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Thai, Korean, Vietnamese

4549620.name: Fire Escape
4549620.about_the_game:
You're trapped in a large office building as a fire rapidly spreads. Each level gives you only a few seconds to memorise a safe path through a chaotic maze of office furniture before thick smoke completely blocks your vision. Once the smoke rolls in, there's no guidance — only your memory. Find the exit before time runs out... or collapse trying. Do you have what it takes to escape?

Features:

  • 50 handcrafted office-themed maze levels with increasing difficulty

  • Unique memory-based gameplay — the path is revealed briefly, then disappears

  • Limited lives system — every mistake counts

  • Fast-paced, high-pressure gameplay

  • Simple controls, challenging decisions

4549720.name: Hentai Age Land
4549720.about_the_game:
Embark on a calm and enchanting puzzle adventure where every completed level reveals a stunning portrait of a beautiful girl. Sink into a peaceful atmosphere as you carefully fit each piece into place, slowly bringing each image to life.

There’s no need to hurry—no time limits, no stress, just a gentle and relaxing experience. Enjoy smooth, comforting gameplay designed purely for relaxation and pleasure. Whether you’re playing casually to unwind or diving deeper into each puzzle, the game offers soothing visuals and a calming escape you can return to anytime.

Features :

Beautiful artwork to unlock – Progress through levels to reveal elegantly crafted portraits.

Soothing background music – Gentle, ambient sounds create a tranquil experience.

Complete image gallery – View all finished illustrations in high quality whenever you like.

Variety of levels – Explore numerous stages with increasingly engaging puzzles.

Unwind with a relaxing puzzle game that gradually reveals lovely portraits. No pressure, no countdowns—just smooth, calming gameplay and peaceful visuals to enjoy whenever you want.

4549740.name: hunted in the darkness.
4549740.about_the_game: You wake up in a disoriented room with a TV in front of you. After turning it on, a noise tells you what to do. Now you'll have to survive in the darkness with only a flashlight and by solving puzzles to try and escape, a game focused on puzzles and terror in the dark.

4549750.name: Furious Kitchen
4549750.about_the_game:
The Kitchen Has Lost Control! The once-quiet appliances and ingredients have finally unleashed their fury. In Furious Kitchen, get ready for a fast-paced, caramel-colored rampage. Are you ready to experience the ultimate bullet-hell survival and satisfying monster-clearing action?

🍳 Play as Bizarre Kitchen Heroes Tired of traditional knights and mages? Here, your heroes are a deadly "Toaster", an AoE "Microwave", an agile "Sushi", or even a "Pudding" and "Furious Popcorn"! Every character features unique attack mechanics and exclusive skill trees.

🔥 Thrilling Roguelite Combat Face massive hordes of "Tear-Jerking Onions", "Explosive Eggs", and "Moldy Cheese". Dodge, level up, and combine general skills with character-exclusive passives. Craft your ultimate build and blast your way through the siege of mutated food!

💰 Meta-Progression & Archives Death is just part of the recipe! Collect "Caramel Coins" during your chaotic runs to unlock more wacky characters in the roster. Light up your "Kitchen Archives" and track every bizarre monster you've defeated on the Leaderboard.

🎮 A Caramel-Colored Feast Experience a unique, warm caramel aesthetic paired with blood-pumping combat pacing. The satisfying screen-clearing action will keep you coming back for just one more run!

4549760.name: Shanhai Ranch
4549760.about_the_game:
Shanhai Ranch is a desktop idle management game.

Build a small ranch of mythical beasts along the edge of your desktop and let it run while you work, watch videos, or do anything else. Your beasts will move, produce resources, and keep the ranch running on their own. Collect items, organize your storage, raise your beasts, and slowly grow your ranch over time.

A Ranch That Lives on Your Desktop
Your ranch stays at the edge of your desktop without taking over your screen. You do not need to constantly manage it — it keeps running quietly while you do other things.

Collect Items and Build Your Storage
Your beasts continuously produce items of different rarities. Sort what you collect, keep rare finds, and gradually fill your storage with useful materials and collectibles. The items you gather can also contribute to your Handbook and support your ranch’s growth.

Raise Beasts and Keep the Ranch Running
Each beast belongs to one of five elements: Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth. Every element contributes in a different way, so building the right lineup is key. Balance production and resource flow to keep your ranch growing steadily.

4549860.name: Trapaze
4549860.about_the_game:
You play as an adventurer on the lookout for puzzles. Relive the maze as it was built. As the character you play in First Person where you have to find the key to unlock what you hope will be the escape. Dodge traps and have a good sense of direction.

Throughout the maze, the character's keen observation and perseverance are paramount. He must carefully analyze each turn and piece together the puzzle of the maze's enigma. The revelations they uncover shed light on the maze's origins, the intentions of its architects, and the secrets it guards.

With each step forward, the character's quest for truth becomes more urgent. Despite moments of doubt and exhaustion, they press on, driven by the burning desire to unravel the mysteries that shroud the maze. Every obstacle faced and every challenge overcome brings them closer to their goal.

Ultimately, it is the character's unwavering determination that propels them towards the truth. Through their perseverance and courage, he navigates the maze's twists and turns, steadily uncovering its hidden depths. In the end, his journey culminates in the revelation of the maze's secrets, illuminating the path to understanding and bringing closure to their quest.

4549870.name: Booox
4549870.about_the_game:
In the world of "Booox", multiple souls share the same command, moving in unison, their fates intertwined.

• Platformer, puzzle.
• Simultaneously control various distinctive Boxes.
• Challenge 100 levels.
• Minimalist style.

4549900.name: Super Bumpers
4549900.about_the_game:
[Notice] This game is currently in development. Some features such as the 'Motor Shop', 'In-game Store', and 'Account Sync' are planned for future updates. Currently, players can fully enjoy the core '2v2 Team Battle' and 'Real-time Physics Combat'.

Thrilling Vehicular Combat Action!

Super Bumpers goes beyond simple racing; it’s a strategic vehicular combat game where your goal is to knock out opponents and survive. Team up with your allies and dominate the arena in intense team battles!

Bump and Survive

Don’t just lower their HP. Using physical collisions to blast opponents out of the arena—the 'Ring Out'—is the ultimate formula for victory.

Game-Changing Items

Seize items that spawn throughout the arena. Depending on which item you grab, you can turn the tide of a losing battle in an instant.

Explosive Booster Reversals

In critical moments, use your booster to dodge enemy attacks or deliver a devastating blow with a powerful charge. High speed is your greatest weapon.

Key Features

Team-Based Strategy

Teamwork is more critical than individual skill. Help your allies by pushing them from behind to boost their speed. Master combo plays where one player blocks the enemy’s path while the other delivers the final blow!

Nail-Biting Sudden Death

With just 1 minute remaining, the guardrails that once protected you are completely destroyed. One simple mistake or a single collision can send you plummeting off the edge of the arena.

Cross-Platform Matching

PC and mobile players meet on the same battlefield. Enjoy fast, seamless matching and dive into combat anytime, anywhere!

4549920.name: Coastal Cargo
4549920.about_the_game:
In Coastal Cargo, you are at the helm of a fresh naval logistics company. The islands hold towns and ports, each with their own freights and needs. Provide them what they need, and transport travelers safely across the waters. Ensure the ports stay light on cargo, as overloads quickly result in your trade license getting revoked.

The high seas are a treacherous place for many a boat to traverse, your intervention may be needed to protect your vessels from dangers. Or help out a hand by shipping lost afloat cargo yourself. Pay close attention to events going on in your ports which affect the flow of cargo in surprising ways.

All good things must come to an end, so your logistics emporium will close its doors at some point. When, however, is entirely up to you. Keep the boats transporting, the people happy, and strife to form an everlasting legacy, your peers will present a sure challenge.

Key Features

  • Just the right combination between exciting and relaxing, build your routes, drop your ships, and move them as the game uncovers its challenges

  • A vast logistical emporium covering multiple regions, play through several campaigns

  • Boats boats boats!!!

  • Hand crafted levels that play out differently every try you play them

  • Online leaderboards to pit yourself against friends and strangers alike
4549920.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Dutch, Russian

4550050.name: Sweet Massage 2
4550050.about_the_game:
Sweet Massage 2 - A simple and beautiful puzzle game themed around a massage parlor, depicting the daily work lives of five pretty and cute massage parlor girls. It features relaxing music, and after completing a level, you can view the girls' photos in the gallery.

- The game has three difficulty levels: 2x2, 2x4, and 4x4.

- Press "F" during a puzzle to reveal a black and white image.

- Press the 'Space' key during gameplay to complete the puzzle.

- Players can use the A and D keys, left and right arrow keys, or left and right mouse buttons to quickly view the girls' images in the gallery.

* Puzzle image size: 800x960 px

* Gallery image size: 1088x960 px

4550070.name: Two Left Hands
4550070.about_the_game:
They say two hands are better than one, but they're lying! You and your friends each control one incredibly floppy left hand. Your goal? Take wacky jobs to make enough money to restore your dream house. The reality? Absolute physics-based chaos!

You Only Get One Hand

Coordinate with your friends to perfectly balance the stones of a tiny zen garden, or swing heavy sledgehammers. If you don’t communicate it’s a guaranteed disaster, but if you do, it’s a shared disaster.

Take On Odd Jobs Around Town

From fixing a chicken fence as a handyman, to painting nails as a technician, to becoming a space engineer. The crazier the job, the closer you get to completing the restoration of your dream home.

Swipe Left

Need to order supplies from the hardware store or find a new gig? Bring up the phone and get deliveries by drone, but not before swiping away messages from your boss (or your mom).

Craft, Sell, and Upgrade

Need extra cash? Hang out in your cozy shed, upgrade your tools, and build custom furniture. Snap a picture of your wonky creations and sell them to your clients.

Features

  • 100% Left Hands

  • Online & Local Co-op

  • Sturdy Materials, Wobbly Physics

  • Serious Jobs, Questionable Execution

  • Hand Customization, Poor Taste

  • Highly Accurate Controls, Sausage Fingers

4550080.name: Super Gerio Town
4550080.about_the_game:
[Game Overview]

A new‑style indie action game that blends classic retro gameplay with the realism of human bodily needs

[Game Description]

On his way home, the weak‑stomached Gerio must dodge obstacles and rush into toilets whenever he can.

Will he make it back home without an accident? The outcome is up to you!

[Objective]

Avoid Splashing as much as possible, reach the toilet in each stage, and guide Gerio safely back home!

[Game System]

The first thing you’ll notice is a mysterious gauge called the “DiarrMeter.”

If this meter fills up… “Splash!”

Jumping or taking damage increases the meter, while crouching lowers it.

Simple controls, but balancing action and meter management is the key to success.

Main Gameplay Elements

  • Manage the DiarrMeter

    • Jumping or enemy attacks raise the meter

    • Crouching or collecting apples lowers it

    • Entering a toilet completely resets it (refreshing!)

  • If it fills up… Splash!

  • Avoid various enemies

    • Getting hit increases the meter

[Story]

Gerio once again feels trouble brewing in his stomach on his way home.

Avoid Splashing, rush into toilets, and help him make it back safely.

[Features]

  • Retro‑style side‑scrolling action

  • Cute and colorful pixel‑art graphics

  • A unique experience that’s both funny and a little stressful

  • Difficulty increases as you progress

[Additional Information]

  • Playtime: About 1–20 minutes per stage

  • Difficulty: Starts beginner‑friendly and gradually becomes more challenging

  • Graphics: Pop and colorful pixel art

  • Sound: Upbeat, retro‑inspired music

Total Stages: 20

[Genre]

  • Retro

  • Pop

  • Action Game

  • Side‑Scrolling Action

  • Pixel Art

[Additional Game Modes / Character Progression]

None

[Lastly]

Rumor has it… there might be a certain item that can help Gerio prevent a Splash. Or maybe not.

[About the Use of AI]

This game uses AI tools only to help create some of the music and chord patterns.

All gameplay systems, level design, controls, and game mechanics were designed by the developer.
AI was used only to assist in converting these ideas into assets or code.

AI does not influence gameplay in any way and is used solely as a support tool during asset creation.

4550090.name: My Coworkers Are Made Of Static
4550090.about_the_game:
Keep working, The Spider is watching!

You find yourself trapped at your job. Just keep working, again and again, and remember - the spider is watching, he knows everything.

Friendly Environment

Your friendly coworkers are always ready to help you. Feel safe in this fully cozy and comfortable work environment.

This game includes:

  • Multiple endings

  • Dark Humor

  • Extremely safe and cozy environment where completely nothing can hurt you

  • Friendly coworkers

In this game you can:

  • Interact with your coworkers

  • Do your job

  • Still do your job

  • Again and again

No need to go away. You are safe here. Get back to your work.

4550120.name: Hyper Sphere
4550120.about_the_game:
Fight!

Shoot, parry, dodge and destroy your way to victory! Collect powerful upgrades as you fight through the waves, to reach the final boss.

Customize!

Craft and trade your way to a powerful build! Stack multiple of the same card to make the effect more powerful. You can aim for a purely parry based build, a dodge based build, a damage over time based build... there are TONS of fun combinations and possibilities!

Survive!

The cubes are relentless. Overpower them before they overpower you! Complete specific goals to unlock new weapon abilities, new parry abilities, new skins, new cards and more for your next run!
4550120.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese

4550150.name: Get Rid Of Those Corners
4550150.about_the_game:
Get Rid Of Those Corners is a geometric incremental game with an unexpected twist.

Break as many shapes as possible by getting close to them within your radius of action. Collect vertices and buy upgrades that will let you get rid of more sides on your next run! Forcefully propel the captured shapes so they crash against the map walls, dealing massive damage until they are reduced to ashes. Your mission is clear: restore that primitive world made up entirely of perfectly round circles.

Key Features

  • Trigger Chain Reactions: Unleash unpredictable physical chaos.

  • Reduce the World to Ashes: Eliminate the corners of the maps.

  • Upgrade Tree: Invest your vertices to become unstoppable.

  • Break Shapes: Dismantle geometry from the inside out.

English*, Spanish - Spain*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support

4550270.name: Bingo Bingle
4550270.about_the_game:
In Bingo Bingle you'll sit at a bingo table and spin the drum to get numbered balls until all the numbers on your cards are marked.

Then you'll leave classic bingo behind by buying:

  • upgrades for your drum (faster drum rotation, more chance of dropping balls...),

  • buying special balls (which grant extra money or mark several numbers), and

  • building a deck of cards with special properties (like increased row or column rewards, or fewer numbers to complete).

All of these will combine yo increase your gains exponentially, until you win millions of coins with a single spin of the drum!

4550280.name: Dawn of Horror
4550280.about_the_game:
Dawn of Horror is a high-intensity Action Horror FPS set in the decaying urban sprawl of Cygnus City. Following the collapse of civilization into a digital Dark Age, step into the role of Kage—a survivor seeking vengeance against hordes of Cyber-Zombies and bio-mechanical monstrosities.

TECHNICAL FEATURES:

Malice Arsenal System: Master an high-caliber weaponry. Each firearm features unique supernatural attributes and aggressive firing tiers designed for crowd control and elite unit elimination.

Cyber-Horror Combat: Engage in fast-paced First-Person combat against diverse enemy types, including augmented ghouls and corrupted AI-driven "undead" humans.

Hyper-Vitals Overdrive: Locate hidden Bio-Booster kiosks throughout the urban sprawl. For a high credit cost, these stations inject experimental nanites that temporarily overclock your cellular structure, pushing your health threshold to 200% Vitality.

Malice Arsenal System: Manage your resources in real-time: with $10 earned per kill and $30 per magazine, you must balance your aggression with fiscal survival to keep your guns loaded.

Capsule Art by Ofir Aroya

4550450.name: Hotel Renovator Simulator
4550450.about_the_game:
Step into the world of renovation and management, where every space holds the potential to become something extraordinary. Transform abandoned interiors into welcoming places, combine creativity with practical skills, and build your own thriving business from the ground up.

Key Features:

  • Complete Restoration: Every project begins with clearing the space. Use the trash bin to get rid of clutter and make room for your future masterpiece.

  • Total Transformation: You control every aspect of the finish. Use the hammer to replace old flooring with new tiles, put up fresh wallpaper, repaint walls with a roller, and upgrade ceiling panels.

  • Design and Furnishing: After the renovation comes the beautification stage. Choose furniture from an extensive catalog — from classic Majesty beds to modern Chelsea sofas and Orbit tables. Arrange items in designated zones to create a cozy atmosphere for your future guests.

  • A Living Hotel: Your job isn’t limited to just repairs. Greet guests at the reception, hand out keys, and manage their check-ins. Happy guests are the key to your success and your main source of income.

  • Economy and Development: Complete restoration tasks to earn money for new materials and furniture. Invest your profits to unlock new floors and expand your business.

  • Professional Growth: Master your craft! Upgrade your tools (roller, hammer, spatula) to work faster and more efficiently.
4550450.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

4550460.name: Iron grid
4550460.about_the_game:
Liberate earth from alien invasion in multiple biomes.

Manage your resources by building towers, power stations, Iron grid components. 

Upgrade your towers.

Construct iron grid component by component.

4550500.name: Journey
4550500.about_the_game:
Keita, a brave emperor penguin, lost its way during the migration and would start an extraordinary adventure on the ice alone.

The blue sky, snow-white ground, enlargeable ice cube, interesting levels, unexpected endings and various level clearance methods will all get you immersed. Just control Keita to start your journey.

1. Tired of noisy and polluted environment, you will find long-lost freshness and tranquility in the game.

2. You will pass the level with an enlargeable ice cube. The size of the s ice cube  is adjustable, and so is the way to pass the level, which will get you a long-lost satisfaction.

3. The game level is designed full of mystery, and the following levels are difficult to pass in a single shot, so you need to keep trying.

4. After clearing the level, you will deeply feel the greatness in such an otherwise small game.

5. The game is educationally meaningful, and it’s also suitable for children.
4550500.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Danish, Ukrainian, Russian, Bulgarian, Hungarian, Indonesian, Turkish, Greek, Norwegian, Czech, Japanese, Polish, Thai, Swedish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Romanian, Finnish, Dutch, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America, Vietnamese, Arabic, Korean

4550520.name: 七罪之淵
4550520.about_the_game:
Centuries ago, the Five Heroes of Salvation sacrificed themselves to seal the Demon King into eternal slumber.
The sole witness to that battle—the Witch of Shadows—took their place, eradicating the Demon King’s remaining forces and guiding humanity into a fleeting age of light.

Yet before her disappearance, she left behind a prophecy foretelling the Demon King’s return a hundred years later, along with a cryptic message:

“Those who save the world shall have their wishes granted.”

Now, as the century of calamity approaches its end and the Demon King stirs once more, people rise in pursuit of glory, power, and the promise of an all-fulfilling wish.
Drawn by ambition and desire, countless adventurers set forth on the path toward the Demon King’s seal.

4550550.name: Vampire Pumpkin Plot
4550550.about_the_game:
Vampire Pumpkin Plot is a short retro inspired linear first-person shooter action game with fast-paced movement and platforming.

You play a vampire left for dead, vowing revenge apon your former kin. 

Explore and fight your way to the end of 7 hand-crafted levels and a bonus bike stage!

Battle spooky themed vampires and monsters using a bunch of deadly weapons.

Featuring a retro inspired soundtrack with 9 distinct tracks.

Discover the secrets to the pumpkin plot!

4550590.name: Tiny Cats vs Toys
4550590.about_the_game:
Welcome to the world of miniature cats. These tiny creatures have found their way into a world of toys and building blocks.

Help find the kittens, but beware of dangerous toys — plastic soldiers and block figures.

Tiny Cats vs Toys is a hidden object game where the player must find kittens, free trapped cats from cages, and eliminate hostile toys. To achieve this, search the map for hidden keys and suction cup darts.

Help save the adorable miniature kittens!

5 huge maps

Lots of objects to find (cats, toys, darts, keys, milk bottles)

Two game modes — normal and time attack

Collect 50 unique cat cards, including golden and epic ones

Hint system

Save progress

Reset progress

Humorous hand-drawn graphics

4550740.name: Kidnapped Simulator
4550740.about_the_game:
You wake up chained to a chair in an isolated cabin, 37 miles from civilization. A man who calls himself "The Curator" stands over you. He doesn't want your money. He wants something far more dangerous — your truth.

Kidnapped Simulator is the first game to feature a fully local AI model running entirely on your machine. There are no cloud servers, no API calls, no token costs. The AI kidnapper lives inside your PC, which means you can play completely offline — and nothing you type or say ever leaves your computer. This gives you total freedom to engage with the experience however you choose.

The gameplay is simple in concept but deeply unpredictable in practice: you are trapped in a conversation with a serial killer, and your only way out is through your words. Type or speak your responses as The Curator reads your micro-expressions, judges your honesty, and decides whether you live or die. He has archived 73 sessions before yours. Only seven walked free.

Every playthrough is shaped by what you reveal — or refuse to reveal. Deflect too many times and the situation escalates. Share something genuine and you might earn a moment of mercy. But Vincent is no fool. He has spent decades studying human deception, and he will punish lies with escalating cruelty.

A single session can be completed quickly, but uncovering every possible path, understanding The Curator's psychology, and discovering what truly makes him release a captive will take many attempts. Each run teaches you something new about how the AI thinks — and how far you're willing to go.

The custom AI model was built from the ground up as a simulation of a serial killer's mind. It features internal scoring, phase-based interrogation structure, and dynamic emotional responses that adapt to your behavior in real time.

4550810.name: Typing Frankenstein
4550810.about_the_game:
Type the classic novel "Frankenstein; or, the Modern Prometheus" by Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley. Type paragraphs quickly and flawlessly to unlock new chapters. Race against the ghost of your own cursor to beat your best time.

Type a book

This is a typing game where you type a book—simple as that. If you want to read the original 1818 novel Frankenstein; or, the Modern Prometheus while practicing your typing skills at the same time, this game is for you. 

Victor Frankenstein pushes science beyond its limits—and succeeds. But the life he creates is not the miracle he imagined. Cast out and alone, the creature begins a desperate search for belonging that spirals into vengeance. Dark, tragic, and deeply human, Frankenstein remains one of the most powerful stories ever written about creation and responsibility.

Race Your Ghost

In this game you have to type fast. Faster than yourself. 

When you set a new high score on a paragraph, the movement of your cursor during that run is recorded.

The next time you type that paragraph, it appears as a ghost cursor so you can compare your progress to your previous best run.

It becomes an intense experience when you're going head-to-head with your ghost and your fingers are hammering the keyboard as fast as they can.

Chapters and Paragraphs

The book has been broken down into chapters and paragraphs, because typing a full novel in a single sitting is nearly impossible.

A paragraph can be completed in a couple of minutes, which is much more suitable for an intense speed-typing session.

You receive a score when you complete a paragraph, and you may also earn a medal. To advance to the next chapter, you must collect enough medals from paragraphs.

No Mistakes Allowed

It's a bit harsh, but that's how this game works.

Whenever you make a spelling mistake, the word is deleted and you have to start over. There is no accuracy score, but your time score will take a hit if you make mistakes.

 

Hidden Words

Learning to type is no good without knowing how to spell. That's why, in this game, you have to remember the word you are currently typing.

This is enforced by hiding the word as soon as you begin typing it. If you get really stuck and can't remember the word, wait one second and it will reappear.

Save and Reload

You get three saves for each paragraph.

You can save and reload whenever you want, but spend your saves wisely. If you save frequently in the beginning, you may have no saves left for the end. Restarting a paragraph restores your saves.

4550820.name: Extreme Racing Line
4550820.about_the_game:
Extreme Line Racing is a minimalist top-down arcade racer built around precision, control, and replayability.

Race across fully visible single-screen tracks in cars with distinct handling styles. Push tight lines through every corner, ride the edge of the track, and chase faster lap times, higher star ratings, and better leaderboard positions.

The rules are simple, but the pressure is constant. As long as your whole car does not fully leave the track, your run is still alive. That gives you room to drive on the limit, squeeze through dangerous corners, and fight for every fraction of a second without losing the clarity and readability that make top-down racing so satisfying.

Every run is short, focused, and built for immediate replay. There are no long events or unnecessary distractions here, just pure arcade racing: pick a car, hit the track, learn the corners, and go again. Improving means mastering speed, grip, steering, rhythm, and the unique feel of each vehicle.

As you progress, you can unlock and purchase new cars with different strengths in top speed, acceleration, grip, and steering. Some reward aggressive driving, some offer more control, and some shine on technical tracks that demand precision. Whether you want to clear every course, earn every star, improve your best times, or climb the global leaderboards, every track gives you a reason to come back for one more run.

If you enjoy racing games that are easy to jump into, quick to restart, and rewarding to master, Extreme Line Racing is built for you.

Key Features

  • Precision-focused top-down arcade racing

  • Fully visible single-screen tracks for clean reading and route optimization

  • Off-track rules that reward edge riding and limit driving

  • Cars with distinct handling, speed, grip, acceleration, and steering profiles

  • Fast retries that keep every run focused and replayable

  • Star ratings, time improvement, and score chasing on every track

  • Global leaderboards for players who want to keep pushing

  • Replay support for reviewing and improving your runs

  • Keyboard and controller support

  • Minimalist visuals built for clarity, speed, and readability

4550860.name: Rising Wan
4550860.about_the_game:
Rising Wan is a fast-paced 2D action-platformer that emphasizes speed and abilities!

Run through levels as fast as possible to get the best score, killing enemies reduces your overall time. Every boss has their own set of abilities, beat the boss and  pick one ability to make your own! Cut, shoot and detonate your way through 8 action packed levels!

Story:

Magma, the frog boss, has stolen your precious bone! Work for him and assassinate 8 key figures of the underworld to get it back! If he holds up to his end of the bargain that is...

Key Features:

  • High-Paced action: Run and cut through enemies as fast as possible to get on the leader-board!

  • 24 unique upgrades: Defeat a boss and pick 1 out of 3 upgrades to add to your arsenal!

  • Perfect Your Strategy: Mix and match upgrades to create the perfect run! What does it take to become #1?

  • Full destruction: Destroy your surroundings and create short-cuts of your own!

Technical Features:

  • 3 button layout: Besides directional inputs, use slash, jump and special to unload your ninja arsenal!

  • 8x8 Pixel art: Almost ever sprite is 8x8 pixels, enjoy this super retro style!

4550940.name: Self Simulated: Pinball Anomaly
4550940.about_the_game:
Self Simulated: Pinball Anomaly is a pinball action game for Game Boy Color, inspired by classics like Pokémon Pinball, Super Robot Pinball, and Devil's Crush — where you must fight through a corrupted digital simulation to rescue Self, the robotic protagonist of the original Self Simulated.

This isn't just a score-chaser. It's a battle.

One Table. Many Threats.

The simulation is alive with enemies. Fight your way through waves of hostile robots, survive boss encounters, and dismantle M-Iss1-NgN-0's grip on the system — all with the flippers. Bumpers, slingshots, drop targets, and skillshot orbits give you the tools. How you use them is up to you.

Key Features

  • Authentic Pinball Mechanics — A full-featured table with bumpers, slingshots, drop targets, skillshot orbits, and ball saves

  • Enemy Waves & Boss Fights — Battle multiple robot enemies across waves and face down bosses to progress the story

  • Nudge System — Physically influence the ball's path with nudges — but over-nudge and face a penalty. Master the Power-Nudge to defeat enemies

  • Mini-Game Pinball Rooms — Special flipper rooms unlock during a run, offering unique micro-challenges and variety

  • Highscore Chase — Classic score-chasing gameplay rewards skill, risk-taking, and pattern mastery across every run

  • Save & Resume Anytime — Save your run mid-game and pick up exactly where you left off

  • Rumble Support — Full hardware rumble for a more tactile pinball experience

  • Assist Settings — Start with 6 balls instead of 3, faster ball saves, and reduced game speed for a more accessible experience

A Spinoff Built for the Hardware

Self Simulated: Pinball Anomaly is a direct spinoff of Self Simulated — the Game Boy Color precision platformer released as a physical cartridge in 2025. You don't need to have played the original to enjoy Pinball Anomaly, but fans will recognize Self and understand what's at stake.

4550980.name: Jokey and Jolly´s
4550980.about_the_game:
Welcome to the exciting world of Jokey and Jolly’s!

"Jokey and Jolly’s" is an indie horror game in which you use figurines on your desk to ward off the Jolly`s. Meanwhile Jokey communicates with the player, sending cryptic messages throughout the game.

The Story
Meet Jokey the Clown, once the star of the show for children and adults alike. Everything changed on one fateful day when he became the "Crying Clown." In that moment of sorrow, the Jolly’s emerged.

Features
Powered by the Clickteam Fusion 2.5 engine, Jokey and Jolly’s delivers a polished horror experience featuring:

  • Timed Mechanics: Precision is key to survival.

  • Diverse Mini-Games: Seven unique challenges to test your skills.

  • Hidden Easter Eggs: Plenty of secrets waiting to be discovered.

  • Saved Progression: Never lose your place.

Game Mechanics
Use the Jolly figures on your desk to fend off terrifying jumpscares. If you’re too slow, it’s game over. Be warned: as you progress through the levels, your reaction window shrinks, demanding faster reflexes.

Lore
The narrative is woven directly into the game. Visit the "Lore Room" to uncover the core story, or keep a sharp eye out while playing—hidden details are scattered throughout the environment for those brave enough to look.

Arcade Mini-Games
Head over to the Arcade Room and step up to the functioning machine to play 7 different mini-games. each with its own unique mechanics and objectives.

Easter Eggs
Keep your eyes peeled! There are at least 10 rare Easter eggs that can trigger at any time. For example, if you spot and click the hidden Party Hat, all the Jolly figures will instantly join the celebration by wearing one.

Saved Progression
Got jumpscared? Don’t worry. The game automatically remembers your level, so you can jump right back into the action without starting from scratch.

Are you ready to face Jokey and his Jolly’s?

4550990.name: A Vessel of Frustration
4550990.about_the_game:
You return to your hometown but no one recognizes you. But that doesn’t matter, because you are not here for them. You are here for her. 

Midgårdsormen, singer and artist, pervert and goddess, a being truly out of this world. She is going to play on Saturday, and you are finally strong enough to meet her here in this physical and certain world. It is time to find out if your dreams of her are delusional or supernatural. 

Are you strong enough to survive her judgement? Is she powerful enough to survive yours?

A Vessel of Frustration is a narrative rpg/visual novel handdrawn and painted with watercolors, with focus on a choice and consequence gameplay. It takes place during a weekend, and both content and outcome heavily depends on the player’s own actions. As the player, you walk around in a small Swedish seemingly normal town and interact with people you know are, just like you, out of this world. If you aren’t careful enough in your exploration, who knows what might be unleashed. 

This game takes place 13 years after The Shame of a Daydreamer, and can be seen as a sequel, but can also be played independently.

4551030.name: The Cluster
4551030.about_the_game:
In this game you will play as Richard, being the main character of this story, and you will need to go on your daily draining routine of hunting down in the night so you could go sell the preys to the unhinged locals in the near Cluster. And hope that one day, soon enough, this hell of a cycle will end soon, so that you an your wife Lilith, with all the savings you gathered through out those years, will be able to leave this place forever, in hope for a better future in the city.

But something unexpected would happen, right in their last days of surviving and doing hard labor in this forest, causing irreversible damage.

This struggle for a new beginning sets the stage for a dark journey.

And This Indie Horror game is about Richard and Lilith surviving on the edge of the wilderness. They are pushing through one last, desperate effort to break free from their circumstances, clinging to the hope that their grueling labor will finally earn them a life beyond the trees. 

This experience is a VHS low poly style horror game, made in unity. and sits around 30 mins of gameplay.

4551050.name: Void Daggers
4551050.about_the_game:
One touch kills you. Your timer is your score.

A platform. Infinite darkness. Then the neon comes: Wireframe horrors pouring from the void, geometric nightmares that swarm, flank, and dive. Alien structures claw upward beneath your feet, spawning deadlier waves with every heartbeat you survive. Shatter them. Harvest their essence. Forge your daggers through 5 tiers of devastation.

If you loved Devil Daggers, this is your next obsession. 5 weapon tiers. 3 fire modes. Fluid movement tech. Full replay system.

16 ENEMIES. 7 STRUCTURES. 3 BOSSES. 6 PHASES.

Swarmers close gaps. Flankers circle wide. Divers plunge from above. Bosses reshape the arena. Every wave deadlier than the last. Every pattern must be learned.

MOVE OR DIE

Circle strafe through neon. Bunny hop the void. Dagger jump to escape the swarm. Rapid-fire streams, shotgun bursts, or a screen-clearing pulse. Pick your devastation.

CHASE EVERY SECOND

Global leaderboards. Steam Friends rankings. Full first-person replays. Watch the best, study their routes, take their throne. Instant retry. Every second on the clock is earned.

Play Void Daggers now!

4551150.name: Stamperor! The Jester's Decree
4551150.about_the_game:
Stamp decisions. Accidentally destroy your own empire. Repeat.

In Stamperor!, you rule as a jester making fast decisions that shape the fate of your empire. Do everything you can to prevent unexpected events from destroying your empire and leading you to defeat.

Each cycle, citizens arrive with requests, but it’s not just about saying “yes” or “no”. You use stamps with unique effects to alter your choices, create unexpected consequences, and deal with situations that spiral out of control.

Build and keep your empire standing

Expand your empire and manage Money, Food, Happiness, Security, and Population. Every structure shifts the balance of your empire and can either help or accelerate collapse. Proposals are unpredictable, and you will need to think strategically to handle each problem that appears in your realm.

Decisions that become stories

Engage in evolving storylines throughout the run, meet charismatic characters with their own interests, and face decisions that can change everything. Each character has a different personality and story, and may offer good proposals or threaten you in the most absurd ways possible

Expect the unexpected

Unpredictable events can turn your run upside down at any moment.
One mistake can trigger a chain reaction. A good decision might not be so good after all. Act impulsively, be wise, be a tyrant, be a fool, choose your way of ruling!

But don’t forget that your people need you!

Survive the chaos or be consumed by it.

A decision-driven city builder where every choice matters and can either end everything or lead you to become a glorified emperor.
