4551330.name: Softscape
4551330.about_the_game:
Restore Life Through Creativity

Softscape is a relaxing first-person sandbox builder where you transform barren spaces into peaceful living gardens.

Start with dry, forgotten plots. Route water through the land, shape the ground, paint natural terrain, place paths, add edging, choose your plants, and decorate each space in your own style.

There are no timers. No pressure. No rush.

Just the quiet satisfaction of turning something empty into something alive.

Build Gardens Your Way

Every plot in Softscape is a small creative canvas.

Choose from a growing collection of trees, shrubs, flowers, water features, paths, trims, benches, and decorative objects to create gardens that feel personal to you.

Build neat and structured spaces, wild natural gardens, cozy corners, symmetrical layouts, or peaceful little sanctuaries filled with plants and movement.

The tools are simple to use, but flexible enough to create countless variations.

Shape, Irrigate, Plant, Restore

Each garden is built through a calm creative loop:

Irrigation

Connect water systems and place sprinklers to bring dry soil back to life. Water unlocks the potential of each plot and prepares it for planting.

Landscaping

Use intuitive brushes to paint grass, soil, stone, bark, and other terrain types. Shape the structure of your garden with paths, natural areas, and decorative ground textures.

Planting

Fill your space with trees, shrubs, flowers, and garden objects. Complete the needs of each plot while still designing it in your own way.

As each space comes together, the world slowly begins to feel alive again.

The Grand Tree

At the heart of Softscape is the Grand Tree, a quiet symbol of restoration.

As you bring life back to forgotten spaces, the world around the Grand Tree slowly awakens. Leaves return. Flowers bloom. Nature begins to reclaim what was lost.

Softscape is not only about making gardens look beautiful. It is about the feeling of care, patience, and presence that comes from creating something peaceful with your own hands.

A Calm Creative Atmosphere

Softscape is designed to be a peaceful place to return to.

Expect:

  • Relaxing first-person sandbox gameplay

  • Cozy low-poly visuals

  • Satisfying planting and landscaping tools

  • Ambient environmental soundscapes

  • Gentle wildlife and visual effects

  • No timers or fail states

  • Creative freedom across every garden

Whether you want to carefully design a beautiful space or simply relax and place flowers for a while, Softscape gives you room to slow down.

Development Roadmap

Softscape is still growing, and future updates are planned to expand the creative tools, environments, and restoration systems over time.

Possible future additions include:

  • More plants, trees, flowers, and decorations

  • Additional environments and biomes

  • New landscaping and placement tools

  • More ways to personalize your gardens

  • Seasonal themes and visual variety

Softscape’s goal is to become a peaceful creative sandbox where every player can build spaces that feel uniquely their own.

4551370.name: Knockout Carnival
4551370.about_the_game:
Welcome to Knockout Carnival!

Jump into a chaotic online multiplayer party game where skill, timing, and pure madness decide who wins. Compete with other players in fast-paced physics-based challenges full of unpredictable moments, hilarious fails, and intense competition.

Push, dodge, jump, and sabotage your opponents as you try to survive each round and become the ultimate winner.

  GAME FEATURES:

• Online Multiplayer Chaos – Compete against other players in unpredictable matches

• Physics-Based Gameplay – Every movement can lead to victory or disaster

• Fun & Competitive – Easy to play, hard to master

• Party Game Madness – Perfect for playing with friends

• Colorful & Dynamic Worlds – Vibrant arenas full of obstacles and surprises

Every match is different. Every fall is funny. Every win feels earned.

Are you ready to survive the chaos?

4551380.name: Robo Siege TD
4551380.about_the_game:
Defend your colonies by building towers and destroying incoming waves of robots. It's up to the player to build towers at strategic locations in order to divert and weaken the enemies so as to make different towers work together. Many different environments and effects brings each world to life.

High Replayability

10 Levels in the main campaign with 3 difficulty levels each. 5 alternative ways to play.

Many Enemies

12 different enemies. Enemies can have shields and armor. Specific towers are more efficient against shields. Stronger but slower towers are better against armor. Three utility bots. One can heal other robots. One is extremely fast. And one gives shields to nearby robots.

Upgrades 

This game is very likely the first incremental tower defense game ever created. An incremental game is one where you achieve many upgrades in quick succession during the entire gameplay. Each tower has 3 ranks that the player can upgrade to directly (2 upgrades each). Each of those ranks have automatic mini upgrades as they achieve a certain amount of damage. Each rank has more mini upgrades than the previous rank. As you make progress, unlock the Factory tower to unleash even more upgrades that must be discovered by the player in game. Can you unlock the golden tower?

Towers

10 towers with 3 ranks each with more upgrades to be discovered in game (with the factory tower). Each tower serves a different purpose that the player can mix and match to optimize their strategy. Get automatic mini upgrades for well placed towers.

4551420.name: SHOTRUN
4551420.about_the_game:
FIGHT FOR YOUR LIFE

SHOTRUN is a brutal, fast-paced one-shot FPS where every move matters and every mistake is fatal. Armed with nothing but your shotgun and your reflexes, you’ll have to survive relentless encounters in a world that gives you no second chances.

No reloading. No hesitation. Just pure speed and precision.

MAKE THE CHAOS

Run through dark, claustrophobic office floors where danger lurks around every corner. Enemies come fast — and you’ll need to be faster. Blast your way through waves of resistance, turning tight corridors into scenes of destruction.

Every shot counts. Every second matters. Adapt, react, survive.

CLIMB THE CORPORATE LADDER

Your goal is simple — reach The Manager. But nothing about the journey is easy. Fight your way through increasingly intense floors, master your movement, and prove that you deserve your promotion.

In this office, success isn’t earned — it’s taken.

FEATURES

  • Ultra-fast, one-shot-one-kill gameplay

  • High-risk, high-reward combat

  • Minimalist but brutal mechanics

  • A strange and deadly corporate world

Linkisa is a 2D hand-drawn Metroidvania set in the rainy and mysterious lands of the Orana Empire. Welcome to you in this adventure inspired by Malagasy folklore, where you explore mysterious lands, master fluid combat, face legendary bosses, and uncover hidden secrets.

      As you journey through a rain soaked and fractured land, questions begin to emerge. What was taken from you? What is Aloka and what is its true purpose? And what does the Empire truly seek?

      Fight as a powerful being, shape your destiny, and restore order, or uncover a truth that was meant to remain hidden.

4551520.name: Your Daddy

4551560.name: Medic Simulator: Combat Zone
4551560.about_the_game:
Become the frontline hero in Medic Simulator: Combat Zone — where every second counts and every decision can save a life. React to unpredictable threats and engage enemies when necessary.

• Engage enemies and be ready to reload your weapon

• Take on dynamic missions while searching for the injured across the combat zone

The battlefield is unforgiving — but the adrenaline is unmatched.

Are you ready to answer the call?

4551570.name: PAPER STRIKE
4551570.about_the_game:
3v3 COMPETITIVE CHAOS IN ONE-MINUTE ROUNDS

Paper Strike is a fast-paced 3v3 competitive game where warrior-mages fight across a series of intense one-minute minigames.

Draw your spells, combine them with instant abilities, and take control of the ultimate power: Armageddon.

DRAW YOUR SPELLS

Manually draw runes to cast your abilities.

  • Precision and timing are key

  • You are vulnerable while casting

  • Every spell is a risk-reward decision

Easy to learn, hard to master.

HYBRID COMBAT SYSTEM

Combine two systems in real time:

  • Spells: powerful, tactical, require drawing

  • Abilities: instant, reliable, used to interrupt and control

Mastering both is the key to winning fights.

ONE-MINUTE MINIGAMES

Each match is a best-of-five series of one-minute rounds, with changing objectives:

  • Team Deathmatch

  • King of the Hill

  • Capture modes

  • Race challenges

  • Special modes like VIP or Bomb

Every round forces you to adapt.

MODULAR MAPS AND BIOMES

Maps are divided into zones with different elemental properties.

  • Dynamic environments

  • Strategic positioning

  • Changing gameplay conditions

No two matches play the same.

THE ARMAGEDDON SYSTEM

Winning rounds gives your team control of Armageddon.

  • Push it across the map

  • Choose the next battlefield

  • Reach the enemy side to win

Comebacks are always possible.

BUILD YOUR STRIKER

Create your own warrior-mage.

  • 8 abilities per character

  • Elemental affinities

  • Distinct playstyles

Experiment with builds and team compositions.

COSMETIC-ONLY PROGRESSION

Unlock:

  • Character skins

  • Spell visual effects

  • Victory animations

No pay-to-win. Skill decides the outcome.

HIGH REPLAY VALUE

  • Randomized minigames

  • Evolving maps

  • Endless combinations of strategies

Every match feels different.

BUILD PAPER STRIKE WITH US!

4551590.name: Chat, Is This Real?
4551590.about_the_game:
How far would you go to go viral?


Chat is this Real? is a first-person psychological horror game. You play as Alex, who, after receiving a VHS tape linked to a forgotten patient, sees the perfect opportunity: to break into an abandoned hospital and start a live stream.

What begins as an impulsive attempt to go viral quickly turns into a nightmare.

Explore dark corridors, discover disturbing clues about the patient's past, and survive increasingly terrifying events while your chat follows everything. Between jokes, questions, warnings, and theories, the audience itself can help you move forward.

Throughout the investigation, encounter paranormal phenomena, urban legends, and secrets linked to the hospital. The more discoveries you make, the more attention your live stream attracts... and the bigger your chat becomes.

But the more Alex discovers, the less it seems like real content... and the more it seems like something is waiting for him.

Features


  • First-person psychological horror with a narrative focus
  • Chat simulation that reacts to events and can offer hints, alerts, and comments
  • Log of mysteries with urban legends, supernatural entities, and secrets linked to the game's story
  • Audience progression as new discoveries and phenomena are recorded
  • Immersive narrative, oppressive atmosphere, and disturbing supernatural events
  • Stealth and chase sequences by entities inhabiting the hospital

4551640.name: Pod's Itty Bitty Adventure
4551640.about_the_game:
"Pod's Itty Bitty Adventure" is a short retro-themed open-world Metroidvania platformer that prioritizes movement and exploration. Guide Pod around a curious Tandy-1000-esque world, looking for power-ups, treasures, and the ultimate goal: self-actualization. A short and sweet experience for all lovers of indie games, retro computers, and collect-a-thons.

(Self-actualization not included)

4551680.name: Bounced: Not Tonight
4551680.about_the_game:
The door is yours. Try not to lose it.

Bounced: Not Tonight puts you on the door of Club Velveteen: the most chaotic nightclub in the city. Armed with a clipboard, a flashlight, and a dangerously low tolerance for nonsense, your job is simple: check who gets in, who gets bounced, and who gets sent flying into the hedge.

Every night has its own rules. New dress codes. VIP guestlists. Banned items. Special guests who think they're above the law. Scrutinise IDs, cross-reference the list, confiscate contraband, and make the call; fast. The queue isn't getting any shorter.

Read it. Check it. Bounce it. Study each patron's documents for fake IDs, expired passes, and suspicious faces. The rules change every shift: last night's guest of honour is tonight's banned list. Learn the criteria, spot the inconsistencies, and keep the riff-raff out.

Physics that are not on your side Rejections don't always go smoothly. With a fully simulated physics engine, every confrontation is a barely controlled disaster. Drag, shove, grab, and ragdoll rowdy patrons or accidentally launch yourself across the pavement. The manager is watching. The crowd is filming.

Better with a partner Bring a friend and split the door. One checks IDs while the other handles the queue. Disagree on a call? Sort it out between you or don't, and watch the chaos unfold. Full co-op support with shared rules, shared consequences, and absolutely no shared excuses.

The night never ends Unlock new venues, wilder events, and increasingly demanding crowds as your reputation grows. Themed nights, celebrity appearances, hen dos, stag parties, and the occasional full scale brawl keep every shift unpredictable.

Features:

  • First-person 3D bouncer sim inspired by Papers Please

  • Full physics-based interactions and ragdoll mayhem

  • Co-op support for 2 players

  • Procedural nightly rules: dress codes, guestlists, banned items

  • Multiple venues and escalating difficulty Comedic tone with absurd emergent moments every shift

4551710.name: Fat Justice
4551710.about_the_game:
In Fat Justice, you are the newly appointed Judge of a chaotic Stone Age island. With no memory of your past, you only know two things for certain: your father has mysteriously disappeared, and your Uncle has just handed you the ultimate seat of power. Now, you must use this newfound authority as your only tool to uncover the truth behind your father's fate, all while trying to keep the tribe from completely tearing itself apart.

Order in the Cave

Every day, you'll try to keep a straight face as islanders confess to the most absurd, borderline hideous crimes imaginable. You'll judge bizarre alibis and prehistoric misdemeanors so spectacularly stupid you'll wonder how humanity even survived the Stone Age.

The Shadow of the Dark Man

But petty island drama is the least of your worries. A ruthless assassin known as the Dark Man is picking off the ruling elite one by one. The War Chief, the Tax Collector, and the Justice of Water are already dead. Odds are, this is the exact same killer behind your father's disappearance, and now you're caught right in the middle of the fallout.

Puppet or Judge?

Everyone has an agenda. Your uncle wants you to follow the rules and catch the killer, while a guy claiming to be your childhood best friend is begging you to burn the whole system down.

Your Island, Your Choice

Every verdict you make shifts the balance of power. How you treat your people will decide the ultimate fate of the island and yourself. Do you blindly side with your uncle to uncover the truth about your father? Do you listen to your friend and spark a tribal revolution? Or will you just be a survivor caught in a political tug-of-war?

Try not to get assassinated by the cat on your desk.

Whose side are you taking?

  • Your Uncle: The man who gave you your power. He wants you to uphold the status quo, keep the island’s bizarre laws intact, and hunt down the Dark Man at all costs.

  • Your "Old Friend": A childhood buddy who is constantly in your ear, begging you to tear down the corrupt establishment and abolish the island's terrible laws.

  • The Desk Cat: The only one you can trust. Pet them while you send criminals to the dungeon.
4551710.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

4551740.name: CalvinChess
4551740.about_the_game:
What is CalvinChess?

It's chess, but the rules keep changing!

CalvinChess is a chess variant with roguelike elements designed for multiplayer gameplay and chaotic fun in mind. After each turn, a player is presented with a choice among various rules or events to apply to the board, changing how pieces move, where they're placed, or even which spaces exist where!

For example, one rule makes rooks move like bishops. Another makes pawns move like knights. Some rules introduce new moves to pieces to allow for new options, and others alter the direction they move on the board. Since rules apply to both players and expire over the course of the game, being able to adapt to change and strategize around a dynamic playing field is a necessity for victory.

Features

  • Customizable game setup - Games can be customized to add/remove certain rules, change the frequency of when they appear and which player gets to choose, what the initial board looks like, and more! If you really wanted to, you could play normal chess!

  • Cartoony and satisfying visuals - Pieces slide into place, move in sequence, and spontaneously combust upon being taken! Also, they all have googly eyes!

  • Dynamic game information - Hovering over a piece while it's your turn visualizes where it can move, factoring in new rules and whether or not a move would put a king into check. Rules affecting specific pieces will also be highlighted as necessary. No need to do all that mental math in your head!

  • Personalization options - Choose what colors the dark and light pieces are!

  • Local and online multiplayer - Play using one computer passing the mouse back and forth or play over an Internet connection! Either way, you're bound to make (or break) a few friendships!

Have fun!

4551780.name: Treasure Blast Quest
4551780.about_the_game:
Dig deep, grab gold, and uncover hidden treasures in a colorful underground adventure!

In Treasure Blast Quest, you control a powerful digging machine and send your hook deep beneath the surface to collect gold, gems, treasure chests, and other valuable loot. Every drop is a gamble — will you strike it rich, or lose precious time pulling up rocks and low-value items?

Use smart timing, plan your moves carefully, and make the most of every second. Reach score targets, unlock more challenging stages, and use your earnings to buy helpful upgrades and tools. As you progress, the underground becomes more rewarding, more dangerous, and more strategic.

Easy to learn and fun to master, Treasure Blast Quest is perfect for players who enjoy casual treasure hunting, score chasing, and satisfying arcade-style gameplay.

Features

Hook-and-grab treasure gameplay

Drop your claw underground to collect gold, gems, treasure chests, and hidden rewards.

Use dynamite strategically

Blast away unwanted items and turn difficult situations in your favor.

Upgrade through the shop

Spend your hard-earned money on useful items and improvements between stages.

Colorful cartoon-style visuals

Explore a bright and charming underground world full of surprises.

Simple controls, rewarding strategy

Easy to pick up, but full of timing, planning, and score optimization.

Replayable score-based progression

Improve your performance, beat your high scores, and become a true treasure hunter.

About This Game

Treasure Blast Quest is a casual arcade treasure-hunting game that combines grabbing, collecting, blasting, and score-based stage progression. Travel underground in search of shining gold, rare loot, and hidden riches while upgrading your tools and mastering the art of efficient treasure collection.

Whether you want a relaxing casual experience or a score-chasing challenge, Treasure Blast Quest delivers a fun and satisfying mining adventure.

4551800.name: A Bit Dicey
4551800.about_the_game:
A Bit Dicey grants unique dice-based mechanics where orientation and face values shape every move you make. 

Plan carefully and rotate to solve the puzzle! Some of the puzzles have more than one solution!

The game is split into 10 different worlds, each introducing a new mechanic while also building on what you've already learned.

A variety of dice and tile types introduce new ways of looking at the puzzle solving. 

  • More than 100 hand-crafted levels

  • Gradually evolving challenges

  • Beautiful and calming pastel colors

Roll, rotate, and rethink every move!

4551820.name: Yuki Jump
4551820.about_the_game:
Climb the Forbidden Jungle Tower in this quick little 2D platformer. Start at the bottom and jump your way up, taking out spiders, snakes, scorpions, and bats along the way. Kill enemies to earn XP, level up your character for more health, stronger hits, and a double jump, then push higher through tougher sections until you reach the top.

Key features:

  • Vertical climbing with 4 height zones that get harder as you go

  • Basic leveling: more XP means better stats and new abilities (Skilltree WIP)

  • Simple enemy types with their own attack patterns (Better AI WIP)

  • Short runs, usually 5 to 10 minutes

  • Instant restart on death so you can try again right away

  • Completely free, no ads or extras

4551890.name: Peak Rhythm
4551890.about_the_game:
Peak Rhythm is a VR rhythm-climbing game where music drives momentum. Every grab and twist powers your robotic platform upward through a neon-soaked city.

Sync your moves to a high-octane electronic soundtrack to master the flow and dominate global leaderboards. Blending physical precision with Cyberpunk aesthetics and Y2K energy, your rhythm is your engine. 

🕹️ GAME FEATURES

  • Rhythm-Powered Climbing: Master “Regular” grabs, “Multi-Twists” (volume knob motion), and “Double” holds on a 5x5 grid. Perfect hits boost your speed; misses slow you down.

  • Solo Mastery: Ascend 7 original tracks across 3 difficulties to perfect your runs. Compete for the highest altitude on map-specific leaderboards.

  • The Soundtrack: Launching with music from indie artists FEISTLING, Killin’ Void, Ion Diary, and funiel, spanning Drum & Bass, Dubstep, and House.

  • Custom Content: Includes a fully functional Beatmap Editor at launch. Create your own maps with your own music.

🚀 EARLY ACCESS ROADMAP

The climb is just beginning. We are committed to delivering frequent updates based on your feedback. Planned features include:

  • Social Multiplayer: Climb side-by-side with friends in real-time.

  • More Songs: Even more original songs coming soon.

  • Voice Chat: In-game communication.

  • Character Customization: Personalize your avatar’s look.

  • Cross-Platform Play: Expanding to other VR headsets.

Join our community to help shape the future of Peak Rhythm!

4552100.name: Cars and Guns: Paper Parts
4552100.about_the_game:
The cardboard trip is not over.

Cars and Guns: Paper Parts is a visceral, surreal vehicular action game with a soulslike heart. Everything here is made of cardboard, tape, and forgotten stories. You are a driver made of scraps, trying to stay whole in a world that wants to recycle you.

Fifteen years ago, Cars and Guns 3D introduced a strange, cardboard world of motorized mayhem. Later, NO THING took you on a monochromatic, surreal journey to the Office of the Future. Now, the paths merge. The road leads to The Garage of the Queen of Ice.

Key Features:

  • The Economy of Scrap: Every enemy you shred drops crumpled cardboard dollars. Collect them to rebuild your vehicle, but beware: when you burn out, your fortune stays on the road as a smoldering pile of trash.

  • Folded Reality: Experience a world where damage means tears and creases. Your car isn't just a health bar. It’s a physical, paper object that falls apart piece by piece.

  • The Garage of the Queen of Ice: A direct, surreal self-parody of the NO THING mythos. This is your sanctuary in the void. A palace of cardboard where paper parts are integrated into something more than just a machine.

  • Analog Soul: No AI, just ink and imagination. A tactile return to the handmade, experimental roots of Evil Indie Games.

The Queen of Ice is waiting in her garage. Will you reach her before you tear apart?

4552140.name: Malice in Wonderland
4552140.about_the_game:
Malice in Wonderland is a fast-paced action roguelike set in the world of Wonderland. Play as Alice after she returned to Wonderland as an adult, worn down by an eternity spent in The Hatter's time loop. 

A FIGHT AGAINST TIME

While escaping Wonderland, time is your health. Destroy enemies in a snappy and responsive combat system that asks not if you can stay alive, but how fast you can kill.

TEAR THROUGH WONDERLAND

Use Alice's powers to smash, shatter, and tear apart everything that gets in your way. Mix and match abilities with The Queen's decrees to create devastating combos.

FAMILIAR CHARACTERS, NEW STORY

After returning as an adult, this place isn't the Wonderland Alice remembers. The Hatter's grown all-powerful, The Queen's gone cold, and Cheshire's gone missing. Discover a new take on the world of Wonderland, and the stories inside it.

4552160.name: Help Me Get Up
4552160.about_the_game:
The Sky is Your Only Escape. Death is Your Only Shortcut.

In a world reclaimed by the undead and ruled by desperate scavengers, the ground is a death sentence. Your only hope? Up. [HELP ME GET UP] is a punishing top-down survival platformer where every step forward is a gamble, and every fall could be your last. Scavenge, fight, and climb through a vertical wasteland of precarious scaffolding, ruined skyscrapers, and makeshift bridges.

The Higher You Get, The Harder They Hit

The air gets thinner, the platforms get narrower, and the enemies get smarter. You aren't just fighting gravity—you’re fighting for your next meal.

Key Features:

  • Vertical Survival: This isn't just a climb; it's a race against depletion. Manage your hunger and thirst while navigating complex aerial puzzles. If you don’t find food in the ruins of an old apartment hanging 500 feet in the air, you won’t make it to the next floor.

  • Scavenge or Starve: Explore off-path ledges and dangerous rooms to find weapons, medical supplies, and canned goods. Will you risk a 3-story drop for a shotgun, or play it safe with a lead pipe?

  • Tactical Top-Down Combat: Fight off relentless Zombies that will lung at you and Bandits who want your loot. Use the environment to your advantage—sometimes the best way to deal with a bandit is to knock them off the ledge.

  • No Checkpoints, No Mercy: Much like the legendary climbing games of old, there are no save points here. If you slip, you fall. How far you fall depends on your luck and your reflexes.

  • High-Stakes Exploration: Use the top-down perspective to scout the path ahead. Look for structural weaknesses, hidden loot crates, and enemy patrols before making your move.

4552190.name: 《30天》
4552190.about_the_game:
《30天》是一部纯文字视觉小说，没有CG，没有配音配乐，只有文字和选择。

雪夜，你捡到一个弃婴。而你和她，只有30天。

游戏特色： 双线叙事：男性线“父亲”与女性线“母亲”，两种视角，两种人生

30天 = 30个选择 = 30个结局

没有正确选项，只有你想成为的，和她学会的

第30天，你和她的结局，会是....？

4552230.name: Make it! Gyoza
4552230.about_the_game:
Let's make gyoza on Steam!

Serve up plenty of gyoza for your customers, and don't let them burn!

Aim for a new high score!

[Score Attack]

Make lots of gyoza and aim for a high spot on the leaderboards!

[Battle]

Compete against others and test your gyoza-making skills!

《Rules》

Cook gyoza and fill customer orders!

Make as many gyoza as you can within the time limit!

《How to Play》

1. Make the filling, wrap it up, then start cooking!

2. Place a lid on the cooker to start cooking the gyoza!

3. Add starch slurry while cooking to make the bottoms nice and crispy!

4. When they're ready, serve the gyoza to your customers! Match the orders exactly to earn more points!

4552250.name: Cage of Y
4552250.about_the_game:
《Cage of Y》是一款引人入胜的回合制角色扮演游戏，以囚禁与解放为主题，在紧凑的战斗节奏中探索自由的意义。在明确的回合框架中，玩家将指挥角色，通过巧妙规划每个行动来战胜对手并逐步揭示角色的命运和背后的故事。

在游戏中，战略思维与解谜能力是解开囚笼的关键。玩家需在攻击、防御及技能使用间做出策略性选择，每个决定都会影响战斗的进程和角色的发展。面对敌人设置的各种陷阱与障碍，快速突破并非唯一途径，理智分析与稳妥的行动方案才是有效的胜利方式。

随着角色的不断成长，玩家将选择提升基本属性或扩展自由解放的手段，以应对更具挑战性的战斗环境。这种成长与策略的融合，使玩家在不断追求自由的过程中寻找最优的战术组合。

《Cage of Y》为钟爱传统回合制 RPG 的玩家提供了一个以囚禁、策略解放与持续抗争为核心的独特单人游戏体验。

4552280.name: YiShi Contagion: Versus
4552280.about_the_game:
In the world of YiShi Contagion: Versus, you will have fast and action packed PvP matches with your friends or in single player. Collect power-ups, survive enemy waves. Beat the boss or get overwhelmed trying. Which one will it be? Each match is yours to find out:

  • Jump into quick, chaotic fights. Play against a friend or take on the CPU in a 1 vs 1 battle. Every match sends you straight into the action.

  • Collect new power-ups after each wave and shape your build. Survive and watch your build spiral out of control.

  • Face dangerous bosses with many tricks up their sleeves. Building your character according to the tools you are given will be the only way to survive.

EASY TO LEARN, HARD TO MASTER

Jump in and start playing in seconds. No complicated controls to learn! As the fights get tougher, smart choices and quick reactions make all the difference. Every run teaches you something new, and no two matches ever play the same.

A WORLD RAVAGED BY A MYSTICAL VIRUS

After the rise of the Phylogenetics, while some nations were ravaged by the virus, other nations saw an opportunity...

  • An arcane virus, locked inside the mantle of the planet. Unearthed by multiple natural disasters, its spread pattern is still a mystery to researches, as it seems to have a mind of its own.

  • Plague Hunters, humans with special abilities that had got awakened around the time beginning of the virus outbreak. Play as either Maria or Tian Tian as your plague hunters of choice, and the nations they represent.

  • Some infected subjects develop what's known as a plague conduit, a unique large organ that mutates depending on its host and it is rumoured to generate incredible amounts of bio energy.

4552340.name: Fast Mine Sweeping: Skill Awakening
4552340.about_the_game:
Mage

Hunter

Warrior

Swordsman

Combine skills wisely for a thrilling minesweeper experience

Choose different characters, combine various skills, and quickly complete challenging minesweeper levels. Features classic minesweeper, standard roguelike gameplay, and challenge mode. With 4 characters and over 100 skills.

4552350.about_the_game:
This is a casual and puzzle puzzle game where the complete image is randomly shuffled into 4 * 4 small images each time. The position of each small image is random, and you need to assemble them into a complete image (in order to make the image move, the final puzzle will be 1/16 smaller).

4552360.name: Galactic Conflict
4552360.about_the_game:
🚀 Galactic Conflict

Command your empire in a real-time 4X strategy experience where every decision shapes the fate of the galaxy.

Expand across star systems, exploit resources, build powerful fleets, and wage war against rival AI empires in a constantly evolving battlefield. Whether you dominate through expansion, strategy, or overwhelming force, only one empire will control the galaxy.

🌌 Expand, Explore, Exploit, Exterminate

  • Explore procedurally generated star systems filled with planets, moons, and asteroid fields

  • Expand your empire by claiming territory and securing strategic locations

  • Exploit resources to fuel your economy, fleet production, and expansion

  • Exterminate rival AI empires through real-time combat and tactical decision-making

⚔️ Real-Time Strategy at Scale

Engage in fast-paced, real-time warfare across multiple star systems.

  • Command fleets in active combat zones

  • Fight simultaneous battles across different systems

  • Balance offense, defense, and expansion under constant pressure

  • React to evolving threats from multiple AI factions

Victory depends on your ability to think ahead, adapt quickly, and manage your empire efficiently.

🧠 Strategic Empire Management

Build and maintain a growing interstellar empire.

  • Manage resources and production

  • Control fleet creation and deployment

  • Expand intelligently to avoid overextension

  • Optimize your strategy based on galaxy size and AI difficulty

Every choice matters — one mistake can cost you entire systems.

🌠 Dynamic Galaxy Simulation

The galaxy evolves whether you're watching it or not.

  • AI empires expand, build, and wage war independently

  • Conflicts continue across systems even when you're not present

  • Large-scale wars unfold dynamically across the map

You are not the only force shaping the galaxy.

🔥 Multiple Difficulty Levels

Challenge yourself against increasingly aggressive AI empires.

  • Normal – Balanced for strategic growth

  • Hard – Faster AI expansion and stronger pressure

  • Insane – Relentless AI with minimal resource limitations

Only the most efficient and ruthless strategies will survive at higher difficulties.

💾 Persistent Progression

  • Save and load your empire at any time

  • Build long-term strategies across extended play sessions

  • Compete for high scores based on performance and difficulty

🎯 Designed for Strategy Players

Galactic Conflict is built for players who enjoy:

  • 4X and grand strategy games

  • Real-time decision making with long-term consequences

  • Managing complex systems under pressure

  • Expanding and controlling large-scale empires

👑 Will You Conquer the Galaxy?

Every system you claim, every fleet you build, and every war you fight brings you closer to total domination — or total collapse.

The galaxy will not wait.
Your enemies will not hesitate.

Adapt. Expand. Conquer.

4552380.name: My Part-Time Job With a Flirty Mistress
4552380.about_the_game:
◆Game Story

After drowning in debt, through a stroke of luck from the heavens and a vase-shattering disaster, you become the temporary butler of a wealthy household, serving a Miss as cold as snow.

Wait a minute... why does this sound so familiar?

A cold heiress who never smiles, a massive fortune up for grabs, scheming relatives plotting behind the scenes... And of course, the classic "melting the ice queen's heart" storyline?

Isn't this just every billionaire romance cliché rolled into one?!

As a clumsy disaster magnet, your daily life goes like this:

- Shattered a million-dollar antique vase on day one ✓

- Nearly burned down the kitchen while cooking ✓

- Walked in on the Miss naked while organizing her wardrobe ✓

- Asked to pretend to be her boyfriend to ward off suitors?! ✓✓✓

- Help the Miss warm her bed!? ✓✓✓✓✓

"Heh... Man, you've successfully caught my attention," says the Miss.

There are way too many domineering CEO clichés here! Is this some kind of "domineering Miss falls in love with me" story?

What you thought would be an ordinary part-time job turned into a triple threat of bloody family power struggles + being an undercover spy beside the Miss + a contract romance!

This was supposed to just be a part-time job, why is the plot getting more and more ridiculous!

4552810.name: 命运观测:选择性缄默
4552810.about_the_game:
Fate Observer: Selective Mutism is a single-player interactive visual novel centered on branching worldlines, character-driven relationships, and mystery.

You play as Gu Yan, moving through a story where every choice can lead you toward different relationships, different consequences, and different endings. Along the way, you will meet the same key characters under changing circumstances, building trust, creating distance, uncovering secrets, or losing your chance to understand them in time.

The game is built around **15 interconnected worldlines**. Through dialogue choices and key decision points, you will guide the story into different routes and gradually piece together the larger truth hidden behind the same core events. Each worldline approaches that truth from a different angle, changing what you learn, when you learn it, and what it costs you to keep going.

Your decisions do more than change a line of dialogue. They influence the order in which information is revealed, the direction of character relationships, the way major events unfold, and the ending you ultimately reach. Some routes bring you closer to the truth sooner. Others make you recognize the same person only through belated understanding.

At the heart of the game is a simple design belief: choice is the process through which life reveals its color. This world is not meant to be judged through black and white, joy and pain, gain and loss. Fate is a spectrum, and from it you draw the colors you choose - never just one. For that reason, the story is not built around routes that exist only to reward you, nor does it rush to judge who is right or wrong. The encounters, partings, resonances, and entanglements you experience across each worldline all refract into a light that is uniquely your own.

Alongside its branching narrative, the game uses character art, CG scenes, visual presentation, music, and sound design to give each worldline its own emotional weight and atmosphere.

If you enjoy story-rich games, multiple endings, relationship-driven drama, and mysteries that only become clear when viewed from several different routes, Fate Observer: Selective Mutism is designed as a journey of choices, consequences, and truths that must be assembled piece by piece.

4553140.name: Scratch Off!
4553140.about_the_game:
Scratch Off! is a deck-building roguelike built around scratch cards. You start with a basic deck, a wallet with no coins, and a landlord who wants his rent. From there, every decision you make shapes your run.

Each turn you pick which cards to commit, scratch them one by one, and watch the numbers add up. Land a full board of positives and you trigger a jackpot. Hit too many skulls and your total tanks. Coins you collect along the way trigger automatically as you scratch, multiplying values, punishing bad luck, and occasionally saving you from disaster.

Between rounds you visit the shop. Buy new cards, add upgrades, grab a coin from the checkpoint cases. Slowly you build something that works, or something that completely falls apart at the worst possible time.

A scratch card game with actual depth

Every card type plays differently. The standard card is a safe workhorse. Diamond cards have brutal skull penalties but enormous clover payouts. Slot cards are one pull from winning everything or losing it all. The Coin is a single cell, pure gambling.

Coins you collect permanently change how the game plays. Stack cherry multipliers. Build a deck around a single card type. Let the landlord win once, unlock the deck that turns every broken coin into a skull, and try again.

Unlock new decks by playing

Every deck unlocks through gameplay, not menus. Win your first run to unlock the Gold Rush deck. Earn minus ten dollars from a single card to unlock No Mercy. The unlock conditions push you to try things you normally would not.

Eight decks in total, each with a modifier that changes the rules of the run. Rent targets go up forty percent. Your hand size shrinks by one. Everything costs less but the shop charges ten times the normal price after you pick up a certain coin.

Build a run, not just a round

Scratch Off! rewards players who think across the whole run, not just the current turn. A coin that feels weak early can be the difference between paying rent on the final group or falling a few dollars short. Removing a bad card now saves you from dead weight later.

The runs are short enough that losing does not sting for long. Long enough that when something clicks and your scratch totals keep climbing, it feels earned.

Features

  • Deck building meets scratch cards

  • Over fifty coins with wildly different effects

  • Eight unlockable decks each with unique run modifiers

  • Jackpot system triggered by full positive boards

  • Endless mode for runs with no finish line

  • 29 languages

Interact with the environment, find keys to open locked rooms, collect documents to learn more about the world and its inhabitants.

As you explore the environment you might also find situations where choices will be prompted. So be sure to interact with the entirety of an environment to find clues, discover secret items or engage in miscellaneous actions to affect the world like pushing objects, breaking containers or dialoguing with NPCs.

4553360.name: King Of Leberkas - Austria Restaurant Simulator
4553360.about_the_game:
Welcome to King Of Leberkas – Austria Restaurant Simulator! 

Run your own restaurant in Vienna and start with a true Austrian classic: the Leberkäse sandwich. Your restaurant itself won’t grow in size – but the number of customers definitely will!

Be careful though: your guests are not patient. They have the classic Viennese attitude – short temper, lots of complaints, and quick insults if you mess up.

🕹️ Gameplay

Easy to learn, hectic to master:

  • 👀 Take orders: Look at a customer to take their order

  • 🍳 Cook: Go to the correct machine and press E to prepare food

  • 📦 Serve: Pick it up with E and bring it to the customer

  • 🍽️ Payment: After eating, look at them again to receive money

  • 💰 Rewards: Earn cash and feedback

🔧 Upgrades & Progression

Instead of expanding your restaurant, you improve efficiency:

  • 🍺 Unlock new products (beer, coffee, schnitzel, toast)

  • ⏱️ increase customer waiting time

  • 👨‍🍳 Hire employees to assist and automate tasks

  • 📈 Attract more customers and increase income

The better you perform, the more customers arrive – and the more chaotic it gets!

German tourists will also visit and confuse things by ordering a “Fleischkäsebrötchen”… 😄

And if a customer becomes too annoying:
👉 Throw food at them!
Just be careful – it will make them even more aggressive!

Can you handle the pressure and turn your restaurant into Vienna’s most popular Leberkäse spot?

4553440.name: 团战不能输
4553440.about_the_game:
游戏核心亮点

  • 高自由度阵容搭配：5 人英雄自由挑选，不同特质英雄组合出多样战术，拒绝千篇一律；

  • 随机抽牌添趣味：每回合随机抽牌，相同阵容也有全新对战体验，耐玩度拉满；

  • 纯策略无操作：无需复杂手速与走位，每回合部署、抽牌决策，全靠智慧取胜；

  • 公平对战：角色卡牌无抽卡机制，所有角色同价。

一、战前准备：组建专属 5 人英雄阵容

开局核心第一步，便是自由挑选 5 名英雄，组建属于你的专属出战阵容。每一位英雄都拥有独一无二的技能卡牌与属性特质，不存在同质化设计 —— 有的英雄擅长群体输出，能快速压制敌方血量；有的侧重防御续航，为己方阵容保驾护航；还有的能提供强力控制增益，打乱对手对战节奏。

你可以根据自己的策略偏好，搭配出多样化的阵容流派，无论是主打速攻压制的爆发阵容，还是兼顾防御与续航的稳健阵容，亦或是依靠控制链取胜的控场阵容，都能凭借 5 名英雄的技能联动，打造专属战术体系，为后续对战奠定基础。

二、对局核心：随机抽牌，每回合都有新变数

进入对战后，核心玩法围绕 “抽牌 + 决策” 展开，随机性与策略性拉满。每回合你都能抽取一张牌，没有固定的抽牌规律，你无法预知下一张抽到的是强力输出技能、应急防御卡牌，还是增益己方的辅助卡牌。

这种随机抽牌机制，让每一场对局都充满未知与新鲜感 —— 哪怕是相同的 5 人阵容，也能因为每回合抽到的卡牌不同，打出完全不一样的对战节奏。有时凭借一张关键的输出卡牌逆风翻盘，有时依靠防御卡牌化解对手攻势，每一次抽牌都可能改变战局走向，让策略博弈更具张力。

三、对战博弈：每回合部署，取舍之间定成败

对战过程中，每回合只能部署一只英雄上场，这也是策略决策的核心环节 —— 没有固定的部署模板，全靠你根据当前战局灵活判断。

你可以选择部署高爆发英雄，主动出击、压制对方节奏，抢占对战主动权，快速消耗敌方血量；也可以选择部署防御型英雄，稳扎稳打，留住爆发性卡牌与核心英雄，耐心等待对方核心英雄登场，再集中火力将其击败。需要注意的是，被击败的敌方英雄将进入 5 回合的复活冷却期，这段时间内，对方将暂时失去该英雄的战力，是你扩大优势的关键时机。

每一次部署都关乎战局走向，是激进压制还是稳健防守，每一个选择都考验你的策略思维，取舍之间，尽显博弈乐趣。

四、决胜时刻：团灭对手，全力突击赢胜利

对战的终极目标，便是击溃对手、赢得胜利，而核心决胜点就在 “团灭对手后的突击阶段”。

当你成功击败对方所有上场英雄，实现团灭后，将迎来关键的进攻窗口 —— 此时对方所有英雄都处于复活冷却期，无法部署上场，你可以趁机对对方玩家发起全力进攻，在对手英雄复活前，最大化输出伤害，争取一举击溃对方核心，直接赢得本次对战胜利。

这一阶段无需过多犹豫，抓住团灭后的黄金时间，合理利用手中的卡牌与剩余英雄战力，集中火力突击，就能将前期积累的优势转化为最终胜利，体验策略博弈的极致快感。

无需操作，全靠策略！自由组建 5 人阵容，凭借随机抽牌的未知性与每回合的精准部署，在博弈中压制对手，团灭后全力突击，解锁属于你的对战胜利，快来开启全新的策略团战体验吧！

4553470.name: Keep Grinding!!
4553470.about_the_game:
Keep Grinding is a Pixel Art, skateboarding adventure. 

A mysterious shadow entity has kidnapped your beloved pets… and it’s up to you to bring them back.

Grind through vibrant city streets, chain together stylish tricks, and explore a world full of secrets as you chase down the darkness that disrupted your peace.

Buy new tricks and upgrade your abilities to become faster, smoother, and unstoppable.

4553490.name: Ape-tite
4553490.about_the_game:
How many primates can you fit in a tight kitchen before it all burns down?

Ape‑tite is a fast, chaotic cooking game about keeping a kitchen running under pressure.

Prepare dishes, juggle orders, and react on the fly as cramped spaces turn simple tasks into problems.

Play solo or together

Play solo or together as things spiral out of control.

Sometimes teamwork helps. Sometimes it doesn’t.

What to Expect

  • Tight kitchens where space works against you

  • Short runs that escalate under pressure

  • Kitchen layouts that demand constant adjustment

  • Managing dine‑in and takeaway orders together

  • Daily twists that reshape each shift 

  • A strong, cohesive culinary theme

No monkey business in the kitchen.

Things fall apart fast under pressure.
4553490.supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

4553500.name: Abyss Drifter
4553500.about_the_game:
Abyss Drifter is an atmospheric space courier game about survival, navigation and isolation.

Humanity once relied on AI to wage its wars. It didn’t end well.

After a near-collapse, advanced AI was banned, leaving distant colonies cut off from Earth. Without it, long-distance space travel became slow, dangerous — and deeply human.

You are a courier in one of these forgotten systems.

Take on delivery contracts or trade goods between planets and stations. Navigate using your instruments, plan your routes, and survive the journey through a harsh and unforgiving environment.

Your ship is your home — and your lifeline.

Space is not forgiving.

You’ll need to prepare for every journey — manage your resources, take care of your health, and make sure your ship is ready.

Out here, mistakes are costly.

FEATURES:

  • Pilot your ship freely across a multi-planet star systems

  • Take contracts and transport cargo between distant outposts

  • Survive extreme planetary conditions and limited resources

  • Navigate using cockpit instruments

  • Trade goods and plan profitable routes

  • Survive by managing fuel, food, water and medicine

  • Repair, upgrade and replace your ship

  • Explore a lonely and atmospheric star systems

4553510.name: DEVIL GATE
4553510.about_the_game:
DEVIL GATE — an atmospheric Action/RPG Hack & Slash inspired by classic Diablo‑style titles and returning to the roots of the genre.
Immerse yourself in a dark West‑Slavic fantasy world where darkness and brutality lurk around every corner. Craft your own playstyle with a unique hybrid multiclass system. Combine abilities, experiment with builds, and find effective approaches to different foes.

Key features:

  • A return to the genre’s roots — the spirit of old‑school Hack & Slash and Diablo‑like RPGs

  • Multiclass system — expanded synergies between classes and flexible builds

  • West‑Slavic setting — journey through a grim, distinctive world drawing inspiration from Eastern European folklore

  • Atmosphere of darkness — gloom, brutality, and despair

  • Choice of solo or cooperative play — face the evil alone or shoulder‑to‑shoulder with friends

4553530.name: DarkRealms
4553530.about_the_game:
A brutal 2.5D boomer shooter. Blast through hordes of demons and undead in fast, aggressive combat built around speed, movement, and accuracy.

Master aerial combat as you dash through the air, launch rockets at the undead, carve through demons with a katana, and unleash devastating shotgun blasts at point-blank range. Every level is designed for momentum, replayability, and speedrunning.

Features:

- Fast-paced arcade-style FPS combat

- 2.5D visuals inspired by retro shooters

- Shotgun, rocket launcher, katana, and more

- Aggressive aerial movement and dash mechanics

- Demons, undead horrors, and brutal boss fights

- Speedrun-focused level design

- Heavy metal soundtrack driving the action

4553620.name: Dark Rail
4553620.about_the_game:
Turn-based management roguelike. Command the Inquisition and rule an industrial city on the empire’s edge. Use your train to meet prisoner shipment quotas by hunting heretics and slaying magical beasts. Produce supplies, contain revolt, and sacrifice prisoners to stop the madness.

HUNT DOWN HERETICS BY TRAIN

Send your inquisitors out by train on deadly quests to hunt down heretics across the frontier. These expeditions cost vital supplies, can raise madness and revolt, and may leave your inquisitors wounded or broken, but they are necessary. The prisoner shipments must never stop, no matter the cost.

MANAGE YOUR RESOURCES

Weigh short-term survival against long-term collapse by upgrading taxation for desperately needed income, even as it drives revolt higher. Research barracks improvements to strengthen and level your inquisitors, and pause or time buildings carefully to match your current shortages and priorities. When Revolt rises you may need to gift away supplies to calm the population and when madness rises... sacrifices will have to be made. Every choice affects Revolt, Resources, and Madness. Resource management is the key to lasting another day.

CHOOSE THE PATHS YOUR INQUISITORS WILL TAKE

Level up your inquisitors, train them for specialized roles, and assign skills that shape how they survive and perform in the field. Manage their health, level them up in the barracks, and choose carefully who you send on each mission.

CHOOSE YOUR PATH WITH THE META UPGRADES 

Earn Blood Points by sacrificing prisoners and completing shipment quotas, then spend them in the meta progression path to unlock powerful new abilities, bonuses, and lasting advantages for future runs. Shape your doctrine between playthroughs, expand your options, and return stronger each time to face harsher demands and greater horrors.

UNIQUE POWERS TO DEFEAT MONSTERS EACH RUN

Each run lets you choose different abilities to shape your strategy and face the dangers ahead. Use them to overcome challenges, survive encounters, and defeat the monsters and magical creatures that stand in your path.

4553740.name: Memory Studio
4553740.about_the_game:
Story Overview

At the edge of a small village stands the Memory Studio, a renovated old abandoned house.
It is a special photo studio that takes on requests to preserve places people don’t want to forget and moments they wish to remember forever through photographs.

Ria, a human girl, and Memo, a talking cat, run the Memory Studio together.
They accept requests and personally travel to locations filled with their clients’ memories, capturing photos and documenting both the past and present of those places.

Character Introduction

Ria

Ria is lively and full of curiosity. She quickly builds rapport even with first-time clients, leading conversations with her warm tone and playful personality.
She occasionally makes quirky jokes, but she has a strong ability to read emotions and empathize with others, making her especially skilled at opening people’s hearts.

Ria’s Memory Camera:
When she photographs an object tied to a memory, its past is captured in the image.
Through photography, she can momentarily freeze objects in place.

Memo

Memo is a quiet, bipedal cat who rarely shows emotions outwardly. Calm, realistic, and cautious in judgment, Memo speaks in a neutral and somewhat indifferent tone.
However, beneath that exterior lies a strong sense of responsibility toward both companions and clients.

Liquid Cat:
With a flexible body, Memo can slip through narrow spaces across the map and interact with objects using elasticity.

Immerse yourself as Ria and Memo, cooperate, and follow the story as you solve puzzles hidden throughout each map—helping recover the precious memories of various clients!

4553780.name: Crystal Ascend
4553780.about_the_game:
Effortless Collection

A relaxing incremental game where collecting is simple and satisfying. Just move your mouse to guide the absorption ring and enclose floating crystals—no clicking required. The ring automatically shatters them and harvests the aether within.

Nurture Your Elementals

Gather enough aether to upgrade your skill tree and enhance your absorption ring. Improve its efficiency and power to collect resources faster and more effectively.

Unlock New Possibilities

Successfully nurture an elemental companion to unlock new elemental seeds. Each one grows into a unique lifeform with its own skill tree, offering fresh mechanics and new ways to harvest aether—keeping your journey full of discovery.
4553780.supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Russian, Portuguese - Brazil, Traditional Chinese

4553840.name: EraPuzzle: Grid & Glory
4553840.about_the_game:
EraPuzzle: Grid & Glory is a casual tile-based puzzle game where smart planning and resource management are the keys to victory. Grow your settlement, harvest the land, and stretch your reach across the map to claim the golden prize — all at your own relaxed pace.

Build villages to gather resources from nearby trees, then use those resources to construct towers that extend your reach across the grid. Connect your way to the goldmine to complete each level. Simple to learn, satisfying to master.

Key Features

- Tile-based puzzle gameplay with a unique resource chain mechanic

- Build villages, towers, and barracks to expand across the map

- Harvest trees for resources — but plan wisely, resources are finite!

- Destroy goblin camps with your barracks to unlock blocked territory

- Refund resources by demolishing buildings — as long as you don't break the chain!

- Beautiful visuals and a relaxing soundtrack

- Hand-crafted levels with increasing depth and challenge

How It Works

Every level starts with your main base. From there, build villages within your reach radius to harvest nearby trees and bank resources. Spend those resources on towers to push your build radius further across the map. Watch out for goblin camps — they block construction in their territory until you build a barracks and drive them out.

Every decision matters. Demolish wisely, plan your chain, and reach the goldmine to claim your glory!

4553870.name: Nice Day For It
4553870.about_the_game:
Tee off for a round of golf... but hurry! In this arcade-inspired golf game, it's a race against the clock to complete as many holes in the allotted time. Compete against friends and strangers in the global leaderboards!

No waiting for swings!

No par or shot count!

If the ball is on the ground - HIT IT!

Holes are not procedurally generated - they will be the same each time, so you can improve your skills on each hole to really shave down those seconds!

And shave down those seconds you will want to, as if you complete every hole then the top spots on the leaderboard are decided by time remaining - it really is a race to the finish!

Nice Day For It!

4553890.name: Service Area Simulator: Prologue
4553890.about_the_game:
🚧 Start Small. Build a Service Empire.

You take over a small, abandoned facility on a lonely roadside.

Store, Restaurant, Gas Station and Motel — manage, grow and transform them all at once into a perfect service chain.

🛒 Build and Grow Your Own Store

Start with empty shelves.
Choose your products, manage your stock and create a store that attracts customers.

Unlock new products.
Set up bigger shelves.
Attract more customers.

Every detail affects your sales.

⛽ Fuel Sales & Vehicle Services

Set up gas pumps and manage vehicle traffic.

But that's just the beginning.

Open car wash services,
unlock advanced service and modification options over time.

A satisfied customer brings more customers.

🍔 Restaurant & 🏨 Motel Management

Serve hungry customers quickly and with quality.
Long wait times? Customer loss.

Offer clean rooms.
Provide comfortable accommodation.
Keep satisfaction high.

Here speed and quality are everything.

👥 Build Your Team. Let Go of Control.

At first, you'll do everything yourself.

But not forever.

Hire cashiers, cleaners, pump attendants
and gradually transform your facility into an automated system.

A good team = a smooth business.

⭐ Customers Never Forget

Your facility is constantly being evaluated:

• Cleanliness
• Wait time
• Product variety
• Stock status
• Service quality

If your rating rises, customers will flood in.
If it falls… your facility stays empty.

The choice is yours.
4553890.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Bulgarian, Danish, Indonesian, Dutch, Finnish, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Polish, Hungarian, Norwegian, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Greek, Czech, Swedish

4553910.name: Codex Solis: Purrgatorium
4553910.about_the_game:
Fly through surreal solar-system battlefields, hunt archons, and survive fast, aggressive space combat built around constant movement, weapon choices, and pressure. Beneath each fight sits a second conflict: captured planetary cells can be claimed, marked with cat cards, and written into living planetary books as part of an asynchronous online war.

Beneath the arcade action sits an asynchronous conquest layer spread across thousands of conquerable cells on eleven planets. Deploy your collected cat cards to attack, defend, and hold territory. Other players can challenge your claims with their own collections, turning each world into an ongoing territorial struggle.

But territory is only half of it.

Every grid cell is also a verse slot in a living planetary book. When you capture a cell, you do not just take land — you replace its text. Each world becomes a contested scripture written and rewritten by players over time, where conquest and authorship are part of the same system.

For players who want pure action, Arcade Mode offers a fully offline way to jump straight into the shooter experience without the semi-online conquest layer. For everyone else, the larger war turns combat rewards into territory control, public writing, and an evolving solar archive.

Key Features

  • Fast-paced 3D space shooter combat across surreal planetary domains

  • Stylized enemy roster including archons, dragons, griffons, helicopters, and stranger symbolic forms

  • Loot, leveling, ammo, power-ups, and combat-driven progression

  • Collectible cat cards that become units in a wider territorial war

  • Asynchronous online conquest across thousands of planetary grid cells

  • Every captured cell doubles as a verse slot in a living book

  • Offline Arcade Mode for players who want pure combat without the meta-layer. With adjustable difficulty.

  • A hybrid of shooter, territory control, collectible strategy, and player-written worldbuilding

4554030.name: Ace & Aro: Heart-to-Heart
4554030.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Ace & Aro Meetup! Everyone is accepted here – whether you’re a-spec yourself or just curious to learn more. Meet the members, try a cocktail (or two) and unwind with some arcade games. Let’s have a heart-to-heart!

Ace & Aro: Heart-to-Heart is a short, insightful narrative experience from the creator of One Night Stand and VIDEOVERSE. Talk freely with a-spec characters, understand their journeys and make lasting connections.

  • Get to know an eclectic cast of characters across the asexual and aromantic spectrums. Build deep connections to keep the heart-to-heart conversations going!

  • Personalise your experience with how you identify. See how your choices are reflected during your visit.

  • Explore a snazzy barcade, dance to the songs in Boogie Beat Revolution, solve digital jigsaws in Puzzle Pieces, or test your knowledge in Queer Quiz. Enjoy the games alone or with your new friends!

Ace & Aro: Heart-to-Heart  contains the following accessibility options:

  • Clear Font / High Contrast

  • Closed Captions

  • Content Warnings / Skippable Scenes

  • Keyboard, Mouse or Touch Screen Controls

  • Self-Voicing

  • Sound and Music Volumes

4554050.name: A Game About Making Numbers Go Up
4554050.about_the_game:
An endless incremental game about making numbers go up. Click, hover or idle, whatever suits your playstyle best!

Click the number. Number gives points!

Buy more numbers. More numbers give more points!

Upgrade numbers. Make numbers bigger, gain more points!
4554050.supported_languages:
English*, French*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Russian*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support
4554050.game_link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4554050/A Game About Making Numbers Go Up/

4554070.name: Overbloom
4554070.about_the_game:
❀🌺🌸Overview🌸🌺❀

Overbloom is a real-time roguelite tower defense where you cultivate powerful plant builds, discover strange items from the past, and survive against a spreading corruption looking to consume all life on the planet!

Build unique setups every run, experiment with status effects, synergies and see how far your garden can go!

🌸Mother Nature always gets the last laugh in this roguelite!🌸

❀🌺🌸Gameplay🌸🌺❀

  • Place plants on a grid-based board to defend the last sapling from waves of corrupted enemies

  • Find items that transform the battlefield, giving you an edge against enemies

  • Combine plant abilities to create powerful, emergent builds

  • Adapt your strategy as enemies evolve and grow stronger

  • Survive as long as possible in increasingly hostile runs

❀🌺🌸Key Features🌸🌺❀

  • 25 unique plants, each with distinct mechanics and abilities

  • 5 starting decks, with passive abilities to suggest a certain playstyle

  • 19 items that alter gameplay, from stat buffs to proc effects such as burning on hit

  • Procedurally evolving runs. No two runs are the same

  • Corrupted enemies that become more powerful overtime

  • Clean, readable pixel art designed for clarity and atmosphere

❀🌺🌸Accessibility🌸🌺❀

Overbloom includes features intended to make the game more accessible to everyone. These features include:

  • Colorblind palettes for aspects of the game such as health, XP, and item rarities, designed for easy differentiation for people affected by deuteranopia, protanopia, tritanopia, or achromatopsia

  • Use of dyslexic-friendly fonts to make important information easier to read

  • The game is fully playable using just a mouse

  • Distinct silhouettes for each plant, item, and enemy for clear readability

  • Settings to adjust brightness and contrast

4554080.name: Socrates Ragebait
4554080.about_the_game:
"If your job is to lock me, what are you without me?" -Socrates

They were supposed to stay in the history books, but they’ve broken through the temporal rift and they are annoying. Ancient philosophers have invaded a modern-day facility, and they won't stop asking "Why?" until your brain melts.

As the night security guard, your job is simple: Contain the thinkers. Protect your sanity.

Key Features:

  • Existential Survival: Use your security monitors to track Socrates, Plato, and Aristotle as they roam the halls looking for someone to debate.

  • Watch Out: These thinkers are crafty. They’ll use every trick in the book, hiding in vents, cutting wires, and sabotaging your gear. Just to nag you with relentless philosophical questions.

  • The "Socratic Method" Defense: Manage your limited power to blast white noise and drown out their "wisdom." Shut the doors and keep the facility locked down before they "enlighten" you to death.

4554250.name: Hellforged
4554250.about_the_game:
Hellforged is a loot-driven, extraction bullet-heaven game where you are in control of the chaos around you. Battle through hordes of bloodthirsty demons and loot epic gear with powerful modifiers and effects that offer exciting new ways to fight. Unlock new sources of power and become the master of chaos to break the Blackpyre once and for all.

Every run is a tense loot heist. Explore the map to capture locations, unlock chests, take on challenging quests, or risk capturing rifts for endgame resources. In order to secure your hard-earned gear, you have to decide if you are willing to risk it all for even greater rewards or if you would rather recover and return to fight with new equipment next time. The choice is yours!


Play as one of the legendary survivors of the shattered expedition. Choose from distinct character classes, each wielding wildly unique and devastating powers.

‎

‎

‎Take your build to the next level by spending talent points in the Eternal Tree, specializing in paths that perfectly synergize with your combat style. Push your limits to conquer hundreds of achievements that are far more than mere cosmetics, as they also unlock new abilities, relics, and powers, alongside elusive secret achievements waiting to be uncovered. Control your fate by using the Arsenal to literally build your deck before every run, handpicking exactly which upgrades and abilities will drop for you during the expedition.

‎

Every run brings back resources to help you prepare for the next expedition. Rebuild the ruins of your camp and unlock new ways to improve your character. Enhance your equipment in various ways and craft a combat style that is uniquely yours. Discover overpowered combinations through impactful synergies that dynamically shift your strategy. Set an enemy ablaze and strike them with a lightning ability to trigger massive explosions that clear the screen when combined with the correct talisman.

Channel your gathered chaos to summon devastating bosses that test the absolute limits of your arsenal, rewarding you with greatly boosted loot. Prove your supremacy to the world by climbing the online leaderboards, where you can fight for the top spot against your friends and the best players globally. Only the strongest will survive. Tread lightly, adapt quickly, and strike hard.

‎

‎
4554250.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

4554330.name: Escape from Vlogger: Runaway
4554330.about_the_game:
Escape from Vlogger: Runaway is an atmospheric and intense survival horror game with elements of adventure action, stealth, and puzzle quests. In the story, the main character sneaks into the house of a popular blogger to uncover his secrets and discover the truth behind his public image. However, it soon becomes clear that this place is a real trap. The doors slam shut, and your only goal now is to escape a house filled with dangerous secrets and the strange behavior of its owner.

You will explore dark and eerie rooms, find useful items, unlock doors, interact with mechanisms, and solve a variety of logical puzzles. Each room acts as a separate quest room where attention to detail, quick thinking, and patience are essential. Levels include hidden passages, secret stashes, traps, and intricate riddles that gradually reveal the story of the house and its owner.

4554350.name: RISING FOOL
4554350.about_the_game:
Game Overview

"Your choices will rewrite your reality."

A grueling cyber-labyrinth spanning 100 floors. Your only lifelines are the random enhancements found beyond each door and your own resource management. Conquer luck with pure strategy in this definitive roguelike experience.

To unlock the functions of the BMI-type investigative support prototype "ADA," investigator Mutsumi Rokkaku dives into the virtual world "B2." Plunging into a massive maze without equipment or pre-set abilities, Mutsumi’s journey is truly that of a "Rising Fool."

Gameplay

This title is a floor-based roguelike where your goal is to conquer 100 levels. In each floor, players must choose one of "Three Doors" to progress through combat and events.

Combat is turn-based, where you select from "Quick, Buster, and Counter" to face enemies. The affinity between these choices, your stats, and limited ST management determine the outcome. ST is consumed for everything—exploration, combat, and skill usage. Deciding when to fight and when to evade is critical. If you are defeated or your ST is depleted, it is Game Over, and you must restart from the 1st floor.

"Select Door → Combat/Event → Power-up → Next Floor" Repeat this cycle to defeat the Guardian at the 100th floor.

The game is primarily played using mouse-driven selection.

Key Systems

1. Tactical Triangle: The 3-Way Psychological Battle

Combat is built on a "Rock-Paper-Scissors" structure: Quick, Buster, and Counter.

  • Quick seals Counters.

  • Buster crushes Quicks.

  • Counter parries Busters.

  • When affinities are tied, the outcome is determined by your Breakthrough Power stat. If Breakthrough Power is also equal, fate is left to chance.

2. Extreme "ST (Stamina) Management"

Every action—Growth, Combat, and Skill Usage—requires a shared resource: ST.

  • The Cost of Combat: ST is consumed for every single action. The longer a battle drags on, the harder it becomes to continue your exploration.

  • The Weight of Gear: Powerful equipment increases your ST Cost per action. Will you choose heavy armor for a quick decimation of foes, or light gear for a war of attrition? Your build's direction determines your survival.

3. Exploration Skills: Devouring Risk

In each floor, you are presented with three doors and six growth parameters. Manipulating these with skills is the key to conquest.

  • Bipolar: Pay ST to double your gained parameters. However, failure results in a lethal "-2x" penalty.

  • Fate Transfer: Reroll the available doors and parameters to pull destiny back in your favor.

  • Gate Summons: Summon a door leading directly to the next floor. Be warned: failure may summon the "Bone Door," bringing you face-to-face with an immediate Game Over.

The 6 Growth Parameters

Vitality / Strength / Resistance / Dexterity / Agility / Luck

These stats directly influence not only the advantages in combat but also your efficiency during exploration. Specializing in the right stats is the only way to defeat the Guardian of the 100th Floor.

4554530.name: Exile Era
4554530.about_the_game:
Exile Era

About This Game

When the AI brands you as "inefficient," when a virus tears the world apart, when former kin divide into three irreconcilable factions—you, an Old Human exiled to the bottom-tier islands, must struggle to survive amid zombies, factions, and AI sweeps.

Exile Era is an open-world game blending RPG character progression, sandbox construction, and zombie survival. In this post-apocalyptic world ruled by algorithms, every choice reshapes your destiny.

Core Features

Three Worlds, One Desperate Situation

Human civilization has fractured completely:

New Humans occupy the core islands, commanding cutting-edge technology and AI privileges—they are the winners of this efficiency revolution;

Old Humans are the discarded survivors of the lower class, struggling on exile islands for a bite of food and a roof overhead—this is your origin;

Mutants are products of the X-virus, retaining sanity yet driven by instinct, existing in the gray zone between human and zombie.

There is no absolute justice, only the instinct to survive.

Define Your Own Survival

Lone Wolf Stealth: One person, one blade, hunting in the shadows, writing legends with silence and precision;

Path of the Leader: Recruit survivors, establish strongholds, and rebuild the spark of order in the apocalypse;

Nomadic Survival: Abandon fixed bases, make your vehicle your home, and seek opportunities between islands.


Every way of living has its cost; every path has its end.

Build Your Sanctuary

From concealed underground bunkers to heavily fortified fortresses, from mobile truck bases to automated industrial outposts—the physics-driven construction system gives weight to every brick and life-or-death stakes to every defensive line.

Set traps, establish power grids, stockpile supplies. When the horde arrives or raiders come knocking, your designs will be tested by blood and fire.

Human Hearts Are Harder to Read Than Zombies

NPCs remember every promise and betrayal. Help a stranger, and they may become your most loyal comrade; raid a settlement, and you gain resources—but may invite endless pursuit.

Teammates will fear, despair, and question your leadership. In resource-scarce desperation, how will you maintain team morale and trust?

The Weekly Trial of Survival

The AI never stops. Every seven days, drones sweep across the islands, marking those "without contribution, without resources, without value."

Hide, fight, or prove your worth—this is the ultimate test every Old Human in the Exile Era must face.

### Dynamic World, Chain of Fate

Weather, seasons, and random events constantly reshape the island landscape. A storm may flood your farmland or cover your infiltration of enemy camps; an airdrop draws competing factions, and your choice to intervene or observe shifts the balance of power.

No two journeys are the same. Your world is shaped by your choices.

Key Gameplay

Open World Exploration: Urban ruins, wilderness, industrial wastelands, underground facilities—each zone holds unique resources, dangers, and secrets to uncover

Deep Character Development: Four skill branches, trait system, and moral choices shape a unique survival specialist

Strategic Base Building: From site selection to defense design, from power networks to automated production, build your sanctuary in the apocalypse

Faction Political Maneuvering: Navigate between New Humans, Old Humans, and Mutants—ally, betray, or remain independent

Diverse Combat: Melee brawling, ranged sniping, trap ambushes, vehicle ramming—choose your hunting style

Procedural Event System: Random encounters, base defense, story choices ensure fresh experiences every playthrough

Are You Ready to Face Exile?

In this world torn apart by algorithms and viruses, efficiency is no longer virtue but a blade; humanity is no longer weakness but the final fortress.

Exile Era awaits every survivor who refuses to submit.

Procedurally generated world. Player-written legends.
