4555090.name: Wandsmith
4555090.about_the_game:
You spawn in with a couple of random wands, a couple of random components, and a random perk. From there you will progress through castles full of enemies that are trying to kill you. 

Enemies drop their wand on death. Pick them up, grab the components you want and move them to your current wand. Or, if the enemy's wand is better, use it as your new main one. 

At the end of each level you'll face a boss- they're bigger, stronger, and they have a staff. Good luck.

Once you defeat the boss, you get a perk and get to go to the next level. Enemies will get more health, different kinds of wands with better stats and components will spawn. 

How do wands work?

Your wand is made up of several different factors that all decide what kind of projectile you will cast.

  • Wand material: Projectile type, number of component slots, mana pool and recharge rate

  • Hilt: Status effect, colour and base projectile stats

  • Components: Modifies the projectile, including cast delay, damage, mana consumption, size, and more.

Want a rapid-fire wand for mowing down hordes? Reduce the wand's cast delay and watch the enemies get torn apart. Just make sure your wand has enough mana to handle it.

Want a powerful blast that brings bosses to their knees? Add damage and fire away. Be careful though, you might end up taking more recoil than you expected.

What kind of spells can I cast?

Currently there are four projectile types:

  • Orb (single shot, standard projectile)

  • Scattershot (many smaller orbs with a wide spread)

  • Laser (melee, attached to your wand)

  • Shield (protective barrier in front of your wand)

Three status effects:

  • Fire (damage over time)

  • Condensed Health (take more damage, and drop a health pickup on death)

  • Condensed Mana (spells cost more mana, and drop a mana pickup on death)

Components are divided into two groups:

  • Tiered modifiers (these have multiple tiers, each tier provides a better modifier bonus but also a negative effect)

  • Unique modifiers (these have a great effect and usually a really negative one too. The modifiers you want will depend on your run and your playstyle)

5 identical tiered components can be combined to get one from the next tier. This gives you an edge over the enemies in the current level.

And there are 36 different base wands, each with a different combination of projectile type, mana pool and number of component slots.

How does mana work?

The higher the amount of mana that's remaining in the wand's mana pool, the better. If you cast a wand with 50% mana left, it's going to consume slightly more mana than when it's at 100%. If you cast a wand with not enough mana remaining, your projectiles will have massively reduced stats, including size and speed. You'll need to balance your loadout effectively to make sure you have the wands needed to take on a group of enemies.

What's a staff?

Staffs are made up of multiple wands, each firing in order when you cast.

The staff has a mana pool equal to the total max mana of all equipped wands. Staffs don't regenerate mana- you'll need to find your own to refill it. It's a powerful weapon that lets you fire a wide variety of spells in quick order, including different status effects and projectile types.

4555100.name: War Room Football
4555100.about_the_game:
Take the reins of a professional football franchise and prove you can build a dynasty.

You're the General Manager. Every roster decision, every draft pick, every contract negotiation runs through you. Build your roster, hire your coaching staff, manage the salary cap, and watch your team take the field, all while an owner demands results.

DRAFT YOUR FUTURE

Scout hundreds of prospects each year through a multi-layered scouting system. Spend scouting points to reveal hidden attributes, attend the combine for measurables, conduct interviews to assess personality, and track college stats as they drop throughout the season. On draft night, field live trade offers and find your franchise cornerstone, or miss on a bust.

BUILD YOUR ROSTER

Manage a 53-man roster with a salary cap that mirrors real football economics where the cap and contracts grow. Structure contracts with signing bonuses, dead cap, and restructures. Navigate three waves of free agency. Flip players at the trade deadline. Even experiment with out-of-position conversions, slide a tight end to guard or a running back to receiver.

SCHEME MATTERS

Hire a coaching staff with real philosophical identity. Choose from 6 offensive and 6 defensive schemes that directly impact how your team plays on the field. An outside zone scheme needs athletic linemen and a back who can find cutback lanes. An air raid scheme needs four receivers who can win in space. On defense, a blitz-heavy front generates pressure but exposes the secondary. Your personnel has to match your philosophy. Your coordinators develop scheme mastery over time, but rival teams may try to poach them.

EVERY FACE TELLS A STORY

Every player on your roster has a unique procedurally generated pixel art portrait. A custom sprite system designed by an artist layers several components, including head shape, hairstyle, skin tone, eye color, facial hair, and accessories, then composites them into pixel art portraits with personality. With billions of possible combinations, you'll never see the same face twice.

WATCH IT PLAY OUT

Simulate games with a play-by-play engine calibrated against real professional football data. Watch drives unfold on a field view with live win probability chart, drive logs, and broadcast-style presentation. Every player attribute, from throw power to route running to block shedding, even a lineman's arm length or a running back's weight, feeds into outcomes on every snap.

DEVELOP YOUR PLAYERS

Players grow and decline on realistic career arcs with position-specific peak ages. Different development traits accelerate growth and training camp events create breakout moments. Watch a late-round pick blossom into an All-Pro, or a top prospect flame out.

THE LEAGUE LIVES

Follow the drama through Blitz, a social media feed where players talk trash, analysts debate your moves, and reporters break stories. Coaching carousels, contract holdouts, milestone celebrations, and playoff hype all generate dynamic storylines that make every season feel alive.

GO DEEPER

Place bets with calibrated spreads and over/unders. Track advanced stats like passer rating, yards per route run, and pressure-to-sack rate. Upgrade your scouting department, medical staff, and stadium by hitting owner goals and earning payouts. Save up steadily, or go all-in by betting your season's income on a championship underdog to cover. Chase Hall of Fame inductions across a 100-year franchise history. Satisfy your owner's goals, or get fired and start over with a new team.

KEY FEATURES

  • Real-world schedule rotation tuned to realistic difficulty curves, informed by prior season performance

  • 7-round draft with scouting reports, combine stats, player interviews, and live draft-day trades

  • Full salary cap system with contracts, restructures, dead cap, and extensions

  • 12 coaching schemes that shape how your team actually plays on the field

  • A sim engine where 20+ attributes per position, from arm strength to hand size, shape every single play

  • Multi-wave free agency with personality-driven negotiations that never feel scripted

  • Blitz social feed with thousands of dynamic storylines that follow your franchise all season

  • Calibrated betting lines with moneylines, spreads, and over/unders for every game

  • Advanced analytics dashboard with deep team and position-specific metrics

  • Hall of Fame, awards, and legacy tracking that spans your entire dynasty

  • Unlimited seasons to build something that lasts decades

4555130.name: Fireworks Designer
4555130.about_the_game:
Create stunning, realistic fireworks with ease, or enjoy creations made by other players.

  • An editor that fully simulates real-world firework structures, balancing physical realism and functionality, capable of reproducing most firework effects.

  • GPU rendering completely resolves performance issues common in fireworks games, easily rendering millions of particles while maintaining high frame rates.

  • Supports multiplayer online fireworks shows — watch displays together with friends or strangers.

  • Steam Workshop supported — share your fireworks or browse others’ creations.
4555130.supported_languages:
English*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support

4555180.name: Chyma and the Toll of Time
4555180.about_the_game:
In Chyma and the Toll of Time, you'll play as the titular Chyma, a little bell trying to unravel the story of his people to save the planet. Chyma wields the power of the Rungback, allowing him to create a copy of himself that will follow his exact movements and actions. Using this ability, solve fun puzzles to ascend the temple, uncovering secrets and learning new powerful abilities along the way!

Solve puzzles with the Rungback!

Using Chyma's special abilities, create a copy of yourself to help solve puzzles. Your copy – the Reverb – will follow your path, allowing you to be in two places at once!

Uncover the mystery of the temple!

As Chyma makes his way through the levels, he will discover special artifacts that can help him learn more about the history of the temple and the ones who lived there.

Master many mechanics!

The temple is filled with all sorts of inventions, from guards to rolling balls to dangerous lasers. Chyma will have to learn to maneuver around and manipulate these obstacles in order to continue on his quest.

Save the world!

There's a meteor swiftly approaching, and the world is without a solution. Only Chyma is courageous enough to enter the mysterious temple to save his home.

Listen to dozens of songs!

Chyma and the Toll of Time features a dynamic sound system, meaning that the music in the level will change as you interact with the environment. One song can have dozens of variations depending on what obstacles are in each level and whether or not they are activated.

Play over 30 levels!

Chyma and the Toll of Time features five unique areas, each with several levels. In total, the game has over 30 levels and a few hours of puzzle-solving fun!

4555260.name: Haiju
4555260.about_the_game:
Plot

Play as Raiju, an electric dog spirit searching for his missing brother Fuju, a Benevolent Wind Spirit whose disappearance has thrown the winds into chaos. With powerful yokai emerging in his wake, collect the 36 Heavenly Wind Bells to unlock the path forward and bring him home.

Play Your Way

Haiju is a classic collectathon at heart, with optional RPG elements for players seeking deeper narrative and worldbuilding, designed so neither system ever interrupts the flow of the other. All dialogue and NPC interaction is entirely optional, woven into the RPG layer for those who choose to engage with it. Drop in for a short session or stay for the long haul. 

The World

Haiju is rooted in traditional Japanese mythology and folklore, bringing ancient spirits, sacred landscapes, and timeless legends to life across every realm.

Boss Fights

The deeper you dig into Haiju's world, the more secrets reveal themselves. Seek out hidden boss battles that demand skills beyond the standard game, and track down the wise sages to learn the abilities needed to topple these ancient foes.

Features

  • Explore an expansive array of spirit realms, each connected to a grounded central hub world

  • Glide across vast distances to reach hidden paths and secret areas

  • Scorch yokai with Raiju's electrical shock attack

  • Channel the thunderous Taiko drum to charge through obstacles at high speeds

  • Uncover ancient lore through the spirits and villagers you meet along the way

  • Solve environmental puzzles woven into the landscape itself

  • Collect Heavenly relics to complete each realm

  • Revisit each realm to uncover new NPC interactions and tackle time challenges

Inspiration

Spyro the Dragon meets Okami, with a hint of Princess Mononoke

4555270.name: Vanisha
4555270.about_the_game:
Pilot a lone fighter through six hostile sectors, dodge storms of bullets, and punch through the Void. Vanisha is a fast, tightly-tuned arcade space shooter where every level is a short, focused combat encounter - clear the kill target, collect drops, level up and upgrade your skills, and push deeper.

Each sector escalates the fight with tougher enemies, denser bullet patterns, and a climactic boss fight. Between fights, branching star map routes lead to grid-based puzzle chambers and shop nodes.

Level up as you fight and pour points into a sprawling skill tree with hundreds of nodes. Unlock keystones to learn new abilities, each opening its own subtree of supporting upgrades that reshape how your ship fights. Stack in 90+ upgrade cards that, pilot 6 distinct ships across, and feed uranium cells into a prestige tree for more power.

Key Features

- Tight arcade combat - WASD movement, mouse-aimed fire, spacebar dash. Easy to learn with mastery-driven depth.

- 24 combat levels across 6 sectors - each with its own climactic boss fight.

- 6 boss encounters - unique patterns, multi-phase health pools.

- Massive skill tree - hundreds of nodes and build-defining keystones that open entire subtrees of supporting upgrades.

- 90+ upgrade cards - weapon mods, defensive buffs, and exotic effects.

- 6 unlockable ship types - each with a unique playstyle

- Sokoban-style puzzle chambers - optional branching nodes that reward unique cards.

4555320.name: Xili Bay in Qinzhou
4555320.about_the_game:
This casual puzzle game features beautiful graphics that make up:

A beautiful coastal area in Qinzhou, known for its serene beaches and stunning sunsets.

Game starts:

Click on 'start game', the image will be grayed out, and the colored parts will be randomly scrambled into 16 small fragments, scattered randomly on the screen

Game process:

Players click on the small image, drag it to its original position to restore it, until all the small images move to the correct position, and the game ends

End or start the next game:

All the small fragments move to the correct position, and the game ends. At this point, click "try again" to repeat the game.

4555350.name: Overtime : Paper Trail
4555350.about_the_game:
You took the night shift at a 24-hour copy shop to pay off a massive debt. You thought your biggest problem would be the loan sharks. You were wrong.

As the hours drag on, the real face of the city reveals itself. At 3 AM, nobody is printing college essays. They are printing bank blueprints. Encrypted chemical formulas. Occult mantras. Hit lists.

You aren't just a cashier anymore. You are the only person who sees the truth. The people on the other side of the glass are planning terrible things, and the only way to stop them is to build a case against them, one photocopied page at a time.

Every document that crosses your desk is a piece of a larger, terrifying puzzle. Who is the corrupt guard working for? What is the rogue chemist building? They think you are invisible. Use that. Let the loud, heavy rhythm of the shop's machines mask your actions. Whether you are quietly making an extra physical copy or secretly saving a digital file, every stolen page brings you closer to revealing the truth.

Smart criminals don't just hand you a murder weapon. They bury it. Sift through the physical batches of warm HVS paper. A target's photograph might be hidden between fake university schedules & mundane electricity bills. You have seconds to identify the real evidence, stash it in your hidden compartment & hand the dummy documents back to the psychopath waiting at the counter. Smile. Act natural. If they catch you reading, they might realize you know too much.

Survive until 6:00 AM, and you face your corkboard. Review the fragmented evidence you’ve scraped together. Connect the dots and choose who to report to the local police.
4555350.supported_languages: English, Indonesian, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish

4555360.name: Specter
4555360.about_the_game:
Trek Through a Shadowed Maze...

"Specter" is an exploration puzzle-platformer that focuses on acquiring hidden items throughout the world. Explore the maze using a single moving platform to traverse the many rooms and interact with the environment. 

Acquired Magic

Use the simple magic platform to move from room to room. It will help you reach new areas and find hidden secrets throughout the maze. 

Unique Puzzles

Each has its own unique mechanics and puzzles. Master these mechanics to find your way forward.

4555460.name: What You Didn't See
4555460.about_the_game:
After a tragic accident, you wake up in a hospital that makes no sense.
The corridors feel wrong, the rooms are empty, and something is following you.

Explore shifting places, collect notes, uncover memories, and piece together the story of what really happened. But be careful, the more you discover, the heavier the guilt becomes.

This is a psychological horror experience focused on atmosphere, exploration, and story.
Your decisions, exploration, and the information you uncover will affect the ending.

Features:
-Multiple endings
-Exploration-based storytelling
-Notes and memories that reveal the story
-Psychological horror focused on atmosphere and tension

It doesn't want to kill you.
It wants you to remember.
4555460.supported_languages:
English*, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support

4555470.name: Platformus
4555470.about_the_game:
Platformus is a pure platformer game. Game has a fast paced gameplay with 3d platformer mechanics. You will focus only run, jump and complete platforms. This game will give you thrill of the platform game.

In Platformus, you will race against your own speed across a variety of different platforms, trying to complete each level in the shortest time possible.

Unlike classic platformers, objects are interactive—you can climb them, jump over them, and move seamlessly across them. This creates a smoother and more fluid experience while running through the platforms.

An uninterrupted aesthetic marathon. As you complete each platform without stopping or getting stuck, you’ll capture beautiful moments and truly feel the speed and flow of Platformus.

Platformus is designed to make you feel both excited and at peace. While experiencing the thrill of a fast and fluid platformer, you will also enjoy the calm, green atmosphere of its world.

Climb without losing momentum. Experience the thrill of long-distance platforming. Compete on carefully designed platforms built to deliver the true excitement of the genre.

Your completion time is recorded after finishing each platform. Challenge yourself to beat your best time and improve your speed on the same level.

Fast-paced gameplay. Platformus delivers an intense and speedy platforming experience.
4555470.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain
*languages with full audio support

4555540.name: EGGCONSOLE HYDLIDE PC-8801
4555540.about_the_game:
An active role-playing game released by T&E SOFT in 1984.

Fairyland is a peaceful kingdom inhabited by fairies.

One of the gems has been stolen by a human with evil intentions, awakening the demon Varalys, who is said to be the strongest in mythological legend.

The player takes on the role of Jim, a brave young man, and his objective is to restore peace to Fairyland by searching for the lost gem and defeating the demon Varalys.

Action is the key to this game.

Players switch between attack and defense modes as they fight monsters by slamming Jim into them.

This game is a pioneer of the Japanede PC fantasy RPGs of the 1980's. It is a monster title that reigned at the top of the popularity rankings in PC game magazines for a long time, with its diverse and beautifully composed fields, including plains, castles, churches, and labyrinths.

  • The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.

  • Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

■ How to Toggle Full Screen Mode

  • Press Alt+Enter to switch between Full Screen and Window Mode.

  • In Steam Big Picture Mode, the game runs in Full Screen only.

■ Controls

This game can be played with an Xbox / PlayStation / Nintendo Switch controller, or with a PC keyboard.

For the best experience, we recommend playing with a controller.

Please note that keyboard behavior changes depending on whether a controller is connected.

[When no controller is connected (PC keyboard controls)]

  • Z / X / A / S: Xbox controller A / B / X / Y

  • Q / W: Xbox controller LB / RB

  • 1: Xbox controller LT (Speed Change)

  • Esc: Xbox controller View (Rewind)

  • Space: Xbox controller Menu (Pause Menu)

4555560.name: Outclassed
4555560.about_the_game:
Outclassed is an arcade dungeon crawler roguelike where you combine passive and active abilities of multiple different classes in order to create powerful builds that allow you to clear an expansive dungeon.

Gameplay

  • Fight through a massive dungeon by using basic attacks or class abilities

  • Level up and acquire new classes or upgrade existing classes

  • Fuse classes to unlock even more powerful abilities

  • Purchase items, which grant powerful passive effects, from chests or shops

  • Own similar classes to gain an extra unique bonus

  • Defeat enemies to rack up as much score as you can!

Content

  • 15+ weapons, each corresponding to a unique synergy that a class belongs to

  • 40+ classes, each obtained with either their passive or active effect

  • 50+ items, each with their own global passive effect

4555630.name: GLIMPO
4555630.about_the_game:
GLIMPO is an arcade roguelite shooter where you fight endless waves of enemies by building your skillset, unlocking synergies and becoming ridiculously overpowered!

Gameplay

  • Buy/sell skills from the shop to build your ideal skillset

  • Fight enemies with unique auto-attacking skills

  • Earn gold, obtain items and unlock synergies

  • Become insanely overpowered!

Features

  • Shorter runs, up to 30 levels of battle with increasing difficulty

  • 40+ skills, each with unique attacks and passives

  • 10+ classes with their own distinct synergies

  • 40+ items that can empower your build

Trailer music by CGFrog.

4555670.name: GameBuilder Puzzle Platformer
4555670.about_the_game:
GameBuilder Puzzle Platformer is a unique grid-based puzzle platformer where you don’t just solve levels — you build the path to complete them.

Each level starts as a partially completed grid filled with obstacles, coins, and a goal. Your objective is to place missing tiles in the correct positions so the character can collect every coin and safely reach the end.

Every placement matters. One smart move can solve the puzzle — one mistake can block the path.

🧩 THINK BEFORE YOU MOVE

Unlike traditional platformers, success depends on planning ahead.
Design the route first, then watch it unfold.

  • Build paths using strategic tile placement

  • Solve puzzles using logic, timing, and creativity

  • Experiment to discover the perfect solution

🔄 UNIQUE TILE MECHANICS

As the challenge grows, so does the variety of tiles you must master. Arrow tiles turn the character left or right and redirect movement. Gravity inversion tiles flip the character onto the opposite surface and change the way the level must be approached. Lever tiles unlock gates and open new paths. Disappearing platforms create temporary routes that must be used carefully. Spike tiles punish unsafe paths. Cloning tiles add a new layer of strategy by creating extra characters, forcing you to think about multiple movements at once. Teleporting tiles instantly move the character from one point to another and open up new ways to cross the level. And dimension switch tiles send the character into a parallel version of the same grid, where the layout, hazards, and opportunities can be completely different.

🌌 PARALLEL DIMENSIONS

Switch between dimensions to solve puzzles in new ways.

A path blocked in one world may open in another.
Your actions in one dimension can completely change the outcome in the next.

🚀 FEATURES

  • Grid-based puzzle gameplay with path-building strategy

  • Increasing difficulty with new mechanics

  • Collect all coins to complete each level

  • Creative mix of puzzle-solving and platforming

  • Family-friendly and logic-driven gameplay

4555720.name: 黑帆王座·Galactic Loadout
4555720.about_the_game:
Power is never given—it’s assembled.
In Black Sail Throne: Galactic Loadout, every run is a gamble of chaos and control. Piece together weapons, shields, scanners, and crew into devastating synergies that spiral out of control. Watch your fragile ship evolve into an unstoppable force as upgrades stack and builds break the limits.

No two runs feel the same. Every choice matters. Every mistake costs.
Adapt, experiment, and chase the perfect build—then push it beyond what should be possible.

The galaxy won’t wait. Neither should you.

4555740.name: BOMBERCOOK!
4555740.about_the_game:
Welcome to BOMBERCOOK!, the only restaurant where the customers are monsters and the menu is explosive!

BOMBERCOOK! is a chaotic, top-down cooking-defense hybrid that blends the frantic workflow of Overcooked with the strategic destruction of Bomberman. As the last chef in a world overrun by hungry invaders, you don't just serve meals, you blast it!.

COOK. BLAST. SURVIVE.

Running a kitchen is hard. Running a kitchen while under siege is a nightmare. To survive, you’ll need to master the art of Explosive Cuisine. Gather raw ingredients from your pantry, prep them at specialized stations, and cook them to perfection in fryers, ovens, and freezers.

A MENU OF DESTRUCTION

One size doesn't fit all when it comes to defense. Experiment with a variety of "recipes" to find the perfect counter for every enemy:

  • Blast Bomb: The standard classic for everyday defense.

  • Repair Bomb: Don’t eat it! Use it to mend your crumbling base.

  • Stun & Ice: Chill out your enemies or shock them into place.

  • Flame & Magnet: Set the battlefield ablaze or pull resources (and foes) into the path of a blast.

DEFEND YOUR BASE

Your kitchen is your fortress. Build and repair your base flags to keep the "customers (creeps)" at bay. From agile Hunters who dodge your blasts to massive Siege Units that fire from afar, you'll need to manage your workflow while manually aiming and throwing your creations to stop them blasting your base away.

SURVIVE THE KITCHEN FROM HELL

Just when you think you’ve got the rhythm down, nature strikes! Adapt to Disaster Phases that change the rules of the game:

  • Typhoons that flood the floor and make ingredients float away.

  • Earthquakes that knock items off stations and ruin your timing.

  • Blizzards that freeze your movement but speed up your cold-prep recipes.

KEY FEATURES

  • High-Stakes Multi-tasking: Balance ingredient gathering and active base defense.

  • 5 Diverse Chapters Planned: Journey from the Cooking School to the treacherous Volcano Kitchen.

  • Quality Matters: Bring in "Booster Upgrades" for massive damage bonuses and faster clears.

  • Epic Boss Fights: Face off against legendary foes like the Burnt Chef and the Disaster Master.

  • Low-Poly Aesthetic: Vibrant, stylized cartoon 3D art that keeps the chaos clear and the explosions satisfying.

Do you have what it takes to be a Master Bomber Chef? Grab your apron, light the fuse, and get cooking!

4555750.name: Karless
4555750.about_the_game:
The sky is no longer a road, and the railways are beyond repair.

After a catastrophic meteor impact shattered the continent of Aris, only the roads remain — and the vehicles that can travel upon them.

You are an engineer at the factory in "Karless", the last city capable of producing vehicles. Design and automate production lines to manufacture cars, and ship them out to reconnect the severed regions of Aris.

Mine raw resources, research new technologies, and build increasingly complex supply chains — from raw ore to steel plates, from engine modules to a fully assembled vehicle rolling off the line.

Key Features

  ∙ Multi-Tier Production Chains — Transform raw resources through three tiers of crafting: ores into intermediates, intermediates into 10 distinct vehicle modules, and modules into a complete car. Every component matters.

  ∙ Full Factory Automation — Lay conveyor belts, splitters, and storage boxes to move items between machines. Set up electric miners, material processors, and assemblers to keep your factory running without lifting a finger.

  ∙ Power Grid Management — Build power plants and choose between wind and fuel modules. Connect machines through power pole networks — no power, no production.

  ∙ Research & Upgrade System — Unlock new recipes and machines through a branching tech tree. Earn stat points to boost crafting speed, belt throughput, mining efficiency, and more.

  ∙ Campaign & Missions — Follow guided objectives that take you from your first manually mined ore to shipping a fully automated vehicle. Each milestone brings you closer to reconnecting the continent.

  ∙ World Map Progression — Ship vehicles to unlock new regions across the shattered continent of Aris. Each zone presents new challenges and resources.

  ∙ Post-Apocalyptic Narrative — Discover the story of Aris through mission briefings, journal entries from the previous engineer, and the traces left behind as you push further into the unknown.

4555760.name: Container Hunter Simulator
4555760.about_the_game:
START SMALL. RULE THE OCEAN.

Start small, push further, and unlock bigger ships. Every step brings you closer to controlling the ocean.

CONTAINERS ARE WAITING FOR YOU. RECOVER THEM NOW.

Containers are waiting for you. Dive deeper, deploy your chain, and pull them out of the ocean one by one.

CONTAINERS FULL OF SURPRISES AWAIT YOU.

Open containers and discover what’s inside. Each one holds different surprises and valuable cargo.

SELL AT AUCTION

Sell your containers at auction and watch buyers compete.

UPGRADE YOUR RADAR. SEE MORE.

With an upgraded radar, detect containers from greater distances, see their depth, and easily identify the most valuable ones.

BE PREPARED FOR DANGERS.

Sharks, explosive barrels, whirlpools, and massive waves… The ocean is filled not only with opportunities but also with danger. Stay alert, or you could lose everything.
4555760.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Bulgarian, Danish, Indonesian, Dutch, Finnish, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Polish, Hungarian, Norwegian, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Greek, Czech, Swedish

4555790.name: The Die of Flower
4555790.about_the_game:
The Die of Flower is a top-down perspective format that gradually reconstructs the entire story by using the special effects of cards. The story may have an order, but the order is not unique.

The Die of Flower sets at least one pass condition in each scene, and these conditions are written on some special cards.

The Die of Flower assists in completing levels through various actions, such as moving, talking, and handing the cards in your hand to the other party. These actions have special significance in The Die of Flower and can ensure the character's survival. if an important character dies, a failure result will occur.

Each time a special effect is used, the text on the card will be recorded on the right. The smoother the recorded text reads, the closer it is to the original meaning of the story.

4555830.name: Zodiacra
4555830.about_the_game:
Link stars together to form complete constellations.
Each puzzle invites you to observe, experiment, and find the correct connections that bring the night sky to life.
Simple to pick up, with satisfying moments of clarity as each constellation is revealed.


Reveal a growing collection of constellations inspired by zodiac signs, mythology, and creatures of legend.
Every completed puzzle unveils a new figure hidden among the stars.


Each constellation is tied to its own background, drawing from zodiac traditions, myths, and folklore.
Learn about the figures you uncover and the stories woven into the night sky.


Relax in a peaceful environment supported by soft visuals and a gentle tone.
Zodiacra is designed to be a tranquil, immersive experience you can return to anytime.

Key Features

  • Connect stars to solve satisfying constellation puzzles

  • Discover zodiac signs, mythical beings, and their stories

  • Relaxing, non-timed gameplay — play at your own pace

  • Atmospheric visuals set against a serene night sky

  • A growing collection of constellations to uncover
4555830.supported_languages:
English*, French*, Italian*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Japanese*, Korean*, Portuguese - Portugal*, Russian*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support

4555840.name: Swamp Game
4555840.about_the_game:
Swamp Game is the definitive swamp life simulation experience. Set in an alternate dimension where the swamp has claimed all, you play the part of the Swamp's newest inhabitant. Waking up with a hole in your head and nothing but the clothes on your body, do you have what it takes to get by, make a living and conquer the Swamp life?

  • Many ways to make money: Complete odd jobs and side gigs, develop your career and rise the ranks, set up active and passive businesses to keep the capital flowing.

  • Many reasons to need money: Swamp life is hard. Fulfill your needs, abuse your vices to get by and whatever you do pay your rent, swamp life gets a lot harder without a roof over your head.

  • Improve your character: Increase attirbutes like Pizzazz to better impress those you meet and perhaps climb the corporate ladder a little faster. Learn a variety of skills like fishing or electronics to provide alternate ways to get by.

  • Swampland Stock Exchange: A soil based stock market. Play it safe with bluechip options like clay. Bet your life savings day trading divested mud options. Sandy Loam, who is she?

  • Many peculiar inhabitants: The swamp is full of life both friend and foe, how will you navigate this complex landscape. Are you a lover or a fighter?

  • Own and customise property: Be it renting or buying out right (lucky you), own and customise your own property with furniture and items you've collected from your time living in the swamp.

4555850.name: Pool Glow
4555850.about_the_game:
Simple. Pure. Immersive.

Pool Glow is an immersive psychological exploration experience that transports players into a bright yet subtly unreal poolcore world—where the water reflects a still, frozen glow, and echoes drift gently through the space. Clean, luminous pools and interconnected environments form a domain that feels both tranquil and quietly comforting.

There is no combat and no defined objective—only exploration, perception, and the gradual emergence of spatial memory. Original music and ambient sound design enhance the sense of presence, drawing you deeper into the experience. If you have the patience, we invite you to follow your own pace, wander slowly through these spaces, and embrace the simplicity and calm they offer. If this atmosphere brings you even a moment of peace and clarity, then it has fulfilled its purpose.

This game is inspired by poolcore artworks shared on Instagram and X, particularly the works of artists such as Jared Pike and P. Carredo.
4555850.supported_languages:
English*, Japanese*, Simplified Chinese*, Korean*
*languages with full audio support

4555880.name: ウンコらしょ！
4555880.about_the_game:
This Game is a click-and-play idle game for children.

The operation is simple, requiring only mouse clicks.

Click on the poop character in the center of the game screen with your mouse to collect the poop.

You can use the collected poop to level up 「Katuyou」 or purchase 「Kairyou」items. This will allow you to collect poop more efficiently and in larger quantities.

If it becomes difficult to collect, press the lever button in the upper left corner of the screen to flush it down the toilet.

You will then have to start collecting poop again, but you will receive various benefits depending on the amount you have collected so far.

The amount of poop collected increases exponentially.

Challenge the limits of the units that can be increased to an astronomical number.

The text in the game is in hiragana (with some English alphabet), making it easy to understand!

4555950.name: The Office Void
4555950.about_the_game:
Welcome to the night shift, coder.

You’re just an ordinary IT guy in a small tech company. While normal people sleep or live their lives during the day, you sit in a dimly lit office, illuminated only by the glow of several monitors.

But reality quickly starts to slip away.

Because of chronic sleep deprivation and an old head injury, you begin experiencing extremely realistic hallucinations. At first, it’s just shadows in the corner of your eye. Then — strange silhouettes. And soon they start moving, whispering your name, and reaching toward you with long, thin fingers.

Your only salvation is coffee.

Every sip brings you back to reality, drives the creatures away, and gives you the strength to keep going. But the coffee is running out, the coffee machine is acting up, and time is ticking.

Gameplay:

  • Manage your alertness and caffeine levels

  • Drink coffee, brew more, and search the office for supplies

  • Complete your work tasks (fix bugs, write code, finish reports)

  • Fight hallucinations: the less coffee you have, the more aggressive and realistic the creatures become

  • Search old documents and colleagues’ chats for clues about your “head condition”

A mix of coffee simulator, psychological horror, and dark office humor.

Features:

  • Atmospheric night office with realistic physics and details

  • Black humor about IT life, bugs, and procrastination

  • Soundtrack of server humming, keyboard clacking, and uneasy silence

  • Short but extremely tense sessions (perfect for one or two nights)

Are you ready to finish this shift? Or will the creatures finally get their programmer?

4555980.name: Space Stone Smashing Simulator
4555980.about_the_game:
This is a sci-fi game where you control a drone designed for asteroid mining.


Fly through space, scan asteroids, and extract valuable resources. Manage your equipment and optimize your mining process to achieve better efficiency.


Features:

- Control a mining drone in space

- Scan asteroids to find resources

- Extract materials using different tools

- Manage cargo and equipment


The game focuses on simple mechanics and a relaxing gameplay experience.

4555990.name: 华夏立志传：战国
4555990.about_the_game:
Rites have crumbled. Seven kingdoms stand divided. Iron and fire forge an era of unmatched cruelty — and unmatched freedom.

You will choose a historical figure whose name is etched in the annals of history, and relive their entire life. Behind every name lies a destiny already written. More legendary figures will join in future updates.

You already know their stories — triumph or ruin, glory or oblivion. But this time, you stand at every crossroads of their life and make the choice yourself. Follow the path recorded in history, or forge one that never existed? Redeem a tragedy that has haunted readers for millennia, or push them into an even darker fate — the choice is yours.

Four Main Careers, Two Side Vocations, Dozens of Endings

Four main career paths, each with a complete progression system, multiple tiers of advancement, and radically different life endings:

Statesman — The court is your arena; the realm is the prize. Start as a humble retainer serving a noble lord. Rise through the ranks as a loyal minister — Senior Minister, enfeoffed lord, pillar of the state. Or harbor greater ambitions: plot a coup, seize a province, and claim the throne of the Son of Heaven to unite all under your rule. Loyal subject or ruthless usurper — the line is thinner than you think.

Traveling Scholar — Your weapon is philosophy; your battlefield is the mind. Choose from four great schools of thought — Confucianism, Daoism, Legalism, or the School of Names. Rise from disciple to the foremost master of your school. Enter the service of a kingdom and reshape its policies through ideology. Win the Grand Debate three times to become the most formidable rhetorician alive. Or spread your teachings across the realm, with disciples in every corner of the land.

Merchant — Gold and goods are your weapons to reshape the world. Travel the trade routes between kingdoms, buy low and sell high, and rise from peddler to the greatest merchant under heaven. Or become a merchant of the court, bankrolling a king's conquest of all rivals.

Swordsman — Shape the world through personal prowess. Master the fist, sword, blade, hammer, halberd, spear, bow, or crossbow. Win the Grand Tournament three times to become the undisputed champion. Achieve a hundred consecutive victories with a single weapon to claim the title of the greatest in that art. Open a martial academy and train disciples across the land. Or walk the path of the assassin — lurk in the empire's shadow and alter the fate of nations with a single strike.

Regardless of which main career you choose, you can also pursue two side vocations:

Physician — Study the ancient healing arts, gather herbs, and brew legendary medicines. Open a clinic to save lives, or use your medical skills to forge connections with the powerful and the noble. A healer's compassion is its own kind of power in a world at war.

Swordsmith — Master the art of metallurgy and forging. Seek rare ores across the land and craft the five legendary swords — Zhanlu, Chunjun, Shengxie, Yuchang, and Juque. A masterwork blade can make a swordsman invincible — or serve as a tribute to open the gates of kings.

Three Battlefields, Three Games of Strategy

Conflict in the Warring States extends far beyond the clash of armies. Three fully independent combat systems, each driven by deck-building, offer three fundamentally different forms of confrontation:

Martial Duels — Deck-building driven melee combat. Collect skill cards across eight weapon schools — fist, sword, blade, spear, halberd, hammer, bow, and crossbow. Build your combat deck, read the rhythm of offense and defense, find the opening, and strike. The core combat system for swordsmen and warriors.

Debate Battles — Deck-building driven rhetorical warfare. Collect skill cards from seven schools of thought — Confucianism, Daoism, Legalism, the School of Names, Mohism, Yin-Yang, and Historiography. Cite the classics, dismantle arguments, and break your opponent's will without drawing a weapon. The core combat system for scholars and ministers.

Grand Warfare — Large-scale military campaigns fought directly on the world map. Collect tactical cards for four troop types — cavalry, infantry, halberdiers, and archers. Deploy formations, manage supply lines, and seize cities to expand your domain. The core combat system for the statesman's path to supremacy.

The three systems are independent yet intertwined — you can defeat a political rival in a debate at court, or crush him with an army outside the city walls.

Free-form Growth with No "Optimal Build"

Five core attributes — Command, Valor, Intellect, Governance, and Charisma. Eighteen skills including Strategy, Cavalry, Hand-to-Hand, Bladework, Archery, Rhetoric, Arithmetic, Stealth, and Cunning. Hundreds of skill cards across three combat systems. Your growth path is entirely in your hands.

Push your eloquence to its peak and dominate the Grand Debate. Hone your swordsmanship to perfection and reshape nations as an assassin. Rise from merchant to the most powerful chancellor in the land. Or develop broadly — govern by day, forge swords and brew medicine by night — and carve out a life that no history book has ever recorded.

No fixed skill trees. No single optimal path. Follow whatever interests you.

A Living Warring States World

We have reconstructed the land of ancient China based on historical sources. Over 200 cities, fortresses, river crossings, and villages are seamlessly connected — from the Jixia Academy of Qi where a hundred schools of thought contend, to the iron-clad Hangu Pass of Qin; from the ritual splendor of Ying, capital of Chu, to the mournful banks of the Yi River in Yan. Cities vary in scale, and values such as population, defenses, farmland, and mines shift dynamically with war and governance.

Nearly a thousand historical figures inhabit this world, each with their own personality, preferences, and life trajectory. Some are obsessed with fine swords; some never put down their books; some live for wine; some shun all company. They are not NPCs waiting to be triggered — they have their own goals and react to shifting circumstances. Build rapport through gifts, sparring, and shared drinks. Deepen bonds through recruitment, sworn brotherhood, or marriage. Every interaction weaves a web of relationships unique to your playthrough.

Your Choices Rewrite History

This is not a story with a predetermined ending. Every decision you make genuinely changes the course of this world.

Events fall into four categories: pivotal historical events that alter the fate of nations and key figures; allusion events inspired by famous idioms and parables; character events that enrich your personal journey; and commissions picked up at taverns and inns. At every critical juncture of a historical figure's destiny, you choose — follow the path the history books recorded, redeem a tragedy that has echoed through the ages, or stride toward a future that never existed and rewrite the ending of the entire Warring States era.

The one who holds the pen — is you.

4556000.name: Tactilite
4556000.about_the_game:
From Nobody to Legend! Take control in Tactilite, a modern football manager that seamlessly blends deep tactics with motivating RPG mechanics. Start in the 3rd division with a squad of unpolished players from Swiss cities, mold them into world-class stars through grueling training, and fight your way to the top of the 1st division. Win the championship, triumph in the cup, and prove that you are the best manager in the world!

RPG Meets Football: Level Up Your Players!

Forget static attributes. Tactilite introduces a dynamic player development system driven by real match experience. Every appearance and every goal brings your boys closer to their next level-up.

  • Individual Skill Trees: Use your earned skill points to invest in three distinct paths, defining each player's specialized class (e.g., Poacher, Dribbler, or Supporter).

  • Powerful Passive Effects: Unlock game-changing perks like Iron Lungs (reduced fitness loss per match) or Miracle Healing (shorter injury durations) to perfectly optimize your squad synergies.

The Interactive Live Match System & Tactics Center

No more dry text simulations! From now on, you are right there calling the shots on the touchline:

  • Interactive Live Matches: Intervene actively during the game. Dynamically cycle through tactical mentalities to react to the scoreline while keeping a close eye on your starting XI's energy levels and cards. Goals scored through your active live interventions are permanently recorded in the players' season statistics!

  • The Assistant Manager Tactics Center: Utilize a powerful strategy hub powered by real FM-style live analysis charts. Track position-specific strength, squad age structure, and expected values (Offensive xG, Defensive Stability, Energy Consumption) in real time.

Tactical Synergies & The Bond System

Eleven great players don't automatically make a great team. Find the perfect synergies for your starting lineup!

  • Real Team Bonds: Players who spend a lot of time on the pitch together build deep chemistry (ranging from Bronze up to the legendary Red bond after 10 seasons). Strong bonds drastically increase your players' maximum form!

  • Strong Personalities: Pay attention to your boys' traits. A "Diva" will step up and shine in crucial high-stakes matches, while a "Mercenary" will turn his back on you the second his salary demands aren't met.

Transfer Market Thrills & Contract Promises

The transfer market never sleeps. Upgrade your manager skills (like Finance Guru or Poaching Expert) to outsmart the AI.

  • High-Stakes Promises: Elite players can no longer be bought with just cash. You must lure them in with concrete contract promises (Starting XI guarantees, goal bonuses, promotion, or cup victory guarantees). But beware: breaking a promise will trigger heavy financial fines from the board!

  • Dice Poker: If a rival club targets the same superstar as you, it comes down to a thrilling showdown at the negotiation table using two 8-sided dice (2d8)!

6 Unique Manager Archetypes

Every single playthrough is completely different! Unlock new manager classes through your achievements, completely turning the rules of the game upside down:

  • Standard: The classic route. No crazy bonuses, no extreme downsides.

  • The Underdog: Receives massive bonuses when facing overpowered teams. However, if you enter the match as the favorite, your players crumble under the pressure.

  • The Tycoon: Starts with an absurd €50 million budget, but every player and agent will demand astronomical fantasy prices from you.

  • Youth Visionary: Your academy talents develop and level up twice as fast.

  • The Taskmaster: Your players gain infinite stamina but face a constant, elevated risk of injury.

  • Hardcore: Reserved exclusively for true management legends.

The Ascension Mode (The Ultimate Endgame)

Dominated the top league and lifted the cup? Congratulations. But don't get too comfortable, because now the real game begins. If the 1st division has become too easy for you, unlock four brand-new parameters in our modular difficulty system and crank up the challenge exactly as high as you can handle:

  • 💰 Financial Difficulty (Lvl 1–5): Tighten your belt. Struggle against dropping match income, exploding transfer fees, and astronomical player salary demands.

  • 🧠 XP Reduction (Lvl 1–5): Progress becomes a premium luxury. Your players learn significantly slower, losing up to -25% XP at Level 5.

  • 🚑 Injury Risk (Lvl 1–5): Real leg-breakers on the pitch! The injury risk increases exponentially (2Level) — at Level 5, you face a 32% higher probability of player absences.

  • ⚔️ Kick-Out Challenge: Zero room for error. Fulfill the ruthless, dynamic seasonal demands of the board, or get instantly fired. Game Over!

Can you survive these merciless conditions and solidify your status as the ultimate lower-league legend?

A Game for Real Managers: Tactilite is a pure single-player experience. No in-app purchases, no microtransactions, no always-online requirement. Just you, your tactical wit, and the long, glorious road to the trophy!

4556020.name: Treasure Clicker
4556020.about_the_game:
Tap the chest, buy upgrades, and grow a hoard that spirals into absurd numbers. Treasure Clicker is a cozy vault fantasy with a sharp incremental spine: every purchase pushes tap damage, passive gold, or the next big unlock.

HEROES & CLASSES
Hire heroes across classic roles. Each class feeds your passive treasure flow so the run keeps moving even when you’re planning the next splurge.

GUILDS & ALCHEMY
Fund guild research to amplify your classes, then pour Essence into alchemy when you’re ready to bend the curve with elixirs.

PRESTIGE & THE SKILL TREE
When the run feels solved, prestige trades progress for Essence and permanent power on a skill tree with real prerequisites and variety.

SPEED CHALLENGES
Step into timed side runs on a fresh temporary hoard. First clears grant lasting bonuses: replays are there when you want to chase a better time.

THE ABYSS
Descend into a boss gauntlet with relics and tap-driven combat that ties back to the crit and build choices you’ve invested in on the surface.

Early Access: Expect balance passes, UI polish, and new content as updates ship. We’ll flag anything that could affect saves in patch notes.
4556020.supported_languages: English, French, Spanish - Spain, Dutch, Polish, Simplified Chinese

4556050.name: Tzelem
4556050.about_the_game:
What Tzelem Is

  • A procedurally-generated dungeon crawler.

  • A game with no permanent upgrades. Your success will be determined by skill, knowledge, and a little bit of luck.

  • A game where you learn by trying things out.

  • A short game, you might be able to finish it in one sitting.

The Weapon

You get three orbs, and you will never have more than three. Use them wisely.

Enemies Might Drop Cards On Death

Different enemies drop different cards, study them as you go.

Cards Can Have More Than One Use

Most cards can have more than one use. Learn what they do so you may use them to your advantage when needed.

4556080.name: The Clock the Queen and the Door on the Beach
4556080.about_the_game:
UNCOVER THE CLUES

Some of the first words you hear from the Inventor:

"I took almost everything with me when I left, but enough remains to let you know, what you need to know..."

Decode the signs left behind for you, hidden in plain sight.

LET THEM GUIDE YOU

"I know you can do it. I have faith in you..."

Unlock the strange machines you find, using your newfound knowledge.

DISCOVER THE REAL REASON FOR YOUR VISIT

"That distant place, a faraway realm, the inhabitants are suffering greatly..."

Embrace your destiny, and help the Inventor avert a disaster.

NOTES for the sake of clarity

The Inventor has left prerecorded messages on intercoms at various points around the island. These will help you understand why things are the way they are, give you background information, guidance, and encouragement.

There is no 'lore', no books or journals to read.
4556080.game_link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4556080/The Clock the Queen and the Door on the Beach/

4556090.name: Zoo Party
4556090.about_the_game:
Dive into the ultimate animal‑brawler party experience, where 2 to 16 players battle through a chaotic mix of fast, funny, and unpredictable minigames. Every match is a tournament of wild challenges and hilarious moments as your chosen animal fights for glory. Whether you’re a strategic fox, a clumsy hippo, or a hyperactive chicken, every character brings personality to the madness.

Play however you want: grab a controller, share one with a friend, or join instantly using your phone. The game adapts to any group size and setup, making it perfect for parties, game nights, and spontaneous chaos. Each round throws you into a new minigame — from frantic dodging to precision challenges to all‑out brawls — keeping the action fresh and unpredictable.

With simple controls, fast rounds, and endless variety, this is a party game built for laughter, rivalry, and unforgettable moments. Outsmart your opponents, survive the madness, and climb the tournament ladder to become the ultimate champion of the animal arena.

4556110.name: Kinetype
4556110.about_the_game:
KINETYPE is a minimalist ASCII roguelite where your keyboard is the interface for survival. Forget the mouse and the controller. To navigate the procedurally generated terminal, you type your commands and hit enter.

Your objective is simple: enter the run, collect what you can, and reach the extraction point. Success earns you Bytes, a currency used for permanent player upgrades and items in the shop. If you fail, your current inventory and win streak are wiped, but your permanent progression remains for the next run.

THE TERMINAL ABILITIES

Survival depends on scavenged code fragments. To claim an ability, move over it and type its name to execute the command:

  • ZAP: Deletes the closest enemy instantly.

  • BOMB: Sets an explosive with a short fuse.

  • MINE: Deploys a proximity trap for trailing enemies.

  • SILENCE: Pauses all enemy movement for 20 steps.

  • PING: Visualizes a direct path to the exit.

  • DASH: Teleports the player by pressing the TAB key.

  • AND MORE: Discover a wide range of additional commands as you dive deeper into the sectors.

TERMINAL THREATS

The grid is populated by hostile entities designed to terminate your session. Every enemy reacts to your movements, creating a tactical, turn-based puzzle:

  • CHASER: A persistent hunter that tracks your coordinates across the grid.

  • VIRUS: Infects your trail of characters, draining the Bytes you’ve collected for extraction.

  • BLINDER: Corrupts your visual feed, forcing you to type and execute commands by feel for a temporary duration.

  • FUSE: Similar to a Chaser, but triggers a catastrophic explosion when it nears your trail.

COMMAND AND CONTROL

By default, Kinetype is a strategic experience where the world only moves when you type. This allows you to plan your route and manage your abilities carefully. For those who want to test their typing speed, Hardcore Mode removes the safety net, forcing enemies to move on a timer if you aren't fast enough with your keystrokes.

CUSTOMIZE THE GRID

Kinetype is built to be flexible. You can play with a clean monochrome look, a classic green "Matrix" terminal, or mod in your own custom colour themes.

Whether you are aiming for a record-breaking win streak or just grinding Bytes for your next upgrade, the terminal is yours to command.

4556150.name: BERSERK TANK
4556150.about_the_game:
This is a single-player tank shooter.

Across open plains and ruined wastelands, you can operate a tank to hunt down every enemy vehicle, or join forces with allies to hold the line. You can even step up as a commander to direct friendly troops and wipe out the opposition.

With multiple meticulously designed scenarios, you'll truly feel the intense atmosphere of the battlefield.

There is no complex backstory—jump right in and start fighting. It's quick, accessible, and all about the thrill of combat.

The game features a variety of famous WWII tanks, each offering a unique driving and combat experience.

4556180.name: RuneKeeper
4556180.about_the_game:
Before the first sunrise, five gods walked the void hand in hand.

They were siblings born from the same thought:

Alaz the Smith, Skadi the Endurer, Litavis the Grower, Shezmu the Dreamer, and Prometheus the Beating Heart.

Together they forged the world's mountains hammered on Alaz’s anvil, seas frozen by Skadi’s sigh, forests sung from Litavis's seed, deserts spun from Shezmu's laughter, and every living pulse tied to Prometheus's drum.

Then came the betrayal...

RuneKeeper is an open-world monster taming RPG,   heavily inspired by old-school Western RPGs in order to bring an experience unique to Japanese games:

FREEDOM!

You will be able to interact and move almost everything in the world whether good or bad, but be warned, your actions will have consequences.

Features

  • Highly interactive world

  • Player Freedom

  • Monster Taming

  • Classless talent system

  • Deep Character Customization

  • Single or Multiplayer

4556210.name: Castle Wars: Legacy
4556210.about_the_game:
Every card can win or lose the game.

Castle Wars: Legacy is a competitive card strategy game where you build, defend, and destroy in tactical battles inspired by a true classic. Based on Ants by Miroslav Němeček and later popularized as Castle Wars by m0rkeulv, Legacy brings the timeless formula into a modern competitive experience by Proclive.

Face off against AI or real players in fast-paced matches (3–5 minutes) where every decision matters. Balance offense, defense, and resource generation as you outplay your opponent and bring their castle down.

Strategic Card Battles

Play resource, attack, defense, and magic cards to control the flow of battle.
Manage Bricks, Weapons, and Crystals, generated each turn by your Builders, Soldiers, and Mages, and use them wisely to execute your strategy.

Build, Defend, Destroy

Your Wall absorbs damage, but once it falls, your Castle is exposed.
Win by destroying your opponent’s castle or by reaching maximum strength before they do.

Build Your Deck

Earn coins through victories, tournaments, campaigns, and achievements. Use them to unlock new cards and create powerful custom decks.

  • Build decks with 75 to 200 cards

  • Create multiple decks for different strategies

  • Adapt your deck before each match to counter opponents or challenges

Multiple Ways to Play

  • Story Campaign – Battle through 6 AI levels and earn up to 3 stars per stage

  • PvP Multiplayer – Compete against real players and climb the ELO leaderboard

  • Daily Tournaments – Enter rotating arenas and compete for coin rewards

Deep Yet Accessible

  • Easy to learn, hard to master

  • Endless strategic combinations

  • Every match plays differently

4556220.name: SANDSTRIKE
4556220.about_the_game:
SANDSTRIKE is a top-down multiplayer shooter set in a post-human future where AI combat robots wage war across scorched desert wastelands. Play solo with AI teammates, team up with friends, or go all-out in free-for-all chaos.

GAME MODES

• Free-For-All — Up to 8 players. No allies. No mercy. Outsmart, outgun, outlast.

• Team Fight — 2v2 Duo or 4v4 Team. Play with friends or fill empty slots with AI bots that coordinate, flank, and fight like real squadmates.

• Zombie Horde (Co-op) — Escort an armored convoy through hostile territory while the AI Director unleashes waves of undead machines, cyborg zombies, and boss mechs. Survive together or fall apart.

All modes support solo play with AI teammates — no waiting for players required.

MULTIPLAYER & SOCIAL

• Steam P2P — No dedicated servers needed. Host or join instantly via Steam Relay.

• Party System — Create a party, invite Steam friends, ready up, and launch together.

• Quick Match — Instant matchmaking across regions. Join or create a lobby in seconds.

• Lobby Control — Set mode, team size, enable/disable bots, kick players.

• Ranked Leagues — Climb 8 tiers from Scrap Heap to God-Mode Protocol based on your combat rating.

• In-Game Chat — Text chat with speech bubbles over your robot's head.

• Emotes — Dance, breakdance, or laugh on the battlefield.

COMBAT

• 25 Weapons — Pistols, rifles, shotguns, heavy weapons, beam lasers, and experimental tech. Pick a Primary and Secondary before each match.

• Weapon Proficiency — Every weapon gains XP with use. Higher level = tighter accuracy across all matches.

• Action Points — Shooting and reloading cost AP. Manage your energy or run dry mid-firefight.

• Grenades — Cook and throw with a blast radius preview. Bounce them off walls or rain them from rooftops.

• Body Part System — 8 targetable zones: Head, Eyes, Torso, Arms, Legs, Groin. Destroy eyes to cut vision range. Break legs to cripple movement. Each part has independent HP.

• Dismemberment — Blow off limbs, watch oil leak, see bones collapse. Persistent damage stays visible on corpses.

• Status Effects — Burning, stun, contusion, system malfunction, oil leak, overheating. Stack them for devastating combos.

LOADOUT & PROGRESSION

• Gear System — Equip headgear, body armor, arm guards, leg plates, and groin protection. Each piece absorbs damage and adds bonus HP for its body zone.

• Implant System — Equip up to 6 passive implants: boost accuracy, fire rate, HP regen, AP capacity, movement speed, sandstorm resistance, and more. Over 30 unique implants across Combat, Defense, Mobility, Energy, Sensors, and Survival categories.

• Drone Shop — Call in a supply drone mid-match. Buy ammo, repair kits, grenades, AP recharge, or full body part reconstruction with Salvage earned in combat.

• Cosmetics — Customize headgear, armor sets, nickname colors, and card effects.

SMART AI

• Bot Personalities — Aggressive (close-range rushers), Cautious (mid-range tacticians), Sniper (long-range precision).

• Tactical Behavior — Bots use wall cover, flank from sides, climb buildings to reach rooftops, coordinate focus fire, throw grenades at groups, and dodge incoming fire.

• Floor Awareness — Bots understand multi-level buildings. They shoot from rooftops, take stairs when wounded, or jump off ledges to chase kills.

• AI Director (Zombie Mode) — Dynamically adjusts zombie spawn intensity through four tension phases: Lull, Build-Up, Peak, and Recovery. No two runs feel the same.

ENVIRONMENT

• Fog of War — Real-time cone-based visibility. Enemies vanish outside your sight arc. Use buildings, walls, and elevation for tactical advantage.

• Sandstorms — Reduce visibility to near-zero. Close the distance or hide — your choice.

• Multi-Level Buildings — Enter buildings, climb stairs to rooftops, fight across floors. Roofs provide height advantage for sniping.

SETTINGS & CUSTOMIZATION

• Graphics — Resolution, fullscreen modes, quality presets (Low to Ultra), anti-aliasing, texture quality, shadow quality and cascades, render scale, FSR upscaling, soft shadows, bloom, vignette, motion blur, SSAO, film grain, chromatic aberration, brightness/saturation/contrast controls, FPS target, VSync.

• Audio — Master, SFX, music, ambient volume sliders. Mute when unfocused.

• Gameplay — Camera lead, smoothing, crosshair color and size, auto-reload.

• Controls — Full keybind reference display.

EARLY ACCESS

SANDSTRIKE is in active development. Planned features:

• Operations Mode — 3-5 chained missions with persistent body damage between stages

• PvPvE — Competing squads with shared AI enemies

• Steam Workshop — Community maps and mods

• More weapons, implants, and enemy types

4556270.name: Kindawn: The Parish Remembers
4556270.about_the_game:
What is Kindawn?

A first-person atmospheric horror exploration game. You play as an adult returning to the Siberian town where you grew up as an orphan. As you piece together fractured memories and uncover what happened in your absence, the line between folklore and nightmare begins to dissolve. The game is designed for a single playthrough of approximately 3-5 hours. There is no combat.

Exploration

Move freely through interconnected locations spanning farmsteads, abandoned Soviet-era buildings, and dense boreal wilderness. Every object and space holds environmental storytelling. Hidden details are never required - but always rewarded.

Environmental puzzles

Progress is gated by logic puzzles embedded in the world - combination locks, hidden mechanisms, and context clues drawn from documents and objects you find. Every solution exists in the environment. There is no abstract inventory manipulation.

Narrative investigation

Collect notes, photographs, cassette tapes, and personal items left behind by the people who once lived here. Your character's backstory is a buried secret, an unresolved loss - unfolds entirely through what you find. No hand-holding.

Tension and threat

Kindawn does not rely on jump scares. Tension builds through audio design, environmental changes, and the slow realization that something is wrong. Certain encounters require stealth and avoidance.

Setting

The aesthetic of "depressive Far North Siberia" is rendered in full detail: VHS players and cheap knock-off tracksuits beside shamanic talismans and mysteries older than civilization. The game draws directly from Yakut folklore and documented paranormal stories. This is not a collection of creepypastas - it is reinterpretation through a personal story of guilt, memory, and return.

Key features

  • First-person atmospheric survival horror

  • 3-4 hour singleplayer experience

  • Post-Soviet Siberian setting rooted in real Yakut folklore

  • Environmental storytelling through objects, notes, and audio recordings

  • Logic-based world puzzles with no arbitrary solutions

  • Original atmospheric soundtrack

  • Slowburn pacing - tension that builds like a Yakutian frost

4556280.name: Decks & Dashes
4556280.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Arena of Elements!

Decks & Dashes is a fast-paced action-deckbuilder where strategic spellcasting meets lightning-fast reflexes. Step into the grand arena as an ambitious mage and battle your way to the top by drafting powerful elemental cards and outmaneuvering your opponents.

In this high-stakes tournament, your deck is your weapon. Will you rely on the explosive power of fire, the freezing control of ice, chaotic wind storms, or the dark arts of necromancy?

But a perfect deck isn't enough—you'll need to stay on your toes. "Decks" handle the strategy, but "Dashes" handle your survival. Dodge enemy spells, weave through dangerous area-of-effect attacks, and position yourself for the perfect devastating counter-strike.

Key Features:

  • Build Your Ultimate Spellbook: Draft and collect dozens of unique magical cards. Mix and match elements to discover broken synergies and craft a deck that fits your playstyle.

  • Action-Packed Arena Combat: Combat happens in real-time. You must constantly move, dash, and reposition yourself to avoid incoming damage while slinging your spells.

  • Master the Elements: Unleash blazing fireballs, summon freezing blizzards, conjure tornados, or raise the dead. Every element has its own unique status effects and mechanics.

  • Face Fearsome Challengers: Go head-to-head against a roster of increasingly difficult magical combatants and massive bosses, each with their own unique attack patterns to learn and overcome.

  • Endless Replayability: With randomized card rewards and diverse enemy encounters, no two runs through the arena are ever the same. Adapt your strategy on the fly to claim victory!

4556450.name: Stamped : Visa Officer
4556450.about_the_game:
Once, the world was stable and at peace. But as water resources began to run dry, nations fell into crisis. Borders tightened, trust disappeared, and strict visa regulations were introduced to control the movement of people.

You are a visa officer assigned to the front line of this system.

Every day, desperate applicants stand before you each with their own story. Your task is to inspect documents, verify identities, and decide who is allowed to enter. A single mistake could have serious consequences.

As pressure rises, so do the stakes. Some will try to deceive you. Some will offer bribes. Others will beg for help. You must choose between following the rules or bending them to survive.

Outside the office, your personal life continues. You must provide for your family, manage your expenses, and live with the consequences of your decisions.

With each passing day, new challenges emerge, and the line between right and wrong begins to fade.

4556470.name: Distance Travellers
4556470.about_the_game:
Loot, Fight and Mine

In Distance Travellers you're missioned with the task of flying your very own ship provided to you by Argon Space Co, your ship is all you need in the barron waste of future spaceflight.

Survival depends on every pilots skill in ruling the galaxy for their own gain, every pilot for themselves.

Mine your way to a peaceful life

You have the option of the route you want to take in this life, if you choose to mine to make your millions then so be it, try to be a shifty miner, warp in, mine and warp out asap without being seen by anyone, upgrade your cargo hold to store more while having the best radar to detect ships sooner.

Jump in Jump out!

Pick where you jump to wisely, jump into the wrong system or area and you could be risking losing all the equipment you've been working so hard on building up.

Once you jump to a system remember that fuel is your limiting resource, fuel is finite so make sure you leave before you loose your ability to fly home.

Battle against traps and AI ships

Find yourself being chased by missiles from around the corner of an asteroid because you got close to an old mine unit, or a patrolling ship trying to keep you out of their mineral area.

Crafting upgrades

Mine or loot resources to unlock better equipment to craft.

Much much more coming....

All footage is Pre-Alpha and is subject to change.

Features

  • Explore procedural generated environments each jump

  • Jump to nearby systems to extract as much loot as possible extraction shooter style

  • Upgrade your ship

  • Gather and craft better equipment

  • Upgrade your ships systems, weapons and equipment

  • Combat enemy ships trying to destroy you

  • Mine asteroids for minerals to upgrade with

  • Complete quests to earn XP to level up your pilot

  • Unlock new ships

  • Unlock new maps and secrets

  • Explore random world events

    much more to come...

4556520.name: Game of Runs
4556520.about_the_game:
🏀 A GAME OF RUNS

Basketball is a game of momentum.

In Game of Runs, you’re the coach in a roguelike deckbuilder where every possession matters. Build your playbook, make clutch decisions, and swing the game in your favor.

🧠 OUTCOACH YOUR OPPONENT

  • Play cards to control each possession

  • Use timeouts and tactics at the perfect moment

  • Adapt to shifting momentum

One mistake can cost you the game.

🔥 CONTROL THE MOMENTUM

  • Go on scoring runs

  • Break your opponent’s rhythm

  • Survive high-pressure moments

A single run can decide everything.

🃏 BUILD YOUR PLAYBOOK

  • 100+ cards

  • Powerful upgrades and synergies

  • Different opponents every run

🔁 PLAY. ADAPT. WIN.

Lose, improve, and come back stronger in a new season.

4556580.name: The Brewline - Prologue
4556580.about_the_game:
Volstead City is rotten and dangerous. Your brother—once the top bootlegger in town—was arrested in a police raid. Now it’s your turn to take over. As Potbellied Racoon and his men try to seize control of the city, you’ll need to dodge both the cops and the criminals while uncovering the truth behind your brother’s arrest.

Create your brand, grow your crops, craft your booze, and meet eccentric customers across the city. Complete their quirky missions, build relationships, and grow your underground empire.

From beer to hard liquors — grow your ingredients and master the machines to craft a wide variety of drinks. Ferment, distill, barrel-age, and infuse flavors to create truly unique bottles then automate it all for maximum profit.

Design your own label, slap it on the bottle, and let the streets of Volstead know your name.

Explore three seasonal regions, drive unique vehicles, uncover neighborhoods, and meet a cast of colorful NPCs.

Each region has its own unique demands and preferences.

Deliver the right drinks to the right neighborhoods, strengthen your contacts, and expand your network.

Move through the districts, grow your influence, and become the one who runs the entire town.

Volstead’s streets are more than just business. Gangs make their own rules, and mistakes are never forgiven. Stay sharp, know who you’re dealing with, and stay alert if you want to survive.
