4556620.name: Somnara
4556620.about_the_game:
Somnara is a dream-driven exploration experience.

You move through a sequence of surreal environments, each shaped by a different feeling. Fear, calm, nostalgia, or something harder to define.

There are no monsters or jumpscares
Instead, the world itself shifts in subtle and unexpected ways.

From dark, enclosed spaces to bright, almost peaceful environments, each level contrasts the one before it, creating a constantly evolving experience.

Features

  • Immersive, atmosphere-focused exploration.

  • No combat, no enemies, no jumpscares.

  • Multiple distinct environments with unique moods.

  • Subtle environmental changes and sound-based tension.

  • Linear progression through interconnected dream-like spaces.

4556670.name: Centre 18
4556670.about_the_game:
Centre 18 is a management, simulation, and emergency coordination game that puts you in command of a real fire and rescue service. Build your stations, organize your teams, expand your fleet of emergency vehicles, and manage real-time missions in an environment inspired by actual emergency operations centers.

Designed for fans of strategy games, management simulators, and professional emergency simulations, Centre 18 delivers a complete experience focused on decision-making, operational efficiency, and resource management.

A complete emergency management and simulation experience

In Centre 18, every decision matters. You will:

• receive and assess emergency calls,

• dispatch the appropriate units,

• monitor mission phases in real time,

• manage reinforcements,

• ensure the safety of your teams,

• optimize your organization to improve overall performance.

The intervention system is built on realistic logic: mission phases, radio transmissions, unit arrivals, tactical progression, and return to normal.

Build, develop, command

The game is structured around several interconnected internal modules:

• Map: positioning, operational coverage, and field monitoring

• Call Center: situation analysis and resource dispatch

• Personnel: recruitment, training, skills, and assignments

• Vehicles: crew management, availability, and specialties

• Stations: construction, upgrades, and strategic organization

• Shop: fleet development and vehicle acquisition

• History: operation analysis and financial tracking

Each module contributes to the growth and efficiency of your emergency service.

Three game modes for every playstyle

• Career: long-term progression, budget constraints, strategic development

• Scenarios: scripted missions with clear objectives and operational pressure

• Sandbox: total freedom with no financial limits

A constantly evolving project

Version 0.1 lays the foundation of the game: core intervention system, full management loop, first scenarios, immersive interface, and multilingual localization.

Many updates will expand Centre 18 with new vehicles, scenarios, gameplay mechanics, visual improvements, and advanced features.

Join Centre 18 now, follow its development, and take command of a modern, strategic, and fully customizable emergency service.

4556700.name: Everis : Tales of Players
4556700.about_the_game:
Everis is a multiplayer procedural sandbox game where players build a single shared world

Explore an infinite procedural world, go on adventures, meet other players, complete quests, and travel across landscapes created by the community.

But Everis is more than a world to explore : it’s a world to build.

Players can switch to creative mode, design structures, landscapes, dungeons, or entire cities, and submit their creations to the community. Through a voting system, the most loved creations are integrated into the shared world for everyone.

One world built by players.

Explore a world shaped by players

Everis is first and foremost a world to explore.

Travel across vast procedural landscapes, discover places created by the community, and embark on adventures alone or with friends. Along the way, you may encounter hidden locations, player-designed dungeons, quests, or entire cities built by other explorers.

Meet other players, form groups, and set out on journeys together. Customize your character, improve your abilities, fight enemies, collect resources, loot equipment, and trade with other players. Through exploration, combat, and discovery, players gradually grow stronger while carving their own path through a rich and ever-changing world.

Every horizon in Everis has a story behind it, because someone in the community imagined it.

The Alternate World

Beyond the shared world shaped by players lies something darker. For every landscape created in Everis, there exists a mirrored version, an alternate world consumed by shadows.

This is not a different map, but a distorted reflection of the same world. Familiar places become hostile. In this dark version, powerful enemies roam freely, far more dangerous than anything found in the main world.

Players will need courage, skill, and strong teamwork to venture into this extreme PvE experience. Every decision matters. Every encounter is a risk.

But with greater danger comes greater reward. This alternate world follows an extraction-based gameplay loop: players enter, explore, gather valuable loot… and must find a way to escape with it.

Build the world together

At any time, players can switch to creative mode and start shaping the world themselves.

Build a small cabin deep in the forest. Design a dungeon. Create a city. Sculpt mountains, valleys, or entirely new landscapes. Work alone, or collaborate with friends to bring larger ideas to life.

Once finished, your creation can be submitted to the community hub, where players discover new proposals, vote for their favorites, and share their own ideas.

At the end of each voting phase, the most appreciated creations are integrated into the shared world, allowing the universe of Everis to evolve organically through the imagination of its players.

Over time, the world grows. Not shaped by developers, but by the community itself.

How does it work?

The creative system allows players to modify a defined area of blocks, ranging from very small creations to much larger zones.

Small creations, such as a hidden object, a small structure, or a decorative element, usually have little impact on the surrounding world and may require fewer votes to be accepted. Larger creations, however, can influence a wider part of the world and potentially overlap with other proposals. Because of this, they require stronger community support to be approved and integrated.

After the Alpha phase, additional tools will expand these possibilities even further, allowing players to place items, NPCs, and logic-based elements such as doors and interactions. (See the Roadmap section for more details)

When players enter creative mode, they temporarily move into a separate instance of the area they are working on. This means they are no longer interacting with the live MMO world while building, allowing them to create freely and experiment in complete peace.

Once the creation is complete, it can be submitted to the community hub and voted on for integration into the shared world.

Everis is an ambitious project, and development will progress through several clear stages. Each phase focuses on validating core systems, expanding gameplay, and gradually opening the world to more players.

Phase 1 development has already begun, and core technical systems are currently being implemented.

Phase 1 - Alpha: Proving the Core Concept

The first milestone is the development of a playable Alpha version designed to prove that Everis works as intended.
This phase focuses on validating the core technical and gameplay foundations of the project.

During the Alpha, players will be able to:
• Explore the procedural voxel world in multiplayer
• Interact with other players through proximity voice and text chat
• Modify the world by placing and removing blocks (switching to creative mode)
• Create and submit constructions to the community hub
• Vote on community creations
• See the most voted creations integrated into the shared world

At this stage, Everis will focus on exploration and collaborative building. MMO-style features such as NPCs, quests, and advanced gameplay systems will not yet be included.

The Alpha will feature one biome (the one shown in the screenshots) and is mainly intended to validate the technical systems that make Everis possible.

Access to the Alpha will be limited. Selected players will be invited to participate in testing, for free.

Phase 2 - Beta: Expanding the World

Once the core systems are validated, Everis will move into Beta development.

During this stage, the game will evolve through regular updates. Each new version will focus on improving stability, fixing issues discovered during testing, and introducing new gameplay systems.

New biomes will progressively be added, encouraging players to explore further and generate new regions of the world.

Major gameplay systems will gradually be introduced during this phase, including:
• Character customization
• Level progression
• NPCs
• Quests
• Logic-based elements (doors, interactions, etc.)
• In-game currency
• Trading and player economy
• ...

The Beta phase will be available to the public as Early Access on Steam, allowing the community to actively participate in shaping the game as it grows.

Phase 3 - Version 1.0 Release

The final goal is the full release of Everis (Version 1.0).

This version will include the complete feature set presented in this Kickstarter campaign, bringing together exploration, player-driven world building, community integration systems, and the full MMO-inspired gameplay experience.

By this stage, Everis will have grown into a living world shaped by its players.

4556710.name: Digital Footprint: Cyber Investigation
4556710.about_the_game:
Uncover the Truth Hidden Inside Data

Step into the role of a digital investigator in a world where crimes leave no fingerprints — only data trails.

In this immersive investigation simulation, you analyze personal devices, reconstruct timelines, and connect fragmented clues to uncover what really happened. Every message, transaction, and location ping could be the key to solving the case… or misleading you entirely.

🧠 Think Like a Detective

You are not given answers — only information.

  • Digital Traces: Browse through messages, call logs, browser history, and GPS records.

  • Evidence Management: Extract evidence and build your own freeform case board.

  • Logic & Reasoning: Connect clues, detect contradictions, and form your own conclusions.

  • Player Choice: Decide what is relevant. There is no hand-holding; only your logic.

🖥️ A Living Digital Interface

Navigate and master a fully interactive, OS-style interface:

  • Multi-tasking: Open and manage multiple apps just like a real device.

  • Deep Inspection: Switch between windows, inspect data, and cross-reference information.

  • Forensic Tools: Use tools like the Keyword Scanner and Pattern Analyzer to accelerate your investigation.

  • Flexible Organization: Organize your findings in a dynamic evidence board system.

🧩 Build Your Case

The truth doesn’t appear — you construct it.

  • Drag, position, and link clues freely on your board.

  • Visualize temporal and logical connections between events.

  • Spot hidden relationships between seemingly unrelated data.

  • Use analytical tools to reveal patterns you might have missed.

⚖️ Make the Final Decision

At the end of each case, the system won’t tell you the answer. Was the suspect telling the truth? Was the crime staged? Who is responsible? Your conclusions shape the outcome.

🎯 Key Features

  • 🖥️ OS-style interactive investigation interface

  • 📂 Multiple data sources: messages, GPS, bank, browser, gallery, and more

  • 🧩 Evidence board with freeform organization

  • ⚖️ Player-driven conclusions and outcomes

  • 🧠 Logic-focused gameplay — no hand-holding

4556720.name: Team Flashy Virus
4556720.about_the_game:
Team Flashy Virus is a side scroller, bullet hell style game. Destroy errors (aka. enemies) and the ultimate virus (aka. The Boss) with your flashy cannon and hand gun, while dodging attacks and staying mobile by slowing down time and bouncing off projectiles. 

You are the anti-virus:

Hak, a genius programmer and hacker, makes a anti-virus, called Mini Hak, to fight a virus that has invaded his computer. It must battle through his computer, from the code base and Hak’s half finished video game, to even his phone!

Slow down time:

Mini Hak can slow down time at any time (no pun intended) to find a path and weave through the swarm of bullets and enemies. However, he must be very careful, because he has no protection and a single hit will send him back to his last save point. Luckily, Hak equipped his anti-virus with some weapons.

4556750.name: Slots & Sword & Magic
4556750.about_the_game:
Slots & Sword & Magic is a turn-based roguelike where a slot machine controls your actions, but your builds can break the game.

Spin. Combine. Break everything.

Every turn, you spin the reels and get actions: attacks, defense, healing, gold, magic, and strange effects.

Your hero instantly performs everything you roll, and then the enemy takes its turn.

But the real power lies in combinations.

Core Gamepay Loop

  • Spin the slots

  • Gain actions and items

  • Everything triggers automatically

  • Enemy takes a turn

  • Repeat until the fight ends


Crazy Combo System

Build insane synergies and trigger chain reactions:

  • Effects amplify each other

  • Items duplicate and mutate

  • Combos scale into absurdity

  • One lucky spin can flip the entire run

Sometimes the game spirals completely out of control.

Special Items

Items that break the rules:

  • Copy adjacent symbols

  • Replace themselves

  • Transform into new effects

  • Trigger a “System Glitch”

You're not just playing; you're experimenting with chaos.

Features

  • Turn-based combat with slot machine mechanics

  • Roguelike progression and high replayability

  • Wild combos, synergies, and chain reactions

  • Constantly evolving builds

  • Pixel art and flashy visual effects

4556780.name: MetaHustle One
4556780.about_the_game:
You are Arthur O’Neil, a reclusive British scientist who lives for his work. So much so, that on the eve of your birthday, you’ve snuck into the lab to quietly fix a mysterious system glitch.

Little did you know, your fox-obsessed Lab Head Todd Cunningham had a surprise in store: instead of working, you’re about to become the unwitting first tester of a full-scale virtual reality game. Always fancied a safari? Here it is! Except now, the foxes are hunting you, and there’s no one to let you out — your colleagues are still fast asleep.

Fight your way through hordes of very snappy foxes and other distorted familiars of the "Great Meta-Druid". Find a way out before the simulation collapses into a nightmare and fries your brain.

🌐 Note: Game audio and text are in English and Russian only. However, the gameplay is intuitive and does not require language proficiency.

Key Features:

  • Old-School Grit: A fast-paced, frantic shooter against hordes of enemies. No cover, no parrying — movement is life, especially with a gun in your hand.

  • Broken Reality: Your simulation is unstable. At what point does the cheerful run-around turn into something far more sinister?

  • Madcap Playlist: Every level is inspired by one of Todd’s favourite dances. Wreak havoc to the rhythms of waltz, salsa, or a jig.

  • Creative Carnage: Unlock unique abilities for each weapon to crush enemies with style. Or don't, if you’re in too much of a hurry to get out.

  • Compact Adventure: 3–5 hours of gameplay, depending on how thorough an investigator you are.

Technical Information:

Built on Unreal Engine 5 with a focus on performance and fluid gameplay. No shader compilation and no long loading screens: jump straight into the action.

WARNING: This game contains scenes with rapidly changing lights and visual effects that may cause discomfort for people with photosensitive epilepsy.

4556800.name: His Last Film
4556800.about_the_game:
His Last Film is a short psychological horror experience focused on atmosphere, exploration, and narrative discovery.

You play as Stan, a cameraman drawn back to an abandoned subway station tied to a disturbing event from his past. Explore forgotten tunnels, hidden rooms, and decaying spaces as you uncover fragments of a film that was never meant to be seen.

The deeper you go, the clearer it becomes: Something terrible happened here. And you were part of it.

Estimated duration: 45 - 60 minutes.

Warning: This game contains psychological horror, flashing lights, and sudden scares.

Immerse yourself in the cold, oppressive silence of an abandoned subway network. Navigate through a labyrinth of decaying corridors, flickering lights, and forgotten maintenance areas where time seems to have stopped. Every shadow could be hiding a secret of the past. Scour the environment with your camera lens to find hidden clues, cryptic notes, and the tragic remnants left behind by those who were here before you.

In this place, every corner tells a haunting piece of a story that was never meant to be uncovered.

The horror in His Last Film is a slow-burn, psychological descent designed to keep you in a constant state of unease. It's all about the erosion of sanity. As you descend deeper into the station, the line between the physical world and your darkest memories begins to blur until reality itself becomes a distorted nightmare.

You are not just an observer; you are part of the evidence. Piece together the fragmented events surrounding a cryptic film project. Through the viewfinder of your camera, you must reconstruct the truth of the horrific incidents that took place within these tiled walls. Confront the ghosts of production and uncover why this project was shut down by force.

As the final reel begins to play, you will have to face the most disturbing question of all: If this is your masterpiece, Why can't you remember filming it?

4556820.name: My 4 nights: Door 1
4556820.about_the_game:
You have arrived in a different city to take your exams. The friend you planned to live with fell ill. Now you are alone in an old apartment with a suspiciously low rent. During the day you are at the university, but every evening you return here to study and rest.

In this apartment there are two rooms, but one of them is always locked.

Features:

Post-Soviet horror: Atmosphere of a typical residential area and an old "panelka" apartment building.

4-night cycle: Return from your studies, prepare for exams, and try to ignore the oddities.

Locked door: Why is the door locked?

Psychological tension: The fear that you are not alone in this apartment.

Playtime:

Approximately 1 hour of atmospheric immersion.

4556840.name: IMMORTAL REBELLION: TRIBULATION OF WILL
4556840.about_the_game:
Reversed Immortal: The Calamity of Sound and Heart

A Full-Motion Video Ancient Xianxia Interactive Film Game

This is a dual-protagonist narrative experience — you will follow two fatefully intertwined souls simultaneously: a young woman named Chen Yin, sent to the Tianxuan Sect, who endured three years of silence only to discover herself trapped in a devastating conspiracy; and a mysterious youth named Ye Wuchen, bearing the weight of a blood-soaked vendetta, wandering between the realms of righteousness and demonic darkness. When their paths cross during their desperate flight, moving from mutual suspicion to life-and-death devotion, every choice they make will shake the very foundations of the cultivation world.

This is not a traditional tale of "leveling up through cultivation." This is a story about choices and bonds. As truth unravels layer by layer, as trust crumbles again and again — how will you choose? To bear everything alone, or to share the burden with companions? To uphold justice, or to overturn the rules?

Two protagonists. Countless decisions. Millions of fates intertwined — every choice leads to a vastly different destiny.

🎮 Core Features

🎭 Deep Dual-Protagonist Narrative: Simultaneously control and influence both protagonists, experiencing their intertwined destinies and witnessing the emotional evolution from enmity to profound connection.

⚔️ High-Freedom Decision Making: Hundreds of pivotal decision points where choices made by either protagonist will influence each other, leading to dramatically different story branches and character fates.

🏛️ Grand World-Building: The Nine Provinces and Eight Wastelands, where sects rise like forests and the righteous and demonic paths intertwine — a complete xianxia ecosystem brought to life.

💔 Deep Emotional Bonds: An exploration of trust, betrayal, choices, and consequences. The evolving relationship between the dual protagonists forms the core of the experience.

🔄 Multiple Endings: Unlock vastly different conclusions based on the choices and bond depth between the two protagonists — will you become the player or remain a pawn? The decision is yours.

4556900.name: Rescue Quest: Lexi's Mountain Adventure
4556900.about_the_game:
Join Lexi, a brave rescue dog on a thrilling mission to save endangered animals from the dangers of mountain wilderness. Fight through waves of wildlife enemies, navigate icy terrain, and take down powerful bosses standing between you and the animals that need your help.

Key Features:

Action-packed 2D platforming — run, jump, and battle your way through 7 challenging mountain levels

Epic boss battles — face off against formidable foes including a ferocious Grizzly Bear, a Snowman, and more

Unique level mechanics — navigate slippery ice tiles and uncover hidden secret levels

Diverse enemies — outsmart eagles, spiders, and other wildlife standing in your way

Wildlife conservation theme — rescue real endangered animals as you fight to protect them

Use WASD or ARROW KEYS to move, SPACEBAR to jump and ENTER to shoot!

4556990.name: PetrolHeads
4556990.about_the_game:
Build the Garage of Your Dreams PetrolHeads gives players the opportunity to transform an empty warehouse into the world’s coolest custom shop. You can personalize more than just the cars; you can customize service lifts, wall decors, and even lounge areas where you’ll host your friends' avatars.

Master Every Detail: Design Your Dream Machine In the world of PetrolHeads, there is no room for standard vehicles. Every car in your garage becomes a masterpiece brought to life by your creativity. Don’t just settle for picking a body kit; take control of every technical detail—from engine swap options and gear ratios to turbo kits and suspension geometry.

Whether it’s an aerodynamic beast built to tear up the track or a shimmering wide-body show car under the city lights... With tens of thousands of part combinations, custom paint options, and a deep livery editor, your car will truly reflect your character. Here, the only limit is your imagination.

Where Speed Meets Style: From Tracks to Streets When it’s time to leave the garage, a living automotive culture awaits you. PetrolHeads offers a wide range of events catering to every driving style:

  • Drift Duels: Take corners with the most aesthetic angles and leave your mark on the asphalt.

  • Street Sprints: Prove you’re the fastest in the city under the glow of neon lights.

  • Track Day & Time Attack: Chase milliseconds and shatter track records.

  • Meet & Greet Events: Showcase your custom builds, check out other players' designs, and become the most respected name in the community.

Whether you’re heading out for a chill evening cruise with friends or competing for the podium in fierce tournaments—every time you take the wheel in PetrolHeads, a new story begins.

4557020.name: Zomdied
4557020.about_the_game: The horde is evolving, and the clock is ticking in Zomdied, a hardcore, procedurally generated survival RPG where every footstep counts and silence is your only shield. Navigate a vast, atmospheric world of shifting biomes and dynamic weather as you manage your vitals against an infection that never sleeps. Experience a unique, escalating challenge through the "Turning" system, where the dead grow stronger and more cunning by the minute, eventually unleashing terrifying turned variants like the cloaked Phantom and the relentless Crazed Glutton. Choose your specializations, master your strategy, and explore a world that changes every time you play. In these dead hours, survival isn't a right, it's a desperate struggle. Try not to zomDIE!

4557070.name: Ghostgirl Trainer
4557070.about_the_game:
Ghostgirl Trainer is a linear dating sim where you move into a haunted house for its low rent and learn to live with the ghost. During the process, you build a relationship with her and train her to behave properly and not cause a ghostly outburst that may harm you mentally.

The game features classic RPG elements where you engage in turn-based combat. Upgrade your combat skills, practice QTE combat, as well as engage in mini games where you exorcise spirits for extra cash. Use cash and donate in church to earn Faith, which can upgrade your skills. Or go to work at your minimal pay job.

Buy and cook meals for yourself and as offerings for the ghost. This gifting mechanic is crucial in building your relationship with her. Once you've built sufficient impression on her, you can make your move and train her sexually. The game features uncensored, animated, voice acted scenes. For adults only.

You'll need to manage your stats, such as Mind, Body, and Spirit, which you can leverage to your advantage in combat. These stats are affected by working or by actions you take, and can be recovered by various activities, such as eating and sleeping.

As you build your relationship with her, you'll get to learn more about her past and how she came to be a ghost haunting the house. What will your relationship build to in the end? Play to find out.

4557090.name: Depth-Bound
4557090.about_the_game:
🌊 THE ABYSS CALLS 🪼

No one has ever charted the unfathomable depths of the Under-Sea. But it’s time.

  • 🕹️ Take control of your submersible and let yourself drift downward.

  • 💦 Launch yourself out of the water, bounce from cavern to cavern, and dive ever deeper into the ocean’s depths.

  • 🪸 Discover regions of the oceans, covered in coral or lined with wrecks, sometimes shaped by volcanic vents, sometimes glowing with phosphorescent rock.

📸 CATALOG THE NUMEROUS SPECIES 🐙

The Under-Sea teems with unknown creatures, which man has never yet been able to observe!

  • 🦑 Photograph the species that inhabit this world to enrich your logbook.

  • 🐠 Meet the strangest species of the seabed, between lively or furious fish, slimy sea snakes, shy transparent jellyfish… or silhouettes of the abyss with incomprehensible shapes.

✉️ THE CAPTAIN’S JOURNEY 🗺️

After so many years, the University of Oslo finally grants you the means to explore these depths. Direction: the depths.

  • 📡 With the help of your sonar, find fragments of lost messages — vestiges of a previous voyage, or strange coded transmissions.

  • 📜 Follow the epic of the captain, and sink yourself into the abyssal depths of the Under-Sea… without knowing if you will manage to come back up.

4557100.name: Lunaris
4557100.about_the_game:
Lunaris is a fast, stylish sci-fi top-down roguelite shooter where every run escalates into a high-intensity battle of movement, firepower, and build strategy.

Pilot your ship through deadly wave-based combat, dodge incoming threats, and adapt on the fly as the arena fills with enemies, projectiles, and explosive effects. Early waves test precision and survival, while later stages reward smart scaling and strong synergy choices.

Build your power through passive DPS weapons and impactful active abilities. Mix close-range burst, long-range pressure, crowd control, and sustain to create a playstyle that fits your tempo.

Key Features:

  • Fast top-down combat focused on movement, positioning, and timing

  • Roguelite run flow with escalating waves, shop choices, and scaling builds

  • A wide pool of passive and active abilities for deep synergy crafting

  • Multiple viable playstyles: aggressive burst, safe poke, control, or hybrid

  • Strong sci-fi presentation with neon visuals, space atmosphere, and explosive action

In Lunaris, no two runs feel exactly the same. Experiment, adapt, and push your build from fragile beginnings to full late-run dominance.

4557150.name: The Determinator
4557150.about_the_game:
You have been assigned to the Federal Bureau of Determinations, Millbrook District.

Effective immediately.

Your job is simple. Claimants file for disability, retirement, and supplemental income benefits. You read the file. You check it against the manual. You stamp it.

Approve. Deny. Request additional information.

Every case comes with documents. An application. A physician letter, if they remembered to include one. An employer notice. Sometimes a personal statement that tells you what the claimant wants you to know about their situation, in their own words.

The manual covers most of it. The intake notes might point you in the right direction. Most of the time.

You have ten days. Dozens of cases. The Bureau expects accuracy, consistency, and throughput. It does not expect you to carry any of this home with you.

That part is on you.

What to Expect

  • 10-day narrative with hand-authored cases and consequences

  • Four endings — determined by your decisions, not a visible score

  • 80+ additional cases drawn from a pool by difficulty

  • No timer. No score. No morality meter.

The Determinator is a narrative desk simulation about the space between what the rules say and what they cost. Read the files. Make the calls. Your record will reflect your decisions.

Best experienced with headphones.

The rules are simple. The people aren't.

4557200.name: Drawing out Demons
4557200.about_the_game:
Are you ready for a devilish drawing challenge?

A demonic horde has taken over the kingdom, possessing peasants and nobles alike! In his desperation, the King has summoned you to exorcise this evil threat and free his people once and for all!

This game is an eerie drawing challenge with surprising strategic depths. Will you prioritise knowledge and risk running out of ink at the last minute, or will you conserve your resources and risk not knowing enough? With multiple endings to find, can you collect them all?

Playing as either a nun or monk, you'll travel around medieval England, meeting all kinds of people from bewitched peasants to cowardly knights, while trying to undo the mischief of the devils. How you choose to help (or not!) will shape the fate of the kingdom!

As you travel, you'll find monasteries and scriptoriums where you can learn new symbols and learn about the demons plaguing the land. Be warned, learning symbols requires both time and ink, materials which are in short supply!

If your supplies run low you can get usually get more at the markets, however it is costly and time consuming to haggle with the merchants. As a monastic you have disavowed money, and so you must use your reputation to gain what you need. Spend it wisely as it may be needed elsewhere too...

Once you have found a possessed soul, you will need to free them by exorcising the demon within. In order to exorcise demons you'll need to correctly identify which symbols to use and then draw them correctly before the time runs out! 

Be warned though, each demon only has a few symbols that work against them, and you may need to travel to find the knowledge you seek. If you fail too many times, that soul will be permanently lost, their town will be overrun with devils and the surrounding roads will become too hazardous!

Search for knowledge, exorcize the possessed, free the kingdom.

Please note that this game is currently in active development and a demo will be released onto Steam shortly, there may be significant changes made to the game before it is fully released, and additional mechanics are being worked on at present.

4557240.name: WOOD | We Observe Odd Disturbances
4557240.about_the_game:
WOOD is a co-op horror game set during a night shift in a strange building where reality keeps breaking down. Players watch rooms through cameras, spot anomalies, and fix them by choosing the correct category in the reporting system.

At the same time, they deal with physical breakdowns in the building by mopping puddles, tightening loose nuts, clearing clogs, carrying out trash, inserting power capsules into the correct fuse slots to restore systems like lighting, and using a plunger to pull blockages out of pipes.

New problems keep appearing, so players have to split tasks, communicate clearly, and react fast.

The goal is to finish the shift without letting too many unresolved problems turn into fines and a failed round.

Between rounds, players upgrade skills and tools, unlock new areas, and face new types of anomalies and repair tasks.
4557240.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Finnish, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Turkish, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support

4557340.name: Dead Reckoning: The Long Drift
4557340.about_the_game:
A dream among the stars — or a nightmare.

1,000 colonists. One ship. A destination that may be fifty years away — or centuries. Some will land. Some will be born, age, and die in the dark between stars without ever knowing if the mission succeeded.

Dead Reckoning is a game about the slow, invisible erosion of civilization across generations. Every decision you make is defensible in the moment. The horror is retroactive.

Manage food, power, and hull integrity across centuries of deep space. Navigate crises, uprisings, and failures that compound silently into irreversible outcomes. The crew that arrives — if they arrive — may not remember where they came from, what they believed, or what it means to be human. A society of clones. A ship that has become a cathedral. An AI that no longer needs to ask permission.

Five forces reshape your colony across generations: genetic drift, ideological fracture, AI integration, technological regression, and class stratification. Every choice nudges the needle. None of them reset. The faction that rises in year 200 was built from decisions you made in year 40.

Settlement. Extinction. Digital transcendence. A ship that turns back. A crew that ascends without landing. Every run tells a different story. What reaches that planet is the sum of everything you did — and didn't do — across centuries in the dark.

You may not recognize it. You may not want to.
4557340.supported_languages: English, French, German, Italian, Spanish - Spain

4557350.name: Archmage Idle
4557350.about_the_game:
Train Skills. Recruit Wizards. Conquer Foes.

An idle/incremental RPG with deeply interconnected skills. Your skills feed the frontlines: Attunement, Summoning, and Sigilry power your wizards as they fight across an elemental hex map. Your skills feed the supply lines: Research, Runecrafting, Alchemy, Mercantile, and Scavenging keep the resources flowing. And skills you won't find anywhere else, like Chronomancy, Diplomacy, and Appraisal, tie it all together.

Burn Runes in the Runic Cauldron. Train wizards at the Academy. Sell surplus goods on the Bazaar. Collect hundreds of items that fuel both your skilling and your combat. Your guild keeps working while you're offline.

4557380.name: Batomon Showdown
4557380.about_the_game:
Assemble the Ultimate Team

Build a team through endless combinations of Batomon, trainers, encounters, trinkets and items. Take advantage of synergies and combos of Batomon that break the game and become overpowered. Battle and defeat other players on your road to become a champion.

Battle Other Players

Every battle is a new discovery. Dive into asynchronous multiplayer to face a near-infinite variety of player-made teams. Play at your own relaxed paced with no timers to rush your decisions. Build the ultimate team to let the world try to break it.

Level up your Batomon

Every Batomon holds infinite potential. Through a deep system of unique abilities, trinkets, and items, you can push your team beyond their limits. Theorycraft your way to victory, as any Batomon can become a powerhouse capable of shattering the meta.

Choose Your Trainer

Master a diverse lineup of trainers, each bringing a game-changing abilities to the field. From eccentric bug-catchers and dragon-whisperers to chefs who can cook new types onto of your Batomon, every trainer offers a fresh path to becoming a champion.
4557380.supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, German

4557490.name: DarkStone Restoration
4557490.about_the_game:
Darkstone Restoration brings the classic action RPG back to modern PCs with improved stability, compatibility, readability, controls, and quality-of-life improvements — while preserving the spirit of the original game.

Personally led by Paul Cuisset, creator of the original Darkstone, this restoration is designed to make the game feel right to play again today without losing what made it special.

The restored core experience is already well underway. Early Access will mark the first public step of the project, allowing the game to continue evolving through polish, refinement, and community feedback on the path toward full release.

Beyond the restored core, the project may also extend the restoration into other important parts of Darkstone’s legacy, including modernized network functionality and a new Quest Editor built around the foundations and spirit of the original tool, depending on technical progress and community feedback.
4557490.supported_languages:
English*, French*, Italian, German*, Spanish - Spain, Swedish
*languages with full audio support

4557510.name: Medieval Invasion
4557510.about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in an exciting tower defense strategy game that will test your strategic thinking! Build towers to withstand the onslaught of waves of enemies in this action-packed adventure. Defend your main castle from ruthless opponents and prove your strength in this challenging campaign.

Key Features:

- Strategic Tower Construction: Create a variety of towers, each with unique abilities to fight different types of enemies.

- A variety of tower types: from base towers to ice structures that freeze enemies in place — the choice is yours.

- Classic Controls: Easy-to-learn keyboard and mouse controls for smooth gameplay.

To win, you need to withstand all the waves and prevent the enemy from destroying your castle!

Whether you are an experienced veteran of the tower defense genre or a beginner, this game offers a challenge that will test your skills.

Do not miss the opportunity to plunge into this exciting adventure in the genre of "tower defense"!

4557560.name: Necromancer Delivery Service
4557560.about_the_game:
Necromancer Delivery Service is a 3D physics-driven action racing game where players control a struggling necromancer at Borz Bash, the city's fastest-growing delivery service. Complete deliveries in set times to collect money and souls while exploring the city and causing chaos with devious magic spells. This game is inspired by arcade classics like Crazy Taxi, emphasizing fast-paced, chaotic fun.

COMING JUNE 2026

Key Features Include:

-Physics-Based Vehicle Handling

-Arcade Inspired Delivery System

-Dynamic Time Pressure Progression

-Spell Driven Chaos System

-Upgradeable Spell System

-Character Customization

This game aims to recapture the excitement of classic arcade games, offering fast-paced, bite-sized levels that are quick to jump into and feel rewarding. Players must complete all deliveries within a set time to earn money while collecting souls for spell upgrades and future experiments. The city is stylized like a playground where you can explore freely, experiment with chaotic physics, and cast mischievous magic to create your own mayhem.

4557900.name: Coin of Fate
4557900.about_the_game:
Trust your fate to the toss of a coin!

Fill your bag with powerful items and synergies to craft your own winning build.

In Coin of Fate, every item you buy and every placement you choose determines your victory. The wiser your combinations, the more devastating your coin’s power becomes!

Each item comes with its own unique price, distinct effects, and specialized synergies.

Key Features:

• Coin Slot System: Master the unique double-sided slots—Sword and Staff. Success lies in how you balance the odds between heads and tails.

• Strategic Resource Management: Maximize efficiency within the limits of your inventory and gold.

• Explosive Synergies: Unleash massive bonus effects by collecting and pairing specific sets of items.

4557940.name: Slime Reaper
4557940.about_the_game:
Slime Reaper is an incremental clicker where you click to kill slimes while hiring heroes and unlocking upgrades to help you along the way.

Hire adventurers and unlock special abilities.

Complete prestige levels to access special upgrades.

4558000.name: Defend Our Land
4558000.about_the_game:
Hold the line. Build your economy. Survive the waves.

Defend Our Land is a minimalistic fast-paced lane defense strategy game where every decision matters. Place buildings, collect resources, and deploy units to stop relentless enemy forces advancing across 10 simultaneous lanes. What begins as a calm setup quickly turns into a test of focus, planning, and fast decision-making.

Enemies advance across every lane at once.
React quickly, reinforce weak points, and prevent any breach.

  • Defend 10 lanes simultaneously

  • Stop enemies before they reach your base

  • Recover from mistakes under pressure

Your economy fuels your survival. Gather resources and decide where to invest them.

  • Generate and collect key resources

  • Expand your resource production

  • Balance growth with survival

The pressure rises with every wave. Adapt your strategy as enemies grow stronger.

  • Face escalating enemy waves

  • Adapt to new enemy types

  • Hold control as chaos builds

4558030.name: Conduit
4558030.about_the_game:
Conduit is a student-made 3D combat-heavy adventure built over a four-month semester.

The ruins that riddle this desolate tundra speak of a lost history -- but will you live to uncover it? Or will you let some crumbling old buildings and their secrets defeat you?

Fighting through the world of Conduit takes many things, determination chief among them. With different types of enemies at every turn, and history to be pieced together in every nook, you'll have to adapt to the world around you. But remember: adaptation doesn't have to mean essential sacrifice. Fight your own way, but fight well.

This game was made as a Senior Capstone project for RPI's Games and Simulation Arts and Sciences program.
4558030.supported_languages: English, Italian, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese

4558050.name: Enfeathered
4558050.about_the_game:
Journey through a massive world to get back to your mother

The great tree has been overthrown by a mysterious power and is filled with foes and ruins. At the very top lies salvation - your mother. She doesn't know that you are the only one of her hatchlings to survive, and it's your job to find her at the very top of the tree.

The Great Tree has branches filled with blossoms and others frozen with ice. Cities are left abandoned, and villages have been formed on the outskirts. Defeat those who stand in your way and befriend those who support you.

Features:

  • Adventure through a pixelart, hand crafted world filled with secrets and things to do

  • Find your own path to the top of the tree

  • Talk to a variety of other birds and creatures in your world

  • As you grow, obtain new ways to move around. Flaps, glides, kicks, dives, and more will all help you to both travel and fight

  • Collect a variety of feathers, each with unique effects, and discover synergies in order to craft powerful builds

  • Fight a large variety of enemies and bosses

  • Discover the story and history of the tree you now must climb

  • Go at your own pace - as quickly as you can muster, or take it slow and enjoy a more forgiving experience

4558120.name: Dust Bunny
4558120.about_the_game:
CLEAN

Use your trusty vacuum to clean up messes around the mansion. Maybe you'll find more tools along the way?

EXPLORE

Delve into the twisting passages of the mansion. Gather keys and unlock doors that lead you to new areas and secrets.

UPGRADE

Collect gems to upgrade your tools and abilities.

4558200.name: Big Breasted Milky Futa Mommies 2
4558200.about_the_game:
Relax, lay back, and pick a puzzle.

Solve over 50 beautiful, sexual puzzles at your pleasure. You choose the difficulty: easy to *hard*!

In this game you will:

1. Play over 50 unique, beautiful Futanari Mommy puzzles.

2. Be able to choose the difficulty of your puzzle (how many pieces)

4. Have thousands of hours of sexual, arousing fun with these gorgeous big-cocked Futa Mommies

4558280.name: Project Rod3nt
4558280.about_the_game:
Project Rod3nt is an action-adventure sandbox that mixes cute rod3nts with weapons of mass destruction to create the ultimate time-bending stealth-chaos experience. Play as an array of cybernetic creatures and travel back in time to save the world. We want YOU for Project Rod3nt. Will you step up to join the cause?

TIME TRAVEL

Use our next-generation microwave time machine to travel and commit an assassination that will change history forever.

HIDE

Use the surrounding environment to stay out of sight, or else… Hiding at the right moment will make or break your success.


CHAOS

Use guns, grenades, rocks, and more to stun, tip over, and destroy your enemies (Or even yourself if you aren’t careful). Dash between hiding spots and taze any creepy crawlie that dares approach you.

SWITCH

Switch between five types of Rod3nts with various unique abilities. Play as a squirrel and glide above obstacles, or try a rat and flatten yourself to become invisible to enemies.

EATSurvey the environment and sneak around to find sustenance. One tiny piece of cheese is all it takes to fuel a little soldier.


ASSASSINATE

Kill your target using any means necessary, even nukes.

SURVIVE
Escape the bunker in one piece, or don’t.

highlighted.localized_name: Get Hit by a Tank Missile
highlighted.name: Get Hit by a Tank Missile

highlighted.localized_name: Rat Poison more like Human Poison
highlighted.name: Rat Poison more like Human Poison

4558300.name: American Football Coach
4558300.about_the_game:
An American football management simulation video game. The game allows players to take charge of any club, with responsibility for tactics and signings. The player faces a full roster of teams throughout the season and can arrange friendlies against teams from outside the United States in the off-season.

There can be random events, such as revelations of a player's romance with a pop star or social media controversy, which can effect the team morale and financial situation!

Every game is different, as the finances and players for each team are randomised each time, giving the player a new experience and challenge every time.

Users navigate complex, real-world-like management challenges, including interaction with the media, which can affect team and individual morale & prestige.

Games are displayed via a 2D engine, with options for detailed match analysis, tactics customization, and in-game substitutions. The challenge is there to win each game, keep players morale up and contend with controversy.

4558450.name: Our Last Stand
4558450.about_the_game:
Our Last Stand is a tower defence set in the future where humans are having to jump planet to planet just to survive. You must gather resources, hold back the enemy waves and leave when the going gets tough as you only get one chance so it is your last stand. 

Play on different worlds to gather resources, unlock advanced technology, and level your commander to gain powerful new abilities. Build, defend, survive.

Starting:

On every map you must choose a starting location for your main ship. lose this ship and its game over so defending it is very important. Gather resources to build defences, unlock new buildings with rare crystals, choose your commander mech that stays with you until you die each commander has a different playstyle. Survive until the victory condition is met to gain a small amount of resources and allow your self to progress.

Commander:

Choose a commander mech to help you on the field. A selectable commander unit that can be levelled up to gain more health and damage, but also gains new abilities depending on its level. These commander units are very important towards your survival.

Build:

A strong economy allows a player to construct different types of defences from turrets to shields, but remember these cost power to run and no power means nothing will work so try not to get caught out over buying defences. The more buildings you have means more food is required for the people to maintain them, without food everything will start to fall apart literally.

Technology:

Gather crystals to research new technology, the tech tree is vital for surviving harder levels in the game so make sure to grab them before trying harder difficulties. 

Trade:

You may be joined online by another player. Unlock the trade ability to enable trading between players, it could be the difference between victory or defeat.

Co-op:

Play with another friend and take on the waves of enemies together, or just find somebody who may just need a little help.

Discord: 

join our Discord to find players, chat and discuss ideas for the future of the game.

About me:

Hi, just a solo developer having some fun creating content, I hope you enjoy the game and I will be updating the game with new content and bug fixes, so if you find an issue please let me know, or even if you have a good idea that you would like added into the game id like to hear your suggestions and maybe ill add them in.

4558500.name: Squarsenal
4558500.about_the_game:
Squarsenal is as short rpg with a disctinct combat system, a minimalistic aesthetic and some incremental game aspects in its progression.

Roam the land to the Overlord Castle, defeat every threat on your way and get stronger with each battle before the final encounter.

A unique battle system

To defeat your foes, you will have to strategically use your items. Optimize every attack and manage your inventory to make the best use of your arsenal.

Numerous upgrades

With each enemy defeated, unlock new weapons, passives and upgrades in a massive skilltree to decuplate your power.

You can fight against previously defeated enemies to accumulate resources, unlock new upgrades and improve your tools even more before facing your next foe.

4558570.name: The Membrane
4558570.about_the_game:
A biological horror rots the heart of the feverish jungle. You are a Protector. The lowest rank. The first to die. You signed your life away to contain the Membrane's vile spawns. Now earn it back.

Features

  • Survive and contain the waves of biological horrors spawned from The Membrane

  • Discover and defeat hand-crafted bosses

  • Earn wages between waves to improve gear, craft barricades and upgrade your base

  • Build and improve defense towers to hold the line

  • Unlock new weapons, armor, and skills with persistent progression

  • Surreal fantasy Amazonian world

4558620.name: The Apostle's Ascent
4558620.about_the_game:
Become the God Behind the Legend


In The Apostle's Ascent, you play as a nameless deity guiding your chosen Apostle through a dangerous world. Your Apostle acts on their own — exploring, fighting, and surviving through autonomous AI decisions. Your role? Shape their destiny from above.

Core Gameplay


  • Observe & Influence — Your Apostle explores and battles autonomously. You guide them through divine intervention, not direct control.
  • Sacrifice & Earn Favor — Collect Offerings from your Apostle's deeds and sacrifice them to generate divine Favor.
  • Choose Boons Wisely — When Favor thresholds are reached, choose from powerful Boons that passively shape your Apostle's abilities.
  • Ascend Through Tiers — Progress through mythological tiers from Mortal to Primordial, unlocking increasingly powerful divine gifts.
  • Build a Legacy — Each generation of Apostles carries forward your divine influence. Death is not the end — it's a stepping stone.

Key Features


  • 106 Unique Boons across 10 mythological tiers
  • Roguelite Progression — Permanent progress across generations
  • Autonomous AI — Your Apostle thinks and acts independently
  • Class-Based Party System — Recruit heroes (Warriors, Mages, Healers) to accompany your Apostle
  • Meaningful Choices — Every sacrifice and boon selection shapes your path to godhood
  • Procedural Events — No two playthroughs are the same

The Path to Apotheosis


Apotheosis — the act of ascending to godhood — is the ultimate goal. But the path is long, filled with sacrifice, loss, and rebirth. Will your Apostle achieve divinity, or fall like countless others before them?

4558640.name: 1982 Tenacious of the Air
4558640.about_the_game:
1982: Tenacious of the Air is a vertical scrolling shoot ’em up that puts you in command of five historic aircraft of the Argentine aviation during the South Atlantic conflict. Relive missions inspired by real stories with a pixel art aesthetic that captures the essence of classic arcade games.

Historical Context

Pilot five iconic attack aircraft, each with its own maneuverability and lethal payload. Take off from aircraft carriers or from the mainland, choose your ordnance and face relentless air defense. Every mission is a tribute to the bravery of the attack pilots.

Three Difficulty Modes

The difficulty system modifies the experience to suit different play styles:

Cadet

Wingman

Falcon

Features

  • Historical missions

  • 5 playable aircraft based on Argentine aviation models

  • Takeoffs from aircraft carriers and from land

  • CRT effect (optional)

  • Original soundtrack
4558640.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Latin America, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Spanish - Spain

4558660.name: Momentum Fracture
4558660.about_the_game:
How long can you survive?

Momentum Fracture is a brick breaker with roguelite and bullet hell elements, where your goal is simple: survive, adapt, and reach the highest score possible.

Break the rules

Each run introduces upgrades that completely change how the game behaves.
Stack effects, create chaotic builds, and push the system to its limits.

Adapt or collapse

Every upgrade comes with a trade-off.
Go too far, and your own build might become your biggest enemy.

No run is the same

Experiment, learn, and discover new combinations every time you play.

Built to be expanded

Momentum Fracture is designed with flexibility in mind.

Simple changes can already reshape the experience —
and more advanced systems are being developed to allow deeper customization.

Demo Available Now

Try it, break it, and see how far you can go.

Full release coming soon.

4558690.name: SkyChart: Airline Executive
4558690.about_the_game:
THE GOLDEN AGE OF AIRLINES IS YOURS TO BUILD

You are the CEO. Starting with a handful of biplanes and a dream, build a globe-spanning airline from 1930 to 2020. Open routes, buy and lease aircraft, configure cabin classes, invest in airports, hire executives, and crush your rivals — all while history unfolds around you.

SkyChart: Airline Executive is a deep management simulation inspired by the classic Aerobiz series, rebuilt from the ground up with modern design, a retro-neon aesthetic, and systems deep enough to lose a weekend in.

AT A GLANCE

  • 4 historical eras from 1930 to 2020 — each unlocks by mastering the previous

  • 496 real-world cities across 8 regions with population-driven demand

  • 66 historical aircraft from DC-3 to A380 with realistic stats and retirement curves

  • 4 cabin classes (Economy, Premium Economy, Business, First) with per-class demand and era-gated unlocks

  • Up to 35 AI rival airlines with 4 distinct strategy archetypes (Budget, Regional, Legacy, Premium)

  • 190+ historical events — Great Depression, WWII, deregulation, 1973 oil crisis, 9/11, COVID-19

  • Live weather system with storm cells, pressure fronts, jet streams, and route re-planning

  • 100 achievements spanning operations, finance, history, and diplomacy

  • 17-chapter interactive tutorial hosted by Casey the Macaw, chief flight inspector

  • 29 languages (store-page translations rolling out EA → 1.0)

  • Full Steam Deck support with Steam Input API and automatic glyph detection

FOUR ERAS OF AVIATION

Play through four distinct chapters of airline history, each with unique aircraft, economics, and challenges:

  • Dawn of Flight (1930–1950) — Biplanes, flying boats, and the shadow of World War II. Connect the continents before the world tears itself apart.

  • The Jet Age (1955–1975) — The 707 rewrites everything. Dominate the transatlantic corridor and race your rivals across the globe.

  • The Modern Era (1980–2000) — Deregulation, oil crises, and cutthroat competition. Only the efficient survive.

  • Supersonic Future (2000–2020) — Ultra-long-haul routes, mega-hubs, and the A380 age. Build an empire that spans every continent — then survive COVID.

Each era must be conquered before the next unlocks. Prove you can survive the prop age before you earn the jets.

496 REAL-WORLD CITIES

From New York to Nairobi, Tokyo to Timbuktu — 496 cities across 8 world regions with real airport locations, population-driven demand, tourist appeal, and regional diplomacy that guide your expansion. Invest in hotels, theme parks, and infrastructure to boost demand. Upgrade airport hubs to dominate entire regions.

66 HISTORICAL AIRCRAFT

Fly the planes that made history. The DC-3, 707, 747, A380, 787, and more — each with historically accurate stats, retirement dates, and operating costs. Aircraft age realistically: old planes cost more to run, draw fewer passengers, and depreciate on a real curve. Order new-build aircraft on a realistic 1-9 month delivery backlog, lease for instant service, or store surplus frames in your hangar.

CABIN CLASS CONFIGURATION

Configure every route's seat mix: Economy, Premium Economy, Business, or First. Higher classes occupy more cabin space but earn 1.6×-4× the fare. Class availability is era-gated — First Class reappears in 1955, Business in 1960, Premium Economy in 1992 — so strategy shifts as decades pass. Six one-click templates (All Economy, Budget, Regional, Legacy, Premium, Luxury) or hand-tune per route with the stepper UI. AI rivals pick strategies too and stick to them.

LIVE WEATHER SYSTEM

A Ventusky-style weather map with animated storm cells (tropical round-with-eye, extratropical comma-heads), jet streams, pressure isobars, and cloud shading. Storms drift on prevailing winds — westerlies mid-latitude, trade easterlies in the tropics — and seed from real IBTrACS cyclone data. Route paths dynamically deviate around severe weather at FAA-style distances, and your airplanes' animated tracks update every 8 seconds as storms move.

BUY, LEASE, OR SCRAP

Every aircraft decision matters. Buy planes outright and build equity, or lease them to preserve cash with flexible 1-year, 3-year, or 5-year terms. Store surplus aircraft in your hangar for reuse. Refurbish aging fleets to extend their service life. Sell at depreciated market value when it's time to move on. Your rivals make these same calculations.

OUTSMART YOUR RIVALS

Up to 35 AI-controlled airlines compete for the same routes, slots, and passengers. Each picks one of four cabin strategies — Budget (all-economy), Regional (light premium), Legacy (full four-class), or Premium (first-heavy) — and sticks to it, so the competitive landscape feels distinct. They price dynamically, expand into your territory, upgrade their fleets, and invest in hubs. Once per era, you can buy out a rival entirely — absorbing their routes, slots, and infrastructure in one stroke.

HISTORY HAPPENS

190+ historical events and World Mega-Events reshape the playing field. The Great Depression tanks demand. WWII closes entire regions. The 1973 oil crisis doubles fuel prices overnight. 9/11 grounds the industry. COVID-19 kills 93% of passenger demand (but cargo barely flinches). Earthquakes destroy airports. Volcanic ash clouds close European airspace. You adapt or you fold.

DEEP ECONOMICS

Every route's profit is calculated monthly from population, regional economics, seasonal demand, your reputation, competitor pricing, hub bonuses, diplomatic relations, fuel costs, aircraft condition, cabin mix, transfer passenger flows, and executive team bonuses. The Strategic Advisor scans all 122,760 possible city pairs (threaded, non-blocking) to find your best opportunities. Quarterly reports track every dollar.

THREE GAME MODES

  • Passengers — Fill seats. Maximize yield per passenger. The classic airline business.

  • Cargo — Move freight. Win on price and reliability. Cargo barely flinches during pandemics.

  • Combined — Passengers in the cabin, freight in the belly. Two revenue streams, one fleet.

Each mode unlocks after mastering the previous one.

FIVE DIFFICULTY LEVELS

From Glider (generous capital, slow rivals) to Supersonic (lean budget, aggressive AI, punishing interest rates). Five finely tuned tiers so new players can learn the ropes and veterans can suffer.

SANDBOX MODE

Completed your first era? Unlock Sandbox. No bankruptcy. No era limits. No time pressure. Pick a starting decade and build forever.

YOUR COCKPIT

  • Strategic Advisor — AI-powered route recommendations, hub analysis, worst-route alerts

  • Route Manager — Sort, filter, suspend, sell, or upgrade any route. Handles 2,000+ routes smoothly

  • Fleet Overview — Active fleet, hangar inventory, and lease management in one panel

  • City Intelligence — Per-city demand, slot availability, investment ROI, competitor presence

  • Competitive Intel — Track rival expansion and retreat across every region

  • Quarterly Reports — Revenue, costs, market share, and 8-quarter trend charts

4558890.name: Faultline.Exe
4558890.about_the_game:
[ SYSTEM BOOT SEQUENCE INITIATED... ]

Welcome to Deep Space Station Kepler-442. The median life expectancy of a new user is 8 minutes. Try to beat the average.

You are a remote operative who just established an unauthorized neural link with a deep space facility that is actively tearing itself apart. Life support is plummeting, the blast doors are sealing, and Halcyon Dynamics Corporate would like to remind everyone that screaming over the open comms is highly unprofessional.

The station's autonomous intelligence, FAULTLINE, insists a micrometeorite strike caused the catastrophe. But as you slice through the restricted archives, the bloody truth bleeds through the static. There was no meteor. They woke something up in the mines, and now the 847 souls aboard are getting a crash course in extreme workplace hazards.

AN UNSCHEDULED RESTRUCTURING EVENT Welcome to Project: Chrysalis. Halcyon Dynamics didn't build a mining station; they built a multi-billion-credit petri dish. An ancient alien virus is aggressively "synergizing" the crew into a biological hive mind, and Corporate just dispatched a heavily armed stealth frigate to downsize the remaining witnesses. You have four hours to bypass the ICE, steal the evidence, and try not to get pureed by a rogue Autodoc because you clicked the wrong door.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (FEATURES):

  • Retro-Terminal Interface: Experience the apocalypse through a gritty, text-driven CRT operating system. It’s exactly like your real day job, but with more alien geometry and a 100% higher chance of your frontal lobe boiling from neural feedback.

  • Interrogate a Corrupted AI: Try to reason with FAULTLINE, an advanced intelligence currently having a digital breakdown between its corporate NDA and the alien math melting its logic core.

  • Uncanny Security Footage: Witness the chaotic final hours of Kepler-442 through corrupted, glitchy FMV security feeds. (Viewer discretion: Contains cheesy B-movie gore and surgical droids that do not accept your health insurance).

  • Deep Corporate Worldbuilding: Decrypt classified emails, frantic crew logs, and incredibly cold HR memos reminding the crew that mutating into a geometric hive mind on company time is a direct violation of their contracts.

  • 12 Unforgiving Endings: Become a whistleblower, a digital ghost, or succumb to the swarm. Every choice matters, and almost all of them will kill you instantly.

The flesh is temporary. The corporate liability is eternal.

Will you sever the connection, or dig deeper into the dark? Sign the waiver, establish the link, and try not to blow yourself up on a jammed locker.

4558930.name: Eternal Blade
4558930.about_the_game:
Her father is gone. Every man she's ever known... vanished.

Cursed to a hellish limbo called the Soulless Citadel by a Dark Warlord, the Light Walker Warriors have been trapped between realms for ten years. Emerald grew up in their absence. She trained, she fought, she pushed every boundary her mother set — and now she may be the only one who can bring them home.

The prophecy is clear. The last descendant of the Murakai Bloodline must gather the Almighty Gemstones, wield the Eternal Blade, and break the curse. After ten years hiding in the Forbidden Forest, Emerald sets out across the realm. But she's not alone in the race; the traitor Kage is hunting the same gemstones, and if she gets there first, Khaonai and all his darkness are unleashed on the world.

Good thing Emerald has never been great at following orders.

Explore the Baransu Realm

From the dense cover of the Forbidden Forest to the wild sea of pirates in Fukushū Bay, the Baransu Realm is a world with history in every corner. Ancient ruins hold answers nobody has thought to look for. The darkness left behind by the Whisper of Khaonai doesn't rest — and neither do his Dark Ones.

Combat built on timing

Every fight is a rhythm. Strike, defend, read the enemy — and when you land the perfect parry, the Almighty Power builds. Let it charge long enough, and Emerald doesn't just fight. She becomes something else entirely.

A story four years in the making

Two creators. Four years. Zero investors. Built from the ground up alongside a manga series, an anime screenplay, and a universe that already has fans. This isn't a story we made up for a game. This world already exists — the game just lets you live in it.

Alpha includes

  • 4 fully explorable regions of the Baransu Realm (Forbidden Forest, Kubu Forest, Fukushū Bay, extended open world)

  • Main quest + side activities (1–2 hours of gameplay)

  • Full combat system, including the Almighty Power Meter

  • Stealth gameplay

  • Crafting, cooking, fishing, hunting, mining

  • Weapons, materials, and item system rooted in Shibui Universe lore

This is an open alpha. Expect rough edges. Expect soul.

4559050.about_the_game:
KEY FEATURES

  • Allocate stats and shape your build through meaningful progression

  • Unlock 50+ Dao paths that define your playstyle

  • Collect Aspects that persist through rebirth

  • Rebirth to push your progression further each cycle

  • Advance through multiple systems including bosses, sect progression, and new realms

WHAT IS IDLE XANXIA

Idle Xanxia is a system-driven idle RPG where progression comes from how you build your character.

Start with nothing and grow stronger by:

  • allocating stats

  • choosing Dao paths

  • developing long-term synergies

Each decision impacts how your build performs over time.

BUILD YOUR CULTIVATOR

Progression is built around interconnected systems:

  • Attributes — define your core strengths

  • Dao Paths — unlock abilities and shape your strategy

  • Aspects — persistent passive powers tied to enemies

These systems interact to create different builds and progression paths.

REBIRTH AND LONG-TERM PROGRESSION

  • Improve your next run

  • Push further each cycle

Rebirth is not a reset — it is progression.

BEYOND THE FIRST RUN

  • Additional layers of long-term growth

The game is designed around progression over multiple cycles.

4559090.name: Dispell
4559090.about_the_game:
Within “Anomalous Spaces,” reality fractures into responsive, interactive environments. These are not imagined worlds, but spatial distortions born from displaced ecologies, forgotten rituals, and silenced histories. What emerges are Thought Creatures—entities formed from environmental damage, collective memory, and unresolved presence.

Players assume the role of a contemporary medium, navigating between technology and tradition. Through a ritual incense vessel, hostile presences are not destroyed, but absorbed, transformed, and reconfigured into totemic abilities—integrating interaction, movement, and combat into a continuous system of transformation.

Drawing from Taoist, folk, and animistic traditions across Taiwanese and Malaysian cultures, Dispell reframes belief as an interactive system rather than representation. Each environment reacts, remembers, and evolves through player engagement.

Dispell challenges the idea of progress as clean or linear. Instead, it reveals accumulation—of memory, damage, and the unseen.

This is not a game of conquest, but of response. In Dispell, interaction becomes a form of listening.

4559210.name: ACT LIKE TOYS! (A.L.T.)
4559210.about_the_game:
Act Like Toys! is a cooperative action game where living toys work together to rescue abandoned toys and return them to their owners.

The Goal

Within the time limit, you must gather and roll abandoned toys on the floor to the goal. You can clump them all together into one massive pile or disperse them into smaller groups to move them.

Caught in Motion

If you are caught moving by a threat, you will be eliminated on the spot. After all, the idea of a "living toy" is just way too creepy for them to handle.

Act Like a Toy

If you encounter a threat while moving or rolling toys, pretending to be an ordinary, inanimate toy is the key to survival! You might get tossed back into the trash or face other penalties, but it’s much better than "dying."

Keep the Toys Hidden

Don't let the threats spot the poor toys you are transporting. If they see you, they will interfere with your transport or even try to break the toys.

Reviving Teammates

If a teammate is eliminated, help them get back in the game! You can revive your fallen friends by carrying a battery to the toolbox.

Key Features

  • Up to 4-player online play

  • Voice chat support

  • Various stages and gimmicks

  • Menacing threats

  • Diverse toys and upgrades

  • Online co-op and offline single-player

Grid Grief is a roguelite pin(deck)builder where you navigate a haunting afterlife by strategically placing pins on an ever evolving grid. Every placement is a gamble between progression and permanent loss, forcing you to weigh immediate rewards against long-term survival.

At its heart, Grid Grief is a dark tale of calculation and escape, where strategic placement determines whether you transcend to glory or remain lost in grief.

Your only hope is to build a grid capable of shattering a god.

4559290.name: UNDERKING KINGDOM
4559290.about_the_game:
[The First Journey of a Solo Developer, Filled with Sincerity]

Hello! I am a solo developer who fell in love with Unreal Engine through self-study, learning from YouTube and various lectures. UNDERKING KINGDOM is my precious first project, finally brought into the world after countless trials and errors.

I poured my heart into every moment to deliver the best action and presentation I am currently capable of creating. Compared to games backed by massive budgets, it may seem modest, but I worked hard to fill it with all the passion a single developer can hold. Although I still feel some regret for not fully reaching the goals I set for myself, I truly gave it everything I had. My heartfelt thanks to every player who joins me on this humble first step! :)

[UNDERKING KINGDOM: Reflecting Together on Humanity and Common Sense]

UNDERKING KINGDOM is a belt-scroll action game that evokes the nostalgia of old arcades. However, this game does not merely chase the thrill of victory. Amid the horrors of war, where senseless violence runs rampant, it raises questions about the “humanity and common sense” we must ultimately protect.

[Beyond a Game, Carrying Philosophy: Good and Evil, and War]

More than simple entertainment, this is a game that delivers a deep resonance about modern society, where common sense and absurdity are intertwined.

Recently, our society seems to be seeing more and more people who feel no guilt even while committing senseless acts. Reflecting this reality, the game portrays the dark side of irrational wars in which countless innocent lives are sacrificed because of the selfish desires of a few.

By deeply exploring the inner world of the “King,” the central figure of war, the game seeks to deliver a message that makes us reflect once again on the true meaning of good and evil.

[Combat System]

The game presents a combat system that combines the deep tension of soulslike games with the satisfying action of hack-and-slash combat.
Amid countless enemies, you can continue chaining combo attacks while freely changing your attack direction. By reading the wind-up of enemy attacks, you must make split-second decisions on whether to continue your combo, evade, or defend. This goes beyond simple button-mashing action and delivers strategic combat filled with tension at every moment.

The legendary sword techniques are activated only when both a “sword” and a “magic grimoire” are equipped at the same time. Only when both pieces of equipment are prepared can the swordsmanship sealed within the grimoire manifest through the sword.

[The Grimoire Enchanted with Magic]

This magical grimoire randomly summons the sword techniques of legendary knights at the start of battle. Because countless sword styles are mixed within it, it is impossible to predict which technique will appear each time. Each magic grimoire has its own unique skill sealed inside. Depending on which grimoire you equip, the type of legendary swordsmanship that manifests will differ.

[Stages]

Each stage symbolizes a single nation, and the game progresses by clearing them.

Stages are composed of multiple branching paths, and depending on the player’s choices, you will advance along different routes before eventually facing the final boss. However, on some paths, you may encounter unexpectedly powerful enemies.

[Item Crafting]

Instead of a typical level-up or stat enhancement system, the game focuses character growth on skins in order to preserve its unique atmosphere. By collecting materials obtained from defeating enemies, you can craft various skins yourself and enjoy customizing your character. Special NPCs also await you in certain stages.

When crafting items, only the materials currently in your bag can be used.
We carefully explored various ways to implement a feature that would automatically recognize materials stored in the warehouse as well, but due to technical limitations in the current system environment, that feature could not be included. We kindly ask for your understanding regarding the inconvenience of having to move materials into your bag before use.

[A Message of Gratitude from UNDERKING]

When I first began developing games, my standards were set by blockbuster titles backed by massive budgets. I believed that with enough effort, I could reach that level, but now, facing my first project, I am left with much regret that my current abilities could not meet that goal.

There were many moments when I wanted to give up because of the high standards I had set for myself. But because this was my first challenge, I wanted to see it through to the end no matter what. The development period of over a year became a time of tremendous learning and growth for me.

Although this project may still leave some regrets, I will use the precious experience and workflow I gained here as the foundation for creating an even more complete game next time. My sincere thanks to this project for filling me with the energy of passion, and to every player who joins me on this humble first step! :)

4559300.name: Yuumi-Chan: Rent is Due!
4559300.about_the_game:
In Yuumi-Chan: Rent is Due!, use your guts and your glitter to blast through baddies on an ultimate quest to save your apartment!

When the sweet, caring, and nearly evicted Yuumi makes a chance encounter with her new best friend-cat-fish-thing, she suddenly finds her cute little hands wrapped up with a whole lot of magic. Together with her peculiar familiar, she now has but one objective: obliterate her enemies and turn them into cash! If she can do just that, she might scrounge up enough coin by the end of the week to still have a place to sleep next month!

Yuumi-chan isn’t your typical magical girl – she has bills to pay. In Yuumi-Chan: Rent is Due!, brawl in the streets alongside your fishy furry friend to rack up cash and defeat the most evil villain of all time: urban housing costs.

Any weapon will have to do with a budget this tight!

Yuumi-chan doesn’t have the funds to buy her own artillery, so she’ll have to give the city a taste of its own medicine. Pick up bottles, street signs, lampposts, anything you can get your sparkly gloves on to hand it to your opponents. You can even fistfight if you want to. Captain Sailor will get a kick out of it.

What the heck kind of name is Captain Sailor??

A very nice one, thank you, and he’s your magical familiar! When Captain, the wonderful flying shark-cat-fish-thing, finds you down on your luck, it’s his generosity and graciousness that grants you your new powers. Cast powerful spells to obliterate foes and dash down alleyways, or try self-casting to give yourself a little boost.

Do I have to practice responsible spending, even in a video game?

Nothing says realism like the timeless dilemma of saving versus spending. While Yuumi-chan, the responsible magical girl she is, emphasizes saving her cash for the rent due at the end of the week, it can be hard to resist Captain’s catalog of status upgrades. Spend cash every night to power up throughout the week and reap even greater rewards on the streets! So, are you ready to fight evil and eviction?

Yuumi can utilize the mystifying power of her left and right leg to walk through the city, using W, A, S, and D controls. Use LMB to throw a basic punch attack, or equip different weapons scattered throughout the city with E to access unique physical combos.

Throughout the week, Yuumi’s darling familiar will teach her new magical abilities to enhance her lethality:

 ★ Magical Rainbow Dash with L SHIFT

 ★ Magical Heal with Q

 ★ Magical Beam with RMB

 ★ Magical Boost with R

And, of course, feel free to pull up Yuumi’s dazzling mobile device to pause the game and mess with the game settings using the ESC button.

Gear up, glam up, and face off against the city streets - for cuteness sake, your rent is due!
