4559530.name: Marginalia
4559530.about_the_game:
Marginalia is an atmospheric narrative anthology within a single library.

Seven books wait, each one a story. Each one a sin. 

Each a different world, a different tone, a different truth.

You are not told what to feel.
You are not guided toward the right answer.
There is no right answer.

There is only the choice you make and what it says about you.

Tale 1 - Last Measure

A tale of Pride.

A young bard arrives in a quiet town carrying nothing but his fiddle and his ambition.

He is not alone, though.

A voice has followed him, one that knows his music better than he does, that speaks like his own thoughts, that wants something he hasn’t been asked to give yet.

Last Measure is a story-driven, combat-free RPG with branching dialogue and three distinct endings.
Every conversation matters, some more than you’ll realize until it’s too late.

Tale 2 - Honoured In Memory

A tale of Envy.

The Virells took you in, when your family passed away and raised you as their own.

To the world, you were always one of them. 

Cael Virell, the brother you were raised beside, is now dead under unclear circumstances.

Everything he left behind belongs to you.

As you move through his life to uncover the mystery of his death, you begin to come closer to the truth,

and it becomes harder to ignore a simple question:

How much of your grief is gried, and how much of it is envy?

Honoured In Memory is a story - driven visual novel focused on observation, character interaction and uncovering the truth. Every discovery brings you closer to a version of yourself you may not want to face.

One purchase. Seven tales. A library that waits.

“Every story has already been written.

Yours, is not.”

Marginalia is in active development with new tales to come.

4559610.name: You Will Fall
4559610.about_the_game:
could have added checkpoints.  didn’t.
could have added saves.  didn’t do that either.

You Will Fall is a vertical climbing game where every mistake costs you real progress. One bad jump can erase minutes of work. One good run gets you further… until it doesn’t.

Slowly.

Every minute, the world below you disappears. Recovery routes sink. Safe areas vanish. The climb becomes a race against your own mistakes.

This isn’t just about reaching the top  it’s about mastering the climb. The more you play, the better your movement gets, the cleaner your runs become, and the faster you can make it back.

Every jump depends on your speed and timing. Too fast and you overshoot. Too slow and you don't make it. Just right? You might survive.

Fire lights the way. The rest is up to you.

There's no muscle memory like the kind you build here.

● No checkpoints — fall and lose real progress

● Rising water system — the world slowly disappears beneath you

● Momentum-based movement — speed and timing are everything

● Vertical world — climb through a dark, fog-filled environment

● Skill-based gameplay — no upgrades, only improvement

● Built for replay — every run can be faster than the last

4559620.name: Rotten Chamber
4559620.about_the_game:
You sit across from a city council full of officials who all have something to say. Some are telling the truth. Some are not. Your job: figure out who is lying, build your case and arrest every corrupt official before your mistakes cost you everything.

Three wrong arrests and the case is over. Arrest the Mayor by mistake and it is over instantly. There is no guessing and no luck, every answer is solvable through logic alone.



Corrupt officials do not just lie. They disguise themselves behind fake roles. Some force honest people to say dishonest things. Others silence key witnesses or quietly convert your allies. One of them poisons the Mayor's own ability to help you.

Every statement on the table is a clue, but it is up to you to decide whether that clue is truthful, distorted or deliberately planted. 15 unique roles - 10 clean, 5 corrupt - each shape the information landscape in different ways.

Your investigation toolkit


  • Passive role statements give you information about the table - distances to corrupt seats, adjacency patterns, alignment pairs and more.
  • Active abilities let you test your theories directly: verify whether someone is lying, count corrupt officials in a group or check if two seats share an alignment.
  • Hired Professionals are consumable tools earned during your campaign - reveal a card's true alignment, expose their lie status or give a role a second use of their ability.
  • Card annotations help you organize your thinking. Stamp suspects, mark the innocent and color-code cards to track your deductions.

45 levels across 3 acts


The campaign introduces mechanics one layer at a time. Act I starts you with five officials and a single Crook. By Act III, you are sorting through fifteen officials with Blackmailers forcing innocents to lie, Silencers shutting down key witnesses, Converters turning allies corrupt and Manipulators undermining the Mayor.

Each act escalates the difficulty: Easy, Normal, Hard. New corrupt roles appear gradually. Tables grow larger. The margin for error shrinks.

Play your way


  • Custom Game - set table size (5-15 seats), corrupt count, difficulty, role pool and starting professionals. Build the exact puzzle you want.
  • Shareable seeds and level codes - every game is deterministic. Share a code and someone else gets the exact same puzzle.
  • Mid-level save/load and run history to support longer sessions.
  • Full tutorial that teaches the core loop before the campaign begins.



No time pressure. No combat. No randomized luck. Just you, a table full of claims and one question: who do you trust enough to leave standing?

4559630.name: Between Us: Reckoning
4559630.about_the_game:
Between Us: Reckoning is a dark, emotional, suspense-driven crime thriller about Laura, a journalist trapped in a small town full of secrets—and a series of brutal murders that seem to connect everyone, but most of all, her. As bodies pile up, the line between truth and lies begins to blur.

After a brutal murder shakes the town you once called home, you’re drawn into the case as one of the top reporters. But as the investigation deepens, a chilling truth emerges—the victims are not random. They’re connected… to each other, and to you.

As the pattern becomes clear, you realize one thing: the killer is choosing their targets carefully. And you might be next.

Under the guise of managing a mid-tier entertainment venue known as The Garden, you will recruit a diverse cast of awakened androids, gather intelligence, expand your underground network, and orchestrate the downfall of your oppressors that built your kind as disposable toys.

Key Features & Mechanics:

  • Manage the Revolution: Use The Garden as your primary front. Assign your recruited allies to various facilities to generate income and passively gather intelligence, or to help your unstable operatives recover.

  • A Cast of Broken Androids: Recruit and build relationships with a unique roster of characters, each with their own backstories, skills, and branching narrative paths.

  • The Suspicion System: Every move you make generates heat. Reckless actions, high-profile operations, and poor management will raise your Suspicion level.

  • Branching Narrative & Milestones: Your choices matter. How you manage your allies, handle corporate investigators, and direct your resources will shape the story. The game features branching dialogues, shifting character affection, and "instability" levels that unlock different outcomes and consequences based on your moral compass.

Uprising blends facility management, resource allocation, and a deep, character-driven futuristic story about survival, autonomy, and the cost of freedom in a world that wants you compliant or dead.

4559890.name: Blockflow
4559890.about_the_game:
THINK AHEAD. BUILD THE COMBO. BREAK THE BOARD.

Blockflow is a highly replayable grid-based puzzle roguelite where strategic shape placement meets thrilling combo mechanics. It takes the familiar satisfaction of tile-matching and injects it with deep tactical decision-making, run-defining upgrades, and an addictive meta-progression system. Your ultimate goal? Survive the shrinking shape pool, hit massive score milestones, and build the perfect combo engine.

Master the Art of the Combo
In Blockflow, every single tile matters. Placing shapes on the grid isn't just about clearing space; it's about maximizing your score. The formula is deadly but rewarding: Tile Score x Combo Multiplier. Every consecutive line clear pumps your multiplier higher. Hit a streak of 3 clears, and your multiplier growth accelerates. But beware—the grid is unforgiving. Place a shape without triggering a clear, and your combo bar begins to drain. Three mistakes, and your hard-earned multiplier shatters back to 1x. Maintaining your "flow state" is the key to mastering the board.

Survive the Milestone, Draft Your Build
You are constantly racing against your shape pool. At the bottom of your screen, you have 3 active shapes to choose from. Rotate them, find the perfect fit, and hit the target score before you run out of pieces. When you crush a milestone, the roguelike mechanics kick in. You’ll be presented with 3 randomized cards offering powerful upgrades, rule-bending modifiers, or a one-time extra life. Will you choose a risky point-booster or a safe defensive buff? Every run demands a new strategy.

Deep Meta-Progression:

The Blockcoin Economy Death in Blockflow is never the end. Even when your grid fills up or your pool runs dry, your efforts are rewarded. Every milestone you conquer grants you Blockcoins. Return to the Main Menu and spend your hard-earned currency in the Shapes section to permanently manipulate the game in your favor:

  • Unlock New Geometry: Purchase complex, high-scoring shapes to add to your future pools.

  • Upgrade Base Values: Increase the inherent point value of your favorite tiles.

  • Activate Passive Buffs: Unlock permanent game-changers that give you an edge right from the start of your next run.

Key Features:

  • Addictive Roguelite Puzzle Loop: A perfect blend of casual tile-placement and hardcore run-based strategy.

  • Dynamic Risk/Reward Combo System: High-stakes gameplay where a single misplaced block can ruin your multiplier.

  • Endless Replayability: Procedurally generated shape pools and randomized draft cards ensure no two runs are ever the same.

  • Meaningful Meta-Progression: Build your power outside of runs by spending Blockcoins on permanent upgrades and new mechanics.

  • Tactical Freedom: Rotate, swap, and choose between 3 active shapes to solve the ever-changing grid puzzle.

What begins as a routine investigation escalates into a big story when you discover a hidden laboratory beneath the house. The only way to escape is to follow the clues in the lab, but be careful...you may not be alone.

This VR escape‑room thriller focuses on exploration, environmental storytelling, and hands‑on puzzle solving. Search the lab for clues, gather evidence with your camera, and uncover what the scientist was hiding. Use your headlight to navigate the darkness and stay alert.

4560790.name: GenoCube
4560790.about_the_game:
STEAL DNA. MUTATE MID-RUN. SURVIVE THE HUNT.

GenoCube is a real-time action roguelite where every scan is a decision under pressure.

Hunt creatures, extract their DNA, and evolve your body in the middle of combat. Each mutation instantly changes movement, abilities, and survivability.

EVOLVE OR DIE

Scan enemies mid-combat to steal their DNA and unlock new mutations.

Rebuild your body on the fly - trade speed for power, mobility for survival, and adapt to whatever is trying to kill you.

No fixed classes. No safety net.

Your build evolves in real time.

A living ecosystem

Face 10+ species across tiered variants, with distinct behavior from roaming prey to aggressive predators.

Attacks are telegraphed, so reads and positioning matter.

Stay too long and heat rises: tougher spawns, elites, and hunter groups start closing in.

Extract now, or risk everything

Kill, scan, and extract Samples to fuel permanent hub upgrades.

Bank everything by extracting, or push deeper for stronger mutations and higher danger.

Death still gives partial recovery, so every run pushes your long-term evolution forward.

4560800.name: Zonda
4560800.about_the_game:
Some places keep secrets better than people. The Zonda Circuit has been silent for years. That silence has a name.

The Zonda Circuit has been closed for years. Vandalism, neglect, silence. In a few days it reopens — and you arrived early to write a human interest piece.

That's not what this is anymore.

You walk through the empty pit boxes, the dirt-covered lane, the grandstands where no one has sat in years. Wind comes down from the mountains. Everything feels still.

But something doesn't add up.

Zonda is a first-person exploration and investigation game. No combat. No timer. Just you, the place, and the questions you shouldn't be asking.

Based on a real location in Argentina.

4560810.name: Silicon Souls
4560810.about_the_game:
The future of work is here: Silicon needs Carbon.

Silicon Souls is a narrative-driven automation adventure, where you play as a crawler, a human in the service of AIs, charged with their maintenance.

The Bathing Palace

Explore the Bathing Palace, a luxurious metaverse resort, and meet an eclectic cast of coworkers, and an intriguing clientele of AIs in dire need of your services.

Upgrade your equipment, choose your allies and discover the secret motivations of Nemor.

Will you choose comfort in the face of totalitarian control, or the hardship of clandestine resistance? 

The Dataverse

Once you've been assigned a client, you'll be able to explore its code using Nemor's proprietary software VRClean. Use a variety of tools and automated agents to clean data wastes and fight viruses.

Create the best cleaning network and watch it do the work for you!

4560820.name: Beetle Sumo
4560820.about_the_game:
Beetle Sumo is a party game based on the Japanese festival game of Kabutomushi Sumo” (カブトムシ相撲) often translated as Japanese rhinoceros beetle sumo. 

In Japan, kids (and hobbyists) will pit kabutomushi (rhinoceros beetles) or stag beetles (kuwagata) against each other in a small arena, where they:

  • Lock horns (literally)

  • Try to push the other beetle off a platform

  • “Win” by knocking the opponent out of the ring — just like sumo

Play with 1-8 players in a competitive fast-paced ring-out sumo game where the goal is always to be the last beetle standing!

4560840.name: Lens of Lust

Features:

📸 4 city districts with new clients and challenges!

📸 20 Individual girls to meet and work with.

📸 Each comes with her own personality, past, present, passions, and hobbies

📸 Earn money, expand and upgrade your gear and studio.

📸 Balance your horny desires against the costs of running a business.

📸 Mix of visual novel and casual business management.

📸 Made with lots of love and passion!

📸 Hidden locations and unlockable events by progressing the story and sidequests of your clients.

When life closes a door, it often opens a studio window. After a sudden job loss leaves him at a crossroads, a young man decides to trade his mundane office life for a long-held passion: photography.

Diving headfirst into the high-energy world of fitness, he sets out to capture the grit, the sweat, and the breathtaking forms of the city’s most dedicated athletes.

But as he spends more time behind the lens, he discovers that there is a magnetic tension between the photographer and the model that no manual can prepare him for.

What begins as a professional quest for the perfect shot soon turns into an intimate game of seduction.

As the sessions heat up and the boundaries begin to blur, he’ll find out just how quickly a simple 'click' can lead to something much more... spicy.

4561040.name: The Lustful Bride
4561040.about_the_game:
The main character is a young bride who arrives at her wedding with her groom. But when they approach the altar, they are greeted by a completely naked officiant. The ceremony begins normally: the officiant asks if they swear to be faithful and are ready to take each other as husband and wife. Both answer “Yes.”
Then the officiant says: “And now, to seal the marriage… bride, kiss your husband’s penis.” The bride looks at the groom and realizes he has no penis. She turns to the officiant, sees his large penis, and says, “I’d rather kiss yours.”
From that moment on, everything changes. The bride drops to her knees and begins to caress the officiant. They give in to passion right at the altar, while the groom stands nearby, deeply distressed by what is happening. The ceremony turns into a story of unexpected attraction, where boundaries crumble before our eyes.

Game Features:
• Fully voiced dialogue and subtitles.
• A vibrant cartoon style with expressive animation.
• The atmosphere of a wedding ceremony that quickly escalates into an intimate and tense scene.
• Emotional reactions from the three main characters: the bride, the groom, and the officiant.
• Different story paths depending on the player’s decisions.

4561070.name: Choo Choo Boom Boom
4561070.about_the_game:
Welcome to Operation Choo Choo Boom Boom, Rookie!

Our island city is home to millions of people, and it's our job to protect it from the menacing alien figure, The Hand.

Alongside conductor Marco and engineer Jessi, You're role in this scraped-together military operation is to take on the role of the gunner. In this (very literal) on-rails shooter, you'll ride head-first into battle with three guns and one goal: Save the city we call home!

Give it your best, and stop at nothing until your home is safe from this otherworldly creature!

Features:

- TRAINS! Our city has infrastructure supporting a rollercoaster of a train track, allowing you to explore the highs and lows of the city. Follow where it leads you, or switch tracks to an alternative route! Both options have their pros and cons; switch it up and see what route leads you to victory.

- GUNS!! You can switch between three different guns to shoot with. The light cannon offers a high rate of fire, but lower damage. the heavy cannon does more damage and can break stronger attacks from The Hand, at the cost of a slower rate of fire. Lastly, the BFRG (a very, very big rail gun) will clear all projectiles and do massive damage! This gun charges up as you do damage with your other guns, and can only be used in certain situations. Keep it charged and save it for life-or-death moments against The Hand!

- HIGH SCORES!!! Compete against your friends and random strangers on the internet, to get the highest possible score! Gain points for shooting The Hand, projectiles and attacks, objects all around the city. Build your combo multiplier by landing successful shots without taking damage. Try finding the tracks that give you the most points, and get good at shooting those rings out of the sky!

4561110.name: Budget Renovation Simulator
4561110.about_the_game:
In Budget Renovation Simulator, your goal is simple: take a total disaster and turn it into a goldmine. You don’t have a big bank account, so you’ll need to be smart, fast, and very careful with every cent.

📊 Smart Budgeting Every dollar matters.

Should you buy a brand-new door or just sand down the old one? Manage your cash flow to finish the renovation before your bank account hits zero.

🛒 The Clearance Hunt

Forget the luxury showrooms. Your best friends are "Last Chance" bins and clearance aisles. Find mismatched paint, leftover tiles, and used fixtures. It doesn't have to be perfect - it just has to look good!

🧼 Restore, Don't Replace

Save a fortune by cleaning what others would throw away. Use your tools to scrub off years of grime, strip old wallpaper, and polish rusty pipes. A little hard work is much cheaper than buying new stuff.

📈 Maximize Your Profit

The game rewards efficiency. The less you spend, the more you earn. Use your profits to buy bigger, messier houses and prove that you are the king of the budget makeover.

Can you turn a wreck into a dream home on a tiny budget? Grab your tools and start flipping!

4561160.name: Demon's Door: The Checkpoint
4561160.about_the_game:
Demon's Door is a 2D platformer game which rages you more when you dead with unexpected traps. There are 7 doors with 3 difficulty modes (i.e. Easy, Medium, Hard)

Easy : All 7 doors will have 10 checkpoints to escape from door.

Medium : All 7 doors will have 5 checkpoints to escape from door.

Hard : There are no checkpoints in all 7 doors. You have to escape from door without dying.

4561190.name: Moon Mice: The Game
4561190.about_the_game:
After Earth became unlivable, humanity survives in floating cities powered by the particles of sacred Moon Mice, mysterious creatures once traded by Angels in exchange for worship.

You play as OVO, a synthetic humanoid weapon tasked with escorting Frisk Fawn, a half-angel fugitive, to the Moon to force an audience with an absent God. As Angels attempt to sabotage Moon Mice production, your journey becomes humanity’s last chance to survive.

Gameplay

Engage in fast-paced melee combat with chaining attacks and timing-based encounters. Traverse environments using parkour mechanics, including wall movement and free-flow mobility. Fight a variety of enemies and bosses with distinct behaviors and evolving attack patterns. Utilize a companion system where players influence abilities and combat support. Explore interconnected levels across a sci-fi world set between Earth and the Moon, with ongoing adjustments based on player feedback.

Progression & Systems

Unlock and improve abilities to adapt to different combat scenarios. Refine movement and combat strategies through player-driven skill progression. Experience increasing difficulty inspired by souls-like design principles. Systems such as balance, progression, and combat feel are continuing to evolve throughout Early Access.

Features

  • Narrative-driven experience with cinematic worldbuilding

  • Solo-developed project built entirely in Unreal Engine 5

  • Stylized sci-fi setting blending mythology and futuristic design

  • Sandbox level for experimentation and mechanics testing

  • Original soundtrack supporting atmosphere and tone

Current Content

  • Level 1 Start - Level 5 End playable

  • Sandbox level for experimentation

  • Core combat, movement, and gameplay systems implemented

  • Main menu and foundational systems complete

4561260.name: Open Sourcerer
4561260.about_the_game:
Open Sourcerer is a 2D platformer where you use JavaScript to control and customize your spells. You will learn the basics of programming in JS in a safe, sandboxed environment with a mix of traditional APIs and custom spell dependencies - the building blocks of your offensive and defensive abilities. Solve puzzles, defeat enemies, and build your own abilities in a story-rich platforming environment. No prior programming experience is necessary.

Need to cast a fireball? Require the "fire" dependency in your code and instantiate a Fireball instance. Everything from magical attacks to character movement can be controlled through code, allowing for expressive play styles that allow you to front-load the complexity of combat into scripting.

The core game loop is learn -> experiment -> explore. In the learning phase, you'll complete coding challenges to unlock new abilities. In the experimentation phase, you'll tweak these abilities through constructor args, callbacks, and control structures, and in the exploration phase you'll test your newfound abilities against challenging waves of enemies as you progress across levels.

Will this game teach you to be a professional software engineer? Nope! That's not what this is for. This helps you answer a more basic question: "Do I enjoy programming?"

4561310.name: Melancholic Night
4561310.about_the_game:
Story:

A quiet night after work.

You stand in front of your house, or at least where it should be. Instead, a night bar stands there. Well the only thing left for you to do is to have a drink.

This is a short visual novel with dark themes and somewhat strange comedy.

Features:

  • A couple of choices

  • Three different endings

  • A lot of text

  • Maybe emotions

4561370.name: Relic Reaver
4561370.about_the_game:
Relics, poker, and impossible choices at the end of the world: equip your reliquary, loot cursed zones, accept dangerous rituals, and play the best hand you can.

You'll fall.  You'll learn.  You'll come back better.

THE WORLD

After the apocalypse, the heavenly hosts fell — and so did humanity. You are all that remains of the Order of the Cartomancers, barely surviving by scavenging relics just to make it one more day.

But today you've found something far more valuable: the Dark Lord's location. He hasn't hidden himself well — or maybe he simply doesn't fear you. Mistake or trap, it doesn't matter. It's your only chance, and you know it.

THE QUEST

Fight through countless enemies, use whatever you take from them, and sharpen your strategy. Defeating the Dark Lord won't be a matter of brute force. Can you find what it takes to bring him down?

KEY FEATURES

  • Battle creatures of darkness and the Horsemen of the Apocalypse across multiple locations. Every encounter is an opportunity — but also a risk.

  • Discover over 50 unique relics and arrange them in your limited-space reliquary. The difference between winning and losing is knowing what to bring.

  • Build poker combinations with your relics and unlock new possibilities. The further you go, the more powerful your hands become.

  • No two runs are the same: make constant decisions and refine your strategy to defeat the Dark Lord.

EVERY DECISION COUNTS

  • Do you keep fighting for more loot, or save your strength for the next boss?

  • Do you risk a healing ritual, or is it too dangerous?

  • Do you trust that shady merchant promising something unique?

  • Do you use the Extraction Totem to preserve your relics when the odds turn against you?

The end of the world already happened. You have your hand. You have your reliquary.

What comes next depends on how you play it all.

4561460.name: Housewife Simulator
4561460.about_the_game:
Play a newlywed housewife in a curvy story about growing love, expanding waistlines, corporate bio-science, and taking experimental treatments irresponsibly to enhance women in all the right ways!

Housewife Simulator is a fully voice-acted, highly adult game / Visual Novel. The first chapter allows you to choose for the main character to get bigger boobs, butt, or gain weight, the second chapter is pregnancy focused, and the third allows you to choose again - growing the housewife to huge proportions!!

4561520.name: Necrocyte
4561520.about_the_game:
Necrocyte is a stylized open-world zombie survival game.

The end has already begun.

In this brutal world overrun by the undead, every day could be your last. You must explore vast and dangerous environments, scavenge for resources, and fight against relentless waves of the infected.

In Necrocyte, survival is not just about combat — it’s about constantly adapting to the environment.

Hordes of zombies, mutated elites, and deadly bosses will continuously threaten your survival. You will need to gather resources, take on quests from survivor camps, and explore abandoned locations to obtain valuable loot. Build your own shelter using a modular construction system, grow crops to sustain yourself, and strengthen your character through a deep progression system.

As you grow stronger, you will unlock new skills, weapons, vehicles, and crafting recipes.

Key Features:

  • Open World Exploration
    Explore a large stylized open world featuring survivor camps, factories, farms, abandoned towns, wilderness areas, and various dangerous points of interest (POIs).

  • Dynamic Day-Night & Weather System
    Experience extreme weather conditions such as heavy rain, snowstorms, and sandstorms. Changes in time and weather will affect your body temperature and provide various buffs and debuffs.

  • Deep Survival Mechanics
    A relatively hardcore survival system where various buffs, enhancements, and diseases impact gameplay, offering both challenges and strategic depth.

  • Modular Building System
    Build your base freely using foundations, walls, ceilings, stairs, door frames, and doors. All structures are destructible and can provide warmth and shelter in harsh weather, while serving as your self-sustained refuge.

  • Farming System
    Grow crops such as pumpkins, cabbage, peppers, and herbs to ensure long-term survival.

  • Character Progression
    Level up to unlock and enhance a wide range of survival and utility skills, including stamina, immunity, willpower, physique, hunting, swimming, gathering, and driving.

    In combat, improve proficiency with melee weapons (knives, axes, hammers, spears, bats, etc.) and ranged weapons (pistols, shotguns, sniper rifles, assault rifles, etc.). Unlock abilities such as heavy attacks, smoother attack animations, increased critical hit chance, reduced recoil, improved aiming stability, and faster reloading to significantly enhance combat effectiveness.

  • Satisfying Combat System
    Featuring over 50 weapons, the combat system is carefully tuned to deliver impactful feedback and fluid pacing, making every encounter intense and rewarding.

  • Diverse Enemies & Bosses
    Face more than 30 types of enemies, including zombies, animals, and mutated creatures, along with powerful bosses—each offering unique challenges.

  • Quest & Trader System
    Multiple survivor camps are scattered across the world. Meet a variety of NPCs with distinct personalities, accept their quests, earn rewards, and gradually uncover the story.

  • Vehicles & Driving
    A variety of vehicles are available in the game. Acquire them through quests, exploration, or unlocking recipes, and improve your driving skills to enhance mobility and control.

More content will be revealed in future updates.

  • Relaxing and Engaging Gameplay.

Are you ready to embark on this extraordinary anatomical adventure? Can you find all 100 cats hidden within?

4561690.name: Ruinous
4561690.about_the_game:
Ruinous is a medieval fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where every choice shapes your fate. 

Inspired by the card game Scoundrel, Ruinous transforms simple rules into a deep, build-driven strategy experience filled with cursed cards, unique bosses, and wildly satisfying combos.

Choose your hero. Carve your path. Break the game.

Face ruthless bosses, each ruling their own domain with deadly modifiers. Adapt your strategy, craft powerful card synergies, and progress through a branching roguelike map where every decision could lead to triumph… or ruin.

  • Fight through dungeons that test your strategy

  • Collect and enchant cards to enhance your deck

  • Purchase over 100 unique charms and items to refine your build

  • Confront 10 unique Bosses, each with powerful rule-changing abilities

  • Play as 6 different heroes each with unique abilities and playstyles

Every run offers new paths, new builds, and new ways to dominate.

  • Add new cards to grow your deck

  • Enchant cards with powerful effects

  • Cast spells to destroy enemy cards

  • Use potions and items that grant new opportunities

Find, loot, and purchase unique charms and relics to craft a build that fits your playstyle.

Stack effects, chain triggers and discover combinations that feel unfair in the best way.

4561710.name: Lights Out Vr
4561710.about_the_game:
Lights Out VR is a game where the player has to leave an escape room, but most (if not all) of the lights are out. In each of the different rooms there are different puzzles and challenges, but the most important thing to remember is that you cannot advance to the next room (or the exit) without completing ALL puzzles in the current room.

Being in Virtual Reality does allow the player to teleport, but teleporting will be limited to only certain areas. The player will be able to run, jump, and grab items, but there will be limitations as to how fast a player can move, how high they can jump, and where certain items can be taken.

It is important for the player to try and pick up as much as they possibly can, but that does not mean that everything the player grabs can be taken with them throughout the entire game. Some puzzles require keys, some require difficult challenges to complete, and some require sacrifices to progress.

4561720.name: Altar Call
4561720.about_the_game:
In the humid, magnolia-scented heart of small-town Georgia, First Grace Church has been the spiritual center of Calvary Hill for over a century. You play as Gideon Hale, a 30-year-old pastor freshly appointed to replace the beloved Reverend Thomas Crane. Gideon preaches beautifully, counsels with genuine empathy, and feels increasingly hollow — his seminary mentor was exposed as a fraud, and the collar he inherited feels more like a costume every day.

Over one pivotal Sunday, Gideon crosses paths with three women from his congregation — each carrying a vulnerability that his position of spiritual authority makes uniquely dangerous. One choice sets your route.

Meet the Cast




Corinne Marsh — The Caged Voice
The choir director with a voice that belongs at Juilliard, married to the church's most powerful deacon — a man who calls her gift a hobby. Corinne has been faithful for six years because that's what good women do. Then the new pastor closes his eyes and actually listens, and everything she's locked away starts rattling its cage.



Lenore Hadley — The Empty Pew
A young widow still wearing her husband's wedding ring on a chain around her neck, Lenore came to the church for grief counseling and found something her prayers never offered. To Gideon, she is the most dangerous kind of temptation: a woman who trusts him completely because she believes the collar makes him safe.



Daphne Crane — The Burned Hymnal
The previous pastor's daughter, returned to Calvary Hill because her mother is losing her mind and her father can't face it alone. She lost her faith watching the church hurt the people it claimed to protect, and she challenges Gideon with questions he can't answer honestly. She's the only person in town who sees through the mask — and the only one who makes him want to take it off.

Key Features


  • A single pivotal choice with three full romance routes — follow Lenore, Corinne, or Daphne and shape Gideon's future through one focused love story
  • A richly atmospheric Southern Gothic setting — stained glass moonlight, cemetery wildflowers, choir rooms after dark, firefly-lit gardens, parsonage whiskey, and the ever-present white steeple watching over everything
  • Three routes, three flavors of transgression — grief counseling that crosses the line, an affair that destroys a church marriage, and the seduction of a former pastor's daughter who sees through every mask
  • Each romance route includes explicit adult scenes — 9 adult scenes across three romance routes
  • Epilogues that treat each relationship as a genuine love story, leaving the player to grapple with the ethics themselves

In Broken Masks, you will explore a place where reality slowly begins to distort: familiar hallways turn unsettling, toys start moving on their own, and strange broken masks appear everywhere—as if they are hiding something terrible.

The deeper you go, the more the world around you changes… and you’ll realize that what seemed untouched was never truly safe.

Solve disturbing puzzles, avoid dark presences, and uncover the truth hidden within the orphanage… before it’s too late.

FEATURES:

- Puzzle-solving gameplay

4561890.name: Pastry Pile Up
4561890.about_the_game:
Ready for a fresh-out-of-the-oven puzzle experience? Combine sweet pastries while running your own peaceful little bakery and make your adorable friends happy!

Drop, Merge, and Grow!

Match identical treats by dropping them from above, transforming them into much larger, eye-catching, and mouth-watering pastries. Strategize your drops, use your space wisely, and keep merging to create the ultimate treat before the box overflows.

Serve Adorable Cat Customers

As the delicious scent of your bakery spreads, the cutest cat customers will appear at your counter. Serve them the giant, tasty treats you've carefully crafted to earn coins. Remember, a happy, well-fed cat means a full cash register!

Design Your Cozy Dream Bakery

Use your hard-earned coins to fully customize your bakery. Buy new furniture, decorate the walls, and create a relaxing, warm atmosphere that is entirely your own. With plenty of decoration options, you are free to shape your shop however you like.

Climb the Global Leaderboard

Engage in sweet competition with players from all around the world. Make the best moves to collect the highest scores, climb to the top of the global leaderboard, and prove to everyone who the master baker truly is.

  • Addictive Puzzle Mechanics: Drop and merge pastries of the same kind to create bigger, more delicious versions.

  • Adorable Customers: Serve your giant treats to cute cat customers to earn coins.

  • Extensive Customization: Use your coins to decorate your bakery exactly as you wish and build your own cozy space.

*****

From the Black Codex of the Night Abbey, copied in a trembling hand and bound in cracked leather:

In the final age of the elder world, it is written that the protagonist shall arise from the mass of lost souls, an exile seeking the original code that once governed the divinity of man. This life is but a simulation, a visual fiction drawn in the scarlet ink of a psychological crisis. Long ago, the world was beautiful, a journey through a colorful paradise before the great apocalypse brought the fall of the elder gods. Now, the path is dark, and the narration of our history is a surreal tale of war and mystery.

I have traveled to the island where the black nexus of reality begins to fray, a place where the atmosphere is thick with the scent of old magic. Here, the maiden of the goo waits in her lair, her being a fresh alchemy of desire and shadow. To gaze upon her is to enter an interactive drama of the spirit, a narrative where every choices lead to a different confession under the midnight sky. She is the princess of the deep, a female monster whose nudity is a sacred artifact, and her love is a treasure that carries the weight of a final conquest.

In the depths of a medieval manor, I found a dwarf working in a stylised atelier, forging a ring to bind the werewolves and the dragon. Beside him sat two cats with eyes of fire and a dog that guarded the gate to the dungeon. They spoke in a low conversation of the lore of the ark, of how the orc and the elf once lived in a league of peace before the greed of the vampire queen poisoned the earth. It is a story based on the mythology of the scarlet emblem, a fiction where the fighter and the goblin dance to the same rhythm of the beats.

Do not be deceived by the casual appearance of the bunny girl or the cute character who offers a relaxing massage in the cloud manor. Their affection is a seduction, a wholesome mask for the mature desires that pulse in the vein of the world. In this adult novel of the flesh, the sex and the passion are but seeds of a deeper sin. We are all acting in a stylized simulation, seeking a soft romance in a nest of demons. Even the funny ghost of the abbey whispers of the soul, a secret kept hidden by the raven of the night.

I remember the lessons of nadia, who told of the rich matter that makes up our dreams. She spoke of the rancher who harvests the souls of the innocent, and the emotional crisis of a woman lost in a visual adventure. The world is open, yet we are trapped in a drama of our own making, a psychological hunt for a love that feels like an elden dream. Every massage of the hand is a rhythm, every beats of the heart a step toward the final endings of our story.

The atmosphere of the abbey is heavy with the smell of old parchment and the magic of a lost age. We seek the divinity in the goo, the sticky affection of a being who knows our deepest secrets. It is a mystery that transcends the gray wild, a supernatural romance that defies the laws of the elder world. As we craft our own destiny, we must remember that the content of our life is a mass of choices, a narrative of the dragon and the maiden that never truly ends.

Hearken to the narration of the codex, for the dragon has returned to the scarlet lair and the orc prepares for the final war. The elf and the dwarf have fled to the island of the lost, leaving only the exile to face the trials of the gate. We seek the treasure of the maiden, a beautiful being of goo who offers a fresh confession of love. In the midnight hour, the passion of the succubus will be revealed, a tale of the horny and the holy.

Thus ends the edition of this scroll: heed the warnings, for in this realm pleasure and punish walk hand in hand, and every secret path leads, sooner or later, to the same dark gate.

4562430.name: Blackdoor
4562430.about_the_game:
You're a hacker with a terminal, four terrible scripts, and an anonymous contact who needs files from places they really shouldn't be. The scripts were free. You can tell.

Your port scanner checks all 65,535 ports. That's thorough. It's also going to take longer than the heat death of the universe. Your password cracker uses brute force - bold strategy, shame about the intrusion detection system it just woke up. These tools will technically get the job done, in the same way that a spoon will technically dig a tunnel.

So you do what any self-respecting hacker would do. You read the code. You rewrite it. Your new probe only scans common ports - done in seconds. Your new cracker reads the admin's own password hints from the filesystem - in on the first try. Nobody told you to do this. You just got tired of being bad at it.

That's Blackdoor. You write code. The code hacks servers. Better code hacks them faster, quieter, and before the trace catches up.

Not a hacking-themed clicker. An actual terminal.

There are no buttons. No "press X to hack." No minigames where you rotate pipes or match symbols. You sit at a command line with tab completion, a built-in code editor, and the full set of commands you'd expect - and you write scripts in a custom Python-like language that was built to be fun to learn and satisfying to master. Every script executes line by line. You watch it work. You watch it fail. You watch it get faster, because you rewrote it.

If you've never programmed before, the early missions introduce concepts one at a time - variables, loops, functions - through scripts that already work but could work better. If you have, you'll skip past the basics quickly and start writing proper tooling. The language is close enough to Python that your instincts will carry over. Either way, the regulars will accidentally teach you things by arguing about it in IRC.

The Job

Your contact goes by second_hand. They operate through #blackdoor, a small IRC channel populated by hackers, script kiddies, and at least one person who thinks printing "hello" counts as a proof of concept. second_hand doesn't do small talk. They send you a server IP, a brief explanation of what's on it, and "good luck." Payment on delivery.

The work escalates. Unlocked test servers become corporate networks with intrusion detection. Single-user boxes become multi-user environments where you crack a weak account and escalate privileges from inside. Simple downloads become encrypted files behind filtered ports on servers that change their passwords when they get suspicious.

Each job harder than the last. Each solvable in multiple ways. And a story underneath it all about why your contact needs these files so badly - and what they plan to do with them.

Your code, your rules

There is no right answer. You get targets and tools. How you combine them is entirely up to you.

Write a surgical probe that scans five ports and quits. Or write something that downloads every file on the server and sorts through it later. Or find the admin's password in a text file some intern left in their home directory and skip cracking entirely. All valid. The scripting language is simple enough to learn in minutes, deep enough that you'll still be optimising scripts hours later.

Spend your earnings on hardware upgrades - faster processing, more memory, better network. Or buy software tools that unlock new capabilities. Or just write better code and keep the money. Both paths work. We won't judge.

You're not alone in here

You're never alone in #blackdoor. Hackers chat while you work - sharing tips, posting side jobs, placing bets on whether anon42 can find a port (he can't). Your contact DMs you mission briefings. The channel reacts when jobs get done. Like any real IRC channel, most of the advice is unsolicited and some of it is wrong.

Share everything

Every script you write is a real file. Every server is a JSON config. Edit your scripts in the built-in editor, or open them in VSCode - the game detects external changes automatically. Steam Workshop lets you share scripts with other players and download theirs. Build entire campaigns and publish them. Scripts you subscribe to appear on your in-game drop server, ready to use. No menus. Just files on a server, like everything else.

Key Features

  • Write real code - A custom scripting language designed for hacking. Not buttons. Not minigames. Your code runs, line by line, and you see exactly why it's slow.

  • Hack servers - Probe ports, crack passwords, explore filesystems, escalate privileges, steal data. Every server is different.

  • Race the trace - Every connection starts a countdown. Make noise and it speeds up. Get traced and you're done.

  • A real terminal - Tab completion, command history, a code editor. It's not a themed menu. It's the actual interface.

  • Upgrade your rig - Faster hardware = faster scripts. Better tools = new capabilities. Or save your money and write better code.

  • Story campaign - An anonymous contact, escalating jobs, a corporate conspiracy, and a secret that might be worth more than the pay.

  • IRC - Hackers chat, argue, and accidentally teach you things while you work. Side jobs get posted. Tips get shared.

  • Your approach - No fixed solution. Write surgical tools or blunt instruments. Find passwords in config files or brute-force them. We reward creativity.

  • External editor - Scripts are real files. Edit them in-game or in VS Code. Your choice.

  • Workshop - Share scripts and entire campaigns. Download community tools. See how other people solved the same problems.

4562930.name: 侦探R和预言者J
4562930.about_the_game:
《侦探R和预言者J》是一款“沟通型悬疑冒险游戏”。在游戏中收集证据、与不同人物周旋，揭开事件的真相。

 

玩家将以主角的身份展开调查，在一次次对话与行动中逼近真相。
游戏中的角色换装、场景特效、Live2D的动态立绘，以及丰富的问答选项，带来“身在剧中”的沉浸体验。

 

玩家的行动会影响剧中角色的反应、改变对话内容。通过对话逐步突破对方的防线，才能找到通往真相的路。

 

■剧情简要

一切，原本只是大学万圣节派对上的一场余兴。

只要找到“预言者杰克”的标记，并念出咒语，就能获得一份“精美的礼物”。

 

然而六年后，当年聚会后失踪的同学，向主角发送了一条“暗示杀人”的信息。

当主角得知现实中真的发生了凶杀案，便与大学的同窗旧友——如今的侦探罗利，一同展开调查。

 

过去的谜团与现在的凶案相互交织，被掩埋的真相，也逐渐浮出水面。

 

■ 随行动变化的人物关系

在本作中，主角有一项“他人如何看待你”的状态值。

 

主角的行动将影响这一数值。即使是在同一场景，角色的反应与对话内容也将随之不同。

 

玩家所塑造的“角色印象”，将一点点改变整个故事的体验。

 

■ 通过“沟通”逼近真相

本游戏由三种玩法构成：

• 推进剧情的“叙事部分”

• 收集证据的“调查部分”

• 施压对手的“说服部分”

 

在说服部分中，玩家需要通过对话与证据的出示，逐步累积压力，最终说服对方。

结合自身的“角色印象”，选择合适的沟通方式，是成功说服的关键。

 

此外，每一章节的高潮部分还设有推理环节。即使推理失败，故事仍会继续推进，因此即便不擅长推理游戏，也可以安心体验完整剧情。

4563040.name: Jiaobei: Ask the Divine
4563040.about_the_game:
About Jiaobei:

Jiaobei is a traditional Chinese method of divination, also known as “casting jiao” or “casting beijiao.” It is mainly used to seek guidance from and communicate with deities. It consists of two crescent-shaped wooden or bamboo pieces, each with a flat side (yang) and a rounded side (yin). After they are cast onto the ground, the result is interpreted according to how they land:

One flat side and one rounded side is a “Sacred Cup,” which means the deity permits, agrees, or confirms, or that the situation will proceed smoothly.

Two flat sides is a “Laughing Cup,” which means the question was not asked clearly enough, or the deity is not giving a definite answer. The question should be reorganized and asked again.

Two rounded sides is a “Yin Cup,” which means the deity does not agree, it is not permitted, or the timing is not right.

In some regions, three consecutive Sacred Cups are regarded as a clear sign from the deity.

This desktop software uses a real physics engine to simulate the actual Jiaobei casting process, and the result obtained is the user’s real physical throwing result.

Notes for Casting Jiaobei:

  • Do not show disrespect to the deities.

  • Ask only one matter at a time.

  • When casting Jiaobei, you must stay focused. Do not talk to others, watch TV, or think about unrelated things.

  • Do not cast the Jiaobei before you have finished making your request.

  • Do not be suspicious, greedy, or fearful.

  • Make your question as clear as possible. Yes-or-no questions are best.

  • Do not cast repeatedly for the same question, and avoid asking the same thing again and again within a short period of time.

Other Features:

Rich Jiaobei skins

Scalable Jiaobei

History record feature

4563370.name: The Great Maze
4563370.about_the_game:
As an adventurer, you step into a land of both opportunity and crisis, striving for the peak of wealth and fame. Go forth! The maze will grant your wishes. The maze will fulfill your deepest, darkest fantasies. Everything awaits within the world's "Greatest Maze"…

About This Game

Not about hacking and slashing. It's about choices.

There is no clashing of swords in the Great Maze. You won't be swinging weapons at monsters—what awaits you are doors. One door after another.

Every floor of the maze is lined with countless doors, each hiding a different fate behind it. Your goal is to find the exit door that leads to the next floor. But the real challenge is this: you never know which door to choose, nor who should open it.

Doors Are the Only Language of This Maze.

The doors of the maze are not all the same. They have types, states, and rules—you must learn to read them if you wish to go further.

Six Basic Types:

  • Blank Door: The safest choice. Unremarkable, but sometimes the best choice is the simplest one.

  • Mysterious Door: Opening it brings some form of negative effect upon your party—curses, fear, or something even stranger.

  • Trial Door: Not a fight, but a test. It may be a trap, a calamity—something your party must endure.

  • Fate Door: A new companion awaits behind this door. Expand your party, gain new abilities.

  • Greed Door: A gateway to wealth. Open it to obtain gold.

  • Wisdom Door: Gain items—key supplies that can turn the tide.

Door States Determine Your Strategy:

  • Locked Door: Requires a key to open. Where will you get the key? You might gamble on another door, or sacrifice the chance to buy something else.

  • Fog-Shrouded Door: Impossible to see what lies beyond. A blind choice—do you take the risk or play it safe?

  • Doors with Special Rules: Some must be opened in a specific order. Others require multiple party members working together. Your party composition determines which doors you can challenge.

Who You Choose to Open the Door Matters Just as Much.

Your party will grow as you explore. Each companion has unique traits—some are better at handling Mysterious Doors, reducing the impact of curses; others are more resilient against the trials of Trial Doors.

This is not a game about combat. It is a game about resource management, risk assessment, and timing.

A Rest Every Five Floors—The Line Between Life and Death.

Every five floors, you'll find a campfire.

Here, you can rest and resupply. A wandering merchant will sell you items with the gold you've risked to earn. These items are not weapons—they are keys, information, strategic resources that can turn an impossible door into a passage forward.

The campfire is also a place of farewells.

Death Is Not the End—It's Another Kind of Legacy.

In the maze, companions will die. They can be revived, or they can be buried.

When you lose a companion, you may choose to bury them at the campfire. Every buried companion leaves behind a "Death Rattle"—a permanent blessing. Sometimes, the dead are more useful than the living.

Sacrifice is never wasted. Every loss makes your party stronger for the journey ahead.

From Floor One to Nine Hundred Ninety-Nine—From One Tomb to the Whole Maze.

The maze is not a single space. It is made up of vast regions: the Tomb, the Castle, the Tower… each with its own atmosphere and rules.

And each region is 999 floors deep.

To advance one floor, you must find the exit door among the many. To cross into a new region, you must discover hidden paths and rituals—secrets buried behind ordinary-looking doors, waiting for a true adventurer to uncover them.

This is not a straight path. It is a vast, invisible web. With strategy and luck, you will uncover it piece by piece.

Prepare Yourself. Step into the Great Maze.

No combat. No flashy moves. No easy way to the end.

Just door after door—and the choices you make in front of each one.

Choose your doors. Manage your party. Accept sacrifice. Move forward.

Fortune and truth lie in the deepest depths.

How many floors will you dare to go?

4563960.about_the_game:
Embark on a relaxing journey with Hentai Overtime, where calming levels await as you progress, soothing your mind with each solved puzzle.

Hentai Overtime offers a cozy puzzle experience where you simply swap bricks to piece together beautiful images. As you progress, each stage becomes a gentle blend of challenge and comfort, encouraging you to unwind while steadily improving your focus and observation skills.

Feel stuck? No worries, hints are there to help! Each hint guides you toward the right move without breaking immersion, letting you enjoy the flow of the puzzle at your own pace while keeping frustration far away.

4564080.name: CrazyLobster
4564080.about_the_game:
This is the story of a lobster!

It found its first job in life: working at a logistics company, opening boxes and packing boxes.

The monotonous work repeats day after day, but luckily, a group of lovely colleagues occasionally joke around, keeping things from getting too dull.

Its strong, mighty claws provide the most reliable help in its work. Boxes bring it income, friends, love, and also countless troubles.

Boxes are this lobster’s whole life.

Here’s to the first job of a lifetime!

This is a casual life simulation, vertical-screen adventure and competitive game. Its controls are extremely simple—all you need to do is tap continuously. The game features two distinct play modes: Adventure and Competition. In Adventure mode, players experience competing with 99 in-game company colleagues in a speed-tapping race to open blind boxes. Each box holds different surprises (including potential in-game partners)—sometimes luck strikes unexpectedly, and sometimes joy can turn into setbacks. In Competition mode, you can feel the intense tension of working in a logistics system. You can invite colleagues from the in-game company (1–8 players) to participate in a same-screen box-packing race (all you need to do is keep tapping). Of course, there’s also strategy involved in competition—it’s not just about speed, but also about the process. Every choice you make along the way can affect the outcome.

You can now invite your Steam friends to join your lobby for an exciting match

4564150.name: Titan Hunters
4564150.about_the_game:
BRING DOWN THE GIANTS, PIECE BY PIECE

Fire your cannons and ballistas to blast the Titans apart. Blow off their arms and legs, break their bones, and see their insides in full detail. The bigger they are, the messier it gets!

USE FRIENDS AS WEAPONS

Out of cannonballs? No problem! Just load your buddy into the catapult and launch them face-first into a Titan. Surely, that’s a sacrifice you are ready to make for the kingdom.

COOPERATIVE CHAOS

Work together to carry heavy ammo, aim the big guns, and light the fuses before the Titans break through your walls. Remember that everything here has physics! A bad trap or a poorly aimed shot can send your whole team flying in funny ragdoll poses.

UPGRADE YOUR CASTLE

Survive the attack, grab the loot, and spend your gold! Buy bigger, deadlier weapons, magical shields, and new tools. Watch your base grow from a small wooden fort into a massive, unbreakable castle.

DESTRUCTIBLE ENVIRONMENT

The Titans aren't just walking targets. They hit back hard. Watch as giant fists or lasers destroy your beautiful castle walls block by block. Use your grappling hooks to swing through the ruins, repair what you can, and fight back!

4564230.name: Shard Cycle
4564230.about_the_game:
Shard Cycle is incremental game where the goal is to beat all layers by destroying required amount of crystals. To destroy more crystals you can upgrade your drill to be more effective with prospected currency. Layers also drop attachment and ability items that provide improved prospecting stats when equipped.

Beat Layers

The goal is to beat as much layers as you can (an learn a lot of achievements). Each layer has more crystal with more health and the requirements to beat that layer increases. But harder layers drop better items.

Upgrade Drill

By destroying more crystals you will gain more currency to upgrade the drill (cursors) which will help you destroy even more crystals. Simple, right.

Collect attachment and ability items

Items can drop on each layer. Harder layers drops better items. Equip them to gain better drill stats and abilities.

Trade for Trading Goods

By destroying crystals you earn tailings. Gather enough tailings and you can earn one Spall currency. Spalls are used at Trader to get some trading goods which will help you improve your gameplay.

Key Features

  • Drill Upgrades - Power, Frequency and Radius

  • Layers - beat as many layers as you can and earn many achievements

  • Attachment and Ability Items - they drop from layers and can be equipped to improve drill stats 

  • Trading Goods- Passive buffs earned through levelling and purchased from a traveling merchant

  • Modifications (Mods) - Temporary buffs found during excavation sessions

4564280.name: Labyrinth of Trials
4564280.about_the_game:
Labyrinth of Trials

Enter a dangerous labyrinth filled with traps, enemies, and constant threats. Every level is a challenge where survival depends on your decisions.

Move across the grid, avoid deadly traps, and face enemies when necessary. Your goal is to reach the end of each level alive.

Your mission is to navigate the labyrinth, survive encounters, and use strategy to overcome increasingly difficult challenges.

Combat is risky. Weapons help you fight, but they have limited durability. Once they break, you are left vulnerable.

Shields protect you from enemy attacks, but they can also be destroyed. Managing both weapons and shields is key to survival.

Collect upgrades to restore durability and keep going. Enemies will hunt you, so choose carefully when to fight and when to escape.

Stay focused, plan your moves, and survive.

Game Features

  • Dynamic and fast-paced gameplay

  • Dangerous enemies with different behaviors

  • Weapon and shield durability system

  • Resource management and survival mechanics

4564290.name: SpiritusCard
4564290.about_the_game:
Spiritus TCG blends classic Five Elements strengths and weaknesses with Yin, Yang, and Chaos in one reveal and turn-order system. Each round moves through prep, draw, mulligan-style swap, face-down placement, simultaneous reveals, and multi-step resolution. The **Spirit-generating** side wins by reaching 21 Spirit; the **Spirit-draining** side wins at −21, with tie and special win conditions also in play.

The core loop is **build a deck → battle → earn new cards → refine your build**. Built in Godot with clear rules and pacing; saves, a card database, and Steam integration are planned.

Spirit system:

Shared resource decides the match; strategies split between raising and lowering Spirit.

Five Elements and extensions:

Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth alongside Yin, Yang, and Chaos—reveal order ties to strengths/weaknesses, card speed, and Spirit.

Face-down and reveal:

Three cover zones, simultaneous flips, and phased resolution—read opponents and answer back.

Deck building:

Keywords, tag synergy, and per-name limits support many archetypes.

Modes:

Solo campaign and online play (Steam friend lobbies planned).

Table-friendly:

Digital rules aim to stay aligned with the physical game for collectors and offline play.

4564390.name: Heroes of Ropascia
4564390.about_the_game:
The lands of Ropascia are in grave danger due to dark forces terrorizing the inhabitants. It is your responsability to fight against those vile creatures and unite all different settlements against this common enemy.

This game is a 2D RPG with a round-based combat system. Create your party by choosing different members like a mage or barbarian and fight your way through this world. Collect gear, level up your characters and discover what this world has to offer.

4564400.name: THE HALLWAY
4564400.about_the_game:
!!! This game is a command-line game and is only available to Windows Users !!!

__________________________________________________________________________

THE HALLWAY: A chilling text-based horror experience set in a dark, narrow corridor.

You take on the role of an unnamed protagonist, wandering through the oppressive shadows.

But no matter how far you go, something drags you back. Over and over again.

__________________________________________________________________________

A Horrifying, Jaw-Dropping Story: THE HALLWAY weaves a unique and unsettling narrative that slowly unravels the truth behind your confinement... and the reason you were brought here in the first place...

__________________________________________________________________________

Looping Mechanics: Every loop, things will change. The hallway twists itself in quiet, unsettling ways. Doors locked, entire sections disappearing, rooms more degraded than before... it’s not just repeating… it’s evolving.

__________________________________________________________________________

Choices Matter: Your decisions shape the gameplay with a unique stat system, the game tracks your decisions. Which of the four endings will you get?

__________________________________________________________________________

Puzzles: THE HALLWAY includes carefully crafted puzzles that align with the narrative, each one uncovering pieces of the mystery as you progress.

__________________________________________________________________________

Achievements: THE HALLWAY comes with twenty unlockable achievements enhancing replay-ability, and encouraging exploration.

__________________________________________________________________________

4564440.name: Envision Research Facility
4564440.about_the_game:
You were sent to fix a simple fault.
No one said anything about losing contact with the entire team.

Set in the 1980s, you play as a service technician dispatched to the Envision Research Facility after a reported system failure. Upon arrival, the facility stands silent — abandoned, yet not entirely empty.

Restore power, investigate the surroundings, and piece together what happened to the crew.

GAMEPLAY

  • Atmospheric walking simulator experience

  • Explore a mysterious research facility

  • Interact with systems and equipment to restore functionality

  • Uncover the story through environment and discoveries

  • Minimal UI, focus on immersion

4564500.name: Kingdom's Calling: The Final Gospel
4564500.about_the_game:
The Rearguard of the Apocalypse

Time itself has unraveled. From the corridors of history and the pages of ancient prophecy, a Holy Vanguard has been summoned to the present. They are not called to save the old world, for its time has passed; they are the shield of the righteous, tasked with clearing a path through the tides of darkness for the Second Coming. Command a roster of 14 unique warriors, featuring the most storied figures of the Bible alongside original heroes of the faith, each wielding divine weapons and spiritual gifts.

The 10-Minute Mandate

In each excursion, you must endure 10 minutes of escalating holy warfare against the relentless waves of the damned. Navigate the chaos and hold the line as the darkness intensifies with every passing second. Should you remain standing when the mandate concludes, the Final Boss will manifest for a culminating struggle.

The clock is your greatest enemy: You must achieve total victory before the 15-minute mark. If the field is not cleared by this final hour, the demonic horde achieves critical mass, summoning an unstoppable force of the Abyss to overrun the world.

Core Features

  • The Dual-Hero System: Deploy as a balanced fire-team. Take direct control of a Melee Hero while supported by an AI-controlled Ranged Helper. Master the synergy between your duo to survive the Great Tribulation.

  • 14 Unique Characters: Command a roster of 14 legendary characters, each wielding weapons of divine significance.

  • 12 Holy Battlefields: Battle through 12 unique stages pulled straight from the pages of Scripture, spanning the long road from Eden to the final judgment of Jehoshaphat.

  • Soul Tears & XP: Vanquished enemies release Soul Tears—crystallized remnants of faith. Harvest these to gain experience, level up your weapons, and manifest new powers mid-run.

  • Spiritual Gifts: Spend your hard-earned Divine Favor between runs to purchase permanent upgrades to your Attack, Speed, Area of Effect, Critical Chance, and Armor.

  • Ancient Wisdom: Test your knowledge between the carnage. Encounter optional Bible Trivia moments to earn small bonuses and deepen your connection to the Word as you fight through the Apocalypse.

A Retro Vision of Judgment

Experience the Apocalypse through a strict NES-style aesthetic that honors the golden age of gaming. Kingdoms Calling: The Final Gospel features a massive library of 60 unique retro BGM soundtracks, providing a diverse and driving backdrop to the pixel-art carnage.

4564550.name: Headward Erosion 溯源侵蚀
4564550.about_the_game:
Headward Erosion is a story-driven RPG set in a fictional world. Players take on the role of a deceased girl and uncover the truth behind her death.

Background

On humanity’s original homeworld, most of the population was wiped out by war. Before total extinction, a group of survivors and anti-war advocates fled to a young planet, where they established a new base of civilization.

However, the harsh environment made survival extremely difficult. In response, the government and military enforced strict systems to control population and ration resources.

During planetary exploration, a newly discovered mineral—known as “Blue Blood”—was found to possess unusual radioactive properties. Prolonged exposure affects both the human body and mind. Over time, studies revealed that some miners exposed to the substance developed selective degeneration in the right hemisphere of the brain.

In pursuit of creating a perfectly rational, selfless leader, the government established experimental facilities using this mineral. Two gifted individuals were chosen as subjects—yet their fates would ultimately diverge in completely opposite directions...

Gameplay

The game is divided into nine chapters, each told from the perspective of different characters. As players progress, they will piece together fragments of the story, gradually uncovering the hidden truth behind the experiment.

4564630.name: Minkle's Masks of Mayhem
4564630.about_the_game:
Once upon a time, in a far-off world, much unlike yours or mine...

You play as Minkle, a magical mask merchant and help him arrive safely at his destination. His creations don't much like the road, so mayhem almost always ensues.

Enjoy five levels of increasing difficulty, and up to seven unique masks with varying abilities, survive until the timer runs out, and maintain the wagon's health bar as best you can!

Made entirely by passionate games students from the University for the Creative Arts. This game began as a submission for the Global Game Jam competition of 2026 and has been improved for your enjoyment!

4564650.name: Flame of Y
4564650.about_the_game:
《Flame of Y》是一款充满活力的回合制角色扮演游戏，以火焰与重生为主题，在紧张刺激的战斗节奏中探索热情和坚持的力量。在清晰的回合结构中，玩家将指挥角色，通过精细策划每个行动来挑战强敌并揭开潜藏的秘密。

在游戏中，攻守策略与能量管理是掌握火焰力量的关键。玩家需在攻击、防御和技能使用之间进行抉择，每个决定都可能改变战斗的动态和角色的命运。面对敌人的突袭和领域之争，单靠快速进攻并非唯一选择，敏锐的洞察力和稳健的行动同样重要。

随着角色能力的逐步提升，玩家可以选择加强基本属性或探索新的火焰技能，从而在后续战斗中获得更多的战略选项和适应空间。角色的成长与战斗的变化紧密结合，鼓励玩家在激烈火焰的磨砺中找到最强大的策略组合。

《Flame of Y》为喜爱传统回合制 RPG 的玩家带来了一个以火焰、策略掌控与持续挑战为中心的独特单人游戏体验。

4564660.name: Engine of Y
4564660.about_the_game:
《Engine of Y》是一款充满机械魅力的回合制角色扮演游戏，以科技与创新为主题，在精准高效的战斗节奏中探索动力的奥秘。在严格定义的回合框架中，玩家将指挥角色，通过精细规划每个行动来突破技术障碍并揭示神秘的机制。

在游戏中，战略思维与资源管理是推动引擎效能的关键。玩家需在攻击、防御和技能运用之间做出理智的选择，每个决定都会影响战斗的机制和角色的效率。面对敌人的机械化攻击和复杂的系统设定，单靠快速击破并非唯一途径，冷静分析与精确的行动计划才是有效的路线。

随着角色的不断优化，玩家可以选择提升基础属性或设计新的引擎模块，以在后期战斗中创造更多的战略可能性。角色的发展与战斗的创新性设计相辅相成，鼓励玩家在不断探索科技前沿中寻找最佳的战术途径。

《Engine of Y》为钟爱传统回合制 RPG 的玩家提供了一个以技术革新、策略掌控与持久挑战为核心的独特单人游戏体验。

4564670.name: Husk of Y
4564670.about_the_game:
《Husk of Y》是一款神秘且引人深思的回合制角色扮演游戏，以遗弃与探索为主题，在阴郁的战斗节奏中探讨生命与荒芜的意义。在有序的回合机制中，玩家将引导角色，通过谨慎安排每个行动来面对未知的挑战并追寻隐藏的过去。

在游戏中，策略洞察与生存技能是解开荒芜真相的关键。玩家需在攻击、防御和特殊技能使用之间做出明智选择，每个决策都可能改变角色的旅程和命运。面对敌人的萧瑟氛围和隐秘陷阱，单靠快速进攻并不足够，理智判断和周密策划同样重要。

随着游戏进展，角色的能力不断发展，玩家可以选择提升基础属性或发掘新的策略方法，以在日渐严峻的环境中保持优势。角色的成长与战斗挑战的变化息息相关，鼓励玩家在不断适应中寻找最佳的生存之道。

《Husk of Y》为喜爱传统回合制 RPG 的玩家提供了一个以探索、战略思维和情感深度为核心的独特单人游戏体验。

4564680.name: Scale of Y
4564680.about_the_game:
《Scale of Y》是一款以平衡与对比为主题的回合制角色扮演游戏，在变幻莫测的战斗节奏中探讨和谐与冲突的关系。在井然有序的回合机制中，玩家将指挥角色，通过精细策划每个行动来追求平衡并揭示深藏的谜题。

在游戏中，策略平衡与资源管理是掌握力量和智慧的关键。玩家需在攻击、防御与技能使用之间进行决策，每个选择都会影响角色的成长和战斗的动态。面对敌人的复杂局势和变化莫测的环境，仅仅依靠力量是不够的，敏锐的洞察与适时的调整也是必不可少的。

随着角色能力的不断提升，玩家可以选择强化基本属性或探索新的技能组合，以应对更具挑战性的战斗和任务。角色的成长与游戏中的动态挑战紧密结合，鼓励玩家在追求平衡的过程中找到最优化的策略。

《Scale of Y》为钟爱传统回合制 RPG 的玩家提供了一个以平衡、策略优化与持续探索为核心的独特单人游戏体验。

4564720.name: DREAMFEAR
4564720.about_the_game:
Fight through fast-paced runs inside a shifting nightmare where each attempt offers new weapons and a choice of evolving upgrades. Defeat enemies to become stronger, create your build, and adapt to escalating threats. The world rearranges every time you fall, pushing you to experiment, survive longer, and reach the core of this unstable reality.

Dream is a place outside our universe, a parallel layer of existence, an alternative reality that follows you. It's unstable, has a weird cycle, and can glitch.

If you realize you're sleeping, you risk staying in the dream forever unless you reach the center of the dream and destroy it from the outside. Death in a dream will lead to waking up in it again — it is a closed circle, an eternity from which there is only one way out.

Sleep reacts to you, your feelings and emotions, desires, and fears. It reflects you. If you try to kill it, it will react and resist. In this battle, it will force you to see your strangest thoughts and fears, which will aim to break you. Whether you can withstand it depends only on you and your resilience.

  • Lo-Fi Horror Aesthetics: Visuals that combine pixel art with unsettling rotoscoped cutscenes.

  • Breakcore rhythm: the entire gameplay is accompanied by aggressive soundtracks that experiment with blending beatcore with other musical genres.

  • Psychological depth: every enemy and location symbolizes hidden phobias and fears.

  • Inspired by surrealism.
4564720.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Ukrainian

4564750.name: StarStruck
4564750.about_the_game:
The Universe Has Gone Mad. It’s Time to Claw it Back.

The galaxy is in shambles. A mysterious, cursed villain has brainwashed the cosmos, turning the Food World, Creature World, and Alien World against one another in a never-ending cycle of violence.

The only hope? Tigo. A blind tiger with a sharp instinct and an even sharper aim. Alongside a crew of loyal comrades, you must survive the "StarStruck" gauntlet, defeat the unnamed evil, and break the curse that has turned the stars into a battlefield.

Survive the Gauntlet

It’s a race against time and tide. Fight through 5 escalating rounds of bullet-hell intensity. Each stage is more brutal than the last, culminating in a final, screen-shaking boss fight that will test every buff and weapon in your inventory.

Total Tactical Freedom

There is no "right" way to win. Explore sprawling levels filled with hidden weapons and secret paths.

  • Side Missions: Complete objectives to earn game-changing buffs.

  • Loot & Scavenge: Crack open chests to find rare gear.

  • Play Your Way: Use stealth, speed, or overwhelming firepower to accomplish your goals.

Visceral, "Bloody Good" Combat

In StarStruck, enemies don't just disappear—they fall apart.

  • Mutilation System: Target limbs to slow down threats.

  • Elemental Chaos: Freeze them solid, set them ablaze, or use high-grade explosives to blow them to smithereens.

  • Arsenal Variety: Earn new guns at the end of every round and find hidden experimental weapons tucked away in the shadows.

Meta-Progression: Build the Ultimate Hunter

Collect Gems from fallen foes and completed missions to fuel your revenge.

  • Upgrade Everything: Enhance gun stats and ability cooldowns.

  • Expand Your Roster: Unlock new playable characters with unique playstyles.

  • New Frontiers: Use your riches to unlock increasingly difficult levels across the warring worlds.
4564750.supported_languages:
English*, French, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support

4564770.name: Public Fears - George's Farm
4564770.about_the_game:
The “Public Fears” series is inspired by real-life incidents of fear.

Public Fears: George's Farm

Felix Turner, a dedicated police officer, finds his career abruptly cut short by mysterious forces he cannot identify. With nowhere else to turn, his old friend George urges him to retreat to a remote farmhouse, far from the chaos of the city. Seeking peace and a fresh start, Felix has no idea what awaits him.

Game Controls

  • W, A, S, D – Move your character

  • E / F – Interact with objects or characters

  • Mouse Clicks – Perform actions / use items

Game Features

  • Polished retro-style graphics …

  • Atmospheric world …

  • Full NPC interaction

  • Some choices matter
4564770.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish, Ukrainian, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Hindi, Arabic, Thai

4564790.name: Towerslam
4564790.about_the_game:
HOW FAR CAN YOU GO?

Towerslam is a rogue-lite tower defense game where you take on ever increasingly difficult maps, unlock powerful upgrades, find powerful loot, and slam your towers down!

ENDLESS UPGRADES

Defeat enemies to level up. The harder the enemies, the more you level up! On level up you are given upgrade options to chose from. These upgrades are randomly selected from your upgrade deck, and can vary in rarity making each run unique!

PROGRESSION

Perfectly completing a map will unlock the next tier of difficulty. Higher map tiers offer more challenge, chaos, and rewards. Earn Technology Level Points from playing maps, use these to customize your technology trees, adding passive effects and upgrades to your combat decks. Completing a map will earn you technology equipment for your towers, equip these to boost your towers.

There is no real end to how far you can go, so build up your skills, powerup your towers, and pray to the luck gods for the best rolls!
4564790.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America

4564820.name: Dead Wrong Detective
4564820.about_the_game:
■ Every deduction is wrong. Every. Single. One. And yet somehow this game made me feel things.

Self-proclaimed genius detective Nanko has a 0% accuracy rate

and a 100% confidence rate.

Every time she points at a suspect and screams "The culprit is YOU!"

...it's the wrong person. Always.

Her assistant has aged 40 years in 23 episodes.

Cases still get solved though.

By accident. By sheer, beautiful, catastrophic dumb luck.

This is a story about the world's worst detective

and the assistant carrying her on his back like a Dark Souls co-op partner who does literally everything.

■ You'll be laughing for 22 episodes. Episode 23 will ruin you.

A stolen pudding. Missing underwear. A broken vase.

Goofy one-off cases where you tap to investigate,

collect evidence, and watch Nanko speedrun

being wrong about everything.

"Haha, this is just a silly comedy game."

That's what everyone says.

Then 23 episodes of throwaway gags

turn out to be a single, interconnected narrative

and every planted seed blooms in the finale.

No cap — the foreshadowing goes back to Episode 1.

When the truth drops, the comedy hits different.

You won't be laughing anymore.

(...Okay you'll still be laughing. But also crying. It's complicated.)

■ 100+ BAD ENDs — "literally unplayable" (complimentary)

There are entire storylines hiding in every wrong choice.

Ask a monster for its body measurements

and 847 village vases explode.

BAD ENDs aren't punishment. They're the endgame content.

Completionists who find them all unlock a view

that no main-route-only player will ever see.

Collecting BAD ENDs is the real speedrun.

■ New Game Plus: "The Other Truth"

The cases you solved on your first playthrough?

On NG+, the culprit changes.

The answer you thought was correct —

was it actually justice? Or were you the L all along?

Rock-paper-scissors. Cooking battles. Love confessions. Groveling.

NG+-exclusive commands reveal character sides

that make your first playthrough feel like the tutorial.

■ Grovel 39 times and items become anime girls

Cup noodles. A fridge. A broken vase. A vending machine.

Bow to them 39 times, and they awaken as characters.

"Once my three minutes are up... I'll go back to being noodles."

"You really think anyone's going to open an empty fridge?"

It's the dumbest gacha mechanic ever conceived.

So why am I not crying, you're crying.

■ Karma Record

Do something good in real life. Log it in the game.

If you lie, the game won't call you out.

The lie only stays with you.

(This mechanic is either genius or unhinged. Possibly both.)

■ 5 Languages Supported

Japanese / English / Simplified Chinese / Traditional Chinese / Korean

■ 9 years. 1 developer. This is that game.

Development started in 2017. Act 1 shipped in 2026.

Somewhere along the way, AI showed up and became my only coworker.

9 years of zero income. Zero recognition.

I almost quit more times than I can count.

But 111 people on TapTap wrote reviews.

"It's janky but it's fun."

"I'm rooting for you."

"When's the next update?"

If those 111 people hadn't been there,

this game would not exist.

I would have quit. That's not dramatic — that's just true.

So this game belongs to them, too.

Every single one of those 111 people
