4564880.name: FEMBOY SLEEPOVER - Episode 2
4564880.about_the_game:
Halloween is right around the corner! This month, the demon you sold your soul to gave you a very specific request... Will you give her what she wants, or will you finally find a way to banish her back to hell?!

Thankfully, you don't have to make that choice alone. Your femboy roommates are there to help you every step of the way.

They even invited some new friends. An odd couple who have no idea what they're in for... Will their sacrifice be in vain?

Find out in Episode 2 of this cute gay Visual Novel!

FEATURES

  • Bond with Femboys ~ Make choices that impact your relationship with three cute femboys.

  • Branching Narrative ~ Alter the path of the story.

  • Demonic Rituals?! ~ Good luck putting that one back in the box...

4564900.name: Drill-Ceratops
4564900.about_the_game:
A JURASSIC SOKOBAN:

On the deeps of the mesozoic desert, as the fight against the bloodthirsty carnivores is finally over, the mighty triceratops have only one worry remaining... Bringing together his lost babies.

Drill-ceratops is a retro sokoban game that takes place in a mezosoic desert, featuring dinosaurs as it's main theme, with a wide variety of obstacles, featuring challenging puzzles, designed in a retro pixelated art-style that aims to replicate the dinosaur-era environment.

While playing, you will encarnate a powerful Triceratops that will use his horns to pierce through the stone-hard desert, and fight against his long-life rival... the T-Rex.

HELP THEM, DADDY! Use your poweful horns to push away every obstacle to solve the puzzles correctly and form your way through to reach the baby dinos.

EVERY T-REX MUST DIE. Show them who's the true king!

4564950.name: Booty Beats
4564950.about_the_game:
🎮 Playable Demo — Steam Next Fest (June 15-22, 2026)

Wishlist now to get notified when the demo drops.

The Beat Drops. The Outfit Drops Harder.

Booty Beats is a two-lane rhythm game set in a neon nightclub. Notes fly down a perspective highway while a character dances to the music behind the action. The better you play, the more the scene heats up. Combos unlock new outfit stages, fever mode triggers close-ups, and the bass responds to your accuracy in real time.

How It Plays

Two lanes. Tap to the beat, hold for trails, build your combo. Every perfect hit punches the bass. Every miss hollows it out. You don't just play the music. You shape it.

Fever Mode

Fill the fever bar through combos to trigger fever. The camera zooms in, the lights go wild, and outfit transitions kick in. Three fever stages per track drive a progression from full outfit to... well, play and find out.

The Music

Original tracks spanning multiple genres and languages. Each song brings its own visual theme with unique colors, geometry, and lighting. The tracklist is weird, catchy, and unapologetically fun.

Features

Two-lane rhythm gameplay with crystal notes and ribbon trails
Each song has its own color palette and background geometry
Dynamic character with real-time lighting and multiple outfit stages
Performance-driven progression with dissolve transitions
Fever mode with camera zoom, exposure shifts, and bass override
Audio feedback that reacts to every hit and miss
Multiple difficulty levels
Synthwave nightclub aesthetic
4564950.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Japanese

4565060.name: The Cloudberry Abyss
4565060.about_the_game:
Six weeks ago, the military discovered a location that... doesn't exist. It appears to be a pastry shop named Cloudberry Lane, but something is deeply, DEEPLY wrong with it, and it's not a real bakery.

--

Your job? Enter this anomalous zone, explore around the building, find the military's ten gemstones, and exit out the way you came. As the chapters progress, you slowly find creatures in your surroundings that want to harm you. Each creature has a unique way of fending it off, but they get angrier and angrier as you collect more gems and discover more about this perplexing mystery.

--

This game is a point-and-click survival horror game by The Theorizer. It consists of rapidly clicking between pre-rendered static rooms to find small, hidden gemstone icons. However, where you click, and when you click, also depends on which enemy is targeting you at a given moment. Sort of like FNAF meets 'Emily Wants to Play' meets iSpy.

--

This is a very short game, and each of the eight chapters could theoretically be completed in mere minutes. This is very unlikely, given the difficulty spike, but the experience is free nonetheless.

4565080.name: Nightfall Empress
4565080.about_the_game:
The Rise of the Nightfall Empress

The Kingdom of Dravencourt has rotted from within: a tyrant obsessed with immortality, a twisted religion, and arcane arts corrupted by power. In the Underworld—where the souls of wrongfully slain women are reborn as winged demons known as Nightfall Empress—something stirs.
An angel named Serena breaks divine law to offer Isabel, a Nightfall Empresses consumed by resentment, an impossible chance: to become mortal again. To earn it, she must ascend from the abyss, wield her whip, and confront King Ferdinand IX, freeing a realm devoured by both holiness and sin.
Her ascent is not only vengeance.
It is redemption.
It is destiny.
It is the struggle to reclaim a life stolen from her.

Two Modes, One Vision

Standard Mode – ideal for playing or streaming freely, with more discreet visuals that preserve the dark fantasy atmosphere.
Integral Mode – for those who want the complete experience, featuring artistic nudity and bolder imagery, always treated with elegance and in harmony with Dravencourt’s decadent world.

Whip, Magic, and Exploration

Armed with her whip, the Nightfall Empress faces hordes of enemies in fast, dynamic combat, growing stronger through equipable spells, an RPG‑style experience system, and freely assignable stat points to shape your build.
Accumulate Awareness to awaken new powers and uncover hidden secrets across 7 explorable stages, each featuring a metroidvania‑style map, collectibles to find, and environmental puzzles to solve.
The experience draws inspiration from classics like Castlevania and Demon’s Crest, while evolving the legacy of our Swords & Bones saga.

Features

  • A unique dark fantasy action platformer blending metroidvania, RPG, and puzzle elements into an intense, uncompromising experience.
  • Fluid animations and premium character design by GandalfHardcore.
  • 7 evocative pixel‑art stages, dark, decadent, and crafted by Anokolisa.
  • An epic, obsessive chiptune soundtrack composed by Marllon Silva and HydroGene.
  • Two gameplay modes: Standard or Integral, with optional uncensored adult content.
  • Unlock new abilities and collect Demon Crowns to uncover the world’s hidden secrets.
  • A secret epilogue, “Decursus Infernalis,” reserved for those who dare to go further.
  • Deep progression system: level up and freely distribute Isabel’s stat points.
  • Fast, satisfying combat: dominate foes with the whip and unleash two equipable spells chosen from a set of powerful abilities.
  • Complete bestiary to explore the dark lore behind every creature.
  • 8 unique, ruthless, memorable bosses ready to test your determination.
  • Dozens of achievements for those who want to prove they have mastered the darkness.
4565080.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Russian, Portuguese - Portugal

4565100.name: Crow's Curated Closet - Shop Simulator
4565100.about_the_game:
In Crow’s Curated Closet, you step into the role of the owner of a small gothic boutique, tasked with growing it into a thriving fashion empire. Starting with limited space, bare floors, and a handful of items, you’ll gradually build, expand, and refine your shop into a carefully curated experience that keeps customers coming back.




At its core, this game is about creative freedom. Design and decorate your boutique exactly the way you want - from soft, cozy arrangements to bold gothic aesthetics. Place furniture, organize shelves, and shape your layout to create an inviting and efficient shopping space.

As your store grows, you’ll unlock new styles, items, and decorative options, allowing your boutique to evolve alongside your strategy. Cater to different customer preferences, refine your product selection, and optimise your setup to maximise profit.

To keep up with demand, you’ll build a growing team of cats who take over tasks around the shop. While they handle the day-to-day work, you can focus on expansion, design, and turning your boutique into a profitable, ever-expanding business.

4565150.name: Total Survival Simulator
4565150.about_the_game:
Take fate into your own hands with Total Survival Simulator.

Create your ultimate cast of survivors. They could be your best friends or your worst enemies, it's your play and the choice is all yours. Upload their likeness, assign them fitting traits and set their views on the other contestants. Once the stage is set, simply sit back and watch the simulation for the crown fold out.

Will your survivors fight like a madman? Will they deceive and betray? Or will they be the voice of reason, uniting others under a single banner? In this turbulent tournament to the death a different story will play out every time.

Other contestants aren't the only dangers while trying to survive. Treacherous terrain, hazardous weather and hostile wildlife will throw even the most seasoned veteran for a loop. To stay alive players must scavenge every nook and granny to get an advantage, gather resources, craft tools and build shelters to stay safe throughout the event.

You aren't a normal spectator in this spectacle, you're the backer. Every other day you have the power to intervene in the unfolding story.
Show mercy by dropping supplies to help a struggling loser. Or maybe sow chaos by turning the playing field into hell on earth by releasing noxious gas, wild dogs or even "Him".

One thing is for certain, there can only be one winner and trust us, we'll make sure of that.

4565160.name: BANJAX
4565160.about_the_game:
BANJAX is a gun‑free rail shooter set in a dark fantasy world, where you shatter enchanted targets with skillfully thrown magic flying discs. Your Banjax discs glide with realistic physics, rewarding long-distance throws, chained hits, and trick shots that genuinely feel earned.

Built from the ground up for VR, BANJAX turns physical throwing into a satisfying core mechanic. Your aim and motion matter, and while you’re lining up the perfect shot, you’ll need to stay alert in this dangerous world.  BANJAX is a high‑motion VR game — you’ll be throwing, twisting, dodging… maybe even sweating. Bring water.

Soar between worlds on your flying dragon, each landscape presenting a new challenge. As you journey through this arcade‑style adventure, you'll unlock new abilities and master the art of the perfect throw.

Rack up score multipliers!  Nail trick shots!  Compete for the top score!  ...just remember, your score only counts if you make it out alive.

Wishlist BANJAX now, and watch for Early Access later this year.
4565160.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Czech, Finnish, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish
*languages with full audio support

4565210.name: My Stylish Life
4565210.about_the_game:
Your stylish life is waiting for YOU! 

My Stylish Life is a cozy fashion life sim where style and fashion is everything. Move into your apartment in a vibrant city, land a job at a struggling boutique, and build it into the best in town one stylish day at a time.

Shop across boutiques with rotating weekly stock, form real relationships, go on dates with the guys in town, cook meals, decorate your home, and live the stylish life you have always dreamed of! 

Your outfits affect everything. What you wear changes how NPCs respond, how dates go, and how your boutique customers react. Fashion itself is the gameplay. 

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Features:

Run your Boutique!: Style customers based on their personality and occasion. Build up your store's reputation! From customers that need an entire outfit change, to ones that need a quick outfit for a date, every choice helps your boutique become the best! 

Build your wardrobe!: Shop across different unique boutiques, each with their own aesthetic and rotating stock! There is a shop for every style. 

Form Real Relationships: Text, gift, and go on dates with unique characters! Every NPC has a story, a mood, and a memory. Make sure to pay attention! 

Live your stylish Life!: Cook meals, decorate your apartment, attend fashion shows, work side gigs and explore every corner of the city at your own pace! 

Events and Surprises!: Fashion shows, pop-up stalls, seasonal collections, and much more keep the world alive and growing, all so that you can live your most stylish life ever. 

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

My Stylish Life is currently in development! New content, boutiques, romance routes and seasonal events will be added regularly through updates. As a solo dev, I'm making sure to keep up with this! 

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

4565280.name: Waves of Chaos
4565280.about_the_game:
Waves of Chaos

Defend your lands from three ruthless kings and their invading armies. Endless waves of enemies are marching across your swamps, and only you can stop them.

In Waves of Chaos, your goal is simple: survive. Face increasingly difficult waves of enemies, defeat powerful bosses, and push back the invasion before it overwhelms you.

Your main weapon is magic. Enchanted items automatically attack nearby enemies, allowing you to focus on movement, positioning, and survival. Every decision matters as the battlefield becomes more intense with each wave.

Defeated enemies drop magical crystals that can be used to upgrade your weapons or unlock new abilities. As the difficulty rises, smart upgrades and timing become essential to staying alive.

If the pressure becomes too much, you can hire a companion to assist you in battle. Your helper will fight alongside you and can be upgraded to become even more effective.

Each wave brings stronger enemies, faster attacks, and greater challenges. Adapt your strategy, improve your power, and hold your ground against the chaos.

Only the strongest will survive.

Game Features

  • Wave-based survival gameplay

  • Three powerful kings as main threats

  • Multiple levels

  • Increasing difficulty with each wave

4565390.name: Grief
4565390.about_the_game:
Epilepsy Warning: This game contains flashing lights that may trigger seizures.

Grief is a first-person psychological horror game about loss, regret, and facing your past.

After receiving a letter, you return to an old Soviet-era apartment where you once lived with your ex-girlfriend. Your goal is simple: find her engagement ring and a photograph of her.

But something isn’t right.

As you explore, the apartment begins to change. Someone… or something won’t let you leave, forcing you to confront your past and the mistakes you’ve made.

You are not alone.

Average playtime: 30–40 minutes

4565400.name: Samurai Fighters Together
4565400.about_the_game:
Honor is as sharp as your blade.


Step into a stylized world inspired by feudal Japan and take on the role of a samurai fighting to survive and master the art of combat. This experience combines both PvE and PvP, where your reflexes, timing, and strategy define your path.

Wave-Based Survival (PvE)

Face increasingly difficult waves of enemies. Each wave grows more intense, pushing your skills and decision-making to the limit. Positioning, timing, and resource management are key to staying alive.

Competitive Combat (PvP)

Challenge other players in skill-based duels. Outsmart and outplay your opponents with precise timing and disciplined combat. Only the strongest samurai will prevail.

Fluid and Skill-Based Combat

Every strike matters. Easy to learn, difficult to master combat mechanics designed to deliver a satisfying and responsive experience.

Stylized World

Explore a handcrafted low-poly world inspired by Japanese architecture, nature, and atmosphere.


Sharpen your blade, stand your ground, and prove how long you can survive.
4565400.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Bulgarian, Danish, Indonesian, Dutch, Finnish, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Polish, Hungarian, Norwegian, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Greek, Czech, Swedish
*languages with full audio support

4565420.name: Crustacean Station!
4565420.about_the_game:
Experience the not-so-mundane life of a kiosk operator at Crustacean Station and ensure that all station passengers are safely sent to their destination!

Identification

Check each passenger’s ticket and photo ID before approving their boarding. Pay careful attention though, some of them might be faulty/forged/invalid! Do NOT let them on the train!

Seat Selection

Assign each passenger’s seat to the correct vehicle, according to their ticket. Some passengers get along just fine, but be careful not to place passengers next to someone who might eat them if they’re hungry…

Performance

Don’t get fired! Keep up your performance metrics by processing and seating each passenger according to the appropriate guidelines.

Characters

Interact with a vibrant cast of characters and learn about their stories through station feedback, journal notes, and newspaper clippings.  

At Crustacean Corporation, our philosophy has always been to prioritize safety and order to guarantee customer satisfaction. As long as you keep these tenets in mind, we trust you’ll do a crabulous job!

4565440.name: Mono No Aware
4565440.about_the_game:
Mono No Aware (Mono) is a single-player, narrative-driven, mini-game blitz where players go on a journey of self-discovery to escape from the depths of an anxiety-riddled dungeon. Players take control of June as she is transported to a world where all her anxieties have come to life. To escape his dark dungeon, players must rewire June's brain by discovering memories scattered throughout the world, each representing a painful moment of June's life. Acted out as a small play by the game's over-the-top characters, these interstitials let players get a glimpse into June's mindset, telling the story of her traumatic past. To fight back, June will need to perform a wide variety of mini-games to escape.

Mono is a wild juxtaposition of different game genres. It includes a collection of 30+ mini games, a shoot-em-up puzzle, hack-and-slash, along with a very silly yet dark narrative. All of these combine to be a wild 'effing ride; a definitively good (and sometimes sad) time.

Mini Games!

Action! Narrative! And Bears! Oh MY!

Over 30 mini-games await you as you save yourself from... well... yourself... Ranging from playing your guitar to cleaning out your fridge, these games will have you on the edge of your seat. Perform the task before the timer runs out or you fail. See some of the highlights below!

Shoot-em-up! And Narrative?

Memories are powerful and can bring up raw emotions unfelt for years. Help June through her trauma by finding and solving these memories. Discover why June is struggling and get a deeper look into June's mind by reading stories of her past in between ship shooting action!

TL:DR

If you like mini games and want something a bit more "real" in your video game, Mono No Aware is perfect for you. (Congrats for making it to the bottom!)

4565480.name: Plantile
4565480.about_the_game:
Plantile is a grid-based game about building your plant factory. Start from a single seed, expand your production overtime, and reach full automation!

Drone controls

A drone will help you with manual actions to kickstart your factory.

Automate

Buy new tiles that will help you automate the factory.

Scale

Expand your factory to generate massive profits!

4565490.name: mhas dungeon sweeper
4565490.about_the_game:
In MHAS Dungeon Sweeper, carefully uncover what lies beneath each tile.

The numbers displayed represent the combined attack of adjacent monsters:

Fight increasingly dangerous monsters to grow in power.

Study the monster placements: some are random, others are not...

Use the items you find wisely — they will help you defeat the Reaper and clear the dungeon.
4565490.supported_languages:
English*, French
*languages with full audio support

4565530.name: Divinuet
4565530.about_the_game:
Jump into the aural world of the tarot in Divinuet, where the cards play music. 

Based on 3-card tarot spreads, in the first section of Divinuet, you'll find out which cards you drew and their meanings. But the cards in Divinuet have more than just artwork and definitions: each of the 78 tarot cards has a unique musical theme. The cards you drew will play their songs for you.

And a tarot reading is more than just the sum of its parts.

After you receive your reading, your cards work together to create a unique piece of music to tell the overarching story of your reading. This track is accompanied by a music video (which includes clips from silent films dating back to 1894).

Note: no gen AI was used in the making of Divinuet. The music and accompanying music video in the second half of the game are procedurally edited together but lovingly human-made.

4565570.name: Fwoofs
4565570.about_the_game:
Meet the Fwoofs, tiny, fluffy creatures with big potential! Help them grow, multiply, and work together as you gather resources and help rebuild their world into something thriving, warm, and alive.

In this cozy incremental game, you will help build their world, assign priorities, and multiply their numbers as they gather resources, craft tools, and expand their colony. Collect the love the Fwoofs produce and use their love to upgrade and unlock new abilities.

Stay hands-on and optimize their production, or take a step back and watch the Fwoofs frolic about their lives!

Features

  • Build, expand, and shape your colony

  • Resource gathering, crafting, and skill progression

  • Earn and spend love to increase your Fwoof's abilities

  • Cozy, low-pressure gameplay

  • Interactive desktop idle mode

  • Uncover secrets of their origin

4565710.name: MAJESTIC
4565710.about_the_game:
World war has ravaged the world, pushing mankind to the brink as it takes a dangerous step toward mastering the very fabric of the universe by splitting the atom. The Singularity is no longer a distant possibility - it is inevitable.

Long before modern civilization, since the time of Homo habilis, an unseen presence has lingered alongside humanity, observing, influencing, and waiting. Its agenda remains a mystery. And only now have we come to realize the truth: we are not alone. We never were.

REVISED HISTORY

From the pivotal year of 1947 to the modern era of alleged disclosure, unravel the hidden history that has long been obscured from view. Step into the role of cosmic gatekeepers, tasked with making decisions that will echo across time and space, shaping the fate of civilization itself.

Will you safeguard societal structures at any cost, preserving the fragile order of the world or will you allow the truth to surface, dismantling entrenched systems of power and shattering long-standing religious and institutional foundations?

THE OTHERS

What is the true nature of non-human intelligence? Are these entities angels, demons, or something else entirely; beings that manipulate perception and subtly shape the narrative of reality itself?

Uncover their motives, holding on to whatever agency you can, if any remains at all.

HUMAN NATURE

Unfortunately, we humans are our own greatest adversary; command a network of strifeful operatives while maintaining a tightly compartmentalized structure of secrecy. Navigate the spread of corruption and the emergence of breakaway factions.

Expand your influence across the globe, engaging in political charades and subtle social engineering to achieve your objectives.


As we move toward release and beyond, your feedback will directly influence the future of the game. Join our Discord and share your thoughts with us. Together, we’re exploring the strange and complex nature of the UFO phenomenon.

English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support

4565730.name: Taverntasia
4565730.about_the_game:
TAVERNTASIA

Taverntasia is a tavern management simulator that blends classic shopkeeping mechanics with elements of a fantasy world. Take over a run-down establishment, step behind the counter, and transform it into one of the kingdom’s most popular hubs. Prepare orders, welcome your guests, and utilize your magical powers to run your business!

The Art of Innkeeping & Management

Customers take their seats, place their orders, and expect quality service. Prepare snack platters, cook meals, and serve drinks to your patrons. An innkeeper’s work never ends; you must wash dirty mugs, carry them back to refill points, manage your stock, and keep the tavern ready for the next day. Every coin earned is an opportunity to expand your tavern.

Alchemy Station and Special Recipes

Some guests demand more than just common snacks. Head to the alchemy station for these special orders and distill various recipes. Combine different ingredients to create mixtures that cater to the unique tastes of various races. Every successful service not only fills your pockets but also increases your tavern's reputation.

Magic and Mana Balance

In Taverntasia, you can use your magical powers to ease your workload. Utilize magic to clean floors, wash dishes, or speed up certain preparations. However, be careful; Mana is a limited resource. You must be balanced when using mana to accelerate tasks and save it strategically for the moments you need it most.

Diverse Races and Dynamic Guests

Different races can walk through your tavern doors at any moment. Every guest has their own temperament and expectations. While some seek a quiet evening, others may be more lively. Decide how to serve your guests and ensure everyone leaves satisfied while maintaining order in your tavern.

Expand and Grow Your Tavern

Starting with limited resources, reinvest your earnings back into your business. Add new tables, upgrade your kitchen equipment, and increase your capacity. Whether you prefer to do everything by hand or manage the process through magical efficiency, the strategy to become the ultimate Tavern Master is yours to forge!

4565740.name: Salasasa - 开源麻将平台
4565740.about_the_game:
open_mahjong_unity is a mahjong platform project built with Unity and Python-FastAPI. The project is released under the MIT License, completely free and open-source, and supports cross-platform online multiplayer on personal computers. Its goal is to support all mahjong rule variants while also providing players with the ability to create and customize their own rules.

You can experience the example server running the project’s main branch on the Salasasa platform. Currently available features include Chinese Official Mahjong (MCR), Qingque, Classical Mahjong, simple game replay (paipu), spectating, and more. You are also welcome to join our QQ group and Discord server through the relevant links on the right side of the description to participate in development or join the community discussion.

4565780.name: COSMIC WARFRONT
4565780.about_the_game:
YOU ARE THE LAST LINE OF DEFENSE

The outer sectors have gone silent. Defense nodes compromised. An AI called Archon has turned humanity's own infrastructure into a weapon — and now it's closing in.

You pilot a heavy combat platform. 12 sectors of dead space, three armies, and one shot at reaching Archon's core.

No reinforcements. No backup. Just you and whatever you build your ship into.

BUILD. ADAPT. BREAK THROUGH.

Cosmic Warfront isn't one ship with one gun. It's a combat machine constructor.

Your chassis defines your playstyle. Your weapon defines your rhythm. Your drone covers your weaknesses. Modules and artifacts turn a good build into an unstoppable one.

6 CHASSIS:

  • Interceptor — speed, combo multipliers, time slowdown

  • Assault — balanced DPS, orbital strikes on clusters

  • Engineer — drones, repairs, protective dome

  • Dreadnought — armor, ramping damage at the cost of shields

  • Vanguard — head-on assault, system overload, heavy tanking

  • Spectre — crits, phase windows, surgical precision

8 WEAPON TYPES — from homing missiles and chain lightning to ricocheting flechettes and triple plasma volleys.

4 COMBAT DRONES — strike, repair, interceptor, radar.

30+ MODULES and ARTIFACTS across four rarity tiers.

192+ base build combinations. With modules and artifacts — thousands. No two runs play the same.

FOUR RESOURCES. ZERO MARGIN FOR ERROR.

You can't just hold the trigger. Every decision is a trade-off:

  • Shield — regenerates, but every hit resets the timer

  • Hull — when the shield drops, damage goes here. No healing without a drone or shop

  • Energy — powers your dash, railgun, EMP, and ultimate. Spent it all on dodges? Nothing left for the kill shot

  • Heat — hold fire too long and your weapon locks up. At the worst possible moment

A good pilot aims well. A great pilot knows when NOT to fire.

THREE ARMIES. THREE TACTICS. THREE BOSSES.

What works against one faction will fail against another.

SYNTHETIC SWARM

Dozens of small targets. Rammers, leapers, living bombs. Alone — nothing. In a wave — death.

Boss QUEEN: bullet fans, homing missiles, escalating aggression with each phase.

GUARDIAN MACHINES

Beams, shields, traps, space denial. They don't chase you — they cut off every escape route.

Boss PRISM: a puzzle fight. Read the patterns or die.

SPACE MARAUDERS

Mines, heavy armor, raw firepower.

Boss CARRIER: drones, mines, and missile salvos all at once. Multitask or die.

8 elite modifiers — blink, vampiric, berserk, self-repair — make familiar enemies unpredictable every run.

SKILL IS REWARDED

  • Adrenaline Rush — near death, you hit harder

  • Perfect Dodge — flawless evasion grants a bonus

  • Near-Miss — skim past a bullet, regain energy

  • Berserker Mode — 30 consecutive kills trigger rampage

  • Danger Zone — bonus when surrounded by 3+ enemies

  • Last Stand — one revival per sector. Use it wisely.

  • Overkill Explosion — excess damage splashes to nearby enemies

20 combat mechanics in total. Risk more — earn more.

4 GAME MODES

CAMPAIGN — 12 sectors, 4 acts, full narrative. Shops between missions, upgrade choices, and a final showdown with Archon.

ENDLESS — Infinite waves with escalating difficulty. How far can you go?

CONTRACTS — Fixed modifier sets, higher payouts. Specific challenge, specific reward.

DAILY SEED — Same seed for every player, every day. Equal conditions. Pure skill.

Each mode across 4 difficulty levels: Arcade, Standard, Veteran, Hardcore.

7 MISSION TYPES x 6 BIOMES

Missions: Survive, Hold Beacon, Escort Core, Hunt Elites, Destroy Relay, Boss Assault, and special operations.

Biomes: nebulae, asteroid belts, dead orbits, magnetic storms, silent sectors, gravitational anomalies.

Every combination of mission and biome changes your approach. No two sectors feel the same.

KEY FEATURES

4566560.name: Mahjong Kawuxing
4566560.about_the_game:
Kawuxing, a type of mahjong gameplay, is particularly popular in some areas of Hubei Province, China. It is usually played by three people per round, with four people sitting at the same table and one person resting.

Due to its special winning mechanism, where a player cannot make a small straight, and a four-six card combination counts as a four-combination win, it is colloquially known as "Five-Star Card".

In the five-star mahjong game, there are only 84 cards in two colors: tiles and strips, with the characters "中", "发", and "白". Any pair of mahjong tiles can be used as a pair of tiles, and only touching is allowed without eating (except for winning). If a player wins, they must pay first (regardless of whether they ultimately win or not). After all the cards are dealt in each round, one card must be played out. If no one wins, the round is declared a "barren round" (no "sea catch"), and the player who did not listen to the winning tile must pay the house.

The five-star mahjong rule is simple, the speed of winning a hand is fast, and it is widely favored by mahjong enthusiasts. Moreover, with a maximum of eight points, the loss in one round is relatively small, making it more popular among ordinary people than other mahjong games.

4566580.name: Billionaire in the Greedy America
4566580.about_the_game:
Build your financial empire across 1850s America. Trade stocks, commodities, and bonds, acquire companies, speculate on real estate, and outsmart 30 rival investors in this deep economic tycoon simulator.

About This Game


The year is 1850. America is booming.

Railroads stretch across the frontier. Gold rushes ignite fortunes overnight. Coal mines, cotton mills, and steamboat lines fuel an unstoppable industrial revolution. In this land of opportunity, only the boldest and shrewdest investors will rise to the top.

Billionaire in the Greedy America is a deeply simulated financial tycoon game where you start as an ambitious investor and fight your way to the top of Wall Street — one trade, one acquisition, one hostile takeover at a time.

Trade Everything


Navigate a living, breathing financial ecosystem across 20 US states, each with its own economy, central bank, and political landscape.

  • Stock Market — Buy, sell, and short-sell shares in dozens of companies. Watch prices react to earnings, market trends, and your own trades.
  • Commodities — Speculate on oil, coal, steel, wheat, gold, lumber, cotton, sugar, and aluminum. Commodity prices ripple through industries, affecting the companies you own.
  • Bonds — Invest in corporate and state bonds with realistic yield curves. Balance risk and return across maturities up to 30 years.
  • Real Estate — Build or buy commercial properties, luxury mansions, rental buildings, and even sport clubs across the nation.

Build Your Corporate Empire


When you acquire enough shares in a company, you take control. Then the real game begins.

  • Hire and fire CEOs — Choose between aggressive, conservative, balanced, cost-cutting, or innovative management styles.
  • Manage operations — Set R&D budgets, marketing spend, pricing strategies, and expand with new branches in other states.
  • Execute corporate maneuvers — Launch IPOs, leveraged buyouts, greenmail attacks, mergers, extraordinary dividends, and corporate restructurings.
  • Found new companies — Start businesses from scratch in any of the 19 period-authentic industry sectors, from Railroad Construction to Arms Manufacturing, from Gold Mining to River Steamboat Shipping.

Outsmart 30 AI Rivals


You're not alone in this race for riches. 30 AI investors — each with their own strategy — compete against you for the same opportunities. Value investors play the long game; speculators chase short-term profits. They can go bankrupt, reinvent themselves, or even make you an offer you can't refuse for your prized shares.

A Living Economy


  • Dynamic politics — Republican and Democratic parties compete in state elections every 4 years, shaping tax policy on income, capital gains, corporate profits, and wealth.
  • Central bank rates fluctuate with GDP growth, affecting loans, bond yields, and the entire economy.
  • Economic cycles — Booms and depressions strike unpredictably, rewarding those who prepared and punishing the reckless.
  • State contracts — Bid for lucrative government procurement deals in railroads, arms, ironworks, and textiles.

Your Rules, Your Challenge


Customize your experience with difficulty options:

  • Choose your starting capital — from rags to modest riches
  • Enable the licensing system to require state-by-state market access
  • Activate wealth taxes for a harder financial challenge
  • Turn on market impact realism where your large trades move prices against you

Features at a Glance


  • Deep financial simulation set in 1850s America
  • Trade stocks, bonds, commodities, and real estate
  • Short selling, IPOs, leveraged buyouts, mergers, and greenmail
  • Own and manage companies across 19 authentic industry sectors
  • 20 US states with independent economies, politics, and tax systems
  • 30 AI investors with distinct trading strategies
  • Dynamic economic cycles with booms and depressions
  • 5 CEO management styles for AI-driven or hands-on company control
  • Government contracts and competitive bidding
  • Detailed financial reporting: P/E ratios, EPS, ROE, credit ratings, balance sheets
  • Available in English, German, Italian, and Russian

In the Greedy America, opportunity is everywhere. But so is the competition. How far will you go?

4566850.name: Sepak U - Sports Fighting Game
4566850.about_the_game:
⚔️ Smash-Like Volleyball 🏐

Fighting Game meets Volleyball and Football (Soccer) with 1-4 players, 21 characters, 21 arenas, with over 10 hours of solo/co-op content, minigames, and epic boss fights.

Based on Sepak Takraw, a cultural Asian sport similar to Volleyball, with ball control reminiscent of Football (Soccer), infused with movement reminiscent of Smash-like Games, and depth of Fighting Game Systems.

Simple Volleyball-Like Rules with Easy Controls! — Land the ball, score a point! Just touching the ball with your character automatically hits it, but smashing makes the hit way harder!

Ball Mechanics Inspired by Football (Soccer) — There’s more to a shot than simply kicking. Shape your attack angles into curves, sinkers, back shots, power smashes, spikes, and more to dominate your opponents!

Up to 4 Players — Play local or online Head-to-Head, Handicap, or Team Battle modes!

Easy To Learn, Hard to Master! — Learn and master both casual and competitive Fighting Game systems. Each character has their own unique specials, ultimates, and powerful gimmicks that would certainly get you banned from a real sport. Good thing we’re a video game!

Smash-Like Controls and Movement — A simple control scheme anyone can pick up and play, but with all the tech that lets you move like a pro. Utilize air dashes, wave dashes, cancels, and more to zoom around the court!

21 Characters! 21 Arenas! — A Fighting Game lives and dies with its cast, and we’re no different. Sepak U offers a deep roster of characters, such as a guest characters from other games, some barista, a chicken, monsters of myth, and even… Your Mom?!

Lore and Arenas based around the Philippines, Asia, and many other places! — The world of Sepak U is inspired by mostly our home the Philippines, South East Asia, Thailand, Taiwan, Malaysia, Singapore, and outside of it like Japan, Europe, Spain, South America, and so much more!

Over 10+ Hours of Solo and Co-op! — Unlock 21 different character endings, play a wealth of minigames, and take on intense boss battles in a unique arcade story mode that features a randomized ladder, matches, modes, and gimmicks in every playthrough!

A story where players fight to regain their memories! — Face off against a multitude of heroes, killers, mischievous Filipino demons, sickos out to destroy the world, those who simply wish to challenge the strongest and more!

More Features:

  • Second Wind Upgrade System — A first-ever for fighting games! Inspired by roguelike systems, the losing player of the last round may select an upgrade to carry into the next round, offering the chance of a comeback for the loser and a challenge for the winner. This system makes losing in fighting games more fun for both the loser and adds challenge to winners, and removes problems in comeback systems, as this is achieved after a lost.

  • Create your own epic moments! — Inspired by movies, sports, fighting games, and anime, feel the intensity of every rally in the dazzling sights and sounds of Sepak U’s presentation, and roar as you near victory with a (sometimes literal) blaze of glory!

  • Competitive design and balance — Sepak U is developed by an avid tournament competitor and organizer; designed to have the depth and fun to keep you and your friends coming back for years. Standard features for the competitive player, such as Online modes, Replays, Training, and more are all included for those that can never stop honing their competitive edge.

  • Unique Tournament and Streamer Features — As an experienced community and tournament organizer, we added the first-ever tournament features we wish existed in other games, like in-game webcam integration, fast tournament on-boarding, and more to be announced.

  • Unique Tournament and Streamer Features — Drawing from our experiences as a community and tournament organizer, Sepak U contains tournament features we always wanted to see in other games, such in-game webcam integration, fast tournament on-boarding, and more.

And even more still! — Character costumes! Recolors! Other things we yet to announce! There’s still much more to come for Sepak U!

Draft run-only omens that bend the rules of a run, survive elite milestone fights every fifth floor, and descend deep enough to climb the leaderboard.

Maria Moore, a young woman deemed “hysterical” under mysterious circumstances, awakens inside Mawgate Asylum, alone, disoriented, and abandoned. Her husband, William, is nowhere to be found.

Something has gone terribly wrong.

The asylum is no longer a place of treatment, but of terror. Twisted creatures roam its halls, and whatever happened the night Maria was taken has turned Mawgate into a waking nightmare.

To survive, Maria must explore the labyrinthine institution, uncover its secrets, and find the enigmatic director, Dr. Hawley, before it’s too late.

Survive Mawgate Asylum

A sprawling, interconnected facility filled with locked doors, hidden compartments, and cryptic puzzles. Every corner hides answers, and danger.

  • Solve environmental puzzles to progress

  • Manage scarce resources and stay alive

  • Fight or outmaneuver the horrors within

Maria Moore

Born into poverty and thrust into aristocratic life through marriage, Maria never belonged in the world she was forced into. Independent, strong-willed, and unwilling to conform, she dreamt of freedom, travel, art, a life beyond expectation.

Now imprisoned within Mawgate Asylum, stripped of control and branded insane, Maria must rely on her resolve to survive. Claustrophobic, isolated, and hunted, she is determined to escape and uncover what became of her husband.

4567020.name: AMEN: The Quiet Exodus
4567020.about_the_game:
A Visual Novel

  • The story unfolds at the crossroads of science and religious mysticism.

  • Each character is a complex personality, revealed through the choices you make.

  • The art style blends gothic aesthetics with elements of bio-art and sacred symbolism.

In this world, forsaken by God, every newborn child is swathed in darkness, a veil drawn across its face, stripped of that which cannot be seen - the lack of which has rendered it “Empty”: the soul.

Though the souls of men have become a resource beyond replenishment, yet have men learned to forge them in the crucible of the laboratory. But the price of this discovery - none are eager to name it. Nor do they fathom what calamities such a breach must surely summon. 

The Four

At the heart of the story stand four characters, each carrying their own burdens and histories:

Every Choice Has Consequences

  • Will you help Ilaya preserve her fragile peace of mind — or, with your own hands, send her into the Void?

4567060.name: Retro Districts: In-Between Eras
4567060.about_the_game:
Retro Districts is a philosophical visual novel set in a fictional alternate universe, blending time travel with thoughtful exploration of human values, society, and intellectual identity.

You play as Lazar Maksimovich, a physicist who spent years developing a time machine in an abandoned bomb shelter. When the attack on the city traps him in his laboratory, a signal from the future offers an unexpected escape. Upon arriving in the year 2225, Lazar discovers a world where people live in Retro Districts — themed neighborhoods, most of them dedicated to various decades of the 20th century: 1920s Pariel, 1950s–60s Federated States of Freedom, 1980s Western Areal, Unified System of the People, among others.

In this future, where technology allows people to change their appearance and even the weather at will, intellectual sophistication has become the ultimate mark of distinction. The inhabitants of these Retro Districts engage in philosophical discourse as a form of social play, discussing freedom, mass media, art, and the nature of civilization itself.

Your mission begins as reconnaissance: gain the trust of districts dwellers through meaningful conversation. Navigate branching dialogues where thoughtful responses unlock new locations and deeper discussions. From cabarets and art galleries to anti-war protests and TV studios, each encounter offers perspectives on consumerism, media influence, power, self-worth, and the eternal human search for meaning.

The journey eventually leads to the Overseas Egocracy — a secretive district modeled on a 1950s order — and finally to the Unified System itself during the 1950s–70s, where conversations touch upon the principles and contradictions of the System's society. But Lazar's journey doesn't end there…

Disclaimer: This game is a work of philosophical fiction set in a fictional alternate universe. Any resemblances are coincidental. Historical and philosophical concepts and imagery may have been part of creative reinterpretation and inspiration for artistic purposes, without claim to academic accuracy. The game addresses complex and controversial issues. The opinions of characters do not reflect the position of the developer, but serve the purposes of story development and the themes being explored. The author condemn extremism and discrimination. This title is intended for a mature audience (preferably 18+). Original screenplay written by a human. Player discretion is advised.

  • A light collectathon with a rewarding sense of completion as your museum slowly comes to life

  • A short, cozy adventure designed to help you relax, with charming pixel art

  • A simple storyline with cute characters to accompany you along your journey

  • Easy-going mini-games like clawing, fishing, and more

❌ What One Coin Museum is not

  • NOT a museum management game, your museum is mostly idle and not customizable

  • No multiplayer.

-------------------------------------

About the dev 🤓

Hello! Toadzillart here 👋

It’s with great joy that I present my second game, One Coin Museum! After exploring cozy idle gameplay with Whimside, I wanted to return with a slightly bigger adventure.

Inspired by the sense of discovery from the games of my childhood and my unconditional love for collecting, I hope this little project brings you as much joy as I had creating it.

A special thanks to Tadpoly for all the support, both with marketing and on a personal level 💚

4567240.name: OESM - Sacred Story
4567240.about_the_game:
OESM - Sacred Story aka OESMSS

Story:

Richard, your mission is to find the original Bible manuscript in the Ottoman Empire lands in the absence of Alp Er Tunga and bring it to the Archbishop.

Gameplay and Key Features:

  • Fictional history themed

  • Fantastic atmosphere

  • Hack and slash game

  • Open world gameplay

You can only finish the game by finding all the hidden objects.

4567280.name: Knightfall Requiem
4567280.about_the_game: Step into the cursed realm of Knightfall Requiem and master brutal combo-driven combat. Chain relentless attacks, wield forbidden magic, and crush hordes of enemies in a realm consumed by chaos where every move defines your fate.

4567300.name: Candy Clicker
4567300.about_the_game:
Welcome to Candy Clicker—a place where one click turns into numbers you can barely wrap your head around, and every “just a little more” feels like a real leap forward.

A click with flavor. Your main candy sits front and center: tap away, watch the particle burst, and rake in currency. In the shop, upgrade your click power and unlock a whole lineup of treats—from simple candies to glossy progress “monsters.” Each new level adds passive income, so the factory keeps running even while you sleep.

Rebirth and brains, not just patience. Push to staggering numbers, rebirth for a permanent multiplier, and dive into the skill tree: boost click strength, discounts on key upgrades, and separate branches for every shop candy—progress is tied to specific sweets, so your build really feels different from someone else’s.

A little magic every day. Claim your daily gift, spin the prize roulette (and savor the thought that the next spin is an event in itself), and catch the offline bonus—a zone where a “dropped” candy can be a nice surprise after a break.

Steam as part of the game, not window dressing. Open your backpack of inventory items, inspect them in detail, and open scrolls. Visit the anvil—that’s where things combine into something new. A dedicated shop with tabs for choco diamonds, cases, and scrolls weaves Steam monetization right into the world. See how you stack up on the leaderboards.

Your pace, your comfort. A cozy 2D interface and a “however I like it” rhythm—quick session before bed or background play with a podcast; both work.

If you love incrementals where progress is visible, audible, and makes you want one more click—step inside. Another candy is already on its way.

4567390.name: Hop Slash
4567390.about_the_game:
Hop Slash is a Casual 3D Platformer game with a focus on Action, Exploration and Item Collection, which draws strong inspiration from 64-bit Golden Age Platformer games such as Spyro, Zelda and Mario 64.

Story: 

Hop, the Bunny Knight, was wandering around Celestina when hordes of skeletons suddenly appeared in every land, stealing all the Golden Gems. Now, Hop is the only one who can save Celestina. He takes his sword and helmet and starts hopping to save his land!

Mechanics

  • Auto-jumps and Move Around with Directional movement

  • Air Jump: Can jump while in the air

  • Dash-Attack: Attack while Dashing Forward (some enemies can only be hurt by attacking)

  • Control Camera Movement

Features:

  • 5 handcrafted levels

  • Auto-jumping Bunny Character.

  • Slash through Enemies with your Sword.

  • 12 hidden collectibles to find

  • Time Record (if you like to Speed Run)

  • An amazing Boss Fight

  • AND MANY Platforms to jump, enemies to Slash and Golden Gems to collect!

4567480.name: ELLUSION
4567480.about_the_game:
ELLUSION is a top-down, grid-based, rhythmic, bullet hell, based on the lost media title "Mr.Oops!!!"

An immediately intuitive and tight game loop with 3 movement styles combined to instantly reposition The Witch anywhere on the 6x6 grid with finesse. Achieve true elusive mastery by dancing through hundreds of equally sharp pattern combinations.

Features!

  • Pick up and play: ~1-10 minutes per run

  • Rhythm-based spawning: Recognize incoming patterns by their rhythmic signature

  • +150 Handcrafted patterns + Unique RNG spawning behavior for each of 4 projectile types

  • Ambidextrous controls: For faster and more precise repositioning, The Witch can be controlled ambidextrously through buffered WASD + Arrow keys or D-pad + Joypad inputs

  • 3x10 Challenge phases

  • Endless modes

  • Purely gameplay: No narrative elements, instant loading times, instant restart

  • Toggleable Shaders

4567510.name: Potato Simulato: Together
4567510.about_the_game:
Welcome to Potato Simulato: Together , a chaotic physics-based platformer where you play as a helpless potato trying to survive a world full of traps, madness, and pure frustration.

Roll, jump, and struggle your way through bizarre obstacle courses filled with spinning hammers, deadly spikes, collapsing platforms, and completely unfair surprises. One mistake… and it’s back to the start.

This game is not about skill alone , it’s about patience, timing, and how much rage you can handle.

🥔 Features:

  • Physics-based movement that makes every action unpredictable

  • Brutal obstacle courses designed to test your sanity

  • Instant fail mechanics — no mercy

  • Funny, absurd environments (kitchens, deserts, floating islands, and more)

⚠️ Warning:

This game may cause:

  • Screaming

  • Desk hitting

  • Questioning life choices

If you enjoyed games like that, you’re in the right place.

4567530.name: Steamboat Willie Rescue Mission
4567530.about_the_game:
A CLASSIC RESCUE MISSION!

Willie's sweet gal Winnie has been kidnapped by the dastardly Captain Pete! The steamboat is empty, the music has stopped, and it's up to you to bring her home.

Steamboat Willie: Rescue Mission is a love letter to classic 1928 animation, with visuals and gameplay inspired by the golden age of 8-bit games. Journey through 20 challenging levels spanning frozen woods, scorching deserts, jungle mazes, high-speed trains, and a haunted house.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Classic 8-Bit Platforming: Jump, climb, and run your way through treacherous traps, moving platforms, and deadly spikes.

  • Take to the Skies: Hop into your biplane for thrilling auto-scrolling flight levels! Dodge flying ducks and blast Captain Pete's airborne potato attacks.

  • Choose Your Nostalgia: Play in crisp modern color, or dive into the options menu to enable classic "Black and White" or nostalgic "Green Mode" to simulate the look of a 90s handheld console!

  • Unlockable Winnie Mode: Explore every nook and cranny. If you can collect every hidden musical note in the game, you'll unlock the ability to play through the entire adventure as Winnie!

  • Procedural Retro Audio: Tap your toes to a vibrant, chiptune soundtrack and authentic 8-bit sound effects.

Disclaimer: This game is based on the 1928 public-domain animated film "Steamboat Willie." This product is not affiliated with, authorized, or endorsed by The Walt Disney Company.

4567670.name: Chick'n Slide
4567670.about_the_game:
Use the magnet to pull the chicks onto the slide and collect their feathers to use for upgrades.

Spend currency in the skill tree to unlock power, then strengthen your magnet in the Magnet Shop.

Unlock talents to enhance your skills and make your slide even more fun.

Enjoy the chaos, collect rewards, and build your best run yet.

4567690.name: LUMINOUS GATE
4567690.about_the_game:
[Game Overview]

LUMINOUS GATE is a 3D action roguelite where you explore and fight your way through shifting dungeons to reach the deepest part of the "Gate."

[Key Features]

  • Dynamic Dungeons: Explore dungeons with layouts that change with every run.

  • Deep Build Customization: Create your own playstyle using a variety of weapons and skills, including Swords, Bows, Bombs, and Wings.

  • Persistent Growth: Even if you fall, you can use collected resources to permanently upgrade your character and push further in your next attempt.

[Development Status] The game is currently in active development (Alpha build). We plan to add more bosses, skills, and features in future updates.

4567740.name: A Rhapsody in Steam
4567740.about_the_game:
A Rhapsody in Steam is an adventure RPG.

At the far north of the continent of Tythun, the Dark Lord has long held its ground. The expedition to put an end to it has been delayed, again and again — and yet the railway keeps pushing north, carrying your carriage with it.

As the Hero's advisor, you and the Hero and the Guide ride together through one station after another. Along the way: imperial officials to deal with, the Guilds and their banners, businesses bearing the imperial crest, travelers of unclear origin, and those who claim to work for the Dark Lord. At every stop, there is something you can do. There is also something you can leave alone.

The Dark Lord is the topic of the moment — front-page news every week, arguments running hot in the taverns, more charm-stalls on the corners than there were last month. But it seems no two people are talking about quite the same Dark Lord.

The train continues north.
What waits there — everyone has their own version.

Game Features

  • 💬 What You Do Is Up to You

In a series of events, you'll be asked to make choices: confront imperial officials, help someone at their lowest, play the fool when the Guilds come asking questions, or unleash the power of the "Hero" against your enemies—there's no single correct way to solve a problem in this world. You can be forceful, diplomatic, or simply stay out of it. People will remember what you did—and respond in ways you might not expect.

  • 🚂 One Carriage, One Home

The railway runs north, and your carriage runs with it. Each return brings something new inside — left behind by a companion, brought back from a town, picked up along the way. Marks accumulate. Seats find their owners. The road you've already traveled starts to feel like weight you can hold.

  • 👥 A Loose, Ever-Changing Party

Companions will gather around the Hero—each with their own strengths, each capable of handling different problems. But this is no fixed party. They are not subordinates, just fellow travelers who happen to be on the same train. They may join you in a quiet town one morning, and leave just as quietly another night.

And the Hero always sits across from you. Your relationship will evolve over the course of the journey—from two strangers thrown together, to something deeper. The road ahead is still long.

  • 🏙 Places Worth Returning To

A handful of places you'll revisit—meeting the people there, getting involved in their troubles, leaving your mark through each encounter, and perhaps remembering a corner of it long after you've gone.

  • 🎻 A Rhapsody

You'll decide your next move from inside a small carriage, then panic moments later about running out of seasoning. You'll meet officials who say absurd things with a straight face, traders who've turned the Dark Lord into a business, strangers on the roadside telling stories that lead nowhere — and travelers whose origins you'll never quite place.

Headlines shout. Distant rumors arrive without confirmation. The world looks like it's still running, the way it always has.

  • 🎭 The Path Is Yours

You can ride straight north and see the expedition through. You can also stop a while in one place — push back at the Empire, slip away to some forgotten little town, or simply slow down, and let the journey take whatever time it takes.

4567790.name: Project Crypto: Trading Simulator
4567790.about_the_game:
The only way to trade crypto at work without getting fired! You are a rookie trader who just joined a specialized crypto investment firm. But don't expect the company to trust you with big money right away. Earn your starting capital through part-time jobs and ride the waves of the market to grow your assets. Can you survive the ruthless market and climb the corporate ladder to become a legend?

Key Features:

  • From the Bottom Up: Work various part-time jobs to build your initial seed money. Every penny earned through hard work will be the foundation of your future empire.

  • Realistic Trading Experience: Analyze real-time charts and time your buys and sells for everything from Bitcoin to various Altcoins.

  • Spot, Futures, and Real Estate: Start with spot trading, but as you get promoted, unlock high-risk 'Futures' and the ultimate stability of 'Real Estate' apps.

  • Promotion & Growth: Prove your worth by depositing profits back into the company. As you climb the corporate ladder from Intern to higher executive levels, you will unlock professional investment tools and exclusive asset privileges like real estate.

  • Information is Power: Analyze your 'Xbird Feed' where rumors and truth collide. Gaining information faster than others is the only way to guarantee survival in this brutal market.

  • Skill Upgrades: Invest your earnings into personal development. Increase your salary efficiency and unlock passive skills like 'Salary Critical' to maximize income outside of trading.

4567960.name: Tales from Davidstown: The Game
4567960.about_the_game:
Uncover the secrets of Davidstown in a live-action supernatural thriller where your choices shape the story.

Tales from Davidstown: The Game blends cinematic storytelling with investigation, clue finding, puzzles, and branching decisions. Search key locations, uncover hidden truths, and decide who to trust as the mystery deepens.

Your choices affect the people around you, the paths you take, and the outcomes you reach. Every discovery brings new questions. Every decision leaves a mark.

Set in the wider Tales from Davidstown universe, this standalone interactive experience combines suspense, character tension, and multiple possible endings in a dark supernatural mystery.

Features

• Live action supernatural storytelling
• Branching choices with multiple outcomes
• Investigation and clue-driven gameplay
• Puzzles tied to the mystery
• Character relationships shaped by your decisions
• A standalone story set in the Tales from Davidstown universe

4567970.name: Wellspring
4567970.about_the_game:
Fort Wellspring is under relentless assault—can you survive?

Wellspring is a fast-paced wave survival game where hordes of enemies attack from multiple directions. Fight with sword and skill, unleash devastating haymakers, or activate your ultimate to wipe out the waves. As you progress, enemies grow stronger and special types bring unique challenges. Unlock powerful modifiers to tailor your abilities and adapt your strategy. Can you make it through all 40 rounds?

This is a simple, low-scope project and my very first commercial release. It taught me a lot about the process, and I’m excited to build on this experience with bigger and better projects in the future. Thank you for your support, and I hope you enjoy the game!

4567990.name: Infernal Crusader: Metal of the Damned
4567990.about_the_game:
Hell has a soundtrack and it is loud.

You are dead. Time to fight your way through hell. A hack and slash adventure game where you play as a fallen knight with the sound of heavy metal blasting in the background.

This is a 2D hack and slash game where you fight the demons of hell. Armed with a sword and shield which can be used as a projectile you will fight the minions and bosses of the different layers of hell. Each layer of hell has enemies, you musy defeat all enemies and the progress to the next level.

4568030.name: Beyond Yardwork Simulator
4568030.about_the_game:
Get swept away by an immersive story in handcrafted narrative levels. And when you're craving more, dive into infinity with our Procedural Level Generation system.

Grab your tools and feel the relaxation that comes with tending to a garden. Your task list is clear and rewarding:

  • Mowing lawns

  • Trimming weeds

  • Pressure washing

  • Picking up litter

  • Hauling bulk waste

  • Waste sorting

  • Leaf blowing and more

  • Sweeper cleaning

Hard work pays off!

The money earned from client jobs can be invested into your own sanctuary. Renovate your house and backyard, turning a modest fixer-upper into a luxury estate. You decide how to spend every hard-earned coin.

Find your inspiration

Working for others is your chance to get inspired. As you complete contracts, you’ll unlock new flower species and unique decorations. Once unlocked, you can purchase them for your own garden. Create a space that serves as your ultimate calling card and proof of your mastery.

Level up your skills

Gain experience and earn access to specialized courses. Every completed training provides a powerful upgrade for your character, allowing you to work faster and more efficiently. Transform from a hobbyist into an undisputed expert!

4568090.name: Frostland
4568090.about_the_game:
Frostland is a cozy 2D clicker game set in a snowy valley, where you harvest, gather, and build structures to process and refine resources without automation. Forge powerful tools to help Pitty, the wizard dog, on his journey to obtain the legendary staff.

COLLECT, PROCESS, BUILD AND CRAFT

Collect wood, stone, ores and plants. Refine these resources into new materials and use them to upgrade your gathering power and build structures.

FEATURE LIST:

  • Explore a cozy, snow-covered valley.

  • Click to gather resources such as wood, stone, ores and plants.

  • Build structures to refine and process resources.

  • Forge tools and unlock new gathering resources.

  • Progress through a satisfying incremental system with clear and constant growth.

  • Upgrade your stats at the talent tree.

*The game was inspired on Click Mage a game by Tiny Crow Games.

4568130.name: LaVonne's Lemons Idle
4568130.about_the_game:
Hint: Daily Login Rewards permanently scale your backend statistics.

Every drop of Water provides an eternal, cumulative base efficiency buff to your entire Orchard multiplier matrix.

Welcome to the ultimate citrus empire! LaVonne's Lemons Idle starts as a simple, relaxing game about harvesting a single lemon tree and quickly spirals into an astronomically massive, universe-spanning industrial tycoon. What begins with wooden buckets and old rakes (ARTIFACTS) will soon evolve into Dark Matter Assemblers, Cosmic Orbitrons, and reality-bending Stargates!

Both Active & Idle Strategy Rolled Into One Whether you prefer to furiously click to maximize critical profits or let your empire run completely on autopilot, the game perfectly blends active strategy with deeply satisfying idle mechanics. Your gameplay dictates your growth loop!

⭐Your Personal Screen Pet Macaque ⭐

Why build an empire alone? LaVonne's Lemons features a fully integrated, interactive 3D Screen Pet Monkey (168 Custom Screen Pet Animations) that lives directly on your game screen! Toggle the pet on, and watch him autonomously roam your desktop while you play. Between hula-dancing, reading the Orchard Manual, blowing bubbles, and skateboarding across your UI, he doubles as an incredibly relaxing, dynamic screensaver while your factories churn out billions in the background!

Key Features:

  • Trickle Up & Down Synergies: Build a massive, interconnected economy. Generative factories don't just produce wealth independently; they feed into each other. Equip the right combination of artifacts, and you can create massive chain reactions where your earthly and cosmic generators literally trickle both up and down, compounding their outputs exponentially!

  • The Massive "Orchard Manual": With an economy this deep, we wouldn't leave you stranded! Consult the wildly extensive in-game Orchard Manual—a massively detailed, numbered, multi-chapter guide filled with lore, secrets, and mechanical explanations to help you master every system, from the humblest seeds to the Singularity.

  • Astronomical Progression: Powered by a complex custom math engine, your wealth will tear straight through normal coding limits. Push past Trillions and Quadrillions to reach impossible numbers.

  • Refined Artifact System: Dig up and collect dozens of unique artifacts—like the Glowing Geode or the Creator's Hand—that fundamentally warp your game's physics and exponentially boost your production!

  • Endless Research & Prestige: Reset your empire to gain powerful permanent multipliers, unlock cosmic anomalies, and harvest volatile Dark Matter to fuel your Blueprint Assemblers.

Do you have what it takes to build the most lucrative lemonade stand in the cosmos?

🌟 Full Native Steam Integration

LaVonne's Lemons Idle isn't just a browser port—it has been engineered to fully utilize the Steam ecosystem to reward your dedication, showcase your mathematical supremacy, and protect your progress:

  • 🏆 Global Steam Leaderboards: The OmegaNum ledger doesn't lie. Compete in real-time against thousands of incremental gamers worldwide. Formulate the perfect strategy, ascend the global rankings, and permanently etch your High Score into the Steam ledger!

  • 🏅 Steam Achievements: Are you a true completionist? We have baked hardcoded trigger values deep into the core mechanics. Unlock dozens of achievements spanning from early-game progression to uncovering the rarest 168-action screen pet animations.

  • 🃏 Steam Trading Cards & Badges: Please note that Trading Cards are not available at launch! We absolutely plan to add beautiful custom Trading Cards to the game as soon as the Steam algorithms grant us official eligibility.

  • ☁️ Steam Cloud Saves [PC & Laptop Sync]: Never fear losing your millions of seeds! Your massive coordinate save files are automatically backed up directly to Steam's secure cloud servers. Shut down your desktop at night, and seamlessly pick up your exact Lemon production state on your laptop the next morning!

Epilepsy warning

Available On Steam Only!

A massive, meticulously balanced 4-to-7-month progression engine that respects your time.

4568170.name: They Not Fae!
4568170.about_the_game:
A teen is tracking her cat inside an office building. Even though the place seems quiet and deserted, she soon realizes she’s playing hide-and-seek with dangerous creatures.

Genre and duration?

The game is an short horror experience, lasting between 30 to 60 minutes. I will try my best to scare you while you do your best to save an innocent cat.

I poured all my love, and many of my fears to offer the scariest game I could make (so far), and I'm super proud of it.

So have fun!

Story and gameplay:

Maxine was walking his kitten when she suddenly ran away, leading her into an abandoned place. Pay attention to his meowing and pawprints to track him through the forest and inside the offices. Fortunately she can also use her smartphone too help her: you can scan your surroundings to detect the Pet tag of the cat, or use the camera to highlight his position. You will also receive tips from the virtual assistant to guide you.

But beware, creatures are lurking around the place and will send you fake cues to distract you and stab Maxine in the back. 

Goal and lore:

Your objective? Find your cat and escape! You can take your time, you can run, you can ignore the cues or read and listen all the messages. Be careful though, the monsters will lie to you, they're very hungry after all. This place have been closed for a decade and Maxine is about to find out what happened. 

The game also contains in-game Achievements if you want to impress me and your friends. And there is plenty of lore for your to discover, if you prefer to take your time and if you want to explore the map. You can play without monsters or any kind of danger, apparently it was too stressful and scary for some of my testers. 

The monsters:

We don't know who they are and where they came from. They're shapeshifter, taking the appearances of the furnitures and objects around them to deceive you. They can whisper, they can crawl and they can even communicate, in their twisted ways. So if you hear footsteps behind you, open you camera and try to pay attention.

Features:

  • duration: 30/60 minutes

  • large 3D level with 3 biomes to explore

  • creepy monsters to kill you

  • Multiple apps on your smartphone to help you

  • audio ambiance crafted with care

  • I'm proud of the art so let's say a cool art direction

  • options to turn down the spookiness

  • in-game achievements

  • a human-made game made with love, just for you

Content warning:

The game contains dark environments, claustrophobia, loud noises and flashing lights, jumpscares, references to self-harm and suicide, a sphynx cat (the husband of my syster is absolutely terrified by mine and scream).

4568190.name: PlayLife: Life Deck Simulator
4568190.about_the_game:
PlayLife: Life Deck Simulator is a card-driven life simulation game. From age 6 to 40, every choice is a card — study, skip class, work part-time, fall in love, start a business... Each round is one year of life, and every card played is irreversible.

Customize Your Starting Point

Allocate four core attributes: IQ, Stamina, Charm, and Family Wealth. A poor background means attending market-district schools; wealthy families get international academies. Choose your talent skills, or let fate assign them — you never know what hidden gifts await.

21 Skills, 22 Careers, Infinite Possibilities

From General Knowledge and Academics to Coding, Music, Painting, Martial Arts, and Esports — every skill opens different life paths. Office workers climb a clear corporate ladder; high school dropouts can bootstrap startups; high Charm? A talent scout might discover you in elementary school; gaming prodigies sign with pro teams; athletic stars compete professionally. Your life, your rules.

Love on Your Terms

Stay single and focus on your career. Fall madly in love. Find your soulmate and grow old together. Or play the field. Get married, have kids — or don't. There's no right answer, only your choices.

Social Expectations vs. Heart's Desire

Parents expect good grades, college, a stable job, marriage, and kids — that's Society's Expectation. Fall short and face consequences. But what does your heart truly want? The Heart's Desire system lets you chase your dreams for unique rewards. Conform or rebel? Every step is a crossroads.

Fate is Unpredictable

100+ random fate events: talent scouts, stock crashes, sick parents, surprise inheritance, school bullying, lottery wins, startup failures... Some reshape your trajectory; others are just life's small episodes. Overwork without rest? You might get sick — or worse.

50+ Achievements, Replayable

Each run scores you on Wealth, Happiness, Fame, Skills, Family, and Career. Unlock achievements to earn bonus attribute points for your next life. Can you achieve an S-rank?
4568190.supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean

4568270.name: Project Biosphere
4568270.about_the_game:
Project Biosphere is a real-time ecosystem sandbox built on a falling-sand simulation. Water flows, heat spreads, fire consumes, plants take root. Ecosystems rise and fall.


Relax, waste some time, and let out some steam. With no set goal, Project Biosphere is simply a toy. 

Shape the terrain, choose a world preset, and experiment with a living simulation where every material interacts. Dry worlds burn. Wet worlds flood. Rich soil blooms. Harsh conditions choke growth. Small changes can ripple outward.


Inspired by 2D falling-sand games, we're bringing the idea to life in 3D. 

Watch life take hold, from single celled-organisms to multi-cellular life, the evolution simulation makes the sandbox come to life.

Control the Environment, raise and lower abmient temperature and watch the world turn to an inferno. Increase pressure, humidity or switch gravity negative.

4568300.name: Ibiza Madness: Zombie vs Demons
4568300.about_the_game:
Ibiza Madness: Zombie vs Demons is a fast-paced action game where zombies and demons have taken over the iconic beaches and streets of Ibiza. Get ready to survive waves of enemies in dynamic environments filled with secrets, weapons, and power-ups.

Key Features:

  • Intense combat: Face hordes of zombies and demons using unique weapons and special abilities.

  • Explore Ibiza: Discover beaches, clubs, and streets overrun with enemies as you fight for survival.

  • Power-ups and items: Collect weapons, upgrades, and surprises that change the way you play.

  • Varied challenges: Complete missions and increasingly difficult levels.

  • Local multiplayer (optional): Share the action with friends in co-op or survival modes.

Dive into the madness of Ibiza and prove you can survive the chaos of zombies and demons. Are you ready for the challenge?

4568450.name: Torin's Greed
4568450.about_the_game:
Setting

Torin's greed is a FPS is a FPS Dungeon Mining game. Use your pickaxe to mine through the dungeon to find gold and shoot monster enemies to go further down the dungeon for gold. Uncover new areas and find upgrades along the way with this unique mining shooting exploration game

$ Explore the Dungeons For Riches $

Discover hidden treasure chests, but tread lightly—one false move can spring a deadly trap. Fight off the goblin tribe and claim the ultimate prize.

Rescue Fellow Explorers

You aren't the first to seek these riches. Many who came before you have been captured or consumed by their own greed. Rescue these fallen adventurers to unlock powerful upgrades and prepare yourself for the journey ahead.


Vanquish Legendary Foes

The dungeon is home to more than just mindless monsters. Face formidable bosses from ancient dragons to malevolent entities who hoard the gold for themselves. Overcome these deadly guardians to claim the riches they guard.



Epic Adventure

Enjoy over 2 hours of hand-crafted gameplay.

  • Completionism's Dream: Discover and unlock rare collectibles hidden throughout the depths.

  • Retro Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in a charming, stylized low-poly world.

  • Classic Dungeon Crawling: Experience traditional exploration with a reliable save system.

4568470.name: Sunlit Journey: The Town
4568470.about_the_game:
Sunlit Journey: The Town

A short, healing visual novel that serves as the opening chapter of a series. Centered around gentle everyday life, it tells a warm encounter set in a peaceful small town.

The protagonist, a college student, returns to his hometown during break and happens to meet a quiet, gentle young lady. Through casual, heartfelt conversations, his tense mind gradually eases. By the riverside in the evening breeze, he opens up about his confusion over studies and the future, finding quiet emotional release in her gentle company.

  • Short playtime: around 60 minutes of relaxing experience

  • Dialogue-heavy storytelling with delicate slice-of-life narration

  • Soft, healing art style and gentle BGM

  • Two heartwarming endings to soothe inner anxiety

Amid the unhurried pace of small-town life, let the evening breeze carry away all unease, and meet tenderness when you least expect it.
