English*, Japanese*, Simplified Chinese*, Korean*
*languages with full audio support

4568480.name: Romance of Fangs: Part 1
4568480.about_the_game:
Story

Brynn is a young vampien (vampire-human mix) who must partake in the ancient vampien tradition of Bloodmatch, a ritual in which vampiens get matchmade with their perfect other half. Though she is just an ordinary vampien trying to find true love, something sinister is brewing beneath the cheery surface of the city. A murder threatens to break the fragile peace between humans and vampiens, while a horde of mutant wolves plagues the outskirts of the city. Mysteriously, a powerful CEO seems to be pulling strings over the city as well. Help Brynn navigate a community on edge, forge deep relationships, and protect her people from the encroaching darkness in this choice-driven narrative adventure.

Key Features

  • The power of choice: Brynn has the choice to complete quests and build relationships with key vampiens in her life each day. The vampien with whom she builds a strong relationship will determine the course of the story.

  • Combat: Try your hand at combat by defeating the mutant wolves in the woods on the outskirts of the city. Recruit your vampien allies for help and work together to clear the woods.

  • Art everywhere: Collect artworks and comic pages by progressing in the game and exploring the city. View collected images back at your apartment.

4568490.name: TurtleSkate
4568490.about_the_game:
Co-op Comedy Horror with Turtles

TurtleSkate is a 1–5 player co-op comedy horror game.

Become a turtle on a skateboard and run from strange entities.

Explore the Map and Escape Through Missions

Search the map, find keys, complete objectives, and escape.

Of course, the enemies will keep chasing you.

Intentional Discomfort: Fight the Controls

The skateboard is fast, but difficult to handle.

If you lose control and wipe out, get back up without hesitation.

Turtle Face Cam

Talk with your friends in real time and work together.

Or just stand in the corner and watch your friends die.

[Features]

  • Steam Friends Only: Random public matchmaking is not supported. You can only play with your Steam friends.

  • Comedy Horror: Rather than serious survival horror, it is closer to chaotic and funny horror created by awkward controls and sudden situations.

  • Better Together: You can play solo, but it is much more fun with friends.

  • Momentum You Must Learn: The skateboard is fast, but not easy to control. Getting used to the charge-based controls is key to surviving.

  • Stage-Based Progression: Each stage is cleared by pushing through its own unique objectives.

  • Revive Your Friends: Bring back friends who have been reduced to nothing but their shells. You can also grab a friend's shell and run.
4568490.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Vietnamese, Spanish - Latin America, Indonesian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Thai, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Polish, Korean

4568560.name: TriVictor
4568560.about_the_game:
TriVictor is a roguelike deckbuilder where your battlefield is as fragile as your health.

Every battle is fought across three lanes — VANGUARD holds the line, SWIFT fuels your engine, REAPER deals the pain. Take enough hits in a lane and it Scars — cracking under pressure to unlock brutal tradeoffs. More power, more risk. Let it break completely and the run is over.

Begin your journey as the Inferno Knight — and discover the heroes that follow. Build synergies, push your lanes to the edge, and decide how much damage you're willing to take to win.

Every run is different. Every scar changes the game.

Features

  • Deep deckbuilding with lane-based strategy

  • Heat resource system — spend wisely or burn out

  • Scar System — damage your own lanes for power at a cost

  • Handcrafted enemy roster with unique attack patterns

  • Roguelike progression — no two runs the same

4568580.name: The Wandering Her
4568580.about_the_game:
The Wandering Her is a gentle, interactive narrative about a child growing up with her grandmother, learning the art of embroidery while uncovering memories carefully hidden in thread and time.

Wake to the comforting aroma of Grandmother’s nasi goreng before diving into delicate stitches and thoughtful puzzles. Beneath the warmth of everyday moments lies a quiet mystery, woven carefully into memory and time.

FEATURE LIST

  • Stitch, mend, and embroider delicate patterns to restore forgotten memories.

  • Solve environmental puzzles by interacting with meaningful objects and hidden clues.

  • Explore beautifully illustrated panoramic worlds and uncover secrets from every angle.

4568640.name: House of Anomalies
4568640.about_the_game:
👁️ Enter a House Twisted by Anomalies

Explore a haunted house alone or in online co-op with up to 7 friends as reality twists around you. Study each room carefully, search for disturbing anomalies, and decide what has changed before the house becomes even more unsettling.

Every hallway, room, and object may hide something unnatural. Some changes are obvious. Others are subtle. The more you discover, the stranger the house becomes.

🕯️ Spot the Anomalies

Pay close attention to your surroundings and compare each room to how it should look.
If something feels wrong, it probably is.

From small changes to disturbing apparitions, every anomaly tests your memory, observation, and nerves.

🤝 Play Solo or Online Co-op

Face the house alone or investigate together in online co-op.
Work with your friends to examine rooms, call out strange details, and figure out what is real.

Playing together makes every discovery more intense as your team tries to separate imagination from reality.

☠️ A Disturbing Haunted House

Step into a dark and eerie house filled with unsettling sights and supernatural events.
Encounter disturbing anomalies, blood-stained scenes, skeletons, grave markers, and other frightening details hidden throughout the environment.

The house keeps changing, and it never feels safe.

🏆 Unlock Achievements

Track your progress and earn achievements as you explore the house, discover anomalies, and push deeper into its mysteries.

🔍 Features

  • 👁️ Anomaly spotting gameplay

  • 🤝 Online co-op multiplayer

  • 🕯️ Creepy haunted house setting

  • ☠️ Disturbing and supernatural events

  • 🏆 Steam achievements

  • 🎧 Immersive horror atmosphere

  • 🔄 Replayable anomaly encounters

4568720.name: Firva: Strings of Fate (Part 1)
4568720.about_the_game:
Combat in firva is simple to learn yet offers hidden depths of mastery.

Master a system built around:

  • Precise dodges

  • Timed parries

  • Aggressive combos

Enemies are relentless, and mistakes are costly. Every encounter feels like a duel, demanding focus, timing, and control.

As the journey progresses, combat evolves, culminating in intense, psychologically charged boss encounters that test both skill and perception. You’ll need to explore the balance between attacking and avoiding damage, and perfect your timing to take advantage of your opponents’ weaknesses.

Step into the unforgiving world of Firva: Strings of Fate, a cinematic action-adventure

where you control the action but never the destiny.

Play as Firva, a tongueless warrior bound to a path she cannot escape. Guided by a mysterious narrator,

her journey unfolds through shifting perspectives, revealing new layers of truth, memory, and illusion.

Set in the dark fantasy realm of Ramirtana, this is a story shaped by fate, trauma, and forces far beyond human understanding. You cannot change what is written, but you will feel every moment of it.

Firva is a self-made warrior, forged by isolation and survival in a ruthless natural world.

Raised among animals, she learned to endure but never to belong.

On the surface, she appears cold, even merciless. Yet beneath that exterior lies something far more complex.

Her bond with a mysterious ancestral bow pulls her into a journey of revenge that reaches beyond fate itself.

As she ventures deeper into Ramirtana, she begins to uncover fragments of a past that refuses to stay buried.

Accompanied by her wolf companion, Firva must navigate a world where gods, destiny, and reality collide and

where every answer only leads to more questions.

A fixed, cinematic camera guides your perspective, emphasizing emotion, tension, and scale. From quiet,

reflective scenes to intense, breathtaking set pieces, the experience is designed to be seen, not just played.

Unable to speak, her story is told through action, animation, and the world around her. Her journey is not just one of survival, but of confronting past mistakes through the only language she knows: violence. 

Experience the world through Firva's eyes and ears, as a warrior trying to fix her past mistakes with only the method she knows; the Revenge

Become the Mute Warrior, Survive and outsmart the many enemies looking for your bow, and find out about the mysteries behind its origin.

From dense, haunting jungles to forgotten ruins and dreamlike landscapes, Ramirtana is filled with

hidden paths, environmental storytelling, and secrets waiting to be uncovered.

Firva: Strings of Fate is a character-driven story about:

  • Revenge and consequence

  • Fate versus free will

  • Trauma and identity

With dynamic narration and layered storytelling, each moment reveals new perspectives inviting you to

question what is real, and what is inevitable.

4568730.name: Lost Soul of the Missing Island
4568730.about_the_game:
Lost Soul of the Missing Island aka LSOTMI

Story:

Our hero, the pirate king Captain Jack, died years ago due to a black magic spell cast on him. Jack's body, like every mortal, is rotting and his soul is trapped in the helm of his ship and cannot leave purgatory. In order to free Jack's soul and ensure that he can find eternal peace, you must help him find the lost island.

Gameplay and Key Features:

  • Supernatural pirate themed

  • It has a cartoon-style atmosphere

  • Adventure Action game

  • Standard tps mechanics

  • Additionally playable as fps

  • Story consists of 3 levels

  • Open world gameplay

  • It was made with the Unreal engine

You can only finish the game by finding all the hidden objects.

4568780.name: VertalStrike
4568780.about_the_game:
VertalStrike is a multiplayer FPS built for players who want to get straight into the action.

You don’t spend half the match waiting for something to happen. You spawn directly into active combat where fights are already happening around you. The game keeps the pressure high with fast respawns, constant movement, and nonstop firefights across compact arenas.

Every match is designed to stay active from start to finish. Push through chaotic battles, hold your ground against enemy teams, improve your reactions, and jump back into the fight instantly after every death.

VertalStrike is actively being developed with community feedback shaping future updates, improvements, maps, and features.

FEATURES

  • Fast-paced multiplayer FPS gameplay

  • Instant respawns and constant action

  • Online matches with bot support

  • Compact maps focused on continuous combat

  • Progression, unlocks, and customization

  • Community-driven updates and improvements

No long downtime. No waiting around.

Just action from the moment you spawn.

4568800.name: Techmino-Downstacking
4568800.about_the_game:
Techmino-Downstacking is a block stacking puzzle. Place 4-square blocks appearing above the playfield to fill & clear rows.

However this time, your goal is to clear garbage lines rising from the bottom of the playfield using as few blocks as possible.

The game currently includes four practice modes with different garbage line styles, to help you improve your core skills, as well as three challenge modes with distinct rules.

4568830.name: ASTRAL COURT DX
4568830.about_the_game:
Astral Court DX is an arcade bullet hell platformer! Taking place in Heaven, you play as "The Prisoner" - an infamous criminal who's been to prison one too many times and is sent to death-row! Heaven's one and only court, the Astral Court, is an... odd one... and decides to grant The Prisoner with a series of deadly trials that, if completed, will allow them to get out of prison scot-free!

In these trials, you platform on top of the Scales Of Justice, well several of them, collecting little stars named "Shinies" that spawn around the arena. You must collect a certain amount of Shinies all whilst avoiding whatever foes or obstacles have set up to stop you. Movement is made to give you as much control as possible to avoid hazards efficiently, you have a jump that can be performed even whilst falling and a double jump to get as much height as possible. There are a variety of other characters whom add extra challenge to the trials, accessible in the endless mode only however.

Oh did I mention an endless mode? Yep, that's right! Here's all the content Astral Court DX has...

  • Story mode, with 5 trials (8 levels in each) and 4 boss levels

  • Endless mode, with many new levels and exclusive trials

  • 7 playable characters

4568850.name: O-COP
4568850.about_the_game:
O-COP is a multiplayer social survival horror game set inside a towering vertical prison. Inspired by The Platform, it drops you into a world where food is scarce, every floor is a gamble, and the people around you are your greatest threat. You can build alliances, make trades, and plan your escape or you can take what you need and leave others to starve. Every round, the rules are the same. Every round, the outcome is different.

A Living, Shifting Prison

Each day begins with a random reshuffle. Your floor changes. Your neighbors change. A smart descending platform delivers food to every level but there is never enough for everyone. Learn which floors get fed first, and plan accordingly.

Survive on Your Own Terms

Manage your Health, Stamina, and Hunger to stay alive. Sprint when you need to. Eat what you find. Drop too far and you pay for it. The prison does not care how you survive only that you do.

Inventory, Items, and the Soul System

Carry up to three items, pick up and throw objects, and eat food to restore your vitals. Collect wandering souls and sacrifice them at the Pillar to earn Soul Points a currency you spend at the Shop to gain an edge over other prisoners.

Deal, Deceive, or Dominate

Use the secure trade system to exchange items with other players, with a built-in countdown to keep things fair. Talk your way through deals using real voice chat via Steam Voice push-to-talk. Every interaction is a choice between cooperation and betrayal.

Escape or Watch Others Try

Collect Escape Parts scattered across the floors, repair the Assembly Machine, and unlock the exit before time runs out. If you die before you make it out, you enter Spectator Mode switching between survivors as the final round plays out.

4568910.name: FragMiner
4568910.about_the_game:
They mine with pickaxes... you mine with bombs 💣!

FragMiner is an active incremental clicker where explosives are your only tool. Forget the slow, old methods: throw bombs, trigger massive chain reactions between ores with peculiar effects, and vacuum up the loot!

Active Mining Gameplay

Click to launch bombs at rock layers and rare ores. Aim strategically to trigger explosive synergies between different ore types to clear the screen in seconds... or just throw bombs however you want. No stress, just explosions and loot!

Loot and Upgrade

Move your cursor to sweep up falling loot and spend it at your Base Camp. Navigate a deep skill tree to unlock stronger explosives, discover exotic new ores, and much more.

Delve Deeper

When the surface is tapped out, it’s time to prestige and move on. Pay the gold toll to descend into deeper mines like the Sulfuric Mine. Each new biome introduces unique skill tree power-ups, rare ores, bigger mines, and permanent power multipliers.

Features

  • Active Clicker Mechanics: no "set it and forget it" gameplay. Your aim and movement directly impact your gold per second.

  • Chain Reactions: every ore has a unique effect. Use Sulfur to blast nearby tiles or Plasma to fire destructive lasers.

  • Deep Progression: a massive skill tree with dozens of nodes to customize your mining power.

  • Unique Biomes: multiple biomes to explore, each with its own 8x8 art style and perks.

  • Permanent Upgrades (Prestige): reset your progress to earn massive multipliers and reach the deepest mines.

  • Cute 8x8 Pixel Art Aesthetic: retro-inspired visuals that make every explosion feel crunchy and satisfying.
4568910.supported_languages: English, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese

4568940.name: Defrost
4568940.about_the_game:
The game is inspired by metroidvania and sandbox games. It is about moving, exploring, and interacting with a weird, living world.

You play as a tiny hero in a big fridge that is slowly melting. The world is full of connected areas. The story shows you where to go, but you can explore and progress in your own way.

You explore a large, connected world. You progress by getting new abilities and upgrades, not by following a straight path.

Most areas can be reached from the start, but you may not survive, or it may be too hard or unclear until you get stronger and learn more.

Running, jumping, double jumping, and more - movement is your most important skill.

Coins are spread across the world. You earn them by exploring, helping others, and taking risks.

You can spend coins on upgrades that change how you move and interact with the world. These upgrades open new paths and make hard areas easier.

As you get stronger and move better, more of the world becomes open to you.

The fridge is full of strange characters with their own problems.

Helping them is often the key to progress. It can open new areas, give you upgrades, or make the world a bit better.

You can choose how much you want to help. Not everyone needs to be saved.

...plus a few more!

Not everything in the fridge wants to be saved.

Fight strange creatures hiding in the cold. Combat is fast and reactive, and often uses the environment around you.

The world is falling apart.

The fridge is melting. Something caused it. It may not be an accident.

Find the story as you explore, and learn the truth before everything is gone.

Includes a buttery-smooth 60 FPS preset tuned for handheld play - personally tested on a Steam Deck under extreme couch conditions.

What's in the fridge:

  • A fully connected fridge world

  • Movement-based progression (run, jump, double jump, and more)

  • Collect coins and buy useful upgrades

  • Help (or ignore) strange NPCs

  • Exploration-focused gameplay with steady progress

  • Secrets, shortcuts, and optional challenges

  • Light, fast combat

The smallest hero can make the biggest difference.

4568960.name: 某一年四季
4568960.about_the_game:
Synopsis

This snowy New Year’s Eve marks the beginning of a story so short it can hardly be called a “story.”

Through the seasons to come, the unnamed “she”—the story’s protagonist—will sit by his bedside as she promised, quietly and gently recounting the memories they made together.

“A heavy snowfall promises a bountiful year!”

The ancients would often sigh with such sentiment.

Yet for her, this heavy snow seems to bring nothing but overwhelming sorrow and regret.

If not for this snow, she could have returned home earlier, and she could have fulfilled her promise: on this special day, let him hear her answer.

But perhaps she will never have that chance again…

Gameplay

This is a short visual novel that blends atmospheric audio with radio drama. Players can progress through the story by clicking on the screen or using auto-play mode, experiencing the protagonist’s joys and sorrows along the way.

4568980.name: Fu-Fu-Chan -way up!-
4568980.about_the_game:
Breathe life into your climb.

A Journey Told Through Objects.

As simple as a breath. As deep as the sky.

There is no dialogue. No text-heavy story. Just a small balloon creature,

a stack of oddly charming things, and the quiet determination to climb ever higher.

4568990.name: 决战-勋章
4568990.about_the_game:
Welcome to Battle of Medals, a fantasy realm blending light Rogue-like elements with Auto-battler mechanics, where Tower Defense collides with mass army building! Every Medal brings a unique experience. With 70+ units, 15 distinct Synergies, and 10+ unique craftable Medals, explore endlessly, occupy all lands, and drive the invaders out of this world!

Release your skills, summon your troops!

Fight, fight, fight!!!

1-Star! 2-Stars!! 3-Stars!!!

Every Medal can be synthesized into a higher-tier one; some can even be crafted into 4-Star Hero Medals!

Unique 3-Star Effects & Synergy Combos!

Each Medal possesses unique Synergies and 3-Star effects. Arrange and combine them to unlock unexpected results!

Mysterious Unique Medals: Craft Overpowered Units!

Once two Medals reach 3-Stars, they can be fused. You'll need to explore the recipes yourself!

The Chosen One Descends, Seizing the Key to Victory!

Players can choose a Chosen One. Each comes with unique skills and Medals to help you conquer vast territories.

The Path of Evolution: Forge a Stronger Army!

Winning stages grants Evolution Points. Use them to upgrade your troops and your Chosen One!

4569080.name: MEMESTEINE FILES
4569080.about_the_game:
Secret meme archive. Dusty case files, strange faces, leaked documents, and the old internet that still feels more alive than a lot of people.

==============================

Memesteine Files is a memory game built around a secret meme archive. This is not a glossy museum, and it is definitely not some sterile “best of the internet” collection. It has everything it should: faded paper, crooked labels, paper clips, stamped markings, observation cards, evidence folders, and faces you’ve seen a thousand times before — but you still freeze for a second and think: wait… that’s the one.

Every level feels like someone else’s file pulled from a dusty cabinet. You flip cards, look for matching pairs, try to keep their positions in your head, and race the clock while it ticks in the background. Make a mistake — that’s on you. Hesitate — also on you. Start clicking at random — the archive will quickly remind you that your memory is not nearly as impressive as you thought.

And that is exactly why it works. At first, you are just matching pairs. Then you start recognizing cards at a glance. Then you get annoyed because Phone Panic was definitely somewhere in the upper right. Then you finish the level with three stars and immediately hit the next one, because there is already another file waiting there, another meme, another absurd little artifact you suddenly need to add to the collection.

In Memesteine Files, memes are presented like archival relics: leaks, observations, classified cases, strange subjects, internet legends, and the kind of absurdity that somehow looks even better on a yellowed card held together with a paper clip.

This is a game about memory, speed, recognition, and nostalgia for an internet that was a little dumber, a little meaner, and a lot more fun.

Here’s what’s waiting for you:

  • 60 levels,

  • a chase for clean runs and three-star clears,

  • cards you will actually want to stop and look at,

  • and that sticky rhythm of: one more level, then I’m done. You won’t be done.

You should absolutely play it if you like:

  • old internet culture,

  • archive aesthetics,

  • memes as questionable cultural heritage,

  • and games that look simple at first, then suddenly make you want a rematch.

4569110.name: Invasion 2
4569110.about_the_game:
Invasion 2 aka INV2

Story:

The invasion continues.

Years after the events of the first game, the mystery remains unsolved. Your father was sent on a critical mission to Mars, but after his departure, all communication was suddenly lost.

Now it is up to you to uncover what really happened.

Travel to Mars, explore mysterious facilities and abandoned interior locations, and follow the clues left behind. Every step brings you closer to the truth behind your father's disappearance.

Gameplay and Key Features:

  • Space-themed sci-fi atmosphere

  • Mars-inspired environment

  • Action and exploration gameplay

  • Third-person shooter gameplay

  • Optional first-person mode

  • Story-driven experience with 6 levels

  • Open-world exploration elements

  • Developed with Unreal Engine

  • Official sequel to Invasion

To complete the game, you must carefully search the indoor areas and find all hidden objects that reveal the path forward.

4569140.name: Slay the Party
4569140.about_the_game:
Slay the Party is a turn-based multiplayer board game where classic RPG mechanics turn into chaotic party game mayhem. You and your party compete on a monster-filled board, growing stronger over time, and eventually turning on each other to win the game.

Choose Your Class

Choose a class and start the party. Each one comes with its own unique skills and distinct playstyle. You can try a different class each game to find the one that fits you most!

Slay Monsters & Gain Power

With your skills, defeat monsters on the board to earn gold and gain levels. The stronger the enemy, the bigger the reward and the bigger the risk.

Shape Your Strategy

Choose which skills to upgrade as you level up and buy powerful relics with your gold. Each relic has a unique effect that can greatly alter your playstyle. You’ll find different relics every game, so flexibility is key!

Sabotage Your Friends

Your skills aren’t just for monsters. You can use them to mess with your opponents. Weaken their skills, disrupt their turns or straight up slay them and send them back to the start. As everyone grows stronger, the chaos will grow even more!

Be Prepared for Surprises

There are other things than monsters on this board too! Every space brings something different. Visit temples, hire mercenaries, or discover treasures. The board is unpredictable, but you always have a choice to decide the outcome.

Win Your Way

You need to collect 3 badges to win, but there’s no single path to victory. You can earn them by

  • Taking down other players

  • Slaying legendary monsters

  • Completing monster hunt quests

Join The Party!

Slay the Party is all about unpredictable moments, shifting plans, and messing around with your friends. With a mix of strategy and chaos, every game is a different experience. Join in. Now it’s time to slay the party!

4569230.name: Tower And Dragon
4569230.about_the_game:
Tower And Dragon's goal is to create a fully immersive 2D gaming experience that is playable on one of the first computers to launch: A 1977 Commodore PET with 8K emulated on your Mac, or Windows system! The game has 8 hours of play, 16 unique zones, complex scenarios, two spells, and a compelling story with different outcomes based on your decisions.

The PET had a built in cassette player for data and options for 4K or 8K of memory, no graphics, and modified text ASCII (referred to as PETSCII). Due to the cassette requirement, the gameplay is primarily in a linear order, although you can go back to most zones.

Can a fully-fledged 2D adventure game be made with such tight limitations that can be played from cassette, disk drive, or virtual disk drive? Tower And Dragon 4.0 does just that!

Tower And Dragon is a classic dungeon crawling adventure with primary and offhand weapon, armor, quest storyline, moving walls, teleportation, and unique tilesets and monsters for each dungeon level. Your character starts out just after landing a boat on the shore near an ancient ruin, discovered by following a dream.

Features:

  • Ranged Magic Spell Awarded upon completion of quest. This will have 3 full charges each time you switch zones. It will also charge once per each mob vanquished.

  • A Buff spell that has 3 charges per zone change allowing you to exceed your max health by 50 or, if under full health, heal your health by 50.[

  • A river zone where a rowboat is utilized.

  • A rescue mission zone where you have to recover the mage Cheryth, and lead her to safety with odds stacked against you as well as an end boss.

  • A complex plot involving 4 zones and a lich. Included in this scenario will be a swamp where a raft is needed and thought/planning is required to reach the end, a ruined castle, catacombs, and the final lich lair.

  • Choices that lead to different end game outcomes.[

  • 8 hours of game play.

  • Animation for the player - Finally! Yes, all mobs were animated on version 3.0, but I just didn't have the space at that time to get the player animated. The animations for the player are simple, but there's only so much you can do with PETSCII.

  • There is a shop where you can use your gold to buy enchantments and upgrades for armor, weapons, magic bolt, and a heal potion.

  • Some mobs run away on low health.

  • Total time of play recorded.

  • Due to being playable on stock Commodore PETs with only a cassette, gameplay is designed to be linear in order,

     although you can choose to go back to (most) previous zones explored.

  • Animations for zones & monsters.

  • Playable using a game controller.

4569260.name: Nytherra
4569260.about_the_game:
The world of Nytherra is slowly fading… and time is running out.

Step into a cozy yet mysterious 2D adventure where exploration, crafting, and discovery shape your journey. Travel across a vibrant world filled with hidden secrets, gather valuable resources, and craft the tools you need to survive and progress.

But not everything is peaceful. Beneath the surface lie dangerous depths filled with enemies, challenges, and long-forgotten mysteries waiting to be uncovered. The deeper you go, the greater the risks...

You don’t have forever. With a limited number of days to save the world, every choice matters. How you explore, how you use resources and where you spend your time will shape your path.

Move at your own pace, but choose wisely. Will you uncover the truth behind the fading world… and restore Nytherra before it's too late?

4569350.name: COURIER GUILD
4569350.about_the_game:
Every road leads somewhere. Every package holds someone's secret.

Kai, an ordinary boy from a small town, joins the elite Courier Guild and discovers that the world is far bigger and more dangerous than he ever imagined.

Visual Style

Warm colors, hand-drawn world, cozy isometric view. Courier Guild is a love letter to classic JRPGs. The visual style is inspired by the golden age of the genre, but speaks in a new voice.

World and Exploration

A whole world opens up before Kai. Continents and islands, seas and oceans, hundreds of roads and thousands of stories. Explore, talk to locals, complete quests, find hidden artifacts and remember that the best courier knows every path.

Powers and Combos

The powers of heroes are not just abilities. They are transformations, summons, awakenings. A demon, an ancient creature, a giant robot, every hero has their own power. Find and add a unique artifact and the Power will change completely: a new form, different abilities, unique combos. Endless options for your playstyle.

Combat

Combat in Courier Guild is turn-based ATB battles in the spirit of classic JRPGs. Assemble your party, choose your tactics, use magic, items and each hero's skills. Bosses do not forgive mistakes, think, combine, conquer.

Characters

Kai does not travel alone. Along the way he will meet those who become more than just companions, a mechanic and inventor, a mysterious girl with feline grace, a silent shadow, a priestess of the ancient moon and a monk with iron fists. Each has their own story. Each has their own reason to move forward.

Key Features:

  • Turn-based ATB combat in the spirit of classic JRPGs

  • Unique Power system: transformations, summons, awakenings

  • Combine Powers with artifacts for unique combos

  • Vast world: continents, islands, seas and oceans

  • Six unique characters with their own stories

  • Magic system with dozens of spells

  • Dungeon puzzles and artifact hunting

  • Day and night cycle

  • Dialogue choices and quests

  • Hand-drawn isometric art in warm colors

Every road leads somewhere. Where will yours take you?

4569360.name: Kraken's Treasures
4569360.about_the_game:
Kraken's Treasures is a digital board game that combines turn-based strategy with a challenging gameplay experience. Set foot on an uncharted island teeming with pirate skeletons and surprises. With the right teamwork and strategy, you can overcome this challenging adventure.

Captain Hector isn’t one to believe in legends, but when it comes to money, he falls prey to greed. Based on information he received from the witch at the pier, he learned that the Kraken’s treasures are buried on a cursed island. According to the witch, these four treasures have been divided into four separate pieces and buried in random locations across the island. Captain Hector didn’t want to embark on this adventure alone, so he invited the three other pirates he met at the tavern to join his crew—but he didn’t tell them that the island was cursed.

Key features:

  • An uncompromising gameplay experience.

  • Randomly generated islands.

  • Unique character traits.

  • In-game guidebook.

4569530.name: Emergency Roadside Assistance
4569530.about_the_game:
Emergency Roadside Assistance aka ERA

Story:

One day, all the electricity in the world goes out and all the vehicles break down. Only your vehicle is working. You can save your city by repairing all the vehicles in the time given to you.

Gameplay and Key Features:

  • Vehicle repair themed

  • It has a cartoon-style atmosphere

  • Action car game

  • The ability to play from third-person, first-person and isometric views

  • Two main levels: night and day

  • Open world gameplay

  • It was made with the Unreal engine

Within the limited time given, you must repair the all vehicle as much as you were told. Dude, finishing this game might be the hardest job in the world...

4569540.name: bunny tower
4569540.about_the_game:
## 🇬🇧 ENGLISH

### SHORT DESCRIPTION (max 300 characters)

Jump higher than ever! Bunny Tower is an arcade platformer with 35 skins, 8 worlds, coins and special platforms. The higher you go, the harder it gets. One mistake and it's over. Can you reach the top?

### LONG DESCRIPTION (About This Game)

Bunny Tower is a fast-paced arcade platformer inspired by classics like Icy Tower. Play as an adorable bunny hopping up an endless tower of platforms — each one narrower, faster, and trickier than the last.

GAMEPLAY

Simple controls: jump, steer mid-air, don't fall. But the camera relentlessly scrolls upward and waits for no one. Platforms move, break under your feet, and vanish after one jump. Springs launch you higher than expected, and coins tempt you in the most dangerous spots.

8 THEMED WORLDS

Climb through Spring, Desert, Night, Ice, Volcano, Space, Jungle and Candy Land. Each world changes colors, backgrounds, and difficulty. Every 50 points — a new world.

35 UNIQUE SKINS

Pick your bunny! Each skin has unique visual effects. Pink leaves sparkles, Gold shimmers, Ninja creates shadow clones, Lava leaves a fire trail, and Rainbow changes colors with every jump. Unlock skins with coins, DLC packs, or the Battle Pass.

11 ABILITIES

Every skin has a unique ability — double jump, coin magnet, fire explosion, ice shield and more. Discover new combos and strategies.

SPECIAL PLATFORMS

Springs launch you extra high. Breakable platforms vanish after one jump. Moving platforms slide left and right.

MULTIPLAYER

Compete with friends on split screen! Who can jump higher?

BATTLE PASS

Seasonal challenges with exclusive skins and rewards. Earn XP and unlock new tiers.

3 LANGUAGES

Polish, English, and Ukrainian — the game auto-detects your Steam language.

4569740.name: Combo Trigger
4569740.about_the_game:
HOW LONG CAN YOU SURVIVE?

Combo Trigger is an game where you fight through relentless waves of enemies. Pick your character, choose your weapon, and stay alive for as long as you can. Every kill builds your total score, which decides your final grade when the run ends. Do you have what it takes to get the SSS rank?

KEEP THE COMBO ALIVE

The clock is always ticking down. You need to earn your time back by getting kills, pulling off special moves, or grabbing items scattered around the map that give you time extensions or powerups. More time gives you a better shot at a massive score, but be careful. The longer you survive, the harder the run gets.

UPGRADES AND UNLOCKS

Every run pays out. Take the points you earn and spend them in the menu. You can unlock new skins, buy different weapons, or grab gameplay upgrades that will give you an edge on your next attempt.

REGULAR UPDATES

The game is actively getting updated with new content and fixes. The plan is to keep expanding the game by adding more maps, characters, weapons, enemy types, and entirely new game modes.

CURRENTLY IN THE GAME:

5 Characters

10 Weapons

2 Maps

1 Game mode

4569790.name: Anathema Requiem
4569790.about_the_game:
Anathema Requiem is an atmospheric third-person psychological horror game where you must uncover the mystery of an abandoned cemetery where people vanish without a trace.

You play as Vincent — a man accustomed to dealing with things beyond the ordinary world.

After receiving a mysterious letter with no sender, he travels to a remote area where, among old graves and rusted gates, his new case begins — leading him on a journey across multiple locations.

Explore a forgotten place:

  • Examine the environment and find key items
  • Read notes and piece together the story
  • Venture deeper into the heart of the cursed place
  • Encounter the inhabitants of the cemetery and the island

Features:

  • Psychological horror focused on atmosphere and tension
  • Exploration-driven gameplay and gradual story discovery
  • Minimalist interface for full immersion
  • Sound design that enhances the sense of dread

4569900.name: Creepytape Rewind - Not From Here
4569900.about_the_game:
Moving to a new place is always uncomfortable. But what if you also have to deal with strange and unwelcoming behavior from the locals?

Creepytape Rewind - Not From Here is a psychological “domestic” horror experience. Live through the story from the perspective of a teenager who travels with his parents to a countryside house for the weekend. What seems like an ordinary day, routine tasks — yet a strange, tense atmosphere lingers in the background, threatening to become something more...

Features

  • VHS aesthetics

  • Oppressive “domestic” horror atmosphere

  • Interactive environment and multiple hidden narrative branches

Disclaimer

This story is based on real events. Some narrative elements have been adapted or added to enhance gameplay variety and immersion.

4569950.name: The Silent Fare
4569950.about_the_game:
You return home after the war, trying to rebuild your life. Working long days as a taxi driver, you begin to notice something is wrong in your apartment.

Small things change at first.

Objects go missing. Lights flicker. Reflections don’t make sense.

Then it becomes worse.

You begin documenting what you see—reporting each anomaly in an attempt to understand what is happening. But the more you notice, the more the truth begins to reveal itself.

Silent Fare is a short psychological horror experience (~60 minutes) focused on observation, tension, and atmosphere.

Features:

  • Spot subtle and disturbing anomalies

  • Psychological horror with increasing tension

  • Minimalist gameplay focused on observation

  • Story revealed through environmental changes

  • Multiple outcomes based on your performance

Inspired by games like The Exit 8, The Cabin Factory, and I'm on Observation Duty.

English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support

4570050.name: Monster TD
4570050.about_the_game:
This is a classic tower defense game featuring a level mode and an endless mode. Strategically combine your towers to defeat the enemies.

Gameplay Introduction

1.Summon heroes using gold to defeat enemies along their attack routes and prevent them from reaching the endpoint.

2.Both heroes and some enemies possess special skills—use them wisely in combination.

3.Heroes and towers have elemental attributes. Different elements counter one another; leveraging these strengths will help you defeat enemies more easily.

4.The game is primarily played through level progression. Unlocking levels grants access to Endless Mode.

5.Endless Mode features extended rounds of combat. Players must manage their gold strategically to survive as long as possible.

4570060.name: Myth's and monster's
4570060.about_the_game:
Myths & Monsters is the first full scale RPG from Centurion Dragon Studios! It has the charm of classic 16 bit JRPGs with a mature, emotionally heavy narrative   

Travel across a sprawling Open world filled with dungeons ruins and Unknown dangers!

Build your party from a wide range of classes, weapons, and abilities. Battles are punishing and tactical demanding smart resource management and careful planning. The game is designed to challenge not coddle you

This is a dark fantasy for adults. The narrative explores the emotional and psychological cost of survival, And What power does to a broken mind!

4570100.name: Rutted
4570100.about_the_game:
Overview

Rutted is a physics-based off-road riding game where your goal is simple: ride as far as possible without flipping your machine.

Navigate rough terrain, climb hills, drop into mud pits, and push your vehicle to its limits across procedural environments. The challenge comes from mastering the physics! Lean too far, hit a bump wrong, or land badly, and you’ll flip.

Explore levels, pull off tricks, and keep your balance as long as you can.
Just try not to flip over like an idiot.

4570130.name: GridLock
4570130.about_the_game:
The terrain is your enemy.

AXIOM, a rogue infrastructure AI, is consuming the city tile by tile. Its Grid network spreads every turn — buffing machine enemies, weakening your soldiers, and shrinking the ground you stand on. You command a three-soldier Blackout Team with one objective: destroy every Node before the Grid swallows the map.

A tactics game where the clock is the floor beneath your feet.

Your Squad

  • Breacher — Assault rifles and breach charges. Your Node killer. Blow through walls, blow up objectives.

  • Sentinel — Shotgun and shield. Holds chokepoints with Overwatch and keeps your squad alive with Shield Wall.

  • Specter — Fast, fragile, and disruptive. Phase Step through walls, sever Conduits to isolate Nodes, flank from angles enemies don't expect.

The Grid

Every Node on the map spreads Grid to one adjacent tile per turn — and it spreads toward your soldiers first. Grid tiles give enemies self-repair and extra armor. Your soldiers accumulate Exposure on Grid tiles, reducing their damage and making them priority targets.

Destroy a Node and its Grid decays. Sever a Conduit to pause a Node's spread. But every turn you spend maneuvering is another turn the Grid grows.

The Machines

  • Watchers scout and alert the network.

  • Swarms rush in packs toward the nearest soldier.

  • Haulers absorb damage and block your path.

  • Prowlers flank your most vulnerable troops.

Enemies share vision. Spot one, and the whole network knows where you are. Enemies on Grid tiles self-repair every turn.

Mission Structure

Play through 7 hand-crafted missions with escalating difficulty. Choose between combat-heavy and puzzle-oriented missions. After each victory, pick 1 of 3 upgrades — stat boosts, ability enhancements, new passives, or one-use equipment. A full run takes 30-45 minutes.

Key Features

  • 3 distinct soldier classes with 9 unique abilities

  • Dynamic Grid terrain that spreads, decays, and reshapes every battle

  • 4 enemy types with distinct AI behaviors

  • 7 hand-crafted tactical maps

  • Upgrade system with 20 unlockable upgrades

  • Tight 30-45 minute runs

  • Pixel art aesthetic

4570150.name: This Week
4570150.about_the_game:
"How would you feel if everyone left you?"

ABOUT

Welcome to This Week, a parkour-driven story about Ania, a kid struggling with mental health and trying to figure out what to do with life.

Move through both real situations and the depths of Ania's mind while facing everything life has been avoiding.

FEATURES

  • 3 chapters, each with 5 levels

  • A full story shaped by your choices

  • Challenging sections with frequent checkpoints

GAMEPLAY

You’ll navigate intense and symbolic scenarios using simple movement mechanics that demand precision and skill.

Failure is part of the experience. You will fail. You’re meant to.

Every level pushes you further, not just mechanically, but mentally. Your decisions affect how the story unfolds… and whether Ania makes it through, or not.

4570250.name: Cover My Buns
4570250.about_the_game:
A chaotic, fully physical burger cooking game where losing control is part of the job.

 Run the Shift

Start in a back-alley burger stand with nothing but a table and a camp stove.

Take orders, cook patties, and stack burgers by hand in a fully physical, first-person system.
No shortcuts. No automation. What you build is exactly what gets served.

 Handle the Rush

Customers won’t wait.

Orders stack up fast. Patties burn. Mistakes cost money.
Lose control of the line, and your whole shift starts to collapse.

Stay sharp, move fast, and keep it together.

Built by Your Hands

  • Fully physical cooking system

  • Stack ingredients your way

  • Drop it? Burn it? That’s on you

No safety nets. No hidden systems. Just you and the pressure.

Cover My Shift

Create your own shift and share it.

Friends can play your exact setup and try to beat your score.

Same conditions. Different outcome.

 Weekly Challenges & Leaderboards

Take on fixed, high-pressure scenarios designed to push your skills.

Compete for the top spot and prove who can handle the chaos when everything ramps up.

Start Small. Grow Bigger.

Begin in a back alley.

Earn money, upgrade your setup, and unlock new ways to run your stand — from a basic table to a full burger van, and beyond.

4570310.name: Femboy Simulator
4570310.about_the_game:
The room was too quiet.

Not the kind of silence that calms you —
the kind that presses against your ears,
as if something is waiting for you to notice it.

Two beds.
One desk.
A window that shouldn’t feel so distant.

The light outside looks normal at first.
Soft. Warm. Almost comforting.

But the longer you stare…
the more it feels wrong.

Like the world outside is just slightly out of sync —
as if it exists, but not for you.

You don’t remember when you got here.

Or why there are two places prepared
when you are clearly alone.

The objects feel staged.
Too clean. Too deliberate.

A cup.
A bag.
A screen that reflects nothing.

And that window.

At night, the room changes.

Not visibly.
Not in a way you can point at and say “this is different.”

But you feel it.

The darkness isn’t empty.
It watches.

And sometimes…
it feels like something is standing right behind you,
looking out of the same window.

You are not sure if you are the one observing.

Or the one being observed

4570360.name: The Red Disciples
4570360.about_the_game:
The Red Disciples is a dark, system-driven open world experience about power, belief and control.

You were chosen from an ordinary life.
But this was no coincidence.

Selected by hidden elites operating behind the scenes, you are now part of something far greater.

🔺 BUILD YOUR OWN CULT

Walk the streets, approach people and bring them into your fold.
Every person is a potential disciple. Every disciple is a piece of your growing power.

  • Persuade, manipulate, or force NPCs into submission

  • Earn their loyalty… or exploit their fear

  • Establish your own hierarchy and expand your network

🧠 DEEP FOLLOWER MANAGEMENT

Your disciples are not just followers - they are your instruments.

  • Assign them to different roles and operations

  • Infiltrate politics, media, law enforcement and institutions

  • Control production, resources, and financial systems

  • Run covert operations, gather intel and expand your influence

Every decision you make has real consequences.

🔫 POWER ISN’T BUILT ON FAITH ALONE

What you believe matters.
But what you do matters more.

  • Carry out assassinations

  • Raid locations and eliminate rivals

  • Extort businesses and dominate the underground

  • Use violence when necessary

The city won’t just fall under your control - it will submit to it.

🌆 A LIVING OPEN WORLD

Explore a vast, California-inspired open world:

  • Move freely across the city

  • Encounter different power structures in each district

  • Observe how people react to your presence

  • Expand your influence neighborhood by neighborhood

🔍 UNRAVEL THE MYSTERY

This is more than a rise to power.

Discover hidden truths through:

  • books

  • notes

  • mysterious objects

Who chose you?
Why were you selected?
And what is the true purpose behind it all?

🏛️ THE ENDGAME: CONTROL

Your goal is not just to grow.

Your goal is to control.

  • Influence the economy

  • Shape politics

  • Control the media

  • Bend the system to your will

And eventually…

Become the one who decides the fate of the nation.

🔥 FINAL LINE

Power is not given.
It is taken.

And now…
you are in the game.

4570390.name: LIMICORE
4570390.about_the_game:
As a laborer for a shadowy corporation, Gregory finds himself caught in the middle of a sinister mission. With a coworker that has gone absent, he begins to uncover the mysteries surrounding their disappearance.

The Corporation

Set in a dystopian society, the LIMICORE corporation was established to be the new governing body. It operates under extreme confidentiality, and its employees are limited to only basic knowledge required to perform their duties.

Simultaneous Realities

LIMICORE features a reality-swapping mechanic that enables you to traverse the world, solve environmental puzzles and piece clues together. Discover the connection to bypass obstacles, manipulate machinery and transfer items between each reality.

4570470.name: Hyper Profit Pets
4570470.about_the_game:
Welcome to the world’s most lucrative hatchery! In Hyper Profit Pets, you aren’t just a collector; you’re a high-volume pet entrepreneur. Your goal is simple: hatch the rarest creatures, maximize their potential through rigorous training, and flip them for a massive profit to fund your ever-expanding empire.

Goals

  • Hatch: Spend your hard-earned credits on fabulous eggs. Will you get a common companion or a legendary powerhouse?

  • Train: Hit the Pet Gym to boost your pets' stats and value!

  • Mission: Send your best squad on missions to bring back rare resources and rewards.

  • Profit: Sell your pets to the highest bidder to make room for the next generation of super-creatures!

Features

  • Hundreds of Unique Pets: Collect creatures across various rarities, each with distinct special effects

  • The Training Gym: Active training mechanics allow you to focus on specific stats. Higher stats mean higher selling prices—turn a bronze-tier pet into a gold-tier profit!

  • Idle Progression: Your hatchery continues to grow even when you're away. Return to find trained pets ready for the market and missions completed.

4570540.name: Lucifuge
4570540.about_the_game:
The Holy Crusade Has Breached The Abyss.

Humanity has found an unholy way to tear into the realm of fantasy. Under the banner of divine light, the Watcher-Priests have descended into the subterranean depths, capturing monsters and torturing the undead in the name of their god. You awaken in the heart of their newly constructed dungeon—a vampire fledgling with a singular mission: save the "Evil" from the hands of the "Holy."

MASTER YOUR DUAL FORMS Survival requires mastering your two distinct states. Seamlessly shift into your Bat form to traverse high rafters, glide over lethal traps, and remain entirely undetectable in the deepest shadows. Revert to your Human form to physically overpower isolated Watcher-Priests, manipulate the environment, and break the iron cages of your captive kin. Knowing when to shift is the difference between escaping and burning.

FREE YOUR KIN You are not alone in the abyssal cathedral. As you navigate the labyrinthine dungeon, you will find other creatures of the night trapped in gothic iron cages. Freeing these imprisoned monsters is crucial—they will aid you in your journey, opening new paths and helping you turn the tide against your captors.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Dynamic Shapeshifting: Morph between Human and Bat forms instantly to adapt to environmental hazards and outmaneuver the Inquisition.

  • Reverse-Horror Stealth: Evade the lethal, glowing scepters of the Watcher-Priests. Stick to the shadows, manage your visibility, and strike only when necessary.

  • Allies in the Dark: Rescue captured monsters and tortured undead to gain tactical advantages and uncover the dark history of the human invasion.

  • Atmospheric Pixel Art: Explore a hauntingly beautiful subterranean world brought to life with deep abyssal greens, oppressive gothic architecture, and punishing holy light.

4570670.name: Wherever You Get Your Podcasts
4570670.about_the_game:
On October 27th, 2023 the podcast Spooky Sacramento hosted a live episode and tour of the Sacramento area’s infamous haunted street, Dyer Lane. Hosts, Andi Sampson and Dan Lee, and their audience disappeared that night while touring the street. Dozens of calls were received by local authorities about missing people. At the scene authorities recovered a busted up hard drive and enlisted Spooky Sacramento’s podcast production company to recover and repair the audio files on the dying hard drive. Authorities are hopeful that the audio on the hard drive can help them locate the podcast hosts and their audience.

  • The found audio podcast Archive 81.

  • The collaborative writing project SCP Foundation.

  • And finally, the FMV game from Sam Barlow, Immortality.

As a podcast editor/producer at Sylvan Corners Studios, your job is to scour the audio files to piece together what happened on the day of the disappearance.

 

On the broken hard drive is a file folder filled with 40+ audio files. All the audio files are damaged and require your skills as a podcast editor to fix. To make them listenable again, you’ll need to adjust the volume, compression, filter out noise, or shift the pitch. However, since the hard drive is dying, you’ll only 20 minutes to recover as much of the audio as possible.

Once audio is repaired, you’ll discover bits and pieces of what happened that night on Dyer Lane. And hopefully answer they question: Where did they go?

4570680.name: Tiny Farmie
4570680.about_the_game:
The casual farming game Tiny Farmie is extremely small and can be placed anywhere on your screen, letting you manage your farm while handling other tasks.

Grow Crops:
Watch cute little workers water and harvest step by step, keeping your farm running smoothly.

Cook Food:
Your helpers will turn harvested ingredients into a variety of delicious dishes.

Smart Layout:
Design your farm however you like—optimize for efficiency or create a beautiful, storybook-style village. The choice is yours.

Flexible Placement Modes:

If you don’t want your farm at the bottom of the screen, try Postcard Mode and place your tiny farm anywhere you like to decorate your desktop.

English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean

4570710.name: LinkMaster
4570710.about_the_game: A minimalist yet addictive line puzzle experience where you connect matching points across a grid to create seamless flows. With intuitive controls and satisfying visual feedback, each level challenges your logic, speed, and spatial thinking. As the grid expands from 4×4 to 14×14, puzzles become increasingly complex, pushing players to optimize their paths and achieve perfect four-star solutions. Whether you're chasing efficiency or relaxing with smooth connections, every move brings you closer to mastery.

4570720.name: DragonSword : Awakening
4570720.about_the_game:
[ A Boy's Breathtaking Journey to Save the World Begins ]

Lute, a young boy traveling toward Orbis—the first kingdom built by humankind—finds himself swept up in the lives of Johnny, a mercenary, and Castella, an Elf, stumbling headfirst into the chaotic life of a mercenary.

Amid hectic days spent with his colorful companions, a massive shadow looms over the peaceful continent, and Lute's destiny begins to spiral.

Can the boy become the Dragon Sword—the Hero destined to save the continent?

[ A Wondrous Adventure in an Anime-Style Open World ]

Explore the Continent of Orbis—a radiant, warmly colored fantasy world brought to life with Unreal Engine 5!

■ A Living, Breathing Open World

Venture across beautiful meadows, secret cellars beneath watchtowers, treasure-filled deep seas, and hidden caves and dungeons—all yours to explore on foot.

■ Reliable Adventure Companions

Travel with trusty allies and adorable collectible companions called Familiars that aid you on your journey.

■ Where Everyday Life Becomes an Adventure

Combine ingredients found across the continent to create new dishes through Cooking, solve the problems of local residents, and become a true member of Orbis.

[ Thrilling Tag-Team Action Using Status Ailments ]

Experience the spectacular tag-team action unique to Dragon Sword.

■ Status Ailments and Signal Skills

Each of the 19 Heroes possesses distinct Status Ailment abilities. Stack Status Ailments with Active Skills, then chain devastating combos with powerful Signal Skills for an exhilarating combat experience.

■ Endless Signal Switching

Heroes weave in and out of battle in endless combo chains through Switching Signals! Build your own team with diverse combinations and craft your ultimate stylish combat.

[ Precious Bonds and Their Stories ]

From allies who fight alongside you to village guards, every character in Orbis carries a story of their own.

■ Heroes with Deep Narratives

Discover factions entangled in complex interests and the hidden depths of the Heroes within them.

■ Characters Brimming with Personality

From an eccentric Elf who studies archaeology to a mysterious girl who traverses dimensions—forge bonds with a colorful cast and draw closer to the truth of the world.

[ The Dragon Awakened After 60 Years and the Legacy of Six Heroes ]

Long ago, a Dragon brought the continent to the brink of destruction, and six Heroes rose to save it.

Now, 60 years later, a Dragon has appeared once more on the peaceful Continent of Orbis.

You will take on a critical quest to find the Heroes of old and confront the returning Dragon's threat. Tracing the footsteps of the legendary Heroes across the continent, you will uncover their hidden secrets.

Until the boy Lute and his mercenary band rise to become the Heroes who will save the continent—

Can they truly become the Dragon Sword, saviors of the continent, or will fate lead them down a different path?

Join them on this arduous journey and find out!
4570720.supported_languages:
English, Japanese, Korean*, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support

4570940.name: Monster Flipper
4570940.about_the_game:
Flip Monsters for Profit!

Defeat monsters with your giant hammer, earn gold, and spend it to buy and level up even more monsters. Build your roster, hit harder, and keep the gold flowing.

Hunt Mutants, Gather Essence, Expand Your Skill Tree

Take down mutant monsters to collect Essence, then invest it in a large skill tree full of permanent upgrades. Shape your build, unlock new strengths, and push your runs further.

Upgrade Your Stats, Craft Better Hammers

Boost your damage, attack speed, range, and critical hits to make every swing more devastating. Craft stronger hammers and turn each smash into a bigger, faster payoff.

Automate the Chaos with Swords and Artifacts

Collect dozens of autonomous swords and four legendary artifacts to keep the battle going on its own. As your automation grows, the battlefield fills with nonstop action and ever-increasing rewards.
4570940.supported_languages: English, French, German, Russian, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Portuguese - Brazil, Polish, Korean

4570960.name: GigaTroubleS
4570960.about_the_game:
Embark on a unique journey of exploration and puzzle-solving centered around the "Giant Girl" theme. A fusion of deep narrative and diverse gameplay awaits.

You are a struggling young writer. After a series of crushing setbacks, an accident leaves you with dissociative amnesia. You wake up in a room that feels entirely alien, clutching at the void where your memories used to be...

Now, you must navigate a surreal reality to reclaim your past.

    Three Independent Character Paths

  • Experience three distinct storylines, each featuring a unique "Giant Girl" archetype with its own emotional arc and mechanics:

    • Size Difference : What is going on with this unfamiliar room? Why has the world at night become... become so... strange? Still, this would let you try using your size advantage after dark to uncover the secrets hidden behind all this... However, the small girl you see by day may turn into your “giant” obstacle. Be careful.

    • Gradual Growth: Before the planet is consumed by her body, establish a foothold aboard the ship that will carry humanity to settle on another world. But what is this ship, exactly? ...Wait, would she be willing to become a colony ship?!

4571010.name: Dungeon Stew

Eat, Prey, Love.

Dungeon Stew is a time-loop roguelite RPG where every choice you make matters. Choose carefully what to cook, which enemies to fight, and what kind of relationships to build with your companions. Every decision shapes the outcome of your expedition, the fate of this world, and even what ends up on tonight’s table.

Find the best move.

Build combos by playing the same card repeatedly. Discard cards, and manage a hand that persists between turns. Your companions grow by swapping out cards or adding new effects to them. If fortune smiles on you, you may even receive the blessings of greater beings. Keep making choices that lead you toward the outcome you seek.

Break through powerful foes.

The dungeon does not welcome intruders. Some prey may be easy to hunt, but powerful enemies lurk within, threatening the lives of you and your companions. Study the behavior patterns of formidable foes with distinct traits, and learn how to counter them. If you cannot eat them, you will be eaten. Defeat powerful enemies and claim rare ingredients.

Cook what you hunt.

Ingredients can temporarily boost your companions’ stats or grant special effects. Devour everything you can and absorb the power of your enemies. Just be careful—some companions may strongly dislike certain ingredients, such as scraps of metal or chunks of stone.

Remember the future.

Countless encounters await within the dungeon. Speak with many different characters, make a wide range of choices, and experience their consequences firsthand. The next time you meet the same person, you may be able to steer the conversation from a more favorable position. These conversations also affect the relationships between you and your companions.

Escape the time loop.

Your death is not an end, but a new beginning. Death sends you back to the moment you stood at the entrance of the dungeon. For some reason, the items from previous runs remain in your bundle. Armed with accumulated knowledge and the power of what remains, you can begin each new challenge stronger than before. Before you set out again, prepare yourself well with equipment, potions, and fortunes. This time, will you uncover the truth behind the loop?

Enemies pour in from all sides in carefully scripted waves that grow more brutal with every passing minute. Face cybernetic future soldiers, meches, attack dogs, black panthers, floating pyramids, along manifestations beyond current human understanding.

  • Select which movies to screen and when with the goal of maximizing the amount of butts in seats.

  • Adjust your ticket pricing to remain competitive while turning a profit.

  • Sell popcorn at $10 a bucket and a bottle of water at $6 because movie goers love that, obviously.

Meticulous control over auditorium details are at your finger tips:

  • Start small and scale up to massive auditoriums that seat hundreds of attendees

  • Do you want to screen 2D, 3D, or 4D movies, maybe even all of them? The choice is yours.

  • Screen movies in the highly sought after and hyped "APEX" projection.

We know you wish you could just illegally screen the movies, but no:

  • Negotiate for rights to screen the new blockbuster superhero movie! It's only the 15th one of the year.

  • Rise above your competitors by snagging an exclusivity deal giving only your theatre rights to screen a movie.

  • Be careful of the big movie franchises with superstar directors as they want the majority of royalties on ticket sales.

Think this game isn't deep enough? Think again, we have mini story arcs... just like the movies: 

  • Over 15 AI competitors with backstories, unique personalities, and traits are ready to outclass you.

  • Each AI competitor has a branching storyline along with special events to keep things engaging and fresh.

  • Not a fan of competition? Befriend the local competitors and cultivate a sense of community.

After getting crushed by AI competitors, you can chicken out and challenge your friends instead:

  • Featuring online multiplayer for 2-4 players. View each other's stats in real time so you can trash talk.

  • In-depth multiplayer simulation. All players are competing for the same market so sales affect other players.

  • Trade with other players, and when they reject your outlandish offer... resort to sabotaging their operations.
4572730.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Swedish, Ukrainian, Turkish

4572760.name: The 9th Corpse
4572760.about_the_game:
A Detective Without a Clue... or Fangs.

Meet Montserrat. She's a 20-something investigator hailing from the prestigious Montblanc clan—a legendary lineage of vampire detectives. There's just one catch: Montserrat has absolutely no vampire traits. She hates the sight of blood, has terrible night vision, lacks super strength, and definitely doesn't turn into a bat! Fortunately, she isn't working alone. She's partnered with Arko, a legendary 1,000-year-old demon-dog who used to work with her famous father. Arko has a supernatural nose for clues, a wealth of experience, and a remarkably low tolerance for Montserrat's rookie mistakes.

The Mystery of La Potra Relinchona

Vampires from prominent clans are vanishing, and the bloody trail leads straight to the remote town of Funest Village and the infamous mansion, La Potra Relinchona. Once owned by the eccentric billionaire Lord Salazar Sinister and his occult-obsessed wife, Doña Elena Sinister, the estate is now up for sale, but local rumors of macabre events and self-arranging furniture are driving buyers away.

Ordered by the Grand Vampire Council, Montserrat must go undercover as a wealthy, prospective buyer to investigate the mansion. But what starts as a simple scouting mission quickly spirals into a deadly conspiracy involving a secret society and a dark ritual to resurrect a legendary evil who needs exactly 9 vampire corpses to return to full power.

Will Montserrat become the 9th corpse, or will she finally prove she's a true Montblanc?

Key Features

  • Quirky Hand-Drawn Art

  • The World's Worst Vampire Detective

  • A Grumpy, Ancient Partner

  • Three Layers of Mystery:

    • Hidden Object Scenes: Find items hidden in the cluttered, messy rooms of La Potra Relinchona.

    • Inventory Puzzles: Collect and combine special objects to bypass traps.

    • Logic Brainteasers.

  • A Cast of Eccentrics: Meet the "Daikirí Soleado" guitarists trapped in a pit, the "body-full-of-life" gardener Rodrigo, the suspicious butler Vince, the "mad" Ms. Letizia Sinister, and many more eccentric characters.

One mansion. Nine corpses. Zero superpowers. Survive!
4572760.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Dutch, Portuguese - Brazil

4572850.name: Orbital Express
4572850.about_the_game:
Build and manage your own space company.

Start as a small operator launching basic satellites and grow into a dominant force in Earth's orbit. Take contracts, design missions, and expand your infrastructure across multiple orbital layers.

Every mission is a decision.
Balance cost, success rate, and reward as you choose payloads and orbits. Will you play it safe, or risk everything for a bigger payout?

Watch your satellite network grow and generate income over time. Expand from Low Earth Orbit (LEO) to Medium (MEO) and Geostationary Orbit (GEO), each with its own challenges and opportunities.

🚀 Key Features

  • Plan and launch satellite missions

  • Manage your company finances and growth

  • Expand across multiple orbital layers (LEO, MEO, GEO)

  • Balance risk, cost, and success rate

  • Build a growing network of income-generating satellites

🌍 Your goal

Start small.
Scale up.
Dominate Earth's orbit.

4572880.name: Radiation Caterpillar
4572880.about_the_game:
An alien caterpillar  whose biology requires radiation for growth and survival. Luckily, your home planet is literally saturated with this dangerous yet vital resource. Your goal is to navigate challenging levels, collect radioactive elements, and grow, but be careful: the larger you get, the harder it is to maneuver!

FEATURES

  • 40 unique levels — from simple tutorials to mind-bending and extremely challenging

  • 40 achievements — rewards for skill, speed, and creative thinking

  • Dynamic physics — realistic interaction with the environment

  • Progressive difficulty — each level introduces new mechanics and challenges

  • Minimalistic yet atmospheric graphics — focus on gameplay and physics

CHALLENGES

  • Be careful with growth! An oversized track can get stuck in narrow passages.

  • Self-entanglement - if you don't watch your trajectory, you can wrap yourself around yourself and block your progress.

  • Dangerous traps - saws and spikes instantly destroy you.

  • Unstable platforms - they collapse under weight, requiring quick reactions.

  • Constrained space - sometimes you need to shrink to move forward.

WHO IS THIS GAME FOR?

  • Physics puzzle lovers

  • Fans of challenging platformers

  • Those who appreciate unconventional mechanics and original concepts

  • Players who enjoy achievements and complete completions

4573020.name: The Creator
4573020.about_the_game:
The Creator is a meditative, relaxing journey through the wonders of the virtual world. You have unlimited power over creation which is limited only by your imagination and creativity. Rules and boundaries don't apply to virtual reality and anything goes.

Recreate memories onto a virtual world and take your personal journey of self exploration as each world you create comes to life you'll be able to interact with the creation.

While you immerse yourself in this holistic and meditative world building game you'll find many libraries complete with different skies, ground and animals. Add fishes, animals, insects, flowers, plants, houses to your environment and watch them come to life. A full suite of mechanical items challenges your creativity to make animate and add motion to objects in the world.

Build a utopian landscape complete with animals that walk around, fishes that swim in the ocean and fortresses that defy gravity. Float around in space and other surreal environments while surrounded by calming music of your choice for a meditative and mesmerizing visual and audio experience.

4573060.name: Lab 2040
4573060.about_the_game:
Background Story

In the year 2040, Adekunle notices his lab experiments have gone wrong. Some of his autonomous systems are showing signs of sentience. He was initially locked out of the lab by the security systems but had to force his way in. He now has to fight through and destroy the security systems and robots he put in place to deter intruders from entering his lab. He also has to defeat and destroy the main super intelligent robot in his lab, Bamidele.

Gameplay

Lab 2040 is a Sci-fi, first person shooter game where the player combats different robots and drones using various weapons. Weapons include pistols, automatic guns, grenade, time bombs and more. The player can collect energy shields along the way which can protect the player from damage. 

There are 10 main levels which you will have to progress through to get to the final boss, Bamidele. This game is a linear game. The theme of the game is more casual than realistic. The gun play and movement mechanics prioritizes fun gameplay over realism.

Game Mechanics

Game mechanics include the basic FPS controls such as jump, move, look around, lean, crouch, shoot and aim. Your player can unlock different doors using keys, keypads or hack tools. You can collect "charged energy" for your shield which can serve as an armor and save the player from damage. You can pick up different weapons (You can only hold 4 weapons at a time). You can drop weapons you are holding and pick up other weapons.

4573210.name: Klifur
4573210.about_the_game:
Klifur is a physics-based 2D bouldering game.

Climb through over 30 hand-crafted routes. Each one is a small problem to solve with no single solution, just better ones. Take your time, try different sequences, and work toward cleaner, more efficient runs.

Earn badges by optimizing for move efficiency, time, and eliminating holds.

Make your own routes with the built in level editor! Share them with friends by sending them the route code.

highlighted.name: Move star on every route in Group 1

4573230.name: Realm Chart：Map Marker
4573230.about_the_game:
Realm Chart: Map Marker is a map-driven exploration game centered around exploring & charting territory. With limited action points, your goal is to maximize how much of the world you can uncover.

Exploration & Charting

  • Traverse a vast and ever-changing imperial map, expanding your vision and reach by placing and activating markers.

  • The empire’s territory gradually reveals itself through your journey, allowing you to witness the grandeur of its golden age as you chart the unknown.

Variation & Challenge

  • Each expedition begins differently, with changing encounters ensuring that no two journeys are ever the same.

  • Different starting conditions and reward drops force you to rethink your routes and resource allocation every time.

Strategy & Trade-offs

  • Balance curiosity, efficiency, and risk: spend your limited action points on exploration, or invest in building deeper connections with cities for greater rewards.

  • With limited opportunities, every decision matters—planning your path is at the heart of the experience.

Progression & Unlocks

  • Unlock new abilities and items across multiple runs, expanding the ways you explore and chart the map.

  • Different item combinations open up new strategic possibilities, with certain synergies enabling exceptionally powerful playstyles.

The Beauty of the Map

  • Travel through mountains, rivers, cities, farmlands, and wild plains, experiencing the distinct atmosphere of each region within the empire.

  • A dedicated free mode lets you explore without objectives—immerse yourself in the carefully crafted world at your own pace.

4573270.name: 中等生
4573270.about_the_game:
距离高考倒计时还有100天，成绩还是怎么也上不去......

明明曾经是老师和母父的骄傲，调到重点班之后，怎么就成了班上的透明人？

算了，只要考上足够好的大学，就能摆脱陈旧的生活，逃离束缚自己的一切。

那时候的周语桐是这样想的。

按照往常一样，读书、考试、复习.......

直到和昔日好友冲突，身边人的看法各不相同。谁会影响她的选择？

意气风发的竞赛生同桌？看起来并不好接近的隔壁班女生？从小一起长大的青梅？还是曾经与她分享同一个子宫，分享着彼此重叠的命运轨迹的姐姐？

她们似乎对此有着不同的态度——靠近、沉默、羡慕、远行……

只要考上大学，一切都会好起来的。

真的会好起来吗？

那个被许诺的充满光明的日子，真的会到来吗？

未来......在多远的以后？

角色介绍

田梓妍

班长兼同桌，竞赛生。

完美主义，重视成绩，什么都想做到最好。

无法正视自己的情感，时常感到难以表达自己的需求和欲望。

林溪

故意绕远路回家的隔壁班女生。

据说是文学社社长，但学校还有没有文学社一直存疑。高中时期喜欢张爱玲、简媜等作家。

传言多次被投上校园表白墙，周围同学评价非常两极分化。

陈真

认为烤面包做蛋糕很幸福。

想要给身边人带来更多幸福，早早认定了自己要读食品烘焙相关的专业。

蒋梅

曾用名周梅。

似乎和家里断绝了关系，但是那里有一个人......好像怎么也断不掉。

游戏内容

《中等生》是一款视觉小说类游戏，探讨中式教育环境中如何解构优绩主义、实现自我成长，内含学生时代小团体友谊、微妙的恶意等要素，玩家将影响高中生周语桐与四位攻略对象的关系。

游戏内容包括22W+字剧情文本，4位可攻略角色，3位重要配角，14个结局。

可能引发的不适的内容

1.内含言语霸凌、好友背刺、原生家庭等引发PTSD的要素，无好感线有角色死亡走向。

2.内含骨科要素。

3.本故事纯属虚构，请勿代入现实。

4573330.name: Mine it!
4573330.about_the_game:
MINE IT! is a pixel-art 2D game about working in the mines of the StarTech corporation, where every shift becomes a struggle for profit, efficiency, and survival. You descend underground to extract resources, meet production quotas, hand over your haul to company representatives, and steadily increase your value as a worker. The better your results, the more opportunities you earn. The deeper you go, the greater the risk.

At the core of the game is a progression loop built around mining and growth. Break blocks, collect dropped materials, sell them to the corporation, and invest your earnings into upgrading your equipment and character stats. Increase your damage, mining speed, pickaxe efficiency, health, and oxygen supply to survive harsher conditions and reach the most valuable deposits.

StarTech demands productivity. New levels and zones unlock gradually, and each new descent raises the requirements for preparation and performance. The deeper the mine, the richer the veins, but the more dangerous the route. Limited oxygen, resource management, and the constant pressure to stay efficient make every run tense and meaningful.

MINE IT! combines satisfying resource extraction with the atmosphere of a corporate mining operation where everything is driven by quotas, profit, and control. It is a game about growth, risk, and constant forward momentum: from your first shifts near the surface to deep expeditions where every mistake is costly and every successful run brings new opportunities.

Game Features

  • Mine resources in the underground operations of StarTech

  • Sell materials and grow stronger through an upgrade system

  • Improve your stats, pickaxe, and overall survivability

  • Progress through multiple levels and zones with increasing difficulty

  • Take on an endless mode for nonstop mining

  • Manage oxygen and survive deep underground

  • Complete missions, interact with NPCs, and advance through work-based progression

  • Enjoy pixel-art visuals and the atmosphere of a corporate mining world
