4573360.name: From Scratch
4573360.about_the_game:
Make anything you like from decorations to cosplay props and fill your inventory with stuff you've created! Use preset templates or craft anything you like from scratch!


Features:

  • Single Player

  • Sandbox

No time limits, no resources to unlock, everything is completely free. Create without any pressure!

  • Undo & Redo

Make mistakes without worry. Undo and redo as many times as you need! pure creative freedom with no pressure.

  • Intuitive Crafting

Cut, crease, and paste however you like. There's no fixed way to do it. Work naturally in any order and any direction that feels right to you.

  • Community-Made Templates (Planned)

Share your cardboard templates with the community and discover creations made by other players.

4573450.name: See-Through Bubbles
4573450.about_the_game:
A chance encounter with a witch dwelling within a pair of glasses...
That was where everything began.

Enjoy the ultimate time-killing puzzle game, bubble shooting,
and have delightful conversations with beautiful girls!

[Game Introduction]

Enjoy a sweet story together with bubble-shooting puzzles!

  • Simple and familiar bubble-shooting puzzle gameplay anyone can enjoy

  • Showtime Mode filled with charming fun

  • Various situations with a cast of beautiful girls

  • Over 300 stages of content

4573470.name: Supermaneuver
4573470.about_the_game:
SUPERMANEUVER is a combat flight action game picking up right back where this arcade genre was in the 90s, where the future was a place to be visited only in cyberpunk anime and cautionary stories, and games were measured in megabytes, not gigabytes. 

Inspired by the visuals and tone of Ace Combat 3: Electrosphere, SUPERMANEUVER’s 20XX is a world defined by corporate war and the last days of an international rules based order, where everything is worth something, and everyone has a price.

You are “Ozzy”, a pilot with a state-sponsored “privateer” group known as “Ximango”; a mercenary by any other name.

Your current contract has brought you to the resource rich, but constantly internally embattled nation of Novaria. You are hired by the Novarian government to combat the rebellion within its borders, while the international Tritolian-Levarian Alliance tries its best to keep the rules of war followed as it oversees peacekeeping operations in Novaria, much to the government’s chagrin.

With the end of this rebellion in sight, the true goals of the Novarian government and the TLA come to a flashpoint with you at the center.

Pick your battle. Choose your enemy. Rule the skies.

Balancing modern gameplay with its inspirations, SUPERMANEUVER handles as fast, snappy, and intuitive as ace pilots have come to expect arcade flight games to be, with all the selections of retro-futuristic planes and weapons inspired from the real world, or in altogether original designs.

Dogfight with skillful AI, throw yourself into massive battlefields from below the crust to low earth orbit, and fight an enemy hellbent on saving the world—or getting rich on its ashes.

All of this depicted in visuals replicated and iterated on from late 90s videogames in look, in sound, and in art.

  • Over 20 playable aircraft and 30 special weapons.

  • A singleplayer campaign with two differing paths and unique missions, written and produced by Matthew "FlyAwayNow" Nguyen (Project Wingman).

  • The world of 20XX, where retro-futuristic cities and mega infrastructure become battlefields to fly over and destroy.

  • Full soundtrack featuring DnB, electronic, trance, and more!

  • Mission Recorder/Replay system.

  • Complementary WSO (who is also your childhood friend!).

4573500.name: Arms Race
4573500.about_the_game: Arms Race is a bullet hell roguelite where there are no chests, enemies have a chance to spawn with random items/weapons with a outfit to match and every floor is inspired by a different continent's mythology and folklore. With 48+ weapons and items every run plays differently, but the enemy that kills you will rob your grave and use your loot against you next round, creating a perpetual arms race between your own skills and the enemies ever growing arsenal of your own items

4573540.name: Shipolis
4573540.about_the_game:
A COZY MINIMALIST CITY BUILDER AND RESOURCE MANAGEMENT GAME

You are a town planner longing for adventures! With your valiant ship, you have been sent to unknown archipelagos with the task of growing cities and building great wonders! You will have to explore the seas, map various sectors, gather resources and set up production lines. Good planning and wise management will be key to achieve your goals!

  • ⛵ Sail the seas and explore various procedurally generated regions with their unique look: lush forests, frozen lands, sand deserts, rock plateaus, and more!

  • 🎨 Contemplate a peaceful world in cute 3D pixel art with a perspective top-down view and dynamic lightning

  • 🗺️ Discover islands hosting many difference resources

  • 🏙️ Develop cities at predetermined spots to grow your population, collect raw materials and set up production lines to transform resources into more advanced items

  • 📐 Pay attention to the fixed layouts of cities to make the most of your available building tiles: carefully plan what to build where!

  • ✨ Place support buildings that can give access to new blueprints or boost adjacent tiles

  • ⏫ Use advanced resources to upgrade your buildings and increase the efficiency of your cities despite the limited building space

  • ⚙️ Set up export routes and supply routes to automatize the transport of resources all around the world

  • ↔️ Watch flows of resources while your ship and each city automatically exchange items from their respective inventory to have everything where needed

  • 💫 Upgrade your ship to move faster and store ever more resources

  • 🌞 Play at your own pace and enjoy a cozy journey of strategy and creativity

  • 🏁 Ultimately, complete every quest and prove your mastery by placing great wonders in each region of the world!

ABOUT RADIANT SLOTH

Radiant Sloth (he/him) is a solo indie game developer from France. He has a passion for creating inspiring and entertaining art, and is committed to ethical and sustainable game development. In particular, he strives to maintain honest and transparent communication with the community, advocates awareness of carbon footprint and climate issues, and bans generative AI tools from his creation process.

4573570.name: Echoes of Stella
4573570.about_the_game:
“Stella: Can you come and play with me?”

Trapped in total darkness, your only hope is a device that translates sound into sight. Every scan reveals the world around you, shaping paths out of the void, but in this distorted mirror world, time your scans carefully, or risk exposing yourself.

Key Features

  • Navigate by Echolocation: Use a unique echolocation device to map your surroundings. Every scan provides a brief moment of clarity in a world of absolute shadow.

  • The Cost of Sight: Every pulse is a signal. Balance the desperate need to see with the necessity of silence, timing your scans carefully to avoid revealing your location to the things lurking in the dark.

  • Something is Listening: Stella, a corrupted reflection of the past, is drawn to your signals. She is hunting you, determined to keep you in her world forever.

  • Uncover Your Identity: Explore the environment to find shattered mirror shards. Piece them together to reveal the truth of who you are and why you’re here.

See the unseen. Or be found.

4573590.name: The Horror Occultist
4573590.about_the_game:
The Horror Occultist

🔥 You were never meant to find this place.

And it was never meant to wake up.

🩸 About This Game

The Horror Occultist is a first-person psychological horror game focused on atmosphere, tension, and slow-burning dread.
Set in a forgotten forest consumed by darkness, you will explore the ruins of an abandoned monastery where an ancient force was once sealed — and later awakened.

This is not a game about constant action.
This is a game about fear that builds… and never leaves.

🌲 A Place That Should Not Exist

Deep within a remote forest lies a place erased from maps and memory.
An old monastery, long abandoned after a catastrophic event that no one fully understands.

Years ago, monks discovered something beneath the earth.
Not a ghost.
Not a demon.
Something far older.

They attempted to contain it using rituals, symbols, and faith.

They failed.

🕯️ The Ritual

Time passed.
The place was forgotten.

Until a cult found it.

They didn’t try to stop what was buried beneath the ruins.
They came to awaken it.

The ritual went wrong.

The monastery collapsed.
The forest became something else.
And whatever was sealed below…
is no longer sleeping.

👁️ You Are Not Alone

You arrive at the location long after everything has already gone wrong.
Or maybe… exactly when you were meant to.

The deeper you go, the more the world begins to change.

Shadows move where nothing should exist.
Sounds come from places that should be silent.
And sometimes…

you will see her.

🎮 Gameplay

  • 🌲 Explore a cursed open environment
    Traverse a dense, oppressive forest filled with secrets, hidden paths, and unseen threats.

  • ⛪ Investigate the abandoned monastery
    Discover ritual sites, forbidden symbols, and the remains of those who tried to stop what lies beneath.

  • 🔒 Descend into the underground prison
    A place built not to keep people inside… but to keep something from getting out.

  • 📼 Piece together the story
    Find fragments of the past through environmental storytelling, recordings, and disturbing visions.

  • 👁️ Unique observation mechanics
    Some entities cannot be perceived normally.
    You must learn how to see… what does not want to be seen.

  • 🕯️ Avoid the cult
    Not all of them are gone.
    And they are not on your side.

  • 👻 Encounter supernatural entities
    Including a ghostly presence that appears when you least expect it — and disappears when you try to understand it.

⚠️ Key Features

  • Psychological horror with a focus on immersion

  • Slow-paced exploration and tension-driven gameplay

  • Minimal UI for maximum immersion

  • Realistic lighting and dynamic sound design

  • Non-linear progression and hidden discoveries

  • Deep environmental storytelling

  • Persistent feeling of being watched

  • No hand-holding — you must figure things out yourself

🧠 Atmosphere Over Action

The Horror Occultist does not rely on constant jumpscares.
Instead, it builds a constant sense of unease.

The kind that makes you stop…
listen…
and question what you just saw.

👁️ Final Words

You are not here to uncover the truth.

You are here because
it wants you to see it.

4573600.name: Jaded Jade Jayden
4573600.about_the_game:
Think before you move. Once you start sliding, there's no stopping!

Help Jayden get rid of those pesky workers that entered princess Yunlong palace uninvited(?)!

In this grid based puzzle, your character moves one direction at a time, barreling forward until something gets in the way. Walls, obstacles, and yes - your enemies. Use that momentum to your advantage and send your foes flying in the most satisfying way possible, but be careful to not break anything valuable, or else...

With a lighthearted world and levels that start easy and escalate to delightfully devious, every stage is a new puzzle to untangle - one (very committed) move at a time.

It's simple and easy to pick up. Touch and controller friendly, with artwork designed with colorblind players in mind!

- NO DRM!

- Singleplayer

- 70+ levels

- Various hazards and obstacles.

- Time attack availlable

- Score tracking.

- CG gallery.

4573970.name: Syntaris
4573970.about_the_game:
In Syntaris, you do not spend your time juggling individual workers. You design the system that directs them. Every module, route, and production chain is part of a larger network, and your job is to shape that network into something efficient, resilient, and scalable.

Start with a single mine and a handful of workers, then expand into a layered industrial base with factories, depots, power structures, research centers, and advanced production lines. Workers handle hauling, construction, and production tasks automatically, while you decide how the base is organized, which modules belong together, and how resources move through the system.

Build and Connect

Place modules and connect them into a network. Position matters because distance affects transport efficiency, power distribution, and defense. Clustering related modules speeds up logistics and reduces power loss, but concentrating critical infrastructure in one place creates a vulnerability. Every layout decision is a tradeoff.

Shape Local Economies

As your base grows, a single centralized system becomes inefficient. You can organize modules into local groups that produce, store, and distribute resources more independently. Each group functions as a partial economy inside the larger base, cutting down long transport chains and making large industrial networks easier to manage and adapt.

Control Logistics with Rules

Logistics runs automatically, but the rules are yours to set. Define how materials should flow by assigning input and output priorities, directing resources through specific routes, or routing supply through designated storage points. You are not watching the system run. You are deciding how it behaves.

Research and Progression

Research unlocks new modules, technologies, and production chains. Progress from basic extraction and processing to advanced industry including fusion energy, antimatter production, and quantum computing. Each discovery opens new ways to organize and optimize your base.

Defend and Conquer

Enemy factions build their own economies, defenses, and military forces. When conflict begins, command soldiers, tanks, aircraft, turrets, and laser systems in real time to defend your base or push into enemy territory. When you break through, you do not just destroy what they built. You capture it. Enemy factories, depots, and production lines can be absorbed into your own network and put to work immediately.

Analyze and Optimize

Track production output, consumption, economic efficiency, and group-level performance to find bottlenecks and fix them. The goal is not just to grow. It is to build a system that works better every time you refine it.

4574000.name: Stabby Stabby Loot Loot
4574000.about_the_game:
Stabby Stabby Loot Loot is a third-person VR Action Adventure where you simultaneously control Orrin, a foul-mouthed gnome, on a gold-hunting rampage, and Njord, a forgotten lesser god.

Play as both Orrin, stabbing and looting his way to riches, and Njord, reaching into the world, tossing enemies like ragdolls and wielding arcane power.

Mastering both characters at once creates a frantic, chaotic, and fast-paced action adventure experience.

Story

Orrin had never been a lucky gnome.

Until a drunken prayer to Njord (the long-forgotten god of luck) turned a losing streak at the local inn's dice table into a mountain of gold.

For one night, everything went right.

Then goblins robbed him on the way home. In his celebratory stupor, he barely raised a fist before they stripped him of everything, coin, boots, dignity… even his pants.

Bruised and bare-legged, Orrin swore vengeance and stormed the goblin caves… where he promptly passed out just inside the entrance.

Now an angry gnome and a fading god are bound together by embarrassment, stolen trousers, and the slim hope that one spectacular win might be the start of a comeback story for both of them.

But luck is rarely random. Dice do not roll themselves, and goblins do not ambush by coincidence. As Orrin fights deeper into the caves, it becomes clear that someone in the village profits from his misfortune.

And deep underground, something far worse than goblins is waking up.

Control TWO characters Simultaneously 

Orrin - A foul-mouthed gnome who solves every problem with sharp, pointy objects, is controlled with the thumb sticks and buttons.



Njord - an old god left behind as new powers rose, but thrilled to be remembered again, is controlled by the VR motion controllers.

Built from the ground up for VR

Stabby Stabby Loot Loot fills the gap between Third-Person Action adventure and VR

  • Simultaneous dual-character control

  • Robust combat system with diverse weaponry and power-ups

  • Combat, platforming, and puzzle levels viewed from a diorama-style perspective

  • Designed for comfortable, seated VR (no motion sickness, small-space friendly)

  • Coordinate between both characters to defeat multiphase boss encounters

  • A short-tempered gnome who breaks the fourth wall with insults, advice, and commentary

This is not a flat Action Adventure adapted to VR.

It is a design that depends on your physical presence and motion controls.

4574100.name: Starward: Civil Defence
4574100.about_the_game:
In Starward: Civil Defence, you are the last line of defense against relentless enemy waves threatening your space station.

Fight for survival in a fast-paced top-down roguelite shooter where every decision matters and every run pushes you further.

FAST-PACED COMBAT

  • Survive intense waves of enemy ships

  • Dodge, shoot, and outmaneuver enemies in real-time combat

  • Experience chaotic moments where survival comes down to skill

 ROGUELITE GAMEPLAY

  • Each run is different

  • Increasing difficulty with every wave

  • Strategic choices between waves

  • Adapt your playstyle to survive longer

 UPGRADE YOUR SHIP

  • Collect resources during combat

  • Craft and upgrade your weapons

  • Improve your ship’s performance

  • Prepare for harder encounters

 RETURN TO THE STATION

  • Manage your resources

  • Upgrade your systems

  • Prepare for the next run

  • Build towards long-term survival

4574120.name: Civilization Idle
4574120.about_the_game:
Civilization Idle

Build. Expand. Conquer time itself.

Step into a world where every decision shapes the destiny of your civilization. Start small, manage resources, and watch your empire grow from a single settlement into a sprawling civilization across 6 eras, from the Stone Age to the Galactic Era.

  • Idle, But Strategic – Progress continues while you’re away, but smart planning is key to unlock 60+ technologies, 70+ buildings, and 40+ worker roles that define your civilization.

  • Epic Achievements & Rewards – Complete 100+ milestones, build legendary 12 wonders, and earn powerful bonuses that reward patience and strategy.

  • Dynamic World – Explore hundreds of procedurally generated territories, interact with neighboring civilizations, trade resources, and survive random events that test your empire’s resilience.

  • Simple to Start, Hard to Master – Easy to pick up for casual players, with depth and complexity for those who love optimization, automation, and tactical strategy.

Whether you’re a strategist or a casual gamer, Civilization Idle lets you shape history at your own pace. Your civilization awaits—can you guide it from a humble village to galactic dominance?

4574210.name: Santa Smoke: Prologue
4574210.about_the_game:
Santa takes a solemn stroll in the snows of solitude. He can't believe his own eyes when he sees what happens next.

Multiple endings. Various surprises. No spoilers.

Santa has problems, like anyone else. For the 364 other days in a year not spent directly spreading wealth and joy around the world, he can be down on himself.

Things with Ms. Claus aren’t like they used to be. He has lived for hundreds of years, with few but the arctic wildlife, elves and spouse as company. He has sustained an empire of love and happiness, but is concerned by how the world has evolved since the industrial revolution. The spirit of Christmas isn’t present, nor is it presents.

Do the children really need gifts?

And that brother of his (he was feared and shunned for his horns), is he making it alright on his own?

All of this is just too much for old Santa sometimes. So what does he do? He takes a hike. And somber, in the snows of solitude, the frost is much to bear, and the past catches up.

“What if Christmas didn’t come this year? And no one paid for Christmas cheer? Who would cry the biggest tear, the child or the store?”

GAMEPLAY

Santa Smoke: Prologue is a procedural 2D platformer about Santa and his ascent away from the cold and descent into Hell. Gameplay consists of running and jumping around to escape the spreading frost and great wall of ice, while picking up candy canes and keeping an eye out for SECRETS.

The real game lies after you have a firm grasp on the movement, and you are able to explore and find all sorts of surprises. The platforming + candy canes is honestly a cheap excuse for gameplay, the true gameplay is 'exploration.

The medals indicate a bit of what to work towards, and the hidden ones unlock fairly naturally as you come across some surprises.

CONTROLS

Hold jump to jump higher, like super meat boy. Hold shift to move faster, like super meat boy. You have a triple jump, not like super meat boy.

Fully open-source, including project assets / behind the scenes available at:

Made with Godot, Blender, Audacity, FL Studio.

...Santa Smoke is coming soon on a Christmas near you. Please check out my other games and YouTube til then (Harper Nicholson)

THE END.

4574220.name: Cargo Runner: Faction Fracture
4574220.about_the_game:
One wrong delivery can start a war.


Cargo Runner: Faction Fracture is a top-down 2D rogue-like space cargo hauler. Pilot your ship through three increasingly dangerous sectors, trading goods between rival factions, managing a tight power budget, and making split-second decisions that shift the balance of power in the galaxy.


Every run is different. Every delivery is a gamble.

The Run

Each run takes you through 3 sectors of procedurally generated star maps. Dock at faction stations to buy and sell cargo, pick up missions, hire crew, and upgrade your ship. But watch your back – pirates patrol the lanes, corruption spreads through each sector, and the factions are always watching.


At the end of each sector, a boss encounter stands between you and the jump gate. Adapt your loadout or die trying.

Key Features

  • Rogue-like Structure – 3-sector runs with permadeath, procedural generation, and high replayability. No two runs play the same.
  • Faction System – Three factions – the Federation, the Pirates, and the Swine – each with unique stations, cargo, missions, and reputation tiers. Help one, anger another.
  • Power Budget Management – Allocate limited power between engines, shields, weapons, and cargo systems. Every upgrade forces a trade-off.
  • Dynamic Economy – Prices shift based on supply, demand, and faction influence. Buy low at one station, sell high at another – if you can survive the trip.
  • Boon Synergies & Build-Crafting – Collect boons and discover powerful synergy combos that define your playstyle. Go all-in on speed, firepower, cargo capacity, or find creative combinations.
  • 9 Unlockable Ships – Each ship has a unique hull, stats, and special ability. Unlock them by completing challenges.
  • Daily Challenges & Leaderboards – Compete for the top score on seeded daily runs.

Inventory Mechanics

Cargo Runner's inventory isn't a menu — it's a live puzzle board. Pack a contraband barrel behind a wall of legal crates and walk past a Federation scan. Wedge a rare mineral into a high-risk slot for +50% payout... if you live long enough to deliver it. A volatile canister lands in your hold mid-firefight? You have 45 seconds to rearrange everything or watch your ship go nova.

What makes it different:

  • Real Tetris-style shapes — 1×1 crates, 2×1 barrels, L-pieces, T-pieces, 3-wide crystal rods. Click to lift, R to rotate. Ghost preview pulses green (legal drop) or red (collision) before you commit.
  • Safe slots vs Risk slots — Safe cells deliver at normal value. Risk cells pay +50% on sale, but they're exposed to scans, volatile damage, and cargo mishaps. Your whole build is where you put which box.
  • Three factions, three economies — Federation prizes legal cargo and ore. Pirates pay top dollar for contraband. The alien Swine buy Unknown cargo at up to 6× base value. Your hold is the negotiation.
  • Weight penalties drop your speed when you overload. Degradation timers eat value from neglected goods. Volatile fuses tick in real time.
  • Delivery packages lock to the grid — one cell you can't move, one paycheck you can't forfeit. Everything else has to pack around it.

Crew & Fleet

Hire crew members who provide passive bonuses and unlock new capabilities. Build out a small fleet to increase your hauling capacity – but more ships mean more targets.

Boss Fights

Each sector culminates in a unique boss encounter. Study their patterns, exploit their weaknesses, and use every upgrade you've collected to survive. Defeat them to unlock the gate to the next sector – or to extract with your earnings.

4574240.name: Havenrail
4574240.about_the_game:
Manage a Moving City

Your train is more than just transportation — it’s a city on wheels. Manage the train and keep vital systems running as it travels through a dangerous world.

Gather Resources

Send teams to gather resources needed to keep the train running. Coal, metal, and supplies are essential for survival.

Build and Upgrade Wagons

Expand your train with new wagons and upgrade existing ones. Each wagon serves a purpose — production, storage, housing, or technology.

Manage Your Economy

Balance production, consumption, and efficiency. Poor decisions can lead to resource shortages and crises on board.

Make Difficult Decisions

Every decision has consequences. What matters more — efficiency or humanity?

Survive a Hostile World

A harsh environment, disasters, and unexpected events will constantly test your strategy.

4574250.name: The Secret Dungeon
4574250.about_the_game:
Embark on a 2-player adventure filled with magic and mystery! Traverse enchanted kingdoms and confront wicked witches and wizards.

The Secret Dungeon, once ruled by a rightful king and queen, has fallen into darkness, now serving as a stronghold for those who practice dark magic.

As an adventurer, you’ll wield your sword, journey through vast realms, find items, upgrades, weapons, and magic, rescue captured kingdoms, and uncover the dungeon’s secrets.

Simple to jump into, approachable for anyone, with plenty of depth for players who want to venture deeper into the dungeon’s mysteries. 

Grab a friend and dive into a world of magic, in this unforgettable 2-player adventure!

4574290.name: ATROX
4574290.about_the_game:
Join our protagonist in a pixel art adventure where you will face your deepest nightmares while traversing a harsh and unknown world, filled with metal, monolithic structures, and the color red.

  • ATROX offers simple and easy-to-understand yet challenging gameplay, where your skills and muscle memory will be put to the test.

  • Each level is unique, meticulously detailed, and crafted with the intention of offering something special to remember.

  • Throughout the game, you will slowly uncover the story through illustrated cutscenes and an original soundtrack.

  • If you are a perfectionist, the challenge is just beginning, as each level grants you a trophy based on your performance; you can push for your best time to show off your skills to everyone.

  • Additionally, for the completionists out care, each level offers collectibles that are used to unlock new levels with even greater challenges.

4574300.name: Bean Wizard Eviscerates the Gonklins
4574300.about_the_game:
🌴 Deep in the natural wildlife frontiers of a distant land known only as Florida, an invasive species is attacking mankind. Dubbed as "The Gonklins", they seek to steal all of humanities coins and cherries.  As the world's first and only Bean Wizard, the US Government has hired you to eviscerate them from existence.  Good luck.

🐜 Bean Wizard Eviscerates the Gonklins is the world's first twin-stick anthill shooter!   Reign terror down on the Gonklins using every bean in your arsenal.  Ice Beans, Fire Beans, Poison Beans, you'll use them all!  But be careful, warrior Gonklins will strike back with their blasters! 

🫘 Team up with Franklin the Janklin, a traitor to his species, to upgrade your bean arsenal to defeat the monstrous King Donklin the Gonklin.

Key Features:

  • 5 Playable Characters!

  • 18 Unique Beans!

  • 40+ Hand-crafted levels!

  • 5 Unique enemy types!

  • 4 unique bosses!

  • Bomb blocks!

  • Switches!

  • Hidden Treasure blocks!

4574320.name: Ah. Ah. Ah.
4574320.about_the_game:
■ A New Sensation of Voice Action: Merging Mic and Rhythm

This title is a rhythm action game where you clear stages using "your voice" instead of a controller.

*A microphone is required to play.

Intuitive Gameplay: Simply vocalize into the microphone in sync with the rhythm on the screen to control your character.

■ Can be cleared quickly

Since the game can be cleared in about 15 minutes, you won't have to strain your throat.
4574320.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean

4574330.name: Borrowed Faces
4574330.about_the_game:
Just Another Shift

Only 9 more stops until you can go home. It's easier said than done when you are driving through the otherworldly realms to pick up humans wandering in places they shouldn't among the denizens of the dark. Luckily you have a journal left from the last guy on your route giving you all his knowledge for surviving. Unluckily you have no idea what happened to him.

Oh, and you can't let the monsters you pick up know who you are. 

About the Game

Borrowed Faces is a first-person immersive horror game where you are a bus driver having peer through the darkness of the passengers you pick up to figure out who is human and who should be dropped off at the next stop. Through 3 distinct levels you interrogate a variety of monsters as they try to gain passage on your bus. You must rely on the information from your trust journal and answers gleaned from dialogue with the passengers to tell friend apart from foe.

Gameplay

  • Atmospheric Suspense: The tension builds as you bring each new passenger onto your bus, wondering if you made the right choices or not.

  • Interrogation or paranoia: You can converse with passengers with text-based options and inspect their tickets, or reject everyone out of fear of making a mistake. 

  • Interactive fiction: This isn't a driving game, it's a story told through first-person interactions. You can choose when to progress to the next area or wander the bus a little while. 

  • Investigative tools: You can mark down in your journal who is a human and review characteristics of each species, along with verifying their ticket information.  Assuming you want to make it to the end of the line at least.

4574370.name: Sword & Banner
4574370.about_the_game:
Sword & Banner is a real-time strategy game where you lead a warband across a fantasy medieval world, raiding settlements, hunting down bandits, trading goods, and building your army for large-scale pixel-art battles.

Command Your Warband

Select, group, and maneuver your troops with classic RTS controls. Form shield walls to absorb incoming attacks, order devastating cavalry charges, and rain longbow volleys on enemy formations. Every unit is an individual with a name, experience, and an upgrade path from peasant to knight.

Fight Beautiful Pixel-Art Battles

Battles play out on procedurally generated maps across multiple biomes and seasons - from sun-drenched grasslands to snow-covered mountain passes. Watch rain darken the earth and snow settle on the ground as you fight. Zoom in to see every sword swing, or pull back to command the full battlefield.

Explore a Living World

Travel between towns and villages on a sprawling overworld. Settlements have populations, industries, and dynamic economies - prices shift with supply and demand. Buy low, sell high, recruit fresh troops, and upgrade your veterans.

Build Your Army

Start with peasants and shape them into swordsmen, archers, spearmen, and beyond. Every unit earns XP in battle and carries their kills with them.

Key Features

  • A blend of classic RTS combat and grand strategy. High micro potential for individual units mixed with formation 'Rank and Flank' style

  • Procedural battle maps with weather systems between different biomes, seasons, and geography

  • Deep unit upgrade tree with 15+ unit types across multiple races

  • Procedural economy with production chains, trade routes, and seasonal events

  • Multiple races: Human, Goblin, Undead, each with unique units and playstyle, more coming soon!

  • Pixel-art visuals

4574410.name: Glossolalia
4574410.about_the_game:
A fully voice-driven psychological horror game.

Your voice is not just how you play.
Your voice is how you survive.

Glossolalia is a psychological horror experience where nearly every interaction is controlled through speech. Speak to move. Speak to solve puzzles. Speak to survive.

Driving alone at night, you hear a strange radio broadcast.
A phone booth appears in the middle of the road.

You stop.

You answer the phone.

And something answers back.

In Glossolalia, you are pulled into a surreal, shifting world where your voice becomes your only tool — and your greatest vulnerability. Answer disturbing questions, navigate impossible spaces, and speak forbidden words to uncover the truth behind the entity trying to possess you.

But be careful.

Not everyone who speaks… comes back.

Features

🎙 Fully Voice-Driven Gameplay

  • Speak to move and interact with the world

  • Answer questions that change the story

  • Use spoken phrases to activate supernatural abilities

  • Your voice is your primary control

👁 Psychological Horror Experience

  • Disturbing questions and moral dilemmas

  • Unpredictable events and environments

  • Reality shifts around you as you progress

  • Minimal UI for maximum immersion

🕯 Speak Forbidden Words

  • Activate "Glossolalia" mode to reveal hidden elements

  • Speak phrases to manipulate the environment

  • Light candles, reveal ghosts, unlock paths

  • Discover new voice abilities as you progress

☎ Surreal, Atmospheric Worlds

  • Phone booths in empty darkness

  • Endless hallways and impossible architecture

  • Victorian mansions and abandoned spaces

  • Entities that react to your voice

🧠 A Story About Possession

  • Something is trying to use your voice

  • Most people don't survive the process

  • Few become something else
4574410.supported_languages:
English*, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support

4574510.name: PROJECT REPRIEVE
4574510.about_the_game:
Can you repent for your sins? Or is a flawless Reprieve something you can't fathom?

MEET YOUR MAIN MAN, NIKO

Boastful, headstrong, and quick-on-his-feet, Niko is the (unfortunate) main character! Tasked with saving his friends and family from eternal damnation.

BEAT UP WEIRDOS AND DEMONS

Use a rock, electric shocks, a gun and your bare hands to fend off the demons trying to kill you. Survive until 6 AM and make another lap around until Ms. Yahweh says you've reprieved enough!

SEE A MYRIAD OF FOES

There's no end to the onslaught of Demons, Manifestations, Aberrations and even Damned Souls that will be thrown at you in this hectic game, with 20+ enemies to unlock (and some secret bonus collaboration characters), you'll hardly find yourself struggling to be uninterested

GET ACHIEVEMENTS, AND HIGH SCORES

With plenty of achievements, an endless mode, and several combinations of modifiers and perks to choose, you'll have plenty to do and unlock!

4574660.name: 90 Minutes Till The World Ends
4574660.about_the_game:
90 Minutes Till the World Ends is a narrative driven visual novel about the final hour and a half of humanity and how you choose to spend it.

You play as a young man trapped in his apartment complex, surrounded by neighbors, strangers, and familiar faceseach dealing with the end in their own way. Some want to confess their feelings. Some want to make amends. Others fall into chaos, denial… or something far more dangerous.

Will you comfort someone who’s breaking down?
Reveal secrets you’ve kept hidden?
Uncover the truth behind the world’s end?
Or ignore it all and go out on your own terms?

You can’t do everything.
You can’t save everyone.
And you definitely can’t rewind.

Every choice consumes time, shaping your relationships, unlocking different paths, and leading to multiple endings—some hopeful, some devastating, some unexpected.

Features:

  • Branching choices with meaningful consequences

  • Multiple characters with unique storylines and endings

  • Minimal Pixel art style

4574760.name: Overdrive Reloaded
4574760.about_the_game:
Overdrive Reloaded is a single player first-person shooter created by Dynamite Games. Drop into a stunning reimagining of the series, built from the ground up with relentless PvE combat, action-packed Arena modes, open world Battle Royale, and all-new skill tree and roguelike progression systems. Serving as the first chapter of the Overdrive story, Reloaded brings every part of the Overdrive world together such as our protagonists, Task Force Scorpion, as they battle the relentless threat known as the Zarya Group.

Increase your Overdrive level

Get eliminations and complete objectives to increase your Overdrive level, a new roguelike progression system allowing you to unlock randomised player buffs in every match. Reaching level 5 lets you activate a random Overdrive ability for a short period of time, and being eliminated can decrease that level.

Evolution

Evolution allows you to work through various skill trees granting permanent player buffs. Earn XP to unlock the ability to evolve your player and discover new skills.

Arena

Fight across various landscapes in fast-paced Arena matches, including classic modes such as Team Deathmatch and Kill Confirmed. You died? Respawn instantly and get back into the fight as your squad try and secure victory. Arena offers a variety of experiences such as the objective-based Control mode, and the ability to call in a game-ending Chemstrike by reaching 30 kills without dying. Create your own custom Arena loadout by levelling up to unlock new weapon attachments and player perks to buff various attributes such as movement speed.

Battle Royale (Public Alpha)

Drop in. Collect loot. Survive. You are on your own in Battle Royale, with no respawns to save you from death. Avoid the Overdrive as the safe zone continues to shrink until nothing is left. Loot crates are scattered across the open world with valuable weapon upgrades, player buffs and more.

Overdrive Reloaded will support multiplayer via server browser in the future

4574790.name: XENO HIVE
4574790.about_the_game:
1. Crew NPCs

Traditionally, a major drawback was the inability to play without gathering a full lobby of players. 

However, XENOHIVE solves this by implementing Crew NPCs, allowing you to enjoy a full-fledged gaming experience even with a smaller group.

2. Stay Engaged Until the Very End

In the past, players who were killed early on were largely sidelined for the rest of the match. 

In this game, however, you can "take over a surviving Crew NPC" even after you've been killed. 

This allows you to actively continue playing and keeps the tension high until the very end.

3. Creature NPCs

Terrifying creatures roam the halls of the spaceship, and they will kill any Crewmates they encounter. 

Additionally, Impostors have the power to remotely control these Creature NPCs to assassinate the crew. 

Because they can keep their own hands clean and leave behind very little circumstantial evidence, tracking down the true Impostor requires a much higher level of deductive reasoning.

4. A New Era of Real-Time Co-op

Discussions are no longer limited to just emergency meetings. 

With the implementation of proximity voice chat, you can seamlessly communicate with nearby players while carrying out your tasks. 

Crewmates must rely on close cooperation and teamwork to stand against the Impostors!
4574790.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Traditional Chinese, Korean, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Latin America, Simplified Chinese, Japanese

4574820.name: Rejected Draft
4574820.about_the_game:
THE SKETCHBOOK WAS FULL

You didn't make the cut. You are a flawed doodle thrown in the trash. Now you're in the bin with the rest of the rejects, and the only way out is through them. But do not let this minimalist sketchbook aesthetic fool you—beneath the simple graphite exterior lies an endlessly deep, mathematically massive incremental battler that hides a staggering engine of strategic choices.

MASSIVE PROGRESSION & SKILL TREES

Grind your way through endless waves of rival sketches, absorbing their power as you climb. Gather a wealth of varied currencies to purchase tools and level up over 50 unique battle stats, each drastically altering your combat capabilities. When you push as far as you can go, prestige your run to earn specialized currency and invest it into thousands of intertwined skill tree levels. Whether you are actively managing your builds or fueling idle progression while you're away, there is always a new threshold to break.

A JOURNEY UNIQUELY YOURS

Progression in Rejected Draft is fully randomized. Between your guaranteed core sketches and randomly rolled higher rarity ones, the potential loadout combinations are practically infinite. No optimal path exists until you forge yours. If everyone on Earth played a billion distinct playthroughs a second since the dawn of the universe, humanity still wouldn't scratch the surface of all possible paths. Every prestige shapes an entirely new journey.

DEEP STRATEGY, LOW ATTENTION

This is an incremental experience that demands your strategic reasoning but respects your time. While there are many active elements to engage with, you will unlock expanding layers of automation as you progress. Designed to be the ultimate second-screen companion, it is a highly satisfying procrastination tool that runs perfectly in the background—allowing you to plot your next massive power spike while still getting your real-life work done.
4574820.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Afrikaans, Albanian, Amharic, Armenian, Assamese, Azerbaijani, Bangla, Basque, Belarusian, Bosnian, Catalan, Cherokee, Croatian, Dari, Estonian, Filipino, Galician, Georgian, Gujarati, Hausa, Hebrew, Hindi, Icelandic, Igbo, Irish, K'iche', Kannada, Kazakh, Khmer, Kinyarwanda, Konkani, Kyrgyz, Latvian, Lithuanian, Luxembourgish, Macedonian, Malay, Malayalam, Maltese, Maori, Marathi, Mongolian, Nepali, Odia, Persian, Punjabi (Gurmukhi), Punjabi (Shahmukhi), Quechua, Scots, Serbian, Sindhi, Sinhala, Slovak, Slovenian, Sorani, Sotho, Swahili, Tajik, Tamil, Tatar, Telugu, Tigrinya, Tswana, Turkmen, Urdu, Uyghur, Uzbek, Valencian, Welsh, Wolof, Xhosa, Yoruba, Zulu

4574850.name: Escape the Exomoon
4574850.about_the_game:
ESCAPE THE EXOMOON is a story-rich first person cyberpunk sci-fi horror game. Hack, hide, and fight your way across an abandoned space colony. Will you escape with your humanity?

As the last survivor of the EXO CORP. space colony, every day is a struggle for survival for Ky. Just as he begins to lose hope, he hears a voice calling out for help through the speakers of a security drone. She offers a seemingly simple trade: get her out from the depths of the abandoned facility and maybe together they can find a way off this rock.

Yet, as he journeys across the surface of Opus, Ky will learn the dark secrets underneath his only home and make difficult decisions that may determine the fate of mankind.

HUMANITY

  • Install upgrades in the form of cybernetics and body modifications using resources you've collected. However, these come with worsening side effects including paranoia, dissociation, aggression, and apathy. Your humanity will determine the choices you can make and the direction of the story.

HACK

  • Using your tech skills to hack into facility systems, you can open new paths for exploration, solve puzzles, and discover clues of what led to the demise of Opus.

HIDE

  • You're nearly powerless against the terrifying army of security robots and creatures that have taken over in EXO's absence. In order to survive, you will need to sneak your way past cameras and enemies while intelligently utilizing the environment and your drone.

    FIGHT

  • When all other options are exhausted, use your limited supplies and V-Volt Electric Pistol to defend yourself against attacks. Alternatively, you can manipulate the facility's technology to trap enemies and gain an advantage.

Other Features:

  • Cinematic graphics and a fully voiced narrative 

  • Multiple endings depending on player decisions

  • Deep lore uncovered through notes, audio logs, and hacking computers

  • Alternative play styles (stealth vs direct combat)

  • Physics, platforming, and logic puzzles with a variety of possible solutions

No generative AI was used in the development of this game.

4574960.name: Prof. Bringoo's Big Dumb Block Factory
4574960.about_the_game:
PLAY with blocks

SQUISH your blocks

GET COMBOS

Get powerups that stack and combine in a hilarious and awesome way.

Play in story mode to uncover Professor Bringoo's evil plan to flood the DIY music scene with poor quality CD-RWs. 

Fight against a wide variety of lovely opponents!

Unlock more characters to play as...

and even more music!

Play against a friend to determine who is the squishiest block squisher!

4575020.name: Harmful Attachment
4575020.about_the_game:
About Harmful Attachment


Set in rain-soaked Portland, Harmful Attachment is an adult romance visual novel where intimacy and ethics collide behind the closed door of a private therapy practice. You play as Nolan, a licensed clinical psychologist with a gift for reading people—and a willingness to dismantle the boundaries that keep them safe.

Three women enter his office carrying different kinds of pain. Your single, pivotal choice determines who Nolan "prioritizes"—and how quickly the therapeutic frame turns from sanctuary to trap, blurring care into dependence and romance into harm.

Meet the Cast




Iris — The Empty Room
A bereaved mother in mandated treatment after a psychiatric hold, Iris lives beside the untouched room of the daughter she lost. Nolan is documented as her primary protective factor—the person standing between her and the abyss. Their intimacy grows in the shadow of existential dependence, where comfort can become a leash.



Sloane — The Flinch
A domestic violence survivor six months into trauma therapy, Sloane has rebuilt her life through discipline, vigilance, and the fragile belief that safe men exist. Nolan becomes her template for safety—until the boundary breaks and she mistakes violation for healing. With Sloane, romance feels like freedom… right up until the door closes.



Gemma — The Offered Hand
A first-time therapy patient with disordered eating and relentless insomnia, Gemma gives, fixes, anticipates, and apologizes as instinct. Nolan's own assessment identifies her as highly susceptible to authority-directed compliance—making their romance the most unsettling, because "yes" may not mean choice at all.

Key Features


  • One defining choice, three routes: Commit to Iris, Sloane, or Gemma and follow a focused romance storyline shaped by vulnerability, trust, and escalation.
  • A clinical narrative edge: The game names what's happening in the room—transference, boundaries, crisis protocol, ethics—so the player can't hide behind ambiguity.
  • Atmosphere as storytelling: The waiting room, the fifty-minute hour, the lamp-lit office after dark—professional comfort rendered intimate, then claustrophobic.
  • Romance with consequences: Each route can look like progress on paper—while the story refuses to let "better" erase what it cost.
  • Themes of power and dependency: Explore how authority, attachment wounds, and the need for safety can transform desire into compliance.

Adult Content

4575080.name: Lost Exit
4575080.about_the_game:
Step into the quiet decay of Crestwood Mall… where something isn’t quite right.

Lost Exit is a first-person psychological horror experience set in a sprawling, infamous shopping mall frozen in time. What begins as a routine night shift quickly unravels into something far more disturbing.

The lights flicker. The halls stretch longer than they should. And the deeper you go, the more the mall begins to change.

You are alone… or at least, you think you are.

Explore a haunting environment inspired by American shopping malls from the 90s, and liminal spaces. Navigate through maintenance corridors, shuttered storefronts, and forgotten attractions as you uncover fragments of a story buried beneath the surface.

Solve the mystery of Crestwood and survive the descent into madness, as the mall tests your awareness, psyche, and nerve. Every decision matters, and not every path leads out.

The mall is watching.

And it doesn’t want you to leave.

Features:

  • Immersive Psychological Horror
    Experience a slow-burning descent into dread with cinematic visuals and atmospheric sound design.

  • Dynamic Exploration
    Traverse a massive interconnected mall filled with secrets, hidden paths, and shifting environments.

  • Narrative-Driven Gameplay
    In Lost Exit, the story is told through shifting environments, psychological tension, and eerie silence. What starts as a routine assignment slowly unravels into something far more disturbing.

  • Cinematic Aesthetic

  • Uncover the Truth
    Piece together the mystery of Crestwood Mall… if your sanity can survive long enough.

4575140.name: Project Uncover
4575140.about_the_game:
Project Uncover

A modern reimagining of classic arcade nostalgia, Project Uncover is a Qix-style casual arcade puzzle game. Players must navigate through deadly enemy interference to cut through the mysterious veil and reveal the beautiful illustrations hidden behind.

Experience simple yet thrilling controls, roguelike-style skill upgrades, and a Custom Mode that lets you turn your own images into playable stages! Dive into Project Uncover now, secure over 80% of the area, and complete your mission.

[Gameplay Controls]

Movement: W (▲) / A (◀) / S (▼) / D (▶)

Silhouette Cutting: Auto

Dash: Spacebar

[Key Features]

  • Strategic Area Capture (Qix-like Gameplay) Step out of the safe zone to boldly draw lines and claim territory. But be warned—the moment an enemy touches your line, your efforts will vanish.

  • Roguelike Skill System Level up to enhance your craft through a variety of upgrades:

    • DASH: Move swiftly in critical moments to escape danger or capture territory instantly.

    • SHIELD: Generates an auto-shield that protects your craft from a single enemy strike.

    • MOTOR: Permanently increases the base movement speed of your craft.

  • Evolving Enemies & Phase System As your capture rate increases, the boss evolves through three distinct phases, deploying increasingly powerful bullet patterns. Experience the shifting intensity with neon color transitions and warning effects that signal each phase change.

  • Diverse Difficulties & Stages With EASY, NORMAL, and HARD presets, players of all skill levels can enjoy the challenge. Clear missions, earn S-ranks, and fill your Trophy Room.

  • Infinite Scalability, Custom Play (UGC) Beyond the default stages, you can load .png or .jpg files directly from your PC to instantly create your own custom levels. Our auto-scaling logic ensures any image is perfectly transformed into a playable game background.

4575180.name: My Sister-in-Law is Secretly a Succubus
4575180.about_the_game:

You’re married to Ava—a bubbly, nurturing, and emotionally dominant woman whose teasing affection and playful control keep you constantly on edge. She’s everything you’ve ever wanted… and everything you secretly fear. What she doesn’t know is that her half-sister, Alice, is secretly a fully awakened succubus who seduces men and sucks out their soul during sex.

One night you witness her feeding—and instead of exposing her, she proposes a dangerous bargain: keep her secret, and she’ll help turn your sweet Ava into a willing hotwife. Intrigued by your filthy submissive desires and the strange power she tastes in your seed, she seals the pact with a single, binding kiss.

The telepathic bond she forges lets her guide Ava’s erotic awakening from the shadows. As your wife sinks deeper into teasing, denial, and seductive dominance, the line between love, lust, and corruption begins to blur.

4575200.name: tombolo
4575200.about_the_game:
Welcome to tombolo! This is a game where you use the sliding effects of vertical and horizontal pieces to make your opponent drop the circle piece off the board! It's a perfect information game like Go, Shogi, Chess, and Othello.

The board is 7×7 with 3 types of pieces. Placing a vertical piece slides rows up and down, while a horizontal piece slides columns left and right. You win if your opponent drops the circle piece off the board on their turn! But if you drop it yourself, you lose.

Fallen pieces become your opponent's hand pieces, creating a cycle between the board and each player's hand. Simple rules, yet the dramatic board changes caused by slides create deep strategic gameplay for beginners and experts alike.

Supports CPU battles (3 difficulty levels), local matches, and online play. Includes a tutorial to get you started.

4575220.name: Tactorius
4575220.about_the_game:
Your mind is the armory.

Tactorius takes the foundation of chess and expands it into a spell-driven system where strategy is created in the moment, not memorized in advance. Every match is shaped by your decisions, what you equip, how you adapt, and what you see that your opponent doesn't.

Over 100 spells let you summon pieces, alter their move patterns, warp mechanics, and chain interactions in ways never imagined. With 6 spells per loadout and countless combinations, no two matches play the same.

Gauntlet:

The centerpiece. Climb a tower of increasingly difficult encounters across 80+ unique enemy and boss types. Earn spell points, build your spell tree, and find the run that cracks the top floor.

Spell Lab:

Experiment with the new spells and pieces. Try out suggested game modes. Save your loadouts.

Skirmish:

Pick a commander and leverage their spells and units to your advantage. Play a match against the engine.

Training:

Learn the pieces, learn the spells, learn what's possible.

4575270.name: Deep Enough
4575270.about_the_game:
Breaking Drug is a simulation where you build your own underground empire from nothing.

Start small. Produce, manage, and expand your operation while navigating a dangerous world filled with risks, opportunities, and unpredictable consequences. Every decision matters — grow too fast and you’ll attract attention, move too slow and you’ll be left behind.

Explore a living environment, meet different characters, and shape your path: stay low and strategic, or take bold risks to dominate the market.

🔥 Features:

  • Sell your trash to earn money, simple drug simulation

Will you rise to the top… or lose everything?

4575330.name: Hiryu no Ken Collection
4575330.about_the_game:
Hiryu no Ken Collection is a collection title featuring the first four titles in the Hiryu no Ken series, along with two international versions. Centered on mixed martial arts-themed action, each title offers its own distinct gameplay elements, including versus fighting, side-scrolling action, and character growth systems.

One of the series’ defining features is the “Shingan System,” in which players aim for points displayed on the opponent’s body to attack and defend, creating a unique style of tactical combat. In addition to its mixed martial arts-inspired gameplay, the series also tells an overarching story about the battle against the evil organization Dragon Fang, which seeks the resurrection of the Great Demon and world domination.

In this collection, players can enjoy the early titles in the series on PC and experience the differences and unique appeal of each game in a single package.

Included Titles

- Hiryu no Ken: Ougi no Sho

- Hiryu no Ken II: Dragon no Tsubasa

- Hiryu no Ken III: Gonin no Ryu Senshi

- Hiryu no Ken Special: Fighting Wars

Japanese language support only.

- Flying Dragon: The Secret Scrolls

- Flying Warriors

English language support only.

- Save and load anytime.

- Customizable key bindings.

- Rewind feature included.

4575390.name: Bow-wow Battle
4575390.about_the_game:
🐕 What is Bow-wow Battle?

Your microphone is your weapon.

Bow-wow Battle is a real-time 1v1 battle game where you become a dog and bark at full volume into your microphone!

🌐 Steam Online Multiplayer!

Bark against players from around the world in real time! Auto-matching finds you an opponent instantly. Push the tug-of-war gauge with your voice volume and bark count! Friend invites supported.

🎮 Simple to Play

  • Pick your dog! (Choose from 7 breeds)

  • Bark! (Bark into your mic!)

  • Win! (Push the tug-of-war gauge to 100% for a K.O.!)

Both voice volume and bark count move the gauge. Screaming alone won't cut it — clear, distinct barks are the key to victory.

⚔ Dog Road — Story Mode

8 stages of boss battles! From Park Puppy to Legendary Dog, defeat them all to become the ultimate dog. Clear each stage to unlock new breeds. Beat the final boss to earn the title "Dog Road Master"!

🦀 Crab Survival

Waves of crabs are attacking! Blow them away with your voice! 5 types of item drops to help you survive longer. Aim for the highest score!

🐶 7 Unique Dog Breeds

Shiba Inu, Pomeranian, Chihuahua, Toy Poodle, French Bulldog, Corgi, and Golden Retriever. All drawn in a warm, hand-drawn colored-pencil art style. Happy smiling dogs transform into fierce barking faces during battle!

🎙️ Full Voice Control

Navigate menus with your voice:

  • "Woof!" ×1 = Confirm

  • "Woof! Woof!" ×2 = Navigate

  • "Woof! Woof! Woof!" ×3 = Cancel

Play without ever touching your keyboard — full bark control mode! (Keyboard controls also supported)

📋 Daily Challenges & Titles

3 daily challenges generated automatically! Complete them to earn WP. Unlock titles like "Shiba Master" and "Corgi Legend" based on your wins with each breed!

📺 Perfect for Streaming

Watching someone bark at full volume is entertainment in itself. Streamers and VTubers — your audience will love this.

You are free to stream, record, and upload videos of this game. Monetization is welcome. Show the world your best bark!

🏪 Unlock Breeds with Wan Points (WP)

Win battles to earn WP and unlock new breeds. K.O. victories earn bonus WP!

🌏 3 Languages Supported

Japanese, English, and Simplified Chinese.

🚀 About Early Access

Currently available as Early Access. Planned updates include:

  • Additional breeds (Pug, Husky, Doberman, etc.)

  • Ranking system (Puppy → Legendary Dog, 6 tiers)

  • New background stages

  • Steam Achievements

  • More BGM and sound effects

    ⚠️ Notice

  • This game uses microphone input. Please be considerate of your surroundings and the time of day. Using a headset and adjusting mic sensitivity allows quieter play.

4575420.name: Push and Pull
4575420.about_the_game: The Push and Pull is a game about relationships and how two bunnies navigate through a rough patch to find a new home. They use the effect they have over each other to navigate puzzles through a series of coordinated actions, trust falls, and collaborative problem solving.

4575440.name: Omen of the Godless
4575440.about_the_game:
🎮 Overview

Omen of the Godless is a first-person roguelike deckbuilder where every decision shapes your path—and every step makes the world more dangerous.

Summoned into a land where the gods have turned against their followers, you must explore elemental dungeons, build your power, and defeat each god to unlock the path to the God King.

⚔️ About This Game

Explore interconnected dungeon paths inspired by classic tabletop adventures. Each run is different, with fog-of-war exploration, branching routes, and unpredictable encounters waiting in every room.

Every step you take increases the threat. As you push deeper, enemies grow stronger—forcing you to decide when to press forward, when to rest, and when to turn back.

Choose your path carefully. Chase powerful rewards and risk escalating danger, or play it safe and reach the boss with fewer resources. The deeper you explore, the greater the rewards—but survival is never guaranteed.

🃏 Build Your Deck

Start each run with basic abilities and grow your deck through discovery and combat. Each elemental dungeon offers unique cards, enemies, and playstyles.

  • Focus on a single element to unlock powerful, specialized abilities

  • Combine multiple elements to create devastating synergies

  • Balance strength, speed, and survivability through your build

Your deck is limited by capacity, forcing meaningful choices between powerful cards and flexible combinations.

🔥 Dynamic Dungeons

  • Procedurally arranged dungeon layouts with backtracking and multiple paths

  • Fog-of-war exploration that reveals new opportunities—and new risks

  • Unstable rooms that can change when revisited, keeping exploration unpredictable

  • Randomized encounters, rewards, and events every run

No two runs are the same.

📈 Risk and Progression

Defeat a dungeon boss to permanently unlock its cards and rewards. Fall in battle and lose everything gained during that run.

You don’t need to find everything in a single attempt. Each dungeon can be replayed, with missed rewards appearing in new locations in future runs—encouraging exploration and mastery over time.

As you conquer dungeons, the remaining ones grow more difficult, forcing you to plan your progression and choose your path wisely.

👑 Ascend and Confront the Gods

Master each elemental dungeon, unlock their power, and prepare for the final challenge. Only by combining everything you’ve learned can you face the God King and end the war against the divine.

4575470.name: Mountains & Molehills
4575470.about_the_game:
To the Underground!

Mountains & Molehills is a turn-based, deck-building rogue-like where the earth you dig becomes your cards! Dig through stages and encounter fierce foes ranging from a crying onion to a massive maned lion made of mushroom!

Here's what to expect beneath the ground!

  • 3 Unique Attack Classes! Soils, rocks, and gemstones fill in for traditional RPG classes, where what you dig defines your class!

  • Hundreds of Relics! A little extra luck, or a total game-changer, these items add some nuance to how your deck gets built! Relics can affect enemy spawns, cards drawn, or even permanently change what a card does!

  • Turn-Based Strategy! Encounter up to 4 enemies simultaneously and spend your turn setting up damage-over-time, healing and buffing yourself, or even just launching attack-after-attack! 

  • Make Friends! Between battles, meet friendly animals such as the Picnic Mouse, complete with dialogue trees, shops, and a friendship-mechanic that carries over between runs!

  • Jot that down! As you find and use attacks and relics, they're added to a Compendium back at the molehill so you can get a better idea of what they do for future runs! 

  • Look to the Stars for Guidance! Unlock star-sign 'Aspects' after successful runs that alter what kinds of materials you'll dig up by default so you can embark as a barbarian, ranger, or mage intentionally!

Dig up some Damage!

Digging for soils, mining for stones, and prospecting for gems give you attacks for the melee, ranger, and mage classes respectively! Each material has its own effect, so gather what you can for a great deck!

One Man's Trash is another Mole's Treasure!

Though a lot of it may look like discarded human junk, that's only because... it is. Relics found underground have all sorts of effects from simple stat-ups, to summoning a hoard of angry rats, to making you breathe fire! The combination you find can take a run from good, to great, to BROKEN!

Turn-Based, Terror, and... Turnips?

From a garden full of vicious veggies, to caves of carnivorous fungi, enemies are themed and imbued with personality as a primary design-goal. Tons of animations and unique enemy attack types keep each area interesting!

4575490.name: Full Thrust at Work
4575490.about_the_game:
Synopsis

A weary office worker, exhausted by the endless pressure of corporate life, is on the verge of quitting. But everything begins to change when he is assigned to mentor a passionate new hire, Noh Maru.

As he guides her through work and reflects on his own forgotten ambitions, he gradually regains his motivation. After leading a major project to success, he earns recognition from his strict boss, Seo Ara, and finds himself growing closer to both women.

Now, standing at a crossroads, he must decide:
Will he stay because of them, or build his own path toward success?

A visual novel romance simulation where you enjoy an engaging office love story, make meaningful choices, and experience multiple endings based on your decisions.

Game Features

  • Story-driven visual novel gameplay

  • Multiple endings depending on your decisions

Controls

  • Mouse Left Click: Next dialogue / Confirm

  • Space Bar: Next dialogue

4575540.name: Shape Survivors
4575540.about_the_game:
You have nowhere to hide, and the walls are always closing in.

The Arena Shrinks

Unlike standard survivor games where you can run infinitely in one direction, the borders in Shape Survivors constantly shrink over time. You are forced into claustrophobic, high-stakes firefights where pushing your weapons to the absolute limit and mastering tight maneuvers are your only ways out.

Climb the Leaderboards

Survival isn't enough; efficiency is everything. Obliterate waves of hostile shapes as fast as humanly possible to maximize your score and cement your name at the top of the competitive leaderboards.

Permanent Meta-Progression

Every death makes you more dangerous. Gather Poly shards during every single run to purchase permanent upgrades. Scale your base power, unlock game-breaking synergies, and start each new attempt vastly stronger than the last.

Achievement Hunter's Dream

With a large list of achievements to unlock, there is always a new challenge to chase, a new build to master, and a new way to break the game.

4575600.name: Stone Creek
4575600.about_the_game:
Important Notice

Stone Creek is an title in active but early development, currently on Playtest phase. Core gameplay systems are live, but the full vision is still being built. New mechanics, content, and features are added regularly, shaped by community feedback.

Stone Creek

For weeks, reports trickled in of the dead rising and wandering the streets. Then they turned, suddenly, vicious, lethal and the world was swallowed by horror and despair. The population has been reduced to almost nothing. Survival is still possible. Purpose is still a reason.

Stone Creek is a persistent multiplayer survival RPG set in a classic zombie apocalypse. The world runs 24/7 whether you're logged in or not. Leave your character in a safe zone and they keep living, trading, resting, and interacting with other players as an NPC.

Survive. Build. Trade. Thrive.

In vanilla Stone Creek, your days are spent:

  • Establishing and fortifying bases against an ever-present threat

  • Laying rail tracks to connect settlements and open trade routes

  • Exploring the world to uncover blueprints and lost technologies

  • Acquiring, repairing, and upgrading equipment, from personal computers to robots and heavy machinery.

Every player has a role

Character progression in Stone Creek is built around genuine interdependence without forcing you into it if you don't want to. Skills develop organically over time, and some players will master something very specialized, like a particular piece of engineering, some style of furniture or construction, a rare recipe, becoming irreplaceable in their community economy.

A platform, not just a game

Stone Creek is designed for communities. Server operators can customize settings, craft unique experiences, and attract players who share their playstyle. Modders and programmers will find deep tools for storytelling, machinima, and world-building. PvP or PvE.

4575650.name: Cosy Puzzle Cabin
4575650.about_the_game:
Cosy Puzzle Cabin is a relaxing puzzle game with 17 different puzzle types, daily challenges, and a warm, cosy aesthetic designed to help you unwind.

What's Inside

  • 17 Puzzle Types — Sliding, Word Scramble, Word Rescue, Noughts & Crosses, Four in a Row, Word Search, Crossword, Memory Match, Memory Pattern, Turn It Off, Odd One Out, Picross, Postcard Jigsaw, Codebreaker, Matchsticks, Fleet Finder & Clue Grid.

  • Daily Puzzle — A fresh puzzle every day with streak tracking to keep you coming back.

  • Today's Postcard — Each day features a public-domain artwork as a jigsaw puzzle.

  • Multiple Difficulty Levels — From quick easy puzzles to tricky brain-teasers.

  • Achievements & Badges — Earn badges for streaks, puzzle mastery, and milestones.

  • Cloud Save — Your progress syncs across devices via Steam Cloud.

Designed to Relax

No timers pressuring you. No ads. No in-app purchases. Just puzzles, a warm colour palette, and the Quicksand font that feels like a cup of tea.

Pick it up for five minutes or settle in for an evening — Cosy Puzzle Cabin fits however you want to play.

4575680.name: Prison Glow
4575680.about_the_game:
Within the high walls, the truth never sleeps.

Prison Glow is a 2D realistic suspense pixel visual novel that tells the story of a girl who suddenly suffers a misfortune and is wrongfully imprisoned. Players take on the role of Judy, navigating a non-linear, multi-timeline narrative to piece together fragmented memories and clues through dialogue and careful observation. She uncovers the truth across different stages of her life and her family’s past.

The game builds its atmosphere with realistic pixel art, guiding players through a suspenseful narrative spanning different life phases, exploring the intertwined fate of humanity, conspiracy, and family secrets while searching for hidden clues in an oppressive environment. Past memories, the attitudes of those around her, and seemingly irrelevant details gradually come together to reveal the full picture.

The story revolves around conspiracy, human nature, and family secrets, unfolding layer by layer with growing tension. As the investigation deepens, more and more hidden truths emerge, and everything that once seemed reasonable begins to crumble.

Past memories, buried histories, and deep family secrets linger between the lines of this novel, waiting for her to uncover them with her own hands.

Reveal? Or conceal?

As the story progresses, the truth gradually comes to light, and every choice the protagonist makes will lead the plot toward its sole ending.

Every stroke left in the painting is the only proof that wishes for me to grow up well.

4575750.name: The Iron and the Oath
4575750.about_the_game:
𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗜𝗿𝗼𝗻 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗢𝗮𝘁𝗵 is an interactive narrative RPG where every choice carves a different path through a world of medieval power, faith, and betrayal.

𝗔 𝗟𝗶𝗳𝗲 𝗙𝗼𝗿𝗴𝗲𝗱 𝗕𝘆 𝗖𝗵𝗼𝗶𝗰𝗲

You are Karl von Aiden, born into a noble family in a land torn between warring powers and ancient loyalties. From childhood to your final hour, every decision you make — whom to trust, whom to defy, what to believe — will shape the man you become and the legacy you leave behind.

𝗙𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗖𝗵𝗮𝗽𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘀. 𝗧𝗵𝗿𝗲𝗲 𝗥𝗼𝘂𝘁𝗲𝘀. 𝗖𝗼𝘂𝗻𝘁𝗹𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝗙𝗮𝘁𝗲𝘀.

Your story spans five chapters of Karl's life, branching into three distinct routes — each revealing different truths about the world and its people. With over 40 attribute gates and dozens of story flags that carry consequences across chapters, no two playthroughs are the same.

𝗞𝗲𝘆 𝗙𝗲𝗮𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲𝘀

  • Deep narrative choices — Your decisions ripple across chapters, unlocking or sealing paths based on your attributes, relationships, and past actions.

  • Attribute cultivation — Develop Karl's Martial, Scholarly, Faith, Political, and Social abilities. The stats you build determine which challenges you can overcome and which doors remain closed.

  • Three branching routes — Pursue martial valor, political cunning, or scholarly wisdom. Each route offers unique story arcs, allies, and endings.

  • Multiple endings — Including 7 distinct bad endings with unique trigger conditions. Your choices have real consequences — not every path leads to survival.

  • Rich visual presentation — Hand-crafted CG sequences with layered animation, dynamic page effects, and a distinctive leather-bound book interface.

  • A prequel story — The Iron and the Oath tells the origin story of the von Aiden family, setting the stage for the events of Court of Shadows.

𝗔 𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗹𝗱 𝗼𝗳 𝗣𝗼𝘄𝗲𝗿 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗕𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗮𝘆𝗮𝗹

Navigate the treacherous politics of noble houses, the rigid hierarchies of the church, and the brutal reality of medieval warfare. Forge alliances, uncover conspiracies, and confront impossible dilemmas where honor and survival rarely align.

Every oath has a price. Every bond can be broken.

4575800.name: The Princess's Tower
4575800.about_the_game:
The Princess's Tower is a lighthearted and erotic touch-and-feel "trainer" game. You play as Frim of Coombmere, a hedge wizard working for the Dark Imperium. Your mission: oversee Princess Ariane and ensure her compliance to help secure the Dark Imperium's rule. But your methods are anything but ordinary—embrace a playful, kinky approach as you train the princess, explore new interactions, and shape her fate.

The Story

Frim of Coombmere is a hedge wizard tasked with having the newly imprisoned princess Ariane sign the Dragon’s mandate. Ariane is a proud princess who is now the head of a ruined kingdom. Frim has his work cut out for him, as Ariane has no intention of signing a document that would hand over the reins of her kingdom to an evil war-mongering nation. However, Ariane has a major weakness; she has been bound in chastity for almost half her life, which Frim intends to use to his advantage. How long will Ariane be able to avoid the lustful temptations with Frim dangling it in front of her whenever he gets the chance?

Day to day

Decide how you’ll spend each day with Ari. Brew potions to sway Ari’s mood, tackle paperwork to line your pockets, and set the stage for a bit of creative discipline.

Ari

Spend time with Ari to influence her mood and behavior in fun, unexpected ways.

Discipline

Use infractions to discipline Ari and collect fragments for upgrades. Use different tools to interact with Ari during discipline!

Upgrades

Trade in fragments for exciting upgrades. Unlock fresh actions and new choices for your playful interactions with Ari.

4575840.name: Unlikely Adventurers
4575840.about_the_game:
Retirement can wait. Revenge cannot.

Return to the golden age of arcades in this tactical pixel-art beat 'em up. Join a band of legendary heroes coming out of retirement to avenge the only thing that made their golden years sweet. Embark on a brutal journey, master technical combat, and uncover the truth behind a senseless crime.

"He wasn't just a dog. He was our last hope."

After decades of clearing dungeons and slaying ancient deities, Daghor and his companions had finally found peace. Their new lives revolved around Dog, a stray who had chosen them as his new family. But peace is a fragile thing.

A cold-blooded execution, a targeted and unexplained attack, has snatched Dog away from them, reopening wounds that time had never truly healed. Now, these "Unlikely Adventurers" must sharpen their blades for one last, bloody crusade. Who gave the order? And why them?

The Gameplay Experience

Unlikely Adventurers blends the soul of 90s Capcom classics with a modern RPG-Roguelite structure. Every run is a journey through devastated lands, where the weight of every strike is felt in your bones.

  • "Weighty & Tactical" Combat: We’ve preserved the solid, physical feel of old-school arcades, enhanced by a modern tactical layer. Master active parries and directional strikes: it’s not just about hitting hard, it’s about hitting at the right moment.

  • Old Dogs, New Tricks: Experience RPG-lite progression that keeps the action flowing. Level up during your run to unlock new moves and boost your stats without ever slowing down the fight.

  • Roll for Fortune: Encounter spontaneous mini-quests where your success is decided by the roll of the dice. Whether you're disarming traps or persuading NPCs, these tabletop-inspired skill checks add a layer of unpredictability to every run.

  • Five Heroes, Five Destinies:

    • Daghor the Paladin: Holy power and a regrettable past.

    • Lyra the Elf Ranger: Elven precision to control the battlefield from afar.

    • Gomer the Gnome Thief: Extreme speed, low blows, and unpredictable moral compass.

    • Sumalar the Drow Mage: Proof that dark magic only gets more lethal—and more cynical—with pointed ears.

    • Thrain the Dwarf Defender: A bastion of pure muscle and heavy iron.

  • The Hunt for Truth: Beating the game with one character is only one piece of the puzzle. Every hero experiences the story from their own perspective, with unique cutscenes and endings. Only by uniting all viewpoints will you access the True Final Chapter and discover the truth behind Dog's death!

Key Features

  • Couch Co-op: Grab your friends and reclaim the glory of local multiplayer. Coordinate your skills to take down waves of enemies.

  • Beautiful Pixel Art: Detailed 2D environments and fluid animations that pay homage to the 16-bit arcade aesthetics.

  • Hardcore Challenge: Decipher complex enemy behaviors that demand split-second timing and absolute mastery of the battlefield.

  • High Replayability: Unlock new content, secret characters, and hidden lore with every successful run.

Developer’s Note:

"In Unlikely Adventurers, the past never stays buried. Get ready to discover that sometimes justice is blind... but vengeance never blinks".
