  • Buntspecht & Rabe Softwaremanufaktur

4576550.name: The Sleepless Nights Origins
4576550.about_the_game:
Meet Isanna. Marketing specialist. Recently relocated. Definitely not having the best year of her life.

Between navigating corporate bureaucracy in a country that doesn't exactly welcome outsiders and quietly pretending she's fine, Isanna has developed a new (quite stressfull and unavoidable) hobby: walking home alone at night and noticing that reality doesn't seem to be holding itself together very well.

The street loops. You noticed, right?

Walk forward through the same rain-soaked corporate district, over and over. Each loop, something might be different. A sign that wasn't there. A shadow that moved. A light that shouldn't be that color. Or maybe nothing at all - maybe the street is exactly as it should be. Which makes you doubt yourself even more.

Your job is to figure out which one it is.

See something wrong? Keep walking forwards. It isnt the same street anymore.

Everything normal? Turn back, and always look over your shoulder.

Guess wrong? Start over.

Simple, right? Sure. At first.

FEATURES

  • A looping night street that is definitely, absolutely, 100% the same every time (it isn't (sometimes))

  • Dozens of nightmares ranging from "wait, did this light just flicker?" to "chat, we are cooked."

  • A fully functional phone because even in a nightmare, you should check your notifications (but you cant write back because it aint safe on the streets)

  • Pixelated visuals that make everything just unclear enough to make you paranoid (but also beautiful)

  • An atmosphere thick enough to chew on

  • Definitely jumpscares. Or just the slow, creeping feeling that something is deeply wrong.

  • Intriguing lore that will appear much more in the later franchise

You need good eyes. And instincts

Pay attention. Trust your gut. Remember, its always just you, a street, and your ability to notice that something is off before it's too late. And maybe don't look at the silhouettes across the road for too long.

 

They might look back.

4576570.name: Somnus Corporation
4576570.about_the_game:
REPORT THE ANOMALY. TRUST NOTHING.

Somnus Corporation is a first-person psychological horror game set inside a looping dream simulation.

SIMULATION HAS:

  • More than 35 Anomalies and entities. (More will come!)

  • 4 Anomaly and 7 Entity variation

You play as John, a dream specialist participating in an experimental consciousness test created by Somnus Corporation. What begins as a routine calibration quickly turns into something far more disturbing.

Each room feels familiar.
But something is always wrong.

A misplaced object.
A missing sound.
A voice that shouldn’t be there.

Your task is simple:

  • Inspect each room carefully

  • Detect anomalies and entities

  • Report your findings through the in-game CRT terminal

  • Advance deeper into the simulation

But the deeper you go, the less reliable the system becomes.

And the less certain you are…
that this placewas ever designed to let you leave.

GAMEPLAY

There are 22 rooms you must inspect.

Your objective is to memorize the original layout and identify anything that changes as the simulation progresses.

Using the Somnus Terminal, you must report:

  • Visual anomalies

  • Physical abnormalities

  • Sound anomalies

  • Time distortions

  • Unknown entities

  • Or confirm that the room is consistent

A correct report allows you to continue deeper into the simulation.

If you make 3 wrong reports, the system will reset — and you’ll be sent back to Room One.

Estimated Play Time: 60–90 minutes

STORY

Somnus Corporation claims to study dreams.

But this simulation was never just a test.

As John pushes deeper into the system, fragments of a hidden truth begin to surface — buried memories, impossible entities, and the fate of those who entered before him.

Some rooms are unstable.

Some memories are not yours.

And some things inside the simulation are already aware of you.

FEATURES

  • Psychological horror focused on tension and atmosphere

  • Anomaly detection gameplay with growing uncertainty

  • CRT terminal reporting system

  • A looping apartment that changes in subtle and disturbing ways

  • VHS-inspired visuals and liminal environments

  • A story-driven experience with hidden lore

  • A short, dense horror experience designed for a single sitting

WARNING

This game contains:

  • Psychological horror themes

  • Disturbing imagery

  • Flashing visual effects

  • Tension-based audio design

  • Themes of consciousness manipulation and mental deterioration
4576570.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Spanish - Latin America, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish
*languages with full audio support

4576600.name: Knight Survivor
4576600.about_the_game:
Your Quest is Survival. Step into the arena as a lone knight facing impossible odds. Knight Survivor strips away the fluff and drops you right into the action in a pure, top-down roguelite experience. Swarms of enemies are closing in, and your only way out is through them.

Build Your Arsenal Why bring a sword to a monster fight when you can bring a Flamethrower? Between each intense wave, spend your hard-earned gold in the Shop to purchase and upgrade up to six weapons at a time. Mix and match your loadout to create devastating synergies.

  • The Classics: Start with your trusty Pistol and upgrade its damage.

  • Heavy Crowd Control: Burn through the swarm with the Flamethrower or clear out packed arenas with Grenade Packs.

  • High-Tech Destruction: Melt elite targets with the high-damage Laser Rifle.

  • Utility: Equip the Magnet to scoop up XP and materials from across the battlefield.

Level Up and Break the Game As you gather XP and level up, you'll need to carefully manage your Knight's stats to keep up with the escalating threat. Stack Crit and Attack Speed to melt waves instantly, or build a tanky juggernaut with high HP, Armor, and Dodge. Don't forget to push your Luck to get the best rolls in the shop!

Key Features:

  • Bite-Sized Runs: Perfect for quick 15-minute sessions or hours of "just one more run" grinding.

  • Wave-Based Arena Combat: Survive the timer, clear the wave, and reap the rewards.

  • Deep Stat Customization: 8 different base stats to upgrade and manipulate.

  • Permadeath: When your HP hits zero, the run is over. Dust off your armor and try again.

4576620.name: Keep On Winning!
4576620.about_the_game:
Keep On Winning! is a playful send-up of incremental games and games of chance.

The idea is simple: press the button, and you either win or lose.
The catch? Your odds of losing are just 1 in 1,000,000.

Will you chase the longest winning streak and climb among the best players in the world, or earn your place in legend by being one of the rare few to lose?

The game was made by a solo developer, with help from a pixel artist and a composer/sound designer.

No generative AI was used in the game.

To keep the competition fair, the draw, leaderboard, and achievement unlocks are all handled on a remote server, making every score fully authoritative.

Moreover, users of auto-clickers will be automatically removed from the leaderboard.

Good luck! Or bad luck...
4576620.supported_languages: English, French, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America

4576690.name: Peace Under Heaven Again
4576690.about_the_game:
Peace Under Heaven Again takes the luck-based card and RPS elements of the original and transforms them into an intense battlefield of schemes, suspicion, and psychological warfare.

  • Tactical Deployment (Rock-Paper-Scissors): Read your opponent’s next move based on the board. Will you focus on a relentless assault, or move to parry and disrupt their plans? In this arena, every advance or retreat is a calculated risk.

  • Diverse Arsenal: Featuring a wide array of card, each with unique activation conditions and effects.

  • The Ultimate Mind Game: Luck is only the beginning; true victory belongs to those who master their opponent’s mind.

Master your weapons, see through their hand, and crush the enemy fortress. Are you ready to dominate the Paper War?
4576690.supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

4576830.name: BUSINGO
4576830.about_the_game:
BUSINGO is a up to 4-player co-op & singleplayer survival game set entirely on a moving bus. You and your team are escaping a cartel. Your primary objective is to keep the vehicle operational and defend it from continuous attacks while navigating a procedurally generated infinite road.

Key Features

  • Moving Base Management: The bus is your only safe zone. Repair the glass, patch the hull, and manage resources while the vehicle is in motion.

  • CO-OP Gameplay: Work together with up to 3 other players. Coordinate roles such as driving, resource collecting, and defending to survive against continuous cartel attacks.

  • Cartel Attacks: Defend the bus against a pursuing cartel. React to their attempts to stop your progress and damage the vehicle. Loot their bases and structures at desert in order to collect better resources.

  • Random & Infinite Generation: The road, obstacles, and environments are generated procedurally. Each run requires adapting to new conditions and hazards.

  • Low-Poly Visuals: The game is built with a low-poly aesthetic, designed to provide clear visual feedback during fast-paced gameplay. BUSINGO's main goal is not realism, but mechanical clarity, ensuring players can instantly identify threats, resources, and structural damage at high speeds.

4576840.name: MayDay MayDie
4576840.about_the_game:
Trust No One in the Sky!

As a group of passengers, your only chance to survive is to work together while your plane’s engines fail one by one, cabin pressure drops, and critical systems collapse.

But there’s one problem…

Your closest friend might actually be a hijackers trying to turn the plane into a fireball.

🔧 Cooperation & Tasks

To save the plane, players must complete tasks that appear in different areas.

  • Restart complex systems

  • Set up correct connections and configurations

  • Keep critical devices stable

  • Find the right solutions through trial and error

Some tasks require precision, others demand speed.
Some will punish you for mistakes.

And most importantly:
You can’t do everything alone.

🔪 Sabotage & Betrayal

There are hijackers hiding among you; instead of attacking directly, they’re working from within.

  • Disable critical systems

  • Delay task completion

  • Start onboard fires that damage the aircraft

  • Drain the plane’s fuel, bringing it closer to a crash

And while doing all this…
They act like they’re on your side.

🎮 Features

  • Multiplayer experience for up to 8 players

  • Real-time tasks and sabotage mechanics

  • Constantly increasing tension and chaos

  • Character customization with different outfits and appearances
4576840.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish
*languages with full audio support

4576860.name: Monotone 2048
4576860.about_the_game:
Monotone 2048 is a minimalist and relaxing classic number puzzle game that retains the core fun of 2048. It features simple controls, high replayability, and offline play, allowing you to start a strategic challenge anytime, anywhere.

Core Gameplay

Slide all number tiles using arrow keys (or WASD). Identical tiles merge into their sum when collided (all values are powers of 2). A new 2 or 4 tile spawns randomly after each move. Reaching the 2048 tile achieves basic victory. You can continue to pursue higher numbers until the board is full and no more merges are possible, aiming to beat high scores through strategic planning.

Key Features

  • Board Size: Default 4×4 classic grid with smooth, responsive controls.

  • Audio: Soft background music, adjustable volume, one-key mute, and unique merge sound effects.

  • Themes: Multiple visual themes including light/dark mode with clean colors, eye-friendly for night play.

  • Achievements: Full Steam achievements, including “First 2048”, “1024 Wins” and more.
4576860.supported_languages:
English*, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
*languages with full audio support

4577040.name: 致，我亲爱的
4577040.about_the_game:
To My Dearest—

一款心理恐怖视觉小说，围绕记忆与自我认知展开。

An English version is planned for release later this year.

A psychological visual novel about memory, perception, and the feeling of being watched.

You will traverse fragmented memories and distorted perceptions, accompanied by figures of unknown origin. Within a collapsing landscape of consciousness, you make choices and move through scenes shaped by emotion and recollection, gradually piecing together a past and a self that have been erased or forgotten.

Your decisions will reshape what lies ahead—and what remains of you.

—

The story begins with a corpse… but “you” do not care what it is. Only confusion, disorientation, and a biting cold drive you to escape.

Then the kite appears.
And the others follow.

You cannot tell what is real, nor where those watching you truly come from.

There is no need to explain.
When you return to reality, “you” will know whose guidance to follow.

—

• Multiple branching paths and endings
• Your choices determine whether “you” confront, avoid, or remain trapped within it all

4577060.name: Desktop Maid Haru
4577060.about_the_game:
Talk with Haru

Talk to Haru!

Give her gifts and raise her affection to unlock new story episodes.

To-Do & Calendar

Write down your tasks and schedule your day like a diary.

Haru will remind you at the right time — and she might get a little upset if you ignore them.

You can also ask Haru about your schedule using AI, and she’ll give you a clear overview of your day.

Timer

With the ultra-focus timer, time only progresses when you’re using the programs you’ve chosen.

It also includes the widely used Pomodoro technique to help you stay productive.

Music & Ambient Sounds

Create your perfect sound environment by combining high-quality lo-fi beats with realistic ambient sounds.

You can import your own music in addition to the tracks provided.

Create playlists and play them whenever you like.

Collect Items

Use coins earned from focus sessions to open card packs and collect items.

Items are divided into:

  • Decorative objects

  • Interactive items

  • Cute animal companions

Decorate Your Deskterior

Collect pixel art and freely decorate the background where Haru lives.

Turn your desktop into a cozy, personalized space.

Play on Your Desktop

Place interactive items on your desktop and play with them.

Each item reacts differently, bringing your space to life.

Built-in AI

Talk to Haru anytime.

She reads your to-do list and gives you a briefing of your day.

She reacts emotionally to your conversations — feeling happy, worried, and more, with changing expressions.

Haru’s AI runs entirely on your PC.

Your conversations are never sent anywhere, and even without internet, Haru is always there to listen.
4577060.supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean

4577180.name: At Night: Haunted Ride
4577180.about_the_game:
At Night: Haunted Ride is a first-person psychological horror experience where you take the role of a ride operator on the night before opening.

In this episode, you follow Jeremy Miller, assigned to run the final test rides of an attraction deep inside a mine. What begins as routine maintenance quickly turns into something else.

Gameplay

The game is structured around a loop: ride, fix, repeat.

Ride the minecart through a looping track

Stop when something goes wrong

Exit the cart and fix what’s broken

Test scare props and mechanisms

Run it again

Every run goes a little further.

Horror & Progression

Jeremy doesn’t know how the ride is supposed to function.

That’s where your assistant comes in.

But even they don’t explain everything.

The Final Test

Once everything is fixed, you run the ride from start to finish.

No stops. No errors. That’s how it’s supposed to be. But something isn’t right. The ride doesn’t behave the same anymore.

Features

  • First-person psychological horror

  • Ride-based gameplay loop

  • Exploration and light chase sequences

  • Unique gameplay inspired by haunted house rides

  • Multiple endings

  • Atmospheric, story-driven experience

  • ~60 minutes of gameplay

Do a great job.

And don’t make them notice you.
4577180.supported_languages: English, Arabic, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Thai, Turkish, Portuguese - Brazil

4577230.name: Danmaku Engine
4577230.about_the_game:
Danmaku Engine is a bullet-hell shoot 'em up built around one idea: every element of every stage should be yours to control.

Weave through 21 handcrafted stages across five difficulty tiers from beginner-friendly fan spreads to divine-border curtains that push even seasoned pilots to their limit. Each stage has its own visual identity, bullet architecture, and original music. Clearing them all is the goal. Understanding them is the reward.

CAMPAIGN

21 stages. Five difficulties: Easy, Medium, Hard, and Extreme

Each stage throws a distinct challenge: orbital streams, spiraling neon wisps, industrial barrages, frozen rings colliding with solar bursts, moon-lit curtains of ghost-fire. No two stages play alike, and no stage will forgive you for standing still.

Progress is tracked. Achievements are earned. Secrets reward those who clear what they thought was impossible.

THE EDITOR

The full stage editor used to build the campaign is available to all players from day one.

  • Pattern Editor — design bullet patterns with full control over speed, spread, rotation, timing, and behavior

  • Boss Editor — compose multi-phase boss encounters from your patterns

  • Background Editor — build animated stage backgrounds

  • Music Editor — compose original MIDI tracks with a built-in piano roll, multi-layer instruments, and playback preview

  • Level Editor — assemble patterns, bosses, backgrounds, and music into a complete playable stage

Everything you see in the campaign was made with these tools. Nothing is locked behind them.

EARLY ACCESS

Danmaku Engine is in active development. The core gameplay loop, all 21 campaign stages, and the full editor suite are playable now. More stages, editor features, and quality-of-life improvements are planned throughout Early Access based on player feedback.

Dodge everything. Build anything.

4577240.name: Ultra's Drive
4577240.about_the_game:
You've got 100km between you and Las Vegas. Between you and the life-changing jackpot waiting at the end of the road. Between you and answers.

Your phone won't stop buzzing. And the thing is you need to read those messages. The story is in there. The whole reason Ultra is making this trip. But so is the highway: the merging trucks, the potholes, the parked cars jutting into traffic, the concrete barriers that don't move for anyone.

Ultra's Drive is a white-knuckle narrative experience about the impossible task of paying attention to two things at once. The story unfolds entirely through your texts but the road demands your eyes, your reflexes, and every last second of your focus.

Miss the messages, and you'll arrive in Vegas not knowing why you came. Ignore the road, and you won't arrive at all.

  • Story-driven narrative delivered entirely through in-game texts read along or risk missing the plot

  • Dodge traffic, parked cars, barriers, and potholes across a 100km drive to Las Vegas

  • Twitch integration — your live audience can control the cars Ultra is trying to avoid

  • Every run is a split-second test: read the message or watch the road

The rules are simple: stay on the road, avoid the obstacles, reach Vegas at 100km. What makes it hard isn't the traffic — it's the texts and your patience. If you wanna go faster, nothing is stopping you. Just like the real world highway, if you drive faster you are just increasing your risk. You can take your time but the best approach is to stay with the flow of traffic. Manage your speed, attention and Fuel gage.

Ultra's Drive is a story-driven driving game where the narrative appears in real time as you play. Messages scroll in at the worst possible moments. A bombshell revelation just as a truck swerves into your lane. A reply you've been waiting for right as a pothole opens up ahead. You have to choose between paying attention to the road or the narrative, can you do both?

The game rewards players who can do both. It punishes those who can't. And it respects the honest truth that most people will have to choose.

Stream it live and your Twitch chat gets in on the mayhem — viewers can interact with the very cars Ultra is trying to avoid, turning your audience into your biggest threat (or your dark entertainment). The chaos is built in.

At the end of the road is Vegas. At the end of the texts is the truth. Ultra just has to survive long enough to reach both.

4577250.name: Court Vision
4577250.about_the_game:
Court Vision is a basketball GM simulation where scouting, drafting, trading, signing, and developing players all run on interconnected systems. Sign with a team and take it through decades of franchise history, with a simulation engine calibrated against real basketball data.

Most basketball simulations treat scouting, training, chemistry, and contracts as separate menus. Court Vision treats them as one system. Trade for a veteran wing and you are not adding OVR. You are changing the development arc of the rookie you paired with him, the chemistry of the locker room he walks into, and the rotation that produces every box score for the rest of the season.

The engine was built against real basketball data. Pace, scoring distributions, usage curves, and clutch win probabilities were tuned until league-wide output matched real outcomes. Team chemistry is a living system shaped by wins, losses, veteran leadership, and franchise history. High-chemistry teams outperform expectations.

  • 30+ individual ratings per player across shooting, finishing, defense, IQ, athleticism, and intangibles

  • Defensive composites that actually suppress opponent scoring

  • Speed matchups, ball movement, offensive consistency, and roster depth impact every result

  • Advanced stats including PER, BPM, True Shooting, Usage Rate, and Win Shares

  • Assign scouts by position group, projected draft range, or sleeper hunts

  • Scout tier determines accuracy and depth of intel

  • Pre-season, mid-season, and pre-draft mock draft snapshots

  • Trade draft pick assets up to six years in the future

  • Specialized training camps with position-specific effectiveness

  • Assign veteran mentors to develop young players quicker

  • Work ethic, development tier, and potential impact development to create unique stories

A trade and free agency engine modeled on how real front offices operate. AI valuations are calibrated against real trade data, so the offers you receive and the deals you can construct hold up to scrutiny.

  • Realistic AI trade valuations based on real-world deal data

  • Multi-team trades and a full trade finder

  • Free agent bidding driven by player preferences: market size, contender status, role, and money

My first NBA 2K was 2K10 with Kobe on the cover. I used to sneak out of my room at night to boot up my Xbox 360 and sim just "one more season". The idea of turning a broken roster into a dynasty had me hooked for years.

Now after years of putting up with underwhelming updates to the myGM experience, that feeling is gone. Trades are still cheeseable. Chemistry is still shallow. Your superstar walks in free agency for no reason. I spent years waiting for someone to fix the basketball GM experience. Nobody did. So I built it myself.

I plan on expanding Court Vision into a full basketball GM career. Start in high school and coach your team to the state title, move to college and win the big dance and finally take your talent to the association and win the chip. Follow your players from the college ranks to the professional draft and into your franchise.

4577280.name: [MULTIPLIERS]
4577280.about_the_game:
[MULTIPLIERS] is an exponential idle clicker game where everything multiplies.

Click or wait for an idle income. Purchase chain based upgrades to maximize your profit. Invest into permanent prestige and evolve upgrades. Automate your purchases and level up infinitely. Use the reset function to increase your extra currencies farming process. Collect all the Steam achievements and reach the highest level!

KEY FEATURES:

  • Idle & clicker hybrid gameplay

  • 2,000+ upgradable items (400 per system)

  • Compounding multiplier chains (each upgrade boosts the last)

  • Prestige, Perks, Evolve and Automation systems

  • Three different currencies

  • Strategic resets to maximize prestige point gains

  • Fancy and minimalistic UI with dark and light themes switching

  • Steam achievements

4577400.name: Deepest Darkest
4577400.about_the_game:
Tenebris, an ancient entity from a realm of nightmares, has reached into our material world and corrupted the minds of the wicked into madness, and has used them to open a gate to bring forth abominations into our world. It's up to you to rip and tear through Tenebris' legion with an arsenal of guns, grenades, power ups and magic spells. Find the gate and destroy Tenebris within the deepest darkest realm of fear in the single player campaign mode. Chew ass and kick bubblegum to a metal sound track by DavidKDB in this violent retro boomer shooter. Hell yeah!

Warning: contains blood and gore.
4577400.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese

4577440.name: Runisthar
4577440.about_the_game:
FAST & LETHAL COMBAT

Rapid turns where every decision is crucial. No more bureaucracy; it's total offense! The innovative Runic Flow allows for a highly modular strategy, creating rune sequences in a frenetic, lethal, and addictive rhythm.

MASTER ELEMENTAL POWER

Feel the brutal power of burning your opponent's life or freezing their momentum. 9 distinct elements transform every combat into a unique collision of mastery and aggression.

UNIQUE ABILITIES

It’s 100% offensive here: every bit of damage is converted into Focus to trigger your Ability. Explode everyone!

BUILD YOUR OFFENSE

Create lethal synergies where every choice empowers your Runes, turning your strategy into an unstoppable force that grows with every strike.

OVERCOME CHALLENGES

Death lurks in every turn. Your opponents are as intelligent and lethal as you are. Triumph over battle unpredictability that tests your mastery to the limit.

DEFEAT IS NOT THE END

Blood boils with defeat, but the journey doesn't stop. Unleash your fury in a Rematch to challenge the same opponent instantly. No time for regrets—only vengeance!

A JOURNEY WITH PERSONALITY

Forget random and confusing paths. Runisthar tells diverse, engaging stories charged with humor. Every encounter is a clash of personal motivations where each fate is decided by the law of the victor.
4577440.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal

4577460.name: SNITCHED
4577460.about_the_game:
Every inmate is a real player. Sell drugs to strangers. But you have to convince them to buy. And they can report you to the guards. And start cafeteria fist fights.
Every inmate is a real player. Sell drugs. Snitch. Start fights. And yes, the cops are real players too.

  • Everybody is in prison and everybody is a real player.

  • Proximity voice chat.

  • Play alone or with friends, in public servers with strangers.

  • Grow weed in your prison cell (because that's what inmates do, obviously)

  • Sell weed to other inmates, but you have to convince them to buy and that it's good product (even if it's not).

  • Buy weed from other inmates (but only if their product is good, or so they say...)

  • And yes, you can be a cop too and catch inmates mid-drug-transaction.

4577480.name: MunchKing
4577480.about_the_game:
Make your adorable jelly bear the King!

Defeat other players to gather candies and claim the crown! You earn one candy for every opponent you take down, but beware—you'll lose one if you get defeated. Collect the target number of candies to seize the throne!

Upgrade your jelly bear's stats!

Periodically enhance unique abilities up to 7 times to create the ultimate jelly bear!

Arm your jelly bear!

Grab weapons that spawn periodically across the map to unleash unique and powerful weapon skills!

Key Features

  • Casual Multiplayer Action: Up to 4 players can battle it out against each other.

  • Vibrant Graphics & Maps: Experience and play across a variety of uniquely themed maps.

  • Dynamic Upgrades: Combine different stat upgrades in every match to create powerful synergies with your weapons and crush your opponents!

4577630.name: My Scout Life
4577630.about_the_game:
My Scout Life puts you in the shoes of a professional football scout. Your mission? Find the next superstar before the big clubs do.

Travel across regions, attend matches, and evaluate young players with raw potential. Not every talent is obvious — your eye for the game is your greatest asset.

Develop. Train. Sell. Sign promising youngsters, invest in their development, and watch their value soar. When the time is right, negotiate with clubs and close the deal for maximum profit.

Build Your Scouting Empire Start small as an unknown scout and grow your reputation. Unlock new regions, expand your network, and attract better prospects as your career progresses.

Every Decision Matters Miss a talent and a rival scout scoops them up. Develop the wrong player and lose your investment. The transfer market waits for no one.

Are you ready to find the next legend?
4577630.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish

4577720.name: CrazyDish
4577720.about_the_game:
CrazyDish is a relaxing and chaotic dishwashing simulation game where you clean, optimize, and compete to become the top dishwasher in the Dishwashing League.

Using the Super Sink 3000, teleport your clients’ dirty dishes straight into your sink and complete a wide variety of absurd yet satisfying contracts.

Gameplay

Prove yourself as a dishwasher by completing various contracts where you'll have to clean a wide variety of items.

The more notoriety you gain as a dishwasher, the more prestigious and lucrative contracts you'll receive!

Your reputation points will also allow you to climb the leaderboard in the Dishwasher League, but if you want to reach the top, you'll have to face the league's three champions: The Three Carls.

The Cleaning Tools You Need

Good dishwashers all know that the best tool will always be the traditional sponge, but those who want to break speed and efficiency records can purchase various accessories, such as the Super Brush, the MicroFoam, or even the Bath Bomb Launcher!

You can also buy upgrades for your tools!

An Easy Game to Complete

Do you dream of easily obtaining trophies? Do you dream of completing a game without pulling your hair out? Do you dream of a two-minute tutorial that then just moves on to something else?

A Ridiculous Game

Do you think this game is ridiculous? Do you think no one will ever buy it after watching the videos and looking at the screenshots? Do you find this game overpriced for what it is? Good news: all you have to do is add it to your cart!

4577740.name: Nail It Or Fail It
4577740.about_the_game:
FAST, CHAOTIC, AND FUN!

Grab your hard hat and get ready to run!

Nail It Or Fail It is a high-octane, chaotic construction simulator where speed is everything and the environment is your biggest enemy. Whether you’re flying solo or teaming up with friends, you’ll need to coordinate, carry, and build under extreme pressure before the clock hits zero.

KEY FEATURES

  • ⚡ High-Speed Cooperation: Play with up to 4 players in local or online co-op. Will you be a well-oiled machine, or will you just get in each other's way?

  • 🏗️ Dynamic Obstacles: Construction is never easy. Navigate moving platforms, dodge swinging hazards, and survive environmental traps that threaten to level your hard work.

  • 🛠️ Master the Chaos: From sky-high skyscrapers to unstable volcanic zones, adapt your strategy to different biomes and increasingly complex blueprints.

  • Physics-Based Fun: Throwing materials to your teammates might save time, but one bad aim could lead to a disastrous (and hilarious) collapse!

You are tasked with defending the core against relentless demonic swarms, but static defenses won't save you here. The terrain is a dynamic puzzle. When the board flips, the rules of reality change, and enemies will start pushing from the abyss below. You must defend both sides of the grid simultaneously.

SURVIVE. EXPAND. UPGRADE. Every run is a new puzzle. Master the core roguelite loop to build an impenetrable fortress:

  • Survive the Wave: Hold the line against increasingly difficult hordes of enemies.

Unleash the Earth Tower to trigger massive area-of-effect earthquakes that fracture the grid, dealing damage to swarms on both sides of the flipping board at the exact same time. Find the perfect build, adapt to the rotating terrain, and outsmart the horde.

COUCH-FRIENDLY TACTICS Unlike most grid-based strategy games, TESSELLAR features full gamepad support. Whether you want to meticulously plan your grid with a mouse and keyboard or build your defenses from the comfort of your couch with a controller, the tactical chaos is always at your fingertips.

4578640.name: Ro Sham Brawl
4578640.about_the_game:
Ro Sham Brawl is a multiplayer party brawler where you throw Rock, Paper, and Scissors objects at opposing players. Every shot is a physics object — it flies, bounces, and never leaves the arena. The map fills up, platforms crumble, and every round spirals into something different.

Rock crushes Scissors. Scissors cuts Paper. Paper covers Rock. The winning object destroys the other object and becomes a persistent threat on the arena. The same rules apply to the arena itself: platforms are made of Rock, Cardboard, or Plastic, and the right projectile type smashes right through them.

Powerups That Stack. Pickups spawn across the arena and modify your projectiles directly. Homing rocks that chase opponents. Ricocheting scissors that bounce off every surface. High speed paper that is impossible to dodge. Shotgun spreads, explosive impacts, gravity wells — and they all stack on top of each other. The longer the round goes, the wilder things get.

Arenas That Don't Survive. Breakable platforms shatter when hit by the right projectile type. And since projectiles never despawn, they pile up as rolling, bouncing obstacles. The arena you start on is not the arena you finish on.

Bring Friends. Bring Chaos. Play with up to 8 players online through Steam, over LAN, or fill the lobby with bots. Go free-for-all or form teams. Pick your arenas, toggle which powerups are in play, and let the physics sort it out.

Key Features

  • Rock Paper Scissors Combat — Throw Rock, Paper, and Scissors as physics-driven projectiles. Projectiles collide and the winner survives and keeps flying.

  • Destructible Arenas — Platforms made of Rock, Cardboard, and Plastic break when hit by the projectile type that beats them. The ground beneath you is never safe.

  • Persistent Projectiles —  Every shot stays in the arena as a physical obstacle unless it is directly destroyed — rolling, bouncing, and blocking your path.

  • Stackable Powerups — Homing, ricochet, explosion, shotgun, sticky, gravity pull, deflection, shield, platform-creating, and more. They modify your projectiles directly and stack for compounding chaos.

  • Up to 8 Players — Online via Steam, or LAN. Supports free-for-all and team modes.

  • Bots — Fill empty slots with bots at adjustable difficulty levels. Practice solo or pad out a match.

  • Deep Movement — Wall jump, wall slide, dash, crouch, and crouch roll. The skill ceiling is as high as you want it to be.

  • Match Customization — Choose which arenas and powerups are active. Configure teams, bot count, and game mode before each match.

"Mega Hyper Ultrastorm" Kevin MacLeod

4578680.name: 红色史诗
4578680.about_the_game:
七律·长征

红军不怕远征难，万水千山只等闲。

五岭逶迤腾细浪，乌蒙磅礴走泥丸。

金沙水拍云崖暖，大渡桥横铁索寒。

更喜岷山千里雪，三军过后尽开颜。

                                   —— 毛泽东

关于游戏

史诗关卡：从突破重围到胜利会师

本作以史实为蓝本，呈现那段波澜壮阔的远征。玩家将率领红军，从江西瑞金出发，从突破第一道封锁线开始，亲历湘江血战的残酷、赤水河畔的奇谋、大渡河上的生死时速，直至最终翻越岷山，迎来胜利会师的伟大时刻。

核心玩法：因战而异，顺势而为

在设计之初，我曾反复思考：什么样的游戏模式最能还原长征？长征的战役是复杂的，很难用一种简单的游戏模式来概括，最终本作选择了“塔防+ 轻度即时战略”的复合模式。这一选择并非为了堆砌玩法，而是源于对长征战役特性的深度复刻：

  • 塔防为主：阵地阻击的韧性 长征途中，面对优势兵力的围追堵截，大量的战斗表现为极其惨烈的阻击战（如延寿阻击战、湘江战役）。塔防模式能完美模拟这种“以少胜多、寸步不让”的阵地博弈。你需要合理布防，在敌军的浪潮中守住那条关乎生死的生命线。

  • 轻度RTS：攻坚与遭遇的变数 长征不仅仅是防守。飞夺泸定桥是攻坚战，而四渡赤水则是灵活穿插的运动战。 在这些关卡中，游戏并不拘泥于塔防模式。你需要主动出击、调度部队进行合围或强攻。

  • 形式服务于史实 在本作中，战役的形式决定了游戏的模式，而非套用公式化的玩法。所有的机制设计，只为一个目标：让你真切地感受长征的每一场战役。

玩法特色

  • 还原真实地图：游戏地图通过高程图地理数据，在虚幻引擎中生成地图地形，基本做到按照真实长征战役地点1:1还原。

  • 授予独特番号：游戏目前共有5种兵种类型，每一个兵种都有独特的属性与成长树，后期均可授予不同的独特番号，解锁特殊能力。建筑同样有不同的升级路线。你既可以把一支小队培养成“铁血尖刀”，专精突击；也可以把后方基地打造成“钢铁堡垒”。

  • 选择战术流派：本作提供约10种核心战术流派，可通过战役进度不断学习成长，每一流派都会大幅改变游戏策略玩法。

  • 点燃民族精神：本作独创“民族精神”系统，作为贯穿全程的成长主线，战役中牺牲的战斗英雄将转化为民族大义，以大义点燃民族精神，铸就红军永不屈服的钢铁雄魂！红军的强大并非来自于武器装备，而是无数革命先辈牺牲所凝聚的强大精神。

写在最后

或许大家都曾在课本上学过长征精神，但那时的我们可能难以深切体会，我也是在如今这个年纪才深切认识到那些先烈的伟大，在此特别鸣谢b站up主“沙盘上的战争”，看了他的系列视频，才让我萌生了制作这款游戏的想法，愿游玩本作的每一位玩家，不仅收获策略的乐趣，也能感受到那份从雪山草地走来的长征精神，让民族的记忆在中华民族心中永不褪色。

谨以此作，致敬那些在长征路上用鲜血和生命开辟前路的革命先烈。

4578880.name: 传染病/Infectious Disease
4578880.about_the_game:
"Infectious Disease" - Conquering the Human Body with the Body of a Virus!

 

- In 2030, the Nine-tentacles Fish Biotechnology company synthesized a completely new virus in the laboratory, which was used to test the ability of simple synthetic non-cellular life forms to acquire new genes，to verify whether the human-to-human transmission of this virus will exceed that of COVID-19 and measles virus.

And you, the player, will control it to infect the human body.

 

- Core gameplay:

Control a single or a group of viruses with the ability to evolve. Start from the mouth, pass through the respiratory tract, lungs, blood, blood-brain barrier, and finally invade the brain neurons to control the entire body.

This is not a simple shooting game, but a microscopic war of survival, strategy, and evolution.

At the beginning of the game, the biological laboratory sprays virus particles into the mouths of the population for infection tests. The player controls the virus and avoids attacks from various immune factors, immune cells, various biological molecules, and electric current charges in the human body all the way from the upper respiratory tract. These attacks are either specific targeted attacks or indiscriminate wide-range attacks. The virus needs to move or use obstacles to avoid various attacks.

The virus destroys the alveolar cells of the human lungs, enters the cells, integrates the virus DNA into the nuclear genome of the cell, and continuously replicates the virus; enters the human blood circulation system, breaks through the blood-brain barrier, and finally reaches the neurons and infects the neurons, integrating the virus DNA into the nuclear genome of the neuron cells, completing a comprehensive infection of the human body.

 

Levels:

1. Upper respiratory tract, BOSS1 flagellate

2. Lower respiratory tract, BOSS2 macrophage

3. Alveoli, BOSS3 immune cell

4. Alveolar cell membrane, BOSS4 cell membrane protein

5. Invade the cell nucleus, BOSS5 endoplasmic reticulum and cell nucleus

6. Escape from the cell interior, BOSS6 inner side membrane protein of the cell membrane

7. Control the infected cells from infecting the healthy cells of the blood system, no BOSS

8. Artery, BOSS8 capillary

9. Vein, BOSS9 macrophage

10. Astrocyte, BOSS10 proteoglycan

11. Astrocyte, BOSS11 neuronal synapse

12. Neuron, BOSS12 neuronal model

- Strategy and Growth:

Viruses seize resources such as ATP, amino acids, nucleic acids, and lipids. They need to constantly evolve and learn to hide, accelerate movement, change their own charges, actively synthesize ATP, actively restore health points, and strengthen their genetic functions to enhance their infective ability and improve their survival capabilities, so as to eventually infect the entire human body.

Defeat each boss, seize their genes, and build your own evolutionary tree.

 

- The wisdom of the immune system:

When confronted with macrophages, T cells, antibody clouds, cytokine storms...

The immune system will learn to strengthen itself, will summon allies, and will set traps.

4579650.name: Rpg Rush

Enter the Arena

A learning-driven project built in public

This game is part of that journey: an evolving experience where systems, gameplay, and content are continuously refined based on real player feedback.

Expect ongoing updates, improvements, and changes as the game grows.

RPG Rush — Where every card plays two games at once

RPG Rush is a strategic Trading Card Game set in a dark fantasy world of warriors, mages, and legends — originally designed as a physical card game, now brought online so players can help shape it during beta.

Build powerful 30-card decks, roll enchanted dice for mana, summon mythical creatures, and outmanoeuvre your opponents in fast-paced 1v1 battles. But here's the twist — the battlefield is only half the game.

Two worlds. One game.

RPG Rush is built around a living loop — two interconnected modes that feed each other and make every card you own matter beyond a single match.

Mode 01 — Card Battles

The classic TCG experience. Roll dice for mana, play cards, summon minions, cast spells, and battle opponents in ranked or casual matches.

Every victory earns XP, gold, coins, and rewards — all of which flow directly into your kingdom.

Mode 02 — Kingdom Rush Mode

A top-down kingdom management mode where your extra cards become currency. Spend them to build and expand your kingdom, earn gold, and unlock new card packs.

Cards you unlock here go straight back into your battle decks. The stronger your kingdom, the stronger your hand.

The Core Loop

Win battles → grow your kingdom → unlock better cards → bring them into battle.

A loop where no card goes to waste.

Your cards. Your strategy. Your victory.

Collect over 100 unique cards — mighty minions, devastating spells, cunning secrets, and powerful defensive magic.

Build 30-card decks across multiple hero classes, each with their own abilities and playstyle. Every match is a test of strategy, adaptation, and timing.

Key Features

🃏 Strategic deck building
Craft decks from 100+ cards across multiple classes. Combine minions, spells, secrets, and defense cards into your perfect strategy.

🎲 3D dice combat
Roll enchanted dice every turn for mana. Trigger enchantments like Blessed, Cursed, Double Roll, and Vampiric — no two games ever play the same.

⏱ Rush clock system
Turn timers shrink from 75 seconds down to 15 as the match progresses. Every decision gets harder. Hesitate and lose.

⚔️ Deep card mechanics
Master minion keywords like Taunt, Charge, Lifesteal, Divine Shield, Poisonous, and more — alongside status effects, spell interactions, and hidden secrets.

🏰 Kingdom Rush mode
Manage your kingdom between battles. Spend cards and gold to build structures, generate resources, and unlock new cards.

🧙 Multiple hero powers
Choose from Warriors, Mages, Assassins, Druids, Warlocks, and more — each bringing a unique edge to the battlefield.

🏆 Ranked competitive play
Climb the ladder, earn rewards, and prove your mastery.

🤖 Practice vs AI
Test your decks against AI opponents on multiple difficulty levels before heading into ranked.

✏️ Card creator & marketplace (in development)
Design and customize your own cards, then trade with other players.

How a Match Works

Every turn follows three phases:

Phase 1 — Roll
Roll enchanted dice to generate mana.

Phase 2 — Actions
Play cards, summon minions, and attack.

Phase 3 — End Phase
Resolve effects, triggers, and board interactions.

Manage your mana (up to 10), protect your 15 health, and reduce your opponent to zero.

Play Your Way

  • Ranked Mode — Compete for leaderboard glory

  • Casual Mode — Play without pressure

  • Practice Mode — Learn and experiment

  • Kingdom Mode — Build, expand, and progress

Collect & Customize

Unlock Common, Rare, Epic, and Legendary cards through gameplay and progression.

RPG Rush is free to play with a focus on fair progression — skill and strategy are what win matches.

A Note from the Developer

RPG Rush is being built by a solo developer with a strong focus on gameplay, systems, and player experience.

Some elements — such as music, visual assets, and certain content — have been created or enhanced using AI-assisted tools. All such content is reviewed, refined, and integrated carefully to match the game’s vision.

As development continues, systems and assets will be improved, expanded, and polished over time.

Join the Journey

RPG Rush is currently in beta.

Jump in, play the game, and share your feedback — your input directly shapes what this game becomes.

4579700.name: Rites of Accord
4579700.about_the_game:
The old world burned. What rose chose a different way to fight. The bloodshed isn't real. The stakes are.

The powers of capital clung to walled enclaves and private armies, but were overcome by communal movements with nothing left to lose. From the wreckage came new societies—communes and tribes rebuilt around ecosystems, each shaped by the biome they call home.

When conflict returned, no one wanted another war. The world’s factions convened and built the Rites—ritualized contests fought in digital arenas before a watching world. Skill and strategy replace mass destruction. Outcomes settle disputes, redraw agreements, and keep the balance without burning the world again.

What Makes Rites of Accord Different

  • Radical Asymmetry — Six factions with completely different mechanics: fog and death echoes, bio-network terrain control, ice resonance, solar momentum, fire transformation, hydro-hacking

  • 30-Minute Matches— Tabletop wargame depth in the time it takes to eat lunch

  • Objectives Over Elimination — Win through territorial control and completing Rites, not just killing units

  • Three-Stage Combat — Hit, Wound, Armor rolls on 2D6 with meaningful modifiers at every step

  • Army Building — Draft your force from a roster of unique units with abilities, subfaction bonuses, and point costs

  • Free to Play— One faction completely free. Additional factions available as DLC

Six Factions, Infinite Ways to Play

  • The Veilbound— Fog zones and death echoes. Kill their enemies and face spectral copies.

  • Symbiont Ethos— Living terrain. Growth tiles spread across the battlefield, buffing allies and hindering foes.

  • Glacial Chorus — Resonance networks. Units harmonize for devastating area effects.

  • Solar Nomadry — Speed and light. Aerial cavalry and momentum-based combat.

  • Reforged— Fire and transformation. Units grow stronger as they take damage.

  • Tideborne Collective — Deception and control. Holo-decoys, hacking, and wall generation.

Matches run 5 rounds and take about 30 minutes. Wargame depth in the time it takes to eat lunch.

Build Your Army

Draft your force from a deep roster of units across five categories — Chaff, Core, Elite, Character, and Heavy. Each unit brings unique stats, weapons, and abilities. Subfaction bonuses reward themed compositions. The army you bring shapes how you play.

Clean Combat

A three-stage resolution system built on 2D6 + stat differentials:

  • Hit Test— Martial vs Martial (melee) or Aim vs Dodge (ranged). Can you land the strike?

  • Wound Test— Weapon Strength vs Durability. Can you hurt them through their toughness?

  • Armor Test — Piercing vs Armor. Can you punch through their protection?

4579750.name: Idle Knight
4579750.about_the_game:
Idle Knight is an idle RPG where your character progresses as you use your PC.

Every interaction matters, mouse clicks, keyboard inputs, controller actions.

As long as you're using your computer, your knight is gaining XP.

The game runs in the background and is designed to fit naturally into your daily routine.

CORE IDEA

The concept is simple:

You don’t actively grind the game.

You progress by simply using your computer.

At first, progression feels fast and rewarding.

Over time, it slows down significantly.

At that point, the game shifts from passive growth to decision-making and optimization.

PROGRESSION SYSTEM

Each input generates XP.

Leveling up gives you stat points that define your character:

- HP : your health and survivability

- DMG : your damage output

- AGI : determines evasion and action speed

Your build directly affects how efficiently you progress and how well you perform in combat.

BUILDS AND STRATEGY

There is no single correct build.

You can focus on raw damage, survivability, or agility-based scaling.

However, as difficulty increases, inefficient builds will slow your progress.

This is where experimentation and optimization become important.

RESETS AND FLEXIBILITY

You are not locked into your decisions.

Special items, such as the Phoenix Feather, allow you to reset your stats while keeping your level.

This lets you test different builds and adjust your strategy over time.

DUNGEONS

Dungeons are structured challenges where you choose which one to enter based on its recommended level.

Each dungeon has a difficulty rating, and selecting the right one is important for your progression.

Once inside, you must climb through multiple floors, defeating enemies along the way until you reach the final boss.

Beating the boss completes the dungeon and grants rewards.

Rewards scale depending on the dungeon difficulty and your performance.

Dungeons are designed to test your build in real conditions.

A weak build will struggle to progress through the floors.

A well-optimized build will clear dungeons efficiently and unlock better rewards.

RANKED MODE

The game features a ranked system with multiple tiers:

Farmer → Stable Boy → Infantryman → Knight → Royal Knight → Warlord

You have a limited number of ranked attempts per day.

Winning increases your rank.

Losing decreases it.

Rank progression depends heavily on your build quality, not just playtime.

HOW YOU PLAY

Idle Knight supports two playstyles:

- Passive play: progress in the background while using your PC

- Active play: optimize builds and push ranked progression

Most players naturally combine both approaches.

COSMETICS

Cosmetic items are available through gameplay or purchase.

They are purely visual and have no impact on gameplay or progression.

MONETIZATION

Idle Knight is free-to-play.

There is no pay-to-win system.

All gameplay-relevant systems can be unlocked through normal progression.

ANTI-CHEAT SYSTEM

Because progression is based on real input detection, the game includes an anti-cheat system.

It detects:

- macros

- automated inputs

- unnatural input patterns

The goal is to ensure fair competition in ranked mode.

ENGINE

Idle Knight runs on a custom engine developed specifically for this game by me (VECR).

It is designed for:

- real-time input tracking

- stable background performance

- long-term incremental progression systems

Everything is built specifically for this type of gameplay.

NOTE

Idle Knight is a long-term progression game.

Progress naturally slows down over time.

The game is designed around optimization, planning, and gradual improvement rather than fast completion.

Survive, Scavenge, Escalate

As the rounds progress and the waves grow deadlier, you must explore the map to power up offline generators, solve intricate puzzles, and unlock doors to expand your safe zones and be 1 step closer to vivtory. Every corner turned is a risk, but it might lead you to a heavier arsenal.

Dynamic Defenses

When the horde presses in, your environment is your greatest weapon. Dynamically manipulate the world around you by dragging furniture to barricade doorways and create desperate chokepoints. Buy yourself the few precious seconds needed to reload, heal, or plan your escape.

Piece Together the Nightmare

The truth behind the outbreak is hidden in the shadows. Explore deeply atmospheric maps to uncover the dark lore of the Necrotoxium incident. Hunt for hidden data logs scattered throughout the environment to piece together the grim reality of what happened—if you can stay alive long enough to read them.

Key Features:

  • Round-Based Survival Horror: Hold out against endless, increasingly aggressive waves of the undead, inspired by classic arcade-survival mechanics.

  • Unpredictable Runs: High replayability means you can never memorize a safe route. Experience complete unpredictability with randomized player spawns, weapon placements, ammo drops, data log locations, and starting enemy variants.

  • Dynamic Barricading System: Don't just shoot—survive. Push, pull, and strategically place furniture to block doorways and slow down the pursuing horde.

  • Tactical Freedom: Instantly switch between an immersive First-Person view for precision shooting, and a tactical Third-Person perspective for better situational awareness.

  • Deep Exploration: Unlock doors, fix broken generators, and solve environmental puzzles to open up new pathways and secrets.

  • Co-op Multiplayer: Face the nightmare alone or team up with friends. Coordinate your defenses, share resources, and watch each other's backs as the waves escalate.

4579830.name: Insomnia is Coming
4579830.about_the_game:
Chapter One

Insomnia, a nightmare, voodoo dolls, a hallway, I'm running, the offering table, a phantom girl scares me, I answer the phone, gas takes the air out of me, I have little time, I survive, papal cereal gives me the strength to fight a dog with a human face, some devil imp tells me I'm late for my own funeral, some chick from a bygone era is hitting on me, and she's headless. Could it get any worse? Yes, some mysterious witch is pushing me into a coffin in the ceiling.

Chapter Two

I end up in a strange, possessed hospital. On the playground, cuddly teddy bears greet me and steal my precious health, but that's what pacifiers are for, they help me survive this nightmare. From a giant pill comes a hideous boy worm, don't take that drug filth! A devil imp tells me I'm late for my own autopsy, some grandmother gives me a birthday present... no, this is the anniversary of my death. Words can hurt. Using some dice in the toilet, I fight the Blood Goddess, and more nightmarish monsters await me in the hallways. From now on, I don't like apples; original sin, a pacifier saves my ass once again. I find a lucky coin, a tree tells me the lottery numbers, I fill out the ticket, I win, but what? Another nightmare. First, a snake woman strangles me, then some dead grandmother injects me with some shit, and I drive away...

Chapter Three

I wake up in a cemetery, fighting a nightmare tree for the TV remote control that helps me return the dead mutants to their graves, collecting the lottery balls that are my ticket to the cemetery chapel. The slot machine does not pay out winnings, a phantom girl runs me over... with a train.

Chapter Four

I walk on tracks suspended somewhere high in a Gothic cathedral, descending the winding staircase of my life to sign a pact with the devil. I hate math, the wedding was a mistake, the bank robbery ruined my life, nightclubs ruined me, drugs almost killed me. I make girls dance as I please with my giant toy, and I throw rolls of toilet paper at a poopman made of drug shit. I crash a car while drunk, my wife is dead, am I alive? Redemption awaits, will I take advantage of it? The world's religions cause conflict? Why do we need national borders, artificial barriers, wars? We are one human race living on the same planet, let's live together in peace and enjoy life. I am becoming a woman. Nothing surprises me anymore.

Chapter Five

Hell, where the devil can't go, he sends a woman there. I fight demons, jump into a chasm, fall into a boat, and some monster rows to take me to purgatory. A phantom girl wakes me from this nightmare.

Chapter Six

I'm in purgatory, people's shadows dance, politicians start wars for business, Jesus is born in a stable, I don't watch lying television, it's better to lick a lollipop. Overcome evil with good. The rattle helps me calm the world and get through the tornado, only to appear in the circle of my own sins. The ghost girl wakes me up for the second time.

Chapter Seven

I'm in heaven. Earth is the hell of another planet. When we die, we live in eternal sleep, good or nightmare, depending on what we were like in life. I have to make the right choice. After death, we are immortal because we live in eternal sleep, from which no one can wake us. The end of Insomnia.

Chapter Eight

I watch the demons of my past. I already know how I want to live and dream!

Life is a game, play well!

We'll probably meet again... if the phantom girl wakes me up again.

 

Statistics: In 8 levels of the game you will encounter 89 different characters, and 27 weapons will allow you to annihilate 38 different enemy monsters.

4580200.name: Donor Zero
4580200.about_the_game:
Donor Zero

You are Frank Sheldon. Former warehouse grunt for a shadowy military outfit. Now you're running an illegal alien organ trade out of your basement in Dayton, Ohio. It's 1993. The invasion is real. So is rent.

Procure.

Pick up the wall phone and call your contacts. These are guys you know from the old days: drivers who cut corners, depot supervisors who look the other way. Buy intercepted alien crates. Some arrive intact. Some are missing half the body. All of them start rotting the moment they hit your freezer.

Extract.

This is the work. Put a specimen onto the table, pick your tools, and get your hands dirty. Trace incision paths with the scalpel. Pulse the laser cutter so you don't scorch the tissue. Use the scanner to find organs buried under layers of alien armor. Every body is a puzzle. Steady hands, full price. Sloppy cuts, damaged goods.

Sell.

Each evening, log into the black market terminal. Three factions are buying: a weapons contractor, a doomsday cult, and a pharma giant. They all want different parts, and they all pay different rates. The bigger the payout, the more attention you draw.

Survive.

You've got 30 days to hit $1.5 million and vanish. No UI meters telling you how hot things are. Instead, look out the basement window. Notice the car that wasn't there yesterday. The guy doing maintenance who showed up this morning. The black van with tinted windows. You learn to read the street, or you don't last long.

Can't pay rent? You're done. Heat too high? They kick in the door.

What's in the box:

  • Hands-on extraction mechanics. You're tracing cuts, managing heat, and scanning for hidden organs. Not clicking menus.

  • Different alien species, each with unique anatomy, layered body systems, and extraction order puzzles.

  • A black market economy that reacts to what you sell, who you sell it to, and how much you flood the market.

  • Systems built entirely on environmental storytelling. No bars, no numbers, no holding hands.

  • 1990s analog everything. CRT terminals, fax machines, fluorescent lighting, concrete walls.

  • Full gore toggle if that your thing.

4580360.name: Dreadfold
4580360.about_the_game:
One misplaced card can flip the whole match.


Dreadfold plays on a 3×3 grid. You have 5 cards in hand from a collection of 320, and you place them one at a time against a rival master. Adjacent cards compare values. Higher number captures the lower. Simple rules, deep consequences.

If you loved Triple Triad in Final Fantasy VIII, this is built on those same foundations. Just a full game instead of a minigame.

320 cards, all hand-painted


Every card was painted by hand. No AI filler, no asset store creatures. Each one has a name, a story in the compendium, and a reason to exist on your bench.

Ranks go from common to legendary across 4 rarities. 40 cards per faction, 8 factions, 320 total.

8 regions, 48 rival masters


Each region is ruled by one faction and defended by 6 masters. Five standard duels and a boss at the end. Beat them, take a card from their collection. Lose, and you give one up.

Regions unlock in a semi-linear path: Savage Lands first, then Withered Forest, then Warriors, and so on. All rematchable as many times as you want.

Deckbuilding without the randomness


Before each match you pick 5 cards from your whole collection. No RNG draws and no hidden hand. You bring the cards you want, your opponent does the same.

A bad match is a bad read, not bad luck. I made it this way on purpose and I know it's a choice some people won't like.

Dark fantasy all the way down


The soundtrack has two moods, exploration and combat, with a crossfade between them when a match starts. The UI is styled like a grimoire because the whole collection is built around reading creature lore as you unlock it.

What's in

  • 320 hand-painted creature cards
  • 8 factions: Warriors, Undead, Demons, Beasts, Nature, Arcane, Abyssal, Aquatic
  • 4 rarities with distinct frames
  • 48 rival masters across 8 regions
  • 3×3 grid battles, no RNG
  • Dynamic soundtrack (ambient + combat, crossfade)
  • 30 fully translated languages
  • Full controller support: Xbox, PlayStation, keyboard and mouse
  • No microtransactions, no loot boxes, no pay-to-win

See you on the board.

4580390.name: Fichitas
4580390.about_the_game:
The game is currently in development, so many things will likely change in the final version. Feedback is greatly appreciated! The best way to reach out is via Discord.

HOW TO PLAY

The game is turn-based. When you drag a token reduces your available actions. On the field, there are multiple tokens. Every token can have one of this five elements (NONE, FIRE, ELECTRICITY, WATER or PLANT), each represented by the icon in its center.

To keep the gameplay fresh and exciting, tokens also feature unique abilities shown in the background. Also there are passive abilities to upgrade your elements, making them longer, bigger, stronger... And for providing general buffs like reducing shop prices, granting extra turns, boosting specific stats...

THE ECONOMY

All the abilities can be obtained in the shop from the game. But you need something very important, coins. There are different ways to earn currency, but the most reliable is achieving goals: you gain 10 coins + 1 bonus coin for every extra action. Alternatively, you can use the electricity ability to generate orbs that produce coins.

UNLOCK POWER-UPS

There are specific conditions to unlock new abilities, and I’m not telling you how... (mostly because I haven't built the system to show it yet! :D)

  • 25 unique power-ups to discover.

  • 8 unlockables.

BUGS

If you spot anything weird, please report it on Discord so I can fix it as soon as possible. AND ABOVE ALL, let me know exactly how it happened.

SHORT STORY

Complete the goals and find the secrets to uncover the lore and the truth behind the MC.

GOOD LUCK WITH THE RNG GODDESS AND I HOPE YOU ENJOY!

4580690.name: Neo Capitalist - Stock Market Survival Simulator
4580690.about_the_game:
The Market Has a Pulse. Sometimes It Breathes. Sometimes It Chokes You.

Neo Capitalist is not just a stock market game where you try to make a profit; it’s a ruthless survival simulation that pushes your character’s limits. Pay your bills, maintain your mental health, and test your moral boundaries as you climb from the bottom to the top.

Start as a slave to the system, become the one who controls it.

Ruthless Survival Dynamics

There are not just green and red lines on the screen; your life is at the end of those lines. If you only focus on the charts and forget your character, the game won't forgive you:

  • Bankruptcy: If you can't pay your weekly taxes or bank loans, you lose everything. Game over.

  • Panic Attacks and Depression: When the markets crash, your stress skyrockets. If you can't manage your stress, you will suffer a Panic Attack. If your happiness hits rock bottom, Depression swallows you and the game ends.

  • Hunger and Passing Out: If your greed for profit makes you forget to eat or sleep, you will Pass Out at the terminal. You will wake up having lost valuable time (and potential money).

Two Different Realities: Choose Your Side

Choose which glasses you will wear to look at the market when starting the game. Both modes have the same deadly rules, but the atmosphere completely changes:

  • Stable Mode: The cold, uncompromising, and realistic financial world of today. A classic terminal interface, modern corporations, and a clean operating system experience.

  • Feel Mode (Cyber-Terminal): Find yourself in a neon-lit, dystopian cyber-punk universe. As your stress level increases, the interface in your optical implants begins to glitch before your eyes. The terminal lives in your brain.

From the Streets to Holding Summits

Start with low capital and do daily courier or part-time jobs to survive. But as you get richer, the game changes. Leave the daily jobs behind and transition to High-Level Jobs and Secret Projects that will provide you with insider trading info and passive bonuses.

Manipulate the System

If you are smart enough, you don't have to just go with the flow of the market.

Gain Reputation by completing dark tasks. When you reach enough power, perhaps you can manipulate the market.

Detailed Economic Loop

  • Fully Fledged Stock Market: Buy and sell in the spot market or take huge risks by opening long/short positions in futures trading.

  • Knowledge is Power: Subscribe to news agencies. Reading the market and catching investment tips is your greatest weapon.

  • Standard of Living: Move from a rock-bottom basement to luxury apartments. Protect your wealth by buying and selling cars and houses.

KNOWLEDGE IS POWER (AND EXPENSIVE)

The market is rigged, so you better rig it yourself. Purchase 4 different subscription levels to access deep market analytics, or risk everything by buying illegal insider trading tips. High risk brings high reward, but a single bad tip can wipe out your entire portfolio.

PERMADEATH

Failure is permanent in this brutal capitalist cycle. When you go bankrupt or your stats drop to zero, the game is over. You lose your portfolio, your house, and your pride. Learn from your fatal mistakes, adapt your strategy, and jump back into this ruthless roguelite loop.

Will you be able to survive?

4580960.name: Shearline
4580960.about_the_game:
Fractured time shapes the battlefield.

Shearline is a turn-based tactical RPG where the board itself decides who can move cleanly, who arrives compromised, and who controls the fight. Fast-time, slow-time, and unstable ground change movement, status, and combat advantage turn by turn.

  • Fight through combat, defense, and escape objectives on handcrafted tactical maps

  • Navigate temporal terrain that changes proficiency, movement, and route planning

  • Use character abilities to create openings, protect allies, and punish bad positioning

  • Turn hostile ground into an advantage and recover from bad crossings at the exact moment it matters

  • Shape a squad of 15 recruitable characters through handcrafted classes, promotions, bonds, and party-building choices

The board pushes back. Take control of it.

Fast-time, slow-time, and unstable ground do more than change the map's color. They change who is effective, how cleanly a squad can move, and how dangerous it is to cross the line at the wrong moment. Vel fighters thrive on haste shear. Other units may lose footing, waste movement, or cross into battle already compromised. Some fights are won by raw damage. Others are won by putting the right person on the right ground one turn earlier.

Shearline gives you tools to break an enemy terrain advantage, open a route, or recover from a bad crossing at the exact moment a battle starts going wrong. Zev's anchor is the clearest of those tools: it can stabilize a hostile patch of ground or clear Disorientation from an ally when you need their attacks to land.

The world runs on stolen years.

Workers go into the time mines for three calendar years and come out thirty years older. Frontier towns survive on leased drift stakes they do not control. The people who profit most from dangerous time also get the safest, most controlled version of it. Zev and her squad start by holding the line around Threshold and end up uncovering something much larger.

Build the squad each fight demands.

Recruit a distinct cast of 15 characters and shape them through handcrafted classes, promotions, bond actions, and party-building choices. Some units excel on specific terrain. Others bring control, support, mobility, or raw staying power. Repeated deployment deepens relationships and unlocks bond abilities that let the right pair cover each other, open routes together, or break a threatened line at the exact moment it matters most.

Meet your crew.

Zev is a Shear-Touched scout who carries Threshold's only portable field anchor and reads the line better than anyone in town. The tool is very much on loan.

Kir is a Vel striker who is at her best on haste shear. Her father survived a 10x time claim; she understands the toll of the haste.

Bryn is a Meridian medic from a family that profits from frontier supply contracts. He knows exactly how the mine economy works, and he came out here anyway.

They are the first three caught up in something much larger.

The Demo

The planned Steam Next Fest: October 2026 Edition demo is built around five handcrafted battles, party progression, exploration in Threshold, and a frontier mystery that opens into a larger conflict.

About the Developer

Shearline is a solo project by Hasteward.

Walk the Shearline. Master time before it turns on you. Wishlist on Steam.

4581130.name: Cat & Mouse Dungeon
4581130.about_the_game:
Cat & Mouse Dungeon is a dungeon-crawling card battler where exploration and deckbuilding are tightly connected. As you move deeper into the dungeon, you will discover enemies, traps, treasure chests, and crystal storage points, all while building the backpack that defines your next battle.

Your backpack is more than inventory. It determines your starting combat cards, which means every choice you make in the dungeon directly affects how the next fight begins. Battles are played around a shared draw pile used by everyone in the encounter, creating constant tension, sudden reversals, and explosive outcomes.

Attack cards pressure your target with extra turns. Reflect cards send danger back where it came from. Skip cards help you escape relentless pressure. Defuse cards are your only protection when bombs appear. Rare missile cards can force an enemy into immediate danger and completely change the flow of combat in a single move.

Every run is a balance between planning and survival. You can play carefully, protect your strongest utility cards, and build for consistency, or push for high-risk, high-reward plays that blow open the battle. With each chest, each trap, and each victory, your build evolves and your strategy changes.

Welcome to Lethal Ghosts, Investigator ...

Explore several unique, handcrafted maps, each filled with clues, environmental details, and hidden dangers.

As you progress, you’ll unlock new tools, new challenges, and eventually new threats.

Two rivals must prove their mastery of seduction - using you as their live subject.

Meet the Demon Girls

Rewrite the Rules

What happens when no one follows the rules?

Your choices decide how far the trial goes…
and who ends up in your arms.

What to Expect
