  • Dark demonic setting within the Velvet Labyrinth universe

Will You Choose… or Take Everything?

You were meant to be tested.

But the trial was never meant to be played your way.

*****

From the Black Codex of the Night Abbey, copied in a trembling hand and bound in cracked leather:

In the era that existed before the first sunrise, when time was not a river but a stagnant pool of obsidian ink, there was no light to guide the way. It was the age of the first God, a being composed not of mercy, but of a singular, terrifying radiance that sought to pacify the screaming echoes of non-existence. This creator did not work with love, but with the cold and unyielding might of a mason carving into the very bone of reality. To look upon the foundations of the world was to witness the grim architecture of a cage being built around the infinite.

This was a far and lonely beginning, a time long before the concept of lust had been carved into the hearts of mortals. In those days, there was no gold to hoard, no silver to covet; the only treasure was silence, and the only tales were the rhythmic vibrations of the void being unmade. It was a period of raw potential, existing before the sting of death was a certainty and long before the rise of any human empire. The universe was rich with a dark, heavy energy, a town of unborn stars scattered across a suffocating cloud of infinite, velvet dark.

But where there is structure, there is rebellion. From the shadows of the first light, the demons manifested - not as monsters, but as personified doubts. A theory was whispered among the first survivors of the celestial chess match between order and chaos: they whispered that hell was not a physical pit of fire, but a hole in the mind, a void where the undead dreams of a fake and hollow lord went to rot and fester. They spoke of a throne built upon the absence of truth, where a ruler who never was sat in judgment over things that never should have been.

Hearken now to the mournful call of the gorgon, whose hair of writhing vipers was not a curse, but a crown of living secrets. Her ancient quest for the lost grail of purity led her not to a throne of ivory, but to a gilded cage of her own making. In that prison, every monster is granted a mature and stellar view of the oasis they can never reach - a shimmering vision of a world where they might have been loved, kept just out of reach by the bars of their own nature.

Please, let it be recorded that every anomaly in the fabric of time - every ghost that haunts a hallway, every shadow that moves without a master - is but a desperate leap of faith taken by a fox in the hen-house of history. We are all scavengers in the ruins of the first creation, searching for an exit from a labyrinth that has no doors. The horror of the world is not the presence of evil, but the absence of a way out. We are trapped in a perpetual farming of souls, a cycle of harvest and replanting where the lucky are those who remain happy in their idle ignorance, never looking up to see the scythe descending through the stars.

The chronicles of the Night Abbey further record that the elf of the high frostwood, a being pale as a cloud and sharp as demon steel, did not seek the light of the heavens. Instead, he spent centuries trading his very essence with the boss of the shifting underworld, bartering for secrets that lay buried beneath a cloud of soot. Deep within a dungeon where the walls themselves seemed to breathe, he remained bound by a shadow that no paranormal rite could sever. This was a darkness not of the eyes, but of the soul, a weight that tethered his spirit to the cold stones of the earth.

High above the subterranean pits, the priestess of the grey order stood upon the jagged cliffs of the world’s end. Her mouth was a fountain of gilded lies, weaving a tapestry of false hope for the desperate. She spoke of a coming magic that would heal the sky, a marvel of light that would return the silver birds to their nests. Yet, in the quiet of the night, she whispered only of doom. Her passion was a cold, brittle thing, a memory of a paradise lost long before the fear of the long age had even a name. She knew that the world was but a ghost of two colliding realities, a fractured mirror reflecting the image of a dragon of vengeance.

This great beast rose from the black pits of the abyss, its scales etched with a supernatural code that governed every movement within the kingdom. It was a law written in fire and blood, dictating that all things must eventually return to the dark. As the last of the daylight died over the horizon, the pussy-willows by the river of eternity turned to ash, their soft silver down scattering like the sparks of a dying fire.

The monks record that in the third era of the great silence, the lamb was brought to the final altar under a suffocating and heavy rain. It was a sacrifice of innocence offered to a sky that no longer listened. A menace of ancient evil grew between the rivals of the high courts, fueled by a blood-oath and a perverted affection that no prayer or cure could soothe. They did not fight for glory, but for the right to rule over the ruins of a world that was already slipping into the void.

The scrolls tell of a place beyond the charted maps, where the ocean curdles into a thick, sentient rot. The female spirit who guarded the salt-shores of that lonely island was not a goddess, but a weaver of illusions, her skin translucent and her eyes the color of bruised violets. She stood upon the jagged rocks where the slime of the next world crawled like a living shroud, a substance that was neither liquid nor solid, but a pulsing essence of decay that sought to reclaim the land. Across multiple horizons, the sky bled a bruised yellow, reflecting the sickness of the tides.

It was to this forsaken shore that the paladins arrived, their banners high and their hearts heavy with a misplaced zeal. They were armored in the erotic vanity of their own perceived righteousness, their plate mail polished to a mirror sheen to reflect a light that no longer shone from the heavens. They climbed toward the jagged peak of the obsidian mountain that dominated the island’s heart, believing that their path was sanctified. Yet, as they marched, the earth began to stir with the restless dead. They were beset by zombies that wore the tattered faces of their own brothers, shambling horrors that dragged themselves from the mire with a relentless, mindless hunger.

The knights fought from the backs of horses made of pale, sickly fire - beasts that screamed as the salt-rot ate into their hooves. They called themselves heroes, shouting prayers to a sky that remained deaf, but the devil himself watched from the black surf, a silent observer of their slow dissolution. He knew that their time was a borrowed thread, a fraying cord that was about to snap under the weight of their own pride. Within the six circles of the mist that choked the mountain, a great tentacle of old history reached out to entangle them. It was the story of the Great crisis, the moment when the world’s spirit fractured and let the darkness in.

One by one, the hunters became the prey, trapped in a medieval carnage that was as brutal as it was senseless. In those final moments, the only intimacy a man could find was the cold, unyielding press of a blade against his throat; a final, terrible experience that stripped away the illusions of glory. It may have been a prayer that left their lips as they fell, or perhaps only a curse against the iron weight of fate that had led them to this shore. Every action they had taken, every march they had made, had been but a step toward this dirty end. The crushing burden of duty had not led them to salvation, but to a shallow grave in the salt-rot, where their names would be forgotten by the very world they sought to save.

Deep within the veins of the earth, far beneath the roots of the world, the ancient cult of the red moon gathered in the flickering shadow of a thousand dying candles. Their religion was not one of prayer, but of steel; they worshipped the tempered blade as the only true arbiter of fate. To them, the scream of metal upon metal was the only holy hymn. In the middle of their deepest ritual, there was a sudden, deafening bang that echoed through the subterranean chambers - not a sound of nature, but the metaphysical shock of a world’s heart breaking. This was an emotional eruption, a tectonic conquest of the spirit that signaled the beginning of the end.

High above, in the jagged cliffs that overlook the weeping vales, the harpy queen shrieked her victory to a blood-red sun. She had come to claim the last remaining princess of the line of Solis, a girl whose silver daggers were of royal make but felt like mere needles against the soaring malice of the sky. Standing at the girl's side was the broken knight, a man who had long ago traded his honor for survival, yet now found himself the sole guardian of the book of the heroine. This ancient volume held the names of those who had died so that the world might breathe for one more hour. Together, the warrior and the child stood before the open and terrifying prologue of the dark forest, a place where the trees were made of calcified grief and the ground drank the light.

This was no mere wood, but a battlefield of an older, aquatic war that had once raged for the soul of the wife of the dead being. This spectral woman, a queen of tides and salt, had once occupied a great house built for a king who had forgotten how to love. In the silent rush of the watchers - a thousand unseen eyes that glowed like embers in the brush - the princess felt the gaze of a skeletal cat that sat atop a pile of hollow skulls. The creature guarded a collection of tainted scrolls, ink-stained parchments that recorded every sin ever committed in the name of peace. These were the chronicles of those who had tried to outlast the beast of the abyss, only to find that the monster was not in the woods, but in the mirror.

As they ventured deeper, the knight felt the weight of the ages pressing down. Every branch that scraped his armor was a reminder of the failed heroine whose path they now trod. They were walking through the memories of a world that was already dead, a kingdom of shadows where the only law was the hunt. lo, the cult below and the harpies above were but two jaws of the same trap, closing slowly upon the last flickers of human hope.

As the knight and the princess crossed the threshold of the known, a faint, sickly blush began to color the sky - not the warmth of a rising sun, but the hue of an open wound. They had reached the edge of the beyond, where the laws of the world were stretched thin and frayed like rotting silk. Before them rose the Spire, a jagged, obsidian needle that seemed to pierce the very eye of heaven. It stood at the vanishing point of all paths, a monument to a civilization that had tried to build a ladder out of their own sins.

Guarding the rusted gates was an ogre - a massive, misshapen brute whose flesh was a patchwork of scars and whose eyes were clouded by an eternal cataract. He did not speak; he only breathed a heavy, rhythmic fog that smelled of wet earth and old iron. The ground beneath his feet was carpeted in the sweet seeds of a parasitic spirit, glowing with a pale, bioluminescent rot. These seeds were not meant for growth, but for consumption, seeking to take root in the warm blood of any living thing that dared pass.

The air here had turned into a lustful winter, a cold so intense that it felt like a physical craving, a hunger that gnawed at the bones. Under the perpetual sunset, where the sky was trapped in a state of dying gold, the iron wings of mechanical crows circled endlessly. They were chasing the ghost of a lizard constellation that had long since vanished from the firmament, following legends that had survived the death of the people who wrote them.

The knight felt the presence of the vampire lords who had once ruled this height, their thirst for life now replaced by a hollow nostalgia for the crowns they once wore. He heard the distant cry of a false dawn, a sound that signaled not hope, but the arrival of the nights that never end. Behind them, a party of desires followed - ghosts of the travelers' own wants and regrets, whispering of the things they had left behind.

This was the gathering of the legion, the uncounted masses who had fallen into the endless evolution of grief. The princess looked up at the horny-crested gargoyles that perched upon the Spire’s ribs, their stone faces twisted into a permanent leer. She felt the growing weight of her exile, a heavy mantle of chaos that threatened to smother her spirit. They were no longer walking toward a destination; they were descending into a simulation of fate where every step was a surrender.

The knight and the princess entered the hollowed heart of the Gothic structure, where the air hummed with the vibrating energy of a big and distant thunder. This was the interior of the Great Tower, a place where every ancient sin was amplified and echoed back as a physical weight. Here lay the fallen legends of a thousand ages, their stories etched into the soot-stained walls. The princess saw the spectral image of a pirate king who had sought to sail the stars, and the ghost of a dwarf lord who had dug too deep in a blind hunger for a myth that predated life itself. They had been the champions of a lost cause, their names now forgotten by the world they left behind.

They walked through a hall of bloodshed, where the rusted sword of an ancient king lay shattered on the floor. It was a place of the hunt, where the only things left were the broken loot of a thousand failed raids. In this beautiful and terrible vein of fantasy, there was no escape. They passed between towering pillars of salt, their surfaces glowing with a bright and unnatural devotion. This was the temple of the scarlet faith, a religion born of the darkest hours, where the girls of the order recited litanies of heat and sacrifice.

The knight looked away as they passed the neighbouring chambers, where the scent of jasmine and sulfur hung heavy. In the flickering light of a cursed flame, he saw the nudity of those who had traded their souls for a moment of love. It was a testament to a passion that had been fanned by the breath of diablo himself. A half-woman, a silent killer from the bathhouse of the damned, stood in the steam, upholding the dogma of the eternal grind. She was a servant of the corruption, a living tool for a demonologist who sat in a corner tracing the medusa-like curls of a map on an ancient atlas.

He was mining the other memories of the dead, seeking a path through the labyrinth of the soul. On a stone table sat a meager pie, the last meal of a condemned man, a small and domestic horror left behind in the grand ruin. The face of the world was changing here, shifting toward the endings found in the nest of the abyss. The path forward was intimiate, a walk through the wonders and romance of a dying age. They were no longer just travelers; they were the last witnesses to a tragedy that had been written before the stars were born.

At the very summit of the Spire, where the air thins until it tastes of copper and cold stars, the knight and the princess stepped into the Hall of Sovereigns. Here, arranged in a circle that mirrored the constellations of a forgotten sky, sat the nine thrones of the architects. They were carved from the bones of titans and draped in the tattered banners of kingdoms that had vanished before the first word of the Codex was written. Each seat was empty, save for the dust of the ages and the lingering scent of old power.

Waiting in the center was the resident guardian of the end - not a creature of flesh, but a shattered angel whose wings were made of rusted clockwork and weeping light. It did not strike them down; it merely looked up toward the boiling sky, where the last of the world's breath was escaping into the void. The angel spoke in a voice that sounded like grinding stones, telling them that the struggle was over, and that a fresh faith was being born - a belief not in salvation, but in the beauty of the inevitable end.

In the corner of the hall, huddled together in the shadows of the final throne, they found the two they had sought: the lost prince of the morning and the wretched goblin who had been his only companion in the dark. They were locked in a shared prison of the mind, a recursive dream where the world was still green and the sun still warm. They did not see the knight, nor did they hear the princess’s cry; they were content to live within the lie, for the truth was too heavy for any soul to bear.

The knight realized then that the Spire was not a ladder to heaven, but the axle upon which the wheel of suffering turned. He laid down his sword and looked at the princess, seeing in her eyes the reflection of a world that was finally, mercifully, going quiet. The Great Crisis had reached its conclusion, not with a roar, but with a sigh. The story of man was ending, and the story of the silence was beginning again.

Thus ends the edition of this scroll: heed the warnings, for in this realm pleasure and punish walk hand in hand, and every secret path leads, sooner or later, to the same dark gate.

Choose your anime girl character, leap across platforms, and collect Secret Boxes hidden throughout each course. Inside? Game-changing skills that can send your rivals flying, protect you from incoming attacks, or launch you across the map like a superhero.

4581600.name: import robots
4581600.about_the_game:
Every planet is full of resources. Your task is to collect them. Open the code editor, write a Python program, and send your robots out to gather what's on the map. Get everything, load the spaceship, and move on to the next planet.

Plan before you code

Every level is a small map — resources to collect, hazards to avoid, a spaceship to load. Plan your route before you code. Every map is a different problem.

Write real Python

A real code editor, built into the game. Syntax highlighting, autocomplete, error detection — powered by the same technology as VS Code. Your robots do exactly what you tell them. So does every bug.

Press run, watch it work

Hit run and every robot follows its own program. The goal is simple: collect everything and load the spaceship. When a robot falls in a hazard or misses a resource, you tweak the code and try again.

One concept at a time

Early levels are short — a few lines to make a robot move and pick something up. Write, run, fix, rewrite. A few levels in, you're using loops, conditionals, and functions. Later, you're coordinating multiple robots running in parallel.

Trapped inside a bizarre, ever-shifting world crafted by a jealous rival, you’ve been shrunk, stripped of certainty, and thrown into a realm where logic bends and illusions breathe. Every corner hides a puzzle, every object a secret, and every solution demands that you think like a magician… not a player.

A Puzzle Game Built on Illusion

This is not a world that follows rules.
It’s a world that pretends to.

  • Discover hidden objects concealed within negative space

Reality Manipulation
Interact with the environment in unexpected ways. Objects are not bound by their purpose.

Negative Space Puzzles

Escape the Magician’s Trap

Piece together the logic behind the illusions.

Think differently. Break the rules. Escape the illusion.

4581700.name: SCP: Dead Letter Protocol
4581700.about_the_game:
Your job isn't to win. It's to decide what you're willing to lose.

Beyond any government's reach, a secret organization contains the most dangerous supernatural threats on Earth. Things that could reshape reality, corrode sanity, or destroy entire nations if they breach containment. You just accepted a position you can't quit.

Choose your apocalypse. Every scenario pits you against a different existential threat. Investigate anomalies, contain creatures, and make morally questionable decisions as entropy tears your facility apart.

You Don't Know What You're Fighting

Every creature starts with it's details hidden behind ████. You don't know its name. You don't know what it does. You don't know how to hurt it. Your loadout locks before the fight begins. Match the creature's hidden vulnerabilities and your weapons tear through it. Choose wrong and your best gear does almost nothing.

Study a creature to reveal hidden traits. Talk to it through branching dialogue that can expose weaknesses or make things worse. Contain it, destroy it, or flee. Every path is viable. None of them are safe.

Creatures you contain are documented permanently. Every trait revealed. Every vulnerability exposed. The next time you face it, you'll be ready.

Four Phases. One Is Yours.

Reinforce the breach or pursue the objective. Recruit an ally or stockpile for what's coming. Spend the round investigating or pray that ignoring the anomaly doesn't cost you the mission.

Your Turn: Three actions. A dozen emergencies. Something is always getting worse while you deal with something else.

Encounters: End your turn in any location to face unique narrative encounters. Resources, allies, items, improved abilities. If you make the right decisions.

Anomalies: Every round, they count down. At zero, they become greater threats and start roaming the facility. Some hunt you down. Some damage the facility. They don't stop.

Entropy: Quiet at first. Until it isn't. Lockdowns seal off entire wings. Failures cascade from one system to the next. At 100%, the scenario's final threat arrives. It doesn't care how prepared you are.

Every decision costs something. Every round, the list of things you can't afford to lose gets shorter.

Between Runs

New operatives and scenarios unlock, expanding the encounters, creatures, and crises the facility can throw at you.

Key Features

- No jumpscares. No grinding. Just the mounting pressure of a facility falling apart faster than you can hold it together.

- 100+ classified creatures. Hidden traits. Branching dialogue. Multiple resolutions.

- Punishing combat built on information, not stats. Know the creature or lose to it.

- Hundreds of unique encounters, anomalies, creatures, NPCs, items, and crises. Every session assembles a different disaster.

- Every round has four phases. Only one belongs to you. The other three belong to the facility.

- Strategic horror built around the one-hour session. Short enough to play on a weeknight. Deep enough to think about the next day.

- Permanent creature database. Contain it once, know it forever.

4581720.name: Fighters Guild
4581720.about_the_game:
Completely free to play. No ads, no in-app purchases, no pay-to-win. Everything in the game is available from the start at no cost.

You are a retired mercenary. Once, you decided to start over and found your own Fighters Guild. The wars are behind you. But the lands around you are restless. Forests swarm with beasts, roads with bandits - and something far worse lurks in the dark. And someone is behind it all.

Tactical 1v1 Combat

Every fight is a duel. Attack, defend, and unleash your abilities. Enemies won't wait for you to make a mistake.

Build Your Guild

Develop your camp, upgrade buildings, and unlock new possibilities. The stronger your guild - the more dangerous the jobs you can take on.

Every Raid is Unique

Choose a location, pick a contract, hire a mercenary, and move out. Each raid is generated fresh - different routes, enemies, and rewards. Come back alive.

Build Your Character

Level up your mercenary, mix active and passive abilities. Every run is a chance to try something new.

Grow or Die

Levels, abilities, items, and artifacts. The deeper you go - the more every choice matters.
4581720.supported_languages: English, Russian, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Spain

4581840.name: Only Driving - Cozy Car Journey
4581840.about_the_game:
Only Driving is a idle car driving game that promises incremental increases. As your vehicle moves automatically, you’ll be able to collect coins along the way and increase your kilometers to get new cars and new upgrades. Every kilometer of this journey will enhance your vehicle and make you feel more at rest.

Features :

  • 10 Unlockable Cars

  • 10 Unlockable Engine Upgrades

  • 10 Unlockable Turbo Upgrades

  • 10 Unlockable Air Filter Upgrades

  • 10 Unlockable Coil Upgrades

  • 10 Unlockable Spark Plug Upgrades

  • 10 Unlockable Gearbox Upgrades

  • 10 Unlockable Exhaust Manifold Upgrades

  • 10 Unlockable Exhaust Upgrades

  • 10 Unlockable Radiator Upgrades

  • 10 Unlockable Suspension Upgrades

  • A nitro boost that increases your speed, coin collection rate, and the number of coins spawned.

  • Upgradable Coin Collect Circle

  • Upgradable Kilometer Counter

  • Upgradable Coin Spawn Rate

  • Upgradable Experience Earn Rate
4581840.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Turkish

4581850.name: LifeSimOS
4581850.about_the_game:
LifeSimOS is a story-rich coming-of-age experience set in 2004, where your world unfolds through a cluttered desktop filled with Messenger chats, IRC conversations, email, music, and late-night choices. Build friendships, navigate messy relationships, explore strange corners of the early internet, and shape your path through a branching story with multiple endings.

Build your online persona by choosing a handle, a real or made-up first name, and the pirate group you’ll run with on IRC. As the team’s encoder, you’re not just along for the ride, you’re the one helping package and push releases into the digital underground.

Every conversation gives you multiple ways to respond, whether positive, neutral, or negative, and each choice directly shapes how others see you.

Meet Hearty, your lovable desktop companion, here to answer questions and help guide you through the world of LifeSimOS.

Step into a cluttered 2004 desktop packed with Messenger chats, IRC, email, music, weird websites, and late-night choices.

The desktop is loaded with side content, surprises, and interactive apps that make the computer feel like a world of its own.

Get distracted by playable bonus apps and retro-inspired games woven right into the system.

Cards, side activities, and random digital distractions give the desktop that late-night, just-one-more-click feeling.

Discover songs and interact with music as part of the desktop experience, not just a background feature.

Dive into strange apps and story-driven distractions that capture the messy, weird energy of the early internet.

Features

  • Explore a fully interactive retro desktop inspired by the early 2000s

  • Shape a branching story through conversations, choices, and relationships

  • Reach multiple chapters and endings based on how you play

  • Chat through Messenger, IRC, and email while uncovering drama, secrets, and surprises

  • Browse weird websites, manage releases, and dig through interactive apps across a cluttered digital world

  • Play mini-games and side activities woven directly into the story

  • Unlock music and discover new songs through an in-game player tied to your friends and conversations

  • Immerse yourself in a nostalgic 2004 atmosphere filled with retro-inspired UI and online culture

LifeSimOS blends interactive fiction, retro internet nostalgia, and desktop roleplay into a deeply personal coming-of-age story where every message, every choice, and every click can shape your future.

Personalize Your Desktop

  • Personalize your desktop with custom content support built right in. Drop your own files into the included music, wallpaper, and profile_pictures folders, and they’ll show up in-game.

  • Load your own songs into the music player, set custom wallpapers for your desktop, and use your own profile pictures for logins and chat. It’s a simple way to make LifeSimOS feel even more like your own space.

4581890.name: Kayak with friends
4581890.about_the_game:
You and your friends, on kayaks! Master the art of kayaking and conquer fierce rivers with your friends (and against them). Explore the world’s most beautiful rivers and become the ultimate kayak champion in this frantic racing adventure.

 

CONTROLLER RECOMMENDED

KWF is fully playable with mouse and keyboard, but it was designed as a controller-based experience.  

 

COMPETITIVE KAYAK RACING FUN

You, your kayak, and some friends! Explore and conquer beautiful rivers of the world. Race your friends in a series of challenging rivers where you must learn and master the ways of the Kayak.

 

PARTY ROCKING

The river calls for respect and awe, but we’re here for the fun! Use rhythmic mechanics synchronized with the music and get an edge over the rest. Get points with your technique and skills, conquer the challenges and become the best kayaker.

 

GRAPHICS AND PHYSICS

Kayak your way through dangerous waters. The advanced dynamic water system simulates fluid mechanics that are very similar to the real thing. Use the water physics to your benefit!

 

MASTER THE CHALLENGE

Earn kayak points throughout the races and challenges. Upgrade your gear and look to become the ultimate kayak master.

 

MINIGAMES

Do you like land-based sports but can’t stand being away from your kayak? We neither. Play soccer, tag, and other minigames on water. Of course, with friends.

4581940.name: Yuntai
4581940.about_the_game:
Yuntai is a story-driven horror detective game set in a mysterious city steeped in Chinese folklore. After receiving a sudden invitation from a long-lost friend, Veris travels to Yuntai City for the Qiqiao Festival, but ends up becoming entangled in eerie supernatural events, bloody cases, and the secrets of a sinister cult.

The City, Yuntai (芸台)

A mysterious city where ancient belief systems are still quietly upheld. Among its most sacred traditions is the worship of Xi Mu (喜母), a clan goddess passed down from the age of tribal settlements. Although most modern residents have long forgotten her, some locals continue to uphold this faith through hidden rituals and regional celebrations, such as the Qiqiao Festival (乞巧大会), which symbolizes sacred craftsmanship and human connection.

In recent years, a sect known as the Troupe Elysium (极乐戏团) has grown increasingly active in Yuntai. They also worship Xi Mu, but interpret her divine will in a far more extreme and twisted way. No longer satisfied with simple devotion, they seek to turn divine power into something tangible and controllable through blood sacrifice. To achieve this, the Troupe offers living believers as ritual sacrifices, using parasitic transformation to remake them into grotesque and horrifying puppets.

Mechanics

Mechanic #1: Notebook
The mysterious notebook serves as the player’s main tool for recording clues, character information, and key event details. As the story progresses, it updates continuously, helping players organize evidence and piece together the truth behind each case.

Mechanic #2: Detective
Players investigate scenes, gather evidence, and connect characters, objects, and events like a real detective. Through careful observation and deduction, they gradually uncover the hidden secrets behind the supernatural cases.

Mechanic #3: Time Loop
At critical moments, players become trapped in a time loop and must relive certain events multiple times. Each loop reveals new clues or perspectives, allowing players to make different choices, change outcomes, and search for a way to break the cycle.
4581940.supported_languages:
English*, Italian*, Spanish - Spain*, Japanese*, Korean*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support

4582030.name: Coin$ Pusher Ltd
4582030.about_the_game:
Coin$ Pusher Ltd. is a game about pushing money into a hole as quickly as humanly possible. There is chill jazz, a handful of minigames, and a definitive ending.

This game is for YOU if you want to get deeply involved in pressing some shiny buttons, make lots of numbers go up, and play with a big magnet.

Game Length

It will take about 20-40 minutes to reach the ending, although my personal record is 11 minutes. See if you can beat that record!

Control Considerations

If you are using touchpad, it may be a struggle as this is quite the click-fest, but it is worth a try.

Coin$ Pusher Ltd. supports touchscreen and stylus pens, but is intended to be played with a mouse.
4582030.reviews:
“Very fun, very polished...”

“I got addicted real fast and felt relaxed and stressed at the same time.”
ZeanoBu

“This game was very fun! It a very simple and relaxing type of game. I love it!”
CheezeKneez!

4582040.name: FLOORS Together
4582040.about_the_game:
FLOORS Together is a cooperative horror experience for 1–4 players where you descend through mysterious, ever-changing floors in search of escape.

Each run challenges your team to explore dangerous environments, gather valuable loot, and make it back to the elevator. Descending isn’t free — the elevator requires enough value to operate, forcing players to take risks, explore deeper, and decide what’s worth carrying.

Core Gameplay:
  • Co-op Survival: Play with others and coordinate your actions to survive increasingly dangerous floors.
  • Loot & Progression: Collect items with value and weight to activate the elevator and descend.
  • Risk vs Reward: Go deeper for better loot, but face greater threats.
  • Safe Areas: Between floors, regroup and purchase tools to prepare for what’s next.

Entities & Threats:
  • Face a variety of entities with unique behaviors.
  • Some rely on sight, others on sound — learning their patterns is key.
  • Each encounter forces you to adapt and react differently.

Multiplayer Dynamics:
  • All players must reach the elevator to continue.
  • Work together to gather enough loot and survive.
  • Every run creates new unpredictable situations.

Descend, survive, and see how far you can go.

4582080.name: Goal Idle
4582080.about_the_game:
Tap the balls to shoot them toward the goal balls that score will earn you sweet cash. Use your earnings to unlock better balls and powerful upgrades. The more balls you have on the field, the more goals you can score! Invest in skills to boost your income and watch your balls fill the pitch while your wallet fills with gold.

Stop clicking and start reigning! Why do the heavy lifting yourself when your "Helpers" can dominate the field for you? Build your ultimate squad of automated strikers and watch your empire grow while you relax. These relentless goal machines don't need breaks or motivation; they are engineered for one thing only: maximizing your profit.

Master the Skill Tree and start fresh with power! Unlock game-changing abilities, choose your path, and reset your progress to become even stronger. Each restart grants you permanent bonuses that stack with every rebirth. Will you focus on speed, power, or automation? The choice is yours and every reset makes you unstoppable!


Unlock Auto-Shooters, your tireless mechanical teammates who score goals and rake in cash for you. Turn your run into a full-blown money-printing machine as your balance shoots through the roof while you sit back and watch the beautiful game unfold.

As you prosper, you'll unlock upgrades that twist the game in your favor:

• Boosted ball types – From rubber to classic to golden, each more valuable than the last

• Faster automation – Let your players do the work while you count the cash

• New skills and abilities – 14 unique upgrades that reshape your strategy

But power always comes with choices. Some skills offer steady income… others demand massive investment for explosive returns. Will you play it safe with rubber balls or gamble everything on golden glory?

When you're ready for even more madness, Prestige to reset your run, gather powerful bonuses, and spend them on permanent upgrades that reshape your strategy. Build your own football empire: Slow and steady, wildly explosive, or pure chaos.

Goal Idle is a dangerously satisfying progression game, where every goal is a little dopamine hit, every upgrade is a strategic choice, and every run is one lucky streak away from becoming a football legend!

4582100.name: CoGaWan
4582100.about_the_game:
CoGaWan is a retro puzzle game inspired by the DOS era, where you take control of a furry creature and your goal is to paint the world around you.

Collect colors from fountains, combine them, and think carefully about every move. Each step changes the game board, and one wrong decision can cost you the entire level.

The game is built on simple rules, but gradually challenges you with increasingly complex puzzles where you must mix colors (cyan, magenta, yellow) and use them strategically.

Key Features:

• Unique color-mixing mechanic (CMY system)

• Dozens of puzzle levels

• Level editor with random map generation

• Easy mode suitable for children – toggle painting on/off and focus only on the tiles that matter

• Retro visuals inspired by classic DOS games

• Low hardware requirements

• Perfect for both short sessions and longer play

Can you find the right path and paint the entire world?

Note: The game runs via an included DOSBox Staging emulator.

4582130.name: The Bone Crypt
4582130.about_the_game:
Welcome to Steam's first PvP Domino Deckbuilder! Tackle the roguelike solo campaign or crush your friends in the online arena.

Hey there! Welcome to The Bone Crypt.

If you love strategy, pixel art, and roguelike deck-builders, you’ve wandered into the right graveyard. I'm building this game to blend classic RPG combat with domino-style puzzle mechanics, making every single turn a fun, brain-teasing challenge. And now, the crypt is officially open to challengers—Online PvP is live!

Whether you are braving the solo campaign or battling friends online, you are trapped in a shifting tomb. Your only way out is to battle through 10 floors of skeletal sentries, abyssal brutes, and the dreaded Bone-Steward. Your weapons? A handful of dirty old bones.

A New Spin on Deck-Building Instead of drawing traditional hands, your "deck" is full of domino-style bone tiles. To defend yourself or strike enemies, you have to connect matching pips on the board.

  • Play it Smart: Match a double Sword for a critical hit that breaks enemy armor! Match a double Shield for a massive block!

  • Play it Desperate: Run out of valid moves? Your bones will glow red. You can force a piece onto the board with a "Desperation Play," but it’s going to cost you your own HP.

Go Head-to-Head in Online PvP Ready to test your builds against real players? Jump into the brand-new online matchmaking and prove you have the best tactical mind in the graveyard. Out-think, out-match, and out-play your opponents in the world's very first competitive domino deckbuilder.

Build Your Arsenal Gather gold to spend at the Marrow Merchant, rest at campfires to heal up (or sacrifice bones for permanent health boosts), and hunt down Elites to earn game-changing Artifacts. Whether you're stacking poison, relying on heavy shields, or setting enemies on fire, the build variety is entirely up to you.

Key Features

  • Online PvP & Solo Roguelike: Tackle the shifting tomb by yourself, or climb the ranks against real players online.

  • Domino-Style Combat: A bone-afide twist on tactical combat! Connect pips to chain attacks, blocks, and magical abilities.

  • Multiple Classes: Start as the Knight or unlock the Rogue, Alchemist, Wizard, Archer, and Necromancer. Each brings unique starting relics and a completely different playstyle.

  • Wildcards & Loot: Unearth special Obsidian, Gold, and Iron bones that act as wildcards to save you from a tight spot.

  • The Heist: Manage to defeat the boss in solo mode? Steal the Obsidian Key and make a mad dash for the Void Gate to win the run!

  • Weird & Wild Encounters: Meet a bizarre cast of tomb-dwellers. From rattling jesters to dumpster-diving ghouls, you'll have to make choices that can either reward you with treasure or leave you cursed.

Play the Demo! This demo gives you a great taste of the outer tombs and the new PvP multiplayer, but there's a lot more marrow to extract in the full release—including the endless Deep Dungeon for those who want to push their builds to the absolute limit.

Try out the demo, leave some feedback, and if the game tickles your funny bone, please consider giving it a Wishlist!
4582130.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese

4582160.name: Shane's Trains
4582160.about_the_game:
Build your railway empire.

Shane's Trains is a railway management simulation where you take control of a rail network and grow it into something great. Start with a handful of stations and a tight budget, and expand across the country - or build something entirely your own.            

Plan your network:

Connect real stations across the UK or place your own anywhere on the map. Lay track, design routes, and link communities together. The built-in map editor lets you create custom stations, draw new lines, and shape the network however you want.

Run the service:

Choose from 9 different train classes, each with distinct speed, capacity, and running costs. Create express and stopping services, set timetables, and assign drivers to keep everything on schedule.                                                                         

Manage the business:

Balance revenue against maintenance, fuel, and staff costs. Take out loans when cash is tight. Upgrade stations with extra platforms, retail units, and parking to boost passenger numbers and income.                                                               

React to events:

Weather disruptions, mechanical failures, demand surges, and tough decisions will test your management skills. Keep your reputation high and your passengers happy.

Two ways to play:

- Career Mode (WIP) - Progressive chapters with unique objectives and challenges, building from a small branch line to a major network.

- Sandbox Mode - Generous budget, everything unlocked. Build freely with no restrictions.

Features:

- Real UK station and route data with accurate geography 

- Built-in map editor - place custom stations and draw your own lines

- 9 train classes from suburban commuters to intercity HSTs

- Dynamic passenger demand and satisfaction

- Station upgrades, tech research, and driver management

- Weather, failures, and event systems

- Save and load with auto-save

- Actively expanding - new regions, train types, and features in development

4582230.name: アガルタ81番線！- City of angels
4582230.about_the_game:
"Agartha Platform 81! - City of Angels" is a roguelike TPS game where you journey through the underground city of Agartha, aiming for the ends of the world.

You will explore various worlds through a rail system called the Chikatetsu, from the underground city covered in iron and plants. Fight for the fate of this city and unravel the secrets hidden within Agartha.

Features

  • Unique Strategic System: The combat system, which emphasizes combos and strategy in a 3D space, delivers the joy of fighting alongside companion characters and a uniquely immersive gameplay experience.

  • Diverse Combos: By utilizing abilities that interact with environmental elements, players can challenge dungeons with diverse fighting styles.

  • Life with Characters: Various characters with different attributes inhabit the Chikatetsu, and you can deepen your relationships with them through communication, recruit them, and fight alongside them.

Visuals

  • Carefully crafted anime-style visuals enhance immersion in this world and create a satisfying gaming experience.
4582230.game_link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4582230/アガルタ81番線！- City of angels/

4582250.name: Socratic Smackdown
4582250.about_the_game:
Have you ever sat down and asked yourself, what if the great philosophers of old were actually animalized fighters throwing down with each other to figure out the next great idea? No? Huh… Well we did, and now we invite you to try your hand at the Socratic Smackdown!! 

  • Philosophical Plat-Fighting 

Socratic Smackdown is the next in the very long and established line of 2.5D platform fighters, this time taking you all across a long forgotten world. It may not be exactly what you learned in history class but you’ll be able to bring your clashes across 12 unique stages— Each tying into a unique character's lore and real world connection! 

  • Unique Characters 

Take control of one of three reimagined ancient philosophers, each with a new animal themed twist! Will you play as Sharkrates, the master of questioning, who is as strong as an incoming tidal wave? Maybe Pythongoras, the charming snake with a passion for all things math and a trick up his sleeve. Or if neither of those suit your fancy, there’s always Newtcolo, our favorite Italian newt, whose eye for power has isolated him from all others. Regardless of who you pick, there will always be new knowledge to learn with each of our legendary champions! 

  • Head-Banging Music 

If you're winning, you’ll know it! Thanks to a dynamic music system, your specific character’s theme song will play when you’re in the lead, letting the whole lobby know who’s beating them! Enjoy your music, because it might’ve just put a big target on your back!

4582260.name: Two Voices: A Journey Through the MET with Rin and Mio
4582260.about_the_game:
【About This Game】

"Sound and Color: A Journey Through the Museum Told in Two Different Languages."

Two Voices is a narrative casual puzzle game where you explore the masterpieces of one of the world's greatest art museums alongside Rin, a music-loving girl, and Mio, a passionate art geek.

Rin perceives the world through the sensory "language of music," while Mio deciphers it through the logical yet fiery "language of art." Through their conversations, static paintings begin to breathe with life, weaving a story that connects their two distinct hearts.

【Key Features】

  • Over 200 Public Domain Masterpieces Discover more than 200 world-renowned works from the Metropolitan Museum of Art (MET) open access collection. Solving puzzles arranged in chronological order allows you to naturally trace the grand timeline of human art history.

  • The Perfect Virtual Experience & Trip Preview Each piece is introduced through the charming banter between Rin and Mio. Whether you're preparing for a future trip to New York or simply want to stroll through the galleries from the comfort of home, this game offers an immersive, educational journey.

  • Soothing 1-Minute Puzzles Unveil masterpieces through intuitive, relaxing puzzles. With each stage taking about a minute, it’s the perfect way to infuse your busy day with a moment of quiet intelligence and artistic beauty.

  • Where Two Languages Become One The title Two Voices represents the journey of realizing that music and art—though different—ultimately express the same prayers and emotions. Immerse yourself in a poignant story of friendship deepening through the power of art.

【Recommended for:】

  • Fans of quiet museum atmospheres and emotional coming-of-age stories.

  • Travelers planning to visit the MET who want a fun way to preview the highlights.

  • Those interested in art history who prefer engaging dialogue over dry textbooks.

  • Players seeking a short, beautiful, and refreshing puzzle experience.

【System Requirements】

Designed as a 2D-focused experience, the game runs smoothly on laptops and portable gaming devices.

"A museum isn't just a place to look at art; it’s a place to share your thoughts with someone." After decoding 200 paintings with Rin and Mio, we hope the world looks a little wider the next time you step through the doors of a real museum.
4582260.game_link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4582260/Two Voices: A Journey Through the MET with Rin and Mio/

4582280.name: Kolchanovo: The Manor
4582280.about_the_game:
Kolchanovo: The Manor is a first-person psychological narrative experience set in a children’s sanatorium inside a former merchant house deep in the Russian woods. A journalist arrives to investigate the incident, as it was reported that the manor had been destroyed by fire. However, the building remains completely intact, and the surroundings feel strange and surreal. Nothing here seems to match reality. You decide to find out what is happening when you see a little girl appear in one of the windows. She may be the only one who can help you understand this place…

Game Features:

  • Immersive first-person walking simulator focused on deep narrative, exploration, and environmental storytelling.

  • Cinematic, film-like cutscenes that pull you deeper into the mystery.

  • A richly detailed, hyper-realistic setting inspired by a real Russian manor built in 1868. Over the decades it served as a merchant’s house, a military hospital, and a children’s sanatorium before tragically burning down in 2020.

  • Unique time-layer navigation: move between overlapping realities and eras within the same location.

  • Antagonists born from deep childhood fears, whispered scary stories from summer camps and sanatoriums, and ancient Slavic folklore.

  • A linear yet emotionally layered story about memory, loss, acceptance, and the possibility of rebirth.

4582300.name: The Heart Of Delly
4582300.about_the_game:
General Idea

A group of teenagers discovers that their parents died in an unknown way inside an abandoned factory. We control Laila, one of the teenagers who wants to escape the factory. She will be responsible for entering and destroying everything, but discovers that she won't be alone inside.

Mechanics

Laila faces several challenges inside the factory. She will use a tool called TookTool and cards scattered throughout the factory. Laila can also find documents, papers, and illustrations around the factory to discover more about its history.

Dangers

Laila will encounter frightening creatures that she doesn't believe are alive. These creatures observe Laila before attacking. She felt watched at every step in that place.

4582340.name: Candy Box U
4582340.about_the_game:
Enter the world of Candy Box U!

You find yourself in a small village, candy slowly filling your pockets. Eat them? Throw them away? or maybe, use them to buy yourself stronger gear?

There's people here that need your help, monsters to slay and candy to discover. Your thirst for candy cannot be sated, and you will stop at nothing to become the Candiest Person In The WORLD.

This is a remake of the classic idle game CandyBox 2  made entirely in the Unreal Engine!
Original game and code was done by aniwey, and permission was granted for me to make this project.

_________________________________________________________

The entire game is controlled using the mouse and keyboard.

==> Click on things with the MOUSE.

Most battles the player moves automatically,

==> In some areas you can use THE ARROW KEYS, [←] and [→] to move left and right,

==> As well as [↑] or [SPACE] to jump.

==> You can press the KEYBOARD keys or Click the corresponding button on screen to cast spells:

- [Q] Fireball

- [W] Teleport

- [E] Acid Rain

- [R] Erase Magic

- [A] Thorn Shield

- [S] Summon Demons

- [D] Obsidian Wall

- [F] Black Hole

- [T] Time Slow

- [G] Shrink

4582490.name: SudoCrawler : Sudoku + Roguelike
4582490.about_the_game:
Welcome to the endless abyss of numbers and strategy!

SudoCrawler is a game that combines Sudoku and Roguelite! If you are a lover of logic puzzles and are addicted to the "meat pigeon" fun of building genres and challenging the limits, hurry up and give it a try.

⚔️ Core gameplay: fill in the numbers and fight Here, Sudoku is not only a puzzle, but also your weapon. You need to keep climbing up in a "digital dungeon" full of variables. Every accurate logical deduction and every correct number entry will be transformed into a substantial blow to the enemy. Completing a row, a column or a nine-square grid can trigger powerful chain reactions and gorgeous skills. Plan your solution sequence and combo rhythm wisely, and kill powerful enemies to the ground before your health is exhausted!

🌟 Core Features

  • 🧠 Classic logic, new sense of fun retains the original Sudoku reasoning core. Whether you are a Sudoku novice or a hardcore player, you can find the perfect balance between "step-by-step deduction" and "sword and sword battle".

  • 🔥 Ever-changing genre construction (Build) During the process of climbing the tower, you will encounter random events, shops and treasure chests. Collect nearly a hundred kinds of relics and props with unique mechanisms! For example, "fill in the correct numbers continuously to get props", "automatically fill in the last remaining number in this palace" or "reveal key numbers at the beginning". Through clever combinations, create a unique genre and crush the boss with your IQ.

  • 🎲 Endless random challenges Every time you start again, it is a new journey. Procedurally generated map routes, completely random enemy combinations, and ever-changing Sudoku boards ensure that every adventure you take is full of unknowns and will never feel boring.

  • 📈 Advanced difficulty and growth system Accumulate resources through failures and victories, and unlock new character talents and initial abilities. As your strength increases, challenge higher advanced difficulties (similar to "advanced levels"), face more stringent mechanisms and more cunning enemies, and constantly break through your logical limits.

4582500.name: Withering State
4582500.about_the_game:
Withering State is a narrative-driven political RPG that follows Premier Alexander Sants as he ascends to lead the People's Republic of Sudlivia in a dangerous time. The Chairman is dead, the Party is more divided than ever, and the neighboring Eastern Bloc is crumbling under the weight of its own reforms. You must navigate a cutthroat Party apparatus, find your place within a shifting web of international alliances, and oversee a stagnant economic system on the verge of sliding into collapse. Your choices will not only chart the course for the five brotherly nations of Sudlivia, but could determine whether you end up as the Chairman of the state, or just another political prisoner...

Features

From his nationality to his role in the explosive Party Congress of 1966, determine how Alexander Sants rose to the highest levels of the Party and became prepared to lead Sudlivia in trying times.

  • Determine Alexander Sants' history, appearance, and political orientation in a detailed interactive prologue

  • Continue to shape your political identity through your choices in speeches, political programs, and allies

  • Build personal relationships with friends, allies, and even lovers, or go it alone by destroying them

Deploy state resources to implement economic programs, make deals with neighboring states, or launch military operations as you are tasked with untangling the crises that Sudlivia faces.

4582580.name: Melovar's Tale
4582580.about_the_game:
Forge Your Deck. Face the Darkness. Write Your Tale.

Melovar's Tale is a deeply strategic roguelike deckbuilder inspired by the greats of the genre such as StS. Set in the dark fantasy world of Eodolas, you'll build powerful decks, discover legendary relics, and carve your path through a world consumed by shadow and flame.

⚔️ 300+ Unique Cards

Every card features deliberate mechanical design. From setting up devastating strikes and elemental statuses to creating impenetrable barriers and defenses to survive each turn. Build synergies across attack, skill, and power archetypes. Cards can become greater and more powerful through various choices on your journey leading to interactions that can leave you triumphant or at death's door. 

💎 100+ Game-Changing Relics

Relics define your run. Each one bends the rules of the game. You will stack synergies, trigger chain reactions, and discover game breaking combos. From common trinkets to legendary boss drops across 5 rarity tiers, every relic reshapes your strategy, and sometimes come with a price.

🗺️ Branching Roguelike Maps

No two runs are ever the same. Navigate procedurally generated maps with branching paths, discover secret events, face escalating encounters, and make meaningful choices at every crossroad. Risk versus reward, every decision matters.

🛡️ Multiple Playable Heroes

Choose from 6 unique heroes, each with distinct decks and special abilities matching their style. Unlock new cards and synergies as you master each hero's playstyle. Cross-hero card synergies add even more depth to your builds.

👹 Epic Boss Encounters

Face the unique bosses of Eodolas' Lore with unique mechanics and multi phase battles. Some follow patterns you can learn to exploit. Others unleash chaotic movesets that demand adaptation. Every boss drops legendary relics that can transform your run.

📈 Deep Meta Progression

Your journey doesn't end with a single run. Earn XP across dual progression tracks. Universal and Hero Mastery, allowing you to unlock permanent upgrades, new cards, perk trees, and Ascension ranks that increase the challenge.

4582600.name: Adventure Springs Bakery
4582600.about_the_game:
Welcome to Adventure Springs Bakery!

Run your dream bakery, learn real economics, and have the most fun you've ever had with flour! Adventure Springs Bakery is a cozy, colorful bakery management game designed for kids, teens, and families (ages 4–18). Bake delicious treats, set prices, manage budgets, serve quirky customers, customize absolutely everything, and discover the joy of running your own business — with Daisey the cat keeping you company every step of the way!

📚 A Real Economics Curriculum — Disguised as a Game

Adventure Springs Bakery isn't just fun — it's a structured educational experience. The game features 36+ graded learning scenarios organized across 5 levels, teaching real economics and business concepts through hands-on play.

  • Apprentice Baker (8 scenarios): Goods & services, revenue & expenses, percentages in pricing, profit & loss, budget basics

  • Junior Baker (8 scenarios): Marketing, sales & promotions, R&D, supply & demand, wages & staff, profit margins

  • Senior Baker (8 scenarios): Scarcity & abundance, shortage & surplus, smart budgeting, revenue targets, business planning

  • Master Baker (8 scenarios): Debt & interest, pricing strategy, volume selling, innovation, financial management

  • Seasonal Specials (4 scenarios): Holiday economics with Christmas, Halloween, Easter, and Valentine's Day events

Every scenario includes:

  • Teaching popups with real-world case studies (e.g. how supermarkets use loss-leaders, why cinemas charge more for popcorn)

  • Key terms & definitions explained in kid-friendly language

  • Fun facts that connect economic ideas to the real world

  • End-of-scenario quizzes with multiple-choice questions and immediate feedback

  • Star ratings (3 stars per scenario, 108 total) based on real performance targets

Perfect for homeschooling, classroom enrichment, and family game nights. The curriculum covers concepts from primary/elementary economics and financial literacy standards, delivered through gameplay that kids and teens actually want to play.

🍪 Bake, Price, Sell, Grow

  • Set your own prices and watch how customers react — too high and they'll walk away, too low and you won't make profit!

  • Manage ingredients, stock your display cabinet, and figure out what sells best

  • Unlock rare recipes through Flavor Lab research — from Blueberry Pie to Steak & Cheese Pie

  • Track demand, revenue and profit with 30-day product graphs

  • Handle the rush with up to 3 employees who auto-restock your shelves

🏪 Build Your Dream Bakery

  • 20+ hairstyles from Mohawk to Ringlets to Afro

👥 Quirky Customers & Funny Friends

  • Customers walk to your counter, eat their purchases, and sit in your chairs

4582730.name: THE AEON FALL
4582730.about_the_game:
THE COST OF SURVIVAL: NOISE SYSTEM

Exploration, mining, construction, and combat—every action generates noise. This noise stimulates the infected, and as your base expands, the threat amplifies relentlessly. You must constantly balance the need for rapid growth against the necessity of safe survival

ACTUAL BATTLEFIELD PRESSURE FROM 100,000 ENTITIES

Beyond mere visual effects, we have implemented true battlefield pressure that reacts in real-time to your decisions. Powered by UE5, a massive AI swarm of up to 100,000 entities will test your defensive infrastructure to its absolute limits.

STRATEGY FORGED THROUGH REPEATED DEATH

4582760.name: What Remains
4582760.about_the_game:
What Remains is a first-person psychological horror experience set in a house that already knows you.

You don't remember the last four days. Something does.

─────────────────────────────────

What lies beneath memory — piece together what happened in the days you can't recall, through the evidence left behind by a version of yourself you don't recognize.

Something is listening — every sound you make is heard, remembered, and used. The house responds to you in ways that shouldn't be possible.

The silence is worse — atmospheric dread built entirely through sound, environment, and implication.

─────────────────────────────────

Explore a childhood home full of environmental storytelling.

Every sound you make is tracked — the entity responds to noise, displaces objects, and grows more active the louder you are.

Manage your composure through grounding actions to stay in control.

What you find in the house is only the beginning.

4582780.name: 掼蛋 Guandan
4582780.about_the_game:
Guandan has a broad influence in China, with over 100 million enthusiasts, and in recent years it has become even more widespread, often described as “a meal isn’t complete without a round of Guandan,” making it a popular form of entertainment in many business and social settings.

Guandan is an online multiplayer card game based on the classic Chinese partnership card game of the same name. Play with others in real time or challenge bots trained with reinforcement learning, and experience the teamwork, timing, strategy, and competitive depth that make Guandan stand out.

Often described as the “golf of card games,” Guandan offers both a relaxed pace and serious strategic depth. Whether you want to jump into a quick match to unwind or sharpen your skills through careful play and teamwork, there is a mode that fits the way you want to play.

Features

  • Authentic Guandan gameplay
    Play the full progression-based mode and enjoy the teamwork, pressure, control, and rank climbing that define the heart of Guandan.

  • Quick-play single-round mode
    In addition to full progression matches, the game also includes a faster single-round mode with Hearts 2 as the fixed trump, making it easy to jump in anytime.

  • Fully random card distribution
    Every match begins with a random deal, preserving the uncertainty, adaptation, and strategic variety that make traditional card games so compelling.

  • Bots trained on public-information play
    The in-game bots are trained with reinforcement learning and make decisions based only on public information, creating a play experience that feels fair, readable, and natural.

  • Online multiplayer and matchmaking
    Join online matches through matchmaking and compete with players of different styles whenever you want to play.

  • No entry cost for matches
    Matches do not require consumable entry resources or paid tokens to start. You can queue up and keep playing without being blocked by resource limits.

  • Play casually or improve seriously
    Whether you want to relax for a few rounds or work on card sense, teamwork, and decision-making, the game supports both casual fun and long-term improvement.

  • Multilingual support
    The interface supports multiple languages, making it easier for more players to enjoy Guandan.

4582850.name: DOO DOO VILLAGE
4582850.about_the_game:
Doo Doo Village is a fast-paced action RPG where survival, growth, and wealth are deeply connected. Each run strengthens your abilities, unlocking new magic and upgrades that push you further into the unknown.

But combat is only the beginning. Return to town to invest your earnings, manage resources, and engage in trading systems that turn hard-earned gold into lasting wealth. Every decision shapes your journey, balancing risk and reward as you build your own path to success.

With its satisfying gameplay loop of fighting, earning, and growing, Doo Doo Village offers a unique blend of dungeon action and economic progression. Will you remain a struggling adventurer, or rise as a legendary mage of fortune?

4582970.name: TWINSTAR 双星

Be cautious of the many traps scattered throughout the station. They may knock you back again and again, but don’t lose heart. Advanced tools hidden within the station will aid you on your journey.
With the help of unexpected allies, you will ultimately overcome the mastermind behind it all and uncover a long-buried secret.

Features

  • A unique fusion of sci-fi and fantasy in a space setting

  • Moderately challenging environmental puzzles

  • A variety of enemies roaming the space station

  • An original soundtrack that captures the mystery of space

4583080.name: Condition Unknown
4583080.about_the_game:
🧾 ABOUT THIS GAME

Condition Unknown is a text-based psychological horror game where you navigate a hospital that no longer behaves as it should.

You arrive with no clear understanding of what happened, only that something has gone wrong — and that you are now part of it.

As you explore, the environment reveals fragments of a larger truth. The deeper you go, the less reliable everything becomes.

Escape may be possible, but only if you understand the rules.

🎮 GAMEPLAY

  • Make decisions that influence progression and outcomes

  • Interact with characters whose behavior changes based on your responses

  • Your choices affect what you are able to learn — and what remains hidden

🧠 THEMES

  • Uncertainty and loss of control

  • Trust and deception

  • The unknown

🔁 REPLAYABILITY

Multiple endings are determined by your actions, discoveries, and survival. Different approaches lead to different outcomes.

4583150.name: Greda Inferno
4583150.about_the_game:
What's it about?

You are Nestor, a renowned potter who lives in the south of the world. One ordinary day, your life takes a brutal turn. You arrive in Hell under mysterious circumstances. You must survive at all costs, and along the way, familiarize yourself with your new town, trying to find a way out of the abyss.

How to progress?

4583160.name: Demonbyte 2
4583160.about_the_game:
Demonbyte 2 is the brutal, over-the-top sequel to the original Demonbyte, built from the ground up using everything learned from creating the first game. Running on an upgraded version of the same engine, this sequel pushes the chaos further than ever before faster, bloodier, and completely unhinged.

This time, it’s personal.

What starts as a revenge story quickly spirals into something far more twisted a path of destruction that uncovers truths even the Slayer of Worlds never saw coming.

🔥 MAXED-OUT BOOMER SHOOTER ACTION

Every system has been refined and cranked to the limit. Combat is faster, more responsive, and more tactical than before.

  • New sprinting system lets you move faster, reposition, and escape overwhelming fights

  • Fully projectile-based combat no more cheap hitscan deaths from across the map

  • Every shot fired is something you can see, dodge, and react to

This creates a more skill-based, chaotic battlefield where awareness and movement matter just as much as firepower.

🧨 INSANE WEAPONS & NEW MECHANICS

Wield a devastating arsenal including new additions like the Husky Puppy Rifle! A Flamethrower, alongside returning and reworked favorites.

  • Weapons now feature custom animations and alternate uses

  • Aim down sights (ADS) with certain weapons like the shotgun for tighter control

  • Set enemies ablaze with the flamethrower and trigger unique death animations

Express yourself mid-combat yes, even flipping off what’s left of your enemies

Weapons now matter. There is no “one weapon wins all” strategy:

  • Snipers dominate long-range, high-damage precision, but slow reloads leave you exposed

  • Dual Uzis shred groups of enemies, but struggle against certain targets like demon eggs

Some weapons can accidentally make fights worse if used carelessly

Each weapon has strengths, weaknesses, and specific use cases forcing you to adapt constantly.

All weapons now use a unified arm system, replacing the varied hand styles from the original game for a more cohesive feel.

💀 BRUTAL GORE & DARK HUMOR

Enemies don’t just die they explode into gibs, blood, and chaos depending on how you take them down.

The world leans heavily into parody and absurdity, featuring exaggerated, over-the-top scenarios and environmental storytelling. Some levels include stylized, adult-themed artwork and enemies that reflect the game’s dark, chaotic tone all of which can be destroyed in spectacular fashion.

🎲 TRUE RNG GAMEPLAY

No two playthroughs are ever the same.

Weapon spawns are randomized, meaning:

  • One run might hand you grenades or a pulse laser launcher right away

  • Another might leave you surviving with uzis or shotguns

This system ensures constant unpredictability and replayability from the very first level.

🗺️ BIGGER, NON-LINEAR MAPS

Levels are now 2x to 3x larger than those in Demonbyte, with a major shift away from linear design.

  • Multiple paths and approaches to objectives

  • Hidden routes and layered level design

  • Greater freedom in how you engage with combat and exploration

🔑 SECRETS THAT MATTER

Secrets have been completely reworked.

Discovering hidden areas can reward you with exclusive weapons that cannot be found through RNG drops. These powerful tools are balanced through limited or randomized ammo drops making every discovery feel impactful.

⚠️ CONTENT WARNING

Demonbyte 2 contains:

  • Intense violence and graphic gore

  • Stylized nudity in environmental art and enemy design

  • Dark humor and parody themes

If you liked the original, this is everything turned up to eleven a faster, meaner, and more unpredictable descent into chaos.

4583180.name: Sunderknight
4583180.about_the_game:
Locate and descend into the pit and tear through endless waves of demons with three weapons at once! Rip open card packs, stack powerful items, and build overpowered loadouts as you fight deeper into the horde! Something ancient waits at the bottom...

Sunderknight is a 3D action roguelite where every run ends in death, and every death makes you stronger. Ive somehow managed to develop this game over the course of a few months being a solo first time developer. I had a ton of fun making this game. I hope you enjoy :)

The demon-tide flows

Descend into demon-infested terrain as hordes pour from the depths. Equip up to three weapons that fire simultaneously, level up to upgrade them with powerful cards, and hunt down hidden merchants for stat boosts. When the timer hits zero, death comes.

Some Lore

The Rapture took the worthy. Humanity tried to cheat what came next, and doomed the world instead. Now demons pour endlessly from a pit that shouldn't exist, and creation itself is stuck waiting. The Lord sends his knights to descend that pit, fight through the hordes, and set things right.

Build Your Arsenal

Every level-up, crack open a card pack and choose from three weapon upgrade cards. Drag your pick onto any weapon to power it up. Cards range from Common to Legendary, and your Luck stat shifts the odds in your favor. Mix universal upgrades that work on anything with weapon-specific cards that push your build to its limits.
Thousands of possible builds with 9 weapons across 3 slots, 50+ upgrade cards, and pre-run prayers mean no two runs play the same.

Move Fast or Die

Slide across the battlefield, charge jump off ledges, and grapple between floating points to stay ahead of the horde. Use every tool you have to keep moving.



  • 9 weapons, three slots - Mix and match any weapons for thousands of combinations! Each weapon targets independently with light and heavy attacks.

4583350.name: All Hallows
4583350.about_the_game:
[ !!! ] OPERATIONAL NOTICE: TECHNICAL DEMO IN PROGRESS All Hallows is currently in active development. The version available for Next Fest is a Technical Manifestation (Alpha) designed to stress-test the "Echo" Protocol and core environmental systems. Content is a work-in-progress and does not represent the final March 2027 release.

The Party is Over. The Harvest Has Begun.

All Hallows is a high-fidelity psychological horror experience set within the decaying concrete remains of a brutalist squat party. What began as an underground rave has warped into a lethal manifestation of urban folklore. The exits are gone, the "Echo" has taken hold, and the music is the only thing keeping you alive—for now.

Key Features:

  • The Echo Protocol: Forget static difficulty. All Hallows utilizes a dynamic "Value Through Decay" system where your environment and resources degrade in real-time. Every light source, every ritual rite, and every second of silence has a shelf-life. You aren’t just surviving; you are managing a failing economy of existence.

  • Vector-Driven Paranoia: This is horror that listens. Our proprietary "Fear Profile" logic monitors your navigation and reaction times. The entity doesn’t just chase; it learns. If you look away, the brutalist geometry reconciles. If you panic, the "Echo" manifests closer.

  • Masterclass Spatial Audio: True horror is felt. Built with professional-grade MetaSounds and directional mastery, the soundscape is weaponized. From distant bass-drops in the "All Hallows" palette to the wet breath of a manifestation behind you, your ears are your primary navigation tool. If you hear it breathing, the zero-trust link has already been severed.

  • Brutalist "Military-Grade" Visuals: Pushing Unreal Engine 5.7.4 to its limit. Lumen-driven darkness and Nanite-saturated decay turn a claustrophobic squat into a photorealistic hellscape. No "sugarcoating," no compromises—just pure, high-fidelity dread.

  • Unforgiving Stealth & Evasion: You have no heavy artillery. Your only weapons are your wits, the shadows, and your ability to outmanoeuvre a manifestation that treats you as its only remaining currency.

Will you survive until sunrise, or will you be consumed by the decay?

4583390.name: Gridlock
4583390.about_the_game:

HOW IT WORKS

- Drag and drop block shapes onto the 9×9 grid

- Fill a complete row, column, or 3×3 square to clear it

- Build combos by clearing lines on consecutive placements

- Game ends when no pieces can fit — you're gridlocked!

DAILY CHALLENGE

Every day, all players receive the same sequence of pieces. You get one shot — plan carefully, compete on the global leaderboard, and see how you stack up.

FREE PLAY

Practice anytime with random pieces. Beat your personal best and sharpen your strategy for the daily challenge. Watch an ad to get a second chance with new pieces!

FEATURES

- Daily puzzle with shared global leaderboard

- Free play mode with local high score tracking

- 3 ways to clear: rows, columns, and 3×3 squares

- Google Play Games achievements and leaderboard

- Clean, minimal design with satisfying clear animations

- Haptic feedback and sound effects

4583440.name: Terrastone
4583440.about_the_game:
The seasons have stopped. To survive, humanity relies on a mysterious power known as Terra Stone. But every great power comes with a price.

After awakening to a mysterious power, you are forced to leave your village and begin the life of a wanderer. Hunt monsters, collect powerful loot, challenge stronger enemies, and uncover the truth behind Terra Stone and the world itself.

Features

  • Fast-Paced Progression and Endless Hunting
