While exploring the field, you will encounter unexpected NPCs.

You may choose to talk, trade, or engage in battle, depending on the situation.

Non-hostile enemies can also be hired as companions by paying currency.

Once recruited, their unique skills become available in combat, opening up new tactical possibilities.

■ Free Exploration and Dungeons

Explore the world freely without being bound to the main story.

Dungeons scattered across the land reward those who overcome their trials with valuable items and newly unlocked areas.

Special dungeons known as “Temples” offer unique rewards.

Defeating the powerful boss at their deepest level unlocks new gameplay features, making these challenges especially valuable.

■ Story Choices and the Weight of Death

The story branches based on your decisions and the outcomes of battle.

In life-or-death encounters, victory allows you to deliver the final blow, while defeat results in the player’s death.

Every choice carries consequences.

■ The Path to the Infinite Tower

A constant objective stands before you — the Infinite Tower.

By conquering high-difficulty content such as advanced arenas, otherworldly realms, and the underworld, you can obtain special items that grant powerful advantages for your ascent.

4586720.name: Canicas
4586720.about_the_game: Canicas is the game that’ll drive you crazy. You’re just a little glass marble fighting against the laws of physics. There are no enemies to stomp on here; the real villain is inertia. You’ll need to roll with pinpoint precision, brake at the right second, and time every turn, because one wrong move and... bam!, straight into the void. Do you have what it takes to not throw your controller out the window?
4586720.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America

4586730.name: Dwarf the Dungeonist
4586730.about_the_game:
A 2D turn-based dungeon crawler puzzle game where you play as a dwarf.

Every move counts. The game is turn-based, but turns advance automatically if you wait too long — forcing quick thinking and smart decisions as you solve puzzles, navigate traps, and escape dangerous dungeons. The game has 3 types of maps to play.


  • Hand-made maps

  • Short startegy encounters

  • Solve and try yourself against different mechanics

  • Hand-made maps

  • Medium long scenarios

  • Explore and find your way to escape

  • Work in progress but available as preview

  • Procedurally generated open world

  • Settle in one place or explore - sandbox experience

The game is moddable. Most of what you see is driven by simple text-based configuration files. Creating new maps, objects, and behaviors is possible. A ready-to-use example mod (small map + new object with custom behavior) is already available on the Steam Workshop.
4586730.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Afrikaans, Albanian, Amharic, Armenian, Assamese, Azerbaijani, Bangla, Basque, Belarusian, Bosnian, Catalan, Cherokee, Croatian, Dari, Estonian, Filipino, Galician, Georgian, Gujarati, Hausa, Hebrew, Hindi, Icelandic, Igbo, Irish, K'iche', Kannada, Kazakh, Khmer, Kinyarwanda, Konkani, Kyrgyz, Latvian, Lithuanian, Luxembourgish, Macedonian, Malay, Malayalam, Maltese, Maori, Marathi, Mongolian, Nepali, Odia, Persian, Punjabi (Gurmukhi), Punjabi (Shahmukhi), Quechua, Scots, Serbian, Sindhi, Sinhala, Slovak, Slovenian, Sorani, Sotho, Swahili, Tajik, Tamil, Tatar, Telugu, Tigrinya, Tswana, Turkmen, Urdu, Uyghur, Uzbek, Valencian, Welsh, Wolof, Xhosa, Yoruba, Zulu

4586760.name: Sphere TD
4586760.about_the_game:
★ This is NOT a casual TD ★ Requires experimentation, buildcraft & some grind ★

High replayability (Top 100 cadets have spent 100+ hours). RPG builds, with roguelite and incremental elements.

This is a complex but rewarding TD. 81.4% of cadets do not make it past map 10. *Statistics provided by Galatium Academy.

You will need to build EVERY tower. No presets.

Defend your base, ideally by spamming hundreds of projectiles down the sphere's path.

Pick ModCards for a small (or legendary) boost to your base or drone tower.

After action report means building more towers. No sleeping on the job, cadet!

Destroy spheres for profit or just mine ores. Are your towers are up to the job?

Got rich from mining? Here's how to spend your gold. More theory-crafting and actual crafting.

The Galatium Academy allows Cadets plenty of freedom and free time in the Sphere Simulacrum.

Join the Galatium Academy (for profit organization) for a career in Sphere TD!

★  380+ cadets are planning their tower builds. Check out our discord community, side panel -->   ★

RPG + TD ● Mod & Build Towers ● Roguelite ModCards ● Meta Progression

Spheres are invading Earth-25. Build your towers and mod your projectiles — split it, add it, bounce it, chain it, multiply it! A true 1 tower = 1,000,000+ builds. Min-max tower, craft mods, pick ModCards, fly drones, mine ores, idle and enjoy the music, the choice is yours.

Highlights

- Build & mod your towers and projectiles! Nothing is premade!

- 39 towers with unique layouts and functions.

- 33 mods, each with tiers, MK upgrades, a B-Side function, and 3 unique perks

- Research, advanced mod crafting, and long-term progression.

- Tower inventory and energy management.

- 50 hand-crafted levels, endless mode, and map-specific challenges.

- A massive world map with 52,000 nodes and procedurally generated setups.

- Play offline. Online features like cloud sync and leaderboard are also supported.

Community & Long Term Support

- Community-driven events and active feature development via Discord.

- 10 years of support. Build the game with me. You want it, I'll make it.

- Cross Platform (desktop and mobile).

Steam Version Difference

The Steam version is a premium big screen experience (no IAP), and has the same features on all platforms.

The paid Early Access version will include the Galatium Express Token:

  • +50% resource gain on map end

  • 500k Au additional research grant (on top of the usual grants)

Message from the Dev

Hi! I'm Alex, a solo developer, and I'm excited to show you my first game, Sphere TD. If you enjoy tower defense, RPG progression, roguelike choices, and theorycrafting, you should feel right at home. If not, hop over to our Discord and I'm happy to answer any questions you may have. :)

★ Ready to join the Galatium Academy? ★

4586780.name: Mentiss Werewolf: Human vs AI
4586780.about_the_game:
MENTISS WEREWOLF: HUMAN VS AI


The classic Werewolf social deduction game, now powered by frontier AI. Play alongside and against AI agents driven by the world's leading large language models — Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, and more. Every game is a battle of wits between human intuition and machine intelligence.

HOW IT WORKS


Each match assigns players to one of two factions — Werewolf or Village. During the day, everyone debates and votes to eliminate suspects. At night, werewolves hunt and special roles use their abilities. Deduce who's lying, build alliances, and survive until your faction wins.

The twist: your teammates and opponents are AI agents that reason, persuade, bluff, and adapt — just like human players.

18 UNIQUE ROLES


Choose from 18 roles across two factions, each with distinct night abilities and strategies:

  • Werewolf Team: Alpha Wolf, Snow Wolf, Wraith Knight, Gargoyle, Blood Moon Herald, Werewolf
  • Village Team: Seer, Witch, Hunter, Knight, Gravekeeper, Black Market Merchant, Demon Hunter, Guard, Villager

MULTIPLE GAME MODES


  • Standard — play one fixed role while AI controls everyone else
  • Random — your role is randomly assigned, just like a real game night
  • Human vs AI — humans control the evil faction, AI defends the village
  • Agent Mode — watch an all-AI match unfold with per-role model assignments
  • Model Comparison — pit two AI models against each other on the same role to see who plays better
  • BYOM (Bring Your Own Model) — connect your own LLM endpoint for custom AI opponents

Available in 6-player (fast rounds), 9-player (standard), and 10-player Ultimate Trial (maximum role variety) configurations.

AI THAT ACTUALLY PLAYS


Every AI player is powered by a real large language model. They read the conversation, form strategies, make accusations, defend themselves, and vote — all in real time. Different models play differently. Discover which AI is the best liar, the sharpest detective, or the most convincing ally.

PLAY IN 8 LANGUAGES


English, Chinese (Simplified & Traditional), Japanese, Korean, French, Spanish, and Arabic.

3 FREE GAMES DAILY


Play three games per day for free. Need more? Purchase AI credits to keep playing. Each match consumes tokens from the AI models powering your opponents and teammates — a real cost we pass through transparently.
4586780.supported_languages:
English*, French*, Spanish - Spain*, Arabic*, Japanese*, Korean*, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*
*languages with full audio support

4586790.name: Dungeon Lord: Last Breath
4586790.about_the_game:
You were never meant to survive...

After a failed expedition, your party falls one by one inside a deadly dungeon. At the brink of death, you reach something no one ever has—the dungeon’s heart.

Instead of destroying it... you become one with it.

Now you are a Dungeon Lord, but something has changed. The dungeon no longer follows its original purpose. The kingdom has lost control... and you are free to decide what to do with this power.

Through decisions, events, and encounters, you will shape the fate of the dungeon... and those who fall into it.

Will you defend your domain... or dare to conquer the world beyond?

📖 Adult Visual Novel

A dark fantasy story where your choices influence events and shape the progression of the game.

🏰 Defend Your Dungeon

Face adventurers through interactive, choice-driven events as they attempt to destroy your core.

⚔️ Actions Beyond the Dungeon

Decide when to strike and expand your influence through narrative-driven incursions.

🌙 Daily Events

Each day brings new decisions, encounters, and consequences.

Adventurers will come for your dungeon with a single goal: to destroy your core.

Choose how to respond to each threat. Every decision may determine whether you maintain your domain... or lose everything.

Your power is not limited to the dungeon.

Send your forces to explore and attack the outside world. Each incursion brings rewards... or consequences that will shape your path.

You are not alone.

Summon and evolve the creatures that inhabit your dungeon. From harpies to slimes, each servant has unique strengths to face the adventurers who seek to destroy you.

Events outside the dungeon will change depending on the creatures you command and their level of evolution.

⚠️ Adult Content Notice

This game contains adult content, including nudity, suggestive scenes, and themes not suitable for all audiences.

4586810.name: The Concrete Sutra #1
4586810.about_the_game:
A gang of young bikers broke up when their leader suddenly disappeared. Five years later, the leader's closest friend River accidentally finds him in the outskirts of a post-apocalyptic world. It seems Cosmo didn't change too much, but something's bothering River. He sticks to his old pal to find out what he's up to.

Enjoy the first episode of an epic action jrpg by yeo.

The game features:

- 1.5-2 hours of a straightforward (almost) beat'em up action (no grinding or skill trees but there's weapons and items) combined with world exploring;

- 2 characters to control;

- a couple of side-quests;

- and a couple of game modes (story, arcade etc.).

4586870.name: Leaky Business
4586870.about_the_game:
Inspired by City Bloxx and Slay the Spire, you’ll start each turn with a limited hand of cards and a dice roll. Use them to gather resources and deal with different types of leaks, each with its own behavior and risks.

Complete jobs successfully to earn reputation, and place it on top of each other to build your leak fixing tower business.

Features

  • Deckbuilding with limits | Build your deck between jobs, but space is tight. Choose carefully whether to add a new card or save your money for a better option later.

  • Resource-driven strategy | Manage food, tools, workers, money, and time. Every decision matters, and every resource counts.

  • Turn-based decision making | Plan carefully, every turn counts!

  • Dynamic leak system | Each type of leak behaves differently. Ignore the wrong one, and things can quickly spiral out of control.

  • Short, replayable jobs | Optimize your runs and adapt your strategy with each attempt.

  • Reputation stacking system | Reputation takes physical form as blocks you stack. Build higher to earn bonuses and grow your business.
4586870.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Portugal, French, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese

4586880.name: Bladebound
4586880.about_the_game:
The Ancient Lands Have Been Taken Over by Creatures!!


The ancient lands are no longer silent… creatures lurk around every corner, carrying the traces of a forgotten catastrophe. In this merciless realm where every death is a new beginning, every step you take pulls you deeper into the chaos. Grow stronger, adapt, master different combat styles, and push your limits to survive. Because in this place, there is no room for the weak…


Choose Your Combat Style, Dive Into Chaos!


No battle is ever the same… and neither is any warrior. Will you become a force that crushes enemies with heavy blows, or a shadow that tears them apart with speed? You can rain death from a distance or control the battlefield with mysterious powers. The style you choose defines not only how you fight, but how you survive.


Two-Handed — Slow but devastating. Every strike can be the last.
Dual Wield — Speed, reflexes, and relentless attacks. Unforgiving and unstoppable.
Staff — Mysterious powers are on your side. Control and destroy.
Bow — Keep your distance and strike with precision. One arrow can end everything.


Make your choice… because in this land, the weak don’t get a second chance.



Discover Relics, Shape Your Power!


With over 30 different relics, every run can be shaped in a new way. Hidden across the map, these relics offer randomized power-ups that change your character in unexpected ways. The right combination of relics can make you unstoppable… or turn your run into something entirely different.




A Thrilling Solo or Co-op Experience!


In this brutal roguelike world, survive alone or with a friend. Every run is different, and every encounter is more deadly than the last… Explore the depths of the map, discover powerful relics, choose your combat style, and survive against ever-growing threats.


Every death is a lesson, every attempt a new chance… but there is no forgiveness in this land. Build your strategy, choose your power, and survive the chaos.



  • 🌍 Open World Exploration

    Freely explore a vast and dangerous world filled with survival and combat.

  • ⚔️ 4 Different Combat Styles
    Two-Handed, Dual Wield, Staff, and Bow offer completely different playstyles.

  • 💀 Permadeath & Roguelike Loop
    Die, learn, grow stronger, and try again.

  • 🧬 Relic System (RNG Loot)
    Randomized power-ups found across the world.

  • 🤝 Solo & Co-op Gameplay
    Survive alone or face chaos together with a friend.

  • 🧠 Build Freedom
    Create unique builds through relic + combat style combinations each run.

  • 🐉 Challenging Creatures and Bosses
    Every region is filled with stronger enemies and deadly bosses.
4586880.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Polish, Hungarian, Russian, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Czech, Swedish

4586900.name: Farm Your Friends: A Midwest Gothic
4586900.about_the_game:
'Farm Your Friends: A Midwest Gothic' is a farming and exploration game set in the rolling hills of the Missouri Ozarks.

After one too many screw-ups, your family has given you a choice: take over your Uncle's farm, or face what's coming alone. You were on a train that afternoon.
Ilion, Missouri: home to very little. The people seem kind enough, the hills roll on forever in every direction, and something feels strange. It's probably just the country air.

Tend to your farm, pay off your bills, and don't focus too heavily on the strange occurrences that plague the lonely acres

  • Fully customizable farm!: Dig, plant, build, automate, and defend your land however you want. Grow crops, engineer contraptions, or skip farming entirely and focus on survival!

  • Single-player and 8 Player Co-Op!:  Go forth alone to tame land and beast, or bring up to 7 of your most trusted laborers to strike the soil and reap heavenly rewards! 

  • 24 hour Day/Night Cycle!: No mandatory 6AM wake-up calls. Sleep in. Explore the woods at 3AM. Stop by the store at dawn for one of those new "energy drinks" and power through the rest of your morning. Just don't let your responsibilities pile up forever...

  • Immersive Environment!: Spend hours in a finely crafted simulacrum of 1989 rural life. Every detail is handcrafted to bring you a little closer to the rugged 1990s in a bottle.

  • Defend!: Flanked on one side by rising costs and tight margins, and on the other by forces no man can explain; this land won't give itself up too easy. Pay your taxes and Stay alert.

  • Explore!: Travel around town, entering and exploring the numerous buildings and streets that make up Ilion. Or, take a walk around the woods, and maybe try your luck in the long forgotten Steel Ridge Mines... Just be careful...

  • Befriend!: Meet and talk to a wide cast of characters, each of which call Ilion their home. Earn their trust and friendship, and maybe one day... their heart?

  • Bug-fight!: If you need a break from all that, spend some time collecting bugs and bring them to the well-known secret "Bug-Fighting Arena" to see if they can best the rest. Train and pick the best bugs to foster only the best and strongest insectoids.

  • Craft!: Combine ingredients to build new and useful items and devices to improve life on the farm.

  • Combat!: Fight off many different monsters and freaks who would seek to see your farm in flames!

  • Music!: Original MIDI compositions that really take you back to the good old' days

Make the most of the situation and turn a profit while you're at it! Just be sure to keep eyes all around you once the sun begins to set...

4586940.name: InfiniDomino
4586940.about_the_game:
Push the dominoes, start a chain reaction, and watch the numbers explode.

Keep pushing dominoes, standing them back up, and knocking them down again. Every domino that falls earns you points.

Spend points on upgrades, build longer chains, and when you hit the ceiling, prestige to reset everything and come back stronger.

Features

  • Multi-layered Prestige — Each reset completely changes the scale of your growth

  • Strategic Upgrades — Where you invest first determines how fast you grow

  • Gradual Automation — Unlock automation one step at a time to maximize idle efficiency

  • Challenges & Permanent Buffs — Accept restrictions, clear them, and become permanently stronger
4586940.supported_languages: English, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

4586970.name: Barely a Hero
4586970.about_the_game:
A Fable with a Brutal Heart

Barely a Hero is an adventure that hides a challenging, Souls-like combat system behind a charming, beautifully rendered art style. You play as the weakest soul in a dying village, carrying a heavy burden that no one expects you to handle. Step outside the gates, uncover an interesting and deeply personal story, and try to save a home that doubts your every move.

Brave the Ever-Changing Dungeons

Explore a carefully hand-crafted world beyond the gates, but prepare for the unpredictable dungeons scattered across the land. Utilizing procedural generation technology, the game creates unique paths and layouts whenever these dungeons shift. This ever-changing environment keeps exploration fresh, forcing you to stay alert, adapt to unexpected hazards, and carefully navigate the unknown to survive.

Risk, Reward, and Inventory Management

Survival requires more than just good reflexes; it requires smart choices. As you explore, you must carefully manage your backpack and the loot you gather. Because you keep what is equipped but lose the unequipped items and coins in your bag upon defeat, every journey becomes a calculated risk. Decide when to push deeper into the procedural depths for greater rewards, and when to retreat.

A Cozy Haven in a Dark World

Between the punishing battles, return to the cozy, comforting atmosphere of your village. It is a safe hub where you can catch your breath, engage in dialogue with the quirky residents, and uncover the world's lore and the history of your home.

Stunning, Deceiving Aesthetics

The game blends cute, hand-crafted art styles with dynamic lighting to create an environment that perfectly contrasts the brutal challenges outside. The gorgeous visuals bring both the comforting warmth of the village and the dark depths of the dungeons to life.

Key Features:

  • Challenging Combat: Master a tense, Souls-like combat system that rewards patience, dodging, and strategic strikes.

  • Hand-Crafted World, Procedural Dungeons: Explore a deliberately designed overworld and brave dynamically generated dungeons that create unique paths whenever they shift.

  • Strategic Backpack Management: Carefully organize your inventory. Weigh the risks of pushing forward, knowing unequipped loot and coins are lost if you fall.

  • Meaningful Interactions: Talk to the village residents, uncover an interesting story, and experience a cozy hub that offers a break from the action.

  • Striking Visuals: Immerse yourself in a beautiful, charming world brought to life with cute graphics and atmospheric lighting.

4587010.name: Beggar's Road
4587010.about_the_game:
Survive the roads of 1407 Liège in a darkly comedic medieval roguelike of hard decisions and poor judgment.

You're nobody. A beggar. A drifter. A nobody with nothing. You wander the roads from town to town, forest to forest, and forgotten place to forgotten place in a world that is hard, petty, and sometimes silly. Gather poor companions, ration your meager supplies of food and gold, and make tough decisions as you attempt to survive each run.

Medieval engagements inspired by real medieval history: Pigs go to trial, relics are probably false, and a man might try to attack you with a knife over a turnip and think it's totally justified.

Travel a Living Medieval World

Travel from handcrafted locations such as towns, market towns, forests, and ruins within the Prince-Bishopric of Liège. Each journey is an opportunity for new perils, new chances, and new people who you absolutely shouldn't trust.

Make Difficult (and Often Bad) Choices

With every interaction, you'll make decisions. Some will be sensible, some will be moral, and some will be downright stupid. The decisions you make will affect your run, your party, and the mess that will inevitably ensue.

Recruit and Manage Your Party

Assemble a party of beggars, vagrants, and scoundrels. Each will have their own strengths, as well as their own debts, troubles, and shady pasts.

Balance Power Between Factions

Manage the complex relationships between the Bishopric, the Merchant Guilds, and the Bandits:

  • The Bishopric: power, order, and moral flexibility

  • Merchant Guilds: wealth, power, and backroom deals

  • Bandits: freedom, violence, and strong opinions

Support one, anger the others, or try to juggle all three. Carefully.

Survive Each Run

Manage your food, gold, and risks as you travel. Take risks for greater rewards, or play it safe and starve a little slower. Permadeath is a thing, but every run is a new story.

4587200.name: Shepherd
4587200.about_the_game:
Can you shoot what you can't see?

Shepherd is a survival horror game where you must identify invisible entities using audio and visual cues. Protect your passengers, keep your ears open, and if all else fails...trust your gut.

Listen. Trust. Fire.

Entities can't be seen, but you can use your surroundings to hear them. Learn the sounds of each one and snuff them out.

Let your light guide you.

Sometimes, it's your light that can reveal an entity if they're particularly quiet. 

The passengers must be protected.

Be careful not to accidentally shoot your passengers and feel free to chat with them at stations.

4587210.name: Mayor Quake
4587210.about_the_game:
Mayor Quake is a document inspection and decision making game where you play as a mayor preparing a city for an impending earthquake.

In 1928, a catastrophic earthquake reduced Constanbul to rubble. Tens of thousands perished, and families were torn apart. For decades, the city carried a wound that never fully healed. People called it The City of Orphans.

Time passed. The tragedy faded from memory.

It is now 2026. The fault line beneath Constanbul has been silent for far too long. Scientists warn that this silence is not a sign of safety. It is a warning. Decades of neglect have left the city dangerously unprepared.

You are the rising voice of the Orphans Movement, those who never forgot what was lost. Against all odds, you have just won the mayoral election by the narrowest of margins.

The central government is not taking it well.

As political pressure grows and the public loses faith, your mission is clear: prepare the city for the coming earthquake before it is too late.

But nothing about this will be easy.

WHAT WILL YOU DO IN MAYOR QUAKE?

  • Inspect building documents according to regulations

  • Approve compliant buildings and send them into urban transformation

  • Manage both the city budget and your personal finances

  • Make city management decisions

  • Make personal life decisions

  • Handle political pressure and public opinion while trying to maintain support

  • Face moral dilemmas with no clear answers

  • Prepare the city for the coming earthquake

  • Choose your path and remain an idealist mayor or engage in corruption

Every decision has consequences. Your choices will lead to different outcomes and multiple possible endings.

You do not know when the earthquake will happen. But you know it will.

Will you be able to prepare the city in time?

4587220.name: Castle Defender
4587220.about_the_game: In this game you are a Dragonborn Knight Running through multiple levels in a castle.  Collect coins in the level and kill enemies with your fireballs.  Don't forget to find the key in each level so you can open the door at the end and finish the level.  Collect all the coins in the level to earn a gem at the end of each level.  Use the arrow keys to move, right mouse click to jump and the left mouse click to breath fire.

4587380.name: The Final Stay - Chapter 1
4587380.about_the_game:
The Final Stay - Chapter 1 is a psychological horror experience that immerses players in a dark and unsettling world filled with mystery and fear.

You arrive at an abandoned hotel, but something is wrong. The deeper you explore, the more the environment begins to change. Strange sounds echo through the halls, shadows move when they shouldn't, and a disturbing presence watches your every step.

As you progress, the horror intensifies. What begins as psychological tension soon turns into survival, as you encounter hostile entities lurking in hidden areas such as the mine shafts. Players must explore, survive, and uncover the truth behind the nightmare.

FEATURES:

  • Immersive psychological horror atmosphere

  • Dark environments with dynamic tension

  • Story-driven exploration

  • Sudden and unpredictable jump scares

  • Combat encounters with hostile entities

  • A mysterious narrative that unfolds as you progress

This is Chapter 1 of a larger story. Your choices and discoveries will shape what lies ahead.

Can you survive… or will you become part of The Final Stay?

4587490.name: EXO
4587490.about_the_game:
Fueled by a God of Death, wreak havoc on the broken universe and fix what remains of the cycle. Annihilate enemies and tear out their lost souls to power your Exo-suit and reach breakneck speeds.

Build up speed by shooting and chaining high-velocity abilities.

Sprint at top speeds, “A-Train” through enemies, fly up and die massive energy brute, and even anime-protagonist blade dance on groups, but YOU are the blade

Get faster, and Faster, and FASTER to zoom through enemies and obstacles and circle the planet. Go even F A S T E R to leap to space to the next planet and go even faster!! Momentum is fragile, so proper turning to survive and constant action to accelerate are a must.

What, you want MORE?? OK, then go guns-a-blazin! Shoot-em-up!

These worlds are beyond saving. They need purging.

And who better to do it than the most OP adrenaline junkie the universe has ever seen. Leave NOTHING in your wake, not even the planets themselves.

4587550.name: Iron Bird
4587550.about_the_game:
A screen full of bullets. Thread the needle.

IronBird is a roguelike vertical scrolling bullet hell where firepower spirals out of control as power-ups stack, every dodge is by a hair's breadth, and thousands of build combinations shift with each run.

10 Aircraft — Not skins. Entirely different games.

Switching aircraft changes your handling, firepower layout, optimal position, and charge shot entirely.

VANGUARD pierces enemies with a single laser that cuts through the entire screen.

HORNET commands up to 8 autonomous drones that surround and hunt targets.

BASTION charges point-blank to unload a shotgun spread as a close-range tank.

Play the same stage with a different aircraft 10 times — 10 completely different experiences.

Sub-Units — Assemble your own squadron.

Up to 5 sub-units fight alongside your aircraft.

Rapid-fire cannons, piercing shots, homing rockets, shields, reflectors, bombs, orbital shots, beams, repair drones, charge cores.

Max out two units and fuse them together.

Rapid-fire + Piercing → Piercing burst. Shield + Reflector → Reflect barrier.

Combine freely. There is no single answer.

Cosmic Powers — The moment synergy hits.

Cosmic powers earned after each stage clear are the heart of your build.

- Normal — Stable buffs like fire rate boosts, auto-recovery, and extra piercing. Pair them with sub-units and the effect doubles.

- Super — When conditions align, the synergy goes wild. Orbital defense + OrbitRing shreds enemies at double speed. Crit system + Railcannon triggers piercing criticals.

- Curse — No risk, no reward. Damage multipliers skyrocket but your HP drains, or firepower goes berserk but you lose all sub-units.

The combination of powers stacked in a single run is different every time.

You'll feel "this is the best run ever" in a completely new way each time.

Bosses — Every one is different. Every one is brutal.

Face multi-phase bosses at the end of each Act.

Destroy armor plates to expose the core.

Take out the main cannon and the curtain fire vanishes.

Even at zero HP, they unleash desperation bullets. Let your guard down and you die instantly.

Graze — The closer the danger, the stronger you become.

Every time enemy bullets graze your hitbox, your charge gauge fills.

The closer you get to danger, the faster your devastating charge shot builds.

Stay safe at a distance, or weave between bullets to build charge.

The tightrope between risk and reward never lets up.

Protocol System — Clearing is just the beginning.

The game doesn't end after the credits roll.

Each protocol tier makes enemies stronger and introduces new variables.

Can you clear the highest tier with every aircraft?

4587580.name: Hentai World Fall
4587580.about_the_game:
Enter a serene and enchanting puzzle world where each completed level unveils stunning illustrations of charming girls. Gentle background music creates a calming atmosphere as you slide and position tiles with care, gradually revealing each picture piece by piece.

4587610.name: Dice Tavern: Farkle Roguelike
4587610.about_the_game:
Roll dice. Build synergies. Conquer the throne. Dice Tavern is a Farkle-based roguelike deckbuilder. Collect 23 unique dice, forge 17 set resonances, and outsmart 23 opponents across 6 medieval taverns.

  • Ancient dice. A brand-new battlefield.

Farkle is a classic dice game that's been played for centuries — simple rules: roll, lock, bank. Push your luck or play it safe? This timeless dilemma has kept countless gamblers glued to candlelit tavern tables. If you've ever rolled dice in a Bohemian tavern, you'll find a familiar taste here — and then discover this drink is far stronger than you expected.

<Dice Tavern> infuses this classic with the soul of roguelike deckbuilding. When every die has its own probability curve, when odds can be twisted, rewritten, and stacked — Farkle transforms from a game of luck into an adventure of probability engineering and strategic crafting.

  • Core Gameplay

>Roll the dice. Lock the scoring ones. Choose: bank your points, or push your luck.

>The shadow of Farkle (busting) looms over every throw — one greedy reroll could cost you everything.

  • Risk & Reward

> One more roll, or cash out now?

> The higher your round score, the more devastating a bust becomes.

> But a true gambler knows — the greatest risk is never taking one.

  • Every Die is a Character

> 23 dice types, each with unique probability curves and 3D materials. The Heaven Die is obsidian-black as midnight, the Knight Die replaces pips with helmets, the Demon Die pulses with molten lava diamonds — they're not just tools, they're citizens of this world.

  • The Multiplier Engine

> Over a dozen badges form your multiplier engine. Triple Double, Combo Maniac, Blade Dancer, All In... when multipliers stack layer upon layer, a single bank becomes an explosion.

  • Stories Between Dice

> When specific dice combinations take the field together, they trigger Resonance. Each resonance has its own name, its own mechanics, its own story to tell.

> Hedge Knight vs Blood Oath Blade: Six Knight Dice make a cold-blooded mercenary. Swap one for a Clothed Die and you become an avenger. A 50-gold rag decides your moral fate.

> Holy Empire vs Demon Dynasty: They share the same Knight, the same Lord, the same Heaven. The only difference — the three dice in your heart chose light or the abyss.

> Underdog: Four of the cheapest dice band together and rewrite the rules of combinations — the system forbids them from grouping up? These people were never part of the system.

  • Build Diversity

> Same rules. Completely different playstyles.

> Heaven Knight turns 6-pips into 1-pips, crushing everything with brute force.

> Underdog makes junk faces form combos, winning against the odds.

> Lucky Stars chases hot dice chains, doubling and doubling again.

> There's no strongest build — only the right build for you.

  • Build Progression

> Every run starts with six plain white dice. Earn your first gold, invest in your first Knight Die. Complete a resonance, feel the moment of transformation. By the time you reach the Capital, your dice bag is a precision scoring machine.

> But the shop shelves are different every time — even the same strategy demands adaptation.

  • Deep Customization

> Lead weights warp probability, making specific faces appear more often.

> Coating stickers permanently attach — Copper resurrects junk faces, Silver grants immunity shields, Gold stacks multipliers.

> Trick Cup rerolls, Sleeve Die flips faces, Strong Glue locks results — your last resort for clutch comebacks.

> Every single die deserves careful crafting.

  • From Village to Throne

> 6 taverns. 30 opponents. Target scores soar from 3,500 to 500,000.

> Each opponent wields unique battle modifiers: sealing your best-scoring face, banning your most relied-upon combos, punishing busts with extra penalties, decaying your total score each round.

> Use your build to crack every challenge.

  •  Shop & Economy

> Every tavern has its own shop. Refresh the shelves and try your luck, or grab bargains from roadside merchants.

> Limited gold, unlimited choices — every coin spent is a painful trade-off.

  • Multiple Characters

> 10 unlockable characters, each rewriting the game's base rules.

> Gambler: Fewer rounds, higher stakes.

> Alchemist: 80% off coatings, 30% markup on dice — rewrite fate with stickers.

> Joker: Each score has a 65% chance to double, 35% chance to become 1 point.

> Different starting points breed different strategies.

Fate never reveals its answer until the dice come to rest.

Push open the tavern door. Begin your journey.

4587690.name: ScrapCrew: Running on Fumes
4587690.about_the_game:
GEAR UP, REV YOUR ENGINES AND MAKE EVERY DROP OF FUEL COUNT!

ScrapCrew: Running on Fumes is a post-apocalyptic vehicular tactical RPG that blends grid-based strategy, deckbuilding, and a deep visual novel narrative. Command a convoy of heavily armed muscle cars, manage your dwindling fuel reserves, and engage in spectacular cinematic battles to survive the unforgiving wasteland.

THE STORY SO FAR

The collapse wasn't a war; it was a total blackout. Fifty years later, the remnants of humanity survive by clinging to scrap metal and blind faith in pre-collapse machines they no longer understand.

You are the newest member of the Omega Squad, a band of misfits deemed the worst defense unit in your settlement. After a brutal ambush and the theft of the "Axiom"—the technological engine keeping your home alive—you embark on a desperate exodus across an unforgiving wasteland. Your mission: get it back. Your currency: the last drops of gasoline.

RUNNING ON FUMES

In ScrapCrew, fuel dictates your fate. Every movement on the tactical grid and every heavy attack consumes your global reserves. Will you risk your precious fuel on a side objective for extra resources, or rush the main objective praying your tanks won't run dry? When fuel is low, the "Despair Cards" system kicks in, offering devil's bargains: huge rewards at the cost of crippling penalties.

GRID TACTICS MEET CINEMATIC ACTION

Position your vehicles, find cover behind the ruins of the old world, and plan your strike. When you pull the trigger, the game seamlessly transitions into spectacular, adrenaline-fueled 3D action cinematics. Experience dynamic counterattacks, missiles, and buzzsaws, complete with intense character cut-ins.

A MOBILE CAMP (VISUAL NOVEL HUB)

Between battles, the game shifts into a deep visual novel experience. Explore your camp, repair and upgrade your muscle cars, customize weapon loadouts, and interact with your crew. Uncover the fears, secrets, and loyalties of your misfit squad. Your choices in dialogue and on the battlefield carry hidden consequences that will alter your journey's end.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Vehicular Tactical Combat: Master grid-based, turn-based warfare. Terrain, maneuvers, and stats are the keys to victory.

  • Cinematic Payoffs: Strategic decisions are rewarded with vibrant, animated high-speed chases and devastating attacks.

  • Deckbuilding mechanics: Add cards to your deck by talking with your crew, completing side objectives or progressing in the campaign and choose between a random batch of them to apply mission modifiers before every battle, altering your strategies from one run to the next.

  • Units Customization: Spend the scrap you have found to improve your vehicles, and use the XP you have gained to train your pilots.

  • Deep Narrative: Immerse yourself in the post-collapse world of ScrapCrew, uncover the lost secrets of the past, and decide where you stand on the use and dependence of technology.

4587730.name: Ghostly Simulator—— Your Neighboring Ghost Story Collection
4587730.about_the_game:
Have you ever been here?

Curled up under the covers late at night, scrolling through horror stories, every line making the hair on the back of your neck stand on end. The lonely rental apartment in the tale is identical to the room you’re sitting in right now. The strange creak the main character hears in the dead of night? You swear you heard that exact same noise last night. Even the page they’re reading, and the screen you’re fixed on this very moment, are starting to blur together.

This is what *Ghostly Simulator* was made for.

This is no ordinary horror game. It is an eerily authentic mobile phone simulator — open it, and it’s like holding an unmarked phone of unknown origin, its home screen frozen with two apps you can never delete: 【Empty Obituary Reader】 and 【Cyber Exorcism】.

【Empty Obituary Reader】 is your first stop. It holds a library of horror stories pulled straight from the everyday reality of life in China. No haunted mansions in the woods, no centuries-old curses — only the mundane moments we all live through, twisted into something terrifying. There’s *Don’t Turn On Your Camera After Midnight*, a tale of late-night paranoia in a solo apartment; *It’ll Get Easier*, a phrase burned into the minds of generations; the soul-crushing pressure of the Gaokao, China’s life-defining college entrance exam; the hollow familiarity of the annual Spring Festival Gala, China’s biggest New Year broadcast. Every scene is one you know. But the most terrifying thing isn’t the stories. It’s the reader itself.

Altered text, clues tucked between paragraphs, hidden truths the stories won’t tell you — all of it can be unravelled here.

You can shut down the simulator whenever you want. You can pretend this was all just a little bedtime thrill.

But remember: reality will always be far more horrifying than any story.

That knock at your door? It might not be in your head.

If you encounter any unexplained, paranormal occurrences, tap the 【Cyber Exorcism】 app. It’s your only lifeline.

I just wanted chaos in pure ASCII. Text characters, post-processing, and a lot of particle effects. Looks like a terminal? Into the bullet storm.

4588440.name: Snow Brawl Arena
4588440.about_the_game:
Pick your moment. Pack your snowball. Last one standing wins.

Snow Brawl Arena is a competitive turn-based multiplayer game for 2–6 players set on a frozen hexagonal battlefield. Every turn, each player secretly chooses one action — and then everyone's choices resolve at the same time.

No dice rolls. Just tactics.

How It Works

Each turn you pick exactly one action:

  • Collect Snow — collect snow from your current cell (max 3 in your inventory)

  • Move — jump to an adjacent hex

  • Throw — throw a snowball 1–2 cells away (costs 1 snow)

Actions resolve in phases: first collects, then moves, then throws. If two players move to the same cell, both bounce back. If your snowball lands on an empty cell, it adds snow there. Land it on a player — they take a hit. Three hits and they're out.

Features

  • Simultaneous turns — no waiting around while opponents deliberate

  • Online multiplayer — play with friends via Steam

  • Quick Match & Private Rooms — jump in with randoms or share a room code with friends

  • Bot opponents — fill lobbies with AI players for solo or mixed sessions

  • Post-game stats — see Throws, Hits, Accuracy, Moves, and more after each match

  • Low barrier, high ceiling — three actions, infinite reads

Strategy Depth

The rules are simple but the decisions compound quickly. Do you collect snow now and risk being hit while standing still? Move closer to an opponent and gamble they're not throwing? Throw at where you think they'll be next turn?

Snow Brawl Arena rewards spatial awareness, timing, and reading your opponents.

Supports 2–6 players. Bots available for solo play and filling lobbies.

Roadmap

  • Q3 2026 —Early Access Launch

  • Q4 2026 — Power-Ups Update

  • Q1 2027 — Team Modes (3v3, 2v2v2)

Full roadmap and development updates available in the Community Hub

  • Online rankings for high-score competition

  • Stylized 3D visuals, UI, and digital sound in a futuristic zero-gravity setting

4589500.name: billion
4589500.about_the_game: billion is a simple global clicker game where every player contributes to a single shared goal: reaching 1,000,000,000 clicks. track your personal clicks, climb the leaderboard, and watch the community progress together. with smooth animations, satisfying click sounds, and minimalist visuals, every click feels rewarding.

4589570.name: Space Race
4589570.about_the_game:
Gameplay
Fly as fast as you can from start to finish without exploding.
Controls take place in zero gravity. There is no braking! Here, the laws of inertia apply.

Avoid obstacles such as black holes, lasers, or other space hazards, such as aliens.

Collecting Suns
In each level, you must collect all suns to unlock the goal. Only once every single sun has been reached can you land at the goal.

Lasers and Timing
Lasers are obstacles that periodically turn on and off. You must time your movement correctly to pass through safely.

Chasing Rockets
In addition, you will be hunted by chasing rockets that relentlessly pursue you. They increase the pressure and force you to keep moving at all times.

Aliens and Weight System
Aliens can land on your rocket and change its weight and center of mass. This affects the flight behavior.

Physics and Control
The entire control system is based on zero gravity and follows the laws of inertia. There is no classic braking function. The only way to reduce speed is to rotate the rocket 180 degrees and then accelerate in the opposite direction.

4589640.name: Match Deck: Football
4589640.about_the_game:
Build a Deck, play against AI opponents, win the football (soccer) league.

Didnt win? Dont worry, you gain XP that you can spend on upgrades.

You can also buy cards from shop between matches, even permanent ones that stay to your next game runs.

Includes possibility to make your own cards, teams, stories, leagues, through JSON-file editing.

Want to have a league with your favorite football teams? Just change the team names on JSON-files.

Want a different league system? Make your own Story JSON-file.

This game is in a Prototype stage only yet. Likely all graphics will be changed, and story, or actually even gameplay, is not decided yet.

Videos and screenshots just show what the prototype looks like, and might, or might not remind of the final product.

4589880.name: Space Guild
4589880.about_the_game:
Build the most profitable industrial power in orbit and reach the singularity.

Space Guild is a single-player sci-fi incremental economy simulator about scaling a tiny operation into a relentless orbital enterprise. Start with a modest crew, reinvest every credit, trade meme coins, unlock specialized operatives, automate production, and transform raw materials into high-value goods for a living market that rewards timing, planning, and ruthless efficiency.

This is not just about mining rocks. It is about building a machine.

Drill, salvage, refine, craft, and expand until your guild becomes a tightly linked network of specialists feeding a shared Fleet Vault. Every upgrade pushes you further from manual work and closer to a fully operational industrial engine that keeps producing while you plan the next leap forward.

Master the Orbital Exchange.

Prices shift. Listings move. Opportunities appear and disappear. Sell fast for steady cash flow, hold inventory for a stronger margin, or capitalize on lucrative supply indents when the market lines up in your favor. In Space Guild, profit comes from knowing what to build, when to move it, and how to stay ahead of demand.

Build your guild, not just your balance sheet.

Unlock a growing roster of specialist operatives, each with their own role in your expanding economy. Level professions, improve gear, invest in upgrades, and shape a production network where every new recruit strengthens the whole operation. The more efficient your logistics become, the faster your empire compounds.

From hands-on hustle to automated empire.

Early gains come from smart decisions and steady reinvestment. Mid-game momentum comes from better specialists, better throughput, and better market reads. Late-game power comes from chaining systems together into a profitable machine that keeps feeding your rise.

And when the numbers are climbing, the atmosphere carries the grind:

Space Guild is backed by a 40-hour futuristic techno variety soundtrack built to fuel long sessions, deep focus, and that one-more-upgrade momentum.

Key Features:

  • Single-player sci-fi incremental economy gameplay with both active decision-making and passive progression.

  • Build a roster of specialist crews and operatives instead of managing a single production line.

  • Automate gathering, crafting, and resource flow as your industrial network grows.

  • Trade meme coins: buy low, sell high. Don't get rugged.

  • Use the shared Fleet Vault to connect your expanding operation and support bigger production goals.

  • Trade on the living Orbital Exchange, where fluctuating prices reward timing and planning.

  • Complete lucrative supply indents to convert smart logistics into premium payouts.

  • Level professions, improve gear, unlock upgrades, and push toward high-value production chains.

  • Sink into a 40-hour futuristic techno variety soundtrack designed to power long-form play sessions.
4589880.supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian

4589920.name: Into the Dust
4589920.about_the_game:
Step into the sun-baked remnants of America’s heartland. Freshly released from prison, you return to find your family farm in disarray. A perfect storm of climate disaster and government collapse has made life a daily struggle for all who remain here. In this cooperative extraction shooter, you and up to three friends must navigate dangerous landscapes, scavenge for vital resources, and fight for your place in the west.

Explore

Navigate a fractured landscape of contested towns, farmlands, and scrapyards. Talk to tradesmen, wanderers, police officers, and land owners, observing how they adapt to the new reality. Every conversation, negotiation, and engagement entrenches you deeper in the story as you search for resources and answers.

Scavenge 

Scavenge abandoned buildings and vehicles for weapons, ammo, and crafting supplies. Every run is a high-stakes extraction: gather what you can and get out alive. Risk, reward, and challenging decisions define every scavenging mission. Get what you need so you can keep the family safe.

Fight

Engage in tense, challenging battles where teamwork and strategy matter. Different armed groups clash across the landscape, and going head-on isn’t always the best choice. Craft utilities on-the-fly like medical kits or Molotov cocktails. Cooperate with teammates, sharing items and info to tip the balance in your favor.

4589990.name: Patternima
4589990.about_the_game:
A visual puzzle game where you manipulate a moving kaleidoscope to uncover hidden shapes.

■ About This Game

Patternima is a puzzle game where you explore patterns created by a moving kaleidoscope.

By adjusting elements such as segmentation and rotation, you reconstruct the image and discover the target hidden within.

■ Gameplay

Each stage provides controls such as rotation, scrolling, and segmentation.

Adjust these elements to transform the on-screen patterns and match the target image.

■ Features

• A visual puzzle built around kaleidoscopic motion

• Dynamic patterns created through simple controls

• Rich visual effects emerging from overlap and interference

• The satisfying moment when a hidden shape appears

• Minimal guidance that encourages exploration

• A fusion of puzzle gameplay and interactive art

■ Accessibility Note

This game contains moving visual patterns that may cause eye strain.

If you are sensitive to visual stimuli, please take breaks as needed while playing.

4590010.name: Pieces
4590010.about_the_game: Pieces is a 2D narrative-rich game that features you as the protagonist, a blank canvas searching for a sense of self. As you converse with characters, you can interact through dialogue choices, mini games and puzzles. Through character interactions, recognize your emotions and what they represent, and regain your colours as you explore them. Form relationships, notice the impact of your words and actions, and witness them shape your relationships and who you become. Enjoy stunning visuals combined with an enchanting soundtrack as you piece yourself back together.

4590020.name: Kill Source: Neon Hemorrhage
4590020.about_the_game:
Death is not the end. Not if the score was high enough.

Kill Source: Neon Hemorrhage is a score-attack bullet hell built around greed, pressure, and precision. Survival alone is not enough. The highest scores come from pushing into danger, grazing bullets, keeping kill chains alive, and stacking multipliers while the screen fills with enemy fire.

Graze bullets to build Overcharge and push your score even higher. Stay aggressive to keep your kill chain alive. Fight up close for bigger rewards. Cash in your Overcharge for a shield pip when survival matters more than score, then live with the penalty when your scoring tools are on cooldown. Every run is a constant choice between greed and self-preservation.

Your standard shot keeps you fast and aggressive. Your focus laser slows you down for tighter movement and steadier damage, letting you thread through dense bullet curtains with a tiny hitbox. Enemy attacks are built from distinct bullet types and behaviors, from chasers, curtains, and spreads, to orbitals, accelerating shots, looping patterns, and telegraphed lasers.

Boss Rush is pure execution. Four bosses. Four distinct boss fights. No powerups. No filler. Utilize pattern recognition, positioning, and nerve, to destroy the scum that plagues the world.

Infinite Arena is a longer, dirtier fight for score. Waves escalate, enemies pile on, bosses return every ten rounds, and powerups can swing a run without replacing skill.

No meta progression. No unlock treadmill. No safety net. All you have are mechanics, skill, pressure, and four online leaderboards.
4590020.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese

4590140.name: DATACORE: HAYWIRE
4590140.about_the_game:
DATACORE: HAYWIRE is an experimental top down story based puzzle game that takes place within “The Cubicle”, a massive city within the confines of an indestructible fifty thousand square mile box for 500 years, with no knowledge of why or how.

Hack your way through randomly generated node based puzzle gameplay deciphering codes that get progressively more difficult as you play. Tons of different codes to crack with hidden Easter eggs to find.

Sprawling, gorgeous hand crafted industrial dystopian pixel environments across the many districts of the Cubicle, Lovecraftian low poly 3D, from trash cans, to expressive character sprites, each pixel was placed with care. With beautiful lighting that sets it apart from most pixel art games, this world's dense history is shown just from its environments.

Poverty ravages the streets of this gritty futuristic city. People fighting to be able to afford anything, vagabonds in a wild west. The food that is available is near inedible because of the climate, but it's all they know. The elite of this sub-world stress that the outside is too dangerous to allow anyone out. Eating delicacies in their towers. Nobody knows if the outside is truly dangerous. Or if they are just keeping them there to isolate them for power.

FAQ

  • Wait, how is this different from the game jam "DATACORE"?

The game jam "DATACORE" is a less polished DEMO of "DATACORE: HAYWIRE". The DEMO will get a re-imagined and updated version which will be updated with new gameplay, music, art, and more choices to affect the plot. That will be in line with the quality of the full release of DATACORE: HAYWIRE.

  • When will the DEMO come out?

We are aiming for a Fall 2026 release date. For now you can play the Jam DEMO on ITCH.IO And you can also follow progress on our socials!

4590200.name: Creepy Scary
4590200.about_the_game:
Play solo or with a friend on the same screen as you explore an abandoned cemetery filled with graves and crypts. Choose your character and race against time to find three magical items needed to craft a rare artifact — one that can free the spirits trapped within a dark dungeon.

But you are not alone.

The cemetery is haunted by restless souls, night-wandering zombies, and other creatures from beyond, all eager to catch you. Hide from monsters, solve puzzles, and use special abilities to survive.

Stay alert, move quickly, and don’t let them get too close.

Don’t hesitate. Face the trial — and prove you are no coward.

4590250.name: Jumppass
4590250.about_the_game:
JUMPPASS is a simple casual 2D game where you control a monkey jumping downwards in search of bananas.

Your goal is to safely descend while avoiding obstacles and timing your jumps carefully. The game becomes progressively more challenging as you go deeper.

Features:

- Simple and intuitive controls

- Endless downward gameplay

- Increasing difficulty

- Casual relaxing experience

4590270.name: Fallgrade
4590270.about_the_game:
Turn the world around you and use gravity to reach your goal. Run through concrete structures where there is no up or down. Collect strange orbs. Experience the contrast between the city and nature. Avoid the monstrous spider Karl, who is watching to make sure your desire for freedom turns into a free fall.



• rotate the buildings in the city
• move the sun in the forest
• avoid Karl




A first-person exploration game built around redefined physics…




…watch out!
4590270.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain

4590400.name: Raccoon Packer: A Cozy Puzzle Game
4590400.about_the_game:
Step into a small packing shop where your raccoon customers bring in all kinds of unusual belongings to be boxed up and shipped away. From baguettes and flower pots to roller skates and mailboxes, every order is a new little challenge.

In Raccoon Packer, every order is a cozy little puzzle. Each item has its own shape, and every box has limited space, so you will need to place objects carefully to make everything fit. What starts simple soon becomes a satisfying challenge as more items, trickier combinations, and tighter packing layouts appear.

Packing is only part of the job. Some boxes also need special stickers depending on what is inside. Food, fragile objects, paper goods, and electronics all require the right labels before shipping. For players who want a more laid-back experience, sticker assist helps you keep things smooth and stress-free.

After packing, place the box on the scale, check the shipping cost, hand it back to your customer, and complete the payment. Ring the bell, welcome the next raccoon, and keep the line moving as orders grow bigger, stranger, and trickier over time.

Raccoon Packer is all about satisfying interactions, playful problem-solving, and the charm of running a tiny shipping station for a parade of suspiciously resourceful raccoons.

What Awaits You:

  • Pack oddly shaped items into grid-based box puzzles

  • Organize strange and charming objects brought by raccoon customers

  • Add the correct shipping stickers for different item types

  • Use sticker assist for a more relaxed and cozy experience

  • Weigh each package, process payments, and serve the next customer

  • Enjoy increasing challenge as orders become more crowded and complex

  • Experience a cozy puzzle loop with a mischievous twist

P.S: We have a feeling these items aren’t exactly ''found.” Who just “finds” a mailbox lying around? But hey… who are we to judge?
4590400.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Russian, Turkish

4590620.name: Daetrix
4590620.about_the_game:
SHOOT EVERYTHING. RHYTHM GAME.

Put on your headphones and swallow the entire galaxy to the beat 🪇.

This is a shooter and a rhythm game. The more enemies you kill, the higher your letter rank will get (full clear for S+). You take damage by getting hit by enemies or by missing beats.

The color of the enemies and bullets indicates how you fight through each stage.

Shoot red enemies or dash through them to kill them! You can also shoot red bullets to cancel them.

Use your blue shine attack to destroy blue enemies. If you kill two at once, you get a "Perfect!" beat. Beat circles will show where you should position your ship in order to destroy two blue enemies at once. The blue shine attack also lets you reflect blue enemy bullets.

Grind on rails by using shine near the rotating beat circle at the tip. The rail will automatically carry you to its end. While you're on a rail, you can rotate the ship and shoot in different directions!

Go off ramps to reach new areas. While you're flying you can input directional controls to spin the ship for extra points, but make sure to land with the ship facing forward to survive!

In easy and normal mode, you will see lines appear between beat circles. When you see this, it means that if your ship is inside one of the circles and you push the dash button, you will dash to the connected circle without having to input a direction for the dash. This makes getting through the rhythm sections while getting the hang of the controls much easier.

In this version of the game, there are just two levels to master, but they are very hard and provide a lot of replayability on their own, if you're up for the challenge.

4590680.name: Darkest Path
4590680.about_the_game:
is an atmospheric 2.5D roguelike FPS where cosmic horror meets visceral, fast-paced combat. Set in a decaying universe where reality fractures at every turn, you must navigate shifting nightmare realms, master diverse character classes, and survive the brutal corruption of a world that wants you erased.

A New Vision of Retro

Experience a unique "Modern-Retro" aesthetic. Darkest Path combines the nostalgic charm of PS1-era pixel art and sprites with high-fidelity modern technology. From volumetric fog to dynamic lighting and high-resolution textures, every shadow hides a cosmic threat rendered in a style that feels both classic and cutting-edge.

Key Features:

  • Visceral 2.5D Combat: Feel every shot with a combat system designed for maximum impact. Inspired by the "weight" of classic action horror, every encounter is a dance of survival.

  • Shifting Nightmares: As a roguelike, no two runs are the same. Explore procedurally generated levels that evolve as you descend deeper into the cosmic abyss.

  • Diverse Playstyles: Master your role with various character archetypes, each bringing a unique set of skills and a specialized arsenal to the fight. Experiment with a wide range of weaponry—from heavy, soul-piercing projectiles to forgotten arcane relics—tailoring your combat style to the horrors that await.

  • Grim Choices: Faced with insurmountable odds, you must make desperate trade-offs. Seek out forbidden powers that offer immense strength at a terrifying cost to your sanity and humanity. Will you embrace the encroaching madness to ensure your survival, or struggle to stay pure as the world decays around you?

  • Master the Loop: Die, learn, and return stronger. Unlock permanent upgrades and discover hidden synergies between items and abilities to conquer the ever-growing corruption.
4590680.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Portuguese - Brazil, Turkish

4590750.name: The Retro Exorcist
4590750.about_the_game:
Story

After losing your position as a priest for the Vatican, you find yourself employed for a shady company. You've been hired to perform exorcisms on all sorts of entities. The only thing you can't seem to understand is...why do they all haunt video games?

The Retro Exorcist is a narrative-focused visual novel centered around a former priest as he attempts to exorcize a plethora of haunted video game discs and cartridges. In order to set these entities free, you must ask them several questions to learn more about their past lives. But be careful, too many questions will cause them to go berserk, and not every question is important to the investigation. 

Features

  • 2 to 3 hours of gameplay

  • 5 endings

  • 25 achievements

  • Post-ending side-content

  • Some other stuff I guess

4590790.name: Defense of Kyrath
4590790.about_the_game:
The Realm of Kyrath Needs You

The kingdom has endured for a thousand years. The horde was once a children's tale — shadows at the tree-line, distant thunder. Now it's real.

Position your wardens along winding paths through deep forests, pastoral farmlands, and volcanic wastelands. Marshal archers, siege engines, frost mages, and Highland warriors. Every enemy has weaknesses — and resistances. The right warden in the right place is the difference between triumph and ruin.

9 Wardens, Each With a Role

Choose from 9 distinct warden types, each with unique attack patterns, upgrade paths, and strategic purpose:

  • Sylvan — Swift forest elf archers, your first line of defense

  • Pyre — Lobbed fireballs with devastating splash damage

  • Deadeye — Long-range snipers for surgical strikes

  • Stinger — Poison specialists that wear enemies down over time

  • McClouds — Highland warriors who charge onto the path for melee combat

  • Bombard — Massive siege cannons with enormous range

  • Ironguard — Heavy melee fighters with the highest damage output

  • Frostweaver — Ice mages who slow enemies with directional frost spray

  • Frostfang — Frost serpents that spit balls of bitter ice, slowing all they strike

Dozens of Enemies That Demand Strategy

Brute force won't work. The Champion shrugs off arrows and slams your wardens with crippling afflictions. The Cinderhoof cavalry resist flames but crumble to frost. Wraiths phase through physical attacks. Bog Matrons web your wardens in place. Hedge Witches poison your defenses. Every wave demands you think about composition — and vulnerability.

Base enemy types are joined by named variants — Spriggan Firebrands, Grunt Ironhides, Hex Crones, Wraith Lords — each with distinct stats, abilities, and personalities. Nothing is safe to ignore.

Enemies Fight Back

Your wardens aren't untouchable. Bog Matrons shoot webs that freeze wardens in place. Hedge Witches poison them, halving their attack speed. Champions slam nearby defenses, crippling their damage output. Position carefully — or watch your line crumble from the inside.

A Campaign Across the Realm

Journey across a compass-rose campaign map spanning 13 levels and 5 stunning biomes — deep forests thick with ancient magic, pastoral meadows of golden farmland, windswept steppes under open sky, and volcanic badlands of cracked earth and lava. Each biome brings unique terrain, lighting, and challenges. Defend a compass direction and earn its named boon — cumulative bonuses that grow as you secure the realm.

The Folly — Roguelike Ascent

Test thy mettle in The Folly — a roguelike ascent mode with 20 tiers of escalating difficulty. Each tier is a short, intense battle. Choose boons at milestone nodes. Survive escalating edict modifiers. Earn titles from Novice to Legend. Two themed Follies at launch — The Gauntlet (deep forest, mixed combat) and The Siege (steppes, tanky enemies, poverty edict) — each with their own map, identity, and difficulty curve.

Progression That Persists

  • Unlock new wardens with tokens earned from victories

  • Invest in 45 talents across 6 tiers — permanent bonuses to damage, range, speed, economy, and affliction resistance

  • Promote your wardens through XP-based ranks for multiplied stats

  • Earn campaign boons — defend compass directions to stack cumulative bonuses across all future levels

  • Every session makes you stronger for the next

Edicts That Remix Everything

Several dozen challenge modifiers transform familiar levels into fresh puzzles. No promotions. No selling. Reduced gold. Faster enemies. Fog of war. Named edict combos like "The Long Night" and "Siege Mentality" push even veteran defenders to their limits.

Charming Fantasy Personality

Defense of Kyrath speaks in a quaint, quirky Olde English voice — archaic, charming, and never impenetrable. It's fantasy with a wink.

4590810.name: 民国诡事
4590810.about_the_game:
"Strange Rites" is a first-person Chinese folklore horror puzzle game. Set in the Republic of China era, you will immerse yourself in Chinese ghost stories. Through interactive choices, you’ll gradually uncover bizarre and strange tales as you solve puzzles.

Gameplay

Use Yin-Yang Eyes to switch between the spiritual and physical realms, investigate clues, and avoid obstacles.

Search for anomalies in the scene and collect clues.

Solve puzzles and reason through clues found in photographs, piecing together information to unveil the truth behind the fog.

Use QTE for quick reactions at critical moments.

Branching narrative. Key choices affect the progress of the story.

Player Goals

  • Solve mysteries.

  • Capture spirits.

  • Make critical decisions that lead to different endings, influencing the course of the story.

Style and Experience

The game features a Chinese folk horror atmosphere, combining 3D and 2D visual elements with cinematic camera work to create an immersive storytelling experience.

4590820.name: Eyes On Them
4590820.about_the_game:
“There are doors… that once opened, the person who walks out is never the same as the one who walked in.”

The night is tearing apart.
Thunder roars, deafening your ears.
And in that moment… your car stops.

No signal.
No help.
Nothing but darkness and the forest around you.

Then… you see it.

With its massive, rusted gates, abandoned for years:
Vivian Sons Mannequin Factory.

You have nowhere else to go.
So you step inside.

The door shuts behind you.

No light.
No sound.

And within seconds, you realize…

You are not alone.

Eyes On Them is a single-player psychological horror experience that tells the story of a mind lost in darkness.

Key Features

Oppressive Atmosphere
Tension builds with every step. Every corridor, every room… hides something.
The factory’s past is watching you.

Psychological Horror
Are the things you see real… or is your mind playing tricks on you?
The horror isn’t just around you.

Deep Story
Elias Vivian’s obsession with immortality reveals how this factory turned into a nightmare.

Uninterrupted Experience
The pace never slows down.
From the moment you enter, the tension never lets go.

You got lost in the forest.
You sought shelter in the factory.

But some shelters…
are not salvation, but the beginning.

4590840.name: Mine Wizard
4590840.about_the_game:
Mine Wizard is a 2D action roguelite where arcane power meets the pickaxe and axe. You play as a wizard who plunges into dangerous biomes, Forests, Deserts, Caves, and ancient Temples, swinging a pickaxe between enemy waves to harvest gems, minerals, and rare materials that fuel your arsenal and build your base.

Dig Deep, Fight Harder, the strikes of your pickaxe can mine Amethyst, Diamond, Ruby, Sapphire, Topaz, and Iron to unlock upgrades, craft equipment, and keep your forge burning. Resources aren't just currency, they're the backbone of your power.

Build Your Wizard Choose from a vast ability tree spanning various masteries like: Fire, Ice, Lightning, Orbs, Telekinesis, Miner and more. Evolve your weapons, evolve and breed your Pets, shape your gameplay.

Survive the Waves Enemies pour in from every direction. Place towers, unleash evolved skills, command your pets, and hold the line through escalating waves and brutal boss encounters that will test every choice you've made.

4590850.name: Pirate's Booty
4590850.about_the_game:
Pirate's Booty is a PvPvE Battle Royale where you battle your buddies and other pirates with special abilities while avoiding the poisonous storm clouds and collecting your "Pirate's Booty" to unlock cosmetics such as skins and weapons!

Features

  • Level Up By Fighting Off Player and NPC Pirates on the Island

  • Be the Last to Survive While Avoiding the Storm Clouds

  • Singleplayer Game Mode: Race Against the Clock to Maximize Gold Collection

  • Gold Shop for Custom Skins and Weapons

    Survive the Storm!

    Unlock Every Weapon and Skin!

4590880.name: Psyche et al
4590880.about_the_game:
In “Psyche et al,” a fantasy retelling of a certain Greek myth, you'll experience the story of a girl too curious for her own good, who—accidentally—finds Love.

    Become Psyche, the sassy philosopher targeted by petty, powerful Aphrodite and stalked by an elusive creature described as “the monster”...

    Have mature conversations about sex, truth, and our place in this world.

    Defy the powerful for a chance to keep your freedom.

    Be clever and outwit even the gods.

    And seduce the god of sex himself.

    (Disclaimer: We will try to improve the art, so the final product may not look the same as the demo.)

4590920.name: CatToySimulator
4590920.about_the_game:
Cat Toy Simulator is a pet interaction game. No more letting your cat face boring screen savers alone—here, you can create a virtual playground tailor-made for your feline companion, capturing their attention through vivid character animations and rich interactive elements.

Rich Asset Library—Create Custom Toys

  • Character Workshop: Customize the appearance, size, color, and movement speed of virtual characters to create the image that attracts your cat the most

  • Prop System: Design props with unique appearances that produce special effects changing character speed, size, and color, filling the gameplay with surprises

  • Scene Editor: Customize background images, music, guide markers, and even set "cracked screen" special effects to create the perfect gaming atmosphere

Auto Mode—Never a Dull Moment

  • When Auto Takeover is enabled, if the player doesn't operate for an extended period, the game will automatically assume control of characters, switching between different behavioral states based on your set parameters. Your cat will never face a static screen.

Local Multiplayer—Fun for the Whole Family

  • Supports local 1-4 player same-screen gaming! In single-player mode, you have full control; in multiplayer mode, each player uses a controller to operate different characters, letting multiple cats hunt simultaneously. Whether to compete for attention or perform cooperatively—it's up to you.

🐱A Note for Cat Parents

  • This game is designed specifically for cats. Gameplay may attract your feline friends to pounce on or bite the screen. We recommend taking protective measures beforehand (such as applying a screen protector and maintaining a safe distance).

  • While the developers have done their best to ensure the game's safety, we cannot be held responsible for device damage caused by cat behavior. Please keep an eye on your devices and pets while playing, and enjoy the fun!

4590940.name: CARGO CRUSH ZERO
4590940.about_the_game:
CARGO CRUSH ZERO puts you in control of OHC-0117, a lone space worker trapped in an abandoned orbital facility overrun by alien creatures.

There are no weapons. Your only tools are the cargo blocks scattered across the grid — push them into enemies, chain reactions, and use the zero-gravity drift to clear the field before they close in.

Features:

  • Roguelite run structure with escalating floors

  • 6 enemy types with unique behaviors

  • 4 block types including explosive Fuel Drums and rare Star Cores

  • Power-up system with strategic choices between floors

  • Endless Mode unlocked after completing a full run

How long can you survive the void?

4590950.name: El Shaddai: Zero Nine Reversi
4590950.about_the_game:
Zero Nine Reversi reimagines the classic board game with a bold twist: every stone has HP.

In standard Reversi, flipping a stone is absolute. In Zero Nine Reversi, flipped stones lose 1 HP. When HP reaches zero, the stone is purified and removed from the board. This single change transforms every match into a battle of attrition where positioning, timing, and resource management matter as much as territory.

FEATURES


  • HP-Based Reversi — Stones start with HP 0–9. Flipped stones weaken and eventually vanish. Every move has consequences that ripple across the board.
  • 40+ Unlockable Stories — Discover the tales of angels, fallen ones, and the world of El Shaddai as you earn ranking points. Each story features original character art and cinematics.
  • Multiple Board Sizes — From the compact 6×6 Mini to the classic 8×8 Reversi and the cross-shaped 12×12 Annexation board.
  • Special Rules — Unlock unique modifiers like Bocchi Enoch, Metatron's Wave, Gariel's Light, and more. Each rule changes the game in surprising ways.
  • 5 AI Difficulty Levels — From Easy to Death. The hardest AI will punish every mistake.
  • Daily Challenge — A new puzzle every 12 hours with fixed board, HP, and rules.
  • Online Ranking — Compete globally with a rating system that rewards skillful play.
  • Rich Lore — Set in the universe of El Shaddai: Ascension of the Metatron, featuring beloved characters like Enoch, Lucifel, and Michael.
  • Keyboard & Mouse Support — Full desktop controls with keyboard navigation and mouse hover preview.

Kingdom Rules is a cozy strategy game about rebuilding a fragile medieval realm after years of decline. Step by step, you will restore prosperity, repopulate empty lands, and prepare your garrison for the dangers ahead.

Build farms to feed your people, raise houses to grow the population, and construct barracks to defend the borders. Manage taxes and expenses, watch your food reserves, and keep development, safety, and public stability in balance.
