4591360.name: Void Balls
4591360.about_the_game:
You start as a ball. You end as an overpowered unit.

Void Balls is a two-button roguelite bullet hell where every run is different. Roll through neon chaos, parry enemies to steal their power, and evolve into something unstoppable.

How It Works

  • Two-button controls — just jump and parry, the ball moves on its own

  • Absorb enemies — parry to steal their essence and grow stronger

  • Evolve every run — 15 upgrade cards reshape your build each time

  • ~10 min runs — fast, replayable, every run plays different

  • Face the Mjolnir — a massive boss that demands mastery of both actions

Controls

  • Jump (Space) — Dodge projectiles, reposition in the air

  • Parry (F / Shift) — Deflect enemies on the ground or mid-air

  • Movement — Automatic. The ball rolls on its own — you react

Parry works anywhere — on the ground or in the air. Jump into danger, parry mid-flight, steal their power. Simple to learn. Hard to master.

Features

  • Full roguelite gameplay loop

  • 15 unique upgrade cards

  • 1 boss fight — Mjolnir, The Hammer

  • Neon visual style with evolving ball mechanics

Coming Soon

  • Multiple playable ball characters with unique abilities

  • Story progression

  • More bosses & enemy variety

  • Minimap

  • More artifacts & cards

Every run is different. Every parry matters. Enter the void.

4591720.name: Liminal Sick Pizza Blue
4591720.about_the_game:
This is a story-focused horror walking simulator, with some part-time job simulation elements depending on the scene, as well as very low-difficulty action scenes. The core design is a simple and accessible adventure in which you walk around, explore, and progress by triggering flags through conversations and events.

The expected playtime is around two hours. Compared to the previous title, "Shoyu Ramen FOREVER," the overall length has been reduced slightly in pursuit of a cleaner and more concise aftertaste.

Compared to the previous game, this one has slightly more horror and slightly less conversation, resulting in a somewhat different balance.

Synopsis

Hajime is a 27-year-old man in a band, at an age when he is beginning to think seriously about various things in life.

At the recommendation of a city office employee, he starts a part-time job at a pizza shop that pays unusually well for reasons of its own.

A one-person shift from the very beginning.

A girl who is supposedly his senior, yet calls herself his junior.

An outrageous manager.

A flood of orders from dangerous customers.

And worst of all, the delivery destinations are "liminal spaces".

On top of that, there are rumors that the shop is cursed. Serious paranormal phenomena occur as well.

It is a story set in the near future, in a society where liminal spaces are used as infinite land.

All of these mysteries are hidden within the cryptic phrase "E2T8P6".

Game Features

  • A simple adventure format in which you walk, explore, and progress through conversations and events

  • A surprisingly serious story built on an absurd premise, with moments of lighter humor woven in

  • A relatively conversation-heavy experience that depicts the relationships and backgrounds of the characters, with slightly improved pacing compared to the previous title. Readings are provided, so even players who are not comfortable with kanji can follow along

  • Compared to the previous title, the difficulty of the minigame-like elements has been greatly reduced. It should no longer be possible to get stuck and be unable to progress

Note: While this title is somewhat smaller in volume than the previous title, "Shoyu Ramen FOREVER," that earlier game was offered at a special introductory price as a debut work, so the price of this title remains unchanged.

4591920.about_the_game:
The world has fallen. Civilization is gone.

You are reborn into a zombie-infested wasteland, carrying memories of your past life. This time, every choice you make will shape a different outcome.

In a world stripped of order and resources, survival is not just about fighting the undead — it's about navigating trust, betrayal, and the limits of human morality.

Gameplay

QTE — React or Die At critical moments, respond fast — evade, fight back, or escape. Your success or failure directly determines whether you live and how the story unfolds.

Dark Exploration & Reconnaissance Use tools like night vision devices to scan ruined environments and detect hidden threats. Decide whether to fight, hide, or slip away unnoticed.

Explore, Gather & Solve Search abandoned locations for resources and clues. Solve environmental puzzles to reconstruct events and push the story forward.

Moral Choices That Shape Your Story In the most desperate moments, you must decide. Save her or leave? Take by force or negotiate? Every choice reshapes relationships and alters what comes next.

Branching Narrative & Multiple Endings

The game features a multi-branch narrative powered by a built-in Story Tree system that tracks every decision you make. Each choice can redirect the story — leading to vastly different outcomes and endings.

Style & Experience

A grounded post-apocalyptic world, told through cinematic immersive storytelling. Every moment is shaped by tension, survival pressure, and emotional weight.

4592100.name: Umigami Eye
4592100.about_the_game:
It is a psychological horror game and walking simulator. Close your eyes to influence your environment. Monsters jumping towards at your screen.

You wake up in a house you don’t recognize. Every time you step outside, you find yourself in a different place — a garden, a different room, a memory. You can’t remember what you did yesterday. You can’t remember why you’re here.

Core Mechanic

Close your eyes to influence your surroundings. Close them to reveal hidden paths and distort reality.

Gameplay

You leave the house and appear in a new, unpredictable location each time. Close your eyes to influence your environment and leave the house. The more you explore, the more pieces of the truth you uncover — and creatures may strike when you least expect it.

Story

You are trapped in a loop of forgetting. Every day begins the same: you wake up in the house, unsure of what happened before. Your goal is to uncover what you’ve been doing here — and why your mind refuses to hold onto it. As memories resurface, the house reveals its real purpose… and your role in it.

4592350.name: Spruce Falls
4592350.about_the_game:
Thursday. Ugh. Specifically April 30th, 1998.

It's prom, and you're locked in the Grand Spruce Diner. Annoyingly it's for a good reason.

Someone chopped down the town's famous Grand Spruce and the collateral damage is Big News. It crushed an expensive chevy, and also killed a guy.

Your job, whether people like it or not, is to figure out which of the many suspicious characters is capable of murder, be it human, tree, or other...

Explore the diner

You may be locked in the diner, but that doesn't mean there's nothing to explore. Bother people, investigate things, look under tables. You might find more than chewing gum.

About this game

This game was conceived as part of the HPS David Lynch jam, hence the heavy Lynchian themes. This is a Good Thing. We decided the game was worth expanding upon and have build it from the ground up, with gooder writing, more fun graphics, more characters to annoy, and most importantly, a fantastic soundtrack that makes you want to stare into the darkness as the fog rolls in.

4592400.name: ABYSS - 9
4592400.about_the_game:
The year is 5026. You have no name, no rights, and no choice. Assigned to the Empire's mining complex, your sentence is the ABYSS-9 expedition. Your mission: pilot an "iron coffin" into the crushing depths of the abyssal wall. At the bottom of the ocean, silence is your only companion... until something starts knocking on the hull.

SURVIVE YOUR SHIFT

In the abyss, negligence is a death sentence. Manage your capsule's vital systems while mining the resources required by the Empire. Not everyone makes it back for a second day of work. Will you be next?

  • CRITICAL POWER MANAGEMENT: Monitor the reactor constantly. If it overheats, you explode. If it dies out, the darkness of the abyss consumes you.

  • OXYGEN AND HEAT SYSTEMS: Oxygen is a finite luxury, and the cold of the depths is relentless. Keep the boiler lit or become a frozen corpse before even hitting your quota.

  • HIGH-RISK MINING: Ore is the foundation of everything. Extract resources to keep your capsule operating and meet your daily quota. In the Empire, those who don't produce, don't live.

THE ABYSS IS ALIVE

You are not alone in these forgotten waters. Uncharted abyssal creatures surround your capsule. Some are merely curious... others are hungry for fresh meat.

  • COMBAT AND EVASION: Find the best way to deal with what dwells in the pitch black. Use the capsule's resources to defend yourself or learn to stay in absolute silence.

BEYOND THE WALL

They say the abyss is not the end of the journey. Rumors among the miners speak of ancient secrets hidden where the pressure should crush any form of life. What is the secret that dwells at the end of the abyss?

4592430.name: DEEP DIVER
4592430.about_the_game:
Deep Diver is an underwater Roguelike survival action game set in a dark and oppressive ocean environment. As a diver, you must survive as long as possible while facing relentless enemy waves and managing your most critical resource: your oxygen.

Core Gameplay

You are constantly in motion, avoiding attacks and fighting off growing hordes of enemies. As time passes, you gain new abilities, improve your build, and push deeper into the unknown. The longer you survive, the stronger you becomebut so do your enemies.

Oxygen Mechanic

The defining feature of Deep Diver is its oxygen system. You must regularly return to the surface to breathe. However, every time you take a breath, the game becomes more difficult.

  • Enemies become faster and more aggressive

  • New and more dangerous threats appear

  • The overall pace of the game increases

This creates a constant tension between survival and progression.

Strategic Choices

Every run forces you to make meaningful decisions:

  • Stay underwater longer to grow stronger

  • Surface early to avoid overwhelming danger

  • Accept increasing difficulty in exchange for progress

Each choice directly shapes how your run unfolds.

Progression System

Throughout the game, you unlock a variety of weapons, abilities, and passive upgrades.

  • Experiment with different builds every run

  • Adapt your playstyle to survive longer

  • Discover new strategies through combinations

No two runs feel the same.

Atmosphere and Tension

Deep Diver emphasizes isolation and the fear of the unknown. Visibility is limited, the ocean is dark, and threats can emerge at any moment. The visual and audio design work together to maintain a constant sense of pressure.

Key Features

  • Unique gameplay built around oxygen management

  • Increasing difficulty with every breath

  • High replayability with dynamic runs

  • Wide variety of weapons and upgrades

  • Strategy-driven progression system

Deep Diver challenges both your reflexes and your decision-making. Will you risk staying in the depths, or surface and make the world even more dangerous? Survival depends on how well you manage both your enemies and your oxygen.

Every Run Is Different

4593000.name: The TEAM game:Corgi&me
4593000.about_the_game:
They say baseball is a team sport.

No matter how good an individual is, they can't make a huge impact without a team holding it together.

But at the same time, we all cheer for a superstar's heroic plays and rage at game-losing blunders.

So, what if you became that superstar?

This story begins when your obscure baseball career as an undrafted walk-on is about to come to a miserable end.

You happen to find a wishing "Monkey's Paw" and make a desperate wish: "Make me the best hitter on the team."

But alas... you really should have read the fine print.

Wait, a Welsh Corgi baseball team?

The Monkey's Paw flipped you the bird and flashed a bright light.

The next thing you know, you've been transported to an alternate universe where a baseball team is made entirely of Welsh Corgi beastmen!

Every time you try to run away, you mysteriously end up back at the stadium. Then, you hear two voices.

A sinister one warns: "Win every league to break the curse. Fail twice, and your soul is mine."

But a faint, hopeful voice whispers: "Don't give up yet."

Left with no choice, you must step up to the plate as the "Best Hitter on the Team" and lead these Corgis to the championship.

Cute, but absolutely hopeless Corgis

Sure, these Corgis are pretty fast on their short little legs, but the rest of their baseball skills are a disaster.

To make matters worse, any player brought in through trades or drafts instantly transforms into a Corgi too!

All you can do is give it your all at the plate and persuade your incompetent manager to somehow build a functioning roster.

Who knows? If you try hard enough, maybe some teams will actually lose to a bunch of Corgis.

Step up to the plate

Every game, you'll face pitchers from the batter's box — read their pitches, time your swings, and aim for the sweet spot.

Each at-bat is quick (just a few seconds), but every hit counts. Smash home runs, line singles through the gap, or watch helplessly as your teammates fumble the lead you built.

Between at-bats, the rest of the game simulates automatically — for better or worse.

Build your team between games

Earn training points from your performance and invest them in yourself or your Corgi teammates.

Manage your roster, set the lineup, choose your batting order, and equip perks to shape your playstyle.

Beyond the Diamond

This team needs more than just a heavy hitter—they need your guidance everywhere. Earn credits to gear up your Corgis and keep them in top condition.

Use the mysterious 'Corgi Whistle' to recruit powerful new players and build your roster.

Train your benchwarmers and send out expedition teams to scout for more talent and credits.

Confident in your analytical skills? You can even earn massive credit payouts by predicting league rankings!

Conquer leagues

Each season follows a full schedule: a regular season, and playoffs leading to the championship.

Win the title to advance to the next league — or it's game over.

From the humble Regional League to the ultimate space League, every step up means faster pitches, nastier breaking balls, and tougher opponents.

Failure is not the end

Thanks to a mysterious helping hand, failing to win the championship doesn't mean your soul is instantly snatched away.

Keep select teammates with you, unlock permanent upgrades, and push further than before.

Grow stronger through every setback and lead your team to ultimate victory.

Individual Glory vs. Team Synergy

The Monkey's Paw isn't the only thing that can bend reality.

You, too, will receive a mysterious power to change the game.

Will you grow into an unstoppable monster who hits 8-run home runs by yourself?

Or will you focus on training your cute Corgi teammates to grow together?

The choice is yours.

4593590.name: RIFT DIGGER
4593590.about_the_game:
A lone robot. An unknown world. And rifts that keep tearing open.

RIFT DIGGER is an isometric base-building automation game where you dig for resources, build and automate production facilities, manufacture weapons, and deploy robot subordinates to capture and hold interdimensional rifts before they consume everything you've built.

Every rift you ignore grows more dangerous. Every one you capture gives you new resources, new power, and new problems.

Core Gameplay

Start with nothing but a pickaxe and a patch of earth. Dig to uncover ore veins, crystals, and rare materials buried beneath the surface. Build facilities that process raw resources into usable components. Manufacture weapons and equipment. Deploy subordinate robots to dig, collect, build, and operate your growing base while you push deeper into the world — or defend what you've already claimed.

Key Features

  • Isometric world exploration — A large bounded world filled with multiple biomes, hidden resource deposits, and rifts that open as you dig deeper

  • Real digging mechanics — The world is destructible. Carve your own paths, create defensive chokepoints, and expose buried deposits

  • Subordinate robot AI — Assign miner bots, builder bots, and collector bots to automate the tedious work so you can focus on strategy

  • Production chains — Raw ore becomes refined metal becomes weapons components becomes firepower. Build and optimize your supply lines

  • Rift capture system — Locate rifts on the map, build defenses around them, and hold them against escalating waves. Each captured rift unlocks new resource types

  • Research tree — Unlock faster machines, better weapons, advanced automation, and new bot types as you progress

  • Steam Achievements — 30+ achievements tracking your progress from first dig to full rift domination

4593620.name: Donkee's Adventure
4593620.about_the_game:
Donkee’s Adventure is a fast-paced 2D platformer about a very determined and very hungry donkey with one simple goal… carrots. Lots of them.

Across 17 levels, you’ll make your way through forests, deserts, graveyards, and snow, and just when you feel like you’ve figured things out, the game finds a new way to mess with you. It starts off simple, then it isn’t, and now you’re fully invested trying to get through one part that really shouldn’t be this hard.

It’s quick, a little chaotic, and doesn’t waste your time. You’re always moving, always retrying, and always thinking “alright this is the run” when it definitely isn’t. Some parts feel easy, some feel a bit unfair, and most of the time it sits somewhere in between. It has a little something for everyone, and really makes you feel like a donkey.

4593650.name: Chaebol Chaos
4593650.about_the_game:
Seoul has had enough. You have trucks.

 

Chaebol Chaos is a satirical physics action game — Angry Birds meets weekend K-drama. Tap to launch kimchi, chicken, and ramen delivery trucks at limousines, penthouses, and suit-wearing chairmen across 25 levels of escalating corporate mayhem.

 

Features

  • Three truck classes — Chicken (fast, weak), Ramen (balanced), Kimchi (slow, devastating)

  • 25 hand-crafted levels across Seoul — Gangnam, Myeongdong, Itaewon, Yeouido, Cheongdam, Hongdae and beyond

  • Combo shockwave system — collide two trucks to deal splash damage, essential for late-game bosses

  • K-drama satire — chairmen, secret contracts, rooftop confrontations

  • Boss finale at the Hanwon Boardroom — take down the Chairman himself

  • Distinctive hand-drawn Seoul art — from boardroom towers to Noryangjin Bridge chases

 

Why launch trucks at chaebols?

Because the penthouse has it coming. Because weekend dramas always end on a cliffhanger. Because physics.

 

Not affiliated with any real chaebol. Any resemblance to actual Korean conglomerates, dramas, or executives is satire, coincidence, and protected speech.

4593710.name: Demon Princess Retreat
4593710.about_the_game:
A new style of RPG blending tower defense, RTS, and extraction escape gameplay.

You play as Nolan, the last surviving princess of the Demon King, leading her people in search of a land where they can survive.

Young and inexperienced, can the Demon King’s daughter flee from every threat, gather resources, grow stronger through your strategy, and finally reach the promised land?

After centuries of war, the Demon King Asaras swept across the continent of Aquirre and united the six great nations.

But humanity did not surrender so easily.

Decades later, the chancellors of the six nations conspired together, gathering heroes from every land to form a force to defeat the Demon King. In the end, the Demon King fell, and the world returned to the rule of the six nations.

The demon race became outcasts once more.

Nolan, daughter of the Demon King, hid with the help of her butler Feyd, living in a remote village on the border of Solaris.

But one fateful day, her identity was exposed.

Forced onto the road of exile, what kind of trials await Nolan?

Will her timid nature lead her into captivity, or will she escape and claim her own destiny?

A gameplay style unlike anything before it.

In each stage, you guide the heroine toward the exit while enemies pursue her by tracing the very path she has taken.

Rush straight for the goal, place towers along the route, search for treasure, or summon heroes to defend you.

Every action consumes mana. If your mana runs dry and the enemy catches up, all will be lost.

Fight your foes, Loot resources, and Escape the map.

Use your strategy, spend the least mana possible, and carve out the ultimate escape route.

4593750.name: Tiny Glass Tank: Dwarf Shrimp and Friends
4593750.about_the_game:
Tiny Glass Tank: Dwarf Shrimp and Friends is a cozy pixel-art aquarium game about catching colorful shrimp and snails, raising the ones you like, selling extras, and using your earnings to decorate small tanks by hand.

Start with a simple tank and build from there. Go on light scooping trips to catch shrimp in different colors and patterns, along with apple snails, ramshorn snails, and fan shrimp. Bring them home, feed them, and decide what should stay, what should be raised for better value, and what should be sold for coins.

Decorating is a major part of the game. Mix plants, moss, driftwood, stones, floor styles, water looks, and tank parts to create clean little displays, lush planted tanks, or messy aquariums full of tiny creatures. Your tanks can be for display, profit, collecting, or just because they look nice.

Tiny Glass Tank can work as a small companion aquarium you leave open on screen, but it is not a fully hands-off idle game. You still check in to scoop, feed, sell, decorate, and slowly improve your setup over time.

What You Do

  • Catch new shrimp and snails on scooping trips

  • Feed critters and raise their hearts to increase value

  • Sell fresh catches for quick coins, or raise favorites for better returns

  • Use your earnings to buy plants, stones, driftwood, tank parts, and other decorations

  • Build tanks for display, profit, collecting, or just because they look nice

Features

  • Light scooping minigames for catching shrimp and snails

  • Over 60 variants across 4 groups: shrimp, apple snails, ramshorn snails, and fan shrimp

  • Heart-based care that increases critter value over time

  • 60 decor pieces for plants, moss, driftwood, stones, and other tank details

  • 36 tank style parts in the shop, including floor styles, water looks, and tank parts

  • 4 tank sizes for building different aquarium setups

  • Tanks that can be left open as peaceful pixel-art companion displays while you check in over time

Tiny Glass Tank is not

  • A sandbox aquarium builder where every decoration is available from the start

  • A fully hands-off idle game where coins and critters grow on their own

  • A strict realism aquarium simulator with deep chemistry, breeding, or species management

  • A rapid-tapping aquarium game built around sudden emergencies or constant interruptions

Climb into your minecart and ride deep into the caves where every run is a high speed gamble through crumbling tunnels, glittering gold veins, and explosive stunts. Dodge hazards, collect treasures, and hold on tight as your cart rockets down twisting tracks.

4594070.name: Simulation Simulator
4594070.about_the_game:
Simulation Simulator is a freeform conversation game where you debate the nature of reality with your AI-powered best friend around a campfire in the woods.

You just took DMT for the first time. An entity spoke to you during the trip -- it said your life is a simulation. Now you're back, sitting across the fire from Bingus, your sober, skeptical best friend. It's up to you where to take it next.

Talk freely. There are no dialogue trees. EVERY CONVERSATION IS UNIQUE. Type whatever you want. Bingus responds dynamically using a local AI model that runs entirely on your machine -- no internet connection or cloud API required.

Find the cracks. The world is full of anomalies hiding in plain sight: names that sound madeup, a factory job nobody can describe, a fire that loops perfectly, stars that look painted on, a radio that only plays one band. Notice them. Point them out. Watch Bingus try to explain them away.

Push toward an ending. Your conversation has real stakes. Build trust or destroy it. Apply pressure or be gentle. Depending on how you play, Bingus might accept the truth, shut you out, confess something he shouldn't know, reach for the pipe, or tell you something he's kept hidden for years.

Five endings. One secret. Complete all five endings to unlock a hidden mode where Bingus remembers everything -- every past conversation, every shutdown, every confession -- and has questions of his own.

Features:

  • Fully freeform text input -- no dialogue trees, no pre-written choices

  • Local AI (Llama 3.1) runs entirely offline -- bundled with the game, no account or internet needed

  • Dynamic trust, pressure, conviction, and romance systems that shape every conversation

  • 15+ discoverable world anomalies with layered rebuttals

  • 5 distinct endings plus a secret meta-narrative mode

  • Procedural synth voice that gives Bingus a unique sound

  • Interactive campfire environment with radio, beer, and ambient anomalies

  • Low-poly aesthetic with post-processing effects (tilt-shift, edge detection, psychedelic shaders)

  • Every playthrough is different -- the AI never gives the same responses twice. Theoretically this game is endless.

4594110.name: Hardwood Basketball Manager
4594110.about_the_game:
What happens between games impacts the game itself. A living news feed tracks league-wide storylines. Off-court events driven by player personalities create locker room drama. Award races build tension mid-season. Every system — morale, stats, relationships, tactics — connects to every other system.

Fully moddable from day one with Steam Workshop integration. Replace rosters, add headshots, customize teams, modify commentary.

Built by an indie developer who believes basketball deserves the same simulation depth that football has had for decades.

Key Features

  • Full season simulation (12-82 game seasons) with playoff brackets

  • 2D tactical match visualizer with defensive scheme labels and shot annotations

  • 28 player attributes across skills, scoring, defense, physical, and mental

  • Player traits: Sniper, Assassin, Lock, Sentinel, Maestro, and more

  • Player progression and aging across multi-season careers

  • The Foundry draft combine with scouting uncertainty

  • Deep tactical system: 15+ options per possession with measurable mechanical impact

  • Free agency with AI decision engine + mid-season trades + draft pick trading

  • Salary cap management and contract negotiations

  • Practice management: freshness, buffs, scrimmage, shootaround

  • Advanced analytics and full box scores with historical statistics

  • Off-court events with player personalities and real consequences

  • Living news feed tracking league-wide storylines and drama

  • AI Coach system controlling tactics, substitutions, and timeouts

  • Morale system with captain influence and emotional contagion

  • Award races: MVP, DPOY, ROY, MIP, 6MOY, COTY

  • Full mod support with Steam Workshop integration

4594150.name: Sir, We Have an Orc Problem
4594150.about_the_game:
Sir, We Have an Orc Problem is a tower defense game with incremental-style meta-progression.

A bazillion orcs

Defend your base against an overwhelming amount of orcs. They're coming with tens of thousands of troops to overrun you. Greet them with even more bullets, rockets and lasers!

Massive upgrade tree

Use resources earned from every run, won or lost, to unlock and upgrade powerful turrets. Every upgrade brings you closer to defeating the horde.

Active abilities

Launch artillery strikes, bombing runs and orbital lasers to slaughter masses of orcs and survive critical situations.

4594200.name: UFO Craft
4594200.about_the_game:
🛸 EARTH IS YOUR TOY!

Welcome to the Interstellar Resource Collection Startup. Your mission: gather valuable resources across different planets and prepare your ship for more dangerous worlds. The locals won't just stand by while you plunder their farms. But you can handle it, right?

You are the captain of an interstellar resource collector. Your mission is simple: arrive, capture, and depart. No mercy, only pure energy of abduction and destruction!

FLY, AIM, ABDUCT:

Controls are intuitive: fly at low altitudes, aim the capture beam, and hold the target. But remember: the heavier the creature, the harder it is to haul away.

DESTRUCTION AND CHAOS PHYSICS:

Keep in mind: just because you've captured a target doesn't mean it's yours. These rascals resist and don't want to leave their homes.

PROGRESSION AND GROWTH:

Start by abducting chickens and end up harvesting herds of alien super-cows. Each valuable object provides resources to upgrade your interstellar ship, so you can spread democracy more effectively...

VARIETY OF PREY:

Collect creatures! The game features a wide range of interactive objects. Each has different value and varying levels of danger. Some might be too much for you to handle.

DYNAMIC THREATS:

Farmers won't just stand and watch their cows fly into the sky. They're armed. Maybe drop something heavy on them....

YOUR ROUTE SPANS THE STARS:

Earth is just the first stop. The galaxy is vast, and each planet holds its own secrets, dangers, and... exotic prey to abduct.

Complete insane missions: sometimes it's more profitable to take what you already have than stay and fight for the rest. After all, you might lose your cargo if you overestimate your strength...

🎮 Full gamepad support (XInput)

🏆 50+ Steam achievements

📸 Photo mode to capture your best abduction moments

Ready to begin the invasion? Add to your wishlist now to get a release notification and don't lose your UFO!

4594400.name: Cavemen Olympics
4594400.about_the_game:
Cavemen Olympics is a fast-paced, online multiplayer party game that pits you and your friends against each other in a hilarious battle for prehistoric supremacy. Forget modern sports—it’s time to settle things the old-fashioned way.

Designed from the ground up for competitive online play, gather your fellow Neanderthals and jump into a gauntlet of bite-sized, chaotic challenges. Whether you are surviving dangerous environments, racing to the finish line, or battling it out in top-down arenas, every round is a desperate dash for glory.

Key Features:

  • Online Multiplayer Madness: "Should be played with someone else online" isn't just a suggestion; it's the rule! Match up with friends or rivals across the globe in frantic multiplayer sessions.

  • A Variety of Prehistoric Challenges: Compete across a diverse rotation of mini-games. From survival arenas and obstacle courses to rhythm and reflex tests, you'll need to adapt quickly to take home the gold.

  • Charming Graphics: Enjoy a vibrant, clean, and colorful art style that brings the goofy, untamed world of the Stone Age to life.

  • Smooth, Responsive Netcode: Built using Photon Quantum, Cavemen Olympics features state-of-the-art rollback netcode. Enjoy seamless, lag-free competitive play where your inputs matter and your victories are truly earned.

  • Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: Simple controls make it accessible for any caveman to pick up and play, but mastering the physics and outplaying your friends will take true evolutionary skill.

Do you have what it takes to climb to the top of the food chain? Unleash your competitive spirit, jump into the arena, and let the Cavemen Olympics begin!

4594450.name: Futa Heim
4594450.about_the_game:
The World & The Conflict

Urban fantasy setting packed with elves, vampires, succubi, shapeshifters, synths and other freaky species across multiple worlds connected by portals/worm-holes.

The Power Structure

Female elves run shit and they fucking hate futas because:

  • Futas breed other futas into elf pussies, spreading their kind

  • Futas breed elf males to produce magical eggs worth serious cash and power

  • Every futa that exists threatens their control by stealing their husbands and ending their bloodline

Their solution? The Futaflay Institute - a college training hunters to capture futas across different worlds and run experiments to make futa semen worthless. No breeding, no eggs, no threat.

Your Role

You're Dromazeth Throxxa, a vampiress working for a futa cult called the Futhorix Cabal. You go undercover at the Institute pretending to be a "training dummy" futa while you’re actually:

  • Building your own breeding harem (males, females, other futas)

  • Producing and selling mana-eggs for profit

  • Recruiting elven royalty for the cult

  • Planning to overthrow the entire elven empire

4594500.name: Skollorn
4594500.about_the_game:
Sköllorn is a minimalist, fast-paced real-time strategy game played on a galaxy of stars connected by lanes. Stars generate fleets automatically. Fleets only travel along the connections you control. There are no harvesters, no tech trees, no build orders — just your commander's doctrine, your chosen abilities, and the split-second decisions that decide who owns the void.

Choose a commander. Build a loadout of universal abilities. Then carve, link, sever, fortify, and overwhelm your opponents across procedurally generated galaxies until every other faction collapses against your might.

Singleplayer and Multiplayer

Up to 8 players. PvP, PvPvE, or co-op PvE. Asymmetric commanders mean every matchup is a different puzzle — a different game, really — and every match is a chance to see what new combinations of doctrines can do to a galaxy. Play with friends, drop into matches with randoms, or take on the AI solo.

Five Commanders. Five Doctrines.

Each Commander brings unique progression, passives, and a game-changing ultimate ability that fundamentally reshapes how you approach the galaxy.

Captain Miller — The Warden

A defensive powerhouse. Fortify your empire with Bastions and project localized SHIELDs over critical chokepoints to outlast the swarm. Your orders are to hold the line — and damn it, you will see it done.

Captain Emerald — The Conqueror

Relentless and aggressive. Trade defense for blistering fleet speed and crack entire clusters open with devastating NOVA detonations. Don't stop expanding. Take it all.

Quartermaster Alice — The Architect

A master of logistics. Chain linked Forges into self-reinforcing supply networks and stockpile a reserve no enemy can match. Hunker down, build up, then bury your foe in numbers.

Colonel Nyirs — The Voidwalker

Unbound by standard space lanes. Exploit Warp nodes and use the WARP ability to teleport massive armies across the map, striking where the enemy is thinnest and severing their lifelines from impossible angles.

Architect Revna — The Weaver

A patient strategist who weaves the galaxy itself into a single fabric. Stitch CONDUITs between your allied stars to permanently bind them into a shared unit pool — strength flowing freely from one end of your empire to the other. Her homeworld awakens as a Nexus, and her conduit pools run deeper than anyone else's. The web takes time. The web is unbreakable.

Persistent Progression

Win or lose, every battle earns you XP. Each Commander has a 10-level skill tree of permanent, account-wide upgrades — passive buffs, reduced cooldowns, and evolved abilities that twist their signature ultimate into something new. Customizing your loadout before the match begins is as important as the battle itself.

Game Modifiers

Toggle a deep set of modifiers to reshape every round.

  • Upgradable Stars unlock runaway production and fleet throughput.

  • Fog of War blacks out everything beyond your borders.

  • Home World turns starting planets into win-or-lose objectives.

  • Shifting Hyperlanes redraws the map mid-battle.

…and more. Every modifier dramatically changes how the game is played — and what kind of commander you'll need to be to win it.

The Galaxy is a Web

The battlefield is a web of celestial nodes, each generating fleets to feed your war machine. You cannot attack anywhere — you can only fight along the lanes that bind one star to another. Every map is procedurally generated, with topologies ranging from tight Grids and chaotic Scatter fields to sprawling Spirals, so the shape of every war is different.

But the web is not fixed.

Alongside your commander's signature ultimate, you bring two universal abilities drawn from a shared pool — your loadout for the match. They reshape the galaxy, supercharge your empire, and tear holes in the enemy's plan.

Reshape the Map

  • LINK — Forge a new lane between two distant stars to open a fresh front.

  • CUT — Sever an enemy lane to isolate clusters and starve their supply.

Empower Your Empire

  • BOOST — Instantly drop reinforcements onto an allied star.

  • BASTION — Convert an allied star into an entrenched fortress.

  • OVERDRIVE — Surge a star's production for a short, brutal window.

  • RECALL — Pull surplus units from across your empire to a single star.

Disrupt Your Enemy

  • FLARE — Strike an enemy or neutral star, vaporizing units on impact.

  • STASIS — Freeze an enemy star, locking down its output for ten seconds.

  • SIPHON — Divert half of an enemy star's production straight into your own.

  • MAGNETIZE — Bait the enemy: nearby stars are forced to fire at the marked target, which cannot fight back.

Build a fortress empire of Bastions. Snake a fragile tendril of supply at the enemy homeworld. Cut their backline and watch their armies starve. The map is yours to break.

4594650.name: Galaxy Cadet
4594650.about_the_game:
Drop onto hostile planets with limited ammo and oxygen, hunt down strange alien life, mine rare ores, and grab everything you can before your oxygen runs dry. Every run is a risk-reward decision: stay longer for bigger profits, or head back before you lose it all. Cash in your haul, invest in upgrades, and prepare for the next, more profitable expedition.

Run-Based Exploration with Real Stakes Land on dangerous planets, manage limited resources, and decide how far to push each expedition.

Hunt and Capture Alien Life Discover and capture a wide range of creatures, from common finds to rare, high-value targets.

Mine Rare Planetary Resources Extract valuable ores during runs to boost your profits and diversify your strategy.

Incremental Progression That Builds Over Time Turn every successful run into permanent upgrades, unlocking stronger weapons, better tools, and higher earning potential.

Expanding Upgrade Tree Invest in weapons, ammo capacity, oxygen efficiency, support tools, and powerful income multipliers.

Hire Mercenaries Scale your operation by bringing in extra help to capture more while you focus on survival.

A True “One More Run” Loop Short, high-pressure runs combined with constant progression make it easy to jump back in and keep improving.

Push deeper. Extract more. Come back richer and stronger.

4594660.name: Novus Terminus: First Flags
4594660.about_the_game:
Set new frontiers in uncharted lands.                                                                                                                                              

     

Novus Terminus: First Flags is a logistics city builder for everyone who misses the feel of classic Settlers games. With modern design and fresh ideas!                         

Every good is real.                                                                                                                                                                  

No abstract resource UI. Every log, every loaf of bread, every iron ore exists physically in the world. You see it sitting on a flag, picked up by a carrier and transported to the next building. Jams are visible and solvable.                                                                                                                                        

Your road network is your puzzle.                                                                                                                                                    

Plan roads, place flags, build depots. The right infrastructure decides success or failure. Watch your transport chains develop, optimise bottlenecks and experience the moment when everything clicks into place.                                                                                                                                                          

  

Three clans, three playstyles.

4594740.name: Still Breathing
4594740.about_the_game:
You're David. Husband. Father. The guy who locked the door.

Outside, the world is rotting. Something hit and now people change — slowly, painfully, irreversibly. Your family got underground in time. Barely.

Now you manage what's left. Food. Medicine. Energy. Morale. Sanity. There's never enough of anything, and someone always goes without.

Send your people out. The surface is contaminated but you need supplies. Fifteen locations — houses, a hospital, a police station, a supermarket, a school — each with unique rooms to explore, things to find, and people you'd rather not meet. Whoever goes out comes back different. Or doesn't come back at all.

Talk to your family. Over 300 conversations shaped by who's alive, who's sick, who's angry, and what you've done. Your wife stops trusting you. Your daughter starts hiding things. Your son talks to an imaginary friend. Your mother-in-law is dying and she knows it. Every day the family dynamic shifts based on your choices, and nobody reacts the way you'd expect.

Answer the door at night. Strangers come. A lost kid. A wounded soldier. A woman who says she's a doctor. A man who offers too much food for nothing in return. Fifteen visitor storylines, each spanning multiple nights, each branching based on what you decide. Help them and risk your family's resources. Turn them away and live with what happens next.

Fight when you have to. Combat tracks your pulse, breath, and adrenaline in real time. Panic makes you miss. Exhaustion makes you slow. You can bring the dog, but if he dies, your son will never forgive you. When the enemy falls, you choose: spare or kill. Your family finds out either way.

Discover what really happened. A working terminal in the bunker. Emails nobody deleted in time. Classified files behind passwords you'll have to find. A BBS board where someone is still posting. The deeper you dig, the worse it gets — and at some point you'll have to decide whether your family deserves to know the truth.

Sixteen endings. Not good endings and bad endings. Just endings. Which one you get depends on who survived, who broke, who forgave you, and one terrible decision you'll have to make in the final days.

Key Features

  • A family that reacts to everything you do. Relationships between all six family members evolve independently. Siblings turn on each other. Marriages fracture. A grandmother's last days become the emotional center of the game — or a footnote you missed because you were too busy surviving.

  • Choices that actually cost something. Feed your son or your wife. Send your daughter to scavenge or keep her safe. Open the door for a stranger's child when yours are starving. There's no right answer. There's just what you can live with.

  • Exploration with consequences. Fifteen fully explorable locations. Every trip out means choosing who goes, what they risk, and what they bring back. Some locations unlock through visitor stories. Some you'll wish you'd never found.

  • 30 days. Every one different. The surface camera shows the world decaying in real time. Radio broadcasts fade. Visitors stop coming. Food runs out. The game doesn't repeat — every day brings new conversations, events, and crises based on your specific situation.

  • Combat that feels like panic, not power. Real-time pulse and breathing mechanics. Your hands shake. Your vision narrows. Winning a fight doesn't feel heroic. It feels like you almost died. The moral choice after combat is often worse than the fight itself.

  • A hidden layer for those who dig deep. The terminal, the emails, the classified documents — they tell a story the game never forces on you. Some players will finish without ever finding it. Those who do will wish they hadn't.

From Dad and Son Games. Made by a father and son who wanted to build a game about family that doesn't pull any punches.

4594790.name: Military Football
4594790.about_the_game:
Military Football is a fun arcade football game that combines football with war and historical themes.

There are no traditional football rules in this game. No referees, no fouls, no stopping. Civilizations inspired by medieval and ancient times face off in intense 6v6 matches. Players don’t just use their feet; they also fight using weapons like swords, axes, shields, bows, and crossbows.

Each player (except goalkeepers) carries melee or ranged weapons. You can disable opponents to create space and score goals using your weapons or classic shots. Every civilization has its own unique weapons and special shots.

Matches are fast and last 3 minutes. When time runs out, the team with the most goals wins. The game speed can be adjusted, allowing both fast-paced and more controlled gameplay.

Each team has its own unique soundtrack. Depending on the civilization you choose, a themed soundtrack plays during the match to enhance the atmosphere.

Military Football combines football, combat, and history in a fun and accessible way. It is designed for players who enjoy short matches, easy-to-learn controls, and chaotic gameplay.

Features:

  • Referee-free, combat-focused arcade football

  • Teams inspired by historical civilizations

  • Unique special shots and soundtracks for each team

  • Fast-paced 3-minute matches

  • Playable offline

  • 11 civilizations. More will be added over time.

4595120.name: LaVonne's Grid Idle
4595120.about_the_game:
Mathematical Progression At Its Zenith

Immerse yourself into a raw, exponential numbers game that respects your time. LaVonne's Grid Idle relies on advanced mathematical scaling to allow your tech trees to infinitely cascade without hitting standard hard caps.

The Grid Mechanics: Balance and upgrade 15 distinct 3D nodes simultaneously. Harness outputs from raw Pulse Relays all the way up to Omni Prisms.

The Void Dimension: Once you harvest enough spatial energy to break the physics barrier, flip your entire board 180 degrees into the Anti-Grid. Manage two entirely separate economies running simultaneously.

Advanced Artifact Engine: Discover, upgrade, and equip Output Cores and Dimensional attunements directly onto your physical nodes to radically multiply specific resource sectors.

The Constellations: Unlock massive technological milestones mapping straight to the stars above, representing your total lifetime Energy output.

Respectful Idle Optimization

Whether you stay active or shut the system down, the core continues to mine.

Return anytime to collect up to 5 complete days of offline mathematical generation instantly!

4595290.name: MUPPLED
4595290.about_the_game:
MUPPLED is a MUltiPlayer PLatform EDitor with a mupton of game modes that offer many ways to mup with friends or strangers online. Play as funny little guys in all sorts of ways to flex your creativity and platforming skills, or maybe just hang out!

Walk on walls and ceilings with changing gravity fields, which open up a world of interesting momentum-based platforming challenges that have endless possibilities in a sandbox environment.

Our game modes include:

SHIFT - Race others on pre-built levels to get all the stars and make it to the exit, either to escape elimination or to get points! We have many levels to play and are actively adding more, and we are also accepting levels from the community as .png files you can create in-game! There is also a Practice mode where you can play specific levels, race your own ghost, and aim for the fastest time on our leaderboards!

BOSS - One player takes on the role of the BOSS. Given a starting and ending platform, the boss needs to create a level that's not too easy and not too hard. Then, everybody takes a shot at beating the level!

SNAKE - In this co-operative game mode, one player controls a snake of blocks, and everybody else rides the snake! The snake must guide everybody through a hazardous world of crazy gravity and spikeballs to collect all of the stars in the level, but be careful, as the snake gets faster and harder to control as you make progress!

FREE EDIT - build whatever you want. we do not care (we care a little)

SPIKE WORLD - Forge a path through a randomly generated spike world by spending resources to create platforms to help you get from start to finish. Collect stars for extra funds for your travels. Try to make it as far as you can before running out of money!

SPIKE PUZZLE - Using savestates, find the least amount of blocks needed to collect all the stars in a small spiky level! There's a new level every day to optimize with leaderboards for the best scores; maybe you can find a better solution than anybody else!

4595350.name: Isolation Edge
4595350.about_the_game:
The outbreak has dismantled the foundations of civilization. Through relentless hunger, the infected have replaced humanity as Earth's apex predators. As one of the last survivors, you stand alone on the crumbling edge of civilization.

Welcome to Isolation Edge — a hardcore sandbox survival game focused on a pure single-player experience. Here, there are no reinforcements, no companions — only your wits and the weapon in your hand.

A Journey of Solitude

In Isolation Edge, you face the end of the world alone. In this desolate land, silence is your greatest enemy and your only companion. Explore diverse ruins and wilderness regions to establish your private sanctuary. Free from the distraction of others, you must learn to endure isolation and maintain both your sanity and vigilance in this one-man war.

Construct the Final "Edge" Fortress

With no teammates to watch your back, automated defense systems become vital. Utilize a deep construction system to reclaim abandoned homes or build a steel fortress from scratch.

[]Fortify your base with electric fences, concrete barriers, and barbed wire.
[]Deploy intricate trap lines and establish power grids.
[]Set up automated turrets to repel increasingly frantic nightly hordes alone.

Live Off the Land or Scour the Ruins

Choose to be a scavenger prowling the remains of the old world for rare supplies and components, or retreat to the hills to sustain yourself through farming, gathering, hunting, or fishing. Manage your hunger, thirst, and wounds carefully — in this world, there is no one to care for you when you fall ill.

Lethal Resource Management & Combat

Utilize a comprehensive crafting system to create everything you need to survive. Use salvaged parts to craft and install scopes, extended magazines, or suppressors for your weapons. Faced with overwhelming swarms, every bullet is precious. Even without mutations, the sheer scale of the primal zombie hordes is enough to suffocate you — if you are surrounded, it means the end.

Face a Tireless Threat

The infected never tire; they sense your presence and gather in swarms. While their behavior is singular, their massive numbers and endless pursuit will be your primary source of pressure. You must constantly adapt your tactics, using the terrain and your traps to outmaneuver them. There are no shortcuts to survival — every pull of the trigger must be a calculated decision.

4595550.name: Cozy Liora
4595550.about_the_game:
How was your day? Tell me about it...

Sometimes all you need is a notebook, a pen, and a cat purring beside you. While Lo-Fi sounds fill your room, you can pour out your thoughts, watch your plants grow, and settle into a little corner that's entirely your own.

That's exactly what this is.

Write Your Journal, Keep Your Moments Every new page every day. It doesn't matter what you write — were you happy today, tired, what was on your mind? Words gather into a small diary of memories that belongs only to you. Writing sometimes feels better than you'd expect.

🐱 Your Cat is Always There You can stop writing and give them some love. They understand you anyway.

🌿 Grow Your Plants, Bring Your Room to Life A tiny seed, a little care, a little time. Every corner is your choice, your story.

🏆 A Totem Every Day Every day you play, you earn a totem that's yours. A small reward, a small memory. Watching your days pile up into something visible... strange but beautiful.

✉️ Anonymous Letters — Reach Someone, Hear from Someone Sometimes you want to say something but don't know who to say it to. Write your letter, release it into the world. Someone, somewhere will read it. Maybe you'll find someone else's letter too. A stranger might have written exactly what you needed in that moment.

🎮 Mini Games from Your Room's Computer Time for a little break! Sit at the computer in your room and enjoy the mini games. A small surprise within your daily routine.

📚 Fill Your Bookshelf The things you do, the moments you live through earn you books. As your library grows, so does your story. Look at your shelf — see how far you've come.

📻 Choose Your Music from the Radio Set the atmosphere you want from the radio. The right sound, the right moment — writing becomes so much easier.

🛋️ A Room That's Entirely Yours This is your space, your peace.

While everything outside moves fast, time slows down here. A cup of tea, sweet music, a purring cat, and you. Ready to write? 🌙

4595610.name: Inspector Pug: The Furrious Murder Case
4595610.about_the_game:
A murder. A city. A pug.

In a dark, rain-soaked city of animals, a single murder awaits solving.

You are Inspector Pug — a detective who is… not exactly the sharpest mind in the precinct.

The world around you is logical, structured, and makes perfect sense.
Your conclusions, however, might take a slightly different route.

Deduction, step by step

Inspired by games like The Case of the Golden Idol, the investigation is built around layered deduction:

  • Combine clues using drag & drop

  • Turn evidence into conclusions

  • Use conclusions to unlock new insights

  • Apply your deductions in conversations

Each conclusion becomes a new building block — allowing you to form longer and more complex chains of reasoning.

Serious world, questionable detective

The city plays it straight.
The characters are rational.
The logic is consistent.

And then there’s you.

  • Ask the wrong questions with confidence

  • Present bizarre conclusions to perfectly reasonable suspects

  • Watch people react… surprisingly seriously

The humor comes not from the world — but from how you interact with it.

A focused detective story

This is a short, story-driven experience (~5–8 hours):

  • 1 murder case

  • 5 episodes across different locations

  • No filler — just investigation, dialogue, and discovery

Discover more than you need

Not every conclusion is required to solve the case.
Some will deepen your understanding of the world.
Some will simply exist because… you thought of them.

Features

  • Play as a pug detective with questionable reasoning skills

  • Build chains of deductions by combining clues

  • Solve a single murder case across 5 episodes

  • Use conclusions in dialogue interactions with characters

  • Experience humor driven by the protagonist, not the world

  • Explore a coherent noir city populated by animals

4595670.name: Satori
4595670.about_the_game:
A Solitaire Roguelike About Patience, Timing, and the Perfect Chain

Satori is a calm, solitaire-inspired roguelike where your best turn is built before it begins.

Arrange cards into scoring patterns, prepare your columns, and wait for the right moment to trigger a chain. One score can open space for another. One cleared pattern can reveal the card you needed. One careful setup can turn into a cascade that changes the entire run.

Chain deeply enough and you reach Satori, a powerful multiplier state where patience, planning, and timing become your biggest payoff.

This is not about playing every move as soon as you see it.

It is about holding the moment until the board is ready.

Build the Perfect Chain

Create scoring patterns using familiar card structures, then shape your board so multiple patterns are almost ready at once.

The real strategy comes from restraint. Sometimes the strongest move is not scoring immediately, but waiting until one pattern can lead into the next.

When the board finally clicks, your chain begins.

Evolve Your Deck

Each run gives you new ways to shape your strategy.

Enhance cards, unlock new effects, discover synergies, and build toward the kind of chain you want to create. Some choices make your scoring stronger. Others change how you approach the board entirely.

No two runs follow the same path.

Face Transformative Trials

Your journey unfolds through Trials that change the rules of the run.

A Trial may shift the value of suits, raise the pressure, limit familiar strategies, or force you to rethink how you build your chains. To keep moving forward, you must adapt.

Mastery comes from reading the board clearly and finding a new path through resistance.

Calm Design, Deep Strategy

Satori is designed to feel quiet, focused, and readable.

The presentation is minimal, but the decisions are meaningful. Every card placement, every delayed score, and every chain reaction can shape the outcome of the run.

Relaxing to play. Rewarding to master.

Endless Replayability

Experiment with different builds, discover hidden interactions, and refine your strategy with every attempt.

Each run is a new chance to prepare a better board, reach a bigger multiplier, and find the moment where everything finally comes together.

More Than Just a Card Game

Satori is about pattern recognition, synergy, restraint, and flow.

Build the board. Hold the moment. Trigger the chain. Reach Satori.

4595710.name: Rangedrifter
4595710.about_the_game:
"Beyond the great plains and mountains, deep inside the forbidden lands, lies a dormant kingdom, unreached in centuries. Those who enter the ranges of its terrible curse, will forever be drifting between its weaving paths, running from its horrible creatures, sleeping in crumbling temples, and watching the lights on the mountain during starry nights."

About

Rangedrifter is a traditional, turn-based roguelike game set in a forbidden land. You travel a remote and shifting path, outsmart deadly traps, overcome monsters and wild animals, gather food and gear, find secrets, and try to reach the lost ancient kingdom lying dormant on the horizon.

Gameplay

The game is played in "runs", where you try to reach the destination of a changing path. Each path is unique, flowing through the world in unpredictable ways: passing by peaceful sights, monster nests and dungeons.

You will encounter large stones marking the way, each granting a charm when you touch them. To survive, you will need to delve into dungeons to find gear, and gather rare food and supplies on the surface.

Rangedrifter is not an easy game. It is meant to put you into situations that are just as fun to fail as to overcome. So while a perfect run could be achieved in an afternoon, the joy is meant to be the found along the way.

Features

  • Turn-Based: Think about your next move and take your time doing it, or it may well be your last.

  • 3D Graphics: Colorful tiles, visual flourishes and dynamic lighting bring a classic look into the third dimension.

  • Controller Support: Fully playable with both controller and keyboard.

  • Permadeath: When the hero dies, the journey resets and a new, winding path leads his way.

  • Survival: Abandoned temples and huts hold precious food and supplies and deadly traps.

  • Combat: Use the weapons, shields and charms you find to fight off evil monsters and wild animals.

  • Large world: A hand-crafted land that tells a story of ruin, filled with ghosts of the past, and the remains of countless adventurers.

    Contents

Visit the official website for daily updates on the game's development.

  • Gear: four different weapons like swords and spears

  • 15 Charms: passive charms, status charms, and more

  • 10 Items: health- and buff potions, poison cures, various foods and more

  • 15 Monsters: kobolds, jackals, skeletons, zombies, and more

  • Traps

  • 25+ Objects: doors, vases, chests, boulders, bushes, bonepiles, tusks and more

  • Effects: fog, water, rain, snow, day & night cycle

  • 70+ Interiors: huts, sewers, temples, caves, dungeons and more

  • 500+ Path-Nodes: forests, rivers, lakes, snow, ruins, temples, bridges and more

  • 80+ Secrets: hidden behind loose walls and in plain sight

  • Countless number of paths

  • Puzzles: boulder obstacles and puzzle rooms

"That narrow, broken path through the trees there. Snakes all the way deep into the kingdom." The old man looks at you. "Rubble and curses are all that's left there. Some other went there long ago. Looked just like you. Best you find something else." He grows silent, his eyes fixed beyond the trees.

4595820.name: Keyboard Warrior: Type to Destroy

Keyboard Warrior: Type to Destroy

Combine your skills and marks at the right moment to create devastating chain reactions and stunning visual payoffs.

Features:

• Dozens of unique stages with beautiful visual themes and progressive difficulty

• Active skills that give you powerful tactical options

• Marking systems that let you strategically alter letter behavior and rewards

• Deep combo system with explosive particle effects and satisfying visual feedback

• Dynamic meteor showers and rich cosmic atmosphere

• Pure keyboard-only controls — no mouse needed

Every successful combo lights up the screen. Every well-timed skill or mark feels incredibly rewarding.

How long can you survive and master the chaos as the Keyboard Warrior?

A fast-paced typing game that perfectly blends precise keyboard action with beautiful visuals and meaningful strategic depth.
