4595910.name: Global Oil Magnate
4595910.about_the_game:
ABOUT THE GAME

Global Oil Magnate is a sophisticated economic simulation that puts you right into the pulsating heart of the global oil industry. You start as an ambitious entrepreneur with your own seed capital to conquer world markets. Your decisions determine whether you go down in history as an industry star or perish in the fierce competition.

Strategic Planning and Starting Conditions

Choose your own path to success. Will you start as an experienced tycoon with massive resources or work your way up from the bottom as an unknown newcomer? Every scenario offers new challenges for your tactical planning. Use the detailed clipboard system to define your strategy.

Global Expansion

The world is your playing field. Establish state of the art offices in strategically important regions and secure the best drilling rights before the competition does. Your global presence and the choice of your headquarters are the key to dominance over the black gold.

React to a Living World

The oil market never sleeps. Prove your skills in dealing with extreme market volatility, tightened environmental regulations, and unpredictable geopolitical crises. Only those who adapt their strategy to geopolitics will survive in the long term.

Detailed Management System

Manage your empire through an intuitive and atmospheric interface. Keep a constant eye on your finances, your reputation, and the condition of your oil rigs. In Global Oil Magnate, every decision counts from the first derrick to the worldwide distribution network.

Are you ready to take control and rise to become the greatest Global Oil Magnate of all time? The world is waiting for your first barrel.

4595960.name: Blooming in Budbury
4595960.about_the_game:
Welcome to Budbury!

It’s a picturesque medieval town where the birds sing, the cobblestone streets are clean, and the local apothecary is running the most beloved artisanal business in the duchy. That’s you.

Blooming in Budbury is a shop-management and farming simulator where you supply the town with exactly what it needs to take the edge off. You’ll start your days as a humble merchant selling basic health potions, but it won't take long before you discover the real money is in Budbury's thriving, completely legal "chill" economy. From innocent potion-crafter to the realm's premier botanist, it's time to let your business bloom!

Peak Shop Keeping Experience

Keep the town running by stocking your shelves with magical remedies and botanical delights. Cure the lumberjack's insomnia, supply the local wizard with mana, and ring up the day's profits.

  • Immersive Management: No boring menus here. Order wholesale goods by sending off your trusty messenger pigeon from the back room.

  • The Tally Desk: Sort your customers' purchases and pack them into satisfying, heavy wicker baskets before sending them on their way.

  • Stock the Shelves: Balance your inventory to make sure you have enough Minor Health Potions for the peasant militia and Huge Mana Potions for the local spellcasters.

Budbury's Finest Cash Crop

When the shop closes, head to your private garden to cultivate the town's most requested goods. It's a perfectly legal, highly celebrated local trade!

  • Farm Your Greenery: Plant, water, and harvest a variety of exotic herbs, relaxing flora, and magical mushrooms.

  • Craft the Good Stuff: Process your harvest to roll everything from a Regular Chill Stick for a stressed peasant on their lunch break to an Extraordinary Chill Stick that will make the user speak with the old gods.

  • Serve the Community: Everyone from the local baker to the off-duty guardsman is a paying customer looking for your finest blends.

High Society Clients

Step out from behind the counter and explore the entire 3D city of Budbury to meet your key clientele. The villagers aren't just faceless wallets; they have specific needs, deep pockets, and special requests for a master botanist like you.

  • Supply the Mad Wizard with mind-bending brews and psychedelic mushrooms.

  • Keep the Captain of the Guard relaxed with a steady supply of his favorite uncommon smokes.

  • Build relationships with the Priest, the Lumberjack, the Blacksmith, and more!

Can you balance the books, tend to your crops, and keep the realm buzzing?

4596010.name: Bar After Bar

4596160.name: Gray Trading
4596160.about_the_game:
Gray Trading is an incremental game where you trade stocks, NFT, do forex and many more in unconventional ways. Your goal is to become the richest person in the world and these are some of the ways to get there.

Trade Stocks

Predict if the market is bearish or bullish and trade for profit.

Trade NFT

Purchase, organize and trade NFT.

Unlock Meta Upgrades

Unlock permanent upgrades to maximize your profit.
4596160.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Portugal, Simplified Chinese

4596180.name: Table of Fates
4596180.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Tavern!

Table of Fates is a roguelike deckbuilder set in a medieval fantasy tavern.

You are a traveler taking a break on your journey, only to discover a mysterious card game that the locals can't stop playing. What starts as a simple match quickly becomes something more.

Play a tactical card game on the table, where your hero battles enemy creatures using spells, abilities, and clever combos, adapting your strategy as each encounter unfolds.

Build your deck, face strange opponents, and see how far you can go.

Build your deck!

Choose your cards carefully and shape your strategy with every reward. Every choice matters as your deck evolves throughout each battle. Combine cards, experiment with different builds, and adapt to the challenges each run throws at you.

  • Adapt your build each run

  • Discover new synergies

  • Turn simple cards into powerful plays

No two runs feel the same!

Each game unfolds across different table setups and evolving scenarios within the tavern.

Every run offers new opportunities and new risks!

Discover powerful items!

Buy relics, drink special brews, and enhance your stats. The right items can drastically change your run, turning simple builds into unstoppable strategies. They also interact with your cards, stats, and other items, unlocking powerful possibilities.

  • Gain passive effects that shape your playstyle

  • Enhance your stats to support different builds

  • Create new synergies between cards and items

Make thoughtful deals!

Between matches, you will encounter a series of events as you interact with the tavern's locals. These moments offer choices, opportunities, and risks that can shape the course of your run.

  • Trade with Merchants

  • Drink with the Barman

  • Encounter beggars, other travelers... and worse

Not everyone has good intentions.

Every interaction shapes your journey.

Spend wisely, act carefully, and think before you refuse...

Locals react and remember your behavior, and your Karma will influence:

  • Who you encounter

  • How they treat you

  • What rewards you receive

Greed and carelessness can cost you more than just gold.

Risk it all... or secure your winnings

At any moment, you could be offered the option to sell your deck and walk away.

Push your luck for greater rewards, or play it safe before everything turns against you!
4596180.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain
*languages with full audio support

4596210.name: Directive 220
4596210.about_the_game:
You decide who gets electricity — and who doesn’t.

Directive 220 is a dark, atmospheric management game where you take the role of an energy dispatcher in a collapsing authoritarian regime. Every decision carries a cost. Hospitals, factories, the military, and civilians all demand power — but you will never have enough to satisfy everyone.

For fans of Papers, Please and political management games.

⚡ WHAT YOU DO

Each work shift, you must:

• Allocate limited power across competing sectors
• Respond to urgent incidents and incoming calls
• Balance grid stability, government pressure, and citizen survival
• Make irreversible decisions under constant time pressure

Every choice solves one problem — and creates another.

⚖️ IMPOSSIBLE DECISIONS

Prioritize critical infrastructure or follow political orders.
Keep the system stable — or protect the people.

You cannot save everyone.

📉 A SYSTEM UNDER PRESSURE

Balance three key forces:

• Grid stability
• Government trust
• Citizen satisfaction

Push too far in any direction, and the system begins to crack.

🔥 FEATURES

• Real-time decision-making under pressure
• Dynamic events and reactive phone calls
• Multiple outcomes based on your choices
• Retro-inspired UI and dystopian atmosphere
• Narrative-driven progression with daily consequences

🧠 CONSEQUENCES MATTER

Mistakes are remembered.
Patterns are noticed.

As pressure builds, your role becomes more dangerous — and more political.

How long can you keep the lights on?

4596220.name: Monke Survivor
4596220.about_the_game:
NO STOPPING, ONLY CHAOS
Survive the endless swarm in a true action-roguelike experience. The map is randomly generated every run and enemies scale exponentially. The game doesn't end at the 10-minute mark; the "Loop" begins, everything speeds up and surviving turns into absolute hell.

WRECK THE MACHINES, HIT THE JACKPOT
The office props aren't just decorations; they are your slot machines. Smash them to loot basic buffs, level up your monkey and chase the jackpot. If you're lucky, you'll break the system and become fully OP.

LOOT, BUILD AND SYNERGIZE
Dump your looted cash into briefcases to unlock unique items. Combine dozens of different gears, upgrade your arsenal and build your own OP synergy to break the run.

SHOW THE BOSS WHO'S IN CHARGE
When the time comes, the CEO enters the arena. Shred through the armor of the Finance, Logistics, IT and HR departments one by one. Strip him down and bounce him around the arena like a ragdoll.

DEMO CONTENT:

  • 3 Characters: Smirky (Fast/Crit), Stinky (Tank/Zeppelin), Kong (Balanced/Strong).

  • Fully Integrated Loop System: A limitless, exponential difficulty test after the 10-minute mark.

  • Terminal Upgrades: Use the money you earn between runs to permanently upgrade your stats.

4596260.name: DREADHOLM
4596260.about_the_game:
Dreadholm is an isometric online RPG set in a dark fantasy world where something has gone very wrong. The village of Ashvale is surrounded. Creatures crawl out of the wilds, the dead are rising, and the plague only known as the withering continues to spread. You arrive with nothing but your weapon.

CLASSES

Warrior - Melee brawler. Builds rage with every hit and spends it on powerful abilities. Tough enough to stand in the middle of a fight and keep swinging.

Mage - Ranged caster. High damage, low survivability. Manage your mana and you'll clear rooms. Mismanage it and you'll be walking back from spawn.

Ranger - Mobile ranged DPS. Fast attacks, high crit chance, built around kiting. If something can't reach you, it can't hurt you.

Priest - Holy support. Heals, buffs, and keeps the party of their feet. Dungeons are a lot harder without one.

LOOT

Equipment drops with randomized affixes... Prefixes and suffixes that roll different stats every time. Your longsword more than likely will not have the same stats as the next one that drops. Compare gear, weigh tradeoffs, and chase your upgrades. Trade what you don't need on the auction house to other players.

DUNGEONS

Instanced dungeons with scaled difficulty. Boss encounters have traditional telegraphed abilities that require positioning and coordination. Bring a party.

EARLY ACCESS

Dreadholm is in active development. It's built from the ground up with a proprietary engine and server by one developer. Updates are regular, feedback is read, and will constantly shape the world and what gets worked on next. What's here now is playable and growing.

Free to play. No cash shop. No paid advantages.

4596480.name: Don't Drop the BOOTY!
4596480.about_the_game:
Don’t Drop the Booty

Grab your crew and hold on tight—because in Don’t Drop the Booty, every bounce could cost you everything.

This chaotic multiplayer platformer challenges you and your team with one simple but high-stakes objective: carry a priceless jewel to the top of a treacherous mountain. Sounds easy? Think again.

The jewel is fragile. Every collision, every slip, every poorly timed throw or catch chips away at its value. What starts as a glittering treasure can quickly become worthless scrap if your team isn’t careful. Precision, coordination, and quick thinking are the only things standing between you and total loss.

Work together to navigate unpredictable terrain, overcome obstacles, and keep the jewel safe as you climb higher and higher. The clock is ticking, the pressure is rising, and one wrong move could ruin the run.

Key Features:

  • Co-op Chaos: Team up with friends in frantic multiplayer gameplay where communication is everything.

  • Physics-Based Mayhem: Expect the unexpected as the jewel reacts to every bump, drop, and impact.

4596500.name: FuturePuck Manager
4596500.about_the_game:
FuturePuck Manager™ is a sci-fi sports management sim set in a humanity-settled star system in the year 3037, putting players in the hotseat to guide their team to glory.

Buy and sell players, choose your winning tactics, and even hire a bounty hunter to retrieve and rescue your players from asteroid-dwelling pirates.

Featuring an array of sci-fi species to assemble your squad from, teams of five go head to head in exciting text-based matches as they look to climb the divisions to the summit of the Alpha League or to claim victory in the Wondrous Cup.

Whatever they do, they'd be wise to avoid finishing bottom of the Delta League - for the vacuum of space awaits those managers that do.
The game was inspired by Speedball 2, tabletop Blood Bowl, and Football Manager, with the fictional sport itself loosely combining features of ice hockey, curling, five-a-side football and lacrosse, and a hand-drawn visual style with slight nods to Space Raiders crisps or years gone by and other sci-fi works.

4596550.name: Aisle Survive
4596550.about_the_game:
Jade operates the last human-run store in Mech City. Her employees must work harder and faster than any robot in existence - or suffer the consequences.

Glen, however, has reached his limit. He's done with retail; he's ready to quit. But there's just one problem: If he doesn't work his notice, Jade will ruin him. He will never work again.

He has no choice. He must finish the week. That's all. One week.

Aisle Survive is a retail rogue-like, a deli-crawling dystopia and a supermarket survivor like no other. The customers will crush you. The banana skins are baying for your blood. Finish the job before the job finishes you.

BECOME A MULTI-TASKING MASTER

Do it all, and do it quickly: stack the shelves, cook the chicken, manage your stress, manager your bladder... all before 5pm. 

FAIL SPECTACULARLY

Jade only accepts the best. Fail a run and descend into the dark depths of the mysterious void to upgrade your gear and bounce back stronger.

STOP THE REVOLUTION

You've stolen the A.I.'s jobs, and they're not happy. Defend the store against the invading drones using Glen's signature breadstick melee. 

EXPERIENCE THE 16 BIT SYNTH

Get the adrenaline pumping with the 16 bit-inspired score.

4596560.name: Inner Sun: Episode Zero
4596560.about_the_game:
Awakening in the Silence of a Dead Ship

The past has been erased along with the flight logs. Instead of a planned colonization, there is only a wreck in orbit and an unknown number of years spent in cryosleep. On the surface of a planet once envisioned as humanity's salvation, different laws now hold sway. Here, reality is malleable, and the boundaries between consciousness and matter have all but vanished.

Key Features:

  • A World of Shifting Forms: Surreal landscapes inspired by the worlds of Jean Giraud. The planet's ecosystem reacts to human presence, manifesting hidden fears and fragmented memories as lethal anomalies.

  • A Feral Legacy: Scattered human settlements grown from the ruins of former ideals. Through 250 years of silence, history has dissolved into myth, and technology has become an object of religious worship.

  • Combatting Illusions: Dynamic encounters with entities whose very nature defies biology. Survival demands more than just reflexes; it requires the ability to discern true threats from the mirages conjured by the planet's atmosphere.

  • A Vertical Journey: The path leads through anomalous deserts and zones of distorted gravity, straight into the planet's depths. Each descent further reveals the true purpose of this world, which hides something in its core more ancient than life itself.

Truth Hidden Beyond the Event Horizon

The search for answers becomes an archaeology of the self. But what awaits at the end of the road, when the planet begins to speak the language of the universe’s existence, and the laws of physics finally cease to apply?

4596590.name: PlaneWorld
4596590.about_the_game:
PlaneWorld is a 2D pixel art survival and exploration game where you build, mine and survive in procedurally generated worlds.

Explore a Living World

Roam 8 unique biomes — forests, deserts, jungles, snowy tundras, mushroom islands and more — with caves, hidden structures and treasures to discover.

Survive and Progress

Manage your health, hunger and oxygen. Craft tools and armor in 5 materials and enchant your equipment.

Face 5 Epic Bosses

From the Slime King to the World Core, each boss delivers an intense multi-phase fight.

Build and Farm

Over 156 blocks, 4 crop types, animal breeding, fishing and cooking — the world is yours.

155 Steam Achievements

Challenges for every playstyle, from casual to hardcore.

4 difficulty modes — including Hardcore (permadeath)
4596590.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain

4596650.name: Hentai Turbulence
4596650.about_the_game:
Embark on a relaxing journey with Hentai Turbulence, where calming levels await as you progress, soothing your mind with each solved puzzle.

Hentai Turbulence offers a cozy puzzle experience where you simply swap bricks to piece together beautiful images. As you progress, each stage becomes a gentle blend of challenge and comfort, encouraging you to unwind while steadily improving your focus and observation skills.

Feel stuck? No worries, hints are there to help! Each hint guides you toward the right move without breaking immersion, letting you enjoy the flow of the puzzle at your own pace while keeping frustration far away.

4596740.name: Itsy Bitsy Spider: Vengeance
4596740.about_the_game:
"The Itsy Bitsy Spider went up the waterspout

Down came the rain and washed the spider out

Out came the sun and dried up all the rain

And the Itsy Bitsy Spider went up the spout again."

But this time, it’s personal.

Play as the Itsy Bitsy Spider, make your way up the waterspout while shooting down enemies, and overthrow the tyrannical tarantula who's hoarding the spout. Keep an eye on the time, you don't want to get washed out!

Itsy Bitsy Spider: Vengeance is a fast paced movement shooter game where you use your many spider abilities such as grappling to get up the water spout before the rain flushes you out. watch out for Big T's minions who will try to slow you down while you are trying to get up the pipe, shoot them before they have a chance to stop you. Once you get to the top of the pipe you must defeat Big T in order to free the pipe from his tyrannical rule and live happily ever after at the top of the pipe.

4596750.name: SNUFF
4596750.about_the_game:
The US West Coast. Los Frontera. Hell on Earth. This town is known as the center of the snuff industry—the production of videos containing real murders, which are subsequently sold on the black market. Finding such a tape here is easier than a loaf of bread.

Alan Baker has lived here as long as he can remember. A seasoned junkie, he is obsessed with snuff, like most of the city’s residents. Living in one apartment with Joseph, his friend, and Anya, whom he cares about, Alan gets by doing odd jobs and dealing drugs. All so he can get his hands on another tape.

An unsuccessful attempt to start a romance throws him off balance, but it doesn’t make him give up. Alan tries to find the best tape to impress Anya, but her unexpected disappearance turns everything upside down. The truth becomes clear when Alan finds the film from the new collection, which contains the brutal murder of the woman he loved.

When the first emotions subsided, a thirst for revenge began to consume him. The bubbling hatred, like acid, eats away at him from within.

He will kill everyone who is responsible for Anya’s death—the only thing that still brought him joy. They won’t escape. None of them will escape accountability.

GAMEPLAY OVERVIEW

  • SNUFF is an FPS immersive sim that combines many game mechanics, and the player can use any of them at their discretion.

  • The world is consumed with filth. Los Frontera is a center of the snuff industry and a crime-ridden city. Murder and human cruelty have been turned into a profitable industry. Several large gangs have, in fact, taken control of the city. The police and local authorities exist only on paper and can’t actually affect the current situation. The black market in this area has now become just as common as any legitimate one.

  • Multiple paths, chosen by you. Game situations can be approached in different ways. Negotiate, sneak past them, pretend to be one of them, or just kill everyone in your way. The decision is yours.

  • A reactive world and NPCs. The world is not static. Your actions will, in the end, have consequences. Both local and global.

  • The combat system. Use the environment as a weapon. Fire the revolver hidden deep inside the trash container, or just break off a piece of rusty rebar at the construction site and use it as a makeshift tool to get rid of the problem in the form of a person.

  • The limited inventory. Alan’s pockets are not boundless. There is a limit to how many items he can carry at once; each item takes up space.

  • Honor system. Your actions have long-term consequences. Kill or spare, save or doom, help or push away.

4596770.name: Sweet Hentai
4596770.about_the_game:
Sweet Hentai - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game featuring five pretty and cute girls with unusual personalities. Experience their daily lives on the streets at night with lighthearted music. After completing a level, you can view the girls' photos in the gallery.

- The game has three difficulty levels: 2x2, 2x4, and 4x4.

- Press "F" during the puzzle to reveal a black and white image.

- Press the 'Space' key during gameplay to complete the puzzle.

- Players can use the A and D keys, left and right arrow keys, or left and right mouse buttons to quickly view the girls' images in the gallery.

* Puzzle image size: 800x960 px

* Gallery image size: 1088x960 px

4596780.name: The Defective One
4596780.about_the_game:
The high school band for the warm-up performance of the school anniversary. They began to pluck the strings in the season when the sycamore leaves fall, making sounds that are either restrained or unrestrained. Express yourself, sing your rock and roll.

 

In a public high school in Chinese mainland in the 2020s, the high school band continued to rehearse the warm-up program after the transgender female Cheng Xiaoyi joined. Follow the options to write your rock and roll attitude.

 

During the game, choose your opinions on everyone's various views in the band.

 

The five members of the band:

Jing Zijun, drummer

 

Lin Yiyan, keyboardist and lead singer

 

Chen Jiwei, guitarist

 

Cheng Xiaoyi, guitarist

 

And our protagonist, bassist

 

Game Content:

Single storyline, choices in the game will not change the overall direction of the game's plot.

 

Note: Contains LGBTQ+

4596790.name: Hostage Down
4596790.about_the_game:
Eloquence and the Weight of Words: Your Only Arsenal

In a setting straight out of an 80s crime film, you’ve been given a mission: you alone possess the gift of persuasion. In Hostage Down, your only tools are your charisma, your persuasive skills, and your composure. Here, you’ll quickly realize that the weight of words is your only reality—every syllable can save a life or trigger total chaos.

Facing you? The most unstable, stubborn, and magnificently absurd personalities imaginable. Every line you type (or speak) is a move in a psychological seduction game. Will you be able to defuse the situation and raise the diplomacy meter through a verbal police simulation and an immersive conversation system?

A Comedy of Situations—Written by You

A spiritual successor to the greatest dialogue duels of adventure games, the game throws you into legendary face-offs. Your mission? Bring extraordinary hostage-takers back to their senses—with style—and handle the most bizarre crises:

  • Live Trip Tour: An influencer willing to do anything to grab “available brain time.”

  • The Green Pirate: An eco-conscious assault led at full speed aboard a hijacked supertanker.

  • Pink Justice: A court of flamingos where etiquette is a matter of life and death.

  • Rebellious Smart Home: A smart fridge that has taken your kitchen hostage.

  • The Anti-Capitalist Santa Claus: The grand finale against the most furious unionist of December 25th.

And many more: feathered ambassadors, paranoid survivalists, and a high-speed train of absolute silence.

Hostage Down: The Art of Negotiation Powered by AI

Thanks to a cutting-edge language model (LLM), the game interprets the real intent behind your words in real time. Your success depends on your creativity, your humor, and your ability to charm—and manipulate—your counterpart. The AI responds with surgical precision to your arguments, allowing you to fully improvise your dialogue to defuse conflicts.

🚀 Key Features

  • Open Dialogue System: Say or type anything. The AI reacts to the strength of your arguments, your narrative choices, and your sense of manipulation.

  • Comedy & Satire: Darkly humorous scenarios designed to test your patience against wildly unhinged hostage-takers.

  • Dynamic Psychometrics: An emotional impact meter that analyzes whether you’re charming, angering, or traumatizing your counterpart during absurd crises.

  • 100% Tension, Non-Violent Gameplay: The adrenaline of a high-stakes police simulation, and the satisfaction of finding the perfect compromise through nothing but wit and humor.

4596850.name: 卑怯な勇者を許さない！～魔王の娘とダンジョン作り～
4596850.about_the_game:
ダンジョンを作って、卑怯な勇者をやっつけろ！

「薬草」を使って回復したり

4596860.name: Idle Protocol
4596860.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Mainframe

Idle Protocol is a minimalist sci-fi tower defense / idle incremental game where tactical loadouts and economy management meet raw, exponential firepower. Set in a dark, neon-lit digital void, your goal is simple: manage a central CPU core and defend against an endless swarm of geometric anomalies.

Dual-Core Tactical Combat
Forget building complicated mazes. In Idle Protocol, you equip exactly 2 active Nodes (Towers) to face the swarm. Choose from 5 distinct weapons, including:

  • Kernel: A balanced central core that focuses on consistent damage and devastating critical strikes.

  • Surge: A high-fire rate node that unleashes devastating Chain Lightning.

  • Solaris: A heavy sniper that applies intense Thermal/Burn damage.

  • Trojan: A viral node that applies Damage over Time through Malware.

  • Cluster: An unstable containment unit focusing on Explosion/AoE damage.


Deep Meta-ProgressionHit an economic wall? Perform a System Reboot to prestige and earn Cycles. Spend your Cycles in the BIOS—a massive Hexagonal Grid Layout skill tree—to unlock game-changing Ultimate abilities like "Infinite Loop" or "Supernova". Defeating Bosses also grants Upgrade Points (Chips) for the Circuit tab to further optimize your build.


The True End Game: Quarantine Protocols
This isn't just an endless grind. Reach Wave 500 to unlock the true endgame: Quarantine Protocols. Initiate a run with up to 5 brutal modifiers—like the No-Click Protocol or Monocore restrictions—to prove your architectural mastery and unlock exclusive Alternate Skins for your nodes.

Key Features:

  • Minimalist Aesthetics: High contrast neon graphics with Bloom and subtle CRT/Scanlines effects.

  • Respects Your Time: Fast-paced fixed wave spawns and Offline Progress that grants 50% of normal earnings while the game is closed.

  • Dynamic Scaling: Watch your damage output skyrocket into the Trillions as projectiles dynamically grow in size and sound heavier based on their level.

  • Built-in Achievements: Track your progress with 50 unique milestones and an integrated Stats Tracking System.

4596870.name: NumberMaxxing
4596870.about_the_game:
Add, subtract, and build bigger combos

NumberMaxxing is a numeric match-3 roguelike where you do not swap pieces into place. Instead, every move lets you add or subtract one sphere into another, changing its value and reshaping the board in real time.

Turn momentum into massive scores

A strong move can snowball fast. Combos can chain into cascades, overlaps, and multiplier spikes, rewarding both quick pattern recognition and smart setup. The goal is not just to score, but to turn the board into a growing engine of points.

Build a run around powerful synergies

Between rounds, expand your run with upgrades and items that push you toward different strategies. Focus on specific colors, scale your scoring, chase economy, or lean into chain-heavy builds that can spiral out of control.

As your run goes on, you will:

  • Create combos by rewriting the board’s numbers

  • Trigger cascades, overlaps, and score spikes

  • Buy upgrades and items that push specific strategies

  • Scale into absurd runs where one move can set off a massive chain

4596910.name: The King’s Messenger
4596910.about_the_game:
Face the Changing Skies

Ride through ever-changing weather as your journey unfolds. From heavy rain to freezing snow, each condition shapes your path and challenges your endurance.

Defend Yourself on the Road

Danger lurks beyond every hill. Bandits will ambush you without warning fight back, survive, and protect the message at all costs.

Survive the Journey

Manage your hunger, thirst, and exhaustion while making crucial decisions along the way. Search for supplies, gather loot, and choose wisely every step could be your last.
4596910.supported_languages: English, German, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese, Polish, Russian, Turkish, French

4596930.name: Mysteries of the House
4596930.about_the_game:
"You wake up with no memories inside the House, a place where reality bends... lies linger... and someone watching your every move."

✦ ✦ ✦

Mysteries of the House is a compiled visual novel series consisting of three main stories: The Jester and the Prince, The Phantom and the Sun, and The Maiden and the Moon. Play as Ellian (name customizable) as he uncovers the secrets of the House, home to powerful individuals and its peculiar creator.

✦ ✦ ✦

STORY 1: The Jester and the Prince 🎭👑

✧ Synopsis: You find yourself waking up with no memories, trapped in a room with two talking drawings. As you investigate to uncover clues about your whereabouts and a way to escape, it becomes clear that there's more to the situation than meets the eye.

✤ MEET THE MAIN CAST ✤

✦ ✦ ✦

STORY 2: The Phantom and the Sun 🎩☀️

✧ Synopsis: After the incident with the Jester and the Prince, you are placed under the watchful eyes of the Phantom and the Sun. Under the Creator's order, the three of you are assigned to track down Mystery, an infamous thief causing chaos in the shadows. As your investigation deepens, it becomes clear that more characters are caught up in this twisted stage play than you originally thought.

✤ MEET THE MAIN CAST ✤

✦ ✦ ✦

STORY 3: The Maiden and the Moon ☕🌙

✧ Synopsis: The Maiden presents an old, mysterious book gifted to her by a House visitor. Unbeknownst to everyone, the book is cursed. Before they know it, they're transported to a world called "Wonderland". Will they find their way back home, or will they succumb to the darkness stirring within this magical world?

✤ MEET THE MAIN CAST ✤

✦ ✦ ✦

GAME FEATURES:

Special Episode 2: A Christmas Miracle

4597020.name: Palimpsest
4597020.about_the_game:
Something is wrong in Millfield, and no one else seems to notice.

Palimpsest is a narrative psychological horror game about exploring familiar spaces that slowly become unfamiliar. Through subtle environmental shifts and layered storytelling, uncover hidden meaning through your own memory.

Set in the quiet town of Millfield, the game follows Nolan, a teenage theater worker who begins noticing unsettling changes in the world around him: shifts in Millfield that no one else seems to question.

After discovering mysterious TV equipment left behind by his father, Nolan is drawn into something deeper. As he is guided toward the truth, the world seems to resist his exploration.

A World That Changes

Explore a world where environments evolve. Familiar spaces shift through subtle changes, breaking patterns, and turning the ordinary into something unsettling.

Observe, Interact, Solve

Progress by noticing what others ignore. Detect subtle differences, interact with objects, and solve puzzles where the key is observation.

A Layered Psychological Experience

Experience Millfield through shifting pixel art and grounded, realistic perspectives. Through environmental storytelling and atmosphere over action, uncover a narrative hidden within observation, repetition, and memory.

4597030.name: Hillforts
4597030.about_the_game:
Hillforts is a medieval card-based autobattler.

  • Build an army: recruit and place units from the shop

  • Research technologies: upgrade your army, economy, or town

  • Upgrade your units: merge to discover stronger versions

  • Siege the enemy castle: build synergies and break through

4597060.name: The Throwing Pinecones Into A Campfire Game
4597060.about_the_game:
Tend the fire. Outlast the dark.

You wake up in a clearing. A campfire. A chair. A journal on the table. Pine trees in every direction. The fire is the

only thing keeping the dark out — and the dark wants in.

The Loop

  • Gather — Pinecones drop from the pines around your camp. Pick them up by hand or fill a bucket to haul more in a single trip.

  • Feed the fire — Empty your bucket into the campfire. Fuel keeps the light alive; overfeed it and the excess burns down into embers.

  • Upgrade — Sit in the chair, open the journal, and spend embers on slower decay, bigger buckets, faster cone drops, and more. Spend more to stock up on extra buckets and torches.

Sanity Is a Resource Too

The longer you spend in the dark, the less you trust what you see. Footsteps that aren't yours. Whispers between the

trunks. Shapes at the edge of the firelight that aren't there when you turn to look.

And not everything out there is in your head.

Stay close to the fire. Or don't.

Co-Op Around the Campfire

Bring friends. Hand off the bucket. Split up to scout farther trees while one of you tends the flame. Proximity voice

chat means the closer you are, the clearer they sound — and the farther you wander, the more alone you really are.

Features

  • Campfire fuel + ember economy with meaningful upgrades

  • Sit-and-read journal UI for a slow, grounded upgrade ritual

  • Sanity system tied to the firelight — the dark drains you, the fire brings you back

  • Solo or Steam co-op with 3D proximity voice chat

  • Bucket, torch, chair, journal — every object has a job

Don't Let It Go Out

If you let it go out… It will come in.
4597060.game_link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4597060/The Throwing Pinecones Into A Campfire Game/

4597170.name: AeroWave OS
4597170.about_the_game:
Fight computer viruses on the beat with your Virtual Assistant!

The year is 2008, you are a high schooler that is obsessed with your computer. Every day you come home from school and run to your computer to play games and speak to your friends on the messaging app. 

You have downloaded one of those new and popular desktop mascots, and she is different from anything else you’ve ever seen. She feels real and is so creative and autonomous, almost like a real person.

Help her defeat the computer viruses by destroying them with music!

Features

𝄞⨾ Nostalgic Frutiger Aero and old internet aesthetic

𝄞⨾ Your own adorable desktop pet, Mirai!

𝄞⨾ Original and cool songs!

𝄞⨾ Addicting gameplay

𝄞⨾ Highscores for you to share and compete with friends

Controls

4597220.name: Lost Sock Simulator 3000
4597220.about_the_game:
Help Gertrude Knitmore find all her lost socks.

Science has cured diseases. Engineering has put humans on the moon. And yet, where do her socks go?

Nobody knows. Nobody has ever known. Until Gertrude.

Lost Sock Simulator 3000 is the groundbreaking idle clicker that finally answers humanity's oldest question by leaning fully into the chaos. Click to collect socks. Buy increasingly unhinged sock-production operations. Watch your empire of missing hosiery grow from a single lonely tube sock into an incomprehensible mountain of footwear that defies the laws of physics, economics, and good taste.

Start with nothing but determination and a suspicious washing machine. Reinvest your socks into bigger, weirder sock-generating machinery. Ascend through levels of sock-fueled madness as your production per second climbs from "found one hidden in the washing machine" to ludicrous numbers.

Features:

  • Satisfying numbers that get so big they stopped fitting on a normal screen

  • A deeply scientific sock-clicking system backed by zero peer-reviewed research

  • 10 generators of escalating absurdity. Go from a simple "Sock Drawer" to an omnipotent "Sock God". Because one sock source was never going to be enough

  • A granny that needs your help and has strong opinions about your sock accumulation pace

  • An ending. Yes, there is an ending. The universe has opinions about your sock collection.

Whether you play for five minutes or five hours, Lost Sock Simulator 3000 will leave you with one certainty: you were always meant to do this.

The socks were never lost. They were waiting for you.

4597310.name: Blood Brides
4597310.about_the_game:
Enter a grim, demon-ravaged medieval world in Blood Brides, an immersive survival shooter that blends methodical gunplay with oppressive dark fantasy. You are a lone knight armed not with crossbow alone, but with rare and powerful firearms—tools of precision in a land consumed by chaos.

Across shattered realms, corrupted by infernal forces, fallen princess-rulers await their fate. Once noble, now broken, they stand at the center of each realm’s collapse. Will you free them from their torment… or claim them as your own in a far darker way?

Key Features:

  • Precision-Based Combat
    Engage in deliberate, skill-driven gunplay where targeting specific body parts determines the outcome of each encounter. Cripple enemies, control the battlefield, and survive overwhelming odds.

  • Expanded Arsenal of Steel and Fire

    Wield a diverse arsenal that bridges eras: razor-sharp blades, brutal melee weapons, and rare, handcrafted firearms ranging from primitive rifles to devastating shotguns. Adapt your combat style to every encounter, seamlessly shifting between close-quarters brutality and calculated ranged precision.

  • Brutal Dismemberment System
    Enemies react dynamically to every shot and strike, with a visceral dismemberment system that lets you tear them apart piece by piece. Blast off limbs to cripple movement and attacks, sever arms to disarm threats, or land precise shots to shatter skulls instantly. Each enemy type responds differently to damage, turning every encounter into a tactical decision—disable, control, or destroy. The brutality is not just visual, but deeply tied to gameplay, reinforcing the unforgiving nature of this dying world.

    Oppressive Dark Fantasy Setting
    Explore cursed lands, abandoned strongholds, and broken kingdoms under demonic control, all brought to life with a heavy, atmospheric tone.

  • Choice and Consequence
    The fate of each fallen ruler lies in your hands. Salvation, domination, or something far more unsettling—your decisions shape both the world and its inhabitants.

  • Mature and Disturbing Themes
    Blood Brides explores dark, adult subject matter through stylized sequences that push the boundaries of morality and power.

4597340.name: (The Ballad of) Igooli and Hakmon
4597340.about_the_game:
Igooli, a static blue circle, used to just be and love it. Until its existence was shaken up by Hakmon — an energy-filled, massless red circle bursting with a lust for action. Together, the two can produce a powerful laser that propels the pair forward, eviscerating everything in its way. Powerful as they are, Igooli and Hakmon's mortality is as fragile as a sheet of glass: if they touch anything, they cease existing.

Game features:

  • Play in a fully hand painted 2D and 3D world 

  • Experience a single-player story filled with boss fights and quests

  • Survive an endless onslaught of resisting entities in the score-chasing Arcade mode

  • Navigate an infinite obstacle course in a procedurally generated endless runner

  • Collect oil-painted bonuses, acquired by performing unique challenges and actions

4597470.name: City Cleaning
4597470.about_the_game:
City Cleaning is a meditative and calming adventure that will allow you to escape the hustle and bustle of everyday life and immerse yourself in a tranquil atmosphere. In this game, your task is to transform the city streets, clearing them of dirt and debris and restoring their former beauty.

Use a variety of tools and equipment to complete cleaning tasks. Each action requires attention, making the process not only rewarding but also engaging.

As you progress through the levels, you'll encounter new challenges that will require a creative approach!

Game Features:

- Various difficulty levels

- Beautiful graphics

- Pleasant music

4597480.name: Cosmic Distortion
4597480.about_the_game:
Cosmic Distortion is a thrilling, high-speed game where you take control of a spaceship and race through an endless cosmic tunnel! Your goal is to deftly dodge all sorts of obstacles, collect points, and try to beat your own high score.

Features:

- Excellent graphics

- Pleasant soundtrack

- A variety of spaceships

4597490.name: Infected World
4597490.about_the_game:
Infected World is a physics-based puzzle game with object destruction!

Embark on a thrilling adventure amidst a zombie outbreak! Your task is to use powerful weapons to battle hordes of the undead and defend your lands. Destroy obstacles and eliminate zombies using strategy and precision. Every decision matters, and only the bravest will be able to overcome all levels and restore order to this chaos!

Game Features:

- Multiple levels

- Complete object destruction

- Physics

- Colorful graphics

4597510.name: Path of Survival
4597510.about_the_game:
In "Path of Survival" you'll take control of a powerful car and embark on a thrilling journey through a zombie-infested world. Your goal is to reach the finish line while shooting down the walking dead that have invaded everything and are everywhere.

Can you beat the clock and reach the finish line, becoming a hero in this crazy world? Don't let the zombies stop you!

★★★ Features ★★★

• Colorful graphics

• Atmospheric soundtrack

• Multiple levels

4597520.name: Postal Expedition
4597520.about_the_game:
Postal Expedition is an exciting 3D game where you get behind the wheel of your van and collect all the letters as quickly as possible.

As a postman, you'll carefully navigate narrow streets, cramped courtyards, and tangled alleys, collecting all the scattered letters in the shortest possible time. Maneuver nimbly, avoid obstacles, and demonstrate true driving skill. Show off your skills and become the fastest postman in the game!

★★★ Features ★★★

- Colorful graphics

- Great soundtrack

- Multiple levels

4597620.name: Grind Up
4597620.about_the_game:
Grind Up is a first-person simulation game with pixel graphics. Produce, collect, grind items, earn money, upgrade your grinder, and play strategically under time pressure. Start working toward your first million dollars.

Collect the items dropped from the production machine and toss them into the grinder, collect the cash, and get rich.

Upgrade your grinder, increase your production capacity, and obtain more valuable items. Each upgrade lets you earn more money and reach your fortune faster.

Every morning your debt grows heavier, every morning the opportunities get bigger. Balance your finances, increase your income, and keep your boss calm. If you postpone your debts too much, you’ll get fired!

Watch your earnings grow as you smoke cigars, reward yourself… and no, smoking cigars won’t actually speed up your work.

Your goal is to reach one million dollars. Increase your income, manage your debts, and achieve your fortune. Remember: reaching your first $100,000 is harder than reaching your first million.

4597630.name: CHROMALEES
4597630.about_the_game:
CHROMALEES: a cute/dark atmospheric, Singleplayer 2D puzzle-platformer built around colour-based mechanics and environmental mystery and storytelling!

FEATURES

  • Atmospheric Narrative: Unravel the mystery of the Vivo Basin through NPC dialogue and environmental storytelling. Piece together fragments of the past and confront what resides in the core of the island.

  • Exploration & Puzzles: Navigate through a progression of locations filled to the brim with secrets for the keen-eyed; Solve a variety of colour-based, mechanical, spatial, and lateral puzzles in order to progress.

  • Environments: Explore an eerie lost world shaped by decay, with each chapter taking place on a new section of the island with distinct atmospheres to discover.

  • Immersive Audio & Visual Design: Lose yourself in carefully painted landscapes and ambience...
    accompanied by a moody original soundtrack, and minimalist, CRT-inspired visuals.

GAMEPLAY

  • Step into the shoes (or rather.. paws) of a small fox as you explore a monochrome island known as the VIVO BASIN over the course of 5 chapters.

  • Use The Prism to manipulate colour in the environment to solve interconnected, creative/lateral thinking puzzles.

  • Uncover narrative fragments, meet a range of distinct characters, and gradually unravel the mystery behind the island, its strange systems, and it's past.

  • Discover hidden secrets scattered throughout the island

MILD CONTENT WARNING

This game contains mild themes and content that may not be suitable for younger players.
(More information will be added closer to release)

4597670.name: Spud Keeper
4597670.about_the_game:
Survive the seasons. Defend your crop. Harvest your spuds.

Spud Keeper is a wave-defense action game with incremental and roguelite elements, where you protect your potato plants from escalating pest attacks by collecting and smashing bugs, earning rewards, and upgrading your tools to survive longer.

COLLECT BUGS!

They will come from burrows in waves and attack the potatoes. Collect them from the potato plants before they are drained.

RELEASE 'EM!

Empty out your bucket in the smashing area so that you can pick-up next batch of bugs.

SMASH 'EM!

Clear the smashing area to earn coins and survive waves and seasons!

BUY NEW TOOLS!

Spend your Coins in run-based shop and spend Spuds in meta-progression shop

4597770.name: Sisyphus Conviction
4597770.about_the_game:
Sisyphus Conviction:

The Greek Myth of Sisyphus now made a 2D Pixel-Art, incremental Clicker. Follow a condemned King who challenged Death several times, but finally paying for his sins against the Gods. 4597850.name: Atmos
4597850.about_the_game:
ATMOS - is a fast paced action roguelike inspired by HADES with elements from ULTRAKILL. You shoot, you slash and you can also smash, while collecting items, upgrading your gear and diving deeper into the story!

CONTINENT OF STEAM

In the not-so-vast lands of Atmos, filled with mountains and technology, you will indulge in an adventure as Diann - a marvelous fella, who is an airhead with great mind, despite how contradictory that sounds. After finding his dad's diary, he decided to set on a travel in order to find him wherever he might be.

CUSTOMIZATION

This game is built on the premise of "customization" primarily inspired by Team Fortress 2. You can choose one of the numerous classes present in the game and further customize them with different weapons, ability variations and runes, to match YOUR way of playing the game.

VARIETY

Randomness of the domains might be scary, but that's the beauty of the game! That's THE THRILL of it! Of course you might need some heavy decision-making in the process, but come-on - you gotta start somewhere. And don't worry, the domain will reward you for your suffering with lots of different artifacts and upgrades that change the way you play and interact with your chosen loadout even further. Nothing is off-limits when it comes to sheer build variety in here.

STORY

Engage with the story of Diann's adventure by interacting with the colorful cast of characters. Experience hundreds of different story events, as you learn more and more about them

4597870.name: Minnow
4597870.about_the_game:
-ABOUT MINNOW-

-Minnow is a troubled young girl who uses her thought and dreams as a well-needed escape from her harsh reality. Introverted and misunderstood, she spends most of her time in her room reading, collecting circuit boards, playing video games and writing stories about her wildest fantasies. 

-EXPLORE-

-Uncover her thoughts, her hopes and her fears. Take a trip with her and explore Minnow's vast, absurd and colourful dreams, each one with unique original music, visuals and atmosphere. 

Explore the deepest depths of Minnow's mind, discovering what her past, her present and her future holds.

4597900.name: Ampsball
4597900.about_the_game:
Ampsball is a 5v5 action-packed sport that combines superhero powers under the beautiful Southern California sunshine. Grab a pair of sunglasses, a beach towel, and your most wrinkled cape for a sport that will make your arch-nemeses want to join in.

SUPERPOWERED CHOICES

  • Mix and match with 6+ distinct super-themes and 4 unique superpowers. Become the hero or villain you’ve always dreamed of being... even though you're just going to try out every possible combination.

  • Express your personality with dozens of unique appearances and vibrant color palettes to ensure your hero looks the part. Alternatively, be indecisive and rock the default costume to look just like everyone else.

SPORT AND COMBAT

  • Pick up and play across 7+ fields each dimensionally unique and intriguingly quirky. Try not to get distracted by the scenery or the giant bat though. 

  • Bring the action with 5v5 online multiplayer fun. Don't be intimidated by the chaos as someone on the enemy team is bound to be AFK anyway. 

  • Connect with your best friends or host a league in a 10-player public or private lobby. Play by your own house rules. We don't keep track of what you do anyway.

THE WORLD

  • Experience the world in a whole new light with beautiful atmospheric variations. From gorgeous neon sunsets and bright clear skies, to blinding laser projectiles from enemy fire. 

  • The battle rages post-match with intense combat in seamless open world chaos. Just try not to hit any of the invisible walls planted there by the arch-villains. 

  • Developed and tested on a low-range PC, expect high-fidelity graphics on most modern hardware. It’s time to squeeze some extra mileage out of that toaster of yours.

4597990.name: O Monumento
4597990.about_the_game:
Explore the mysterious disappearance of the Royal Family in a secretive plaza that hides many secrets. "O Monumento" is a first-person short game of puzzles and investigation, featuring a time-limited mechanic—be quick or you’ll lose all the clues.

  • Run and Solve - Which means that every minute counts, something is causing all the clues to disappear over time, so you have until then to answer all the questions.

  • Take Notes - It is very important that you have something to write down all the valuable information and answers.

  • Clues - Finding items won't be so easy, they are hidden in many places, and nothing will suggest that they can be picked up or that they are a clue.

4598030.name: Endless Harvest
4598030.about_the_game:
Endless Harvest is relaxing yet strategic incremental farming game where every crop you place changes the efficiency of your growing plot of land. Grow crops, unlock upgrades, and optimize your farm as much as possible!

Your goal is to increase your profit by optimizing your farm layout, where crop placement matters due to various abilities and synergies. Use that profit to unlock new crops which bring even more powerful interactions and meaningful decisions. Experiment with different layouts to see which one brings you the most money. 

Endless Harvest allows you to choose the way you play the game, whether you prefer a calm experience, or a mathematical madness of maximizing profit. Grow, Expand and refine your farm into a highly sophisticated system.

4598070.name: Strict Sensei
4598070.about_the_game:
You’re a 21-year-old medical student struggling to focus. No matter how hard you try, you're unable to concentrate on your studies.

Desperate for help, you ask your intimidating professor Shizuka for guidance, and she writes a custom essay specifically for you after you promise that you'll study and take your education seriously—but the very next day, she catches you slacking off at the newly opened waterpark. Infuriated, she decides to punish you.

Experience a day of being punished by Shizuka, your 199-cm-tall, no-nonsense, super-strict sensei.

Features:

  • ~2.2K words

  • Kinetic novel

  • 22 Unique character animations

  • 29 Total images

  • A gallery featuring all animations in the game

4598190.name: Fill The Void
4598190.about_the_game:
Fill The Void is a physics-driven action game where you play as a black hole. Slide across surfaces, open your mouth, and swallow everything in sight. A butterfly. A bowling pin. A slot machine. A whole hibachi grill. A syscraper. Every object you consume makes you larger, faster, and hungrier. Nothing is ever quite enough.

Grow. Transform. Devour.

Shift between two forms: a void that crawls across surfaces and eats the world from below, and a sphere — a bouncing, rolling physics ball with a little pixel face — that jumps, dashes, and sticks to walls. Land on a new surface. Become the void again. Eat everything. Move on. Repeat at a larger scale.

Strange places, strange meals.

Every level is a themed diorama packed with things that are about to be consumed. Butterfly sanctuaries. Bowling alleys. Coconut orchards. Casinos. Hibachi joints. Christmas lodges. Midnight oases. Block parties. Each one rendered in a distinctive visual style and unique collectable items that make up the level.

Features:

A Katamari-inspired action game about being a black hole that consumes, grows, and morphs

Shift between hole mode and sphere mode — eat, grow, jump, dash, wall-stick, repeat

Your sphere has a procedural pixel face — seven expressions that react to how you play

Themed diorama levels full of objects to consume, slice apart, and destroy

Unlock abilities, costumes, and fill a gallery of everything you've ever eaten

A handcrafted visual style: screen-locked textures, CRT effects, gravitational lensing, and edge outlines

Local split-screen versus and co-op

Gamepad and keyboard/mouse support

4598310.name: Uptime 99.9%: Datacenter Simulator
4598310.about_the_game:
Uptime 99.9%: Datacenter Simulator is a technical management simulation where you build, operate and maintain your own server infrastructure. Monitor system performance in real time as you balance CPU load, temperature and power consumption. Keep your systems running efficiently to maximize uptime, generate income and prevent failures that can disrupt your entire operation.

Start with a small setup and expand your datacenter. Install new servers, manage increasing load and optimize your infrastructure to achieve maximum stability and performance!

Operate and grow your own datacenter from the ground up and react to system issues accordingly. Improve your setup and push your infrastructure to its limits while maintaining control over performance and reliability.

Key Features

  • Manager your own Datacenter

Deploy and operate multiple server types across rack slots and expand your infrastructure over time.

  • Real-time system simulation

Track CPU usuage, temperature and power consumption as your systems run under load.

  • Prevent failures and downtime

Overheating, crashing and shutdowns impact your uptime and revenue directly.

  • Earn and expand

Maintain stable systems to generate income and reinvest into new hardware and upgrades.

  • Optimize for efficiency

Balance performance and stability to keep your uptime as high as possible.

4598380.name: OverRead
4598380.about_the_game:
CONSUME TEXT AT THE SPEED OF THOUGHT.

OverRead is an experimental reading utility that offers a new way to engage and flow with text. Utilizing a customizable R.S.V.P. (Rapid Serial Visual Presentation) engine, OverRead is designed to help you devour novels, documents, and technical manuals at blazing speeds by eliminating the physical limitations of traditional reading.

When reading a standard page, your eyes are forced to constantly scan back and forth across lines—a mechanical process known as saccades that causes eye fatigue and limits your reading speed. OverRead bypasses this entirely. By locking your eyes onto a single Optical Recognition Point (O.R.P.), the text is flashed directly into your focal center word by word.

No scanning. No losing your place. Just a literal psychological "flow state" where information is absorbed directly into your consciousness.

FEATURES:

  • The R.S.V.P. Engine: Experience reading in a frictionless environment. Eliminate eye strain and easily push your reading speed to 300, 500, or even 800+ Words Per Minute.

  • Import Your Own Library: Bring your own documents. OverRead natively supports importing local `.TXT` and `.PDF` files. The system automatically extracts the text and tracks your exact word-by-word progress.

  • Tune Your Cognitive Uplink: The human brain has limits, but the terminal is yours to command. Adjust your target "Baud Rate" (WPM) on the fly, and use the "Gradual Speed-Up" feature to ease your brain into high-speed playback automatically.

  • Optical Customization: Tailor the visual feed to your specific needs. Adjust font scaling, highlight letter positioning, and choose from multiple curated interface themes—from crisp Daylight, to vintage Monochrome Archives.

SYSTEM COMPATIBILITY NOTE:

Please be aware that OverRead’s visual anchoring technique is explicitly designed for alphabetic languages (such as English, Spanish, German, French, etc.). Logographic writing systems (including Chinese and Japanese) rely on entirely different cognitive parsing mechanisms and are not currently optimized or officially supported by this specific R.S.V.P. protocol.

4598570.name: Mount buzhou
4598570.about_the_game:
岁在辛未，民国二十载

辛亥革命的烈火曾将封建帝制彻底焚毁，但一个真正独立民主的新中国并未从它的废墟中涅槃重生。

在三座大山的暴政之下，数千万劳苦大众归于黄土之中。

在无尽的内战与剥削面前，共和的最后灯火行将熄灭。

南京国民政府在北伐的血火中崛起，无数青年曾为那面青天白日旗在东征北伐中逝去。

但他们的牺牲换来的却是一场惨痛的背叛。

三民主义的宏伟蓝图，最终都化作了新军阀实行独裁的遮羞布。

它的军队因杂牌林立而如死尸般臃肿涩滞，它的中枢因派系倾轧而如马戏团般内讧不休。

各路大帅从南京国民政府脆弱的统一中貌合神离，维持着危如累卵的割据平衡。

在这片古老的土地上，列强的军舰和贪婪的租界正窃居于此。

无论是曾经闪耀的十里洋场上海，还是遥远富饶的东北平原，皆已落入或即将落入敌手。

山河破碎，兄弟阋墙。

无数仁人志士所思所想皆为同一，要将这个古老的国家按自己的愿景重新统一。

然而不同的人有不同的救国发想。

雨季的港岛裹着海腥味与铁锈的气息。

四一二与七一五的阴霾尚未散去，地下党人如同暗夜中的孤舟，在军统、巡捕房与列强利益的夹缝中艰难求生。

尽管它在白色恐怖中颜面丧尽，元气大伤，

但仍中国共产党决意在井冈山与瑞金的红土地上再次奋起对抗这吃人的世界，捍卫劳苦大众的生存。

你将作为扮演几名地下战争的亲历者，步入那个风雨飘摇、暗流涌动的亚细亚东岸。

护送关键人物踏上一条长达数千里的隐秘交通线。

从纸醉金迷的远东谍海，到百载商埠的暗流涌动；从汀江河畔的险恶山路，直到赤色黎明升起的中央苏区。

4598640.name: Soul Proprietor
4598640.about_the_game:
Step into the shadows as a Necromancer. Make the dead work for you.

Build a dark empire with supernatural entities.

Invest souls to expand your roster.

Sell minions to fund more powerful buildings.

Acquire Properties to serve as your Soul-factories.

Spend Souls on to automate your harvest.

4598740.name: System Shutdown
4598740.about_the_game: System Shutdown is a 3D VR action hack and slash. Players can expect encounters with multiple enemies, where they must carefully maneuver around their attacks in order to take them out. This game is a work in progress and proof of concept for a future video game I wish to pursue creating in the future.

4598750.name: Epic Card Battle Simulator
4598750.about_the_game:
What is an Epic Card Battle Simulator?

A Full card game auto-battler with no micro-transactions. The game-play flows from 2 different phases:

 1. Card Playing Phase: summon little dude into tactical positions, level them up by stacking identical cards to summon more, spend gold to refresh your hand and pull cards to play!

2. Battle Phase: the little dudes fight each other in a battle simulation, hands-off it's an auto-battler, they go until one side is wiped out!

lose 5 rounds and you've lost, however make your opponent lose 5 rounds and you win!

        

Play by yourself in a 1v1 asynchronous setting (battle current random player saves).

Or invite up-to 6 friends, doing random 1v1 battle rounds until 1 player is left with lives!
Also I actually made it so you can keep playing if you're out! Alive players board saves are put in a pool, while they're matched in 1v1 battles, eliminated players can still verse runs from that pool ... pretty epic!

Current Release Plan

  • In the coming weeks I'm doing network testing probably through Steam Play-testing, which will be to test the networking capabilities across different people's devices and with more people.

  • The free demo will contain 4 faction decks (Medieval Men, Lizard men, Orcs & Wildlife), & will include all modes including friend games! (Hopefully will be in the June Next Fest!!)

  • Full Release will have a few more factions decks, these will be added to the current pool of decks.

4598810.name: COLDSNAP
4598810.about_the_game:
Ignite the Heart of a Dying World

The planet Cadmus was once the galaxy's industrial crown jewel, but relentless mining has left it a hollow, frozen husk. As S.N.A.P., a repurposed reparations unit, you are the last spark of hope for this desolate world. Your directive is simple: descend through the layers of the planet's crust, restart the frozen center, and save your dying home.

Master the Heat

Wield Thermon, a powerful melee weapon fueled by pure thermal energy. Chain light and heavy attacks into devastating combos to juggle and decimate mechanical foes.

Evolve to Survive

No two descents are the same. As you fight deeper, customize your robot's capabilities to match the rising threat. Scavenge parts from fallen enemies to gain permanent stat boosts or consume them for immediate, massive surges in power.

The Pressure is On

Time is your enemy. The longer you take, the stronger the mechanical horde becomes. Activate the generators to power the massive drills that carry you deeper, then defend them against waves of enemies in a desperate race to the next layer.

Do you have the spark needed to thaw a dead planet?

4598880.name: Forgotten Depths
4598880.about_the_game:
Only you, your torch, and the echo of your own footsteps... You descend into the abyss in search of a mysterious artifact promised to fetch a handsome sum. But was it ever going to be that simple?

The stone slabs slam shut behind you. It’s terrifying enough to be trapped in a dungeon where a flickering torch is your only companion, but then... you hear it. The rattle of chains. Perhaps the situation is far worse than you imagined...

  • Explore claustrophobic halls where every turn could be your last.

  • Find notes and solve puzzles to find your way out.

  • Hide in tombs to evade the chase, but don't forget to douse your light.

  • Stay silent. He HEARS you. He SENSES your presence.

  • Something or someone does not want to let you leave.

Survive the depths. Reach the surface. Breathe the fresh air... if you can.

4598890.name: Click and Slash
4598890.about_the_game:
Click And Slash

Click and Slash is a desktop clicker: handle your daily tasks while staying productive. You’ll be able to track your clicks per day, week, and month, plus a percentage that evaluates your productivity accordingly. Perfect for forcing yourself to work! But don’t forget to upgrade your damage to make the cutest (and hottest) monsters in your region tremble.

You can also slack off watching your favorite movies—ones you’ve hunted down with your VPN! Because you can deal damage without clicking, all while watching your life flash before your eyes. Fill your encyclopedia with adorable, absurd monsters you’ve mercilessly tormented. You’re such a great person…

So, you know what to do?

After an unexplained biological mutation, humans evolved into Gény.

(Yes, evolution decided to flip science the bird by replacing our neurons with marshmallow clouds and our bones with gummy bears. Congrats, humanity has reached its ultimate stage: becoming a radioactive plushie with sugar addiction issues.)

They may be adorable enough to melt a heart of stone—these little furballs chirping "blip blop" as they bounce around—but don’t let their appearance fool you. One second, they look like a kitten raised by unicorns, and the next… they’ve got the face of a vegetable forgotten in the back of the fridge after a weekend bender. (The government’s new obsession? Connecting five synapses and neurons per day. What even is this? A failed molecular cooking experiment? A Rorschach test gone wrong? Doesn’t matter.)

Let’s get back to our sheep (or rather, our Gény): to escape the Playful Transformation Virus™ (patent pending, do not ingest), you’ll have to beat them until they take their last breath (or until your mouse gives up the ghost, your choice). Eradicate the entire Gény species—yes, even the one staring at you with those big puppy-dog eyes. (Sorry, kid, but humanity’s survival comes before your right to exist as a cursed toy.)

Once you’ve harvested enough Energy Particles™, you might have a chance to escape. Or not. Because in the end, you’ll probably end up as Post-Apocalyptic Veggie Mash™—that delicious genetically modified sludge that feeds the surviving Gény. (Basically, you’ve become fast food for the end of the world. Congrats, you’ve reached the top of the food chain: all the way at the bottom, with the peels.)

Gameplay: "Click and Slash™ – The Game That’ll Make You Forget You Ever Had a Life (If You Ever Did)"

Ever clicked a button or used an input device? (No, not like that, you perv. We’re talking game clicks, not clicks on sites that’d make your grandma blush.) Well done, [Generic First Name]. (Yeah, we gave you a generic name because you clearly tick all the boxes for this job:)

  • You spend more time in front of a screen than in front of a mirror (and that’s saying something).

  • Your CV boils down to "Survived three seasons of a competitive game without getting banned."

  • You still think "productivity" applies to you (spoiler: no).

Let this game run and live your best life (or what’s left of it):

  • Play other games (because one isn’t enough to fill the abyssal void of your existence).

  • Write a novel (suggested title: "How I Wasted Five Years of My Life Clicking Cute Things for a Salary That Doesn’t Even Cover My Gym Membership"—which, by the way, you never use).

  • Draw (a self-portrait of you crying in front of your screen).

Or just let the game run in the background while you… (insert any normal human activity here, like sleeping, eating, or watching cat-fail videos. Because yeah, even in the middle of the apocalypse, you’re still basic.)

Boost your damage with the symbolic pay we’ll give you (because the World Mental Health Organization decided saving the world doesn’t deserve real money—just virtual currency). Follow the instructions! (Yes, it’s an order. No, we’re not negotiating. Want a union? Too late, the Gény already ate the reps. Even your childhood best friend went off the rails… At least they were evacuated with dignity.)

It might be the end of the world, but taxes haven’t changed. (Actually, they’ve gone up. Welcome to the post-apocalyptic economy, where even death won’t free you from your debts.) That’s why you can boost your earnings (and, conveniently, your frustration levels). And why bother exerting yourself when damage can rack up automatically? (After all, there’s no harm in napping in front of your screen—whether it’s here or at a nuclear plant. At least here, you’re less likely to cause a nationwide blackout.)

Oh, and I almost forgot (because clearly, your memory has a short shelf life): once you’ve collected enough Virtual Currency™ (or "gold coins," for the uninitiated), feel free to optimize your DNA with the Prestige™ feature (because nothing says "I’ve got my life together" like mutating into something even weirder). Doing so will compile all the data from the Gény you’ve lovingly eliminated to make you stronger! (Or at least give you the illusion of being useful. That’s something, right?)

Encyclopedia: "Knowledge Is Power (Ignorance Is Bliss)"

By battling and eliminating Gény (with the grace of an elephant in a china shop), you’re enriching our Educational Database™. (Yes, the one that’s completely useless but looks great on your profile. Like your badges from some unlisted arena that’s been around for ten generations.)

Our Encyclopedia logs info on the Gény and how many you’ve defeated. (Because nothing says "I’m a hero" like a kill count worthy of a Sunday hunter.) The higher your… uh… "Genetic Performance Score™" (let’s call it that, even if it’s just an excuse to make you click more), the more you’ll get to passionately smash living creatures of mysterious origin. (Yes, we know you’re getting off on it. No, we’re not judging. Well, maybe a little.)

The secret to happiness? (Spoiler: There isn’t one, but we’ll pretend.) Here’s a hint:

  • Eliminate cute things.

  • Pretend to feel guilty.

  • Do it again.

  • Buy cosmetic upgrades to feel better.

  • Realize you’ve become a monster too.

  • Accept your fate.

  • Click some more.

  • Question your life choices.

  • Repeat the nonsense ad infinitum.

After all…

Equipment: "Because Even a Monkey with a Stick Can Become a Warrior"

Sometimes, Gény drop useful items. Don’t ask where they come from (do I look like I know? Maybe they manufacture them in their secret candy factory? Maybe they’re just recycled trash turned into armor? Who cares—grab them and shut up.)

Take the best gear available (even if it looks like a discount superhero pajama set) and show them who’s boss! (Spoiler: It’s not you. But at least you’ll look ridiculous with style.)

Energy Particles™: "Because Coffee Is So 2020"

Inject yourself with non-toxic (we hope) Energy Particles™ to boost your power and become a slightly improved version of yourself. (It won’t be hard, judging by your current state.)

Guaranteed results (or not):

  • You’ll become stronger (or at least feel like it, which is half the battle).

  • You’ll experience visual hallucinations (but hey, at this point, it’s just a bonus).

  • You’ll start resembling a Gény yourself (and there we go—you’ve become what you fight. Congrats, you’ve fulfilled your destiny.)

Team Collaboration: "Because Even the Apocalypse Needs Paperwork"

Our Experts in Far-Fetched Theories™ (yes, we fired the actual scientists to cut costs) track your progress and efficiency. (Because nothing motivates an employee like a dashboard flashing red.)

They’ll be evaluated and multiplied by… (wait, let me check…) your motivation level. (Kidding! Mostly. Your daily/weekly/monthly/yearly click count is meticulously analyzed, along with your Virtual Currency™, eliminations, and even your procrastination levels.)

Keep your productivity maxed out (even if you feel like smashing everything) while going about your daily business on your digital device.

PS: If you figure out how to click in your sleep, let us know. We’ve got a bonus for you.

Rumors: "Because Even Gény Have Rights (Well, Almost)"

Word is some Gény have varied relationship preferences. (And that’s great news… for us! Because diversity is profitable, and we love stats.)

But otherwise… (let’s be honest, we don’t really care) we’re not monsters (okay, maybe a little, but shhh)—we do it quickly and without unnecessary suffering. (Well, for us, anyway. For them, it’s another story.)

We’ve also got Striped Creatures™ (because apparently, we had to tick the "diversity" box in the game), but hey, they’ll end up as crosswalk paint too, so it’s not like it’s any better. (Sorry, guys. Life’s cruel, and the apocalypse is crueler.)

Conclusion: "Because Life’s Like This Game—Pointless, But We Keep Playing Anyway"

The conclusion? (Spoiler: There isn’t one. Life has no meaning, and neither does this game.)

Download Click and Slash™ (because clearly, you’ve got nothing better to do) and keep your productivity at its peak (even if it just means you’re a slave to the digital system).

Collect Gény in your Encyclopedia (because nothing says "I’m a psychopath" like a list of creatures you’ve lovingly eliminated).

Boost your damage to kick some ass (or at least feel like you’re in control of something in your life).

Leave yourself encouraging notes (because if you don’t, no one else will).

Gear up with useful items (even if, in the end, you’ll just be clicking like a maniac hoping it’ll make a difference).

And above all… live your life. (Or what’s left of it. Because in the end, this game is here to boost your morale… or at least give you the illusion of being useful while the world burns.)

PS:

If you find the meaning of life, I’m all ears, huh. Because it’s not just you who’s an idiot… your family too.

PPS:

If you find a Golden Pineapple, watch out—you’re in the wrong game…

PPPS:

If you’ve got a mobile trash can that needs fixing, I’ve got a buddy with thick glasses who’ll fix it. Otherwise
4598890.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain

4598930.name: Frank 'n' Stein's Body Shop
4598930.about_the_game:
Run a bizarre shop, process strange and unsettling goods, and survive escalating chaos. Stock won’t last, customers won’t wait, and nothing is ever quite right. Sell fast, adapt faster, because everything must go.

What starts as a humble shop quickly spirals into something far stranger. Goods arrive in questionable condition, customers make unusual requests, and the line between routine work and outright madness begins to blur. Stay organized, keep the shelves stocked, and do whatever it takes to keep business moving.

Time is always against you. Items need preparing, sorting, and selling (often all at once). The faster you work, the more you earn. But rush too much, and mistakes start piling up. Can you keep control as the pressure builds?

Features

Run Your Shop

Manage your workspace, organize inventory, and keep goods moving. Every item matters and nothing sticks around for long.

Process Strange Goods

Tenderize, cook, cut, or otherwise “prepare” items before they’re ready for sale. Not everything arrives in a sellable state.

Fast-Paced Gameplay

Balance speed and efficiency in a chaotic, hands-on gameplay loop. The better you perform, the more intense things become.

Dynamic Chaos

Expect the unexpected. Systems overlap, problems stack, and situations escalate as your shop grows busier.

Atmospheric World

A stylized, low-poly world filled with odd details: flickering torchlight, cluttered shelves, and a constant sense that something isn’t quite right.

Meet Unusual Companions

You’re not entirely alone. Some will help. Some will just watch.

The Goal

Grow your shop, handle the increasing workload, and survive the chaos long enough to turn a profit. There’s always more to do, more to sell, and more to deal with.

4598940.name: Last Dive: Echo Trench
4598940.about_the_game:
EACH DIVE GETS WORSE

A routine deep-sea recovery job turns into a descent you may not survive.

Descend from the safety of your diving bell into a dark shipwreck zone on the ocean floor. Search for sunken gold, navigate broken wrecks, and return before the trench changes again. With every successful dive, familiar routes grow stranger, the wrecks feel more hostile, and something in the deep begins to respond to your presence.

Last Dive: Echo Trench is a short first-person underwater horror experience focused on atmosphere, exploration, and escalating dread. Explore the crushing silence of the abyss, enter fractured wrecks, and survive long enough to understand why the ocean keeps pulling you back.

  • A short, focused underwater horror experience built for one or two tense sittings

  • Descend from your diving bell into a dark shipwreck zone deep on the ocean floor

  • Explore sunken wrecks, recover lost gold, and push deeper with each return

  • Face escalating anomalies as familiar routes change across repeated dives

  • Atmospheric and psychological horror driven by darkness, sound, and isolation

  • A linear story in a semi-open underwater environment built around tension, discovery, and dread

A simple job. A dark ocean. And something below that will not let you leave.
