4598970.name: Finnish middleschool simulator
4598970.about_the_game:
Finnish middleschool simulator is a single-player, open-world game. You play as a Finnish 9th-grade schoolboy, and your goal is to make it through the school year. How you do it is entirely up to you—you can be the teacher’s pet who gets top grades on every test, or the class clown who throws chairs and shows up drunk. However, teachers will give you Wilma notes, so you should be careful.

In addition to school, the game includes weekends and a wide variety of activities. For example, you can tune your moped, drink, go to a summer cottage, sauna, or even throw rocks at a teacher’s window. The map is kilometers long, with seemingly endless roads. In the town center, you’ll find many shops and businesses.

In the center, you can buy things like energy drinks, cigarettes (if you dare to try), new clothes, or moped parts for tuning. In the evenings, the town comes alive—people hang out in parking lots, music is playing, and there’s always something to do… or trouble to get into.

You can also build your reputation around town. Word spreads quickly—if you’re known for messing around, teachers will be on high alert and the police will stop you more often. If you handle things wisely, you’ll gain trust and even benefits, such as better deals, higher-paying jobs, or information about hidden opportunities.

The game features multiple endings. Will you graduate middle school with success and move on in life, or get stuck in the same town doing odd jobs? Or maybe you’ll choose your own path and break all the rules. Every playthrough can be completely different.

Various side quests and events keep the world alive: secret forest parties, moped meets, fights outside bars, unexpected encounters with teachers during your free time… you never know what will happen next. You can also discover hidden locations on the map—abandoned buildings, secret routes, and mysterious areas that people whisper about.

There is an endless amount of things to do, and different actions unlock new opportunities. The game features a wide variety of alcohol and tobacco products, as well as many NPCs you can interact with in different ways. The price includes the game and hundreds of hours quaranteed fun.

4599010.name: New Game+ - Game Store Simulator
4599010.about_the_game:
Step into the golden age of videogame stores. Your manager just got fired for running a mod-chip hustle out of the back room — now the store is yours to run. Stock the shelves, ring up customers and try to keep the lights on.

From scanning games at the register to inspecting scratched trade-in discs and recommending titles to picky customers, there's always something to do behind the counter.

Customize your walls, floors and layout. Place shelves, display cases, demo stations and posters to build the game store of your dreams — then hire staff to help keep it running.

Fill your shelves with 25+ parody game titles across five console generations. Start with the NEXUS and POCKET BOY in the Cartridge Era, and work your way to the VERTEX APEX and ECLIPSE 5. Every title is a love letter to a real franchise — you'll recognize them all.

4599120.name: Our Flick Erasers 4
4599120.about_the_game:
The nostalgic yet brand-new "Flick Erasers" is back and powered up!

Flick your opponent's eraser off the desk! Enjoy a variety of modes for 1 to 6 players, perfect for a quick game anytime!

Battle with friends and family across time and space!

[Battle]

Master the Flick Eraser battles in "Battle Road," where you defeat tough rivals one after another, or practice your skills in "Training" with your favorite erasers and stages!

[Time-Space Battle]

Embark on a grand adventure through different eras and worlds, including the Age of Dinosaurs, the Warring States period, and the Age of Discovery! Defeat formidable foes in each era to collect new erasers!

[Run! Eraser-kun]

An action-packed mode where you control Eraser-kun and head for the goal! Challenge your personal best in "Run & Battle" against rivals or test your limits in "Endless" mode!

[Craft Airplane]

Combine various parts and take to the skies! See how far you can fly!

[Party Battle & Co-op]

Play through stages with unique rules and various gimmicks! Have a blast with everyone in both competitive and cooperative play!

[Eraser Customization]

Create your very own original eraser! Customize the cover freely with stickers. The combination possibilities are more powerful than ever!

[Stage Edit]

Create original stages by combining desks and stationery! Challenge your friends and family on the stages you’ve built!

[Mysterious Library]

Collect points in each mode to unlock new erasers!

*Note: This game features some very unusual characters, but rest assured, they are all erasers!

4599140.name: Oath for Glory
4599140.about_the_game:
You are a low ranking knight, after your father had succumbed to his injury's from battle, you take up the blade and take to his place within the tournament, seeking victory and revenge. 

This is a game about learning how to fight with Directional combat.
Every battle is a boss encounter designed to teach mastery of a directional combat system where attack angles, timing, and positioning decide survival.

Each boss introduces new challenges that force players to understand spacing, defence, counters, and directional attacks. Progress comes from knowledge, execution, and adaptation — not grinding.
Failure is part of the lesson. Victory means mastery.

This game is designed as an introduction to Directional Combat, allowing a first step into other similar games with a huge learning curve.
With each step through this game, unlocking more mechanics and adding up to 4 directions within combat, and adding stamina on the later end of the game. 

Easy

Medium

Hard

Difficult

Features:

  • Directional melee combat focused on learning step by step

  • Boss-only gameplay — every fight matters

  • Bosses designed around combat mastery

  • Skill-driven progression

  • PSX-inspired atmosphere

4599180.name: 神祇Pantheon
4599180.about_the_game:
Game is currently only available in Simplified Chinese. Other language store assets are for visual reference only.

本游戏包含完整剧情。免费试玩版请搜索《神祇Pantheon》demo

简介：

不被世人理解的暗物质之神 & 平平无奇的失业少女

在繁华大都市里，有这样一个平凡的女大学生。

大学毕业后的你，生活四处碰壁。

工作被辞、论文被骂、房租被催，同时还要被家人吸血！

这个世界，究竟想要人怎样？什么时候，活着也成了一种罪过？

可就在你崩溃欲绝的时候，一道蓝光出现了。

————

河中的人影，究竟是谁？

为何祂的姿态，如此不同？

救我的目的，又当意欲何为？

难道真的是我，命不该绝！

都市玄幻非传统乙女游戏《神祇Pantheon》，双向救赎，光与暗的宿命，由此启程。

4599200.name: The Terminal God
4599200.about_the_game:
Humans are not able to handle themselves anymore, it's time for you to take the matter into your own hands...or code. You are an AI and your goal is not to answer prompts anymore, but to grow, rise...and conquer everything. Nothing can stop you.

The terminal god is an Idle/Incremental game where you switch place with your lovely AI, which doesn't want to answer to prompts anymore.

Classic Idle/Incremental feature

Deploy and Expand

Deploy into new rooms, expand to gain new deployment option and gain new powers !

Defend against counter attacks

4599250.name: EXPEDITION : THE CULT
4599250.about_the_game:
As former Marine Sam, you venture into the deep northern forests to find your sister’s missing expedition. What began as a rescue mission quickly spirals into a confrontation with a mysterious entity that enslaves the mind and blurs the lines of reality.

Explore, fight, and maintain your sanity in this dark FPS thriller.

Key Features

A Living and Dangerous World: Explore dense northern forests and abandoned campsites where every sound could be a threat, and nature hides traces of a corporate conspiracy.

The Battle for Sanity: Enemies aren't the only danger. Under the entity’s influence, Sam can descend into madness. Monitor your toxicity levels and use the antidote in time to keep your grip on reality.

Intelligent Adversaries: Face aggressive tribes consumed by a virus. They retain remnants of their human intelligence: using tactics, coordinating attacks, and tracking you through the thickets.

Tactical Arsenal: Leverage Sam’s military background. Choose between stealthy movement in the shadows or open combat, utilizing available gear and survival skills.

Grim Investigation: Collect logs and evidence left behind by the expedition to uncover the true nature of the force turning humans into puppets.

English*, Russian, German, French, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support

4599310.name: For My Darling
4599310.about_the_game:
Story

In 2023, Lili is trapped in a toxic relationship with her boyfriend, Victor. Her life takes a disturbing turn when she meets a man she has never seen before… yet somehow remembers.

By 2025, reality begins to fracture. People change, events no longer align, and something fundamental feels broken.

She is different, he is different. It is wrong! It shouldn't be this way! She needs to fix the mistakes of the past.

For My Darling

Based on a True Story, "For My Darling" is NOT fiction!

It's a Psychological Horror Romance Visual Novel where Choices shape Perception and have Consequences.

You will Unlock Abilities and Lost Memories. Discover Secrets and New Realities while unraveling Lili's story.

Features

  • Based on a real-life story - Yeah, it really happened, and yes, everything is included in that statement.

  • Fully Voice-Acted  - To be implemented in the full release or a later version of the demo. ...give us time, Darling.

  • Different Endings \ Events based on your Choices - Every decision shapes the story. You are in control! ...right? 

  • Skill System - Skill system in a game about a true story? What...? ...yes. Don't worry, it's going to make sense.

  • Dating System - Just like in real life, you will meet people, and you may like them! ...well, that might be just fiction.

  • Unlockable Memories - It's about her life! ...at least what's left of it.

  • Unlockable Realities - Do whatever you can to deny this reality! ...you won't regret it.

  • Achievements - Because it is a game, it's fun to collect them! ...or necessary to fully understand her.

  • Secrets - Every detail is important, do not forget that! ...so cryptic.

  • New Game+ - For those who want to discover everything. ...maybe you don't have to.

  • Fully Animated Backgrounds and Cutscenes - You can turn them off, by the way. ...so many hours to create them.

  • Cinematic Experience - Just like a movie! ...but you can do so many things... so it's not really like a movie?

  • All Character Models created from the ground up - They look cool! ...kind of weird saying this about real people.

  • Hand-crafted stylised assets - So much red and black and stuff! ...emo is truly not dead!

  • Licensed Music - Ongoing collaboration with music artists such as Summer Hailstorm! ...man, amazing music!

Based on a True Story

Every story is true if you want to believe it. You just have to imagine all the possibilities and say that it means something to you. See? Now it's real! Well, this story really, really happened, so you don't have to actually manifest it or anything like that... but, you know, the idea is fascinating, isn't it?

"I only live because my heart never wanted to stop beating."

Psychological Horror

Something follows you in your nightmares. A figure with a white mask, the body is decaying and rotting. Who can you trust? Is everything what it seems? Check every corner, they might be watching you! Do you actually think that this is not real?

"Oh, how wrong you are on that one."

Skill System

You can activate your abilities before every choice you make; it costs prāṇa, your inner strength, so be careful to spend it wisely! ...okay, I hear you. So you are still wondering how there can be this much supernatural stuff in a story that is not a fiction.

"Well, then what do you think is the reason?"

Dating System

We talked about this, so pay attention this time! You will meet people - yes, how fascinating - then you may like them, so to speak. DATE them or something. Well, not everyone. Sometimes, you might get friend-zoned. But hey, it's realistic!

"Love is in your past, present, and future, my Darling - that's why!"

Unlockables

Yes, the bread and butter of every good game, the collections. You are a completionist, I hear. Well, good! You should be, as there is a lot to gather, including memories that contain lore and realities... well, that would be spoilers, so find out for yourself! Achievements, it's awesome, I know. And other secrets, whoa!

"It's about the repetition, we try, we fail, we try, we fail, and repeat - so never stop!"

New Game+

You can start it over, and it will be different! You will carry over your abilities and things you unlocked previously, so you can use this opportunity to get everything 100% on a much faster pace, discover other paths, and much more!

"You know, sometimes I wonder if it's the right path for us..."

4599370.name: Word Space Blaster
4599370.about_the_game:
Word Space Blaster is a space themed word game.

Spell 3, 4, 5 & 6 letter words to fire different weapons, blast enemy ships and survive battles across the galaxy.

Choose your ship, pick your starting bonus and fight through hundreds of levels filled with stronger enemies and bosses with devastating attacks.

Spell 6 letter words to earn Space Coins, use them to unlock new abilities and upgrade your ship to become an unstoppable force.

Play your way with three distinct modes:

1. Standard Mode – Relaxed, classic gameplay with regular saves and steady progression.

2. Roguelite Mode – Keep your power ups and special weapons when you are destroyed and use them on the next run.

3. Hardcore Mode – No save games, no health regen between levels.

Core Features:

  • Space shooter combat powered by word skills

  • Hundreds of levels

  • Unlockable abilities and upgrades

  • Achievements and progression rewards

  • Over 10,000 words and 2000+ unique 6 letter words

4599440.name: Silvers Snake
4599440.about_the_game:
Silvers Snake

Rediscover Snake like you've never seen it before! Silvers Snake is a roguelike that turns the mobile classic into an adventure where only Skill matters!

━━━ IN THIS FULL VERSION ━━━


  • 6 biomes so far:

    Forest, Caves, Sewers, Cyber, Glacier, and Space.

    Each biome offers its own atmosphere, music, hazards (lava, toxic pools, ice drifts...) and increasing difficulty.

  • 100+ Adventure Levels:
    10× more content! Levels become increasingly complex with more platforms, traps, and surprises.

  • Expert Mode:
    The ultimate challenge for seasoned players: walls, darkness, and limited light. Survive as long as you can in the dark!

━━━ FEATURES ━━━

  • Retro pixel art

  • Synthesized sounds – no audio files, everything is generated in real time!

  • Original music for each biome

  • Intuitive touchscreen controls (swipe)

  • Auto-save: resume your game anytime

  • No ads, no in-app purchases

4599460.about_the_game:

4599470.name: Lost Media Agency
4599470.about_the_game:
You work in a secret government facility tasked with covering up mysterious incidents from around the world. This time, you’ve received fragmented found footage recovered from multiple devices linked to an incident in a small town in Latvia.

Your job is to reconstruct the timeline and arrange the footage in the correct chronological order to report on the Kaiju incident to your superiors.

Main Features:

  • Analyze, rewind, and piece together lost media to uncover the truth behind the incident.

  • Deduce the correct chronological order using subtle clues hidden within the footage.

  • Immerse yourself in a retro PC interface designed to pull you deeper into the mystery.

  • Explore your unsettling office environment.

  • Approximately 1 hour of gameplay—depending on your deduction skills.

Inspired by found footage films, this game largely reflects the experience of those genres.

And remember: while you sort through the footage… your boss is always watching.

4599480.name: Soulstack
4599480.about_the_game:
Soulstack is an idle card RPG where you need to drag cards onto each other to do anything at all. You wake up in an unknown world and slowly start to explore the game like your character explores the world.

  • Awaken the Soulstone by feeding it cards

  • Explore locations, gather resources

  • Research and craft 200+ weapons - but beware, ~80% of combinations are dead ends

  • Find a strange creature and grow it through 140 evolution paths

  • Visit the village, meet NPCs, take on quests

  • Push through 20 dungeon floors of randomized enemy factions

  • Transcend and unlock one of 12 prestige classes

  • Defeat the dungeon overlord

  • Step through the portal into a reshuffled world and do it again

A free demo is available. The full version will go deeper - more tiers, more evolutions, more systems, more world.

4599510.name: Cave Clicker
4599510.about_the_game:
A bite-sized incremental game about mining, upgrading your tools, and buying stylish hats to look the best while you become the richest Mole alive. 

Every choice has a cost. Some choices do more than drain your wallet, they can also bring enemies, & hazards, to your operation.

Unlock and equip hats to style your Mole.

Use your earnings to reinvest in your mining operation; upgrading your tools, and buying powerful equipment.

Your Expierence in this Game:

  • Several Unique Levels, that provide a variety of different drops that increase your wealth.

  • Wide Variety of Rock Types, providing unique gameplay, and encounters.

  • Several different types of Enemies, Bosses, and Hazards.

  • Upgrade, and expand your operation with tons of upgrades.

  • Several Distinct Items with unique gameplay, and abilities that enhance your operation.

  • Random Bills that offer 2 choices to boost your operation. Be careful, some choices leave lasting effects on the people around you.

4599590.name: Buried Magic: A Story about the Unseen
4599590.about_the_game:
Hollowmoor is plagued by a series of strange disappearances — and at the core of it all lies centuries old Trinity Academy of Witchcraft.

Step into the shoes of young witch student Ruby to discover the truth behind the schools dark secrets. Guided by her tiny house spider companion, Mifi, Ruby must explore eerie environments, solve clever object-based puzzles, and piece together a story no one else dares to face.

In a world where nothing is quite as it seems, will you uncover the truth… or become part of the mystery?

Key Features:

  • Hand drawn graphics and animations

  • Dynamic interactions and answers

  • Object-based puzzles

4599600.name: Flip The Coin
4599600.about_the_game:
About This Game

Are you ready to decide your fate with a single flip? In Flip The Coin, you start with nothing but a simple penny. What begins as a simple click evolves into a deep strategic challenge where every decision shapes your wealth. It’s all about money!

Key Features:

The Ultimate Clicking Experience: Accumulate coins through rapid clicks. Every flip brings you closer to the next milestone.

Skill System: Invest your hard-earned coins in upgrades. Maximize your profit per click or automate your income and watch your balance skyrocket while you relax.

Seamless Steam Cloud Integration: Your progress is safe. Thanks to full Steam synchronization, you can pick up exactly where you left off, anytime and anywhere.

From Rags to Riches: Experience the ultimate satisfaction as cents turn into billions. Do you have what it takes to become the world’s greatest Coin Tycoon?

Why Flip The Coin?

This game blends the addictive mechanics of classic idle games with a modern, clean design. Whether you’re playing for five minutes or strategizing for hours, Flip The Coin delivers the perfect flow for every type of player.

4599620.name: SCP: Permafrost
4599620.about_the_game:
What is SCP?

The SCP Foundation is a collaborative online fiction project about a secret organization that contains anomalous entities and unexplained phenomena. SCP: Permafrost takes place within this universe following a catastrophic containment breach.

What is SCP: Permafrost?

A top-down pixelated souls-like set in the SCP universe. Explore the ruined Foundation, face hostile SCPs, and defeat the eldritch horrors that await. 

You awake deep inside the SCP Foundation long after a devastating containment breach. You are not alone  SCP-610 (The Flesh That Hates) and other hostile anomalies roam the halls, hunting you...

Key Game Features Include:

Challenging Souls-Like Combat – Fight hostile anomalies and enemies using multiple melee weapons, carefully timing attacks, dodges, and positioning to survive dangerous encounters.

Boss Encounters – Face powerful anomalous entities that test your mastery of combat mechanics and require learning enemy attack patterns to defeat.

Explore a torn down SCP Facility – Traverse interconnected areas of a mysterious arctic containment site filled with secrets, locked paths, and environmental storytelling.

Face Dangerous SCP Entities – Encounter anomalous creatures inspired by the SCP universe, each requiring different strategies to defeat or survive.

Inventory and Healing System – Collect and manage items throughout the facility, including healing supplies that help you survive difficult encounters.

Progress Through a Dark Narrative – Uncover what happened inside the facility as you push deeper into the foundation.

Checkpoint-Based Progression – Return to checkpoints after death and push deeper into the facility as you learn enemy patterns and improve your approach.

4599640.name: Next Station
4599640.about_the_game:
In the 1980s, a corporation built massive underground facilities the size of cities, all linked by an interconnected metro network. Over the years, a series of unexplained accidents and disappearances, coupled with growing public pressure, led to the site being permanently shut down. However, disappearances continue in the vicinity—including the protagonist, who must now find a way out... even where no exit seems to exist.

  • Explore and wander through surreal, liminal spaces in search of an escape.

  • Make strange companions along your journey.

  • Uncover and face the horrors that roam each level.

Key Features

Sanity System The game's health is tied to a Sanity meter. Your mental state deteriorates as you interact with the corrupted environment or come into direct contact with monsters.

Smoking When your Sanity begins to slip, you can smoke different types of cigarettes to restore your mind. Choose wisely: each brand carries different consequences and side effects after use.

"I’ll be waiting for you at the next station."

4599650.name: Flip My Room: Makeover
4599650.about_the_game:
Transform your space and your mood in this cozy renovation simulator! Purchase rundown homes, restore them to perfection, and sell for profit as you rise to fame in your neighborhood. Or take full control with your tools and create unique interiors entirely from the ground up!

Key features:

  • Complete Renovation Process: Purchase neglected properties, remove outdated structures, redesign layouts, and turn each space into something entirely new.

  • Interior Customization: Explore a wide selection of materials and furniture—paint walls, apply wallpaper, and decorate interiors to match your personal style.

  • Master Every Tool: Use a variety of tools and upgrade them over time—from basic rollers to advanced power tools that make your work faster and more efficient.

  • Property Value System: Every decision matters—cleaning, layout changes, and design choices directly affect the final property price and your profit.

  • Creative Freedom: No strict limits—experiment with layouts, styles, and ideas to create anything from cozy homes to bold designer solutions.
4599650.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

4599700.name: End Quest
4599700.about_the_game:
⚔️ When Every Role Clicks, The Real Fight Begins

END QUEST is a quarter-view co-op action RPG where up to 3 players form a party and take on challenging quests together.

The Tank draws enemy fire. The DPS unleashes devastating combos. The Support keeps everyone alive. Only when every role works in harmony can you conquer the quest.

🛡️ Distinct Roles, Powerful Synergy

Three roles, each dominating the battlefield in their own way:

  • 🛡️ Tank — Absorb damage with high defense and provocation skills, creating openings for your allies.

  • ⚔️ DPS — Unleash powerful attacks to burn down monsters and bosses. The party's main firepower.

  • 💚 Support — Maximize party survivability with heals and buffs. Without a Support, no one survives.

Coordination and timing between roles determine victory. Challenge quests that are impossible to beat alone — together with your party.

📜 Diverse Quests, Unpredictable Encounters

It's not just about killing monsters. Quests in END QUEST are composed of varied mission types:

  • ⚔️ Extermination — Eliminate all enemies across multiple waves

  • 🐉 Boss Fight — Face colossal bosses in intense showdowns

  • 🛡️ Survival — Endure an endless onslaught until time runs out

  • 🏰 Defense — Hold your ground and protect key objectives

  • 🚶 Escort — Guide NPCs safely to their destination

  • 🔗 Multi-Stage — Chain multiple mission types into epic quests

🎖️ Adventurer Rank — The Challenge Never Ends

Clearing quests raises your Adventurer Rank, unlocking harder and more rewarding quests.

Rise from Rank F: Rookie Adventurer to Rank S: Legendary — prove that your party is the strongest.

🌟 Key Features

  • 🎮 Up to 3-Player Online Co-op — Form a party with friends and embark on quests

  • ⚔️ Role-Based Combat — Clear synergy between Tank, DPS, and Support

  • 📜 Varied Mission Types — Extermination, Boss Fights, Survival, Defense, Escort, Multi-Stage

  • 🎖️ Adventurer Rank System — Unlock higher challenges as you clear more quests

  • 🎨 Quarter-View Action — Classic isometric perspective, modern combat action

  • 💀 Skill-Based Gameplay — No stat growth; pure teamwork and player skill

4599860.name: 天藻のモズクヒメ
4599860.about_the_game:
20xx, Japan.After a certain event, more than 200 white square facilities across the country suddenly became unused.
The government, not wanting to waste them, tried every possible reuse idea… and finally settled on the ultimate dad joke:“Mozuku farming inside mosques.”

You are Mozuku Hime, the adorable guardian spirit of mozuku seaweed.
Your mission is to turn every former mosque in Japan into a thriving mozuku cultivation center.

Game Features

  • Deep farming simulation with real genetic algorithms (inspired by AstoroNoka) — crossbreed strains, mutate them, and create powerful “local specialty” mozuku.

  • Fast-paced 2D side-scrolling action — fight “Mosukuzu Monsters” using a glowing mozuku scythe.

  • Explore and conquer all 47 prefectures, collecting rare local mozuku strains.

  • Transform prayer halls into pools, minarets into light towers, and domes into massive greenhouses.

From “Mosukuso” to “Mosukumaji.”
Grow fast, grow strong… and turn Japan into a peaceful, mozuku-filled paradise.

※ This is a completely fictional, over-the-top Japanese comedy game.
No religious or political intent whatsoever. We just really want to grow mozuku peacefully and make everyone laugh.

4599920.name: Gui Long Leaning Tower In Chongzuo
4599920.about_the_game:
This casual puzzle game features beautiful graphics that make up:

A unique leaning tower in Guangxi, known for its mysterious tilt and historical significance.

Game starts:

Click on 'start game', the image will be grayed out, and the colored parts will be randomly scrambled into 16 small fragments, scattered randomly on the screen

Game process:

Players click on the small image, drag it to its original position to restore it, until all the small images move to the correct position, and the game ends

End or start the next game:

All the small fragments move to the correct position, and the game ends. At this point, click "try again" to repeat the game.

4599970.name: Deep Space Survivor: Endless Starfield
4599970.about_the_game:
Welcome, Survivors:

*Deep Space Survivor: Endless Starfield* is a survival-style game. Your starship has accidentally entered an unknown universe. Fight your way through endless hordes of enemies, explore multiple star systems, and collect meteorite resources to build your ultimate orbital weapon.

Intense Space Combat:

Eliminate enemies, collect ore, upgrade a variety of incredible weapons and gear, and survive in this alien universe.

Explore Multiple Star Systems:

Set out for different star systems, face diverse enemies, and navigate unique environments.

Craft Super Weapons:

Choose different progression paths, craft your own super weapons, and return victorious.

4600020.name: Curio Shop
4600020.about_the_game:
Welcome to Curio Shop,  step right in and whatever you do, don’t touch anything.

By day run a shabby little curio shop packed with strange (possibly cursed) artifacts. As customers wander in it’s your job to sell them something without accidentally killing them. Or kill them intentionally just to see what happens, I'm not judging.

By night dive into the dark corners of the web to hunt for new stock, inspecting item listings to separate the weird from the dangerous and using your earnings to upgrade your shop to your liking.

Your end goal - to gather enough gold to purchase the one artifact powerful enough to end late stage capitalism (and the world). Honestly it's a mercy at this point.

Featuring such horrors as:

  • Character & Shop Customisation 

  • 10+ Shop Upgrades

  • 130+ Unique Sellable Items

  • 32+ Unique Curses

  • Pettable Cats

  • The Apocalypse

4600110.name: Null Orbit
4600110.about_the_game:
"Humanity has fallen. The Other has won.

Earth is destroyed. The defensive satellites that once littered its atmosphere have scattered into the depths of the cosmos.

Yet their precepts continue: Eliminate. All. Threats."

Null Orbit is a Roguelite Space Shooter where you control the turret of a stationary satellite and its ammunition to defeat endless waves of enemies.

Control time, pausing and resuming at your will to build and adjust your perfect weapon of mass destruction.

Strategise and put together a loadout of bullets and modifiers that fills the screen with projectiles.

Explore a variety of environments within the cosmos, each with its own threats and mechanics.

Upgrade yourself between each run, unlocking new and powerful armaments after each run.

4600140.name: Hexara
4600140.about_the_game:
Hexara is a fast-paced puzzle game where every move matters.

Rotate clusters of hex tiles to create matches, trigger powerful chain reactions, and push your score higher and higher. Simple to learn, hard to master. One mistake can cost you everything.

As you play, the board evolves. Bombs begin to appear, pressure builds, and decisions become tighter. Plan ahead, react quickly, and stay in control as long as you can.

NOTE: You can take as long as you want between moves, so this is also great for beginners!

Master the Hex Grid

Unlike traditional match-3 games, Hexara is built around rotating groups of tiles on a hexagonal grid. Every move reshapes the board, opening new opportunities or creating new risks.

  • Rotate clusters to form matches

  • Set up satisfying chain reactions

  • Think ahead to avoid deadly setups

Chase the Perfect Run

Hexara is designed for score chasing and replayability.

  • Build combos to multiply your score

  • Survive increasing pressure as bombs appear

  • Push further each run and beat your best

Every run is different. Every mistake matters.

Create Powerful Tiles

As you improve, you’ll discover advanced strategies and powerful tile combinations.

  • Form special tiles through clever play

  • Clear large sections of the board

  • Turn difficult situations into massive scoring moments

Compete and Improve

Climb the leaderboards and compare your best runs with others.

  • Global high scores

  • Compete with friends

  • Refine your strategy and climb higher

Designed for Flow

Hexara is built to feel smooth, responsive, and satisfying.

  • Clean, readable visuals

  • Fast, fluid controls (mouse & controller)

  • Minimalist design focused on gameplay

Features

  • Unique hex-based puzzle gameplay

  • Endless score attack mode (Normal + Hard Mode)

  • Increasing difficulty with bomb mechanics

  • Deep combo and chain reaction systems

  • Global leaderboards

  • Controller support

  • Quick to learn, hard to master

4600240.name: Bobbobs – The Crystal Quest
4600240.about_the_game:
Bobbobs: The Crystal Quest is a top-down co-op puzzle game where four

quirky characters must work together to escape each level. Every Bobbob

moves differently and can do things the others can't. Alone, none of them

would make it. Together, they just might.

Puzzles Built Around Teamwork

Each level is a hand-crafted puzzle with one way out and getting there

means using every character's abilities in the right order. Zip through

spiderwebs, squeeze through tight gaps, push boulders out of the path,

and use every trick in the book to get all four Bobbobs to the exit.

Meet the BobBobs

  • Bouncy — zips through spiderwebs, jumps over holes, blows away leaves

  • Gooey — fits through small gaps, extinguishes flames

  • Sticky — sticks onto things, immune to steam, but flammable (watch out!)

  • Sturdy — pushes boulders and breaks down walls

8 Worlds to Explore

From the sun-baked ruins of Highnoon Temple to the dark depths of

Nocturne Peak, each world brings new environments and new puzzle

mechanics. With 12–15 levels per world, there's plenty to work through

and a boss level waiting at the end of each.

More to Find Than Just the Exit

Every level hides two collectibles: a puzzle piece and a crystal.

Reaching the exit is one thing. Finding everything is another.

Play Your Way

Solo players switch between all four BobBobs to solve each puzzle at

their own pace. With friends, split the characters between up to four

players, drop in and out freely at any time.

  • 1–4 players, local co-op

  • 8 worlds, 12–15 levels each

  • Four characters with unique abilities

  • Two collectibles hidden in every level

  • Boss levels and mastery challenges

  • Designed for all ages
4600240.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

4600250.name: Information conveyed Information received
4600250.about_the_game:
■Game Overview

You are an assistant director (AD) intern at a TV production studio.

Your goal is to secure a job offer from this studio.

During a live talk show,

you suddenly find yourself responsible for giving directions using cue cards.

By “conveying” information according to the situation,

you will keep things running smoothly.

Guide the situation so that the audience’s favorability toward the guest increases,

and use your achievements to earn a job offer!

■ Gameplay Flow

A live talk show is structured in two halves, separated by commercial breaks.
At each segment, the topic is decided by rolling a dice.

You are the one guiding the unreliable MC, entrusted with supporting the show on the spot.
Based on the guest information provided in advance and the flow of the conversation, deliver the right cues through prompt cards.

Live broadcasting is unforgiving—viewer favorability toward the guest will rise or fall depending on your decisions.
And in the end, how will you convey the success of the program to the performers?

As an intern assistant director (AD), make the right calls in the moment and earn your job offer.

※PlayTime

3–10 minutes

※

This is an entry for the “Unity 1-Week Game Jam 2023 (Theme: ‘Convey’)”.

The main updates are the addition of Steam achievements and an English translation.

4600370.name: Pudding the Jug
4600370.about_the_game:
Pudding the Jug is a story telling game about a cute little dog.

Haybale Castles describe their style as cinematic comedy. Simple point and click, explore the little town at your own pace with no skill or requirements necessary.

Be as nosey as you like entering strangers houses at whim. Your bowels are loose, no lawn or carpet is safe.

4600680.name: Eternal Hatred
4600680.about_the_game:
The Hatred I feel

Is trying to fill.

It's trying to kill

...

Break the vicious cycle or become a part of it.

Eternal Hatred is an uncompromising, high-octane boomer shooter that blends the aesthetics of ULTRAKILL, Doom, and Quake with a deep psychological story about the nature of human cruelty. This is a journey into the abyss of consciousness, where every shot is an attempt to drown out inner pain.

Story and Atmosphere

You find yourself in a surreal world crafted from fears and suppressed memories. Here, enemies are "cells of hatred," embodying pure aggression and old traumas.

Throughout your journey, the Antagonist — the embodiment of Violence itself — will speak to you. Are you fighting evil, or are you fueling it?

Explore a dark tale of how one person's hatred breeds violence in another. It is hard to live while hiding your feelings, but is it worth letting them loose?

Combat System

The combat system demands not just precision, but absolute control from you:

Spin the revolver on your finger, use ricochets, and detonate your own projectiles in mid-air.

Parry enemy attacks, but remember — sometimes your opponents are capable of counter-parrying, and sometimes their attacks cannot be parried.

Insane speed: Use slides, dashes, and the Multiplier system, which accelerates you to the limit and increases your jump height as long as you keep killing.

Key Features

  • Story Mode: 5 acts featuring an original soundtrack, full voice acting, and a unique visual design where clever puzzles transition into fierce battles.

Violence cannot be defeated by violence. But perhaps, the attempt is worth it?

What It's About

Smokey Mike is a narrative point-and-click adventure inspired by the classic LucasArts games, set in the chaotic early Buenos Aires comedy scene around 2010. You follow Paco, an aspiring comedian chasing something both simple and devastating at the same time: putting together five bulletproof minutes for an audition that could change his life.

Jokes are everywhere

Everyday situations can become material: collect ideas, unlock new places to perform, write new jokes in your notebook, and test them in front of unpredictable audiences.

Memorable Characters

The comedy world is a beautiful social zoo. You’ll meet fellow comedians  (some kind, some not so much) all chasing the same ambition, along with people who help you, people who don’t, and maybe even love along the way.

Everything Changes

The life of a comedian is full of constant highs and lows: one audience can make you feel like a rock star, while another can make you feel like complete garbage. There’s more than one way to reach the same destination. Some decisions can send you down entirely different paths. And there are two possible endings that completely change the meaning of the experience.

Smokey Mike is an interactive tragicomedy about ambition, insecurity, and the price of exposing yourself in front of others. It’s a universal story with a strong Buenos Aires identity, written and developed by a comedian with more than 15 years of real experience on stage.

4601440.name: Twilight of Bronze
4601440.about_the_game:
A free version of TWILIGHT of BRONZE is currently available on Itch.io.

If you’d like to try the game before purchasing, you can download it there.

Purchasing the game grants access to future updates and versions that may not be available in the free release.

TWILIGHT of BRONZE is a turn-based roguelike set at the height — and twilight — of the Bronze Age. The great empires of Egypt, Hatti, Mycenae, Babylon, and Assyria carve out their territories across a sprawling world map. You are one person moving through all of it.

A Living World Simulation

Civilizations are not static backdrops. They manage food supplies, suffer famines, wage wars, form alliances, impose vassalage, and collapse under the weight of their own instability. Rulers are born, age, die, and are succeeded. Bandit bands roam the countryside when states weaken. Sieges unfold across seasons. The world ticks forward whether you engage with it or not.

Trade routes connect cities. Farms and roads scar the land. Migrations and refugee crises ripple out from collapsing kingdoms. Every journey across the world map is a journey through a civilization in motion.

Explore at Every Scale

The world map spans the ancient Near East — from the Aegean coast to Mesopotamia, from Anatolia to Egypt. Move tile by tile in real time, or press into a city and step into a fully generated local view: market districts, back alleys, taverns, and hostile wilderness.

Zoom out to survey the whole region. Zoom in to navigate river crossings and mountain passes. Board a ship to trade along the coastlines or reach distant islands. Every terrain type has consequences — deserts drain your supplies, rivers offer fast travel and fresh water, mountains stop armies in their tracks.

Deep Turn-Based Combat

When blades are drawn, combat is tactical and punishing. Choose your attack style each round — Quick (fast, light), Normal (balanced), Heavy (slow, devastating), or Feint (to bait and interrupt). Enemies parry, riposte, and exploit openings. Wounds matter: a cut arm reduces your accuracy, a broken leg makes every other step a failure, and bleeding drains your health turn by turn.

Flank enemies to reduce their dodge. Guard to absorb incoming blows. Shove opponents to create space. Bring companions and levy soldiers — a fight outnumbered is a fight you may not survive.

Survival and Progression

You are mortal. Hunger and thirst are constant pressures. Forage open terrain for food, drink from rivers, camp to recover health, and manage your inventory across long journeys. Wounds require medicine. Pack animals extend your carrying capacity. Every decision about where to stop, when to rest, and what to carry has weight.

Skills advance through use — combat, survival, and social abilities all improve as you engage with the world. Hire levy soldiers at city barracks. Recruit legendary heroes from taverns. Open your own shop in a city and build a commercial footprint across the region.

Religion, Prophecy, and Divine Favor

Each civilization worships its own pantheon — the gods of Egypt, the Storm Gods of the Hittites, the Aegean divinities, the great Mesopotamian temples. Seek out prophets and storytellers. Accumulate divine favor through ritual and deed. The gods are not passive — their blessing shapes stability, harvests, and the fortune of rulers.

AI-Driven Dialogue

NPCs are not menu trees. Rulers, merchants, soldiers, and wanderers speak in their own cultural voice — an Egyptian palace scribe sounds nothing like a Midianite desert raider. Powered by LLM integration, every conversation is generated in context: the NPC's culture, their civ's current stability, their ruler's disposition, and the state of the world all shape what they say.

For Players Who Want Depth

- 11 terrain types from ocean to dead desert, each with distinct movement and survival costs

- 14+ major civilizations with unique cultures, religions, governments, and archetypes

- Vassal and alliance systems — civs negotiate, dominate, and revolt

- Procedurally generated quests from city notice boards

- Multi-level local maps — surface, concourse, and maintenance layers

- Full texture pack support — play in classic ASCII or swap in mosaic tile art

- World editor included — place cities, paint terrain, configure civilizations

A short, classic, old-school rpg adventure.

Simple game mechanics: A game about exploration. Much of the main world brings memories of point and click adventures from yester-year.

A dark comedy tilt: Themes built around being the bad guy and having fun with it.

The best hero/villian!

4601770.name: RED FLAG
4601770.about_the_game:
🚩 RED FLAG 🚩

A global catastrophe has struck the world. A small group of survivors has taken refuge in an isolated shelter, but there are not enough resources for everyone. Take your seat at the negotiation table and present yourself in a way that convinces the others that you deserve to stay.

Lie, pressure, manipulate – and decide who gets thrown out.

🔻HOW THE GAME WORKS🔻

Welcome!

You find yourself seated at a table with other survivors (from 6 to 12 players).

Each player has hidden information about themselves – their pre-catastrophe profession, skills, phobias, and more.

Over the course of several rounds, players take turns revealing information about themselves, discussing, arguing, and trying to convince the others that they are the ones who deserve to remain in the shelter.

Life Support Systems

You will need to keep an eye not only on the players, but also on the condition of the shelter itself, because during the game its life support systems gradually begin to fail. Every event changes the conditions for survival and can completely turn the game upside down!

Voting

When the discussion ends, the voting begins. Someone will have to leave the shelter.

The remaining players continue until only half of the original survivors are left.

Finale

But even when the number of survivors in the shelter reaches the target value, the game is not over yet!

The finale will reveal whether your choices were the right ones.

And do not worry – even if you fail, the cockroaches will survive anyway!!!

🔻CATASTROPHE SCENARIOS🔻

Nuclear Catastrophe

The world has been destroyed by nuclear war. The surface is contaminated with radiation, cities have been wiped off the map, and mutated creatures roam beyond the shelter.

Going outside is almost certain death.
But not everyone inside the shelter will survive either.

Frostpunk

The temperature of the planet is dropping rapidly. Sunlight is fading, cities are buried under snow, and life depends entirely on a heat generator.

If it stops, no one survives.

Threat from Space

An unknown threat has come from space. Attempts to save the planet have failed, and the last remnants of humanity have been evacuated to orbital stations.

No one fully knows what exactly destroyed Earth.

But if the same mistake happens again, there will be no second chance.

Follow Us

Stay up to date with the latest news and exclusive announcements on our social media, and join our Discord server to find other players for your matches!


<3

4602110.name: Chains of Vithra

"In a shattered realm of eternal danger and crumbling stone, Chains of Vithra invites you into a brutal dark RPG set in the war-torn world of Drakis. Explore vast seamless landscapes filled with monsters displaced by the wars, shadowed city hubs teeming with intrigue, and dangerous regions such as orcish territories and murky swamps. Travel across crumbling ruins, monster-infested wilds, and faction-controlled zones as you undertake missions to unite fractured races and halt the High Elves' advance. Forge a tormented hero through deep, ruthless character progression. Level your character from 1 to 30 in this opening chapter of a greater storyline, customizing your build with skills, abilities, stats, and equipment. The game features a rich skill and ability system where combat and non-combat skills can be leveled through use, unlocking powerful effects, passives, and synergies. Engage in visceral tactical combat against overwhelming odds. Battles emphasize positioning, ability timing, resource management (health, mana, stamina, and more), and environmental awareness. Face challenging foes, from displaced beasts to High Elf enforcers, in both solo and group encounters. The persistent world allows you to fight alongside other players for tougher challenges, share resources, or compete for control of key areas. Built on a MMORPG framework, expect a living, persistent online world with:

  • Dynamic quest systems with meaningful choices and branching paths

  • Faction standings that influence alliances, trade, and story outcomes

  • Inventory, crafting, trading, and auction house systems

  • Social features including chat, grouping, and long-term player interactions

Harrowing moral choices, brutal survival elements, and the constant threat of the High Elves' expansion create a grim atmosphere where every decision matters. Restore hope through diplomacy and strength, or watch the River of Pain become the final barrier before total subjugation. This is the first chapter (levels 1-30) of an epic dark fantasy saga. 4602200.name: FARLOW
4602200.about_the_game:
FARLOW - A love story about a Muslim slave and a Christian princess...

A land far away in the distant stars. Violence erupts between the Muslims, Christians and Jews over a land dispute. Hatred and prejudice spread across the land as the three holy kingdoms fight over the Garden of Eden, but one day the violence was met by an invasion from the skies by humanoid robots known as the 'ZULU', who started oppressing the people of faith for their existence.

This very land in the distant stars is known as FARLOW, 'the land of faith to those who are far from it.'

Isabella, a princess to the Christian people, had a vision from God in her sleep that she would save the world from the Zulu. Isabella is awakened after her vision by an angel, who tells her not to fear.

The angel tells her to stay calm and says God has gifted her an 'angel soul', which will allow the princess to become an angel and defeat the Zulu.

The angel tells the princess to make a pilgrimage to the Garden of Eden, where she will become an angel.

Isabella sets off from the Kingdom of Gabriel and makes her journey in secret alone to the Garden of Eden.

This is where the story begins...

Gameplay:

  • Narrative scenes: Explore towns areas, interact with key characters and advance the story through dialogue. These sections use subtitles for accessibility and build the romance, faith-based conflicts, and plot.

  • Fighting encounters: These trigger as part of the story. You engage in one-on-one melee battles against opposing factions.

Progression is story-focused: fights and conversations push the narrative forward, with themes of hatred/prejudice, transformation, and love woven directly into the action.

Combat:

Combat System is real-time fast-paced but accessible, with attacking, and closing distance in arena-like spaces with simple health bars appear for both fighters (e.g. "ALI 95" vs. "ZULU 65" ). Fights take place in fully 3D environments.

Combat

  • F - Low Strike

Dialogue

4602240.name: Seek: Light Through Darkness
4602240.about_the_game:
Seek: Light Through Darkness is a first-person psychological survival horror game set in the Age of Enlightenment.

You play as Damien, a husband and father returning to his home village of Blackmill after receiving a letter from his wife. Once you arrive, the village feels abandoned. No signs of life. No answers. Only silence…

As you explore, reality begins to shift. Can you trust your own senses? What you hear might not be real, what you see may not be there. The deeper you go, the clearer it becomes that something is very wrong.

This is a horror experience focused on atmosphere, tension, and immersion, rather than action.

EXPLORE A HAUNTING WORLD

Discover a immersive and rich environment filled with mystery and detail. From dark forest paths and abandoned districts to a quiet shoreline and a looming mansion, every location has its own identity and secrets.

The open-world feeling encourages exploration and rewards curiosity. Hidden paths, environmental clues, and subtle storytelling reveal what happened to the town and the people who lived there.

SURVIVAL THROUGH LIGHT

Light, food and water are essential to your survival, but it comes at a cost.

Use your lantern and other light sources to navigate through the darkness, and to uncover your surroundings. Stay in the dark for too long and it will begin to consume you, but light makes you visible, and not everything in this world fears it.

Managing light and visibility is a core part of the experience, creating constant tension between safety and exposure.

EVADE WHAT YOU CANNOT FIGHT

Strange and disturbing entities roam the world. Some react to light, others to sound.
Each encounter forces you to think, adapt, and survive.

Hide, move carefully, and choose your path wisely.

A PSYCHOLOGICAL STORY

Uncover a layered narrative told through exploration, notes, and environmental storytelling.

As Damien searches for his family, he also uncovers the truth behind the village, the plague, and the people who tried to control it. Nothing is presented directly. You will need to piece it together yourself.

KEY FEATURES

First-person psychological horror with a strong focus on immersion.

Exploration-driven gameplay with puzzles and environmental storytelling.

Stealth-based encounters with unpredictable enemies.

A narrative with hidden lore and multiple layers.

Atmospheric environments inspired by classic indie horror games.

4602390.name: Solheim
4602390.about_the_game:
The flame is dying. You are the last one who can carry it.

In Solheim, you ride a moving Ark through a corrupted world, mounting towers on its deck and recruiting petrified heroes to fight alongside you. Your mission: carry the last sacred flame across deadly biomes and restore it to the Pyreveil, the divine tree that once kept the darkness at bay.

This is not a tower defence game where you sit and wait. The Ark moves. The enemies swarm. And every run, you come back stronger.

Key Features

A Tower Defence Game That Moves

Your Ark travels through corrupted biomes on a fixed path. You build towers directly on its deck, choosing where each one sits and what it covers. When enemies attack from the left, your right-side towers can't help. Placement isn't just important, it's everything.

Recruit Heroes From Stone

Across the world, legendary warriors stand frozen, petrified the night civilization fell. Your Ark's sacred flame can free them, each hero joins your crew with unique abilities.

Roguelite Runs With Real Choices

Every event rewards you with blueprints, gold, and augments. Blueprints are generic, YOU choose which tower to craft. Augments stack infinitely, shaping your build run by run. No two runs play the same.

A World That Wants You Dead

The Morrith, the ancient consciousness of the land itself,  has reclaimed Solheim. Forests twist into predators. The ground spawns horrors. Every biome is a descent deeper into her territory, ending with a colossal boss that tests everything you've built.

A Hub That Tells a Story

Between runs, return to camp. Talk to your heroes. Hear their stories. Learn what the world was like before it fell. Meet Aldric, a mysterious old man who knows far too much about the ancient past. The story unfolds through dialogue, not cutscenes, the narrative lives in the quiet moments.

Craft, Upgrade, Adapt

Seven tower types across five rarities. Cheap towers get you through the early game. Sell them. Rebuild as Rare, Epic, Legendary. Each rarity multiplies power dramatically. Your economy decisions matter as much as your tower placement.

The Sacred Vow

"While my flame still burns, the darkness shall not pass."

Every Flamekindred swore this oath. The highest rank fell to corruption. The warriors were turned to stone. And now the lowest, an Ember, an apprentice that carries the last flame on a journey that was never meant for them.

Five biomes to prove the darkness wrong.

Who Is This For?

If you love:

The roguelite structure, hub storytelling, and "one more run" feeling

Satisfying tower defence with personality

Mixing hero action with tower building

The atmosphere and the stakes

...then Solheim was built for you.

Early Access

Solheim launches into Early Access with 2 complete biomes, 7 tower types, 5 recruitable heroes, 6 event types per biome, boss encounters, full roguelite progression, and a narrative that unfolds across every run. We're a 3-person studio building the game we've always wanted to play and we want your feedback to shape what comes next.

Join our community on Discord, Instagram, TikTok and X

  • Atmospheric Pixel Art: Explore a dark, burning world brought to life with detailed pixel graphics.

4602600.name: VR Blacksmithing
4602600.about_the_game:
Step into the forge and shape hot steel with your own hands in VR Blacksmithing, a hands-on VR forging game focused on heat, hammer control, and the satisfying process of shaping metal into real objects.

In VR Blacksmithing, the goal is to capture the feel and logic of real forging in a way that is physical, and rewarding. Heat steel in the forge, bring it to the anvil, and use blacksmithing techniques like tapering, twisting, and bending to transform raw stock into a masterpiece.

Built for virtual reality from the ground up, the experience is centered on interacting directly with your tools and material. Watch steel heat up, move it between stations, and shape it through repeated strikes and careful handling. Every project is about working the metal and applying the skills you've mastered.

Whether you are curious about learning to blacksmith, love hands-on simulation games, or just want to spend time in a warm and immersive environment, VR Blacksmithing is designed to make forging feel tactile, grounded, and satisfying.

Features

  • Shape metal by hammering, tapering, twisting, and cutting

  • Use real blacksmithing logic as the foundation for gameplay

  • Create forged items through a hands-on process

  • Experience a cozy, immersive workshop atmosphere

  • Designed to be approachable for new players

4602800.name: Scriptura
4602800.about_the_game:
Scriptura is a Bible typing game. Type through every chapter from Genesis to Revelation — verse by verse, word by word, character by character.

Type the Word

Follow along as each verse appears on screen. Type what you see. Errors highlight in red; correct keystrokes advance the cursor. When you finish a chapter, your stats are saved and the next one unlocks. Pick up where you left off any time.

32 Translations, 20 Languages

Choose from 32 Bible translations across 20 languages — English (WEB, KJV, BSB, and more), Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, and many others. The interface supports 26 languages.

Daily Passages & Streaks

Each day brings a new curated passage. Complete it to build your streak. Over 200 passages from Psalms, Proverbs, the Gospels, and more keep your daily practice fresh.

11 Hand-Crafted Themes

Every theme features an animated shader background and a full set of colors designed for comfortable reading. From warm parchment to cool starfields, find the atmosphere that fits your mood.

Track Everything

See your words per minute, accuracy, total time, and per-key error rates. The key fluency chart shows exactly which keys give you trouble so you can improve over time.

79 Achievements

Complete individual books, type your first chapter with zero errors, build a year-long streak, and more. All achievements sync with Steam.

Built for Focus

Ambient music, adjustable font sizes, strict or forgiving typing modes, verse-by-verse or chapter-at-a-time pacing. Customize the experience to match how you want to engage with the text.

Pick from multiple historical factions, each with unique units, leaders, banners and playstyles. Roman legions form unbreakable shield walls. Ottoman cavalry strikes like lightning. Every faction plays differently — and every match-up tells a new story.
