4603490.name: 记忆画廊
4603490.about_the_game:
He forgot who he was, yet remembered how to see the dead.

After a horrific car accident, he woke up under the operating room lights.

He couldn’t remember his name. He couldn’t remember why he was lying in the hospital. He couldn’t remember the crying faces beside his bed — even more bizarrely, some of those faces disappeared the moment he blinked, as if they had never existed at all.

He soon discovered an absurd truth: he could see the dead. Those wandering spirits lingering in the world were staring at him silently, like drowning people clinging to the last piece of driftwood.

He had wanted to ignore them. If he didn’t even care who he was, why should he care about the dead’s last wishes?

Until he felt a note in the pocket of his hospital gown, with an unfamiliar address written on it.

The gallery was small, so small that it could only hold a dozen or so paintings. But the moment he pushed open the door, something more primitive than memory hit him — all the paintings, all the colors and brushstrokes, were depicting the same figure.

He didn’t remember that person.

But his paintbrush did. His heartbeat did. The place in his chest that had been crushed in the car accident, yet still ached faintly, remembered.

From then on, he embarked on a strange path: while helping wandering spirits fulfill their final obsessions, he searched for the vanished figure in the paintings. Every time he completed a commission, a piece of dusty memory emerged; every time he drew closer to a truth, a shadow quietly retreated in the dark.

Someone had been helping him all along. When he needed clues the most, guidance always arrived unexpectedly; when he fell into danger, someone blocked the darkest blade for him. But he couldn’t catch up to that figure, couldn’t see that face clearly, and wasn’t even sure — if that person was still alive.

Or perhaps, from the very beginning, she was never alive.

Some promises are longer than death. Some forgettings are gentler than love.

Xing Bugui:

A 27-year-old freelance painter with a gentle, persistent yet suspicious personality. After losing his memory in a car accident, he embarked on a journey to find his lost memories.

Li Yuchi:

A mysterious person who helps the protagonist with the difficulties encountered in various commissions, while not wanting to get too close to him, hoping that the protagonist can live a peaceful life.

Xuanxuan:

A cheerful little girl who appears in the hospital. She is wise beyond her years, yet she is always left alone with no adults accompanying her.

Xiao Qi:

A warm-hearted young colleague. Though she looks young, she is very good at taking care of others.

4603540.name: Who Haunts The Haunters?
4603540.about_the_game:
The Manor is Breathing.

In most social deduction games, you're looking for a "red name" or a suspicious movement. In [Who Haunts The Haunters?], the evidence is environmental. As an Intruder commits sins—stealing treasures or extinguishing spirits—their presence begins to decay the very world around them.

Key Features

  • Environmental Paranoia (The Taint System)

    • No more UI-based suspicion meters.

    • Stage 1: Only you can hear the high-pitched ringing in your ears.

    • Stage 2: Birds screech as you pass, and candles flare blue when you're near.

    • Stage 3: The room freezes, frost creeps onto others' screens, and the whispers of the dead follow you everywhere.

  • Spiritual Stability: A Living Win-Condition

    • The game doesn't just end on a timer. The Manor’s "Stability" gauge shifts with every action.

    • The Corruption Phase (<30%): Vines block your paths, and the "Mirror of Regret" shatters, releasing sealed players back into the game—but they return corrupted.

    • The Purification Phase (>70%): Secret vaults open and safe zones are established, protecting the innocent.

  • The Asura’s Hour

    • The Intruders’ kill cooldowns drop to 10 seconds, turning a game of cat-and-mouse into a frantic slaughter.

    • Will you hide in the dark, or risk a ritual to bring the stability back up?

  • Authentic Eastern Rituals

    • Perform "Purification Rituals" based on traditional folklore.

    • Feed the sorrowful koi fish by predicting their swimming paths, or awaken the Will-o'-the-wisps in the stone lanterns.

The Dead Don't Leave.

Being killed isn't the end. Become a Lingering Spirit to gather fragments of regret and help your team from beyond the grave. Or, if you were an Intruder, haunt the rituals of the living to ensure the Manor falls.

4603560.name: Hentai Age Shadow
4603560.about_the_game:
Enjoy a fun and addictive card-flipping puzzle game where your memory and focus are put to the test. Flip over cards to find matching pairs—when two identical cards are revealed, they automatically disappear from the board.

Clear all the cards to uncover a stunning hidden image of a beautiful, charming girl. Each level brings a new picture to reveal, rewarding your progress and skill.

Features :

Engaging arcade-style tile-matching gameplay

Two game modes: Normal and Hard

Relaxing and soothing background music

No time limit to complete the level

With simple gameplay, smooth animations, and visually appealing rewards, this game offers a relaxing yet engaging experience. Challenge yourself, improve your memory, and unlock every captivating image as you play!
4603560.supported_languages:
English*, Dutch*, Greek*, Japanese*, Polish*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Portuguese - Portugal*, Russian*, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*, Turkish*
*languages with full audio support

4603700.name: Save Princess Torosso
4603700.about_the_game:
⚔️ Save Princess Torosso


Become a wizard of light and rescue Princess Torosso from the prison island.

Save Princess Torosso is a fantasy 3D action adventure that combines ranged magic combat, skill card progression, and 3D platforming obstacle sections. Instead of complex equipment builds or skill trees, it focuses on intuitive controls and stage clearing, like a classic arcade game.

A pure fantasy adventure, the kind everyone dreamed of at least once in childhood, begins again.

🎮 Game Features


Magic-focused 3D action

The skill cards used in combat come in four types.

  • Projectile Magic
  • Area Magic
  • Summon Magic
  • Shield Magic

Aim, cast, and defeat the enemies closing in on you.
Collect skill cards, strengthen your magic, and advance to the next stage.

Intuitive progression system

Progression is centered on skill cards and items obtained during combat.

When you defeat enemies, you can obtain items related to health, mana, movement speed, and attack power.
Defeat certain enemies to earn skill cards. Collect the same skill card again, and that skill is automatically strengthened.

You do not need to study complex builds. Simply keep playing, and your character will naturally grow stronger.

3D platforming obstacle sections

Between chapters, platforming obstacle sections introduce a different rhythm from combat.
Use jumping, movement, timing, and mount controls to reach the next area.

Game Progression

In each stage, defeat the required number of target enemies to open the door to the next stage.
At the end of a chapter, a boss awaits. Defeat the boss, and an obstacle section leading to the next chapter begins.

⏱️ Steam Leaderboard


How fast can you rescue Princess Torosso?

When you complete the game, your clear time is recorded on the Steam Leaderboard.
Compete with players around the world and become the fastest player to rescue the princess.

📖 Story


In an age when the bloodlines of light and darkness still remained in the world,
an arrogant imperial prince is rejected after proposing to Princess Torosso. He borrows the power of darkness, invades the kingdom, and takes the princess to a cursed prison island.

A young wizard who has shared a special bond with the princess crosses the sea alone, carrying love, guilt, and the duty of one born from the bloodline of light.

Now it is time to cut off the fate of darkness with your own hands.

🕹️ Controls


A gamepad is recommended.
Controls can be checked in the lower-right corner of the screen during gameplay.
4603700.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, French, German, Russian, Polish

4603880.name: Rupture
4603880.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Rupture. RUPTURE is a heavy, tactical sci-fi shooter where gravity is broken and survival is earned. Jump into the brutal, fast-paced Free-to-Play Multiplayer, or purchase the Premium Campaign DLC to experience the relentless, story-driven fight for survival at ground zero of a spatial cataclysm.

Free-to-Play Multiplayer: Tactical & Unforgiving Step into the heavy plating of a Praetorian and take the fight online. This isn't a nimble arena shooter—you are walking artillery. Feel the physical weight of your armor as you chain together heavy gunfire, savage melee executions, and tactical gear deployments. When the environment fractures and gravity fails, fire up your thrusters and take the firefight to zero-G. Use vertical space to outmaneuver your enemies and dominate the battle.

The Campaign (Premium DLC): Into the Cataclysm An event known only as "The Rupture" has torn a classified research sector apart. As a Praetorian trapped at the epicenter, your only way out is straight through the nightmare. Purchase the Campaign DLC to push your way through a relentless, story-driven single-player experience. Piece together what triggered the disaster from the wreckage, data logs, and desperate survivors. No filler—just a focused, brutal push to the facility's core.

Key Features:

  • Brutal, Heavy Gunplay: Feel the weight of every step and shot. Manage your ammo, use cover, and strike hard across both multiplayer arenas and the single-player story.

  • Weaponize Gravity: Seamlessly transition between heavy, grounded combat and zero-gravity firefights where the rules of engagement change completely.

  • Free-to-Play Combat: Squad up or fight solo in heavy, tactical multiplayer matches that demand skill, aggression, and environmental awareness.

  • Survive the Narrative (DLC): Scavenge the collapsing facility to upgrade your suit and weapons. Tweak your loadout to match your playstyle as you survive dynamic, high-stakes encounters.

4603940.name: The Office Cat
4603940.about_the_game:
Bring a little chaos to the workplace in The Office Cat! Play as a mischievous feline exploring a busy office, knocking things over, disrupting coworkers, and turning everyday routines into hilarious moments. Sneak around, interact with objects, and create playful trouble while uncovering all the quirky secrets hidden in the office.

Key features:

  • Playful Cat Gameplay: Take control of a curious office cat and explore every corner of a busy workplace, interacting with objects in fun and unexpected ways.

  • Unlockable Tricks & Areas: Discover new abilities, hidden spots, and additional office zones as you progress and cause more trouble.

  • Relaxing Sandbox Experience: No pressure or enemies—just explore, play, and enjoy the freedom to mess around at your own pace.

  • Hidden Details & Discoveries: Find small secrets, funny interactions, and unexpected moments scattered throughout the office.

  • Pure Mischief Gameplay: Knock over items, push objects, and create satisfying messes across desks, shelves, and workspaces.
4603940.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

4603960.name: Banana Blood
4603960.about_the_game:
They call it certain death.

I call it an a-peeling adventure.

The locals tell stories about missing people and voices coming from under the ground.

A farm where no one lives, yet no one dares to enter and peek inside.

The air here smells too... Sweet.

Banana Blood is a first person comedy horror game about, well, bananas. You arrive at the banana farm that's surrounded by mystery and death and it's up to you to find out what's going on here. Weird banana creatures are creeping around, the smell of fresh banana bread is filling the air, and you can't help but feel yourself being dragged into this place.

The game is a mix of comedy and horror: the banana jokes and puns are running wild here and the cartoon-like banana creatures are too nightmarish to be in a kids' show. You get to explore the Banana Farm, the secrets inside, run from the evil creatures, solve puzzles, laugh at the jokes and jump from the scares. We have a wide selection of evil bananas chasing you and giving you nightmares, such as the violent Banana Demon, the dancing Pink Banana, creepy Banana Children, a sinister Banana Mannequin... And they're all trying to summon the Banana God.

The game also has bus customization. The game isn't about a bus. And it's not even your bus. To be honest, the bus driver is quite angry with you about it. But you can still pick some new paint colors for that bus.

Time to go bananas.

4604050.name: Everlost
4604050.about_the_game:
A World Without Edges

Everlost drops you into an infinite, procedurally generated wilderness where no two worlds are alike. Forests, highlands, frozen wastelands and open plains stretch endlessly in every direction — no loading screens, no boundaries, no repetition.

Every biome has its own character. Dense pine forests where light filters green through the canopy. Rocky highlands swept by cold wind. Flat plains perfect for building. And frozen wastes where every step costs warmth.

Survive First. Everything Else Follows.

You start with nothing. No map, no quest marker, no tutorial hand-holding. Find wood, find shelter, manage your warmth before the temperature drops. The survival loop is intentionally unforgiving in its early hours — which makes the satisfaction of a fully built base all the more earned.

  • Hunger, thirst and body temperature are your constant companions

  • Resources are finite locally — explore or starve

  • Night brings threats that punish the unprepared

  • Death means a new world, not a checkpoint

Build What You Imagine

The building system is designed for creative freedom with structural logic. Snap walls to a world-aligned grid, layer floors upward, add doors and interactive objects. Build a lean-to for night one — build a fortified compound by week one. The choice, and the consequence, is yours.

A Solo Passion Project

Everlost is handcrafted by a single developer under the Orivilon studio. Every system — terrain generation, inventory, crafting, building, save and load — is written from scratch in C# on Unity. This is a game made with genuine love for the survival genre.

Key Features

  • Infinite Procedural Terrain — Multithreaded chunk-based generation, seamless and endless

  • Deep Crafting System — Progress through tiers of tools, weapons and structures

  • Modular Base Building — Grid-snapping system for walls, floors, roofs and objects

  • Inventory & Hotbar — Drag-and-drop inventory with quick-access hotbar

  • Dynamic Day-Night Cycle — Daylight for gathering, nighttime for staying alive

  • Low-Poly Aesthetic — Bold geometry and dramatic lighting on any hardware

  • Full Save / Load System — Your world persists between sessions

4604090.name: Double or Nothing
4604090.about_the_game:
Double or Nothing is a turn-based strategy roguelite built around multiple customizable spinning boards.

Start with a simple table and turn it into your own machine. Add new segments, upgrade high-value wedges, buy relics, and decide when to take risks. Every spin can score points, generate gold, heal, add shields, or punish you with curses.

Face escalating antes, survive dangerous House Moves, and defeat a boss at the end of each ante. Clear tables to push deeper through the roster, then unlock Hell Mode for a harder version of the full game.

Why it plays differently:

  • Build your wheel during each run by adding and upgrading segments

  • Balance score, gold, shields, healing, and curse management

  • Use shops, relics, and table-specific rules to shape powerful synergies

  • Choose when to play safe and when to risk everything with Double or Nothing

  • Fight through ante bosses and clear the final showdown

  • Unlock Hell Mode and replay every table under tougher rules

Tables and modes:

  • 18 playable tables, each with its own identity, rule set, and presentation

  • Standard, Gambler, Cursed, Minimalist, Hoarder, Daredevil, Fortress, Mirror, and Void

  • Normal Mode for progression and full clears

  • Hell Mode with stronger bosses and harsher score targets

Core systems:

  • Segment upgrades that push weak wedges into powerful payoffs

  • Bets that reward reading the wheel correctly

  • Relics that reshape economy, streaks, defense, and boss damage

  • House Moves that force adaptation during boss rounds

  • Bonus Room side games that offer extra rewards and high-risk swings

4604120.name: FARLUME: Into the Silent Dark
4604120.about_the_game:
CHASE THE LAST SIGNAL. SURVIVE THE VOID.

Humanity is gone. In their final moments, they compressed everything they were into a single signal and sent it into the void. You are the last AI ship — chase that signal through endless waves of geometric enemies, mutate your weapons into neon chaos, and decode what it means to be the last one listening.

FARLUME is a roguelite bullet heaven where every single pixel is drawn live by code. No sprites. No textures. Just pure procedural neon geometry.

⚡ COMBAT & BUILDS

Weapons fire automatically — you focus on movement and survival. 15 unique weapons with 14 powerful evolutions — 29 total weapon forms to discover and master. 20 passive abilities. 25 hidden Signal Resonance synergies that secretly transform your build. 6 ships with distinct playstyles. Banish unwanted upgrades, Reroll for better options, and craft your perfect run.

🌌 ENEMIES & BOSSES

Hordes of geometric enemies flood the screen while your weapons unleash neon chaos in every direction. 22 enemy types from snipers to gravity orbs. 16 bosses with cinematic intros — most lurk hidden until you're strong enough to face them. Plus the Void Queen finale and the 25-minute Void Reaper sudden-death encounter. 12 Anomaly Events strike every 3 minutes — Plasma Storms, Vampiric Auras, Dead Zones, Berserk Hordes. Push the Void Corruption meter to 100% and survive the Breach for rare loot.

🔁 META PROGRESSION

Permanent Echo Upgrades across Hull, Core, and Drive trees. 14 unlockable Relics earned via kill milestones — each reshapes your run. Weapon Mastery milestones grant permanent buffs. 14 goals to chase. Bronze, Silver, and Gold loot chests — bosses always drop Gold.

💀 4 DIFFICULTY MODES + ENDLESS & CHALLENGE LAYERS

From Easy to VOID PROTOCOL souls-like (passive healing disabled — chests still heal, double fragment rewards, triple enemy damage). Layer on Endless mode or 9 Challenge modifiers for extra punishment. Earn VP Badges on every ship.

📖 A STORY WORTH CHASING

5 biomes from Deep Space to Signal Source — humanity's final broadcast origin. 50 Signal Log entries across 5 Acts tell humanity's final stories — a mother's farewell, a child's drawing, a musician's last song. 2 main endings + 1 hidden third ending. Boss cinematics, signal whispers, and a full ending cutscene.

🎨 POLISH & ACCESSIBILITY

Neon geometry visuals with CRT shader toggle. Full controller support. Localized in 10 languages (13 regional variants on Steam). Separate SFX/Music/Master volume sliders.
4604120.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese, Turkish

4604180.name: Once Upon
4604180.about_the_game:
Once Upon

A narrative RPG that plays itself while you work.

Pick a module — fantasy food cart journey or sci-fi survival mystery. Create your character. Set a task from your real life. Start a 25-minute Pomodoro timer and go do that task.

While you focus, the AI writes your next chapter.

When the timer ends, you come back to a new page of the story waiting for you. The world has moved. Your crew has done things. Someone said something you need to respond to. You read the chapter, make a few decisions from the cards on screen, type any free-form actions you want into the action box, and start another Pomodoro.

That's the loop. Not a game you grind — a game that grows alongside your real-life focus sessions, one chapter at a time.

(Not in a work mood? Turn the Pomodoro timer off in Settings → Debug Mode and generate sessions on demand.)

Two Modules At Launch:

The Wanderer's Table

 — A fantasy cooking journey. You travel a continent with a food cart, a stubborn pony, and your grandmother's half-finished cookbook. Five great cities, five cuisines, no combat. The weapon is a pot. The magic lives in the kitchen. ~70-90 sessions.

Outpost Kaleo

 — A sci-fi survival mystery. 31 colonists are missing. No distress signal. You have five crew, a damaged base, and one question: what happened here? Tiered lore revelation, psychological horror, multiple endings. Up to 31 sessions.

How It Plays

Every session gives you a fresh chapter, 3-6 decision cards, and a free-text action box. The AI runs NPCs, events, resources, and dice rolls behind the scenes. Your job is to steer, not micromanage.

Build Your Own Module

is really an engine with two games loaded into it. Everything — world, crew, rules, AI personality, events, music, theme — lives in a single folder of JSON files and art. Swap the folder, swap the game. Full Module Author Guide ships with the download. Drop a DLC folder in `modules/` and the engine auto-discovers it. If you can describe a world, you can build a module.

Free AI Included

Ships with a free AI tier built in. No API key, no account, no subscription — launch and play.

Full English and Simplified Chinese.

4604220.name: Wild Bunch
4604220.about_the_game: "Wild Bunch" is a unique puzzle game, combining cute cartoon graphics, four main characters and addictive gameplay. It uses a "tile sliding" format as a base for it's puzzles, that progress from easy to difficult. There is a lot of variety to the levels and puzzles, across six unique worlds.

4604230.name: ConOps21: Subversion Protocol
4604230.about_the_game:
Neo-London. The Dominion controls the feeds, the frequencies, and the future. Beneath the chrome and the curated quiet, something older and stranger is waking up.  You are Cipher Reeve. The Dominion tried to erase you. The protocol failed. Where they expected silence, something stayed.

ConOps21: Subversion Protocol: Book One — Black Signal is an interactive drama — prestige TV in game form. Authored, cinematic, canon-controlled. A complete experience for players who finish novels and watch series. No prior knowledge required. The Signal finds everyone eventually.

The Dominion does not rule by force. It rules by silence. Memory is engineered. History is curated. The population does not remember what they lost — because the systems that erased it were designed specifically to prevent remembering loss.  Beneath that surface lies the wreckage of the world before. A buried infrastructure. A wounded intelligence. A network of relay nodes the Dominion believes it neutralized but never fully mapped. A pre-Dominion civilization that built itself on shared memory — and was lobotomized for it.  Cipher Reeve is the first person in decades capable of hearing what is left. He is not chosen. He is what survived an erasure that should not have been survivable. What that means — for him, for his sister, for a city that has forgotten how to remember — is the spine of the series.

  • Cipher Reeve, first-person — you inhabit him. The camera is at his eye level. His hands appear during specific moments. You never see his face. You are the perceiver, not the avatar.

  • A supporting cast you can trust the writing on — Sylva, the analyst whose nervous system reads patterns no one else sees. Kain, the deserter who knows what the Dominion really is. Mara, the archivist who refused to delete what they ordered her to. Each has interiority. Each carries weight beyond their function.

  • Hyde — the part of Cipher the Dominion failed to erase. Internal voice. Cognitive architecture. Not a separate being. Not a character on screen. The fracture that kept Cipher alive.

  • Investigation, not action — the world responds to attention. Surface reads, memory scans, signal traces. What you choose to look at shapes what you carry forward.

  • Six minutes and forty-four seconds of broadcast — the moment the city heard what it cannot unhear. A name spoken aloud for the first time in decades. The end of an empire that thought silence was permanent.

  • Choices that persist across all six releases — your Memory Archive carries forward. The Signal State Index tracks the city's waking. What you do in Book One matters in Books Two through Twelve.

  • The novel exists alongside the game. ConOps21: Subversion Protocol: Book One — Black Signal available now on Amazon.  Same world. Same characters. Different medium. Each goes deeper into different rooms of the same architecture. Neither requires the other.

What was erased is not gone. What is buried remembers the hand that buried it.

The Dominion fears one thing above all: that humanity remembers itself. They have been wrong about everything except the threat. They were never going to be in time.  This is the first key. The world has eleven more.

Read the book, available on Amazon:  ConOps21: Subversion Protocol: Book One — Black Signal

4604280.name: 最后的妙笔人
4604280.about_the_game:
何为妙笔人——

这是一群天赋异禀的叙事高手，有着「凝梦成牌」并编织故事的能力。

他们曾行走大陆编织世间故事，如今被魔王掳入囚笼，只为取悦爱听故事的莉莉丝。

妙笔人的审判官·王女莉莉丝——

魔王独女莉莉丝，身居囚笼核心，骄纵恣肆、毒舌刻薄，对故事有着近乎偏执的极致追求。她是妙笔人的生死裁决者，唯有以笔墨凝梦编织的奇趣故事能博得其青睐。未受青睐者，其归宿将会是恶龙的腹中。

游戏特色——

1. 无需打牌，给你简洁轻快的独特游戏体验：

这是一款快节奏轻量肉鸽卡牌游戏。相较于传统肉鸽卡牌游戏，在本游戏中你的卡组固定为12张卡牌，且游戏完全摒弃了出牌操作，每轮都会翻开若干卡牌完成自动结算，你将收获简洁轻快的独特游玩体验。

不过，这并不代表游戏是缺乏挑战的。本游戏以灵感为核心资源：它既可帮你重翻卡牌，让卡牌效果联动更极致，以获取更多评分；同时也能帮你搜寻关键卡牌，以优化你的卡组上限。有限灵感的分配，将是你全程最核心的策略抉择。

同时，每轮结束后「选 1 张新牌替换 1 张旧牌」的卡组优化，同样充满策略 —— 你需要不断挖掘你卡组的上限，才能应对持续攀升的关卡难度。

2. 10 + 流派自由搭配，保证游戏的策略深度与耐玩性：

丰富的卡牌库支持多种流派构筑——武器道具流，恶人战争流，技能沉底流，竞技场配对流，野兽翻倍流，多标签流，组织尘封流......高重复游玩价值让你每一次冒险都充满新鲜感，永远期待下一个“故事”的到来。

3. 创作巨著并解锁全新卡牌，持续为你带来新乐趣：

收集的素材卡巧妙组合，谱写一部部“巨著”。每次成功创作都会解锁强力新卡，让你的牌组愈发丰富，流派逐步成型。

4604330.name: CYBER92 DATAWAR
4604330.about_the_game:
ENTER A BROKEN REALITY

Welcome to CYBER92 DATAWAR, a fast-paced, Retro-Realistic Cyberpunk Shooter where perception is your greatest weapon. This is a distorted digital nightmare where reality fractures, glitches, and collapses in real time. Shift between experimental 2nd-person and 3rd-person perspectives, and fight through a world where your vision is no longer reliable, and survival depends on how you interpret the chaos.

 A First-of-its-Kind PERSPECTIVE (Second-Person Shooter)

This is not a traditional shooter. Experience a rare second-person system fused with third-person combat, where awareness, positioning, and perception are constantly manipulated. What you see cannot be trusted, and what you don’t see may already be hunting you.

MASTER TIME & SPACE

Engage in brutal, high-pressure combat where time-space distortion is your only advantage. Bend the flow of reality to dodge incoming fire, chain precise shots, and execute devastating close-quarters melee attacks. Enemies emerge without warning, forcing instant reactions in a battlefield that never stabilizes.

HACK YOUR VISION & ADAPT

Reality is corrupted, but you can reconfigure it. Cycle through 7 radically different vision modes to survive the visual noise and expose hidden threats. Shift between stark black-and-white clarity, aggressive green night vision, surreal purple thermal distortions, and much more. Each mode reshapes the fight and your understanding of the world.

CONTROL THE CHAOS

When precision fails, unleash destruction. Commandeer fully drivable tanks and tear through enemy lines in explosive, physics-driven combat. Environments collapse, systems fail, and control becomes an illusion in a battlefield built to break.

A STORY BEYOND THE SCREEN

Beneath the collapsing system lies a fractured meta-narrative. As the main character reaches total system failure, the developer breaches their own creation using a physical floppy disk, rewriting the code, restoring life, and triggering a surreal connection between creator and creation. Reality no longer exists only inside the game.

KEY FEATURES

  • Experimental 2nd-person and 3rd-person combat system

  • Time-space distortion mechanics for precision and survival

  • 7 unique vision modes (glitch, thermal, night, abstract, and...)

  • Brutal gunplay combined with melee combat

  • Stealth-based gameplay and tactical repositioning

  • Drivable tanks and destructible environments

  • Surreal cyberpunk world with a meta-narrative twist

4604380.name: Game Dev Clicker Simulator
4604380.about_the_game:
From bedroom developer to industry giant — your studio, your rules.

Game Dev Clicker Simulator puts you in the shoes of a solo developer with big dreams and a tight budget. Build your first game, reinvest every cent and watch your small studio grow into a multi-studio corporation that dominates the video game industry.

Develop. Hire. Expand.

Every decision drives your studio forward. Create games across multiple genres, manage your team's budget and juggle several projects at once as your empire grows. The bigger you get, the more complex the challenge — and the more satisfying the reward.

Key Features:

  • Start as a solo indie dev and grow into a global corporation.

  • Develop games across multiple genres and adapt to market trends.

  • Hire employees, upgrade your tools and unlock new technologies.

  • Manage multiple studios running projects in parallel.

  • Unlock milestones, achievements and industry recognition as you scale.

Play actively or let your studios run on their own — there will always be something to upgrade, launch or conquer. The industry won't wait — will you rise to the top?
4604380.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, French, German, Korean, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian

4604410.name: Unbox your Workspace
4604410.about_the_game:
Unpack creativity and build your perfect workspace! In Unbox your Workspace, every box holds new possibilities—furniture, gadgets, and decor waiting to be placed just the way you like. Organize, decorate, and customize your environment to boost comfort and productivity. Turn an empty space into a functional and inspiring setup that truly feels like your own.

Key features:

  • Unboxing Experience: Open a variety of boxes filled with furniture, equipment, and decorative items, discovering new pieces to enhance your workspace.

  • Creative Setup: Arrange and organize your desk, shelves, and room layout to create a comfortable and efficient environment tailored to your style.

  • Customization & Aesthetics: Choose how every element looks and fits together—experiment with different layouts, colors, and decorations to achieve the perfect vibe.

4604750.name: Do NOT Press Me
4604750.about_the_game:
Think this is just another boring clicker? You’re dead wrong.

Clicker with a BossFight???

Yeah, you're right!

Do NOT Press Me is a strange and atmospheric psychological experience where a single decision changes everything.

You are faced with a simple choice:

press the button… or don’t.

But nothing is as simple as it seems.

Update:

This update introduces new content and improvements:

• Expanded interactions

• A brand new boss fight

• New location for the 2D levels

• 2 new achievements

More content is coming soon. Thank you for your support.

As you progress, the game begins to react to your actions, your patience, and your curiosity. What starts as a harmless interaction slowly turns into something deeper, darker, and more unsettling.

Take your time.

Think carefully.

And remember — every choice matters.

Gameplay:

Do NOT Press Me combines simple interaction with unexpected gameplay twists.

At its core, the game revolves around a single mechanic — interacting with a button.

However, as you progress, new layers are introduced, turning this simple idea into something much deeper.

• Make decisions that directly affect the game world

• Explore different outcomes based on curiosity or restraint

• Navigate short platforming sections that break the flow of interaction

• Discover hidden paths, secrets, and unexpected reactions

• Experience moments where the game challenges your logic and expectations

Features:

• A unique psychological experience that evolves based on your actions

• Multiple endings depending on your choices

• A mix of point & click interaction and platforming challenges

• Minimalist yet atmospheric visual style

• Unpredictable gameplay that constantly breaks expectations

• Short but memorable experience designed to stay with you

Do NOT Press Me… unless you really want to know what happens.

4604830.name: Exit Error
4604830.about_the_game:
In a world where death no longer comes, survival lost its meaning long ago. There's no need to worry about dying in this game.

  • Only return objects that you believe are correct. Incorrect objects may cause errors in the simulation.

  • Use weapons in different ways.

"Simulation B-743 has devolved into a structure where agents don't strive to finish because there is no death. I need to give them another form of punishment so they can keep moving forward. Otherwise it will never be completed."

-Ven

4604870.name: Slingshot: Escape the solar system
4604870.about_the_game:
Gravity is your enemy. It's also your only way out.

Slingshot is a pixel-art orbital mechanics arcade. One rocket. A limited fuel tank. Sun, planets and moons pulling at you from every direction. Thrust at the wrong moment and you're lost to the void. Thrust at the right moment and the solar system becomes a slingshot.

Launch. Explore. Crash.

You will die. A lot. Slingshot rewards patience, observation, and the slow build-up of orbital intuition. And also fuel management. Each crash teaches you something (or maybe not).

Upgrade your ship

Fortunately, every place you explore in the solar system, and every escape allows you to upgrade your ship to make your explorer life a bit easier.

Escape the solar system

Exploring is nice, but once your ship and skills allow it, you will launch again and try to escape the solar system.

You know this is your ultimate goal. You still don't know why, but you have to.

Features

  • You control when to burn and in which direction, as long as you have fuel. Thrust prograde at the right instant and gravity takes care of the rest.

  • (Almost) real orbital physics. Velocity Verlet integration at 4ms substeps. Every body pulls on you simultaneously. No on-rails trajectories, no fake physics. Okay you don't care, but just to say it might be hard to master.

  • 12 technologies to unlock. Efficient thrusters, fuel tank extensions, ion drives, plasma afterburners, phase shields, solar collectors, wormhole generators. Build your ship the way you want to play.

  • 100+ achievements. Solar escape runs, destination stars, fuel-efficiency challenges, hidden easter eggs. Rank up from rookie pilot to legend.

  • 12 destinations to discover. Each one comes with its own soundtrack that unlocks when you arrive.

Tune in to Spacify

Spaceify is a music player. For astronauts.

You don't know why yet, but every escape destination has it's own soundtrack you need to unlock.

Open the Spacify tab in the pause menu to play them on demand.

How it plays

Launch from Earth. Burn to break the atmosphere. Then the solar system opens up. Mercury hugs the Sun, Venus waits patiently, Mars will throw you outward if you time it right, and Jupiter's gravity well is either your salvation or your grave.

The trick isn't to thrust more. It's to thrust at the right moment : the bottom of your orbit, where every drop of fuel gives you the maximum boost. Learn to read the trajectory line. Learn to trust gravity. Learn to fall with style.

Explore. Every destination matters.

Escaping the solar system is just the beginning. Beyond the Sun's gravity well lies a map of reachable stars — Proxima Centauri, Barnard's Star, Sirius, and more. Each one is a different challenge, a different route, a different song. Some you'll stumble into. Others will take every tech upgrade, every trick, and every ounce of patience you've built up.

The logbook tracks where you've been. The Spacify player remembers every soundtrack you've unlocked. Your ranks, achievements, and fastest escape times persist across every run.

Built for obsession

Slingshot is for players who love physics more than tutorials and precision more than hand-holding. No story mode. No cutscenes. No filler. Just you, a tiny pixel spaceship, a solar system that does not care whether you make it out alive, and a killer soundtrack.

4604940.name: The Dark Realms of Chrysalis
4604940.about_the_game:
A psychological exploration experience where the world is not what it seems.

Step into a quiet, desolate realm shaped by perception, memory, and something… unseen. As Eren, you will explore a world that slowly begins to change — not around you, but through you.

As you explore, subtle visual distortions may appear — colors shifting, light behaving unnaturally, and the world itself feeling unstable. These moments are part of the experience, reflecting the fractured perception of the protagonist.

The Dark Realms of Chrysalis is a psychological, atmospheric exploration experience focused on subtle unease, perception, and discovery.

You play as Eren — a man shaped by war, memory, and something deeper that lingers beneath the surface of reality.

At first, the world appears familiar: a quiet forest, an abandoned village, a distant inn.

But something is off.

Not everything can be trusted — not the environment, not what you hear, and not even what you see.

🌑 A WORLD THAT SHIFTS WITH YOU

The environment subtly changes as you explore. Colors distort, sounds evolve, and reality itself begins to feel unstable.

🧠 PSYCHOLOGICAL EXPERIENCE

This is not about jump scares. It’s about tension, perception, and the feeling that something is wrong… before you understand why.

🎵 IMMERSIVE SOUND & ATMOSPHERE

Carefully layered audio and music create a constant sense of unease, guiding your emotions without telling you what to feel.

🗡 LIGHT COMBAT ELEMENTS

Engage in simple but impactful combat moments, including parry and counter mechanics that enhance tension rather than dominate the experience.

💬 FRAGMENTED NARRATIVE

Through subtle dialogue and environmental clues, you begin to piece together what is happening — and what has already happened.

This is just the beginning.

What you see may not be real.

What you feel… might be.

What to Expect

* A psychological, atmospheric experience focused on feeling and perception, not constant action

* A world that feels quiet, cold, and subtly wrong

* Moments of tension, unease, and uncertainty — rather than traditional horror or jumpscares

* Simple but impactful combat that supports the experience, not defines it

Note: At times, the experience may catch you off guard — not just with tension, but with unexpected moments of humor.

What This Game Is Not

* Not a fast-paced, combat-driven experience — combat is simple and supports the atmosphere, rather than aiming for deep or AAA-style mechanics

* Not a large open-world RPG filled with quests and systems

* Not a traditional, hand-holding experience — much of it is meant to be felt and interpreted

This is not a game about scale

It is a focused, atmospheric experience — built to make you feel something.

A world meant to be explored, not fully explained.

Inspired by an era of games where immersion, mood, and presence mattered more than size or complexity.

A Note on the Experience

This is an evolving indie project, and the experience may vary depending on your setup.

For the best immersion:

* Audio, graphics, and controls can be adjusted in the settings to match your preferences — the options are provided so you can tune the experience to your liking

* Performance can be tuned based on your system

Taking a moment to shape the experience to your liking will help you get the most out of it.

A Simple Understanding

This game is built with care and intention.

Step into it, adjust it to your liking, and let it unfold.

It won’t hold your hand — and that’s part of the experience.

4605040.name: Drown World
4605040.about_the_game:
Drown World combines grid-based mining with a pixel-perfect elemental simulation. Dig for resources, upgrade equipment at your airship, and carve your way through a volatile underground world in search of long-lost dwarven relics as waves of rain flood the tunnels you leave behind.

  • Dig: Delve too greedily and too deep! Collect resources amongst natural hazards — oil, lava, fire, flammable gas, acid and more. Skilled players will use the environment against itself.

  • When it rains, it pours: Rain doesn't just fall — it finds every tunnel you've carved. Manage rising floodwater, navigate shifting weather conditions, and never dig yourself into a corner you can't escape.

  • Elemental Simulation: Every pixel behaves. Water flows, lava spreads, gas ignites, acid eats through rock. Experiment, discover interactions, and learn to weaponise the underground against itself.

  • Two Ways to Descend: Two Ways to Descend: Story Mode eases you in stage by stage, saving progress and introducing new elements gradually. Descent Mode strings those stages together into one relentless run.

  • Your Airship, Your Arsenal: Return to the surface to upgrade your equipment, unlock new tools, and prepare for whatever the underground throws at you next.

  • The World is Never the Same: Fully procedurally generated levels mean every run brings new layouts, new hazards, and new ways to die.

4605050.name: Arcade World Cups
4605050.about_the_game:
Arcade World Cups is football without frills. You enter, play, and feel the excitement from the very first second, reliving the experience of the 80s arcades, but with updated gameplay and game modes.

The biggest tournament

Play the most important international championship of 2026 with the real match schedule.

Advance phase by phase until you lift the cup and become the champion.

Leagues Inspired by the Best in the World

Play league tournaments with up-to-date schedules. Start from the first matchday and compete until the end in a complete, self-contained experience.

The Most Important Continental Cups

Participate in the best cups with their real fixtures.

Two Control Styles, Two Different Gameplay Styles

Choose how you want to control the match::

  • 8-way movement with keyboard or D-pad, with the option to change pace.

  • 360° control with the analog stick for a smoother experience

All or Nothing

Experience the tension of a penalty shootout.

Community Content

The game allows you to use community-created databases to expand the experience.

4605170.name: Rush Dish Order
4605170.about_the_game:
The Ultimate Delivery Service in the Apocalypse 

Welcome to Rush Dish Order, where the "Dinner Rush" can be a fight for your life. In this casual management experience, you take on the role of the world’s bravest delivery driver in a town that never sleeps, because it's full of the undead.

Daytime: Business as Usual
Explore a newly generated town every time you play. Your mission is simple: pick up orders, navigate the streets, and serve your customers while the food is still fresh. Every successful delivery earns you the cash needed to upgrade your operations and prepare for what's coming after sunset.

Nighttime: Survival of the Fastest
When the sun goes down, the "other" customers come out. Use the money you earn to boost your delivery speed on foot or with a vehicle. Zombies won't pay for their meals, they’ll try to take whatever you have, or you if you're empty-handed! Manage your business into the ground, or raise it up to franchise into the next city in RUSH DISH ORDER!

4605210.name: Pet the Cat
4605210.about_the_game:
1,Unique “petting” gameplay: Use your mouse to pet the cat and trigger powerful attacks while surviving waves of enemies.

2,Charming hand-drawn world: Dodge, shoot, and upgrade in a cute and lively art style.

3,Build your own playstyle: Choose from food, items, and weapons between waves to create your unique build.

4,Upgradeable weapons & talent tree: Every run offers new possibilities and exciting progression.

5,Global leaderboard: Compete with players worldwide and become the ultimate cat-petting master!

4605240.name: Make my Sandwich
4605240.about_the_game:
Inhale the aroma of fresh bread and become the most thoughtful chef in Make my Sandwich! This is a cute, relaxing puzzle game where every sandwich is a tiny masterpiece crafted specifically for your guest.

Study the notes, decipher preferences, and mind the exclusions.

Your task isn’t just to assemble a snack—it’s to truly listen and understand. Every customer arrives with a unique order card. What’s on the menu today? "I want something light, but no fish" or "Anything but cheese, I have an allergy"?

Experience Every Ingredient. The gameplay is built on tactile drag-and-drop mechanics.

  • Choose your base: Soft white bread, crispy egg bread, or healthy seeded bread? Drag it onto the cutting board.

  • Build the filling: Layer by layer, stack fresh vegetables, mouth-watering meats, fish, or cheese.

  • Add a drink: The perfect sandwich needs the perfect companion—be it aromatic coffee, tea, or a refreshing soda.

In Make my Sandwich, there are no timers and no rush. This is your personal cozy corner where you can enjoy the process of creating beautiful food to the sound of calm music.

Progress through dozens of levels, from simple orders to complex culinary puzzles where every detail matters. Meet every requirement, and every sandwich will be perfect!

Key Features:

  • Care in Every Card: Solve your customers' wishes by taking their diets, allergies, and taste preferences into account.

  • Tactile Assembly: Simply drag and drop ingredients and bread onto the board to create appetizing layers.

  • Rich Variety: Dozens of cute, detailed items—from various types of bread to fish and meat fillings and drinks.

  • Cozy & Relaxing: Enjoy aesthetic art, peaceful gameplay, and a pleasant atmosphere with zero pressure.

  • For Everyone: A heartwarming game that is perfect for unwinding at any age.

4605340.name: Sushi Yummy
4605340.about_the_game:
Sushi Yummy is a cozy clicker where your only goal is to eat as much sushi as possible at a conveyor belt sushi restaurant.

Eat 'em Up and Stack Plates!

Each plate of sushi you eat provides nutrients.
Your objective is simple: keep eating sushi and accumulate nutrients.

(Nutrients vary in type and amount depending on the plate.
And yes, as everyone knows, the black ones are the most premium.)

It’s all-you-can-eat—but there’s a time limit.
The key is how much sushi you can consume within the given time.

Sushi is the source of your power

Use the nutrients you collect to unlock and upgrade your sushi-eating abilities.
Over time, you’ll be able to consume sushi more efficiently.

And More than Just Sushi

Sometimes, you can call in a model train to deliver your desserts.
(These are also one of the sources of rare nutrients.)

Every time you stack plates, you get a chance to enter a prize draw.
Collect capsule toys that provide various automation features.

Notes

  • In this game, you eat sushi directly from the conveyor belt—but please don’t do this in real life.

  • Most of the Fun Facts about sushi in this game are NOT true.

Guidelines about Streaming / Uploading Video

You are free to stream or upload gameplay and review content of this game, and monetize it.

However, we would appreciate your cooperation with the following:

  • Please include a URL to this store page in your video description.

4605380.name: Block Clicker
4605380.about_the_game:
Hi! I'm a solo indie game developer trying to create fun and entertaining games.

Block Clicker is a mining clicker game where you break blocks to collect resources and grow your operation.

Mine a wide variety of blocks, each with different values, and turn your resources into powerful upgrades. Improve your clicking strength, unlock automation systems to keep progressing even when you’re not actively playing.

Features

  • Mine a variety of blocks, each with unique values

  • Upgrade your power with strong Player Upgrades

  • Build automation systems that mine for you

  • Use consumables for strategic boosts

  • Complete missions and unlock achievements

  • Prestige to grow stronger every run

Break blocks. Earn resources. Build your mining empire.

4605560.name: Occupancy
4605560.about_the_game:
Be careful where you let your eyes rest.

Occupancy is a first-person psychological horror series built around interviews with people who lived through experiences that don't quite add up. A detective has spent years collecting these cases. Events that don't fit. Anomalies in survivors' accounts. Gaps where memory should be.

Each chapter is one of those interviews, and you play both sides of it. As the survivor, you walk through a first-person reconstruction of the night, moving through the rooms they remember and doing the things they had to do. As the detective, you sit across the table with the case file open, holding everything that was left behind after it happened. You can swap between the two at any time. The memory in front of you and the evidence in your hands don't always line up. Find the disagreements and clear them from the memory to remember more of what actually happened, before something else takes hold.

Chapter 1

Some nights are too dark to remember clearly.

The first interview. A young man, a teenager at the time, alone in his family's house for an evening. What he remembers and what was found afterward don't match, and where they don't, something else is waiting. He hasn't spoken about it in years. Tonight he tries.

Gameplay

  • Walk through memory. Each interview drops you into a first-person reconstruction of the night. Move through the spaces he describes, examine objects, take in details the conversation will need later.

  • Catch what doesn't belong. Switch your attention between the room as he remembers it and the room as the evidence shows it. The differences are the truth surfacing. Find them and you can push past them to the next part of the night.

  • The gaps don't stay empty. What you leave behind, what you don't notice, feeds something. The more you leave, the worse it gets.

  • Choose how the night gets told. Your dialogue and your attention shape which version of it you reach by the end. There's no single ending, and there's no obvious right one.

What to expect

  • A complete standalone story. Future chapters follow the detective into new investigations. New survivor, new night, new environment.

  • Multiple paths and endings, with branches that diverge meaningfully partway through. (not just 1 final choice)

  • No two interviews unfold the same way. The anomalies, the evidence, and the memories you can recover shift from playthrough to playthrough.

  • Built in Unreal Engine 5, focused on optimized photorealistic graphics.

From the developer

A few things I want to be upfront about, since these questions tend to come up and I want to be transparent:

  • Each chapter is a complete experience. Nothing is held back or split off, despite the game having "Chapters." I fully believe in each chapter being its own experience and being a completely playable game on its own. The only reason for the format is to give me the ability to connect them all on top of the standalone games.

  • In regards to voice acting and localization, the game will have voice acting however since I am a solo developer the voice acting will only be in English at launch. That said the game will still have subtitles and other interface localization for all of the languages listed in the side bar. (voice dubbing is on the table for post launch updates though)

  • The release date is currently set to sometime in 2027. Ideally I want it to launch sooner rather than later, but the nature of making a game may say otherwise. That said, at the very least I plan to have a playable demo months before release. (its cliche but I would rather publish something I feel is a good product and worth a players time and money than rush something because there's a deadline)

Thanks for reading. If this is your kind of thing, a wishlist helps me know there's an audience for it.
