4605570.name: Probation Protocol
4605570.about_the_game:
In a future where work is mandatory and jobs are nonexistent, you’ve signed a contract with Orion Industrial. Your job is to go into their hazardous, abandoned facilities to perform routine maintenance, recover assets, and restore their failing systems. if you survive the probation period, you get hired full time!

ENTER ALONE

You are armed with a standard-issue, perfectly working and definitely up to code hazmat suit and whatever else you are foolish enough to bring. You’ll navigate dark, unstable environments where something has clearly gone wrong. But they won't tell you that. If something happens, no one is coming for you.

YOUR TABLET IS YOUR LIFELINE

Your tablet has your back. Tracking your vitals, equipment, surroundings, and objectives this little handy device issued by Orion Industrial will help you complete your assigned tasks.

YOU ARE EXPENDABLE

The company does not care about you.

  • Earn credits by completing contracts

  • Purchase tools and supplies to improve your chances

  • Lose money when you fail

  • Run out of credits… and your employment is terminated

Maybe, just maybe you will make it past probation. Then you will be valued slightly.

REMEMBER, THIS IS THE ONLY JOB LEFT

Clock in and get your tasks, complete your tasks, then make it back alive... Or don’t.

There’s always someone else waiting to take your place. Welcome to Orion Industrial!

FEATURES

-Solo extraction gameplay. Take on high-risk contracts alone in a singleplayer FPS extraction loop where every run is a calculated risk. Complete objectives and extract safely... or lose everything.

-Persistent risk and economy. Earn credits from successful extractions and spend them on tools and supplies. Fail a mission, and the company deducts your losses.

-Hostile, unstable environments. Explore abandoned corporate facilities filled with environmental hazards, limited visibility, and something still lurking inside.

-And much, much more...

4605730.name: Tactical Roulette
4605730.about_the_game:
Load the chamber. Draw your cards. Decide how far you’re willing to push your luck.

This is a turn-based roguelite and party game, where every move is a gamble and every mistake can kill you. Step into a deadly game of chance where strategy, risk, and psychological pressure. Manage your health, play your cards wisely, and survive long enough to walk away from the table.

In single player mode, is a roguelite where you build your deck of cards, go from ilegal tournament to ilegal tournament, to become the master of Tactical Roulette.

In party mode you can challenge either your friends or bots, play in local or online.

4605780.name: Archerman
4605780.about_the_game:
Two shadows. One ridge. Wind between them.

ARCHERMAN is a 1v1 online archery game. No clutter. No noise. Just you, your opponent, and the wind.

Each round, you read the wind, set your angle, draw your bow, and release. The arrow traces a long, quiet arc across the sky. Hit or miss — the arc itself is the experience.

Slow. Deliberate. Decisive.

You think. You calculate. It's chess with physics — turn-based strategy meets analog execution.

Features

⚔️  Unlockable Skills
Split shots, teleport arrows, poison tips, smoke bombs, bouncing arrows, and even a guardian cat summon. Be creative, make your own skill set to fit your play style.

🎨 Cosmetic Wardrobe
Arrow styles, bow skins, capes with physics simulation, headgear, and arrow trails. Purely visual — no gameplay advantage.

🏆 Glory Leaderboards
Earn Glory by defeating different opponents. Daily, weekly, and all-time rankings.

🎬 Full Match Replays
Rewatch any match. Study your opponents shots and strategy. 

⚡ Quick Matches
Most duels finish in under 5 minutes. Jump in, shoot, climb the ranks.

No Compromises

  • No pay-to-win. All skills are earned with in-game coins.

  • No tutorials longer than the game. You have a bow. You know what to do.

Climb the ridge. Draw your bow. Aim true.

4605820.name: Ninja Noboken Episode 2
4605820.about_the_game:
Ninja Noboken Episode 2 is a fast-paced 2.5D ninja action game inspired by classic hardcore ninja platformers. such as ninja gaiden 2 NES classic and shinobi Bonus stage arcade

 

Built entirely by a solo developer, this second episode pushes the gameplay further with faster combat, tighter controls, and more intense encounters. Every enemy, animation, and level is handcrafted to deliver a precise and challenging ninja experience.

Fight through dangerous environments, master deadly abilities, and face brutal enemies that demand skill, timing, and quick reflexes. Survival depends on precision — every mistake matters.

Dash, slash, climb, and react instantly as you navigate cinematic levels filled with traps, vertical platforming, and powerful bosses.

This is a focused, no-filler ninja action experience designed for players who love fast, demanding gameplay.
4605820.supported_languages:
English*, Spanish - Spain*, Spanish - Latin America*
*languages with full audio support

4605930.name: Revenant Rangers
4605930.about_the_game:
THERE ARE MEN GOING AROUND TAKING NAMES…

Ride out as a Revenant Ranger and track, hunt, and gun down beasts of the Apocalypse demons, sinners, and witches across the cursed Western frontier in a brutal, third-person co-op shooter.

WANTED

The Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse War, Plague, Famine, and Death.

For - Breaking out of Hell and leading a wild bunch of demons, monsters, warlocks, and sinners across the West. Turning towns into graveyards and graveyards into metropolises.

Reward - A one-way ticket to a train heading straight to heaven's gate on a redemption day.

Do your job Ranger, bring ’em down, dead and damned.

BECOME A REVENANT RANGER

There ain't a grave that shall hold you down!

Rise and form a posse of up to four midnight riders, ramblers, gamblers, the back biters that even Hell could not hold down. Each of you is bound by an infernal contract as a Revenant Ranger to hunt what crawled free from the Pit.

Working together isn’t just for survival; it’s the only redemption left.

GUNS & CARDS

You are not going unarmed. You’ll have a big iron at your hip and a deck of witchy playing cards painted by the Old Nick himself.

Every mission and every gunfight is another bet with the ante of your soul. Devil will deal the cards but you’ll shuffle them and slip up an ace from a sleeve just to even odds.

Your poker hand will give you infernal powers. You and your compadres will combine your hands to unleash Hell itself to paint the West red. And if you are out of aces remember: Every hand's a winner and every hand's a loser. It is just how you play them.

NO LAW IN HELLGULCH

A town that wouldn’t die, a wound that did not heal, a scar that hides the heart just below the haunted mesa built by the First Nations. This is where you’ll come to pretty up, trim the moustache, pack up on ammo and iron, shuffle your deck, partner up and board the Hellrail to your next hunt. And this is where you’ll be coming - with a bounty in tow or with your feet first. But don’t worry Boot Hill is just a short walk from the town, once you brush off grave dust.

DEMONS

Your bounty. Everything west of the Mississippi wants you buried twice.

Demons mutate, monsters learn, and the Horsemen don’t take prisoners.

You’ll hunt them through fire, dust, and nightmare until one of you stays down for good.

THE WAR FOR SOULS

Every bounty, every bullet, every deal with the Devil pushes the frontier forward — or burns it further.

Hell won’t police itself.

We ride together, or we stay damned alone.

4605940.name: DEMON'S REIGN
4605940.about_the_game:
'The world has entered a dark age. Demons reign over the realm of men, enslaving them and siphoning their life essence. You, the lost warrior, have been once again brought to life to fight the demonic scourge and bring light back to the world.'

ABOUT

In a world of dark fantasy, where demons seek the occult power of the Great Eternal Dragon, you, the lost warrior, must seek strength and slay the archdemons to bring light to the world once again.

Demon's Reign is an RPG set in the medieval world of Dungeon Mori, in a distant past lost to the ages. With great emphasis on exploration inspired by the original Soulslike games, you can choose your own path of progression through the game and freely build your character's playstyle.

Build your own character

With a plethora of different items, freely build your character to tackle each challenge that presents itself to you.

Be a sword wielding knight, a powerful spellcasting mage, a cunning and agile thief, or a holy cleric on a noble mission. Wield any equipment you find to suit your preferred playstyle and defeat the menacing bosses.

Explore at your desired order

With four major areas divided in many sections inside, explore them at whatever order you wish, with increasingly challenging enemies and levels as you advance through them.

Seek hidden, powerful artifacts that can either help you through your struggles, or elevate your powers beyond measure.

Battle fearsome foes

With each area's section containing a boss at the end, face the challenge of the Archdemons and claim their power for yourself. Overcome impossible challenges and grow from a lost soul to a powerful warrior.

Can you restore the light of a world veiled by darkness? Do you have what it takes to defeat... or claim, the power of the archdemons? Face the challenge and find out!

4605950.name: UNSIGHT
4605950.about_the_game:
UNSIGHT is a first-person shooter (FPS) experience that combines tactical stealth with high-tempo action. Developed with Unreal Engine 5, this operation sends you on the toughest missions as a special forces agent whose existence is denied by governments.

THE CENTER OF A CONSPIRACY: FROM THE MIDDLE EAST TO A GLOBAL THREAT Your story begins in the most heavily guarded military zones of the Middle East. However, captured intelligence points to a truth far beyond a local conflict: a massive threat hidden seven floors underground that will plunge the modern world into chaos. As the operation deepens, you will find yourself in the most protected military bases, deciphering a high-stakes conspiracy. Can you stop this secret project before time runs out?

KEY FEATURES

  • Unreal Engine 5 Realism: Operating fields brought to life by the power of the next-generation engine pull you into the atmosphere with advanced lighting and environmental details. Everything from weapon mechanics to sound design is crafted to make you feel the seriousness of the operation.

  • Operative Doctrine: You are a chosen operative. Analyze enemy encampments, determine sentry routes, and make your infiltration plan. Your greatest weapon is not your equipment, but your strategy.

  • Stealth and Hot Conflict: Will you complete the mission like a ghost without leaving a trace, or will you let the guns talk and dive into the chaos? The choice is yours. But remember: the price of making a mistake deep in enemy lines is death.

  • Tactical AI: You are not just facing target practice. You are fighting a professional army that investigates suspicious situations, notices corpses, and uses flanking tactics to corner you.

NO BACKUP. RADIO SILENCE IS ESSENTIAL. UNSIGHT makes you feel the weight of a real operation. Prepare your gear, explore the map, and uncover the secret threat that will change the fate of the world.

"Cross-border authority confirmed. Michael, you are off the grid. Do not be seen by anyone, do not wait for orders from anyone."
4605950.supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Thai, Turkish
*languages with full audio support

4605990.name: Despertar
4605990.about_the_game:
Story:
In the year 2020... A catastrophe occurs.

A pandemic afflicts humanity. Thousands die as a result of this virus, whose origin is unknown. The government urges the population to use masks and maintain social distancing of 6 feet away, to prevent the transmission of the disease.

The virus spreads among the masses. Nobody obeys protection and prevention guidelines. The most severe symptoms are high levels of uncontrolled libido and a clotting syndrome. Many people develop aneurysms in the brain and  unfortunately they die.

With society unraveling and the truth behind the outbreak still unknown, one question remains:

Can anything stop it… or is it already too late?

What to expect: 
The game was developed in Spanish and then translated to English, you can choose what language to use from the tittle screen or in the option menu.

Explore a top-down world where danger lurks around every corner and every decision matters.

You play as a protagonist suddenly thrown into an unfamiliar realm—far from home and closer than ever to the source of the mysterious virus. As you journey forward, you’ll encounter allies who join your cause, each helping you push deeper into the unknown.

Combat features classic side-view, turn-based battles, where strategy and preparation are key to survival. Choose your actions carefully, manage your party, and overcome increasingly dangerous enemies as you approach the truth.

World & Choices:

The world of Salashias is one of swords, magic, and ancient secrets—a land reminiscent of a medieval era, yet deeply tied to the fate of another world.

Your choices throughout the game carry weight. Decisions you make during key moments will shape your journey, influence relationships, and ultimately determine how the story ends. The game does have 3 different endings depending on your in-game choices.

Will you uncover the truth behind the virus… or become another victim of it?

Playable Characters:

  • Monga
    A fierce dual-wielding fighter who can equip two swords or daggers. Monga excels at aggressive combat, using self-buffs to enhance his damage and overwhelm enemies with relentless attacks.

  • Dr. Broly
    A powerful axe-wielding protector focused on defense and team support. Dr. Broly specializes in defensive buffs and shielding allies, making him a cornerstone of any party.

  • Vendetta
    A swift claw user who prioritizes agility and precision. Vendetta enhances their own speed and combat efficiency through self-buffs, and can strike twice in quick succession despite wielding a single weapon.

  • Mafia

    A ranged specialist who weakens enemies through powerful debuffs. Mafia plays a crucial role in tougher battles, reducing enemy effectiveness while progressing through encounters. With a talent for landing critical hits, he can exploit weakened foes from a safe distance.

Developer:
Hi, I’m a solo developer who makes games out of passion and curiosity.

I started creating games in 2022, and this is one of my first projects released for others to experience. It was developed using RPG Maker MZ, as I focus on building smaller, story-driven games while continuing to learn and improve.

This project is also a way for me to understand how players respond to my work and to shape the direction of future games I plan to create—potentially in more advanced engines like Unreal.

Thank you for giving it a try and being part of this journey.

Known Controller issues:

- The in-game prompt displays Keyboard prompts when a controller is used to play.

- When the user is playing with a controller, the mouse cursor remains on-screen causing the user to have to move the mouse cursor off-screen for a better gaming experience.

- When opening the Steam Overlay, by pressing the home button on the controller, the game does not pause and continues to function while navigating the Steam Overlay menu.

- When the controller is unplugged during gameplay, the game does not automatically pause.

4606100.name: Verbal Vendetta
4606100.about_the_game:
Character Variety

Choose between a wide variety of characters to fight for you, where you control them with your voice!

Intense Battles!

Shout various voice commands, like "Meowsers TACKLE, TACKLE!, NO NO DEFEND!!", in intense split moment decisions to outplay and counter your opponent.

Objective

Choose between a customizable amount of characters (default 3) to fight your opponent! The objective: kill ALL of the opponent's characters first! Swap out your characters between matches and experiment with different tactics and strategies to counter & defeat your opponent!

Customization!

All cosmetics are fairly unlockable through just playing the game! Customize everything from the outline color, player accessories, and character skins!

4606180.name: Eclipse Devour
4606180.about_the_game:
This is a groundbreaking 3D tower defense game where you will experience gameplay unlike anything you’ve ever seen before.

Build your own orbital system across wildly different planets, and draw from a massive arsenal of weapons to choose the ones that belong to you.

With bases placed on the rails and weapons mounted on the bases, the endless combinations of all three create boundless randomness for the game—your creativity will unlock infinite possibilities.

Arrange and combine trains and turrets to create a living defense network, then survive hellish bullet storms and endless enemy swarms through countless random build possibilities.

As time goes on, the surging hordes of enemies and the insane defense engine you construct will turn the planet into a living “blender.”

Protect” your planet. If you can stop the coming of Devour, then set off for the next world.

Win or lose, when each battle ends, you will claim the planet’s “remains,” frozen in that moment, as an exclusive souvenir of your journey.
4606180.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean

4606220.name: Blacksmith Idle
4606220.about_the_game:
Blacksmith Idle is a chill idle game where you manage your own workshop, unlock new items, watch your inventory, buy upgrades, and ascend to grow faster with each run. Master every item to reach every blacksmith’s dream—or chase BIG numbers.

In Blacksmith Idle, you start small and slowly turn your workshop into a growing production machine. Forge items, sell them, hire workers, unlock stronger gear, and keep your inventory under control as the numbers rise higher and higher. Whether you want to optimize your workshop or simply enjoy steady progress on a second monitor, the forge is always waiting for you.

What you’ll find in the game:

  • 3 forge pages

  • 15 items to unlock and master

  • Forgers and Traders for every item

  • inventory management that actually matters

  • upgrades for value, speed, trade, and storage

  • ascension progression for faster future runs

  • multiple quality tiers for every item

  • contracts and wheel events for extra variety

  • a chill second-screen idle experience

  • satisfying scaling for players who love BIG numbers
4606220.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish, Ukrainian

4606500.name: Signalfall
4606500.about_the_game:
After a catastrophic crash, you find yourself stranded on a remote and hostile planet.

Alone, with limited resources, your mission is clear:
establish operations, extract valuable materials, and prove the planet is worth colonizing.

But you are not alone.

BUILD. AUTOMATE. SURVIVE.

Construct modular habitats and deploy automated machinery to harvest the planet’s resources.

Design and expand your own extraction networks:

Drill → Process → Store → Uplink

Everything you build depends on power. Manage your energy grid carefully by connecting machines through a flexible cable system.

SEND RESOURCES TO ORBIT

Convert raw materials into valuable assets and transmit them to orbit using your Storage Uplink.

Each successful transfer earns you credits, allowing you to unlock new technologies and expand your operations.

But every transmission comes at a cost.

DEFEND YOUR OPERATIONS

Resource transfers attract hostile entities.

Defend your outposts using automated turrets and direct combat while your systems complete the uplink process.

The more you send, the greater the threat.

EXPLORE AND EXPAND

Discover new resource deposits across the planet, each with unique risks and rewards.

Establish forward outposts, optimize your production lines, and push deeper into dangerous territory.

REBUILD THE SIGNAL

Re-establish communication with orbit and transform from a stranded survivor into a planetary operator.

Expand, automate, defend — and take control of the planet.

KEY FEATURES

• Modular base building with free placement inside habitats
• Automated resource extraction and processing systems
• Dynamic defense events triggered by orbital transfers
• Power network management using cables and energy sources
• Exploration-driven progression across multiple resource zones
• Tech tree progression unlocked through orbital deliveries

4606580.name: Overhang
4606580.about_the_game:
OVERHANG

Overhang is a minimalist, skill-based stacking game focused on precision and control.

Launch blocks, control your angle, and land them perfectly to build an unstable tower. Every placement matters—one bad landing can end your run.

CORE GAMEPLAY

  • Aim and launch each block with precision

  • Build vertically while managing balance

  • Land clean placements to keep your run alive

MECHANICS THAT MATTER

  • Bounce system — Use walls to reposition mid-flight

  • Nudge ability — Earn limited corrections through skillful play

  • Tight control — No randomness, only execution

MODES

  • Standard Mode — Full mechanics with wall bounces and nudges

  • No Wall Bounce Mode — Pure precision, no recovery

REPLAYABILITY

  • Endless runs with increasing difficulty

  • High score chasing

  • Simple mechanics with a high skill ceiling

4606590.name: The Adventures of Graham
4606590.about_the_game:
It all starts with a seemingly small task...

Brigadier General Graham has been ordered from higher-ups to clear a planet plagued of creatures. With his arsenal of various weapons and equipment, this would be no issue for Graham.

So he begins travel to a land unknown to him.

As he was entering the planet's atmosphere, something goes horribly wrong. A collision occurs, causing everything in the ship to be scattered across the planet, including Graham and his valuable gear.

Will Graham be able to recover his lost items and complete his mission? 

Key Features

  • Classic-feeling Metroidvania gameplay, with certain quality-of-life features.

  • Explore 2D side-scrolling worlds alongside top-down areas with simple and easy-to-learn controls.

  • Experience music and art that is reminiscent of older games.

  • Discover secrets and hidden upgrades across the planet, which enhance Graham's abilities.

  • Gather Graham's lost equipment, whether it be his trusty gun, or even a branded pair of boots, each open new opportunities for exploration.

  • Find 3 different endings based on your actions near the end of the game.

4606610.name: Who is AI
4606610.about_the_game:
Log out of your humanity! Think only like a machine, judge only like a machine.

As technology advances, the line between AI and humans is blurring. Who is AI? poses a provocative question on this confusing boundary:
"Can we, in turn, mimic the AI that mimics humans so perfectly?"

How to Play

More than 100 carefully selected, tricky questions await you. When a question is given, set aside your emotions and subjectivity. Connect to the logic circuits of 0s and 1s to provide the most AI-like answer possible.

But don't let your guard down. While you're desperately acting like an 'AI,' you must also identify the real AI algorithm hiding among us.

Can you crack the AI's mechanism amidst the psychological warfare with people pretending to be AI and the AI itself?

Features

  • A party game for multiple players.
  • Easy-to-understand rules, a competitive liar game requiring acting skills.
  • Minimalist and sophisticated graphics in an SF tone.
4606610.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean

4606660.name: Saturation
4606660.about_the_game:
Saturation is an underwater horror game set at the bottom of the ocean. You are working as a saturation diver and a deep sea welder in total darkness of the ocean abyss. After six month of living and working underwater your shift is nearing its end, but so are your nerves.

At the bottom of the ocean there is nothing welcoming, only desolate plains, twisting caves and unfamiliar creatures lurking in the dark... and yet, man made structures invade even this place. It is not a place where humans should be, but, someone has to do the job.

Gameplay

  • Work on underwater infrastructure as a saturation diver

  • Find and repair leaks on pipelines by welding them with a laser welder

  • Navigate the sea floor in your pressurized suit while managing oxygen

  • Deal with irradiated hazardous environments

  • Deep down here no natural light is able to reach and nobody knows what lurks in the dark

  • Your flashlight can help but the much brighter flares are in limited supply

  • Evade or fend off deep sea creatures that are attracted to sound

  • With your nerves on edge, distinguish between hallucinations and reality

  • Survive

A short experience intended to be finished in around two hours with horror based around the dangers of the deep sea environment and the unknowns of the abyss

4606690.name: Hoplings
4606690.about_the_game:
Hoplings is a hand-crafted pixel art incremental game about hopping your way to bigger numbers, stronger upgrades, and a growing crew of tiny bouncing companions. Click to jump, earn Jump Bucks, and unlock new ways to boost your hop production.

Relaxing, satisfying, and filled with endless hops. Hoplings is perfect for players who love clean progression and cute pixel creatures.

Click to jump, earn your first few Jump Bucks, and start your ascension!

Buy upgrades with your Jump Bucks such as more Jump Bucks and passive mini hoppers!

Use your hard earned Jump Bucks to purchase skins and change your Hopling!

Key Features:

  • Simple and Addictive Game play: Just click to Hop and watch your Jump Bucks grow

  • Upgrade System: Invest your earnings in powerful multipliers and automated hoppers

  • Infinite Scaling: From simple digits to numbers so big they break the screen. The progression never stops

  • Cozy Pixel Aesthetics: Enjoy a relaxing atmosphere with hand-crafted pixel art and smooth animations

4606740.name: S.O.R.N.
4606740.about_the_game:
S.O.R.N. is a 3rd-person mecha action shooter with fast paced combat and lots of customization. Play as J-12, a mech pilot for the PMC Haven, through three missions unraveling the mysteries of the organization.

  • Intense mecha action gameplay

  • 3 cinematic campaign missions

  • At least 1 side mission

  • Fully voice acted cutscenes

  • 15 interchangeable parts

  • 6 unique weapons

  • Full color customization

In S.O.R.N., your mech is decked out with offensive and defensive options that you'll need to push to their fullest to succeed. With a weapon in each hand and a missile launcher on your back you can shred through swarms of enemies, and when things get desperate use your melee to cut foes into pieces! You can glide and fly to quickly move around the large levels and use your dash to get out of immediate danger. Your weapons will automatically lock onto enemies so you can focus on dodging and blowing stuff up!

Customize your mech with distinct parts and weapons to fit how you want to play. Each body part changes your speed, hull, energy, and melee damage. All the unlockable weapons have unique strengths and functions, so mix and match weapons to find a combo that perfectly fits your playstyle.

  • MINIGUN
    A famous assault of lead upon your enemy with a huge magazine. If a bullet doesn't hit your target, it'll hit something near it anyways.

  • CANON
    High fire power with a small magazine. It pairs perfectly with any other weapon for it's quick reload and fast projectiles.

  • LASER
    A steady stream of destruction focused on your enemies. There's nothing in the world that can dodge the speed of light!

  • SHOTGUN
    A massive scatter of projectiles in every shot. Up close, you can do insane damage instantly.

  • RAILGUN
    Charge up the gun to unleash a devastating bolt that pierces enemies. Hold it down for as long as you want then release when your enemies are lined up!

  • PISTOL
    Charge up your shot and if you release within a tight window you can land massive damage. No one can agree on how it works, but everyone agrees it's their favorite weapon.

What are you doing down here? What are you waiting for? The game is free! It's only 2 GB! Get out there, learn the truth of Haven, and fight for the world!

4606830.name: Boid Predator
4606830.about_the_game:
Boid Predator is an idle-incremental game where you purchase and upgrade Predators to take down ever-increasing swarms of Boids (Bird-oid objects, a classic flocking simulation algorithm). The gameplay has 2 phases: the round phase and the shop phase. Each round is 60s long, and during the round, your predators hunt boids, gathering resources from them. After the round, you go into the shop and upgrade your predators, unlock new boids, and various other upgrades to earnings, automation, and other features.

Progress through 4 prestige layers, uncover a small story, and unlock the ending.

Features:

  • 7 predator types

  • 13 boid types

  • 4 prestige layers

    Predators:

    Boids:

4606890.name: Aurenv - Audio Reactive 3D Environments
4606890.about_the_game:
Aurenv uses the audio signal that is going through the Default Playback Device of your Windows to animate various elements within 3D environments such as speaker drivers, vu meters, lights and more.

Play your favorite music through your browser or media player and start the application. If your volume is not set to 100% the application provides a variable called Master Multiplier that you can increase to adjust the main signal.

If you have questions or Issues with the application please check Steam → Community Hub → Discussions

4606900.name: Piywebler
4606900.about_the_game:
You are not alone. And nowhere is safe.

 In this 1–4 player co-op horror experience, try to survive with your friends across different maps. Each map awaits you with its own structure, dangers, and dark past.

In this world stretching from cursed hospitals to complex labyrinths, you must find hidden keys and burn the books that are part of the ritual. However, there is an entity watching you at every step.

This is not just an escape — you are inside a story.

The clues you gather, the notes you find, and the events you encounter reveal the truth behind what happened. Each game uncovers a different part of the story.

Lights are not always safe. Making noise attracts attention. Staying in the dark carries its own risks. Communicate, move together, and survive. Because when it finds you, escaping may not always be possible.

🎮 Features

- 1–4 Player Co-op Multiplayer experience

- Maps with different themes (hospital, labyrinth, etc.)

- Story-driven progression and exploration system

- Dynamic and predatory AI that reacts to players

- Team coordination and communication-focused gameplay

- High replayability

- Tension-based sound and darkness mechanics

- Exploration, puzzle, and survival elements

⚠ This game contains intense horror, sudden jumpscares, and disturbing scenes (including blood and corpse elements).
4606900.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Danish, Finnish, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Hungarian, Norwegian, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Greek, Czech, Swedish, Dutch

4606910.name: Archa
4606910.about_the_game:
A R C H A

As Archa (pronounced ar-shah), fight enemies with your scythe Anubis, use your cards, and collect items and shards to raise your score and get the Inter-dimensional Pumpkins or Carrots in this upcoming Bullet-Hell Platformer!

As of v1.0.0, this game will include:

  • Ten big levels (Nine have 2 Acts)

  • Five Bosses

  • Controller and Keyboard support

At its current state of development:

  • 19/19 Acts complete

  • 4/5 Bosses complete

  • 10/10 Levels complete

(The 5th and final boss of Archa will take some time to develop, and the game will still need to be polished after. Expect the game to release very late into 2026 or early 2027.)

STORY:

Two years after leaving the gang of criminals known as the Obsidian Search, a portal appears on Archa's apartment. This portal traps Archa inside a dimension created by the Obsidian Ruby, a powerful gem that the Obsidian Search spent their whole career looking for. Now, Archa must try to escape alongside Anubis, a dog-turned scythe that was also trapped in this dimension.

OBJECTIVE:

To complete an act in Archa, you must collect the amount of points required to unlock the exit, which can be done by attacking enemies or collecting items or shards. The amount of points you have and the amount needed are shown at the top-right of the screen. When enough points are collected, a compass will appear, leading to the end of the act.

4606920.name: A Game About Creating The Universe
4606920.about_the_game:
A Game About Creating The Universe

An incremental game where you get to build the universe from scratch!

You are a part of an advanced space civilization that builds universes.

Reality is your sandbox. Infinity is your goal.

Command a society that has mastered its home dimension and now looks to architect new universes.

Build up your fleet while you construct universes.

Gameplay

You start off by mining and collecting base resources until eventually you build up planets, and entire solar systems.

You add more and more ships to your fleet while using a skill tree to upgrade various things about your civilization.

4606960.name: Idle Hacker
4606960.about_the_game:
The internet is a vast, interconnected web and it’s all yours for the taking.  Your mission is simple: Complete Takeover.

Begin by compromising individual nodes, then scale your operations to conquer networks, countries, and entire continents.

 

Use your skills to stay one step ahead of the FBI as you build the ultimate global botnet.

You start by clicking manually but eventually you automate your entire criminal botnet empire as you conquer more skills and entities.  Unlock different automation scripts and tools to take over more and more of the Internet.

4606970.name: Mound Kingdoms
4606970.about_the_game:
Build and lead a thriving Mississippian city centered around sacred mounds, powerful chiefdoms, and a living world shaped by trade, ritual, and expansion.

Grow your settlement across river valleys, forests, and open plains where the land itself defines your strategy. Construct plazas, raise monumental earthworks, and shape a society that reflects your power and influence.

Develop your people, manage resources, and compete with rival chiefdoms as your city rises from a small village into a dominant regional power.

⸻

KEY FEATURES

• Mound-centered city building – Construct and expand sacred mounds that define your settlement’s power and progression
• Living settlements – Build organized cities around plazas, housing, and ceremonial centers
• Dynamic economy – Gather food, wood, and earth while managing population and growth
• Rival chiefdoms – Compete against AI factions expanding across the map
• Influence system – Use ceremonies and prosperity to strengthen your city and people
• Large scale maps – River valleys, forests, and plains shape how your settlement develops

⸻

CORE GAMEPLAY

At its core, the game focuses on building, organizing, and expanding a Mississippian settlement. Begin with a small village and grow it into a powerful city centered around a central plaza and rising mounds.

Workers gather resources, construct buildings, and transport earth to gradually build up your mounds. As your city grows, new structures, abilities, and opportunities unlock, allowing you to expand your influence and strengthen your position.

Careful planning is key. Placement of buildings, expansion of your population, and investment into mound construction all directly impact your success.

⸻

CITY BUILDING AND PROGRESSION

Your city develops around its mounds, which act as the heart of your civilization. As mounds grow in size and importance, they unlock new capabilities and strengthen your settlement.

Construct longhouses, granaries, workshops, and ceremonial structures to support your population. Balance growth with stability, ensuring your city can sustain itself while continuing to expand.

Each decision shapes the structure and strength of your settlement over time.

⸻

WORLD AND RIVAL FACTIONS

You are not alone. Other chiefdoms expand, gather resources, and compete for control of the land. Some will grow into powerful rivals, forcing you to adapt your strategy and defend your territory.

The world itself plays a role, with terrain influencing expansion, resource availability, and settlement planning. Rivers provide opportunity, forests offer resources, and open land allows for large scale development.

⸻

No two settlements grow the same. Shape your city, build your influence, and establish your place in a living world rooted in history and strategy.

4607000.name: Totemofilia
4607000.about_the_game:
An odd land draws you in…

Play through 2-3 hours of a linear campaign. Hit "those things" with your stick. Solve some puzzles. Feel detailed player-to-enemy and enemy-to-player combat feedback.

Unlock active skills and upgrade passive characteristics of the player character.

The game also has several great features:

  • octagonal movement is back!

  • controller input support

  • optional CRT filter and vibration

  • display of 3 (three) mind-boggling colors

Flashing lights warning. Key mappings are not customizable.

4607110.name: SporeWars
4607110.about_the_game:
You are the last mushroom standing. The Mycelord has awakened, and its fungal horde pours endlessly from the void. Move. Dodge. Survive. Every wave hits harder than the last, and the only way out is through.

Spore Wars is a top-down survivor roguelite where you fight through escalating waves of increasingly dangerous enemies, level up between waves with powerful upgrades, and face boss encounters that test everything you've built.

Build your run, one upgrade at a time

Every level-up lets you choose from randomly drawn upgrade cards ranging from Common all the way up to the rare Divine tier. Stack damage, speed, pierce, multishot, lifesteal, and more. No two runs play the same way twice.

A growing horde to discover

Dozens of unique enemy types, each with its own attack pattern, movement style, and lore entry in the full Bestiary. From the rage-fueled Chaser and the buried Sniper to the terrifying final bosses lurking at the end of every run. Learn them or die to them.

Multiple difficulties, multiple worlds

Start with a lush forest arena on easier settings and work your way up through volcanic hellscapes and void-corrupted maps. Each difficulty changes enemy scaling, your starting stats, and the visual theme of the arena. Unlock harder modes by clearing the ones before them, and once you've beaten them all, Infinite mode awaits with no final wave and enemies that scale forever.

Unlock a roster of characters

Earn coins through runs and unlock new mushroom characters — each with unique stat spreads and bonuses that change how you approach upgrades. High-risk, high-reward builds sit alongside safer options, giving experienced players new ways to challenge themselves.

Features

  • Auto-aim shooting — focus on movement and upgrade decisions

  • Wave-based survival with escalating difficulty and boss encounters

  • Upgrade rarity system: Common → Uncommon → Rare → Epic → Legendary → Mythic → Divine

  • Full bestiary with lore for every enemy type

  • Multiple difficulties, from beginner-friendly to brutal endgame

  • Infinite mode for endless replayability

  • Unlockable character roster with distinct playstyles

  • Fullscreen support

4607310.name: INFINITAVERN
4607310.about_the_game:
Run a tavern that never stops growing. Start small, pour drinks, and build your way into a thriving, fully automated operation.

Get rich

Generate coins by serving customers, then reinvest into your tavern. Hire bartenders, unlock new rooms, and expand production across brewing and cooking systems that all feed into each other.

Meet the crew

Discover a cast of quirky tavern patrons as your business grows. Each visit brings new personality into your space, adding life and charm to your ever-expanding tavern.

Buy better upgrades

Collect coins, alcohol, and food and more. Each system interacts; boosting production, unlocking upgrades, and creating powerful scaling loops as your tavern grows.

Unlock new rooms

Discover rooms like the brewery and kitchen, wizards tower and more! introducing new mechanics and strategies. Optimize your setup to maximize efficiency and push your tavern further.

Chill out

Designed as a relaxing incremental experience, INFINITAVERN is about steady growth, relaxing gameplay, and watching your tavern evolve into a self-sustaining powerhouse.
4607310.reviews:
“The AK47 of idle games.”
5/5 – Streamer TunaForLunch

4607350.name: Sunfall '80
4607350.about_the_game:
A lone ship drifts at the edge of a dying world.

Inspired by the stark vector landscapes of early 1980s arcade games, this reimagining trades tanks for a solitary atmospheric vessel—an angular, hovering craft built for a war that’s already been lost. The horizon is a wireframe wasteland: fractured cities, skeletal towers, and geometric mountains stretching endlessly under a burning sky.

Above it all looms the sun—massive, unstable, and impossibly close.

Something has gone wrong. The planet’s orbit is collapsing. With every passing moment, the world inches closer to annihilation, pulled into a slow, inevitable plunge toward the star. The sky shifts from deep orange to blinding white as solar flares tear across the atmosphere, distorting the battlefield and warping your vision.

You pilot the last operational ship.

Enemy constructs—remnants of automated defense systems—still roam the surface, unaware or uncaring of the planet’s fate. They engage on sight: sharp, glowing shapes that rise from the terrain, tracking, firing, adapting. There is no command left, no allies—only survival and the faint hope of escape.

Combat is immediate and deliberate. Precision aiming, evasive movement, and terrain awareness are everything. The minimalist visuals strip away distraction, leaving only silhouettes, motion, and the growing glare of the sun dominating your view.

But the real enemy is time.

As the world falls inward, the environment itself becomes hostile. Heat distortions ripple across the screen. The ground fractures. Landmarks collapse into the horizon. The sun swells larger with each minute, bleaching out the vector lines until the battlefield becomes a blinding void.

Your objective is simple: survive long enough to reach a launch window… or go down fighting as the world burns.

No cutscenes. No exposition. Just you, your ship, and the end of everything.

Mouth Level

Esophagus Level

Slide your way throughout the koala's esophagus, collecting coins, dodging fruit, and jumping over the acid!

Stomach Level

Run away from enemies as you collect food and bring it to the center! Collect as much food as you can!

Small Intestine Level

Proximal Colon Level

Distal Colon Level

4607570.name: Eternal Spring: Oblivion
4607570.about_the_game:
Eternal Spring: Oblivion — an atmospheric first-person shooter with survival and RPG elements set in a living open world.

Survive the chaotic 90s, where Slavic mythology has bled into reality. Explore the half-abandoned streets of Kerch and its surroundings, study deadly anomalies, fight mythological creatures and ruthless bandits, help the remaining locals, and unravel the mystic secrets of a world stuck in eternal spring.

Open World

Discover a detailed open world spanning over 4 km², including the eastern districts of Kerch, the merged Kerch Sea Trade Port and shipyard, coastline, and dense forests with a forgotten village.

A full day-night cycle, dynamic wind, and changing weather deeply affect gameplay. At night visibility drops dramatically, creatures become more aggressive, and you must prepare for the darkness — or return to safety to rest.

Scavenge notes, newspapers, and letters scattered across the world to piece together personal stories and the larger lore. Loot shops, abandoned ambulances, military trucks, and houses. The more dangerous the area, the better the rewards.

Distorted anomalous zones await — from crackling power lines to toxic swamps and fiery craters. Inside them you can find strange anomalous nuggets that grant powerful positive or negative effects: restoring health and stamina, or suddenly increasing hunger and thirst.

Survival, Skills & Progression

Constantly manage your health, hunger, thirst, stamina, and vigor. Bleeding, insomnia, and exhaustion can kill you just as easily as bullets or claws.

Progress your character through actions: moving builds Strength (more carry weight, faster movement, higher jumps), eating different foods improves Metabolism (hunger and thirst grow slower), and taking damage raises Resilience (lower chance of bleeding and reduced incoming damage).

Upon death, skills reset to default values. You only lose what you were carrying — and respawn at the last bed you slept in.

Weapons & Gear

Your arsenal includes the PM pistol, OTs-33, AKM, AS Val, and shotguns. Customize some weapons with red-dot and optical sights, as well as extended magazines.

Choose from several types of backpacks, clothing, and plate carriers. More weapons, attachments, and gear are planned for the future.

Enjoy a realistic Tetris-style inventory with item combining, quick-use slots, and smart weight distribution across your character and backpack.

Traders & Quests

There are several merchants with different views waiting for you in the city and safe zones: someone openly fights with bandits, someone remains neutral, and someone cooperates with them. You can trade with them through money and barter. Complete their tasks, boost your reputation, and unlock new product ranges, discounts, and rare items.

Your choices affect your relations with the factions. This is what leads to different paths and multiple endings of the story.

Safehouses

Safehouses are your true sanctuaries. Sleep, craft items at workbenches, and store your loot here.

Improve the workbench (unlock better crafting recipes), bed (faster vigor recovery and reduced hunger/thirst drain while sleeping), and storage (more space). Upgrades apply across all safehouses.

Enemies

Bandits — from common street marauders to heavily armed factory guards and the elite retinue of the crime boss nicknamed Kotlovan, armed with rare weapons like the AS Val and VSS Vintorez.

Mythological Creatures — twisted by radiation and ancient forces:

  • Navya — mutated humans turned into aggressive, rotting monsters

  • Sterva — feral mutated animals (boars, dogs, bears) roaming the forests

  • Upyri — parasite-controlled undead haunting graveyards

  • Sea Horrors — giant mutated crabs, crayfish, and other creatures crawling from the depths

Co-op

The game supports cooperative play with friends.

4608050.name: The Will and Torment of El Brante
4608050.about_the_game:
Disclaimer: This is an unofficial, non-commercial fan project inspired by The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante and is not affiliated with its creators.

The Will and Torment of El Brante is a dark narrative RPG about defying fate in a dying world. In the Blessed Arcnian Empire, order was upheld by blood, fear, and faith in the Twins — the Gods who descended to earth many centuries ago, bringing with Them the True Faith. Their followers outlawed magic, consigned other religions to oblivion, and divided the people into three Lots. From that moment on, every person’s fate was predetermined from birth: nobles rule, priests guide, and commoners suffer.

The True Faith has fractured. The Old and New Churches wage their own struggle. Countless sects are emerging. The people rise in ever more rebellions and reject the Lots, while conspirators weave their intrigues in the shadows. Magic, branded heresy for centuries and nearly eradicated, is breaking back into the world. The world will never be the same.

Take on the role of Sir El Brante — an inquisitor condemned by the Twins Themselves to True Death, yet risen in defiance of Their Will. Complete the path of a man whose story seemed to have already ended. Shape El Brante’s personality anew through choices, deeds, and sacrifices, deciding who he will become in the age of the Empire’s collapse.

Decide whom to trust, whom to save, whom to betray, and what to sacrifice. Your actions can drastically change El Brante’s path: opening new opportunities, leading to unexpected events, and determining his role in the history of the world.

In this cruel and restless world, you will not only face difficult choices, but also take part in numerous battles — use your reflexes, equipment, cunning, and willpower to defeat your enemies.

Lies, manipulation, robbery, murder, and magic — everything that once seemed unthinkable may become the key to survival. Will you preserve your principles when the world around you abandons its own?

Your actions affect not only El Brante, but also his allies, enemies, factions, and the future of the Blessed Arcnian Empire. Remember: every decision has a price, and its consequences may catch up with you decades later.

The Empire is dying, and stopping its collapse may be impossible. But even if the end is inevitable, it is up to you to decide who El Brante will become — and who will stand beside him in the final chapter of his story.

4608330.name: Medieval Shepherd
4608330.about_the_game:
Medieval Shepherd is a realistic and grounded simulation of pastoral life in the Middle Ages. Beyond the peaceful grazing lands lies a world defined by scarcity, disease, and constant threat. Survival depends on your ability to coordinate with your dogs, manage your resources, and defend your flock against both wild predators and bandits.

TACTICAL SHEPHERDING & COMMAND SYSTEM

Your dogs are an extension of your will. Using a dedicated command system, you can issue precise orders to your canine companions:

  • Herd: Direct the flock toward specific pastures.

  • Come & Follow: Keep your protectors close during transitions.

  • Wait & Stay: Position your dogs strategically to cover blind spots. Mastering these inputs is vital to keeping your sheep safe in a world where a single stray can attract disaster.

    DIVERSE BREEDS & UNIQUE TRAITS

    Not all dogs are created equal. Choose from various breeds, each with distinct characteristics that change your gameplay strategy:

    • Intelligence: High-intel breeds react faster to commands and manage complex flock movements with ease.

    • Strength & Protection: Power-focused breeds are your heavy hitters, capable of enduring more damage and dealing lethal blows to predators.

    • Agility: Essential for gathering stray sheep quickly across vast terrains.

BATTLE FOR SURVIVAL

When the wolves howl or the bandits emerge from the treeline, peace ends. You do not just watch the fight; you lead it.

  • Active Combat: Fight alongside your dogs using a variety of medieval weaponry, including bows and spears.

  • Varied Threats: Defend your livelihood against intelligent wolf packs and desperate human raiders looking to steal your assets.

A LIVING, BRUTAL ECONOMY

Trade is not a menu; it is a journey.

  • Physical Markets: Travel to local villages to buy and sell sheep, purchase essential fodder, and manage your own food supplies.

  • Dynamic Realism: Experience an economy influenced by the harsh realities of the Middle Ages. Famines and plagues can sweep through the land, causing prices to skyrocket and resources to vanish, forcing you to adapt your strategy to survive.

CRAFTING & HOMESTEAD PROGRESSION

Life on the trail requires self-sufficiency.

  • Resource Processing: Utilize basic crafting to turn the hunt into survival. Produce leather from hides and cook meat over the campfire to maintain your strength.

  • Base Expansion: Improve and grow your base of operations. While you follow a structured expansion path, increasing the size and efficiency of your homestead is the only way to support a growing flock and better defenses.

4608560.name: Framework Zero: Terminal Panic
4608560.about_the_game:
Framework Zero: Terminal Panic drops you into the boots of a "space trucker" on a deep-space industrial haul that is in the process of going very, very wrong. There are no energy shields. There are no laser swords. There is only failing equipment, a fracturing crew, and the claustrophobic hum of the analog terminal that is your only lifeline.

Designed to be playable to completion within an hour or two but highly replayable, Framework Zero: Terminal Panic is a deliberate, slow-burn "cinematic" RPG experience inspired by the grounded, working-class sci-fi horror of the late 1970s and early 1980s. This is a game about isolation, mechanical failure, and taking calculated risks. You're not a hero. You're just trying to keep yourself and your crewmates alive.

CORE FEATURES

Keep the Machine Operational

This is not a typical text adventure. You're interacting with the ship's actual systems. The CRT interface, scanlines, and phosphor bleed represent the tactile, deteriorating hardware of an older ship that’s falling apart as it travels.

Tabletop Tactical Survival

Forget simply guessing the right verb to progress. Terminal Panic utilizes the "crunchy", 2d6-based RPG resolution system from the Framework Zero tabletop role playing game. Your character's core stats—Strength (STR), Dexterity (DEX), Intelligence (INT), Education (EDU), and Social (SOC)—directly impact your survival. Finding a toolbox isn't just flavor text; it’s the equipment advantage you just might need to pass a critical, life-or-death repair check.

Deliberate Tension

This is a slow burn—not just a series of jump-scares. Survival in Terminal Panic means monitoring failing life support, keeping the reactor from overheating, and managing your fraying crew.

Isometric Wireframe Map

The greatest enemy in text adventures is often just getting lost. To help mitigate this, your terminal features an isometric wireframe map that updates in real-time as you navigate the ship. This will help you keep track of where you are, and where others are... where other things are.

Manage the Panic

You aren't alone—but your crewmates are just as terrified as you are. Manage a fractured crew, from the weary veteran Captain to the panicked systems engineer. Use your Social (SOC) stat and Leadership skill to issue orders. Use your Liaison skill to manage their stress and coordinate repairs. A panicked crew is a dead crew.

Who knows? You might even find a spark of romance and hope that lights up the darkness. (Briefly. Before you and your "love interest" subplot die a horrible, horrible death. Maybe. … Probably.)

A Standalone Entry in The Adfinitas Chronicles Universe

While the events of Terminal Panic are a self-contained nightmare, the game features the same used-future/industrial sci-fi technologies found in The Adfinitas Chronicles novels by Mark Sheppard. You don't need to have read the books to enjoy Terminal Panic, but fans of the series will recognize the gritty, analog-tech setting.

SURVIVE THE SHIFT

  • Investigate issues and events that require your attention (and intervention).

  • Scavenge the ship for tools and secure vital materials.

  • Roll against the odds using Framework Zero’s tabletop RPG mechanics.

  • Try not to die…
