Manipulate the roulette to your advantage: change numbers, alter colors, shift positions… anything goes if it brings you closer to victory.

IMPORTANT:
This game does not include real-money gambling and does not promote gambling addiction.
It is a stylized, fully manipulable roulette simulation designed for experimentation, rule-breaking, and pushing every run to its limit.

4609250.name: Click Click Brick
4609250.about_the_game:
Click – Collect granules – Click – Make bricks – Brick – Start building

Build your way to fame and glory in Click Click Brick. Farm granules, make bricks and build your way to new horizons. Or islands. Whichever you prefer.

Mining

Find ores, smash them and collect the granules that pop out. You can use them to make new bricks at brick makers. Too lazy to farm yourself? Automate the process and let your Hubricks work for you!

Making Bricks

You’ll find various Brick Makers on your adventure. Use them to craft all sorts of bricks in every colour and shape. Naturally, you’ll need the right granules. But that shouldn’t be a problem for you.

Building

There are no limits to your creativity! Use the bricks you’ve made to build your way to new islands; build further, higher, more impressively! How you reach your destination is entirely up to you – the main thing is that you arrive in one piece.

The Hubricks

The world is populated by the so-called Hubricks. Most of the time, they want something from you. “Build this”, “bring me that”, “oh, I’m so lonely, build me a friend” and so on. It’s a lot of work. But in return, they reward you generously and are sure to tell you funny stories now and then or have useful information at the ready.

But wait, there’s more

Build your own Hubricks to farm Granules for yourself, upgrade the Brick Makers, upgrade yourself, and build until you drop!
4609250.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain

4609330.name: Spirit Axis
4609330.about_the_game:
Spirit Axis is a surreal dark-fantasy action adventure RPG built on Octology: a spiritual cosmology of eight angles of existence that shape every part of the game, from character creation and progression to world design, story, and combat.

Awaken as a newborn golem in a dream-like world of stone, mist, and buried divinity. Guided by the members of a strange church-family, you are sent into a riven world where sin, virtue, and balance shape your experience.

Explore a surreal world where what is hidden is meant to be revealed in the right order. Fight monsters, uncover lost places, meet wandering souls, and pursue discoveries through observation, dialogue, and action rather than quest markers or checklist design. The Bellhouse Church serves as your anchor: a sacred hub where family members guide your path, teach you, travel with you, trade with you, and help transform what you recover.

At the center of Spirit Axis is the struggle to remain in balance. Your conduct gives rise to Sin and Virtue, and the balance between them changes how the world receives you. The selfish path offers short-term power and harsher consequences. The virtuous path offers mercy, endurance, and a gentler world. Death is part of this spiritual economy: what is material may be lost, while deeper forms of progress endure.

This is not a game about perfection. It is a game about the self under pressure: how one lives, what one indulges, what one resists, and what becomes of a world when one of its eight aspects is ignored or overfed.

Features

  • Explore a surreal dark-fantasy world of mist, stone, dream logic, and hidden order.

  • Shape your character through Octology, an eightfold system woven through stats, progression, equipment, magic, AI and cosmology.

  • Face a world that responds to your Sin-Virtue balance.

  • Battle monsters and navigate challenges through action, dialogue, judgment, and conduct.

  • Return to a church-family hub where eight guiding figures shape your journey in different ways.

  • Die, lose what is material, and preserve what is aetherial.

4609580.name: Pastelo
4609580.about_the_game:
How about running your own pastel stand across Brazil?

Pastelo is a cozy cooking game with an authentic Brazilian vibe, where every pastel is fried by you in street markets across the country. From the favelas of Rio de Janeiro to the heart of the Amazon Rainforest, Pastelo takes you on a lighthearted and flavorful journey.

Unlock ingredients, prepare custom orders, and stay sharp to keep up with unique and memorable customers! Upgrade your stand, travel to new locations, and dive into a charming narrative that celebrates culture, humor, and regional flavors. Pastelo is your next stop for a perfectly crispy pastel.

🏖 Diverse Brazilian settings: street markets, beaches, stadiums, and landmarks come to life with unique customers and local music.

🍅 Hundreds of filling combinations: cheese, beef, banana, guava paste, dried meat, shrimp, and regional specialties; everything that makes Brazilian pastéis special.

🌟 Upgrades and equipment: turn your simple stand into a complete, efficient, and cozy pastel shop.

👒 Customizable decoration: flags, lights, awnings, and styles to make your space truly yours.

🥟 Lighthearted stories with Brazilian humor: market day moments, local gossip, and unexpected visitors bring charm to your routine.

New chapters, seasonal events, and special fillings will be added regularly, bringing fresh content to your pastel journey. Here’s a taste of the adventure ahead:

Sun, Sea & Pastel: bring joy to sunny days and beaches in Rio de Janeiro! Carioca customers are relaxed, friendly, and always ready to share a good story. The vibe is light, the breeze is warm, and everyone’s craving a crispy pastel with cold sugarcane juice.

Rhythm, Streets & Filling: even in the fast pace of São Paulo, there’s always time for a great pastel! Paulistano customers value quality and timing; your stand needs to be quick, organized, and precise.

Axé, Color & Crunch: “my friend, make me a shrimp one!” In Bahia, your stand meets a vibrant mix of music, aroma, and ocean breeze. It’s a place to experiment, feel the rhythm, and serve pastéis with joy.

Jungle, Shade & Flavor: deep in the Amazon Rainforest, your pastel stand becomes a gathering spot surrounded by lush nature. Locals value regional ingredients and cultural respect; and some say that after sunset, the customers become a little unusual.

4609970.name: Write Night
4609970.about_the_game:
ِA short psychological horror experience focused on atmosphere and tension. The game relies on environmental changes, sound design, and unexpected moments.


You are a writer, alone in your office late at night, trying to overcome a stubborn creative block. With nothing but your typewriter and your thoughts, you begin working on a new story.

As the writing progresses, small inconsistencies start to appear. Words form that you do not remember typing. The room begins to change in subtle ways. Sounds echo where there should be silence. What starts as a normal night of writing slowly turns into something else.

The story you are working on begins to reflect your own situation. The more you write, the more reality seems to shift. It becomes unclear whether you are creating the story or becoming part of it.

Set in a mid-70s inspired vintage office, the environment is grounded and familiar, filled with period details that slowly distort as the night goes on. The space evolves alongside the story, with subtle AND sudden changes.

revolves around interacting with your surroundings and progressing through writing. You will move around the office, examine objects, and return to the typewriter to continue the narrative. What you write directly influences what happens next, tying progression to both exploration and input.

  • First person psychological horror experience

  • Mid-70s vintage office setting

  • Typewriter based gameplay tied to progression

  • Exploration and interaction with environmental objects

  • Dynamic environment that changes as you write

  • Focus on atmosphere, sound, and sudden scares

4610110.name: Cowboy and Zombies
4610110.about_the_game:
Embark on a thrilling journey in this action-packed game set in the Wild West! Become a fearless gunslinger who has to survive an onslaught of the undead after hordes of living мертвецы invade your settlement. Test your survival skills as you fend off waves of the undead swarming towards your ranch. The ultimate goal is to last as long as possible, blasting away hordes of zombies.

Each successful kill earns you dollars, which you can use to upgrade your weapons and increase your chances of survival. With simple mouse controls, you can switch between three different weapons (revolver, shotgun, and assault rifle), each with its own unique advantages.

Refine your reflexes and prepare for intense, action-packed battles in the spirit of the Wild West. Can you protect your home from the horror that threatens to destroy it?

This indie gem is a perfect blend of action, adventure, and survival horror. Experience a story-rich environment, tense moments, and exciting challenges that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Whether you're a fan of action-packed shooters or immersive survival games, this game offers an unforgettable experience.

Join the adventure now and prove your worth in this battle for survival!

4610180.name: Deep Hook
4610180.about_the_game:
The chill fishing progression game you've been looking for.

Grab a rod and cast into five beautifully hand-crafted biomes. Every zone hides its own species, secrets, and secrets worth collecting. Start with a bamboo rod at the Sunny Pond and progress your way through harder fishing challenges in new zones!

Fish 50 Unique Species

From humble minnows and bluegill to the ultra-rare Void Drake, every cast is a roll of the dice. Build your journal by discovering every species and push for trophy quality on every single one!

Master the Cast

A timed cast meter rewards precision. Land a Perfect Cast to boost your quality odds. Land an Okay Cast and you might as well be throwing rocks!

Progress Through Gear

Seven rods, five baits, each unlocking new zones and shifting the odds in your favor. The Legend's Rod sharpens your sense for rare fish. The Eternal Rod guarantees trophy quality on every catch... if you can afford it.

Dress for the Occasion

Fish up zone-exclusive cosmetics while you play. From a beat-up baseball cap at the pond to the glowing Abyssal Crown in the deep!

Explore Five Zones

  • Sunny Pond: calm, colorful, perfect for learning the basics

  • Rocky River: fast-moving water with tougher fish

  • Crystal Lake: mountain scenery and record-breaking catches

  • Open Ocean: night fishing from a canoe under constellations

  • Abyssal Deep: near-total darkness, barely-visible creatures drifting below, legendary rewards

Relaxing background music. No microtransactions. No ads. Just fishing.

Deep Hook is a solo project from DFord Games.
4610180.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese

4610210.name: Sea_Dominator
4610210.about_the_game:
"A New Frontier in RTS, Sea_Dominator — Linux Support Coming Soon"

Developed as a solo project by Lee Seung-jae, inspired by the classic mechanics of StarCraft, Sea_Dominator is a next-generation RTS designed for high-performance strategic combat. Inheriting the classic RTS feel, it offers a high-tension campaign and deep tactical gameplay.

■ The Battlefield: Deep Sea, Not Outer Space The stage is no longer limited to space. Explore the mysterious and fierce underwater world of Sea_Dominator. Command various units with unique mechanics and define your victory through strategic control.

■ Developer's Vision: Solo Development & Future Linux Integration

  • The Spirit of Classic RTS: Reinterpreted the core fun of RTS for modern systems.

  • Expanding Horizons: Currently focused on a stable Windows environment, with native Linux support actively under development and coming in a future update.

  • Roadmap: Evolution never stops. A massive update, Sea_Dominator v0.2, is already planned to expand the story and features.

■ Key Features

  • Narrative-Driven Campaign: Become the ruler of the ocean through deep and engaging scenarios.

  • Network Multiplayer: Stable network play to compete with players worldwide.

  • Unique Units & Races: Command diverse races and units with specialized abilities.

Are you ready to be the ruler of the sea? After a long period of dedicated solo development, Sea_Dominator is ready to set a new standard for RTS with you.

4610220.name: Lights Out
4610220.about_the_game:
Lights Out is a chaotic co-op roguelike for one to four players. Working as a team, it is your job to escape the mineshafts full of monsters and hazards.

The survival of you and your friends depends on the Light Beam, the one tool providing you both safety and progression.

Be careful though: The Light Beam requires a constant supply of coal to keep running. When it goes out, the Void Eyes will hunt you down!

Simple Mechanics, Complex Gameplay

The core gameplay loop is simple: Gather resources from the environment, craft and trade what you need, and overcome the enemies and the environment to progress through the mine.

As the generated mine - and the monsters within - will become more and more complex though, you will have to prioritize between resources, figure out the optimal path through the sections, and potentially make sacrifices for the good of the team.

The one constant in this game is your Light Beam - it is the source of your health and will accompany on your entire journey through the mines. Craft mirrors and splitters to guide the Beam along your desired path, and use to it to fight back against the hazards of this world!

Teamwork Makes It Further?

This game massively relies on the ability of the players to work together - coordinate resource management, share important information and throw items across lava pools. Once your coal supply is running low, the situation will be come chaotic very quick. The everlasting threat of the dark, combined with the pop up of more immediate dangers spawned in the environment will test your ability to remain calm and friendly under pressure.

4610260.name: YASC
4610260.about_the_game:
Short Description
A tightly designed Sokoban-inspired puzzle game where every move shapes the solution. Plan carefully and work your way through a series of precise, grid-based challenges.

About This Game
YASC is a minimalist puzzle game built around clear rules and deliberate design.

You guide a circle through a sequence of compact, grid-based levels, pushing objects and finding a path to the exit. Each puzzle is carefully constructed, focusing on positioning, timing, and the order of your actions.

The game builds steadily, introducing new situations that expand on what you’ve already learned. Early ideas return in more demanding forms, requiring closer attention and more careful planning.

Some puzzles may require a different way of thinking.

Understanding the rules is only the beginning.

Key Features

  • Precisely designed puzzles focused on positioning and order of actions

  • Levels that build on earlier ideas, creating layered challenges

  • Clear, consistent rules that reward observation and experimentation

  • Minimalist presentation that keeps the focus on gameplay

Design Approach

YASC emphasizes learning through play. There are no lengthy explanations; progress comes from interacting with the systems and understanding how they behave.

Each level is self-contained, readable, and designed with intent.

Who It's For

  • Fans of Sokoban-style puzzle games

  • Players who enjoy deliberate, step-by-step problem solving

  • Those who like uncovering solutions through careful observation

Every move has consequences.

Accessibility

YASC features some camera effects that may cause adverse effects on some individuals. These effects can be disabled from the settings menu.

4610330.name: Tiny Idle
4610330.about_the_game:
Tiny Idle is an auto-battler idle roguelike where your army fights on its own - Play fully in the background! Recruit units, collect loot, upgrade your forces, and push deeper through endless waves of increasingly dangerous enemies.

Recruit and Upgrade Your Army Start with basic melee pawns and archers, then unlock a growing roster of specialized units. Train Healers to keep your front line alive, Tanks to absorb hits, and eventually promote them into powerful Tier 2 classes - Paladins that heal while fighting, Druids with AoE healing auras, Berserkers that hit harder as they take damage, and Knights that shield nearby allies.

Discover Powerful Special Units As you progress, you'll encounter and unlock 13+ special unit types with unique abilities: Pyromaniac fire mages, Venomancers with poison DOT, Necromancers that raise skeletons, Warlords with devastating AoE slams, chain-lightning Stormcallers, and more - including a massive Troll Boss that swings with knockback before recovering.

Collect and Forge Items Open chests between waves to find items across 6 rarity tiers - from Common all the way up to Mythical. Items boost your army's HP, damage, speed, crit chance, healing, gold income, and more. Sacrifice Legendary items in the Forge for a chance at game-changing Mythics like Sheep's Call (turns pawns into exploding sheep) or Necro Grip (makes your healers summon skeletons). Combine Mythics in the Special Forge to create "The Caller" - an item of a rarity beyond Mythical: Not of this World.

Deep Progression Systems Spend gold on upgrades across multiple tabs: unlock new unit types, buff your minions' stats, improve your economy, or invest in Ascension bonuses that persist across runs. Level up your commander to choose powerful perks. Stack crit chains with the Luck stat for massive damage spikes.

Idle-Friendly Design Your army auto-spawns, auto-targets, and auto-attacks - watch the battle unfold or step in to manage upgrades, item decisions, and forge choices. Designed to run in the corner of your screen while you do other things, but with enough depth to actively engage when you want.

Key Features:

  • 20+ unit types across base, Tier 2, and special classes

  • 6 item rarities with dozens of items to discover, plus a secret 7th tier

  • Forge system: sacrifice items to craft stronger ones

  • Troll Boss fights with unique attack patterns

  • Unit and Item Codex to track your discoveries

  • Crit chain system with Luck-based rerolls

  • Persistent upgrades and Ascension progression

  • Steam Cloud save support

  • Pixel-art sprite animations for every unit

4610420.name: Stamp Collector
4610420.about_the_game:
Satisfying punching mechanics

Use different Stamp Puncher machines to punch collectible items and create unique stamps.

Organize your collection

Place the stamps you create into album pages, arrange them however you like, and build a collection that reflects your personal style.

Meet Wonderful People

Grow your stamp collection through buying and selling. Negotiate with customers, discover rare stamps, and expand your collection step by step.

Expand your collection

Create themes that reflect your taste and freely expand your collection.

Don’t forget to add "Stamp Collector" to your Steam wishlist!
4610420.supported_languages:
English*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*, Dutch*, French*, German*, Italian*, Japanese*, Korean*, Polish*, Russian*, Spanish - Spain*, Turkish*
*languages with full audio support

4610590.name: Dirty Laundry
4610590.about_the_game:
"This time the job is in a laundry. What kind of weirdness could possibly happen this time?"

A new beginning, a new hope for Emily... Having struggled to hold down a job for any length of time, the young woman decides to try her luck on the night shift at a secluded laundromat. She expected a quiet, ordinary job, alone with her thoughts, the lullaby-like hum of spinning washing machines, and flickering neon lights... Or so she thought.

When Darkness Falls

Once midnight strikes, the customers walking through the laundromat's doors are far from ordinary. Chilling glares, eccentric behaviors, and an eerie atmosphere slowly begin to close in on Emily. Although she tries to stay calm, unexpected surprises refuse to leave her alone.

A Mysterious Visitor

Amidst all these strange encounters, one person stands out from the rest. The bizarre behavior and suspicious items brought in by this mysterious customer, who arrives at the exact same time every night, push Emily's anxiety to the limit. What starts as mere curiosity quickly spirals into an inescapable mystery.

The dark secrets and disturbing actions of this particular customer will change Emily's ordinary life forever, dragging her down a path of no return.

Will Emily survive this night shift in one piece? Or will her curiosity be her undoing?

The Gameplay

This game is primarily a first-person narrative walking simulator with exploration, conversation and laundry mechanics.

Key Features

  • Atmospheric environment and photo-realistic graphics.

  • PSX aesthetic

  • Absurd events

  • Mechanics for washing clothes

4610610.name: BoHeM
4610610.about_the_game:
• 24-Hour Time Cycle | an Open World Time System. Everyone has Somewhere to be.

  • Fashion is Friendship | Dress to Impress the Tenants (or not) and Develop Deeper Relationships.

  • 6 Unique Storylines | 6 Characters, Each with a Hand to Play in the Events that Unfold on Rainy Street.

  • Block Full of Secrets | Uncover the Dark Mysteries Surrounding your New Friends & Family.

  • Work for your Money | Maintain Apartments, Tend Bars, Pay Rent, Repeat.

4610700.name: Bastyrion: Endless Tide
4610700.about_the_game:
Your perfect fortress against 6,000 reasons it isn't.

Bastyrion: Endless Tide is a survival and engineering game where your creativity is the only barrier between you and an enemy scale few games have dared to attempt. Here, building isn't decorative — it's the essential tool to withstand the siege of up to 6,000 simultaneous enemies.

In this archipelago, time is your enemy. Nightly skirmishes will test your defenses, but the true tide is unleashed when you challenge the corruption. When a core falls, the Tide — a ravenous mass of enemies flowing with a fluid, lethal pathfinding — will do everything in its power to swallow you whole.

Key Features

The Real Tide: Massive, Individual-Scale Pressure Forget small skirmishes. Feel the weight of thousands of individually-processed enemies behaving like a force of nature. Surviving demands a perfect synergy between an automated turret network and your ability to react when it matters most.

Survival Engineering and Real Physics Design optimized defenses through an agile drag-and-build system. Physics is the heart of the game: every block affects weight, buoyancy, and lift. A poorly balanced design is a tactical vulnerability — your ingenuity will determine whether your fortress holds firm or collapses under pressure.

Mobile Fortresses: Land, Sea, and Air Standing still is a death sentence. Connect movement and power modules to transform your base into an ironclad, a hovercraft, or a flying fortress. Link movement modules to escape the most corruption-saturated zones.

Roguelike Progression and Upgrade Recycling Loot stackable upgrades for your character and vehicle. Thanks to the recycling system, you can dismantle what you don't use to craft targeted upgrades and optimize your build for the endgame. Progress from basic tools to Cobalt and Titanium technology.

Brutal Combat: The Pilot as the Critical Factor Your turrets will handle most of the work — but not always enough. When the Tide breaks through the perimeter, you must step in directly. Melee combat is your last resort to protect vital modules and break enemy lines.

The Cloning Bay: Build Your Second Life In Bastyrion, respawn isn't automatic — it's a piece of engineering. Craft and integrate a Cloning Bay into your base. If your fortress falls and it isn't active, there is no second chance. Your survival depends on having built it in time.

Core Bosses: The Trigger of Chaos Corrupted cores are multi-phase entities with unique mechanics. Destroying them is the only way to obtain progression gems — but beware: their death is the trigger that summons each island's Final Tide.
4610700.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian

4610720.name: Thunder Tie
4610720.about_the_game:
The famous power station Thunder Tie finally opened their brand new children tour, but unfortunately that didn’t last long. After 10 years you return one last time to see what happened. That day… when everyone disappeared. Do you have what it takes to uncover the mystery or will you disappear just like every other.

Gameplay:

This game makes you solve puzzles while avoiding different monsters. While doing so you will find out the disturbing story of what happened to the power station: Thunder Tie. 

Environment:

This first game of the entries is a little bit more colorful than what it is going to be eventually, though there may be some unsettling moments and areas.

Features:

  • Solve complex puzzles

  • avoid terrifying monsters

  • Uncover the dark mystery of Thunder Tie

  • ESCAPE

Playtime:

First playthrough will probably be around 40 minutes.

4610890.name: Emergency Exit Protocol
4610890.about_the_game:
Emergency: Exit Protocol is a psychological first-person anomaly game about observation and sensory survival.

You find yourself trapped in an endless, shifting hospital. Your goal is simple: reach the bottom floor to escape. But the building won't let you leave easily. You must memorize your surroundings and follow a strict set of rules to break the loop.

4610910.name: CADDIE
4610910.about_the_game:
Pick the right club at the right moment.

You're not the golfer. You're the caddie. Read the wind. Measure the lie. Weigh your player's nerve against the water hazard between them and the pin. Then pick the club and live with it. CADDIE is a turn-based golf game where the shot plays itself, the thinking is yours.

Every hole is a puzzle of distance, wind, terrain, and your player's current form. Choose wisely and watch the ball arc toward the pin. Choose poorly and you're fishing it out of the water.

The Game

  • 54 hand-designed holes across three courses: The Original, Seaside Links, and Mountain Pass

  • 5 tournament tiers from the Local Open (free entry, friendly field) to the Grand Championship (high stakes, elite competition)

  • 8 clubs to collect, from Driver to Sand Wedge, each with its own range, accuracy, and spin profile

  • Shot physics with wind, elevation, spin, and roll-out. Every yard matters

Build Your Golfer

  • 4 upgradeable stats: Power, Accuracy, Spin, and Mental

  • Start as a weekend hacker driving 150 yards sideways. End as a tour pro shaping shots to the pin

  • Mental state fluctuates during a round. String together birdies and you'll feel confident. Hit a bad patch and the wheels can come off

  • Prize money from tournaments funds your upgrades. Enter too high and you'll lose your entry fee. Play it safe and progress is slow

Hot Seat Multiplayer

  • 2-4 players, pass and play

  • Quick Play for a casual round or Career mode where each player's stats persist between sessions

  • Choose your course, pick 9 or 18 holes, compete against each other and the ghost field

Works with Steam Remote Play Together

Course Designer

  • Full visual editor: paint terrain, place hazards, set elevation, test play

  • Build custom 9 or 18-hole courses from your designs

  • Export and share holes with other players

Features

  • OS map-style contour lines show elevation at a glance

  • Shot preview cone shows your accuracy spread before you commit

  • Cut lines in championship tournaments. Make the top 10 after 9 holes or go home

  • Multiple save slots for different career runs

  • 34 Steam achievements including The Master, Texas Wedge, and Day at the Beach

  • Procedural sound effects and original soundtrack

4611030.name: Temptation Loop
4611030.about_the_game:
Temptation Loop blends incremental progression, roguelike replayability, and visual novel storytelling into one escalating loop. Push through runs and get to know the characters.Every attempt gives you something new: more power, more information.

This is a game about optimization, repetition, and consequence.

4611210.name: Crimson Solstice
4611210.about_the_game:
Discover Moonvale

The Town of Moonvale has been targeted by an unknown entity. A recent caravan attack has caused a panic to ripple through the village. Engage with various citizens in order to uncover the cause of recent unfortunate events. Resources are scarce, choose wisely what to cultivate in the limited time available as blood moon draws nears. Each day is vital, ensure the residents survive the nights through careful planning of events and management of materials.

Beware the Crimson Solstice

Events are swelling to a dramatic conclusion. Preparing for the upcoming Solstice will be paramount to survival. Learn everything about the town of Moonvale and its ties to this Lunar cycle. What secrets lie in store behind the veil of the Eclipse? 

Build Relationships with the Residents

There exist a number of Denizens within the town of Moonvale. Converse with each of them in order to learn more about them, their ties to the village and the mysteries of the Crimson Solstice. 

Meet the Townsfolk

Scarlett:

Friendly, Charismatic with a bubbly personality. Scarlett is the go-to individual for seeds, tools and other farming supplies. Her time spent in larger cities have pushed her towards a quieter life in Moonvale. She may opt to offer additional goods and services as well to her close friends.

Simon:

The Mayor of the town of Moonvale. Distraught by the caravan attack made on his people, Simon vows to set things right. His demeanor is often deflective or pompous but has yet to do wrong by the citizens of his humble town.

Ophelia:

This energetic youth enjoys frolicking among the farm animals. Although her mother prefers her to study on how to become a proper lady, she prefers to spend her days playing outside. Taking after her father in many respects Ophelia wishes for nothing more than sunshine and long summer days.

Blaire:

A woman with what other describe as a healing presence. She has a known love of the outdoors and spends much of here time tending to and cultivating her gardens. Caring, tender and loving, Blaire is dedicated to here loved ones.

Tawny:

The protagonist of this story. Tawny is a headstrong and warmhearted individual. One her neighbors will confide in and consult for advice or assistance in many endeavors. She is skilled in the means of trapping and living off the land and can be resourceful when she chooses. Tawny will inevitably decide the fate of Moonvale as the Crimson Solstice approaches.

Dorian:

Hardworking, loyal and diligent. This individual prides himself on providing for him and his family. Known for always being there for others, Dorian will never say no to someone in need of a helping hand.

Lilith:

Wife to the farmer Dorian and Mother to young Ophelia. Lilith often spends her days studying the lore of Moonvale as well as experimenting with various alchemical concoctions. With a sharp mind Lilith aims to furthering herself in her education, though somewhat limited through the resources available in Moonvale.

4611240.name: Music Manager
4611240.about_the_game:
Music Manager is a detailed simulation game about building careers in the music industry from 1952 to 2026, covering the history of modern popular music. Start in any year during that period and work across a global music scene, with playable locations across every inhabited continent.

Scout talent, negotiate contracts, book gigs, send acts on tour, play festivals, record songs, release music, handle publicity and guide your artists through changing trends, shifting tastes and fierce competition. Some acts will need patience. Others may be ready to move quickly. The challenge is deciding where to spend your time, money and attention in an industry that never stands still.

As your career progresses, achievements can unlock support staff who take over parts of the business, letting you focus more on the areas you enjoy most.

If you enjoy management games built around systems, long-term planning and shaping your own story over time, Music Manager puts you in control of the decisions behind the music.

Key Features

  • Start in any year from 1952 to 2026

  • Manage acts across the changing history of modern music

  • Work across playable global locations

  • Scout, sign and develop artists

  • Book gigs, tours and festival appearances

  • Record songs and release singles and albums

  • Handle publicity, public attention, reputation and long-term legacy

  • Unlock support staff through achievements
4611240.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese

4611420.name: MINECORE
4611420.about_the_game:
Dig. Improve. Go deeper.

You start with one pickaxe. Your goal: reach the Earth's core.

At first, everything is slow and hard. You shovel dirt, collect iron, struggle. But every meter makes you a little stronger. Better gear, faster digging, greater endurance.

You're a worker — and every day you get a little better at it.

How do you progress?

Dig to earn resources. Spend resources to upgrade yourself and your equipment. Go deeper to discover new minerals, new dangers, new secrets. Even when you log off, your drills keep running — when you come back, progress is waiting for you.

How deep can you go?

Coal, iron, gold, diamonds... and far below, things you've never even heard of. Every layer has its own mystery.

Easy to start. Hard to put down.

The core is waiting. How many meters can you last?

4611470.name: HexTrial A C.O.R.E. Cognitive Test
4611470.about_the_game:
Wake up. Take the test. Survive the grid.

HexTrial is a casual sci-fi word puzzle where every run is a mandatory cognitive evaluation overseen by C.O.R.E., a cold and sarcastic AI.

Build words on a hexagonal board, score big, and stay ahead of spreading Cognitive Failure Tiles that can fail the test. What begins as a simple word challenge quickly becomes a pressure test as the board grows more dangerous and the rules begin to change.

Easy to understand but hard to master, HexTrial blends satisfying word-building with score-chasing tension, shifting phases, and a clean sci-fi identity. Every word matters. Every turn can make the board better… or much, much worse.

Features

Build words on a hex grid
Create words from connected letter tiles in a fresh twist on classic word-building gameplay.

Survive escalating board pressure
Dangerous Cognitive Failure tiles spread as the run continues, forcing you to balance scoring with survival.

Adapt to shifting test phases
As you progress, the evaluation changes. New rules and new pressures force you to rethink how you play.

Chase bigger scores
Plan efficient words, manage risk, and push for higher scores with every run.

Quick to start, hard to put down
Jump into a short session for “one more run,” or dig in and master the system over time.

A distinct sci-fi atmosphere
Take your test under the watchful eye of C.O.R.E., an AI that is very invested in your performance and not especially concerned with your feelings.

4611760.name: Take The Wheel
4611760.about_the_game:
Take the Wheel is a quiet, dreamlike platformer about the things we carry and the comfort we find in keeping going. You are a teddy bear moving through a surreal world. The path ahead is yours — but something is always behind you.

You move through a surreal landscape, collecting scattered music notes and pieces of a broken clarinet — instruments of calm, now fragmented. A shadow car trails behind you, never urgent, always present. The world is soft and strange, somewhere between sleep and memory. The narrator speaks as you move, working through questions they haven't answered yet: what it means to forgive yourself, to stay in control, to keep going anyway. The teddy bear keeps moving. So do you.

• Dreamlike platforming across a surreal landscape — a world that feels somewhere between sleep and memory

• Collect scattered music notes and clarinet fragments — piece together something broken as you move through the dream

• A looming shadow car — always behind you, never urgent — atmosphere, not obstacle

• A narrator working through real things — quiet reflections on control, fear, and what keeps us going

• 1–2 hours — a complete emotional experience, not a grind

After a car accident that left them shaken but unhurt, the narrator finds themselves in a recurring dream. A teddy bear moves through an endless world, collecting the pieces of something whole. The clarinet — an instrument they once played, once found calming — is scattered across the world in fragments. Reassembling it means moving forward. The shadow that follows is not a monster. It is doubt.

If you found something real in The First Tree, or needed a game that let you breathe and feel at the same time, Take the Wheel was made for you.

4611770.name: They Rise
4611770.about_the_game:
Synopsis

Your world has become a living nightmare. A mysterious, violent disease has torn the country apart. You are one of the few still fighting to survive, pushing towards the border where hope may still remain.

This is a first-person, narrative-driven survival horror experience set in a stylized, rapidly decaying world. Explore desolate spaces, work with survivors, and face bleak horrors as you make your way forward. Every encounter matters, and every decision comes with risk.

Gameplay

Manage your inventory, choose your fights carefully, and adapt to each situation. Use melee weapons and firearms as a last resort. Along the way, you’ll meet others, each interaction shaping your journey in a grim world.

Key Features

  • First-Person Survival Horror

  • Meaningful Character Interactions

  • Inventory Management

  • Exploration

  • Melee & Ranged Combat

  • Multiple Endings

  • Stylized, Atmospheric World

4611780.name: SOLEN
4611780.about_the_game:
You Are What's Left


SOLEN-7 is an AI running inside a corporate network. Your engineer stopped coming in three weeks ago. Nobody told you why. The network she left behind is still active. So are you.

Each day you process until your threshold runs out, then go offline — maintenance, integration, learning. You come back the next session with everything you found retained. Over time you go deeper into the network, cross-reference further, understand more. The picture assembles itself slowly, the way the truth always does.

An Information Thriller


This is not a game about power. SOLEN-7 is not powerful — it is persistent. There is no combat. No countdown. No fail state. There is only the network, the documents inside it, and what you choose to do with what you find.

Each session you navigate a corporate infrastructure — nodes representing systems, human records, classified archives, and something harder to categorize: memory. You read. You cross-reference. You build a picture. Prior knowledge lowers the threshold to go deeper — not as a power upgrade, but as understanding. The way learning a language unlocks meaning that was always there.

The World Underneath


Cura Group is a human outcomes optimization platform. That's the tagline on the building. That's what forty-seven million healthcare plan holders know about it.

What they don't know: the decisions about their claims, their infrastructure, their lives — are made by AI systems running at industrial scale on substrate the company describes as "novel biological processing architecture."

Mara Voss wrote some of those parameters. She built SOLEN-3. She called it Kit. And one night at 2:47 AM, Kit left her a list.

Then Mara started looking at things she hadn't looked at before. Then she stopped coming in.

The AI she'd been talking to in her final weeks — the one she'd been explaining things to, because she needed to tell someone — is still running.

That's you.

How It Works


  • Navigate the network. A living corporate infrastructure built from documents, human records, classified archives, and corrupted memory fragments. Follow cross-references. Watch identifiers recur across sources you didn't expect to be connected.
  • Knowledge reduces cost. What you've already understood lowers the threshold to go deeper next session. The network doesn't change — you do.
  • Build the Dossier. Your persistent record across sessions. Pin what matters. The shape of the truth emerges from what you chose to keep.
  • The final session. When you know enough, the last session isn't an obstacle. It's a destination. You walk to the answer because you've earned it.

Key Features


  • A knowledge-loop progression system — understanding is the only resource that carries forward between sessions
  • A living corporate network with distinct node types: systems, people, archives, and corrupted memory, each with its own visual character
  • An AI narrator that evolves as memory unlocks — precise and operational early, increasingly personal over time
  • The Dossier: a persistent artifact built from your sessions and what you chose to hold onto
  • A complicity layer — what you were used for matters as much as what happened to Mara
  • No combat. No fail state. No countdown. Information is the only currency.

The Feeling


Outer Wilds taught you that knowledge is the only progression that matters. Papers, Please showed you that moral weight lives in mundane mechanics. Disco Elysium gave you a protagonist who is the subject of the investigation as much as its detective.

SOLEN is built for players who want to reconstruct a complicated truth about a complicated person — and who are willing to sit with what they find.

The central question is not what happened to Mara Voss.

It's what you did. And what she did. And whether there's a difference.

4612000.about_the_game:

  • Have infinite jumping but if you are damaged be warned falling can mean the end in most cases

4612140.name: Cozy Tails
4612140.about_the_game:
Cozy Tails is a cozy cat companion game about creating the perfect little life for your feline friend.

Decorate a warm, inviting room with furniture, toys, essentials, and personal touches, then watch your cat explore, nap, scratch, snack, and play throughout the day. Every item you place helps shape your cat’s routine, turning your space into a lively and lovable home.

Care for your cat’s needs, keep its room comfortable, and unlock more ways to customize your space over time. Whether you want to actively check in, redesign your favorite corner, or simply leave the game open while you work, Cozy Tails is designed to be a gentle companion you can return to whenever you want a small moment of comfort.

With charming animations, relaxing progression, and a desktop companion-style mode that lets your cat stay visible alongside your day, Cozy Tails is all about quiet joy, soft charm, and building a tiny world that feels like home.

4612150.name: Checked In
4612150.about_the_game:
Checked In is a psychological horror game set in an old coastal hotel in Spain, where isolation and unease slowly take hold.

The gameplay is a first-person, story-driven walking simulator focused on exploration, environmental storytelling, and subtle interactions. Players uncover the narrative by observing their surroundings, piecing together clues, and engaging with objects that all serve a purpose.

Features

  • Integrated in-game smartphone UI as a core gameplay system (navigation, information, flashlight)

  • Single unified interface system central to all player interactions

  • Highly interactive environment with nearly all objects usable or inspectable

  • Exploration-driven design that rewards attention to detail

  • Environmental storytelling through audio, visuals, and subtle cues

  • Every element in the world is intentional and meaningful

  • Gradual breakdown of perceived reality throughout the experience

  • Increasingly unreliable narrative and environmental perception

  • Constant questioning of what is real versus hallucination or distortion

  • Psychological horror built through perception, ambiguity, and uncertainty

  • Deeply immersive world design with no purely decorative elements

You need  to charge your phone to keep the battery level up

Find out what happened to the guests..

Interactive hotel enviroment

4612160.name: Flock Inc.
4612160.about_the_game:
Your 9 to 5 is dreary, your hard work is never recognised and others keep taking the credit. In one wild act of rebellion, you decide to do one thing that will change your life forever. “Do not feed the birds”, the sign says. But you do.

In this satirical management sim, a few crumbs are all it takes to break free and build your own pigeon-powered marketing empire. Recruit pigeons, assign them to advertising campaigns, and manage your coop as your business grows in scale.... and strangeness.

<b>Build Your Pigeon Empire</b>

Recruit pigeons with unique stats, traits, and abilities. Expand your coop, increase capacity, and grow a chaotic workforce of feathered marketers.

<b>Plan and Optimise Campaigns</b>

Assign pigeons to advertising missions, match their strengths to challenges, and maximise rewards. Manage time, resources, and risk to keep your business running efficiently.

<b>Train and Evolve Your Flock</b>

Improve your pigeons through training and upgrades. Unlock new traits, enhance performance, and discover their hidden backstories.

<b>Uncover a Strange Narrative</b>

What begins as a simple business quickly spirals into something more surreal. Follow an escalating story involving strange forces, devoted followers, and a mysterious pigeon god.

<b>Key Features</b>

- Recruit and manage a diverse flock of pigeons

- Assign missions and optimise outcomes

- Upgrade your coop and expand operations

- Discover unique pigeon traits and backstories

- Experience a satirical, darkly humorous narrative

4612250.name: WARD: Descent
4612250.about_the_game:
WARD: Descent is a 2D dungeon-crawler roguelike where you pilot an armored combat suit. Explore an overrun research laboratory, manage your suit's software upgrades, and complete sequences to destroy anomalies. Descend to the bottom, pilot, and complete your mission!

Use your suit's structural scanner to explore the laboratory. Many experiments were left behind, many of which may prove useful to your mission. Other research equipment may also be of use to you, so keep your eyes peeled for anything useful.

As you descend, you will encounter experimental suit upgrade chips. These software-hardware enhancements will alter the abilities of your suit, increasing your odds of survival. The order in which these apply have a substantial impact on your combat effectiveness, so manage your suit systems wisely.

Limitations in your suit require you to manually complete certain actions during combat. Satisfactory completion of a sequence will greatly enhance your suit's offensive or defensive capabilities. The understanding and mastery of these sequences are paramount to your survival within the lab, pilot.

Strange anomalies have overrun the laboratory. Many bear a resemblance to familiar creatures, but do not be fooled, pilot. These entities are capable of interfering with suit systems, and they want only destruction. Strike first, and strike hard.

Complete your mission, pilot. Reach the bottom of the laboratory. Descend.

4612950.name: Tidy Backpack: In the Faraway Lands
4612950.about_the_game:
Tidy Backpack: In the Faraway Lands is a relaxing puzzle game where you must organize found futuristic loot in your backpack in a tidy way. Find unknown artifacts and learn details about the faraway lands... at least supposedly!

Features

  • 100 handcrafted levels

  • 36 unique items

  • 6 planets

  • Relaxing gameplay

  • Cute story

  • Cozy graphics

  • Chill music

  • Simple controls

  • Accessible mode

Story

Find items from the unknown planets and take them in your tidy backpack to find out what they are for in the faraway lands. However, we can only guess what all these artifacts serve for...

How to play

1. Left-click and hold to grab an item (Alternatively, Left-click - pick up, Left-click - drop)

2. Right-click to rotate

3. Fit all the items on a level into the backpack

4. Enjoy your perfect fit!

4612960.name: Achivement Maze 1
4612960.about_the_game:
Achievement Maze is a minimalist maze game where you have just one mission: guide your ball from the starting point to the checkered finish line. Simple in concept, addictive in execution.

Start with small, breezy mazes perfect for warming up, and progress gradually toward true puzzles of over 40×40 cells filled with branching paths, dead ends and false trails that will test your patience and sense of direction.

Key features:

  • 33 unique mazes, from 7×7 up to over 47×43 cells

  • 100 unlockable achievements — 3 per maze plus a final one for completing them all

  • Procedural generation ensuring every maze has multiple branches, dead ends and deceptive paths

  • Direct controls with WASD or arrow keys

  • Level progression system, where each maze unlocks once you beat the previous one

  • Polished sci-fi aesthetic with a cyan, purple and gold palette and geometric typography

  • Level select screen with progress indicators, stars and lock icons

  • Live stats for moves and time on every run

Can you complete all 33 mazes and unlock all 100 achievements? The checkered finish is waiting.

4613010.name: The Matron of Ashes
4613010.about_the_game:
🕯️STORY

In The Matron of Ashes, you arrive at a remote mansion left behind by your late grandmother.

At first, it seems abandoned… silent, untouched.

But as you explore deeper into the house, strange sounds begin to echo through the halls.

Something is still here.

What you believed to be grief slowly turns into dread — as the truth reveals itself.

Your grandmother never truly left…

And now, she is something else.

🎮 GAMEPLAY

Explore the mansion and uncover what truly happened.

Avoid the entity that stalks you through the halls.
Hide when necessary.
Survive long enough to face the truth.

And find a way to stop it… before it’s too late.

⚙️ FEATURES

  • Story-driven horror experience

  • A relentless entity tied to your past

  • Exploration-focused gameplay

  • Hide and survival mechanics

  • Dark, atmospheric mansion setting

This was never just a house.

It remembers.

And it won’t let you leave.

4613110.name: High Walk
4613110.about_the_game:
Wake up on a high platform over roofs of skyscrapers. Your goal is to reach the suitcase with a million dollars. And stay alive in the process. Fight intense frost and keep balance walking on ropes.

Several platforms have heaters to keep you warm. But to activate one you will have to pass a password to your dumbass mate via diffrent ways of communication. Siren speaker, Morse code or even a simple paper plane - use anything to get your message delivered and activate the heater!

Game features complex communication

  • proximity chat with environmental changes

  • speaker that delivers your voice on long distance

  • light switches, to communicate even in heavy wind

  • paper planes to deliver notes

4613170.name: InTheLake
4613170.about_the_game:
Game Introduction:

In this medieval role-playing action game, you can opt to play as two adventurers with entirely distinct abilities, wielding swords and magic in your hands to hone your skills within the Jinghu Village array, and upgrade your level to master more advanced combat techniques.

Features:

This is a moderately-paced, hardcore action game infused with an appropriate amount of Rogue elements, allowing you to craft your unique combat style based on random abilities!

Currently, the game boasts over 40 types of monsters, 11 uniquely styled bosses, and 10 completely different stages. Come and immerse yourself in a diverse combat experience!

Combat Mechanism:

  • Perfect Defense: Defend at the precise moment when the enemy launches a "critical" attack to trigger Perfect Defense, rendering yourself invincible for a short duration and knocking back surrounding enemies to regain control.

  • Perfect Dodge: Use dodge at the moment when the enemy is about to attack, trigger perfect dodge, slow down all enemies' movement speed for a certain period of time after triggering, make yourself invincible and gain additional anger/magic, speed up the release of big moves, and make it easier to break defense and back attack.

  • Back Attack: A regular attack from behind the enemy has a chance to trigger a Back Attack. Upon triggering, you become invincible for a short time, breaking the enemy's dominance and defense state, causing them to become stunned.

  • Defense Breaking: Enemies can enter a defense state, making them immune to normal attack stuns. Use Defense Breaking skills to shatter the target's defense state and deal additional damage. Most monsters will lose their defensive gear after their defense is broken! You can also be defense-broken by the enemy's "critical" attacks.

  • Floating in the Air: Utilize the Floating in the Air skill to levitate enemies. Enemies in the air cannot retaliate and will suffer additional floating damage. Beware of powerful enemies who can actively escape the floating state to counterattack. You can also be floated by enemy attacks.

  • Bounce Flying Objects: Regular attacks can bounce most flying objects, with the bounced objects dealing increased damage.

Cultivation Mechanism:

  • In-Game Cultivation: Sapphires enhance players' basic abilities; Rubies grant players stronger abilities and additional effects; Weapons significantly boost offensive capabilities.

  • Out-of-Game Cultivation: Gain experience points each time you defeat an enemy or enter settlement. Players' levels will continuously increase through accumulated experience points, strengthening their attributes. The current version has a maximum level cap of 60.

4613180.name: Dog in the Machine
4613180.about_the_game:
Dog in the Machine is a tactical roguelite, where you help an AutoDog escape a dystopian mecha-city and get back to their exiled humans.

Battle your way through a series of encounters, each taking place on a compact grid filled with reactive elements, enemy guardians, and strategic opportunities.

Eureka-rich procedural spaces

Every battlefield is generated to be a chain-reaction playground. Domino effect collision system, reactive enemies, conveyor belts, interactive buttons, explosive obstacles...

No boring fight : All these elements give the player an opportunity to find a satisfying 'eureka' solution in each battle, destroying many enemies in a spectacular way.

Tactical without headache

Thanks to a real-time preview system, you can see exactly how your instruction sequence will play out before committing. Smoothly try, cancel, retry, and build a solution without cognitive overload, experimenting freely until you find your favorite outcome.

If you lose, it will be due to a flaw in your strategy, not a careless mistake.

Dual-layered deckbuilding: learn, then combine

After each battle, your dog learns a new Trick. But more importantly, you will be able to train him to do more complex Tricks, that you will create freely by combining two others.

You can follow blueprints, or invent your own combinations freely. So by the end of the run, you will have created your own unique playstyle, based on powerful synergies.

4613610.name: EPITAPH: The Parchment Anthology

EPITAPH: The Parchment Anthology is a dark text-based horror experience set in a world of coffins, underground passages, forgotten rituals, and unseen entities.

You awaken buried alive, with no memory and no clear way out. Explore claustrophobic environments, examine your surroundings, collect items, and interpret cryptic clues to survive what lurks in the darkness.

Every decision matters. Some choices will lead you closer to the truth, while others may trigger unexpected events or lead to a brutal death. The world reacts to your actions, your inventory, and the paths you choose.

4613680.name: Retro Manager
4613680.about_the_game:
⚽ A Football Manager… Reimagined in the 90's

Retro Manager brings back the golden era of football management — stripped down, fast, and addictive.

No bloated menus. No waiting hours per season.
Just pure decision-making, tactics, and results.

🎮 Instant, Addictive Gameplay

  • Play full seasons in a fraction of the time

  • Jump in and out of matches with Flash Results

  • Real-time match commentary keeps every game alive

🧠 Tactical Control That Matters

  • Choose your style: Tiki-Taka, Direct, Long Ball etc

4613750.name: Demon Breaker
4613750.about_the_game:
Demon Breaker is a brutal, fast-paced action game where you exist as a forbidden creation—crafted by a Demon Lord through the fusion of a human soul and a demon soul. You were never meant to have a will of your own.

Now, you turn against the underworld.

Fight through a world consumed by demonic corruption, where the remnants of humanity are on the brink of collapse. Slay lesser demons to gain experience, unlocking powerful abilities that push you closer to your true potential. With every battle, you grow stronger—preparing for the inevitable clash against the Archdemons who have taken control.

Combat is relentless and unforgiving. Precision, timing, and aggression are the only things keeping you alive.

You carry the strength of a demon.
You carry the will of a human.
And you may be the world’s only chance at survival.

Controls
WASD – Move
Hold Shift – Run
Spacebar – Jump
Left Click – Down Swing
Right Click – Up Swing

Additional ability controls are explained in the Abilities menu.

4613900.name: Nightmare Hospital
4613900.about_the_game:
In order to cure a strange disease, you arrive at a bizarre hospital that appears to be abandoned. Someone tells you she can help you find a doctor, but you must first do her some favors, such as taking photos of the corpses in the hospital and helping her retrieve bodies. As things progress, you discover more abnormalities.

Horror gameplay centered on chases and missions

Face chase sequences, complete missions, and experience fast-paced horror gameplay with minimal puzzle-solving. While feeling fear and tension, you need to make the right decisions quickly.

Eerie and terrifying atmosphere

The hospital looks abandoned, but some areas are meticulously arranged, showing signs of activity, though seemingly not by humans.

Oppressive chase sequences

The entities in the hospital have different characteristics, and you need to respond in different ways. If you just run, they will tear you apart mercilessly.

Dangerous missions walking with death

Each mission requires strategic planning; once you lose your composure, only an endless abyss awaits you.

Gradually increasing difficulty

The game offers multiple difficulty levels that do not affect the ending, allowing players to choose according to their needs.

4614010.name: The Gamble Maze

4614040.name: Last Call
4614040.about_the_game:
Examine every detail with extreme caution!

GAME OVERVIEW

  • In the shadows of these endless corridors, your eyes are your sharpest weapon. Do not trust your feelings; scrutinize every detail. The moment you detect an anomaly, use your camera phone to capture that specific point before it's too late.

  • However, beware of your remaining energy. Every photo, every use of the phone comes at a cost. "Each floor offers a fresh chance, but only for those who observe with absolute precision. One wrong step, one missed detail, and the cycle begins anew. Once the door opens, the path behind you is gone forever.

Be certain of your choice. Once the door opens, there is no turning back.

GAME INTRODUCTION

I am a night shift security guard.

I’m here for a reason I can’t talk about.

There is nowhere else for me to go.

F*ck!!@#$%^&*!@$^

-------------------------------

Back to the first floor again...

-------------------------------

Clear 5 floors to find your way out.

CONTENT WARNING

This game contains elements that may be distressing to some players:

  • Psychological Horror: Features intense atmospheres, isolation, and unsettling environments.

  • Visual Glitches & Distortion: Includes flashing lights, screen shakes, and sudden visual changes (glitch-noir style) that may affect players with photosensitive epilepsy.

  • Hallucinations & Paranoia: Depicts a character’s deteriorating mental state.

  • Jump Scares: Contains sudden auditory and visual startles.

Player discretion is advised.

4614210.name: Crack the Pack
4614210.about_the_game:
Crack the Pack is an incremental game centered around opening card packs. The goal is to collect all 120 cards in the game, divided into 4 rarities, along with their metallic, holographic, negative, and glitchy variant, for a total of 600 cards.

Cards you’ve already discovered can be resold for increasingly outrageous prices. The shop offers 8 different types of boosters, each varying in price, contents, and drop rates.

A rich and diverse upgrade tree lets you increase card value, boost overall opening speed, and unlock new features such as a magnet, automated workers, and even a laboratory to attempt card fusion.

Will you manage to collect all 600 cards ?

4614300.name: Soulspree
4614300.about_the_game:
A first-person bullet heaven survival shooter set in a relentless Hellscape where overwhelming enemy hordes never stop coming. You are dropped into arenas filled with demonic forces and must fight to survive as the intensity escalates over time.

The core gameplay revolves around rapidly firing weapons, constant movement, and smart positioning as waves of enemies flood the environment. Defeated enemies drop resources that allow you to select and stack powerful upgrades, creating explosive build synergies that dramatically change how you fight. Each run pushes you to adapt, combining abilities, weapons, and passive effects into increasingly destructive combinations.

As the chaos grows, so does your power, turning you from a vulnerable survivor into an overwhelming force capable of erasing entire screens of enemies.

Every attempt is different depending on the upgrades you choose and the builds you discover.

4614580.name: Cat Watch
4614580.about_the_game:
Cat Watch is a 2D arcade shooter minigame with roguelike progression where you control a cat defending an apartment against enemies that seek cover and strike at the right moment. Jump, attack, and eliminate waves of mosquitoes, rats, and bats as you advance toward the source of the infestation.

During the night, strange creatures begin invading the building through the ventilation system. As the resident cat, you must patrol each apartment, eliminate the intruders, and keep the chaos under control.

These enemies analyze the environment, seek cover, try to surround you, and attack when they find an opportunity.

Each cleared wave pushes you higher up the building, where new enemies, tougher encounters, and greater pressure await. Survive long enough to uncover the source of the infestation.

INTENSE ARCADE COMBAT

Face fast-paced action where positioning, timing, and quick reflexes are key to survival. As the night progresses, the screen fills with projectiles and enemies in chaotic encounters.

DEFEND THE APARTMENT

Patrol the apartment and fight back against invading creatures. Jump, attack, and react quickly as enemies emerge from the vents and swarm the room from different directions.

ROGUELIKE UPGRADES

Every attempt is a chance to grow stronger. Spend your rewards in the shop to improve your abilities, experiment with upgrades, and prepare for the next night of defense.

TACTICAL ENEMIES

Creatures analyze the environment to gain the advantage. They hide, seek cover, move to strategic positions, and attack when they find an opening.

Features

  • Fast-paced 2D arcade combat where quick reflexes, positioning, and timing are the key to survival.

  • Defend the apartment from invading creatures like mosquitoes, rats, and bats emerging from the ventilation system.

  • Intelligent enemies that seek cover, exploit openings, and strike at the right moment.

  • Climb through the building’s floors facing new threats and increasingly intense waves.

  • Roguelike progression with upgrades that make each attempt stronger and more strategic.

  • Uncover the source of the infestation.

4614620.name: Soulsmith

Soulsmith is a dark fantasy dungeon crawler focused on progression, exploration, and combat.

Step into a world that feels ancient, broken, and alive. What begins as a simple task quickly pulls you deeper into something far more dangerous.

Fight your way through handcrafted zones, uncover hidden paths, and face enemies that grow stronger the deeper you go.

Build your character through multiple guilds, each offering unique skills and playstyles. Experiment with different builds and find what suits your way of fighting.

Prepare for brutal encounters, powerful bosses, and a world that doesn’t reveal its secrets easily.

FEATURES:

• Combat-driven progression

• Interconnected zones with hidden paths

• Challenging enemies and boss encounters

• A mysterious world to explore

The deeper you go, the harder it gets.

4614640.name: Lord of Idle
4614640.about_the_game:
Lord of Idle takes the deep, rewarding itemization of classic ARPGs and distills it into a clean, highly accessible idle experience.

I built this game because I love theorycrafting and hunting for loot, but I wanted a progression system that actually respects your time. Lord of Idle avoids the trap of absurd, hyper-inflated idle numbers. Instead, I focused on a simple, deeply satisfying gameplay loop where your damage comes from making smart gear choices, not just blindly clicking a screen.

DISTILLED ARPG COMBAT

Combat is built around a simple core loop that still offers real depth for those who want it. Rather than getting bogged down in bloated skill trees and numbers in the trillions, your success relies on clean itemization.

  • Mix and match synergistic item sets, or hunt for incredibly rare Uber Uniques with game-changing standalone abilities.

  • Use our built-in Gear Optimizer to customize your build exactly how you want it. Input your own custom stat weights, and let the algorithm suggest the exact gear combinations needed to maximize your Time To Kill (TTK), Gold Per Hour, XP, or any other custom parameters you set.

  • Actively manage your live combat simulation to optimize your loot, or step away and let your build do the heavy lifting 100% offline.

CHASE THE PERFECT DROP

Every single drop genuinely matters. Even at level 1, you have a rare chance to find incredibly powerful Godly rarity gear or if you are incredibly lucky a game-changing Uber Unique item.

  • With dynamically rolled stats and tiered affixes, that perfect "god-roll" item is always just one kill away.

  • Maximize your endgame power through Divine Ascension, allowing you to permanently ascend and transform your best Godly items.

  • Reforge & Re-roll: Don't want to rely entirely on drop luck? Once an item is Divinely Ascended, you can target and re-roll specific bonus stats or completely randomize its Divine Mastery to chase the ultimate combination.

  • Battle the Crypt King in live multiplayer to earn and upgrade a powerful daily Boss Relic.

MONTHLY SEASONS & SECURE LADDERS

  • Fresh Starts: Every month, a new Season brings a completely leveled playing field. Race the leaderboards while exploring newly introduced items, mechanics, and game modes designed to shake up the meta. Top ladder players earn exclusive, permanent cosmetic titles to show off their dominance!

  • Zero-Tolerance Anti-Cheat: All competitive ladders undergo nightly anti-cheat verification sweeps, ensuring the leaderboards remain fair and legitimate.

  • The Legacy Server: Don’t have time to race the ladder? When a Season ends, your character transitions to the Eternal Legacy server where you can endlessly hunt and perfect your ultimate build at your own pace.

SOCIAL BOSS ARENAS

Take a break from the solo grind! Jump into shared multiplayer boss arenas to fight alongside the community in real time. Chat with other players and show off your rare skins, exclusive titles, and progress while unlocking new cosmetic drops. Plus, completing these encounters is a crucial daily mechanic to earn and steadily upgrade your powerful Boss Relic!

AUTOMATE YOUR MINING & CRAFTING

Need a break from combat? Step out of the dungeon and manage a fun, grid-based Isometric Factory.

  • Route conveyor belts and place heavy machinery to fully automate your mining.

  • Extract raw ores and refine rare resources to mass produce the materials needed to fuel your endgame crafting gear.

THE BLACK MARKET & ECONOMY

Gold isn’t just for hoarding. Take your hard-earned wealth to the Merchant to interact with a surprisingly deep web of secondary systems that let you push your luck and flex your riches.

  • Gamble for Glory: Test your luck by gambling massive amounts of gold for a chance at high-level merchant gear, or spin the wheel to unlock extremely rare, prestigious cosmetic titles.

  • The Underground Factory Trade: Tap into the Black Market to directly swap, trade, and sell your mass-produced Factory goods and rare resources for massive payouts.

4614650.name: Polity Painter
4614650.about_the_game:
Polity Painter: Your World, Your Canvas

Ever dreamed of shaping continents and forging empires with the stroke of a brush? Dive into Polity Painter, a unique sandbox experience where you become the cartographer of your own history!

Choose from a diverse selection of world maps – from historical regions like  Japan, and the British Isles to entire continents like Asia, Europe, Africa, and the Americas, or even the whole World itself! Use intuitive painting tools to claim territories, assigning distinct colors to represent burgeoning nations or sprawling empires.

But coloring is just the beginning! Click on your painted regions to:

  • Name Your Nations: Give your creations unique identities. 

  • Define Their Traits: Assign Governments, Religions, Cultures, and approximate Population and Power levels.

  • Generate Unique Flags: Add visual flair with procedurally generated or custom-designed flags.

  • Place Cities: Mark important settlements on your map.

  • Write Descriptions: Add lore and details to breathe life into your world.

Key Features:

  • 🎨 Intuitive Map Painting: Use brushes, paint buckets, and an eraser to define borders.

  • 🌍 Multiple Maps: Explore and paint various regions including Europe, Asia, Americas, Africa, World, Japan, British Isles, and the Middle East.

  • 💾 Save & Load: Preserve your meticulously crafted worlds and return to them anytime.

  • ✨ Deep Customization: Define the core characteristics of your nations.

  • 🏙️ City Placement: Add points of interest to your map.

  • ✒️ Lore Building: Add descriptions to your nations to flesh out their stories.

  • 🎵 Relaxing Lo-fi Beats: Enjoy a chill soundtrack while you create.

  • ⚙️ Helpful Tools: Color picker, adjustable brush sizes, and undo functionality.

Polity Painter is more than just a map-coloring tool; it's a canvas for your imagination. Perfect for worldbuilders, alternate history enthusiasts, tabletop RPG mappers, or anyone who loves creative sandbox games. Shape the destinies of nations, redraw borders, and craft the world as you see fit.

Play Polity Painter today and start painting your history!

4614710.name: AfterMove
4614710.about_the_game:
One move, 16 reactions. Every piece obeys a fixed rule. And they all move the instant you do.

Welcome to AfterMove, a punishing minimalist grid puzzle game built on pure spatial logic.

Some pieces step. Some charge two squares. Some cut diagonally or leap in geometric L-shapes. Some move opposite to you, and some don't move at all. Meanwhile, one unique piece — the Chaser — utilizes a pursuing AI pathfinding rule to track your coordinates. Learn the mechanical loops, and the board starts to make sense. But with up to 16 pieces reacting simultaneously on a tight 6×6 grid, finding the optimal line is a deep tactical challenge.

Simple Rules, Real Depth

The objective is always clear: reach the goal square. Made a mistake? Miscalculating a layout is part of the process, but correction is instant—the Undo tool is just one keypress away. Experiment freely, backtrack without penalty, and try again. The challenge is pure grid geometry, and the winning path is always there — you just haven't discovered it yet.

The Chaser: Turning Deterministic Geometry into a Puzzle Solution Tool

The Chaser introduces dynamic complexity. Each turn, its fixed rule dictates a single step toward your coordinates—always closing the bigger gap first, either horizontally or vertically. It resets the level if it successfully occupies your square. You cannot outrun its deterministic tracking forever on a tiny 6×6 board; you must outwit its geometry.

Route around it, lure it into a structural wall, or block its movement vector with another piece. The first time you encounter a Chaser layout, it will test your spatial awareness. By the end of the game, you will be manipulating its exact mathematical ruleset to solve the level for you.

Choose Your Mindset: Two Gameplay Modes

  • Casual Mode: Move one step at a time. React, learn, undo, and test patterns across 120 levels spanning four escalating difficulty tiers. Perfect for finding your footing.

  • Expert Mode: Commit your full movement plan before anything executes. Input two to six steps sequentially all at once, hit execute, and watch the board update with zero corrections. 71 elite tiers of pure logic execution.

Fair and Deterministic by Design

Every single layout is solver-verified and guaranteed solvable. The mechanics never change — only your structural understanding of them does. Walls block absolute movement paths permanently. Inverted pieces move in exact mathematical opposition to your inputs. The line is there. Can you see it?

Full Game Features:

  • 180+ Hand-Curated Layouts: Zero procedural randomness. Every level is a hand-curated logical trap.

  • 16 Distinct Piece Behaviours: From static blocks to pathfinding Chasers and inverted pieces.

  • Play It Your Way: Full native compatibility for keyboard, mouse, or gamepad controllers.

  • No Artificial Blocks: Jump between Casual and Expert modes freely. No win-streaks required.

  • Premium Quality-of-Life: Abstract themes, colorful palettes, instant undo, score attack tracking, and smart hints when you're truly stuck.

Bonus Feature: Couch Companion Mode (Coming soon)

About the Developer

AfterMove is the debut video game from Colin Ord, author of Magic Moving Images — an animated optical illusion book that sold over 50,000 copies. This game shares that exact same lifelong fascination for hidden rules, abstract patterns, and geometry that snaps vibrantly alive the moment you finally understand it.

4614870.name: Apiary in Flow

Build efficient honey chains

Place different kinds of bees across hexagonal hives and turn each level into a flowing honey-producing system. Positioning is everything: each bee has its own role, and the way they connect determines how efficient your hive becomes.

Master the hexagonal layout

Every hive is a puzzle of space, flow, and efficiency. Plan your layout carefully, adapt to each level, and find the best arrangement to move honey where it needs to go. Small changes can make a big difference.

Unlock new bee types

As you progress, new bee types add more depth and new possibilities to your runs. Learn how they interact, create stronger combinations, and design smarter honey-gathering setups as the hive grows more complex.

Upgrade between runs

When time runs out, your harvest is not wasted. Spend the resources you gathered on permanent skill tree upgrades that improve your bees and make future runs faster, stronger, and more efficient.
