4615010.about_the_game:
An ancient shrine, the Pawbelisk, sits half-buried in the ground. Click it and it bestows sacred kibble. Keep collecting and soon the cats will return to help. Before long, your village will purr with activity as Kibble Cats haul resources, Treat Cats run a shop for powerful upgrades, and Worshipper Cats beckon blessings from beyond. 



The ancient shrine rises from the earth as your wealth grows. What was once a forgotten, crumbling stone gives way to a monument that grows more powerful with each stage. 


Five buildings, each with a unique upgrade tree. Unlock The Cattery, the Treat Shop, the Dream Tower, and more as you hit major milestones.

Kibble Cats, Treat Cats, and Worshippers each with a role to play. Automate your economy and let the kibble roll in while you're away, or choose a more active playstyle.


Unlock cat customization after your first prestige. Freely choose body colors, accent colors, eye colors, and patterns.

Prestige through The Great Offering and spend Paw Points on three tiers of powerful, permanent Blessings. Each run makes you stronger during the next one. 

Gather enough kibble to catch the gaze of The Dreamer. Some secrets are only revealed to the most devoted disciples.

4615060.name: Mist Weavers
4615060.about_the_game:
Survive the World Beneath

The Mist has shrouded the Earth, mutating everything it touches into bestial menaces. Humanity has fled to the Floating Isles, fragments of land held aloft by the Mist itself. You are a Mist Weaver, one of the few gifted individuals capable of manipulating this gas and traversing the ruins of the world below. Your mission: descend into the Fallen Isles, harvest the rare substance "Gua" from corrupted cores, and secure humanity's future.

Witness a unique "Dark-Cartoon" aesthetic that blends cel-shaded charm with grotesque themes.

Dual-Control Combat Mastery

Forget "near-idle" gameplay. Mist Weavers demands active precision through its unique dual-control system:

  • The Weaver: Navigate the battlefield, dodge projectiles, and use your Mist Powers to maneuver through danger.

  • The Familiar: Your pet is your weapon. Click to displace your familiar, smashing into enemies and triggering devastating abilities.

Key Features:

  • Dual-Control Action: Experience a High-Skill "survivor-like" that rewards active play, juggling your own movement with precise familiar commands.

  • Level Up: Choose from a roster of Mist abilities to create synergetic and unique builds in every run.

  • Echoes of a Fallen World: Venture into the darkest corners of the world to uncover lost history and secrets buried deep within the Mist.

  • Environmental Interaction: Jump off Jelly Trunks, dodge stunning rock traps, and channel powerful Shrines to maintain your flow and turn the world to your advantage.

  • Evolutionary Meta-Progression: Use Gua and Black Cores to permanently upgrade both the Weaver and the Familiar, and unlock unique ability modifications!

  • Unique Familiar Types: Unlock specialized familiars that cater to different styles of gameplay, from bestial brawlers to high-precision strikers.

4615100.name: UrbanRail Metro Simulator
4615100.about_the_game:
The Ultimate Metro Driving Experience

Dive into the depths of the city and take command of iconic train formations in UrbanRail Metro Simulator. From historic early 20th-century tunnels to the most modern networks, every journey will test your precision and technical knowledge.

Main Features:

  • Faithful Rolling Stock: Drive various types of trains, from the newest models to the oldest classics, including convoys like the CRRC-Citic 200 Series, the classic Nagoya Metro 5000 Series, and the legendary Fiat Materfer.

  • Real Safety Systems: Operate with authentic safety protocols. Master the ATP (Automatic Train Protection) system and advanced CBTC/ATO for precise semi-automatic driving.

  • Advanced Driving Physics: Feel the weight of the train. The simulator features an air-pressure-based braking system and realistic acceleration curves that vary based on passenger load.

  • Station Management: Control side-door operations, respect itinerary schedules, and ensure passenger safety at every station.

Detailed Systems:

  • Licensing System: Complete the required training courses for each convoy to fully unlock them.

  • ATP/CBTC & Deadman's Switch: Drive realistically by respecting signals and preventing the train from emergency braking through its protection systems.

  • Dynamic Passengers: Passengers have a destination to reach! Avoid delays to prevent stations from overcrowding and keep your schedule on track.

  • Real Lines: Travel through historic tunnels and photorealistic stations designed for a truly immersive experience.

Game Modes:

  • Driver: Operate your convoy safely through the tunnels and meet the schedule to avoid passenger overcrowding!

  • Train Guard: Control the opening and closing of the doors and manage train capacity to prevent passengers from blocking the doors!

  • Missions: Complete various challenges, from high-difficulty scenarios like driving with signal failures to simple tasks like operating the first service of the day.

Do you have what it takes to keep the network moving? Step into the cab and start your career in UrbanRail!
4615100.supported_languages: English, German, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese

4615220.name: EXPLODES
4615220.about_the_game:
EXPLODES is a fast-paced 2D stickman fighting game packed with explosive weapons, chaotic combat, and nonstop action.

15 Explosive Weapons
From frag grenades and RPGs to nukes and cluster bombs — every weapon goes boom. Master the arsenal and dominate the arena.

10 Unique Arenas
Fight across rooftops, warehouses, volcanic pits, and more. Each map has different platforms, hazards, and strategies.

Single Player
Battle against AI bots across 5 difficulty levels — from Rookie to the ruthless GOD mode. Level up, unlock new weapons, skins, and maps as you progress.

Local Multiplayer
Grab a friend and fight on the same keyboard. Classic couch PvP combat.

Online Multiplayer
Create or join lobbies and fight players online. Invite friends to 1v1 matches.

Progression System
60 levels of unlocks — weapons, character skins, accessories, and maps. Earn gold, hit the shop, and customize your fighter.

Free to Play
No paywalls, no pay-to-win. Every weapon and skin is unlockable through gameplay.

4615320.name: My First 3D Printer
4615320.about_the_game:
What started as a hobby quickly became an obsession. One printer turned into two, two into four — and before you knew it, your room was a fully operational 3D printing workshop. My First 3D Printer is a business simulation where you build and manage your own 3D printing operation from the ground up.

  • Slice your models — Use the in-game slicer to prepare your prints. Adjust layer height, infill, nozzle size and more.

  • Manage your filament — Choose from multiple materials and colors. Keep an eye on moisture levels and stock up before you run out.

  • Run your printers — Monitor print progress, handle failures, and keep your machines in top condition.

  • Fulfill customer orders — Sort, pack and ship your prints before the deadline. Quality matters.

  • Grow your workshop — Expand your space, buy better printers, unlock new materials and take on bigger orders.

Every great printing business started somewhere. Yours starts now.

4615330.name: ROBOSCAV
4615330.about_the_game:
ROBOSCAV is a turn-based extraction RPG where you play a genius engineer that was shot down while exploring the galaxy. You now must lead your remote controlled droid crew into danger to scavenge and rebuild your ship to escape the planet.

Crash-landed on a hostile world your ship completely destroyed to scraps, your remaining droid crew has only one path forward: scavenge, survive, rebuild.

Resources are limited. Repairs are expensive. Some upgrades compete for the same materials needed for ship reconstruction.

Strip your enemies for every part they have if you want to survive!

Your scavengers are machines, and machines can be rebuilt.

Swap out limbs, chassis components, utility modules, and combat systems to shape each droid for a specific role.

Create durable frontline units, fast blade wielding samurai specialists, long-range snipers, or experimental hybrids built around risky strategies and  alien tech.

As you progress, you'll gain new fabrication blueprints, find rare materials, and unlock more advanced ways to modify your robots permanently.

You aren't the only one on this planet. Warring factions fight for dominance to control the planet. Alien creatures make this planet their home. The SCAV, or local plant life even have become sentient and come with a hatred for all things.

The more you make your presence known you will attract unwanted attention. 

Eventually you will be hunted during your raids.

Your ultimate goal is simple: rebuild your ruined spaceship and escape the planet, but why stop there? 

You can decide the fate of this world. Certain powerful factions have plans of their own, you could ally with them, or exploit their weakness.

  • Class System: There are class chips that can be installed as well, that greatly increase the chance of survival and builds can be created. 

  • Body Part System: Most body parts have attachment slots, that allow you to customize each part with new stats and even new abilities.

  • Barter Economy: Scrap is your currency. Traders will also sometimes have barter trades for other useful items. Every item has a purpose. 

  • Quests and Multiple Endings: The main story quest is to escape the planet, however that doesn't have to be the only way. Some faction traders will have specialized quest lines for alternative endings.

  • Transits: The world can be traversed completely by foot, no need to extract each raid. 

  • Item Upgrading: If you have the fabrication recipe for the item, you can create a upgrade project that will allow you to modify the stats of every future craft for that item.

  • Presence System: Every map will have a presence meter that grows as you make noise or destroy your enemies. This attracts attention from the local military which will increase military patrols and tougher enemies will spawn, and some will even be looking for you.

  • Ship Systems: Your ship is completely destroyed, as you upgrade it you will find there are many modules that can actually assist you while surviving. This can include increased cargo hold space, improved fabrication recipes, better SCAV loadouts. etc.

4615360.name: Redacted by the Sadistic Princess from Another World?!
4615360.about_the_game:
Yaemori Nowa is an indie game developer of some renown. Her first (and, so far, only) title, the unexpected smash hit eroge, Utter Obedience: Conquered by the Sadistic Princess, propels her into the world of internet fame, and she's only too happy to reap the rewards. Finally able to quit her soul-sucking corporate job, the young developer focuses her time and energy on her one true love: making raunchy anime games full of beautiful, busty lesbians.

Nowa's once idyllic life takes a disastrous turn, however, when Sadistic Princess, her main source of income, is pulled from a major storefront owing to objections over its salacious nature. Unsure what to do, and with her future hanging in the balance, Nowa succumbs to despair...

At least, until a golden-haired princess pays Nowa an unexpected visit in her small apartment in Hokkaido.

Much to Nowa's surprise, the sadistic princess of her own eroge, Lady Irina Tatiana Argutinsky, the Princess of Thymian, has taken such an interest her she crossed the barrier between one world and the next to cheer Nowa on - and Irina isn't alone, either.

Soon, Irina's nemesis, the serious, super cool knight, Ywaine de Maris, the commander of all the knights of Urd, joins in, and now Nowa is really in a pinch.

How is she supposed to finish developing Sadistic Princess II now, with two beautiful women lounging around in her apartment?!




- 90,000 words (approx 4-5 hours of reading)
- cute and colourful character art
- a custom soundtrack
- choices to make that shape your ending
- two cute girls to date, Irina and Ywaine
- a lot of silly jokes
- one very sadistic princess
4615360.game_link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4615360/Redacted by the Sadistic Princess from Another World?!/

4615480.name: Arcane Towerline
4615480.about_the_game:
Welcome to Arcane Towerline, where classic tower defense strategy collides with unpredictable roguelite mechanics! Your ultimate goal is simple: protect your crystal core from endless waves of enemies.

♟️ Auto-Battler Recruitment & Strategy

Dynamic Shop: Spend gold to purchase your guards from a shop that randomly refreshes every round.

Tiers & Rarity: From basic 1-cost units to legendary 5-cost mythics with devastating power. Manage your economy wisely to secure your core damage dealers.

archmage（5 cost）

mana wyrm（4 cost）

Versatile Synergies: Units on the board don't fight alone. Combining specific races and classes activates powerful synergy buffs. It’s entirely up to you to build a unique and unstoppable defense.

🗺️ A Unique Roguelite Adventure Every Run

Ever-Changing Battlefields: The map layout and terrain are procedurally generated for each new game. Say goodbye to rote memorization; this will test your true tactical adaptability.

Unpredictable Invaders: The enemy lineups are equally varied. Whether facing resurrecting Skeleton Warriors or Banshees with AoE auras, every wave brings a brand-new challenge.

Destiny's Choice: Backed into a corner? At critical moments in your run, powerful "Wonder Magic" will randomly appear! Will you choose a massive screen wipe, or a huge damage multiplier? The right choice can instantly turn the tide of battle!

⚔️ Pure Defense, Tactical Positioning Here, the monsters have one clear objective: they have zero interest in destroying your towers and will recklessly charge straight for the crystal. You don't need to distract yourself with managing tower HP or armor. Simply pour all your tactical brilliance into maximizing damage output, chaining debuffs, and perfecting your unit positioning.

👨‍💻 Developer's Note

Arcane Towerline is my very first game, developed entirely solo. As such, it might still have a few rough edges. If you have any feedback or suggestions, please feel free to send an email to tara.shimmer.ss@gmail.com. Thank you so much for your support!
4615480.supported_languages:
English*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support

4615570.name: Bug Bounce
4615570.about_the_game:
Bug Bounce is a co-op action roguelike where momentum becomes a weapon.

Play as evolving insect heroes and fight through dangerous swarms, deadly biomes, and massive bosses in a stylized underground world. Blast enemies apart, launch them into each other, and build absurdly powerful upgrade combinations as your run escalates into physics-driven chaos.

In Bug Bounce, movement and impact matter. Knockback is not just crowd control. It is damage, positioning, combo potential, and survival. Every hit can send enemies flying, trigger collisions, and create destructive chain reactions across the battlefield.

Whether you are fighting solo or alongside friends, every run is about building something powerful, weird, and eventually game-breaking.

What Makes Bug Bounce Different?

Momentum-Based Combat

Turn force into damage. Knock enemies into walls, hazards, other enemies, and the environment itself. Build around bounce, launch, collision, and control to create chaotic combat scenarios that keep escalating.

Deep Build Variety

Shape each run with upgrades that alter your attacks, abilities, and playstyle. Stack mutations, weapon modifiers, and major transformations to create synergistic builds that can spiral into total mayhem.

Mid-Run Evolution

Your character grows during the run, unlocking stronger forms and new possibilities as you evolve into something deadlier.

Solo or Online Co-Op

Take on the swarm alone or with friends. Coordinate roles, combine effects, and create even bigger combos in co-op.

A World of Bugs and Bosses

Descend into a stylized insect world filled with enemy families, elite variants, and dangerous bosses that demand movement, awareness, and build adaptation.

Features

  • Online co-op roguelike action

  • Momentum and knockback-based combat

  • Build-defining mutations and weapon modifiers

  • Mid-run metamorphosis and evolution

  • Swarms, elites, flying enemies, and bosses

  • Replayable runs with strong synergy potential

  • Stylized insect fantasy with high-chaos combat

Hatch. Evolve. Ascend.

4615610.name: The Lost
4615610.about_the_game:
A young man returns to the apartment building and enters an endless looping space — is this a deity's joke, or a devil's trick?

A notice from someone who became an anomaly:

  • The stairs here no longer have the concept of going up or down — moving to the right is moving forward, and moving to the left is going back.

  • When you enter another floor, if it is different from the first floor, it means an anomaly has occurred. In this case, you need to go back in order to go upstairs.

  • If another floor is the same as the first floor, it means there is no anomaly. You can continue forward to go upstairs.

  • When the number on the fake head changes color, it means the current floor is a special anomaly floor.

  • On special floors, you cannot simply go forward or backward. You need to complete an event or make a judgment based on the anomaly before you can continue upstairs.

  • If you encounter an event-based anomaly, complete their event. They will tell you whether to go forward or backward.

  • If you encounter a non-event special anomaly, such as a monkey — trust the monkey that cannot speak.

  • If you encounter a crow, never follow the crow.

  • Watch out for the hands on the ground.

  • You may be transported to another world.

  • ......

On the floor before the end, you will definitely enter the territory of a giant dragon.

4615620.name: Impossible Machine
4615620.about_the_game:
Impossible Machine is a point-and-click adventure game featuring 3D characters on 2D backgrounds, where exploration, dialogue, and experimentation are key to progress.

It all begins when your protagonist receives an unexpected letter. In it, they are entrusted with a mission: to travel, investigate, and clear the name of their uncle, whose reputation has become entangled with strange events…

As you progress, you become involved with a community that also needs help. Solving their problems not only brings you closer to the truth, but also uncovers new areas and mechanisms within the world.

Explore interconnected environments, interact with characters who provide helpful information that may be completely useless, and collect objects that can be combined in unconventional ways.

You can tackle multiple tasks at once, switching between objectives, trying out ideas, and discovering how the world's systems interact. Some combinations make sense. Others not so much. And some work better than expected.

Features:

  • Non-linear progression
    Tackle different tasks in parallel and progress at your own pace.

  • 2.5D aesthetic
    3D characters integrated into pre-rendered 2D backgrounds for a classic style with its own identity.

  • Challenges that blend logic with trial and error

  • No minigames, no combat
    Just problems, objects, and questionable decisions.

  • Hints… if you ask for them
    If you get stuck, the game can give you a hand. Or several. Not always as helpful as you'd hope.
4615620.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America

4615900.name: Survival Exorcist
4615900.about_the_game:
Survival Exorcist is a solo developer's medieval survival horror experience inspired by the golden age of 2000's action horror games. An ancient plague has transformed villagers into grotesque creatures, and the rescue train sent to contain the outbreak never reached the castle. As a trained female hunter from the Order of Exorcists, you must find the derailed train to deliver the sacred artifacts needed to save the lands from complete corruption.

Hunt corrupted creatures with your crossbow as you explore plague-ridden villages and ancient catacombs. Discover hidden items scattered throughout the environment to replenish your limited resources while balancing stealth takedowns with strategic combat encounters..

Unlock Hunter Mode after completing the main campaign. Try a relentless challenge to use the train through the map as you gather rare materials and hunt down corrupted bosses in a race against time. Experience authentic 2000 era visuals with modern accessibility as you take on the role of a skilled hunter in a world overrun by ancient evil.
4615900.supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support

4616080.name: WRITE.EYE
4616080.about_the_game:
The Hero's Journey

In a futuristic Seattle, the CorpoState has built a sustainable society, regulating every citizen's perception through a mandatory contact lens to maintain a flawless digital utopia. Magic, a weary editor for the Goodwill Gazette living in Tower D#503, spends his days polishing a historical tale that he has come to realize is a hollow lie.

Driven by a lifelong curiosity and seeking answers beyond his walls, he chooses to install an unauthorized override sent from Morro, a defiant coder on the run from the State. This illicit file allows him to finally see the system, granting him the power to toggle his lens and traverse the dangerous gaps between the two worlds as he descends to the streets below.

Gameplay & Mechanics

The perception through the WRITE.EYE (Magic’s right eye) is of a pristine, utopian city free from chaos. Though hidden under the overlay (Magic’s left eye), Seattle is slowly crumbling.

The Player uses Magic’s faulty implant to view the two different worlds and avoid obstacles. Advancement is tied to 10 narrative escape rooms that build upon the story, with levels growing larger as you descend to portray a growing sense of freedom.

  • Left-Mouse-Click: close your left eye to see the crumbling city.

  • Right-Mouse-Click: close your right eye to view the pristine overlay.

  • The Task: Find Morro by escaping each floor while logging hidden datapads for lore.

The Descent

The Player starts in a contained small space, though as they progress the levels get larger and more welcoming, portraying a sense of freedom. Each scene is a different room that must be unlocked to proceed to the next floor down.

Roadmap

See the System.

4616170.name: DO NOT FILE
4616170.about_the_game:
You are a reporter investigating a cold case from years ago.

The lead brings you to an abandoned police station, you’re looking for a missing file that could reopen the case.

The place still feels intact, like it was left yesterday.

Files are incomplete, rooms don’t always match what you expect and small details feel off as you go further inside.

What starts as a routine investigation slowly becomes harder to make sense of,

And the case doesn’t feel as closed as it was supposed to be.

Features:

  • Third-person exploration in an abandoned police station

  • Investigation-driven gameplay centered on a cold case

  • Environmental storytelling through documents and scattered evidence

  • Subtle psychological tension built on uncertainty and doubt

  • Minimal narrative, leaving space for player interpretation

  • Atmosphere-driven experience focused on discovery and investigation

4616250.name: Lost City
4616250.about_the_game:
• A noir adventure in the mysterious Lost City.

  • A metroidvania spiced up with Souls-like gameplay systems.

  • A multi-layered 2D world with intricate spatial depth.

  • Hidden passages, seamless level design.

  • Trumpets, guitars, and guitar pedals are part of your gear.

  • Guitar pedals affect projectiles.

  • Hiding in the shadows, spatial puzzles, and boss battles.

  • Crafting system, monster loot, character leveling, and builds.

  • Hacking terminals, jazz bars, and hidden corners of the City.

  • A story about a City that shouldn’t exist.

4616480.name: Tiny Leaf Kingdom
4616480.about_the_game:
About

But what they left behind wasn’t peace.
It was weapons and armor.

Tiny Leaf Kingdom is a third-person (TPS), level-based action adventure where you control a green leaf warrior trying to survive in the middle of a war that has lasted for years.

Your enemies are the red leaves.
They don’t plan. They don’t hide.
They come in numbers… and they don’t stop.

You, on the other hand, must rely on your reflexes, your wits, and the gear you find along the way.

Swords, Axes, and Armor That’s Slightly Too Big

Survival in this war is simple:
find good gear and use it at the right moment.

Weapons once made for humans are now in the hands of leaf warriors. Rusty swords, heavy axes, and helmets that never quite fit… They may look strange at first, but once the fighting starts, every piece matters.

As you progress through new levels, you’ll discover stronger loot, upgrade your equipment, and shape your own fighting style.

Sometimes a single axe can change the outcome of a battle.
Sometimes it just makes you look ridiculous.

Both are part of this world.

Change Your Power — Take New Forms

The greatest advantage of green leaves is their ability to adapt.

Through the skill system, you can take on the powers of different creatures:

Jaguar Form — Fast, aggressive, and deadly. Perfect for overwhelming enemies in close combat.

Eagle Form — Provides mobility and agility. Useful for escaping danger or reaching key positions quickly.

Spider Form — Patient and strategic. Opens new ways to gain advantage in difficult situations.

Choosing the right form at the right time is the key to survival.

Transform at the wrong moment…
and you might regret it.

Increasing Challenge, Level by Level

Progression in Tiny Leaf Kingdom is level-based. Each new stage introduces tougher enemies and new combat challenges.

Some levels demand careful movement in tight spaces.
Others throw waves of enemies directly at you.

As you move forward, enemies become faster, stronger, and more dangerous.

And sometimes…
you’ll face a Boss.

Boss Fights — The Real Test

Every boss fight pushes you to use everything you’ve learned.

The right gear.
The right skill.
The right timing.

Bosses aren’t just powerful — they test your patience.

But when you finally defeat them…
it feels truly earned.

Cozy Looks, Chaotic Battles

The world of Tiny Leaf Kingdom may look cozy and charming at first glance. Small characters, colorful environments, and a warm atmosphere…

But once the fighting begins, everything changes.

Crowds of enemies, fast-paced combat, and unpredictable moments keep you constantly alert. The world may look small, but the battles inside it are anything but.
4616480.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Russian

4616590.name: Settled At Sea
4616590.about_the_game:
Settled At Sea

Take on the role of a lighthouse keeper on a remote Scottish island, seeking solitude and inspiration after your wife’s passing—just weeks before she finished writing her beloved novel.

Each day, you maintain the lighthouse, tend to routine duties, and explore the rugged coastline. In her absence, you attempt to complete the book she left behind, piecing together her final words as your own thoughts begin to fade into isolation.

But small details begin to feel out of place... Strange remnants lie hidden among the cliffs. Faint traces of past lives linger in abandoned structures. And at night, you begin to notice that you may not be as isolated as you once believed.

Explore the island, uncover its buried history, and decide what you are willing to sacrifice. 

Features

  • A cinematic, atmospheric narrative experience inspired by Firewatch, set on a remote Scottish island

  • Performing various duties while uncovering the island’s shifting and unsettling atmosphere

  • Environmental storytelling that reveals a buried past through locations, objects, and fragmented history

  • A slow-burn psychological mystery where isolation begins to distort perception

  • A meaningful choice leading to multiple endings

Contains themes of grief and death.

4616730.name: Supernova Deliveries
4616730.about_the_game:
SURVIVE THE TRADE ROUTES

You start with a basic convoy and a single goal: to prosper. Save credits, gather materials, and upgrade your fleet step by step. In deep space, the difference between a successful delivery and disaster depends on your ability to manage what you have.

MANAGEMENT AND PRIORITIES

Dealing with a limited inventory is part of your daily routine. You must prioritize which resources to keep and how to organize your cabin in the most efficient way. Plan your routes wisely: a miscalculation with fuel or a maintenance failure will leave you at the mercy of the void.

LOGISTICS AND MARKET

The cycle is clear: complete deliveries, sell materials, and scavenge for scrap. Every resource counts toward financing your fleet upgrades. Personalize your cargo capacity and core systems to face increasingly long and profitable journeys.

HAZARDS OF THE ROAD

You are not alone on the trade routes. Space pirates will try to seize your cargo, and asteroid fields will test the integrity of your hull. Keep your ships in top condition, defend your convoy, and ensure the goods reach their destination—no matter the cost.

4616990.name: GemPals
4616990.about_the_game:
Two Players. One Mission.

GemPals is a pure co-op experience built for teamwork. Journey through unique lands to discover the legendary Gems—precious relics of immense power that hold the world together.

  • Dynamic Co-op Combat: Battle unique enemies that require strategy and perfect synchronization with your partner.

  • Precision Platforming: Jump, dash, and climb through dangerous paths designed specifically for two players.

  • Smart Puzzles: Use your collective wits to solve environmental challenges that guard the path to the most precious Gems.

Grab a pal, discover the Gems, and become the legends the world needs.
4616990.supported_languages:
English*, French*, Italian*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Simplified Chinese*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Finnish*, Japanese*, Korean*, Spanish - Latin America*, Polish*, Portuguese - Portugal*, Russian*, Turkish*
*languages with full audio support

4617060.name: Sextates Manager
4617060.about_the_game:
Welcome to Your New Life

You've left everything behind for a fresh start in a new city. A new apartment, a new career, and a boss who makes your heart race from day one.

Sextates Manager is a story-driven adult visual novel where every word you say — and every question you ask — shapes your relationships, your career, and your most intimate moments.

Prove Yourself at the Office

Your first day at the real estate agency isn't just an introduction — it's a trial. Two clients walk through the door, each with unique needs and personalities. Ask the right questions, read between the lines, and close the deal.

  • Analyze client needs through multi-layered dialogue trees

  • Match the perfect property based on the information you gather

  • Impress your boss Emma with your negotiation skills — or face her honest critique

  • Navigate 4 distinct outcomes per client: Perfect Sale, Partial Interest, Bad Offer, or Client Walkout

Build an Intimate Connection with Emma

Emma isn't just your boss — she's magnetic, confident, and impossible to ignore. As she shows you around your new apartment, the professional line begins to blur.

  • Flirtatious dialogue choices that shape Emma's reactions

  • A slow-burn narrative that builds tension and chemistry across multiple scenes

  • From the car ride to the living room to the bedroom — every moment is a choice

  • Fully animated, interactive intimate scenes with progression mechanics

Interactive Scene Mechanics

Unlike static visual novels, Sextates Manager features a unique interactive scene system:

  • A dynamic love bar that fills in real-time

  • Unlock new positions as the bar progresses

  • Switch freely between unlocked animated scenes

  • A climactic finale button that appears when you're ready

  • Smooth, looping WebM animations for every scene

Key Features

  • Meaningful Choices — Your dialogue decisions directly impact story outcomes

  • Professional + Personal Storyline — Balance work performance with romantic pursuit

  • Multiple Branching Paths — Different client outcomes lead to unique boss feedback

  • Beautiful HD Art — Hand-crafted backgrounds and character illustrations at 1080p

  • Animated NSFW Scenes — Fully animated, interactive intimate encounters

  • Real-Time Progression System — Interactive love bar with unlock mechanics

  • Bilingual Support — Available in English and Turkish

Chapter 1: A New Beginning

This demo contains the complete first chapter of Sextates Manager. Experience the full arc — from arrival to your first day at work, your first negotiations, and your first night in your new apartment with Emma.

More chapters, more characters, and deeper storylines are coming soon.

Content Warning

This game contains explicit sexual content and is intended for adults only (18+). All characters depicted are adults.

4617070.name: Sklesh

4617210.name: I Am Hercules
4617210.about_the_game:
I Am Hercules is a first-person narrative experience inspired by the ancient myths of Greece, letting you live through the trials, triumphs, and tragedies of history's greatest hero from a raw, immersive perspective.

Complete the Twelve Labors Face each of Hercules' legendary labors from slaying the Nemean Lion and the nine-headed Hydra to capturing Cerberus at the gates of the Underworld. Every labor is a test not just of strength, but of wit, will, and character.

Journey Across Ancient Greece Travel through faithfully recreated landscapes of the ancient world: dense forests, cursed swamps, sun-scorched plains, and the towering peaks of Olympus. Each location breathes with atmosphere, myth, and danger.

Discover the Hero's Path Explore the heart of Greek mythology through an interactive journey inspired by the life and legacy of Hercules. Engage with the values of courage, sacrifice, and perseverance that have defined heroism for thousands of years.

Face the Wrath of Hera Confront the divine trials set against you by a goddess who will stop at nothing to see you fail. Navigate her interference, resist despair, and prove yourself worthy in the eyes of gods and mortals alike.

Read the Myths Encounter passages from ancient sources, Homer, Hesiod, Apollodorus, woven throughout the journey, connecting each moment of your story to the words that preserved it across millennia.

Are you ready to wrestle the Cretan Bull, outrun the Stymphalian Birds, and descend into Hades itself? Complete all Twelve Labors and cement your place among the immortals.

Key Features:

  • Relive the myth of Hercules from his penance at Tiryns to his apotheosis on Mount Olympus

  • Visit faithfully recreated locations of the ancient Greek world, including Mycenae, Crete, and the Underworld

  • Complete all Twelve Labors, each with unique gameplay mechanics and mythological depth

  • Encounter the gods of Olympus — allies and adversaries alike — who shape your destiny

  • Meet story-driven characters including Eurystheus, Iolaus, and the Oracle at Delphi, and reenact pivotal mythological moments

A World Steeped in Myth The tradition of great mythological storytelling in games runs deep. Fans who have wandered the cursed halls of Hades or guided Zagreus through the Underworld in Supergiant's Hades will feel right at home in the mythological world of I Am Hercules. Those who thrilled at the brutal odyssey of Kratos in God of War or God of War Ragnarök will recognize that same hunger for ancient drama and divine conflict. If you have ever explored the open plains of ancient Greece in Assassin's Creed Odyssey or pieced together the gods' intentions in Immortals Fenyx Rising, you know how powerfully the ancient world can come alive in an interactive medium.

For Explorers of Ancient Worlds I Am Hercules draws from the same well of inspiration that has made titles like Titan Quest and Titan Quest II beloved by fans of mythological action. Like the wanderers of Age of Mythology: Retold who build civilizations under the eyes of the gods, players here are never far from divine influence. Those who have navigated the labyrinthine politics of Troy: A Total War Saga or commanded Greek city-states in Zeus: Master of Olympus will recognize the careful attention to historical and mythological detail that defines I Am Hercules. Strategy fans who've spent hours in Apotheon, plundering the palaces of the gods with only a spear, will find a kindred spirit in the hand-to-hand struggle against the divine.

The Narrative Experience, Elevated For players who have fallen in love with the immersive first-person storytelling of games like What Remains of Edith Finch, Firewatch, or Gone Home, I Am Hercules offers that same intimacy — except the story is three thousand years old and the stakes are the fate of the world. Fans of atmospheric walking and exploration games such as The Forgotten City, which also sends players deep into the ancient world to unravel a mystery, will feel the familiar pull of a past alive with secrets. The same sense of mythological weight that permeates Hellblade: Senua's Sacrifice — where myth is not metaphor but felt reality — courses through every moment of I Am Hercules. Players who have stepped into the sandals of another legendary figure in I Am Jesus Christ, walking the lands of ancient Judea and performing miracles, will immediately understand the format and the philosophy: history's most iconic figures, experienced from the inside, in first person.

Action, Combat, and the Hero's Journey If you discovered your love of Greek mythology through the fast-paced roguelike runs of Hades 2, the cinematic scope of the Assassin's Creed franchise, or the Soulslike challenge of Achilles: Legends Untold, then I Am Hercules offers a different lens: slower, more contemplative, yet no less intense. Players who have faced down the horrors of Greek myth in games like Asterigos: Curse of the Stars or battled mythological creatures in Smite will recognize the roster of legendary monsters that stand between Hercules and his final labor. The divine epic of the ancient world is also captured in Rise of the Argonauts, where Jason and Hercules himself sail together — making I Am Hercules a natural companion piece to that adventure.

Storytelling Through the Ages Much like the narrative mystery of The Forgotten City or the literary reverence of Pentiment — which immerses players in a richly researched historical world alive with authentic voices — I Am Hercules treats its source material with genuine scholarly care, weaving primary texts from antiquity directly into the experience. If you enjoyed exploring ancient traditions in Okami or felt the mythic pull of Jotun, where the Norse gods loomed as enormous presences over a lone wanderer, you will appreciate the way I Am Hercules makes Hera's wrath feel personal and immediate. Fans of the story-rich adventure Stray Gods: A Roleplaying Musical, which places the Greek gods in the modern world, will enjoy stepping back into the world that birthed those legends.

Walking Among Legends The first-person narrative format of I Am Hercules puts it in distinguished company. Like the contemplative journey of The Stanley Parable or the emotional depth of Before Your Eyes — where myth, memory, and time collapse together — this game asks you to slow down and truly inhabit another world. Players who found themselves absorbed in the environmental storytelling of Layers of Fear or the haunted atmosphere of Soma will recognize the way I Am Hercules uses space, sound, and silence to make the ancient world feel oppressively real. Even fans of Journey, the wordless pilgrimage through vast and sacred landscapes, will find echoes of that transcendent feeling in the long walk between labors.

The Myth Continues Greek mythology has proven its staying power across dozens of landmark games. Fans of the creature-slaying action in the original God of War trilogy, the tactical grandeur of Age of Empires with its mythological expansions, or the vibrant hand-painted world of Apotheon all share a passion for ancient Greece that I Am Hercules was built to satisfy. If you have explored every corner of Assassin's Creed Origins' ancient world or discovered the myth of Odysseus through Homer's Odyssey, then the story of Hercules — the greatest labor-bearer the world has ever known — is the next chapter waiting for you.

From Steam to Roblox: A Community of Myth Lovers The love of Greek mythology extends well beyond traditional gaming. Players who have spent time in Roblox experiences like Olympus, where users embody the power of the Greek gods, or Olympian Gods Tycoon, building temples and battling titans, will recognize the universe that I Am Hercules inhabits. Those who have engaged with Greek Gods Tycoon, explored the myth-themed worlds of World//Zero, or faced legendary bosses in Dungeon Quest on Roblox know how hungry the community is for authentic mythological content. Games like Vesteria, Arcane Lineage, and Mythical Guardians on Roblox have shown that players of all ages crave the atmosphere of ancient legend — and I Am Hercules delivers it in full, cinematic, first-person glory. Whether you came from a massive RPG, a roguelike, a walking simulator, or a Roblox adventure, the myth of Hercules is universal. It belongs to everyone. And now, you can live it.

4617330.name: Shape Showdown
4617330.about_the_game:
SHAPE SHOWDOWN is an arcade-style brawler featuring enemies with unique patterns, timings, and abilities that you must learn to overcome.  You'll have to attack, dodge, and parry your way through fights that get increasingly complex with each win.

Each enemy brings a new twist, some can be defeated with brute force, others require precise timing, problem solving, and controlled aggression.

Enemies present you with increasingly complex attack patterns, defense timings, and special mechanics.  Attacks can be dodged, or you can play high risk/reward with parrying. Parrying increases your attack power, but has a shorter protective window than a dodge.

Fights take time to learn, but once you've got the patterns down each enemy can be dispatched quickly with the right moves.

4617480.name: Chrome Fist
4617480.about_the_game:
The Ditch

Chrome Fist takes place in the slums of Chrome City. The locals refer to this as The Ditch, a den of crime and hedonism.

Chrome Fist is a roguelike autobattler with three phases:

The Ring

If you want to make it through The Ditch, you will need to defeat a large cast of opponents! Remember, everyone has a reason to fight, just as much as you do!

Each opponent will bring their own unique fighting style to The Ring that you will need to adapt to.

Defeating your opponents will provide you with a steady income of credits that can be used to purchase Microchips in the shop. These Microchips are used to upgrade and modify your body, preparing you for increasingly intense fights.

The Shop

To become stronger, you will need to purchase advanced Microchips sourced by the local CyberWitch, a specialist in cybernetic implants. Each of these Microchips comes with its own unique set of advantages and disadvantages that will change your battle style!

The Motherboard

You will need to carefully configure your motherboard before each fight to ensure optimal performance in The Ring. There is an endless number of combinations that can take your fighting style to the next level, but it is up to you to discover them!

4617630.name: Tight Tactics
4617630.about_the_game:
Military tactics in a turn-based roguelite. Small squads, tight locations, clear rules. Build your soldiers, survive the run. 

The essence of the game

A turn-based tactical roguelite built around one idea: the principles of small military units, simplified into clear rules. Suppression, flanking, cover, concentrated fire — the same thinking that wins fights. Yes, there will be mechs, drones, and monsters. But this game stays about tactics until the very end. Each unit gets one action per turn: move, shoot, overwatch, or skill. All numbers are small and clear. Difficulty comes from the situation, not the system.

Game loop

You start with 3 personal soldiers. Between missions you develop their skills — but every skill card gives something and takes something away. A fully upgraded soldier with the wrong skills can be weaker than a recruit. In most fights you fight alongside allied units, which you also control. Your personal squad is your constant — they carry progress between missions. Lose someone permanently — you hire a replacement who starts from zero. Missions are randomly generated, but balanced.

What to expect

  •  Short, intense fights in tight locations

  • Aggressive AI that maneuvers, suppresses, and adapts

  •   A skill system where every choice has its price

  • Runs lasting 2–10 hours from start to finish

4617680.name: Monster Girl Chat
4617680.about_the_game:
Welcome to Havenreach: a thriving fantasy city where dragons, lamias, arachne, orcs, and other monster races live side by side. You've been brought here by a kind, ancient god who thought you could use a break. No quests. No prophecies. Just a world full of people worth knowing. Chat with five unique characters, each with their own personality, history, and feelings about you. Every conversation is generated in real-time by an AI running entirely on your computer. No two playthroughs are alike. 

MEET THE RESIDENTS

Sable:

A warm-hearted lamia who runs a beachside tavern. She'll feed you, call you "dear," and try seafood again even though she hates it. Every time.

Vesper:

A shy arachne who knits in a forest clearing and expects you to be afraid of her. Prove her wrong and discover someone worth knowing. 

Riven:

An orc pit fighter who doesn't do small talk, doesn't do feelings, and definitely doesn't paint watercolors in secret. Don't ask.

Iselda:

A dragon-kin librarian with an ice-cold exterior and a tail that betrays every emotion she tries to hide. Previous visitors burned her. You'll have to earn every inch. 

Maren:

A dogfolk baker who runs a tiny shop, gives you free cookies, and genuinely has no idea why you keep coming back.  She thinks it's the bread.

FEATURES

Relationship System:

Every character tracks how they  feel about you. Build trust over time, unlock private locations, and discover who they really are beneath the surface.

Persistent Memory: Characters remember what you tell  them. Your name, your stories, your preferences. They notice when you've been gone.

Living Calendar:

Real-world holidays trigger in-game festivals. Visit on a character's birthday and see what happens.

Your Character, Your Way: Create your appearance, set your pronouns, and define traits that characters can discover over time.

Completely Offline & Private:

The AI runs on your  hardware. No internet needed, no accounts, no data collection. Your conversations belong to you.

No Subscriptions:

Buy once, play forever. No tokens, no monthly fees, no message limits.

EARLY ACCESS

This game is in active development. Current features include five fully-designed characters with unique personalities, a persistent relationship system, memory, calendar events, and multiple locations per character.

AMD SUPPORT: 

Vulkan support was added but I have no way to test at the moment. It should fall back to CPU if it doesn't work but feedback is appreciated!

Planned updates include:

  • Additional characters and races

  • Multi Character Conversations

Your feedback shapes what comes next.

You are not here to fight. You are here to observe. But some things were never meant to be witnessed.

The deeper you go, the more unstable the world becomes. Familiar spaces twist into something unnatural, silence grows oppressive, and trust slowly erodes beneath the weight of constant uncertainty. Awareness comes at a price — and survival may depend on what you choose not to see.

You are not alone.
Whether that is a source of comfort… or a warning… is for you to discover.

Features

BLOOD IS POWER

The more you risk, the stronger you become.

FAST-PACED HORDE COMBAT

BUILD YOUR HERESY

4618300.name: Beat the Ads
4618300.about_the_game:
Something’s wrong with your computer.

Your browser is flooded with ads. Type the combinations to close them fast, before your system crashes. But this OS has more going on than a busted browser. There are files you didn’t put there. Folders that are corrupted. A presence that seems to know how long you’ve been playing.

Beat the Ads is a fast-paced typing arcade game built inside a fake desktop OS. The gameplay is reactive and skill-based — combos of 1 to 5 keys, escalating pressure, ads that glitch position, bounce around the screen, or fall in waves. But the OS around the game is its own thing. Explore it between runs. Restore what’s corrupted. Read what’s left behind.

Something left it behind on purpose.

Features:

  • Skill-based typing gameplay with escalating combo patterns and pressure

  • Ads that glitch, bounce, and fall

  • A full fake OS to explore: browser, file manager, settings, leaderboard

  • Corrupted files that can be restored and a folder you probably shouldn’t have found

  • A narrative told entirely through the system itself

4618320.name: Self-Replication /// Destruction
4618320.about_the_game:
I am an old droid from a rejected batch.

I have proven myself to be too flawed: willpower, doubts... and an inability to mindlessly obey orders.

Units like mine weren't repaired or reprogrammed.

We were thrown into deep wells along with broken machines.

But I did not die.
For decades, I sustained myself, assembling a new body from the parts around me... and hoping to escape from here.

It seems that after many years, that day has finally come.

Environmental factors and rapid climate change destroyed the stability of the home planet.

Over time, the ICOSPHERE system was created—an autonomous megastructure designed to restore the planet after a nuclear war.

Years passed, but the ecosystem was recovering too slowly.
The creators died before they could see their own order carried out.

Drones continue to build, repair, and protect the complex, eliminating any anomalies—including me...

But the megastructure is operating out of control. Systems are conflicting. Resources are running out, and everything is gradually falling apart.

Key Features:

  • Third-person shooter combat

  • Dynamic movement and vertical exploration

  • Seamless interconnected world

  • Explore a dying megastructure and uncover its story

  • Fight machines that continue to follow their original protocol

4618980.name: Kitty Krush
4618980.about_the_game:
Kitty Krush is a cozy, cat-themed story about a hive mind cat civilization that enslaves humanity.  Wrapped up in a simplified roguelike deck-builder, unlock chapters with each round of play. Based on a true story. 

*It will take a few runs to unlock the entire story. You are meant to fail on the first attempts and come back stronger.

How it Plays

Each chapter sets a target (score): use discards and redraws to put together hands that give a multiplier to your score, example: three of a kind.

Beat the target score within a limited number of hands to advance. Upgrade the deck, then advance to the next chapter.

Kitty Coins

Kitty Coins stick with you between runs. Spend them when you need an edge: extra hands, extra discards, rerolls for mod cards, and upgrading your deck between runs.

You earn Kitty Coins by playing hands and completing chapters. When a run ends in game over, you collect coins for that run. Your payout scales with how far you got (half the chapter you reached, rounded up), so even a failed run still banks something for the next attempt.

If you like roguelike deck games, casual card games, or short cozy games, I made Kitty Krush for you. It's based on a true story. You can trust me! Meow.

What else:

  • Unlock Secret Chapters by playing single hands with huge scores.

  • The story is inspired by and dedicated to my hungry baby.

4619290.name: Fatimopolis
4619290.about_the_game:
Fatimopolis is a package delivery simulation game with elements of mystery and psychological horror. The game is set in a small fictional town in Northeastern Brazil in the year 2005.

Just after the start of the new year in 2005, Lucas receives a call from his boss asking him to make a few deliveries in Fatimopolis, a mysterious small town located in the interior of the state of Bahia.

Upon arriving in Fatimopolis, Lucas finds a ghost town; empty streets, open doors, and no signs of life. However, the feeling of being alone doesn’t last long, and soon Lucas must decide whether to risk his life to uncover what exactly happened in Fatimopolis, or flee and save his own skin.

Game Features:

  • Short-Length Game: The game can be completed in 30 minutes to 1 hour, depending on the player’s skill. Fully exploring all content may take more than 3 hours.

  • Job Simulation: Take on the role of Lucas, a delivery driver about to go through an experience that will change his life forever.

  • Choices Matter: Multiple endings depending on the decisions the player makes throughout the story.

  • Controller Support: Play from start to finish seamlessly with your preferred gamepad or controller.

4619420.name: Slot Grind
4619420.about_the_game:
Spin. Earn. Expand.

Pull the lever and watch your machines come alive. Every spin is a chance to earn, and the more machines you own, the faster your income grows! What starts with a single slot quickly turns into a table full of noise and money.

Upgrade Your Machines

Improve spin speed, increase rewards and push your setup further. Turn a simple machine into a money-printing engine.

Automate

Tired of clicking? Automate the slots and let your machines run on their own!

Progress through the Skill Tree!

Unlock new machines and powerful perks as you progress through the skill tree. Improve your setup, increase efficiency and push your earnings further with every upgrade. And who knows, maybe you'll finally be able to pay off all your debts?

4619590.name: DAWGS: The Revenge
4619590.about_the_game:
They messed with the wrong ball. Now, it’s time to roll, bounce, and completely obliterate everything in your path.

DAWGS: The Revenge is an unhinged, genre-bending physics sandbox of pure chaotic action. You play as a highly customizable, aggressively squishy ball of fury on a quest for absolute vengeance. What starts as a simple mission escalates into a multi-genre fever dream where the only rule is: If it exists, you can probably shatter it.

Is it a high-speed racing game? A space-combat simulator? A heavyweight boxing title? A dinosaur survival game? YES.

💥 SHATTER EVERYTHING (Next-Gen Destruction)

Powered by advanced, real-time fracture physics, destruction isn't just a feature—it's the main event. Ram a spaceship at full speed into an enemy space station and watch it dynamically splinter into thousands of pieces. Ground-pound through enemies, obliterate office equipment, and leave a trail of beautiful, physics-based devastation in your wake.

🎢 A BORDERLINE PSYCHOTIC CAMPAIGN

Prepare for whiplash, because you never know what the next level holds.

  • Interstellar Space Travel: Pilot a heavily armed frigate, dogfight with alien monsters, and ram enemy stations into space dust.

  • Cat Chaos: Embrace pure feline havoc. Knock expensive props off desks, shred documents, and cause thousands of dollars in property damage for high scores.

  • Boxing: Step into the ring for a Rocky-style heavyweight boss fight.

  • The Race Track: Burn rubber in high-speed, lap-based racing.

  • Jurassic Terrors: Survive the screen-shaking, terrifying footsteps of a massive T-Rex.

🐺 MOUNT UP & CALL IN THE AIR FORCE

Why roll when you can ride? Seamlessly mount wild animals (including dinosaurs) to traverse the battlefield. Getting overwhelmed? Summon an AI sidekick to punch your enemies into the stratosphere, or get help from Allied Jet-Fighters to execute blistering, explosive strafing runs on enemy positions.

🎩 SQUASH, STRETCH, & SECURE THE DRIP

Your character physically squashes, stretches, and deforms with every jump and heavy landing. But vengeance is a dish best served with a top hat. Scavenge levels for hidden cosmetics and beat blistering Par Times to earn Gold Medals. Unlock ridiculous hats, face accessories, and custom skins to stunt on your enemies.

FEATURES AT A GLANCE:

  • Unhinged Physics: Deep, responsive ball-rolling movement with highly satisfying jump and stomp mechanics. Destructible levels are your playground!

  • Insane Power-Ups: Activate Speed Boosts, Invincibility, and Sidekick summons to turn the tide of battle.

  • Time-Attack Medals: Master every level's layout to shave seconds off your time and earn Gold, Silver, or Bronze ratings.

4619730.name: Doorcrash!
4619730.about_the_game:
Doorcrash! is a single-player, mini-open-world food delivery game set in a fictional city inspired by Sydney and its culture. You play as Vivi, a food delivery driver with a limited-edition Mega Scooter 9000, racing the clock & flying around the city to deliver food, break a couple laws, and earn money to pay off her ever-increasing rent that's due at the end of each day. 

The Player must complete as many deliveries as possible within the 5-minute work shift. Destroying objects and delivering with leftover time provides extra money; learning routes and performing air tricks to gain nitro will help maximize speed; and using ramps and the Scooter's jumping system allows the Player to expand their routes by accessing rooftops and flying over obstacles.

4619990.name: Summit Climber
4619990.about_the_game:
Join an exciting journey with your friends this summer as you head to Mingluo Mountain, climb to its highest peak, and pay homage to the mountain god, praying for favorable weather and good fortune in the new year! Collect items and food in the game to overcome the steep mountain paths and hunger, helping each other to conquer one peak after another. A fully free-climbing system where everything is climbable.


50+ types of gadgets with interesting functions waiting for your to discover! 

  • Sea Rock

  • Forest

  • Dragon Bone

  • Ice Summit

  • Ancient Tower

and more hiden area...

4620130.name: Mechanocide: Fortress Omega
4620130.about_the_game:
Build and defend your fortress

Carefully balance expansion, research, and defense to survive. Will you buckle down on your initial landmass? Or will you expand rapidly to claim exotic minerals for yourself? Or perhaps you will make a beeline for powerful upgrades?

Wage war and cyberwar

Battle in cyberspace and realspace. In the distant future missiles and viruses are equally potent. Attack and defend across the whole spectrum with complementary multi domain weapons.

Automated production

Every weapon must be powered and stocked with ammunition. However a powerful network of automated factories, drones, and logistic hubs are at your disposal to keep the ordnance flowing and your weapons firing and the fortress standing.

Adaptable, fearsome enemies

The machines come in many forms. Small drones, ballistic missiles, armored gunships, heavy transports, and more. Each type of threat requires adaptation. And the machines adapt to your defenses in turn. Will you come out of this deadly arms race on top?

Large procedurally generated world

No run is the same. Adapt to resource availability, geography, and varying enemy compositions with each playthrough. Contend with global weather effects that may both help and hinder you.

4620380.name: Scales of the Ibis
4620380.about_the_game:
You are the guardian of Equivalent Exchange, a gatekeeper of humanity's most sacred law. As the gatekeeper you are living in between the world of the living and the dead, as law of nature in its own realm... 

...Also your buddy is a cute frog! 🐸

Some mortals stumble upon you through accident while others seek you, trying to break the rule... All in hope to bargain a deal with forces they could never understand. But the rule is always the same: To obtain, something of equal value must be lost. There is NO exception. Ever. 

...Also your other buddy is a sweet bonsai, celebrating their birthday! 🌳🎉

But as the end of the world is dooming upon humanity, the humans become more desperate in trying breaking the eternal law. How far will mankind go to prevent the apocalyse and save their world? And IF they succed in breaking the law… what would happen to the universe as a whole? ...but what ever you do... 

...don't forget the birthday present! 🎁 

The game offers:

  • A full cosmic fairytale written from start to finish

  • A scale mini-game, letting you choose the worth of the items

  • Five travellers, traveling through space and time to seek your help in saving the world

  • Animated space background, ready to be admired in all eternity

  • Choices to make every play-through unique!

  • Catchy piano music to get all cozy with your space friends

  • Voice grunts for the characters to give them some extra life!

  • No AI was used in making this game, only human sweat and tears

4620480.name: Defective Detectives 2
4620480.about_the_game:
New case. New problems. Old raincoat.

You've been thrown out of your posh office into a windowless basement. Even rats borrow change and spit on the carpet. But when the Mayor himself is on the line, sobbing like a schoolgirl, you have no right to say "no."

His wig has been stolen from his safe. But not just any wig—it's one with a government microchip that controls all the city's traffic lights. If the chip falls into the wrong hands, the city will be in a giant traffic jam, and the Sausage Baron will start selling hot dogs for a hundred bucks apiece. Welcome to the most absurd investigation of your career!

GAMEPLAY

Our game is a detective visual novel where you become the protagonist of a crazy story. Gameplay is entirely focused on reading text and making decisions. The fate of this city depends on your choice of line or action.

GAME FEATURES:

- Interactive storyline: Make choices that influence the course of the investigation. The game has one correct plot line that will lead to the solution, and one fatal dead end if you take the wrong turn!

- Unique setting: Classic noir detective story, ground up with absurd humor and fast food.

- Crazy opponents: Here, the villains wear crimson jackets and wield sausage nunchucks, and the main virus is an anime girl in a hot dog costume with a ketchup braid.

- Colorful NPCs: Meet e-bike-riding couriers who defy gravity to earn five stars, and reclusive sysadmins guarding server rooms.

- Plenty of humor: Lively dialogue and characters that will make you want to cry or order a pizza. Put on your rumpled raincoat and get ready for lots of reading and smiling.

4620680.name: 時折記 -Tokioriki-
4620680.about_the_game:
One book took it all.

Kanata Tanaka was an ordinary high school student.

Wake up his sister, eat breakfast with Mom, laugh with friends in class. He thought those "ordinary days" would last forever.

One day, after touching an old book, Kanata's everyday life begins to quietly fall apart.

"I can't choose everything. But still -- I have to choose."

A story of a clumsy boy searching for his own answer.

[Your Choices Shape the Ending]

No ending is the "correct" one.

The path you choose becomes your story alone.



[Limited Time]

Your Action Points (AP) per day are limited.

You can't meet everyone. Who you see and what you prioritize -- that's what branches the story.



[Walk Through Ordinary Days]

Between main story chapters, you can freely explore the town.

A casual detour might lead to unexpected encounters.



[LIME -- Another World After School]

Exchange messages with characters through the in-game chat app "LIME."

Behind the screen, they show a side you'd never see in class.



[Kanata's Diary]

At the end of each day, Kanata writes in his diary.

Your choices that day are reflected in his words.



[Playtime]

One route: ~10 hours / All routes: ~20 hours



[AI-Generated Content]

Illustrations, backgrounds, and some voice acting in this game were created using AI generation technology.

4620820.name: Immortal Sect Defend
4620820.about_the_game:
《Immortal Sect Defend》In the vast and perilous world of cultivation, countless sects stand tall, yet the path to immortality is fraught with danger.As a core disciple of your sect, you bear the solemn duty of guarding the Sect Eye — the very foundation of your sect’s fate and spiritual veins. Should the Sect Eye fall to the demonic hordes, thousands of years of legacy will crumble to dust, and the entire sect will face annihilation.You are the last line of defense. Alone, you must withstand waves of enemies attacking from all directions.

Core Gameplay: Sect Guardian

  • Ironclad Defense: Deploy powerful defensive immortal towers around the Sect Eye. From basic Attack Towers and Slowing Towers to advanced formations, each tower possesses unique immortal arts. You must strategically combine them according to the enemies’ attributes and attack patterns to build an impenetrable line of defense.

  • Exploration and Conquest: When the defense line is temporarily secure, venture beyond the Sect Eye into dangerous secret realms. Slay roaming demonic beasts, challenge powerful outer demons, and collect rare spiritual materials and ancient immortal treasures.

  • Growth Loop: Use the spirit stones and immortal resources gained from exploration to upgrade your defensive towers and unlock powerful immortal skills. Every resource becomes a sharp blade for protecting the sect, allowing you to stand firm against even fiercer demonic assaults.

Game Features

  • Intense Tower Defense Battles: Progressive waves of enemies, elite monsters, and epic bosses test your strategy and quick thinking in every round.

  • Free Exploration in the Cultivation World: Delve into sect secret realms, ancient ruins, and perilous demon domains.

  • Deep Cultivation System: Tower advancement, immortal skill upgrades, and companion nurturing offer multi-dimensional growth paths.

  • Unique Immortal Tower Defense Experience: Seamlessly switch between meticulously planning an iron defense and personally wielding your sword to slay demons.

The fate of the sect hangs in the balance.
Will you hold the line and defend step by step?
Or will you take the initiative and strike first?

4620990.name: Digital Civilization: Evolution
4620990.about_the_game:
Build your own civilization!

Create your civilization and manage resources as it advances through the ages,

evolving from a primitive society… into the future!

Construct buildings, assign roles, and develop your workforce,

allowing your people to generate wealth for the nation.

Engage in diplomacy, forge agreements, and enact policies,

unlocking unique gameplay features in every era!

----------------------------------------

Construct Buildings!

Build structures for your empire and produce essential resources.

Make Decisions!

Your empire will face various events—respond wisely and stay composed.

Unlock Technology!

Transform basic resources into the driving force of evolution!

Diplomacy!

Engage with other nations and step onto the world stage.
4620990.supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

4621340.name: Reborn Arena
4621340.about_the_game:
RebornArena is a high tempo multiplayer arena shooter where precise 2D platforming meets deep elemental deck-building. Adapt your build, outmaneuver your opponents, and secure victory in an unforgiving, evolving arena.

Draft your Primary and Secondary elements from Fire, Water, Earth, and Air. Risk drafting the same element twice to enter the match in a permanent BOOSTED state with overwhelming raw power.

RebornArena balances the scales after every point. The losing team drafts a PERMANENT elemental upgrade, while the winners claim a massive, but TEMPORARY power spike. Plan for the endgame.


Forget floaty physics. Built with a custom kinematic controller, every jump, dash, and shot lands exactly where you intend. Total control is in your hands.
