4621800.name: Indebted Duke
4621800.about_the_game:
<Indebted Duke> is a deck-building game where you manage your estate by building your deck.

Step into the shoes of a medieval duke (deep in debt) managing his estate. You are the duke who has succeeded your incompetent older brother. You must revive your debt-ridden estate and pay off your debts.

Estate residents—such as knights, farmers, and cooks—will become your deck, providing you with their respective cards. Each resident has cards specific to their profession.

Farmers produce wheat, and cooks process the wheat into flour to bake bread and generate income.

If a cook uses all the flour in your hand at once to bake bread, you can earn a large sum of money.

Decks based on agriculture, mining, and commerce are ready. Manage your estate with your own unique deck!

A cook can change careers to become a baker. And if that baker marries a knight... their child will become a knight who bakes.

From knights who bake to guards who mine, the villagers grow stronger with each generation.

Every aspect of the villagers’ lives—from raising children to changing careers, marriage, and childbirth—becomes your business!

Bandits who target your fiefdom will attack periodically. You must defend against them alongside your villagers.

At first, weak groups will come, but as time passes, increasingly powerful groups will attack.

Train villagers such as guards, knights, and assassins to defeat them! Each uses their own unique skills in battle.

Assassins flank the enemy formation to strike from behind, while crossbowmen rapidly fire their crossbows.

<Indebted Duke> is designed as a card game where you build and manage your own fiefdom by turning your subjects into cards, with their recruitment and class changes forming the deck-building process. Additionally, the game offers a challenging experience through periodic battles and debt repayment mechanics.

- Strategic gameplay involving raising units with strong cards and skills to build your deck

- “Genetic Deck Building” where you marry units with strong cards and pass their traits down

- The tension of periodic battles and unpredictable random events

- A casual medieval fantasy world brought to life with charming pixel art

4621810.name: Livin' the Cream: Ice Cream Simulator
4621810.about_the_game:
Experience the smooth, satisfying flow of ice cream in real time.

Craft delicious ice cream from scratch using fresh ingredients, mix flavors, and create the perfect texture. Turn simple ingredients into tasty, satisfying ice cream delights.

Customize the ice cream based on each customer’s request with a variety of toppings and combinations. Serve exactly what they want and keep your customers happy.

Keep your shop clean while things get messy. A clean space keeps the experience sweet for everyone.

Turn an empty space into your dream ice cream shop. Customize your shop’s look and style to make it your own.

Buy fresh ingredients from local markets, stock your shop, and keep your business running.
4621810.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Indonesian, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish, Vietnamese, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support

4621990.name: Special Request: Chapter 2
4621990.about_the_game:
Special Request: Chapter 2 — The Alignment is where control stops being subtle and where everything begins to shift.
A major escalation in pressure, exposure, and adult content — all driven by Laura’s choices.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

ABOUT THE STORY

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Laura is no longer on the outside. Her public image is now linked to PAM. Her presence is visible, and her role is no longer something she can refuse without consequence.

The city begins to see her differently. Not just as a professional — but as something more. The attention lingers. And she feels it.

What once felt like protection begins to shift. Trust becomes uncertain. Expectations sharpen. Questions arise — and she has no answers.

Within PAM, the rules evolve. Responsibilities expand. Privileges disappear.

Performance is no longer measured by results.

It’s measured by alignment.

Meetings become evaluations. Opportunities become tests. And correction is no longer explained.

New environments open up — some public, some carefully hidden. Nothing is random.

Outside PAM, things start to fall apart.

Laura is not forced to stay. But leaving is no longer simple.

Every decision carries weight — not as a system, but as a consequence. Through the Pure / Corrupt psychological framework, her choices shape how she interprets pressure, trust, and her own behaviour.

The Corrupt path now branches further: Independence — or submission.

Different paths reveal different truths. Different responses lead to different forms of control.

Chapter 2 expands the world, deepens the systems of influence, and introduces the structures that will define everything that follows.

Nothing is fully explained.

But everything is already in motion — with or without her.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

FEATURES

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

• Second chapter of a four-part psychological thriller visual novel

• Significantly expanded content — more scenes, more choices, more consequences

• Thousands of high-quality images and animated sequences

• Deeper psychological systems shaping perception, trust, and behaviour

• Corrupt path expands into Independent and Submissive trajectories

• Multiple overlapping storylines influenced by player decisions

• New environments — from public spaces to controlled internal PAM locations

• Cinematic 2D visuals with a realistic, atmospheric presentation

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

MATURE CONTENT DESCRIPTION

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

This visual novel contains mature themes, including erotic tension, psychological pressure, adult relationships, and explicit sexual content.

Content is context-driven and integrated into the narrative, focusing on atmosphere, implication, and character psychology rather than standalone scenes.

All characters are 18 or older.

4622170.name: Date For Dead
4622170.about_the_game:
Swipe right. Fall in love. Don’t ask what it costs.

What if moving on wasn’t that simple?

Til Death Dates Us Part is a narrative-driven dating simulator set in a modern world where monsters and humans coexist.

You play as Victoria Frankenstein, a brilliant scientist navigating life after a devastating loss.
Trying to move forward, she turns to a dating app—meeting strangers, forming connections, and chasing something that feels just out of reach.

A Different Kind of Dating Sim

Swipe through profiles.

Chat, flirt, and go on dates with a diverse cast:

Get to know a cast of unique characters:

  • A bold and seductive vampire filmmaker

  • A quiet but intense minotaur

  • A painfully awkward zombie

  • A narcissistic ancient god

  • And others who might actually care about you

Every choice matters. Every interaction shapes your relationship.

But the truth unfolds slowly…

Choices That Shape More Than Relationships

  • Build attraction through dialogue and actions

  • Discover hidden sides of each character

  • Decide how far you're willing to go

  • Navigate moments that feel increasingly… complicated

The better things go, the harder they become to define.

Something Beneath the Surface

Not everything is what it seems.

Some moments repeat in strange ways.
Some connections feel heavier than they should.
Some silences say too much.

And sometimes… it feels like you’re holding on to something that doesn’t want to stay.

Tone

A blend of:

  • Dark romantic comedy

  • Emotional storytelling

  • Philosophical undertones

  • Character-driven narrative

Funny, uncomfortable, intimate—and ultimately tragic.

4622830.name: Darkstone Bay
4622830.about_the_game:
A shipwreck has been hidden on this island for 300 years. Will you be the one to find it?

Story

In the spring of 1721, the Spanish galleon El Diablo Dormido - The Sleeping Devil, vanished from all imperial records without explanation. No wreckage was ever found. No survivors ever surfaced. For three centuries historians assumed the ship was lost to a storm somewhere in the Atlantic. They were wrong. It never left the island. And neither did its secrets.

About the game

Darkstone Bay is a first person 3d escape room inspired puzzle adventure. Solve ancient puzzles, decode forgotten symbols, find hidden objects and explore a mysterious uncharted island as you uncover the secrets of a galleon that vanished in 1721.

Cross the island, from sandy beaches to ancient caves, old mines and dense jungle. Every location has hidden objects and puzzles to discover on the way. Will you find the galleon and discover what was hidden?

Features

  • Solve puzzles inspired by escape rooms

  • Explore beautiful environments

  • Decode ancient symbols and uncover hidden objects

  • Immersive original soundtrack and effects to pull you into the adventure

Controls:

Movement: WASD + Mouse

Rotate: R

Run: SHIFT

Menu: ESC or M

4623020.name: 吉他制造专家 Guitar Luthier
4623020.about_the_game:
In this 100% hand-drawn pixel art guitar-building simulation game, you start as an ordinary luthier and forge your own legendary guitar brand from scratch.

The game features an extremely free customization system: from the body, neck, truss rod, electronics, pickups, pickup rings, and pickup configurations, to finishes, hardware, color schemes, and nearly every component—you can freely combine them all to craft a one-of-a-kind electric guitar.

You will run your own luthier workshop:

  • Play the electric guitar in the game world with a real-world electric guitar and hear the impact of your accessories on the tone of an electric guitar.

  • Accept orders from a variety of clients

  • Interpret their real needs and aesthetic preferences from their descriptions

  • Keep costs reasonable for clients with limited budgets

  • Every combination of wood, pickups, strings, frets, and more shapes the guitar’s tonal character

  • Continuously refine setups to precisely match the tone and playability clients desire

Game controls are simple and intuitive: just click and design to easily assemble parts, letting you focus on creation without tedious, repetitive tasks.

The game includes a professional rating system that analyzes your guitar’s characteristics across multiple dimensions, including playability, sustain, and frequency response. This helps you scientifically match client needs and improve the quality of your work.

As your workshop grows, you will be able to:

  • Establish your own guitar brand

  • Sign brand ambassadors

  • Build custom high-end guitars for famous musicians

  • Develop new luthier techniques and unlock more parts and craftsmanship

  • Gradually turn your brand into the top choice for musicians worldwide

After the full release, we will continue to deliver regular updates, including brand-new guitar hardware, body shapes and building techniques, ensuring endless new possibilities for your creations.

From a small workshop to a world-renowned guitar brand — your journey as a luthier begins here.
4623020.supported_languages:
English*, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*
*languages with full audio support

4623090.name: Tiny Catcher
4623090.about_the_game:
Tiny Catcher is a fishing game where you can keep it open in a floating window mode, so you can place it wherever you want while doing other things on your PC. The idea is to have something cozy running in the background while you work, study, or just relax.

The game will have an avatar shop customization where you can spend the points you get fishing, and its own Fishpedia to keep track of not only the fish you got, but also the ones that gave you more points! Every fish has a random point calculation based on size and weight!

Fish chance

  • Common: 60%

  • Uncommon: 25%

  • Rare: 10%

  • Epic: 4%

  • Legendary: 1%
4623090.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil

4623280.name: Bonfire Buddies
4623280.about_the_game:
Bonfire Buddies is an online co-op survival game where you and your friends must keep the fire alive through the night.

Venture into the darkness to gather wood, fend off enemies, and make it back before the fire burns out. The farther you go, the greater the risk — and the reward.

Work together, manage your resources, and survive as long as you can.

  • Online Co-op gameplay — survive the night with friends

  • Simple, replayable loop — gather, return, repeat

  • Risk vs reward exploration — go farther for better resources

  • Dynamic survival pressure — the fire is always burning down

  • Atmospheric environment — dark, tense, and unpredictable

Bonfire Buddies is currently in Early Access.

The core multiplayer survival experience is fully playable, and we’re actively working on expanding the game with new content, enemies, and mechanics.

Your feedback will help shape the future of the game.

4623550.name: The Path of Kana
4623550.about_the_game:
A dying world. A sacred flame. A young woman who must carry both.

The Celestial Kingdom has fallen. Corrupted by the grief of High Priest Lucian Noctis, the veil between the living and spirit realms has been torn. Darkness spreads with every passing hour. Chosen by the ancient spirit Ignifae, Kana must journey across a shattered world, reassemble the Astralis Staff, and purify seven black lanterns that hold the tormented souls of the fallen Celestial Kingdom.


Explore a Hand-Crafted World: Venture through sacred temples, each dungeon a distinct experience with its own atmosphere, puzzles, and secrets waiting to be uncovered.


Methodical, Rewarding Combat:
Master a deep item progression system where preparation and timing matter. Use items to battle and also solve puzzles, every new ability unlocks new puzzle solving abilities.

A Narrative with heart: Uncover a story told through exploration and discovery. The world remembers its history, and paying attention rewards you.


Built-In Randomizer for Endless Replayability: A fully integrated randomizer mode shuffles item placement using sphere-based progression logic, ensuring every run is completable, surprising, and shareable. Seed sharing, community leaderboards, and speedrun infrastructure are built in from the ground up.


The Path of Kana is a love letter to the golden age of top-down adventure games. Built for the players who grew up with them, and the ones discovering them for the first time.

4623620.name: Postin Paradise
4623620.about_the_game:
Welcome to Postin Paradise, a unique post office incremental game where you'll experience the satisfying routine of processing envelopes, managing upgrades, and discovering mysterious events in a cozy factory setting.

Your daily routine involves sorting envelopes, stamping them with precision, and watching your productivity grow. But, you know, this isn't just any ordinary postal office.

Core Gameplay Mechanics

  • Envelope Processing: Sort and stamp envelopes as they come down the conveyor belt with realistic physics-based interactions

  • Upgrade System: Invest your earnings in permanent upgrades to improve your efficiency, unlock new abilities, and expand your postal empire

  • Day/Night Cycle: Experience dynamic time progression with unique events and atmosphere changes between day and night

  • Coin Collection: Gather coins from processed envelopes to fund your upgrades and unlock new features

Progressive Enhancement

Start with basic tools and gradually unlock advanced machinery and abilities. From automatic stamping systems to special power-ups, your postal office evolves from a simple workspace to a high-tech operation. The upgrade system offers meaningful choices that affect your gameplay style.

Atmospheric Experience

Enjoy your favourite music through the vinyl music system, and the satisfying sound effects that enhance the postal worker experience. The game's visual style combines low-poly aesthetics with lighting and cartoon style to create a cozy atmosphere.

Features

  • Satisfying Core Loop: Process envelopes with physics-based interactions that feel responsive and rewarding

  • Upgrade System: Multiple upgrade paths with permanent progression

4623890.name: Boom Rush: Desert OPS
4623890.about_the_game:
Your spacecraft has crash-landed deep in the desert. Immediately after, Space Base Nyra locates your position and detects heavy enemy activity in the area. You are not alone.

With Nyra’s constant radio guidance, you must fight through escalating enemy waves. Eliminate drones, aerial vehicles, humanoid units, and finally breach the ancient fortress to neutralize the energy core. Survive the waves, destroy the defense turrets, and return home through the portal Nyra opens for you.

Radio Communications (Full Set)

Nyra (Space Base – Professional, calm, and serious tone):

  • “Pilot, we are aware of the crash. High aerial activity detected in your sector. Drones and reconnaissance craft are approaching to locate you. Stay alert.”

  • “Second wave incoming. They’re sending a large number of aerial vehicles. Connection is weakening… Be careful. I’ll re-establish contact soon.”

  • “We’ve detected a fast-approaching humanoid entity heading straight toward you. Take it out immediately. … Roger that. Intense heat signatures detected at 12, 3, and 9 o’clock. Get through them. Aerial activity is still high — stay focused.”

  • “The fortress gates have opened. There’s a massive energy signature inside. Destroy the defense turrets and clear the area. We’ll open a portal for you. Good luck, Pilot.”

  • “Excellent work, Pilot. All threats neutralized. You can come home now. Portal is ready.”

Player (You – Confident, battle-hardened tone):

  • “This is child’s play. I don’t need support.”

  • “What the hell are these…? Nyra, I need backup!”

Key Features:

  • Wave-based escalating action combat

  • Real-time radio storytelling with Nyra

  • Dynamic desert FPS battles

  • Increasing difficulty across stages

  • Short, intense, and replayable missions

4624460.name: Puzzle ATLAS
4624460.about_the_game:
A handcrafted puzzle game built around one idea: every challenge should feel different.

Work through 60 handcrafted puzzles spread across 10 themed rooms, each containing 6 unique challenges. Every puzzle brings its own mechanic, presentation, and way of thinking, from logic and observation to sequencing, routing, timing, and deduction.

Discover new systems and push through an increasingly varied set of brain-teasing trials. This is a game about learning, adapting, and getting that satisfying moment where everything finally clicks.

4624470.name: Pengzle:Arctic Arcane
4624470.about_the_game:
"THINK FAST. BUILD THE FORMULA. COMPLETE THE MAGIC BY YOURSELF."

Pengzle is a real-time puzzle action adventure about reading the battlefield, weaving mana, and shaping magic in the middle of combat.

Mana keeps flowing, enemies never stop pressing forward, and every fight asks you to decide what formula to finish first, when to cast, and whether to play it safe or hold out for something bigger. Pengzle feels its best when sharp judgment and quick execution come together in the same moment.

Here, magic is not something you simply trigger. It is something you build.

The type and order of mana determine what spell takes shape, and even the same battle can unfold differently depending on the combination you choose. You can reach for a quick, reliable answer, or stack formulas together for a bigger swing that changes everything. When a spell you built lands at exactly the right moment, the payoff feels immediate, tactile, and deeply satisfying.

At the heart of the adventure is Pengzle, a small penguin mage.

Travel through an original polar fantasy world of snowfields, frozen seas, magical animalfolk, and quiet wonder. With its unusual animal hero and wintry fantasy setting, Pengzle offers a kind of adventure that feels both distinctive and warmly memorable.

Pengzle:Arctic Arcane

1. WEAVE FORMULAS IN REAL TIME

  • Arrange mana in your Casting Room to shape spell formulas.

  • Different types and sequences of mana create different kinds of magic.

  • Every combination is a choice, and every choice can shift the battle.

2. WHERE JUDGMENT MEETS EXECUTION

  • Read the flow of combat and choose the formula that fits the moment.

  • Battles unfold in real time, so every decision must be carried through without hesitation.

  • The rhythm of combat comes alive when careful planning meets quick hands.

3. BIGGER RISKS, BIGGER PAYOFFS

  • Use a safe spell to survive the moment, or hold out for a combination that changes the tide.

  • Overlapping formulas let you unleash powerful multi-casts in a single sequence.

  • The more ambitious your play, the greater the reward—and the greater the danger.

4. A PENGUIN MAGE IN A POLAR FANTASY

  • Play as a small penguin mage moving forward in his own way.

  • Explore a world of snow, ice, magic, and animal civilizations.

  • Step into a fantasy adventure filled with warmth, mystery, and crystalline beauty.

4625240.name: 长安首富模拟器
4625240.about_the_game:
This is an ancient Chinese open-world business simulation game where you start from nothing and gradually build your own commercial empire.

Travel freely between different towns, buy goods at low prices, sell them for profit, and accumulate wealth through trade. As your fortune grows, you can purchase land, invest in mining industries, and build stable businesses with long-term income. You can also open a private bank to manage loans and financial services, or pursue an official career to gain more resources and opportunities.

The game also features rich life progression systems, including building your own residence, meeting various characters, and managing family life. Trade, industrial investment, financial management, and career progression are all interconnected, allowing you to freely shape your own path from an ordinary citizen to a legendary figure of wealth and influence.

4625480.name: Emoji Catcher
4625480.about_the_game:
Catch the falling emoji icons!

Story Mode: Features 110 fixed levels, with additional randomly generated levels to challenge you.

Endless Mode: A score-based survival mode! Different items grant different points. Catch bombs or devils while your shield is active, and you'll earn 10 points each!

4625760.name: 山上那个猴儿
4625760.about_the_game: A Western Journey-themed idle/clicker game with simple controls, rich content, and long-term progression. You play as a young monkey from the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit, who sets out to explore the Western Journey world a hundred years after the legendary pilgrimage. Battle various demons and monsters, enhance your cultivation realm, forge powerful armor and weapons, learn divine abilities and secret arts, collect magical artifacts and treasures, and refine miraculous elixirs.

4625990.name: 字獄 JIGOKU
4625990.about_the_game:
"Enemies, weapons, maps, even yourself — everything is made of words."

― Dengeki Online

"A unique action roguelite set in a world built entirely from words."

― gamebiz

WORDS WAGE WAR.

In 字獄 JIGOKU, the entire world is built from words. Enemies are words. Weapons are words. You are a word. Survive endless hordes of living characters across five stages — Wild, Mountain, Sea, Dark, and Heaven.

TAKE. RISE.

Begin as 人 (Human) and evolve through battle — 拳 (Brawler), 侍 (Samurai), 鬼 (Oni), and finally 神 (God). Each evolution transforms your stats, attacks, and abilities. Choose elemental skills — Fire, Ice, Wind, Lightning, and more — to build your arsenal against ever-growing swarms.

Features

  • A one-of-a-kind action game built entirely from Japanese characters

  • Evolution system: 人 → 拳 → 侍 → 鬼 → 神

  • Mix and match elemental skills to create your build

  • Five distinct stages, each with unique biomes and bosses

  • Loop structure with escalating challenge

4627180.name: Null Ascent: Stellar
4627180.about_the_game:
Shapes drift. Your cursor destroys. Energy runs out. Spend everything you earned and go again

Three upgrade trees. Money buys power. Coloured resources change how you play.

Ascend. Lose your upgrades. Keep your power. Watch Zone 1 crumble beneath you

Null Ascent: Stellar

is a short-run incremental game built around one simple loop: hover, destroy, upgrade, ascend.

Geometric shapes drift across the screen. Your cursor damages anything it touches. Energy drains. When it's gone, the run ends — and everything you earned comes with you.

Back in the Hub, you spend. Standard upgrades make you stronger. Synthesis upgrades make you play differently. Prestige upgrades make your next run feel like a different game entirely.

Then you go again.

A hub worth coming back to

Three upgrade trees. Money buys power. Coloured resources buy personality. Stellar Dust buys permanence. Every run feeds the hub. The hub is where your identity lives.

Runs that grow with you

Start at 10 seconds. End at several minutes. Run length isn't a setting — it's a reflection of how far you've come.

Prestige is a gear shift, not a reset

When you ascend, you lose your money and upgrades. You keep your Stellar Dust and your permanent bonuses. Zone 1 becomes trivial. New enemies appear. The game shifts beneath you.

Enemies with personality Every geometric shape has a behaviour. Circles are fast. Diamonds split. Hexagons shield. Post-prestige, they mutate — familiar shapes, new rules.

The run is the engine. The hub is the game.

4627220.name: Untold Memories: Grandma's House
4627220.about_the_game:
Rick is left in his grandmother’s care while his parents are away on a business trip. What should have been an ordinary week soon turns into a nightmare. From the moment he enters the house, Rick feels that something is deeply wrong. His grandmother acts strangely, the house feels unnatural, and every night he is awakened by disturbing sounds echoing through the halls.

As the days pass, paranormal events grow more intense, and Rick begins to realize that the house is hiding something far more sinister than he imagined. His grandmother repeats only one warning:

Never go down to the basement.

FEATURES

  • One Week of Fear: Step into Rick’s shoes as he is forced to spend an entire week in his grandmother’s house, where each passing day brings stranger behavior, darker nights, and growing terror.

  • Psychological Horror: Experience a story-driven nightmare filled with disturbing sounds, paranormal events, and an oppressive atmosphere that keeps you questioning what is real.

  • Exploration & Mystery: Search through a deeply unsettling house, uncover hidden clues, and slowly piece together the terrifying truth behind your grandmother and her home.

  • Nightly Disturbances: Every night, Rick is awakened by eerie noises echoing through the house. What begins as fear soon turns into a desperate need to uncover what is happening.

  • A Forbidden Basement: Your grandmother gives only one warning: never go down to the basement. The deeper you dig into the house’s secrets, the closer you get to the horrifying truth hidden below.

  • Atmospheric Storytelling: Immerse yourself in a tense and cinematic horror experience built around isolation, family fear, and the dread of living under the same roof as something deeply wrong.

4628110.name: Sellin' Snake Oil
4628110.about_the_game:
You are a traveling merchant in the Old West with one goal: make enough money to buy your ranch. To get there you will need to trade smart, prepare for the road ahead, and make decisions that can either grow your wallet or empty it.

Sellin' Snake Oil is a roguelike trading game where you buy and sell goods across randomly generated towns in runs that last around 30 to 45 minutes. Every run starts fresh with a new map, new town economies, and new challenges to navigate.

Trading is the core of the game but it is not as simple as just buying cheap and selling high. Town economies are driven by what they produce and what they need, and world events can shift prices at any moment. You also have to think ahead. Do you spend everything on goods to maximize profit, or keep some money in your pocket in case things go wrong on the road?

The trail between towns is just as important as the trading itself. You might run into wolves and have to decide how to handle them based on what you are carrying. A wounded man on the ground could be genuinely in need of help, or he could be setting you up. Traveling merchants you meet on the road are your main source of upgrades, so those encounters are worth paying attention to.

Speaking of upgrades, they change how your runs play out in a big way. Expanding your storage lets you carry and sell more goods which is the most straightforward way to grow. But later upgrades start asking you to make real tradeoffs. You can cut your travel time in half but only carry half the goods. You can increase what you sell everything for, but bandits will come after you more often. These decisions shape the kind of run you are going for.

Sellin Snake Oil sits in a part of the western genre that does not get much attention. There is no shooting your way to victory here. It is about the everyday life of someone trying to make their fortune in the wild west through wit, preparation, and knowing when to take a risk.

The ranch is waiting. Start Sellin'.

4630420.name: Zetrya: Dungeon Dive
4630420.about_the_game:
Zetrya: Dungeon Dive is a game where a group of adventurers work their way through a dungeon with the goal of clearing it. Finding new threats along the way.

[Gameplay]

  • A 2D action RPG with an overhead view.

  • An exploration mode to traverse the map, encountering or avoiding enemies.

  • A turn based side view made where all the combat occurs.

4631110.name: Trashy Cashy
4631110.about_the_game:
Trashy Cashy is an incremental game where you make money from trash. Keep optimizing how you find and sell it to become fabulously rich. Along the way, decide what to do about the one who has been with you from the very beginning.

Finding packages of trash, pulling junk out of them, sorting it, and selling it to customers - what could possibly be better than that? Only doing it more efficiently!

This is an incremental game where the main goal is to watch the numbers get bigger, and losing is impossible. Every action improves something - whether it’s the chance of finding especially valuable trash, the power of the weapon you use to open packages, or the efficiency of your auto-helper: Stabby-9000, a small bot that helps slice packages open with its blades.

Progress through the skill tree, and very soon you’ll realize that the level of trash you’re dealing with has reached a whole new scale. And you’re collecting it like a true professional. Before you know it, your bank account will be showing off a very respectable sum!

As you play, you’ll discover all kinds of trash and all kinds of customers, each with their own individual requests... And you’ll also decide where friendship stands in all of this.

In the full version of the game, after completing the main playthrough, the Prestige system will unlock, allowing you to play again and again while buying powerful new upgrades.

Enjoy the game!

4631860.name: The HOUSE
4631860.about_the_game:
In every casino game, the house always wins. In THE HOUSE, you are the casino.

A New York mafia family runs the most crooked casino in Vegas — and you're their engineer. The feds are watching. The bosses are impatient. The only way to keep everyone happy is to make the machines pay out exactly as much as you need. No luck required. Just skill, strategy, and a willingness to bend every rule in the book.

Build Your Machine THE HOUSE is a roguelite where you design and engineer your own slot machines from the ground up. Add reels, sculpt your symbol roster, and tune the odds until every spin feels less like gambling and more like inevitability. Every run starts simple — and ends in gloriously cascading payouts that print money faster than the mob can count it.

Symbols, Synergies, and Chaos Your reels are populated with symbols, and no two behave the same way. Fruits chain into multipliers. Sevens stack bonuses. Wilds fill the gaps. Learning how symbols interact is the core skill of the game — but not everything on your reels is friendly. Chaos symbols corrupt your machine in unpredictable ways, eating payouts, cloning symbols, and obscuring your reels. The right build doesn't just survive chaos — it exploits it.

Back-Room Components Between rounds, install components that change how your machine fundamentally operates. Amplify specific symbols, warp payout calculations, and create synergies that stack in ways the casino inspectors definitely didn't approve. With dozens of components available, no two runs ever play the same way.

A Roguelite Built Around Escalation Each run is a gauntlet of escalating targets, elite encounters, and a climactic boss fight designed to stress-test everything you've built. Persistent progression between runs unlocks new symbols, components, and machines — the more you play, the deeper it gets.

Key Features

  • Roguelite slot machine engineering — you build the machine, not just play it

  • Deep symbol roster with unique behaviors and synergies

  • Chaos symbol system that corrupts your reels and rewards mastery

  • Dozens of back-room components with cascading combo potential

  • Elite encounters and a climactic boss fight

Persistent progression that expands your options across runs

*11 out of 10 gambler recommend this game
